jobs.title: Scientist Production (GRADE A-C)
jobs.salary_text: R791 604 – R1 189 767 per annum, (OSD), (all-inclusive package structured in accordance with the OSD rules)
jobs.summary: Develop and implement scientific analysis methodologies at the Department of Agriculture in Stellenbosch, requiring a BSc Honours in Chemistry and SACNASP registration.
jobs.requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and BSc Honours (Chemistry). Compulsory registration with South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as a Professional Natural Scientist. Job Related Work Experience: Three (3) years post-qualification experience. Job Related Knowledge: Applicants must have knowledge of Public Service and Departmental prescripts/policies. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Agricultural Products Standard Act 119 of 1990. Liquor Product Act 60 of 1989. Job Related Skills: Programme & project management. Scientific methodologies. Research & development. Knowledge of legal compliance. Data analysis. Computer-aided scientific applications. Technical report writing. Creating a high-performance culture. Professional judgment. Presentation skills. Mentoring. Decision making. Team leadership. Analytical skills. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication. Networking. Computer literacy. People management. Planning and organizing. Conflict management. Change management. Problem solving and analysis. Extended working hours. Handling of hazardous chemicals. A valid drivers’ license.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement methodologies, systems and procedures. Identify (in consultation with customers) needs for new methods of analysis. Identify gaps and develop appropriate interventions. Provide scientific advice and support. Develop working relations with client base. Provide scientific data, information and advice as required. Review scientific publications. Perform scientific analysis and regulatory functions. Conduct analysis of scientific data. Gather and interpret data, evaluate results and disseminate information. Formulate proposals and compile reports. Develop and customise scientific techniques. Coordinate and conduct the routine testing of agricultural food. Research and Development. Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Conduct basic and applied research. Research/literature studies to improve expertise. Publish and present research findings. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on science-related matters. Human Capital and Development. Mentor, train and develop staff in order to promote skills/knowledge transfer. Supervise scientific work and processes. Manage the performance and development of staff.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Xoliswa Tlali Tel No: (021) 809 1643
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email SPrecruit64@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: African, Coloured Males and persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates, for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie (GRAAD A-C)
af.summary: Ontwerp en implementeer wetenskaplike ontledingsmetodologieë by die Department of Agriculture in Stellenbosch, wat 'n BSc Honneurs in Chemie en SACNASP-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en BSc Honneurs (Chemie). Verpligte registrasie by die South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as 'n Professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Werksverwante werkservaring: Drie (3) jaar ervaring na kwalifikasie. Werksverwante kennis: Aansoekers moet kennis hê van Openbare Diens- en Departementele voorskrifte/beleide. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Agricultural Products Standard Act 119 of 1990. Liquor Product Act 60 of 1989. Werksverwante vaardighede: Program- en projektebestuur. Wetenskaplike metodologieë. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Kennis van regsvergunning. Data-ontleding. Rekenaargesteunde wetenskaplike toepassings. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Professionele oordeel. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Mentorskap. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Analitiese vaardighede. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntefokus en toespreeklikheid. Kommunikasie. Netwerk bou. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Personeelbestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Verlengde werksure. Hantering van gevaarlike chemikalieë. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer metodologieë, stelsels en prosedures. Identifiseer (in oorleg met kliënte) behoeftes vir nuwe ontledingsmetodes. Identifiseer gapings en ontwikkel toepaslike ingrypings. Verskaf wetenskaplike advies en ondersteuning. Bou werksverhoudings met kliëntebasis. Verskaf wetenskaplike data, inligting en advies soos benodig. Hersien wetenskaplike publikasies. Voer wetenskaplike ontleding en regulatoriese funksies uit. Voer ontleding van wetenskaplike data uit. Versamel en interpreteer data, evalueer resultate en versprei inligting. Formuleer voorstelle en stel verslae op. Ontwikkel en pas wetenskaplike tegnieke aan. Koördineer en voer die roetine toetsing van landbou-voedsel uit. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Voer basiese en toegepaste navorsing uit. Navorsings-/literatuurstudies om kundigheid te verbeter. Publiseer en bied navorsingsbevindings aan. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor wetenskapverwante aangeleenthede. Menslike kapitaal en ontwikkeling. Mentor, train en ontwikkel personeel om vaardigheids/kennisoordrag te bevorder. Hou toesig oor wetenskaplike werk en prosesse. Bestuur die prestasie en ontwikkeling van personeel.

zu.title: Umsizi weSayensi (GRADE A-C)
zu.summary: Lungeza futhi usebenzise izindlela zokuqamba okusha kohluko lwezibalulekile kwi-Department of Agriculture eStellenbosch, kudingeka ibe ne-BSc Honours Chemistry kanye nokubhaliswa kwi-SACNASP.
zu.requirements: Isicelo kumelwe sibe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-BSc Honours (Chemistry). Ukubhaliswa ngokumelene kwi-South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengomuntu wesayensi ngokwemisebenzi kudingeka. Ukuqashelwa kwezinsimbi zokuhleleka: Isikhathi esithathu (3) iminyaka yokusebenza ngemva kokuthola izifundo ezisetshenziswayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Abantu abafaka izicelo kumelwe babe nolwazi ngemithetho esemthethweni yomphakathi nezinhlelo zomnyango. I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-Agricultural Products Standard Act 119 of 1990. I-Liquor Product Act 60 of 1989. Izindlela ezingezansi ngokwemisebenzi: Ukuphatha izinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi. Izindlela zekhono lezibalulekile. Ukuqashelwa kokuthuthukiswa kanye nokuthuthukiswa kolwazi. Ulwazi ngemithetho esemthethweni. Ukuphepha kolwazi. Izindlela zokuqasha izindlu ezingezansi. Ukubhala ngokwemisebenzi. Ukubumba isiko elenza abantu baphume kahle. Isinqumo sezwi. Izindlela zokuzethula. Ukubaka. Ukwenza isinqumo. Ukuphatha iqembu. Izindlela zokuhlola. Ukubumba okusha. Ukuphatha imali. Ukugxila kokuqashelwa komthengi kanye nokuphendula. Ukwaziswa. Ukuxhumana nabantu. Ukuzinza ekwaziseni ngekhal zasemakhompuyutha. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuhlela kanye nokuqashwa. Ukuphatha imizwa eshaywana. Ukuphatha ushintsho. Ukuxazulula inkinga kanye nokuqashwa. Ukwenza uhlelo olungajwayelekile. Ukuphatha ama-chemical ezingozini. Ilayiseni yokuqasha elihamba phambili.
zu.duties: Lungeza futhi usebenzise izindlela, izinhlelo kanye nemithetho yokuhleleka. Qaphela (kuxhumana nabathengi) izidingo zezindlela ezintsha zokuqashwa kolwazi. Qaphela izikhala futhi lungeza izindlela zokuqashwa ezifanele. Nikeza ngeluleko lesayensi kanye nensekelo. Lungeza ubuhlobo nomthengi. Nikeza ngolwazi, ukwaziswa neluleko njengoba kudingeka. Hlola ukushicilelwa kwemisebenzi yesayensi. Yenza ukutholwa kwamabalo kanye nemisebenzi ephathwa ngumthetho. Yenza isibalo seziyindinganiso zamabalo. Qoqa futhi uhumushe imininingwane, linganisa imiphumela futhi sasaze ukwaziswa. Lungeza izinkulumo ezimala futhi lungeza imibiko. Lungeza futhi uqondise izindlela ezintsha zokusetyenziswa kolwazi lwesayensi. Hlela futhi yenza ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile kokudla okutshalwa. Ukuqashelwa kokuthuthukiswa nokwenza izinto ngokusha. Ukuthuthukiswa ngokunjalo kokwaziswa ukuze ugcine izindlela ezintsha ezisebenzayo. Yenza ucwaningo olusuka ngezansi kanye nolusebenzisekayo. Ucwaningo/philo yezincwadi ukuze ukhulise ulwazi lwakho. Shicilela futhi unikeze ngemininingwane yocwaningo. Xhumana namahlelo/amarhadi kwezokucwaningwa eziphathene nesayensi. Izinsimbi zokwaziswa nokuthuthukiswa. Baka, fundisa futhi thuthukisa izisebenzi ukuze ukhulise ukudluliswa kolwazi. Qapha imisebenzi yesayensi kanye nezinhlelo zayo. Phatha imisebenzi nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: IsSayensi Sokukhiqiza (GRADE A-C)
xh.summary: Phuhlisa nokusebenzisa iindlela zohlalutyo lwesayensi kwisebe le-Agriculture eStellenbosch, kufuneka ube nedigri ye-BSc Honours kwi-Chemistry nokuqatshelwa kwi-SACNASP.
xh.requirements: Isicelo kufuneka sibe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 nedigri ye-BSc Honours (Chemistry). Ukuqatshelwa ngokuyimfuneko kwi-South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengo-Professional Natural Scientist. Ulwazi lokusebenza oluhambelana nesithuba: Iimbonakaliso ezintathu (3) zeminyaka yokusebenza emva kokufumana izidanga. Ulwazi oluhambelana nesithuba: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe lolwazi malunga nemigaqo/yimicimbi yeZiko loLuntu nesebe. I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-Agricultural Products Standard Act 119 of 1990. ILiquor Product Act 60 of 1989. Amakhono ahambelana nesithuba: Ulawulo lwenkqubo nendalo. Iindlela zesayensi. Uphononongo nophuhliso. Ulwazi ngokuzithoba ngokomthetho. Uhlalutyo lwedata. Izicelo zesayensi ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ukudala inkqubo yenkqubo yokusebenza ephezulu. Isigqibo sesigqibo. Amakhono okubonisa. Ukululeka. Ukwenza isigqibo. Ukulathisa iqela. Amakhono ohlalutyo. Intsingiselo. Ulawulo lweemali. Ugqithiso kumathuba okusabela. Unxibelelwano. Ukwakha umthombo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulawulo labantu. Uluvo loluhlelo nokuqokelela. Ulawulo lwegxabhongo. Ulawulo lenguquko. Ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo. Iiyure ezinde zokusebenza. Ukuphatha iikhemikhali ezibuhlungu. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa nokusebenzisa iindlela, iinkqubo neenkqubo. Chaza (ngokubonisana nabathengi) iimfuno zendlela entsha yohlalutyo. Phawula iindleko zipheleleyo uphuhlise iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokuqonda. Nikeza icebiso lenkxaso yesayensi. Phuhlisa ubudlelwane bokusebenza nabathengi. Nikeza idatha yesayensi, ulwazi necebiso njengoko kufuneka. Phinda ubuke iinkqamoleo zesayensi. Yenza uhlalutyo lwesayensi nemisebenzi yokulawula. Yenza uhlalutyo lwedata yesayensi. Qokelela uhlu oluchaziweyo lwedata, vavanya iziphumo yaza usasaze ulwazi. Yeza iingcebiso yaza udibanise iingxelo. Phuhlisa nokulungelelanisa iindlela zobuchwepheshe bobusayensi. Lawula yaza wenze uvavanyo lokuzilolonga kokutya kwelimosi. Uphononongo noPhuhliso. Intshukumo entsha yobugcisa bokugcina usasazo kwizitshixo ezintsha nobuchwepheshe. Yenza uphononongo olusisiseko nokusetyenziswa. Uphononongo/ifundo yolwazi ukuphucula ubugcisa bukaqhayiya. Shicilela yaza ubonise iziphumo zophononongo. Nxibelela nabemi/babengama kwimicimbi ehlobene nesayensi. Iinkxaso zabantu noPhuhliso. Qeqisha, khulisa yaza uphuhlise abasebenzi ukuze uphuhlise izakhono/ukudluliswa kolwazi. Lawula umsebenzi nokuqhuba iinkqubo zesayensi. Lawula inkqubo nentshukumo yabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Resource Conservation Inspector
jobs.summary: Inspect and manage locust outbreaks in De Aar, conducting surveillance, ecological risk assessments, and post-control impact evaluations for the Department of Agriculture.
jobs.requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Agriculture/Environmental Management/Nature Conservation/Pest Management (NQF 6). A minimum of two (2) years relevant experience. Job Related Knowledge: Agricultural Pest Act, Natural Environmental Management Act, Natural Environmental Management Biodiversity Act. Knowledge of policy development. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act. Labour Relations Act, Water Act. Job Related Skills: Geographical Information System skills. Policy development and analytical skills. Research and monitoring skills. Leadership skills, Negotiation Skills, Excellent communication skills (verbal, presentation and report writing). Knowledge of project planning and management. Inspection and auditing skills. Problem solving and analysis. Facilitation and coordination skills. Computer skills. Ability to act with tact and discretion. A valid drivers’ license. Ability to work extended hours. Extensive travelling.
jobs.duties: Surveillance, assess, activate and monitor locust outbreak (control). Response to locust outbreak reported to verify the outbreak. Conduct ecological risk assessment in the area. Organise and plan control. Inspection and monitor control units. Conduct post control evaluation (impact assessment). Identifying and make recommendation for research needs. Manage the storage of chemicals in the district locust areas Surveillance, assess, execute and monitor blackfly outbreak. Monitor and evaluate blackfly larvae population. Identify the position of the rapids (control site). Administer trial to determine the dosage rate for each rapid in preparation of the control operations. Execute control operation. Conduct post control monitoring and evaluation to determine the impact of the control action. Identifying and make recommendation for research needs/challenges and solution. Surveillance, assess, activate and monitor quelea (bird) outbreak. Response to outbreak report for verification. Conduct pre-inspection / evaluation to determine the extent of the outbreak, Conduct the ecological risk assessment of the area. Plan, organise, co-ordinate and manage control operation. Conduct post control monitoring for remediiation/sanitary and evaluation of the impact. Identifying and make recommendations for research needs/challenges and solutions. Conduct training and awareness campaigns. Identify, planning and organising of training. Training of prospective migratory pest outbreak controllers. Conduct awareness campaign. Management of Migratory Pests Data. Capturing outbreak data. Mapping of data areas.

af.title: Hulpbronbewaringsinspekteur
af.summary: Inspekteer en bestuur sprinkaanuitbrake in De Aar, voer bewaking, ekologiese risikobepalings en na-beheer impakevaluerings uit vir die Department of Agriculture.
af.requirements: Aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Landbou/Omgewingsbestuur/Natuurbewaring/Plaagbestuur (NQF 6). 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar relevante ervaring. Werksverwante kennis: Agricultural Pest Act, Natural Environmental Management Act, Natural Environmental Management Biodiversity Act. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act. Labour Relations Act, Water Act. Werksverwante vaardighede: Geografiese inligtingstelsel-vaardighede. Beleidsontwikkeling en analitiese vaardighede. Navorsings- en moniteringsvaardighede. Leierskapsvaardighede, onderhandelingsvaardighede, uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings, voorleggings en verslagdoening). Kennis van projekbeplanning en -bestuur. Inspeksie- en ouditvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en analise. Fasiliterings- en koördineringsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vermoë om oortyd te werk. Uitgebreide reis.
af.duties: Bewaking, beoordeel, aktiveer en monitor sprinkaanuitbraak (beheer). Reageer op aangemelde sprinkaanuitbraak om dit te verifieer. Voer ekologiese risikobepaling in die gebied uit. Organiseer en beplan beheer. Inspeksie en monitering van beheereenhede. Voer na-beheer evaluasie (impakbepaling) uit. Identifiseer en doen aanbevelings vir navorsingsbehoeftes. Bestuur die berging van chemikalieë in die distrik se sprinkaangebiede. Bewaking, beoordeel, voer uit en monitor swartvlieguitbraak. Monitor en evalueer swartvlieg-larwe-populasie. Identifiseer die posisie van die stroomversnellings (beheerperseel). Dien proefneming toe om die dosiskoers vir elke stroomversnelling te bepaal ter voorbereiding van die beheerbedrywighede. Voer beheerbedrywigheid uit. Voer na-beheer monitering en evaluasie uit om die impak van die beheeraksie te bepaal. Identifiseer en doen aanbevelings vir navorsingsbehoeftes/uitdagings en oplossings. Bewaking, beoordeel, aktiveer en monitor quelea (voël) uitbraak. Reageer op uitbraakverslae vir verifikasie. Voer voor-inspeksie / evaluasie uit om die omvang van die uitbraak te bepaal. Voer die ekologiese risikobepaling van die gebied uit. Beplan, organiseer, koördineer en bestuur beheerbedrywighede. Voer na-beheer monitering vir remediesie/sanitêre aangeleenthede en evaluasie van die impak uit. Identifiseer en doen aanbevelings vir navorsingsbehoeftes/uitdagings en oplossings. Voer opleiding en bewustheidsveldtogte uit. Identifiseer, beplan en organiseer opleiding. Opleiding van voornemende migrerende plaaguitbraakbeheerders. Voer bewustheidsveldtogte uit. Bestuur van migrerende plaagdata. Vaslegging van uitbraakdata. Kartering van data-gebiede.

zu.title: Isiphathindi sokugcina imithombo
zu.summary: Hlola uphola bese ulawula ukuphumelela kwezigwegwesi e-De Aar, wenza ulwondlulo, ukuhlola izingozi zokusingathwa kwemvelo, kanye nokuhlola imiphumela yesikhathi esedlule sokulawula umnyango we-Agriculture.
zu.requirements: Isicelo kufanele sibe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma kwe-Agriculture/Environmental Management/Nature Conservation/Pest Management (NQF 6). Ubude obungenamva weminyaka emibili (2) wokuqashwa kwayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Agricultural Pest Act, Natural Environmental Management Act, Natural Environmental Management Biodiversity Act. Ulwazi ngokuqaqa imigomo. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act. Labour Relations Act, Water Act. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono we-Geographical Information System. Amakhono wokuqaqa nokuhlaziya imigomo. Amakhono wolwazindalo nokulawula. Amakhono okuba ngumholi, amakhono ezenzakalo, amakhono amakhulu wokuxhumana (ngomlomo, okubukhulu nangokubhala imibiko). Ulwazi lokuhlela uphiko futhi kulawulwe ukuphatha. Amakhono wokuhlolwa futhi kuhlolwa ngokusemthethweni. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Amakhono wokwazi ukuxhumanisa ngendlela ehle futhi ukulawula izinto. Amakhono wokusebenzisa isiqukathi. Ukukwazi ukuziphatha kahle ngokuzihlonipha. Isivume sokushayela. Ukukwazi ukusebenza amahora amaningi. Ukuzula kakhulu.
zu.duties: Ulwondlulo, ukuhlola, ukuvuselela nokulawula ukuphumelela kwezigwegwesi (ukulawula). Impendulo kokuphumelela kwezigwegwesi okushiwo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelela. Ukuhlola ubungozi bokusingathwa kwemvelo endaweni. Ukuhlela uphiko nokulawula. Ukubuyekeza nokulawula amayunithi. Ukwenza isibonke isilinganiselo esedlule (ukuqina imiphumela). Ukuthola nokunikela ngemininingwane yemibuzo yokuxazulula. Ukuphatha ukugcinwa kwamakhemikhari emigubasela wezigwegwisi esifundeni Ulwondlulo, ukuhlola, ukusebenzisa nokulawula ukuphumelela kwe-blackfly. Ukulawula nokuhlola imifula yamabalule e-blackfly. Ukuqinisa isabelo esigijima (indawo yokulawula). Ukulinganisa ukwedlule ukuze kutholwe izinga lesamba kwesabelo ngasinye ukuze kumiswa izinhlelo zokulawula. Ukusebenzisa inqubo yokulawula. Ukuhlola isikhathi esedlule sokulawula futhi kwedlulele ukwazi imiphumela yesenzo sokulawula. Ukubona futhi ukwenza ukuzisa izincomo ngemininingwane yokuxazulula. Ulwondlulo, ukuhlola, ukuvuselela nokulawula ukuphumelela kwe-quelea (inyoni). Impendulo kokushiwo ngokuphumelela ukutholakala. Ukuhlola ukwedlule / ukuqina ukuthi zingakanani izibuko, ukuhlola ubungozi bokusingathwa kwemvelo kwendawo. Ukuphatha inqubo yokulawula, ukuhlela, ukuxhumanisa nokulawula. Ukulawula isikhathi esedlule sokuhlolwa ukuze kuhlehliswe/kuhlanzwe futhi kuhlutswe imiphumela. Ukubona futhi ukunikela ngemininingwane ngemininingwane yokuxazulula. Ukufundisa nokwazi imikhankaso. Ukubona ukuthi kufanele sifunde imikhankaso, ukuyihlela nokuyilawula. Ukufundisa abaphathi bokuphumelela kwezihambahamba. Ukuhlomula imikhankaso yokwazisa. Ukuqoqa imibhali yokulawula izilwane ezihamabo. Ukuhlola imibhali yokuphumelelana kokutholakele. Ukuthwebula imibhali yezindawo zedatha.

xh.title: Isikhwedle somvikelo wombane
xh.summary: Ukuvavanya nokulawula ukuphuma kwesikrwamba e De Aar, ukuqhuba ukulandela, izilinganiselo zomngcipheko wekholoji, kunye nokuvavanya umphumo emva kolawulo kwi Department of Agriculture.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umfundi abe nakho I Grade 12 Certificate kunye ne National Diploma in Agriculture/Environmental Management/Nature Conservation/Pest Management (NQF 6). Isiphithiphithi seminyaka emi-2 (2) yamava ahambelanayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Agricultural Pest Act, Natural Environmental Management Act, Natural Environmental Management Biodiversity Act. Ulwazi ngophuhliso lwenkqubo. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act. Labour Relations Act, Water Act. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Amakhono eGeographical Information System. Amakhono okuphuhlisa inkqubo kunye nokuhlola. Amakhono okuphanda nokugcina amehlo. Amakhono okuba ngumfundi, amakhono okucingelana, amakhono amabini okunxibelelwana (okuthethwayo, okubonwayo nokubhaliweyo). Ulwazi ngokucwangcisa nokulawula iprojekthi. Amakhono okuvavanya nokucontuza. Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuhlola. Amakhono okulawula nokuhambelanisa. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ikhaliti yokusebenza ngobulumko nangazenzekelayo. Ilayisenisi esebenzayo yokushayela. Ikhaliti yokusebenza iiyure ezininzi. Ukunyamzelwa okubanzi.
xh.duties: Ukulandela, ukuvavanya, ukwenza usebenze nokugcina amehlo ukuphuma kwesikrwamba (ukulawula). Ukuphendula kwisikrwamba esibikiweyo ukuqinisekisa ukuphuma kwaso. Ukuqhuba isilinganiselo somngcipheko wekholoji kwindawo. Ukuqamba kunye nokucwangcisa ukulawula. Ukuvavanya nokugcina amehlo ukulawula iiyunithi. Ukuqhuba isilinganisilo emva kokulawula (isilinganiselo somphumo). Ukuqapha kwaye uzenze iingcebiso malunga neemfuno zophando. Ukulawula ukugcinwa kwamachiza kummandla wesikrwamba wesithili Ukulandela, ukuvavanya, ukwenza usebenze nokugcina amehlo ukuphuma kweblackfly. Ukugcina amehlo kwaye uvavanye inani leblackfly larvae. Ukuqonda isikhundla sezibuko (indawo yolawulo). Ukuphatha uvavo ukuze kugqitywe izinga ledosi yezibuko ngalinye kulungiselelko lomsebenzi wolawulo. Ukuqhuba umsebenzi wolawulo. Ukuqhuba ukugcina amehlo nokuvavanya emva kolawulo ukuze kugqitywe umphumo womsebenzi wolawulo. Ukuqapha kwaye uzenze iingcebiso malunga neemfuno/izititobo zophando kunye neendlela zoncedo. Ukulandela, ukuvavanya, ukwenza usebenze nokugcina amehlo ukuphuma kwequelea (iinyoni). Ukuphendula kumbiko wokuphuma ukuze kuqinisekiswe. Ukuqhuba ukuvavanya phambi kwesixa / isilinganiselo ukuze kugqitywe ubukhulu bokuphuma, Ukuqhuba isilinganiselo somngcipheko wekholoji wendawo. Ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba, ukuqhelanisa kunye nokulawula umsebenzi wolawulo. Ukuqhuba ukugcina amehlo emva kolawulo ukuze kulungiswe/kuhluzwe kwaye kuvavanywe umphumo. Ukuqapha kwaye uzenze iingcebiso malunga neemfuno/izititobo zophando kunye neendlela zoncedo. Ukuqhuba imisebenzi yokuzisa ulwazi nolungiselelo. Ukuqapha, ukucwangcisa nokuqamba ulungiselelo. Ukufundisa abalawuli abayimfuno yezinambuzane ezihambahambayo. Ukuqhuba ulungelelwaniso lokuzisa ulwazi. Ukulawula iData yezinambuzane ezihambahambayo. Ukufaka idata yokuphuma. Ukuzoba iindawo zedata.

jobs.reference_number: DBE/59/2026 Branch: Office of the Director-General Chief Directorate: Media Liaison and National and Provincial Communication
jobs.title: Chief Director: Media Liaison and National and Provincial
jobs.summary: Chief Director needed to lead media liaison and communication strategy for the Department of Basic Education in Pretoria, requiring 10 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate recognised qualification at NQF level 7 in Communication, Marketing, Public Relations or a related field, as recognised by SAQA. A relevant NQF level 8 or higher qualification, as recognised by SAQA, will be an added advantage. The incumbent must have a minimum of ten (10) years’ experience in communication, public relations, media liaison, marketing, content development and/or internal communications, of which at least five (5) years must have been at senior management level. Proven experience in strategic communication, media liaison, public relations, stakeholder communication, marketing campaigns, content development and internal communications will be required. Experience in the education sector, public sector, intergovernmental environment, or a similarly complex stakeholder environment requiring high-level media liaison, crisis communication and stakeholder management will be an added advantage. Process competencies: Knowledge Management, Service Delivery Innovation, Problem Solving and Analysis, Client Orientation and Customer Focus, Communication skills. Core Competencies: Strategic Capacity and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management and Change Management, promotion communication, innovation and creativity, and the ability to prepare speeches. The candidate must be confident, trustworthy, accurate, adaptable and diplomatic. Applicants must have a valid driver’s licence and be willing to travel extensively.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for providing effective communication services to the Minister, the Department of Basic Education (DBE) and Education Departments in the provinces; Responsible for leading communication strategies for the Minister, DBE and provinces; Managing communication campaigns; Managing urgent and unplanned communication matters; Responding to deadlines and quality inputs; Overseeing and providing strategic direction in the development and implementation of communication channels and strategies for the Ministry, the Department of Basic Education and Provincial Education Departments; Overseeing, implementing and managing communication campaigns for the Department of Basic Education and providing support to communication campaigns undertaken by the Ministry of Basic Education, where required; Ensuring effective management and utilisation of appropriate communication channels for the Ministry and the Department of Basic Education; Building and sustaining a positive reputation for the Ministry and the Department of Basic Education; Managing planned, unplanned and urgent communication matters for the Ministry, where requested, and for the Department of Basic Education; Arranging media and press conferences; Responding to media enquiries; Responding timeously to deadlines and providing quality inputs into matters that affect the Ministry and the Department of Basic Education; Overseeing strategic content development, public relations, stakeholder communication, media liaison and internal communication functions in support of the Department’s priorities and the broader basic education sector; Supporting delegated tasks from the Minister, Deputy Minister, DG, HEDCOM and CEM; and ensuring proper financial, administrative and personnel management. Ensuring that appropriate financial, administrative and personnel management procedures are in place and in accordance with the requirements of the Department of Basic Education, relevant Public Service and Administration policies and the Public Finance Management Act.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Monyela Tel No: (012) 357 3294/ Mr M Segowa Tel No: (012) 357 4291
jobs.applications: Submitted via post to: Private Bag X895, Pretoria, 0001 or hand-deliver to: The Department of Basic Education, 222 Struben Street, Pretoria or you can email your application Sechele.O@dbe.gov.za/Monyela.N@dbe.gov.za/Segowa.M@dbe.gov.za/Ku malo.N@dbe.gov.za. Please visit the Department of Education’s website at www.education.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the most recently approved Z83 Application for Employment Form, obtainable from the DBE Website or any Public Service Department/Webpage. Use of the old Z83 Form will result in disqualification. The Z83 must be completed in full and page 2 duly signed. A clear indication of the post and reference number that is being applied for must be indicated on your Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 with a detailed Curriculum Vitae (only). Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates on or before the day of the interview. Successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks, qualification and employment verification including social media profiles). Appointment is subject to positive results of the security clearance process. The successful candidate will be required to sign an annual performance agreement and, where applicable, annually disclose his/her financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Applicants, who do not comply with the requirements outlined above, will not be considered. A Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) (Nyukela Certificate) is required for all SMS appointments; the full detail of the outlined requirements and course information       can      be     sourced       by      following     the     link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course-SMS-pre-entry programme. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Mediakakelantasie en Nasionale en Provinsiale
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur benodig om mediakakelantasie en kommunikasiestrategie vir die Department of Basic Education in Pretoria te lei, wat 10 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike erkende kwalifikasie op NQF level 7 in Kommunikasie, Bemarking, Openbare Betrekkinge of 'n verwante veld, soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Relevante NQF level 8 of hoër kwalifikasie, soos erken deur SAQA, sal 'n voordeel wees. Die ampsdraer moet 'n minimum van tien (10) jaar se ervaring in kommunikasie, openbare betrekkinge, mediakakelantasie, bemarking, inhoudontwikkeling en/of interne kommunikasie hê, waarvan ten minste vyf (5) jaar op seniorbestuursvlak moet gewees het. Bewese ervaring in strategiese kommunikasie, mediakakelantasie, openbare betrekkinge, belanghebbendekommunikasie, bemarkingsveldtogte, inhoudontwikkeling en interne kommunikasie sal vereis word. Ervaring in die onderwyssektor, openbare sektor, interowerheidsomgewing, of 'n soortgelyk komplexe belanghebbende-omgewing wat hoëvlak-mediakakelantasie, krisiskommunikasie en belanghebbende-bestuur vereis, sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Prosesbevoegdhede: Kennisbestuur, Dienslewering Innovasie, Probleemoplossing en Analise, Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus, Kommunikasievaardighede. Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese Kapasiteit en Leierskap, Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging, Finansiële Bestuur en Veranderingsbestuur, bevorderingskommunikasie, innovasie en kreatiwiteit, en die vermoë om toesprake voor te berei. Die kandidaat moet selfversekerd, betroubaar, akkuraat, aanpasbaar en diplomatiek wees. Aansoekers moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê en bereid wees om wyd te reis.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees daarvoor om doeltreffende kommunikasiedienste aan die Minister, die Department of Basic Education (DBE) en Onderwysdepartemente in die provinsies te verskaf; Verantwoordelik vir die lei van kommunikasiestrategieë vir die Minister, DBE en provinsies; Bestuur van kommunikasieveldtogte; Bestuur van dringende en ongeplande kommunikasie-aangeleenthede; Reageer op sperdatums en gehalte-invoere; Oorsig oor en verskaffing van strategiese rigting in die ontwikkeling en implementering van kommunikasiekanale en -strategieë vir die Ministerie, die Department of Basic Education en Provinsiale Onderwysdepartemente; Oorsig oor, implementering en bestuur van kommunikasieveldtogte vir die Department of Basic Education en verskaffing van steun aan kommunikasieveldtogte wat deur die Ministerie van Basiese Onderwys onderneem word, waar vereis; Verseker van doeltreffende bestuur en benutting van toepaslike kommunikasiekanale vir die Ministerie en die Department of Basic Education; Bou en handhaaf van 'n positiewe reputasie vir die Ministerie en die Department of Basic Education; Bestuur van beplande, ongeplande en dringende kommunikasie-aangeleenthede vir die Ministerie, waar versoek, en vir die Department of Basic Education; Reël van media- en perskonferensies; Reageer op medianavrae; Tydig reageer op sperdatums en verskaf van gehalte-invoere in aangeleenthede wat die Ministerie en die Department of Basic Education raak; Oorsig oor strategiese inhoudontwikkeling, openbare betrekkinge, belanghebbendekommunikasie, mediakakelantasie en interne kommunikasiefunksies ter ondersteuning van die departement se prioriteite en die breër basiese-onderwyssektor; Ondersteun van gedelegeerde take van die Minister, Adjunkminister, DG, HEDCOM en CEM; en verseker van behoorlike finansiële, administratiewe en personeelbestuur. Verseker dat toepaslike finansiële, administratiewe en personeelbestuurprosedures in plek is en in ooreenstemming met die vereistes van die Department of Basic Education, relevante Public Service and Administration-beleide en die Public Finance Management Act.

zu.title: Umululi Omkhulu: Ukuxhumana Namaphikoabezindaba Kwezwe Nasezifundeni
zu.summary: Udinga Umululi Omkhulu okuzokuba ngumholi ekuxhumeni namaphikoabezindaba nasesuqwenini sokuxhumana loMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo ePretoria, okudinga unyaka wama-10 wamava.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezisezinhlokweni ze-NQF level 7 Ezokuxhumana, Ezokumaketha, Ezokwazimphilo Komphakathi noma inkambu eholelayo, njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Iziqu ezithintekayo ze-NQF level 8 noma eziphezudlule, njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA, kuzoba yinzuzo. Kumele kube nokuhlinzekwe iminyaka eyishumi (10) yamava kwezokuxhumana, izokwazimphilo komphakathi, ukuxhumana namaphikoabezindaba, ukumaketha, ukwakhezelwa okuqukethwe kanye/noma ukuxhumana ngaphakathi, lapho okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) kumele ibe iloslwe ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphathwa. Izowa imava eziveziwe ekuxhumeni okuyisu, ukuxhumana namaphikoabezindaba, izokwazimphilo komphakathi, ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli, amakhasimi okuqashiswa komaketho, ukwakhezelwa okuqukethwe kanye nokuxhumana ngaphakathi. Amava esimweni sezemfundo, esiphakathini kanye nemvelo kahulumeni wezinyanga ezahlukene, noma esimweni esibucayi ngokufanana esidinga ukuxhumana namaphikoabezindaba ngesikhathi esiphezulu, ukuxhumana ngexesha lwezinsuku ezinzima kanye nokuphathwa kwabahlanganyeli kuzomele kube yinzuzo. Amakhono emisebenzi: Ukuphathwa kolwazi, Inovethi yokulethwa kwenkonzo, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, Ukugxila kumthengi nokubhekisisa izidingo zabathengi, Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono abalulekile: Ikhono lesu kanye noholo, Ukuphatha abantu nokunika amandla, Ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye Nokuphathwa Koshintsho, ukukhuthaza ukuxhumana, inovethi nokudala, kanye nethuba lokulungula izinkulumo. Kumele umuntu ophakanyiswe ube nokuzethemba, ethembekile, eqinisekiswe ngokuqinisekiswa, enokuzivumelanisa nasezimeni kanye nohlakaniphile thweba kanye noxhumo. Kumele abafakisisa babe nelaysensi yokushayela evumelekile futhi bethande ukuhamba kakhulu.
zu.duties: Kuzofanele anikeze amasevisi okuxhumana afanele kuNqbe, uMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo kanye Namaphiko Abosezinsizakalo zemfundo ezifundeni; Ukuhola amasu okuxhumana kuNqbe, kuMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo nasemiphakathini yezifunda; Ukuphatha amakhasimi okuxhumana; Ukuphatha izindaba eziphuthumayo ezingagidinganise ezenzekile zokuxhumana; Ukuphendula ngokulindwa kwesikhathi kanye nemiqulu noma okuholela ukuphendula ngomdlandla; Ukuba ukhuleke futhi uhola ngesu lokwakhezelwa okuqukethwe kwayakhiwe kanye nokusebenzisa izinkimbinkimbi ezingavezwa okuqukathwayo ezingenhla zokuxhumana ezihlongene nesesiqu enkosi yeqembu lesoMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo kanye Namaphiko Abosezinsizakalo zemfundo ezifunda; Ukulawula, ukuyisebenzisa nokuyiphatha imikhuba yokuxhumana ezenziwa itholakala ngemuva kakhulu njengoba lolu hlelo luqukethe okungadali okuhle kakhulu enhloso kaNqbe nelombuso weMfundo Eyisisekelo, ikakhulukazi lapho okufunekile; Ukuphathwa nokusetshenziswa kokuqinisekisiwe kwezinsizakalo ezifanele zokuxhumana ezihlongene nasesimweni sikabongqondwemfundo nasezifunda; Ukwakha futhi ukugcina ngokwesikhathi esiduzulula izwi okuhle ihlezi nebhalwe emaphakathi ngothando eziphakeme mayelana nesiminya se Nhlobo neMfundo Yethu yethu yethu yezisulu nelomnyango; Ukuphatha izindaba zokuxhumana ezihleliwe, ezingheliwe kanye noma ezibucayi ezingakenzelwa hhayi isikhathi esithize, ikakhulukazi lapho kuceliwa khona, futhi lapho kudingeka khona kokuba kumenzeleka ngomnyango; Ukuhlela izinkulumo namaphikoabezindaba; Ukuphendula imibuzo yamaphikoabezindaba; Ukuphendula ngokulindwa kwesikhathi kokubekiwe futhi ukunikeza imiqulu yezinjongo entsha kuleyo ngaleyo ndaba ephathelene nohulongaxa okuhlukene okuhole ekumunyweni okhulunywe nguKhongolethe neNhlelo yakho ehlukile emnyangweni we-DBE; Ukugcwalisa ukubakhezelwa kokuqukethwe okuhle, ukuxhumana nabantu besichibiyelo, ukuxhumana nabantu bomphakathi, ukuxhumana nabezindaba kanye nezenzo zokuxhumana ezifanele kuzo zonke izindawo ngokusekela ukuhambisana koluntu kube yisekelo kokuziphendulela nezinyanga ezenzeka kule ndawo yokuxhumana esiyidinga okuningi noma okuncane okubalulekile ngenxa yokuhlinzeka abantu abaningi bomphakathi ngenhloso yokukhululeka kokubakhululela ekuxhumaneni kwawo onke amaphiko; Ukusekela imisebenzi ethunyelwe nguNqbe, uNqbe osekela lowo owayengowayeyona mholi weSizwe, u-DBE noKhongolethe nemikhotho yezinsizakalo; Ukugcwalisa nokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimali, okubhalwa ngokomthetho nokuphathwa kwezigwegqesi zomphakathi ezifakwe isinyathelo esiyingqongqosha kulesi sikhathi esingakahlukaniswa nenhlelo yalelo zitayela esinika amandla isigaba sezimali kohlelo oluphelehle lokukhiqiza imali ethile ekhokhelwa abasebenzi bomphakathi.

xh.title: Um lawuli Oyintloko: Ulungano lwabezindaba kwiNqanaba lesiNazwe nesiPhondo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa uMlawuli Oyintloko oza kuba nhloko wolungano lwabezindaba nendlela yolonwabo lweenkcazelo kwisebe lezeMfundo eNqangi ePretoria, elicela unyaka wamava angama-10.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezisemthethweni ezikumqangatho we-7 we-NQF kwiNkcazelo, uThengiso, uBudlelwano noLuntu, okanye indima efana nalo, njengokuqatshiweyo yi-SAQA. Iziqu ezikumqangatho we-8 we-NQF okanye ngaphezulu, njengokuqatshiweyo yi-SAQA, ziya kuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Umntu oze kuthatha le nxaxheba kufuneka abe nobunyaka obungaphezu kweshumi (10) bemava kwiNkcazelo, uBudlelwano noLuntu, ulungano lwabezindaba, uThengiso, uPhuhliso lweziqulatho, nokucwangcisa iinkcukacha zangaphakathi, apho kubbingo seabahlali abangaphezulu kwamashumi amahlanu (5) kufuneka ibe ngaphezulu. Iimava ezibonakalisiweyo ekuncediseni ngenkcazelo, ulungano lwabezindaba, ubudlelwano noLuntu, ukunceda abathintekayo ngenkcazelo, iinkampu zothengiso, uphuhliso lweziqulatho, nokuqwemasela iinkcazelo zangaphakathi ziya kufuneka. Iimava kwiziko lemfundo, kwiziko likarhulumente, kwindawo yokusebenzisana phakathi karhulumente, okanye kwindawo ethile enamathuba amaninzi okubeka abathintekayo, edinga ulungano oluphezulu lwabezindaba, iinkcazelo zexeshana olunzima, nolawulo lwabathintekayo luya kuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Amandla kwiinkqubo: uLawulo lolwazi, uPhuhliso kwinkonzo eveliswa kwindawo yayo, ukuSombulula iingxaki noNzulu lwazo, uQhagamshelo lwoMthengi nokuQwalasela iimfuno zakhe,akhethwayo nakuziphi na iimeko. Amandla aphambili: uLawulo oluQhubela phambili noBuntu, uLawulo bantu bukaBantu kakhulu, uLawulo lweMali noGuqulo lweNkqubo yomthetho ekulawuleni abantu abakule nyango zeMfundo, khankanya iinkcazelo, iinkqubo ezintsha, namagama angathethwa ngokubanzi ngabantu abakule nyango, nendlela yokulungiselela iinkqubo ezithethwayo ngezithuba ekudingekwa ngamalungu abantu bakhankanywe ngaphaya ngaphezulu kwiinkqubo zolawulo zale miba entsundu. Kufuneka abe nguMntu ongathath'ehlatyeni kwaye athenge iimfuno ngenkqubo yakhe ngokubanzi kwindawo yakowethu kwaye azi ukuba unokwenzela iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo zezakwoThixo. Ikhandidethi kufuneka iqiniseke, ithenjwe, ichaneke, ihlale ihambelana nendlela yemeko yantoni na na imisebenzi elifanelekileyo nokuzithoba ngokomthetho wakowethu.
xh.duties: Umama ophumeleleyo uya kuba nokulawula nokuqinisekisa ukuba inkonzo yonke isetyenziswa ngokwemigaqo yonke malunga nolwazi, inkonzo, ukwenza okutsha, ukusombulula iingxaki, unxibelelwano, nokuqwalasela iimfuno zamakhasiweyo, nokuthuthuzela abantu abanomdla ekwaziseni nasekubeni nakuzo zonke iinkqubo ekulawulweni. Ukubakho bukhona beenkqubo ezichanekileyo kwingcali yonke: uLawulo lolwazi, uPhuhliso kwinkonzo ekulawulweni kwakhona, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokwazi ukuMila kwezo nkcazela zizonke, uQwalaselo lweNkonzo kuMthengi nakuNxibelelwano, iNkcazelo. Iinkqubo eziphambili: uLawulo oluQhubela phambili noBuntu, uLawulo nokuNika Amandla Abantu, uLawulo lweMali nokulawula iTshintsho, ukukhuthaza iNkcazelo, uPhuhliso lokwenza izinto ngokutsha nokuya phambili, nendlela yokulungiselela iinkqubo ezithethwa kwindawo ethile. Ikhandidethi kufuneka iqiniseke, ithenjwe, ichaneke, ihlale ihambelana nendlela futhi ithande inxibelelwano nabantu ngokuziphatha okuhle. Kufuneka abe namava okwenza iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo nezibalulekileyo kwiziko, alinganisela inani lemeko yonke lokuqinisekiswa nokusebenza kakhulu kwaye athande ukuzijahazisa. Ikhandidethi kufuneka iqiniseke, ithenjwe, ichaneke, ihlale ihambelana nendlela, futhi ithande unxibelelwano nabantu. Kufuneka abe namava okwenza iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo nezibalulekileyo kwiziko elikhulu, elineziko lemfundo elidibana neenkcukacha ezininzi ezibalulekileyo, apho kudingeka khona ukuqinisekisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokwazisa abantu. Abantu abangena kakhulu kwiinkonzo zolawulo bemfundo, kwiziko likarhulumente, kwindawo yokusebenzisana phakathi karhulumente, okanye kwindawo ethile enamathuba amaninzi ekufuneka kubekho abantu abakwaziyo ukuphakamisa izinto ezingathintwa, kuya kuba luncedo elingezekwayo. Amandla kwiinkqubo: uLawulo lolwazi, uPhuhliso kweNkonzo eveliswa kwindawo ethile, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokwazi ukuQwalasela iNkcazelo, uQhagamshelo lwoMthengi nokuQwalasela iimfuno zakhe. Amandla aphambili: uLawulo oluQhubela phambili noBuntu, uLawulo lwabantu noKunika amandla, uLawulo lweMali noGuqulo lweNkqubo yomthetho ekulawuleni abantu abakule nyango zeMfundo, khankanya iinkcazelo, iinkqubo ezintsha, namagama angathethwa ngokubanzi ngabantu abakule nyango, nendlela yokulungiselela iinkqubo ezithethwayo ngezithuba ekudingekwa ngamalungu abantu abakhankanywe ngaphaya ngaphezulu kwiinkqubo zolawulo zale miba entsundu.
