jobs.title: Chief Director: Legal and Legislative Services
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum, inclusive salary package
jobs.summary: Lead the Chief Directorate for Legal and Legislative Services at the Department of Basic Education, providing strategic legal advice and managing litigation and legislative services.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor of Laws degree (LLB) or equivalent legal qualification (NQF level 7) recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA); Admission as an attorney or advocate in South Africa; The successful candidate must be in good standing with the relevant professional regulatory body. A minimum of 10 years’ relevant post-qualification legal experience, of which at least 5 years must be at senior managerial level; Experience in the interpretation, development, implementation and/or litigation of legislation, policies and regulations within the education sector or a comparable public sector environment; Demonstrable experience in education law, including experience in advising on, developing, interpreting or implementing education legislation, regulations or policy, is an essential requirement; Proven experience in constitutional law, administrative law, legislative drafting and regulatory development, public sector litigation and regulatory governance will be an advantage; Knowledge of Administrative law and constitutional law as applied to the education sector; Ability to deliver legal advisory services to government departments, public entities or statutory bodies. Process competencies: Knowledge management; problem-solving and analysis; client orientation and customer focus; communication; negotiation; stakeholder management; and risk management. Core Competencies The post requires a person with excellent Strategic capability and leadership; people management and empowerment; financial management; change management; programme and project management; and service delivery innovation. leadership and strategic management skills, Excellent written and verbal communication; Computer skills; Research and policy formulation; Presentation skills; Analytical and problem-solving skills; Candidates must be confident, trustworthy, accurate, adaptable and diplomatic.: Strategic Capacity and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management and Change Management, promotion communication.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for providing strategic leadership and management to the Chief Directorate: Legal and Legislative Services, comprising the Directorates: Litigation and Advisory Services and Legislative Services. Provide high-level, independent and practical legal advice to the Minister, Director-General and the Department on constitutional, administrative, education and public law matters. Managing and overseeing litigation involving the Minister, the Director-General and the Department, including the development of litigation strategy, the instruction of the State Attorney and external counsel, and the monitoring of court orders and settlements. Leading and overseeing the drafting, amendment, interpretation and implementation of education legislation, regulations and related legal instruments. Coordinating and monitoring the Department’s legislative programme and ensuring that proposed legislation and policy are constitutionally and legally sound. Providing legal support, where appropriate, to provincial education departments on matters affecting the national basic education system. Advising on the legal mandates, governance and administration of statutory bodies falling within the basic education portfolio. Drafting, reviewing and negotiating national and international agreements, memoranda of understanding and other legal instruments. Developing and maintaining systems for legal risk management, compliance monitoring and the implementation of legal opinions and court orders. Managing the Chief Directorate’s human, financial and operational resources and ensuring effective performance, accountability and service delivery.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Monyela Tel No: (012) 357 3294/ Mr M Segowa Tel No: (012) 357 4291 OTHER POST
jobs.applications: Submitted via post to: Private Bag X895, Pretoria, 0001 or hand-deliver to: The Department of Basic Education, 222 Struben Street, Pretoria or you can email your application Sechele.O@dbe.gov.za/Monyela.N@dbe.gov.za/Segowa.M@dbe.gov.za/Ku malo.N@dbe.gov.za. Please visit the Department of Education’s website at www.education.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the most recently approved Z83 Application for Employment Form, obtainable from the DBE Website or any Public Service Department/Webpage. Use of the old Z83 Form will result in disqualification. The Z83 must be completed in full and page 2 duly signed. A clear indication of the post and reference number that is being applied for must be indicated on your Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 with a detailed Curriculum Vitae (only). Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates on or before the day of the interview. Successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks, qualification and employment verification including social media profiles). Appointment is subject to positive results of the security clearance process. The successful candidate will be required to sign an annual performance agreement and, where applicable, annually disclose his/her financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Applicants, who do not comply with the requirements outlined above, will not be considered. A Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) (Nyukela Certificate) is required for all SMS appointments; the full detail of the outlined requirements and course information       can      be     sourced       by      following     the     link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course-SMS-pre-entry programme. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Regs- en Wetgewingsdienste
af.summary: Loods die Hoofdirektoraat vir Regs- en Wetgewingsdienste by die Department of Basic Education, deur strategiese regsadvies te verskaf en litigasie en wetgewingsdienste te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureus-grade in die regte (LLB) of ekwivalente regsqualifikasie (NQF level 7) wat deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) erken word; Toelating as 'n prokureur of advokaat in Suid-Afrika; Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet in goeie standing by die relevante professionele regulerende liggaam wees. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se relevante post-kwalifikasie regservaring, waarvan ten minste 5 jaar op senior bestuursvlak moet wees; Ervaring in die interpretasie, ontwikkeling, implementering en/of litigasie van wetgewing, beleide en regulasies binne die onderwyssektor of 'n vergelykbare openbare sektor omgewing; Aantoonbare ervaring in onderwysreg, insluitend ervaring in die advisering oor, ontwikkeling, interpretasie of implementering van onderwyswetgewing, regulasies of beleid, is 'n noodsaaklike vereiste; Bewese ervaring in grondwetlike reg, administratiewe reg, wetgewingsopstelling en regulatoriese ontwikkeling, openbare sektor litigasie en regulatoriese bestuur sal 'n voordeel wees; Kennis van Administratiewe reg en grondwetlike reg soos toegepas op die onderwyssektor; Vermoë om regsadviesdienste aan regeringsdepartemente, openbare entiteite of statutêre liggame te verskaf. Prosesbevoegdhede: Kennisbestuur; probleemoplossing en analise; kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus; kommunikasie; onderhandeling; belanghebbende bestuur; en risikobestuur. Kernbevoegdhede Die pos vereis 'n persoon met uitstekende Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; mensebestuur en bemagtiging; finansiële bestuur; veranderingsbestuur; programme- en projekbestuur; en dienslewering innovering. leierskap en strategiese bestuursvaardighede, Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardighede; Navorsing en beleidsformulering; Aanbiedingsvaardighede; Analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Kandidate moet selfversekerd, betroubaar, akkuraat, aanpasbaar en diplomatiek wees.: Strategiese kapasiteit en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, finansiële bestuur en veranderingsbestuur, bevordering kommunikasie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van strategiese leierskap en bestuur aan die Hoofdirektoraat: Regs- en Wetgewingsdienste, wat bestaan uit die Direktorate: Litigasie en Adviesdienste en Wetgewingsdienste. Verskaf hoëvlak-, onafhanklike en praktiese regsadvies aan die Minister, Direkteur-generaal en die Departement oor grondwetlike, administratiewe, onderwys- en publiekregtelike aangeleenthede. Bestuur en toesig hou oor litigasie waarin die Minister, die Direkteur-generaal en die Departement betrokke is, insluitend die ontwikkeling van litigasiestrategie, die instruksie van die Prokureur-generaal en externe prokureurs, en die monitering van hofbevele en skikkings. Lei en hou toesig oor die opstel, wysiging, interpretasie en implementering van onderwyswetgewing, regulasies en verwante regsinstrumente. Koördineer en monitor die Departement se wetgewingsprogram en verseker dat voorgestelde wetgewing en beleid grondwetlik en regsgeldig is. Verskaf regssteun, waar toepaslik, aan provinsiale onderwysdepartemente oor aangeleenthede wat die nasionale basiese onderwysstelsel raak. Adviseer oor die regsmagte, bestuur en administrasie van statutêre liggame wat binne die basiese onderwysportefeulje val. Stel nasionale en internasionale ooreenkomste, memoranda van ooreenkoms en ander regsinstrumente op, hersien en onderhandel dit. Ontwikkel en handhaaf stelsels vir regsrisikobestuur, nakomingsmonitering en die implementering van regsmenings en hofbevele. Bestuur die Hoofdirektoraat se menslike, finansiële en operasionele hulpbronne en verseker doeltreffende prestasie, aanspreeklikheid en dienslewering.

zu.title: Chief Director: Legal and Legislative Services
zu.summary: Bhekisa iChief Directorate ye Legal and Legislative Services e Department of Basic Education, inikeza eluleko lezomthetho elihle kanye nokuphatha izinkantolo nezinsiza zomthetho.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele zeBachelor of Laws (LLB) noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezomthetho (NQF level 7) ezibhekwayo yiSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA); Ukwamukelwa njengesimeli noma njengomelomthetho eSouth Africa; Ofakwayo kufanele abe ngokuhambisana nomhlaba nomzimba nenhlangano e Lawula uhlelo lomthetho. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-10 isipiliyoni esidlule emsebenzini womthetho, lapho okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 kufanele kube ngazinga eliphezulu lokubusa; Isipiliyoni ekuyalweni, ekuthuthukiseni, ekusetshenzisweni kanye/noma ekulweni izinkantolo zomthetho, amagomopolo nemithetho elawulayo ngaphakathi kwesigaba semfundo noma endaweni efanayo yomphakathi; Isipiliyoni esibonakalayo emthethweni wemfundo, kufaka phakathi isipiliyoni ekwelulekeni, ekuthuthukiseni, ekuhumusheni noma ekuphathweni imithetho yemfundo, imithetho elawulayo noma umgomopolo, sibadingo esibalulek; Isipiliyono esibonwayo emthethweni womthethosisekelo, emthethweni wolawulo, ekubhaleni imithetho nasekuthuthukiseni imithetho elawulayo, ezinkantolo zomphakathi kanye nolawulo loluho bayobe lusiza; Ulwazi ngomthetho Wolawulo kanye nomthetho wosisekelo njengoba usetshenziswe esigabeni semfundo; Ikhono lokuletha izinsiza zeluleko lezomthetho emaphikweni kahulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi noma izinhlangano ezisemthethweni. Izindlela zokwenza: Ukulawula ulwazi; ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda; ukujula kubathengi futhi bagxile kubathengi; ukuthintana; ukuthatha izinkulumo; ukuphatha abahlanganyeli; kanye nokuphatha ingozi. Amakhono abalulekile Isikhundla sifuna umuntu onesipho esihle sebhola nokuBusa; ukuphatha abantu futhi banike amandla; ukuphatha izimali; ukuphatha inguquko; ukuphatha amaphrogramu kanye namaphrojekthi; kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwensiza ebcathulwe. Amakhono obuholi noku Busa nge strategic; Isipho sobuhle bokuhumusha nokukhuluma; Amakhono ekhompyutha; ukucwaninga nokubumba umgomopolo; Amakhono okubamba inkulumo; Amakhono okuhlaziya futhi axazulule izinkinga; Abafakwayo kumele baqiniseke, baqotho, baqonde kahle, baguquguquke futhi babe nobuhlakani.: Isipho sobuholi nokuBusa, ukuphatha abantu futhi banike amandla, ukuphatha izimali kanye nokuphatha inguquko, ukuthuthukiswa kokuthintana.
zu.duties: Omunye ofakwayo kuzophatheka ngokunikeza ubuholi nobulawuzi obuhle kanye nokuphatha iChief Directorate: Legal and Legislative Services, ehlanganisa iDirectorates: Litigation and Advisory Services kanye neLegislative Services. Nikela ngeluleko lezomthetho eliphezulu, elizele nobungcweti kuMinista, uDirector-General kanye noMnyango ezindabeni zomthethosisekelo, zolawulozemisebenzi, zemfundo kanye nomthetho kazwelonke. Ikwelulekiswa ukuphatha nokugqamisa izinkantolo ezihilela uMinista, uDirector-General noMnyango, kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo yokulwa ezenkantolo, ukuyala kwabomthetho wezwe kanye nabomthetho bangaphandle, kanye nokuqapha imiyalo yenkantolo nezinqumo. Busa futhi ugqamise ukubhalwa, ukulungiswa, ukuhumusha kanye nokuphatha imithetho yemfundo, imithetho elawulayo kanye nezinye izinto eziphathelene nomthetho. Hlanganisa futhi uqaphele uhlelo lomthetho loMnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho ohlelwayo nomgomopolo muzomthethosisekelo futhi usemthethweni. Nikela ngesekelo lomthetho, lapho kufanele khona, kumaphiko emfundo ezifundazwe ezithinta inkqubo yemfundo yezisekelo yezwe. Luleka ngemibhalo yomthetho, ukuphathwa kanye nokulawulwa kwezinhlangano ezisemthethweni ezitholakala ngaphansi kwesigaba semfundo yezisekelo. Bhala, phinda uhlole futhi uthathe izinkulumo-mabuyekezano zamavesi amazwe nomhlaba wonke, izazimemo zokuqonda kanye nezinye izinto eziphathelene nomthetho. Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze izinhlelo zokuphathwa kengozi yomthetho, okuqapha ukulandela imiyalo kanye nokuphatha izinhlamvu zemibono yomthetho nemiyalo yenkantolo. Phatha izinsiza zabantu, ezezimali kanye nezokusebenza zeChief Directorate futhi qinisekise ukwenza kahle, ukuziphendula nokulethwa kwezinsiza.

xh.title: Umlawuli Ophambili: Iinkonzo zeZomthetho nokuBaluleka kweMithetho
xh.summary: Kukhokela iNkundla yeNkululekwa kaMlawuli Ophambili: Iinkonzo zeZomthetho nokuBaluleka kweMithetho kwiSebe leMfundo yeSiseko, nikela iingcebiso zomthetho ezibalulekileyo kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuxweba kunye neenkonzo ezithunyelwa ngokomthetho.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo seBachelors yomthetho (LLB) okanye izifundo zomthetho ezilinganayo (NQF level 7) ezivunyiweyo yiSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA); Ukamiswa njengommeli okanye igqwetha eSouth Africa; Umphumeleli kufuneka abe kumo olungileyo kubumbano olusebenza ngokusemthethweni oluhambelana naye. Iminyaka engu-10 ubudala yokugqiba izifundo zomthetho ngaphezu kokuba neso ziqu, equlethe iminyaka engu-5 ubudala enganyanzelisiyo kubalo abalam (senior managerial level); Ihlazo lokusebenza ekutolikeni, ekuphuhliseni, ekusebenziseni nasemigebeni yomthetho, kwiimboniso zomthetho (policies) kunye nemithetho yolawulo ngaphakathi kwelophu yemfundo okanye kwindawo efanayo yomphakathi wesabaphathwa ngayo; Ihlazo ebonakalise ngokusebenza kwelizwi lomthetho welophu yemfundo, kuquka nahlazo lokucebisa, ekwakhiweni, ekutolikeni nasemsebenzisweni womthetho wolawulo welophu yemfundo, ngumfuno osemgqeni; Ihlazo elibonise ngokumthetho webango nabazinga (constitutional law), umthetho wolawulo loorhwebo (administrative law), ukuhlohla komthetho nokuphuhliswa kolawulo (legislative drafting), iinkqubo zemigebenyange yesixeko somphakathi (public sector litigation) nolawulo kuzo zonke ezi ndawo kuya kuba luncedo; Ulwazi ngomthetho wolawulo (administrative law) nomthetho webango nabazinga njengoko kusetyenziswa kwelophu yemfundo; Ihlazo lokunikela iinkonzo zengcebiso zomthetho kumaphandle esebe karhulumente, kubhunga ebalulekileyo (public entities) okanye kumagunya amathetho (statutory bodies). Ukuziphatha emsebenzini (Process competencies): Ulwazi ngokulawula ulwazi; ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda ngokucokisise; ukuzinikela kumthengi nokuqwalasela iimfuno zakhe; iindlela zokubonakalisa iingcinga (communication); iindlela zokubetha ingxaki (negotiation); ukusingathwa ngokulingana ngamaphakathi (stakeholder management); nokuqonda iingozigumbi nokuzilawula. Iimfuno eziphakathi (Core Competencies): Esi sithuba sifuna umntu onamandla okulinga amandla aye ngokuphuhlisa iindlela ezintsha zobunye (Strategic capability) nokuqhuba; ukulawula abantu nokubakhuthaza ukuba bezimisele ngokuzimisela kwakhe; ukulawula iimali nokuqonda ukubaluleka kokuguquguquka; ukusebenzela ngokuzimisela kumagunya abantu; ukulawula iinkqubo neenkqubo ezingathunyelwa ngokomsebenzi; nokuphuhlisa iindlela ezintsha zokwamkela iinkonzo abazifunayo. Iimfuno zobuqu: ukulawula abantu ngokomsebenzi, ukubakhuthaza, iindlela zokulawula iimali, nokuzimisela ngokusebenzela nabo, ngokubonisa abakwenzayo, nokuthobela iingcebiso ezithunyelwa ngokuyivelwana ngamaphandle karhulumente abanakho ukuthengisa amagunya abo. : Imandla aqhuba ngokusesikweni nokuBekisa uLawulo, uLawulo lwabantu nokubakhuthaza, uLawulo lweMatyi nokuguqula iindlela, ukuthuthuzela nokwazisa ngesandla esilula nangesiNgesi; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha; ulwazi ngeendlela zokucinga ngokucokisise ekusebenziseni amagunya; ulwazi ngeendlela zokubonisa ngokucokisise amandla okukhokela iiprojekthi; ukulunga ngokutolika iingxaki nokuzisombulula. Abathunyelwa kufuneka babe ngabathembekileyo, bakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuba abanazizigqibo ezahlukeneyo ezingathathi hlangothi, bazi ukubeka kuqala iingcinga ezibalulekileyo, bazi ukuhlangabezana namava ngokuzimisela ngokusebenzela abantu, bazi ukulingana nezinye iingcali ngangona bethanda na ngokuzimisela.
xh.duties: Umphumeleli uya kuba netyala lokunikela amandla okuthath’iingxoxo ezibalulekileyo nokusingathwa kokuLawuLwa iNkundla yeNkululekwa kaMlawuli Ophambili: Iinkonzo zeZomthetho nokuBaluleka kweMithetho, equlethe oMlawuli baseNkundla yeNkululekwa: Iinkqubo zeMigebenyange zeLizwi (Litigation) kunye neNkonzo eNika iNgcebiso (Advisory Services) neNkonzo yeNkqubo yoMthetho (Legislative Services). Nika iingcebiso zamaphakathi aqavileyo, azimeleyo ngaphezu kokusebenza ezenza umthetho webango nabazinga (public law), wolawulo (administrative law), wemfundo nolwazi lomphakathi kuSihlalo weNgangezandla (Minister), uMlawuli-Jikelele (Director-General) naseSebeni. Lawula kwaye ulawule inkqubo yemigebenyange ehamba phambi kweNkantola equka uSihlalo weNgangezandla (Minister), uMlawuli-Jikelele (Director-General) nesebe karhulumente leNkundla, kuquka nokuqonda ukulawula iinkqubo zokulungiselela imigeba, nokunikela iingcebiso ngokukhetha oogqetha babakho karhulumene abakumagunya asemthethweni nasemaphandle eNkundla yooMengamela bakaRhulumente (State Attorney), kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zeNkundla nangeengcamango-magunya (settlements) zonke iinkantola ezingatsho iingcamango ngokukhethwa kwazo. Khokela kwaye ulawule ukucwengwa nokuhlohlwa komthetho wolawulo welophu yemfundo, ukulungiswa, ukutolikwa nokusetyenziswa kwawo nolunye ulwazi oluqhutshwa lumthetho. Qhagamshela kwaye ulawule inkqubo yomthetho othunyelwe ngokusemthethweni yoSebe kwaye uqinisekise ukuba umthetho oqulunqwe kwaye imiboniso yomthetho (policies) ivunyelwe ngokomthetho webango nabazinga nangokomthetho wonke. Nika inkxaso yomthetho, apho kufuneka khona, kumaphandle esebe karhulumente nakumaphakathi asebenza ngokutsha nasekubeni ngamaphandle afuna ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo zemfundo yonke lapha kusebenza ngayo nkqubo yemfundo yokukhetha iinkqubo ezifikelela kubantu abaninzi. Nikela iingcebiso ngamagunya abo abasemthethweni, ngokulawulwa kwabo nangokusingathwa ngokomthetho kwabo kumagunya asemthethweni apha phakathi kwalo nyulo lophuhlisa iinkqubo zemfundo yoluntu (basic education). Cwenga, peluza kwaye uthenge iingqalinganiselo zengingqi namazwe ngamazwe, iinkcukacha ezingagqibekanga ngomthetho zokuvana njengamaphandle kunye nolunye oluqhutshwa lumthetho. Phuhlisa kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo zokulinganisa iingxaki zomthetho ezifikelela kumaphandle ashiya iinkalo zokungabi nayindlela yokuhlangabezana nomthetho nokusetyenziswa kweekhomitya zeNgcebiso (legal opinions) nokuqwalaselwa kweenkqubo ezithunyelwa zibe ngumthetho othunyelwa nguRhulumente ukuba abantu abalawulwayo bayenze into ethileyo okanye bangayenziyo (court orders). Lawula iziseko zabantu, iimali nakwamanye amagunya aye asetyenziselwa ukulungelelana nokuLawuLwa iNkundla yeNkululekwa kaMlawuli Ophambili: Iinkonzo zeZomthetho nokuBaluleka kweMithetho kwaye uqinisekise amandla okusebenza okubamb'inqaba, ukuzimisela ukwenza okubalulekileyo kwaye abantu bakho bathole iinkonzo abazifunayo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role in the Department of Basic Education conducting research and evaluations across schools, districts and provincial offices.
jobs.requirements: The applicants must be in possession of an appropriate three-year (NQF level 6) post matric qualification or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA; Four (4) years’ relevant experience as an Assistant Director or equivalent level in the education sector; A sound knowledge of the education policy and legislation environment; Must have a strong language competency in Sepedi, Setswana or isiZulu; Knowledge of matrix and project management; Experience in qualitative and/or quantitative research methodology; Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines; Ability to work independently without supervision to meet targets; Sound analytical skills; Report writing and presentation skills, including MS PowerPoint presentation skills; Strong communication (verbal and writing) skills; Computer skills in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Access and Outlook); Willingness to work extensive hours and be prepared to travel; A valid driver’s licence; Passion to make a positive contribution to South African education.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be liaising with district officials and school management teams to prepare for evaluations/research; Conducting independent research/evaluation in sampled schools, districts and provincial offices following prescribed evaluation protocol and evaluation instruments; Analysing data using appropriate qualitative and quantitative tools or techniques; Providing a clear assessment of the state if teaching and learning in all schools, districts and provincial offices evaluated, this will include collecting and analysing data; As an integral part of a school evaluation process, observe educators in practice using approved instruments; Writing, editing and analysing reports as well as provide recommendations for improvement; Collating reports from different members of the evaluation team; Analysing research/evaluation reports to identify emerging trends within districts and schools; Conducting document analysing and preparing reports with recommendation regarding the course of action that the Basic Education Sector needs to take; Verifying the findings of a school self-evaluation; Contributing to standards setting in education; Sharing research findings in different platforms and structures; Identifying problem areas within the basic education sectors and outline action research, which seek to address them; Performing any other functions as deemed appropriate by the Supervisor within the ambit of labour law.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Monyela Tel No: (012) 357 3294/ Mr M Segowa Tel No: (012) 357 4291
jobs.applications: Submitted via post to: Private Bag X895, Pretoria, 0001 or hand-deliver to: The Department of Basic Education, 222 Struben Street, Pretoria or you can email your application Sechele.O@dbe.gov.za/Monyela.N@dbe.gov.za/Segowa.M@dbe.gov.za/Ku malo.N@dbe.gov.za. Please visit the Department of Education’s website at www.education.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the most recently approved Z83 Application for Employment Form, obtainable from the DBE Website or any Public Service Department/Webpage. Use of the old Z83 Form will result in disqualification. The Z83 must be completed in full and page 2 duly signed. A clear indication of the post and reference number that is being applied for must be indicated on your Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 with a detailed Curriculum Vitae (only). Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates on or before the day of the interview. Successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks, qualification and employment verification including social media profiles). Appointment is subject to positive results of the security clearance process. The successful candidate will be required to sign an annual performance agreement and, where applicable, annually disclose his/her financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Applicants, who do not comply with the requirements outlined above, will not be considered. A Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) (Nyukela Certificate) is required for all SMS appointments; the full detail of the outlined requirements and course information       can      be     sourced       by      following     the     link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course-SMS-pre-entry programme. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos in die Department of Basic Education wat navorsing en evaluerings oor skole, distrikte en provinsiale kantore uitvoer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n toepaslike driejaar- (NQF vlak 6) post-matriekkwalifikasie of ekwivalente kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken; Vier (4) jaar se relevante ervaring as 'n Assistentdirekteur of ekwivalente vlak in die onderwysektor; 'n Deeglike kennis van die onderwysbeleid- en wetgewingsomgewing; Moet oor sterk taalbevoegdheid in Sepedi, Setswana of isiZulu beskik; Kennis van matriks- en projekbestuur; Ervaring in kwalitatiewe en/of kwantitatiewe navorsingsmetodologie; Vermoe om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom; Vermoe om onafhanklik sonder toesig te werk om teikens te bereik; Sterk analitiese vaardighede; Verslagskryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede, insluitend MS PowerPoint-aanbiedingsvaardighede; Sterk kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik); Rekenaarvaardighede in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Access en Outlook); Bereidwilligheid om lang ure te werk en bereid wees om te reis; 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie; Passie om 'n positiewe bydrae tot Suid-Afrikaanse onderwys te lewer.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal met distrikamptenare en skoolbestuurspanne skakel om voorbereiding te tref vir evaluerings/navorsing; Onafhanklike navorsing/evaluering in gemonsterde skole, distrikte en provinsiale kantore uitvoer volgens die voorgeskrewe evaluingsprotokol en evalueringsinstrumente; Data ontleed met behulp van toepaslike kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe instrumente of tegnieke; 'n Duidelike assessering van die toestand van onderrig en leer in alle geëvalueerde skole, distrikte en provinsiale kantore verskaf, wat die insamel en ontleed van data sal behels; As 'n integrale deel van 'n skoolevalueringsproses, opvoeders in die praktyk observeer met behulp van goedgekeurde instrumente; Verslae skryf, redigeer en ontleed, asook aanbevelings vir verbetering verskaf; Verslae van verschillende lede van die evalueringspan samestel; Navorsings/evalueringsverslae ontleed om opkomende tendense binne distrikte en skole te identifiseer; Dokumentontleding uitvoer en verslae met aanbevelings voorberei rakende die optrede wat die Basiese Onderwyssektor moet neem; Die bevindings van 'n skoolselfevaluering verifieer; Bydra tot standaardstelling in onderwys; Navorsingsbevindings op verschillende platforms en strukture deel; Probleemareas binne die basiese onderwysektore identifiseer en aksienavorsing uiteensit wat daarna streef om dit aan te spreek; Enige ander funksies verrig soos deur die toesighouer as gepas geag binne die bestek van die arbeidswetgewing.

zu.title: Isikhulumeli-Sikhulu
zu.summary: Indima yesikhulumeli-sikhulu eKhomishani yeZemfundo eYisisekelo yokwenza ucwaningo nokuhlola ezikoleni, emaphandleni nasemahhovisi ezifundazwe.
zu.requirements: Abafakelayo kumele babe nesiqu semfundo esifanele seminyaka emithathu (NQF level 6) ngemva kwe-matric noma esiqeshana esilinganayo njengoba setshunwe i-SAQA; Beminyaka emine (4) yohlelo oluhambisanayo njengoMqondisi oNcedisayo noma izinga elinganayo emkhakheni wezemfundo; Ukwazi kahle inqubomgomo yemfundo nemveliso yomthetho; Kumele babe nobuhlakani obusinda obululumini ngolimi lwesiPedi, isiTswana noma isiZulu; Ulwazi lokuphatha imatrix namaphrojekthi; Hlelo lokwenza ucwaningo ngokwesimo noma ngokwenani noma kokubili; Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi nokuhlangabeza izikhathi zokuvala; Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa ngaphandle kolawulo ukuze kufeze izinto ezibekiwe; Amakhono okuhlaziya ahle kakuhle; Amandla okubhala imibiko nokubhukuda, kuhlanganise namandla okubhukuda ku-MS PowerPoint; Amakhono okuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala) ahle kakuhlu; Amakhono wekhompyutha ku-MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Access kanye ne-Outlook); Idumo elokwokusebenza isikhathi eside futhi okulungele ukuhamba; Ilayisenisi yokushayela eseleyo; Inhliziyo yokuthatha inxaxheba emzamweni wemfundo yaseNingizimu Afrika.
zu.duties: Omunye ophumelelayo uzoxhumana nabasebenzi bamaphandle namaphuzu aphethwe amabhodi wezikole okulungelela ukuhlola/ucwaningo; Ukwazi ukwenza ucwaningo/ukuhlola ezikoleni ezithunyiwe, emaphandleni nasemahhovisi ezifundazwe ngokulandiza imethlothi yokuhlola nemithi yokuhlola; Ukwahlula idatha ngokusebenzisa imithi noma amasu afanele ngokwesimo nangokwenani; Ukwethula isilinganiso esicacile ngobumo bokufundisa nokufunda ezikoleni zonke, emaphandleni nasemahhovisi ezifundazwe ezihlolewayo, lokhu kuzohlanganisa ukuthutha futhi ukuwahlula idatha; Njengengxenye ebalulekile yenqubo yokuhlola ibhodi lesikole, ukubukela othisha bedlula esikhundleni ngesikhathi ngemithi evunyiwe; Ukwabhala, ukuhlela nokuhlaziya imibiko ngokunjalo nokunikeza izincoma zokuphucula; Ukuqoqa imibiko esuka kubaluli abahlukene bethimba lokuhlola; Ukuhlaziya imibiko yokucwaningo/ukuhlola ukuthola imigqa eqhamukayo emaphandleni nasezikoleni; Ukwazi ukuhlaziya amadokhumenti nokulungelela imibiko enezincoma ngomkhakha ohleka othi i-Sekitha yoZemfundo eYisisekelo imele ithathe; Ukuqinisekisa iziphumo zokuzihlola isikole; Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekubekeni izinga ezemfundo; Ukwabelana ngesiphumu sokucwaningo kumaphulatifomu namasakhiwo ahlukene; Ukuhlola izindawo ezingezinhle ezikhakheni zemfundo eziphansi bese uchaza ucwaningo lwenzo, olubheka ukulungisa lezo zindawo; Ukwenzanoma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi njengoba kubukeka kufanele nguMqondisi ngaphakathi kwesibopho somthetho wezisebenzi.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli
xh.summary: Indima yaseSekela Mongameli kwisebe lezeMfundo eMbangi yokwenza uphando nokuqwalasela kumaziko emfundo, kumaphondo nakweziko karhulumente kabaphondo.

xh.duties: Umfo ongumnqwazi uza kudibana namalungu aphondo nakwithimba yolawulo lesikolo ukuze alungiselele ukuqwalasela/uphando; Akuqwalasela/uphando ngokuzimela kwizikolo ezikhethekileyo, kumaphondo nakweziko karhulumente kabaphondo esilandela imigaqo ebalulekileyo nezixhobo zokuqwalasela; Uhlola idatha esebenzisa izixhobo okanye iindlela ezifanelekileyo zobungakanani nabungakanani; Unika isilinganiso esicacileyo ngesimo sokufundisa nokufunda kwazo zonke izikolo, kumaphondo nakweziko karhulumente kabaphondo ekuqwalaselweyo, okuza kuquka ukuqokelela nokuhlola idatha; Njengenxalenye ephambili yenkqubo yokuqwalasela isikolo, uqwalasela ootitshala esebenzisa izixhobo ezivunyiweyo; Ubhala, uhlela futh uhlola iiripothi kananjalo unike iingcebiso zokuphucula; Uqokelela iiripothi ezivela kulwahlwanlalwahlulelo abavela kwikomiti yokuqwalasela; Uhlola iiripothi zophando/okuqwalasela ukuze atsho izimbonakaliso ezisavelayo kumaphondo nakwizikolo; Uqwalasela amaxwebhu futh ulungiselela iiripothi eenkcazelo mayela nendlela ekufuneka ithathe iSebe leMfundo; Uqinisekisa iziphumo zokuqwalasela isikolo ngokwalo; Unika isabelo ekusekeni iigunya kwimfundo; Ukwabelana ngeziphumo zophando kumaza ngamaza nasemihlaba; Uchaza iindawo ezinengxaki kwemi yemfundo yaseMzantsi Afrika futh uyaphawula uphando oluthathiweyo ngokuzimisela ukulungisa le ngxaki; Uzenza nawuphi na omnye umsebenzi njengoko kubonakalise ngumlawuli ngaphakathi kwemithetho yabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Chief Deputy Commissioner: Incarceration and Corrections
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 August 2026 @ 15h45. It is the sole responsibility of an applicant to ensure that their application reaches the Department of Correctional Services before closing date.
jobs.summary: Chief Deputy Commissioner role at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office in Pretoria, responsible for managing incarceration policies and inmate management processes.
jobs.requirements: A postgraduate qualification (NQF level 8) in Behavioural Sciences/ Social Sciences/Public Administration or equivalent as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). (8) Years’ senior managerial level experience in a similar environment. A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory (required from all applicants prior to appointment). Security Clearance. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Required Knowledge: Understanding of the dynamics of the Justice Cluster. Understanding of the public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act and Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Competencies and Attributes: Knowledge and understanding of Public Service policies and mandates. Knowledge of all legislation, norms and standards that governs health care. Understanding of DCS Environment, parole administration, tracing, community mobilisation, corrections management, remand detention, management of overcrowding, security, continuous risk assessment tool, personal development, relevant prescripts, case management, social cohesiveness, screening and assessment, care planning and coordination. Quality improvement. PFMA – compilation of budgets, estimation, expenditure and reporting. Applied strategic thinking, communication, project management, presentations, report writing skills. Service delivery standards. Developing others (coaching, mentoring, training). Project and programme management. Decision making, problem solving, networking / liaison with stakeholders, negotiation, organising, conflict management and analytical thinking. Policy development, analysis, monitoring, evaluation and implementation advice. Information collection.
jobs.duties: Manage incarceration and design, develop and review policies, procedures and guidelines for inmate management within the Department of Correctional Services in line with the Correctional Services Act and the White Paper on Corrections. Review and evaluate inmate management processes such as inmate discipline, re-integration, and inmate investigations. Ensure effective correctional security operations and the safe custody of all incarcerated persons, while maintaining a safe and secure environment that supports the rehabilitation of offenders and those under community corrections. Ensure safe and secure DCS facilities and provide security standards services with respect to DCS. Design, develop and facilitate infrastructure and facilities maintenance programmes. Ensure that facilities are kept at required minimum standards set out by the relevant legislation, national and local standards, in particular, DCS requirements. Management of performance information. Management of human resources, finances and assets.
jobs.enquiries: Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589 or Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307
jobs.applications: Indicate the reference number and position you are applying for on your application form (Z83) and send your complete application to: The Department of Correctional Services, Post Advertisement Section, Private Bag X136, Pretoria, 0001 OR hand deliver at: 124 WF Nkomo Street, Poyntons Building, Corner WF Nkomo and Sophie De Bruyn Street, Pretoria, 0001 (Previous: Corner Church and Schubart Street) OR you can submit your application online at: https://careers.dcs.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Appointment under the Correctional Service Act Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. A pre-entry certificate from the National School of Government (NSG) is required from all applicants prior to appointment. The full details of the SMS pre-entry course are obtainable on: Certificate for entry into the SMS (Senior Management Service) | thensg Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification/s and criminal records verification. Appointment to some of these posts will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the department. Following the interview and technical exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA directive on the implementation of competency- based assessment). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tool. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Please send a separate and complete application for each post you are applying for, stating the correct reference for each position you are interested in. Candidates must comply with the minimum appointment requirements. CV’s should be aligned to reflect one’s degree of compliance with the advert requirements and responsibilities. The Department of Correctional Services reserves the right not to fill any of these advertised posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoofadjunkkommissaris: Gevangenisering en Korrektiewe Dienste
af.summary: Hoofadjunkkommissaris-rol by die Departement of Correctional Services se nasionale hoofkantoor in Pretoria, verantwoordelik vir die bestuur van gevangeniseringsbeleide en gevangene-bestuursprosesse.
af.requirements: 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 8) in Gedragswetenskappe/Sosiale Wetenskappe/Openbare Administrasie of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). (8) Jaar se senior bestuursvlak-ervaring in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. 'n Sertifikaat vir toetrede tot die Senior Management Services (SMS) wat by die National School of Government (NSG) verkry is, is verpligtend (vereis van alle applikante voor aanstelling). Sekuriteitsklarering. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Begrip van die dinamika van die Justisieklauster. Begrip van die openbare diensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act and Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en Eienskappe: Kennis en begrip van Openbare Diensbeleide en mandate. Kennis van alle wetgewing, norme en standaarde wat gesondheidsorg regeer. Begrip van die DCS-omgewing, parooladministrasie, opsporing, gemeenskapsmobilisering, korreksiebestuur, aanhouding van aangehoudenes, bestuur van oorbevolking, sekuriteit, deurlopende risikobevalingsinstrument, persoonlike ontwikkeling, relevante voorskrifte, gevallebestuur, sosiale samehorigheid, sifting en assessering, sorgbeplanning en koördinering. Kwaliteitsverbetering. PFMA – opstel van begrotings, raming, besteding en verslagdoening. Toegepaste strategiese denke, kommunikasie, projekbestuur, voorleggings, verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Diensleweringstandaarde. Ontwikkeling van ander (afrigter, mentor, opleiding). Projek- en programbestuur. Besluitneming, probleemoplossing, netwerkbreï/skakeling met belanghebbendes, onderhandeling, organisering, konflikbestuur en analitiese denke. Beleidontwikkeling, analise, monitering, evaluering en implementeringsadvies. Inligtingversameling.
af.duties: Bestuur gevangeniserings- en ontwerp, ontwikkel en hersien beleide, prosedures en riglyne vir gevangene-bestuur binne die Departement of Correctional Services in ooreenstemming met die Correctional Services Act en die White Paper on Corrections. Hersien en evalueer gevangene-bestuursprosesse soos gevangenetug, herintegrasie en gevangene-ondersoeke. Verseker doeltreffende korrektiewe sekuriteitsbedrywighede en die veilige bewaring van alle gevangen persone, terwyl 'n veilige en beveiligde omgewing gehandhaaf word wat die rehabilitasie van oortreders en dié onder gemeenskapskorreksies ondersteun. Verseker veilige en beveiligde DCS-fasiliteite en verskaf sekuriteitsstandaarddienste met betrekking tot DCS. Ontwerp, ontwikkel en fasiliteer infrastruktuur- en fasiliteite-onderhoudsprogramme. Verseker dat fasiliteite gehou word by die vereiste minimumstandaarde wat deur die relevante wetgewing, nasionale en plaaslike standaarde uiteengesit is, in besonder DCS-vereistes. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

zu.title: Chief Deputy Commissioner: Incarceration and Corrections
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaChief Deputy Commissioner e-Department of Correctional Services National Head Office e-Pretoria, esibhekene nokuphathwa kwezinqubomgomo zokuboshiwa kanye nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwababoshiwe.
zu.requirements: Isiqu sezipostgraduate (NQF level 8) kwi-Behavioural Sciences/ Social Sciences/Public Administration noma okulinganayo njengoba kuqashwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). (8) iminyaka yemfundo yokuphatha esezingeni eliphezulu endaweni efanayo. Isitifiketi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholakale e-National School of Government (NSG) iyaphothula (idingwa kubo bonke abafakisi ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Ukuqinisekiswa kokuphepha. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oludingekayo: Ukuqonda ukuphila kwesikhungo se-Justice Cluster. Ukuqonda inqubomgomo yesevisi yomphakathi nesakhiwo somthetho ohlobene (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act and Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 njengoba kulungisiwe). Amandla nezici: Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nemigomo yesevisi yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngawo wonke umthetho, amaningi namazinga aphatha inhlalo yenhlalo. Ukuqonda imvelo ye-DCS, ukuphathwa kwe-parole, ukulandwa, ukumobilisa umphakathi, ukuphathwa kokulungisa, ukuboshwa kwesikhashana, ukuphathwa kwesixuku, ukuphepha, ithuluzi lokuhlola ingozi ephila, ukuthuthukiswa kwomuntu, iziyalezo ezihlobene, ukuphathwa kwecala, ukubamba umphakathi, ukuhlola futhi uhlole, ukulungiselela ukunakekela kanye nohlelo. Ukuthuthukiswa kokulingana. PFMA – ukubumba amabhajethi, ukulinganisa, ukusebenzisa futhi kubike. Ukucabanga ngokobuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, ukubonisa, amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amazinga okulethwa isevisi. Ukuthuthukisa abanye (ukulekela, ukulekela, ukufundisa). Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaprojekthi. Ukwenza izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumanisa / ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli, ukuxoxisana, ukulungiselela, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya ukucabanga. Ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, ukuhlaziya, ukulawula, ukuhlola kanye neluleko lokusebenzisa.okuqoqa ulwazi.
zu.duties: Phatha inkohlakalo kanye nokubumba, ukuthuthukisa nokubuyekeza izinqubomgomo, izinqubo nemihlahlandlela yokuphathwa kwabagibeli ngaphakathi kwi-Department of Correctional Services ngokuhambisana ne-Correctional Services Act kanye ne-White Paper on Corrections. Buyekeza futhi uhlole izinqubo zokuphathwa kwabagibeli njengesiyalo sabagibeli, ukubuyiselwa emphakathini, kanye nokuphenya ngabagibeli. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kahle kwezokuphepha ezenhlangano zokulungisa kanye nokugcinwa ngokuphepha kwabo bonke ababoshiwe, ngesikhathi esifanayo sigcina imvelo ephephile nevikela ukwesekwa ukulungiswa kwabayisokeyo nalabo abaseduze nolungelelwaniso lw emphakathini. Qinisekisa izingqikithi eziphephile futhi zivikelekile ze-DCS futhi ahlinze ngamasevisi amazinga okuphepha mayelana ne-DCS. Bumba, thuthukisa futhi uncike ezinhlelweni zokugcinwa kwezakhiwo namasiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasiza agcinwa emazingeni abeke njengoba kuqokelelwe umthetho ohlobene, emazingeni kazwelonke nasendawo, ikakhulukazi, izidingo ze-DCS. Ukuphathwa kolwazi ngemisebenzi egqamile. Ukuphathwa kwabantu,wezimali nezimpahla.

xh.title: IKomishinala eNkulu eNtloko: Ukubethwa kweentolongo nokulungisa
xh.summary: Inkundla yeSithili seNdibano eNkulu kwiSebe lezeNkonzo zokuLungisa kwiNtloko yeZiko leRhulumente elisePretoria, ephathe ukulawula iinkqubo zokubethwa kwabantu kwiintolongo neenkqubo zokulawula iitshabi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sangemva kwesidanga (inqanaba le-8 NQF) kwiSayensi yezenkalo / iSayensi zeNtlalo / uLawulo lukaRhulumente okanye esilinganayo njengoko kuqatshwa yiSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Iminyaka (8) yamava obulumko kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo kwimo efanayo. Isatifikethi sokungena kwiinkonzo zoLawulo lwabanobulumko (SMS) esitholwe kwiNdlu yoLwazi yelizwe (NSG) sinyanzelekile (sifunwa kubo bonke abafaka izicelo ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Ukuqinisekiswa koluntu oluphakamileyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi olufunekayo: Ukuqonda iinjongo zokuqhuba phambili kwaye zohlaziywe ngokutsho kwemithetho yoluntu nokuhamba kwalo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wonke, iimfuno nemigangatho elawula inkonzo yezempilo. Ukuqonda ukusebenza kwesebe, ulawulo lokuzelelwa luluhlu lwemiqathango yokugqithisa, ulawulo lwezicelo zoluntu ngokusebenzisa iinkalo, ulawulo lweekhathalogu, ukugcina iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo nezinxulumene nazo, iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zokulawula abantu, iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zokukhokela abantu, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokukhokela abantu, iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ezinxulumene nokulawula abantu. Ukuphucula umgangatho. Imithetho yokuLawula iMali yorhulumente – ukuqulunqa amaphulo ezimali, ukulinganisa, ukusebenzisa neendaba ezixoxwayo. Ukucinga ngokubanzi, ukunxibelelanisa, ulawulo lweenkqubo, izibingelelo, amakhono okubhala iingxelo. Imigangatho yokuzelelwa kweenkonzo. Ukuphuhlisa abanye (ukulunga, ukulunga, ukulunga). Ulawulo lweenkqubo neenkqubo. Ukwenza izigqibo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukunxibelelanisa / ukunxibelelanisa nabalawuli, ukucela, ukulunga, ulawulo lwezinxabaxaba nokucinga ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo, ukuhlola, ukulawula, ukuvavanya nokunikela izindaba zokuzelelwa kweenkonzo. Ukuqokelela ulwazi.
xh.duties: Phatha indalo yokubethwa kweentolongo kwaye uphuhle, uphuhlise kwaye uhloliswe ngokutsha iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokusebenza nemikhubo yokulawula iitshabi ngaphakathi kwiSebe lezeNkonzo zokuLungisa ngokwemo yoMthetho wezeNkonzo zokuLungisa noLwazi oluMhlophe malunga nokulungisa. Hlola kwaye ulinganise iinkqubo zokulawula iitshabi njengokolawula inyameko kwezitshabi, ukubuyiselwa kwentlalo, nangeziphithiphithi ezingamatshabi. Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngempumelelo kwezosebenzo zolawulo loluntu ekubethweni kweentolongo nokuqinisekisa ukulondoloza ngokhuseleko bonke ababethwa iintolongo, ngelixa ligcina indawo ekhuselekileyo nesezinzileyo exhasa ukulungiswa kwabo bagwenxa nababo bakwisimo lonwabizo lwentlalo ekulungisweni. Qinisekisa iindawo eziqinisekisiweyo ezingakhuselekanga zezeNkonzo zokuLungisa ezingakhuselekanga kwaye ibonelele ngeenkonzo zemigangatho yalawulo loluntu ukuba ngokwemigaqo yezeNkonzo zokuLungisa. Phuhla, phuhlisa kwaye uncede ngokusungula iinkqubo zokugcina izakhiwo neendawo zokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuba izakhiwo zigcinwa kwimigangatho ebekiweyo emincinci ejolwe kumthetho oqhelekileyo, kwimigangatho yengingqi nengingqi, ngokukodwa, iimfuno zesebe. Ulawulo lweekhathalogu zenkcazelo ekuvelwayo. Ulawulo lweekhathalogu zoluntu abalawulwayo, ezemali neempahla.

jobs.summary: Regional Commissioner providing strategic leadership and offender programme management for the Department of Correctional Services across multiple regions.

af.title: Streekskommissaris
af.summary: Streekskommissaris wat strategiese leierskap en bestuur van oortredersprogramme vir die Department of Correctional Services oor verskeie streke verskaf.
af.requirements: Nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 8) in Openbare Administrasie / Regte / Kriminologie / Sosiale Wetenskappe of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Services (SMS) wat by die National School of Government (NSG) bekom is, is verpligtend (van alle aansoekers vereis voor aanstelling). 8 -10 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. Deeglike kennis van die SA Korrektiewe Stelsel en begrip van die funksionering van die Strafregstelsel. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse Strafregstelsels en die Korrektiewe Dienste-argitektuur. Begrip van staatsdiensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, met klem op die Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en Eienskappe: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Dienslewering-inovasie. Kliëntgerigtheid en klanfokus. Finansiële bestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Program- en projektebestuur. Kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Transformasiebestuur. Beïnvloeding en impak. Beleidsontwikkeling, fasilitering, konflikbestuur en konseptuele vaardighede. Diversiteitsbestuur. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Konfidensialiteit. Interpersoonlike verhoudings en tydbestuur. Verantwoordelikheid. Diplomatie en takt. Beleidsontwikkeling en implementering. Goeie korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap om effektiewe, doeltreffende en ekonomiese bestuur van die streek te verseker ter verwesenliking van beleidsuitkomste. Bestuur die verskaffing van sorgprogramme om die persoonlike welsyn van oortreders te handhaaf. Bestuur die verskaffing van programme wat op die ontwikkeling van oortreders gemik is. Bestuur die lewering van sekuriteitsdienste aan persone, diensverskaffers, die publiek, oortreders en enige ander departementele werksaamheid. Bestuur van die Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming, Sekuriteitskluster en ander belanghebbendes in die streek. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van nasorgdienste aan oortreders. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van korrektiewe programme om oortredende gedrag te korrekteer. Effektiewe risikobestuur om nakoming van die risikobestuursplan van die departement te verseker. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies, bates en prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Onozakwabo Bokulawula Amaphasi
zu.summary: Onozakwabo Bokulawula Amaphasi ukunikela ngobuholi obubalulekile nokuphathwa kwamaphulo abasemuqondweni wobugebengu ku-Department of Correctional Services kulo lonke izifundazwe eziningi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingeni le-postgraduate (NQF level 8) kuPublic Administration / Law / Criminology / Social Sciences noma iziqu ezilinganayo njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Isitifiketi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholiwe e-National School of Government (NSG) siyimpoqo (sidingwa kubo bonke abafakizicelo ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). 8 -10 unyaka wesipiliyoni esimweni sobuholi obuphezulu. Ukuqonda kahle ngokuhamba kwesistimu ye-SA Correctional System nokuzuqonda ukusebenza kwe-Criminal Justice System. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Oludingekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-South African Criminal Justice Systems nesakhiwo se-Correctional Services. Ukuqonda inqubo yomnyango kazwelonke ohlelo lwemithetho eluhlobene (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, ngokugqamisa i-Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 njengoba kulungisiwe). Izakhono nezimo: Ikhono lobuholi nokuqonda izindlela ezibalulekile. Innovation yokuletha izinsizakelo. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuqaphela izidingo zamakhasimende. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuphathwa oshintshweni. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuqinisekisa amandla abo. Ukuphathwa amaprojekthi kanye namaphulo. Izakhono zokuxhumana (ezibalomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kokuguqulwa. Ukuthonya kanye nomphumela. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo, ukukhokha, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga nokuqonda izinto ngobungcondvo. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zabantu. Izakhono zokuxoxisana. Ukugcina iwumfihlo. Izibopho zomuntu nomuntu kanye nokuphathwa isikhathi. Ukubhekelelwa. Bungcingco kanye nobuhlakaniph obuzolile. Ukuthuthukiswa nokuphoqa kwemigomo. Izimiso ezinhle zokuphathwa kwentolo ebuso elihle.
zu.duties: Nika ubuholi obubalulekile ekwenza ibe khona izindlela ezisebenzayo, ezikhicitayo nezinciphisa izindleko ekuqondweni indawo ukuze kufinyelelwe emiphumeleni yohlelo. Phatha ukunikezwa kwemikhuba yokunakekelwa ukuze kugcinwe impilo yabantu abasemuqondweni wobugebengu. Phatha ukunikezwa kwemikhuba ehlosa ukuthuthukisa abantu abasemuqondweni wobugebengu. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokuvikela kubasebenzi, abanikezeli benkonzo, umphakathi, abantu abasemuqondweni wobugebengu nanoma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi yomnyango. Phatha iqembu leNgcwebo, Ukuvikela Ubugebengu, Ukuvikela kanye nabanye abahlanganyeli endaweni. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa okulandelayo kwabantu abasemuqondweni wobugebengu. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwemikhuba yokulungisa ukuze kushintshwe ukuziphisa kokweba.enza izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuphathwa kwezingozi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana nenqubo yokuphathwa kwezingozi yomnyango. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zabantu, izimali, izimpahla nenkcazelo yemiphumela yokusebenza.

xh.title: Onququzeleli Wezifunda
xh.summary: Onququzeleli wezifunda ebonelela ngolawulo olusesikweni nolawulo lweenkqubo zokuqinisekisa i-Department of Correctional Services kumazana amaninzi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esiphezulu (NQF level 8) kwi-Public Administration / Law / Criminology / Social Sciences okanye isidanga esilinganayo njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA. Isatifikethi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esifunyenwe kwi-National School of Government (NSG) siyaphothulwa (sifunwa kubo bonke abafaka izicelo phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Unyaka wamava onke ali-8 -10 kwinqanaba eliphezulu lobaluleke. Ulwazi oluzinzileyo malunga ne-SA Correctional System nokuqonda ukusebenza kwe-Criminal Justice System. Ukuba nobugcisa ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisenesi yokushayela ethethwe ngokusemthethweni. Ulwazi Olufunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-South African Criminal Justice Systems ne-Correctional Services architecture. Ukuqonda inkqubo yesebe loluntu nendlela yolawulo edityaniswe nayo (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, ngcono phezu kwe-Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 njengoko ilungisiwe). Ikhono Neempawu: Ikhono lokuququzelela iinkqubo nokuqaqambisa ulawulo. Ukutsha iinkonzo eziziswa kakhulu kuwo wonke umntu. Ukubakholelwa kubathengi nakumanxibelelanisi. Ulawulo lwezimali. Ulawulo lwentlangano. Ulawulo lwabantu nokuqinisela abantu. Ulawulo lweenkqubo nemisebenzi. Ikhono lokunxibelelana (elishiyweyo nelibhaliweyo). Ikhono lokusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Ulawulo lokuqwalasela nokwenza utshintsho. Ukubandakanya abanye nokuba namandla. Ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo, ukulawula iingxabano, ukubonelela ngeenkqubo namakhono okuqonda. Ulawulo lweentlobo ngeentlobo zabantu. Ikhono lokucinga okanye lokuhambelana phakathi kwamaqela. Ukugcina iyimfihlo. Unxibelelwano lwabantu nolawulo lwexesha. Ukuziphendulela. Unxibelelwano oluhle nokuzipatha kakuhle. Ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo nokuzisebenzisa. Iinkqubo zolawulo oluhle loluntu nakwishishini.
xh.duties: Nika uququzelelo olusesikweni ekugqinisekiseni ukulawulwa okusebenzayo, okusebenzayo nangcono kwezomnotho kwelonke ukuze kufezekiswe iziphumo zenkqubo. Lawula ukubonelela ngeenkqubo zokukhathalela ukuze kugcinwe impilo yabagwenywa. Lawula ukubonelela ngeenkqubo ezijolise ekuveliseni abagwenywa. Lawula ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zokhuseleko kubasebenzi, kuboneleli Beenkonzo, kumanxibelelanisi, kubagwenywa nakulo naliphi na isebe elisebenzayo. Ulawulo lwe-Justice, Crime Prevention, Security cluster nakwelinye iindaba ezinxibelelanayo kwelo nginge. Lawula ukuveliswa nokusebenza kweenkonzo zokukhathalela emva kokukhululeka kwabagwenywa. Lawula ukuveliswa nokusebenza kweenkqubo zolungiso ukuze kulungiswe indlela yokuziphatha eyiphiko lesono. Ukulawula ngokusebenzayo iingozi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela icebo lokulawula iingozi lesebe. Ulawulo lweempahla zabantu, zemali, izinto ezibhalwayo nenkcazelo yemveliso.

jobs.duties: Design, develop and maintain the DCS organisational functional structure. Conduct organisational assessments to identify structure gaps, duplications and areas for optimisation. Develop and review functional structures aligned to legislative frameworks, mandates and strategic objectives. Prepare organisational design reports, motivation documents and structural map updates. Ensure alignment of functional structures with approved business processes and service delivery models. Design, develop and maintain the DCS post establishment and related norms. Develop and update post establishment frameworks, norms and standards based on organisational requirements. Analyse workforce distribution to identify shortages, surpluses and optimisation opportunities. Develop post provisioning models and scenario planning to support decision making. Prepare and submit establishment reports for internal and external stakeholders. Manage post provision and allocation of posts as well as reporting thereof. Facilitate the allocation, reallocation and redistribution of posts based on needs analysis. Review and approve requests related to post creation, abolition, upgrading or transfers. Ensure that post allocation processes comply with legislation, budget constraints and HR policies. Liaise with finance to ensure coherence between funded posts and the compensation budget. Manage and implement human resource planning strategies and processes. Develop and implement the annual and MTF HR planning frameworks. Conduct environmental scanning and workforce analysis to determine HR risks and capacity requirements. Coordinate workforce forecasting, succession planning and talent management support. Compile the Workforce Plan and ensure submission in line with legislative requirements. Monitor implementation of HR planning interventions and make recommendations for improvement. Management of human resources, finance, assets and performance information.

af.title: Direkteur: Organisasie-ontwikkeling
af.summary: Direkteur van Organisasie-ontwikkeling by die Departement of Correctional Services se nasionale hoofkantoor in Pretoria, verantwoordelik vir die ontwerp en instandhouding van die departementele funksionele struktuur.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Bestuursdienste, Bedrywighedebestuur, Menslikehulpbronbestuur of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Vyf (5) jaar se middel-/seniorbestuurservaring in die betrokke veld. 'n Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Services (SMS) wat by die National School of Government (NSG) verkry is, is verpligtend (vereis van alle applikante voor aanstelling). Veiligheidsklarering. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse Kriminele Regstelsel en die Correctional Services-argitektuur. Begrip van openbare diensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act en die Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en Attribuute: Transformasie en veranderingbestuur. Kennis van HR-beleide, werksevaluasie en prestasiebestuur. Vestigingkontrolering en PERSAL-bestuur. Organisasie-, opleidingsontwikkeling en werknemersprestasie. Begrip van Openbare Diensbeleid en wetgewende raamwerk. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede, strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Beleidsontwikkeling, projek- en programbestuur. Transformasie en veranderingbestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Probleemoplossing en analise. Diensleweringinnovasie en besluitneming. Mensebestuur, bemagtiging, integriteit en eerlikheid. Konfidensialiteit, interpersoonlike verhoudings, selfgelding en vermoë om te netwerk. Diplomasie, taktvolheid, beïnvloeding en impak.
af.duties: Ontwerp, ontwikkel en onderhou die DCS-organisasie se funksionele struktuur. Voer organisatoriese assesserings uit om struktuurgapings, duplikasies en areas vir optimalisering te identifiseer. Ontwikkel en hersien funksionele strukture wat belyn is met wetgewende raamwerke, mandate en strategiese doelwitte. Berei organisasie-ontwerpverslae, motiveringsdokumente en strukturele kaartopdaterings voor. Verseker belyning van funksionele strukture met goedgekeurde besigheidsprosesse en diensleweringmodelle. Ontwerp, ontwikkel en onderhou die DCS-posvestiging en verwante norms. Ontwikkel en werk posvestigingsraamwerke, norms en standaarde by wat op organisatoriese vereistes gebaseer is. Analiseer werkmagverspreiding om tekorte, surplusse en optimaliseringsgeleenthede te identifiseer. Ontwikkel posvoorsieningsmodelle en scenario-beplanning om besluitneming te ondersteun. Berei vestigingsverslae voor en dien dit in vir interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Bestuur posvoorsiening en toewysing van poste asook verslagdoening daaroor. Fasiliteer die toewysing, hertoewysing en herverdeling van poste gebaseer op behoefte-analise. Hersien en keur versoeke rakende poskepping, afskaffing, opgradering of oorplasing goed. Verseker dat postoewysingsprosesse aan wetgewing, begrotingsbeperkings en HR-beleide voldoen. Skakel met finansies om koherensie tussen gefinansierde poste en die vergoedingsbegroting te verseker. Bestuur en implementeer menslikehulpbronbeplanningsstrategieë en -prosesse. Ontwikkel en implementeer die jaarlikse en MTF-HR-beplanningsraamwerke. Voer omgewingsskandering en werkmaganalise uit om HR-risiko's en kapasiteitsvereistes te bepaal. Koördineer werkmagvoorspelling, opvolgbeplanning en talentbestuursondersteuning. Stel die Werkmagplan op en verseker indiening in ooreenstemming met wetgewende vereistes. Monitor implementering van HR-beplanningsintervensies en maak aanbevelings vir verbetering. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies, bates en prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Umphathi: Organisational Development
zu.summary: Umphathi we-Organisational Development e-Department of Correctional Services National Head Office e-Pretoria, onendima ekubumbeni kanye nokugqamisa isakhiwo somsebenzi somnyango.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kweziqu eziphakeme (i-NQF level 7) njengoba kugunyazwe yi-SAQA kwi-Management Services, Operations Management, Human Resources Management noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yokuba ngumphathi ophakathi/ongenhla kuleyo ndawo. Isitifiketi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholwe e-National School of Government (NSG) iyadingeka (idingwa kubo bonke abafaka izicelo ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Ukucociswa kwezokuvikela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Oludingekayo: Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda i-South African Criminal Justice System kanye nesakhiwo se-Correctional Services. Ukuqonda amapholisi omphakathi kanye nesesekelwa somthetho ohlobene nawo (i-Public Service Act and Regulations, i-Public Finance Management Act kanye ne-Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 njengoba iguquliwe). Ikhono namaphuzu: Ukuguqula futhi kuphatwe ushintsho. Ulwazi ngamapholisi we-HR, ukuhlola izikhundla kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza kahle. Ukulawula izikhundla nezokuphathwa kwe-PERSAL. Izinhlelo, ukuthuthukiswa kwesiqu kanye nokusebenza kahle komsebenzi. Ukuqonda amapholisi omphakathi nesesekelwa somthetho. Ikhono lokuphathwa kwezimali, ikhono elihlelekile kanye nobuholo. Ukuthuthukisa amapholisi, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye namaphulo. Ukuguqula futhi kuphatwe ushintsho. Ukuqondiswa ikhasimende kanye nokuqala ngesikhathi esifunekayo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nohlalutyo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhuba yokuletha izinsizakulo kanye nokuthatha izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukunika amandla, ukuzithiba kanye noqotho. Ukugcina iyimfihlo, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, ukuzethemba kanye nenhlanhla yokuxhumana. Isobuciko, ukuhlonipha, ukuminya kanye nethonya.
zu.duties: Hlela,uthuthukise futhi agcine isakhiwo sezinhlelo zomsebenzi ze-DCS. Yenza ukuhlola kwezinhlelo ukuze kutholwe izikhala kuleso sakhiwo,okuphindwe kabili kanye nezindawo ezingathuthukiswa. Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze izakhiwo ezihambisana nezinhlelo zomthetho, imisimo kanye nenhloso-mgomo. Lungiselela imibiko yokuhlela izinhlelo,amadokhumenta okusukuma ngawo kanye nokubuyekeza imephu yesakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zihambisana nezinhlelo zokuqashiwe zenshisekelo kanye nezinhlelo zokulethwa kwenkonzo. Hlela, thuthukisa futhi gcine ukumiswa kwezikhundla kwe-DCS kanye nemithetho ehlobene nayo. Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze izinhlelo zomsumBulo wezikhundla, imithetho nezindinganiso ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zenhlelo. Hlaziya ukusatshalaliswa kwezisebenzi ukuze kutholwe ukuntuleka, okwedlule kanye namathuba okuthuthukisa. Thuthukisa izinhlelo zokuqashiswa kwezikhundla kanye nekulungelelisa izimo ukuxhasa ukuthathwa kwezinqumo. Lungiselela futhi uhlonze imibiko yokumiswa kwesikhundla kubaphathi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Phatha ukulethwa kwezikhundla ukusatshalaliswa kwezikhundla kanye nokubika ngakho. Siza ekusatshalalisweni, ukuqanjwa kabusha kanye nokwabelwa kabusha izikhundla ngokusekelwe kuhlalutyo lwemfuno. Buza futhi vumela izicelo eziphathelene nokudalwa, ukususwa, ukuphakanyiswa noma ukudluliswa kwezikhundla. Qinisekisa ukuthi inqubo yokubhekanisa izikhundla ilandelana umthetho, imikhawulo yesabelo kanye namapholisi we-HR. Xhumana nomnyango wezezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana phakathi kwezikhundla ezixhaswa ngesabelo sokukhokhelwa. Phatha futhi ufake izindlela zokuqashiswa kobuhlakani bezinsizakalo kanye namaqembu. Thuthukisa futhi ufake izinhlelo zonyaka kanye ne-MTF HR. Yenza ukuhlola imvelo kanye nohlalutyo lwezisebenzi ukuze kutholwe izingozi ze-HR nezidingo bemandla. Hlelanganisa ukubikezela ngabezomsebenzi, ukuhlelwa kwesikhundla sokulandela kanye nokusekelwa ekuphathweni abanamakhono. Hlela iNdlela Yomsebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ihlongozwa ngokulandelana imithetho. Qapha ukufake izinhlela zocwaningo lwe-HR futhi unikeze izincomo zokuthuthukisa. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo, kwezezimali, kwezimpahla kanye nenani lokuqashiswa.

xh.title: UmLawuli: uPhuhliso lweSebe
xh.summary: UmLawuli woPhuhliso lweSebe kwiNational Head Office ye-Department of Correctional Services e-Pretoria, unoxanduva lokuyila nokulondoloza isakhiwo ezisebenzayo sesebe.
xh.requirements: Ifomali yeqelobakhusi (NQF level 7) ekuqatshelwa yi-SAQA kwiinkonzo zoLawulo, uLawulo lweenkonzo, uLawulo lweZabasebenzi okanye esinye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Imimiselo emihlanu (5) yamava enkqubo yabaphathi abaphakathi/baphezulu kwicala elichanekileyo. Isatifikethi sokungena kwiinkonzo zoLawulo oluphezulu (SMS) esifunyanwa e-National School of Government (NSG) simfuneko (sifunwa kubo bonke abafaka isicelo ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Isiqinisekiso sokucocwa kweekhredithi. Ukuba nobuchule ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi olufunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda inkqubo yoLuntu noLawulo boBubi eMzantsi Afrika kunye nesakhiwo sezezoNkonzo ezingalunganga. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zemigaqo yaseburhulumenteni nomthetho ojikeleze loo nto (iMthetho woLuntu noMthetho weNkonzo yoLuntu, iMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu kunye noMthetho weeNkonzo eziLungileyo u-Act 111 ka-1998 njengoko ulungisiwe). Iimfuno ezifunekayo: Ugqithiso lwemigaqo yoluntu ithintelwe kwindawo ekuyo. Ulwazi ngamagqabantshintshi e-DCS, iinkqubo zokuqwalasela abantu basebenzi nokubeka umgangatho wamava abasebenzi ngawo. Ulawulo lwemigaqo yokubeka abantu kwizikhundla kunye nokuyilawula ngokomthetho. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zoluntu ezahlukeneyo, iinkqubo zoluntu zolawulo nokuphuhlisa abantu. Ukuzinika isigqibo ekwenzeni iinkqubo zamanyathelo obuntshontsho bomsebenzi ekhaya. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yabasebenzi, ukulinganisa imisebenzi nokulawula inkqubo yokwenza umsebenzi. Ulawulo lokuzinika isigqibo ngemigaqo yoluntu kunye nokulawula abantu abakwindawo ethile. Amakhono oLawulo lweMali, amandla okuqonda isimo ngokubanzi kunye noLawulo. Ukuphuhlisa amagqabantshintshi, ukulawula iiprojekthi neenkqubo. Ukuguqulwa koluntu nokulawula utshintsho. Ukubakho kwiindaba ezahlukeneyo zoluntu kunye nokubeka izigqibo ngokubanzi. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuzinika isigqibo ngokubanzi. Iinkqubo zokuqonda isimo ezahlukeneyo zokunika izigqibo ezahlukeneyo. Amandla okulawula abantu, ukubakhuthaza, ukuzithoba nokuzithemba. Ukugcina iyimfihlo, ubudlelwane nobuntu, ukuzimisela nokuba nodidi oluthile lokuzibandakanya nabanye. Ukuziphatha ngokunesiqu, ukuzithoba, ukwenza izigqibo ezithile kunye namandla okuyilawula.
xh.duties: Yila, phuhlisa kwaye ulondoloze isakhiwo sezisebenzi esisebenzayo se-DCS. Yenza iingqinamba zohlolo lwesebe ukuze kwazwe iindlela ezingenanto, eziphinda-phindayo nakwindawo ezingelinganiswanga kakuhle. Phuhlisa kwaye uqhube isakhiwo ezisebenzayo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho, iimiso kunye nemigangatho eqhagamshelana neyonke. Lungiselela iingxelo zoyilo lwezisebe, amaxwebhu okukhuthaza kunye nokuhlaziya ipepu yemida yesakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuba isakhiwo ezisebenzayo siahambelana neenkqubo zoshishino ezamkelekileyo kunye neendlela zokuzelelisa iinkonzo. Yila, phuhlisa kwaye ulondoloze isiseko sezithuba ze-DCS kunye nemigangatho edibene nayo. Phuhlisa kwaye uhlaziye iinkqubo zemigaqo yezithuba, imigaqo yomgangatho ngokweemfuno zesebe. Hlaziya ukusabalaliswa kwabasebenzi ukuze kwazwe iindlela ezingekhoyo, ezongezelelekileyo namathuba okulungisa. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zokuzelelisa izithuba kunye neqela leenkqubo zokulinganisa ukuze kuxhaswe ukwenza izigqibo. Lungiselela kwaye uzele iingxelo ngamagatya e-DCS kwabathathi nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Phatha iinkqubo zokuzelelisa izithuba, ukwabiwa kwezithuba nakwingxelo ngazo. Yenza izikhokelo ekubeni sezwa, ukususa kwindawo ekuyo nokuba kwakhona izithuba ngokwahlulwa ngokweemfuno. Hlaziya kwaye uvume iimfuno ezinje ngokudala izithuba, ukuyiphelisa, ukuyinyusa okanye ukudlulisa. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokwabela izithuba ziyahambelana nomthetho, imida yesabelo semali kunye namagqabantshintshi abasebenzi. Thathelana ingxelo nesebe leemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba izithuba ezixhaswa ngemali ne-sikelo semali yomvuzo ziyahambelana. Phatha kwaye usebenzise iindlela ezahluweneyo zokucwangcisa abasebenzi kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Cwangcisa kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zonyaka kunye ne-MTF. Hlaziya ikomkhulu namanqanaba abasebenzi ukuze kwazwe iingozi kunye nemfuno yamandla okusebenza. Lawula ukuqikelela amandla okusebenza, ukulinganisa ukulandelelana kolawulo kunye nokulawula abantu abanamandla. Qamba iNkqubo yoLungelelwaniso lwaBantu baseBenzi ukuze iqhutywe ngaphantsi kwemigaqo efanayo yomthetho. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwezicwangciso zamanyathelo okulungelelwanisa abantu basebenzi kwaye wenze izindululo ezingathathi hlangothi ngolwandiso. Lawula izisebenzi, iimali, iimpahla kunye nolwazi ngokusebenza kwesebe.

jobs.summary: Director: Core Curriculum at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office in Pretoria, responsible for developing and maintaining training curricula.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA in Human Resources Development, Human Resource Management or equivalent qualification. Five [5] years middle/senior management experience in the relevant field. A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory (required from all applicants prior to appointment). Security clearance. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Required Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of the South African Criminal Justice System and the Correctional Services architecture. Understanding of public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act and the Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Competencies and Attributes: HR policies, transformation and change management. Empathy, analytical and compliance. Organisational development and training. Conflict resolution and employee’s performance. Understanding of Public Service policy and legislative framework. Financial management skills, strategic capability and leadership. Policy development and programme management. Client orientation and customer focus. Problem solving and analysis. Service delivery innovation and decision making. People management and empowerment. Integrity and honesty. Confidentiality, interpersonal relations and assertiveness. Ability to network, diplomacy and tactful.
jobs.duties: Develop and maintain curriculum and DCS training units. Develop processes for all core curriculum programmes, ensuring alignment with organisational objectives and occupational standards. Review and update training curricula regularly to ensure they remain relevant, competency-based and aligned to legislative changes. Conduct research and benchmarking on training best practices to inform curriculum enhancement. Coordinate curriculum development workshops with subject matter experts and instructors. Provide support and guidance to training units on curriculum implementation and interpretation. Manage the provision of basic training in line with the Correction Service Learnership. Ensure that all basic training curricula and learning materials meet NQF and SAQA standards and requirements. Coordinate the scheduling, delivery and administration of basic training programmes across training centres. Oversee the monitoring and evaluation of basic training to assess quality, learner progress and programme effectiveness. Facilitate and monitor both theoretical and workplace experiential learning phases in accordance with learnership guidelines. Ensure that programme implementation aligns with departmental training policies and legislative frameworks. Support trainers and facilitators through capacity-building initiatives and provision of required resources. Manage the provision of orientation and induction. Manage the review, updating and quality assurance of the orientation and induction manual to ensure relevance and accuracy. Plan, coordinate and oversee the implementation of the orientation and induction programme. Provide guidance and support to facilitators responsible for delivering induction sessions. Ensure proper documentation, attendance records and evaluation reports are maintained. Ensure effective management and administration of colleges and the provision of firearm training in line with the Firearms Control Act. Ensure that firearm training curricula and learning materials comply with the Firearms Control Act and other regulatory requirements. Ensure consistent monitoring and evaluation of firearm training to assess learner competence and training effectiveness. Manage the verification and assessment processes related to firearms competency certification. Ensure compliance with departmental policies, statutory requirements and safety protocols relating to firearm use and training. Conduct risk assessments and ensure that training facilities meet safety and security standards. Management of human resources, finance, assets and performance information.
