Veiligheidsklarering. Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse Kriminele Regstelsel en die Correctional Services-argitektuur. Begrip van die openbare diensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act en die Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en Eienskappe: HR-beleid, transformasie en veranderingbestuur. Empatie, analities en nakoming. Organisasie-ontwikkeling en opleiding. Konflikoplossing en werknemerprestasie. Begrip van die openbare diensbeleid en wetgewende raamwerk. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede, strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Beleidontwikkeling en programbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en klem op kliëntediens. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Dienslewering-innovasie en besluitneming. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Integriteit en eerlikheid. Konfidensialiteit, interpersoonlike verhoudings en selfversekerdheid. Vermoë om te netwerk, diplomaie en taktvol.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en onderhou kurrikulum en DCS-opleidingseenhede. Ontwikkel prosesse vir alle kernkurrikulumprogramme en verseker belyning met organisatoriese doelwitte en beroepsstandaarde. Hersien en werk opleidingskurrikula gereeld by om te verseker dat dit relevant, op bevoegdheid gebaseer en met wetgewingswysigings in lyn bly. Voer navorsing en meting van best praktyke op opleiding uit om kurrikulumverbetering in te lig. Koördineer kurrikulumontwikkelingswerkswinkels met vakdeskundiges en opleiers. Verskaf ondersteuning en leiding aan opleidingseenhede oor kurrikulumimplementering en -interpretasie. Bestuur die verskaffing van basiese opleiding in ooreenstemming met die Correction Service Learnership. Verseker dat alle basiese opleidingskurrikula en leermateriaal aan NQF- en SAQA-standaarde en -vereistes voldoen. Koördineer die skedulering, aflewering en administrasie van basiese opleidingsprogramme oor opleidingsentra. Hou toesig op die monitering en evaluering van basiese opleiding om gehalte, vorder van leerders en effektiwiteit van die program te beoordeel. Fasiliteer en monitor beide teoretiese en werksa-ervaringsleerfases in ooreenstemming met leerderskapsriglyne. Verseker dat programimplementering met departementele opleidingsbeleid en wetgewende raamwerke ooreenstem. Ondersteun opleiers en fasiliteerders deur kapasiteitsbou-inisiatiewe en die verskaffing van benodigde hulpbronne. Bestuur die verskaffing van oriëntasie en inlywing. Bestuur die hersiening, bywerking en gehaltesekerheid van die oriëntasie- en inlywingshandleiding om relevansie en akkuraatheid te verseker. Beplan, koördineer en hou toesig op die implementering van die oriëntasie- en inlywingsprogram. Verskaf leiding en ondersteuning aan fasiliteerders verantwoordelik vir die aanbieding van inlywingsessies. Verseker behoorlike dokumentasie, bywoningsrekords en evalueringsverslae gehou word. Verseker effektiewe bestuur en administrasie van kolleges en die verskaffing van vuurwapenopleiding in ooreenstemming met die Firearms Control Act. Verseker dat vuurwapenopleidingskurrikula en leermateriaal aan die Firearms Control Act en ander regulatoriese vereistes voldoen. Verseker deurlopende monitering en evaluering van vuurwapenopleiding om leerdersbevoegdheid en opleidingseffektiwiteit te beoordeel. Bestuur die verifikasiy en assesseringsprosesse rakende vuurwapenbevoegdheidsertifisering. Verseker nakoming van departementele beleide, statutêre vereistes en veiligheidsprotokolle rakende vuurwapengebruik en -opleiding. Voer risiko-assesserings uit en verseker dat opleidingsgeriewe aan veiligheids- en sekuriteitsstandaarde voldoen. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies, bates en prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ikhuriyulumo Esiyinhloko
zu.summary: Umphathi: Ikhuriyulumo Esiyinhloko eNtshonalanga Kolunyuko Lwezikhala Esiyinhloko kolunyuko ezweni ePitoli, ophathwa ngesikhundla sokwakha nokugcina izikhala zokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Ithifikheyithi leziqu ezingaphansi kwesikhathi (NQF level 7) njengoba sivunyiwe yi-SAQA kokuQeqeshwa Kwabantu, uKulawulwa Kwabantu noma isiqu esilinganayo. Iminyaka yokuQeqeshwa yeminyaka emihlanu [5] ngaphezulu kokulawulwa kwesikhathi esiphakathi noma phezulu kuleso simiso. Ithifikheyithi yokungena kuKwindla YobuKhaladi BezeNkulu (SMS) etholakala eSikoleni SikaHulumeni weNyanga (NSG) iyisidingo esibekiwe (sidingwa kubo bonke abafaki isicelo ngaphambi kokwabiwa isikhundla). Ukuqinisekiswa kwesivikelo. Ukubhala ngesikhathi esigqoke ngokugcwele. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Oludingekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda Isimiso Senkantolo yezcala eNingizimu Afrika kanye nokuqumba kwezikhala zeNtshonalanga Kolunyuko. Ukuqonda insimbi yohulumeni kanye nendlela yomthetho ohlobene nayo (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act and the Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Ukuzimisela nokubakhona: Izinqubomgomo ze-HR, ukuguqulwa nokuphathwa koshintsho. Ukuzwela, ukuhlaziya kanye nokuzwisana nemithetho. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo kanye noQeqesho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Ukuqonda insimbi yohulumeni kanye nendlela yomthetho. Amakhono okuphatha imali, ikhono lesimiso nezinhlelo nokuba ngumholi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuzijwayeza kumthengi kanye nokuqagela umthengi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuuhlaziya. Ukuthuthuka kokulethwa kwensebenzo nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokunika amandla. Ukuqina nokuqotho. Ukugcina imfihlo, izinhlobonhlobo zezingxoxo kanye nobuqotho.
zu.duties: Bizele futhi ulondoloze ikhuriyulumo namayunithi we-DCS eqeqesha. Bazakha izindlela zonke izinhlelo zekhuriyulumo esiyo, uqinisekise ukuthi zihambisana namagugu ezinhlelo kanye namazinga womsebenzi. Phinda uhlole futhi uvuselele izikhala zokusebenza njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zihlala ziwusizo, ngaphansi kokuqonda koshintsho lwesimiso. Yenza ucwaningo kanye nokulinganisela izindlela ezinhle zokuqeqesha ukwaziswa ngokuthuthukiswa kwekhuriyulumo. Linganisa uQeqesho lwezikhungo zokuthuthukiswa kwekhuriyulumo nabacwaningi bezindaba kanye nabaphathi. Nikeza inkxaso nokuhlakanipha kwamayunithi okuqeqeshayo ngokuqashwa nokuhlaka kwamagama. Lawula ukulethwa kokuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo ngokuhambisana neNyanga yoQeqesho Lwabafundi. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imikhakha yokulethwa kokuqeqesho okuyisisekelo kanye nezinto zokufunda zihlangabezana namazinga kanye nezigaba ze-SAQA. Lawula ukuhlelwa, ukulethwa kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo ezikhundleni zokuqeqesha. Qapha futhi ulinganise ukulethwa kokuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo ukuze uhlole izinga, inqubo yomfundi kanye nesisekelo sezinhlelo. Phatha futhi uqaphele kokuqonda ngokubhaliwe kanye nokusebenza emhlabeni ngokuhambisana nemiqondo yeNyanga yoQeqesho. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo kuhambisana nezinqubomgomo zokuqeqeshwa zomnyango kanye nendlela yomthetho. Nxusa oqeqeshi kanye nabahola ngokuqondana nokuqhutshwa kokuqonda nokunikelwa izinsiza eziyidingekayo. Lawula ukulethwa kokumaka nokufakwa esikhundleni. Lawula ukuhlolwa, ukuvuselelwa kanye nokuqinisekiswa kweNsetshenziswa yokumaka nokufakwa esikhundleni ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kuyiqiniso futhi kulungele. Hlela, linganisa futhi uphele ukusetshenziswa kwenhlelo yokumaka nokufakwa esikhundleni. Nikeza ukuqhutshwa kanye nokuqashwa kulabo abahola ababhekene nokuletha izikhala zokumemela. Qinisekisa ukuthi iziqoshwa zokubhala, iziqu zokubakhona kanye nemibhalo yokuqagela zigcinwe kahle. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokusebenziseka kwayo kwezikhungo zokuqeqesha kanye nokulethwa kokuqeqeshwa ngesikhali ngokuhambisana noMthetho woKulawulwa Izikhali. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhala zokuqeqeshwa ngesikhali kanye nezinto zokufunda zihlangabezana noMthetho woKulawulwa Izikhali kanye nezinye izidingo ezisemthethweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuqhutshwa ukuqapha nokulinganisa okuqhutshwayo kokuqeqeshwa ngesikhali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umfundi uyazi futhi ukuthi uqeqesho lolusebenza. Lawula ukuqinisekiswa kanye nezinqubo zokuqagela eziphathelene nokukhishwa kothifikheyithi wokwazi ukusebenzisa izikhali. Qinisekisa ukuhlangabezana nezinqubomgomo zomnyango, izidingo zomthetho kanye nemithetho yokuphepha ephathelene nokusetshenziswa kanye nokuqeqeshwa ngesikhali. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwezinsipho futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izikhungo zokuqeqesha zihlangabezana namazinga okuphepha kanye nokuqinisekiswa. Ukuphathwa kwabantu, imali, izimpahla kanye nolwazi oluphathelene nokusebenza.

xh.title: Titshala: Isifundo esiNgundoqo
xh.summary: Titshala: Isifundo esiNgundoqo kwi Department of Correctional Services National Head Office e Pretoria, ejongene nophuhliso kwaye aze agcine iisifundo zokuqeqesha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) esamkelwe yi SAQA kwikuPhuhliso lweMisebenzi yabaBantu, uLawulo lweMisebenzi yabaBantu okanye isidanga esilinganayo. Iminyaka emihlanu [5] yamava ukulawula abantu abangaphezulu kwelinye iqela ekwindawo ethintela ngqo. Isatifikethi sokungena kwiSenior Management Services (SMS) esifunekayo kuwo onke amagosa aphezulu kwindawo abasebenza kuyo nesebe elithintela ngqo abantu abangenayo kuso asingathunyelwa kwelinye iqela elisebenza ngokutsha ukuba asikho kwindawo eseamkelwa kuyo ngokusesikweni (nokuthunyelwa kuyo ngabantu abangenayo kuyo) (isimemo esithunyelwa kwelinye iqela ngexesha elithile). Ukuqinisekiswa kokuba ngumntu onako ukuthembeka ekubeni ngumsebenzi. Ukuba nakho ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi olufunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda inkqubo yobuLungisa boNgcwelakade eMzantsi Afrika kunye ne ndlela abasebenza ngayo i Correctional Services. Ukuqonda inkqubo yorhulumente wezabenzo kunye nophando oluqhagamshelene nayo ngokomthetho (i Public Service Act and Regulations, i Public Finance Management Act kunye ne Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 njengoko igqityiwe). Ikhono kunye neempawu ezinye: Iinkqubo zomsebenzi wezorhwebo, iinguquko ezinzima ukuzenza. Inxaxheba ekubeni nako ukuqonda, ukutshintsha kwaye uhlale ugqiba izinto. Ukwakha kwaye uqeqeshe abantu abangenwa bubomi obutsha. Ukuzama ukusombulula iingxaki ezibangelwa bubudlelwane phakathi kwabasebenzi abangenwa bubomi obutsha.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa zigqibe kwaye ugcine isifundo kwaye nayunithi zokuqeqesha ze DCS. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zonke ezingundoqo zesifundo, ukuqinisekisa ukulungelelana nemigangatho yeqembu kunye nemigangatho yomsebenzi. Phinda uhloze kwaye uhlaziye iisifundo zokuqeqesha ngamaxesha athile ukuze uqinisekise ukuba zihlala zixhobekile, ezisekelwe kakhulu kukwaziswa kunye nokulungelelana natshintsho esebenzayo kwimithetho. Qhuba uphando kunye nokuthelekisa ngendlela engcono yokusebenza ukuze uzeke ngakumbi ngokuphuculwa kwesifundo. Lawula iinkqubo zokuphuhlisa isifundo ngokubamba ingqungquthla nabachwephetshe kwintlalo yomntu kunye nabafundisi. Nikezela ngenkxaso kunye nemigaqo ebalulekileyo kuyunithi zokuqeqesha malunga nokusebenza nokutolika isifundo. Lawula ukunikezelwa kokuqeqeshwa okusesikweni ngokuvumelana ne Correction Service Learnership. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iisifundo zokuqeqeswa okusesikweni kunye nezinto zokufunda zihlangabezana nemigangatho kunye neemfuno ze NQF kunye ne SAQA. Lawula ulungelelwaniso, ukunikwa kunye nokulawulwa kweenkqubo zokuqeqeshwa okusesikweni kuziko zonke zokuqeqesha. Qhagamshela ukujonga nokulinganisa ukusebenza okusesikweni ukuze kuqatshwe ukhuseleko lomsebenzi, inkqubela yokufunda kumfundi, kunye nokusebenza kwemigaqo yokuqeqesha. Yenza kwaye ujonge zonke iinkqubo zokufunda ngokubhekisa kumigaqo ebalulekileyo efundiswa kwaye ujonge nakwimigaqo engeyonto efundwa ngokomsebenzi ngokuvumelana neemigaqo ezilawula ulwazi lomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo kulungelelana nemigaqo yokuqeqesha yesebe kunye namaphu athe athembekileyo eceliweyo. Nika inkxaso kubafundisi kunye nabakhokeleli ukuba bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo ngokuphucula amandla abo kunye nokubanika izinto ezifunekayo ukuba bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo ngokufanelekileyo. Lawula ukunikwa kwabantu abasha iinkqubo zokuqala nokungeniswa kwabo. Lawula ukuhlaziywa, ukuvuselelwa kwaye kuqinisekiswe ukhuseleko lwezinto ezifundwa kuyo nayunithi yokuqalisa nokungenisa abantu abasha ukwazi ukuba kukho ukuchaneka kolwazi nokusebenza kwemigaqo ebalulekileyo. Cwangcisa, ulawule kwaye ujonge ukusetyenziswa kwinkqubo yokungenisa nabantu abasha abaqalayo. Nikela ngemigaqo ebalulekileyo kunye nenkxaso kulabo bakhokelela abantu abasha abangenisiweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kugcinwa amaphepha, iziphathi zobukho kunye neemvume ezibalulekileyo zokujonga imigaqo ebalulekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kulawulwa kwaye kusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kukho urhulumente kunye nothotho lweekolishi ezingundoqo ukuya kwelona nqanaba lisezantsi kwaye kwenziwe imisebenzi egqithiswe kubo ngokulawula imisebenzi yabo ngokusebenzisa i Firearms Control Act. Qinisekisa ukuba iisifundo ezifundiswa ngokugqithisela imisebenzi kubantu abakhululekileyo abanamalungelo okusebenzisa izixhobo ezibulala ngokutshaya iplatyki zihlangabezana neemfuno ze Firearms Control Act kunye nezinye iimfuno ezisezantsi ezibalulekileyo kunye ne Firearms Control Act. Qinisekisa ukuba kuye kubekho ukujonga nokulinganisa imisebenzi egqithiswe kubantu abakhululekileyo abanamalungelo okusebenzisa izixhobo ezibulala ngokutshaya iplatyki ukuze kuqatshwe ukwazi ukusebenza komfundi ukubona ukuba uyayazi na le nto ifunekayo kuye nakho ukusebenza komsebenzi wakhe. Lawula iinkqubo ezijongana nokujonga kwaye kuqatshwe ukuba ngaba bakhona na abantu abafanelekileyo ngokugqithisa imisebenzi yabo ngokusebenzisa izixhobo ezibulala ngokutshaya iplatyki kunye nokukwazi ukusebenzisa oku baye bafunde kuko kwaye baqinisekiswe ngalo lonke ixesha. Qinisekisa ukuzinza ngokulawulwa kwemigaqo yesebe, iimfuno ezibekiweyo ngokomthetho kunye nemigaqo egqithiswe kwindlu yamaphakathi yokujonga ukhuseleko kunye nokuchaneka kolwazi nokusebenza kwemigaqo egqithiswe kwindlu yamaphakathi ebalulekileyo yokujonga imisebenzi yabo. Lawula ukujonga kwaye uqinisekise ukuba iziko zokuqeqesha zihlangabezana nemigangatho yokhuseleko esebenzayo. Lawula ukujonga nokubeka iindlela zokujonga ukuba kuye kubekho ukhuseleko olusebenzayo ekujonge imisebenzi yabo ngokusebenzisa imigaqo egqithiswe kwindlu yamaphakathi ebalulekileyo yokujonga ukhuseleko kunye nemigaqo yamaphakathi abalulekileyo.

jobs.title: Director: Formal Education and Skills Development
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 August 2026 @ 15h45. It is the sole responsibility of an applicant to ensure that their application reaches the Department of Correctional Services before closing date.
jobs.summary: Director role managing formal education curriculum and skills development programmes for offenders at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA in Education/Social Sciences or equivalent. A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory (required from all applicants prior to appointment). Five [5] years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level in a similar environment. Security clearance. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Required Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of the South African Criminal Justice System and the Correctional Services architecture. Understanding of public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act and the Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Competencies And Attributes: Knowledge of all legislation, norms and standards that governs education and skills development. Knowledge of PFMA – compilation of budgets, estimation, expenditure & reporting. Understanding of DCS environment. Knowledge and understanding of Public Service policies and mandates. Understanding of justice cluster. Knowledge of relevant prescripts, social cohesiveness and quality improvement. Applied strategic thinking and networking/liaison with stakeholders. Project management and analytical thinking. Presentation and report writing skills. Service delivery standards. Developing others (coaching, mentoring, training). Decision making, problem solving, negotiation and organising. Communication and conflict management. Policy development, analysis, monitoring, evaluation and implementation advice.
jobs.duties: Manage, develop and design Formal Education curriculum programs in line with South African Qualification Authority standards (SAQA). Manage, develop and design formal education curriculum programs and strategies for offenders. Manage formal curriculum administration for offenders. Develop and manage the rollout of formal education and training of offenders in line with frameworks and departmental policies and procedures. Manage the coordination of formal training. Manage, develop and design skills development curriculum programs and strategies for offenders in line with South African Qualification Authority standards (SAQA). Manage skills development curriculum administration for offenders. Manage and ensure proper research and development of the program. Develop and manage the rollout of skills development training for offenders in line with relevant legislation, regulations, frameworks and departmental policies and procedures. Manage the coordination of the skills training. Identify risk factors and ensure monitoring and evaluation of formal education and skills development programs services. Develop strategies for monitoring and evaluation of the formal education and skills development programs. Ensure the effective and efficient management skills development monitoring tools. Management of human resources, finance, assets and performance information.
jobs.enquiries: Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589 or Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307
jobs.applications: Indicate the reference number and position you are applying for on your application form (Z83) and send your complete application to: The Department of Correctional Services, Post Advertisement Section, Private Bag X136, Pretoria, 0001 OR hand deliver at: 124 WF Nkomo Street, Poyntons Building, Corner WF Nkomo and Sophie De Bruyn Street, Pretoria, 0001 (Previous: Corner Church and Schubart Street) OR you can submit your application online at: https://careers.dcs.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Appointment under the Correctional Service Act Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. A pre-entry certificate from the National School of Government (NSG) is required from all applicants prior to appointment. The full details of the SMS pre-entry course are obtainable on: Certificate for entry into the SMS (Senior Management Service) | thensg Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification/s and criminal records verification. Appointment to some of these posts will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the department. Following the interview and technical exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA directive on the implementation of competency- based assessment). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tool. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Please send a separate and complete application for each post you are applying for, stating the correct reference for each position you are interested in. Candidates must comply with the minimum appointment requirements. CV’s should be aligned to reflect one’s degree of compliance with the advert requirements and responsibilities. The Department of Correctional Services reserves the right not to fill any of these advertised posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Direkteur: Formele Onderwys en Vaardigheidsontwikkeling
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat die bestuur van die formele onderwyskurrikulum en vaardigheidsontwikkelingsprogramme vir oortreders by die Department of Correctional Services Nasionale Hoofkantoor in Pretoria behels.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Onderwys/Sosiale Wetenskappe of gelykwaardig. 'n Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Services (SMS) wat by die National School of Government (NSG) verkry is, is verpligtend (van alle aansoekers vereis voor aanstelling). Vyf [5] jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. Veiligheidsklarering. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die South African Criminal Justice System en die Correctional Services-argitektuur. Begrip van die openbare diensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act en die Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en Eienskappe: Kennis van alle wetgewing, norms en standaarde wat onderwys en vaardigheidsontwikkeling regeer. Kennis van PFMA – samestelling van begrotings, raming, bestedings en verslagdoening. Begrip van die DCS-omgewing. Kennis en begrip van Public Service-beleide en mandaat. Begrip van die justisieluster. Kennis van relevante voorskrifte, sosiale samehorigheid en gehalteverbetering. Toegepaste strategiese denke en netwerkwerking/liaison met belanghebbendes. Projektebestuur en analitiese denke. Voorleggings- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Diensleweringstandaarde. Ontwikkeling van ander (afgerig word, mentorskap, opleiding). Besluitneming, probleemoplossing, onderhandeling en organisering. Kommunikasie en konflikbestuur. Beleidsontwikkeling, ontleding, monitering, evaluering en uitvoeringsadvies.
af.duties: Bestuur, ontwikkel en ontwerp Formele Onderwyskurrikulumprogramme in ooreenstemming met South African Qualification Authority-standaarde (SAQA). Bestuur, ontwikkel en ontwerp formele onderwyskurrikulumprogramme en -strategieë vir oortreders. Bestuur formele kurrikulumadministrasie vir oortreders. Ontwikkel en bestuur die uitrol van formele onderwys en opleiding van oortreders in ooreenstemming met raamwerke en departementelebeleide en prosedures. Bestuur die koördinasie van formele opleiding. Bestuur, ontwikkel en ontwerp vaardigheidsontwikkelingskurrikulumprogramme en -strategieë vir oortreders in ooreenstemming met South African Qualification Authority-standaarde (SAQA). Bestuur vaardigheidsontwikkelingskurrikulumadministrasie vir oortreders. Bestuur en verseker behoorlike navorsing en ontwikkeling van die program. Ontwikkel en bestuur die uitrol van vaardigheidsontwikkelingsopleiding vir oortreders in ooreenstemming met relevante wetgewing, regulasies, raamwerke en departementelebeleide en prosedures. Bestuur die koördinasie van die vaardigheidsopleiding. Identifiseer risikofaktore en verseker monitering en evaluering van formele onderwys- en vaardigheidsontwikkelingsprogramdienste. Ontwikkel strategieë vir monitering en evaluering van die formele onderwys- en vaardigheidsontwikkelingsprogramme. Verseker die effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van vaardigheidsontwikkelingsmoniteringsinstrumente. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies, bates en prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Umluleki: Imfundo Ephathwayo nokuThuthukiswa kweKhono
zu.summary: Isikhundla somluleki sokuphatha ikhulamu yemfundo ephathwayo neminhlela yokuqeqesha amakhono abantu ababoshiwe eKantolo Loqobo Lwomnyango wezAmaNkonzo zokuLungisa ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zezinga elingaphansi (NQF level 7) ezikuqashelwa yi-SAQA kwiMfundo / ezeSayensi eZomphakathi noma okulingana nayo. Isitifiketi sokungena kumasevisi abaphathi abaphezulu (SMS) esitholakale eSikoleni SikaHulumeni (NSG) siyindlela ephoqelelekile (sidingwa kubo bonke abafakisi ngaphambi kokuba bashoniswe). Uhambo lwe-Five [5] iminyaka yemisebenzi ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi / ophakeme endaweni efanayo nalena. Kuhlanziwe imvume yokuphathwa kwezokuvikela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oludingwayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda ngohlelo lweNqubo yoBululezekazi kwaNingizimu Afrika nowakhe wokwenziwa kwezAmaNkonzo zokuLungisa. Ukuqonda ngomgomo wesevisi yomphakathi nosimiso oluhlobene nomthetho (uMthetho wesevisi yomphakathi nokuMiswa kwawo, uMthetho woKuphathwa kweMali yoMphakathi noMthetho wokuLungisa izinkonzo 111 ka-1998 njengoba ulungisiwe). Ikhono nezimpawu: Ulwazi ngawo wonke umthetho, amagunya nokuqakuliswa okuphatha imfundo nokuqeqeshwa amakhono. Ulwazi lwe-PFMA – ukuhlanganiswa kwezimali ezidiwayo, ukulinganisa, ukusebenzisa nemibiko. Ukuqonda ngendawo ye-DCS. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemigomo nemiyalo yesevisi yomphakathi. Ukuqonda ngomphathi wolunga. Ulwazi ngemiyalo ephathelene nezinto, ukuhlangana komphakathi nokuqaqamba kwekhwalithi. Ukucabanga ngesu elisetshenzisiwe nokuxhumanisa / ukuthintana nabahlanganyeli. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nokuhlaziya ukucabanga. Amakhono okubamba imibhikisho nokubhala imibiko. Izilinganiso zokuhlolwa kwezinkonzo. Ukuphakamisa abanye (ukuyakhula, ukuyala, ukuqeqesha). Ukwenza izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxoxisana nokuhlela. Ukuthinta kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkinga. Ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlaziya, ukuqapha, ukubuyekeza nokunikela icebo lokusebenza komgomo.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha, ukuthuthukisa futhi ukwakhe imihlela yekhulamu yeMfundo Ephathwayo ngokuvumelana namazinga eNtshisekelo yoMthetho kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika (SAQA). Ukuphatha, ukuthuthukisa futhi ukwakhe imihlela namasu ekhulamu yemfundo ephathwayo kubantu ababoshiwe. Ukuphatha ukulawulwa kwekhulamu ephathwayo kubantu ababoshiwe. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuphatha ukusatshaliswa kolwazi kanye noqeqesho abantu ababoshiwe ngokuvumelana nasimiso namagomomnyango kanye nokuqakuliswa. Ukuphatha ukuhlanganiswa kokuqeqeshwa okuphathwayo. Ukuphatha, ukuthuthukisa futhi ukwakhe imihlela namasu ekhulamu yokuqeqeshwa amakhono kubantu ababoshiwe ngokuvumelana namazinga eNtshisekelo yoMthetho kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika (SAQA). Ukuphatha ukulawulwa kwamakhono ekhulamu yokuqeqeshwa abantu ababoshiwe. Ukuphatha futhi ukuqinisekisa ucwaningo olufanele nokuqeqeshwa kwenhlela. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuphatha ukusatshaliswa kokuqeqeshwa amakhono abantu ababoshiwe ngokuvumelana nomthetho othintekayo, imiyalo, izimiso namagomomnyango kanye noqakuliswa. Ukuphatha ukuhlanganiswa kokuqeqeshwa amakhono. Ukuhlola imibangela yengozi futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuqashelwa nokubuyekezwa kwezinsizakusebenza zemfundo ephathwayo kanye nemihlela yokuqeqeshwa amakhono. Ukuthuthukisa amasu okuqapha nokubuyekeza imihlela yemfundo ephathwayo nokuqeqeshwa amakhono. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa ngempumelelo ngokusebenzisa amathuluzi okuqapha amakhono okuqeqeshwa. Ukuphatha izinsizakamuntu, izimali, izimpahla nolwazi ngemikhuba yezebhizinisi.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Imfundo Eqaqwe Ngokusesikweni nokuPhuhliswa kweNkhosi
xh.summary: Inkundla yomlawuli ephatha icurriculum yemfundo eqaqwe ngokusesikweni nendlela zokuphuhliswa kwenkhosi kwabangeni ngenxaxheba kwisebe leZiko leenkonzo zokuLungisa eNdzuzo kwindlu enkulu kwiPretoria.
xh.requirements: Isifundo se-undergraduate (inqanaba 7 le-NQF) njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA kwi-Education/Social Sciences okanye eselifana nalo. Isatifikethi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholiweyo kwisikolo karhulumente we-National School of Government (NSG) siyaphothulwa (sifunwa kuzo onke amangeni phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Iminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu [5] yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/phezulu lokulawula kwendawo efanayo. Isikhululo sokhuseleko. Ukuba nobuchule ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo. Ulwazi Olufunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda inkqubo yoBulawa zeCala zaseMzantsi Afrika nokwakheka kweZiko leenkonzo zokuLungisa. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zelizwe nemithetho ehlobene nayo (uMthetho weZenkonzo zeLizwe nemiQathango, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente noMthetho weeNkonzo zokuLungisa 111 ka-1998 njengoko ulungisiwe). Ikhono nezinto ezigqithisayo: Ulwazi ngawo onke amathetho, imilinganiselo nemiqathango elawula imfundo nolwazi lokuPhuhliswa kweNkhosi. Ulwazi nge-PFMA – ukulungiselela amabhajeti, ukulinganisa, ukuchithwa kwemali nokuBika. Ukuqonda imo ye-DCS. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zelizwe neMithetho yayo. Ukuqonda urhwebo loBulawa. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nayo, ukuqhaga kokuzonke nokuPhucula umgangatho. Ukucinga ngokusesikweni nokusebenzisa ulwazi nokuqhagamshelana nabathathi-nxaxheba. Ulawulo lweenkqubo nokuqhathanisa izinto. Ikhono lokubonisa nokuBanga iingxelo. Imilinganiselo yokunika iinkonzo. Ukuphuhlisa abanye (ukuyala, ukuyala ngokusesikweni, ukuziqqisa). Ukwenza iigqibo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuxoxisana noku lungisa. Unxibelelwano nokuLawula iingxabano. Ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo, ukuqhathanisa, ukulandelela, ukulinganisa ingomso nokuNika ingcebiso ngokuzisebenzisa.
xh.duties: Ukulawula, ukuphuhlisa nokuyila iinkqubo zecurriculum zeMfundo Eqaqwe ngokusesikweni ngokwemilinganiselo ye-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Ukulawula, ukuphuhlisa nokuyila iinkqubo zecurriculum yemfundo eqaqwe ngokusesikweni neendlela zayo kubangeni ngenxaxheba. Ukulawula ukulawulwa kwecurriculum eqaqwe ngokusesikweni kubangeni ngenxaxheba. Ukuphuhlisa nokuLawula ukusasazwa kwemfundo eqaqwe ngokusesikweni nokuziqqisa kubangeni ngokwemithetho yesebe nokuqhubeka. Ukulawula ukuhlanganiswa kokuziqqisa ngokusesikweni. Ukulawula, ukuphuhlisa nokuyila iinkqubo zecurriculum yolwazi lokuPhuhliswa kweNkhosi neendlela kubangeni ngokwemilinganiselo ye-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Ukulawula ukulawulwa kwecurriculum yolwazi lokuPhuhliswa kweNkhosi kubangeni ngenxaxheba. Ukulawula kuqiniseke uphando nokuPhuhliswa kwenkqubo. Ukuphuhlisa nokuLawula ukusasazwa kokuziqqisa kolwazi lokuPhuhliswa kweNkhosi kubangeni ngokomthetho ochanekileyo, imithetho, imilinganiselo nokuqhubeka kwesebe. Ukulawula ukuhlanganiswa kokuziqqisa kolwazi. Ukuqapha iingozi nokuQinisekisa ukulandelela nokulinganisa iinkonzo zecurriculum zeMfundo Eqaqwe ngokusesikweni yolwazi lokuPhuhliswa kweNkhosi. Ukuphuhlisa iindakada zokulandelela nokulinganisa inkqubo yemfundo eqaqwe ngokusesikweni yolwazi lokuPhuhliswa kweNkhosi. Ukunika isigqibo ngokulawulwa ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo amathuba oLwazi lokuPhuhliswa kweNkhosi. Ukulawula abantu, imali, izinto ezibalelwa kwaye iinkcukacha ngenkonzo.

jobs.title: Director: Social Work Services
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 August 2026 @ 15h45. It is the sole responsibility of an applicant to ensure that their application reaches the Department of Correctional Services before closing date.
jobs.summary: Director role at the Department of Correctional Services National Head Office in Pretoria, responsible for managing and coordinating social work services and programmes for inmates.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA in Social Work or equivalent. Five [5] years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in a similar environment. Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as a Social Worker. A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory (required from all applicants prior to appointment). Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Required Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of the South African Criminal Justice System and the Correctional Services architecture. Understanding of public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act and the Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Competencies and Attributes: Knowledge of professional counselling and social work services. Building and sustaining relationships in primary health care. Strategic capability and leadership. Service delivery innovation. Client orientation and customer focus. Financial management. Change management. People management and empowerment. Programme and project management. Communication skills (verbal and written). Problem solving and decision making. Transformation management. Influencing and impact. Policy development, facilitation, conflict management and conceptual skills. Diversity management. Negotiation skills. Confidentiality. Interpersonal relations and time management. Accountability. Diplomacy and tact. Policy development and implementation. Good corporate governance principles.
jobs.duties: Manage, develop, design, implementation, administration and evaluation of services and programmes in line with relevant legislation, regulations, frameworks and departmental policies and procedures. Manage social support services. Manage and monitor the coordination of special categories for inmates. Ensure the coordination of outreach programmes to educate others about psychosocial related problems. Plan and ensure that social work research is undertaken. Liaise and attend meetings with external stakeholders as part of stakeholder engagement. Management of human resources, finances, assets and performance information.
jobs.enquiries: Ms TP Ngobeni Tel No: (012) 305 8589 or Ms NS Khumalo Tel No: (012) 307
jobs.applications: Indicate the reference number and position you are applying for on your application form (Z83) and send your complete application to: The Department of Correctional Services, Post Advertisement Section, Private Bag X136, Pretoria, 0001 OR hand deliver at: 124 WF Nkomo Street, Poyntons Building, Corner WF Nkomo and Sophie De Bruyn Street, Pretoria, 0001 (Previous: Corner Church and Schubart Street) OR you can submit your application online at: https://careers.dcs.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Appointment under the Correctional Service Act Before you apply: All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. Please take note that correspondence will only be conducted with the shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application is unsuccessful. Please do not call the department to enquire about the progress of your application. A pre-entry certificate from the National School of Government (NSG) is required from all applicants prior to appointment. The full details of the SMS pre-entry course are obtainable on: Certificate for entry into the SMS (Senior Management Service) | thensg Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification/s and criminal records verification. Appointment to some of these posts will be provisional, pending the issue of a security clearance. If you cannot get a security clearance, your appointment will be re-considered/possibly terminated. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the department. Following the interview and technical exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA directive on the implementation of competency- based assessment). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tool. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Please send a separate and complete application for each post you are applying for, stating the correct reference for each position you are interested in. Candidates must comply with the minimum appointment requirements. CV’s should be aligned to reflect one’s degree of compliance with the advert requirements and responsibilities. The Department of Correctional Services reserves the right not to fill any of these advertised posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Direkteur: Maatskaplike Werkdienste
af.summary: Direkteursrol by die Department of Correctional Services National Head Office in Pretoria, verantwoordelik vir die bestuur en koördinering van maatskaplike-werkdienste en -programme vir gevangenes.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Sosiale Werk of gelykwaardig. Vyf [5] jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as 'n Maatskaplike Werker. 'n Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Services (SMS) wat by die National School of Government (NSG) verkry is, is verpligtend (vereis van alle aansoekers voor aanstelling). Rekenaarvaardig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die South African Criminal Justice System en die Correctional Services-argitektuur. Begrip van openbare diensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act en die Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en Eienskappe: Kennis van professionele berading en maatskaplike-werkdienste. Bou en handhaaf van verhoudings in primêre gesondheidsorg. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Diensleweringsinnovasie. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Finansiële bestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Program- en projektebestuur. Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Transformasiebestuur. Beïnvloeding en impak. Beleidsontwikkeling, fasilitering, konflikbestuur en konseptuele vaardighede. Diversiteitsbestuur. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Vertroulikheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudings en tydsbestuur. Verantwoordelikheid. Diplomatie en takt. Beleidsontwikkeling en implementering. Beginsels van goeie korporatiewe bestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur, ontwikkel, ontwerp, implementeer, administreer en evalueer dienste en programme in ooreenstemming met tersaaklike wetgewing, regulasies, raamwerke en departementele beleide en prosedures. Bestuur sosiale ondersteuningsdienste. Bestuur en monitor die koördinering van spesiale kategorieë vir gevangenes. Verseker die koördinering van uitreikprogramme om ander op te voed oor psigososiale verwante probleme. Beplan en verseker dat maatskaplike-werknavorsing onderneem word. Skakel met en woon vergaderings by by eksterne belanghebbendes as deel van belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies, bates en prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Umholi: Iinsiza Zomsebenzi Wengaphakathi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somholi eNdwini yezenhlalo mayelana nezinsiza zokusebenza zomnyango wezokulungisa iziphambano, Kanti inxeba likahulumeni likhaya ePretoria, libhekene nokuphathwa kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwemisebenzi yezokwengcondvo kanye nemihlengei yabasebenzi balezi zinhlelo.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingaphansi kweziqu (NQF level 7) njengoba samukelwa yi-SAQA ku-Social Work noma okulinganayo. Five [5] years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in a similar environment. Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wokwelapha ngokomzwelo. Isitifiketi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholakala e-National School of Government (NSG) sibucayi (sidingwa kubo bonke abafuna izikhundla ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oludingekayo: Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda i-South African Criminal Justice System kanye nesakhiwo se-Correctional Services. Ukuqonda inqubo yohulumbe kanye nezinyathelo ezihambisana nomthetho (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act kanye ne-Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Amakhono kanye nezici: Ulwazi ngokwelapha ngokomzwelo kanye nezezenhlalo. Ukwakha kanye nokugcina ubudlelwano ekuqaleni kwezempilo. Ikhono lokubusa kanye nokuqonda uhlelo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza eziyisipho. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuqaphela izidingo zabathengi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuphathwa koshintsho. Ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nakho ukubakhutsaza. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi. Amakhono okuxhumana (okuvela emlonyeni nakubhalwe). Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuphathwa koshintsho. Ukunika amandla nomthelela. Ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo, ukweluleka, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye namakhono okucabanga. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Ukugcina imfihlo. Ubudlelwano nabantu kanye nokuphatha isikhathi. Ukuba nesibopho. Ukuziphatsha ngobungcweti kanye nokuzwela. Ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusebenzisa inqubo. Izimiso ezinhle zokuphatha inkampani.
zu.duties: Phatha, thuthukisa, kluma, phatha ukusetshenziswa, loloba kanye nokuqapha imisebenzi kanye nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nomthetho ohambisanayo, imithetho, izindlela kanye nemibhalo yomnyango kanye nezindlela zokwenza. Phatha izinsiza zokwesekwa ngokomzwelo. Phatha futhi ulawule ukuhlanganiswa kwezigaba ezikhethekile kubasebenzi balezi zinsiza. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemihlela yokufinyelela ukufundisa abanye ngezinkinga eziyimiphumela yengqondo kanye nakho okuyimvakalelo. Cwangcisa futhi uqinisekise ukuba kwenziwa ucwaningo ngomsebenzi wengaphakathi. Xhumana kwaye ubambe iqhaza emihlanganweni nabalingane bangaphandle njengoba kuyinxenye yokuzibandakanya ngokwemihlela. Ukuphathwa kolwazi lwemisebenzi, imali, izinto ezingenamsebenzi ngenkathi zisafuna ukusetshenziswa kanye nolwazi olumayelana nokusebenza.

xh.title: Umongameli: Iinkonzo zoBuntu bomsebenzi
xh.summary: Indima yomongameli kwisebe lezemiLiselwe koluntu ekuBungeni kwelizwe eliPretoria, ephathiswe ukulawula nokuhlanganisa iinkonzo zoBuntu bomsebenzi namanqaku abanjelwe iibhedi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwesidanga seNQF level 7 njengokumanywa yi-SAQA kwiSocial Work okanye esilinganayo. Iimutha emithathu [5] yeminyaka yamava kumgangatho ophakathi oPhezulu wolawulo kwimeko efanayo. UkuBhalisa kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi woBuntu. Isatifikethi sokungena kwiSenior Management Services (SMS) esitholwe kwiNational School of Government (NSG) sinyanzeliswayo (sifuneka kubo bonke abafaka isicelo phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Ukuba nobugcina bolwazi lwekhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela eSebenzayo. Ulwazi oluFunekayo: Ulwazi nokuQonda inkqubo yoBulawa eNingizimu Afrika neluQobo lwezeMiLiselwe koluntu. UkuQonda iNkqubo yeNkonzo kaLuntu neNkqubo yakuHluwa kolawulo edibeneyo (uMthetho woBucala bakaLuntu namaQela oMthetho, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaLuntu noMthetho weMiLiselwe koluntu 111 ka-1998 njengoko ulungisiwe). Iimpawu nobuNtshatsheli: Ulwazi lokuCelisa ngobuchwepheshe ngeNkonzo yoBuntu bomsebenzi. UkuLwa nokuGcina ubudlelwane kwiNkonzo yempilo yokuqala. Ukukwazi ukuCocisa nokuQhuba. uNkamiso oluTsha lweNkonzo. uJoliso kumXhasi nakuGxila kumThengi. uLawulo lweMali. uLawulo loGuqulo. uLawulo abaNtu nokuBa namanXA. uLawulo lweNqaku neenkqubo. Amandla okuThetha (ethethwayo neweBhalwe). ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuThatha iziGqibo. uLawulo loGuqulo. ukuNgenisa isandla nokuba namaphupha. uPeloqinikwe, ukuXhobisa, uLawulo loLwazi, iimpawu zokuBeka iNkqubo. uLawulo lweNtlobo-ngeNtlobo. amandla okuNxibelelwana. eMfihlekweni. uBohlobo boNxibelelwano noLawulo lweXesha. uBubeke. iNkundla yokuziphatha. uPeloqinikwe noBusihlulu. uMthetho oNgenisa iNkqubo woMgaqo-nkqubo noMthetho oQhuba iNkqubo yoMgaqo-nkqubo.
xh.duties: Lawula, phucula, yila, phumeza, lawula nokuNgenisa amanqaku ezeNkonzo nakuMthetho weNqaku ngokwesiseko seNkqubo, uMthetho, iNkqubo yakuHluwa nakoMthetho wezeBuka obuNyulu bobuLungisa nokuBeka iNkqubo yoLuntu. Lawula nokuQwalasela iNkonzo yokuNxibelelwana yoBuntu bomsebenzi nokuLawula iNkqubo yoNxibelelwano. Qinisekisa ukuNxibelelwana koluntu nokuNxibelelwana koluntu. Hlala kwangoku kwaye uNcedise nabani na ngokwakhiwa koluntu nakuNxibelelwano. Cwangcisa kwaye qinisekisa ukuba kwenziwa ulwazi oluLinganayo lweNkonzo yoBuntu bomsebenzi. zu.title: Umqondisi: uMphathi WeNdawo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobuhlola ngezindawo: uMengameli wendawo okhangela izikhungo zokulungiswa kobugebengu, amabhodi okuphathwa kwe-parole kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela ukuphatha amadinga kulo lonke amabhodi okuphathwa kwendawo, okudinga iziqu ezinga le-NQF level 7 futhi abe neminyaka emihlanu womhlaba wolawula.
zu.requirements: Izidingo: iziqu zesikhundla esingaphansi kwezinga le-NQF level 7 kwezolawulo komphakathi / izomthetho / ukufunda ubugebengu / ukuqalwa kwezomthetho mayelana nobugebengu / izifundo zomphakathi noma iziqu ezingakufanelana njengoba kuqashwe yi-SAQA. Isitifiketi sokungena esikhundleni se-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholwe esikoleni kazwelonke sezolawula somphakathi (NSG) siyaphoqelelwa (sidingwa kubo bonke abafaka izicelo ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Ezinkathini eziyisihlanu [5] zomuntu onamava esikhundleni sobaphathi abaphakathi noma abaphezulu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela okuvunyiwe. Ulwazi oludingekayo: Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda indlela esebenza ngayo i-South African Criminal Justice System kanye nesakhiwo sezinkonzo zokulungiswa kobugebengu. Ukuqonda inqubomgomo yomphakathi kanye nezindlela ezibekwe umthetho ezihambisana nayo (i-Public Service Act kanye nemithetho yayo, i-Public Finance Management Act, kugqamise i-Correctional Services Act 111 of 1998 njengoba ilungisiwe). Izakhiwo kanye nezici: Ikhono lokubuka phambili kanye nobuholi. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nemitapo yemidwebo. Ukuphathwa kwezimali, ithuba lokushintsha futhi ohlukahlukene kanye nokulawula ulwazi nokuletha izinto ezintsha ekwenzeni inkonzo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda okubalulekile. Ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokunika amandla abanye. Ukwazi ukuthatha njengamanxiwa futhi ugqamise ukukhathalela abathengi. Ukuxhumana nalabo abaseduze naye. Ukuqina kwesithunzi nokwethembeka.
zu.duties: Qapha ukusebenza okusebenzayo kwezokuboshiwa kanye nokulungiswa kobugebengu, amabhodi okusikhuluma nge-parole, izinkonzo zenhlangano, izinhlelo zentuthuko, izinkonzo ezokunakekelwa, izikhungo zokulungiswa kobugebengu kanye nokulungiswa kwabakithi endaweni yolawulo. Qapha ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokuvikela ukuphatha amadinga okuqinisekisa usiko olujulile nezinhlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa nokulandelwa kwezinqumo kanye nezinqubo endaweni yolawulo. Sakaza futhi sigcine ubudlelwano obusebenzayo nabalingane ababalulekile endaweni ekuhlala kuyo indawo yolawulo. Ukuqapha ngokusebenzayo ukubonakala enkantolo kuboshiwa abalindelwe ukuzwa icala. Ukuphathwa kwezengozi ezenzeka ngesikhathi kwenziwa umsebenzi endaweni yolawulo. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi, kwezimali nempahla. Ukukhuthaza inkonzo yomphakathi kanye nentuthuko yabo bonke abagebengu kanye nalabo abakhiphiwe i-parole ababenjalo ekulungisweni kwabakithi. Ukuphathwa kolwazi mayelana nemikhuba emihle yomsebenzi.

Ukuqonda iinkqubo zemigaqo yoluntu womphakathi nolawulo oluhambelana nawo (iPublic Service Act nemiqathango, iPublic Finance Management Act, ngenkxaso ekugxininisweni kwiCorrectional Services Act 111 of 1998 njengoko ilungisiwe). Ukuzipatha nemiqatho efunekayo: Ikhono lokubeka iinqobo nobungakanani bokulawula nokuba ngumtakeli-hamba. Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Ulawulo lweziyobisi, lokutshintsha izinto nolwahlukano. Ulawulo lolwazi nokuqaliswa okutsha kwenkonzo yokuhamba. Ukuzoba iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Ulawulo labantu nokuqinisekisa amandla abo. Ukumiswa komthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Unxibelelwano. Ukuqina nokuzithembisa.
xh.duties: Ukubukelela ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo kokubekwa edlwangweni nolungiso, amabodi okuzivumela okwesikhashana, iinkonzo zenkampani, iinkqubo zophuhliso, iinkonzo zoluko, iindawo zolungiso nabalungisi bengingqi ngaphakathi kommandla wolawulo. Ukubukelela ulawulo lweenkqubo/ziqendu zokhuseleko eziquka isiphelo soxanduva lokuhlola imiba naziqenduokuqinisekisa ukhuseleko. Ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza nokuzinza kumathirki nemigaqo ngaphakathi kommandla wolawulo. Ukuqamba zigqibeko kwaye zigcinelwe ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nabalingani abaphambili ngaphakathi kwindawo ebumelwaneni bommandla wolawulo. Ulawulo olusebenzayo lokubonakala kwinduli koosuleleli abalindele ukuziswa ebaleni. Ulawulo lwemiba ezinzima ekusebenzeni ngaphakathi kommandla wolawulo. Ulawulo lobuchule bomntu, ezoimali nezinto. Ukukhuthaza inyanisekelo lomphakathi nokuphuhlisa bonke ozenze iinyanga noosulelele ababekiweyo kulungele lwasengcingeni ngaphandle. Ulawulo lophawu lwemigaqo yemisebenzi eyenzekayo.

jobs.title: Regional Head: Facilities

jobs.summary: Regional Head of Facilities for the Department of Correctional Services in the Eastern Cape, responsible for policy coordination and maintenance strategy implementation.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Building Science or equivalent. A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory (required from all applicants prior to appointment). Five [5] years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level in a similar environment. Registration with the relevant professional council of South Africa will be an added advantage. Security clearance. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Required Knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of the South African Criminal Justice System and the Correctional Services architecture. Understanding of public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, with emphasis on the Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Competencies and Attributes: Programme and project management. Engineering, legal and operational compliance. Engineering and operational communication. Process knowledge and skills, mobile equipment operating and maintenance skills and knowledge. Engineering design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer aided engineering applications. Creating high-performance culture. Technical consulting. Engineering and professional judgement. Strategic capability and leadership. Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Financial management. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication, people management, planning, organising, conflict management and negotiation skills. Change management.
jobs.duties: Responsibilities: The coordination of policy. Implementation of new policies, procedures and standards. Monitoring of effectiveness of policies, procedures and standards. Maintain operational effectiveness. Implement maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Quality assessment of facilities. Assessment of facilities on a continuous basis to ensure that proper maintenance is carried out and documented and maintenance teams are properly trained, housed, financed and equipped for their task. Ensure adherence to OHS Act. Ensure training is affected as required by the OHS Act. Ensure continuous updating of the building and maintenance programme for the region. Ensure that priorities in the building and maintenance programme are still in line with departmental strategies and objectives. Ensure the effective and cost-efficient provision of municipal services in the region. Ensure that payment for services are done in a timeous manner. Management of human resources, finances and assets. Management of performance information.

af.title: Streekshoof: Fasiliteite
af.summary: Streekshoof van Fasiliteite vir die Department of Correctional Services in die Eastern Cape, verantwoordelik vir beleidskoördinasie en die implementering van instandhoudingsstrategie.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Building Science of ekwivalent. 'n Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Service (SMS) verkry van die National School of Government (NSG) is verpligtend (vereis van alle aansoekers voor aanstelling). Vyf [5] jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak in 'n soortgelyke omgewing. Registrasie by die tersaaklike professionele raad van Suid-Afrika sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Veiligheidsklarering. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse Strafregstelsel en die Correctional Services-argitektuur. Begrip van openbare diensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, met klem op die Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 soos gewysig). Bevoegdhede en eienskappe: Program- en projekbestuur. Ingenieurswese, regs- en operasionele nakoming. Ingenieurswese en operasionele kommunikasie. Proseskennis en -vaardighede, vaardighede en kennis vir die bedryf en instandhouding van mobiele toerusting. Kennis van ingenieursontwerp en -ontleding. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Ingenieurs- en professionele oordeel. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Probleemoplossing en -ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Finansiële bestuur. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie, mensebestuur, beplanning, organisering, konflikbestuur en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Veranderingsbestuur.
af.duties: Verantwoordelikhede: Die koördinering van beleid. Implementering van nuwe beleide, prosedures en standaarde. Monitering van doeltreffendheid van beleide, prosedures en standaarde. Handhaaf operasionele doeltreffendheid. Implementering van instandhoudingsstrategie deur die verskaffing van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Kwaliteitsassessering van fasiliteite. Assessering van fasiliteite op 'n deurlopende basis om te verseker dat behoorlike instandhouding uitgevoer en gedokumenteer word en dat instandhoudingsspanne behoorlik opgelei, gehuisves, gefinansier en toegerus is vir hul taak. Verseker nakoming van die OHS-wet. Verseker dat opleiding beïnvloed word soos vereis deur die OHS-wet. Verseker deurlopende opdatering van die bou- en instandhoudingsprogram vir die streek. Verseker dat prioriteite in die bou- en instandhoudingsprogram nog in lyn is met departementele strategieë en doelwitte. Verseker die doeltreffende en koste-doeltreffende verskaffing van munisipale dienste in die streek. Verseker dat betaling vir dienste betyds gedoen word. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting.

zu.title: Umhlangabezane Wezinguquko: Izakhiwo
zu.summary: Umhlangabezane Wezinguquko wezakhiwo kwi-Department of Correctional Services e-Eastern Cape, onoxanduva lokuhlanganisa amapholisi nokuqaliswa kwendlela yokugcina izakhiwo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhathi esiphansi (NQF level 7) ezamukelekwa yi-SAQA kwi-Building Science noma ezifanayo. Isitifikedi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholiwe e-National School of Government (NSG) siyisidingo (sifunwa kubo bonke abafaka izicelo ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Ukuba nokuholzwa kweminye emihlanu [5] uphezu kwabunye iminyaka ngazinga lokuba ngumphathi ophakathi noma ophakeme endaweni efanayo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-professional council ehambisanayo yase-Ningizimu Afrika kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukucaciswa kwezokuvikela. Ukubhala nokuqonda ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oludingekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-South African Criminal Justice System nokwakheka kwe-Correctional Services. Ukuqonda umgomo wesevisi yomphakathi nosimiso womthetho ohlobene nawo (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, nangaphezulu ku-Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Amakhono nezimpawu: Ukuqondisa amaphrogramu namaphrojekthi. Ukuthobela umthetho wezobunjiniyela, bomthetho nokuqhubeka. Unxibelelwano lwezobunjiniyela nokuqhubeka. Ulwazi namakhono enqubo, amakhono okusebenzisa nokugcina ukuthutha kwemishini nolwazi. Ulwazi lokuqamba nokuhlaziula izakhiwo. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ezibuswa yikhompyutha. Ukudala isiko elisebenza ngamandla amakhulu. Ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe. Isinqo sezobunjiniyela nesizima. Ikhono lokubamba iqhaza ekuqondiseni nokuqhuba. Ikhono lokuxazula izinkinga nokuhlaziula. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuqondisa iqembu. Ubuciko. Ukuqondisa imali. Ukuqaphela abathunjwa futhi uphendule. Amakhono okuxhumana, okuphatha abantu, okucwangcisa, okuhlela, okuphatha izinkinga nokuxoxisana. Ukuphatha inguquko.
zu.duties: Izinxibelelwano: Ukuhlanganisa amapholisi. Ukuqaliswa kwamapholisi amasha, izinqubo nezindinganiso. Ukuqaphela ukusebenza kwamapholisi, izinqubo nezindinganiso. Ukugcina ukusebenza ngokwemisetshenziswa. Ukuqalisa indulela yokugcina izakhiwo ngokunikezwa kwezakhiwo, izimiso nezinsiza ezifanele. Ukuhlola izinga lezakhiwo. Ukuhlola izakhiwo ngokuqhubeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukugcana okufanele kwenziwa futhi kubhalwe ukuthi amaqembu okugcina ahlotshwe, ahlale kahle, axhaswe nge’mali ahlinzwe ngezinsiza ezifanele. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela i-OHS Act. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kwenziwa njengoba kudingwa i-OHS Act. Ukuqinisekisa ukubhalwa ngokuqhubeka kohlelo lokwakha nokugcina eveni lonke. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okubalulekile ohlelweni lokwakha nokugcina kusahambisana nezindlela nezinhloso zomnyango. Ukuqinisekisa ukunikwa ngokusebenza kahle nangokugcina amaholo amasevisi omasipala eveni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhokhelwa kwezinsiza kwenziwa ngesikhathi. Ukuphatha abantu, imali nezimpahla. Ukuphatha ukwaziswa ngemisebenzi.

xh.title: Inkokeli yommandla: Iindawo
xh.summary: Isithuba sobuNkundla beeNkcukacha zeNdawo kwi-Department of Correctional Services kwi-Eastern Cape, enoxanduva lokulungelelanisa imigaqo-nkqubo nokuphumeza inkqubo yokonakaliswa.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA kwi-Building Science okanye esingekho ngaphantsi koko. Isatifikethi sokungena kwi-Senior Management Services (SMS) esifunyenwe kwi-National School of Government (NSG) siyaphoqeleka (sifunwa kubo bonke abafaka isicelo phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Imihla elikhulu [5] yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi eliphezulu lolawulo kwimeko efanayo. Ukujoyina kunye nekomkhulu elichwephileko lelona lisemzantsi Afrika kuya kuba luncedo elongeziweyo. Isaziso sokhuseleko. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba ethe ngqo. Ulwazi olufunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda inkqubo yoBulungisa boSolwa eMzantsi Afrika nokwakhiwa kwezeNkonzo zoLungiso. Ukuqonda umgaqo-nkqubo wesebe likarhulumente nolawu lwemithetho eluhlobene nayo (i-Public Service Act and Regulations, i-Public Finance Management Act, ngasikweni kwi-Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 njengoko ilungisiwe). Ikhono neempawu: Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Ulwakhiwo lwezakhiwo, ulwalo-lwemithetho nokuzinikela kumsebenzi. Unxibelelwano lwezakhiwo nomsebenzi. Ulwazi nakhono lweenkqubo, ukusebenzisa nokulondoloza izixhobo ezihambahambayo nolwazi. Ulwazi lokuyila nokuqwalasela izakhiwo. Uphando nophuhliso. Izicelo zokwakha ngesikhombisi. Ukuyila inkqubo yamava. Isepitshi yobugcisa. Ukuqwalasela kokwakhiwa nobungcali. Ikhono lokuqonda nokuqondisa. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Inovethi. Ulawulo lweemali. Ukwagqitha kubathengi nokuabela. Unxibelelwano, ulawulo lwabantu, ucwangciso, ukuhlela, ulawulo lweengxabano nakhono lokuxoxisana.
xh.duties: Izibhenezo: Ulungelelwaniso lwemigaqo-nkqubo. Usetyenziso lwemigaqo-nkqubo, iinkqubo nezazinga ezintsha. Ukulola ukusebenza kwemigaqo-nkqubo, iinkqubo nezazinga. Ukugcina ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo. Ukuphumeza inkqubo yokonza ngenkqubo yokubonelela ngokweenkokeli, iinkqubo namathafa. Ukuqinisekiswa kokulinganiswa kolwakhiwo. Ukutshintshiselwana iindawo ngokungapheliyo ukunqinisekisa ukuba ukonakaliswa okulungileyo kwenziwa kwaye kubhalwe, kwaye amaqela okonakaliswa aqeqeshwe kakuhle, abekwe kwindawo yokuhlala, axhaswe ngeemali kwaye anezixhobo zomsebenzi wawo. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela kuMthetho we-OHS. Qinisekisa ukuba uqeqesho lwenziwa njengoko kufuneka nguMthetho we-OHS. Qinisekisa ukuhlaziwa ngokungapheliyo kwenkqubo yokwakha nokonakaliswa kummandla. Qinisekisa ukuba izinto eziphambili kwinkqubo yokwakha nokonakaliswa zisakuhambelana neendaba ezichokobe nezijingo zesebe. Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngokusebenzayo nangexabiso elisebenzayo iinkonzo zasezidlulini kummandla. Qinisekisa ukuba ntlawulo yeenkonzo iyenziwa ngexesha elilungileyo. Ulawulo lwabantu, iimali namaxhobo. Ulawulo lweenkcukacha zokusebenza.

jobs.summary: Director responsible for managing all aspects of Johannesburg Medium B Correctional Centre, including security, case administration and implementation of the Correctional Services Act.

A certificate for entry into the Senior Management Services (SMS) obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is compulsory (required from all applicants prior to appointment). Top secret security classification will be an added advantage. Successful completion of corrections science learnership/basic training. Experience and knowledge of the South African Correctional System and Criminal Justice System. Computer literate. Valid driver’s licence. Understanding of public service policy and related legislative framework (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), with emphasis on the Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Extensive experience in collective bargaining mechanisms and traceable experience in ensuring efficient and effective human resource management. Manage operational support services. Foster a working relationship with the Justice Cluster and the community. Monitor, evaluate and take appropriate action in relation to outcomes on the risk trends. Manage the development and care functions of offenders. Manage social work services, spiritual/moral development, health functions and hospital services for inmates. Ensure that a consistent system of activities within the centre is developed and regular committee sittings do take place. Management of performance information. Management of human resources, finances and assets.

af.title: Direkteur: Hoof van Korrektiewe Sentrum
af.summary: Direkteur verantwoordelik vir die bestuur van alle aspekte van Johannesburg Medium B Correctional Centre, insluitend sekuriteit, kasadministrasie en implementering van die Correctional Services Act.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Publieke Administrasie of ekwivalent. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. 'n Sertifikaat vir toetrede tot die Senior Management Services (SMS) verkry van die National School of Government (NSG) is verpligtend (vereis van alle aansoekers voor aanstelling). 'n Top geheim sekuriteitsklassifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Suksesvolle voltooiing van korreksiewetenskap-leerderskap/grondonderrig. Ervaring en kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Korrektiewe Stelsel en Strafregstelsel. Rekenaargeletterd. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vereiste Kennis: Begrip van die dinamika van die Justisiekluster. Begrip van openbare diensbeleid en verwante wetgewende raamwerk (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), met klem op die Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Relevante ervaring in regulatoriese raamwerk wat openbare diensbeplanningsprosesse regeer. Uitgebreide ervaring in kollektiewe onderhandelingsmeganismes en naspeurbare ervaring in die verseker van doeltreffende en effektiewe menslike hulpbronbestuur. Diepgaande kennis en ervaring van die menslike hulpbronne-wetgewing en regulatoriese raamwerk. Bevoegdhede en Attribuut: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Finansiële en transformasiebestuur. Beleidontwikkeling. Projek- en programbestuur. Fasilitering. Veranderingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Tydbestuur en kliëntefokus. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Afgerigtheid en mentorskap. Goeie werketiek. Vertroulikheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om lang ure te werk. Diplomasie en taktvol. Beïnvloeding en impak. Verantwoordelikheid. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.

Bestuur die implementering van die imperatiewe van die Witpapier oor Korreksies. Bestuur van kasbestuursadministrasie, sekuriteit, ontwikkeling en sorg, eenheidsbestuur en kasbestuurskomitees deur te verseker dat toelatings en vrylatings uitgevoer word, eiendomstoor beveilig is en vermenging van oortreder se kontant, boetes en borgtogbetalings gedoen word. Bestuur interne sekuriteit deur te verseker dat bystandlyste beskikbaar is, voldoende sekuriteit in die sentrum en deurlopende deursoeking gedoen word volgens registers, ens. Bestuur eksterne sekuriteit deur te verseker dat benutting van oortreders by werkspanne, amptenare wagpligte uitvoer en toringposte beman. Bestuur die ontwikkelings- en sorgfunksies van oortreders. Bestuur maatskaplike werkdiense, spirituele/morele ontwikkeling, gesondheidsfunksies en hospitaaldienste vir gevangenes. Verseker dat 'n konsekwente stelsel van aktiwiteite binne die sentrum ontwikkel word en dat gereelde komiteesittings plaasvind. Bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne, finansies en bates.

af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Finansies/Ouditeuring/Voorsieningskettingbestuur. 'n Sertifikaat vir toelating tot die Senior Management Service (SMS) verkry by die National School of Government (NSG) is verpligtend (vereis van alle aansoekers voor aanstelling). Kennis van finansiële wetgewende raamwerke van die Openbare Diens, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Nasionale Tesourie-regulasies (Riglyne, instruksienotas en riglyne), begrotingsbestuursprosesse en -prosedures en voorsieningskettingbestuursraamwerk. zu.title: Umlawuli: Internal Control and Compliance
zu.summary: Umlawuli we-Internal Control and Compliance e-Department of Correctional Services National Head Office e-Pretoria, obuka ukuzinza kwezimali, izinhlelo zolawulo lwangaphakathi kanye nezinhlelo zokubika.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-undergraduate (NQF level 7) ezenziwa isazi ngu-SAQA kwezomnotho/ Ukuhlola/ Ukuphathwa kwe-Supply Chain Management. Isitifiketi sokungena ku-Senior Management Services (SMS) esitholakala e-National School of Government (NSG) siyimpindephinde (sidingwa kubo bonke abafaki isicelo ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu [5] yokuhlola ezingeni lomphathi ongumphakathi noma ophakeme enkundleni ehambisanayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oludingekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda i-South African Criminal Justice System kanye nokwakheka kwe-Correctional Services. Ukuqonda inqubomgomo yomphakathi kanye nohlaka lomthetho oluhlobene (Public Service Act and Regulations, Public Finance Management Act and the Correctional Service Act 111 of 1998 as amended). Amakhono nezimo: Ulwazi ngemiyalo yezimali (MCS and GRAP). Ulwazi ngehlaka lomthetho lwezimali lomphakathi, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury Regulations (Directives, instruction notes and guidelines), izinqubo namaphrocessi okuphatha ibhajeti kanye nohlaka lokuphathwa kwe- Supply Chain Management. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinhlelo zezezingeni likahulumeni (PERSAL, LOGIS, BAS). Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwempahla, thenga kanye nezindlela zokwenza umsebenzi. Ulwazi ngokuhlela isu, ukwenza ibhajethi, ukuhlola kanye nokuphatha ubungozi. Ukwenganyela abahlanganyeli kanye nokuphatha inguquko. Ikhono lokuhlela isu nokuqondisa. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokubanika amandla. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa, ukutolika nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izu kanye nomthetho. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana kanye nokuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukugcwaliseka kokuqashwa kwezindlela ze-Treasury Regulations, i-Modified Cash Standard noma i-Generally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP) kanye namanye ama-Prescripts aba nomthelela kwezimali kanye no- Supply Chain Management (SCM). Qinisekisa izinhlelo zolawulo lwangaphakathi nezokubika ezizinzile ngokwenza ukuhlola, kanye nokuqinisekisa izinhlelo ezingahambisani nemithetho kwezimali kanye no- Supply Chain Management. Nikeza uhlelo lokuhlola ubungozi kwezimali kanye no- Supply Chain Management ngokusungula futhi ubukele izinhlelo zokuphatha ngendlela efanayo izinkinga ezingahambisani nemithetho kanye nokubika ngendlele efanele. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa okusebenzayo kwezokuhlola, kokubili i-Internal Audit kanye nehhovu le-Auditor-General of South Africa ukuze kuphathwe ngokushesha imibuzo yezokuhlola. Phatha ukunikezwa kokuvikela ukwenza ubuqambi kanye nokulawula izintela. Nikeza umbiko wanyanga zonke ku-National Treasury nakusiKantolo eSikhulu Sezimali mayelana nezimo ezibikiwe zokusebenzisa izimali ngendlela engafanele, engenamsimbi kanye neyokuchitha izimali nsizakala. Buka futhi ulawule ukuqashwa kwezinhlelo zokuqinisekiswa. Ukuphathwa kolwazi mayelana nemisebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi, kwezimali kanye nezimpahla.

Ukuziqondakalisa ngengcinezela yoluntu nolwandiso lwayo ngezinye iinkqubo eziza nayo (iPublic Service Act and Regulations, iPublic Finance Management Act, iNational Treasury Regulations, iPublic Service Act 111 ye1998). Ulwazi ngolawulo loMthetho oza ngezigqibo, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezilawula abantu abathile, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezilawula imali esetyenziswa ngokomthetho (iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA)), iNational Treasury Regulations (Directives, instruction notes and guidelines), iinkqubo nendlela yokulawula imali nolwandiso lweziMpahla ezithunyelwa ngeenjongo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngokuqonda iinkqubo zeRhulumente ezilawula imali. Ukuziphatha okuhle nokukwazi ukulawula imali. Ukuzinza koluntu, nokuqonda ukuba ngumntu ongumlawuli. Ukuzinza nokuba nolwazi ngokulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezilawula abantu abathile, ezilawula imali esetyenziswa ngokomthetho (iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iNational Treasury Regulations, iinkqubo nendlela yokulawula imali, iinkqubo nendlela yokulawula imali, iinkqubo ezilawula imali esetyenziswa ngokomthetho, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezilawula abantu abathile).
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okusebenzayo kokuzithoba ngokwamalungiselelo eTreasury, kwiModified Cash Standard okanye kwiGenerally Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP) nakwezinye iimScript ezinceda kwezeMali kwaye zithinto ukulawulwa kweSicelo se Supply Chain Management (SCM). Qinisekisa ukulawula okusebenzayo kwangaphakathi nezikhokelo zokuvelisa iingxelo ngokwenziwa kokuhlolwa, ukumiswa kwendlela emalunga nezoMali kunye namancedo e Supply Chain Management ekuzithobeni okungalunganga. Yenze inkqubo yokulinganisa ubungozi kwezoMali nakwi Supply Chain Management ngokuphuhliswa nokulawulwa kweenkqubo zokusingatha ngokulinganayo iindaba zokungazithobi ngokulungileyo nokubika ngokufanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kolwabiwo-lwase ngokusebenzayo, kokwabo uNtlalo-ntsinda ongaphakathi nokulawulo leNkundla kaMphathiswa weziLwazi-mali waseMzantsi Afrika, ukusombulula ngexesha iimbuzo ezivela kulwabiwo-lwase. Lawula ukunikwa kolwazi lokuthintela ukrangula nolawulo lokulahleko. Zize iingxelo nyanga zonke kuNational Treasury nakusiNkulumbuso wezeMali kwimibandela ebikweyo engalunganga, engazuzuzo nengatyalikelwayo. Lawula kwaye ulandele ukusebenza kweenkqubo zokuzithoba. Ulawulo lolwazi ngemigaqo yokwenza. Ulawulo lwabantu, ezemali nempahla.

xh.summary: Isithuba somLawuli kwisebe leZiko loLungiso lweenkonzo eziphatha ifayili yeefundi zeziseko, ifondo yamafa kunye neenyana, kunye nesivumelwano seProtea-Karridene eNtloko eNkulu yoMmandla ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezingaphantsi kwesidanga (NQF level 7) ezivunywe yi-SAQA kwiNtengiso yoLawulo lwaseZikowini / uLawulo lweShishini / uLawulo / uLawulo lweShishini okanye okulinganayo. Isatifikethi sokungena kwiSebe lezeMisebenzi ePhakamileyo (SMS) esityiweko kwiSikolo seeLwazi sikaRhulumente weSizwe (NSG) simfuneko (sifuneka kubo bonke abafake izicelo ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni). Iminyaka esi [5] yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/phezulu lolawulo kwimeko efanayo. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiweyo. Ulwazi olufunekayo: ukuqonda iimpembelelo zeQela loBulungisa, iPeperu eMhlophe ngokuLungisa eMzantsi Afrika nePeperu eMhlophe ngoBambeleli abalindele ukuziswa ngenkundla. Ukuqonda iNqumla yeRhulumente yoLuntu nomthetho ohambelanayo (uMthetho woLawulo woLuntu namalungiselelo awo kunye noMthetho woLawulo lweMali eRhulumentini). Ikhono neempawu: Ikhono lokulawula ngokwezichaso nokukhokela. Inguquko ekulekweni kwemisebenzi. Uqhelaniso nabanini bemisebenzi nokuqwalasela abathengi. ULawulo lweMali. ULawulo loguquko. ULawulo labantu nokuqaqamba. ULawulo lweenkqubo namaphrojekthi. Ikhono lokuthetha nokubhala. Ikhono lokuxazulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. ULawulo loguquko. Ukuthonya nomosinga. Uphuhliso, ukuqhuba, ulawulo loqhudelwanano kunye namakhono okuqamba. ULawulo lwehlahlobanti. Amakhono okuxoxa. Iimfihlo. Iingqwalasela zobuntu nokulawula ixesha. Ukuziphendulela. Ubulumko nobungathandi banto. Uphuhliso nokusebenzisa iNqumla. Iimvisiswano ezilungileyo zoLawulo lweKampani.
xh.duties: Ulawulo olusebenzayo lwezimali nezinye iintsapho zamalungu nokuqinisekisa ulawulo olulungileyo lwemali yefundo. Uncedo kummandla ekusekweni kweklabhu nokumisa iindawo zokurhweba. ULawulo olusebenzayo lwefundo yamafa kunye neenyana. ULawulo lwesivumelwano seProtea-Karridene namaphrojekthi okujolisa ukuphucula ifundo. Ukuqinisekisa ngokoqhubelo ukuthobela zonke iinqula, imigaqo namalungiselelo ngaphakathi kwesebe nayo achaphazela ifundo. ULawulo olusebenzayo lengozi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthobela iplani yolawulo lweengozi. ULawulo olusebenzayo nolufezekisayo lwefundo yemidlalo yelizwe kunye nezimali mboleko zokufunda ezingenazo inzala. Okubika kwexesha ngesikathi samaxesho kuboto yabaBaphathi ngeenkxalabo zamazizo nefundo eziphuhla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba abagcini bemali bayakhiwa nzela kwinkqubo yemali/esoftweka efanelekayo nakulawulo lweMali ngokubanzi. ULawulo lwezibhalo zenkonzo. ULawulo labantu, iimali namacebo.

jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.summary: Chief Executive Officer sought by the Department of Employment and Labour to lead strategic planning, corporate governance, operations and business growth at Supported Employment Enterprise in Silverton.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF Level 7 as Recognized by SAQA in Business Administration / Public Management / Business Management / Commerce / Economics / Industrial Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Manufacturing Management / Operations Management / Public Management. A valid driver’s licence. Five (5) years experience at a Senior Managerial level in the manufacturing or operations environment. Knowledge: Manufacturing and production, Planning, evaluating and governance, Treasury Regulations, Sound Support Employment Enterprise concepts, Employment and labour Market challenges in South Africa, National Development goals, Public Service Act, Finance, Human resource, Operations and marketing, Research and development. Skills: Leadership, Planning and organising, Communication, Diversity management, Computer literacy, Analytical, Presentation, Interpersonal, Report writing, Leadership, Networking.

Lead and direct all Operations of the Enterprise. Drive business development, market positioning and Enterprise growth. Lead and direct performance monitoring, evaluation and Enterprise reporting. Provide Strategic leadership, support and advice to the SEE regarding financial management functions and ICT practices. Lead the management of human Resource Operations in the Enterprise. Lead the management of Human Resource Development, Performance Management and Employee Health and Wellness functions in the Enterprise.
