af.title: Chief Executive Officer
af.summary: Department of Employment and Labour soek 'n Chief Executive Officer om strategiese beplanning, korporatiewe bestuur, bedrywe en besigheidsgroei by Supported Employment Enterprise in Silverton te lei.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 soos erken deur SAQA in Business Administration / Public Management / Business Management / Commerce / Economics / Industrial Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Manufacturing Management / Operations Management / Public Management. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Vyf (5) jaar ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak in die vervaardigings- of bedryfsomgewing. Kennis: Vervaardiging en produksie, beplanning, evaluering en bestuur, Treasury Regulations, goeie Support Employment Enterprise-konsepte, Employment and labour Market-uitdagings in South Africa, nasionale ontwikkelingsdoelwitte, Public Service Act, Finansies, menslike hulpbronne, bedrywe en bemarking, navorsing en ontwikkeling. Vaardighede: Leierskap, beplanning en organisering, kommunikasie, diversiteitsbestuur, rekenaarvaardigheid, analities, voorlegging, interpersoonlik, verslagskrywing, leierskap, netwerking.
af.duties: Lei en bestuur die implementering van die Enterprise se strategiese plan, besigheidsplan en doelwitte. Verseker goeie korporatiewe bestuur, risikobestuur en nakoming. Lei en bestuur alle bedrywe van die Enterprise. Dryf besigheidsontwikkeling, markposisionering en Enterprise-groei aan. Lei en bestuur prestasiemonitering, evaluering en Enterprise-verslagdoening. Verskaf strategiese leierskap, ondersteuning en advies aan die SEE rakende finansiële bestuursfunksies en IKP-praktyke. Lei die bestuur van menslike hulpbronbedrywe in die Enterprise. Lei die bestuur van menslike hulpbronontwikkeling, prestasiebestuur en werknemergezondheids- en welstandsfunksies in die Enterprise.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Ophethe Ikhulu Leshishini
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umphathi Omkhulu Ophethe Ikhulu Leshishini ngumnyango we Employment and Labour ukuba abe ngumholi wezokuhlela kabanzi, ulawulo lwebhizinisi lwenkampani, imisebenzi yokusebenza nokukhula kwebhizinisi e Supported Employment Enterprise e Silverton.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinganqangi ezinga le NQF Level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi SAQA kuma Business Administration / Public Management / Business Management / Commerce / Economics / Industrial Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Manufacturing Management / Operations Management / Public Management. Ileyisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Isipiliyoni seminyaka eyisihlanu (5) esibangeni sabaphathi abaphezulu emvelwaneni wokukhiqiza noma wokusebenza. Ulwazi: Ukukhiqiza nokukhiqiza embonini, Ukuhlela, ukuhlola kanye nolawulo, Imitsetmo ye Treasury, Izimiso ezinhle ze Sound Support Employment Enterprise, Inkinga ze Employment kanye nothengiso kanye nethi lungiselelo e South Africa, Izinhloso zezwe zokuthuthukiswa, I Public Service Act, I Finance, izinsizakalo zabantu, Imisebenzi kanye nothengiso, Ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko. Amapassport: Ubunkosi, Ukuhlela kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo, Unxibelelwano, Ukuphathwa kobunye ulimi, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuhlaziya, Ukubhala izikhashana, Ukuba nomoya wokuxhumana, Ukubhala imibhalo, Ubunkosi, Ukwakha izinhloba zonxibelelwano.
zu.duties: Hola futhi uqondise ukusetshenziswa kohlaka lwe Enterprise lwezindlela zokuqamba, uhlelo lwebhizinisi kanye nemigomo. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluhle lwebhizinisi, ulawulo lwezingozi kanye nokuthobela imithetho. Hola futhi uqondise yonke imisebenzi ye Enterprise. Phenduka uthuthukise ibhizinisi, ukubekwa kweso ukuthengiswa kanye nokukhula kwe Enterprise. Hola futhi uqondise ukulandwa kwentengo, ukuhlola kanye nokubika nge Enterprise. Nikeza ubunkosi obuyisilekelelo, ukwesekwa kanye nenkulumo-ngqo mayelana ne SEE mayelana nomsebenzi wokuqasha imali kanye nezindlela ze ICT. Hola ulawulo lwezinsizakalo zabantu ze Human Resource Operations ku Enterprise. Hola ulawulo lwe Human Resource Development, ulawulo lwenzo kanye nemisebenzi yezempilo kanye namaphiliso abasebenzi ku Enterprise.

xh.title: Ithusi eliPhezulu eliNgunye
xh.summary: Kufunwa ithusi eliphezulu elingunye ngumsebenzi wase-Department of Employment and Labour ukuba kalatha ucwangciso lweenjongo, ulawulo lolwakhiwo lwenkampani, iziphili, nentluko yoshishino kwi-Supported Employment Enterprise e-Silverton.
xh.requirements: Isifa kwinqanaba le-NQF Level 7 njengokuvunywa yi-SAQA kwi-Business Administration / Public Management / Business Management / Commerce / Economics / Industrial Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Manufacturing Management / Operations Management / Public Management. Ilayisenesi yokuqhayisa esemthethweni. Imihla yomsebenzi emi-5 (5) kwinqanaba lokuba ngumlawuli oyinketheli kwindawo yokwenziwa kwezinto okanye kwindawo eziphilayo. Ulwazi: Ukwenza kweenkokheli nokukhiqiza, Ucwangciso, ukuhlola nolawulo, Iitjhbhalo ze-Treasury, Iinkomba ezichanekileyo ze-Supported Employment Enterprise, Iingcinga zomsebenzi nentengiso yabasebenzi e-South Africa, Iinjongo zeZizwe eziPhuhliswayo, Umthetho woLwalamuko loLuntu, Iimali, abantu abangenamsebenzi, iziphili kunye nentengiso, Uphononongo nentluko. Amakhono: Ukulatha, Ucwangciso nokuqamba, Unxibelelwano, Ukulawula iintsapho ezahlukeneyo, Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukuhlola, Okubonakalayo, Okusesiqu, Ukubhala iingxelo, Ukulatha, Ukwenziwa kweenxibelelwano.
xh.duties: Latha kalatha kuqalise ucwangciso lweenjongo lwe-Enterprise, ucwangciso loshishino nemiqango. Qinisekisa ulawulo lolwakhiwo oluchanekileyo loluntu, ulawulo lobungozi nokuthobela umthetho. Latha kalatha zonke iziphili zokusebenza kwi-Enterprise. Khuthaza ukuphuhliswa koshishino, ukubekwa kwentengiso nentluko ye-Enterprise. Latha kalatha ukuqwalasela ukusebenza, ukuhlola nokubika kwi-Enterprise. Nikela ngukulatha ngokweenjongo, inkxaso kunye neengcebiso kwi-SEE malunga nemisebenzi yokuqonda iimali nokuqhelisela iidijitha. Latha ulawulo lomsebenzi wabantu abasebenzayo kwi-Enterprise. Latha ulawulo lokuPhuhliswa kweLisebe lokuQonda iimali, ukuQwalasela ukusebenza nokuQwalasela impilo yabasebenzi nendalo kwi-Enterprise.

Cobit/ ITIL Fundamentals, CCNA, CompTIA Security+, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) en CompTIA CySA+ is 'n bykomende voordeel. Vyf (5) jaar funksionele ervaring in die IKK / IT-omgewing. Cobit/ ITIL Fundamentals, CCNA, CompTIA Security+, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) kanye ne-CompTIA CySA+ kuyinto engeza inzuzo. Ukwazisebenza iminyaka emihlanu (5) kokusebenza endaweni ye-ICT / IT. Hlela, fake ngaphakathi uphathe idatha ehlanganisiwe, Access Point Network (APN) kanye ne-Mobile Networks. Phatha imisebenzi yokuvikela ukubhema emshinini ngaphakathi kwe-Department. Phatha wonke amas zas e-Sub-Directorate.

jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed at the Compensation Fund in Pretoria to manage HRD strategies, workplace skills plans, performance management and developmental programmes.
jobs.requirements: Undergraduate qualification (NQF level 6) as recognized by SAQA in Human Resource Management / Human Resource Development. 5 years’ functional experience in Human Resource Development & Performance Management of which 2 years at Assistant Director level in Human Resource Development & Performance Management environment. Knowledge: Performance Management Methodology, Principles and strategies. Digital Acumen / Relevant HRM system / Learning Systems / Performance Systems, etc. Del and Compensation Fund business strategies and goals. COIDA. DPSA Directives. af.summary: Statutêre Dienste-beampte benodig by die KwaZulu-Natal Provinsiale Kantoor om nakoming van arbeidswetgewing af te dwing, wat 'n regskwalifikasie en een jaar se relevante ondervinding vereis.

zu.title: Umphathi wamasevisi Ezomthetho
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhundla somphathi wamasevisi Ezomthetho e-KwaZulu-Natal Provincial Office ukuze kuqiniswe ukuhambisana nomthetho wabasebenzi, kudinga iziqu zomthetho kanye nonyaka owodwa wamava ahambelanayo.
zu.requirements: I-BPROC/ I-BCOM Law/ I-LLB. Unyaka owodwa (1) wamava kwindawo yomthetho/ukuhambisana nemithetho. Ilayisense elitholiwe lokushayela. Ukuqoqa izibalo zeziyuniti.

af.title: Bcea-inspekteur
af.summary: BCEA-inspekteur by Dundee Labour Centre wat handhawing van nakoming van arbeidswetgewing deur beroepsinspeksies en ondersoeke afdwing, wat 'n relevante driejaar-kwalifikasie en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jaar relevante kwalifikasie in Arbeidsverhoudinge / BCOM Regte / LLB. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Departementele beleide en prosedures, Skills Development Act, Labour Relation Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Unemployment Insurance Act. Unemployment Insurance Contribution Act. af.duties: Voer beroepsinspeksies uit met die doel om nakoming van alle arbeidswetgewing te verseker. Voer ondersoeke uit na aangemelde sake rakende die oortreding van arbeidswetgewing en tree waar en wanneer nodig af te dwing. Voer gereeld proaktiewe (Blitz) inspeksies uit om nakoming van arbeidswetgewing te monitor. Voer voorligtingsveldtogte uit oor geïdentifiseerde en toegewysde arbeidswetgewing. zu.title: Isiphengi se-BCEA
zu.summary: Isiphengi se-BCEA esikhungweni sezabasebenzi e-Dundee esibeka ukuthobela umthetho wobusebenzi ngokwenza ukuhlolwa nokuphenya emsebenzini, kudinga iziqu zobudlule obuthathu ezifanele kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zobudlule obuthathu (3) ezifanele koBudlelwano Basebenzini / I-BCOM Law / I-LLB. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango, umthetho wokuQaqeleka Amakhono, umthetho woBudlelwano Basebenzini, umthetho weziMiso Eziyisisekelo zokuQashwa, umthetho weNsimbi yokungalaleli eSebenzini. Umthetho wokuNikela ngokusiza eNgqikithini yokuGaqelwa ngabangasebenzi. Amakhono: Ukukhuthaza, ukuHlela lokuHlela (umsebenzi wakho), ikhompuyutha (Amaspredshithi, I-PowerPoint, nokuBhala), phakathi kwabantu, ukuXazulula izinkinga, ukuphendula imibuzo, ukuHlaziya, ukuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala, umthetho weGunya ekuQeqeshweni Kwabasebenzi.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuhlolwa emsebenzini ngegijima lokwethembisa ukuthobela yonke imithetho yobusebenzi.enza ukuphenya izindaba ezibikwe ngokuphathene nokungalaleleka komthetho wobusebenzi uphinde ubuse lapho futhi nini lapho kudingeka khona. Yenza ukuhlolwa okuzethembisa (i-Blitz) njalo ukuze ubuke ukuthobela umthetho wobusebenzi. Yenza amakhempu okukhuthaza ngemithetho yobusebenzi etholakele enikelwe. Siza ekubhalweni kwezinhlelo zokuhlola, imibiko nokuqoqanwa kwezibalo kuzindaba ezinikelwe.

xh.title: Isiphenduli kwi-BCEA
xh.summary: Isiphenduli kwi-BCEA kwiziko leDundee Labour elibeka ukuthobela imithetho yabasebenzi ngokwenza iindwendwo zokuqinisekisa nophando, kwaye kufuneka ube nesidanga sezimali esifanelekileyo seminyaka emithathu nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sezimali esifanelekileyo kwiminyaka emithathu (3) kwilabour Relations / BCOM Law / LLB. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi: Iindlela nemiqathango yesebe, Skills Development Act, Labour Relation Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Unemployment Insurance Act. Unemployment Insurance Contribution Act. Amakhono: Ukwenza amacebo, Ukuqamba iindlela nokuhlela (Umsebenzi wakho), Khompyutha (Spreadsheets, PowerPoint, nokubhala ngesandla), Ubomi obungaphakathi, Ukuxazulula iingxaki, Ukuphendula iimbuzo, Ukuhlola ngokweenkcukacha, Ukuthetha nokubhala, Employment Equity Act.
xh.duties: Yenza iindwendwo zomsebenzi ngenjongo yokugqiba ukuthobela yonke imithetho yabasebenzi. Phengisa iingxelo ezibikiweyo ezimala nokungalaleli kwimithetho yabasebenzi uze uyiphathe apho naxa kufuneka. Yenza iindwendwo ezize ngaphandle (Blitz) rhoqo ukuze ulandele ukuthobela imithetho yabasebenzi. Yenza amajelo okuzisa ulwazi kwimithetho yabasebenzi echongiweyo enikiweyo. Nceda ekubhalweni kweendwendwo zamacebo, iingxelo nokuqokelela izibalo kwiimeko ezinikiweyo.

jobs.title: Scientist Production Grade A: (ABALONE)
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: Conduct applied scientific research on abalone population biology and fishery dynamics to support the sustainability of South Africa's abalone fishery.
jobs.requirements: A BSc (Hons) degree or equivalent qualification in Fisheries Science, Marine Science, Marine Biology, Biological Oceanography, Population Ecology, Quantitative Ecology, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a closely related discipline with a strong quantitative and fisheries science focus; compulsory registration with the South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) as a Professional Natural Scientist (proof must be attached); a minimum of three (3) years’ post-qualification natural scientific experience in fisheries science, marine resource assessment, fisheries research or a related scientific field; demonstrated knowledge and practical experience in population dynamics, fisheries stock assessment and quantitative modelling techniques; proven experience in statistical analysis and modelling of biological and fisheries data; experience in developing, customising and applying scientific models and analytical tools in support of fisheries management and resource rebuilding; knowledge of abalone biology, ecology and fishery dynamics, including recovery and rebuilding strategies for depleted stocks; proven ability to manage, analyse and interpret large scientific datasets; computer literacy, including advanced use of statistical and data analysis software and standard office applications; experience in scientific reporting and the preparation of management-oriented scientific advice; ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary scientific team; good communication and stakeholder engagement skills; willingness to participate in fieldwork, diver-based surveys, farm and processing-facility sampling, and extended field deployments where required; and a valid South African driver's licence.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will join the Benthic Research Group and contribute to the scientific rebuilding and long-term sustainability of South Africa’s abalone fishery. The successful candidate will conduct applied scientific research on the population biology, ecology and fishery dynamics of abalone; undertake quantitative analyses, statistical modelling and stock assessments; develop and apply scientific methodologies, models and analytical tools to support fisheries management and resource recovery; participate in biological monitoring programmes, including diver-based surveys, field sampling and sampling at abalone farms and processing facilities; collect, analyse, interpret and disseminate scientific information; prepare scientific reports, management advice and peer-reviewed publications; participate in Scientific Working Groups and provide scientific inputs into fisheries management and policy development; engage with fisheries managers, industry, research institutions and other stakeholders; review and synthesise relevant scientific literature; identify research gaps and contribute to the development of appropriate scientific interventions; assist with the planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of research projects; and contribute to the supervision, mentoring and development of technicians, students and junior scientists while maintaining continuous professional development in fisheries science
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Qayiso Mketsu at 082 782 9674
jobs.applications: FIM20-2026@dffe.gov.za

Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, Senior Certificate, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry-level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. Following the interview and the technical exercise of all SMS posts, the Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. zu.summary: Yenza ucwaningo olusetyenziswayo kwesayensi ngebhayoloji yabantu baleyo nhlanzi kanye nemicimbe yezololo ukuze usekele ukugcina isimo sezololo ze-abalone eNingizimu Afrika.
zu.requirements: I-BSc (Hons) degree noma izifundo ezilinganayo kwi-Fisheries Science, Marine Science, Marine Biology, Biological Oceanography, Population Ecology, Quantitative Ecology, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, noma inkampani exhunyiwe kakhulu kwezibalo kanye nophando kwezolimo lwangaphansi kwamanzi ngokugcizelela; ukubhaliswa ngokwesinyathelo kwi-South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP) njengentatheli yemvelo yezokwenzayo (isibonelo kufanele sithunyelwe); okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yokusebenza emkhakheni wocwaningo lwemvelo emva kokuthola izifundo kwezolimo lwangaphansi kwamanzi, ekuqoqeni izinsiza zasolwandle, kucwaningweni kwezolimo noma emkhakheni othile wezesayensi; ukwaziswa okubonakaliswe kanye nokuhlakanipha emkhakheni wezinto ezintsha, ukubala imigqa ephathwayo yezinhlanzi, ezinye izindlela zokubala izibalo; amava abonakaliswe ekubaleni amanani kanye nokubhala imibhalo yezinto eziphilayo kwezolimo; amava ekuthuthukiseni, ekwenzeni ngendlela oyifisayo, kokuqonda ngokusebenzisa izibalo sayensi ezixhumanayo; ukwazi ngemvelo yezinhlanzi, isayensi yendalo yazo, kanye nemicimbe ehlobene nolwandle, okuhlanganisa izindlela zokubuyisela nokwakha kabusha izinto ezingase zibuyele emuva; ikhono eliveziwe ekuphathweni, ekuhlazeni nasekuqondweni izixhumanisi ezinkulu zocwaningo olungemthetho; ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, okuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zekhalenda nezibalo, futhi nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zansuku zonke; amava ekubhaleni imibiko yezokwenzayo kanye nokulungiselela izinkomba eziyisayensi eziqondene nokuphathwa; ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela kanye nokuqhuba eqenjini elihlangene abasebenza ngemikhakha eyahlukene; amakhono okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuqonda ukuthi abathintekayo bafuna ukuxhumana; ukuzithoba ukuba yingxenye yomsebenzi wasensimini, ukuxhumanisa abadayisi, ukuqoqa izinto ezitholakala ezibukweni zezolimo kwezinhlanzi, kanye nokusebenza isikhathi eside kuleyo ndawo lapho kudingeka khona; kanye nesiqu sase-South Africa sokushayela.
zu.duties: Ophumelelayo uzonyuselwa eqenjini Lophando olungaphansi kolwandle futhi aze anikeze isandla ekwakhiweni kwesayensi nasekuqiniseni isimo sasenkathi enkulu sokuzinza kolwandle ekuthuthukisweni kwebhuloho ezweni lakithi. Ophumelelayo uzoba nesibopho ekwenzeni ucwaningo lwesayensi olusetshenziswa ocwaningweni ngezinto ezihlotshaniswe nolwandle, indalo, kanye nemicimbe ehlobene nobugcisa bokuloba; aqedele isibalo esinobuningi, ukubala kwemibhalo, kanye nokuhlola imigqa ephathwayo; aze asungule futhi asebenzise izindlela zesayensi, imibhalo kanye nezinsiza zokuhlola ukuze asekela ukuphathwa kolwandle kanye nokuqiniswa kwezinto ezingcolisayo; ahlanganyele ezinhlelweni zokuqapha izinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa izinhlela zokuhlola abadayisi, ukuthathwa kwesampula enkundleni, kanye nokuthathwa kwesampula ezibukweni zolwandle nasemakethe yezolimo lwangaphansi kwamanzi; aqoqe, ahlaze, achaze futhi adlulise ulwazi lwesayensi; alungise imibiko yesayensi, izinkomba zokuphathwa, kanye nemibhalo etholakala ngokuphepha; ahlanganyele eqenjini Lophando Sayensi futhi anike iminikelo yesayensi ekuphathweni kwenhlangano yolwandle nakuthuthukisweni kwezinqumo; axhumane nabaphathi bezenhlangano yolwandle, nabasembizweni, nabezinhlangano zophando, kanye nanabanye abahlanganyeli; ahlola futhi aqoqe imibhalo ephathelene nesayensi; abone izikhala zophando futhi anike isandla ekuthuthukisweni kwezinye izixhumanisi zesayensi ezifanele; asize ekwenzeni izinhlelo, ekusebenziseni, ekuqapheni nasekuhloleni izinhlela zophando; futhi anike isandla ekuqondiseni, ekweliseni nakuthuthukisweni kwabaqaphi, abafundi, kanye nabasosayensi abasha aze aqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa kwakhe ngobungcweti kwinhlangano yolwandle.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Accounting
jobs.summary: Manage GTAC budgets, financial reporting and public finance compliance in line with PFMA, NT regulations and departmental policies.
jobs.requirements: Degree or related qualification in Financial Management or related field. A minimum of 5-7 years’ experience in Budget Planning, Financial Reporting, and in Public Service Financial Management, at least 3-5 years’ experience of which at supervisory / management (ASD) level. An extensive knowledge of PFMA and NT Regulations is an added advantage. Competencies required: Client Service Orientation: Client-service orientation implies helping or serving others, to meet their needs. It means focusing on discovering those needs, figuring out how to best meet them as well as putting into practice the Batho Pele spirit. The term “clients” refers to both internal and external clients. Concern for Quality and Order: Desire to see things done logically, clearly, and well. It takes various forms: monitoring and checking work and information, insisting on the clarity of roles and duties, setting up and maintaining information systems. Effective Communication: Ability to transmit and receive information clearly and communicate effectively to others by considering their points of view in order to respond appropriately. This may involve listening, interpreting, formulating, and delivering verbal, non-verbal, written, and/or electronic messages. It includes the ability to convey ideas and information in a way that brings understanding to the target audience. Holding People accountable: Acts to ensure others perform in accordance with clear expectations and goals. Emotional Intelligence: Capacity for recognising their own feelings and those of others, for motivating themselves and others as a result of this awareness, and for managing emotions within themselves and in others. Information Sharing: Both the motivation to expand and use one's knowledge and the willingness to share this knowledge with others. Integrity/ Honesty: Contributes to maintaining the integrity of the organisation; displays high standards of ethical conduct and understands the impact of violating these standards on an organisation, self, and others; is trustworthy. Networking and Influencing: Establishes, maintains, and utilises a relevant network of contacts in order to keep a pulse on public, political, and internal issues and make informed decisions. It implies an intention to persuade, convince, influence, or impress others in order to meet the intended objectives. Results Orientation: Concern for holding yourself and others accountable for achieving results or for surpassing a standard of excellence. It includes the process of setting measurable objectives, implementing change, and then checking back to determine the effect of your efforts. The standard may be one’s own past performance (striving for improvement); an objective measure (results orientation); outperforming others (competitiveness); challenging goals one has set, or even what anyone has ever done (innovation). Strategic Orientation: Strategic orientation is about taking a broad-scale, long-term view and assessing options and implications. It demonstrates an intimate understanding of the capabilities, nature and potential of the department. It involves taking calculated risks based on awareness of social, economic, market, and political issues, trends, processes, and outcomes as they impact the strategic direction of the department and its linkages with the direction of government. Systems Thinking: Orientation to think in system-wide terms with regard to functions or divisions within the organisation. This includes spotting opportunities to connect the initiatives underway in other areas or proactively sharing information or resources that can be seen to have relevance and impact on others. Team Participation: Works co-operatively with others, working together as opposed to working separately or competitively. Valuing Diversity: Ability to understand and respect the practices, customs, values, and norms of other individuals, groups and cultures. It goes beyond what is required by governmental employment equity regulations to include the ability to respect and value different points of view and to be open to others of different backgrounds or perspectives. It includes seeing others’ differences as a positive part of the work environment. It also means being able to work well with a wide variety of people representing different backgrounds, cultures and socio-economic levels. Vision and Purpose: Modelling and promoting high personal and professional standards that support the organisation’s vision, mandate, and values. Sharing goals, objectives, and ideas to encourage others to commit to and be enthusiastic about realising the vision.
jobs.duties: To ensure that the GTAC budgets are managed in line with relevant legislation, regulations, frameworks, and departmental policies and procedures. Management Accounting Compliance: Monitor legislative and regulatory prescripts relating to public finance management and accounting including the PFMA, GAAP, and GRAP, and make recommendations for amendment to GTAC financial policies and procedures where relevant. Monitor compliance to GTAC financial policies and procedures, and report and ensure that non- compliance issues are addressed. Monitor and address the performance and integrity of the financial management system (PASTEL). Manage the management accounting and reporting schedules, ensuring compliance with NT reporting requirements. Provide advice and guidance to budget managers on the use of forecasting methods and tools. Participate in the internal and external audit reviews. Budget Preparation Management: Coordinate the preparation of financial information required for the strategic and annual performance planning process. Analyse and quality assure the financial information requirements for the evaluation and development of business and project plans. Check and verify the supporting information for various financial planning processes. Develop templates for the collection of budget information from budget managers. Analyse, interpret, and communicate the treasury guidelines for the estimates of national expenditure (ENE). Review and analyse the annual budgets and ensure alignment with the Operating plans. Budget Planning and Implementation Management: Coordinate the preparation and consultation for the MTEF budget process. Align budget statements with the annual performance plan and the strategic plan. Analyse and interpret the requirements for the annual cash flow projections and adjusted as prescribed by Treasury and recommend corrective action where required. Budget Adjustments Management: Undertake the planning and supervise the preparation and consultation process in the implementation of the adjustments estimates process. Assess where shifting of funds/ virements is required and possible by reviewing expenditure against budget and making recommendations for adjustments. Supervise the recording of adjustments and provide feedback to the relevant components. Monitor that all shifts/virements are included in the adjusted budget. Budget rollovers/retain of surpluses management. Ensure that prescripts for ‘funds committed but not spent’ and compliance requirements for budget rollover/retain surplus requests are disseminated to programme managers and in compliance with the NT guidelines. Ensure that all roll-over/ retain surplus requests are analysed, considered, and proposal recommendations developed and submitted to the CFO for a recommendation. Ensure that the approved rollovers are incorporated in the budget adjustments. Monitor expenditure trends, assess additional funding requirements from the adjustment estimates process, and develop proposals on the virement or shifting of funds. Budget Reporting Management: Evaluate information on monthly reports produced (variance between actual versus budgeted expenditure) and recommend appropriate actions where necessary. Monitor that all shifts/virements are included in the In-Year Monitoring Report. Evaluate and monitor the costing model in place. Compile information for the interim and annual performance reports. Provide information for the preparation of the annual financial statements.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Finansiële Rekeningkunde
af.summary: Bestuur GTAC-begrotings, finansiële verslagdoening en openbare finansiële nakoming in ooreenstemming met PFMA, NT-regulasies en departementele beleid.
af.requirements: Graad of verwante kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur of verwante veld. 'n Minimum van 5-7 jaar se ervaring in Begrotingsbeplanning, Finansiële Verslagdoening, en in Openbare Diens Finansiële Bestuur, waarvan ten minste 3-5 jaar se ervaring op toesigt- / bestuursvlak (ASD). 'n Uitgebreide kennis van PFMA en NT-regulasies is 'n voordeel. Vereiste bevoegdhede: Kliëntediensgerigtheid: Kliëntediensgerigtheid impliseer die help of bedien van andere om in hul behoeftes te voorsien. Dit betien om op die ontdekking van daardie behoeftes te fokus, uit te vind hoe om dit die beste te bevredig, asook om die Batho Pele-gesin in die praktyk te bring. Die term "kliënte" verwys na beide interne en eksterne kliënte. Bekommernis oor Kwaliteit en Orde: Begeerte om te sien dat dinge logies, duidelik en gedoen word. Dit neem verskeie vorme aan: die monitering en nagaan van werk en inligting, die aandrang op die duidelikheid van rolle en pligte, die opstel en instandhouding van inligtingstelsels. Effektiewe Kommunikasie: Vermoë om inligting duidelik te versend en te ontvang en effektief met andere te kommunikeer deur hul standpunte in ag te neem om toepaslik te reageer. Dit kan luister, interpreteer, formuleer en die aflewer van mondelinge, nie-verbale, geskrewe en/of elektroniese boodskappe behels. Dit sluit die vermoë in om idees en inligting oor te dra op 'n manier wat verstaan by die teikengehoor bring. Mense Verantwoordelik Hou: Tree op om te verseker dat andere in ooreenstemming met duidelike verwagtinge en doelwitte presteer. Emosionele Intelligensie: Vermoë om eie gevoelens en die van andere te herken, om hulself en andere as gevolg van hierdie bewustheid te motiveer, en om emosies binne hulself en in andere te bestuur. Inligting Deling: Beide die motivering om kennis uit te brei en te gebruik en die bereidwilligheid om hierdie kennis met andere te deel. Integriteit/ Eerlikheid: Dra by tot die instandhouding van die integriteit van die organisasie; toon hoë standaarde van etiese gedrag en verstaan die impak van die skending van hierdie standaarde op 'n organisasie, self en andere; is betroubaar. Nettwerkwerking en Beïnvloeding: Stel, onderhou en benut 'n relevante netwerk van kontakte om 'n pols te hou op openbare, politieke en interne kwessies en ingeligte besluite te neem. Dit impliseer 'n voorneme om te oortuig, te beyver, te beïnvloed of om indruk te maak op andere om die beoogde doelwitte te bereik. Resultaatgerigtheid: Bekommernis om uself en andere verantwoordelik te hou vir die bereiking van resultate of om 'n standaard van uitnemendheid te oortref. Dit sluit die proses in om meetbare doelwitte te stel, verandering te implementeer, en dan terug te keer om die effek van u pogings te bepaal. Die standaard kan eie verlede prestasie wees (streef na verbetering); 'n objektiewe maatstaf (resultaatgerigtheid); om andere te oortref (mededingendheid); uitdagende doelwitte wat gestel is, of selfs wat iemand nog ooit gedoen het (innovasie). Strategiese Gerigtheid: Strategiese gerigtheid gaan oor die neem van 'n breë, langtermyn siening en die assessering van opsies en implikasies. Dit demonstreer 'n diepliggende begrip van die vermoëns, aard en potensiaal van die departement. Dit behels die neem van berekende risiko's gebaseer op bewustheid van sosiale, ekonomiese, mark- en politieke kwessies, tendense, prosesse en uitkomste soos hulle die strategiese rigting van die departement en sy skakels met die rigting van die regering beïnvloed. Stelseldenke: Gerigtheid om in stelselbreed terme te dink met betrekking tot funksies of afdelings binne die organisasie. Dit sluit in om geleenthede raak te sien om inisiatiewe wat in andere areas aan die gang is te verbind, of proaktief inligting of hulpbronne te deel wat gesien kan word om relevansie en impak op andere te hê. Spandeelname: Werk saamwerkend met andere, saam werk in plaas van afsonderlik of mededingend te werk. Waardeering van Diversiteit: Vermoë om die praktyke, gebruike, waardes en norme van andere individue, groepe en kulture te verstaan en te respekteer. Dit gaan verder as wat deur regeringsindiensnemingservigheidregulasies vereis word deur die vermoë in te sluit om verskillende standpunte te respekteer en te waardeer en oop te wees vir andere van verskillende agtergronde of perspektiewe. Dit sluit in om andere se verskille as 'n positiewe deel van die werksomgewing te sien. Dit beteken ook om goed te kan werk met 'n wye verskeidenheid mense wat verskillende agtergronde, kulture en sosio-ekonomiese vlakke verteenwoordig. Visie en Doel: Modellering en bevordering van hoë persoonlike en professionele standaarde wat die organisasie se visie, mandaat en waardes ondersteun. Deel van doelwitte, oogmerke en idees om andere aan te moedig om toe te trou en entoesiasties te wees oor die verwesenliking van die visie.
af.duties: Om te verseker dat die GTAC-begrotings bestuur word in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing, regulasies, raamwerke en departementele beleid en prosedures. Bestuursrekeningkunde Nakoming: Monitor wetgewende en regulatoriese voorskrifte met betrekking tot openbare finansiële bestuur en rekeningkunde insluitend PFMA, GAAP, en GRAP, en maak aanbevelings vir wysiging aan GTAC finansiële beleid en prosedures waar relevant. Monitor nakoming aan GTAC finansiële beleid en prosedures, en rapporteer en verseker dat nie-nakomingskwessies aangespreek word. Monitor en spreek die prestasie en integriteit van die finansiële bestuurstelsel (PASTEL) aan. Bestuur die bestuursrekeningkunde en verslagdoeningskedules, en verseker nakoming van NT-verslagdoeningsvereistes. Verskaf advies en leiding aan begrotingsbestuurders oor die gebruik van voorspellingsmetodes en -instrumente. Neem deel aan die interne en eksterne oudit hersienings. Begrotingsvoorbereiding Bestuur: Koördineer die voorbereiding van finansiële inligting wat vereis word vir die strategiese en jaarlikse prestasiebeplanningsproses. Analiseer en verseker die gehalte van die finansiële inligtingsvereistes vir die evaluering en ontwikkeling van besigheids- en projekteplanne. Kontroleer en verifieer die ondersteunende inligting vir verskeie finansiële beplanningsprosesse. Ontwikkel sjablone vir die insameling van begrotingsinligting van begrotingsbestuurders. Analiseer, interpreteer en kommunikeer die tesourie riglyne vir die raming van nasionale besteding (ENE). Hersien en analiseer die jaarlikse begrotings en verseker belyning met die bedryfsplanne. Begrotingsbeplanning en Implementering Bestuur: Koördineer die voorbereiding en konsultasie vir die MTEF-begrotingsproses. Belyn begrotingsstate met die jaarlikse prestasieplan en die strategiese plan. Analiseer en interpreteer die vereistes vir die jaarlikse kontantvloei projeksies en aangepas soos deur Tesourie voorgeskryf en beveel regstellende aksie aan waar vereis. Begrotingsaanpassings Bestuur: Onderneem die beplanning en toesig hou oor die voorbereidings- en konsultasieproses in die implementering van die aanpassingsramingsproses. Assesseer waar die skuif van fondse/ oorplasing benodig en moontlik is deur besteding teen begroting te hersien en aanbevelings vir aanpassings te maak. Hou toesig oor die optekening van aanpassings en verskaf terugvoer aan die relevante komponente. Monitor dat alle skuifings/oorplasings in die aangepaste begroting ingesluit is. Begroting oorrol behoud van surplus bestuur. Verseker dat voorskrifte vir 'geld toegewy maar nie bestee nie' en nakomingsvereistes vir begroting oorrol/behou surplus versoeke aan programbestuurders versprei word en in nakoming met die NT riglyne is. Verseker dat alle oorrol/ behou surplus versoeke geanaliseer, oorweeg en voorstel aanbevelings ontwikkel en aan die CFO vir 'n aanbeveling voorgelê word. Verseker dat die goedgekeurde oorrols in die begrotingsaanpassings ingelyf word. Monitor bestedingstendense, assesseer bykomende befondsingsvereistes van die aanpassingsramingsproses, en ontwikkel voorstelle oor die oorplasing of skuif van fondse. Begrotingsverslagdoening Bestuur: Evalueer inligting oor maandelikse verslae geproduseer (variansie tussen werkelike teen begrote besteding) en beveel toepaslike aksies aan waar nodig. Monitor dat alle skuifings/oorplasings in die In-Jaar Monitoringsverslag ingesluit is. Evalueer en monitor die kostemodel in plek. Stel inligting op vir die tussentydse en jaarlikse prestasieverslae. Verskaf inligting vir die voorbereiding van die jaarlikse finansiële state.

zu.title: Iphini Lomqondisi: Ezenzimali Ezenziselwa Inani
zu.summary: Phatha izabelomali ze-GTAC, ukubika kwezimali nokuhambisana nomthetho wemali yomphakathi ngokwemigaqo ye-PFMA, imigaqo ye-NT nemigomo yomnyango.
zu.requirements: Iziqu noma izifundo ezihambisanayo kokuqashwa kwezimali noma ngqo ekuleso sikhundla. Ukwazisa okungenani kweminyaka engu-5-7 ekwelapheni izabelomali, ukubika ngezimali, nakokuqashwa kwezimali kwinkonzo yomphakathi, okungenani kweminyaka engu-3-5 lapho khona kunesikhundla sokubukeka / sokuphatha (ASD). Ulwazi olunzulu nge-PFMA nemigaqo ye-NT kuyisibonelo esingeza inzuzo. Izidingo bokukwazi ukwenza umsebenzi: Ukubuka ngqo izidingo zabatholakelayo: Lokhu kusho ukusiza noma ukukhonza abanye, ukuze kuhlangatshelwe nezidingo zabo. Kusho ukugqamisa ukuthola lezo zidingo, ukucabanga ukuthi kungaziwa kanjani ngokufanelekileyo nokuvezwa kokwenza konke okuhlobene nomoya wakwaBatho Pele. Igama elithi abatholakelayo libhekise kubatholakelayo banganaphakathi nabangaphandle. Ukunaka ikhwalithi nokuqondisa: Inkathi yokubona izinto zenziwa ngokulandela umthetho wengqondo, ngokucacileyo, nangokufanele. Kuveza ngamajubane amasha: ukulawula nokuqhathanisa imisebenzi kanye nalokhu okufakiwe, ukuphikelela ekucaceni kwezikhundla nemisebenzi esijabulisa, ukumisa kanye nokuqondisa imithetho yolwazi ekuyona ihle lolwazi. Ukuthintana ngokusebenzayo: Ukukwazi ukuthumela nokuemukela ulwazi ngokucacileyo nokuba nokuqonda okusebenzayo kwabanye bese uvame ukucabangele imibono yawo ukuze uphendule ngokufanele. Lokhu kuhilela ukulalela, ukuhumusha, ukuhlela nokuhambisa imiyalezo ezenzayo noma ezingenzayo, kabanzi noma ubuchwepheshe. Kufaka phakathi ukukwazi ukuvezwa kwemibono nolwazi ngendlela ezoveza ukuqonda kubantu abaliqondiswe kuyo. Ukubamba abantu baziphendule: Ukuqhathanisa izenzo ukuze qinisekiswa ukuthi abanye benza ngokuhambisana nezethembe eveciwe nemigomo ephilayo. Iqondo lezinkalo zengqondo: Amandla okuzwa iziva zawo nasawabanye, wokuziqhubela phambili nawabanye ngenxa yokuziva konke okuhlobene, nangokuzilawula iziva zakhe nasawabanye. Ukukhulisa ulwazi: Ukuzijabulisa ngokwanda kokuvula nokusetshenziswa ngokociko nokuqonda kwakho besekukho isilingo sendlela yokwabelana lolwazi kubantu abente. Ukuzinza / ukuqothoza: Kukhokha ukugcina ukuqotha kobuzwe; ukubonakalisa imigomo emisha yokwenza emihle nokuqonda umthelela wokuphula imigobo ezweni, kuwena naso kubanye; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ungamthembeki. Ukuxhumanisa nokuqinisekisa ukuholayo: Ukumisa, ukugcina, nokusetshenziswa okusesizingeni sabantu abakwenza ukuze kuhlale kumnandi kuwe kwezomphakathi, ezepolitiki, kwezangaphakathi nokwenza izinqumo ezibucayi. Kuhlanganisa izinkalo zokuqinisekisa, ukuzuza, ukugqugquzela noma ukumangazisa abanye ukuze kuhlangatshelane nako okujulise izinjongo. Ukujulise izinjongo: Inkinga yokubamba nawe nawabanye ngokuphendule ekwenzeni iziphumelelo noma ekwedlula imigomo yokugqoka. Kuhlanganisa inqubo yokuqamba imigomo yokwenza ngokulinganiseka, ukulandelwa kokushintsha bese ubuyela emuva ukuze ubone umphumela wemizamo yakho. Imigomo ingase ibe yisipumelelo sakho esidlule (ukuqondiswa ekutheni kwenze ngcono); isilinganiso esibucayi (ukujulise iziphumelelo); ukuqaqabela abanye (ukugqugquza imizwa); imigomo eqinisekileyo oyiqumbe, noma nakho konke okwenzwe nawe (ukulintsha). Ukubuka kwengqondo eqondiswe kuhle nangaphakathi: Ukubuka kwengqondo kuqondiswe ekubukeni nasekuqhathaniseni izinketho kanye nemithelela yezinto kanye nasekubukeni kwezinsuku zakudala. Kubonakalisa ngokuqonda okupheleleyo ngamandla, imvelo kanye nangenani elikhululekile likaMnyango. Kuhlanganisa ukwenza ukugqugquzela amaphupha ahleliwe ekuqondeni izindaba, izimo zomphakathi, ezezimali, zomthengisi kanye nezepolitiki, ukuvakatshela kwezinto, inqubo nemiphumela yazo njengoba ezithinta isiqondiso esibucayi soMnyango kanye nokuxhumaniswa kwaso nokuqondiswa kwesiphuzi sika-Hulumende. Ukucabanga ngesimiso ngokupheleleyo: Ukubuka ngokucabangela ukugcina kwesimiso ngokupheleleyo nangokuhlobene nemisebenzi noma izigaba ezingaphakathi kwenhlangano. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubona izikhathi zokuqhathanisa izinhlelo ezibhukuda kwezinye izindawo, nangokukhululeka ukwabelana ngolwazi noma izinsiza ezingabonwa ngokuthi zibaluleke kakhulu kwezinye. Ukubamba iqhaza eqhweni: Ukusebenza ngokusebenzisana nabanye, ukuba munye ngokuphikisana nokusebenza ngokuhlukana nangokukhuphula imizwa yeqembu. Ukubuka ngokuthanda izinhlobonhlobo: Amandla okuqonda nokuhlonipha imikhuba, okuvamile ukuba kuyo, amagugu nezimiso zabantu, okubalulekile kunoma yiluphi uhlobo. Kudlula ngalokho okudingwa yimigomo yezabelomali kahulumende ukufaka amandla okuhlonipha nokubuka izimiso ezihlukene nokuba mindlekile ngabanye bangemuva okuhlukene noma ngemibono ehlukene. Kufaka ukubona izinto ezihlukene zabantu njengesona sithakazelelo sokusebenza. Kuhunyushwa ngamandla okusebenza kahle nabantu abaningi abehlukene ngokwemvelo ekumele imvelo, amasiko kanye nezimo zezimali nangokwamazinga ezenzansi. Ukubona kanye nethemba: Ukugqugquzela nokukhuthaza ngokuqonda okuphezulu ngokoqaqulisile nakokuzijabulisa okusekela umbono, isibopho namagugu inhlangano. Ukukhulisa amagugu, imigomo, namagugu ngezenzo ezokhuthaza abanye ukuba bazibophezele baze bajabule ngokuqonda ukubona kweqiniso.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhajethi e-GTAC aphathwa ngokulandela imithetho, imigomo namagunya aphathelene, kanye nemigomo nezeMikhuba kaMnyango. Ukulawula ukuhambisana nomthetho wezezimali ezibhalwe ngenani: Ukubuka imithetho namagunya aphathelene nokuqashwa kwezimali zomphakathi kanye nokubhalwa kwawo, okuhlanganisa i-PFMA, i-GAAP kanye ne-GRAP, bese kunikelwa izindaba zokulungiswa kwemigomo kanye nezeMikhuba yezezimali ze-GTAC lapho kufanele khona. Ukubuka ukuthi kuhambiswa ngemigomo nezeMikhuba yezezimali ze-GTAC, bese kubikwa futhi kuqinisekiswa ukuthi izinkathazo ezingahambisani nomthetho zilungiswa. Ukubuka ukusebenza nokuzinza kweqiniso kwesimiso sokuphathwa kwezimali (PASTEL). Ukuphatha izinkathi zokuqashwa kwezimali nababikwayo, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi kuhambisana nezidingo zokubika kwa-NT. Unike amacebo nokuqondisa abaphathi bhajethi ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela namathuluzi okubikele phambili. Ukubamba iqhaza ukubukweni kogqoqho langaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuphatha ukulungiselelwa kwebhajethi: Ukulungisa ulwazi oludele abaphathi bokuqondiswa okubalulekile futhi ngokwanelelolwazi oluadingwa ukuhlonzwa nokusungulwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi namaphulo. Hlola bese uqinisekisa ukungena kolwazi lwesikhundla okudingeka imicimbi eziningi zokucwaningwa kobuchwepheshe bokwenza imigomo yesabelomali. Umise amathempulethi ukuze kuvunyelwe ulwazi ngokungena kolwazi olusuka kubaphathi bemali. Hlola, ulandule, ubike ngqo ulwazi ngokuhlelelwa kwemali yezimali ezichithwa esifundazweni (ENE). Buyela uhlole bese ucubungula izabelomali zonyaka ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nokuhlelwa kwemisebenzi. Ukulungiselela nokuphatha isabelomali nokusetshenziswa kwawo: Lungiselela ukubonisana mayelana nokuqashwa kohlelo lobudlelwano belikhulu eMTEF. Hlanganisa amagama isabelomali nohlelo lokwenza oluhle lonyaka nohlelo oluhle lokubona. Hlola ulwazi futhi ulandule imfuneko yokuqwashisa imali ehamba ngonyaka bese kulungiswa njengoba kuchaziwe uBhansa, futhi uphakamise ukulungiswa lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuphatha ukulungiswa kwesabelomali: Hlela isikhathi bese uqaphela ukulungiselelwa nokubonisana kokuqhathaniswa kwezimali ezichithwayo ukuze kufakwe ezindaweni ezithile. Buza ukuthi kutholakala kwesabelomali / amanye amatshe ucashwa, bese uhlela imigomo yokushintsha imali ukwenza imibiko. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kwemali efakwe kumaphoyinti ahambisanayo futhi unike impendulo ngaloko. Buza ukuthi imali efunwayo ihlanganiswe egcineni kwesabelomali. Ukugcinwa kwesabelomali / ukuphathwa kwesabelo. Qinisekisa ukuthi imithetho ebeka inkinga emali echaqululwe kodwa ingachithwa kanye nezidingo zokuhambisana nemfuneko yokucela ukugcinwa kwebhajethi / ukugcinwa kwesabelo kuyisikhulumi kubaphathi beMibhalo nangokuhambisana nemigomo ka-NT. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izicelo zokugcinwa / ukugcinwa kwesabelo zihlolwa, zihlolwe, futhi zenziwe izinketho zokuqedela bese zithunyelwa kwi-CFO ngenkomba eqondile. Qinisekisa ukuthi izabelomali ezamukeliwe zifakwa kuhlelo lokulungiswa kwesabelomali. Bukela amathrendi okuchithwa kwemali, ahlule imfuneko yokwengeza imali evela kuhlelo lokuqwashisa imali, bese umisa iziphakamiso ngokudluliswa okungalungiswa kwemali. Ukuphatha ukubikwa kwesabelomali: Hlola ulwazi olukhona kwemibiko yenyanga ezivezwa (isihlukanisi phakathi kwezimali ezichitshwe nezimali ezibhalwe ibhajethi) futhi uphakamise izenzo ezifanele lapho kudingeka khona. Bukela ukuthi zonke izinto ezibhekwe ngokulungiswa kwesabelomali zifakwe kumbiko wokugqamisa ngaphakathi kweminyaka. Hlola futhi ubuke ukugcinwa kuhlelo lokwabiwa kwemali. Lunge ulwazi ngemibiko yonyaka nangaphakathi kwamaphuzu. Nikeza ulwazi ngokulungiselelwa imibiko yemali yaminyaka yonke.

xh.title: Isebe Elizayo: I-Deputy Director: Financial Accounting
xh.summary: Lawula amabhajethi e-GTAC, iinkcazelo zemali kunye nokuzithoba ngokwemithetho yemali yoluntu ngokwemigaqo ye-PFMA, iintaela ze-NT kunye namapolisi esebe.
xh.requirements: I-degree okanye isifundo esinxulumenayo kwi-Financial Management okanye olongezo oluxhumile. Amava angaphantsi kwe-5-7 eminyaka yiwo afunekayo kwi-Budget Planning, i-Financial Reporting, nakwi-Public Service Financial Management, kwaye ungamva ongaphantsi kwe-3-5 eminyaka apho uphatha ulawula (ASD) inqanaba. Ulwazi olubanzi ngomthetho we-PFMA kunye neentaelo ezingezantsi ze-NT ngumvuzo ongekhoyo. Iimpawu ezifunekayo: Ukumisela ikhasenda: Ukumisela ikhasenda kuthetha ukuncedisa okanye ukukhonza abanye, ukuze aphelelwe iimfuno zabo. Kuthetha ukugxila ekufumaneni ezo nfuno, ekuzameni iindlela ezona zilungileyo zokuziphelelisa, nasekubekeni elubambeni umoya we-Batho Pele. Igama elithi “abathengi” libhekisa kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukukhathalela ngokwemigaqo nolandelelwano: Inkqubela yokubona izinto zenziwa ngokulandelana ngokucacileyo, kwaye zenziwe kakuhle. Ithatha iindlela ezahlukeneyo: ukuqwalasela nokukhangela ulwazi nolunye uhlobo lwenkqubo, ukumisisa ukucaciswa kwemisebenzi yamalungiselelo, ukuseka kunye nokugcina inkqubo yolwazi. Unxibelelwano olusebenzayo: Ulwazi lokuthumela nokuamkela ulwazi ngokucacileyo nokunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo nabanye ngokuqwalasela iimbono zabo ukuze uphendule ngokufanelekileyo. Oku kunokubandakanya ukumamisela, ukutolika, ukwenza iindlela, nokuvelisa imiyalezo egamini, ngaphandle kwamagama, ebhaliweyo, okanye kwindlela ye-elekthronikhi. Kuqulathe ulwazi ngamava nolwazi okuthumela iimbono nolwazi ngendlela evelisa ukuqonda kwabathunjwa babo. Ukubamba abantu ababekiweyo: Izenzo ezenziwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba abanye benza njengoko bekucaciswe nangokwemigomo echazwe kakuhle. Isazela ngemvakwendalo: Ulwazi lokumangalisela iimvakalelo eziqu kunye nezabanye, ukuzibusa labo nabanye njengexesha lolwazi, nolawulo iimvakalelo kubomi babo nakwabanye. Ukwabelana ngolwazi: Isakhono nesifiso sokwandisa nokusebenzisa ulwazi olunye, nokuba namandla okulwabelana nalolu lwazi nabanye. Ukuqina/ uqine: Inceda ekugcineni intsebenziswano yorhwephishwa ekuzimezeleni; ibonisa imilinganiselo ephezulu yomsebenzi wengqondo elungileyo nokuqonda inginga ekuphuleni le milinganiselo kwisebe, eku, nakwabanye; iyathembakaliswa. Ukuseka intsebenziswano nokuchukumisa: Iyaziseka, iyayigcina, kwaye isebenzise uluntu obumbene nayo ukugcina ukubamba isigaba sabantu, iintshukela, neendaba ezingaphakathi ngenjongo yokwenza izigqibo ezikwaziyo ukuzinika isigqibo. Kuthetha inkqubela yesisa esokuthetha, esokuqinisekisa, esokuchukumisa, okanye esokumangalisa abanye ukugcineni iinjongo ezithunjwe zibe ze. Isigqibo ngemveliso: Ukukhathalela ukubuzwa nawe nabanye emzulisweni ngokufezekiswa kweziphumo okanye ukwenza ngaphezulu kokumisela ukwenzeka kolona ntlelo. Iqulathe iinkqubo zokuqumba iinjongo ezithothothwe ngokwemilinganiselo, ukuzenza utshintsho, nokuqwalasela ukuba lubuyela lusebenza kangakanani na amava akho. Esi sigqibo singaba ngokungaphi na kwakini ukwenza kakuhle ngeminyaka yakho edlulileyo (inkqubo yokuziphucula); isilinganiso esichazwe ngokusobala (isigqibo kwiziphumo); ukwenza ngaphezulu kwabanye (ukukhuphisana); iinjongo ezibuzwe ezenziweyo, okanye nokuba yintoni na oyenzileyo. Ukumisela ukumkhetha isantya sesoxho sengqondo: Esi sigqibo singokumisela ukubuka ngobukhulu bakho, ixesha elide kwaye unqamle iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezinokwenzeka nentsingiselo yawo. Kubonisa ukuqonda ngokusesikweni ngamandla esebe, imvelo kunye namandla esebe. Kuqulathe ukwenza izigqibo ezibalwe ngokulinganiselwa kwemivakalelo ekwazini ngeendaba ezimali, ezontlalo, ezentsika namapolitiki, iindlela zentshukela, iinkqubo, namaphetha njengoko ezingozi intsika yokulawula esebe nendlela ahlanganisweyo nayo eyurhulumente. Amanqanaba enkqubo yokucinga: Isantya sokuqwalasela ukucinga kwi-nkqubo ngokubanzi kwaye ngokweziqu kwimisebenzi eyahlukeneyo okanye ngokwahlukaniswa kweyure ngaphakathi korhwephishwa. Oku kuquka ukuqhawula amathuba okudibanisa iinkqubo ezenziwa kwezinye iindawo okanye ngokulinganisela ukwabelana ngolwazi okanye amathuba ajongene nalawo kubomi. Ukuhluzwa kweekomiti: Usebenza ngokudibana ngeekomiti, usebenzisana eyodwa ngokuchasene nokuba bucala ngokwahlukana. Intlonipho yolwazi woluntu: Ulwazi ngokunqamla nokuzinikela ngokwenza inkqubo yakho ithathelwe ingqalelo iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zabathengi, amaqela, iinkqubo namagugu obume bomntu wonke, ngaphandle koko kufunwa ngumthetho wezibasebenzisi karhulumente. Kuthethwa ngokwenza ngaphezulu kokugqithiselwa ngumthetho ukuba uqonde, unamathisela imigaqo ehlukile nolwazi olahlukeneyo, kwaye ungame kubambiwa ngaphakathi. Iqulathe ukubakho bobakho bezinye izazimali kwendawo yokusebenza. Kuthetha nokuba ukwazi ukusebenza kakuhle nabantu abaninzi abavela kumagugu, iinkqubo nemida engathathiwa ndawonye okanye ngokwentsalo. Imbono nolwazi: Ikhuthaza, ithuthelisa imilinganiselo yobuntu kwingqondo ngokusabela iindlela ezingagqibekanga ukuba zibe ngokulinganisela kwekonidane, iyonke iyonke, iinkalo ezikumgangatho ophezulu ezixhasa umbono, ilungiselelo nezimvo. Ukudibanisa iinjongo, iindaba neemeko ngenjongo yekhuthazo lokuza nabanye bazibophe iinkalo kule ndima, kwaye bakhuthazwe ngokuzinikela nangonwabo ekuphumeleiseni.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba amabhajethi e-GTAC alawulwa ngokwemithetho exhasayo, imigaqo, iinkqubo namapoli okhetho, kunye namapoli ngeenkqubo zesigqibo. Ulawulo lokuqinisekisa iimali ezingavunywa ngomthetho: Qwalasela imigaqo yolawulo neenkqubo ezingangeni xa kubhalwa imali ezingekho emthethweni, olu lawulo lwezimali zoluntu, olu nakwi-PFMA, GAAP, kunye ne-GRAP, ukwenza izindululo ukuze kushiywe izindululo kwamapoli e-GTAC nezimali ezingakho. Qwalasela ukuba amapoli e-GTAC nemigunyaziso ebesekwe njani, ukuba kusikwa iingxaki ezingazange zenzeke njani. Qwalasela ngakunye ukuze kulungiswe imisebenzi yekhompyutha yamapoli ezakwenza isiphumo esingazange siqhube kakuhle kwaye ulawule umthetho wamapoli kunye neenkqubo ezizeletywe, ukuqinisekisa ukuba kulandelwa imfuno yokubika ukusuka kwi-NT. Nika ingcamango ephilayo kunye nabaphathi bhajeti kwizixhobo zokusetyenziswa ekulungeni iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokubalwa ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ulawulo lokulungiselela bhajethi: Lawula ukulungiselelwa kolwazi ngemali ezidingekayo kwinkqubo yokulungelelanisa iinkqubo ezintsha zokuziphumeza ngonyaka. Hlola ukuze uvule okanye uvule ingxaki ekubekeni kolwazi malunga neemfuno zolwazi ezincwadi zeshishini iinkqubo ngokukhetha iindlela ezizeletywe neencwadana. Qwalasela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi ngemali oluxhaswa ziinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezimali kwixesha elizayo. Sebenzisa amagqabi avela kumapoli ngolwazi ngemali ekusuka kubaphathi bhajeti. Hlaziya unikezelo ngemali ulwazi, usityhile kwaye usize nolu lwazi ngemali emthethweni weentsikelelo ekufuneka kubhale uwoyilo kakuhle wemali ekhululo. Qwalasela iinkcukacha ngemali efunwayo ngokwentsimbi zolawulo lwemali kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezikwaziswa ngalo nyaka, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulungelelwaniso nemigaqo yaseyurhulumente yamaphulo. Ulawulo lokulungiselela nokuqalisa inkqubo yokusebenzisa imali: Lawula ukulungiselelwa nokuqinisekisa ulwazi kwinkqubo yamabhajethi e-MTEF. Lungiselelanisa izitatshende zemali noma ngaphezulu kwepalen eyenza ngokwemigaqo yonyaka. Hlaziya inxaxheba kulwazi kwezidingo ezimali ekusetyenziswa ngonyaka wonyaka ukulungelelanisa isilinganiso esihle kwaye ulungise ngenkqubo yokuqinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa isilinganiso esakulungelelwa. Ulawulo lokubuyisela imali etshisiweyo: Yiba nolwazi ngexesha lokuqinisekisa ukuba izindululo zixhasa ngokomthetho nezigaqo kwiinkqubo ezizeletywe nangokuphindaphinda. Sebenzisa ulwazi ngemali yosiba nokuqwalasela inkqubo ngokutshintsha imali kwindawo ekuyo nokuvelisa iindululo ngokuzisa imali. Lawula ulwazi ngokubuyisa ulwazi ngemali kwindawo eqondileyo, qwalasela iindlela ezithintela ekuphindaphinden imali esebenzisa nangemigaqo yeentsikelelo eyarhulumente. Qwalasela ukuba zizonke iindlela ezizeletywe zibhale ngokutshintshwa kwemali ekukhoyo. Ulawulo lokuvelisa amabali ngokubuyisa imali: Hlaziya ulwazi ekubakho kwezibali ezinyanzelwe ngamagama eze ngokwentsimbi yokuzenzakala ezibonelela ngezinto ezahlukeneyo, nokuqinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ngokulinganiselwa. Qwalasela iinkqubo ezizeletywe kwinkqubo yokubakho kobomi bezimali. Hlaziya isilinganiso esizela ngokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo exhaswa ngurhulumente.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Exams and Assessments
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026 at 16H00. NOTE` : Applications must be submitted on Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/Documents and must be Accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (With Three Contactable References). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A user guide and ‘how to’ videos will assist in how to complete for the form and digital signature. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in term s of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action. The appointment will be done in line with the approved Employment Equity Plan. Persons with disability are encouraged to apply. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. OTHER POSTS
jobs.summary: Senior administrative officer needed to manage exams and assessments at TVET colleges, requiring a relevant diploma or degree and 3 to 5 years of teaching experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. An appropriate (3) year National Diploma or Degree in Education / Public Administration/Business Management/Office Management. 3-5 years in teaching and learning environment. Computer Literacy. A valid Driver’s Licence. Knowledge of White Paper on PSET Act. Knowledge of the Public TVET sector and its regulatory and legislative framework. Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector. Knowledge and understanding of ITS. Knowledge of practice notes, national, provincial policy frameworks relevant to Education, Training and Development. Knowledge of Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act. Good Administration. Planning and organizing. Financial management. Report writing. Good Communication. Problem solving. Computer literacy. Analytical. Client oriented. Project management. Team leadership. People management. Client service focus. Integrity. Committed. Proactive. Loyal. Ethics. Duties : Ensure the provision of examination services. Administer exam venues (i.e. seating plan, direction to exam venue, instruction to student and other related duties as per exam manual). Manage concessions for students with disabilities prior examination sitting. Ensure the monitoring of examination processes and procedures. Administer College exam centers for trimester or semester or year examination cycle. Ensure if invigilator and student comply with examination policy and regulations. Ensure the safekeeping and distribution of question papers. Develop the internal Assessment (ICASS/ISAT) Monitoring and Verification tool. Develop College Examination Policy and Terms of References (TOR) for Examination related committee. Ensure the submission of examination data to DHET. Coordinate meetings for before and after exams to discuss irregularity experience and develop strategies. Conduct training of Invigilators, Markers and Data Capturers. Ensure the preparation of logistical arrangements for training (materials, equipment, transport, refreshment and venue). Develop internal marking plan and administer internal marking centers. Administer Invigilator agreements, contracts and signing thereof. Coordinate appointment of Chief Invigilators and Examination Officers. Administer and conduct training for Invigilators, Markers and Data Capturers on exam processes and procedures. Establish the function of Irregularity Committee. Coordinate activities for the development of learning material. Administer the establishment of both the Examination and Irregularity Committee for both Colleges and Campuses. Provide secretariat service to the Committee and ensure the compilation of reports. Ensure the management and control of issuing of the certificates. Administer the issuing of certificate application form and quality assurance on submitted data. Administer the processing and submission of all Diploma applications, keep record and handle enquiries. Ensure the tracking of outstanding certificate applications (Statement of results, Diploma, NCV Certificates). Ensure the distribution of certificates to the students. Ensure proper administration of the examination unit. Administer the communication of exam time tables to the students. Administer the distribution of examination results, year mark etc to the Campus Managers. Report the clashing of exams dates. Manage all human, financial and other resources in the unit. Render management service to the staff. Manage the development and performance of the staff. Manage the performance agreement of the staff. Adhere to Department of Higher Education & Training and College policies and procedures. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Hoof Administratiewe Beampte: Eksamens en Assessering
af.summary: Hoof administratiewe beampte benodig om eksamens en assessering by TVET-kolleges te bestuur, wat 'n relevante diploma of graad en 3 tot 5 jaar se onderrigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 / Matriek / Vlak 4 Sertifikaat. 'n Toepaslike (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Onderwys / Publieke Administrasie / Besigheidsbestuur / Kantoorbestuur. 3-5 jaar in 'n onderrig- en leeromgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige Bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die Witstuk oor die PSET-wet. Kennis van die openbare TVET-sektor en die regulatoriese en wetgewende raamwerk daarvan. Kennis en begrip van die hoër onderwyssektor. Kennis en begrip van ITS. Kennis van praktyknotas, nasionale en provinsiale beleidsraamwerke wat relevant is vir Onderwys, Opleiding en Ontwikkeling. Kennis van die Wet op Vaardigheidsontwikkeling, Openbare Diensregulasies en Openbare Dienswet, Arbeidsverhoudingswet. Goed Administrasie. Beplanning en organisering. Finansiële bestuur. Verslagskrywing. Goeie Kommunikasie. Probleemoplossing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Analities. Kliëntgerig. Projekbestuur. Spanleierskap. Menslike bestuur. Kliëntediensfokus. Integriteit. Toegewyd. Proaktief. Loyaal. Etiek. Pligte : Verseker die voorsiening van eksamensdienste. Administreer eksamenplekke (d.w.s. sitreëlings, rigting na eksamenplek, instruksies aan studente en ander verwante pligte soos per eksamenhandleiding). Bestuur toegewings vir studente met gestremdhede voor eksamenaflegging. Verseker die monitering van eksamenprosesse en prosedures. Administreer kollege-eksaminsentra vir trimester- of semester- of jaareksamensiklus. Verseker dat eksaminator en student voldoen aan eksamenbeleid en -regulasies. Verseker die veilige bewaring en verspreiding van vraestelle. Ontwikkel die interne Assessering (ICASS/ISAT) Moniterings- en Verifikasie-instrument. Ontwikkel Kollege-eksamenbeleid en Terms of References (TOR) vir eksamenverwante komitee. Verseker die indiening van eksamendata by DHET. Koördineer vergaderings voor en na eksamens om onreëlmatighede te bespreek en strategieë te ontwikkel. Voer opleiding van Eksaminators, Nasienpersoneel en Datavasleggers uit. Verseker die voorbereiding van logistiese reëlings vir opleiding (materiaal, toerusting, vervoer, verversings en plek). Ontwikkel interne nasienerplan en administreer interne nasiensentra. Administreer eksaminatorooreenkomste, kontrakte en ondertekening daarvan. Koördineer die aanstelling van Hoof-eksaminators en Eksamenbeamptes. Administreer en voer opleiding uit vir Eksaminators, Nasienpersoneel en Datavasleggers oor eksamenprosesse en -prosedures. Stig die funksie van die Onreëlmatigheidskomitee. Koördineer aktiwiteite vir die ontwikkeling van leermateriaal. Administreer die stigting van beide die Eksamen- en Onreëlmatigheidskomitee vir beide Kolleges en Kampterraine. Verskaf sekretariële diens aan die Komitee en verseker die opstel van verslae. Verseker die bestuur en beheer van die uitreiking van sertifikate. Administreer die uitreiking van sertifikaat-aansoekvorms en gehalteversekering op ingediende data. Administreer die verwerking en indiening van alle Diploma-aansoeke, hou rekords en hanteer navrae. Verseker die naspeuring van uitstaande sertifikaat-aansoeke (Verklaring van resultate, Diploma, NCV-sertifikate). Verseker die verspreiding van sertifikate aan die studente. Verseker behoorlike administrasie van die eksameneenheid. Administreer die kommunikasie van eksamenroosters aan die studente. Administreer die verspreiding van eksamenresultate, jaarmerk, ens. aan die Kampterrainbestuurders. Rapporteer die botsing van eksamendatums. Bestuur alle menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne in die eenheid. Verskaf bestuursdiens aan die personeel. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en prestasie van die personeel. Bestuur die prestasie-ooreenkoms van die personeel. Hou by die Departement of Hoër Onderwys & Opleiding en Kollegebeleide en -prosedures. Alle kortlys-kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toetrede-assesserings onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes en die ander moet 'n integriteits-etiese gedrag-assessering wees.

zu.title: Inkokheli Yomlawuli: Ukuhlolwa kanye Nokuqashwa
zu.summary: Kudingeka inkokheli yomlawuli ukuphatha ukuhlolwa nokuqashwa emakholishi we-TVET, kufuna idiploma noma idigri ethile kanye neminyaka engu-3 kuya kweyi-5 yohlu lwemisebenzi yokufundisa.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4. Idiploma yezwe leminyaka engu-(3) noma i-Degree kwe-Education / Public Administration/Business Management/Office Management. 3-5 iminyaka esimweni sokufundisa nokufunda. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. I-Driver's Licence evumelekile. Ulwazi nge-White Paper on PSET Act. Ulwazi ngemikhakha ye-Public TVET kanye nokuqondwa kwayo ngokomthetho nemithesho. Ulwazi nokuqonda umkhakha we-Higher Education. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-ITS. Ulwazi ngemibhalo yokusebenza, izakhiwo zezinhlelo zomthetho wesiZwe nasemphakathini ezibalulekile ku-Education, Training and Development. Ulwazi nge-Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act, kanye ne-Labour Relations Act. Ukuphatha okuhle. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuphatha imali. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuxhumana okuhle. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlaziya. Ukuqondiswa komthengi. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukuba ngumholi wethimba. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuqondiswa kolisekelo komthengi. Ukuqotha. Ukuzibophezela. Ukuba ngaphambili. Ukuqotha kwesibopho. Izimilo. Imisebenzi: Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlolwa. Phatha izindawo zokuhlolwa (okungukuthi ihlelo lokuhlala, izinkomba zesikhungo sokuhlolwa, imiyalo kumfundi kanye neminye imisebenzi ehlobene njengoba kushiwo kumdhawula wokuhlolwa). Phatha izinkuntshu zabafundi abaphila nokusinda phambi kokuhlola. Qinisekisa ukuqapha inqubo kanye nemithetho yokuhlolwa. Phatha izikhungo zokuhlolwa ze-Kholishi ngesikhathi esingaminyaka ethathu noma isigamu noma isikhathi senyaka yokuhlolwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi abaqaphi kanye nabafundi bayalandisa umthetho kanye nemithesho yokuhlolwa. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokusatshalaliswa kwamaphepha ezibuzo. Yakha ithuluzi lokulawula nokugunyaza i-internal Assessment (ICASS/ISAT). Yakha umthetho wekholishi wokuhlolwa kanye ne-Terms of References (TOR) yomkomidi ohlobene nokuhlolwa. Qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwedatha yokuhlolwa ku-DHET. Hlanganisa izinkomishaphi phambi nangemuva kokuhlolwa ukuxoxa ngemibono engahlanhle kanye nokwakha izu. Hlela ukugadluliswa kwabafundi ngemisebenzi emikhulu yokuqasha. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kokuqashwa emisebenzini (izinto, izisetshenziswa, ukuthutha, ukuphakela kanye nesikhungo). Yakha ihele lokubeka uphawu ngaphakathi kanye nokuphatha izikhungo zokubeka uphawu ngaphakathi. Phatha izivumelwano, izinkontileka kanye nokusayinwa kwabaqaphi. Hlanganisa ukuqashwa kwe-Invigilators abaphambili kanye no-Examination Officers. Phatha futhi uqashe ukuqeqesha kwe-Invigilators, Markers ne-Data Capturers mayelana nokuqashwa kwekholishi. Yakha imisebenzi yokulawula ukuphathwa kokuqashwa. Hlanganisa imisebenzi yokuqashwa kwezinto zokufundwa. Phatha ukumiswa kwe-Examination Committee kanye ne-Irregularity Committee kumakholishi kanye nasenkampini. Nikeza insiza yesikhungo somnyango kwi-Examination Committee futhi qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemibiko. Phatha ukukhiqizwa nokulawulwa kwesitifikedi. Phatha ukuthunyelwa kwamafomu esitifikedi nokuhlolwa kwedatha ethunyelwe. Phatha ukuthunyelwa kwazo zonke izicelo zamanuela, ukuhola nokugcina okubhaliwe. Ukwenza isifundo sokuba ngomakhelwane, ukubamba imincwadi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi iphila kahle emmangweni, ukuthumela okubhaliwe kumakhelwane nokugcina imiphumela yesiFundiso yakho. Ukugcina ukuziphendulela kwakho ukuba ngumThengisi kahle kakhulu nezinye izidingo ezithile noma ukuvamele ukuba ngumuntu onesiphothi phandle komnyakazo wokubekwa noma ukubukwa kahle, okumele uhambisane nezinkinga ezivela kubantu abayisipiliyoni kweyimikhiqizo noma imisebenzi yezimali, ukwamukela ukubakwakho ngokusemthethweni kuphela kodwa ngaphandle kokumiswa imithetho yokubuqotho. Hlole izinga lokuhlala noma ukufunda okubi okwenziwe, iphinde ilungise. Hlolisisa isibonakaliso sokuhle kwezimiso ekuvunyweni iziqu ezingezona ezinye kuphela kodwa ngazo zonke iziqu zesitifikedi. Ukuthumela ezinye izindawo ezithile ngemvula noma ngaphandle kwayo ukuba zibe nomthelela ekunakekelweni noma kwezinye izimilo, mayelana nokubakho kwawo wonke umuntu, ekuhlotsheni kwesikhala phakathi nokuhla kweziqu. Ukunakekelwa nokulondolozwa kwezinsizakalo mayelana nokuphunyuka kwemisebenzi. Ukuphathwa nemali ekuyiyo nakuba ibiyini ekuhlolweni. Ukuthumela izinkomba ezithile ukuze kudluliselwe emnyameni ongaka. Ukuphatha ukuhamba nokuhamba komsebenzi kanye nezinye izinhlelo ezenziwayo ngamafomu nangohlelo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kube nenzuzo ekuhlakaniphini ekunakekeleni imali, ukuba nethemba nokuyinakekele kahle emsebenzini noma esimweni sokuhlolwa. Ukuthumela kubantu ukuba bazamele ukuba nethemba lokusebenza okuwukuphumelelwa komsebenzi, ukuba yithamsanqa nokuba yithemba lokusebenza noma lokuzifundela ngabanye ekwenzeni imisebenzi noma ezinye izinkomba. Hlolisisa okuhle okungenziwa kubalandeli bokuqeqesha noma abanye abantu ukuthi bafunde ukuthi kungenzwa kanjani ukunakekela amafomu, ukuhlela izinkomba ezinkulu. Hlolisisa ukuba ukhona yini noma ukukhuthaza imigomo yemisebenzi ekuqashweni. Ukubakhuthaza futhi banakekele kakhulu ukuba basebenze kahle noma basebenze ngokulingene, ukuba nethemba lokuba basebenze kahle. Ukubakhipha ezinye izinto okungenzeka zibe khona ezizokwenza ukuba bangakwazi ukuziphendulela ukuthi bengakwazi ukusebenzela kuphi noma bengakwazi ukuthi bangakwenza noma yini. Ukubakhipha ezindaweni abakhona ukuba bazame ukuba nabanye abantu abangakwazi ukuba nethemba lokuba ngabantu abasakhulile noma bengasakhulile. Ukuthumela kubantu ukuba bazamele ukusebenza futhi ukuba nethemba lokuba ngabantu abaqotho, abaqinisekile, abanethemba, abantu abakwazi ukuphumelela ekunyakazeni kwabo. Ukubakhuthaza ukuba bafunde, bathole iziqu ezinhle, baze bakwazi ukuba basebenze. Bakhuthaze abantu abasha ukuba bafunde ukwazi ukuthi banganakeka kanjani imali yabo nokuba nethemba lokuba bakhule. Phatha onke abantu, imali kanye nezinye izinsizakalo esikhungweni. Nikela ngensiza yokuphatha kubasebenzi. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokusebenza kwabasebenzi. Phatha isivumelwano sokusebenza sabasebenzi. Landela imigomo kanye nemithesho ye-Department of Higher Education & Training kanye ne-Kholishi. Bonke abafaki izicelo ababekwe ohlwini, okuhlanganisa ne-SMS, bazokwenza izivivinyo ezimbili zangaphambi kokuqashwa. Isivivinyo sokuqala sizoba umzamo wokuphila ukubeka kokuqashwa kobuntu ngokusekelwa kwezidingo ezithile kanye nezijwayelekile zesikhundla futhi esinye kumele sibe isivivinyo sobuqotho (ukuziphatha okuhle).

xh.title: IOfisa Elokhulu Lolawulo: IiViwo Nokuqwalaselwa
xh.summary: Kufuneki igosa elikhulu lolawulo lokulawula iviwo nokulinganiswa kumaziko e-TVET, elifuna i-diploma okanye i-degree efanelekileyo kunye neminyaka engama-3 ukuya kwa-5 yokufundisa.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric / Level 4. I-National Diploma ye-(3) iminyaka okanye i-Degree efanelekileyo kwi-Education / Public Administration/Business Management/Office Management. I-3-5 iminyaka kwimeko yokufundisa nokufunda. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. I-Driver’s Licence esebezayo. Ulwazi ngeWhite Paper on PSET Act. Ulwazi ngemmmandla we-TVET kahulumeni nakumagunya alo namagunya womthetho. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwemmmandla we-High Education. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-ITS. Ulwazi ngamaxwebhu amagquba, amapholisi abuzwe kwihlabathi jikelele nakurhulumente ongakanani namagunya afanelekileyo kwi-Education, Training and Development. Ulwazi ngeSkills Development Act, Public Service Regulations kunye noMthetho wePublic Service, noMthetho weLabour Relations. Ubulungisa bobulawulo. Ulwazi lokucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ulawulo lwezimali. Ukwabhala iingxelo. Unxibelelwano olulungileyo. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlola. Ukubheka kumthengi. Ulawulo lweiprojekthi. Ukulatha iqela. Ulawulo labantu. Ukubheka kuwo wonke umntu kulwazi lomthengi. Intembeko. Ukuzinikela. Ukuba namandla. Ukuthembeka. Indlela yokuziphatha. Imisebenzi: Qinisekisa ukubonelela ngezinkonzo zovavayo. Lawula iindawo zovavayo (okt. isicwangciso sokuhlala, iindlela zokuya kwidolobha lovavayo, imiyalelo kumfundi nezinye imisebenzi ezalathwa kwincwadi yovavayo). Lawula iindlela ezisikelwe umda kubafundi abaswakamile phambi kokuqhuba uviwo. Qinisekisa ulondolozo lweenkqubo neendlela zovavayo. Lawula iindawo zovavayo zeKholeji kumjikelo wesithathu-hlwini okanye wenyanga okanye wenyaka. Qinisekisa ukuba bagcwalise i-Gestapo ngolawulo nokusasazwa kweephepha zemibuzo. Yila ithulusi eligqithiswayo le-Assessment (ICASS/ISAT) ngaphakathi. Yila iKholeji Examination Policy kwaye uchaze iimbopheleleko zee-Terms of References (TOR) zikomkhulu wekomiti yovavayo. Qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kolwazi kwi-DHET. Hlanganisa iindibano phambi nangemva kovavayo ukuze kuxoxwe ngemiba engaqhelekanga kunye nokuyila iindlela. Qeqsha abaGcini beKholeji, abaBhali kunye nabaSebenzi beKhompyutha. Qinisekisa ulungelelwaniso lwezinto ezingaqaqambeki (iimpahla, izixhobo, ukuhamba, ukutya kunye nendawo). Yila isicwangciso sokubhala ngaphakathi ulawule iindawo zokubhala. Lawula iindlela zokuvumelana kolwazi, iinkontrakti kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuqinisekiswa. Hlanganisa ukumiselwa kukaGcini weKholeji nosasazi loLwazi kubasebenzi. Lawula ukuqeqshwa kwabaGcini, abaBhali nabaSebenzi beKhompyutha kwinkqubo neendlela zovavayo. Misa inkqubo yeKomiti yoGciniso. Hlanganisa imisebenzi yokuqhuba iinkqubo zemfundo. Lawula ukumiselwa kweekomiti zovavayo nezabakho ubugcisa kwiKholeji naseKhasipo. Bonelela ngolonke loyilo oluvela kwiKomiti ukuqinisekisa ukuqulunqwa kweengxelo. Qinisekisa ulawulo nokulawula ukunikelwa kweenkqubo. Lawula ukunikelwa kweefomu zesatifikethi kunye nokuqinisekiswa kolwazi oluthunyelweyo. Lawula ukuqhubwa nokuthunyelwa kweenkqubo zonke zeDiploma, ulondoloze irekhodi uphendule iimbuzo. Qinisekisa ukulandelelwa kweenkqubo ezingagqitywanga zeSatifikethi (Isitatimende seziphumo, iDiploma, iinkqubo ze-NCV). Qinisekisa ukusasazwa kweenkqubo kubafundi. Qinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lwedolobha lovavayo. Lawula ukwaziswa kolwazi kolwazi kwabafundi. Lawula ukusasazwa kolwazi, iZnaku zomsebenzi kunye nezinye iinkcukacha kubaLawuli beKhasipo. Sikhulisa iNgxelo ngesibhaxu samaxesha eNgcwele. Lawula onke amandla ezimali namanye amathuba edolobha. Bonelela ngolonke lwezinkonzo eziyimfuneko kubasebenzi. Lawula ukuphuculwa kokusebenza kubasebenzi. Lawula iinkonzo ezithintelwe kubasebenzi. Zithobe kumthetho wezoMfundo ePhakamileyo & uQeqsho nakumapholisi neendlela zeKholeji. Bonke abaKhethwayo, kuquka i-SMS, baya kwenza iilinguqulo ezimbini zovavayo. Elinya liza kuba ngumzobo wokuzilolonga ukubona ukuba umkhwa wokuzilolonga uyafaneleka nangokobuchwepheshe nemfuno yendlela yokuziphatha, elinye lona kufuneka linguvavayo lokuziphatha (indlela yokuziphatha ngokomthetho).
