jobs.summary: Manage and maintain Management Information Systems and institutional databases at a TVET college, requiring a diploma or degree in IT and at least three years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. An appropriate National Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, or any other related qualification. A minimum of three (3) years' relevant experience in Management Information Systems, database administration, information systems support, institutional reporting, or data analytics. Proven experience working with the Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS) system (TVET COLLEGE BMS SYSTEMS) is a prerequisite. Knowledge of DHET policies, TVETMIS reporting requirements, and higher education information systems. Knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and reporting tools is required. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Microsoft Excel, is essential. Knowledge of Business Intelligence and data visualisation tools such as Microsoft Power BI, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) or similar reporting platforms and A valid Driver’s Licence. Knowledge of Management Information Systems principles, database administration and information management. Knowledge of the Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS) system, relational databases, database querying, business intelligence tools and reporting applications. Understanding of data governance, data quality management, information security and institutional reporting frameworks within the TVET sector. Knowledge of DHET reporting requirements, TVETMIS reporting processes and the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Good understanding of systems analysis, information management. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and report- writing skills with the ability to interpret complex institutional data and present meaningful management information. Ability to develop dashboards, statistical reports and performance indicators to support evidence-based decision- making. Good communication, presentation, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and maintain a high level of accuracy, confidentiality and attention to detail. Adhere to Department of Higher Education & Training and College policies and procedures.
jobs.duties: Provide support in the administration, maintenance and optimisation of the College's Management Information Systems (MIS) and the Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS) to ensure the integrity, availability and security of institutional information. Maintain and administer institutional databases, perform data validation, cleansing and reconciliation, monitor system performance, implement system updates, maintain user access controls, perform routine backups and support the implementation of information security and data governance standards. Provide first-line support to ITS users, resolve system- related queries, develop and maintain system documentation, facilitate user training, and assist in the implementation of system enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives in support of institutional objectives. Collect, extract, analyse, interpret and report on institutional data to support planning, monitoring and evidence-based decision-making. Develop and generate management reports, dashboards, statistical reports and key performance indicators for College Management, Council, the Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET) and other stakeholders. Support the coordination and submission of statutory reports, monitor data quality and compliance with DHET reporting requirements, identify trends and provide analytical insights to improve institutional performance, ensure compliance with College policies, the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) and other applicable legislation, and perform any other duties delegated by the Assistant Director: Management Information Systems. ITS database. Comply with DHET and College policies and procedures. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Senior Bestuursinligtingstelsel-administrateur
af.summary: Bestuur en onderhou Bestuursinligtingstelsels en instellingsdatabasisse by 'n TVET-kollege, wat 'n diploma of graad in IT vereis en ten minste drie jaar se relevante ervaring.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 / Matriek / Level 4-sertifikaat. 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma of Baccalaureusgraad in Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, of enige ander verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se relevante ervaring in Bestuursinligtingstelsels, databasisadministrasie, inligtingstelselsondersteuning, instellingsverslagdoening, of data-analise. Bewese ervaring in die werk met die Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS) stelsel (TVET COLLEGE BMS SYSTEMS) is 'n voorvereiste. Kennis van DHET-beleide, TVETMIS-verslagdoeningsvereistes, en hoëronderwys-inligtingstelsels. Kennis van SQL, relationele databasisse, en verslagdoeningsnutsmiddels word vereis. Vaardigheid in Microsoft Office Suite, veral Microsoft Excel, is noodsaaklik. Kennis van Business Intelligence en datavisualiseringsnutsmiddels soos Microsoft Power BI, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) of soortgelyke verslagdoeningsplatforms en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van Bestuursinligtingstelsel-beginsels, databasisadministrasie en inligtingsbestuur. Kennis van die Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS) stelsel, relationele databasisse, databasisnavrae, business intelligence-nutsmiddels en verslagdoeningstoepassings. Begrip van databestuursbeleid, datakwaliteitsbestuur, inligtingsekuriteit en instellingsverslagdoeningsraamwerke binne die TVET-sektor. Kennis van DHET-verslagdoeningsvereistes, TVETMIS-verslagdoeningsprosesse en die Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Goeie begrip van stelseltotligting en inligtingsbestuur. Uitstekende analitiese, probleemoplossings- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede met die vermoë om komplekse instellingsdata te interpreteer en sinvolle bestuursinligting te bied. Vermoë om kontroleskerms, statistiese verslae en prestasie-aanwysers te ontwikkel om bewysgebaseerde besluitneming te ondersteun. Goeie kommunikasie-, aanbiedings-, interpersoonlike en belanghebbendebestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, veelvuldige prioriteite te bestuur en 'n hoë vlak van akkuraatheid, vertroulikheid en aandag aan detail te handhaaf. Voldoen aan Department of Higher Education & Training en College-beleide en prosedures.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning by die administrasie, instandhouding en optimalisering van die College se Bestuursinligtingstelsels (MIS) en die Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS) om die integriteit, beskikbaarheid en sekuriteit van instellingsinligting te verseker. Onderhou en administreer instellingsdatabasisse, voer datavalidering, skoonmaak en rekonsiliasie uit, monitor stelselprestasie, implementeer stelselopdaterings, onderhou gebruikerstoegangbeheer, voer roetine-rugsteune uit en ondersteun die implementering van inligtingsekuriteits- en databetuurstelselstandaarde. Verskaf eerstelynondersteuning aan ITS-gebruikers, los stelselverwante navrae op, ontwikkel en onderhou stelseldokumentasie, fasiliteer gebruikersopleiding, en help by die implementering van stelselverbeterings en deurlopende verbeteringsinisiatiewe ter ondersteuning van instellingsdoelwitte. Versamel, onttrek, analiseer, interpreteer en rapporteer oor instellingsdata om beplanning, monitering en bewysgebaseerde besluitneming te ondersteun. ontwikkel en genereer bestuursverslae, kontroleskerms, statistiese verslae en sleutelprestasie-aanwysers vir College-bestuur, die Raad, die Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET) en ander belanghebbendes. Ondersteun die koördinering en indiening van statutêre verslae, monitor datakwaliteit en nakoming van DHET-verslagdoeningsvereistes, identifiseer tendense en verskaf analitiese insigte om instellingsprestasie te verbeter, verseker nakoming van College-beleide, die Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) en ander toepaslike wetgewing, en voer enige ander pligte uit wat deur die Adjunkdirekteur: Bestuursinligtingstelsels gedelegeer word. ITS-databasis. Voldoen aan DHET- en College-beleide en prosedures. Alle gekorte lys kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toelatingsassesseringe onderneem. Die een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes en die ander moet 'n integriteit (etiese gedrag) assessering wees.

zu.title: Umphathi Ophakeme Wesistimu We-Management Information Systems
zu.summary: Phatha futhi ugqoze amasistimu we-Management Information Systems kanye namadethabhesi esikhungo ekolishi le-TVET, okudinga idiploma noma idigri kwi-IT futhi kube okungenani iminyaka emithathu yokuqeqeshwa okuhlobene.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12 / Matric / Level 4. I-National Diploma edingekayo noma i-Bachelor's Degree kwi-Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, noma noma yisiphi esinye isifundo esihlobene. Okuncane eminyaka emithathu (3) yokuqeqeshwa kwi-Management Information Systems, database administration, information systems support, institutional reporting, noma data analytics. Okuqinisekisiwe ukusebenza ngesistimu ye-Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS) system (TVET COLLEGE BMS SYSTEMS) kuyadinga. Ulwazi ngemigomo ye-DHET, izidingo zokubika ze-TVETMIS, kanye namasistimu e-higher education information. Ulwazi nge-SQL, relational databases, kanye namathuluzi okubika luyadinga. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-Microsoft Office Suite, ikakhulukazi i-Microsoft Excel, kubalulekile. Ulwazi nge-Business Intelligence namathuluzi okubonisa idatha njenge-Microsoft Power BI, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) noma amapulatifomu okubika afanayo kanye ne-Driver’s License evunyiwe. Ulwazi ngemigomo ye-Management Information Systems, database administration kanye nolwazi lokuphathwa kwedatha. Ulwazi ngesistimu ye-Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS), relational databases, database querying, business intelligence tools kanye nezinhlelo zokubika. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwedatha, ukuphathwa kwezinga lekhwalithi yedatha, ukuphepha kolwazi kanye namaphulejini okubika esikhungweni ngaphakathi kwesigaba se-TVET. Ulwazi ngokuthi yiziphi izidingo zokubika ze-DHET, izinqubo zokubika ze-TVETMIS kanye ne-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Ukuqonda kahle ukuhlaziya kwamasistimu, ukuphathwa kwedatha. Amakhono okuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqhweba imibiko, nokuhlakanipha ekuchazeni idatha esinkaxa yesikhungo futhi ubonise ulwazi oluwusizo ekuphathweni. Isikhono sokuthuthukisa amadashibhodi, imibiko yezibalo kanye nezinkomba zokusebenza ukuze sekwe izinqumo eziyisisekelo ebufakazini. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, okubukwa komphakathi, nobuntu kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlobo zabalimi. Isikhono sokuzebenza wedwa, ukulawula izinkomba eziningi kanye negcina izinga eliphezulu lokunemba, iyimfihlo kanye nokunakisisa imininingwane. Zinze ngemigomo kanye nezindlela ze-Department of Higher Education & Training kanye nekolishi.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso ekuphathweni, ekuqochenweni nasekweniusebenzeni kahle kwamasistimu e-Management Information Systems (MIS) ekolishi kanye ne-Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza, ukutholakala nokuphepha kolwazi lwesikhungo. Gcina uphathe amadethabhesi esikhungo, wenze ukuqinisekiswa kwedatha, ukucofa nokuhlanganisa kabusha, ulawule ukusebenza kwesistimu, faka izibuyekezo zesistimu, gcina izilawuli zokufinyelela zabasebenzisi, wenze izipele ezisuku njalo futhi useke ukusetshenziswa kwezinga lokuphepha kolwazi nemigomo yobuholi bedatha. Nikeza inkxaso yokuqala kubasebenzisi be-ITS, uxaze izinkinga eziphathelene nesistimu, uthuthuke ugcinе iziqoshana zesistimu, ubambe iqhaza ekulweni abasebenzisi, futhi usize ekusetshenzisweni kwezithuthukisi zesistimu kanye nemiyalo yokuthuthukiswa ngokuqhubeka ngokusuke ekusekeleni amaphuzu esikhungo. Qoqa, khombotha, hlaziya, chaza futhi ubike ngolwazi lwesikhungo ukuze useke ukuhlela, ukulawula kanye nenqumbo yokuthatha izinqumo esekelwe ubufakazi. Thuthukisa futhi ukhiqeze imibiko yomphathi, amadashibhodi, imibiko yezibalo kanye nezinkomba ezibalulekile zokusebenza kolishi sabaphathi, leBandla, i-Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET) kanye nabanye abahlomuli. Sekela ukuhlanganisa nokuhlolwa kwemibiko esemthethweni, lawula izinga lokuhle kwedatha nokuhambisana nezidingo zokubika ze-DHET, khomba izinkomba futhi unikeze okubukwayo ukuhlaziya ukusebenza kwesikhungo, qinisekisa ukuhambisana nemigomo ekolishi, i-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) kanye nezinye izindleko ezisebenzayo, futhi wenze noma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi onikezwe ngumodi omncinyane: Management Information Systems. Idethabhesi ye-ITS. Hambisana nemigomo kanye nezindlela ze-DHET nakolishi. Bonke abagqwayizi abafakiwe kuhlu, okuhlanganisa i-SMS, bazenza izivivinyo ezimbili zangaphambi kokuqala isikhundla. Esinye sizoba yisivivinyo sokuphatha ukuze kubonakale ukufaneleka komuntu othunywe ngesikhundla kusetshiswa izidingo zetheknoloji nokuvamile zesikhundla, esinye kumele sibe yisivivinyo sokuzinza (okuhlobene nokuziphatha).

xh.title: Ulawuli Ophakamileyo woLawulo lweNkqubo yolwazi
xh.summary: Lawula ugcine iNkqubo yolwazi eLawulwayo neesiseko seendaba zenhlangano kwikholeji ye-TVET, kufuneka idiploma okanye isidanga kwi-IT kwaye ubengonxe namava ambalwa ahambelanayo ongaphantsi kwamathathu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seBanga le-12 / iMatric / iNqanaba le-4. iDiploma yeziZwe okanye iSidanga seBachelors kwiNkqubo yolwazi, iNkqubo yolwazi oLawulwayo, iTekhnoloji yolwazi, ISayensi yeKhompyutha, iSayensi yeDatha, okanye nayo iphi na enye ifanelekileyo. Ungakanani umnyaka ongaphantsi kwamathathu (3) okubambe kunyaka wamava ohambelanayo kwiNkqubo yolwazi oLawulwayo, ulawulo lwebhanki yolwazi, inkxaso yenkqubo yolwazi, ingxelo yenhlangano, okanye ukuhlalutya kolwazi. Amandla okusebenza ngeSofthiwe yeThethari eHlanganisiweyo (ITS) (iINKQUBO ZE-TVET COLLEGE BMS) ngumfuno wangaphambili. Ulwazi ngemigaqo ye-DHET, iimfuno zengxelo ye-TVETMIS, iinkqubo zolwazi zemfundo ephakamileyo. Ulwazi nge-SQL, iisiseko seenkcukacha ezinxulumene, neezixhobo zengxelo luyimfuno. Amandla okusebenzisa iMicrosoft Office Suite, ngakumbi iMicrosoft Excel, luyimfuno ebalulekileyo. Ulwazi ngeNgcuessBusiness Intelligence neezixhobo zokubonisa ulwazi ezinje ngeMicrosoft Power BI, iSQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) okanye ezinye iindawo ezifanayo zengxelo nelayisensi yokuQhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngeemigaqo yeNkqubo yolwazi oLawulwayo, ulawulo lwebhanki yolwazi lolwazi nolawulo lwedatha. Ulwazi ngeSofthiwe yeThethari eHlanganisiweyo (ITS), iisiseko seenkcukacha ezinxulumene, ukubuza iisiseko seenkcukacha, neezixhobo zeNgcuessBusiness Intelligence namaxwebhu eNkcazelo eQulunqwe. Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kweedatha, ukulawula ikhwalithi yedatha, ukhuseleko lolwazi neendlela zengxelo yenhlangano kwingingqi ye-TVET. Ulwazi ngeemfuno zengxelo ye-DHET, iinkqubo zengxelo ye-TVETMIS noMthetho woKhuselo loLwazi lwuBuntu (POPIA). Ukuqonda kakuhle uhlalutyo lwenkqubo, ulawulo lolwazi. Amandla amabalase ehlalutyo lokusombulula iingxaki noku bhala iingxelo, anamandla okutolika idatha eyinkimbinkimbi yenhlangano aze abonise ulwazi oluwusetyenziso olusetyenziswa ngokusembuxweni. Amandla okwenza amadashibhodi, iingxelo ezibalwayo neenqonqodo zokusebenza ukuxhasa ukuthatha izigqibo ezisekelwe kwimiqondo. Amandla amabalase eNkcazelo eQulunqwe, angathethi phambi komntu, angathandanab abantu baphila kwaye unabalamule abathathi-nxaxheba. Amandla okusebenza eyedwa, ukulawula iinto ezininzi ezibalulekileyo uze ugcine umgangatho ophezulu wokuqinisekisa ukuchaneka, imfihlo kunye nokunaka iinkcukacha. Thobela imigaqo yeSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho nendlela zokusebenza.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekulawuleni, ekugcineni nasekuyilongeni iinkqubo zeNkqubo yolwazi oLawulwayo (MIS) zeKholeji neSofthiwe yeThethari eHlanganisiweyo (ITS) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuchaneka, ukufumaneka nokhuseleko kolwazi lolwazi. Gcina uze ulawule iisiseko zeenkcukacha zolwazi zenhlangano, wenze ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi, ukucofa nokubuyiselana kolwazi, ulawule ukusebenza kwenkqubo, uze ufake izihlaziyo zenkqubo, ugcine ulawulo lokufikelela komsebenzisi, wenze iibhakaphu zemigangatho yemihla ngemihla uze uxhase ukusebenza kweenkqubo zolwazi nokuhlolwa kwemigaqo yokulawula iinkcukacha zolwazi. Nikela ngenkxaso yokuqala kubasebenzisi be-ITS, uxazulule iimbuzo enxulumene nenkqubo, uze uqambe ugcile ixwebhu lenkqubo, uze ulawule uqeqesho lomsebenzisi, uncedise ekusebenzeni kweenkqubo ezithuthukisiweyo nasekuqhutyweni kolwazi olusoloko luthuthuka ngokuxhasa iinjongo zenhlangano. Qokelela, ukhuphe, uhlolisise, utolike uze uxele ingxelo malunga nedatha yenhlangano ukuyixhasa iplani, ukulawula nokuthatha izigqibo ezisekelwe kwimiqondo. Qamba uze uveze iingxelo zolawulo, amadashibhodi, iingxelo ezibalwayo neenqonqodo zokusebenza ezibalulekileyo kubalule beKholeji, kuBhunga, kuSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho (DHET) nakwabanye abathathi-nxaxheba. Xhasa ukulungelelanisa nokuhambisa iingxelo ezisemthethweni, ulawule ikhwalithi yedatha nokuvumelana neemfuno zengxelo ze-DHET, uchonge iindidi uze unike imibono ehlalutyo ukuphucula ukusebenza kwenhlangano, uqinisekise ukuvumelana nemigaqo yeKholeji, uMthetho woKhuselo loLwazi lwuBuntu (POPIA) namanye amagunya asebenzayo, wenze nawuphi na umsebenzi omiselwe nguM lawuli oncedisayo: iNkqubo yolwazi oLawulwayo. Isiseko seenkcukacha ze-ITS. Thobela imigaqo ye-DHET neyeKholeji. Bonke abagqogiweyo, kuquka ne-SMS, kuya kwenziwa iimpimo ezimbini zangaphambi kongeno. Enye iya kuba ngumzobo wokuzilolonga ukuze kumiswe ukufaneleka komgcini esekwe kwimfuno yobuchule nejikelezileyo yendawo, omnye kumele ube nguviwo lokuzinza (indlela yokuziphatha ngokuzithobileyo).

jobs.summary: The Department of Higher Education and Training seeks a senior risk management officer to develop and implement risk frameworks, strategies and plans at TVET Colleges, requiring a diploma or degree and three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. An appropriate National Diploma/Degree in Internal Auditing / Risk Management or equivalent qualification. Three (3) years’ experience in Risk Management or relevant field. Computer literacy. A valid Driver’s Licence. Knowledge of relevant legislation, policies and procedures relating to Risk Management. Good verbal and written communication. Interpersonal skills and problem-solving skills. Research and report writing and presentation skills. Candidate must be trustworthy, proactive, and reliable and committed to service delivery. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Develop, review and implement in consultation with management, risk management policy, framework, methodology and strategy. Implement risk management plan i.e. risk identification, risk appetite and tolerance and risk classification. Facilitate and compile strategic, operational and process level risk register. Facilitate risk related trainings, workshops and awareness campaigns to management and employees. Facilitate and monitor application and procedures associated with risk management functions and activities. Liaise with Internal Audit concerning fraud indicators and implementation of fraud prevention strategies. Conduct follow ups on reported fraud and corruption within the College. Ensure Compliance with risk management related framework and other applicable legislation. Compile all risk management related reports. Adhere to Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) and College policies and procedures. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Senior Risikobestuurbeampte
af.summary: Die Department of Higher Education and Training soek 'n senior risikobestuurbeampte om risikoraamwerke, strategieë en planne by TVET-colleges te ontwikkel en te implementeer, wat 'n diploma of graad en drie jaar se ondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 / Matrik / Vlak 4-sertifikaat. 'n Gesikte Nasionale Diploma/Graad in Interne Oudit / Risikobestuur of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Drie (3) jaar se ondervinding in Risikobestuur of relevante veld. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis van relevante wetgewing, beleide en prosedures rakende Risikobestuur. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasie. Interpersoonlike vaardighede en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Navorsing en verslagskrywing en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Kandidaat moet betroubaar, proaktief en betroubaar wees en toegewyd wees aan dienslewering. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, hersien en implementeer in oorleg met bestuur, risikobestuursbeleid, raamwerk, metodologie en strategie. Implementeer risikobestuursplan d.w.s. risiko-identifisering, risiko-aptyt en -verdraagsaamheid en risiko-klassifikasie. Fasiliteer en stel strategiese, operasionele en prosesvlak-risikoregister op. Fasiliteer risiko-verwante opleidings, werkswinkels en bewusmakingsveldtogte aan bestuur en werknemers. Fasiliteer en monitor toepassing en prosedures wat verband hou met risikobestuursfunksies en -aktiwiteite. Skakel met Interne Oudit rakende bedrog-aanwysers en implementering van bedrogvoorkomingstrategieë. Doen opvolg op aangemelde bedrog en korrupsie binne die College. Verseker Nakoming van risikobestuur-verwante raamwerk en ander toepaslike wetgewing. Stel alle risikobestuur-verwante verslae op. Hou by Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en College-beleide en -prosedures. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toetrede-assessering onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteit (etiese gedrag) assessering wees.

zu.title: Ongumlondolozi Omkhulu Wokuphathwa Kwezingozi
zu.summary: I-Department of Higher Education and Training ifuna ongumlondolozi omkhulu wokuphathwa kwezingozi ukuthuthukisa futhi asuse izindlela zokusebenza, izindlela nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezingozi e-TVET Colleges, okudinga idiploma noma iziqu kanye neminyaka emithathu yohlu lwamo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4. Idiploma/yiziqu ezifanele ze-National Diploma/Degree ku-Internal Auditing / Risk Management noma iziqu ezingakenzeki. Iminyaka eyithathu (3) yohlu lwamo kokuphathwa kwezingozi noma inkambu ehlobene nakho. Ukubhalisa kwakhompyutha. Ileyisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nezenqubo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezingozi. Ukuxhumana kahle ngokomlomo nakubhalwe. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okucwaninga, ukubhala izibalo kanye nokubonisa. Umguli kufanele abe oyithembekile, abe ngumuntu othatha isinyathelo ngaphambili, futhi abe oyothembekile futhi azenikele ekulethweni kwenkonzo. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcindezi.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa, hlola futhi usebenzise ngokubonisana nokuphathwa, inqubomgomo yokuphathwa kwezingozi, indlela yokusebenza, indlela nenqubomgomo. Sebenzisa uhlelo lokuphathwa kwezingozi okungukubuka kwezingozi, isilinganiso sokwamukela izingozi kanye nokuhlukanisa izingozi. Hola futhi uqoqe ukubhalisa kwezingozi ezinga lezinqubo, ukusebenza kanye nokuqhubeka phambili. Hola ukuqeqeshwa okuhlobene nezingozi, izinkomfa kanye nemikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukuzwa kubaphathi nakubasebenzi. Hola futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kanye nezenqubo ezihlobene nemisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezingozi. Xhumana ne-Internal Audit mayelana nalezinkomba zokukhohlakala kanye nokuqhuba phambili izindlela zokuthibela ukukhohlakala. Hlola izindaba ezibikiwe zokukhohlakala kanye nokonakaliswa kolwazi ngaphakathi kwesikole. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana nendlela yokusebenza yokuphathwa kwezingozi kanye naleyo thinye imithetho evumelekile. Qoqhela yonke izibalo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezingozi. Zithobe kwezinqubomgomo kanye nezenqubo ze-Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) kanye ne-College. Bonke abaguli abakulelu, okuhlanganisa ne-SMS, bazodlula okuhlola kabili ngaphambi kokuqala. Okulodwa kuzoba kuzivivinyo zokwenza ukuze kutholwe ukufaneleka komguli okusekelwe ezidingweni zociko nezijwayelekile zesikhundla, okunye kufanele kuzivivinyo sokuziphatha (okuziphatha ngesimilo).

xh.title: Umsebenzi Ohamba Phambili WokuLawula Iingozi
xh.summary: Isebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha lifuna umsebenzi ohamba phambili wolawulo lwengozi ukuba aphuhlise aze asebenzise iinkqubo zolawulo lwengozi, iindlela neenkqubo kwiiKholeji zeTVET, kufuneka idiploma okanye idigri kunye neminyaka emithatu yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe seGrade 12 / Matric / Level 4. Idiploma/Idigri yeSizwe efanelekileyo kwiNgohlakalo Langaphakathi / uLawulo lweengozi okanye isifanekiselo sekwalifikheyishini. Iiminyaka emithatu (3) yamava kuLawulo lweengozi okanye kwinkundla enxulumene nayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuQhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemithetho, iinkqazo neenkqubo ezinxulumene noLawulo lweengozi. Isakhono sokunxibelelana ngemile nangesibhali. Isakhono sobudlelwane nabantu nesakhono sosombululoweenkinga. Isakhono sokuphanda nokuBhala iingxelo nokubonisa. Umzobi kufuneka abe nthontele, akhusele iintsinga, aze athe tya athembekile kwaye azibophelele kwinkonzo ehlinzekayo. Isakhono sokusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Ukuphuhlisa, ukuphepha nokusebenzisa ngokuvakalayo nenxulumene nolawulo, inqaku wolawulo lwengozi, inkqubo, indlela noshwangashwanga. Ukusebenzisa inkqubo yolawulo lwengozi oko kukuthi ukuqapha iingozi, isifuno senkohlakalo nokumelana nayo nokuhlelwa kweengozi. Ukukhuthaza nokudibanisa urejista weengozi kwinqanaba loshwangashwanga, lokusebenza nolandelelwano. Ukukhuthaza iinkqubo zolwazi ngeengozi, iinkqubo zokuzilolonga kunye neenkqubo zokwandisa ulwazi kulawulo nakumsebenzisi. Ukukhuthaza nokulandelela isicelo neenkqubo ezinxulumene nomsebenzi kunye nemisebenzi yolawulo lwengozi. Ukunxibelelana neNgohlakalo Langaphakathi malunga nabahANJI bomgca wenkohlakalo nokusebenzisa iindlela ezithintela inkohlakalo. Ukulandelela izigxina ngeenkohlakalo nokonakaliswa okubikiweyo ngaphakathi kwiKholeji. Ukuqinisekisa ukuHambelana nenkqubo yolawulo lwengozi eyinxulumene nayo nanye imithetho elsebenzayo. Ukuqokelela yonke iingxelo ezinxulumene nolawulo lwengozi. Ukuzithobela iinkqazo neenkqubo zeSibe leMfundo ePhakamileyo & uQeqesha (DHET) naseKholeji. Onke abazobi abakhethiweyo, kuquka i-SMS, kuya kwenza iintlolo ezimbini zangaphambi kokungena. Enya kuya kuba luluvavo lokuzilolonga ngokwenza ukuqonda ukufaneleka komzobi ngokusekelwe kwiimfuno zobuchwephesha nejeneriki zesithuba, enye kuye kufuneka ibe luluvavo lobuzolo (ukuziphatha ngokugqithisileyo).

jobs.summary: IT Technicians are needed at TVET Colleges to provide first and second-line ICT support, maintain infrastructure, and administer user accounts, with a minimum diploma and two to three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. An appropriate National Diploma / Degree in Information Technology (IT), Information Systems, Network Engineering, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, or equivalent qualification. Minimum of 2 – 3 years' experience in an ICT environment supporting enterprise infrastructure. (HCIP) – Routing & Switching, Security, Cloud Computing, or related specialisation. A valid Driver’s Licence. Knowledge of ICT infrastructure, network administration, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and server management. Knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, Azure, and virtualisation technologies. Understanding of cloud-based infrastructure and hybrid environments. Knowledge of backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices. Understanding of network security technologies including firewalls, endpoint protection, email security, and security monitoring tools. Ability to perform vulnerability assessments and implement security controls. Knowledge of system integration, user provisioning, identity management, and access control. Understanding of ICT governance frameworks and service management principles. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Ability to interpret ICT challenges and provide effective solutions. Excellent customer service and stakeholder engagement skills. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. Strong communication, documentation, and report- writing skills. Project coordination and time management skills.
jobs.duties: Provide first and second-line ICT support services to College users and maintain the effective operation of the ICT Service Desk. Install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, telephones, software applications, and peripheral devices. Administer user accounts, email services, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 services, and access management processes. Support and maintain network infrastructure including switches, routers, wireless networks, structured cabling, internet connectivity, and voice communication systems. Assist with the administration, monitoring, maintenance, and upgrading of server infrastructure, cloud services, virtualisation platforms, and enterprise applications. Implement and support cybersecurity controls, endpoint protection solutions, patch management, vulnerability remediation, information security measures, and compliance with ICT security standards. Monitor ICT infrastructure to ensure the availability, integrity, and confidentiality of College information systems and services. Perform backup and recovery procedures, disaster recovery activities, business continuity support, data migration, and secure offsite storage of institutional information. Assist with systems integration initiatives, cloud migration projects, digital transformation programmes, and the implementation of new ICT technologies and services. Maintain ICT asset registers, technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and system configurations. Conduct troubleshooting, diagnosis, testing, installation, configuration, and upgrade activities on ICT infrastructure and systems. Provide telephonic, remote, and on-site support to users across all College sites. Gather and analyse user requirements, identify ICT-related challenges, recommend solutions, and participate in ICT projects and innovation initiatives. Ensure compliance with Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET) regulations, College policies, ICT governance frameworks, and industry best practices while providing efficient, reliable, and customer-focused ICT services. Adhere to Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) and College policies and procedures. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Inligtingstegnologie (IT), Inligtingstelsels, Netwerkingingenieurswese, Kuberveiligheid, Wolkrekenaartegnologie, of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van ICT-infrastruktuur, netwerkadministrasie, wolkrekenaartegnologie, kuberveiligheid en bedienerbestuur. Kennis van Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, Azure en virtualiseringstegnologieë. Begrip van wolkgebaseerde infrastruktuur en hibriede omgewings. Kennis van rugsteun, rampherstel en besigheidskontinuiteitpraktyke. Begrip van netwerksekuriteitstegnologieë insluitend vuurmuure, eindpuntbeskerming, e-possekuriteit en sekuriteitsmoniteringsinstrumente. Vermoë om kwesbaarheidsassesserings uit te voer en sekuriteitskontroles te implementeer. Kennis van stelselintegrasie, gebruikersvoorsiening, identiteitsbestuur en toegangsbeheer. Begrip van ICT-bestuursraamwerke en diensbestuursbeginsels. Sterke probleemoplossings- en analitiese vaardighede. Vermoë om ICT-uitdagings te interpreteer en effektiewe oplossings te bied. Uitstekende kliëntediens en belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en veelvuldige prioriteite te bestuur. Sterke kommunikasie-, dokumentasie- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Projekoördinering en tydbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf eerste- en tweedelynse ICT-ondersteuningsdienste aan Kollege-gebruikers en handhaaf die effektiewe werking van die ICT-diensbank. Installeer, konfigureer, onderhou en los probleme op met rekenaars, skootrekenaars, drukkers, telefoone, sagtewaretoepassings en randtoerusting. Administreer gebruikersrekeninge, e-posdienste, Active Directory, Microsoft 365-dienste en toegangsbestuursprosesse. Ondersteun en onderhou netwerkinfrastruktuur insluitend skakelaars, roeteerders, draadlose netwerke, gestruktureerde bedrading, internetkonnektiwiteit en stemkommunikasiestelsels. Bystand verleen met die administrasie, monitering, onderhoud en opgradering van bedienerinfrastruktuur, wolkdienste, virtualiseringsplatforms en ondernemingstoepassings. Implementeer en ondersteun kuberveiligheidskontroles, eindpuntbeskermingsoplossings, plekvullingbestuur, kwesbaarheidsregstelling, inligtingsekuriteitsmaatreëls en nakoming van ICT-sekuriteitsstandaarde. Monitor ICT-infrastruktuur om die beskikbaarheid, integriteit en vertroulikheid van Kollege-inligtingstelsels en -dienste te verseker. Voer rugsteun- en herstelprosedures uit, rampherstelaktiwiteite, besigheidskontinuiteitsondersteuning, datamigrasie en veilige buiteperseberging van instellingsinligting. Bystand verleen met stelselintegrasie-inisiatiewe, wolkmigrasieprojekte, digitale transformasieprogramme en die implementering van nuwe ICT-tegnologieë en -dienste. Onderhou ICT-bateregisters, tegniese dokumentasie, standaardbedryfsprosedures en stelselkonfigurasies. Voer probleemoplossing, diagnose, toetsing, installasie, konfigurasie en opgraderingsaktiwiteite uit op ICT-infrastruktuur en -stelsels. Verskaf telefoniese, afgeleë en terpersele ondersteuning aan gebruikers by alle Kollege-plekke. Versamel en ontleed gebruikersvereistes, identifiseer ICT-verwante uitdagings, beveel oplossings aan en neem deel aan ICT-projekte en innovasie-inisiatiewe. Verseker nakoming van Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET)-regulasies, Kollege-beleide, ICT-bestuursraamwerke en bedryfsbest practices terwyl doeltreffende, betroubare en kliëntgerigte ICT-dienste verskaf word. Hou by Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET)- en Kollege-beleide en -prosedures. Alle gekorte lys kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toetredingsassesserings onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes en die ander moet 'n integriteit (etiese gedrag) assessering wees.

zu.title: Abahluli Bezobuchwepheshe Be-IT
zu.summary: Abahluli bezobuchwepheshe be-IT badingeka KumaKholishi we-TVET ukunikeza ukwesekwa kwe-ICT okweshayini lokuqala nalesesibili, ukugcina izakhiwo, kanye nokuphatha ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi, ngediploma elincane kanye neminyaka emibili kuye kwayithathu yamava.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12 / Matric / Level 4. Idiploma Yezwe / I-Digri efaneleko kwi-Information Technology (IT), Information Systems, Network Engineering, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, noma izifundo ezinganiswa. Okuncane iminyaka engu-2 – 3 yamava endaweni ye-ICT esekaya izakhiwo zomuntuqu. (HCIP) – Routing & Switching, Security, Cloud Computing, noma ukutholwa okuhlobene nalokho. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi ngezakhiwo ze-ICT, ukuphathwa kwenethiwekhi, i-cloud computing, i-cybersecurity, kanye nokuphathwa kwiseva. Ulwazi nge-Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, Azure, kanye namateknoloji we-virtualisation. Ukuqonda izakhiwo ezisekelwe kwi-cloud kanye namaphulasizi ahlanganisiwe. Ulwazi ngokuqoqwa kwenani lemininingwane, ukubuyisela emuva ngemuva kwecala ledisastha, kanye nokwenza isikhathi nendlela yokuthi ihhoveli lisebenze njalo. Ukuqonda amateknoloji okuvikela inethiwekhi okuhlanganisa amafirewall, ukuvikelwa kwe-endpoint, ukuvikela i-imeyili, kanye namathuluzi okulandelela ukuvikeleka. Ikhono lokwenza ukulinganisa ukubuthaka kanye nokuphoqa izindlela zokuvikela. Ulwazi ngokuhlanganisa amasistimu, ukulungiselelwa komsebenzisi, ukuphathwa kokubalwa komuntu, kanye nokulawula ukungena. Ukuqonda izisekelo zokubusa ze-ICT kanye nemigomo yokuphatha isevisi. Amandla okuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokuhumusha izinselele ze-ICT nokunikeza izixazululo eziyithunyelwe. Amandla aphezulu okukhonza abakhulumayo kanye nokuxhumana nabahlokohlobo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkinhso kanye nokuphatha okubalulekile okuningi. Amandla amakhulu okuxhumana, ukubhala amadokhumenti, nokubhala imibiko. Amandla okuhlanganisa iphrojekthi kanye nokuphatha isikhathi.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkonzo yokuwesekwa kwe-ICT kweshayini lokuqala nalesesibili kubasebenzisi beKholishi ugcine ukusebenza okuyisisekelo kwe-ICT Service Desk. Faka, lungisa, phatha bese uxazulula izinkinga kumadesktop, amalaphotho, abaprinta, amatelifoni, izinhlelo zesoftware, kanye nezinto ezihlobene nazo. Phatha ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi, inkonzo ye-imeyili, i-Active Directory, inkonzo ye-Microsoft 365, kanye namaphulosej okuphathwa kokungena. Sekela futhi ugcine izakhiwo zenethiwekhi okuhlanganisa ama-switch, ama-router, amanethiwekhi angathunyelwa ngensimbi, ukubekwa kwamakhebula, ukuhlangana nge-inthanethi, kanye namasistimu okuxhumana ngamaphimbo. Siza ekuphathweni, ekulandeleleni, ekugcineni, nasekhululekiseni izakhiwo zeseva, inkonzo ye-cloud, ama-platifomu we-virtualisation, kanye nezinhlelo zomuntuqu. Phoqa bese usekela izilawulo ze-cybersecurity, izixazululo zokuvikela i-endpoint, ukuphatha ama-patch, ukulungisa ukubuthaka, izinyathelo zokuvikela ulwazi, kanye nokuhambisana namazinga okuvikeleka we-ICT. Landelela izakhiwo ze-ICT ukuze kuqiniseke ukutholakala, ukuqiniseka, kanye nokugcina imfihlo kumasistimu nasezinkonzweni zolwazi zeKholishi. Yenza izinqubo zokuqoqa kanye nokubuyisela emuva, imisebenzi yokubuyisela emuva ngemuva kwecala ledisastha, ukwesekwa kokuqhubeka kwehhoveli, ukudluliswa kwemininingwane, kanye nokugcoba ngokuphephile kwemininingwane yenhlangano emaphandle. Siza nokuqashelwa kokuqala izinhlelo zokuhlanganisa amasistimu, amaphulo ukudlulisela i-cloud, imiyalelo yokuguqula idijithali, kanye nokuphoqa amateknoloji we-ICT amasha kanye nezinkonzo. Gcina imiyalo yezinto ze-ICT, amadokhumenti ezobuchwepheshe, izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza, kanye nolungiselelo lwamasistimu. Yenza ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlolwa kwezifo, ukuhlola, ukufaka, ukulungisa, kanye nemisebenzi yokuqaliswa kabusha kuzakhiwo namasistimu e-ICT. Nikeza ukwesekwa ngomakhalekhukhwini, ekude, nasesiteshini kubasebenzisi kuzo zonke iziteshi zeKholishi. Qoqa futhi uhlaziye izidingo zabasebenzisi, wazi izinselele ezihlobene ne-ICT, uphakamise izixazululo, futhi ubambe iqhaza emaphulo we-ICT nasekuqaliseni izinto ezintsha. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho yesikhungo i-Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET), imithetho yeKholishi, izisekelo zokubusa ze-ICT, kanye namazinga ahamba phambili emkhakheni nakunikeza inkonzo ye-ICT esebenzayo, ethembekile, futhi egxile kukhulumoyimboni. Zilandele imithetho yesikhungo i-Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) kanye nemithetho nangemiyalelo yeKholishi. Bonke abantu abakhethiwe, okuhlanganisa ne-SMS, kuzofanele balenze amahlolwa amabili angaphambilini kokungena. Anowodwa uzoba ukuzivivinya okusebenzayo ukuze kutholwe ukufaneleka komuntu ngokusekelwe ezidingweni ezobuchwepheshe nangokuvamile kulesikhundla, kanye nowunye ofanele ukuba ukuholwa ukuzivivinya kobuqotho (ukuziphatha ngokuyikho).

xh.title: Oochwepheshe be-IT
xh.summary: Kufunekwa oochwepheshe be-IT kwiZiko le-TVET ukwenza inkxaso yokuqala kunye nenyanga yesibini ye-ICT, ukugcina izakhelo, noku lawula iakhawunti zabasebenzisi, nedisiploma elincinane neminye emithandathu ukuya kuthathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric / Level 4. Isidanga seNational Diploma / Degree esifanelekileyo kwi-Information Technology (IT), i-Information Systems, i-Network Engineering, i-Cyber Security, i-Cloud Computing, okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Okungenwa yiminye emibini ukuya kuthathu yamava kwindawo ye-ICT exhasa izakhelo zeshishini. (HCIP) – i-Routing & Switching, i-Security, i-Cloud Computing, okanye ingqinelano ekuhlotyweyo. Ilayisense yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngesakhelo se-ICT, ulawulo lwenethiwekhi, i-cloud computing, i-cybersecurity, kunye nolawulo lweeseva. Ulwazi nge-Microsoft Windows Server, i-Active Directory, i-DNS, i-DHCP, i-Group Policy, i-Microsoft 365, i-Azure, kunye netekhnoloji ye-virtualisation. Ukuqonda ngesakhelo esisekwe kwi-cloud kunye nendawo ezidityaniswe ndawonye. Ulwazi ngoku gcina iakhawunti, i-disaster recovery, kunye nemisebenzi yokuqhuba phambili ishishini. Ukuqonda ngetekhnoloji yokhuseleko lwenethiwekhi kuquka i-firewalls, ukhuselo lwe-endpoint, ukhuseleko lwe-imeyile, kunye nezixhobo zokuqapha ukhuseleko. Ikhono lokwenza isilinganisilo sokungakhuseleki nokusekela izilawulo zokhuseleko. Ulwazi ngokudityaniswa kweenkqubo, ukunikela kumsebenzisi, ulawulo lobunikazi, kunye nolawulo lokufikelela. Ukuqonda ngezakhiwo zolawulo ze-ICT nemi yolwango yokwenza inkonzo. Ikhono elinamandla lokuxazula nokuqonda ngokulinganayo. Ikhono lokutolika iingqinamba ze-ICT kunye nokunika izisombululo ezisebenzayo. Ikhono elihle lekonzo labathengi nokuzibandakanya nabaphathi abahlotyiswe nayo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo noku lawula izinto ezibalulekileyo eziliqumba. Ikhono elinamandla lokunxibelelwana, ukuqulatha iinkcukacha, kunye nokubhala iiripoti. Ikhono lokuhambelana nongqamano weeprhojekthi nokuqonda ngokulawula ixesha.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yenkxaso yokuqala kunye nenyanga yesibini ye-ICT kubasebenzisi beKholeji kwaye ugcine ukusebenza okusebenzayo kwe-ICT Service Desk. Faka, misela, gcina, kwaye uzulule iidesktop, iilaptops, iiprinta, iifowuni, izicelo zesoftware, kunye nezixhobo ezingaqhelekanga. Lawula iakhawunti zabasebenzisi, iinkonzo ze-imeyile, i-Active Directory, iinkonzo ze-Microsoft 365, kunye nemisebenzi yolawulo lokufikelela. Sekela kwaye ugcinte isakhelo senethiwekhi kuquuka i-switches, iirhota, iinethiwekhi ezingenazintambo, i-cabling ekuqulathiweyo, unxibelelwano nge-intanethi, kunye nemitsho yonxibelelwano lwamazwi. Nceda ngolawulo, ukuqapha, ukugcina, nokuphucula isakhelo seeseva, iinkonzo ze-cloud, iiplathifomu ze-virtualisation, kunye nezicelo zeshishini. Sekela kwaye usekelwe izilawulo ze-cybersecurity, izisombululo zokhuselo lwe-endpoint, ulawulo lwe-patch, ulungiso lwe-vulnerability, iziqinisekiso zokhuseleko lolwazi, kunye nokuvumelana nemigaqo yokhuseleko ye-ICT. Qapha isakhelo se-ICT ukuqinisekisa ukufumaneka, ukuzinza, kunye nokugcinwa kolwazi lweenkqubo neenkonzo zeKholeji. Zenza imisebenzi yokugcina nokubuyisa iakhawunti, iinkqubo ze-disaster recovery, inkxaso yokuqhuba phambili ishishini, ukuthumela i-data, kunye negcino elikhuselekileyo lwangaphandle kolwazi lesikhungo. Nceda ngokuqaliswa kweenkqubo zodityaniswa, iiprojekthi zokudityaniswa kwi-cloud, iinkqubo zokuguqula idijitha, kunye nokusekela iitekhnoloji ze-ICT ezintsha neenkonzo. Gcina iirejista zeempahla ze-ICT, iinkcukacha ngeenkqubo, iinkqubo ezizezekileyo zokuvela kwezona msebenzi, kunye nokumiswa kweenkqubo. Yenza ukuxazula, ukuxilonga, ukuvavanya, ukufaka, ukumisela, nokuphucula imisebenzi kwindawo yeesakhelo kunye neenkqubo ze-ICT. Nika inkxaso ngomnxeba, ngenkqubo, nasesixhweni kubasebenzisi kuzo onke amawobi eKholeji. Qokelela kwaye udwelise iimfuno zabasebenzisi, chonga iingqinamba ezinxulumene ne-ICT, nikela ngamacebiso, kwaye uthabathe inxaxheba kwiiprojekthi ze-ICT kunye namaqandu ashukumisayo esiphelo. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana nemigaqo yesebe ye-DHET, iingqwalasela zeKholeji, iinkqubo zolawulo ze-ICT, kunye nemigaqo ekudityaniswe ngayo xa kunika iinkonzo ze-ICT ezisebenzayo, ezithembekileyo, kwaye ngezento joluse abathengi. Yame kumgaqo nbeenkqubo zesebe le-DHET nakuwo iKholeji. Onke amagqabi alo kwindawo yokhetho abizwa ngokuba abakwi-SMS, kuya kwenza iimbuzo ezimbini zangenwa ngaphambili. Enye iba ngumzobo wamava wokumisela ukufaneleka kwakhe ngokuchasene neemfuno ezibalulekileyo kulo nyaka, esinye ke sibe ngumbuzo wokuzinza (kwindawo ka-IT) ngokusisilumko.

jobs.summary: Chief Administrative Clerk: Payroll position at TVET Colleges under the Department of Higher Education and Training, requiring a National Diploma or Degree and 3-5 years of financial management experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. An appropriate National Diploma or Degree in Accounting / Financial Management / Human Resource Management or equivalent qualification. 3-5 years’ experience in the financial management environment. A valid Driver’s Licence. Knowledge of financial functions, practices, as well as the ability to capture data, operate a computer and collate financial statistics. Knowledge of financial accounting. procedure, methods and principles established for the processing of specific salary/ financial transactions. Knowledge of the Public Service financial legislations, procedures and Treasury Regulations (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Knowledge of financial operating systems (PERSAL, BAS, MIS) etc. Computer skills. Planning and organising skills. Good verbal and written communication. Basic numeracy skills. Ability to perform routine tasks. Ability to operate office equipment. Flexibility. Interpersonal Relations. Accuracy. Client service focus. Integrity. Committed. Proactive and loyal.
jobs.duties: Ensure the Implementation of Budget Control and expenditure. Facilitate and coordinate the annual budgeting process. Perform monthly budgetary and Expenditure analysis. Effect budget adjustments. Prepare budget. administer College adjustment Estimates. Compile Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) projections. monitor expenditure trends and reconciliation against budget and cash flow projections. monitor expenditure allocation and amendment of erroneousness allocations. Compile financial reports. Compile monthly budget reports. Safeguard all financial documents of the College. Prepare the unit for the annual financial audit and respond to enquiries. Reconcile salary payments with salary ledger. Administer payroll control and salary administration. Provide inputs and implement salary administration and payroll control policies. Reconcile salary payments against the salary ledgers for all cost centres on the system. Manage the written appointment of paymaster. Maintain and update pay points and their associated staff. Print, distribute and collect payrolls. Sign a monthly salary administration and payroll control compliance certificate. Safeguard and preserve payrolls. Load third party payment on bank system (SARS, UIF, COIDA and SDL). Supervise human resources/staff. Allocate and ensure quality of work. Personnel development. Assess staff development. Apply discipline. Report on state of expenditure. Adhere to Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) and College policies and procedures. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.
