af.title: Hoofadministratiewe Klerk: Salarisstaat
af.summary: Hoofadministratiewe Klerk: Salarisstaat-pos by TVET Colleges onder die Department of Higher Education and Training, waarvoor 'n National Diploma of Degree en 3-5 jaar se ervaring in finansiële bestuur vereis word.
af.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. 'n Gesikte National Diploma of Degree in Accounting / Financial Management / Human Resource Management of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in 'n finansiële bestuursomgewig. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van finansiële funksies, praktyke, asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële statistieke te versamel. Kennis van finansiële rekeningkunde. prosedures, metodes en beginsels wat vir die verwerking van spesifieke salaris-/finansiële transaksies vasgestel is. Kennis van Openbare Diens-finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en Tesourieregulasies (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Kennis van finansiële bedryfstelsels (PERSAL, BAS, MIS) ens. Rekenaarvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasie. Basiese syferkundige vaardighede. Vermoë om roetine take uit te voer. Vermoë om kantooruitrusting te bedryf. Buigsaamheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Akkuraatheid. Kliëntediensfokus. Integriteit. Toegewyd. Proaktief en lojaal.
af.duties: Verseker die implementering van begrotingsbeheer en -besteding. Fasiliteer en koördineer die jaarlikse begrotingsproses. Verrig maandelikse begrotings- en bestedingsontleding. Doen begrotingsaanpassings. Berei begroting voor. administreer College se aanpassingsramings. Stel Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF)-projeksies op. monitor bestedingsneigings en afstemming teen begroting en kontantvloei-projeksies. monitor bestedingstoekenning en wysiging van foutiewe toekenning. Stel finansiële verslae op. Stel maandelikse begrotingsverslae op. Bewaar alle finansiële dokumente van die College. Berei die eenheid voor vir die jaarlikse finansiële oudit en reageer op navrae. Stem salarisbetalings met die salarisgrootboek af. Administreer salarisstaatbeheer en salarisadministrasie. Verskaf insette en implementeer beleide vir salarisadministrasie en salarisstaatbeheer. Stem salarisbetalings teen die salarisgrootboeke vir alle kostesentrums op die stelsel af. Bestuur die skriftelike aanstelling van die salarisbeampte. Onderhou en werk betaalpunte en hul geassosieerde personeel by. Druk, versprei en haal salarisstate in. Teken 'n maandelikse salarisadministrasie- en salarisstaatbeheer-nakomingsertifikaat. Bewaar en behou salarisstate. Laai derde party-betalings op die bankstelsel (SARS, UIF, COIDA en SDL). Oulig menslike hulpbronne/personeel. Ken werk toe en verseker kwaliteit van werk. Personeelsontwikkeling. Evalueer personeelsontwikkeling. Pas dissipline toe. Rapporteer oor die stand van besteding. Hou aan by Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en College se beleide en prosedures. Alle gekandideerdes op die kortlys, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toetreidingsassessering ondergaan. Die een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteitsassessering (etiese gedrag) wees.

zu.title: Obala Ophethe Izimali OyiNhloko: Ukukhokha Amaholo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobhodi lomlawuli ophethe izimali: ukukhokha amaholo kuma-TVET Colleges ngaphansi kwe-Department of Higher Education and Training, sidinga i-National Diploma noma i-Degree kanye neminyaka engu-3-5 yokuhlanganyela enkonzweni ekuqondweni kwezimali.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4. I-National Diploma noma i-Degree efanele kwi-Accounting / Financial Management / Human Resource Management noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Eminyakeni engu-3-5 yokuhlanganyela enkonzweni ekuqondweni kwezimali. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ezimali, izindlela, kanye nakhono lokufaka idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuhlanganisa izibalo zezimali. Ulwazi ngesibalo seziimali. inqubo, izindlela kanye nemigomo emisiwe ukuze kwenziwe izinkokhelo ezithile zamaholo / izimali. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezimali yesevisi yokomphakathi, izinqubo kanye nemithetho yeTreasury (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Ulwazi ngamasistimu okusebenza ngawo izimali (PERSAL, BAS, MIS) njll. Amandla okusebenza ngekhompyutha. Amandla okuhlela futhi uqonde izinto. Ukuxhumana kahle ngokukhuluma kanye nokubhala. Amandla abalayo ayisisekelo. Amandla okwenza imisebenzi eqhubekayo. Amandla okusebenzisa izinto zofisi. Ukuhlukahluka nokuguquguquka. Ukuxhumana nabantu. Ukunembe. Ukuqashelwa kwezidingo zomthengi. Ukuzethemba. Ukuqinisekiswa. Ukubamba iqhaza ngaphambili futhi uthembekile.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphothulwa kwezintela kanye nokuchithwa kwemali. Hlela futhi uqondise inqubo yokubudgeta ngonyaka.enza ukuhlaziya ukweqiswa kwebhajethi kanye nokuchithwa kwemali njalo ngenyanga. Yenza ulungiso lwebhajethi. Lungiselela ibhajethi; phatha ukulinganiselwa kwezimali zeKholishi. Hlanganisa izibikezelo ze-Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Bheka izindlela zokuchithwa kwemali kanye nokubambisana ngebhajethi kanye nezibikezelo zokusakaza kwemali. Bheka ukwabiwa kwemali echithwayo nokulungiswa kokwabiwa okungalungile. Hlanganisa imibiko yezimali. Hlanganisa imibiko yebhajethi njalo ngenyanga. Sigcina zonke iziqubulo zezimali zeKholishi. Lungiselela iyunithi ukuya kokuholwa kwezimali ngonyaka futhi uphendule imibuzo. Bambisela imali ehola kuleja yamaholo. Phatha ukulawula amaholo kanye nokuphathwa kwamaholo. Nikela izinto ezingenisiwe futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kwamaholo kanye nokulawula ukukhokha amaholo. Bambisela imali ehola ngeleja yamaholo kuzo zonke izikhungo eziholayo kulesistimu. Phatha ukubhaliwe kokubekwa komphathi weholo. Gcina futhi ulungise izindawo zokukhokhelwa kanye nabasebenzi abahlobene nazo. Phrinta, yahlukanisa futhi uqoqe amaholo. Sayina isitifiketi sokuzinza kolawulo lokuphathwa kwamaholo kanye nokulawula amaholo njalo ngenyanga. Gcina futhi uvikele amaholo. Faka ukukhokhelwa kweqembu lesithathu kusistimu yebhange (SARS, UIF, COIDA and SDL). Qondise abasebenzi/izinsiza zomuntu. Ame futhi uqiniseke inani lokuhlela kwemisebenzi. Intuthuko yabasebenzi. Hlola intuthuko yabasebenzi. Faka isiyaluyalu. Nikezela umbiko ngemo yezimali echithiwe. Landela izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo ze-Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) kanye nezinqubo zeKholishi. Bonke abaqeqeshiwe ababekiwe, okuhlanganisa i-SMS, bazokwenza ukuhlola okubili ngaphambi kokungena esikhundleni. Okunye kuzoba umzamo osemthethweni wokuqinisekisa ukufaneleka komuntu oqokwayo ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zobuchwepheshezejikelele besikhundla, okunye kumele kube ukuhlola ukuzinza (ukuziphatha ngokungcolile).

xh.title: ISikhulu esiPhambili seNkonzo eBhulawini: iNtlawulo yemivuzo
xh.summary: Isikhulu esiPhambili seNkonzo eBhulawini: isithuba seNtlawulo yemivuzo kwiKholeji zeTVET ngaphansi koSebe lezemfundo ePhakamileyo nakweziqeqesho, kufuneka iDiploma yesiZwe okanye iDegree kunye neminyaka engama-3-5 yamava aphathwa ngayo imicimbi yemali.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric / Level 4. iDiploma yesiZwe efanelekileyo okanye iDegree kwi-Accounting / Financial Management / Human Resource Management okanye ngesiqinisekiso esilinganayo. iminyaka engama-3-5 yamava kwendawo yolawulo lweemali. ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yemali, imigaqo, kunye nolawulo lokufaka idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zemali. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwemali. iinkqubo, iindlela nemiqathango emisiweyookuqhuba iintshekeliso ezithile zemivuzo / zemali. Ulwazi ngemithetho yemali yoLuntu, iinkqubo nokuMila kwesikwerhu (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, iManuali yemali). Ulwazi ngeenkqabamithi zemali (PERSAL, BAS, MIS) njl. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ilizwi elhle kwaye libhaliweyo. Amakhono abalo abalulekileyo. Ulawulo lokwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo. Ulawulo lokusebenzisa izixhobo zofisi. Ukuguquguquka. Iimalamano nabantu. Ukuchaneka. Ugqaliselo kwinkonzo yabathengi. Intembeko. Uzinikelo. Ukuba ngaphambili nonguzithobile.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa kolawulo leBajeti nokuchithwa. Qinisekisa kwakhona oxhase ukucwangciswa kweminyaka yonke yebajeti. Yenza isahluko ngenyanga sebajeti nokuchithwa. Yenza ukulungelelwanisa kweebajeti. Lungiselela ibajeti. lawula ulungiselelwanisa lweKholeji. Qamba iindlela ezibonakalayo zeMedium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). qaphela iindlela zokuqwalelwa kwemali nokulinganisela elungelelaniswa neebajeti nokuqhuba imali. qaphela ukwabiwa kwemali nokulungiswa kolwabiwo olungalunganga. Qamba iingxelo zemali. Qamba iingxelo zenyanga zebajeti. Siphaze zonke iixwebhu zemali zeKholeji. Lungiselela iyunithi yonyaka wokuhlolwa kweemali kwaye uphendule imibuzo. Linganisa iintshekeliso zemivuzo ngebhukhwe yemivuzo. Lawula ulawulo lwentlawulo yemivuzo nolawulo lwemivuzo. Nikeza izimvo kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zolawulo lwemivuzo nolawulo lwentlawulo yemivuzo. Linganisa iintshekeliso zemivuzo ngokuchasene nebhukhwe yemivuzo kuzo zonke iindawo zentengo kwinkqubo. Lawula isibhalo esibhaliweyo somlawuli wetlawulo yemivuzo. Gcina kwaye uvuselele iindawo zentlawulo kunabasebenzi abahlotyeneyo nazo. Printa, yahlathaze kwaye uqokelele iintlawulo zemivuzo. Sayina isatifikethi sonyaka nokulawulwa kwemivuzo kwaye iqinisekiswe ukulawulwa kwentlawulo yemivuzo. Siphaze kwaye ulondoloze iintlawulo zemivuzo. Faka iintlawulo zabantu abathathu kwinkqubo yebhanki (SARS, UIF, COIDA and SDL). Lawula abasebenzi nabantu. Yahlathaze kwaye uqinisekise umgangatho womsebenzi. Ukuphuhlisa abantu. Hlola ukuphuhlisa abantu. Sebenzisa isithunzi. Xela ngemo yokuchithwa kwemali. Bandakanyeka kumthetho kaSebe lezemfundo ePhakamileyo & eziQeqesho (DHET) nemiqatho yekholeji neenkqubo. Onke amagqabantshathi abekiweyo, kuquka iSMS, kufuneka athathe izahlulelo ezimbini zangaphambi kokungena. Esinye siza kuba sisilumkiso sokuzilolonga ukumisela ukufaneleka komgqatswa ngokusekelwe kumfuno yobuchwepheshe begqabantshathi kwaye esinye sime kubuncwadi bokuzithemba (ukuziphatha ngokungenisa).

jobs.title: Campus Administrator
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026 at 16H00. NOTE` : Applications must be submitted on Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/Documents and must be Accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (With Three Contactable References). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A user guide and ‘how to’ videos will assist in how to complete for the form and digital signature. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in term s of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action. The appointment will be done in line with the approved Employment Equity Plan. Persons with disability are encouraged to apply. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. OTHER POSTS
jobs.summary: Campus administrator role providing administrative support, enrolment planning, report preparation, and meeting coordination at a TVET college within the Department of Higher Education and Training.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4 Certificate. An appropriate National Diploma / Degree in Office Management and Technology / Public Management or equivalent qualification. 1-2 years relevant experience in Administration environment. A valid Driver’s Licence. Knowledge of office administration. Knowledge of Public Service legislations and policies. Knowledge of PSET. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET/ CET Administration. Understanding of the Higher Education sector. Understanding of corporate governance. Understanding Cost centre budgetary, expenditure and cash flow management. Employment Equity Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act and any other related legislation. Planning and organising. Financial management. Report writing. Communication and interpersonal. Problem solving. Computer literacy skill. Analytical skill. Client- oriented. Project management. Team leadership. Planning and organising. People management. Client service focus. Integrity. Committed. Proactive and Loyal.
jobs.duties: Render administrative support services. Draw up a campus enrolment plan for both NCV and report 191. Gather departmental information and compile a report for A-TEAM and Campus Management. Prepare reports, presentations, and other correspondence. Arrange meetings, conferences, workshops and other gatherings as required. Provide other secretarial support services to campus management. Administer and coordinate human resource services: Coordinate Leave forms and submit to central office. Coordinate PMDS documents and submit to central office. Coordinate all relevant documentation pertaining to disciplinary cases and grievances. Follow up and resolve all human resource administration queries and issues emanating from campus staff. Maintain human resource records administration. Monitor the attendance register for staff. Coordinate the compilation of duty registers and payment for part-time lectures. Provide procurement services: Recommend purchase requisitions to Campus Manager. Draft procurement memo. Complete requisition form. Receive goods and services. Coordinate and submit invoices to central office for processing. Verify the correctness of goods and services supplied against the appropriate documentation. Follow-up on campus requisitions made. Support the implementation college staff wellness programme at campus level. Maintain a proper filing system: Maintain files for all campus staff. Filing of all relevant documentation according to QMS requirements and the National Achieve Act. Keep record of postage received from central office and ensure that the distribution is done accordingly and register is kept by the relevant official. Administer student registration and examination process: Assist in the registration of students. Store student portfolios of evidence and student records. Scan documents of students. Capture and reconcile information for students. Ensure data exceptions and corrections. Process the details of applications for programmes and credits. Coordinate the student registration process. Coordinate the examination process. Adhere to Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) and College policies and procedures. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. LK Boikhutso Tel No: (011) 730 6600 / Mr. T Matsaba Tel No: (011) 730
jobs.applications: must be submitted to recruitment@eec.edu.za OR hand delivered at Ekurhuleni East TVET College: Central Office, Sam Ngema Road, Kwa – Thema.

af.title: Kampusadministrateur
af.summary: Kampusadministrateurpos wat administratiewe ondersteuning, inskrywingsbeplanning, verslagopstelling en koördinering van vergaderings by 'n TVET-kollege binne die Department of Higher Education and Training bied.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 / Matriek / Vlak 4-sertifikaat. 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie / Openbare Bestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 1-2 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n administratiewe omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van kantooradministrasie. Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing en beleide. Kennis van PSET. Kennis en begrip van TVET-/CET-administrasie. Begrip van die hoër onderwyssektor. Begrip van korporatiewe bestuur. Begrip van kostesentrum se begrotings-, bestedings- en kontantvloei-bestuur. Employment Equity Act, Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act en enige ander verwante wetgewing. Beplanning en organisering. Finansiële bestuur. Verslagskrywing. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossing. Rekenvaardigheid. Analitiese vaardigheid. Kliëntegerig. Projektbestuur. Spanleierskap. Beplanning en organisering. Mensebestuur. Kliëntediensfokus. Integriteit. Toegewyd. Proaktief en lojaal.
af.duties: Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Stel 'n kampus-inskrywingsplan vir beide NCV en report 191 op. Versamel departementele inligting en stel 'n verslag vir A-TEAM en Kampusbestuur op. Berei verslae, aanbiedings en ander korrespondensie voor. Reël vergaderings, konferensies, werkswinkels en ander byeenkomste soos vereis. Verskaf ander sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan kampusbestuur. Administreer en koördineer menslike hulpbronndienste: Koördineer verlofvorms en dien dit by die sentrale kantoor in. Koördineer PMDS-dokumente en dien dit by die sentrale kantoor in. Koördineer alle relevante dokumentasie rakende dissiplinêre sake en griewe. Volg alle menslike hulpbronadministrasie-navrae en kwessies wat van kampuspersoneel afkomstig is, na en los dit op. Onderhou menslike hulpbronrekordadministrasie. Monitor die bywoningsregister vir personeel. Koördineer die samestelling van pligtreisters en betaling vir deeltydse dosente. Verskaf verkrygingsdienste: Beveel aankooprekwisisies by die Kampusbestuurder aan. Opstel van 'n verkrygingsmemo. Voltooi die rekwisisievorm. Ontvang goedere en dienste. Koördineer en dien fakture by die sentrale kantoor in vir verwerking. Verifieer die korrektheid van gelewerde goedere en dienste teen die toepaslike dokumentasie. Volg kampusrekwisisies wat gedoen is, na. Ondersteun die implementering van die kollege se personeelwelstandsprogram op kampusvlak. Onderhou 'n behoorlike lêerstelsel: Onderhou lêers vir alle kampuspersoneel. Lêer van alle relevante dokumentasie volgens QMS-vereistes en die National Achieve Act. Hou rekord van pos wat van die sentrale kantoor ontvang is en verseker dat verspreiding dienooreenkomstig gedoen word en dat die register deur die relevante beampte gehou word. Administreer studenteregistrasie en eksamenproses: Bystaan met die registrasie van studente. Berg studentportefeuljes van getuienis en studenterekords. Skandeer dokumente van studente. Vang en versoen inligting vir studente. Verseker data-uitsonderings en -korreksies. Verwerk die besonderhede van aansoeke vir programme en krediete. Koördineer die studenteregistrasieproses. Koördineer die eksamenproses. Hou by die Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) en kollegebeleide en prosedures. Alle gekose kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toetrede-assesserings ondergaan. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteit (etiese gedrag)-assessering wees.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wesikhungo
zu.summary: Indima yomlawuli wesikhungo onikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa, ukuhlela ukubhaliswa, ukulungiselela imibiko, kanye nokuqondisa izinkomfa esikhungweni samabanga aphakeme namakholeji phansi koMnyango WeMfundo Ephakeme NoQeqesho.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 / Matric / Level 4. I-National Diploma / Degree ethi ifanele ku-Office Management and Technology / Public Management noma izifundo ezilinganayo. 1-2 iminyaka yokuthola ulwazi mayelana nokusebenza kwabasebenzi. I-Driver's Licence esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuphathwa kohhovisi. Ulwazi ngemithetho nangamaphoyisa asebenza e-Public Service. Ulwazi nge-PSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-TVET/ CET Administration. Ukuqonda inqubo yemfundo ephakeme. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwebhizinisi. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuchithwa kwemali nokuphathwa kwegazi le-Cost centre. Employment Equity Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act nanoma yimuphi umthetho ongahlobene nalawo. Ukuhlela nokuhlela imisebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuxhumana nokuzwana nabantu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Isipho sokuqonda okubhalayo. Ukugxila kumakhasimende. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuphatha iqembu. Ukuhlela nokuhlela imisebenzi. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuqala ukubeka phambili izidingo zamakhasimende. Ukuthembeka. Ukuqina. Ukuqonda izinto ngaphambi kokuze kwenzeke futhi wethule inkuthazo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngamasevisi okwesekwa okuphathwa kwemibhalo. Hlela ihlelo lokubhalisa kwesikole samabanga aphakeme nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kwesikhungo kokubili i-NCV ne-report 191. Qoqa ulwazi lomnyango uze uhlanganise umbiko ohlukaniswayo we-A-TEAM kanye noBaphathi Besikhungo. Lungiselela imibiko, izethulo, neminye imibhalo evumelana. Hlela izinkomfa, amakhasimende, amakilasi oqeqesho, nanhlobonhlobo yemihlangano njengoba kudingeka. Nikezela ngamanye amasevisi okwesekwa kwababhalisi kubaphathi besikhungo. Phatha futhi uhlanganyele amasevisi abasebenzi: Hlanganyela amafomu okuhlala ibanga elithile uwathumele kwihhovisi elikhulu. Hlanganyela amadokhumenti we-PMDS uwathumele kwihhovisi elikhulu. Hlanganyela wonke amadokhumenti ahambisana nezindaba zokuhlukunyezwa kanye nezikhulumi. Landela futhi uxazulule yonke imibuzo nemitapo yohlelo lokuphathwa kwabasebenzi evela kubasebenzi besikhungo. Gcina imibalo yohlelo lokuphathwa kwabasebenzi. Qapha futhi ulawule irekhodi lokubikhona kwabasebenzi. Hlanganyela ekubhaliseni amarekhodi okusebenza kanye nokuqedwa kwezinkokhelo zabafundisi abasebenza isikhathi esingaphelele. Nikeza ngamasevisi okuthenga: Phakamisa izinto ezingadingeka zithengwe kubaphathi besikhungo. Bhala imemo yokuthenga. Gcwalisa ifomu lokuthenga. Yamukela izimpahla kanye namasevisi. Hlanganyela futhi uthumele izikweletu kwihhovisi elikhulu ukuze ziqashwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimpahla nezinsizakalo ezitholiwe ziyahambisana namadokhumenti afanele. Landela izinto ezingadingeka zithengwe esikhungweni. Sekela ukusebenza kohlaka lwesikhungo lokuthuthukisa impilo yabasebenzi emazingeni esikhungo. Gcina uhlelo oluhle lokugcina imibhalo: Gcina amafayela abasebenzi bonke besikhungo. Yenze igciwane lemibalo elandelana nemithetho ye-QMS kanye ne-National Achieve Act. Gcina irekhodi leposi eyamukelwe kwihhovisi elikhulu uze uqinisekise ukuthi yahlukaniswa ngendlela efanele futhi irekhodi ligcinweumphathi ohambisanayo. Phatha ukubhaliswa kwabafundi kanye nenzongakho yokuhlola: Siza ukubhalisa kwabafundi. Gcina amabhokisi nabafundi bayashintsiswa uma kunelungelo futhi amarekhodi abafundi. Skene amadokhumenti abafundi. Faka ulwazi futhi ulinganise ukungahambelani kolwazi abafundi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kulungiswa amaphutha emininingwane. Setha izinkomba ezithile ngokufaka izicelo zohlelo nezikweletu. Hlanganyela nenzongakho yokubhaliswa kwabafundi. Hlanganyela nenzongakho yokuhlola. Zilandele izinqumela zamaphoyisa nomnyango we-Higher Education & Training (DHET) kanye nemithetho yesikhungo. Bonke abagqogiweyo, kuhlanganise ne-SMS, bazokwenza amahlolulu amabili okungena kuqala. Omunye uzoba yisivivinyo sokuqeqeshwa ukunquma ukufaneleka komuntu ohleliwe ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zezobuchwepheshezi ngokuhlobene nesikhundla kanti omunye kumele abe ukuhlolwa kobuqotho (ngokuziphatha okuhle). Hlola imibuzo egqamile ngokomthetho oyisisekelo ngokuhlobene nezenzo zomnyango, futhi ngokuhlobene nabasebenzi nangokuhlobene nesikhathi esingaphelele kwesikole samabanga aphakeme nokusebenza kwamaphoyisa. Yenza isivivinyo sokuhlola ulwazi ngokusekelwe ezinkingeni ezitholakalayo, uma kunesikhathi esithize, futhi uhlole ezinye izinhlobo zezinkinga ezitholakalayo. Uma uzama ukunquma ukuthi ukwazi ukwenza noma yikuphi ukusebenza okuwukuphela kwesikhathi, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyazi ukuthi imiphumela ingathinta kanjani izinkomba zesikhungo ngokuhlobene neziqondiso namaphuzu abantu ngabanye.

xh.title: Mlawuli weKhasi
xh.summary: Indima yomlawuli wekhasi eqinisekisa inkxaso yolawulo, uqeqesho lokubhalisa, ulungiselelweni lwemibiko, nokuhlanganiselela iindibano kwikholej ye-TVET ngaphakathi kweDepartment of Higher Education and Training.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 / Matric / Level 4. I-National Diploma / Degree esifaneekileyo kwi-Office Management and Technology / Public Management okanye ngesiñikiwo esilinganayo. Iminyaka engu-1-2 yamava ahambelanayo kwindawo yolawulo. Ilayisensi yokuqhayisha esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweofisi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo nemithetho yesebe lolawulo kaRhulumende. Ulwazi lwe-PSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawulwa kwe-TVET/ CET Administration. Ukuqonda ummandla we-Higher Education. Ukuqonda ulawulo lwentsi. Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kwebhajethi ye-Cost centre, ukuchithwa kwemali, nolawulo lwokusuka kwangaphakathi kolwabiwo lwezemali. I-Employment Equity Act, i-Public Service Regulations ne-Public Service Act, i-Labour Relations Act nayo nayiphi na enye imithetho echanekileyo. Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ukulawula imali. Ukubhala imibiko. Unxibelelwano nobuntu. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okuhlola. Ukwanga kumxhasi. Ukulawula iiprojekthi. Ukulawula iqela. Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ukulawula abantu. Uqwalaselo kwisebe labaxhasi. Inyaniso. Ukuqatywa. Ukuqhuba phambili nothembeko.
xh.duties: Zuzisa iinkonzo zolawulo lonxibelelwano. Ludwe ilungiselelo lokubhalisa kwikhasi lokuzoba zombini i-NCV nereport 191. Qokelela ulwazi lwesebe uze ulungiselele umbiko wee-A-TEAM nokuLawula iKhasi. Lungiselela imibiko, iintonogezo, nayo nayiphi na enye indlela yokunxibelelana. Hlela iindibano, iinkonferensi, amaworshop, naye naninye na amaqumbe njengoko kufunekayo. Zuzisa elinye ixesha iinkonzo zonxibelelwano ezuncedisa ukulawula ikhasi. Lawula uze uhlanganise iinkonzo zamandla abantu: Hlanganise iifomu zeSick Leave uze zithunyelwe kwiziko eliphakathi. Hlanganise amaxwebhu e-PMDS uze athunyelwe kwiziko eliphakathi. Hlanganisa onke amaxwebhu ahambelanayo abhekisele ecaleni lokusesikweni nezindida. Landela uzisombulule onke amaxwebhu abantu kwikhasi kwaye wazisombulule izinto ezivela kubasebenzi bakwikhasi. Gcina amaxwebhu wolawulo lwabantu. Qwalasela irejista yokubakho kwabasebenzi. Hlanganisa ulungiselelo lwerajista yemisebenzi nentlawulo yabalifundi bemizuzu. Zuzisa iinkonzo zokuqasha: Nikezela ngengcebiso malunga neqondo lokuthenga kumlawuli weKhasi. Bhala imemo yokuthenga. Gqiba ifomu yokufuna izinto. Yamkela iimpahla neenkonzo. Hlanganisa ize zithunyelwe iivenkile kwiziko eliphakathi ukwenzelwa ukugqibelela. Qinisekisa ukuchanekile kokuba yilempahla neenkonzo ezithunyelwe ngokomaxwebhu ahambelanayo. Landela imithetho yokufuna iimpahla kwikhasi. Nceda ukuphunyezwa kwenkqubo yemfundo yabasebenzi bekoleji kwinqanaba lekhasi. Gcina inkqubo yokulondolozwa kwamaxwebhu: Gcina amaxwebhu kawonke umsebenzi kwikhasi. Gcina onke amaxwebhu ahambelanayo ngokweemfuno ze-QMS kunye ne-National Achieve Act. Gcina irekhodi yeposi efumaneka kumntu wonke kwaye uqinisekise ukuba ulwabiwo lwenziwe ngokufanelekileyo kwaye nerejista igcinwa ngumntu ofanelekileyo. Lawula inkqubo yobhaliso lwabafundi nezibhalo: Nceda kubhaliso lwabafundi. Gcina amaxwebhu abafundi namarekhodi abo. Skena amaxwebhu abafundi. Faka ulwazi abafundi kuqwalaselo nokulinganisa. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa kwezinto ezithintelwe ngokwedatha. Qhuba iinkcukacha zokugqibela kumagama abafundi namakredithi abo. Hlanganisa inkqubo yobhaliso. Hlanganisa inkqubo yemviwo. Landela imigaqo-nkqubo nemithetho ye-Department of Higher Education & Training (DHET) neyekholeji. Onke amagqabantshintshi ashiywe ibele kubakho, kuquka nama-SMS, kuya kwenza iingcali ezimbini zokuqalisa ngenkqubo. Enye yaazo kuya kuba luvavo lokuzilolonga ukumiselwa koluvo lokubakho komntu ngokwemfuno ekulandelelayo, eyesibini kumele ibe luvo ngokuchanekileyo kokuziphatha (intlonipho).

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Parliamentary and Cabinet Support
jobs.centre: Head Office: Tshwane and Cape Town (Sessional)
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 - R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), (an all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Provide support services for Parliamentary and Cabinet matters, coordinating multiple workstreams and tracking deadlines at the Department of Home Affairs.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Political Sciences, Public Management and Administration or related field at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA. 3 years’ experience at Junior Management / Assistant Director is required. Understanding of various Portfolio and cabinet Committees. Knowledge of foreign policies. Understanding of Intergovernmental Relations framework. Knowledge of NEPAD, SADC and sanctions and mechanism. knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury regulations. Knowledge of the South African Constitution. Understanding of departmental legislation as well as Human Resources legislation and prescripts. A valid drivers’ license. Regular travel between Pretoria and Cape Town, particularly during Parliamentary sitting. Willingness to travel frequently and work outside normal office hours when operationally required. Ability to communicate with all levels of management. Required skills and competencies: People Management and Empowerment. Service Delivery Innovation. Client Orientation and Customer Focus. Financial Management. Communication. Decision Making. Planning and Organising. Exceptional organisational and coordination skills. Business report writing. Strong written communication and editing skills. Computer literacy (advanced Microsoft Office Suite). Strong administrative and document management skills. Strong analytical skills. Problem-solving and conflict management. Ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet tight deadlines. Strong sense of accountability and ownership. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Attention to detail. Influencing and networking. Presentation skills. Facilitation skills. Negotiation skills. Interpersonal relations. Professionalism, discretion and integrity. Patriotic, Honesty, Integrity and Accountability.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Provide support services to Parliamentary matters, portfolio- selected committees and Cabinet matters. Coordinate multiple concurrent Parliamentary and Cabinet workstreams. Track deadlines across the Department and follow up with branches to ensure timely submissions. Coordinate departmental interaction with Parliamentary Committees in accordance with the Parliamentary programme. Render administrative and technical support to departmental delegations attending Parliamentary briefings and committee meetings. Manage the drafting, quality assurance and submission of departmental responses to Parliamentary questions posed to the Minister of Home Affairs. Facilitate and coordinate departmental responses to Parliamentary and Cabinet enquiries. Coordinate inputs from relevant branches and participate in the drafting and finalisation of Cabinet memoranda for Cabinet consideration. Ensure departmental compliance with all Parliamentary and Cabinet processes, policies and prescribed timeframes. Monitor the implementation of decisions taken by Cabinet, Cabinet Committees and Parliamentary Committees that are relevant to the Department. Maintain accurate tracking systems and records of Parliamentary questions, committee resolutions, Cabinet memoranda and Cabinet Committee minutes. Escalate risks or delays that may impact compliance with Parliamentary or Cabinet deadlines. Drive the implementation of the Batho Pele principles within the unit in all interactions with internal and external stakeholders. Develop and implementation of policy and procedure, directive acts and regulations. Develop and review communications policies and code of practice for the directorate. Implement governance processes, frameworks and procedures. Ensure compliance with all audit requirements, quality and risk management frameworks, standards and procedures. Monitor and ensure compliance with legislation, regulations and DHA policies and procedures. Plan the production of annual reports in line with corporate strategy. Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Unit. Coach and guide staff on best practices and compliance with regulatory requirements.
jobs.enquiries: Head Office: Mr B Mathatho Tel No: (012) 406 4250
jobs.applications: Applications compliant with the “Directions to Applicants” above, must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za or DGrecruitment@dha.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za sent to the correct address specified at the bottom of the posts, on or before the closing date, accompanied by a fully completed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021), obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za, citing the correct post number and job title, and a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date dd/mm/yy), job title, duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of at least two contactable employment references (as recent as possible), regardless of online or manual submission. Where a valid Driver's License and a Professional Driving Permit (PDP) is a requirement, this must be indicated on the CV. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Shortlisted candidates will also be required to submit a copy of their ID document, a valid driver’s license (if specified as a job requirement), relevant educational qualifications / RPL certificates / Academic Transcripts of completed qualifications, and Acting letters as directed. Furthermore, applicants who possess (a) foreign qualification(s), are required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications, as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA); for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity, will be subjected to an interview, various relevant tests and assessments, and employment suitability checks (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, and employment references including verification of exit reasons, and conducting business with State). Once appointed, serving of a prescribed probation period, and obtaining of a security clearance appropriate to the post, will be required. Correspondence between the Department and candidates will be limited to shortlisted candidates, only. The DHA is a merit-based, equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In line with its commitment to promoting representivity, in the filling of entry-level positions preference may be given to locally based candidates on grounds of affordability as well as to (unemployed) youth and the DHA’s interns and learners who have successfully completed their respective skills development programmes. In the filling of all posts, preference may be afforded to persons with disabilities, and in respect of SMS-level posts, to women. Persons falling in these categories and who meet the post requirements are preferred. The DHA complies with the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act No. 4 of 2013). Applicants’ personal information will be used for recruitment purposes, retained where required for audit, and safeguarded against unauthorised disclosure, except where legally required. Submission of an application constitutes consent to such processing. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Parlementêre en Kabinetsondersteuning
af.summary: Verskaf ondersteuningsdienste vir Parlementêre en Kabinetsake, koördineer veelvuldige werksrome en hou sperdatums by die Department of Home Affairs dop.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Politieke Wetenskappe, Openbare Bestuur en Administrasie of 'n verwante veld op NQF vlak 6 soos deur SAQA erken. 3 jaar se ervaring op Junior Management / Assistant Director word vereis. Begrip van diverse Portefeulje- en Kabinetskomitees. Kennis van buitelandse beleid. Begrip van die interregeringsverhoudingsraamwerk. Kennis van NEPAD, SADC en sanksies en meganismes. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Treasury-regulasies. Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Grondwet. Begrip van departementele wetgewing sowel as Wetgewing en voorskifte rakende Menslike Hulpbronne. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.gereelde reis tussen Pretoria en Kaapstad, veral tydens Parlementêre sittings. Bereidwilligheid om gereeld te reis en buite normale kantoorure te werk wanneer operasioneel vereis. Vermoë om met alle vlakke van bestuur te kommunikeer. Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Dienslewering-innovasie. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Finansiële bestuur. Kommunikasie. Besluitneming. Beplanning en organisering. Uitsonderlike organisatoriese en koördinasievaardighede. Sakeverslagdoening. Sterk skriftelike kommunikasie- en redigeervaardighede. Geletterdheid in rekenaars (gevorderde Microsoft Office Suite). Sterk administratiewe en dokumentbestuursvaardighede. Sterk analitiese vaardighede. Probleemoplossing en konflikbestuur. Vermoë om veelvuldige prioriteite te bestuur en konsekwent stywe sperdatums te haal. Sterk sin vir aanspreeklikheid en eienaarskap. Vermoë om onafhanklik met minimale toesig te werk. Aandag aan detail. Beïnvloeding en netwerking. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Professionaliteit, diskresie en integriteit. Patriotisme, eerlikheid, integriteit en aanspreeklikheid.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal onder andere vir die volgende spesifieke take verantwoordelik wees: Verskaf ondersteuningsdienste aan Parlementêre sake, portefeulje-geselekteerde komitees en Kabinetsake. Koördineer veelvuldige gelyktydige Parlementêre en Kabinetswerksrome. Hou sperdatums regdeur die departement dop en volg takke op om tydig indienings te verseker. Koördineer departementele wisselwerking met Parlementêre Komitees in ooreenstemming met die Parlementêre program. Verskaf administratiewe en tegniese ondersteuning aan departementele afvaardigings wat Parlementêre voorligtings en komiteevergaderings bywoon. Bestuur die opstel, gehalteversekering en indiening van departementele response op Parlementêre vrae aan die Minister van Binnelandse Sake. Fasiliteer en koördineer departementele response op Parlementêre en Kabinetsnavrae. Koördineer insette van relevante takke en neem deel aan die opstel en finalisering van Kabinetsmemorandums vir oorweging deur die Kabinet. Verseker departementele nakoming van alle Parlementêre en Kabinetsprosesse, beleide en voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke. Monitor die implementering van besluite geneem deur die Kabinet, Kabinetskomitees en Parlementêre Komitees wat relevant is tot die departement. Onderhou akkurate opsporingstelsels en rekords van Parlementêre vrae, komiteebesluite, Kabinetsmemorandums en notules van Kabinetskomitees. Eskaleer risiko's of vertragings wat nakoming van Parlementêre of Kabinetsperdatums kan beïnvloed. Dryf die implementering van die Batho Pele-beginsels binne die eenheid in alle interaksies met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Ontwikkel en implementeer beleid en prosedure, direktiewe wette en regulasies. Ontwikkel en hersien kommunikasiebeleide en gedragskode vir die direktoraat. Implementeer bestuursprosesse, raamwerke en prosedures. Verseker nakoming van alle ouditvereistes, gehalte- en risikobestuursraamwerke, standaarde en prosedures. Monitor en verseker nakoming van wetgewing, regulasies en DHA-beleide en prosedures. Beplan die produksie van jaarverslae in ooreenstemming met korporatiewe strategie. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne binne die eenheid. Afrig en begelei personeel oor beste praktyke en nakoming van regulatoriese vereistes.

zu.title: Sekela-Mqondisi: Ukusekela iPhalamende neKhabhinethe
zu.summary: Nikela ngesevisi zokusekela izindaba zePhalamende naseKhabhinethe, ukuhlanganisa izindlela eziningi zokusebenza kanye nokulandelela izindlela zesikhathi eDepartment of Home Affairs.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kweziqu ezigatshaneni ze-Political Sciences, Public Management and Administration noma inkambu ephathelene nayo ezingeni le-NQF level 6 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Kudingeka uhlelo lokusebenza iminyaka engu-3 ezingeni le-Jobari Management / Assistant Director. Ukuqonda nge-Portfolio namakomidi eKhabhinethe ahlukene. ulwazi ngemithetho yangaphandle. Ukuqonda ngohlelo lwezikhungo eziphakathi mayelana nohlelo lokusebenza kahle. Ulwazi nge-NEPAD, i-SADC kanye nezinqubo zokuvinjelwa. Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) nezimiso ze-Treasury. Ulwazi ngumthethosisekelo wase-Ningizimu Afrika. Ukuqonda ngemithetho yomnyango kanye nemithetho yezinsiza zabantu nemiyalo. Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayela. Ukuhamba njalo phakathi kwe-Pretoria nase-Cape Town, ikakhuluzi ngesikhathi kuhlala iPhalamende. Ukuzithanda ukuhamba kaningi kanye nokusebenza ngaphandle kwezikhathi ezijwayelekile zofisi lapho kudingeka ngokusebenza. Ikono lokuxhumana namazinga onke omphathi. Amandla okuphatha nokwazi okudingekayo: Ukuphathwa nabantu kanye nokunika amandla. Intuthuko yohlelo lokuletha izinsiza. Ukubhekisela iklayenti nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuxhumana. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ukukwazi ukubumba futhi uhlanganise ngendlela ehlu kakhulu. Ukubhala imibiko yebhizinisi. Amandla amakhulu okubhala nokuhlela. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (advanced Microsoft Office Suite). Amandla amakhulu okwaziswa okuphathwayo nokulawula amadokhumenti. Amandla amakhulu okuhlaziya. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuphatha izinkinga phakathi kwabantu. Ukukwazi ukuphatha izinto ezibalulekile eziningi futhi uhlangabezane nezikhathi ezibekiwe ngaphandle kokuleqa. Ukuqonda okujulile ngokubamba iqhaza nokubheka izinto. Ukukwazi ukusebenza wedwa ngaphandle kokulawulwa kakhulu. Ukuqaphela izinkomba. Ukunika isinkelo nokuxhuma. Amandla okubukhoma. Amandla okukhuthaza. Amandla okuxoxisana. Ukuzinanya nabantu. Ukuba ngumuntu othembekile, ongathathi hlangothi futhi oneqiniso. Ukuzithanda izwe, ukuqamba amanga, ukuqamba amanga kanye nokubheka izinkomba.
zu.duties: Ophumelele uzobizwa ngokuba ayibheke, phakathi kwabanye, okulandelayo: Nikela ngesevisi zokusekela izindaba zePhalamende, amakomidi okukhethwe i-portfolio kanye nezindaba zeKhabhinethe. Hlanganisa izindlela eziningi ezihamba ngesikhathi efanayo zokusebenza zePhalamende naseKhabhinethe. Landela izikhathi zokuvala ekuqhubeni umnyango kanye nokulandela amagatsha ukuqinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwesikhathi esifanele. Hlanganisa ukuxhumana komnyango namakomidi ePhalamende ngokuhambisana nohlaka lwePhalamende. Nikela ngokusekela okuphathwayo kanye nangobuchwepheshe kubabambe iqhaza bomnyango abaya ezinkombweni zePhalamende namakomidi. Phatha ukubhala, ukuqinisekisa ngobungako nokuhambisa izimpendulo zomnyango kuzimbuzo ezezelwa ngu-Ngqongqoshe wezabantu ePhalamende. Kubusise futhi uhlanganise izimpendulo zomnyango kuzimbuzo zePhalamende naseKhabhinethe. Hlanganisa okungenwayo kumagatsha aholayo futhi ubambe iqhaza ekubhaleni nasekuqedeni imibhalo ezezelwa iKhabhinethe ukuze iKhabhinethe ihloliswe. Qinisekisa ukuthi umnyango uyahambisana nazo zonke izinqubo, izinqumo nezikhathi ezibekiwe eziyisimiso zePhalamende naseKhabhinethe. Lilandle ukuphunyiswa kwezinqumo ezithathiwe yiKhabhinethe, namakomidi eKhabhinethe kanye namakomidi ePhalamende ahlobene nomnyango. Gcina izindlela eziqinisekile zokulandela nezinkomba zezimbuzo ePhalamende, izinqumo zamakomidi, imibhalo yeKhabhinethe namaminithi akomidi weKhabhinethe. Phakamisa izingozi noma ukubambezela okungase kuthinte ukuthi umnyango uhlangabezana nezikhathi zokuvala zePhalamende noma iKhabhinethe. Khuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemigomo ka-Batho Pele ngaphakathi kwenhlangano kuzo zonke izinhlangano ezibheke phakathi nangaphandle. Hlela futhi uzeke imigomo nokuqondiswa, iziqondiso nemithetho. Hlela futhi uhlole imigomo yokuxhumana kanye nomthetho wenkambu yokusebenza. Yenza izinqubo zokubusa, amasiko okubusa nezinqubo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nazo zonke izidingo zokuhlola, izindingo zokulinganisa ubungako nokuphathwa kwezingozi. Lilandele futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho, imigomo namagunya omnyango. Hlela ukukhiqizwa kwemibiko yonyaka ngokuhambisana nomgomo webhizinisi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kahle nokuphumelelayo kwemithombo yemali kanye nezinsiza zabantu ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Coche futhi uholele abasebenzi ngokwenzelwa okuhle kuhlangene nokuthobela imigomo.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Inkxaso yePhalamende nesebe looManyano
xh.summary: Kuvelise iinkonzo zonke inkxaso kwimicimbi yePhalamende nesebe looManyano, ukuqubulisa iindlela ezininzi ezizimeleyo zomsebenzi kwaye ulandele iimhla zokuvala kwiSebe leZabahambi bangaphakathi.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezingezantsu kwizifundo zezePolitiki, uLawulo koluntu noBaluleko okwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 njengoko kuthewayo yi-SAQA. Kufuneka ube neminyaka emi-3 yamava kwiQondo elingangqamana / iSekela uMlawuli. Kuqonda iKomiti ezahlukeneyo zePortfolio nesebe looManyano. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yamazwe angaphandle. Kuqonda inkqubo yamaQondo aQuthwayo phakathi koRulumimmo. Ulwazi nge-NEPAD, i-SADC nemiThetho yokuVala kunye neendlela zayo. Ulwazi loMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA) nemimiselo yeTreasury. Ulwazi lweMtetho-siseko waseMzantsi Afrika. Kuqonda imithetho yesebe kanjalo nemitetho yabaSebenzi kunye nemiyalelo. Ileyisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukuhamba rhoqo phakathi kwePretoria naseCape Town, ngakumbi ngelixa iPhalamende lihlala. Kuzipatha ngokulungelelana ukuba uhamba rhoqo kwaye usebenze ngaphandle kweeyure ezisemthethweni zofiso xa kufuneka ngokusebenzayo. Ikelo lokunxibelelana nayo yonke iinqanaba yolawulo. Amaphepha obugcisa namakhono afunekayo: uLawulo lweeNtu kunye namandla okuzenzele. Iingcinga zonikezelo lonke. uLungelelaniso kumXhasi nogcino lokuQwalasela. uLawulo lweMali. uNxibelelwano. uThatho lwamagiginya. uCwangciso lokuHlela. Amakhono apheleleyo wokuhlela noqubulisa. Ukwabhala iingxelo zabashishino. Aakhoni amakhulu obhalo oluqinileyo nokulungisa. uKwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha (iMicrosoft Office Suite ethuthukileyo). Amakhono amakhulu okulawula imibhalo kolwazi. Amakhono anamandla wokuhlola. ukuSombulula iingxaki noLawulo lokuxabana. Ikelo lokulawula iindaba ezininzi ezibalulekileyo kwaye uhlale uwafikelela kwimizuzwana emincinci eyekiweyo. Indifa enamandla yokuziphendulela nayo yonke into. Ikelo lokusebenza yedwa ngaphandle kolawulo oluncinci. Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha. Ukuchukumisa nokwakha ukuxhumana. Amakhono okubonakalisa. Amakhono okuncedisa. Amakhono okuxoxisana. uBudlelwane obu phakathi kwabantu. Ubugcisa bokuziphatha, isigqibo nokwazisa. Uthando lwezwe, uQqhayiso, uKwazisa nokuZiphendulela.
xh.duties: Umama wamava ophumeleleyo uza kuba nenxaxheba phakathi kwabanye, kumsebenzi olandelayo ocacisiweyo: Kubone iinkonzo zonke inkxaso kwimicimbi yePhalamende, iikomiti ezikhethwayo zePortfolio nayo imicimbi yesebe looManyano. Qubulisa iindlela ezininzi ezibambe kangangoko zePhalamende nesebe looManyano ezihamba ngaxa nye. Landela iimhla zokuvala kuwo wonke iSebe kwaye ulandele ngeentliziyo namasebe ukuqinisekisa ukuba izithwalwa ngexesha elichanekileyo. Qubulisa uNxibelelwano lweSebe ngeeKomiti zePhalamende ngokwaneenkqubo yePhalamende. Bonisa inkxaso yolwazi ngokulawula nangokubuchwephesha kumabandla eSebe eya kumaxelwa ePhalamende naseendibakeni zeeKomiti. Lawula ukuqamba, ukuqinisekisa ukwakho nokuTHUMA iimpendulo zesebe kumbuzo wePhalamende ubuzwa kuNgqondohli weSebe leZabahambi bangaphakathi. Qedisa kwaye qubulise iimpendulo zesebe kumbuzo wePhalamende nesebe looManyano. Qubulisa izimvo ezivela kumasebe achaphazelekayo kwaye ube yinxaxheba ekwaziseni nasekugqibeleni kwamagqabi esikhumbuzo sePhalamende esebe lwenza isicwangciso. Qinisekisa ukuzithanda kwesebe ngako yonke iinkqubo, iinkqubo kunye neemvakalelo zexesha ezichaziweyo zePhalamende nesebe looManyano. Qwalasela kwaye qinisekise ukuzithanda ngokwemithetho yomthetho wakho wonke ophuma kuMongameli wesebe looManyano, neeKomiti zesebe looManyano nakomsebenzi ophathelene neSebe. Gcina iinkqubo ezichanekileyo zokulandela kunye namagqabi emibuzo wePhalamende, iinkqubo zokugqiba nezigqibo, amagqabi esikhumbuzo sePhalamende kunye neNqibo yeeKomiti zesebe looManyano. Phakamisa iingozi okanye ukulibaziseka okungalithinta ulawulo ngokwemithetho wePhalamende okanye iimhla zokuvala zesebe looManyano. Khulisa inkqubo yokusebenzisa iimigaqo yeBatho Pele ngaphakathi kwisebe kuyo yonke uNxibelelwano nabantu abangenyo nangaphakathi. Yakhile kwaye ukuQhuba inkqubo namakonzo okusebenza okwesebe nemitetho yokwenza izigqibo. Yakhile kwaye ukuQwalasela iinkqubo zokuNxibelelana nankqubo yokusebenza yesikhululo. Zisebenzise iinkqubo, iinkqubo kunye namagqabi oBulembu. Qinisekisa ukuzithanda ngako yonke iimfuneko zokuqinisekiswa, ukwakho ulawulo lwengozi, izimo kunye nokuqinisekiswa ngokwemithetho. Qwalasela kwaye qinisekise ukuzithanda ngokomthetho, imithetho nakunenkqubo namakonzo e-DHA. Cwangcisa ukukhulisa iingxelo zeminyaka yonke ngokwaneenkqubo yeshishini. jobs.title: Assistant Director: Asset Control

jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Asset Control at the Department of Home Affairs Head Office in Tshwane, requiring an accounting or finance qualification and three years supervisory experience in asset management.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Accounting, Financial Accounting, Financial Management, Cost and Management Accounting, Auditing, at NQF 6 as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) Years’ Supervisory experience in an Asset Management environment is required. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulations Act. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act. Knowledge of the South African Constitution. Understanding of departmental legislation as well as Human Resources legislation and prescripts. Knowledge of the National Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of modified cash system (MCS). Knowledge of BAS, LOGIS and BAUD systems. Knowledge of the Supply Chain Management practices. Knowledge of Asset Management Framework. Knowledge of the Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Required skills and competencies: Capability and leadership. Service delivery innovation. Stakeholder relations and customer focus. People management and empowerment. Programme and project management. Communication. Decision making. Financial Risk Management. Asset Control Management. Expenditure Management and Administration. Budget administration. Business Report Writing. Initiating action. Asset verification. Problem solving and analysis. Presentation Skills. Interpersonal Skills. Communication Skills. Planning and Organising Skills. Computer literacy Skills. Decision Making Skills. Negotiation Skills. Reconciliation Skills. Patriotic, Honesty, Integrity and Accountability.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Facilitate and effective asset management in the Department. Facilitate and develop the asset and acquisition plans and strategies. Facilitate and maintain the asset register integrity. Assist with the monthly reconciliation of BAS, update the current year addition register and ensure completeness and accuracy on the LOGIS, BAS and FA System. Facilitate and implement physical verification of assets in the department. Facilitate and maintain the movement of assets, update the movement, condition, location of moveable assets in the register. Facilitate the investigation of instances of not verified assets lost, stolen or damaged assets and report them to the Loss Control Committee for recovery. Facilitate and maintain recording of write-offs, disposals and asset losses. Maintain disposals of assets including recording of income and related administration. Maintain and update moveable lease register. Facilitate the lease commitment and disclosure note. Facilitate and establish norms, standards and processes for assets in the Department. Assist to generate Return on Investment and other prescribed and delegated reports for National Treasury and Business Owners. Facilitate and maintain effective operations within the fixed asset management unit. Ensure the implementation of effective risk and compliance management. Implementation of policies, procedures, directives, acts and regulations. Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Unit. Coach and guide staff on best practices and compliance with regulatory requirements.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Batebeheer
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Batebeheer by die Department of Home Affairs Hoofkantoor in Tshwane, wat 'n rekeningkunde- of finansieskwalifikasie en drie jaar se toesigervaring in batebestuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Accounting, Financial Accounting, Financial Management, Cost and Management Accounting, Auditing, op NQF 6 soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar se toesigervaring in 'n batebestuursomgewing word vereis. Kennis van die Public Service Regulations Act. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Grondwet. Begrip van departementele wetgewing asook Menslike Hulpbronne-wetgewing en voorskrifte. Kennis van die National Treasury Regulations. Kennis van die aangepaste kontantstelsel (MCS). Kennis van BAS, LOGIS en BAUD-stelsels. Kennis van die Supply Chain Management-praktyke. Kennis van die Asset Management Framework. Kennis van die Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Vermoë en leierskap. Dienslewering-inovasie. Belanghebbende-verhoudinge en klienfokus. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Program- en projekbestuur. Kommunikasie. Besluitneming. Finansiële Risikobestuur. Batebeheerbestuur. Uitgawebestuur en -administrasie. Begrotingsadministrasie. Besigheidsverslagdoening. Aksie inisieer. Bateverifikasie. Probleemoplossing en -analise. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Beplannings- en organiseervaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Besluitnemingsvaardighede. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Versoeningsvaardighede. Patriotisme, eerlikheid, integriteit en aanspreeklikheid.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir, onder andere, die volgende spesifieke take: Fasiliteer effektiewe batebestuur in die departement. Fasiliteer en ontwikkel die bate- en verkrygingsplanne en -strategieë. Fasiliteer en handhaaf die integriteit van die bateregister. Bystand verleen met die maandelikse versoenings van BAS, werk die bykomingsregister vir die lopende jaar by en verseker volledigheid en akkuraatheid op die LOGIS, BAS en FA-stelsel. Fasiliteer en implementeer fisiese verifikasie van bates in die departement. Fasiliteer en handhaaf die beweging van bates, werk die beweging, toestand en ligging van roerende bates in die register by. Fasiliteer die ondersoek van gevalle van ongeverifieerde bates, verlore, gesteelde of beskadigde bates en rapporteer dit aan die Loss Control Committee vir terugwinning. Fasiliteer en handhaaf die optekening van afskrywings, beskikings en bateverliese. Handhaaf beskikings van bates insluitend optekening van inkomste en verwante administrasie. Handhaaf en werk die roerende huurregister by. Fasiliteer die huurverbintenis en openbaarmakingsnotas. Fasiliteer en stel norme, standaarde en prosesse vir bates in die departement vas. Bystand verleen om Return on Investment en ander voorgeskrewe en gedelegeerde verslae vir National Treasury en Business Owners te genereer. Fasiliteer en handhaaf effektiewe bedrywighede binne die vastebatebestuursseenheid. Verseker die implementering van effektiewe risiko- en nakomingsbestuur. Implementering van beleide, prosedures, direktiewe, wette en regulasies. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne binne die Eenheid. Stoot en begelei personeel oor beste praktyke en nakoming van regulatoriese vereistes.

zu.title: Osizo Lomqondisi: Ukulawula Izimpahla
zu.summary: Osizo Lomqondisi: Ukulawula Izimpahla eHHhovu Eliyinhloko le-Department of Home Affairs eTshwane, lidinga iziqu zezibalo noma ezemali kanye namaphunga amathathu okuba ngumphathi wokuhlolwa okuhambisana nokulawula izimpahla.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kweziqu ezingaphakeme e-Accounting, Financial Accounting, Financial Management, Cost and Management Accounting, Auditing, ezingeni le-NQF 6 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Kudingeka abe namaphunga amathathu (3) okuba ngumphathi wokuhlolwa emkhakheni we-Asset Management. Ukwazi ngomthetho we-Public Service Regulations Act. Ukwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act. Ukwazi uMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuqonda umthetho womnyango kanye nomthetho kanye nemiyalo ye-Human Resources. Ukwazi ngemiyalo ye-National Treasury Regulations. Ukwazi ngosimishi wegazi olushintshiwe (MCS). Ukwazi izimishi ze-BAS, LOGIS ne-BAUD. Ukwazi izindlela ze-Supply Chain Management. Ukwazi i-Asset Management Framework. Ukwazi i-Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ikakhono nokubusa. Into enkulu kule ukuletha izinto ezintsha ekulethweni kwenkonzo. Ukuxhumana nabahlotshanayo kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokunikela amandla. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ukuxhumana. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kengozi yezimali. Ukuphathwa kokulawula izimpahla. Ukuphathwa kwezimali eziyakhiswa kanye nokuphathwa. Ukuphathwa kwebhajeti. Ukubhala imibiko yebhizinisi. Ukuqala ukwenza okuthile. Ukuhlolwa kwezimpahla. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlola. Amakhono okubamba imihlangano. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuqamba. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Amakhono okuhlanganisa. Uthanda izwe, uqinisile, unokuthembeka uphendule ngemisebenzi yakhe.
zu.duties: Umkhethwa ophumelelayo uzobekwa ngemibuzo phakathi kwabanye ukwenziwa kwale misebenzi ethize: Ukukhuthaza nokuphatha izimpahla ngempumelelo kumnyango. Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zezimpahla nokuqoqa kanye namasu. Ukukhuthaza ukugcina ukuzinza kwesibhalo sezimpahla. Ukusiza ekwenzeni isibhekisoNyanga zenyanga se-BAS, ukubhalisa kwekhwalepha yonyaka wamanje kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuphela nokulunga kwe-LOGIS, BAS ne-FA System. Ukukhuthaza nokwenza ukuhlolwa okuyisibhaxu sezimpahla kumnyango. Ukukhuthaza ukulondolozwa kohambo lwezimpahla, ukubhalisa uhambo, isimo, nedolobha lezimpahla eziyahambehwa kusibhalo. Ukukhuthaza uphenyo lwezimpahla ezingaqinisekiswa, ezilahlekile, ezebiwe noma ezonakaliswe baze zibikwe kwi-Loss Control Committee ukuzosetshenziswa. Ukukhuthaza ukubhaliswa kokubhaliswa okhishiwe kwezimpahla ezibhaliswa ngaphandle, ezikhishiwe nezimpahla ezilahlekile. Ukulondoloza ukukhishwa kweczimpahla okubandakanya ukubhaliswa kwengeniso kanye nolawulo ohlotshaneni. Ukulondoloza futhi ukubhalisa izimpahla eziyikhweza ezihambahambayo. Ukukhuthaza ukuzibophezela ekuletheni izinkontileka kanye nokuvezwa kwemininingwane. Ukukhuthaza ukumisa imigomo, izinga nokuqedela izimpahla kumnyango. Ukusiza ukubalula i-Return on Investment kanye namanye emibiko ebekiwe nedayelwe ye-National Treasury nabonini bebhizinisi. Ukukhuthaza ukulondolozwa kokusebenza okuhluziwe emkhakheni we-fixed asset management unit. Ukwenza isinqumo sokusetshenziswa komthetho ophathwa nokuqondiswa kwengozi. Ukusebenzisa imigomo, izindlela, imiyalo, izinto ezimayelana kanye nomthetho. Ukwenza ukuphathwa okuhle nokusebenza kahle kabantu, izinto ezingatanguki nezimali emkhakheni. Ukuqeqesha futhi uhole abasebenzi ngendlela ezinhle zokwenza kanye nokuqondisa ukusingathwa komthetho.

xh.title: Ulathiso: UkuLawula iNkqubo yeNkonzo
xh.summary: Onozimele: Ulawulo lweZinto kwisiKulu esiNgunam seNgangamswelo ngoTshwane, eNdyala neNqanaba loMvuzo. Oku funekayo kukuba ugqibe isidanga esiNtubisa imali kwisikolo nesidanga esikhulu sokulawula. Inyanga ezintathu (3) zokuba ngumLawuli kwiziko elenza umSebenzi wezinto. Inqanaba ne-32 njengoko ithathwa ngesiBakalo sokuGqibeleleyo sesiGqibo ukulawula izinto nakwisihlobo esisebenzela kwindawo ekuyo iNkonzo kwiNgangamswelo eNyakatho.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo kwiziNkqubo ze-Accounting, Financial Accounting, Financial Management, Cost and Management Accounting, Auditing, kwi-NQF level 6 njengoko zivunywe ngumazwe we-SAQA. Kufuneka kukho iNyanga ezintathu (3) zamanqanaba okuLawula ngomVersebenzi oza kwenziwa kwindawo yokulawula amadlamatsha. Inolwazi ngomthetho wezibhalo ezisebenzayo zeSebenziso. Inolwazi ngomthetho woLawulo iimali zeMali. Inolwazi iQumrhu loMthethosiseko eNingi eMzantsi Afrika. Ukuqonda ngokumthetho weSebe kwaye nokumthetho neziphethu zokuLawula abantu baseZiko. Inolwazi ngemithetho yezigqibo eNtlaka yeNzuzo. Inolwazi kolunyazi I-ScoA. I-Nkqubo ngokwazi iindlela ezixhapoliswayo kunye nokuMisela iinkqubo. Ulwazi yoluqwalaselo olutye kweNkonzo. Isipho ngokuLawula iinkqubo ezikwindima ezikhusela abantu baseSebe. Ulwazi ngamagunya neNqanaba. Inzuzo. Ukunxibelelana namaBantu baseMncintiswano. Ukubeka abantu ngokusetyenziswa kweMali. Ukubonelela ngokuBhalwa ngokochuku nokulinga. Ukuthetha, Unxibelelwano, Ulwazi ngokuBhalwa kubakho njalo ngokusetyenziswa kwenqanaba eliphezulu ngomculo. Ubungcali bokulawula iinkqubo zokusebenzela kwimizimba. Ukuba nolwazi ngokuLawula kwimizimba. Ulwazi oluphezulu ngokuThatha izigqibo ngokupheleleyo. Ukuyalela iNkqubo. Isipho ngokuNika iNkqubo.
xh.duties: Umsebenzi ophumeleleyo uya kuba nezibopho eziphela kokuqhuba imisebenzi elandelayo: Ukubonelela ukulawulwa okusebenzayo kwezinto kwisebe. Ukubonelela ekuphuhliseni iindlela namacebo okuqokelela nokuza nezinto. Ukubonelela ekugadeni ukuzinza kobuko bokubhaliswa kwezinto. Ukuncedisa ekuvumelaniseni nyanga ngamnyanga kwe-BAS, ukuhlaziya ubuko bokongeza kwangalesnyanga yangoku kuqinisekisa ukuzinza nokuchaneka kwamagama aku-LLOGIS, BAS kunye ne-Fa System. Ukubonelela ekusebenziseni ukugquba ngokwenyani izinto kwisebe. Ukubonelela ekugadeni ukushukuma kwezinto, ukuhlaziya ukushukuma, imeko, indawoyezinto ezinokususwa kubuko. Ukubonelela ekuphandeni ngenxa yezinto ezingaqinisekiswanga, ezilahlekileyo, ezibutywe okanye ezonakalisiweyo kuziduliswe e-Qela loLawulo Lokulahleka ukuba zifunyanwe. Ukubonelela ekugadeni ukuqamba okubhaliweyo, ukulahla nokulahleka kwezinto. Ukugcina ukulahwa kwezinto kuquka nokubhala inzuzo kwayo nolawulo oluhambelanayo. Ukugcina ukuhlaziya ubuko bokuqasha izinto ezinokususwa. Ukubonelela kumnxeba wokuqasha nokuziveza ngenqanaba elifunekayo. Ukubonelela ekusekeleni imilinganiselo, izindinganiso namagqibo nezinto kwisebe. Ukuncedisa ekwenzeni iNzuzo ngaphezulu kweMbeko kwaye namabango apheleleyo abekiweyo eZizwe eeNtlaka yeNzuzo nabaNiniabaMboni. Ukubonelela kugcino olusebenzayo kwindawo yolawulo lwezinto. Ukubonelela ekuyaleleni iindlela ezisebenzayo ezilawulwa kwiziCwangciso ezingathathiwa. Ukusebenzisa iindlela ekugcineni imisebenzi ngokutsha kwakunye nokuqwalasela ukulawula ukungena ekuphumelelweni. Ukubonelela kumziiso welawulo, aqakathe kakhulu kubuLungisa bokuSebenza nokuLawulwa kwemisebenzi kulo. Ukuqeqesha ukubonakalisa iindlela ezinokwenzeka kwaye azisebenzisi ngokomthetho kwindawo yolawulo.

Los tegniese of praktiese probleme van werknemers op en eskaleer komplekse sake na die toesighouer. Monitor die werksverrigting van die SLA tussen die voor kantoor en die eenheid en neem korrigerende stappe waar nodig. Implementeer doeltreffende operasionele beheermaatreëls om korrupsie en ander nie-finansiële verliese te voorkom. Skakel met Government Printing Works en ander belanghebbendes om gehalte en tydige dienslewering te verseker. Fasiliteer die tydige en nakoming-volgende indiening en/of wegdoening van onafgelewerde of onvolledige identiteitsdokumente. Verseker die voortdurende in- en uitbestuur van rekords in die eenheid. Hou toesig oor en implementeer ondersoek- en rekordsprosesse en -prosedures. Onderhou goeie verhoudinge met kliënte en belanghebbendes. Implementeer doeltreffende risiko- en nakoming in ooreenstemming met die tersaaklike praktyke. Verseker doeltreffende en doelmatige bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne binne die eenheid. Afrig en begelei personeel oor beste praktyke en nakoming van regulatoriese vereistes.

zu.title: Ochwepheshe Ophan Ngamabhalamathupha Ophakeme: Ukuphenya Namarekhodi
zu.summary: Qapha futhi umenze ukutholakala kokuphenya namarekhodi abathengi eNdiya Yunithi Yamahhovisi Elikhulu le Department of Home Affairs e Tshwane.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingenisa emkhakheni we Public Management, Administration, Operations Management kwelosi 6 le NQF njengoba setshunywe yi SAQA. Kudingeka 2 unyaka weminyaka yokuhlolwa kolwazi emkhakheni wokuba ngumphathi nodlalo emkhakheni we Civic Services / Customer Service kanye nendawo ephathekayo yokuphenya nokubhala kwamarekhodi. Ukuqala kolwazi lokubeka izinqavane. Ulwazi ngokuqashwa nokuyisekelo komthetho wendima ye (Civic Services). Ulwazi ukuqonda ukuthi yini ebalulekile yokuphila nokulandisa izindaba kanye nomthetho wokubuyela emuva noma ukugcina kwamabhalo esekethekayo. Ulwazi lokuqonda okutholwa phakathi kwezinkomba zokuxhumana. Ulwazi olubalulekile ngohlelo lokuhlolwa kobuntu bomuntu. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba futhi usebenze esikhathini eside. Izindidi ezifanele zokwenza umsebenzi: Ukuletha inkonzo. Ukuzethemba nokuzinza. Ukugcina futhi ugxile kulawula abantu abaningi. Izenzo ezinhle kumthetho. Ukuxazulula ukungahambisani. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala izincazelo. Ukubona imibala nokuzwa. Ukukwazi ukuqonda nokulandelwa imiyalo yezithombe. Amandla okuphatha kakhulu izinto futhi nokuhamba isikhathi eside. Ukukwazi ukucabanga futhi uphendule ngokushesha. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono abalulekile okulungisa izithombe. Amakhono okukhuluma. Amakhono okucubungula. Amakhono okuhlukanisa futhi uqaphele. Ukukwazi ukuziphendulela, Ukuzethemba, Ukuzinza kanye Nokuziphendulela.
zu.duties: Umuntu okhethiwe uzoba nesibopho sokwenza, phakathi kwabanye, le misebenzi elandelayo: Qapha futhi uphendule ngokulandelwa kwesinqumo sokuphenya namarekhodi abathengi emkhakheni. Qinisekisa futhi uphendule ngokuphenya nokusebenza ngamarekhodi ngokulandela izinqumo ezifanele namagunya emkhakheni. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinqumo ezitholakala eholo lelinye zilungele ukusetshenziswa. Qinisekisa ukuphenya nokubhalwa kwesinqumo ngokuba nesidingo ngasinye. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwe khwalithi ngokuthi isinqumo sithathwe kanjani. Xazulula izinkinga ezinzima noma ezisebenzayo ezivela kubasebenzi bese uzinikeze Umphathi ezingenza zinze. Qapha ukusebenza kwe SLA phakathi kweholo lelinye nendawo bese uthatha isinyathelo lapho kudingeka khona. Phendula ngokusebenza okuhle kokuhlela ukuze kwingaganeki ukungalungi kanye nezinye izinto ezingalahlekelwa imali. Xhumana ne-Government Printing Works kanye nabanye abantu abavela emaphandle ukuze kuhlale kunekhwalithi bese inkonzo ihamba kahle. Phendula ngokuthi izinqubo ezingathunyelwa noma ezingagqitywa zamapasi zihlolwe noma zisuswe ngokushesha nangendlela efanele. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinto ezingenayo naseziphuma emkhakheni. Qapha futhi uphendule ngokusebenza kokuphenya nokubhalwa kwamarekhodi. Zigcine ezinhle futhi zibe nokuxhumana okuhle nabathengi kanye nalabo abavela emaphandle. Phendula ukungalungi nokungabi nabantu abangaphumeleli emkhakheni ngokuya emthethweni. Qinisekisa ukulawula okuhle kwezabantu, izinto eziphathekayo nezimali ngokuphelele emkhakheni. Fundisa futhi uhola abasebenzi ukuba basebenze ngendlela efanele bese belandela imithetho.

xh.title: Umvuzo ophezulu weZandla ezibamba izikhundo: Uphenyo neZigcino
xh.summary: Ukulawula nokusebenzisa inkqubo yokwenza uphando negcinwe iirekhodi zabathengi eNtlanganisweni yoRhulumente wezoba ngaphakathi iTshwane.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-undergraduate kwiPublic Management, Administration, Operations Management kwinqanaba leNQF 6 njengoko sivunywe ngumZwi kaSAQA. Kufuneka ube neminyaka emi-2 yamava kwinqanaba lomlawuli ube namava kwindawo yeCivic Services / Customer Service nasekuweni iindawo ezisisiseko zophando negcinwa iirekhodi. Kuqikelelwe ulwazi olusisiseko lwezeMigaqo yoLawa loRhulumente. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weSebe neziMigaqo (Civic Services). Ulwazi neqondo lwenkqubo yokuvavanya. Ulwazi olusisiseko lweNkqubo yoLawulo lweZamantu. Ukulungele ukuhamba nokusebenza iiyure evezayo. Amakhono namava afunwayo: Ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Umbekiso kumthengi nakwindalo yamathengi. Inyanisekiso nokuzinikela. Ubudlelwane nabathengi. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokwahlulahlula. UkuBhala ngokubonelelayo. Imbonakalo ngombala nokuva. Isakhono esisisiseko sokuyiqonda nokulandela i-camera scripts. Amandla omzimba wokuphatha izixhobo ezinzima uthathe isimo. Isakhono sokuqonda nokuqhatha ngokukhawuleza. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono obugcisa obusisiseko sokuhlela imifanekiso. Amakhono okunxibelelana. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlela. Amakhono okwahlulahlula. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki. Uthando lwelizwe, Inyanisekiso, Ukuzinikela nokuBhekisa.
xh.duties: Umsebenzisi opumeleleyo uya kuba nenxaxheba kwaye enemisebenzi elandelayo phakathi kweminye: Ukulawula nokusebenzisa inkqubo yokwenza uphando negcinwe iirekhodi zabathengi kwilungelo. Ukuqinisekisa nokusebenzisa uphando negcinwe iirekhodi ngokulandela iinkqubo nezithetho ezichanekileyo kwilungelo. Ukuqinisekisa nokulungisa onke amafayile afunyenwe kwiofisi engaphambili. Ukuqinisekisa uphando negcinwe iirekhodi yesicelo ngokweemfuno. Ukuqinisekisa ukungena kolwazi olubalulekileyo ngokumayelana nesicelo. Ukusombulula iingxaki ezize ngobuchwephesha okanye ngokomzobo eziphuma kubasebenzi baze athumele izinto ezinzima kumLawuli. Ukuqapha inkqubo yokusebenza kweSLA phakathi kweOfisi eNgaphambili nelayela elisebenzayo uthathe izigqibo zokulungisa apho kufuneka khona. Ukusebenzisa izixhobo zolawulo olusebenzayo lokuthintela inkohlakalo naphelinye iingcuthe ezingezo zezemali. Ukunxibelelana noManyano lokuShicilela kaRhulumente nabanomdla abanye ukuze kuqinisekiswe uhlobo oluphezulu nokuhanjiswa kwemisebenzi ngexesha elichanekileyo. Ukwenza ulwazi lokugcina okanye ukuphelisa iFaxa eziHanjiweyo ezingazange zihanjiswe okanye ezingagqibiwanga ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangendlela echanekileyo. Ukuqinisekiswa kokulawulwa ngokuqhubekayo kweerekhodi ezingenayo nasezikhuphayo kwisebe. Ukulawula nokusebenzisa iinkqubo nezithetho zophando nokugcina iirekhodi. Ukugcina ubudlelwane obuhle nabathengi nabanomdla. Ukusebenzisa ingozi nokuqinisekiswa okusebenzayo ngokwemigaqo engathintelayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kolawulo olusebenzayo nolusebenzayo kwezabantu, izixhobo eziyimfuneko nezemali ngaphakathi kuleSebe. Ukufundisa nokukhokela abasebenzi kwindlela ezilungileyo zokusebenza nokuzinikela ngokwemigaqo efunwayo.

jobs.title: State Accoutant
jobs.summary: State Accountant needed at the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services in Centurion to process creditor payments and manage financial accounts at Level 7.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 / Senior certificate and National Diploma (NQF 6) in Accounting / Financial Management or relevant qualification within the related field. Minimum of 1 – 3 years’ experience in Financial Environment Management or related field. Knowledge of financial management, accounting, and business practices. Knowledge of BAS/LOGIS/PERSAL. Computer literate (Ms Word, Excel and Outlook). Ability to communicate verbally and in writing. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Ability to multi-task and general administration capabilities.

Prepare and submit paid batches for filing. Respond to queries from Service Providers. Prepare month creditor’s accounts. Follow up on creditor queries arising from creditors reconciliation. Process payment of salary related transactions. Prepare and submit monthly expenditure reports. Maintain payment register to track all forms of payments. Prepare of the In year monitoring report. Preparation of the expenditure report documentation as per responsibility codes of the programmes and expenditure patterns monitoring. Identify misallocations of funds. Preparation of Budget process(MTEF/AENE/ENE). Cashflow Management.

Minimum van 1 – 3 jaar se ondervinding in Finansiële Omgewingsbestuur of 'n verwante veld. Kennis van finansiële bestuur, rekenkunde en besigheidspraktyke. Kennis van BAS/LOGIS/PERSAL. Berei maandelikse krediteurrekeninge voor. Volg krediteurnavrae na wat voortspruit uit krediteurvereffening. Verwerk betaling van salarisverwante transaksies. Ukuze kube okungenani isipiliyoni seminyaka engu 1 kuya kwayo eyingu 3 kwendawo yokuLawula Imali noma endaweni efanaleyo. Ulwazi ngokulawula imali, isibali, nezindlela zomsebenzi. Ulwazi ngeBAS/LOGIS/PERSAL. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenza ngokwekhompyutha (Ms Word, Excel kanye neOutlook). Ukuba nesikhathi sokuxoxa ngomlomo kanye nokubhala. Ukuba nesikhathi sokuzenza nobunye ukusebenza njengesiqale. izesikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi owodwa phakathi kuka-1 no-3 kuleso sikhathi kanye nendawo ehlotshanayo. Ulwazi lokulawula imali. Ulwazi lwe-BAS/LOGIS/PERSAL. Ulwazi lweekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Outlook).
zu.duties: Abamuva abaphumeleleyo bazobe benesibopho sokulawula ukucutshungulwa kwezinkokhelo zabatshali ezingu 30 izinsuku. Hlola ukuthi ayiphi na iphutha itholakala emafakeni okuthengisa kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuziphathe kwemibhalo esekelayo. Lungiselela futhi uhambise iziqa ezikhihazwe ukuzobe zibekwa esigqamini. Tuphu iNdlela Yokuqasha Ibhange.

Kufuneka babe neminye yamava eminye engama-1 - 3 kwimini yemizobo yezemali okanye elunxwemeni oluhambelana nalo. Ulwazi ngokulawula iimali, isibongozo nemisebenzi yeshishini. Lungiselela i-akhawunti zabatyali-mali zamanye. Landela imibuzo yabatyali-mali evela kumdaniso wemibuzo yabatyali-mali. Hlela iintlawulo ezihlobene nomvuzo.
