jobs.title: Deputy Surveyor-general
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS).
jobs.summary: Deputy Surveyor-General position in Pretoria overseeing registry services and cadastral document examination for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and an undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) as recognised by South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), specifically a four-year B or BSc Degree in Geomatics / Land Surveying or related equivalent qualifications and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council. Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5(2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle/senior managerial level in a land surveying environment. Appropriate post registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Cadastral Survey knowledge. Technical System knowledge. Cadastral Spatial Information knowledge. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with misconduct. Internal control and risk management. Project management principles and tools. The political landscape of South Africa. Job related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business ability. Communication (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Manage the provisioning of registry services. Oversee the receipt and dispatch of cadastral documents submitted for examination and approval. Ensure that the necessary fees of office have been paid prior to the acceptance of cadastral documents into the system. Oversee the provision of registry enquiry services. Oversee the maintenance of the cadastral correspondence filing system. Oversee the rendering of registry delivery and collection services. Manage the rendering of first level examination services. Oversee the allocation of land parcel numbers. Ensure technical compliance of all cadastral documents prepared and submitted by Professional Land Surveyors. Ensure proper application of all relevant land administration legislation, policies and procedures. Communicate all relevant new management decisions, policies and information to staff. Manage the rendering of second level examination services. Oversee the examination and approval/rejection of all cadastral documents prepared and submitted by Professional Land Surveyors. Report on directorate progress as required. Ensure proper application of all relevant land administration legislation, policies and procedures. Communicate all relevant new management decisions, policies and information to staff. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors. Oversee and render cadastral advisory and research services to all spheres of government, as well as the public. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors, government officials and organs of state. Provide feedback on proposed cadastral documents to any competent authority empowered to grant or approve a right to the use of land for a specified purpose. Assist with the interpretation and legal implications for existing and proposed cadastral documents, which have been or are to be registered in a Deeds Registry. Provide responses to litigation documentation, including reports to court, relating to existing or proposed cadastral documents. Liaise with the Registrar of Deeds and officials from the Deeds Registry to ensure cadastral documents approved in the office of the Surveyor-General are registerable and ensure harmonious application of the cadastral system. Liaise with voluntary geomatics organisations and professional bodies in the built environment sector. Respond to any Presidential, Ministerial, Provincial hotline request or Director-General task relating to the competencies and area of jurisdiction of the office in which the official serves. Liaise with members of the public on behalf of the Surveyor-General on complex or unusual land parcel boundary or property legislation-related matters. Support the training and development of officials in the cadastral system environment.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Kekana Tel No: (012) 312 8344
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 524 Stanza Bopape and Steve Biko Street, Suncardia Building, 6th Floor, Arcadia, 0002 or by email to Post185@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males and African, Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunk-Opmetingsgeneraal
af.summary: Adjunk-Opmetingsgeneraal-pos in Pretoria wat toezig hou op registrasiedienste en die ondersoek van kadastrale dokumente vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 7) soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), spesifiek 'n vierjaar B- of BSc-graad in Geomatika / Landmeting of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies, asook 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Voor-toelatingsertifikaat tot die SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien moet word. Geregistreer as 'n Professionele Landmeter by die South African Geomatics Council. Geregistreer as 'n Deeltitelpraktisyn ingevolge Artikel 5(2) van die Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum van 5 jaar ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n landmetingsomgewing. Toepaslike na-registrasie-ervaring in kadastrale meting. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van kadastrale meting. Kennis van tegniese stelsels. Kennis van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting. Kennis van Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems en Geographical Information Management. Kennis van tegnologiese vooruitgang wat nuttig is vir die kadastrale metingstelsel. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Regeringstelsels en -strukture. Regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse. Programopstelproses. Begrip van die bestuursinligting- en formele verslagdoeningstelsel. Hantering van wangedrag. Interne beheer en risikobestuur. Projekbestuursbeginsels en -nutsprogramme. Die politieke landskap van Suid-Afrika. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projekbestuur. Spanbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Rekenvaardigheid. Hulpbronbeplanning. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Tydbestuur. Besigheidsvermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik).
af.duties: Bestuur die voorsiening van registrasiedienste. Hou toezig op die ontvangs en versending van kadastrale dokumente wat vir ondersoek en goedkeuring ingedien word. Verseker dat die nodige kantoorgelde betaal is voor die aanvaarding van kadastrale dokumente in die stelsel. Hou toezig op die voorsiening van registrasienavraagdienste. Hou toezig op die onderhoud van die kadastrale korrespondensielêerstelsel. Hou toezig op die lewer van registrasie-aflewerings- en invoordienste. Bestuur die lewer van eerstevlak-ondersoekdienste. Hou toezig op die toekenning van landperseele nommers. Verseker tegniese nakoming van alle kadastrale dokumente wat deur Professionele Landmeters opgestel en ingedien word. Verseker die behoorlike toepassing van alle relevante grondbestuurswetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Kommunikeer alle relevante nuwe bestuursbesluite, beleide en inligting aan personeel. Bestuur die lewer van tweedevlak-ondersoekdienste. Hou toezig op die ondersoek en goedkeuring/verwerping van alle kadastrale dokumente wat deur Professionele Landmeters opgestel en ingedien word. Rapporteer oor direktoraatvordering soos vereis. Verseker die behoorlike toepassing van alle relevante grondbestuurswetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Kommunikeer alle relevante nuwe bestuursbesluite, beleide en inligting aan personeel. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeters. Hou toezig op en lewer kadastrale advies- en navorsingsdienste aan alle sfere van regering, asook aan die publiek. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeters, regeringsamptenare en staatsorgane. Verskaf terugvoer oor voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente aan enige bevoegde gesig wat bemagtig is om 'n reg tot die gebruik van grond vir 'n spesifieke doel te verleen of goed te keur. Bystand verleen met die interpretasie en regsertige implikasies van bestaande en voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente wat in 'n Akteregister geregistreer is of moet word. Verskaf antwoorde op litigasiedokumentasie, insluitend verslae aan die hof, rakende bestaande of voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente. Skakel met die Registrar of Deeds en amptenare van die Akteregister om te verseker dat kadastrale dokumente wat in die kantoor van die Opmetingsgeneraal goedgekeur is, registreerbaar is, en verseker die harmonieuse toepassing van die kadastrale stelsel. Skakel met vrywillige geomatics-organisasies en professionele liggame in die geboude-omgewingsektor. Reageer op enige Presidentiële, Ministeriële, Provinsiale hotlynversoeke of Director-General-take rakende die bevoegdhede en jurisdiksiegebied van die kantoor waarin die amptenaar diens doen. Skakel namens die Opmetingsgeneraal met lede van die publiek oor komplekse of ongewone landperseeelgrens- of eiendomswetgewingverwante aangeleenthede. Ondersteun die opleiding en ontwikkeling van amptenare in die kadastrale stelselomgewing.

zu.title: UMelesipho kaNoMlingani-omkhulu wokuqamba izindawo
zu.summary: Isikhundla samelesipho kaNoMlingani-omkhulu wokuqamba izindawo ePretoria esibhekele phansi izinsizakalo zokubhalisa nokuhlola imibhalo yezindawo zomhlaba kuMnyango wezokulungiswa kwomhlaba nentuthuko yasekhaya.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafakiswa kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 nangaphezulu kakhulu isiqu se-undergraduate (NQF Level 7) esamukelekwa kuSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ngokukhethekayo i-Degree yeminyaka emine ye-B noma i-BSc kwi-Geomatics / Land Surveying noma iziqu ezingaphambene ezihlobene nakho kanye nesitifiketi se-Nyukela (isitifiketi sangaphambi kokuqaliswa kwi-SMS) esinikwa ngaphambi kokuqashwa. Bhaliswe njengoMlingani wezokulinganisa umhlaba ochwepheshe kuSouth African Geomatics Council. Bhaliswe njengoMbonisi wezibalo zezindawo ngokwesigaba 5(2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Ukwaziswa okungenani kweminyaka eyi-5 endlebeni yabaphathi abaphakathi/baphezulu emkhakheni wokulinganisa umhlaba. Ukwaziswa okuhambisana nokubhaliswa emumva kokwenza umsebenzi wokulinganisa izindawo zomhlaba. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ethande. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokulinganisa izindawo zomhlaba. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lwebhalo lendawo. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zelwazi lemhlaba, izinhlelo zolawulo lwemhlaba kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwelwazi lezwe. Ulwazi ngentuthuko kubuchwepheshe esinceda isinhlelo sokulinganisa izindawo zomhlaba. Ukulawula nokubheka imikgobampilo yomsebenzi. Izinhlelo nezakhiwo kahulumeni. Inqubo yokuthatha izinqumo kahulumeni. Inqubo yokulungiselela uhlelo. Ukuqonda ukugcina ulwazi nemibalo yokubika. Ukuphathwa kweziphambeko. Ukulawula imphi yengaphakathi kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsongo. Izimiso nezinsizakulo zokuphatha imiklamo. Indawo yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwemiklamo. Ukuphathwa kwebhunga. Izinhlobonhlobo zokuxhumana. Ukubikezela ibhajethi. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuhlela izinsiza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi. Ikhono lezoshishino. Ukuxhumana (ngokukhuluma nokubhala).
zu.duties: Phatha izinsizakalo zokubhalisa. Bhekelela ukwamukelwa nokuthumela imibhalo yezindawo ethunyelwe ukuze ihlolwe ivunyelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimali ezidingekayo zisikhungo zikhokhelwe ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwemibhalo yezindawo kusinhlelo. Bhekelela ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokubuza mayelana nokubhalisa. Bhekelela ukugcinwa kwenqubo yokulondoloza imibhalo yezindawo. Bhekelela ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokulethwa nokuthunyelwa kokubhalisa. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlola ezingeni lokuqala. Bhekelela ukwabiwa kwamanani amaphasela omhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuzinzelela kobuchwepheshe kuzo yonke imibhalo yezindawo elungiswe bese ithunyelwa abalinganisi bomhlaba abachwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhambisana kwawo wonke umthetho, amapholisi namanyathelo alawula umhlaba. Yezindaba zonke izinqumo ezintsha zabaphathi, amapholisi nolwazi abasebenzini. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlola ezingeni lesibili. Bhekelela ukuhlola nokuvuma noma ukwenqaba wonke umhlaba othunyelwe abalinganisi bomhlaba abachwepheshe. Bika nganquboyela yokuqhubekayo njengoba kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhambisana kwawo wonke umthetho, amapholisi namanyathelo alawula umhlaba. Yezindaba zonke izinqumo ezintsha zokuphatha, amapholisi nolwazi abasebenzini. Nikeza iphotu yobuchwepheshe abalinganisi bomhlaba abachwepheshe. Bhekelela futhi unikeze izinsizakalo zokweluleka ngezindawo zomhlaba nokusesihlahleni kuzo zombili izindikelo kahulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Nikeza iphotu yobuchwepheshe abalinganisi bomhlaba abachwepheshe, abaphathi kahulumeni namagunya kahulumeni. Nikeza impendulo ngemibhalo yezindawo entsha ecushiwe kunoma iyiphi igunya elinamandla lokunikeza noma ukuvuma ilungelo lokusetshenziswa komhlaba ngenjongo ethize. Siza ekutolikweni nasezimpindelweni ezomthetho ngemibhalo yezindawo ekhona noma ecushiwe, ebulaliwe noma okuzobhaliswa ku-Deeds Registry. Nikeza izimpendulo ezibhalweni zokulwa izinkantolo, okuhlanganisa nemibalo yenkantolo, ehlobene nemibhalo yezindawo ekhona noma ecushiwe. Xhumana noMbhali weziDeeds nabasebenzi be-Deeds Registry ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi imibhalo yezindawo evunyelwe esikhungweni sikaNoMlingani-omkhulu ingabhaliswa futhi kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa okuhlanganisiwe kwesinhlelo sezindawo zomhlaba. Xhumana nezinhlangano ezizimele ze-geomatics namagunya abachwepheshe emkhakheni wokuakhiwa. Phendula noma yisipho isicelo sephresidensi, seminista, sephrovinsi noma isabelo sikaMongameli esihlobene namandla nendawo yokubusa isikhungo lapho ofishalela khona. Xhumana nabantu bomphakathi ngenkathi yamela uNoMlingani-omkhulu ezindabeni ezinzima noma ezingajwayelekile zamagunya omhlaba noma ezomthetho wempahla. Sekele ukugaywa nentuthuko yabasebenzi emkhakheni wesinhlelo sezindawo zomhlaba.

xh.title: Isekela loMbane weSikrobhu-jikelele
xh.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela uMbane weSikrobhu-jikelele ePretoria esibukela iinkonzo zesikrobhu nokuphonononga amaxwebhu e-cadastral kwiSebe leZokulungisa iMvela nokuPhuhlisa iPhakathi.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafake izicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikhedi yesiQopi sikaGrade 12 nangunesima-mfuno ezingeni lokuqala (iNqanaba le-7 NQF) njengokuqatshwa yiSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ngokukodwa i-Degree ye-B okanye i-BSc yeminyaka emine kwiGeomatics / iLand Surveying okanye izifundo ezizizo ezingasemva kwezi kunye nesatifikhedi yeNyukela (iSatifikhedi yokuNgena kwiSMS) ebonelelwa phambi kokwamkelwa. Kufunke abhalwe njengoMbanji womBini weMvela ochunwe kwiSouth African Geomatics Council. Kufunke abhalwe njengoQeqeshe weSectional Titles ngokwesigaba 5(2) seSectional Titles Act, 1986. Kufunke abe nokuba mkhulu iimvelo zeminyaka eli-5 kwinqanaba leboophakathi/baphezulu bokulawula kwindawo yokuba womBini weMvela. Iimvelo ezifanelekileyo zangaphambi kokubhaliswa kwiqhinga lokucwangcwa kwelifu elingakumbi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluxhumene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokulolonga kwelifu elingakumbi. Ulwazi lweNkqubo yobuChwepheshe. Ulwazi loLwazi oluPhakathi ngamaQela eMvela. Ulwazi lweNkqubo zoLwazi ngeMvela, iNkqubo zoLawulo lweMvela nokuLawula iNkqubo yoLwazi loNyani. Ulwazi ngokuPhuhliswa kwesoNqanga esiluncedo kwiNkqubo yokuLolonga iMvela. ukuLawula kuSebenzisa nokuQwalasela iMisebenzi. Iinkqubo nezakhiwo zoLawulo. Iinkqubo zokuThatha iigqibo kuLawulo. Inqubo yokuMisela iinkqubo. ukuQonda iNkqubo yolwazi lolawulo nokuChaza iNkqubo yokuPela nemiBiko. ukuQhelana nokwenza iimPazamo. ukuLawula ngaphakathi nokuLawula iingozi. Iimpawu zokuLawula iiprojekthi. iNkcubeko yezopolitiko yaseSouth Africa. Amakhono axhumene nomsebenzi: ukuLawula iiprojekthi. ukuLawula iqela. ukuHlobana nabantu. ukuQikelela iMali. ukuSebenzisa iKhompyutha. ukuCwangcisa izixhobo. ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuThatha iigqibo. ukuLawula ixesha. ukuSebenzisa umQondo webhizinise. ukuThetha nokuBhala.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zesikrobhu. Bukela ukwamkelwa nokuthunyelwa kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral anikelwe ukuba aqwalaselwe kwaye avunywe. Qinisekisa ukuba imali efunekayo yefayo ihlawulwe phambi kokuba amaxwebhu e-cadastral awamkelwe kwindalo. Bukela ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokuPhendula imibuzo kwesikrobhu. Bukela ukugcinwa kwenkqubo yokulungiselela iifayile ze-cadastral. Bukela ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokuNikela nokuThathwa kwezinto esikrobhini. Lawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokuQwalasela kwinqanaba lokuqala. Bukela ukwabiwa kweenombolo zamacebo emvela. Qinisekisa ukuzaliseka ngobuchwepheshe kwamaxwebhu onke e-cadastral alungiselelwe kwaye anikelwe ngooMbanji bomBini weMvela ababamba ngobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kwawo onke amagazethi, iinkqubo neendlela ezimal namaqhinga okulawula iMvela. Xela bonke abasebenzi ngeegqibo ezintsha, iinkqubo nolwazi oluxhunene nolawulo. Lawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokuQwalasela kwinqanaba lesibini. Bukela ukuQwalaselwa nokuvunywa/ukuqhatywa kwamaxwebhu onke e-cadastral alungiselelwe kwaye anikelwe ngooMbanji bomBini weMvela ababamba ngobuchwepheshe. Phawula ngokuqhubela phambili ngokwemfuneko. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kwawo onke amagazethi, iinkqubo neendlela ezimal namaqhinga okulawula iMvela. Xela bonke abasebenzi ngeegqibo ezintsha, iinkqubo nolwazi oluxhunene nolawulo. Nikela ngengcebiso ngobuchwepheshe kooMbanji bomBini weMvela ababamba ngobuchwepheshe. Bukela nikela ngeengcebiso zocwaningo nge-cadastral kulo onke amaphandle kaRhulumente, nakumntu wonke. Nikela ngengcebiso ngobuchwepheshe kooMbanji bomBini weMvela ababamba ngobuchwepheshe, abasebenzi boRhulumente nakumaziko ohulumende. Nikela ngeengxelo ngeeproposals zamaxwebhu e-cadastral nakweyiphi na igunya elinamandla lokunika okanye vuma ilungelo lokusetyenziswa komhlaba ngesu esibalulekileyo. Nceda nokuCediswa ngokuwohloka nangemiphumela yamagazethi kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral asakhoyo okanye atyihiwe, ajayele ukuba bhaliswe okanye aze abhaliswe kwiDeeds Registry. Nikela ngemibuzo yamaxwebhu okuxoxwa ngayo, kuquka nemibiko yekhofu, ephathelene namaxwebhu e-cadastral esakhoyo okanye ebandakanywa ekuTyikityweni. Thintana noMphathi weeDeeds kubasebenzi beDeeds Registry ukuze iqinisekiswe ukuba amaxwebhu e-cadastral avunyiwe kwindawo kaMbane weSikrobhu-jikelele angenwa kwiDeeds Registry kuqinisekiswa ukuzaliseka ngokuhambelana nokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo ye-cadastral. Thintana neendawo ezizimeleyo ze-geomatics nombutho ochwepheshe kwindawo yokwakha. Phendula nakwisicelo nasiphi na sePResidents, seMinister, i-Provincial hotline okanye umsebenzi kaDirector-General ngokuxhomekeke kwindawo anokuzimela kuyo. Thintana nabantu ngokwelixa likaMbane weSikrobhu-jikelele kumaphuphu amabinzana okanye angaqhelekanga, okanye ngamacebo amakhulu oMhlaba. Ceda ngokuqeqesha nokuPhuhlisa abasebenzi kwindawo yegquma le-cadastral.

jobs.title: Deputy Surveyor-general
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Deputy Surveyor-General for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pietermaritzburg, overseeing cadastral document examination, registry services and fee collection at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and an undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) as recognised by South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), specifically a four-year B or BSc Degree in Geomatics / Land Surveying or related equivalent qualifications and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council. Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5(2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle/senior managerial level in a land surveying environment. Appropriate post registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Cadastral Survey knowledge. Technical System knowledge. Cadastral Spatial Information knowledge. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with misconduct. Internal control and risk management. Project management principles and tools. The political landscape of South Africa. Job related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business ability. Communication (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Manage the provisioning of registry services. Oversee the receipt and dispatch of cadastral documents submitted for examination and approval. Ensure that the necessary fees of office have been paid prior to the acceptance of cadastral documents into the system. Oversee the provision of registry enquiry services. Oversee the maintenance of the cadastral correspondence filing system. Oversee the rendering of registry delivery and collection services. Manage the rendering of first level examination services. Oversee the allocation of land parcel numbers. Ensure technical compliance of all cadastral documents prepared and submitted by Professional Land Surveyors. Ensure proper application of all relevant land administration legislation, policies and procedures. Communicate all relevant new management decisions, policies and information to staff. Manage the rendering of second level examination services. Oversee the examination and approval/rejection of all cadastral documents prepared and submitted by Professional Land Surveyors. Report on directorate progress as required. Ensure proper application of all relevant land administration legislation, policies and procedures. Communicate all relevant new management decisions, policies and information to staff. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors. Oversee and render cadastral advisory and research services to all spheres of government, as well as the public. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors, government officials and organs of state. Provide feedback on proposed cadastral documents to any competent authority empowered to grant or approve a right to the use of land for a specified purpose. Assist with the interpretation and legal implications for existing and proposed cadastral documents, which have been or are to be registered in a Deeds Registry. Provide responses to litigation documentation, including reports to court, relating to existing or proposed cadastral documents. Liaise with the Registrar of Deeds and officials from the Deeds Registry to ensure cadastral documents approved in the office of the Surveyor-General are registerable and ensure harmonious application of the cadastral system. Liaise with voluntary geomatics organisations and professional bodies in the built environment sector. Respond to any Presidential, Ministerial, Provincial hotline request or Director-General task relating to the competencies and area of jurisdiction of the office in which the official serves. Liaise with members of the public on behalf of the Surveyor-General on complex or unusual land parcel boundary or property legislation-related matters. Support the training and development of officials in the cadastral system environment.

Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunk-Opmetingsgeneraal
af.summary: Adjunk-Opmetingsgeneraal vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pietermaritzburg, wat toesig hou oor die ondersoek van kadastrale dokumente, registerdienste en die invordering van gelde op SMS Level 13.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Level 7) soos deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) erken, spesifiek 'n vierjarige B- of BSc-graad in Geomatics / Land Surveying of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies, asook 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Toelatingsertifikaat tot die SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien moet word. Geregistreer as 'n Professionele Landmetingsgeleerde by die South African Geomatics Council. Geregistreer as 'n Seksionele Titelspraktisyn ingevolge Artikel 5(2) van die Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/senior bestuursvlak in 'n landmetingsomgewing. Toepaslike na-registrasie-ervaring in kadastrale landmeting. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van kadastrale opmeting. Kennis van tegniese stelsels. Kennis van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting. Kennis van Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems en Geographical Information Management. Kennis van tegnologie-vooruitgang wat nuttig is vir die kadastrale opmetingstelsel. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Regeringstelsels en -strukture. Regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse. Programopstelingsproses. Begrip van die bestuursinligting- en formele verslagdoeningstelsel. Hantering van wangedrag. Interne beheer en risikobestuur. Beginsels en hulpmiddels van projektebestuur. Die politieke landskap van South Africa. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projektebestuur. Spanbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Hulpbronbeplanning. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Tydbestuur. Besinsvermoë. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik).
af.duties: Bestuur die verskaffing van registerdienste. Hou toesig oor die ontvangs en versending van kadastrale dokumente wat vir ondersoek en goedkeuring ingedien word. Verseker dat die nodige kantoorgelde betaal is voordat kadastrale dokumente in die stelsel aanvaar word. Hou toesig oor die verskaffing van registernavraedienste. Hou toesig oor die instandhouding van die kadastrale korrespondensielêerstelsel. Hou toesig oor die lewer van registeraflewerings- en -insameldienste. Bestuur die lewer van eerste vlak ondersoekdienste. Hou toesig oor die toekenning van grapperseelnommers. Verseker tegniese nakoming van alle kadastrale dokumente wat deur Professionele Landmetingsgeleerdes voorberei en ingedien word. Verseker behoorlike toepassing van alle relevante landadministrasiewetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Kommunikeer alle relevante nuwe bestuursbesluite, beleide en inligting aan personeel. Bestuur die lewer van tweede vlak ondersoekdienste. Hou toesig oor die ondersoek en goedkeuring/afwysing van alle kadastrale dokumente wat deur Professionele Landmetingsgeleerdes voorberei en ingedien word. Rapporteer oor direktoraatvoortgang soos vereis. Verseker behoorlike toepassing van alle relevante landadministrasiewetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Kommunikeer alle relevante nuwe bestuursbesluite, beleide en inligting aan personeel. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmetingsgeleerdes. Hou toesig oor en verskaf kadastrale advies- en navorsingsdienste aan alle sfere van regering, asook aan die publiek. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmetingsgeleerdes, regeringsamptenare en staatsorgane. Verskaf terugvoer oor voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente aan enige bevoegde gesag wat bemagtig is om 'n reg tot die gebruik van grond vir 'n spesifieke doel te verleen of goed te keur. Bied hulp met die interpretasie en regsgevolge van bestaande en voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente wat in 'n Akteregister geregistreer is of gaan word. Verskaf antwoorde op litigasiedokumentasie, insluitend verslae aan die hof, wat verband hou met bestaande of voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente. Skakel met die Registrar of Deeds en amptenare van die Akteregister om te verseker dat kadastrale dokumente wat in die kantoor van die Opmetingsgeneraal goedgekeur is, registreerbaar is en die harmoniese toepassing van die kadastrale stelsel verseker. Skakel met vrywillige geomatics-organisasies en professionele liggame in die geboude omgewingsektor. Reageer op enige Presidente-, Ministers-, Provinciale hotlyn-versoeke of Director-General-take wat verband hou met die bevoegdhede en jurisdiksiegebied van die kantoor waarin die amptenaar diens doen. Skakel namens die Opmetingsgeneraal met lede van die publiek oor ingewikkelde of ongewone grapperseelgrens- of eiendomswetgewingverwante aangeleenthede. Ondersteun die opleiding en ontwikkeling van amptenare in die kadastrale stelselomgewing.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla Esesikhundleni Somlinganisi-Jikelele
zu.summary: Isiphathimandla Esesikhundleni Somlinganisi-Jikelele se-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ePietermaritzburg, esibuka phezu kokuhlola amadokhumenti e-cadastral, imisebenzi yeregistri nokuthola imali ezingeni le-SMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kothe: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nocwecwe lobuGred 12 nangesidingo seziqu zasekhono (NQF Level 7) njengoba somiyo i-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ngokukhethekile idigri yeminyaka emine ye-B noma i-BSc kwi-Geomatics / Land Surveying noma izidingo ezalinganayo kanye nocwecwe lwe-Nyukela (ucwecwe lokungena e-SMS) okuhambiswa ngaphambi kokugqashwa. Kumele ibhalwe njengoMlinganisi Wezwe Ochwepheshe ku-South African Geomatics Council. Kumele ibhalwe njengoMsebenzisi Wezihloko Zesigaba ngokwesigaba 5(2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Ukwesaba unyaka we-5 weminyaka yohlaka ohlakeni lokuphakathi/phezulu kwesigaba sabaphathi emhlabeni wokulinganisa izwe. Uhlaka olufanele bokubhalise emva kokulinganisa izwe. Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokulinganisa i-Cadastral. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lolwazi lwesikhala se-Cadastral. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zolwazi ngomhlaba, izinhlelo zolawulo komhlaba nokuPhatha Ulwazi EseBuge. Ulwazi ngentuthuko yobuchwepheshe oluwusizo kuhlelo lokulinganisa i-Cadastral. Ukuphatha nokubheka ukusebenza. Izinhlelo nezakhiwo zahulumeni. Inqubo yokuthatha izinqumo kahulumeni. Inqubo yokuhlela amaphrogremu. Ukuqonda ulwazi lokuphatha nohlelo lokubika ngokusesimweni. Ukuphatha amacala angahambisani nokuziphatha. Ukulawula ngaphakathi nokuphatha ingozi. Imigomo namathuluzi okuphatha amaphrojekthi. Isimo sezepolitiki sase Ningizimu Afrika. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukuphatha iqembu. Izinhlobonhlobo zomuntu ngamunye. Ukubheka holide. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukwenza uhlelo lwezinsiza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ikhono lezinhlelo zokusebenza. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangesibhali).
zu.duties: Lawula ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zeregistri. Buka phezu kokwamukela nokuthumela amadokhumenti e-cadastral ahambiselwa ukuhlolaokuze kunqunywe. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali efanayo ye-ofisi ikhokhelwe ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral esimweni. Buka phezu kokunikezwa kwezinkonzo zemibuzo yeregistri. Buka phezu kokugcina uhlelo lokugcina okubhalwayo nge-Cadastral. Buka phezu kokuletha izinkonzo zokulethwa nokuthathwa kwezinto zeregistri. Lawula ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokuqala zokuqonda izinga. Buka phezu kokwabelwa izinombolo zamaphakeli womhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibhalo e-cadastral ihlangabezana ngokwezobuchwepheshe nokulungiselelwa nokuhambiselwa abalinganisi Bezwe Abachwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwayo yonke imithetho, imigomo namacandu ebandakanya ukulawula komhlaba. Xhumana ngawo wonke amaqdoaka omphathi amasha, imigomo nolwazi nabasebenzi. Lawula ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zesibili zokuqonda izinga. Buka phezu kokuhlola nokuvuma nokwenqatha yonke imibhalo e-cadastral ebookelelwe nokuhambiselwa abalinganisi Bezwe Abachwepheshe. Bika ngentuthuko yedirekithori njengoko kudingiwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi kusetshenziswa ngokufanele yonke imithetho nolawulo komhlaba, imigomo namacandu. Xhumana noma yisiphi isinqumo esisha sokuphathi, imigomo nolwazi kubasebenzi. Nikeza izeluleko zangobuchwepheshe kubalinganisi Bezwe Abachwepheshe. Buka phezu futhi unikeze izinkonzo zokweluleka nentolvelo e-cadastral kuyo yonke izigaba zahulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Nikeza izeluleko zobuchwepheshe kubalinganisi Bezwe Abachwepheshe, abasebenzi bahulumeni kanye nezikhulu zenqiko. Nikeza umbhalo okhululekile ngokuthumela imibhalo e-cadastral kunoma yiliphi igunya elinamandla okunikeza noma kuvume ukusetshenziswa kwelinye ilungelo ngomhlaba ngohlaka oluthize. Siza nokuqonda kanye neziphumo ezomthetho yemibalo e-cadastral esikhona futhi ebanjwayo, kuleyo abhalwe noma izobhalwa kurejistri yamade. Nikeza impendulo emibhalweni yezinkantolo, kuhlanganise nokubika ngenkantolo, mayelana imibhalo e-cadastral esikhona noma ebanjwayo. Thintana noMbhali Wamade kanye nabasebenzi abavela kurejistri yamade ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo e-cadastral evunyiwe kofisini kaMlinganisi-Jikelele ingabhalwa, bese kuqinisekiswa ukusetshenziswa okuvumelana kohlelo i-Cadastral. Thintana nezinhlangano ezizimele i-Geomatics nemibimbi yobuchwepheshe kumkhakha wokwakhiwa kwemvelo. Phendula noma yisiphi isicelo senkantolo kaMongameli, seNgqongqoshe, esifundazwe noma umsebenzi kaMlinganisi-Jikelele ohlobene namandla nediliya le-ofisi lapho khona uqeqeshwa. Thintana namalunga omphakathi ebizo likaMlinganisi-Jikelele ezindabeni ezinkhulu noma ezingajwayelekene zamalimi aphakathi komhlaba noma ngemithetho yempahla. Sekela ukuqeqesha nentuthuko yabasebenzi emkhakha wohlelo i-Cadastral.

xh.title: Isekela loNoxumba-jikelele-wezomhlaba
xh.summary: Isekela loNoxumba-jikelele-wezomhlaba kwiSebe leZolimo loLutshintsho lweMimandla nokuPhuhliswa kweendawo ezikwisithili ePietermaritzburg, elidlula ngqo kwisayensi yokupela amaxwebhu e-cadastral, iinkonzo zerekota kunye nokuqokelelwa kwemali ehlawuliswayo kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno esezantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikhedi yeGrade 12 kunye nelayisensi yomgangatho ongaphantsi (NQF Level 7) evunywe yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ngokukodwa iDigri yeminyaka emine ye-B okanye i-BSc kwi-Geomatics / Land Surveying okanye izifundo ezingangamana nazo, kunye nesatifikethi se-Nyukela (isatifikethi sangaphambili kwi-SMS) esinikwa ngaphambi kokwamkelwa. Kufuneka abhaliswe njengoMpeleki oLungeleleneyo woMhlaba kwi-South African Geomatics Council. Kufuneka abhaliswe njengoMprakthisha we-Sectional Titles ngokwesigaba 5(2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Kufuneka abe neminye elishumi yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/phezulu lolawulo kwimeko yokupezula umhlaba. Amava afanelekileyo emva kokuBhaliswa kwimimisela yecadastral. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokuPela uMhlaba kwi-Cadastral. Ulwazi ngamanqanaba aPhakamileyo eNkqubo. Ulwazi ngeSpaziyela iNkcukacha ze-Cadastral. Ulwazi ngeeNkqubo zeNkcukacha ngoMhlaba, iNkqubo zoLawulo loMhlaba kunye noLawulo lweNkcukacha ezoBume bomMhlaba. Ulwazi ngokuPhuhliswa kobuChwepheshe obuLuncedo kwiNkqubo yokuPela uMhlaba kwi-Cadastral. uLawulo kuNtsholovo kwaye kuQwalaselwa. Iinkqubo nemiVimbo kaRhulumente. Iinkqubo zoTshintsho lwesigqibo koRhulumente. Inqanaba lenkqubo yokumisa. UkuQonda iNkqubo yoLawulo lweNkcukacha nendlela yokuchaza ngokusesikweni. UkuSebenza nokuWonakaliswa kokuziphatha okungalunganga. uLawulo lwangaphakathi nokuQwalaselwa iingozi. iNkqubo ezizeyo ngesixhobo seProjekthi. iNdawo yamasweko eMzantsi Afrika. Ikhono elinxulumene nomsebenzi: uLawulo lweProjekthi. uLawulo loQembu. uBudlelwane phakathi koBantu. uBikelelo lweBhajethi. uKwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha. uCwangciso lweZixhobo. ukusombulula iNgxaki nokuThatha isigqibo. uLawulo lwexesha. Ikhono leshishini. uNxibelelwano (ngemilomo nangokubhalwa).
xh.duties: uLawula ukubonelela ngenkonzo zerekota. uQwalasela ukwamkelwa nokuthunyelwa kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral awanikelwa ukuyalwa kuvunyanwe. uQinisekisa ukuba imali yofise ihlawulwe ngaphambi kokwamkelwa kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral kwinkqubo. uQwalasela ukubonelela ngenkonzo zokupendula ngeRekota. uQwalasela ukugcinwa kwenkqubo yokugcina iincwadi zoxumano ze-cadastral. uQwalasela ukubonelela ngenkonzo zokuThunyelwa nokuQokelelwa kweRekota. uLawula ukubonelela ngenkonzo zokuYala kwinqanaba lokuQala. uQwalasela ukwabiwa kwamanani abe ngumhlaba. uQinisekisa ulandelelwano ngokobuchwepheshe bokwakheleka kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral alungiselelwayo nawanikwa ngooMpezulu abaLungeleleneyo bomHlaba. uQinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwayo yonke imithethonqubo, iinkqubo namacebo olawulo loMhlaba. uDlulisa yonke imigqibelelo yentengiso yolawulo entsha, iinkqubo nolwazi kubasebenzi. uLawula ukubonelela ngenkonzo zokuYala kwinqanaba lesiBini. uQwalasela ukuYalwa nokuVunywa/okuLahlwa kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral alungiselelwe ngooMpezulu abaLungeleleneyo bomHlaba. uChaza ngenqanaba lenkqubo njengoko kufuneka. uQinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwayo yonke imithethonqubo, iinkqubo namacebo olawulo loMhlaba. uDlulisa yonke imigqibelelo yentengiso yolawulo entsha, iinkqubo nolwazi kubasebenzi. uNika iziphulelo-mali kubMpezulu abaLungeleleneyo bomHlaba. uQwalasela kanye nokubonelela ngezenkonzoncedo zocandelo lwe-cadastral ukuba zikwazo nakuzo naziphi na iindawo zorhulumente, nakunjenganelu. uNika iziphulelo-mali kubMpezulu abaLungeleleneyo bomHlaba, kuRhulumente kwanakumabumba oRhumamate. uNika ingxelo nangamaxesha apha ngamaxwebhu e-cadastral acetywayo nakuziphi na iindawo ezinamandla okuvumela ukusetjenziswa kolawulo ngokuchanekileyo lwelizwe kwiinjongo ezichaziweyo. uNceda ngokutolika nangemiphumela yomthetho kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral akho okanye ecetywayo, angabhaliswe okanye abhaliselwa kwiRekota yeeNtengiso. uNika iimpendulo nangamaxwebhu okuvakalayo kuGqabhuka, kuquka iingxelo zangasemasimini, ngangamaxwebhu e-cadastral akho okanye ecetywayo. unxibelelwane noMmlambedi weeNtengiso nangamaphuphu oMsebenzi weRekota yeeNtengiso ukunceda ukuba amaxwebhu e-cadastral avunyelwe kwiofisi kaMpezulu-jikelele wezomHlab a kwakunye nokunceda ukusetyenziswa ngokuvumelwana kwenkqubo ye-cadastral. unxibelelwane neendyunyana ezithanda ukuzimela kunye namabumba azele ngobuChwepheshe kwicala lokwakha Uluntu. uPhendula nakuphi na isiCelo sikamongameli, so Ngqondvishe, esiSithili, okanye umThetho kaMongameli jikelele nxulumene namandla nokuba ngowesikhundla sobuNxibelelwano apho ulawula khona. uXhumana noluntu ngenkxaso kaMpezulu-jikelele wezoMhlab ngemiba ecwe-cwe okanye engaqhelekanga ngokweemida zamashumi amabini emiHlab a okanye ngokomButho wePropathi ombi. uxhasa ukuQeqeshwa nokuphuhliswa koBesebenzi kwimeko yegama leNkqubo yecadastral.

jobs.title: Deputy Surveyor-general
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Deputy Surveyor-General position in Cape Town within the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, managing cadastral document examination and registry services at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and an undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) as recognised by South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), specifically a four-year B or BSc Degree in Geomatics / Land Surveying or related equivalent qualifications and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council. Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5(2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle/senior managerial level in a land surveying environment. Appropriate post registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Cadastral Survey knowledge. Technical System knowledge. Cadastral Spatial Information knowledge. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with misconduct. Internal control and risk management. Project management principles and tools. The political landscape of South Africa. Job related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business ability. Communication (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Manage the provisioning of registry services. Oversee the receipt and dispatch of cadastral documents submitted for examination and approval. Ensure that the necessary fees of office have been paid prior to the acceptance of cadastral documents into the system. Oversee the provision of registry enquiry services. Oversee the maintenance of the cadastral correspondence filing system. Oversee the rendering of registry delivery and collection services. Manage the rendering of first level examination services. Oversee the allocation of land parcel numbers. Ensure technical compliance of all cadastral documents prepared and submitted by Professional Land Surveyors. Ensure proper application of all relevant land administration legislation, policies and procedures. Communicate all relevant new management decisions, policies and information to staff. Manage the rendering of second level examination services. Oversee the examination and approval/rejection of all cadastral documents prepared and submitted by Professional Land Surveyors. Report on directorate progress as required. Ensure proper application of all relevant land administration legislation, policies and procedures. Communicate all relevant new management decisions, policies and information to staff. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors. Oversee and render cadastral advisory and research services to all spheres of government, as well as the public. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors, government officials and organs of state. Provide feedback on proposed cadastral documents to any competent authority empowered to grant or approve a right to the use of land for a specified purpose. Assist with the interpretation and legal implications for existing and proposed cadastral documents, which have been or are to be registered in a Deeds Registry. Provide responses to litigation documentation, including reports to court, relating to existing or proposed cadastral documents. Liaise with the Registrar of Deeds and officials from the Deeds Registry to ensure cadastral documents approved in the office of the Surveyor-General are registerable and ensure harmonious application of the cadastral system. Liaise with voluntary geomatics organisations and professional bodies in the built environment sector. Respond to any Presidential, Ministerial, Provincial hotline request or Director-General task relating to the competencies and area of jurisdiction of the office in which the official serves. Liaise with members of the public on behalf of the Surveyor-General on complex or unusual land parcel boundary or property legislation-related matters. Support the training and development of officials in the cadastral system environment.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Kekana Tel No: (012) 312 8344
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 4th floor, No 2 Riebeeck Street, ABSA Building, Cape Town or by email to Post187@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males and African, Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunk-Opmetings-generaal
af.summary: Pos van Adjunk-Opmetings-generaal in Cape Town binne die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, wat kadastrale dokumentondersoek en registratiedienste bestuur op SMS Level 13.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Level 7) soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), spesifiek 'n vierjaar B- of BSc-graad in Geomatics / Land Surveying of verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasies en 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien word. Geregistreer as 'n Professionele Landmeetkundige by die South African Geomatics Council. Geregistreer as 'n Seksionele Titels-praktisyn ooreenkomstig Artikel 5(2) van die Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum van 5 jaar ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n landmeetkundige omgewing. Toepaslike na-registrasie-ervaring in kadastrale opmeting. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kadastrale opmetingskennis. Tegniese stelselkennis. Kadastrale ruimtelike inligtingskennis. Kennis van Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems en Geographical Information Management. Kennis van tegnologiese vooruitgang wat nuttig is vir die kadastrale opmetingstelsel. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Regeringstelsels en -strukture. Regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse. Programopstelingsproses. Begrip van die bestuursinligting- en formele verslagdoeningstelsel. Hantering van wangedrag. Interne beheer en risikobestuur. Projekbestuursbeginsels en -instrumente. Die politieke landskap van South Africa. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projekbestuur. Spanbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Hulpbronbeplanning. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Tydsbestuur. Besigheidsvermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik).
af.duties: Bestuur die verskaffing van registratiedienste. Hou toesig op die ontvangs en versending van kadastrale dokumente wat vir ondersoek en goedkeuring ingedien word. Verseker dat die nodige kantoorgelde betaal is voordat kadastrale dokumente in die stelsel aanvaar word. Hou toesig op die verskaffing van registratienavraedienste. Hou toesig op die instandhouding van die kadastrale korrespondensielêerstelsel. Hou toesig op die lewer van registrasie-aflewerings- en -insameldienste. Bestuur die lewer van eerste-vlak ondersoekdienste. Hou toesig op die toekenning van grondperseelnommers. Verseker tegniese nakoming van alle kadastrale dokumente wat deur Professionele Landmeetkundiges opgestel en ingedien word. Verseker die behoorlike toepassing van alle tersaaklike grondbestuurswetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Kommunikeer alle tersaaklike nuwe bestuursbesluite, beleide en inligting aan personeel. Bestuur die lewer van tweede-vlak ondersoekdienste. Hou toesig op die ondersoek en goedkeuring/afwysing van alle kadastrale dokumente wat deur Professionele Landmeetkundiges opgestel en ingedien word. Rapporteer oor direktoraatvoortgang soos vereis. Verseker die behoorlike toepassing van alle tersaaklike grondbestuurswetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Kommunikeer alle tersaaklike nuwe bestuursbesluite, beleide en inligting aan personeel. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeetkundiges. Hou toesig op en lewer kadastrale advies- en navorsingsdienste aan alle sfere van regering, asook aan die publiek. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeetkundiges, staatsamptenare en staatsorgane. Verskaf terugvoer oor voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente aan enige bevoegde gesag wat bemagtig is om 'n reg tot die gebruik van grond vir 'n gespesifiseerde doel te verleen of goed te keur. Bied hulp met die interpretasie en regskonsekwensies van bestaande en voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente wat in 'n Akteregister geregistreer is of sal word. Verskaf antwoorde op litigasiedokumentasie, insluitend verslae aan die hof, rakende bestaande of voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente. Skakel met die Akteregistrateur en amptenare van die Akteregister om te verseker dat kadastrale dokumente wat in die kantoor van die Opmetings-generaal goedgekeur is, registreerbaar is en die harmonieuse toepassing van die kadastrale stelsel verseker. Skakel met vrywillige geometrie-organisasies en professionele liggame in die beboude omgewingsektor. Reageer op enige Presidentiele, Ministeriële, Provinsiale hotlynversoek of Direkteur-generaal-taak rakende die bevoegdhede en jurisdiksiegebied van die kantoor waarin die amptenaar diens doen. Skakel met lede van die publiek namens die Opmetings-generaal oor komplekse of ongewone grondperseelgrens- of eiendomswetgewingverwante aangeleenthede. Ondersteun die opleiding en ontwikkeling van amptenare in die kadastrale stelselomgewing.

zu.title: OSiphathhi-mhlaba ohlezi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sosiphathhi-mhlaba ohlezi eCape Town kumnyango we Land Reform and Rural Development, uphethe ukubuyekezwa kwemibhalo yekadastre nesevisi zeregistry ezingeni le SMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se Grade 12 kanye nelayisensi yeziqu ezingaphansi (NQF Level 7) evunyiwe ngu South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ikakhulukazi i Degree yeminyaka emine ye B noma i BSc ku Geomatics / Land Surveying noma iziqu ezilinganayo kanye nesitifiketi se Nyukela (Isitifiketi sangaphambi kokungena kwi SMS) esithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ukube uyithwetshiwe njengo Professional Land Surveyor ne South African Geomatics Council. Ukube uyithwetshiwe njengo Sectional Titles Practitioner ngokwesigaba 5(2) se Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Ukube unamava eminyaka engu-5 nangaphezulu ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi/ophezulu emkhakheni wezokulinganisa kwethu. Abasebenzi abafanelekileyo abathunyelwe kwindawo yabo yokulinganisa kakhulu kwindawo ababekwe kuyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi nge Cadastral Survey. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngencazelo yendawo yekadastre. Ulwazi mayelana nezinhlelo zolwazi ngaphandle, izinhlelo zolawulo lolwazi kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi ngezindawo. Ulwazi ngemikhuba yobuchwepheshe ebalulekile kuleso sifundo. ukulawula kanye nokuqaphela. Izinhlelo nezakhiwo zahulumeni. Inqubo yokwenza izinqumo kahulumeni. Inqubo yokulungelelisa uhlelo. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kolwazi kanye nezinhlelo zokubika ezisemthethweni. Ukuphatha ukuziphatha okungalungile. Ulawulo lwangaphakathi kanye nezenzo zokuphatha ingozi. Izinhlobo zamaphuzu nezinkomba zolawulo lwezinhlelo zokwenza umsebenzi. Isimo sezepolitiki saseNingizimu Afrika. Amandla okusebenza ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukulawula izinhlelo. Ukulawula iqembu. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukubuka ngaphambili kwezimali. Ukubhaliswa ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha. Ukucubungula ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Amandla emisebenzi. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe).
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zeregistry. Qaphela ukutholwa nokuthunyelwa kwemibhalo yekadastre ethunyelwe ukuze ibuyekezwe futhi ivunyelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimali ezadingekayo zikhokhelwe ngaphambi kokuba imibhalo yekadastre ivunyelwe ukungena kuleyo nkqubo. Qaphela ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zemibuzo yeregistry. Qaphela ukugcinwa kwenqubo yokulondoloza imibhalo yekadastre. Qaphela ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokulethwa nokuthathwa kwemibhalo yeregistry. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokubuyekeza izinga lokuqala. Qaphela ukwabiwa kwezinombolo zamapulangizwe emhlabathini. Qinisekisa ukuziphendula ngobuchwepheshe kwemibhalo yekadastre eyilwe futhi ethunyelwe ngabo Professional Land Surveyors. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhambisana nomthetho wazo wonke umthetho, izinqubo namasiko ahlobene nolawulo lwethu. Yezindaba zonke izinqumo ezintsha zokuphatha, izinqubomgomo yolawulo nemibhalo ohlotsheni lwabanini iziqu ezenzelwe abasebenzi. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokubuyekeza izinga lesibili. Qaphela ukubuyekezwa nokuvunyelwa/ukwenqatwa kwemibhalo yekadastre eyilwe futhi ethunyelwe ngabo Professional Land Surveyors. Bika ngentuthuko yeqhema njengoba kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhambisana nomthetho wazo wonke umthetho wolawulo, izinqubo nemigomo ephilayo. Thumela izindaba ezintsha ezibalulekile zokuphatha, imigimo yolawulo kanye nolwazi ohlwini lwabantu abayilawulayo abenza umsebenzi. Nikeza izeluleko ezingamazinga aphakeme ohlelweni lwebhizinisi labo bonke abasebenzisi be Professional Land Surveyors abangene kubuyezwe ngemibhalo yemithetho esemthethweni namasu abhukunywa ngawo amandla okunika incazelo egcwele mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwethu kanye namalungu abantu ohlotsheni lwabantu abayilawulayo abenza umsebenzi kulezi zikhungo ezahlukene zokusebenzela imithetho yesikhathi, kanye nezinsiza. Nikeza umbhalo kulo naliphi igunya elinamandla okunika noma ukuvuma isesulo sokusetshenziswa kwethu nganoma yisiphi isidingo esithile. Siza ekuchazeni kanye nasezimpawu ezibalulekile mayelana nemibhalo yekadastre ekhona noma ecebisiwe, evunyiwe noma okulindeleke ukuba igunyazwe kwindawo yokubhalisa iziqu zesiko elitsha. Nikeza izimpendulo zamaphoyisa egunya elithile emphakathini ohlwini lwebanga eliphansi ohlelweni olubhaliswe khona namaphupho okwenza isikhathi eside namakomidi ahlezi ohlelweni mayelana nabakwazi ukubhalisa imibhalo yesikhathi ngemithetho yalowo naliphi igunya elinelayisensi yokukhuluma nabantu abangene kubuyekeze imithetho noma ukusetshenziswa okungalungile kwamasu okuziphendula kwezimali okungamukeleki ohlelweni lwebhizinisi leli. Xhumana ne-Registrar of Deeds kanye nabasebenzi abavela kwi Deeds Registry ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imibhalo yekadastre ekuqinisekisiwe emphakathini webhizinisi lika Surveyor-General ingavunyelwa futhi kugcinwe ukuhambisana kwentela yezinkinga ezingaba khona ezingozi ekusebenzeni ngaphezulu kwamandla okusebenza, kanye namaphoyisa egunya elithile emphakathini okuzibophezela ekusebenziseni imigomo namakhomidi eNkantolo ahlezi mayelana nokwenza iziqu eziningi futhi ezingazelelwe ukuba zihlolwe ngaphandle komthetho ohlelweni. Xhumana nabantu abangene kahle noma abakwazi ukumela isikhathi eside, abasebenzela izigaba ezahlukene zohlelo kanye nabantu abafuna ukuqonda okwenzekile. Siza ekusebenziseni inkqubo yokuqonda izinkinga ezingamukeleki ezingamandla akhulu kakhulu futhi nasekuthuthukisweni kohlelo lwebhizinisi.

xh.title: Kwindlalifa kaMpelelelwa-jikelele
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMpelelelwa-Jikelele osekelayo eCape Town kwisebe leLand Reform and Rural Development, elawulayo ukujongwa kwamaxwebhu e-kadastra neenkonzo zerekhodo kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisezantsi: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesatifikethdi seGredi 12 nangenyethemba lezazinzulu ezisezantsi (NQF Level 7) njengoko kuthathwa ngumButho weZazinzulu waseMzantsi Afrika (SAQA), ngokukodwa idigri yeminyaka emine yeB okanye iBSc kwi-Geomatics / ukuPelalela koMhlaba okanye iinzulu ezingqamana nazo ezingezantsi kunye nelayisensi yeNyukela isatifikethdi esinikwa phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Kufuneka abhalisiwe njengoMpelelelwa weZazinzulu ochwepheshe kwiBhungo le-Geomatics lasemzantsi Afrika. Kufuneka abhalisiwe njengomenzi we-Sectional Titles ngokwesigaba 5(2) somthetho we-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Kufuneka abe nokungqina kweminyaka eli-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lolawulo kwimeko yokuPelela koMhlaba. Kufuneka abe namava afanelekileyo emva koku NTloko bokubhalisa kokuPelelelwa kweKadastra. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluchaseneyo ngenxutyi yomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokuPelelelwa kweKadastra. Ulwazi lweNkqubo yobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngeKadastra yoLwazi lweNdalo. Ulwazi ngeenkonzo zeNkqabo yoLwazi loMhlaba, iNkqabo yoLawulo loMhlaba nokuLawulwa koLwazi lweGeographical. Ulwazi ngokuqhubela phambili kobuchwepheshe olusetyenziswa kwiNkqabo yokuPelelelwa kweKadastra. Ukuqwalaselwa kokuQwalaselwa koMsebenzi nokuQwalaselwa. Iinkqabo nezakhiwo zorhulumente. Iinkqubo zokuThatha iziGqibo zorhulumente. Inkqubo yokumisa iinkqubo. Ukuqonda inkqabo yolwazi lolawulo nerekhodo yesikhundla. Ukusingatha okungalunganga. Ulawulo lwangaphakathi nolawulo lwengozi. Iinkqubo nezixhobo zoLawulo loVimba. Isimo sezepolitiki saseMzantsi Afrika. Amakhono achaseneyo ngenxutyi yomsebenzi: uLawulo loVimba. uLawulo loQela. Iimvano ezingabemi. Ukuqikelela kweBhajeti. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha. uCwangciso lweZixhobo. ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuThatha iziGqibo. uLawulo lwexesha. Ikhono leshishini. uThetho (lwendalo nolubhaliweyo).
xh.duties: Phatha ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zerekhodi. Qaphela ukwamkelwa nokuthunyelwa kwamaxwebhu e-kadastra anikelwa ukuba uphelelwe isihloko kuvunywe. Qinisekisa ukuba imali yefuni yofiso ihleli ihlelwe ngaphambi kokuba amaxwebhu e-kadastra amkelwe kwinkqubo. Qaphela ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zokubuza kwirekhodi. Qaphela ukugcinwa kwenkqabo yokulungelelanisa amaxwebhu e-kadastra. Qaphela ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zokulethwa nokubuthwa kwerekhodi. Phatha ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zokupelelelwa isihloko kwinqanaba lokuqala. Qaphela ukwabiwa kumanani amaqhekeza omhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuzinza ngokwezobuchwepheshe kwawo onke amaxwebhu e-kadastra alungiswe aweywe ngabapeleleli beMpevwaki yoMhlaba. Qinisekisa ukusetenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kwawo onke umthetho, iinkqazo neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolawulo lwemhlaba. Yaziwonke amaqhayiya amakhulu amatsha olawulo, iinkqazo nolwazi kubasebenzi. Phatha ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zokupelelelwa isihloko kwinqanaba lesibini. Qaphela ukupelelelwa nokuvunywa/ukwalwa kwawo onke amaxwebhu e-kadastra alungiswe aweywe ngabapeleleli beMpelelelwa yoMhlaba. Ngexesha elithile, chaza ngemisebenzi yophuhliso njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukusetenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kwawo onke umthetho, iinkqazo neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolawulo lwemhlaba. Yaziwonke amaqhayiya amakhulu amatsha olawulo, iinkqazo nolwazi kubasebenzi. Nikela ngesalathiso sabuchwepheshe kubapeleleli beMpelelelwa yoMhlaba. Qaphela kwaye nikeze iinkonzo zesalathiso nokuphonononga eziyingqayi kuzo zonke iinqanaba zorhulumente, nakunjalo kwindalo. Nikela ngesalathiso sobuchwepheshe kubapeleleli beMpelelelwa yoMhlaba, abasebenzi borhulumente namagunya karhulumente. Nikela nengxelo ngeenjongo zamaxwebhu e-kadastra nakwinaluphi na igunya elinamandla lokunika amandla okuvuma inkqazo yokusebenzisa umhlaba ngenjongo ethile. Ncedisa ngokuchaza nokusebenza kwamathetho kuwo onke amaxwebhu e-kadastra akho okanye awakhiwayo, apapashiweyo okanye okuza kupapashwa kwiNkqabo yeZiqu. Nikela iimpendulo kwimaxwebhu engxoxweni yamathetho, kuquka neengxelo ezikelwe kwinkundla, ezithinta amaxwebhu e-kadastra akhoyo okanye awakhiwayo. Thethana noMgcini weZiqu nabasebenzi beNkqabo yeZiqu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba amaxwebhu e-kadastra avunyiwe kwiofisi kaMpelelelwa-Jikelele ayakwazi ukubhalwa kuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetenziswa ngokuhambelana kwenkqabo ye-kadastra. Thethana namaqumrhu afuna iindlela ezahlukeneyo zobuchwepheshe beGeomatics namadoda athile kwicandelo lezolimo. Phendula nawuphi na isicelo seNkosi yaseNdingalweni, seNgqungquthela, seNdibano yamaPhondo okanye somsebenzi kaMlawuli-Jikelele ophathelene namandla nendawo yolawulo lwesikhululo apho lowo mphathi akhonzayo. Thethana nabemi ngenxa kaMpelelelwa-Jikelele kwimiba esingxamileyo okanye engaqhelekanga ngamagqabi anomda wamaqhekeza omhlaba okanye umthetho ophathelene nepropati. Xhasa ukuyila nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi kwimeko yenkqabo ye-kadastra.

jobs.title: Deputy Surveyor-general
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Deputy Surveyor-General in Mmabatho to manage registry services and oversee cadastral document examination, archiving and fee collection at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and an undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) as recognised by South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), specifically a four-year B or BSc Degree in Geomatics / Surveying or related equivalent qualifications and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council. Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5(2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle/senior managerial level in a Land Surveying environment. Appropriate post registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: The Constitution of the Republic of South Africa. Good governance and Batho Pele principles. Labour and Employment Legislation. Public Service Regulations, 2016 (as amended). Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Transformation of the Public Service. Employment Equity Act, 1998. Deeds Registries Act, 1937. Land Survey Act, 1997. Sectional Titles Act, 1986. South African Geomatics Professions Act, 2013. South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, 2003. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, 2013. Mining Titles Registration Act, 1967. Other, all other property related legislation, including old order legislation and ordinances. Proclamation and policies applicable to Land Administration, Land Measurement Standards, and Land Information Systems. International Conventions on land policy and geographical information management. Cadastral Survey knowledge. Technical System knowledge. Cadastral Spatial Information knowledge. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with misconduct. Internal control and risk management. Project management principles and tools. The political landscape of South Africa. Job related skills: Good interpersonal relations. Good communication (verbal and written). Problem solving and decision-making. Dispute and conflict management. Time management. Computer software. Project management. Planning. Team management. Budget forecasting. Resource planning and organising. Business.
jobs.duties: Manage the provisioning of registry services. Oversee the receipt and dispatch of cadastral documents submitted for examination and approval. Ensure that the necessary fees of office have been paid prior to the acceptance of cadastral documents into the system. Oversee the archiving of all documents. Oversee the maintenance of the cadastral correspondence filing system. Oversee the rendering of messenger services. Manage the rendering of first and second level examination services. Oversee the allocation of land parcel numbers. Ensure technical compliance of cadastral documents. Verify new cadastral documents in relation to parent property information. Oversee the examination and approval/rejection of all cadastral documents prepared and submitted by Professional Land Surveyors. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors and government officials. Report on directorate progress monthly as required. Know and apply all relevant land administration legislation, policies and procedures. Communicate all relevant new management decisions, policies and information to staff on weekly basis. Render and facilitate professional advice for land reform projects and state surveys. Receive requests for land reform assistance as and when required. Provide and oversee professional advisory services for land reform projects and state surveys. Perform research on land reform projects and state surveys. Plan the required land parcel boundary investigation when required. Generate reports for land reform support according to findings and policy. Submit reports on land reform findings upon finalisation. Consult with interested and affected parties to land reform projects and state surveys. Ensure that the beacons relating to a state survey have been pointed out and accepted by the relevant officials including the beneficiaries where applicable prior to the approval of the cadastral documents. Oversee and render professional advice on the cadastral system and existing and proposed cadastral documentation. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors, government officials and organs of state. Provide feedback on proposed cadastral documents to any competent authority empowered to grant or approve a right to the use of land for a specified purpose. Assist with the interpretation and legal implications for existing and proposed cadastral documents, which have been or are to be registered in a Deeds Registry. Provide responses to litigation documentation, including reports to the court relating to existing or proposed cadastral documents. Liaise with the Registrar of Deeds and officials from the Deeds Registry to ensure cadastral documents approved in the office of the Surveyor- General are registerable and ensure harmonious application of the cadastral system. Liaise with voluntary geomatics organisations and professional bodies in the built environment sector. Respond to any presidential hotline request relating to the competencies and area of jurisdiction of the office in which the official serves. Liaise with members of the public on behalf of the Surveyor- General on complex or unusual land parcel boundary or property legislation- related matters. Liaise with custodians of geo-spatial information that either support or depend upon Cadastral Spatial Information. Support the training and development of officials in the cadastral system environment. Oversee the undertaking of field surveys for verification of surveys, dispute resolution and inspections. Test a survey for correctness, accuracy or authenticity in accordance with legal provisions, if reason for doubt exists. Take necessary action in connection with a survey tested for correctness, accuracy or authenticity, when required. Prepare and submit a report in connection with an application to a court, if deemed desirable. Undertake field surveys to identify boundaries of state land properties to resolve boundary disputes.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Kekana Tel No: (012) 312 8344
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Cnr James Moroka and Sekame Drive, West Gallery, Megacity, Mmabatho, 2735 or by email to Post188@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males and African, Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. af.title: Adjunk-Opmetingsgeneraal
af.summary: Adjunk-Opmetingsgeneraal in Mmabatho om registerdienste te bestuur en om die ondersoek, argivering en heffing van kadastrale dokumente op SMS-vlak 13 te oorsien.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 7) soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), spesifiek 'n vierjaar B- of BSc-graad in Geomatics / Landmeting of verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasies en 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Toelatingsertifikaat tot die SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien is. Geregistreer as 'n Professionele Landmeter by die South African Geomatics Council. Geregistreer as 'n Seksionele Titels-praktisyn kragtens Artikel 5(2) van die Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n landmetingsomgewing. Toepaslike na-registrasie-ervaring in kadastrale landmeting. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika. Goed bestuur en Batho Pele-beginsels. Arbeids- en dienswetgewing. Public Service Regulations, 2016 (soos gewysig). Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Transformasie van die Openbare Diens. Employment Equity Act, 1998. Deeds Registries Act, 1937. Land Survey Act, 1997. Sectional Titles Act, 1986. South African Geomatics Professions Act, 2013. South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, 2003. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, 2013. Mining Titles Registration Act, 1967. Ander, alle ander eiendomsverwante wetgewing, insluitend ou-orde wetgewing en ordonnansies. Proklamasies en beleid van toepassing op Land Administration, Land Measurement Standards, en Land Information Systems. Internasionale konvensies oor grondbeleid en geografiese inligtingsbestuur. Kadastrale opmetingskennis. Tegniese stelselkennis. Kadastrale ruimtelike inligtingskennis. Kennis van Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems en Geographical Information Management. Kennis van vooruitgang in tegnologie nuttig vir die kadastrale opmetingstelsel. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Regeringstelsels en -strukture. Regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse. Programopstelling proses. Begrip van die bestuursinligting en formele verslagdoeningstelsel. Hantering van wangedrag. Interne beheer en risikobestuur. Projekbestuurbeginsels en -nutsgoedere. Die politieke landskap van Suid-Afrika. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Geskil- en konflikbestuur. Tydbestuur. Rekenaarprogrammatuur. Projekbestuur. Beplanning. Spanbestuur. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Hulpbronbeplanning en -organisering. Besigheid.
