af.duties: Bestuur die verskaffing van registerdienste. Oorsien die ontvangs en versending van kadastrale dokumente wat vir ondersoek en goedkeuring ingedien word. Verseker dat die nodige kantoorfooie betaal is voor die aanvaarding van kadastrale dokumente in die stelsel. Oorsien die argivering van alle dokumente. Oorsien die instandhouding van die kadastrale korrespondensie-lêerstelsel. Oorsien die lewer van boodedienste. Bestuur die lewer van eerste- en tweedevlak-ondersoekdienste. Oorsien die toekenning van grondeenheid-nommers. Verseker tegniese nakoming van kadastrale dokumente. Verifieer nuwe kadastrale dokumente in verhouding tot ouer-eiendomsinligting. Oorsien die ondersoek en goedkeuring/afwysing van alle kadastrale dokumente wat deur Professionele Landmeters voorberei en ingedien is. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeters en regeringsamptenare. Rapporteer maandeliks oor direktoraatvooruitgang soos vereis. Ken en pas alle toepaslike grondbestuurswetgewing, beleid en prosedures toe. Kommunikeer alle toepaslike nuwe bestuursbesluite, beleid en inligting weekliks aan personeel. Lewer en fasiliteer professionele advies vir grondhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Ontvang versoeke om grondhervormings bystand soos en wanneer vereis. Verskaf en oorsien professionele adviesdienste vir grondhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Doen navorsing oor grondhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Beplan die vereiste grondeenheid-grensondersoek wanneer vereis. Genereer verslae vir grondhervormingsondersteuning volgens bevindings en beleid. Dien verslae oor grondhervormingsbevindings in na afhandeling. Raadpleeg geïnteresseerde en geraakte partye by grondhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Verseker dat die bakens wat op 'n staatsopmeting betrekking het, uitgewys en deur die toepaslike amptenare insluitend die begunstigdes waar van toepassing, aanvaar is voor die goedkeuring van die kadastrale dokumente. Oorsien en verskaf professionele advies oor die kadastrale stelsel en bestaande en voorgestelde kadastrale dokumentasie. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeters, regeringsamptenare en staatsorgane. Verskaf terugvoer oor voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente aan enige bevoegde gesag wat bemagtig is om 'n reg tot die gebruik van grond vir 'n spesifieke doel te verleen of goed te keur. Bystand verleen met die interpretasie en regtelike implikasies van bestaande en voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente wat in 'n Deeds Registry geregistreer is of gaan word. Verskaf reaksies op litigasie-dokumentasie, insluitend verslae aan die hof met betrekking tot bestaande of voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente. Skakel met die Registrar of Deeds en amptenare van die Deeds Registry om te verseker dat kadastrale dokumente wat in die kantoor van die Opmetingsgeneraal goedgekeur is, registreerbaar is en harmonieuse toepassing van die kadastrale stelsel te verseker. Skakel met vrywillige geomatics-organisasies en professionele liggame in die bou-omgewingsektor. Reageer op enige presidensiële hullynversoek met betrekking tot die bevoegdhede en regsgebied van die kantoor waarin die amptenaar diens doen. Skakel met lede van die publiek namens die Opmetingsgeneraal oor komplekse of ongewone grondeenheid-grens- of eiendomswetgewing-verwante aangeleenthede. Skakel met bewaarders van geo-ruimtelike inligting wat óf Kadastrale Ruimtelike Inligting ondersteun óf daarvan afhanklik is. Ondersteun die opleiding en ontwikkeling van amptenare in die kadastrale stelselomgewing. Oorsien die onderneming van veldopmetings vir verifiëring van opmetings, geskilbeslegting en inspeksies. Toets 'n opmeting vir korrektheid, akkuraatheid of egtheid in ooreenstemming met wetlike bepalings, indien redes vir twyfel bestaan. Neem nodige stappe in verband met 'n opmeting wat vir korrektheid, akkuraatheid of egtheid getoets is, wanneer vereis. Berei en dien 'n verslag in verband met 'n aansoek by 'n hof voor, indien as wenslik beskou. Ondemeem veldopmetings om grense van staatsgrondeiendomme te identifiseer om grensgeskille op te los.

zu.title: oSekela Mqondisi-Wokuhlolwa Komhlaba
zu.summary: oSekela Mqondisi-Wokuhlolwa Komhlaba eMmabatho ukuphatha izinsizakusebenza zeregistry nokubuka ucwaningo lwemibhalo yecadastral, ukugcina ukuqoshwa kwayo nokuyiqoqa imali ezingeni leSMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 nenesifundo esingaphansi kwesiqu (NQF Level 7) njengoba somisiwe i-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ikakhulukazi idigri yeminyaka emine ye-B noma iBSc Degree ku-Geomatics / Surveying noma izifundo ezihlobene nayo ezingalinganayo nesitifiketi seNyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) esinikelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Abhalwe njengo-Professional Land Surveyar e-South African Geomatics Council. Abhalwe njengo-Sectional Titles Practitioner ngokwesigaba 5(2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Okuncane iminyaka engu-5 yohluva ezingeni eliphakathi noma eliphezulu lobaphathi emkhakheni we-Land Surveying. Ulwazi oluhambisana nobuhlakani bokubhalwa esikhundleni ocwaningweni lwecadastral. Ilelesi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: IsiMthethosisekelo se-Riphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika. Imigomo emihle yokubusa kanye nemigomo ye-Batho Pele. Umthetho Wabasebenzi Nosebenze. Imithetho Yomphakathi, 2016 (njengesilungisiwe). Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1999. Ukuguqulwa Komphakathi. Umthetho Wokulingana Kuhluva, 1998. Umthetho Wokuqoshwa Kwamadeed, 1937. Umthetho Wokuholwa Komhlaba, 1997. Umthetho Wama-Sectional Titles, 1986. Umthetho Wemisebenzi ye-Geomatics eNingizimu Afrika, 2013. Umthetho Wokwaziswa Kolwazi Olusesikhundleni eNingizimu Afrika, 2003. Umthetho Wokuhlelwa Kolwazi kanye Nokuphathwa Komhlaba, 2013. Umthetho Wokuqoshwa Kwezihloko ZokuMbathwa, 1967. Ezinye, konke okunye umthetho ohlobene nepropathi, okuhlanganisa umthetho wedlo nelawula. Isimemezelo kanye nemigomo esebenza ekuPhathweni Komhlaba, Izilinganiso Zokulinganisa Umhlaba, kanye Nezinhlelo Zolwazi Ngomhlaba. Izivumelano Zamazwe Ngomhlaba kanye nokuPhathwa Kwaziswa Ngobuhlelokwenhlokweni. Ulwazi Ngocwaningo Lwecadastral. Ulwazi Lwesistimu Yobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi Ngolwazi Olusesikhundleni Emtatsheni weCadastral. Ulwazi Lwezinhlelo Zolwazi Ngomhlaba, iziNhlelo ZokuPhatha Umhlaba kanye NokuPhathwa Kwaziswa Ngobuhlelokwenhlokweni. Ulwazi Ngokuqhamuka Kobuchwepheshe okuwusizo eSistimini Yocwaningo Lwecadastral. Ukuphathwa kokuQashwa kanye NokuQapha. Izinhlelo kanye nezakhiwo zahulumeni. Inqubo YokuThatha Izinqumo Hulumeni. Inqubo YokuHlela Izinhlela. UkuQonda kolwazi Lokuphatha kanye nesistimu esemthethweni yokubika. Ukubhekana Nobugebengu. Ukulawula Ngaphakathi kanye NokuPhathwa kengozi. Imigomo Yamaphrojekthi kanye Namathuluzi. Isimo sezombusazwe saseNingizimu Afrika. Amakhono Ahlobene Nomsebenzi: Izindaba Ezihle Zomuntu Nomuntu. Ukuxhumana Okuhle (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuxazulula Izinkinga kanye Nokuthatha Izinqumo. Ukuphathwa Koxakwanoxakwano. Ukuphathwa Isikhathi. Isofthiwe Yekhomphyutha. Ukuphathwa Amaphrojekthi. Ukuhlela. Ukuphathwa Iqembu. UkuQagela Imali Yesabelo. Ukuhlela kanye NokuHlela Izinsiza. Ibhidinesi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakusebenza zeregistry. Buka ukwamukelwa nokuthunyelwa kwemibhalo yecadastral enikelwe ukuze ihlolwe futhi ivunyelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimali ezidingekayo zefulethi zikhokhelwe ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwemibhalo yecadastral esistimini. Buka ukugcinwa kwayo yonke imibhalo. Buka ukugcinwa kwe-fayela lezincwadi zecadastral. Buka ukunikezwa kwezinsizakusebenza zomthumeli. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakusebenza zokuholwa okulingana nokuholwa okwesibili. Buka ukwabiwa kwezinamba zamaphesenti omhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuzwilantephu kokuhambisana nobuchwepheshe kwemibhalo yecadastral. Qinisekisa imibhalo entsha yecadastral ebandakanya ulwazi lwe-parent property. Buka ukuholwa kanye nokuvunyelwa noma ukwenqatshwa kwayo yonke imibhalo yecadastral elungisiwe futhi inikelwe ngu-Professional Land Surveyors. Nikeza izeluleko zobuhlakani ku-Professional Land Surveyors kanye nabasebenzi bahulumeni. Bika inqubo yedirekthathi njalo ngenyanga njengoba kudingeka. Yazi futhi usebenzise yonke imithetho, imigomo kanye nezinqubo ezihlobene nokuphathwa komhlaba. Yezisa yonke izinqumo ezintsha zokuphatha, imigomo nolwazi kubasebenzi njalo ngesonto. Nikeza futhi wenze kubalulekile izeluleko zobuhlakani zamaphrojekthi okulungiswa komhlaba kanye nezemibhalo zesizwe. Yamukela izicelo zosizo lokulungiswa komhlaba lapho kudingeka khona. Nikeza futhi ubuke izinsizakusebenza zezeluleko zobuhlakani zamaphrojekthi okulungiswa komhlaba kanye nezemibhalo zesizwe. Yenza ucwaningo ngamaphrojekthi okulungiswa komhlaba kanye nezemibhalo zesizwe. Hlela ucwaningo oludingekayo lwemida yamaphesenti omhlaba lapho kudingeka khona. Khipha imibalo yokwesekwa kokulungiswa komhlaba ngokwesiphakamiso kanye nengumthetho. Thumela imibalo mayelana nokutholakile kokulungiswa komhlaba lapho kuqediwa khona. Xenela kubaphathi abathakazelwe nabanomthelela kwamaphrojekthi okulungiswa komhlaba kanye nezemibhalo zesizwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi amabhodo ahlobene nesimibhalo sesizwe abonisiwe futhi amukelwe abasebenzi abahlobene kuhlanganise nalabo bazuzo lapho kusebenza khona ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa kwemibhalo yecadastral. Buka futhi nikeza izeluleko zobuhlakani ngesistimu yecadastral kanye nemibhalo yecadastral ekhona noma eceliwe. Nikeza izeluleko zobuhlakani ku-Professional Land Surveyors, abasebenzi bahulumeni kanye namagungu asezwe. Nikeza umbiko mayelana nemibhalo yecadastral eceliwe kunoma iyiphi igunya elinamandla okunikela noma ukuvumela ilungelo lokusetshenziswa komhlaba ngenjongo ethile. Siza ngokuqonda kanye nokuthi ithini ngomthetho imibhalo yecadastral ekhona noma eceliwa, okuvele kuqoshiwe noma kuzoqoshwa kwi-Deeds Registry. Nikeza izimpendulo zoshintsho lwemibhalo yeswe, okuhlanganisa nemibalo enkathuni yezinkantolo mayelana nemibhalo yecadastral ekhona noma eceliwe. Xhumana no-Registrar of Deeds kanye nabasebenzi be-Deeds Registry ukuze qinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo yecadastral evunyelwe kumnyango we-Surveyor-General iyakwazi ukuqoshwa futhi qinisekise ukusetshenziswa okuhambisanayo kwesistimu yecadastral. Xhumana namagungu we-geomatics okuzithandayo kanye namagungu obuhlakani esigabeni sezokwakha. Phendula kunoma yisiphi isicelo esivela kwilayini esikhulu sesikhulu esihlobene namakhono kanye nendawo yokusebenza kwezinkundla lapho khona lowo muntu enza umsebenzi. Xhumana namalungu omphakathi ngokwesibongo somsunguli we-Surveyor-General ngemibuzo eyinkimbinkimbi noma engajwayelekile ngemida yamaphesenti omhlaba noma ngomthetho wepropathi. Xhumana nalabo abagcina ulwazi lwe-geo-spatial olusekela noma oluthembela kuko ulwazi lwe-Cadastral Spatial Information. Sekela ukuqeqeshwa kanye nokuqanjwa kwabasebenzi esimeni sesistimu yecadastral. Buka ukwenziwa kwemibhalo yesimibhalo sendawo ukuze kuhlolwe imibhalo yesimibhalo, ukuxazulula uxakwanoxakwano kanye nokuholwa. Hlolla isimibhalo mayelana nokulunga, ukuqinisekisa noma ukuqamba ngokwezomthetho, uma kukhona isizathu sokungabaza. Thatha isinyathelo esidingekayo esihlobene nesimibhalo esihlolwe ngokulunga, ukuqinisekisa noma ukuqamba, lapho kudingeka khona. Lungiselele futhi thumela imibalo esihlobene nesicelo enkathini, uma kubonakala kufaneleka. Yenza imibhalo yesimibhalo ukuze uhlonze imida yamaphropathi womhlaba wesizwe ukuxazulula izinkinga zemida.

xh.title: ISekela likaMlawuli-Jikelele wezoMlinganiselo
xh.summary: ISekela likaMlawuli-Jikelele wezoMlinganiselo e Mmabatho ukulawula iinkonzo zeregistry nokuqonda phezulu ukuhlolwa kwamaxwebhe e-cadastral, ukugcina iirekhodi nokuhlawulelwa kwemirhumo kwinqanaba le SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno esemgangathweni: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikhethi se Grade 12 nangaphezulu kwesiqu esingekho ngamabomvu (NQF Level 7) esamkelwe yi South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ngokukodwa i Degree yeminyaka emine ye B okanye i BSc kwi Geomatics / Surveying okanye izifundo ezilinganayo ezinxulumene nalo kwaye kufuneki inike isatifikethi se Nyukela (isatifikethi sokungena ngaphambili kwi SMS) ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Kufuneka abhalwe njengoMhloli weZwe oNgamandla kwi South African Geomatics Council. Kufuneka abhalwe njengoQeqeshwa we Sectional Titles ngokwesigaba 5(2) se Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Kufuneka abe nophuhliso olungenangamva eminyaka engu 5 kwinqanaba lokulawula eliphakathi neliqhekthesi kwindawo yoMlinganiselo weZwe. Kufuneka abe namava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwinKqubo yokulinganisa i-cadastral. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluxhumaniswa nomsebenzi: uMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika. ulawulo olulungileyo neenkusela zo MamaBase base Batho Pele. uMthetho weBase nemisebenzi. iZikhululo zokuLawula zeNkonzo yoLuntu, 2016 (njengoko zitshintshile). uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zoLuntu, 1999. uTshintsho lweNkonzo yoLuntu. uMthetho weQhinga lokuSebenza, 1998. uMthetho we Deeds Registries, 1937. uMthetho woMlinganiselo weZwe, 1997. uMthetho we Sectional Titles, 1986. uMthetho wamaPhethu e Geomatics eS aza Afrika, 2013. uMthetho weSouth African Spatial Data Infrastructure, 2003. uMthetho woCwangciso loMhlaba nokusebenzisa iNdlela yoMhlaba, 2013. uMthetho wokuBhalisa kweeMvzo zoKutsha kwenziwe, 1967. Kolunye uMthetho onxulumene nempahla, kuquka imithetho yakudlovo nemiGaqo. Izimemo neenqobo ezisebenza kuLawulo loMhlaba, iStandard zoMlinganiselo woMhlaba, iNkqubo zeNkcukacha ngomHlaba. iiNkqubo zoMhlaba zeNkcukacha nazo ngeLwazi loMhlaba ngoMhlaba. Ulwazi nokuLinganisa kweCadastral. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo eNgingqi. Ulwazi ngeNkcukacha yeNdawo eCadastral. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo zeNkcukacha zoMhlaba, iinkqubo zoLawulo lomHlaba noLawulo lweNkcukacha iNgcangcazelo nemoYili. Ulwazi ngophuhliso lobuChwepheshe obusize kwiNkqubo yokulinganisa iCadastral. uQqwphelo lomSebenzi nokuQqwalasela. iNkqubo neNkqubo zoLuntu. iNkqubo zoLuntu ezinqamlezа iziGqibo. iNkqubo yoBeka iNkqubo. uQondisiso lweNkqubo yoLawulo iNkcukacha nokuLungiselela iNkcukacha ngokoMthetho. ukuQwalasela okungalunganga. uLawulo lwaNgaphakathi noQqwphelo loThintelо. iNkusela zoLawula iNkqubo neziTyhidi. iPoliqi yoLuntu iNkqubo eMzantsi Afrika. Amandla awodwa axhumaniswa nomsebenzi: uQhagamshelwano oluhle lwantu. uQondisisе oluhle nokubhala (ngomlomo nangesibhelo). ukuSombulula iingxaki nokwenza iziGqibo. uLawulo lweengxaki noQhagamshelwano. uLawulo lweSikhathi. iSoftware yeKhompyutha. uLawulo lweProjekhthi. uLungelelwaniso. uLawulo loQembu. ukuQikelela iBajeti. uQqwphelo noLungelelwaniso lwethu nokoQongqotha iMpahla. iShishini.
xh.duties: Lawula ukubonelela kweekonzo zeregistry. Qonda phezulu ukwamkelwa nokuthunyelwa kwamaxwebhe e-cadastral afakiweyo ukuqwalaselwa nokuvunywa. Qinisekisa ukuba imirho ekantshi ihlawulwe ngaphambi kokwamkelwa kwamaxwebhe e-cadastral kule nkqubo. Qonda phezulu ukugcinwa kwayo onke amaxwebhe. Qonda phezulu ukugcinwa kwenkqubo yokuFayila izixushwa ezixhonywe kwi-cadastral. Qonda phezulu ukunikwa kweenkonzo zabathunywa. Lawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokuqala nasele nqanaba lesibini zokuqwalaselwa. Qonda phezulu ukwabiwa kwamagama abe ninawo umhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuzinza ngokomthetho ngokobuchwephesha amaxwebhe e-cadastral. Qinisekisa amaxwebhe e-cadastral amatsha ngokwengxaki yenkcukacha yempahla. Qonda phezulu ukuqwalaselwa nokuvunywa/ukuvalwa kwawo onke amaxwebhe e-cadastral alungiselwe nafakwe nguBahloli bomHlaba oNga mandla. Nikeza ingcebiso yobugcisa kuBahloli bomHlaba oNga mandla nakuBalawuli base urhulumente. ive nge nkqubo yonqamlezо ngeyam ukuba kuhlalwe kuxela ngenkqubo njengoko kufuneka. Qonda yaye usebenzise wonke umthetho oloyikho, iinkqobo neenkqubo ngolawulo bomHlaba. Xelela abasebenzi ngemigqibo yomlawulo amatsha, iinkqobo nolwazi ngesonto ngamnye. Nikeza yaye ulawule ingcebiso yobugcisa kuqoqosho lweeprojekthi zeLand Reform nokuqwalaselwa iisurvey zeLuntu. Thola iimfuno zosizo lweLand Reform njengoko kufunwa. Nikeza yaye ulawule iinkonzo zengcebiso zobugcisa ukwenzela iipropositi zikaLwazi yaza is iza kwiiprojekthi zikaLwazi nokoqwalaselwa iziSurvey zikorhulumente. Zungeza iingxelo neenkqubo ngokwemigaqo yasekuhlaleni. Yenza izicwangciso ngeenkcazelo ngomzila wolwazi lukaLwazi. Zii nkquba ngokusesikweni ngokubhala iingxelo ezixhumanayo nekwanqamlezana. Hluza izifundo ngokusesikweni mayelana neNkcazelo yeempahla nolwazi. Xela ngokwazi kweNkcazelo nokuqwalaselwa nokungenwa ngaphandle komsebenzi. Zii nkquba nokungenwa ngaphandle kweNkcazelo yeempahla neenkcazelo ngokusesikweni ezizesikweni. Zinikele kwizindulamthetho ekufunyenwe ngqo umgaqo-nkqubo ulawulo lweNkcazelo yeempahla. Сombulula iingxaki ngokuqondisisa nokukhetha izigqibo zolawulo eziya kwindlela yokwenza umsebenzi wekhompyutha. Zii nkquba iingxelo nokuqamba izindulamthetho ngokusesikweni ngokuqonda izindulamthetho. Сombulula iingxaki ngokuqondisisa nokukhetha izigqibo zolawulo ezinzima ezingajelwayo okanye ezahlukileyo ezingadli ngokomhlaba namanye amagunya ezinye izindulamthetho ngokomthetho. Zisenze izindulamthetho kwabalinganisi base mthethweni nabaLimi bomhlaba beNkcukacha ngokomhlaba. Сombulula iingxaki ngokuqondisisa nokuphendula iingxelo ezifunwa ngokuqondisisa nokuvakalisa uLwazi oluPheleleyo. Сombulula iingxaki ngokuqondisisa nokugcina amaxwebhe e-cadastral ngokuqondisisa nokuhlangabezana nokoqwalaselwa okusesikweni. Сombulula iingxaki ngokuqondisisa nokwamkela iimveliso ezisesikweni ezingafunwa ngokusesikweni kwabambeleli bomThetho nakulawulo lwamaxwebhe okuhambelana ne-cadastral. Сombulula iingxaki ngokuqondisisa nokusingathwa kwamaxwebhe e-cadastral ngokusesikweni nakumthetho oqinisekisa izixhobo ezahlukeneyo ezingafakwanga ngokusesikweni. Сombulula iingxaki ngokuqondisisa nokuxela ngokusesikweni nangokomthetho ukuba umntu uyayazi imigaqo yokulawula nokuhamba kweekhonzo ngokomthetho oqinisekisa ukuba ngumsebenzi osesikweni. Сombulula iingxaki ngokuqondisisa nokuphendula ngokusesikweni ngokomgaqo-nkqubo weNkcazelo neNkqubo yoluntu ngokweNkcukacha.

jobs.title: Deputy Surveyor-general
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Deputy Surveyor-General sought to oversee registry services, cadastral document processing and archiving at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Bloemfontein.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and an undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) as recognised by South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), specifically a four-year B or BSc Degree in Geomatics / Surveying or related equivalent qualifications and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council. Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5(2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle/senior managerial level in a Land Surveying environment. Appropriate post registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: The Constitution of the Republic of South Africa. Good governance and Batho Pele principles. Labour and Employment Legislation. Public Service Regulations, 2016 (as amended). Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Transformation of the Public Service. Employment Equity Act, 1998. Deeds Registries Act, 1937. Land Survey Act, 1997. Sectional Titles Act, 1986. South African Geomatics Professions Act, 2013. South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, 2003. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, 2013. Mining Titles Registration Act, 1967. Other, all other property related legislation, including old order legislation and ordinances. Proclamation and policies applicable to Land Administration, Land Measurement Standards, and Land Information Systems. International Conventions on land policy and geographical information management. Cadastral Survey knowledge. Technical System knowledge. Cadastral Spatial Information knowledge. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with misconduct. Internal control and risk management. Project management principles and tools. The political landscape of South Africa. Job related skills: Good interpersonal relations. Good communication (verbal and written). Problem solving and decision-making. Dispute and conflict management. Time management. Computer software. Project management. Planning. Team management. Budget forecasting. Resource planning and organising. Business.
jobs.duties: Manage the provisioning of registry services. Oversee the receipt and dispatch of cadastral documents submitted for examination and approval. Ensure that the necessary fees of office have been paid prior to the acceptance of cadastral documents into the system. Oversee the archiving of all documents. Oversee the maintenance of the cadastral correspondence filing system. Oversee the rendering of messenger services. Manage the rendering of first and second level examination services. Oversee the allocation of land parcel numbers. Ensure technical compliance of cadastral documents. Verify new cadastral documents in relation to parent property information. Oversee the examination and approval / rejection of all cadastral documents prepared and submitted by Professional Land Surveyors. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors and government officials. Report on directorate progress monthly as required. Know and apply all relevant land administration legislation, policies and procedures. Communicate all relevant new management decisions, policies and information to staff on weekly basis. Render and facilitate professional advice for land reform projects and state surveys. Receive requests for land reform assistance as and when required. Provide and oversee professional advisory services for land reform projects and state surveys. Perform research on land reform projects and state surveys. Plan the required land parcel boundary investigation when required. Generate reports for land reform support according to findings and policy. Submit reports on land reform findings upon finalisation. Consult with interested and affected parties to land reform projects and state surveys. Ensure that the beacons relating to a state survey have been pointed out and accepted by the relevant officials including the beneficiaries where applicable prior to the approval of the cadastral documents. Oversee and render professional advice on the cadastral system and existing and proposed cadastral documentation. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors, government officials and organs of state. Provide feedback on proposed cadastral documents to any competent authority empowered to grant or approve a right to the use of land for a specified purpose. Assist with the interpretation and legal implications for existing and proposed cadastral documents, which have been or are to be registered in a Deeds Registry. Provide responses to litigation documentation, including reports to the court relating to existing or proposed cadastral documents. Liaise with the Registrar of Deeds and officials from the Deeds Registry to ensure cadastral documents approved in the office of the Surveyor- General are registerable and ensure harmonious application of the cadastral system. Liaise with voluntary geomatics organisations and professional bodies in the built environment sector. Respond to any presidential hotline request relating to the competencies and area of jurisdiction of the office in which the official serves. Liaise with members of the public on behalf of the Surveyor- General on complex or unusual land parcel boundary or property legislation- related matters. Liaise with custodians of geo-spatial information that either support or depend upon Cadastral Spatial Information. Support the training and development of officials in the cadastral system environment. Oversee the undertaking of field surveys for verification of surveys, dispute resolution and inspections. Test a survey for correctness, accuracy or authenticity in accordance with legal provisions, if reason for doubt exists. Take necessary action in connection with a survey tested for correctness, accuracy or authenticity, when required. Prepare and submit a report in connection with an application to a court, if deemed desirable. Undertake field surveys to identify boundaries of state land properties to resolve boundary disputes.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Kekana Tel No: (012) 312 8344
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 136 Charlotte Maxeke Street, SA Eagle Building, Bloemfontein, 9300 or by email to Post189@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males and African, Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onder-Surveyor-generaal
af.summary: Onder-Surveyor-generaal gesoek om registratuurdienste, die verwerking van kadastrale dokumente en argivering by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Bloemfontein te oorsien.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Grade 12-sertifikaat en 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Level 7) soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) hê, spesifiek 'n vierjarige B- of BSc-graad in Geomatics / Surveying of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies, asook 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien moet word. Geregistreer as 'n Professionele Landmeter by die South African Geomatics Council. Geregistreer as 'n Sective Titles Practitioner ingevolge Section 5(2) van die Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum van 5 jaar ervaring op middel-/senior bestuursvlak in 'n Land Surveying-omgewing. Toepaslike na-registrasie-ervaring in kadastrale opmeting. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Die Constitution of the Republic of South Africa. Goeie bestuur en Batho Pele-beginsels. Arbeids- en indiensnemingswetgewing. Public Service Regulations, 2016 (soos gewysig). Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Transformasie van die Openbare Diens. Employment Equity Act, 1998. Deeds Registries Act, 1937. Land Survey Act, 1997. Sectional Titles Act, 1986. South African Geomatics Professions Act, 2013. South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, 2003. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, 2013. Mining Titles Registration Act, 1967. Ander, alle ander eiendomverwante wetgewing, insluitend ou-orde wetgewing en verordeninge. Proklamasies en beleide van toepassing op Land Administration, Land Measurement Standards en Land Information Systems. Internasionale konvensies oor landbeleid en geografiese inligtingsbestuur. Kennis van kadastrale opmeting. Kennis van tegniese stelsels. Kennis van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting. Kennis van Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems en Geographical Information Management. Kennis van tegnologiese vooruitgang wat nuttig is vir die kadastrale opmetingstelsel. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Regeringstelsels en -strukture. Regering se besluitnemingsprosesse. Programopstelproses. Begrip van die bestuursinligting- en formele verslagdoeningstelsel. Hantering van wangedrag. Interne beheer en risikobestuur. Beginsels en instrumente van projeksbestuur. Die politieke landskap van Suid-Afrika. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Geskil- en konflikbestuur. Tydbestuur. Rekenaarsagteware. Projeksbestuur. Beplanning. Spanbestuur. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Hulpbronbeplanning en -organisering. Besigheid.
af.duties: Bestuur die voorsiening van registratuurdienste. Oorsien die ontvangs en versending van kadastrale dokumente wat vir ondersoek en goedkeuring ingedien is. Verseker dat die nodige kantoorfooie betaal is voordat kadastrale dokumente in die stelsel aanvaar word. Oorsien die argivering van alle dokumente. Oorsien die instandhouding van die kadastrale korrespondensielêerstelsel. Oorsien die lewer van boodskapperdienste. Bestuur die lewer van eerste- en tweedevlak ondersoekdienste. Oorsien die toekenning van landperseelnommers. Verseker tegniese nakoming van kadastrale dokumente. Verifieer nuwe kadastrale dokumente in verhouding tot ouer eiendomsinligting. Oorsien die ondersoek en goedkeuring / afwysing van alle kadastrale dokumente wat deur Professionele Landmeters opgestel en ingedien is. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeters en regeringsamptenare. Doen maandeliks verslag oor die vordering van die direktoraat soos vereis. Ken en pas alle relevante landadministrasie-wetgewing, beleide en prosedures toe. Kommunikeer alle relevante nuwe bestuursbesluite, beleide en inligting weekliks aan persone. Lewer en fasiliteer professionele advies vir landhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Ontvang versoeke vir landhervormingsbystand soos wanneer dit vereis word. Verskaf en oorsien professionele adviesdienste vir landhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Doen navorsing oor landhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Beplan die vereiste ondersoek na landperseklyne wanneer nodig. Genereer verslae vir landhervormingssteun volgens bevindings en beleid. Dien verslae oor landhervormingsbevindings in na afhandeling. Raadpleeg belanghebbende en geraakte partye by landhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Verseker dat die bakens wat op 'n staatsopmeting betrekking het, uitgewys en deur die relevante amptenare, insluitend die begunstigdes waar van toepassing, aanvaar is voordat die kadastrale dokumente goedgekeur word. Oorsien en verskaf professionele advies oor die kadastrale stelsel en bestaande en voorgestelde kadastrale dokumentasie. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeters, regeringsamptenare en staatsorgane. Verskaf terugvoer oor voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente aan enige bevoegde gesig wat bemagtig is om 'n reg tot die gebruik van grond vir 'n spesifieke doel te verleen of goed te keur. Help met die interpretasie en regsimplikasies vir bestaande en voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente wat in 'n Deeds Registry geregistreer is of sal word. Verskaf antwoorde op litigasiedokumentasie, insluitend verslae aan die hof rakende bestaande of voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente. Skakel met die Registrar of Deeds en amptenare van die Deeds Registry om te verseker dat kadastrale dokumente wat in die kantoor van die Surveyor-Generaal goedgekeur is, registreerbaar is en om die harmonieuse toepassing van die kadastrale stelsel te verseker. Skakel met vrywillige geomatics-organisasies en professionele liggame in die bou-omgewingsektor. Reageer op enige presidensiële hotlynversoeke wat verband hou met die bevoegdhede en regsgebied van die kantoor waarin die beampte diens doen. Skakel namens die Surveyor-Generaal met lede van die publiek oor ingewikkelde of ongewone landperseklyn- of eiendomswetgewingverwante aangeleenthede. Skakel met bewaarders van geo-ruimtelike inligting wat óf kadastrale ruimtelike inligting ondersteun óf daarvan afhanklik is. Ondersteun die opleiding en ontwikkeling van amptenare in die kadastrale stelselomgewing. Oorsien die onderneming van veldopmetings vir die verifikasie van opmetings, geskilbeslegting en inspeksies. Toets 'n opmeting vir korrektheid, akkuraatheid of egtheid in ooreenstemming met regsbepalings, indien daar rede vir twyfel bestaan. Onderneem nodige stappe in verband met 'n opmeting wat vir korrektheid, akkuraatheid of egtheid getoets is, wanneer vereis. Berei voor en dien 'n verslag in verband met 'n aansoek by 'n hof in, indien dit as wenslik beskou word. Onderneem veldopmetings om klyne van staatseiendomme te identifiseer om klyngeskille op te los.

zu.title: Osobala ihhovisi likaNoMlingani weZwe
zu.summary: Kufunwa uNoMlingani weZwe ongumongameli ohlolle izinsiza zokubhalisa kwemitapo yolwazi, ukucubungula amadokhumenti we-cadastral nokugcina emtapolwazini eDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development eBloemfontein.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane kakhulu: Abafaka izicelo kumele benesatifikethi seGrade 12 nendima yokufunda ephansi (NQF Level 7) evunyiwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ikakhulukazi idigri yeminyaka yane ye-B noma i-BSc Degree kwi-Geomatics / Surveying noma iziqu ezingabalinganayo nokuthi kufakwe isatifikethi se-Nyukela (isatifikethi sokungena ku-SMS) ngaphambi kokwethiwa. Kumele abhalwe njengoMbonisi weZwe osebenzayo ne-South African Geomatics Council. Kumele abhalwe njengomenzi womsebenzi we-Sectional Titles ngokwesigaba 5(2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Okuncane iminyaka eyi-5 yohlelo lokusebenza ezingeni eliphakathi/phezulu loluphathe ekondleni lokuMlinganiswa KwabaMhlabathi. Uhlelo oluhambisana nesikhathi esedlule kokubhaliswa kokusebenza ekusingathweni kwe-cadastral. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: IsiMthetho-sisekelo sazeRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuphathwa kahle kanye nemigomo yamaBatho Pele. IsiMthetho sokuSebenza kanye NesabaLuli. Imithetho yonke yesiNdingo sikaZwelonke, 2016 (njengokuhlolwa). IsiMthetho sokuQondisa kweMali kaZwelonke, 1999. Ukuguqulwa kweNkonzo yaZwelonke. IsiMthetho sokuqaliswa kokuqhuba emsebenzini, 1998. IsiMthetho se-Deeds Registries, 1937. IsiMthetho sokuMlinganiswa kweziMango, 1997. IsiMthetho we-Sectional Titles, 1986. IsiMthetho se-South African Geomatics Professions, 2013. IsiMthetho se-South African Spatial Data Infrastructure, 2003. IsiMthetho se-Spatial Planning and Land Use Management, 2013. IsiMthetho se-Mining Titles Registration, 1967. Okunye, sonke esinye isimemo esihlobene nendlu, okuhlanganisa imithetho edala futhi eyalawulo. Isimemo kanye nemigobo ekuhlelekile eQondisweni kwaBantu, iziNani zokuQamba kweMango, kanye nezinhlelo zezimange zomhlabathi. Izivumelwano zeZwe ngokumgomo womhlabathi kanye nokuqondisa ukwaziswa kwezwe. Ulwazi lokuMlinganiswa kwe-Cadastral. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo eziNgcwele. Ulwazi lweSpatial Information we-Cadastral. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo zokwaziswa kweMango, izinhlelo zoLawulo lweMango kanye nokuQondisa Ulwazi lweZwe. Ulwazi ngeqhaza lesiNzululwazi ebokeza isiNxozi se-Cadastral. Ukuphathwa kolwazi olufunwayo kanye nokubonwa kwemitapo. Izinhlelo nezakhiwo kahulumeni. Inqubo yokweqa kwemitapo yohulumeni. Ukumiswa kohlulelo lwemihango. Ukusizwa kwemitapo kahulumeni. Ukumiswa kwemitapo ehlehlile. Ukucaciswa komphumela wesimemo esibhaliwe. Ukuphathwa kokuqedwa kwemibango yangaphakathi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamaphoyinti kanye nokuqondiswa kwezinsiza. Uhlelo lokuqamba isimemo nesixazululi. Isibhaxa sokubhala (ngomlomo nangolimi). Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqeda isimemo. Ukuphathwa kokungaboni emehlweni kanye nokusixabanisi esiswayo esisabalele. Isikhathi sokuQedwa kweNyanga. IsiNxozi sesiNzululwazi esakhiwa isandla. IsiNxozi seNkulumo eGaxenye noma yonke iminikelo yesimemo. IsiNxozi seHhovisi lesiNketho. Ukwaziswa ngezinsiza namaphoyinti. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokusesikhatini. Ukuphathwa kolwazi nokuNika amandla. Ukubhuka kokuHlela kweMabutsu. Ukuphila kokuhola ibhasikidi. Ukuphepha nokubona izinsiza. Business.
zu.duties: Phatha ukubuyiselela kwezinsiza zomtapo. Qapha ukwamukelwa nokuthumelwa kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral abhaliselwe ukuqashelwa nokuvuma. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimali ezifunekayo zihhovisi zikhokhelwe ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral esinhlelweni. Qapha ukugcinwa kwawo wonke amadokhumenti. Qapha ukugcinwa kwekhasi lokubhalela le-cadastral. Qapha ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomyalezane. Phatha ukunika izinsiza zokuqala kanti futhi nokwesibili sokuhlola. Qapha ukwabelwa kwamanani omhlaba. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa okusebenzayo kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral. Hlola amadokhumenti ama-cadastral amasha ebanda lolwazi ngaphakathi kwalawo mhlaba. Qapha ukuqashelwa nokuvunjiswa / ukuphikiswa kwawo wonke amadokhumenti e-cadastral alungiswe futhi athunyelwe nguMbonisi weZwe osebenzayo. Nikeza izeluleko eziNgcwele kubaBonisi beZwe basebenzayo nezikhulu kahulumeni. Bika inqubo yehhovisi nyanga zonke njengokudingekayo. Qonda futhi usebenzise sonke imithetho ephathelene nokuLawulwa kwaBantu, imigomo kanye nemiyalelo. Yazisa wonke umhloli ohlezi lushelelayo izinqumbo ezitsha zokuphatha, imigomo nolwazi ohlelweni lwamalunga. Pheleleza futhi uhlele izeluleko noma nguBunhloli bokuvakatshiswa kwamaphoyinti ahlobene nalawo mhlaba nokwesabalela kwelinye ihhovisi lombuso. Vumela izinsiza zokufaka izicelo zomhlaba njalo uma kudingeka. Nikeza futhi uqaphe izinsiza zobunhloli eziphelele kumaphoyinti ahlobene nalowo mhlaba nakumahhovisi omphakathi e-survey. Landisa amaphoyinti ahlobene nalowo mhlaba kanye nokuSetshenziswa kwehle kukaBaningi. Tadisha kumaphoyinti ahlobene nokusetshenziswa komhlaba nasemahhovini kahulumeni. Cacisa imigomo yemizila yalowo mhlaba ekuxazululweni izinkinga ngokulandelwa kwemigomo. Hlela imigomo yemiphumela ngokuthola imiphumela kumaphoyinti asetshenziswa ekuhulumeni. Thumela imibiko enguHlele kokuQedwa kokuHlola kumaphoyinti ahlobene nokuSetshenziswa komhlaba. Boleke nabantu abanomthelela ekuphatheni komhlaba nasemahhovini kaBhudi ephathelene nalawe mhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkomba ezihlobene nesayensi kahulumeni zivezwe futhi zamukelwa iziphathimandla ezifanele okuhlanganisa nabanikazi bawo uma kunesidingo ngaphambi kokuvunywa kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral. Qapha futhi unike izeluleko ezisebenzayo esinhlelweni se-cadastral namadokhumenti e-cadastral asanda kuthiwa asetshenziswe. Nikeza izeluleko eziNgcwele kubaBonisi beZwe basebenzayo, izikhulu kahulumeni nezinhlangano zombuso. Nikeza imiphumela yamadokhumenti e-cadastral asanda kuthiwa kusetshenziswe kunoma yimuphi umgumango onamandla okuvuma noma ukuvumela ilungelo lokusetshenziswa komhlaba ngesizathu esithile. Siza ngokuhumusha kanye nezimpumputhe eNgcwele zamadokhumenti e-cadastral angasetshenziswa kumtapo we-Deeds. Nikeza izimpendulo ezisuka ekuxazululweni kwemibuzo, kuhlanganise imibiko eNkundleni ephathelene namadokhumenti e-cadastral akhona noma asanda kuthiwa kusetshenziswe. Xhumana noMbhalisi we-Deeds nezikhulu evela eDeeds Registry ukugunyaza ukuthi amadokhumenti e-cadastral avunyiwe ehhovisi likaSurveyor-General abhaliseka futhi ukugunyaza ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelisayo kwe-cadastral system. Xhumana nenhlangano ezizimele geomatics nabanikazi bamaphoyinti ezingxenyeni zokwakha ezinkundleni zokuSetshenziswa. Phendula nakho yikuphi yisicelo sehotline sikaMongameli esihlobene namandla nendawo yolawulo yehhovisi lapho isikhulu sikhonzake khona. Xhumana nabayini bentela ngombuso kaSurveyor-General ngokuqhubela phambili kwezinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi okuyilawo mhlaba okungalolunye udaba. Xhumana ngezinsiza zolwazi lwezwe ngezifundo eziyisibonakaliso ngemaphoyinti kahulumeni. Sekela ukuguliswa nokuhlela kwamandla izikhulu endaweni yokuLungiswa kokumiswa kwemitapo. Qapha imisebenzi yokuhlolwa kwemikhandlu nokuHlolwa kokuphumelelisa. Hlola noma ubuni lokuthi imisebenzi iyisibo kokuzenzakalela, ukuthi iyichene na, ngaphandle kokubhiyozela esukela esibukweni ngokuba yikho okungenza kuthiwa kungenwa yizindlela ezivela emthethweni. Yenza okudingekayo okuhlobene nesabelo seNkosi esihlolwe ukuthi sichasiswe ngokupheleleyo uma kudingwa isizathu sokungabaza ngempela. Lungisa futhi uthume imibiko ephathelene nesibonelo kundini, uma kuyisidingo. Yenza imisebenzi yokuhlolwa kokuhlongakho komhlaba ngokusabalalisa imikhandlu kahulumeni ezindaweni zabo nasezindaweni eziyingxenye yabo.

xh.title: USekela Mlawuli wezemilinganiselo
xh.summary: Kufunnekwa uSekela Mlawuli wezemilinganiselo ongazokuqonda iinkonzo zeregistri, ukucubungula amaxwebhu e-cadastral nokugcina iifayile kwisebe Lezulimo Londolozo nentsapho ezasekhaya eBloemfontein.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi kwesixhaso: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifiketi seBanga lesi-12 nangobuntu obungaphantsi kweziqu (NQF Level 7) njengoko kunakwa yiSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ngokukodwa iDigrizi yeB okanye iBSc Degree kwisikhathi seminyaka emine kwiGeomatics / Surveying okanye iziqu ezizakwelo ezinxulumene nazo nesatifiketi seNyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) esinikelwa phambi kokwamkelwa. Kufunke abhaliswe njengoMlinganiseli weZomhlaba oGqithisileyo kwiSouth African Geomatics Council. Kufunke abhaliswe njengoQeqeshwa weeCandelo zoBumini ngokwesigaba 5(2) seSectional Titles Act, 1986. Kufunke abe nokuhlolwa okuncedisa lweminyaka eyi-5 nangaphezulu kwindqanaba elingana nolawulo aphakathi / phezulu kwindawo yokulinganisa umhlaba. Ukuba nokuhlolwa okufanelekileyo kubhaliso ngemisebenzi yokulinganisa i-cadastral. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: uMgaqo-siseko weRiphabliki yaseSouth Africa. Ulawulo olulungileyo nemiqathango kaBatho Pele. Izicatshulwa ngomsebenzi nokwamkelwa kwisebe. Imigaqo yoNkonzo kaHulumeni, ka-2016 (njengoko ilungisiwe). uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhaphuliki, ka-1999. Uguqulo lweNkonzo kaHulumeni. uMthetho woLungelelwaniso loQasho, ka-1998. uMthetho beeRegistri zeSicelo, ka-1937. uMthetho woKulinganisa uMhlaba, ka-1997. Sectional Titles Act, ka-1986. South African Geomatics Professions Act, ka-2013. South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, ka-2003. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, ka-2013. Mining Titles Registration Act, ka-1967. Ezinye, yonke eminye imithetho enxulumene nepropati, kuquka imithetho yendlela yakudla nezikhululo. Isaziso nemigaqo ebandakanyekayo kuLawulo loMhlaba, iZilinganiselo ezingamanzi oLwazi loMhlaba. Iivishoni ezingamazwe ngamazwe malunga nomgaqo-mthetho wokulawula iinkcukacha zemveliso nezolimo. Ulwazi ngesixhobo esingamanzi esikwisikhokiyo se-cadastral. Ulwazi ngokulawula inkqubo yamafayile. Ulwazi lwezobunkanyi kwinkqubo yesikhokelo ngokulawulwa kwesiseko sendalo. Ulwazi ngokuqonda imiba ekwanikela isicatshulwa se-cadastral. Ulwazi olusebenza kwindlela yemisebenzi ekukhethwa iinkqubo. Ulwazi ngokuqonda indlela eziqhelanayo nezinto ezifunwa kwindlela yomsebenzi. Ukubeka ngqo iinkqubo kwimisebenzi. Isikhokelo esikusikweni nokuqonda iinkqubo zokwenza iimvisiswano. Ukuphathwa koxhaphakadi lwegosa liphakathi kwabasebenzi. Ukuqonda inqanaba elinganaso nokuqonda iinkqubo ezisemthethweni zokwenza iimiso. Ulwazi ngokudibanisa umhlaba welungelo. Ulwazi ngamagunya omtsha esikhokelo ngokubakho emhlabeni jikelele.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zeregistri. Qonda ukwamkelwa nokuthumela kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral anikelwa ukuba acutshungulwe avunywe. Qinisekisa ukuba izimali ezifunekayo ezisebenzayo ezihlawulwa zihlawulile phambi kokwamkelwa kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral ekuthunjweni kwawo kwinkqubo. Qonda ukugcina kwamaxwebhu onke. Qonda ukulondoloza inkqubo yefayile yokubhalelana eyi-cadastral. Qonda ukunikwa kweenkonzo zabathunywa. Lawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokuphonononga kobunyani nangaphezulu kokuqala nasekweni aqediweyo ekuqedeni iinkonzo. Qonda ukwaba amanani amaxwebhu e-cadastral ahambelana nolwazi lwendalo lomsuka. Qonda ukuphonononga nokuvuma / ukwala yonke amaxwebhu e-cadastral alungisiwe anikelwa nguBalinganiseli beZomhlaba oGqithisileyo. Nikeza ulwazi olugqithisileyo kuBalinganiseli beZomhlaba oGqithisileyo namagosa karhulumeni. Nika ingxelo ngeqhinga elithile qondo lenyanga ngokuba kuyimfuneko. Qonda yonke imithetho, imigaqo neenkqubo ezifaneleyo zolawulo loMhlaba kwaye uzisebenzise. Dalazela ulwazi olutsha olunxulumene nezigibo zolawulo, imigaqo nezazisi kwbasebenzi ngeveki nganye. Nikeza ulwazi oluqinisekisiweyo olubhekisa kumaphulo ezolimo kwaye ulungelelanise izicelo ezijoliswe kumaphulo ezolimo. Nikeza kwaye ulawule iinkonzo zokucebisa ezingcali kwimiphumo yezolimo kunye noqeqesho kwezolimo ekuqeqeshwa ngokusemthethweni.

jobs.title: Deputy Surveyor-general
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: The Department of Land Reform and Rural Development seeks a Deputy Surveyor-General for East London to oversee cadastral document examination, registry services and archiving at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and an undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) as recognised by South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), specifically a four-year B or BSc Degree in Geomatics / Surveying or related equivalent qualifications and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council. Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5(2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle / senior managerial level in a Land Surveying environment. Appropriate post registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: The Constitution of the Republic of South Africa. Good governance and Batho Pele principles. Labour and Employment Legislation. Public Service Regulations, 2016 (as amended). Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Transformation of the Public Service. Employment Equity Act, 1998. Deeds Registries Act, 1937. Land Survey Act, 1997. Sectional Titles Act, 1986. South African Geomatics Professions Act, 2013. South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, 2003. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, 2013. Mining Titles Registration Act, 1967. Other, all other property related legislation, including old order legislation and ordinances. Proclamation and policies applicable to Land Administration, Land Measurement Standards, and Land Information Systems. International Conventions on land policy and geographical information management. Cadastral Survey knowledge. Technical System knowledge. Cadastral Spatial Information knowledge. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with misconduct. Internal control and risk management. Project management principles and tools. The political landscape of South Africa. Job related skills: Good interpersonal relations. Good communication (verbal and written). Problem solving and decision-making. Dispute and conflict management. Time management. Computer software. Project management. Planning. Team management. Budget forecasting. Resource planning and organising. Business.
jobs.duties: Manage the provisioning of registry services. Oversee the receipt and dispatch of cadastral documents submitted for examination and approval. Ensure that the necessary fees of office have been paid prior to the acceptance of cadastral documents into the system. Oversee the archiving of all documents. Oversee the maintenance of the cadastral correspondence filing system. Oversee the rendering of messenger services. Manage the rendering of first and second level examination services. Oversee the allocation of land parcel numbers. Ensure technical compliance of cadastral documents. Verify new cadastral documents in relation to parent property information. Oversee the examination and approval/rejection of all cadastral documents prepared and submitted by Professional Land Surveyors. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors and government officials. Report on directorate progress monthly as required. Know and apply all relevant land administration legislation, policies and procedures. Communicate all relevant new management decisions, policies and information to staff on weekly basis. Render and facilitate professional advice for land reform projects and state surveys. Receive requests for land reform assistance as and when required. Provide and oversee professional advisory services for land reform projects and state surveys. Perform research on land reform projects and state surveys. Plan the required land parcel boundary investigation when required. Generate reports for land reform support according to findings and policy. Submit reports on land reform findings upon finalisation. Consult with interested and affected parties to land reform projects and state surveys. Ensure that the beacons relating to a state survey have been pointed out and accepted by the relevant officials including the beneficiaries where applicable prior to the approval of the cadastral documents. Oversee and render professional advice on the cadastral system and existing and proposed cadastral documentation. Provide professional advice to Professional Land Surveyors, government officials and organs of state. Provide feedback on proposed cadastral documents to any competent authority empowered to grant or approve a right to the use of land for a specified purpose. Assist with the interpretation and legal implications for existing and proposed cadastral documents, which have been or are to be registered in a Deeds Registry. Provide responses to litigation documentation, including reports to the court relating to existing or proposed cadastral documents. Liaise with the Registrar of Deeds and officials from the Deeds Registry to ensure cadastral documents approved in the office of the Surveyor- General are registerable and ensure harmonious application of the cadastral system. Liaise with voluntary geomatics organisations and professional bodies in the built environment sector. Respond to any presidential hotline request relating to the competencies and area of jurisdiction of the office in which the official serves. Liaise with members of the public on behalf of the Surveyor- General on complex or unusual land parcel boundary or property legislation- related matters. Liaise with custodians of geo-spatial information that either support or depend upon Cadastral Spatial Information. Support the training and development of officials in the cadastral system environment. Oversee the undertaking of field surveys for verification of surveys, dispute resolution and inspections. Test a survey for correctness, accuracy or authenticity in accordance with legal provisions, if reason for doubt exists. Take necessary action in connection with a survey tested for correctness, accuracy or authenticity, when required. Prepare and submit a report in connection with an application to a court, if deemed desirable. Undertake field surveys to identify boundaries of state land properties to resolve boundary disputes.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Kekana Tel No: (012) 312 8344
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Ocean Terrace, Block H, corner of Coutts and Moore Street, Quigney, East London or by email to Post190@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males and African, Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. OTHER POSTS To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onder-landmeter-generaal
af.summary: Die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development soek 'n Onder-landmeter-generaal vir East London om kadastrale dokumentondersoek, registersisteemdienste en argiewering op SMS Vlak 13 te oorsien.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 7) soos deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) erken, spesifiek 'n vierjarige B- of BSc-graad in Geomatics / Landmeetkunde of verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasies, asook 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (toelatingsertifikaat tot die SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien moet wees. Geregistreer as 'n Professionele Landmeter by die South African Geomatics Council. Geregistreer as 'n Sedisionele Titelspraktisyn ooreenkomstig Artikel 5(2) van die Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel / senior bestuursvlak in 'n landmeetkundige omgewing. Toepaslike ervaring na registrasie in kadastrale landmeting. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika. Goedgekeurde bestuur en Batho Pele-beginsels. Arbeids- en dienswetgewing. Public Service Regulations, 2016 (soos gewysig). Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Transformasie van die Openbare Diens. Employment Equity Act, 1998. Deeds Registries Act, 1937. Land Survey Act, 1997. Sectional Titles Act, 1986. South African Geomatics Professions Act, 2013. South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, 2003. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, 2013. Mining Titles Registration Act, 1967. Ander, alle ander eiendomsverwante wetgewing, insluitend ou-orde wetgewing en ordonnansies. Proklamasies en beleide van toepassing op Land Administration, Land Measurement Standards, en Land Information Systems. Internasionale konvensies oor grondbeleid en geografiese inligtingsbestuur. Kennis van kadastrale opmetings. Kennis van tegniese stelsels. Kennis van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting. Kennis van Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems en Geographical Information Management. Kennis van vooruitgang in tegnologie nuttig vir die kadastrale opmetingstelsel. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Regeringstelsels en -strukture. Regering se besluitnemingsprosesse. Programopstelproses. Begrip van die bestuursinligting- en formele verslagdoeningstelsel. Hantering van wangedrag. Interne beheer en risikobestuur. Projektebestuursbeginsels en -nutsmiddels. Die politieke landskap van Suid-Afrika. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Geskil- en konflikbestuur. Tydbestuur. Rekenaarsagteware. Projektebestuur. Beplanning. Spanbestuur. Begrotingsvoorspelning. Hulpbronbeplanning en -organisering. Besigheid.
af.duties: Bestuur die verskaffing van registersisteemdienste. Oorsien die ontvangs en versending van kadastrale dokumente wat vir ondersoek en goedkeuring ingedien is. Verseker dat die nodige kantoorfooie betaal is voordat kadastrale dokumente in die stelsel aanvaar word. Oorsien die argivering van alle dokumente. Oorsien die onderhoud van die kadastrale korrespondensielêerstelsel. Oorsien die lewer van boodskapperdienste. Bestuur die lewer van eerste- en tweedevlak-ondersoekdienste. Oorsien die toekenning van grondperseelnommers. Verseker tegniese nakoming van kadastrale dokumente. Verifieer nuwe kadastrale dokumente in verhouding tot moeder-eiendomsinligting. Oorsien die ondersoek en goedkeuring/afwysing van alle kadastrale dokumente wat deur Professionele Landmeters opgestel en ingedien is. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeters en regeringsamptenare. Rapporteer maandeliks oor direktoraatvooruitgang soos vereis. Ken en pas alle relevante grondadministrasiewetgewing, beleide en prosedures toe. Kommunikeer alle relevante nuwe bestuursbesluite, beleide en inligting wekeliks aan personeel. Lewer en fasiliteer professionele advies vir grondhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Ontvang versoeke vir grondhervormingsbystand soos wanneer nodig. Verskaf en oorsien professionele adviesdienste vir grondhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Doen navorsing oor grondhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Beplan die vereiste grondperseelgrensondersoek wanneer nodig. Genereer verslae vir grondhervormingsondersteuning ooreenkomstig bevindings en beleid. Dien verslae oor grondhervormingsbevindings in na finalisering. Raadpleeg belanghebbende en geraakde partye by grondhervormingsprojekte en staatsopmetings. Verseker dat die bakens wat op 'n staatsopmeting betrekking het, uitgewys en deur die relevante amptenare, insluitend die begunstigdes waar van toepassing, aanvaar is voor die goedkeuring van die kadastrale dokumente. Oorsien en lewer professionele advies oor die kadastrale stelsel en bestaande en voorgestelde kadastrale dokumentasie. Verskaf professionele advies aan Professionele Landmeters, regeringsamptenare en staatsorgane. Verskaf terugvoer oor voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente aan enige bevoegde gesig wat gemagtig is om 'n reg tot die gebruik van grond vir 'n spesifieke doeleindes te verleen of goed te keur. Bystand verleen met die interpretasie en regsgevolge van bestaande en voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente wat in 'n Akteregister geregistreer is of gaan word. Verskaf antwoorde op litigasiedokumentasie, insluitend verslae aan die hof rakende bestaande of voorgestelde kadastrale dokumente. Skakel met die Registrar of Deeds en amptenare van die Akteregister om te verseker dat kadastrale dokumente wat in die kantoor van die Surveyor- General goedgekeur is, registreerbaar is en harmonieuse toepassing van die kadastrale stelsel verseker. Skakel met vrywillige geomatics-organisasies en professionele liggame in die bou-omgewingsektor. Reageer op enige presidensiële hotlynversoek rakende die bevoegdhede en jurisdiksiegebied van die kantoor waarin die amptenaar diens doen. Skakel met lede van die publiek namens die Surveyor- General oor komplekse of ongewone grondperseelgrens- of eiendomswetgewingverwante aangeleenthede. Skakel met bewaarders van geo-ruimtelike inligting wat óf kadastrale ruimtelike inligting ondersteun óf daarvan afhanklik is. Ondersteun die opleiding en ontwikkeling van amptenare in die kadastrale stelselomgewing. Oorsien die onderneem van veldopmetings vir verifiëring van opmetings, geskilbeslegting en inspeksies. Toets 'n opmeting vir korrektheid, akkuraatheid of egtheid ooreenkomstig regsbepalings, indien rede vir twyfel bestaan. Onderneem nodige aksie in verband met 'n opmeting wat vir korrektheid, akkuraatheid of egtheid getoets is, wanneer nodig. Berei en dien 'n verslag in verband met 'n aansoek by 'n hof in, indien as wenslik geag. Onderneem veldopmetings om grense van staatseiendomme te identifiseer om grensgeskille te besleg.

zu.title: Isikhulu esihlonziweyo se-Surveyor-General
zu.summary: I-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ifuna uMekeli wokuqamba we-Surveyor-General wase-East London ukuba auphathe ukuhlola amadokhumenti e-cadastral, imisebenzi yeregistry nokugcina amadokhumenti e-SMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwesidingo: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesatifiketi se-Grade 12 nangesiqu sokufunda esingaphansi kwe-degree (NQF Level 7) esamukelekwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ngokukhethekile i-B noma i-BSc Degree yeminyaka emine kwi-Geomatics / Surveying noma iziqu ezingaphezulu ezihlobene nalezo nekhalathi le-Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) elicela kunikezwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Kufanele abhaliswe njengoProfessional Land Surveyor ne-South African Geomatics Council. Kufanele abhaliswe njenge-Sectional Titles Practitioner ngokwesigaba 5(2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Kufanele abe neminyaka engu-5 yamava ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi / ophakeme kwindawo ye-Land Surveying. Kufake kubukeka inani lamava ngemva kokubhaliswa kokwenza i-cadastral surveying. Kufanele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Isimali mthetho se-Republic of South Africa. Izimiso ezinhle zokulawula nezimiso ze-Batho Pele. Umtsetfo we-Labour and Employment Legislation. I-Public Service Regulations, 2016 (njengokulungisiwe). I-Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Ukuguqulwa kwe-Public Service. I-Employment Equity Act, 1998. I-Deeds Registries Act, 1937. I-Land Survey Act, 1997. I-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. I-South African Geomatics Professions Act, 2013. I-South African Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, 2003. I-Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, 2013. I-Mining Titles Registration Act, 1967. Olunye, wonke umtsetfo ohlobene nempahla, okuhlanganisa umtsetfo kanye namalawu endalo. Isimemezelo nezinqumela ezisetshenziswa ku-Land Administration, Land Measurement Standards, kanye ne-Land Information Systems. I-International Conventions mayelana nemithetho yomhlaba wamazwe nezindlela zokuphatha imininingwane yomhlaba. Ulwazi lwe-Cadastral Survey. Ulwazi lwe-Technical System. Ulwazi lwe-Cadastral Spatial Information. Ulwazi nge-Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems kanye nokuphatha imininingwane yomhlaba. Ulwazi ngemishini yamakhompyutha ethuthukisa isimiso se-Cadastral Survey System. Ukuphathwa nokubukwa kwemisebenzi. Izimiso zikahulumeni nangakho. Inqubo yokwenza izinquma kahulumeni. Inqubo yokusetha amaphrohgramu. Ukuqonda imininingwane yokuphatha nendlela yokubika ngokusemthethweni. Ukuphathwa kwezenzo ezingalungile. Ukulawula izindleko zangaphakathi kanye nokuphatha ingozi. Izimiso namathuluzi okuphatha imiklamo. Isimo sezepolitiki saseSouth Africa. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ukuthetha kahle (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuphatha izinkinga nangezingxabano. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Isofthiwe yekhompyutha. Ukuphatha imiklamo. Ukuphatha iqembu. Ukubika ngemali ekhokhwayo. Ukuhlela futhi uhle imithombo. Umhlaba wetabhizinisi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunika imisebenzi yeregistry. Qaphela ukwamukelwa nokuthunyelwa kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral awethulwe ukuze ahlolwe futhi avunyelwe. Qiniseka ukuthi izinkokhelo ezingeadangatayo zikhokhelwe ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral esimisini. Qaphela ukugcinwa kwawo wonke amadokhumenti. Qaphela ukugcinwa kwesimiso sokulondoloza amadokhumenti we-cadastral correspondence. Qaphela ukunika imisebenzi yomthumeli. Phatha ukunika imisebenzi yokuhlola ezingeni lokuqala kanye nalesesibili. Qaphela ukwaba amanombolo azehlwayo e-land parcels. Qinisekela ukuhambisana kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral ngokuthweni. Qinisekisa amadokhumenti e-cadastral entsha ukuze ahambisane nemininingwane yempahla umzali. Qaphela ukuhlola kanye nokuvuma/ukwenqaba kwawo wonke amadokhumenti e-cadastral alungiswe futhi ethunyelwe aboProfessional Land Surveyors. Nikeza izeluleko ezingamandla kuboProfessional Land Surveyors kanye nabasebenzi bahulumeni. Bika ngokuba kwezinhlelho kanjongo nyanga zonke njengoba kudingwa.azi futhi usebenzise wonke umtsetfo, izinqumela kanye nezenqubo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwomhlaba. Yeqa yonke imiqulu yokwenquma engaphezulu, izinqumela nemininingwane kubasebenzi nsuku zonke zibe yisonto. Nikeza futhi uthole izeluleko ezingamandla kumiklamo yokulungiswa komhlaba kanye nezilinganiso zikahulumeni. Yamukela izicelo zokwesekwa kokulungiswa komhlaba lapho kudingeka khona. Nikeza futhi uqaphele izinsiza ezingamandla zokweluleka kumiklamo yokulungiswa komhlaba kanye nezilinganiso zikahulumeni. Yenza uphando ngamaphrojekthi ahlunga umhlaba nezilinganiso zikahulumeni. Hlela uphando oludingekayo mayelana namagamu ezindawo ezehlwayo e-land parcels lapho kudingeka khona. Dala umbiko ngokwesekwa kokulungiswa komhlaba ngokokutholakale nangomyalo. Thumela imibiko mayelana nokutholakale kokulungiswa kwomhlaba esiyiqedile. Phendula abantu abanentshwayo nomthelekileyo kumaphrojekthi ahlunga umhlaba nezilinganiso zikahulumeni. Qiniseka ukuthi osule abayihlobo bezilinganiso zikahulumeni bakhombisiwe futhi bamukele abasebenzi abahlotshaniswe kuyo lapho kudingeka khona, ngaphambi kokuvuma amadokhumenti e-cadastral. Qaphela futhi nikeza izeluleko ezingamandla ngomtholampilo we-cadastral system kanye namadokhumenti e-cadastral akhona kanye nalawo abhekiselwe kusona. Nikeza izeluleko ezingamandla aboProfessional Land Surveyors, abasebenzi kahulumeni kanye nezikhulu zikahulumeni. Nikeza umbiko mayelana namadokhumenti e-cadastral abhunjulwayo kunoma yibuphi obuyikhulu bokukwazi ukunika noma ukuvuma ilungelo lokusebenzisa umhlaba ngenjongo ethize. Siza ekutolikeni nangokuchazwa ngokomthetho kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral okhona nalawo abhekiselwe kusona, abegciniwe noma okumele kugcinwe kwi-Deeds Registry. Nikeza izimpendulo emafayeleni ezinkantolo, okuhlanganisa namaphrojekthi aye enyameni mayelana namadokhumenti e-cadastral okhona nalawo abhekiselwe kusona. Yophula noMamunjeli we-Deeds kanye nabasebenzi be-Deeds Registry ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi amadokhumenti e-cadastral avunyelwe ofisini i-Surveyor-General angagcinwa uhlelo lokwaba futhi uqinisekise isimiso se-cadastral system esivundile. Yophula nabaholi bemikhakha ye-geomatics emitholana namagugu eqenjini le-built environment. Phendula kunoma yisiphi isicelo esithunyelwe kuhulumene ngokusiza ngokuqhuba mayelana namandla kanye nesabelo sezikhundla ofini ikhomishane. Yophula nabantu bendlu ngokwakhe i-Surveyor-General kwezinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi noma ezingavamile mayelana namagamu ezehlwayo e-land parcels noma ngokomtsetfo we-property. Yophula nabagcini bemininingwane ye-geo-spatial abasiza noma abathemba kwi-Cadastral Spatial Information. Seke ukufundisa kanye nokuqeqesha abasebenzi kwisimiso se-cadastral system. Qaphela ukwenziwa kwezilinganiso zomhlaba ukungabaza kwamaphrojekthi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlola. Hlola isilinganiso sokuthi silungile, qinisekile noma sinamacala ngokuhambisana nomthetho, uma kunesizathu sokungabaza. Yenza okudingekayo mayelana nesilinganiso esihlolekile ukuthi silungile, qinisekile noma sinamacala, lapho kudingeka khona. Lungisa futhi uthumela umbiko mayelana nesicelo senkantolo, uma kubonakala sifanele. Yenza izilinganiso zomhlaba ukuze ubone amagamu ezehlwayo ezimpahla zikahulumeni ukuze uxazulule izinkinga zamagamu.

xh.title: USekela woMlawuli-jikelele woMilinganiselo
xh.summary: Isebe leLand Reform and Rural Development lifuna uSekela woMlawuli-jikelele woMilinganiselo wase East London ukuba alawule ukuhlolwa kwezixhobo ze-cadastral, iinkonzo zerekhodi nokugcina iifayile kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka benam iQikkiela ye-Grade 12 kunye nesifundo se-undergraduate (NQF Level 7) esamkelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), ngokukodwa i-Degree ye-B okanye i-BSc yeminyaka emine kwi-Geomatics / Surveying okanye izifundo ezilinganayo kwaye benam i-certificate ye-Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) eziyiswa phambi kokuba baqokelelwe. Makabhaliswe njengoMlinganiswebhumi oNobuchule koMlambo waseNingizimu Afrika wee-Geomatics (South African Geomatics Council). Makabhaliswe njengoGunyathiwe bee-Sectional Titles ngokwesigaba 5(2) se-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Kufuneba anamava okungenawo amnyaka angama-5 ohlangothini lolawulo embindini / phezulu kwindawo yokulinganisa umhlaba. Amanaba afanelekileyo emva kokuqokelelwa kwimvelaphi yokusebenza ekuhloleni i-cadastral. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: iNgumphefumlo waseRiphablikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (The Constitution of the Republic of South Africa). Ulawulo olulungileyo kwaye nemigaqo ye-Batho Pele. Imithetho yabasebenzi noQoqosho. Imigaqo yoBulungisa benkululeko, 2016 (njengoko itshintshiwwe). uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente, 1999. Utshintsho loBulungisa benkululeko. uMthetho woQoqosho loLungiselelo lwe-1998 (Employment Equity Act, 1998). uMthetho weeNtengiso zokuBhalisa, 1937. uMthetho woKulinganiswa komHlaba (Land Survey Act), 1997. uMthetho wee-Sectional Titles, 1986. uMthetho weeNtura zobuGcisa be-Geomatics zaseNingizimu Afrika, 2013. uMthetho weSouth African Spatial Data Infrastructure ka-2003. uMthetho woCwangciso loNdawo noLawulo loKusetyenziswa koMhlaba, 2013. uMthetho woBhaliso lwezihloko zokuKhiqiza i-1967 (Mining Titles Registration Act). Olunye, naziphi na ezinye iimithetho enxulumene nento, kuquka iimithetho namaxwebhu amdalize kunye nemiqathongo. Isaziso nemigaqo egqithiselwa koLawulo loMhlaba, iMilinganiselo yemiQondo yoMhlaba, kunneeNkqubo zeMolula ulwazi ngomhlaba. IziNqununu zamazwe ngamazwe ngomgaqo-nkqubo womhlaba nolawulo lwesaziba sebhumi. Ulwazi ngokuHlola i-Cadastral. Ulwazi leeNkqubo zobugcisa. Ulwazi nge-Spatial Information ye-Cadastral. Ulwazi ngeeNkqubo zoLwazi lomHlaba, iNkqubo zoLawulo lomHlaba nokuLawulwa kwesaziba sobuGcisa be-Geomatics. Ulwazi ngophuhliso lwezobugcisa olusetyenziselwa iNkqubo yokuHlola i-Cadastral. Ukulawula kwaye ulandele imimiselo yokusebenza koluntu. Iinkqubo nezakhiwo zorhulumente. Iinkqubo zokuThatha isigqibo korhulumente. Inqkubo yokumisela iinkqubo. Ukuqonda iNkqubo yolwazi lolawulo kunneeNkqubo zokuBika ngokusemthethweni. Ukuphathwa kwenkohlakalo. Ulawulo loLungile nokulawula ingozi. Imigaqo nezixhobo zoLawulo lweProjekthi. imeko yamanyathelo ezopolitiko eNingizimu Afrika. Amakhono anxulumene nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano lokwabelana ngokulunge. Unxibelelwano oluhle (oluthethwayo nolubhaliwayo). Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuThatha izigqibo. Ukulawula izinto ezingavumelwani neengxabano. Ukulawula iXesha. Isofthiwe yeKhompyutha. Ukulawulwa kweekqubo. uCwangciso. Ukulawula iQela. Ukubikezela iNkqubo yemali. uCwangciso lwezixhobo nokuCwangcisa. Ishishini.
xh.duties: Lawula ukubonelela ngenkonzo zerekhodi. Lawula ukwamkelwa nokuthunyelwa kwezixhobo ze-cadastral eziyiswa xa kusenziwa ukuhlolwa nangenso iso. Qinisekisa ukuba iimali ezifunekayo zofise zihlawulwe phambi kokwamkelwa kwezixhobo ze-cadastral kwinkqubo. Lawula ukugcinwa kweefayile zonke iixhobo. Lawula ukugcinwa kwendlela yokubhala iifayile zoxulumano olusentloni. Lawula ukubonelela ngenkonzo zomthunywa. Lawula ukubonelela ngokuqinisekiswa koluntu koluntu ngokoqobo lokuHlola i-cadastral. Lawula uluhlu lwamanamba esantya sokuphela iinkonzo zokuhlolwa ekuqaleni nasekuqhubekayo. Qamisa amanamba esantya esantya sikaqele ezinikezelwe. Lawula ukuvumelana nobuchule bobugcisa kwezixhobo ze-cadastral. Qinisekisa izixhobo ezintsha ze-cadastral ngokuchasana nalwazi lentsika yemveli. Lawula ukuhlolwa nokuvunwa/ukwenqatshwa kwezixhobo zonke ze-cadastral ezilungiselelwe kwaye zithunyelwa nguBaqobi bokuKala bemiHlaba uMlinga. Nika izigqibo zobuchule kuBaqobi bokuKala bemiHlaba basebenza kumgaqo-nkqubo. Bika ngokuqhuba ngokwenkqubo yenyanga njengoko kufuneka.azi kwaye usebenzise yonke imithetho, imigaqo name inkqubo ezichukumisa uLawulo loMhlaba. Yenza ngokwempilo unxibelelwano phakathi kwengingqi namagqabantshathi engqondweni ngemigaqo entsha ekuyimiPhatho yokuhla kwindawo abanokuyifumana xa kudingeka. Nikeza kwaye ulawule izigqibo zobuchule zeeprojekthi zelawulo lomhlaba nokulinganiswa komhlaba kumthetho wephulumente. Yenza ucwangciso lokuphonononga imida yesantya sikaqele xa kudingeka. Dala ngokwezifundo zamagqabantshathi ezifunwa ngocwangciso lomhlaba. Thumela iingxelo ngezifundo zemida esantya esixaneno kwelinye icandelo ngokudityaniswa kwamagunya nokuVuma amaqhakamshela axhaphazileyo kwiiprojekthi zegunya lomhlaba ekuqaleni. Qinisekisa ukuba izikhumba ezinxulumene nokulinganiswa komhlaba ngokutsha kuboniswe kwaye lamkelwe ngamalungu abalulekileyo ngokusekelwe kumthetho wephulumente xa kunjalo, xa kusenziwa ucwangciso lwesiCwangciso sokunika isakhono ukubonelela ngemigaqo yamathuba amaninzi esantya esixaneno kuluntu ngokuhambelana neNgxoxo yokuLinganiswa komHlaba ngokwemigaqo emike. Dibana nabajonge nzulu kumashishini namagunya eGeomatics. Balule kubanzi bokulwa kwiNkqubo yoBuchule nomGaql-nkqubo wakho wonke wokuSebenza.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Strategic Land Acquisition
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 101 468 per annum (Level 12), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director to coordinate strategic land acquisition in Limpopo, requiring a relevant diploma and three years' junior management experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Agricultural Studies / Agricultural Economics / Development Studies / Town and Regional Planning / Social Sciences / Real Estate / Property Management (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualifications.
