Minimum of 3 years’ experience at junior management level in Strategic Land Acquisition. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Land Reform: Provision of Land and Assistance Act 126 of 1993 as amended. Labour Tenants Act, 3 of 1996. Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994. Extension Security of Tenure Act, 62 of 1997 as amended. State Land Lease and Disposal policy. Beneficiary Selection and Land Allocation Policy. Knowledge of post settlement support programmes. Knowledge of Agrarian Transformation as well as key priorities of government. Knowledge of Comprehensive Rural Development Programmes (CRDP). Land Reform Prescripts and other relevant departmental prescripts. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Strategic management. Negotiation. Computer literacy. Stakeholder relations. Facilitation / coordination. Presentation. Financial management. Project management. Interpersonal relations. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the acquisition of strategically located land aligned to the national imperatives. Provide support to district offices on the identification and acquisition of strategically located land suitable for acquisition by the State. Maintain and update project register of all suitable land acquisition for the State. Facilitate mapping and overlaying of the identified land with key commodities. Manage the assessment and valuation of identified properties. Align acquired land to other departmental interventions and programmes. Provide support on land acquisition approval process through relevant structures. Monitor updates of projects in terms of the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) requirements. Facilitate the selection of suitable candidate and allocation of land. Ensure quality assurance and information management services between district, provincial and national office. Ensure that the land allocation process is compliant to the Beneficiary Selection Policy. Coordinate the selection process of beneficiaries for the land allocation. Coordinate land allocation process through relevant approval structures. Facilitate proper handover of allocated land to Property Management. Provide land acquisition support services across districts including District Land Committees. Support land acquisition procedures within relevant policy and programme guidelines. Coordinate the liaison with relevant role-players / stakeholders with regards to land acquisition projects support requirements Ensure coordination of the transfer and registration process. Facilitate the appointment of a Conveyancer. Facilitate signing of the deed of sale. Facilitate the signing of expedition letters. Facilitate the processing of payments.
jobs.enquiries: DT Machoga Tel No: (015) 495 1955 / LS Mahasha Tel No: (015) 495 1956
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 61 Biccard street, Polokwane, 0700 or by email to Post199@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Strategiese Landverkryging
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur om strategiese landverkryging in Limpopo te koördineer, wat 'n relevante diploma en drie jaar se junior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Agricultural Studies / Agricultural Economics / Development Studies / Town and Regional Planning / Social Sciences / Real Estate / Property Management (NQF Level 6) of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op junior bestuursvlak in Strategiese Landverkryging. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Land Reform: Provision of Land and Assistance Act 126 of 1993 soos gewysig. Labour Tenants Act, 3 of 1996. Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994. Extension Security of Tenure Act, 62 of 1997 soos gewysig. State Land Lease and Disposal policy. Beneficiary Selection and Land Allocation Policy. Kennis van post-settlement ondersteuningsprogramme. Kennis van Agrariese Transformasie asook sleutelprioriteite van die regering. Kennis van Comprehensive Rural Development Programmes (CRDP). Land Reform Prescripts en ander relevante departementele voorskrifte. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Strategiese bestuur. Onderhandeling. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Belanghebbenderelaties. Fasilitering / koördinering. Voorlegging. Finansiële bestuur. Projekbestuur. Tussenmenslike verhoudings. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Koördineer die verkryging van strategies geleë land wat ooreenstem met die nasionale prioriteite. Verskaf ondersteuning aan distrikkantore met die identifisering en verkryging van strategies geleë land wat geskik is vir verkryging deur die Staat. Onderhou en werk die projekregister van alle geskikte landverkryging vir die Staat by. Fasiliteer die kartering en oorleg van die geïdentifiseerde land met sleutelkommoditeite. Bestuur die assessering en waardasie van geïdentifiseerde eiendomme. Lly die verkrygende land aan ander departementele ingrypings en programme. Verskaf ondersteuning met die goedkeuringsproses vir landverkryging deur middel van relevante strukture. Monitor opdaterings van projekte in terme van die Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) vereistes. Fasiliteer die seleksie van geskikte kandidate en die toekenning van land. Verseker gehalteversekering en inligtingsbestuursdienste tussen distrik, provinsiale en nasionale kantoor. Verseker dat die landtoekeningsproses voldoen aan die Beneficiary Selection Policy. Koördineer die seleksieproses van begunstigdes vir die landtoekenning. Koördineer die landtoekeningsproses deur middel van relevante goedkeuringsstrukture. Fasiliteer die behoorlike oorhandiging van toegewysde land aan Property Management. Verskaf landverkrygingsondersteuningsdienste oor distrikte, insluitend District Land Committees. Ondersteun landverkrygingsprosedures binne relevante beleids- en programriglyne. Koördineer die skakeling met relevante rolspelers / belanghebbendes met betrekking tot landverkrygingsprojekte se ondersteuningsvereistes. Verseker koördinering van die oordrag- en registrasieproses. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van 'n aktevervaardiger. Fasiliteer die ondertekening van die koopkontrak. Fasiliteer die ondertekening van spoedbriewe. Fasiliteer die verwerking van betalings.

zu.title: Obambe Njengengxenye Yomqondisi: Ukutholwa Kwezwe Ebalulekile
zu.summary: Obambe njengengxenye yomqondisi ophathe ukutholwa kwezwe ebalulekile e-Limpopo, ofuna idiploma ehambisana nalokhu nobungako bobunzima beminyaka emithathu bokuba ngumphathi oshaqisayo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okubi semgwaqo: Abafakisiswa kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma kuma-Agricultural Studies / Agricultural Economics / Development Studies / Town and Regional Planning / Social Sciences / Real Estate / Property Management (NQF Level 6) noma izifundo ezifana nalezo ezidingekayo. Okungenani unyaka wama-3 wobuhlobo obusezinqenyeni zokuphatha abashaqisayo kokuTholwa Kwezwe Ebalulekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: I-Land Reform: Provision of Land and Assistance Act 126 of 1993 njengokulungiswe. I-Labour Tenants Act, 3 of 1996. I-Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994. I-Extension Security of Tenure Act, 62 of 1997 njengokulungiswe. Inqubomgomo yase-State Land Lease and Disposal. Inqubomgomo yokuKhethwa Kwabatholi Bemiholo Nokwabiwa Kwezwe. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zokusekela abantu emva kokuhlinzwa ngomhlaba. Ulwazi lwe-Agrarian Transformation kanye nezinhloso ezibalulekile kahulumeni. Ulwazi lwe-Comprehensive Rural Development Programmes (CRDP). Imiyalo yokuLungiswa Kwomhlaba kanye naleminye imiyalo ephathelene nomnyango. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukuphatha izinqubomgomo. Ukuxoxisana. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ubudlelwano nabantu abahilelekile. Ukwenza / ukuhlanganisa. Okwethula. Ukuphatha imali. Ukuphatha iphrojekthi. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa ukutholwa kwezwe okubekwe ngokubaluleka kuhambisana nezidingo zesizwe. Nikeza inkundla yokuqondiswa ezikhundleni zesifunda ekubeni nokutholwa kwezwe esibekwe ngokubaluleka esifanele ukuba sitholwe uMbuso. Gcina futhi uvuse izinkomba zephrojekthi yazo zonke izindawo ezifanele zokutholwa komhlaba uMbuso. Yisa phambili ukushajwa kanye nokubekwa kolwazi izinkundla abazitholile kwezindawo ezibalulekile. Phatha ukulinganiswa nokuqondiswa ngobungako futhi kuthathwe inani lezindlu abazitholile. Lungisa izwe esitholile namanye amaphuzu okungenelela kanye nezinhlelo zomnyango. Nikeza usizo ekutheni umhlaba utholwe ukuthi umvume njengokuqediwe izinhlelo ezihlukene. Hlola izibuyekezo zamaphrojekthi ngokwesidingo se-Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). Yisa phambili ukukhethwa kwabafaneleyo kanye nokunikezwa komhlaba. Qinisekisa uthuthukiswa kohlelo lokulondoloza ulwazi oluhle phakathi kwezikhundla zesifunda, isifundazwe nezikhundla zesizwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi inqubo yokwabela umhlaba ihambisana nenqubomgomo yokukhethwa kwabafakwa ohlelweni. Hlanganisa inqubo yokukhethwa kwabathola abahlome ukuthi bathole umhlaba. Hlanganisa inqubo yokwabela umhlaba kuzo lezo zinhlelo ezifanele zokuvuma. Yisa phambili ukunikezwa komhlaba okubekwe ngokulungile ohlelweni lokuLawula Izinto. Nikeza usizo olutholwa komhlaba kulo lonke amasifunda ngokuhlanganisa nama-District Land Committees. Seke izinqubo zokutholwa komhlaba ngaphakathi kohlaka lwenqubomgomo kanye nezinhlela ezihlukene. Hlanganisa ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli / nabantu abadlula isikhundla noma basemhlabeni jikelele ngokwezidingo zokusekela amaphrojekthi okutholwa umhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kwenzakalo yokudluliswa kanye nokubhaliswa ngokugcwele. Yisa phambili ukumiswa kwe-Conveyancer. Yisa phambili ukusayina kwebhayisi lokuthengisa. Yisa phambili ukusayina kwamagama okushajwa ngokushesha. Yisa phambili ukwenza izinkokhelo.

xh.title: Under-Somluxwebhu: Ukufunyanwa kweMihlaba eNto nto
xh.summary: Under-Somluxwebhu oza kulungelelanisa ukufunyanwa kweMihlaba eNto nto kwindawo yeLimpopo, efunisisa izidanga ezifanelekileyo kunye namava eminyaka emithathu kokusingathwa kolawulo lwamathuba.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingapheliyo: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seQela lesi-12 kunye neNational Diploma kwi-Agricultural Studies / Agricultural Economics / Development Studies / Town and Regional Planning / Social Sciences / Real Estate / Property Management (NQF Level 6) okanye izifanelelo ezilinganayo ezinxulumene nendima. Amava angapheliyo eminyaka engama-3 kwinqanaba lolawulo lwamathuba kwiStrategic Land Acquisition. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Land Reform: Provision of Land and Assistance Act 126 of 1993 njengoko lugqityiwe. Labour Tenants Act, 3 of 1996. Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994. Extension Security of Tenure Act, 62 of 1997 njengoko lugqityiwe. State Land Lease and Disposal policy. Beneficiary Selection and Land Allocation Policy. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zoxhaso lwemihlaba emva kokumiselwa. Ulwazi ngeAgrarian Transformation nakumaphambili amakhulu karhulumente. Ulwazi ngeComprehensive Rural Development Programmes (CRDP). Izikhokelo zoBundlu boMhlaba kunye nezinye izikhokelo ezinxulumene nesebe. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (lwemilomo nolubhaliweyo). Ulawulo oluninto nto. Inkingaxabiso. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Unxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba. Ukulungelelanisa / ukwongezelelana. Okubonakaliswa. Ulawulo lweziqoqo zemali. Ulawulo lweiprojekthi. Unxibelelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa ukufunyanwa kwemihlaba ekumelo ndawo ngokwemigibe yelizwe. Nikeza inkxaso kweziko lonxibelelwano ngokuzingisa nokufumanisa imihlaba ekumelo ndawo efanayo nokufunyanwa ngurhulumente. Gcina uze upheze irekhodi yeprojekthi yonke imihlaba elifanelekileyo yokufunyanwa ngurhulumente. Yenza ukulinganiswa kwamacephu nokubekwa phezu kolwazi lwemihlaba efunyenweyo kunye neempahla eziphambili. Lawula ukuqinisekiswa nokuqikelela ixabiso lempahla efunyenweyo. Lungelelanisa imihlaba efunyenweyo nezinye iindlela zokungenelela nezinkqubo zesebe. Nikeza inkxaso kwinkqubo yamagama obulumko okufunyanwa kwemihlaba ngeendawo ezifanelekileyo. Qaphela ukuqwalasela kweeprojekthi ngokwemfuno zeEnterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). Yenza ukhetho lwabathunjwa abafanelekileyo nokwabelwa umhlaba. Qinisekisa ukwenziswa koluhlobo nolawulo lolwazi phakathi kweziko lonxibelelwano, londawo nakwisebe lelilizwe. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yababelwa umhlaba ihambelana ne-Beneficiary Selection Policy. Lungelelanisa inkqubo yakhetho laba banelungelo labo lokwabelwa umhlaba. Lungelelanisa inkqubo yokwabelwa umhlaba ngeendawo zamagama obulumko afanelekileyo. Yenza ngokuchanekileyo ukunikelwa kwemihlaba ebelwe abantu kwi-Property Management. Nikeza iinkonzo zoxhaso lokufunyanwa kwemihlaba kuzo zonke iindawo kubandakanya District Land Committees. Xhasa iinkqubo zokufunyanwa kwemihlaba ngaphakathi kweendawo zengqiqo kunye neenkqubo ezinxulumene nendima. Lungelelanisa unxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba / abadlali abaphambili ngokuphathelene neenkxaso zokufunyanwa kweekomitye zemihlaba, qinisekisa ukulungelelaniswa kwenkqubo yokudluliswa nokuqwalaselwa. Lungelelanisa ukhetho lomhloli wezomhlaba. Lungelelanisa ukusayina koxiwo loku-rhweba. Lungelelanisa ukusayini kweleta zokuqhubela phambili. Lungelelanisa ukucubungula iindleko zamaxabiso.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Coordinate and validate land claims lodgement in East London, requiring a relevant diploma or degree and three years' experience in land reform.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and Bachelor’s Degree / National Diploma in Agriculture / Development Studies / Social Science / Law or any related equivalent qualification. Minimum 3 years’ experience in land reform environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Development management including strategic management. Research methods and techniques. Community facilitation. Understand and Interpret Business Plan. Thorough knowledge in land reform and development-related issues. Knowledge of Restitution of land rights. Knowledge of Land Reform. Knowledge of rural development. Development management including strategic management. Understanding and interpret Business Plan. Job related skills: Project management. Negotiation. Contract management. Leadership. Communication (verbal and written). Ability to draft terms of reference for service providers. Ability to manage consultants. Excellent report writing. Initiative, able to take responsibility and meet deadlines. Computer literacy. Ability to produce report. Ability to facilitate community meetings. Good networking. Ability to draft terms of reference for service providers. Willingness to travel, to spend extended periods in the field and work irregular hours.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the lodgement of land claims. Categorise claims per local municipality. Engage municipalities on claims to be settled. Validate land claims. Conduct oral and archival research. Conduct site inspection process (Mapping). Identify homestead. Partaking in analysis of aerial photograph reports. Facilitate where there are overlapping land claims. Facilitate separation of tenants, beneficial of occupation and registered land rights. Verify lodged claim. Conduct in loco inspection. Produce in loco inspection report. Assist in closing of commitment register. Coordinate clearance of suspense account. Manage payment of beneficiaries. Negotiate the settlement of claims. Conduct option exercise with claimants. Identify claims for historical and current valuation by the Office of the Valuer General. Escalate historical valuation for offers. Settle the claims. Conduct verification process. Conduct analysis of family tree. Sign off completed name verification report. Draft Section 42d submission.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A van Vuuren Tel No: (043) 701 8127 or Ms AC Kili Tel No: (043) 701 8186
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Ocean Terrace, Block H, corner of Coutts and Moore Street, Quigney, East London or by email to Post193@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Projekkoördineerder
af.summary: Koördineer en valideer die indiening van grondeise in East London, wat 'n relevante diploma of graad en drie jaar se ervaring in landhervorming vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Bachelorsgraad / Nasionale Diploma in Landbou / Ontwikkelingsstudies / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Regte of enige verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Minimum 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n landhervormingsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Ontwikkelingsbestuur insluitend strategiese bestuur. Navorsingsmetodes en -tegnieke. Gemeenskapsfasilitering. Verstaan en interpreteer besigheidsplan. Deeglike kennis van landhervorming en ontwikkelingsverwante kwessies. Kennis van Restitusie van grondb_Regte. Kennis van Landhervorming. Kennis van landelike ontwikkeling. Ontwikkelingsbestuur insluitend strategiese bestuur. Verstaan en interpreteer besigheidsplan. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projekbestuur. Onderhandeling. Kontrakbestuur. Leierskap. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om terms of reference vir diensverskaffers op te stel. Vermoë om konsultante te bestuur. Uitstekende verslagskryf. Inisiatief, in staat om verantwoordelikheid te neem en sperdatums te haal. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om verslag te lewer. Vermoë om gemeenskapsvergaderings te fasiliteer. Goeie netwerk bou. Vermoë om terms of reference vir diensverskaffers op te stel. Bereidwilligheid om te reis, vir lang tydperke in die veld deur te bring en onreëlmatige ure te werk.
af.duties: Koördineer die indiening van grondeise. Kategoriseer eise per plaaslike munisipaliteit. Raadpleeg munisipaliteite oor eise wat gesettleer moet word. Valideer grondeise. Voer mondelinge en argiefnavorsing uit. Voer terreininspeksieproses uit (Kartering). Identifiseer woning. Neem deel aan ontleding van lugfoto-verslae. Fasiliteer waar daar oorvleuelende grondeise is. Fasiliteer skeiding van huurders, bevoordeeldes van okkupasie en geregistreerde grondb_Regte. Verifieer ingediende eis. Voer in loco-inspeksie uit. Produseer in loco-inspeksieverslag. Help met sluiting van verbintenisregister. Koördineer skering van suspensierekening. Bestuur betaling van begunstigdes. Onderhandel die skikking van eise. Voer opsie-oefening met eisders uit. Identifiseer eise vir historiese en huidige waardasie deur die Office of the Valuer General. Eskaleer historiese waardasie vir aanbiedings. Settleer die eise. Voer verifikasieproses uit. Voer ontleding van stamboom uit. Teken voltooide naamverifikasieverslag af. Stel Section 42d-voorlegging op.

zu.title: Umqondisi Womthamo
zu.summary: Qondanisa futhi uqinisekise ukufakwa kwezimangalo zemithi yomhlaba e-East London, okudinga ithifikethi noma idiploma ezinhle kanye namaphesenti eminyaka eyi-3 kwezolimo noma izifundo zokuthuthukiswa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree / National Diploma kwi-Agriculture / Development Studies / Social Science / Law noma noma yikuphi ukufanele okuhlobene nalokho. Uhlolojikelele lonyaka we-3 weminyaka yokusebenza emzamweni wenguqulo yomhlaba. Ilayisense yokuqasha ehambisana nesimo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwezinto ezithuthukiswayo kufaka nolawulo olubambekayo. Izindlela namasu ocwaningo. Ukwenza umsebenzi wesikhungo somphakathi. Ukuqonda nokuhumusha i-Business Plan. Ulwazi olujulile kwezinguqulo zomhlaba kanye nezindaba eziphathelene nokuthuthukiswa. Ulwazi mayelana nokubuyiselwa kolwazi lomhlaba. Ulwazi ngoGuqulo lomhlaba. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya. Ukuphathwa kwezinto ezithuthukiswayo kufaka nolawulo olubambekayo. Ukuqonda nokuhumusha i-Business Plan. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukulawula umthamo. Ukuxoxisana. Ukuphatha isivumelwano. Ukuba ngumholi. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwayo). Ikono lokubhala izinqamuleli zomsebenzi abahlinzeka ngomsebenzi. Ikono lokuphatha abacebisi. Ukubhala imibiko ngokungathembeki. Ukuzethemba, ukwazi ukuthatha inkinga kanye nokuhlangabezana nesikhathi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ikono lokwenza imibiko. Ikono lokuqhuba imihlangano yomphakathi. Uxhumano oluhle. Ikono lokubhala izinqamuleli zomsebenzi abahlinzeka ngomsebenzi. Uku﬩a ukuvakasha, uku﬩a isikhathi eside ensimini futhi usebenze amahora angavamile.
zu.duties: Qondanisa ukufakwa izimangalo zemithi yomhlaba. Hlukanisa izimangilo ngamasipala wendawo. Xhumana namasipala mayelana nezimangalo ezizosetshenziswa. Qinisekisa izimangalo zemithi yomhlaba. Yenza ucwaningo olunkulumweni nolwesikhathi esidlule. Yenza inqubo yokuhlolwa kwendawo (Ukumapa). Khomba amakhaya. Thatha inxaxheba ekuhlaziyeni imibiko yezithombe ezivela esibhakabhakeni. Siza lapho kunemithi yomhlaba ephindaphindwe. Siza ekuhlukaniseni abahlawuzele, abazuza ekubeni nomhlaba nabanothile ababhalisile ilungelo lomhlaba. Qinisekisa izimangalo ezifakiwe. Yenza ukuhlola kwendawo. Yakha imibiko yokuhlola kwendawo. Sisa ekuvalweni kwesibuko sezibopho. Qondanisa ukusulwa kwe-akhawunti yosizo. Phatha ukukhokhelwa kwezinzuzo. Xoxa ngokumiswa kwemithi yomhlaba. Yenza khetho lezinketho nalabo abaphethe izimangalo. Khomba izimangalo zokuqashwa kwamanani amiswa isikhathi esidlule nanamuhla yiNdiyabe yokuqashwa kwamanani. Phakamisa ukutholwa kwamanani kwesikhathi esidlule ngezenzo. Misela izimangalo. Yenza inqubo yokuqinisekisa. Hlaziya isihlahla somndeni. Sayina imibiko eqedileyo yokuqinisekisa amagama. Bhala isibambiso se-Section 42d.

xh.title: Umlawuli woMsebenzi
xh.summary: Ilungelelanisa kuqinisekise ukungeniswa kwezikhalazo zamhlaba e East London, kufuneka kubekho idiploma okanye idigri echaphazelekayo kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava kokulungiswa komhlaba.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisezantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seQela le-12 kunye neQhalankqubo le-Bachelor okanye iDiploma yaseSizwe kwiZolimo / KwiNdalo eZithuthukiswayo / KwiNzululwazi yeZentlalo / ngomthetho okanye nalipho na elipelayo elifanayo. Iminyaka engu-3 yamava kwindawo yokulungisa umhlaba. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluthintekayo nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lokuthuthukisa kuquka ulawulo oluhlekisiweyo. Iindlela namakhulu ophando. Ukwenza lula uluntu. Ukuqonda nokutolika iNkqubo yeShishini. Ulwazi olugqithisileyo malunga nokulungiswa komhlaba namaphulo athe ngqo nokuthuthukiswa. Ulwazi malunga nokubuyiselwa kwamalungelo omhlaba. Ulwazi ngokuLungiswa koMhlaba. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa kwamaphakathi. Ulawulo lokuthuthukisa kuquka ulawulo oluhlekisiweyo. Ukuqonda nokutolika iNkqubo yeShishini. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lomsebenzi. Ukuqeqesha ngomnxeba. Ulawulo lweenkonzo. Ukulawula. Unxibelelwano (olunyathelweyo nolubhalwayo). Ikhono lokubhala iinkqubo zomsebenzi zabanikezeli beenkonzo. Ikhono lokulawula oorhulumede. Ukubhala iimbiko ezilungileyo. Insumo, ukuba nakho ukuthatha inxaxheba nokuyifeza kwixesha elichaziweyo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokwenza umbiko. Ikhono lokwenza lula iindibano zoluntu. Unxibelelwano olululo. Ikhono lokubhala iinkqubo zomsebenzi zabanikezeli beenkonzo. Ukulungelelana ukuhamba, ukuhlala ixesha elide edolophini nokusebenza iiyure ezingajonganga njalo.
xh.duties: Ilungelelanise ukungeniswa kwezikhalazo zamhlaba. Hlulahlula izikhalazo ngomasipala wengingqi. Nxibelelanisa namalungiselelo ukuba kuxoxwe ngazikhalazo eziza kuxazululwa. Qinisekisa izikhalazo zamhlaba. Yenza uphando lwasemlonyeni nolwegazethi. Yenza inkqubo yokujonga indawo (Ukuzoba umzila). Chonga indlu. Thatha inxaxheba kwahlulwa-lwahlulwa kweembiko zefoto ezithathwa ngaphezulu. Yenza lula apho kubakho khona izikhalazo zamhlaba eziphethanayo. Yenza lula ukuhlulwa kwabahlinzekiweyo, abazuza ngenkqubo yokuhlala kunye namalungelo abhalisiweyo omhlaba. Qinisekisa isikhalazo esingenisiweyo. Yenza ukujonga kwendawo. Velisa umbiko wokujoya kwendawo. Nceda kuvalweni kwesikhiya seelayiseni. Ilungelelanise ukucocwa kwe-akhawunti ethintelwe ngesikhashana. Phatha ukuhlinzwa kwezahluleli. Xoxa ngokuvelwa kwezikhalazo. Yenza inkqubo yokukhetha izikhalazo namakhalazi. Chonga izikhalazo ezifuna ukubalwa kwamaxabiso kwimbali nakwanamhlanwe yiQonga leVuler-Jenal. Phakamisa ukubalwa kwamaxabiso kwembili izikhundla kusenziwa amanikezelo. Xazulula izikhalazo. Yenza inkqubo yokuqinisekisa. Yenza uhlalutyo lwesithiyo somzi. Tyikitya umbiko ogqityiweyo wokuqinisekisa amagama. Bhala inikelo loluLungiselelo loMthetho 42d.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Administration
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Human Resource Administration in East London, requiring a National Diploma and 3 years' supervisory HR experience, at salary level 9.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Human Resources Management / Labour Relations / Human Resource Development / Public Administration / Public Management (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience at supervisory management in human resource management. PERSAL Personnel Certificate, PERSAL Leave Administration Certificate. Knowledge and experience in pension administration. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Employment Equity Act. Public Service Regulations. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Public Service Act. Skills Development Act. Labour Relations Act. Public Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC) resolutions. Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). Public Finance Management Act. Job related skills: Analytical thinking. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Report writing ability. Problem solving ability.
jobs.duties: Implement and monitor human resources prescripts. Implement human resource management resolutions. Keep employees well informed on new developments of human resource prescripts. Monitor employee benefits and conditions of service. Oversee processing of service terminations timeously. Check and ensure correct completion/submission of pension forms including nomination forms. Keep and maintain a database for submitted cases to Government Employees Pension Fund (GEPF). Follow-up on all outstanding pension claims with GEPF. Assist deceased employee’s family to claim funeral benefit from GEPF. Identify, draw and keep annual list of all employees due to retirement. Make payment follow-ups and attend to pension queries. Provide feedback to pension beneficiaries. Recover all liabilities from pension proceeds. Coordinate or conduct service benefits workshops. Ensure compliance with the relevant prescripts when processing allowances. Ensure correct implementation of allowances on PERSAL e.g. housing acting etc. Approve leave transactions and ensure that correct codes are used. Ensure that leave applications comply with policies and prescripts. Ensure submission of leave plans and adherence thereof. Verify correctness of incapacity applications and ensure timeous submission to the Health Risk Manager. Liaise with the Health Risk Manager regarding submitted incapacity applications. Implement decision. Verify over granted leave prior to service termination of officials. Check and verify leave gratuity/discounting calculations and ensure correctness. Conduct workshops/induction on leave. Conduct leave audits. Facilitate and implement performance management, training and development. Check the database of Personal Development Plans (PDP’s). Consolidate provincial inputs of Workplace Skills Plans (WSP) which addresses skills requirements. Check compliance of submissions of employees requiring training. Coordinate provincial training and development activities. Consolidate training statistics. Approve Employee Performance Management and Development System (EPMDS) documents on PERSAL. Ensure that EPMS statistics is updated and submitted weekly. Arrange moderating committee (MC) meetings. Check and quality assure MC outcome letters. Compile memo for approval of performance rewards. Approve / authorise the implemented performance rewards. Register System Change Control (SCC) to correct service records of employees after payment of pay progression. Do arrangements to process payments of employees who terminated service with the Department. Arrange meetings to discuss dissatisfaction cases. Monitor and implement recruitment and selection. Check funded and vacant posts on PERSAL. Verify submission and supporting documents for advertisement. Ensure that employment equity targets are updated. Monitor adherence to recruitment and selection plans. Check minutes and proceedings after the shortlisting process. Check submission for selection of suitable candidates. Confirm security screening and qualification screening results. Ensure that posts are filled within the prescribed period. Approve appointments, transfers, translation on PERSAL. Ensure that officials are correctly placed on PERSAL. Facilitate and monitor employee relations processes. Monitor disciplinary cases submitted for compliance with prescribed timeframes. Check progress on the resolution of cases with National Office. Assist with the implementation of sanctions. Monitor compilation statistics on disciplinary cases submitted. Facilitate meetings with organised labour. Provide advice on grievances, misconduct and discipline matters. Implement the disciplinary hearing sanctions. Facilitate the resolution of grievances within the prescribed period.

jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Ocean Terrace, Block H, corner of Coutts and Moore Street, Quigney, East London or by email to Post192@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured and Indian Males and Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie in East London, vereis 'n Nasionale Diploma en 3 jaar se toesighoudende HR-ervaring, op salarisvlak 9.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Arbeidsverhoudinge / Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur (NQF Level 6) of 'n verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in toesighoudende bestuur in menslike hulpbronbestuur. PERSAL Personeelsertifikaat, PERSAL Verlofadministrasiesertifikaat. Kennis en ervaring in pensioenadministrasie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Wet op Indiensnemingregverdighed. Openbare Diensregulasies. Wet op Basiese Diensvoorwaardes. Openbare Dienswet. Wet op Vaardigheidsontwikkeling. Wet op Arbeidsverhoudinge. Resolusies van die Onderhandelende Koördinerende Raad van die Openbare Diens (PSCBC). Bevordering van die Wet op Toegang tot Inligting (PAIA). Bevordering van die Wet op Regterlike Administrasie (PAJA). Wet op Openbare Finansiesbestuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Analitiese denke. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Verslagdoeningsvermoë. Probleemoplossingsvermoë.
af.duties: Implementeer en monitor menslike hulpbronvoorskrifte. Implementeer menslike hulpbronbestuursresolusies. Hou werknemers ingelig oor nuwe ontwikkelings van menslike hulpbronvoorskrifte. Monitor werknemerbydrae en diensvoorwaardes. Hou toesig oor die tydige verwerking van diensbeëindigings. Kontroleer en verseker die korrekte invulling/indiening van pensioenvorms, insluitend benoemingsvorms. Hou en onderhou 'n databasis vir ingediende sake by die Government Employees Pension Fund (GEPF). Volg alle uitstaande pensioeneise by GEPF op. Help die oorlede werknemer se gesin om begrafnisvoordele by GEPF te eis. Identifiseer, trek en hou 'n jaarlikse lys van alle werknemers wat op die punt staan om af te tree. Doen betalingsopvolgings en hanteer pensioennavrae. Verskaf terugvoer aan pensioenbegunstigdes. Herwin alle aansprake uit pensioenopbrengste. Koördineer of voer diensvoordele-werkswinkels uit. Verseker nakoming van die relevante voorskrifte by die verwerking van toelaes. Verseer die korrekte implementering van toelaes op PERSAL, bv. behuising, waarneming, ens. Keur verloftransaksies goed en verseer dat die korrekte kodes gebruik word. Verseer dat verlofaansoeke aan beleide en voorskrifte voldoen. Verseer die indiening van verlofplanne en die nakoming daarvan. Verifieer die korrektheid van ongeskiktheidsaansoeke en verseker die tydige indiening daarvan by die Gesondheidsrisikobestuurder. Skakel met die Gesondheidsrisikobestuurder rakens ingediende ongeskiktheidsaansoeke. Implementeer besluite. Verifieer oormatige verlof voor die diensbeëindiging van amptenare. Kontroleer en verifieer verlofgratifikasie/afslagberekeninge en verseer korrektheid. Voer werkswinkels/induksie oor verlof uit. Voer verlofoudits uit. Fasiliteer en implementeer prestasiebestuur, opleiding en ontwikkeling. Kontroleer die databasis van Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's). Konsolideer provinsiale insette van Werkplekvaardigheidplanne (WSP) wat aan vaardigheidsvereistes voldoen. Kontroleer die nakoming van indienings van werknemers wat opleiding benodig. Koördineer provinsiale opleidings- en ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite. Konsolideer opleidingsstatistiek. Keur Werknemerprestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel (EPMDS)-dokumente op PERSAL goed. Verseer dat EPMS-statistiek bygewerk en weekliks ingedien word. Reël matigingskomitee (MC)-vergaderings. Kontroleer en verseer gehalte van MC-uitslae-briewe. Stel 'n memo op vir die goedkeuring van prestasiabelonings. Keur/maak die geïmplementeerde prestasi belonings toeganklik. Registreer System Change Control (SCC) om diensrekords van werknemers na betaling van salarisvoortgang te korrigeer. Maak reëlings om betalings te prosesseer van werknemers wie se diens by die Departement beëindig is. Reël vergaderings om ontevredenheidsake te bespreek. Monitor en implementeer werwerwing en keuring. Kontroleer befondsde en vakante poste op PERSAL. Verifieer indiening en ondersteunende dokumente vir advertensies. Verseer dat indiensnemingregverdigheidsdoelwitte bygewerk word. Monitor nakoming van werwings- en keuringsplanne. Kontroleer notules en verrigtinge na die kortlysmakeringsproses. Kontroleer indiening vir keuring van geskikte kandidate. Bevestig resultate van sekuriteitskontrolering en kwalifikasieverificering. Verseer dat poste binne die voorgeskrewelde periode gevul word. Keur aanstellings, oorplasing en translasie op PERSAL goed. Verseer dat amptenare korrek op PERSAL geplaas word. Fasiliteer en monitor werknemersverhoudingsprosesse. Monitor dissiplinêre sake wat vir nakoming van voorgeskrewelde tydperke ingedien is. Kontroleer vordering rakende die afhandeling van sake by die Nasionale Kantoor. Help met die implementering van sanksies. Monitor samestelling van statistiek oor ingediende dissiplinêre sake. Fasiliteer vergaderings met georganiseerde arbeid. Verskaf advies oor griewe, wangedrag en dissiplinêre aangeleenthede. Implementeer die dissiplinêre verhoor-sanksies. Fasiliteer die oplossing van griewe binne die voorgeskrewelde tydperk.

zu.title: Onozinti: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu
zu.summary: Onozinti: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu e-East London, kudinga i-National Diploma kanye neminyaka eyi-3 yesipiliyoni sokuphatha kwi-HR, eholo izinga 9.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane okudingekayo: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma kwi-Human Resources Management / Labour Relations / Human Resource Development / Public Administration / Public Management (NQF Level 6) noma iziqu ezifana nalezo. Okuncane ukuthi ube neminyaka eyi-3 yesipiliyoni sokuphatha kwi-human resource management. Isitifiketi se-PERSAL Personnel, isitifiketi se-PERSAL Leave Administration. Ulwazi nesipiliyoni ekuphathweni kohlolomhlalabo. Ilayisensi yokushayela ehambisana nemigomo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Employment Equity Act. Public Service Regulations. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Public Service Act. Skills Development Act. Labour Relations Act. Izinqumo ze-Public Service Co-ordinating Bargaining Council (PSCBC). Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). Public Finance Management Act. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Qalisa futhi ulawule imiyalo yezinsiza zabantu. Qalisa izinqumo ezimala nezinsiza zabantu. Gcina izisebenzi zikunjululewe ngentuthuko entsha ngemiyalo yezinsiza zabantu. Qaphela izinzuzo zezisebenzi nezimo zokusebenza. Bheka ukuthi inqobo nje itholakala ngokuphela kwesevisi. Hlola futhi uqiniseke ukuthi kugcwaliswe/kunikelwa ngendlela efanele amafomu ohlolomhlalabo kufaka phakathi amafomu okhethwayo. Gcina futhi ulondoloze idathabheyisi yamacala anikelwe kuGovernment Employees Pension Fund (GEPF). Landela konke okuseleyo kwamaphesenti eGEPF. Siza umndeni wesebenzi eseshiye izwe ukuthi athole inzuzo yonkulo eGEPF. Hlola, khwebula futhi ugcinwe uhlu lwaneminyaka yonke yezisebenzi zonke eziseduze nokuthatha umhlalaphansi. Yenza ukulandela ukukhokhwa futhi uphendule imibuzo yohlolomhlalabo. Nikela imbiko obuyela kubazuza ohlolomhlalabo. Buyisawo yonke imali okufanele kuhlolwe ohlolomhlalabo. Hleze noma wenze amakilasi ezinzuzo zokusebenza. Qiniseka ukuthi kulandelwa imiyalo ehambisana nalapho kucutshungulwa amasente ezinsiza. Qiniseka ukuthi amasente azolawulwa kahle kwi-PERSAL isb. izindlu, ukubekwa njengabambiswe, njll. Vuma ukushintshana kwemvume yokuhlala ikhaya futhi qiniseke ukuthi kusetshenziswa amakhodi afanele. Qiniseka ukuthi izicelo zokuhlala zivumelana nemigomo nemiqulu. Qiniseka ukuthi kunikelwa iplani yokuhlala futhi kulandelwe. Qiniseka ukuhamba kahle kwezicelo zobudonda futhi uqiniseke ukuthi zinikelwa esikhundleni kumlawuli wezingozi ezempilweni ngokushesha. Xhumana nomlawuli wezingozi ezempilweni mayelana nezicelo zobudonda ezinikelwe. Yenza izinqumo. Hlola ukuphuma kwemvume ngaphambi kokuphela kwesevisi kubasebenzi. Hlola futhi uqiniseke ukuthi izibalo zesibonezela sikahamba kahle/nqumela kwamaholo futhi zilungile. Yenza amakilasi/isingeniso ngemvume. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwemvume. Yenza futhi uqalise ukuphathwa kokusebenza, ukuqeqesha nentuthuko. Hlola idathabheyisi yamaPlani entuthuko yomuntu ngamunye (PDP's). Hlanganisa okufakwe izifunda zeplani yamakhono omsebenzi (WSP) ephatha izidingo zamakhono. Hlola ukulandelwa kwemigomo yokunika abasebenzi abadinga ukuqeqeshwa. Hleza izenzo zokuqeqesha nentuthuko ezifundeni. Hlanganisa izibalo zokuqeqesha. Vuma amafayili EsiNzuzo Sokuqasha Nokuphathwa Kwezisebenzi (EPMDS) kwi-PERSAL. Qiniseka ukuthi izibalo ze-EPMS zibuyekeziwe futhi zinikelwa njalo masonto. Hlela izinkumpane zokulinganisela (MC). Hlola futhi uqiniseke ukuthi incwadi yezincomo ze-MP ihamba kahle. Hlela inkumbulo yokuvuma izipho zokusebenza. Vuma / gunyaza izipho zokusebenza ezisetshenziswayo. Bhalisa iSystem Change Control (SCC) ukuze kulungiswe irekhodi lesevisi yezisebenzi emva kokukhokha ukwanda kwamaholo. Yeza izinhlelo zokuqasha izisebenzi abashiye isevisi nomnyango. Hlela izinkumpane ukuxoxa ngamacala okungahambi kahle. Qaphela futhi uqalise ukubhaliswa nokukhethwa. Hlola izikhundla ezikhokhiwe nezize ku-PERSAL. Qiniseka ukuthi kunikelwe imibhalo esekelayo yalokho okuthunyelwe abakhangiswa abasha. Qiniseka ukuthi izinhloso zokulinganisela ezifundeni zibuyekeziwe. Qaphela ukulandelwa kwezinhlelo zokubhaliswa nokukhethwa. Hlola amaminithi nokuqhubeka kwezinkumbase ngemva kokuhlehlwa uhlu lwabakhethiwayo. Hlola okunikelwe ukuze kukhethwe abantu abafanele. Qaphela imiphumela yokuseswa kokuphepha kanye nokuseswa kwemfundo. Qiniseka ukuthi izikhundla zigcwaliswa esikhundleni esibaluliwe. Vuma ukubhaliswa, ukudluliswa, ukuguqulwa kwi-PERSAL. Qiniseka ukuthi abasebenzi babekwe kahle kwi-PERSAL. Yenza futhi ulawule inqubo yezinkambiso zezisebenzi. Qaphela izenzo ezingahambi kahle ezithunyelwe ukuze zivumelane nesikhathi esibaluliwe. Qaphela ukuthi kuhamba kanjani ukuxazululwa kwamacala eNdiwo yesiQango. Siza ngokuqalisa izinqumo. Qaphela izibalo mayelana nezicelo zezenzo ezingahambi kahle ezithunyelwe. Siza izinkumpane nomsebenzi ohleliwe. Nikela izeluleko ngamacala okukhalaza, ukuziphatha kabi nokungathathi ihlabathi. Phatha izinqumo zokuzwa izenzo. Siza ukuxazulula izikhalazo ngasesikhundleni esibaluliwe.

xh.title: Umncedisi Wecala: Urhwebo lweZabantu
xh.summary: Umncedisi Wecala: Urhwebo lweZabantu eEast London, lifuna iDiploma yeSizwe kunye neminyaka emi-3 yamava obaphathi kwindima yerhwebo labantu, kwingqanaba lomvuzo 9.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno esiseko: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesiGinqiba seGqeberha eli-12 kwaye nesiDiploma esiSizwe kuLawulo lwamabalule eZabantu / ukuHamba koluse ngaphakathi kweziBaho / uPhuhliso lwerhwebo labantu / uLawulo lweZigoromkaka / uLawulo lwamagosa esiZwe (NQF Level 6) okanye isifanekiso esinxulumeneyo. Ubuncinane iiminyaka emi-3 yamava kulawulo lokuqonda kulawulo lwesiseko esithintela urhwebo labants. IAT yabasebenzi bePERSAL, IAT yolawulo lweNqaml yolwazi iphathwa ngamagosa esiBhalo. Ulwazi namava kulawulo lomvuzo wogqitho koluse. Ilayisenisi yokushwankathela efunwa kumthetho ngokubonakalayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nesebe: Ithetho lokulinganisela ukubakho koluntu. Imimiselo yoLuntu yesiZwe esebenzayo. Ithetho lemiba yakwaseKhaladi egqithiselwe ngokobomi esiBhalo esiseko. Ithetho leZiko loluntu eseBhalweni. Ithetho leSiseko esibanzi seNtloko. Ithetho lokuQonda ngokubakho koluntu olukwaziyo lweSiseko. Ithetho lokulinganisa olusuka esibhalweni somntu wonke. Ithetho lokwazisa koluntu lokwenza isigqibo sokuqhuba koluntu (PAIA). Ithetho lokwazisa ngokubakho koluntu lokulungelelana koluntu (PAJA). Ithetho lokulawula iMali esakuziwa esiBhalweni (PFMA). Amakhono ahambelana nesebe: Ukucinga ngokuphonononga. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo kunye nobhalo). Ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha. Ukubhala ingxelo. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Zisele ixesha lonke ukuzinza koluntu kwamagosa esiBhalweni. Umisele inkqubo yokukhankanya iingxelo zamagosa esiBhalweni. Gcina abantu beziko bakwazise ngemiqulu esitsha yamagosa esiBhalweni. Phatha iinzuzo zabantu basebenza kwakhona emisebenzini yomhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuba olu hlobo lusebenzise ngokukhawuleza ekupheleni koluntu abaluvela kwindawo nesebe lale minyaka igqithile. Jonga ukuze uqiniseke ukuba iifomu zomvuzo zilungele ukuhambisa zize zingene kwindawo nazo. Hlala uzihamba ngokuphathwa koluntu iinkqubo ezingeneyo kwaba bantu baye bakwazi ukuba bancedwe ngokubakho koluntu. Hlalisele iingozi ezifanelekileyo ongazihlanganiseyo koluntu zomvuzo walawo boke bakwenze. Songela ngoMhla wokuqala ntlimbi wakwakho oKumkani ukusuka esibhakabhakeni. Beka iinkqubo ngokwenene zomhlaba wentlimbi oKumkani wakho, kwaye uzigcine ubukhulu. Yenza izicwangciso zokuncedisa abantu abathandwa nguKhululeko lolwazi ukuyixhasa uluntu ngokuzenzakalelayo. Qwalasela iimfuno zokuqwalasela imicimbi yexesha esele noluntu. Nikeza ngolwazi kwizikhulwana ezisebenza ngaphantsi koluntu. Qwalasela ukuthengiswa koluntu kwezinto ngokutsha koluntu oluvela kumthetho esitebelo. Yenza uqwalaselo lokumisela kwakhona urhwebo lwamagosa esiBhalweni ngokutsha lokuqwalaselwa koluntu. Qwalasela urhwebo oluthengisa amagosa esiBhalweni ngendlela efanelekileyo. Lungiselela inqanaba elilodwa lokuphumelela ngexesha elifanelekileyo lomvuzo namakhosi abantu basebenzayo basebenzela olunye uluntu lwase Kondlavelo. Yenza iinkcukacha ezifanayo ngokuhamba kwexesha koluntu oluthengiswa. Hlola igalelo labantu abangahoywa ngokuzenzakalela kwabakho bengcali kwindalo ezingenayo yolonwabo kuluntu kwaye ulungelelanise uluntu oluthengisa ngendlela echanekileyo. Yenza ukuba izikhulwana zibe ngokuqinisekileyo ngezixhobo ezifanelekileyo. Hamba ngakumbi kwinkqubo yokudlulisa koluntu kwindawo ekhoyo yamagosa esiBhalweni ngokutsha ngendlela efanelekileyo. Phathisa ngenkqubo yamalungiselelo abantu basebenzayo kwakhona.

jobs.summary: Manage daily media monitoring services for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, tracking coverage on land reform and distributing clippings nationally.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Communications / Journalism / Media / Marketing / Public Relations (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in communications service environment. Proven experience in social media management, content creation, and campaign execution is often required. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Policies and legislations governing communication. Exhibitions and events as communication platforms. Job related skills: Computer literacy. Interpersonal. relations. Communication (verbal and written). Analytical thinker. Decision making. Problem solving and organisational ability. Social media ability. Ability and willingness to travel extensively and work outside office hours.

Collate news media clippings. Distribute media clippings to clients nationally, including Provincial Shared Service Centers (PSSCs) through e-mail and other platforms. Provide media rapid response service in collaboration with Government Communication and Information System (GCIS) on pertinent or controversial media reportage. Keep track of all social media platforms, publish regularly, reply to posts and engage with audiences to build relationships and brand loyalty. Analyse departmental media coverage. Produce weekly media coverage report with summaries of the week’s main stories. Track and report on social media analytics, monitor key performance indicators for compilation of periodic reports. Advice management on proactive actions to counter negative publicity in the traditional and social media spaces. Source and develop regular content for use on internal and external media and marketing platforms, including audio-visual, print and digital communication platforms, including Facebook, X App, TikTok, and Instagram. Manage and coordinate departmental Podcast and other supplementary digital communication platforms. Contribute articles / stories to newsletters. Provide communication support during events of the Department. Profile branches, entities and stakeholders of the Department. Interview internal and external clients of the Department. Develop innovative ways for new articles writing, publishing and distribution. Manage, supervise, and give guidance to subordinates. Assign tasks to staff members. Provide guidance to staff members on how task should be performed. Assess performance of subordinates.
