af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Aktuele Sake
af.summary: Bestuur daaglikse mediabewakingsdienste vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, spoor dekking oor gronderhervorming na en versprei knipsels nasionaal.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Kommunikasie / Joernalistiek / Media / Bemarking / Openbare Betrekkinge (NQF Level 6) of 'n verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n kommunikasiediensomgewing. Bewese ervaring in sosiale media-bestuur, inhoudskepping en veldtoguitvoering word dikwels vereis. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van beleide en wetgewing wat kommunikasie regeer. Tentoonstellings en geleenthede as kommunikasieplatforms. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Analitiese denker. Besluitneming. Probleemoplossing en organisatoriese vermoë. Sosiale media-vermoë. Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om wyd te reis en buite kantoorure te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur die daaglikse mediabewakingsdiens. Voer mediabewaking uit om media-dekking oor gronderhervorming, grondbestuur en landelike ontwikkeling by te hou. Stel nuusmediaknipsels saam. Versprei mediaknipsels nasionaal aan kliënte, insluitend Provincial Shared Service Centers (PSSCs), per e-pos en ander platforms. Verskaf 'n vinnige mediareaksiensdiens in samewerking met Government Communication and Information System (GCIS) oor ter sake of omstrede mediadekking. Hou alle sosiale media-platforms dop, publiseer gereeld, reageer op plasings en tree met gehore in aanraking om verhoudings en merklojaliteit op te bou. Analiseer departementele mediadekking. Produseer 'n weeklikse mediadekkingsverslag met opsommings van die week se hoofstories. Spoor sosiale media-analitiek na en rapporteer daaroor, hou sleutelprestasie-aanwysers dop vir samestelling van periodieke verslae. Adviseer bestuur oor proaktiewe maatreëls om negatiewe publisiteit in die tradisionele en sosiale mediaruimtes teen te werk. Verskaf en ontwikkel gereelde inhoud vir gebruik op interne en eksterne media- en bemarkingsplatforms, insluitend oudiovisuele, druk- en digitale kommunikasieplatforms, insluitend Facebook, X App, TikTok en Instagram. Bestuur en koördineer die departementele potgooi en ander aanvullende digitale kommunikasieplatforms. Dra artikels / stories tot nuusbriewe by. Verskaf kommunikasieondersteuning tydens geleenthede van die Departement. Profiliseer takke, entiteite en belanghebbendes van die Departement. Onderhou onderhoude met interne en eksterne kliënte van die Departement. Ontwikkel innoverende maniere vir die skryf, publisering en verspreiding van nuwe artikels. Bestuur, hou toesig oor en gee leiding aan ondergeskiktes. Wys take toe aan staadslede. Verskaf leiding aan staadslede oor hoe take uitgevoer moet word. Beoordeel prestasie van ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Onozinjana: I-Current Affairs
zu.summary: Phatha nsuku zonke inkonzo yokulalela imedia yomnyango we-Land Reform and Rural Development, ukulanda ukushiswa kwezindaba ngenhlabathi nokusatshalaliswa kwezikhirope kuzo zonke izindawo.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka umuntu abe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma ye-National kulezi zinhlanu zezifundo: Izinkulumo / Indaba ezithunyelwa kwelinye ilizwe / Imishini yokuxhumana / Ukuthengisa / Ukuhlobana nomphakathi (NQF Level 6) noma ezinye iziqu ezifanayo nalezi. Kudingeka abe nopilo lokuqonda izinto ezintsha ezibhalwe emhlabeni wonke jikelele, ikakhulukazi kulezi zinkalo ezilandelayo: ukwazi ukuphathwa kwezinkulumo-magama, ukudalwa kokuqukethwe nokusetshenziswa kwamasu okuthola abantu abaningi. Kudingeka abe namakhono okusebenza ngekhompyutha, okuhlanganisa nokwazi ukusebenzisa izinto ezinjengabalingisi bezinkulumo-magama, ukubhala nokufunda. Ukuze akwazi ukuhlola, aqonde futhi enze izinqumo ezinhle. Kudingeka futhi abe namakhono okulawula imishini yokuxhumana kwezentengiso nokuxhumana nabantu. Kufanele abe nothando lokuqonda izinkinga ezithile futhi akwazi ukuzixazulula. Kudingeka futhi abe namakhono okusebenza kahle nabanye futhi abe nesibindi sokugibela ibhasi ukuze ayekwazi ukuhamba amakhilomitha amaningi, aphinde akwazi ukusebenza ngisho nangezinsuku ezingezona ezenkantu. Ku-requirements okudingekayo kule minyakho yezindaba: ukwazi kanye nokuqonda kwezinkulumo ezisetshenziswa kule minyakho.
zu.duties: Palaza nsuku zonke inkonzo yokulalela imedia. Yenza ukulalela imedia ukuze ulande izindaba ngokushiswa kwezindaba mayelana ngenhlabathi, abaphathi benhlabathi nentuthuko yemakhaya. Qoqa izikhirope zezindaba ezishisiwe. Yabelana ngesikhirope sezindaba nakuzo lonke ilunga lezithakazelo kulelo zwe lonke, okuhlanganisa namasikhungo asezingeni lephrovinsi asebenza ngokuhlanganyela (PSSCs) nge-imeyili nakwezinye izinkundla. Nikeza inkonzo yokujoyinda umlilo ukusiza mayelana nemedia, kubambisene nehlelo lokuxhumana likahulumeni nolwazi (GCIS), ekubikeni ngezindaba ezibalulekile noma ezibangela impikiswano. Landa ukuthi kuyaqhubeka yini yonke imishini yokuxhumana kwezentengiso ekhaya nakwalabo ababukelayo, shicilela kaningi, phendula iziyalo futhi uncume kubantu abaningi ukwakha ubudlelwano nenkambiso yokukhuthaza abathengi. Hlaziya mayelana nenhlabathi nokuthi kuyaqhubeka yini imidiya etholakalayo kakhulu emnyangweni. Yenza imibiko yamasonto onke mayelana nezindaba ezishisiwe, okuhlanganisa nokubhala kabusha okufushane ngemibhalo eminingi. Qoqa nokuthi imishini yokuxhumana kwezentengiso isebenza kanjani futhi ulandele imibandela yesimo esihle sokuthi kutholwe imibiko ethile. Phendula ngokuphathwa kwabantu ngokuthi abanye bacinge ngale ndaba ekulawuleni imishini yokuxhumana nobunkondliphili obuvelele ekuqoqeni imibiko yezinsuku ezithile. Tshela iziphathimandla ukuthi zenzani ukuze zithole izindaba ezinhle abantu abazitholile, okuhlanganisa ukuba bakhulume nabo, nokuthi basakaze ngakho. Qondanisa imibhalo etholakala kumakhulu okuxhumana nanoma yimaphi amanye amakhulu okuxhumana kwezentengiso eklabhini, okuhlanganisa nokuthi kutholwe izinkulumo-magama nemibhalo ejwayelekile kumakhulu okuxhumana nakwamanye amakhulu okuthengisa. Linganisa nokuthi imishini yokuxhumana kwezentengiso ihlobene kanjani nezinsiza ezitholakalayo nakubantu ababukela imibhalo. Yenza imibhalo elungiselelwe ukusetshenziswa kumakhulu okuxhumana kwezentengiso angaphakathi nangaphandle, kanye nokuyikhomba ekuthumeleni imibhalo yemidiya ekhaya nakulabo abangaphandle. Phepha nokuthola imibhalo ejwayelekile kubantu abashintshe ngekhanda labo, beke itshaniwe futhi abantu bayibone, bese kuba khona ithuba lokuba abantu bacabange ngale ndaba nokuthi bangayixhasa kanjani le ndaba. Khombisa iziqu eziyingqayizivele ekuthumeleni imibhalo kuwo wonke umuntu okhuluma nalowo ovezwa yiwonke umuntu. Bethela imibhalo elinganiselwe mayelana nenhlabathi nokuthi ihlobene kanjani nomhlabawonke. Thutha abantu abangaphandle ngamandla omnyango, kufaka phakathi abantu abangaphandle nangaphakathi. Babuze imibuzo abantu abangaphandle kanye nabangaphakathi bomnyango. Yenza izindlela ezintsha zokubhala, ukushicilela nokusatshalaliswa kwezindaba. Phatha, qondisa futhi unikeze iseluleko abantu abangaphansi kwakho. Nikeza umsebenzi kubasebenzi. Nikeza iseluleko kubasebenzi ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kanjani. Hlola ukusebenza kwabangaphansi kwakho.

xh.title: lawuli oyedwa wezabaphathi wezabaphathi: iindaba zangoku
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zokuqwalasela iindaba zemihla ngemihla zeSebe loGuqulo lweMitha noLawulo nokuThuthukiswa kwamaPhondo, ukulandela iindaba ezimalunga noguqulo lwemitha nokusasaza iinkatsha zendaba kuwo wonke ilizwe.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona msinya: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGreyidi 12 kwaye babe neDiploma yaseZiko lemfundo ephakamileyo kwiZomazwaz / iNdaba / iMeyibha / iNtengiso / iZorhwebo lwasekuhlaleni (NQF Level 6) okanye isidanga esilinganayo esinxulumeneyo. Kufuneka abe nokuba nokuhlolwa okungaphantsi kweminyaka emi-3 yamava kulawulo lwezokuxhumana. Kulindelekile ukuba abe namava aboniswe ngokusimama kolawulo kuxhaso lwezentlalo ze-intanethi, ukudalwa kweziqulatho, kwaye oqhuba amava ekuphumezelelweni kwemisebenzi. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluxhomekeke kumsebenzi: Ulwazi ngeMigaqo-siseko namalungiselelo alawula izokuxhumana. Iimbali zentengiso nakwamaxabiso njengendlela ezisetyenziswa ukuxhumanisa nabathengi. Amandla okusebenza oluxhomekeke kumsebenzi: Ukuba lisebele kakhulu ekusebenzeni kwekhompyutha. Amava obudlelwane bakho kunye nabanye abantu. Ukuchaza (ngelizwi elithethwayo nangalokubhaliweyo). Ukucinga ngenkqubo yesi sacholo. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukusombulula iingxaki ngenkqubo yolawulo olungekho ukulunga. Amandla ekusebenzeni kuxhaso lwezokuqwalasela kwezentlalo ze-intanethi. Amandla nokulungelelanisa ukuhamba kakhulu kwakhona usebenze ngaphandle kweyure ezimiselweyo zolawulo.
xh.duties: Phatha inkonzo yokuqwalasela iphephandaba yemihla ngemihla. Yenza ukuqwalasela kwabezindaba ukuze ulandelise indaba ephathwe ngabezindaba malunga noguqulo lwemitha yolawulo, ulawulo lwemitha nokuthuthukiswa kwamaphondo. Qokelela iinkatsha zendaba ezithi zithunyelwe kumaphephandaba. Yasule iinkatsha zendaba nakumaxhasa kuwo wonke amaphondo, kuquka neenkonzo eziya kwi-Provincial Shared Service Centers (PSSCs) nge-imeyile nakwezinye iinkqubo. Nikezela ngenkonzo yophulo olukhawulezayo lokuphendula kabezindaba ngokubambisana ne-Government Communication and Information System (GCIS) ngendaba ezibalulekileyo okanye ezingqubuzanayo ezithunyelwa kumaphephandaba. Landela zonke iinkqubo zoxhaso lwezentlalo, shicilela ngokuhlala-hlala, phendula izimemo zenze umanyano nabathengi ukuze wakhe iintlangano nokuthembeka kwentsengo. Qwalasela indaba ephathwe ngabezindaba ngeSebe. Yenza ingxelo yamveki yonke ngenkcazelo yendaba ephathwe ngabezindaba, iqule iinkathazo eziphambili zeviki. Landela ulwazi kuxhaso lwezokuqwalasela kuwezentlalo ze-intanethi, qwalasele izalathiso eziphambili zokusebenza ukuze zenziwe iingxelo ngamaxesha athile. Nika izikhokelo abalawuli ngezenzo ezingathathiwa ngxaki ukuze kugqithiswe iindaba ezimbi ezibhalwe kumaphephandaba aqhelekileyo nakuxhaso lwezokuqwalasela kwezentlalo ze-intanethi. Zifune kwaye uphuhle iziqulatho ezahlala zithi zibenziwe kwiinkqubo ezizakusebenza ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezobuchwepheshe, kwindlela yokubumba umfanekiso nokubhalwa kweenkcazelo, iinkqubo zokudlula iinkcazelo, iinkqubo zokudlula iinkcazelo nge-intanethi, iquka i-Facebook, i-X App, iTikTok, ne-Instagram. Phatha ulawulo kakhulu nezinye iinkqubo zokubumba iinkcazelo ezingenasiqu. Yenza iingxelo ngeendaba ezahlala zithi zibenziwe kumaphephandaba. Yenza iingxelo ngendaba ezahlala zithi zibenziwe kumaphephandaba. Zifune iindlela ezintsha zokubala iindaba ezahlala zithi zibenziwe, ukuzishicilela nokuzisasaza. Lawula, qwalasele, kwaye unike izikhokelo abasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho. Misela imisebenzi kubasebenzi. Nikezela izikhokelo abasebenzi ngendlela emiselweyo yokwenza umsebenzi. Qwalasela inkqubo yabasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakho.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior Administrative Officer managing restitution land claims databases and records at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in East London.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Information Management / Information Science / Records Management (NQF Level 6) or National Diploma in Business Administration or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in restitution, records management environment, registry services. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of statistical, registry and records management. Knowledge of projects and process. Knowledge of government legislation that governs National Archives and Records Service Act. Job related skills: Time management skills. Planning and organising skills. Decision making skills. Computer literacy. Analytical skills. Telephone etiquette. Interpersonal and communication (verbal and written) skills. Ability to carry out registry and records management activities. The ability to always work efficiently and effectively.
jobs.duties: Develop, administer and maintain restitution land claims database. Maintain the implementation of file plan in the office. Check the quality of standardised files. Compile the report of standardised files and inventory. Update inventory of standardised files. Update inventory of approved Section 42D’s. Provide land restitution claims related information. Compile spreadsheet on letters complied for claimants. Give claimants accurate information regarding the status of their claims. Respond to general enquiries about the lodgement of land claims. Update statistical information for the office in all land claims lodged and settled. Provide registry services. Receive and issue brown files not scanned on Electronic Document Management System (EDMS). Receive and register incoming files. Keep records of files and collected information for existing land claims. Ensure that registry rules are adhered to by officials. Monitor access to registry system. Monitor and control movement of files by registering them on movement control sheet. Conduct file audit to ensure that no files are kept for more than 5 days in officials office unless the official ask for extension. Maintain office search. Ensure all files transferred to registry are recorded from clients. File indexing. Spot check on file at registry/incident audit. Maintaining filling system. Capture approved projects or files for easy retrieval in registry and create file number for approved Section 42D, Section 42C and Section 42E. Check all Section 42D’s dispatched to and received from national office if all documents are signed and returned same as was dispatched. Update and provide land claims information to project teams to enable the acceptance and gazetting of claims. Receive and register incoming and approved files. Update the status of the claims on approved acceptance research report, non-compliant, dismissed, deferred and gazetted claims. Ensure that new information received from operational units is captured on spreadsheet. Keep statistics of files captured on spreadsheet and report monthly. Coordinate and execute other administrative duties. Provide clerical support services to the directorate. Provide personnel administration clerical support services. Provide financial administration services in the component. Process documents for archival and disposal. Operate office machine in relation to registry functions.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A van Vuuren Tel No: (043) 701 8127 or Ms A Kili Tel No: (043) 701 8186
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Ocean Terrace, Block H, corner of Coutts and Moore Street, Quigney, East London or by email to Post191@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Indian and White Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte wat restitusie-grondeise-databasisse en -rekords by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in East London bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Inligtingsbestuur / Inligtingswetenskap / Rekordbestuur (NQF Level 6) of 'n Nasionale Diploma in Besigheidsadministrasie of 'n verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Minimum van 2 jaar se ervaring in restitusie, rekordbestuursomgewing, registerdienste. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van statistiese, register- en rekordbestuur. Kennis van projekte en prosesse. Kennis van regeringswetgewing wat die National Archives and Records Service Act regeer. Werksverwante vaardighede: Tydbestuurvaardighede. Beplannings- en organiseervaardighede. Besluitnemingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Analitiese vaardighede. Telefoonetiket. Interpersoonlike en kommunikasie (mondelinge en skriftelike) vaardighede. Vermoë om register- en rekordbestuursaktiwiteite uit te voer. Die vermoë om altyd doeltreffend en effektief te werk.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, administreer en onderhou die restitusie-grondeise-databasis. Onderhou die implementering van die lêerplan in die kantoor. Kontroleer die gehalte van gestandaardiseerde lêers. Stel die verslag van gestandaardiseerde lêers en inventaris op. Werk die inventaris van gestandaardiseerde lêers by. Werk die inventaris van goedgekeurde Seksie 42D's by. Verskaf inligting rakende grondeiserestitusie-eise. Stel 'n sigblad op van briewe wat vir eisers opgestel is. Gee akkurate inligting aan eisers rakende die status van hul eise. Reageer op algemene navrae oor die indiening van grondeise. Werk statistiese inligting vir die kantoor by ten opsigte van alle grondeise wat ingedien en geskik is. Verskaf registerdienste. Ontvang en reik bruin lêers uit wat nie op Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) geskandeer is nie. Ontvang en registreer inkomende lêers. Hou rekords van lêers en versamelde inligting vir bestaande grondeise. Verseker dat amptenare die registerreëls nakom. Monitor toegang tot die registerstelsel. Monitor en beheer die beweging van lêers deur dit op 'n bewegingsbeheerblad te registreer. Voer 'n lêeroudit uit om te verseker dat geen lêers vir meer as 5 dae in 'n amptenaar se kantoor gehou word nie, tensy die amptenaar om 'n verlenging vra. Onderhou kantoorsoektog. Verseker dat alle lêers wat na die register oorgeplaas is, van kliënte aangeteken word. Lêerindeksering. Doen steekproewe op lêers by register/insidente-oudit. Onderhou die stelsel vir lêerberging. Lui goedgekeurde projekte of lêers in vir maklike onttrekking in die register en skep 'n lêernommer vir goedgekeurde Seksie 42D, Seksie 42C en Seksie 42E. Kontroleer alle Seksie 42D's wat na en ontvang van die nasionale kantoor gestuur is of alle dokumente geteken en teruggestuur is dieselfde as wat gestuur is. Werk grondeise-inligting by en verskaf dit aan projekspanne om die aanvaarding en bekendmaking van eise moontlik te maak. Ontvang en registreer inkomende en goedgekeurde lêers. Werk die status van die eise by op goedgekeurde aanvaardingsnavorsingsverslag, nie-nakoming, van die hand gewys, uitgestel en gepubliseerde eise. Verseker dat nuwe inligting wat van operasionele eenhede ontvang is, op 'n sigblad vasgelê word. Hou statistiek van lêers wat op 'n sigblad vasgelê is en doen maandeliks verslag. Koördineer en voer ander administratiewe pligte uit. Verskaf klerikale ondersteuningsdienste aan die direktoraat. Verskaf klerikale ondersteuningsdienste vir personeeladministrasie. Verskaf finansiële administratiewe dienste in die komponent. Verwerk dokumente vir argief en beskikking. Bedryf kantoormasjien in verband met registerfunksies.

zu.title: Ongamelihlandlo Wezinto Ezibalulekile
zu.summary: Ongamelihlandlo Wezinto Ezibalulekile obhepha imininingwane nemibhalo yezikhalazo zomhlaba ebuyiswa esikhundleni sokubuyisa umhlaba eDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development e-East London.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neDiploma Yezizwe ekuphathweni kolwazi / Ezenzululwazi olwazi / Ekuphathweni kwemibhalo (NQF Level 6) noma iDiploma Yezizwe Ekuphathweni Kwezoshishino noma iziqu ezihambisana nalezi. Okuncane unyaka weminyaka engu-2 wokuhlangabezana kumbuyiso womhlaba, indawo yekuphathwa kwemibhalo, kanye nezinkonzo zekuphathwa kwaye kubhalwe imibhalo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwezibalo, ekuphathweni kanye nasekuphathweni kwemibhalo. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo kanye nezenzakalo. Ulwazi lomthetho kahulumeni ophatha iNational Archives and Records Service Act. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlanganisa. Amakhono okuthatha izinqumo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Indlela yokuthetha ngocingo. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokukhuluma (okuthunyelwe nokubhalwe). Ikono lokwenza imisebenzi yekuphathwa kwemibhalo kanye nesisekelo. Ikhono lokusebenza kahle ngempumelelo nangokusimama njalo.
zu.duties: Buthana, uphathe futhi ulondoloze imininingwane yezikhalazo zomhlaba ebuyiswa. Gcina ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwamafayela ehhovisi. Hlola ikhwalithi yamafayela alinganisiwe. Hlela umbiko wamafayela alinganisiwe kanye nokuqhathanisa. Mukhalipha uluhlu lwamafayela alinganisiwe. Mukhalipha uluhlu lokuvunywa kweSection 42D. Nikeza ulwazi ngomhlaba othunyelwe mayelana nezikhalazo. Hlela ikhasi lesibali ngemikhangelo evunyiwe kwabakhalazo. Nikeza abakhalazo ulwazi olunembile ngokuba yisimo sezikhalazo zabo. Phendula imibuzo ejwayelekile ngokungenisa izikhalazo zomhlaba. Mukhalipha ulwazi ngezikhalazo ezungeniswe nakwezexeshiswe ehhovisi lonke. Nikeza izinkonzo zekuphathwa kwemibhalo. Thola futhi uphathamise amafayela angenamkhondo ekuskenziwa ngohlelo lokuphathwa kwemibhalo yamagumbi (EDMS). Thola futhi ubhalele imibhalo efakwa emafayela. Gcina imibhalo yamafayela nolwazi olutholakele ngomhlaba okhona. Qinisekisa ukuthi amaphoyisa aloyiswa ngemithetho yokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Qapha ukungena ohlelweni lokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Qapha futhi ulawule ukunyakaza kwamafayela ngokubhalisa kuhlu lokuhamba. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwamafayela ukuze qinisekise ukuthi akukho fayela eligcinwa nsuku ezingu-5 ehhovisi lomphathi ngaphandle kokuthi umphathi acele ukunwebwa. Gcina ukusesha ehhovisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amafayela adluliselwa kwindawo yokuphathwa kwemibhalo abhalwe kubathandi. Ukushajwa kwamafayela. Ukuhlola ngokungalindeli ifayela endaweni yokuphathwa kwemibhalo/ukuqashwa kwezehlakalo. Ukugcina uhlelo lokubhalisa. Faka imiklamo noma amafayela avuniwe ukuze kube lula ukuwukhipha endaweni yokuphathwa kwemibhalo udale inombolo yefayela elivunyiwe leSection 42D, Section 42C kanye neSection 42E. Hlola wonke amafayela eSection 42D athunyelwe nayatholakale esikhungweni sankulu ukuthi yonke imibhalo isayiniwe futhi ibuyiswe ngendlela efanayo nendlela yayo ethunyelwe. Mukhalipha futhi unikeze ulwazi ngomhlaba ongeniswe izikhalazo kumakhasimba emiklamo ukunika isikhathi sokwamukela kanye nokushicilelwa ezikhalazini. Thola futhi ubhalise amafayela angeniswa nakwezavunyiwe. Mukhalipha isimo sezikhalazo esibhalwe kumbiko ovunyiwe wolwazi wokwamukela, ongahambisani namaphuzu, onqanyuliwe, ogciniwe namafayela ashicilelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi olusha olutholakale kumayunithi okusebenza lifakwe kuhlu lokushaja. Gcina izibalo zamafayela afakwe kuhlu lokushaja futhi wenze umbiko nyanga zonke. Hlela futhi uzenzele eminye imisebenzi yohlelo oluphathwa. Nikeza izinkonzo zokusiza ngemisebenzi yohlelo kwizigaba. Nikeza izinkonzo zokusiza ngemisebenzi yabantu. Nikeza izinkonzo zokuphathwa kwezimali kulungeni. Hlela imibhalo yokugcinwa nokulahwa. Sebenzisa igrizu lehhovisi ngokuhlobene nezinkonzo zekuphathwa kwemibhalo.

xh.title: Senior Administrative Officer
xh.summary: Umsebenzi oyi Senior Administrative Officer uphatha isiseko sedatha kunye namarekhodi ezigaba zemiba yokubuyiselwa kwamahlaba kwi Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e East London.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho: Abafakeli kufuneka babe ne Satifikethi se Grade 12 kunye ne National Diploma kw Information Management / Information Science / Records Management (NQF Level 6) okanye i National Diploma kw Business Administration okanye nelifana nalo ngesidanga. Unyaka oyi 2 kuphela wamava kwindawo yokubuyisela izinto, kulawulo lwegcinwa lolwazi, nakwinkonzo yeregistry. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngezibalo, ukulawula irekhodi kunye nokugcinwa kolwazi. Ulwazi ngamaprojekthi namanyathelo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezorhwebo kahulumeni olawula i National Archives and Records Service Act. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Amakhono okulawula ixesha. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlela. Amakhono okwenza izigqibo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlola. Ubuqhakamshelwano bugqibeleleyo. Amakhono obudlelwano nabantu nokunxibelelwana (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ikholo lokwenza imisebenzi yeregistry kunye negcinwa lolwazi. Ikholo lokuqhuba ngcono nangempilo ngalo lonke ixesha.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa, lawula igcina isiseko sedatha yezigaba zemiba yohlaho lwamhlaba. Gcina ukuqutywa kwesicwangciso sefayile kwindlu yenkomkhulu. Phonononga ngangokwenzekayo izinga lefayile ezenziwe ngendlela esemthethweni. Hlela ingxelo yefayile ezilungisiweyo kunye noluhlu lwemisebenzi. Qwalasela uluhlu lwemisebenzi wefayile ezilungisiweyo. Qwalasela uluhlu lwe Section 42D ezamkelekileyo. Yinkcazela ngolwazi oluthe kratya malunga nezigaba zemiba yohlaho lwamhlaba. Hlela spredshithi yamagama abhaliweyo kwabafaki izigaba. Nikela abafaki izigaba ngolwazi oluchanekileyo malunga nesimo sezabo zemiba. Phendula imibuzo jikelele malunga nokufaka iinkalipho zohlaho lwamhlaba. Qwalasela ulwazi lwezibalo lendlu yenkomkhulu kuzo zonke iinkalipho ezifakwayo nezifezekileyo. Yiba nesebe lenkonzo yeregistry. Amkela kunye nokupha iifayile ezisamtyelekileyo ezingangeniswa kwi Electronic Document Management System (EDMS). Amkela ubhalise iifayile ezifikelayo. Gcina irekhodi yefayile ulwazi oluqokelelweyo malunga nezikhalipho ezikhoyo. Qinisekisa ukuba amaphoyisa alandela imigaqo yeregistry. Lilisele ukungena kwendlela yeregistry. Lilisele ulawulo lokunyuka kweefayile ngokuzibhalisa kwiphepha lokulawula. Yenza uvavanyo lwefayile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba akukho fayile igcinwa ngaphezu kwamahashe angama 5 kwindlu yenkomkhulu kuphela kwaphela ukuba official engasaluli ngesantya esibi. Gcina isiphithiphithi sendlu yenkomkhulu. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iifayile eziyiwa kwi registry zibhalwe kusuka kumaxhoba. Isalathiso sefayile. Yenza uvavanyo lwe spodini kwifayile kwi registry/uvavanyo lwezehlo. Ukugcina indlela yokuzalisa. Faka amaprojekthi okanye iifayile ezamkelekileyo ukuze zibuyiswe lula kwi registry udale inombolo yefayile ye Section 42D, Section 42C kunye ne Section 42E. Phonononga zonke i Section 42D ezithunyelwa kwaye ezifunyanwa ezivela kwindlu yenkomkhulu yezwe ukuba zonke amaxwebhu asayiniwe azibuyiselwe ngendlela efanayo nezithunyelweyo. Qwalaselaunikela ulwazi malunga nezikhalipho zemiba kumathambo amaprojekthi ukwenza kube lula ukwamkela ukubhengezwa kwezikhalipho. Amkela ubhalise iifayile ezifikelayo namkelekileyo. Qwalasela isimo sezikhalipho kwingxelo yokamkelwa yophando, ezingamkelekanga ngemigaqo, ezivaliweyo, ezilibazisiweyo nezibhengezweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi olutsha olufunyanwe kumacandelo asebenzayo lufakwe kwi spredshithi. Gcina izibalo zefayile efakiweyo kwi spredshithi uze unike ingxelo nyanga zonke. Linganisela uphumeze ezinye iinkonzo zolawulo. Yiba nesebe lenkxaso-msebenzi yabakhipha-bhali kumdibaniso wabaphathi. Yiba nesebe lenkxaso-msebenzi yabakhipha-bali kwabaphathi basekhaya. Yiba nesebe lenkonzo yolawulo lwezemali kwicandelo. Hlela amaxwebhu ukugcinwa nokulahlwa. Sebenzisa isixhobo sendlu yenkomkhulu ngokubhekisele kwimisebenzi yeregistry.

jobs.title: Senior Project Officer: Land Development Support
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Support land development projects by coordinating producer commercialisation, partnerships and capacity building in the Joe Gqabi district.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and Bachelor’s Degree in Agricultural Economics / Agri Business / Agricultural Management / LLB (NQF Level 7) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 2 years relevant experience in land reform environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of the Department’s policies, prescripts and practices pertaining to Land Reform. Knowledge and understanding of sector needs and business requirements. In- depth knowledge of policy development and monitoring and evaluation techniques. Knowledge and understanding of government development policies, e.g. National Development Plan, National Growth Path, Planning and Budgeting Framework, etc. Research methodology. Good corporate governance principles. Knowledge in human and financial management. Job related skills: Project management. Communication (verbal and written). Agricultural development. Conflict management. Stakeholder mobilisation. Financial management. Computer literacy. Information management and analytical thinking. Willingness to trave.
jobs.duties: Implement projects for the development of producers towards commercialisation. Assist with co-ordinating the process of identifying producers to be supported. Assist in the establishment and management of partnerships between producers and development partners. Organise capacity building and training programmes for producers. Facilitate the appointment of prospective strategic partners and service providers. Facilitate resource mapping and mobilisation of all identified farms for development in line with departmental priorities, Annual Performance Plan and Operational Plan of the Branch. Assist in facilitation of the development and approval of project registers. Assist in facilitation of farm assessment and feasibility studies. Compile reports and assist in the development of business plans. Co-ordinate processes toward approval of projects. Co-ordinate the compilation of approval documents. Ensure alignment and compliance of submissions to the policies / standard operating procedures. Present the submissions to the relevant committees and structures. Promote good corporate governance and compliance with financial and human resource. Conduct ongoing monitoring and reporting of projects under implementation. Adhere to relevant prescripts and legislative framework (human and financial resources). Assist in mitigation of the identified operational and fraud risks. Adhere to internal and external controls in line with the policies.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A van Vuuren Tel No: (043) 701 8127 or Ms AC Kili Tel No: (043) 701 8186
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Ocean Terrace, Block H, corner of Coutts and Moore Street, Quigney, East London or by email to Post194@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Projekbeampte: Ondersteuning vir Landontwikkeling
af.summary: Ondersteun landontwikkelingsprojekte deur die koördinering van produsent-kommersialisasie, vennootskappe en kapasiteitsbou in die Joe Gqabi-distrik.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Landbou-ekonomie / Agri-besigheid / Landboubestuur / LLB (NQF Level 7) of 'n verwante ekwivalent kwalifikasjon besit. Minimum van 2 jaar relevante ervaring in 'n landhervorming-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van die Department se beleide, voorskrifte en praktyke rakende Landhervorming. Kennis en begrip van sektorbehoeftes en besigheidsvereistes. Diepgaande kennis van beleidontwikkeling en monitering- en evaluerings tegnieke. Kennis en begrip van regeringsontwikkelingsbeleide, bv. Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, Nasionale Groeipad, Beplannings- en Begrotingsraamwerk, ens. Navorsingsmetodologie. Goeie korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels. Kennis van menslike en finansiële bestuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projekbestuur. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Landbou-ontwikkeling. Konflikbestuur. Belanghebbende-mobilisering. Finansiële bestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Inligtingsbestuur en analitiese denke. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Implementeer projekte vir die ontwikkeling van produsente tot kommersialisering. help met die koördinering van die proses om produsente te identifiseer wat ondersteun moet word. Help met die vestiging en bestuur van vennootskappe tussen produsente en ontwikkelingsvennote. Reël kapasiteitsbou- en opleidingsprogramme vir produsente. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van voornemende strategiese vennote en diensverskaffers. Fasiliteer hulpbrontoewysing en mobilisering van alle geïdentifiseerde plase vir ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met departementele prioriteite, die Jaarlike Prestasieplan en Operasionele Plan van die Tak. Help met die fasilitering van die ontwikkeling en goedkeuring van projekte registers. Help met die fasilitering van plaasassesserings en haalbaarheidstudies. Stel verslae op en help met die ontwikkeling van besigheidsplanne. Koördineer prosesse vir goedkeuring van projekte. Koördineer die opstel van goedkeuringsdokumente. Verseker belyning en nakoming van voorleggings met die beleide / standaard operasionele prosedures. Dien die voorleggings voor aan die relevante komitees en strukture. Bevorder goeie korporatiewe bestuur en nakoming van finansiële en menslike hulpbronne. Doen deurlopende monitering en verslagdoening van projekte wat geïmplementeer word. Hou aan die relevante voorskrifte en wetgewende raamwerk (menslike en finansiële hulpbronne). Help met die versagting van die geïdentifiseerde operasionele en bedrogrisiko's. Hou aan interne en eksterne kontroles in ooreenstemming met die beleide.

zu.title: Induna Yephrojekthi: Ukusekelwa Kokuthuthukiswa Kwendlu
zu.summary: Sekela amaphrojekthi okuthuthukiswa kwendlu ngokuhlanganisa ukwenziwe kwezinhlanganisela kwabakhiqizi, ubudlelwano nokwakha amandla endaweni i-Joe Gqabi district.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwemigqa: Abafakizicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree ku-Agricultural Economics / Agri Business / Agricultural Management / LLB (NQF Level 7) noma iziqu ezifanayo ezihlobene. Ubuncane eminyakeni eyi-2 yohluvo oluhlobene endaweni yokulungiswa kwendlu. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwezinqumo zomnyango, izinkulumo ezibekiwe kanye nezindlela ezithintela ukulungiswa kwendlu. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda izidingo zesigaba nezidingo zebhizinisi. Ulwazi olujulile ngokuthuthukiswa kwezinqumo kanye netheknoloji yokuqapha nokuhlola. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda izinqumo zokuthuthukiswa kahulumeni, njeng. National Development Plan, National Growth Path, Planning and Budgeting Framework, njalonjalo. Indlela yocwaningo. Imigomo yobulungiswa obuhle ekuqashweni. Ulwazi ekuphathweni kwabantu nemali. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuthuthukiswa kwezolimo. Ukuphathwa kwezingxabano. Ukuhlanganisa abahlanganyeli. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukuphathwa kolwazi nokuqonda ngokuhlaziya. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Phatha amaphrojekthi okuthuthukiswa kwabakhiqizi ukuba bakhulele kwentengiselwano. Siza ekuhlanganisweni kwenqubo yokuthola abakhiqizi abaza kusekelwa. Siza ekusekweni nakuphathweni kobudlelwano phakathi kwabakhiqizi nabalingana bokuthuthukiswa. Hlela izinhlelo zokwakha amandla nokuqeqesha abakhiqizi. Khuthaza ukuqashwa kwabalingani abahlelekile bokuhlela kanye nabahlinzeka ngesevisi. Khuthaza ukumaphwa kwemithombo yezinsiza kanye nokuhlanganisa yonke imizi etholakele ukuthuthukiswa ngokuhambisana nezindandatho zomnyango, i-Annual Performance Plan ne-Operational Plan yesebe. Siza ekukhuthazweni kokuthuthukiswa nokugunyazwa kwebhalansi yamaphrojekthi. Siza ekukhuthazweni kokuhlola imizi nokwenza izifundo zokutholakala. Hlela imibiko usize ekuthuthukiseni amaphulani ebhizinisi. Hlanganisa izinqubo eziya ekugunyazweni kwamaphrojekthi. Hlanganisa ukuhlelwa kwamadokhumenti okugunyazwa. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nokuhlonishwa kwezithunywa ngokwezinqumo / izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza. Yethula izithunywa kumakomidi nokwakhiwa okuhlobene. Khuthaza ubulungiswa obuhle ekuqashweni nokuhlonishwa kwemali nabantu. Yenza ukuqapha okuphatha ukubiko kwamaphrojekthi asehla. Zinze ngemithetho nemisho yomthetho ehlobene (abantu nemali). Siza ekunciphiseni ingozi ezitholakele zokusebenza nokuqamba. Zinze ngolawulo lokungaphakathi nangaphandle ngokwezinqumo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Ohamba Phambili Weprojekthi: Inkxaso Yophuhliso Lomhlaba
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso amaphrojekthi ophuhliso lomhlaba ngokulungelelanisa ukuzenzela kwamashishini abavelisi, ukuqaliswa kwezibhanzi kunye nokwakhiwa kwamandla kwisithili sase-Joe Gqabi.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se-Grade 12 kwaye nabe ne-Digri ye-Bachelor kwi-Agricultural Economics / Agri Business / Agricultural Management / LLB (NQF Level 7) okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nayo ezilinganayo. Ubuncinane i-2 yeminyaka yamava ahambelanayo kwimeko yophuhliso lomhlaba. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngepolisi, ngeemithetho yesebe kunye nenkqubo ezithintela uPhuhliso Lomhlaba. Ulwazi nokuqonda iimfuno zesector kunye neemfuno zoshishino. Ulwazi olujulile ngenkqubo yophuhliso lwezopolitiko kunye nendlela zokuqwalasela nokuqwalasela iziphumo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinqobo zophuhliso karhulumende, njengoko kuqatshelwa kwi-National Development Plan, National Growth Path, i-Planning and Budgeting Framework, njl. Indlela yokwenza uphando. Iimpawu zolawulo olulungileyo lolwimi lodwarha. Ulwazi ekulawulweni kwezabantu nezimali. Amapatinshi ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukulawula iprojekthi. Unxibelelwano (ngolwimi lokubhala nokuwathetha). Uophuhliso zolimo. Ukulawula iingxabano. Ukuhlanganisa abanenngxaxheba. Ukulawula imali. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukulawula ulwazi nokuqwalasela ngokucinga. Ukulungelelana ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Zonke iiprojekthi zophuhliso labavelisi ngakumashishini.UNCEDO ngokolungelelanisa inkqubo yokukhetha abavelisi abaya kunikwa inkxaso. Nceda kuqalisweni kolawulo lwezibhanzi phakathi kwabavelisi kunye nabanik inkxaso. Limba iinkqubo zokwakhiwa kwamandla nokhader abavelisi Sika isikhundla ngokuqaliswa koluntu kunye nabakhi bezicwangciso ezingagqibekanga kokubakho lweziseko zeendawo zonke iifam ngokwemiqathango yesebe, Ndceda ekuqwube ekuqhutywa phambili nakyamkel iirejista zeprojekthi. Ndceda ukuqhutywa phambili kokulinga kwamafama ezinding ngezifundo ezithengisa. Hlaziya iingxelo nceda ekuqaliseni amacebo eebhanesi. Langelela iinkqubo ngakunikelwa kwephrojekthi. langelelanisa umbhalo kwamaxwebhu okuhambisa nokwamkelwa. Qinisekisa ngokuhambelana nokuzithoba ngokomthetho kwezibhalo kwiipolisi / iinkqubo zokuqhuba ezisesikweni. Nikezela izibhalo kwikomiti namadoda alawulayo. Khuthaza ukulawula ngendlela yokuzenzela uluntu nokuzithoba kwemithetho yemali nobantu. Yenza ukuqwalasela ngokoqhuba kwaye ungenise iingxelo ngamaphroje ekwaqaliswa. Zithobe nangokumthetho nangemithetho elawulayo (ngabantu nemali). Nceda ngokunciphisa amathuba ezingozi ezikumphakathi n ezokukhohlakala ezikhethiweyo. Zithobe ngokwaba ndlela yolawulo langaphakathi nangaphandle ngokwemithe thango yepolisi.

jobs.title: Senior Project Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Senior Project Officer investigating and validating restitution claims, gathering evidence, compiling reports, and negotiating settlements for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in East London.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and Bachelor’s Degree / National Diploma in Agriculture / Development Studies / Social Science / Law (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in land reform environment. A valid driver’s license. Job related knowledge: Development management including strategic management. Research methods and techniques. Community facilitation. Understand and interpret business plans. Thorough knowledge in land reform and development related issues. Knowledge of restitution of land rights. Knowledge of land reform. Knowledge of rural development. Job related skills: Project management. Negotiation. Contract management. Leadership ability. Communication (verbal and written). Ability to draft terms of reference for service providers. Ability to manage consultants. Excellent report writing ability. Initiative, able to take responsibility and meet deadlines. Computer literacy. Ability to produce report. Ability to facilitate community meetings. Good networking ability. Willingness to travel, to spend extended period in the field and work irregular hours.
jobs.duties: Investigate and validate restitution claims. Gather oral and documentary evidence. Compile research report and gazette the claim. Verify the beneficiaries of lodged claims. Compile family tree and gather supporting documents. Compile verification reports. Negotiate the settlement of claims. Conduct options from the claimants. Conduct resolution of the claims. Prepare terms of reference for valuation and Office of the Valuer-General (OVG) recommendations. Compile spreadsheet for valuations. Conduct deeds research for properties. Facilitate the finalisation of lodged claims Compile offers from OVG recommendations. Compile Section 42D on approved offers. Engage with stakeholders and manage land claims enquiries. Respond to all enquiries (Ministerial, Chief Director, Director-General, Chief Land Claims Commissioner, Premier). Respond to Presidentials.

af.title: Senior Projekbeampte
af.summary: Senior Projekbeampte wat restitusievorderinge ondersoek en bekragtig, bewyse bymekaarmaak, verslae opstel en skikking onderhandel vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in East London.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Baccalaureusgraad / Nasionale Diploma in Landbou / Ontwikkelingstudies / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Regte (NQF Vlak 6) of 'n verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 2 jaar se ervaring in 'n landhervormingsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Ontwikkelingsbestuur insluitend strategiese bestuur. Navorsingsmetodes en -tegnieke. Gemeenskapsfasilitering. Begryp en vertaal besigheidsplanne. Deeglike kennis van landhervorming en ontwikkelingsverwante kwessies. Kennis van restitusie van grondbesitregte. Kennis van landhervorming. Kennis van landelike ontwikkeling. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projekbestuur. Onderhandeling. Kontrakbestuur. Leierskapsvermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om termyne van verwysing vir diensverskaffers op te stel. Vermoë om konsultante te bestuur. Uitstekende vermoe om verslae te skryf. Inisiatief, in staat om verantwoordelikheid te neem en sperdatums te haal. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om verslae te lewer. Vermoë om gemeenskapsvergaderings te fasiliteer. Goeie netwerkvermoë. Bereidwilligheid om te reis, om lang periodes in die veld deur te bring en onreëlmatige ure te werk.
af.duties: Ondersoek en bekragtig restitusievorderinge. Versamel mondelinge en dokumentêre bewyse. Stel navorsingsverslag op en publiceer die vordering in die Staatskoerant. Verifieer die begunstigdes van ingediente vorderinge. Stel stamboom op en versamel ondersteunende dokumente. Stel verifikasi verslae op. Onderhandel die skikking van vorderinge. Voer opsies van die eisers uit. Voer resolusie van die vorderinge uit. Berei termyne van verwysing vir waardasie en Office of the Valuer-General (OVG) aanbevelings voor. Stel sigblad vir waardasies op. Voer aktenavorsing vir eiendomme uit. Fasiliteer die finalisering van ingediente vorderinge. Stel aanbiedinge uit OVG aanbevelings op. Stel Artikel 42D oor goedgekeurde aanbiedinge op. Skakel met belanghebbendes en bestuur grondaansprake-navrae. Reageer op alle navrae (Ministeriële, Hoofdirekteur, Direkteur-Generaal, Hoofgrondaansprake-kommissaris, Premier). Reageer op Presidentiële.

zu.title: ISiphethu Esiphezulu Somphathi Wephrojekthi
zu.summary: ISiphethu Esiphezulu Somphathi Wephrojekthi esiphenya futhi siqinisekisa izifundo zokubuyiselwa komhlaba, siqoqa ubufakisi, sihlela imibiko, futhi sixoxisana ngemivuzo ngeHhovisi Lokubuyisela Komhlaba Nentuthuko Yasemaphandleni e-East London.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor’s Degree / i-National Diploma kwezolimo / Izifundo Zentuthuko / Isayensi Yomphakathi / I-Law (NQF Level 6) noma izifundo ezihlobene ezingalingana. okungenani eminyakeni engu-2 yokuhlangabezela emkhakheni wokubuyisela komhlaba. Ilayiseni yasegadini evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwentuthuko kufaka phakathi ukuphathwa okuhlelekile. Izindlela nezindlela zocwaningo. Ukusiza umphakathi. Ukuqonda futhi kuqondwe izinhlela zebhizinisi. Ulwazi olunjengokuthwii oluphelele kokubuyisela komhlaba kanye nezindaba ezihlobene nentuthuko. Ulwazi ngokubuyiselwa kwamalungelo omhlaba. Ulwazi ngokubuyisela komhlaba. Ulwazi ngentuthuko yasemaphandleni. Ikhono elihlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Ukuxoxisana. Ukuphathwa kwezinkontilaka. Ikakhono lokuhola. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwayo). Ikakhono lokubhala izigaba zezinkomba zabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Ikakhono lokuphatha abanakekelisi. Ikakhono elihle lokubhala imibiko. Ukuzethemba, ukwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba futhi uhedle imikhawulo yesikhathi. Ukuzazi kwekhompyutha. Ikakhono lokukhiqiza umbiko. Ikakhono lokuxhumana nabantu bomphakathi. Ikakhono elihle lokuxhumana. Ukuzijabulisa ngokuhamba, ukuhlala isikhathi eside ensimini futhi usebenze amahora angeqavile.
zu.duties: Ukuphenya futhi uqinisekise izifundo zokubuyiselwa komhlaba. Uqoqe ubufakisi ngomlomo nakubhalwayo. Uhlele umbiko wocwaningo ushicilele isifundo. Uqinisekise abazuza izifundo ezinikelwe. Uhlele isihlahla sabomndeni uqoqe amadokhumba asekelayo. Uhlele imibiko yokuqinisekisa. Xoxisana ngemivuzo yezifundo. Enze izinketho zabantu abanikelwe izifundo. Enze ukuxazulula kwezifundo. Ulungele izinkomba ezihlobene nokuhlolwa kwentengo kanye nezincoma zika-Office of the Valuer-General (OVG). Hlela ispredshithi yezentengo. Yenza ucwaningo lwamadikhele ezimpahla. Siza ekugcineni izifundo ezinikelwe. Hlela iziphakamiso ezitholwe ku-OVG. Hlela i-Section 42D kuzipho ezamukelekile. Xhumana nabahlanganyeli uphathe imibuzo ngokubuyiselwa komhlaba. Phendula yonke imibuzo (Nkosi, uMqondisi Omkhulu, uMqondisi Jikelele, uSihlalo Wamaphoyisa Wokubuyisela Komhlaba, uNdlunkulu, uNobhala Jikelele, noMongameli). Phendula imibuzo evela kuMongameli.

Ukuba nakho ukuqhubela phambili iindibaniselwano zomanyano. Ukulungele ukuhamba, ukuhlala ixesha elide emzini nakwindawo yokwenza umsebenzi nangokungamkelwanga kwamavesi.

Yenza ukuba kuqedwe amangalo angenwe ngokuchanekileyo. Hlanganisela izicelo ezivya kumganoo we-OVG. Hlanganisela isigaba se-42D ngezicelo ezamkiweyo. Job related knowledge: Basic knowledge of financial functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate a computer and collate financial statistics. Basic knowledge and insight of the Public Service financial legislations procedures and Treasury Regulations (Public Finance Management Act, Division of Revenue Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Financial Manual). Knowledge of basic financial operating systems (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, etc). Job related skills: Planning and organisational. Computer literacy. Communication (verbal and written). Basic numeracy.
jobs.duties: Render financial accounting transactions. Receive invoices. Check invoices for correctness, verification and approval (internal control). Process invoices (e.g. capture payments). Filing of all documents. Collection of cash. Perform salary administration support services. Receive salary advices. Process advices (e.g. check advices for correctness, capture salaries, bonuses, salary adjustments, capture all deductions etc). File all documents. Perform bookkeeping support services. Capture all financial transactions. Clear suspense accounts. Record debtors and creditors. Process electronic banking transactions. Compile journals. Monitor and follow up on debtor accounts. Register new debts. Follow up on debt related submissions (State Attorney cases etc). Send statements to debtors monthly either by post or by email. Render a budget support service. Collect information from budget holders. Compare expenditure against budget. Identify variances. Capture, allocate virements on the budgets. Distribute documents regarding the budget. File all documents. Receive and capture cash payments.

af.title: Finansiesklerk
af.summary: Finansiesklerk benodig in Polokwane om fakture, betalings, liasering en salarisadministrasie-ondersteuning vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development te hanteer.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Werkverwante kennis: Basiese kennis van finansiële funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële statistiek bye te bring. Basiese kennis en insig van die Openbare Diens se finansiële wetgewingsprosedures en Tesourieregulasies (Public Finance Management Act, Division of Revenue Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Financial Manual). Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, ens). Werkverwante vaardighede: Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Basiese syferkennis.
af.duties: Verskaf finansiële rekeningkundige transaksies. Ontvang fakture. Kontroleer fakture vir korrektheid, verifikasie en goedkeuring (interne beheer). Verwerk fakture (bv. betalings vaslê). Lias van alle dokumente. Invordering van kontant. Voer salarisadministrasie-ondersteuningsdienste uit. Ontvang salarisadvise. Verwerk advise (bv. kontroleer advise vir korrektheid, salarisse, bonusse, salarisaanpassings vaslê, alle aftrekkings vaslê, ens.). Lias alle dokumente. Voer boekhouondersteuningsdienste uit. Lê alle finansiële transaksies vas. Skuiw rekeninge. Rekord debiteure en krediteure. Verwerk elektroniese banktransaksies. Stel joernale op. Monitor en volg debiteurrekeninge na. Registreer nuwe skulde. Volg skuldverwante voorleggings na (Staatsprokureur-sake, ens.). Stuur maandeliks state aan debiteure óf per pos óf per e-pos. Verskaf 'n begrotingsondersteuningsdiens. Versamel inligting van begrotingshouers. Vergelyk besteding teen begroting. Identifiseer afwykings. Lê viremente op die begrotings vas en wysig toe. Versprei dokumente rakende die begroting. Lias alle dokumente. Ontvang en lê kontantbetalings vas.

zu.title: Umlobi Wezimali
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlobi wezimali ePolokwane ukuphatha izikweletu, izinkokhelo, ukugcina kwamafayela kanye nenikelo lokusekelwa kolawulo loholo le-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwazo: Abafaka izinhlelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olusisisekelo ngemisebenzi yezimali, kanye nokukwazi ukungena kolwazi kwi-computer, ukusebenza nge-computer kanyeokuqoqa izibalo zezimali. Ulwazi olusisisekelo nokuqonda emthethweni wezimali wesebenzi kahulumeni neziqondiso ze-Treasury Regulations (Public Finance Management Act, Division of Revenue Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Financial Manual). Ulwazi lwezinhlelo ezisisisekelo zezimali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, etc). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela kanye nenhlelo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza nge-computer. Ukuxhumana (ngolimi lwenkomfa nolokuShayiwe). Ukubala ngokulinganisela okusisisekelo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemisebenzi yokubhukuda ezimali. Thola izikweletu. Hlola izikweletu ukuthi zilungile, ukuqinisekiswa nokugunyazwa (ulawulo langaphakathi). Chibyelela izikweletu (isb. ukungena kwezinkokhelo). Gcina amafayela wonke amadokhumenti. Ukuthola imali. Yenza imisebenzi yonikelo lokusekelwa lolawulo loholo. Thela izeluleko zoholo. Chibyelela izeluleko (isb. hlola izeluleko ukuthi zilungile, vusa amaholo, izibhambo zoholo, ulungise izinkokhelo, vusa wonke amanye amakheshuni etc). Faka wonke amadokhumenti. Yenza imisebenzi yonikelo lokusekelwa kokugcina izincwadi zezimali. Ngena ngemisebenzi yonke yezimali. Cacisa ama-akhawunti okulindele. Bhala abadayisi nabanikeli bzezimali. Chibyelela imisebenzi yohlelo lokubhanka ngokwe-elekthronikhi. Hlela amajournal. Bheka ngokubhekele kanye nokulandela ama-akhawunti abadayisi. Bhalisa izikweletu ezintsha. Landela ukungeniswa koluhlelo oluhlobene nezikweletu (amacala e-State Attorney etc). Thumela izitatimende kubadayisi nyanga zonke ngeposi noma nge-imeyili. Nikela ngonikelo lokusekelwa lebhajedi. Qoqa ulwazi kubanikeli bebhajedi. Thefanisa ukuchithwa nemali ebejabulelwa ibhajedi. Hlaba amaphuzu ahlukene. Vusa, umathe izinkokhelo ezibhajedini. Sabelana amadokhumenti abhajedi. Faka wonke amadokhumenti. Thola futhi vusa izinkokhelo zimali. Vusa wonke amadokhumenti.

xh.title: I-Finance Clerk
xh.summary: Kufuneki iFinance Clerk ePolokwane ukubala iinvoice, iinkokhelo, ukugcina iifayile nokuxhasa lolawulo lomvuzo kwiDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12. Ulwazi oluxhomekeke kumsebenzi: Ulwazi olusembuku ngeemisebenzi yemali, iinkqubo kunye nolwazi lokubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokujunga iisatistiki zemali. Ulwazi olusembuku nokuqonda iinkqubo zomthetho wemali wesebe likarhulumente kunye nezezo zeTreasury (i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Division of Revenue Act, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, i-Financial Manual). Ulwazi lweenkqubo zemali ezingowona mgangatho (i-PERSAL, i-BAS, i-LOGIS, njl). Ikhono elixhomekeke kumsebenzi: Ulawulo nokuhlelwa. Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha. Unxibelelwano (oluthethwayo nolubhaliwayo). Ukubala ngemivo ezingowona mgangatho.
xh.duties: Kwenza iinkqubo zemali zokubhala izitatu. Ukamela iinvoice. Ukhangela iinvoice ukuba zichanekile, ukuqinisekisa nokuvunywa (ilawulo langaphakathi). Ukusebenza ngiinvoice (umz. ukubhala iinkokhelo). Ukugcina iifayile zaluxesha zonke amaxwebhu. Ukuqokelela imali yasekhohlu. Kwenza iinkonzo zokuxhasa lolawulo lomvuzo. Ukamela izaziso zemivuzo. Ukusebenza ngosaziso (umz. ukukhangela usaziso ukuba luchanekile, ukubhala imivuzo, iibhonasi, ulungiso lomvuzo, ukubhala konke ukutyholo njl). Ukugcina iifayile zaluxesha zonke amaxwebhu. Kwenza iinkonzo zokuxhasa ukubhala iibhuku. Ukubhala zonke iinkqubo zemali. Ukucoca ama-akhawunti abekiweyo phantsi. Ukubhala abatyhali kunye nabatyholi. Ukusebenza ngeenkqubo zebenki yekhompyutha. Ukwakha iijournal. Ukuqonda kulandelelanisa ama-akhawunti abatyhali. Ukubhalisa amatyala amatsha. Ukulandela iinkqubo ezidityaniswe nemityala (iinqobo ze-State Attorney njl). Ukuthumela iisitatimende kubatyhali nyanga zonke ngegesi nange-email. Kwenza inkonzo yokuxhasa isabelo semali. Ukuqokelela ulwazi kubagcinii-sabelo. Ukuthelekisa ukuchithwa nemali esabelwe. Ukuqonda ukwahlukana. Ukubhala, ukwabela iindibaniselo kwisabelo semali. Ukusasaza amaxwebhu malunga nesabelo semali. Ukugcina iifayile zaluxesha zonke amaxwebhu. Ukamela ukubhala iinkokhelo zekhohlu.

af.title: Hulptiensoffisier
af.summary: 'n Hulptiensoffisier word in Polokwane gesoek om kadastrale dokumente te verwerk en te administreer, met 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en rekenaarvaardigheid as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat beskik. Geen ervaring word vereis. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Basiese begrip van kaarte en kadastrale dokumente. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasie. Rekenaarprogrammatuur. Goeie organisasie. Boongemiddelde aandag aan detail.
af.duties: Verwerk dokumente vir kadastrale vereistes. Ontvang en registreer diagramme, algemene planne, seksietitels en opnamerekords. Reproduseer kadastrale dokumente vir die registrasiekopieë. Administreer kadastrale dokumente. Maak 'dummy trips' en 'mark out'-borde vir alle dokumentkluise. Verseker dat uitgeslete hangstroke vervang word en beskadigde dokumente herstel word. Verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte. Haal dokumente op en lewer dit op versoek van personeel by die toonbanke namens eksterne kliënte. Verskaf kadastrale inligting aan eksterne kliënte. Vang kadastrale data vas. Vang alfanumeriese data van kadastrale dokumente in die databasis vas. Korrekte vasgevangde foute/weglatings in data op versoek. Skandeer kadastrale dokumente. Skandeer alle nuutgoedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Baklei alle versoeke en projekte vir herskandering, ontbrekende beelde, Client Service Centre en ander afdelings aan. Argiveer kadastrale dokumente. Berei voor en lêer al hierdie dokumente in hul onderskeie dokumentkluise. Doen 'n lukrake ondersoek na die stand van lêerwerk sowel as die stand van dokumente. Argiveer nuutgoedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente en hervul ou dokumente. Plaas mark out-borde en dummy trips in die plek van opgehaalde dokumente.

zu.title: Inkantshana Yezinkonzo Ezesekelayo
zu.summary: Kufunwa Inkantshana Yezinkonzo Ezesekelayo ePolokwane ukucubungula nokuphatha amadokhumenti we-cadastral, kudingeka ifikhalesi yebanga le-12 kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafakwayo kumele babe neFikhalesi yebanga le-12. Akukho mhlawulwa wamava obhekisiwe. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwemaphu namadokhumenti we-cadastral. Amandla ahlobene nomsebenzi: Izinhlobonhlambo ezinhle zabantu. Ukuxhumana okuhle ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe. Isofthiwe yekhomphyutha. Ukuhlela okuhle. Ukuqaphela imininingwane ngaphezu kwesilinganiso.
zu.duties: Cubungula amadokhumenti ngezidingo ze-cadastral. Thola bese ubhalisa idiyagramu, amaphula ajwayelekile, izihloko zezigaba namarekhodi esiphandi. Kopisha amadokhumenti we-cadastral ezikopishi zokubhalisa. Phatha amadokhumenti we-cadastral. Yenza ‘izikhwebu ezaziwayo’ namabhodi ‘okumaka’ kuzo zonke izigodlo zamadokhumenti. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasonti amabalabala abekwa esikhundleni, namadokhumenti alimele ahlinzekwa. Nikeza ulwazi lwe-cadastral kubakhaya kanye nabakhaya abangaphandle. Khupha bese ulehla amadokhumenti abawe abasebenzi abakhasho kanye namakhalawunisha esidali ngomumo wabakhizi abangaphandle. Hlinzeka ngolwazi lwe-cadastral kubakhizi abangaphandle. Faka idatha ye-cadastral. Faka idatha yamagama namaminagumbi esuka kumadokhumenti we-cadastral kwidathabheysi. Lungisa amaphutha/okungabikho okufakwe kwidatha uma kucelwa. Skena amadokhumenti we-cadastral. Skena onke amadokhumenti we-cadastral ashaja emusha abhaliswe. Phathisa konke ukucelwa namaphulo okuzoskena kabusha, izithombe ezilahlekile, Isikhungo Sezinkonzo Zabakhizi kanye namanye amagatsha. Gcina amadokhumenti we-cadastral. Lungisa bese ufaka lonke lawa madokhumenti ezigodlo zawo zamadokhumenti. Yengeza ukuhlola okungajwayelekile ubuhlunjwa bokugcina kanye nobuhlunjwa bamadokhumenti. Gcina amadokhumenti we-cadastral ashaja emusha abhaliswe bese ugcwalisa kabusha amadokhumenti amadala. Faka amabhodi okumaka nezikhwebu ezaziwayo esikhundleni samadokhumenti okukhishiwe.

xh.title: Iofisa yeNkonzo eNcedisayo
xh.summary: Kufunekwe iofisa yenkonzo encedisayo kwiPolokwane ukucubungula nokulawula amaxwebhu e-cadastral, kufunekwe isatifikethi seGrade 12 nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufunekube nobuso besatifikethi seGrade 12. Akukho mphumelelo efunwayo. Ulwazi oluxhwithwe kumsebenzi: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda okusemva kwemaphu namaxwebhu e-cadastral. Amandla axhwithwe kumsebenzi: Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle lokuthetha nokubhala. Isofthiwe yeKhompyutha. Ukulungelelanisa okuhle. Ukunakwa iinkcukacha ngaphezu kwesiqingatha.
xh.duties: Cubungula amaxwebhu ngeenjongo ze-cadastral. Yamkela ubhalise iidayigram, iiplani ezizezona, izihloko ezithintwe ngokwesigaba namarekhodi ezilinganiso. Yenza kwakhona amaxwebhu e-cadastral amakopi obhaliso. Lawula amaxwebhu e-cadastral. Yenza ‘iindwendwe ezisixhenxe’ neebhodi ‘eziphawula’ yonke indlu yamaxwebhu. Qinisekisa ukuba amafa aqhotsiweyo abekwa kwakhona, namaxwebhu ashukumisweyo alungiswa. Nikeza inkcazelo ye-cadastral kumaxhasi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Khupha nilethe amaxwebhu acelwe ngumsebenzi wabasebenzi nommibanqango ngomthetho wamaxhasi abangaphandle. Nikeza inkcazelo ye-cadastral kumaxhasi abangaphandle. Tsala iinkcukacha ze-cadastral. Tsala iinkcukacha ze-alpha-numeric kwimaxwebhu e-cadastral kwisebe lolwazi. Lungisa iimpazamo/eziyitshoyo ezisukiweyo kwiinkcukacha xa celwa. Skena amaxwebhu e-cadastral. Skena onke amaxwebhu e-cadastral avunyiwe amasha. Phendula zonke iicelo namaphulo okuskena kwakhona, izithombe ezilahlekileyo, iZiko loLwazi loNxibelelwano neeSahluko. Gcina amaxwebhu e-cadastral. Lungiselelisa uzibeke wonke la maxwebhu kwindlu yawo yonke yamaxwebhu. Yenza ukukhangela ngokungahoyi ukubakuka kokugcina nemo yamaxwebhu. Gcina amaxwebhu e-cadastral avunyiwe amasha uze ugcabisise kwakhona amaxwebhu amadala. Faka iibhodi eziphawula nayeendwendwe ezisixhenxe endaweni yamaxwebhu a khutshiweyo.

jobs.title: Inspector: Occupational Hygiene
jobs.department: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources
jobs.summary: Inspector for Occupational Hygiene in Welkom to conduct mine audits and inspections relating to occupational hygiene exposures and enforcement actions.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma in Occupational Hygiene or Environmental Health (NQF6) plus Certificate in Mine Environmental Control with minimum 3 years’ experience in Occupational Hygiene and a driver’s license, Knowledge of: Mine Health and Safety Act Regulations and Legal Hazard identification and risk management, Public Service Code, DMPR Policies, Skills: Ability to interpret and apply Mine Health and Safety Act, DMPR Policy and staff codes, management skills: Planning, Leading, Organising and controlling, report writing and formulation, good interpersonal relations, Be able to recommend mining occupational solutions, negotiation skills, language proficiency and computer skills, Thinking demand: Innovative thinker, Analyse situations carefully, make fair and reasonable.
jobs.duties: Conduct and report on underground, shaft and surface audits and inspection on matter relating to occupational hygiene exposures, stressors and other matter relating to mine occupational hygiene and take the necessary enforcement action where necessary. Investigate and report on mine related accident, contraventions, and complaints as well as the analyses of mine accidents and trends to determine high risk mining operations and take appropriate action. Serve on any necessary boards of examiners. Investigate, consult, and provide input on mine closure, prospecting rights, mining rights and permit, EMP’s and township development. Provide inputs to regional reports, revision of mining regulations, guideline and standard and application of exemptions, permissions and approvals related to occupational hygiene.

af.title: Inspekteur: Beroepshigiëne
af.summary: Inspekteur vir Beroepshigiëne in Welkom om mynoudits en inspeksies met betrekking tot beroepshigiëne-blootstellings en handhawingsaksies uit te voer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Beroepshigiëne of Omgewingsgesondheid (NQF6) plus Sertifikaat in Mynomgewingsbeheer met minimum 3 jaar se ondervinding in Beroepshigiëne en 'n bestuurslisensie; Kennis van: MynGesondheids- en Veiligheidswet Regulasies en wettige gevaaridentifikasie en risikobestuur, Openbare Diens Kode, DMPR Beleide; Vaardighede: Vermoë om MynGesondheids- en Veiligheidswet, DMPR Beleid en personeelkodes te interpreteer en toe te pas, bestuursvaardighede: Beplanning, Leiding, Organisering en beheer, verslagskrywing en formulering, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge; In staat wees om mynberoepsoplossings aan te beveel, onderhandelingvaardighede, taalvaardigheid en rekenaarvaardighede; Denkvereiste: Innoverende denker, Analiseer situasies sorgvuldig, maak billik en redelik.
af.duties: Voer ondergrondse, skag- en oppervlakoudits en inspeksies uit en rapporteer daaroor oor aangeleenthede met betrekking tot beroepshigiëne-blootstellings, stresfaktore en ander aangeleenthede rakende mynberoepshigiëne en neem die nodige handhawingsaksie waar nodig. Ondersoek en rapporteer oor mynverwante ongelukke, oortredings en klagtes asook die ontleding van mynongelukke en tendense om hoë-risiko mynbewerkings te bepaal en neem toepaslike aksie. Dien op enige nodige eksamineerdersrade. Ondersoek, konsulteer en verskaf insette oor mynsluiting, prospekteerregte, mynregte en permitte, EMP's en dorpsontwikkeling. Verskaf insette tot streeksverslae, hersiening van mynregulasies, riglyne en standaarde en toepassing van vrystellings, toestemmings en goedkeurings verwant aan beroepshigiëne.

zu.title: Isiphaphi: Ukugcina Ukuthambekela Kolusebenzi
zu.summary: Isiphaphi sokugcina ukuthambekela kolusebenzi eWelkom ukwenza izehlulelo namaphoyiza amayini ahlobene nokubhekwa kwesisimo kolusebenzi nezinyathelo zokuphoqa ukuhambiswa kwemithetho.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe ngeNqubo yokugcina ukuthambekela kolusebenzi noma Izenhlalo nezempilo zendawo (NQF6) kanye nesitifiketi sokulawula isimo semayini esinolwazi lweminyaka engu-3 ngokungenisa emsebenzini wokugcina ukuthambekela kolusebenzi kanye nelesihevi. Ulwazi ngo: Izimiso zomthetho weMine Health and Safety Act kanye nokubona ngokomthetho izengozi nokuphathwa kwezingozi; Ikhowudi yasezweni; Izinqubomgomo zeDMPR. Amakhono: Ikono lokuhlola nokusebenzisa umthetho weMine Health and Safety Act; inqubomgomo yeDMPR namakhowudi abasebenzi. Amakhono okuphatha: ukuhlela; ukubusa; ukuhlelela nokulawula; ukubhala nokwakha imibiko; nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Ukuba n ikhono lokunikela izixazululo zokuthambekela kolusebenzi kwemayini. Amakhono okuxoxisana; ukuphathwa kolimi namakhono ekhompyutha. Ukucabanga kudingwa: ukuba umuntu othuthukisa izinkolelo; ukuhlola izimo ngokucophelela. yenze izinto ezilinganisela futhi ezisemthethweni.
zu.duties: Yenza futhi ubike ngokwehlulelo namaphoyiza asemhlabathini esixhakaxholo nasabukele phezulu ezindabeni ezihlobene nokuthambekela kolusebenzi, izinto ezenza ingcindezi nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nokugcina ukuthambekela kolusebenzi kwemayini, futhi uthathe isinyathelo esidingekileyo sokuphoqa ukwethulwa kwemithetho lapho kudingeka. Ihlola futhi ibike ngemikhuba yemayini, ukuphuka kwemithetho, nezikhalazo kanye nokuqamba kwaba kumayini kanye namathrendi ukuthola imisebenzi yomhlabo kuphela ezimai kakhulu futhi athathe isinyathelo esifanele. Ukuba yilungu kubodi yalowo nalowo ochwepheshe abadange isixazululo. Ihlola, ixoxa, inikeze imininingwana ngokuvalwa kwemayini, amalungelo okuhlola, amalungelo okumbila, namapesenti, ama-EMP kanye nokuthuthukiswa kommandla. Inikeze imininingwana kumibiko yasemandla, ukubuyekezwa kolawulo lomhlaba, isiqondiso, kanye nolawulo nokusebenzisa amakhululo, izimvume, nokuvunyelwa okuhlobene nokuthambekela kolusebenzi.

xh.title: Mphathi wohlobo lomsebenzi: Igiene Yomsebenzi
xh.summary: Umphathi we Igiene Yomsebenzi e Welkom ukwenza iindaba zokuvavanya kwaye ahlulele iindaba ezithintelwe kwiiginyeko ze igiene yomsebenzi nakwenzakalo ephoqwayo.
xh.requirements: I Diploma yesizwe kwi Igiene Yomsebenzi okanye Impilo Yemivelaphi (NQF6) ngesatifikethi sokulawula iNqanaba leMvelaphi yeMigodi kunye neminyaka emi-3 ngokubanzi yamava kwi Igiene Yomsebenzi nelayisensi yokushayela. Ulwazi nge: IMathatha eLawulayo noMthetho woKhuseleko lweMigodi, ukuqaphela iingozi ezisemthethweni nokulawula ingozi, Ikhodi yoNkonzo kaRhulumente, iNgqwalasela ze DMPR. Amandla: Ukuba nako ukuqukuqela nokusebenzisa uMthetho woKhuseleko lweMigodi, iNgqwalasela ze DMPR namiqathango yabasebenzi, amandla okulawula: ukuCwangcisa, ukuBeka phambili, ukuBumba nokulawula, ukubhala iindaba nokuzeke, ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu, ukuba nako ukucebisa izisombulu zoMgodi womsebenzi, amandla okuxoxisana, ukuzithanda ulwimi nokuqonda ikhompyutha. Ukucinga kufuneka: Ukuba mkhetheko, ukuhlola iimeko ngokoyiko, ukwenza izigqibo ezilungileyo nezikwazi ukuzithembisa.
xh.duties: Yenza ubuhlalo ubhale nge ndaba zokuvavanya kumathunzi, kwisebe kwaye nasemaphezulu kwalo naluphi na uhlobo oluphathelene neginyeko ye igiene yomsebenzi, ukuxhatshazwa nakwezinye ndaba eziphathelene ne igiene yomsebenzi yomgodi uze uthathe izigqibo eziphoqwayo xa kufuneka. Phando ubhale malunga neengozi, ukwaphula umthetho nakucomplaind ephathelene nolugodi ukwabukela naye iingozi zomgodi iim fundamentally trends zokhethwa kwaye sigqibo ekuxhatsheni ngamandla operations kwaye uze uthathe action kwaye kubekho kooyikho kokuba kukho i board sika board abay kubhozo. Phado kubonisane nikela malunga ne ndaba zokokezelwa zomgodi, izigunya zophando, izigunya zomgodi namvumelaniso, i EMP's nakususwa kwindawo yasezidolophini. Zela izigqibo malunga nendaba ukuba apho yiibhakuhla zemithetho yomgodi nezagqibelo phaya kwindawo yokusebenza kusetyenziswa ke igiene yomsebenzi ngendlela ekunikelwa iindaba.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Strategic Planning
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 - R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), all-inclusive package, consisting of 70%/ 75% basic salary and 30%/25% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Strategic Planning at the Office of the Chief Justice in Midrand, requiring a relevant diploma and five years' experience including junior management.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Strategic Management / Corporate Governance / Social Sciences / Development Studies / Economic Science / Public Administration or relevant qualification at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience of which three (3) years should be at ASD/Junior Management in the Strategic Planning environment. A valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate's suitability based on the post's technical and generic requirements. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of National Treasury Prescripts, extensive knowledge and experience in strategy formulation, strategic planning or management service capacity environment, a sound knowledge of public finance legislation, knowledge of Strategic Framework on Planning (APP & Strategic Plan), Statistical knowledge, knowledge of Government prescripts, Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulation 2016 and Public Service Transformation. Skilled in advanced computer literacy, advanced communication (verbal & written), financial management, presentation, planning and organising, analytical and decision-making, problem solving, strategising, report writing and project management.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the development and approval of the OCJ Strategic, Annual Performance and Operational Plan: Develop circulars, timeframes and guidelines/ template for the APP, facilitate inputs for the development of the OCJ Strategic and Annual Performance Plan, ensure alignment of OCJ SP and APP is compliant with the planning prescripts, and compile the SP and APP presentations. Assist in coordinating Strategy and Service Delivery Planning (SDP) processes, including performance reporting, data analysis, and monitoring of institutional targets. Conduct the Situational Analysis for the OCJ: Conduct analysis of the internal and external environment as it relates to the OCJ and determine the analysis’s particular goals and objectives as well as the stakeholders that will be participating. Manage the Sub Directorate: Management of performance and development, undertake Human Resource and other related administrative functions.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Ms P. Mahlangu Tel No: (010) 493 2501 HR Related Enquiries: Ms. S Tshidino Tel No: (010) 493 8771

Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful.
