Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. af.title: Onderdirekteur: Strategiese Beplanning
af.summary: Onderdirekteur vir Strategiese Beplanning by die Kantoor van die Hoofregter in Midrand, wat 'n relevante diploma en vyf jaar se ervaring insluitend juniorbestuur vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Strategiese Bestuur / Korporatiewe Bestuur / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Ontwikkelingsstudies / Ekonomiese Wetenskap / Publieke Administrasie of 'n relevante kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring waarvan drie (3) jaar op ASD/Juniorbestuursvlak in die Strategiese Beplanning-omgewing moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Alle gekose kandidate sal 'n voor-toetreed praktykoefening as deel van die assesseringsmetode onderneem om die geskiktheid van die kandidaat op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van Nasionale Tesourie-voorskryfte, uitgebreide kennis en ervaring in strategieformulering, strategiese beplanning of bestuursdiens-kapakiteitsomgewing, 'n deeglike kennis van openbare finansies-wetgewing, kennis van Strategiese Raamwerk vir Beplanning (APP & Strategiese Plan), Statistiese kennis, kennis van Regeringsvoorskryfte, Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulation 2016 en Public Service Transformation. Vaardig in gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid, gevorderde kommunikasie (mondelings & skriftelik), finansiële bestuur, aanbieding, beplanning en organisering, analitiese en besluitneming, probleemoplossing, strategisering, verslagskrywing en projekbestuur.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en goedkeuring van die OCJ Strategiese, Jaarlikse Prestasie- en Operasionele Plan: Ontwikkel sirkuliers, tydraamwerke en riglyne/sjablone vir die APP, fasiliteer insette vir die ontwikkeling van die OCJ Strategiese en Jaarlikse Prestasieplan, verseker dat belyning van OCJ SP en APP aan die beplanningsvoorskryfte voldoen, en stel die SP- en APP-aanbiedings saam. Bied hulp met die koördinering van Strategie- en Diensleweringbeplannings (SDP) prosesse, insluitend prestasieverslagdoening, data-anise, en monitering van institusionele teikens. Voer die Situasie-ontleding vir die OCJ uit: Doen ontleding van die interne en eksterne omgewing soos dit op die OCJ betrekking het en bepaal die ontleding se spesifieke doelwitte en oogmerke asook die belanghebbendes wat sal deelneem. Bestuur die Subdirektoraat: Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling, onderneem Menslike Hulpbron- en ander verwante administratiewe funksies.

zu.title: I-Sekela NDuna: Ukuhlela Ngokwesu
zu.summary: I-Sekela NDuna Okuhlelayo Ngokwesu eNkundleni Yenkundla Ephambili eMidrand, kudingeka idiploma efanele kanye namaju eminyaka esiwayi ahlanganisa abaphathi abancane.
zu.requirements: Abafakelayo kufanele babe ne-National Diploma ku-Strategic Management / Corporate Governance / Social Sciences / Development Studies / Economic Science / Public Administration noma izifundo ezifanele e-NQF level 6 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ukuhlangenwe nakho okuncane kweminyaka eyisihlanu (5) lapho kuleyo minyaka emithathu (3) kufanele ibe yi-ASD/Abaphathi Abancase emkhakheni wokuhlela ngokwesu. Idrayiva elikhona nesebense izofaka isand esengeziwe. Bonke abafakelayo abakhethiwe bazokwenza isivivinyo sebuhlwempu ngaphambi kokungena njengengxenye yendlela yokuhlolwa ukuba kucaciswe ukufaneleka komfundi ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zobuchwepheshe nezijwayelekile zesikhundla. Ulwazi Nobukhali: Ulwazi lwe-National Treasury Prescripts, ulwazi olujulile nokucohla ngokuhlela ngokwesu, emkhakheni wezinsiza zokuphatha noma ukuhlela ngokwesu, ulwazi oluhle ngomthetho wezimali zikahulumeni, ulwazi lwe-Strategic Framework on Planning (APP & Strategic Plan), ulwazi lwesibalo, ulwazi lwezinhlobo zomthetho kahulumeni, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulation 2016 kanye ne-Public Service Transformation. Bakhula ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha ngobuchwepheshe, ekuxhumaneni ngobuchwepheshe (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe), ekuphateni izimali, ekuboniseni, ekuhleleni nokuhleba, ekuhlaziyeni nokuquma, ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekuhleleni ingqikithi, ekubhaleni imibiko nasekuphateni izinhlelo.
zu.duties: Yenza isu lokuthuthukisa futhi sivunyelwe ngokuhlela ngokwesu i-OCJ, i-Annual Performance ne-Operational Plan: Bathathe amamemorandum, amasu nobuqondiso / amathempleyithi we-APP, hlanganisa iminikelo ukuthi kuthuthukiswe i-OCJ Strategic ne-Annual Performance Plan, qinisekisa ukuthi i-OCJ SP ne-APP zihambisana nazo zimisele imithetho yokuhlela, bese uhlela imiboniso ye-SP ne-APP. Siza ekuhleleni izinhlelo ze-Strategy ne-Service Delivery Planning (SDP), kuhlanganise nokubika ngokusuka kwemisebenzi, ukuhlaziywa kwemininingwane, kanye nokuqondisa izinhloso zenhlangano.enza Isihlaziyo Sezimo Se-OCJ: Hlaziya izimo zangaphakathi nangaphandle njengoba zihlobene ne-OCJ futhi ngabe ngamaphuzu amakhulu nezinhloso zoku hlaziywa, kanye nalabo abazoba yingxenye yaleyo minikelo. Phatha i-Sub Directorate: Uphatho kokusuka kwemisebenzi nokuthuthukiswa, wenze imisebenzi ye-Human Resource neminye imisebenzi ehlobene nayo yezengqondo.

xh.title: Isekela nguMlawuli: uQeqesho lweZicwangciso
xh.summary: Isekela nguMlawuli woQeqesho lweZicwangciso eKwindla leNkulumbuso eNtlonga eMidrand, lifuna izidanga ezifanelekileyo kunye neminye emihlanu yamava equka ulawulo lwabanzi.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe neDiploma yeSizwe kuLawulo lweZicwangciso / uLawulo loBumbano lweShishini / ngeZondolo eZenziwayo / ngeZeZifundo eZinto eZithuthukiswayo / ngeZenzelelo lezoQoqosho / uLawulo loRulumamo oLwenziwayo okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo kwinqanaba le-6 leNQF njengoko qatshelwa yiSAQA. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava apho iminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka ibe kwi-ASD/uLawulo lwaBanzi kwindawo yoQeqesho lweZicwangciso. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba eyasebenzayo iya kuba lusizo oluongezelelweyo. Onke amagosa akhethwe ngomgcisho baya kwenza isicatshulwa esibuzwayo sokuqhuba phambi kokungena njengenxalenye yendlela yokulinganisa ukugqiba ukuba umzobi ulungele ngokusekwe kwiimfuno ezibuchwephesha nezijwayelekile zesithuba. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemiQondiso yeNdlu yeNgcwecwe yeSizwe, ulwazi olubanzi namava ekwenzeni isicwangciso, uqeqesho lwezicwangciso okanye ulawulo kwindawo yamakhono abasebenzi, ulwazi olunzulu ngomthetho wemali kahulumeni, ulwazi lweSakhelo seZicwangciso (APP & Strategic Plan), ulwazi ngamanani, ulwazi ngemiQondiso kaHulumeni, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaHulumeni, uMthetho koNkonzo kaHulumeni, IMigaqo yoNkonzo kaHulumeni ka-2016 nokuGuqulwa koNkonzo kaHulumeni. Ukrelekrele ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha ngamazinga aphakamileyo, ukunxibelelana ngamazinga aphakamileyo (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ulawulo lwemali, okokubonisa, ukucwangcisa nokuhlelwa, ukwahlula-hlula nokwenza izigqibo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza izicwangciso, ukubhala iingxelo nolawulo lweeprojekthi.
xh.duties: Yenza izicwangciso zokuqhuba phambili nokuvunywa kwe-OCJ Strategic, i-Annual Performance ne-Operational Plan: Lunga izaziso, iinkqubo zexesha kunye neenkqubo zokwelengwa / isakhelo se-APP, yenza izimvo zokuqhuba phambili ekwenziweni kwe-OCJ Strategic ne-Annual Performance Plan, qinisekisa ukuvumelanisa kwe-OCJ SP ne-APP kumthetho wezicwangciso, uze uhlanganise iinkcazelo ze-SP ne-APP. Siza ekulawuleni iNqamla yoQeqesho lweZicwangciso nezeZenzo zoKunikezela koNkonzo (SDP), kuquka ukuchaza ukusebenza, ukuhlalutya idatha, nokulinda iinjongo zeMbumba. Yenza uNohlalutyo lweMeko ye-OCJ: Hlalutya imo yangaphakathi nangaphandle nje ngoko iphathelene ne-OCJ uze umise iinjongo ezithile nemiqondiso yohlalutyo nakwabathathi-nxaxheba abaza kuthatha inxaxheba. Lawula iNgqungquthela eNgezantsi: Ulawulo lokusebenza nentuthuko, yenza imisebenzi yoLawulo lweZempilo kunye neminye imisebenzi yolawulo edibana nayo.

af.title: Senior Hof-tolk
af.summary: Die Kantoor van die Hoofregter soek 'n Senior Hof-tolk by die Arbeidsappèlhof in Durban om tolkdienste oor verskeie hofverrigtinge te lewer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Tolk of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in die taalkundeveld op NQF-vlak 6 met 360 krediete, soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Minimum van een (01) jaar praktiese ondervinding in 'n tolkomgewing of 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat met ten minste tien (10) jaar se praktiese ondervinding in 'n tolkomgewing. Bedrevenheid in Engels en Isizulu, bedrevenheid in enige ander inheemse taal, d.w.s. Xhosa, Sotho, Tswana of Zulu en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal 'n voor-toetreedings praktiese oefening onderneem as deel van die assesseringsmetode om die kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van tersaaklike Wette en Regulasies; kennis van kultuur; kennis van die vakgebied; weet hoe om te vertaal en in staat wees om tydraam te hou. Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office), doeltreffende kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling), tydbestuur, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, beplanning en organisering, besluitneming, analitiese denke, uitmuntende Engelse taal, probleemoplossing, tesame met die volgende eienskappe: buigsaam, selfgedrewe en gemotiveerd, vermoë om onder druk te werk, akkuraatheid en aandag aan besonderhede.
af.duties: Lew tolkdiens. Tolk in strafregtelike verrigtinge, siviele verrigtinge, sake rakende die Wet op Bejaarde Persone, sake rakende die Wet op Gesinsbeskerming teen Teistering, Arbeidshof-sake, Onderhoudswet-sake, Kinderjustisie-sake, lykskouings en Gelykheidshof-sake; tolk in voorverhoorverrigtinge en konsultasies. Skakel met die toesighouer ten opsigte van tolke vir buitelandse tale; tolk van brontaaltaal na doeltaal tydens Hofverrigtinge vir voorverhoorkonsultasies; tolk nie-verbale gebare, dramatisering en belydenisse. Skakel met die Regbank om oor gereedheid en/of prestasie in die Hof te beraad. Lew hoorbare en duidelike tolking van bron- na doeltaal sonder versiering of weglatings terwyl die taal behoue bly. Dra die korrekte taal oor ooreenkomstig die taalgebruik van die spreker. Beheer die spreker en verseker dat aanhalings korrek getolk word. Vertaal regsdokumente en getuienisstukke. Bestudeer en ontleed die brondokumente. Voer die nodige navorsing uit en raadpleeg die tersaaklike partye. Verseker akkurate sitaatvertaling van dokumente. Kontroleer, redigeer en hersien die vertaalde dokumente. Vertaal meganies opgeneemde oudiomateriaal. Ontwikkel terminologie en verskaf steun by die rekonstruksie van rekords. Akkumuleer terminologie en bou 'n databasis op. Vul die terme en onderskeie betekenisse in die glossariumregister in. Versamel alle verhoordokumente wat nodig is om tolking te vergemaklik. Skep woorde en verrig spesifieke lyn- en administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies vir die Regbank, Hofbestuurder en Toesighouer.

zu.title: Umhumushi Ophakemei WeNkantolo
zu.summary: IOfisi yoMntwebankulu yezwe ithumba ukuthola uMhumushi Ophakemei WeNkantolo eNkantolo Yezikhalazo Zabasebenzi eDurban ukuze ahleze abeke izinsiza zokuhumusha kumahlathi amaningi okwenziwa kankantolo.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izwi kumele babe neDiploma Yezwe kuHuhmusha noma izifundo ezilinganayo esimkhakheni wezilimi ezingeni leNQF level 6 anama-credits angu-360 njengoba kutshunywe nguSAQA. Amanani eminyaka engu-1 ngenani elingu(01) yokusebenza okwenziwa kumkhakha wokuHhumusha noma isitifiketi seGrade 12 aneminyaka engu-10 ngenani elingu(10) yokusebenza okwenziwa kumkhakha wokuHhumusha. Ukwazi kahle isiNgisi nesiZulu, ukwazi kolunye ulimi lwesintu, okuyilolu Xhosa, Sotho, Tswana noma Zulu kanye nephasi Yokushayela okusemthethweni kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Bonke abantu abazokhethwa bame kwenza isivivinyo sokusebenza ngaphambi kokungena njengengxenye yendlela yesivivinyo ukuthola ukufaneleka komuntu okhethwa kusekelwe ezidingweni zobuchwepheshe nezijwayelekile zesikhundla. Ulwazi namagejasu: Ukubuka kwezAksenemthethonkambiso ezihlobene, ulwazi ngamasiko, ulwazi ngendawo yesihloko, ukwazi ukuhumusha nokugonda isikhathi. Ubugigci ekusetshenzisweni kwekhompyutha (MS Office), okudlulisa kalula (okubhaliwe nokuqhanyeliwe), okuphatha isikhathi, ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu, okucubungula nokuhlela, okwenza izinqumo, okucabanga okuhlol'isisindo, isiNgisi esihle, okuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nezici ezilandelayo: ukuguquguquka, ukuzigqatsa nokugqugquzelwa, ukuthwala umthwalo wezinkinga, ukulunga nokunakisisa imininingwane.
zu.duties: Nikela ngezinsiza zokuhumusha. Ukwhumusha ezimeni zezenzo ezingekho emthethweni, ezimeni zomthetho ojwayelekile, ezimeni zeOlder Persons Act, ezimeni zeFamily Protection from Harassment Act, ezimeni zeLabour Court, ezimeni zeMaintenance Act, ezimeni zeChild Justice, Izinspiyo kanye nezeEquality Court, ukwhumusha ezimeni zangaphambi kokulawa nezigqonganeni. Xhumana nomqondisi wabahumushi bezilimi zokwenza, bahumushe kulimi lokuqala aze ethathelwe kulimi lokugqamisa phansi inkantolo ngesikhathi kwensiswa okwelulekwa kwangaphambi kwesigwegwe, bahumushe izenzo ezingezona ngomsindo, i-dramatisation kanye ne-misakazo. Xoxa nabaNjiniyela beNkantolo mayelana nokulungele futhi/noma ukwenza kwabo eNkantolo. Nikela ngokuhumusha okuzwayo futhi okucacile ulimi lokuqala aze ethathelwe kulimi lokugqamisa ngaphandle kokunongeza noma ukushiya okuthile lokhu ulimi lugcine. Dlulisa olimi olulungile ngokuhambisana nokuusetshenziswa kwelimi komkhulumi. Lawula umkhulumi uqiniseke ukuba izinhlangothi ezithunyelwe zihumusheka kafanele. Humusha amaphepha ezomthetho futhi okubukwa. Funda futhi uhlwaye amaphepha okuthunyelwe. Yenza ucwaningo oludingekayo ulwazi futhi uxhumane nezigqoqi ezithintekile. Qinisekisa ukuhumusha kafanele amaphepha. Hlola, hlela kabusha ulungise amaphepha ahumushiwe. Humusha okurekhodiwe ngomsindo ngomshini. Yiza negama elisha linikeze inkhaso ekwakhiweni kabusha kweephepha. Qoqa amagama akhe ukwakha isiqukathi se-data. Faka amagama nentshutuko yawo kwesiqukathi seglossary. Qoqa yonke imaphepha okudingeka ekugcineni komelwe ukuze kusize ekukhuluma ngokuhumushwa. Yigaqize imibhalo yezigaba futhi unike izinkinga ezigatshaneni zegatsha lenkantolo, umqondisi weNkantolo kanye noMqondisi.

xh.summary: IOfishi yoMongameli Wobulungisa ijonge umHumushi Oyintloko weNkundla eNkundla yokuPhela yabaSebenzi eDurban ukuba anikeze iinkonzo zokuHumusha kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zeenkundla.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neNational Diploma kokuHumusha okwesikweni esilinganayo kwinkalo yeeelwimi kwinqanaba le-6 le-NQF ngeekredithi ezingama-360 njengoko kuziwa nguurhothiweyo ngu-SAQA. Ifanele ukuba abe nolwazi lokusebenza olungqongqozelelweyo kwimowubo yokuhumusha unyaka omnye (01) okanye icastify yesi-12 ngeyure ezili-10 (10) zolwazi lokusebenza kwimowubo yokuhumusha. Ukuqonda ngeSizulu nesiNgesi, ukuvakalisa naziphi na ezinye iilwimi zasekhaya, oko kukuthi isiXhosa, isiSotho, isiTswana okanye isiZulu nedilesi yasekhonkiso elisebenzayo kuya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Onke amagqabi alawulwe aya kuthatha umzobo olunzulu phambi kokungena njengenxalenye yendlela yokulinganisa ukuze kuqediswe ukuzinhlonipha komfaki isicelo ngokusekelwe kumfuno ekukwizithuba. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho namalungiselelo, ulwazi ngenkcubeko, ulwazi ngendawo yesihloko, ukwazi ukuguqula nokuba nakho ukugcina ithuba. Ukuziphatha ngokweenkqubo zekhompyutha (MS Office), unxibelelwano olusebenzayo (elibhalwe nelithethwayo), ulawulo lwexesha, ubuhlobo obuhle ngenkqubo, uceziso lwezigqibo, ekuguqulweni, ubuchule ngolwimi lwesiNgesi, izisombululo ezilula, nokubakho le minxaka: Tshintshiselana ngezicinga, uzigqithisele waze wakhuthazeka, ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngxamisele, ukuchaneka nokunaka iinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zokuHumusha. Humusha kwiinkqubo zezo ezingamahlwempuzo, iinkqubo zomtsetfo, izindaba zoMthetho weBElimi, izindaba zoMthetho woKhuselo loMndilili kubandlululo, izindaba zeNkundla yeBasebenzi, izindaba zoMthetho woKuxhaswa komndilili, izindaba zoBulungiswa beSikhwama, izindaba zokuBungiswa nazo nokulingana kweNkundla, Humusha kwindlela yexesha langaphambili kweenkundla nangokuswela kubazali. Thintathinta noMphathi weHumushi welwimi lwengingasemzini, humusha ukusuka kwelwimi lomthombo kuya kwelwimi elihumushiweyo ngexesha lweenkundla ezikwisigaba sangaphambili, humusha iimpawu ezingezizo ezibekwayo, iinkcukacha zentsiphu nezazimo. Yiba nomngeni noMongameli wokudibana ngokulungele nokuphumeza kweNkundla. Nika iinkonzo ezivakalayo nangokucacileyo zokuHumusha ukusuka kwelwimi lomthombo kuya kwelwimi elihumushiweyo ngokungazandikiswa okanye ukushiyawe ngelixa ulondolozo ulwimi. Dudulisela ulwimi oluchanekileyo ngokulandelana kwenkqubo yolwimi yomthethi. Lawula umthethi uze uqinisekishe ukuba izalathiso zahumushwa ngokuchanekileyo. Guqula iinkcukacha zomtsetho nendlela yokuqamba. Funda uhlalutye iinkcukacha zomthombo. Yenza uphononongo olubalulekileyo uze uchaze namapha ahambelana nendalo. Qinisekisa ukuqonda ngokuchanekileyo okukuguqulwa kweenkcukacha. Khangela, hlela uze ulungise iinkcukacha eziguqulwe. Guqula iindlela ezenziwa ngesandi ezilondedwe ngenkqubo. Phuhliza iinkcazelo yaye unike inkxaso ekuphindaphindenweni kweekhadi. Gcina iinkcazelo yaye uphuhlize isiseko sekhompyutha. Faka iinkcazelo nentsingiselo yawo kwesikhebe sedictionary. Qokelela iinkcukacha ezininzi ezikwisigqibo nangokuchanekileyo zokulunga kuHumusho. Yiyo iilwimi yaye uzenze inkqubo ngenkqubo yokuncedisa ngaphandle komthethi iNkundla, uMphathi weNkundla noMphathi.

jobs.title: Registrar’s Clerk
jobs.centre: Labour And Labour Appeals Court: Cape Town
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: A Registrar's Clerk is needed at the Labour Court in Cape Town to manage court files, receive pleadings and attend to public and legal practitioner enquiries.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of Grade 12 certificate or equivalent qualification at NQF level four (4) as recognised by SAQA. No experience is required. Experience in general Legal Administration and /or a minimum of one (1) year’ Administration experience in a Legal environment, LLB Degree / B com Law/BA Law/ Paralegal and/or an equivalent qualification and a driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate's suitability based on the post's technical and generic requirements. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of Public Services Legislation, Prescripts and Regulations. Skilled in research, communication (verbal and written), presentation, minute taking and report writing, problem solving and decision making and time management, good reporting, planning and organising, creative and analytical thinking and computer literacy (MS Office).
jobs.duties: Attend to enquiries from the public and Legal Practitioner for the upliftment of files, receiving pleading/ notice from Legal Practitioner/ Messenger for filling and stamping with date stamp, attend to filling of pleadings in the corresponding Court file, attend to drawing requested files and putting away Court files daily. Ensure that all requested for re-issuing of Court orders are attended to. Court online related duties. Assisting with enquiries from the public and legal practitioner and assist the Registrars with the locating of missing files.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr.SD Hlongwane Tel No: (021) 424 9035 HR Related Enquiries: Mr. SD Hlongwane Tel No: (021) 469 4032
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/91/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. af.title: Registrale Klerk
af.summary: 'n Registrale Klerk word benodig by die Arbeids Hof in Cape Town om hoflêers te bestuur, pleitstukke te ontvang en navrae van die publiek en regspraktisyns by tewoon.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak four (4) soos deur SAQA erken besit. Geen ervaring word vereis. Ervaring in algemene Regsadministrasie en/of 'n minimum van een (1) jaar se Administrasie-ervaring in 'n Regsomgewing, LLB-graad / B com Law/BA Law/ Paralegal en/of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie en 'n bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate sal 'n voor-toetreed praktiese oefening onderneem as deel van die asseseringsmetode om die kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes te bepaal. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van Openbare Dienste-wetgewing, Voorskripte en Regulasies. Bedrewe in navorsing, kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), aanbieding, notulerings en verslagdoening, probleemoplossing en besluitneming en tydbestuur, goeie verslagdoening, beplanning en organisering, kreatiewe en analitiese denke en rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office).
af.duties: Skenk aandag aan navrae van die publiek en Regspraktisyn vir die ophaling van lêers, ontvang pleitstukke/ kennissgewings van Regspraktisyn/ Bode vir invulling en stempeling met datumstempel, skenk aandag aan invulling van pleitstukke in die ooreenstemmende Hofslêer, skenk aandag aan uittrek van versoekte lêers en wegpak van Hofslêers daagliks. Verseker dat alle versoeke vir heruitreiking van Hofbevele bygewoon word. Hof aanlyn-verwante pligte. Bystand verleen aan navrae van die publiek en regspraktisyn en help die Registrateurs met die opspoor van vermiste lêers.

zu.title: Isiklime sika-Registar
zu.summary: Kudingeka isiklime sika-Registar eNkantolo yezaBasebenzi eCape Town ukuphatha amafayela enkantolo, ukwamukela izifundo ezithunyelwa enkantolo kanye nokuphendula imibuzo yomphakathi neyabezomthetho.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifikedi se-Grade 12 noma iziqu ezilinganayo kwizinga le-NQF level four (4) njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Akukho olunye uqeqesho oludingeka. Uqeqesho ekuqondweni kwezomthetho kanye/noma unyaka owodwa (1) weminyaka uqeqesho ekuqondweni kwezomthetho, iziqu ze-LLB Degree / B com Law/BA Law/ Paralegal kanye/noma iziqu ezilinganayo kanye nelayisensi yokushayela kuzoba usizo olwengeziwe. Bonke abaphume kolu hlu bazokwenza isenzo esibukwa ngaphambi kokungena njengengxenye yendlela yokuhlola ukuze kusungulwe ukufaneleka komfaki isicelo ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zezobuchwepheshezejalo nezijwayelekile zaleso sikhundla. Ulwazi Namasikhombi: Ulwazi ngemithetho yomphakathi, iziqondiso kanye nemithetho. Ukukwazi ukucinga, ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala), ukubeka izinkomba, ukuthatha iminithi kanye nokubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo kanye nokuphatha isikhathi, ukubika ngokufanele, ukwelula kanye nokuhlela, ukucabanga ngokudalula kanye nangokuhlaziya kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office).
zu.duties: Ukuphendula imibuzo yomphakathi neyabezomthetho mayelana nokuthatha amafayela, ukwamukela izifundo/izaziso ezithunyelwa ababezomthetho/abathunyiwe zibekwe futhi zifakwe usuku ngemophu, ukuzibandakanya ekubhaleni izifundo kumafayela ahambisana enkantolo, ukuzibandakanya ekukhuphuleni amafayela aceliwe kanye nokubeka amafayela enkantolo nsuku zonke. Qinisekisa ukuthi konke okuceliwe ukushintshwa kwezinqumo zendawo zenkantolo kunakekelwa. Imisebenzi ehlobene nenkundla yenkantolo e-inthanethi. Ukusiza imibuzo yomphakathi kanye neyabezomthetho kanye nokusiza aba-Registar ekutholeni amafayela alahlekile.

xh.title: Umnekaphondo weZiko leNxibelelaniso lokugqibela iMfazwe yeZiseko
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe khona umnekaphondo weziko lenxibelelaniso lokugqibela imfazwe weziseko eCape Town ukulawula iifayile zenkundla, ukwamkela iinxatso nokunyangelela imibuzo yomntu wonke nemibuzo yabasebenzi bomthetho.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seQeli lesi-12 okanye izifundo ezilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF elinesi (4) njengoko kugunyaziswa yi-SAQA. Akukho nalunye uqeqesho olufunekayo. Uqeqesho kolawulo lomthetho jikelele nokuthoba okanye inyanga enye (1) yamava olawulo kwimeko yomthetho, iziqango ze-LLB / ye-B com Law / ye-BA Law / eyakupaRalegal nokuba nalipho na elidla isixa elilingana noku kwaye elinesiqanga sokuqeshwa kuya kubakho nzuzo. Onke abakhethiweyo abakwishadi elikhawulezayo baya kwenza isixhobo somzobo phambi kokungena njengenxalenye yendlela yokulinganisa ukuze kugqitywe ukuba umntu uyanelisekelo ngokusekelwe kwiimfuno ezizekiweyo nangokubanzi zesithuba. Ulwazi nobugcisa: Ukuba nolwazi ngeMithethoYencekuYomphakathi, iMithetho nokuLawulwa kwaye nozano kwaye ukho ubugcisa bukwimiba yophando, ithetho-bukiwe nokubhalwayo, okuboniswa phambi komntu, ukuthabatha amanqaku nokubhala iingxelo, amandla okusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo nokulawula ixesha, ukuvela iingxelo, ukulungisa izicwangciso nokuhlela, ukucinga ngendlela esekwa kucingo ngeengqondo kwaye usazi ukusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha i-MS Office.
xh.duties: Kunyangelelwa imibuzo yomntu wonke nokuvela kwabasebenzi bomthetho malunga nokubuyiswa iifayile, ukwamkela iinxatso / isaziso kumsebenzi womthetho / kumthunywa zokuvala nokuthenga inxaxhamba yemini efakelwa ngemini kunye nakusetyenziswa inxatso efunyenwe kumsebenzi womthetho / komthunywa, kuhandlelwa ukuvalwa iindawo zeenkundla ezihambelana naye kwaye kuhandlelwa ukutsalwa kweefayile eceliweyo nokubeka iifayile zenkundla ngemini. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba zonke iicelo eziceliweyo malunga nokubuyiswa kwakhona iinkqubo zenkundla zihandlelwe. Imisebenzi ehambelana nenkundla kwi-intanethi. Uncedo kumthetho oceliweyo baceda ngokubuyela kwindlela yokufumanisa iifayile ezilahlekileyo.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist: Planning Alignment
jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive salary package). The remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to personal needs within the relevant framework. R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive salary package). The remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to personal needs within the relevant framework.
jobs.summary: Senior Specialist needed in Pretoria to oversee and align institutional plans with government frameworks, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and 8 years' planning experience.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 7 qualification in any of the following: Social Science / Economics Development Studies / Public Administration / Management. 8 years’ experience in strategic planning / public sector institutional planning / public sector operating planning / public sector development planning / public sector monitoring & evaluation of which 5 years’ experience should be at middle/senior managerial level. An NQF level 8 qualification, or higher, will be an added advantage. A valid drivers-license. A good understanding of political, government planning and governance issues. Good understanding of government across the three spheres and partners for development. Knowledge of government prescripts (including National Treasury regulations), policies, administrative processes, practices, and programmes. Knowledge of the National Development Plan (NDP) and the Medium-Term Development Plan and their implementation processes. Ability to foster and manage effective working arrangements with other centre of government departments and social/development partners to ensure co-ordinated and integrated actions. Willingness to travel on a regular basis. Competencies & Skills: Management skills including people management and empowerment, and experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams. Ability to provide strategic direction and leadership. The ability/experience to create an environment for high performance culture and staff development. Ability to manage multiple projects. Excellent interpersonal & communication skills (written & verbal). Highly developed negotiation and conflict management skills. Strategic and analytical skills. Research and policy analysis skills. Financial management and project/programme management skills. Good computer literacy skills. Personal Attributes: The incumbent must be assertive and self-driven, innovative and creative, client orientated and customer focused, solution orientated and able to work under stressful situations. A relevant NQF Level 7 qualification in Social Sciences, Public Administration, Development Studies or related fields. Minimum of at least 8 years appropriate experience in public sector monitoring and management of which 5 years’ experience should be at middle/senior managerial level. A relevant post- graduate qualification (NQF 8) will be an added advantage. A valid Driver’s License. Competencies / Skills: strong research, communication, report writing skills and project and leadership skills. The candidate must also demonstrate advanced capabilities in respect to the development, implementation and monitoring of related policies and procedures; analytical skills, excellent financial, HR and strategic management skills and good interpersonal relations. A sound knowledge of Microsoft Office applications is essential. Personal attributes: The incumbent must be assertive and self-driven, innovative and creative, client orientated and customer focused, solution orientated and able to work under stressful situations and the ability to maintain high levels of confidentiality. The candidate must be willing to travel.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible to oversee, coordinate, assess and align institutional plans (Strategic Plans, Annual Performance Plans, Operational Plans & Implementation Plans) with government frameworks and priorities for national departments and Schedule 3A public entities. Ensure effective quarterly performance reporting processes for non-financial performance information of national departments and Schedule 3A public entities. Develop, coordinate and facilitate oversight frameworks, strategies and processes with reference to. institutional planning for national departments and Schedule 3A public entities. Manage, coordinate and facilitate stakeholder engagements on national planning processes and frameworks and reporting for national departments and Schedule 3A public entities. Professional management and leadership in respect of the provision of the core functions and services assigned to the Directorate and support cross-functional work within the department. The successful incumbent will be responsible to Facilitate service delivery improvements through frontline monitoring and provide support on monitoring initiatives by the Executives. To Planning, Review (Annual Plan). Oversight Monitoring & Support& Knowledge Management. Communicating Results & Committing to Change. verification & Improvements Facilitation. Management of Directorate Resources.

af.title: Senior Spesialis: Beplanningbelyning
af.summary: Senior Spesialis benodig in Pretoria om instellingsplanne met regeringsraamwerke toe te sien en te belyn, wat 'n NQF 7 kwalifikasie en 8 jaar se beplanningservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Ter relevante NQF level 7 kwalifikasie in enigeen van die volgende: Sosiale Wetenskappe / Ekonomiese Ontwikkelingsstudies / Publieke Administrasie / Bestuur. 8 jaar se ervaring in strategiese beplanning / openbare sektor instellingsbeplanning / openbare sektor operasionele beplanning / openbare sektor ontwikkelingsbeplanning / openbare sektor monitering & evaluering waarvan 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/senior bestuursvlak moet wees. 'n NQF level 8 kwalifikasie, of hoër, sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. 'n Goeie begrip van politieke, regeringsbeplannings- en bestuursake. Goeie begrip van regering oor die drie sfere en vennote vir ontwikkeling. Kennis van regeringsvoorskrifte (insluitend Nasionale Tesourie-regulasies), beleide, administratiewe prosesse, praktyke en programme. Kennis van die National Development Plan (NDP) en die Medium-Term Development Plan en hul implementeringsprosesse. Vermoë om doeltreffende werkreëlings met ander sentrum van regeringsdepartemente en sosiale/ontwikkelingsvennote te bevorder en te bestuur om gekoördineerde en geïntegreerde optrede te verseker. Bereidwilligheid om gereeld te reis. Bevoegdhede & Vaardighede: Bestuursvaardighede insluitend mensebestuur en bemagtiging, en ervaring in die bestuur van multi-dissiplinêre spanne. Vermoë om strategiese rigting en leierskap te bied. Die vermoë/ervaring om 'n omgewing vir 'n hoë prestasiekultuur en personeelontwikkeling te skep. Vermoë om veelvuldige projekte te bestuur. Uitstekende interpersoonlike & kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik & mondelings). Hoogs ontwikkelde onderhandelings- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Strategiese en analitiese vaardighede. Navorsings- en beleidsanalise-vaardighede. Finansiële bestuurs- en projek/programbestuursvaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid. Persoonlike eienskappe: Die ampsdraer moet selfversekerd en selfgedrewe wees, innoverend en kreatief, kliëntgerig en op die klant gefokus, oplossingsgerig en in staat wees om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk. 'n Ter relevante NQF Level 7 kwalifikasie in Sosiale Wetenskappe, Publieke Administrasie, Ontwikkelingsstudies of verwante velde. Minimum van ten minste 8 jaar gepaste ervaring in openbare sektor monitering en bestuur waarvan 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/senior bestuursvlak moet wees. 'n Ter relevante nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF 8) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige Driver's License. Bevoegdhede / Vaardighede: sterk navorsing, kommunikasie, verslagskryfvaardighede en projek- en leierskapsvaardighede. Die kandidaat moet ook gevorderde vermoëns toon ten opsigte van die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van verwante beleide en prosedures; analitiese vaardighede, uitstekende finansiële, HR- en strategiese bestuursvaardighede en goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. 'n Deeglike kennis van Microsoft Office-toepassings is noodsalik. Persoonlike eienskappe: Die ampsdraer moet selfversekerd en selfgedrewe wees, innoverend en kreatief, kliëntgerig en op die klant gefokus, oplossingsgerig en in staat wees om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk en die vermoë hê om hoë vlakke van vertroulikheid te handhaaf. Die kandidaat moet bereid wees om te reis.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees om toe te sien, te koördineer, te assesseer en te belyn instellingsplanne (Strategiese Planne, Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne, Operasionele Planne & Implementering van Planne) met regeringsraamwerke en -prioriteite vir nasionale departemente en Schedule 3A openbare enteite. Verseker doeltreffende kwartaallikse prestasie-verslagdoeningsprosesse vir nie-finansiële prestasie-inligting van nasionale departemente en Schedule 3A openbare enteite. Ontwikkel, koördineer en fasiliteer toesigraamwerke, -strategieë en -prosesse met verwysing na. instellingsbeplanning vir nasionale departemente en Schedule 3A openbare enteite. Bestuur, koördineer en fasiliteer belanghebbende-betrokkenheid oor nasionale beplanningsprosesse en -raamwerke en verslagdoening vir nasionale departemente en Schedule 3A openbare enteite. Professionele bestuur en leierskap ten opsigte van die voorsiening van die kernfunksies en -dienste wat aan die Direktoraat toegewys is, en steun kruis-funksionele werk binne die departement. Die suksesvolle ampsdraer sal verantwoordelik wees om diensleweringverbeterings te fasiliteer deur voorlynmonitering en om steun te verleen aangaande moniteringsinisiatiewe deur die Uitvoerendes. Na Beplanning, Hersiening (Jaarlikse Plan). Toesigmonitering & Ondersteuning & Kennisbestuur. Kommunikasie van Resultate & Toewyding tot Verandering. verifikasiïng & Verbeteringsfasilitering. Bestuur van Direktoraatbronne.

zu.title: Ochwepheshe Omkhulu: Ukuqondaniswa Kwezinhlelo
zu.summary: Kudingeka Ochwepheshe Omkhulu ePretoria ukuze abukeze futhi aqondanise izinhlelo zesikhungo nezinhlelo zomphakathi kahulumeni, kudingwa izifundo ze-NQF 7 nenqubo yokuhlela iminyaka engu-8.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF 7 kulezi: Izenzululwazi Zezentabanjhlolojengo / Izifundo Zophuhliso Labezomnotho / Ukuphathwa Komphakathi / Ukuphathwa. Eminyakeni engu-8 yokuhlela okubalulekile / ukuhlelwa kwezikhungo zomphakathi kahulumeni / ukuhlelwa kokusebenza komphakathi kahulumeni / ukuhlelwa kokuthuthukiswa komphakathi kahulumeni / ukubuka nokuhlolwa komphakathi kahulumeni okuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-5 okumele kusezingeni lomphathi ophakathi/omphezulu. Isifundo senga-linganiso le-NQF 8 noma esiphezulu kakhulu, kuzothola inzuzo enkulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe. Ukuqonda kahle izindlela zezombusazwe, ukuhlela kwabahulumeni kanye nezindlela zokubusa. Ukuqonda kahle ngohulumeni kuzo zonke izigaba ezintathu kanye nabahlobo bokuthuthukiswa. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zohulumeni (okuhlanganisa izimiso ze-National Treasury), izinqubomgomo, inqubo yolawulo, amasu, kanye nezinhlela. Ulwazi lwe-National Development Plan (NDP) kanye ne-Medium-Term Development Plan kanye nendlela yokuzisetshenziswa. Isakhono sokukhuleka nokuphatha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo nokubambisana namanye eminyango yesikhungo sika hulumeni kanye nabahlobo bokuze kwenzeke ngokuvumelana. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba njalo. Amakhono namava: Amakhono okuphatha okuhlanganisa ukuphatha abantu nokunikeza amandla, kanye nalokho nakho ekuphatheni amaqembu ahlukahlukene. Isakhono sokunika isiqondiso nokuholwa kubalulekile. Isikhathi/esiphotholanga ukudala isimo sezokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi kanye nokuze kube ngamasiko okusebenza ngamandla. Isakhono sokuphatha imikhuba eminingi. Amakhono okuxhumana nokuxhumana (okushiwo nangomlomo). Amakhono okuxoxisana ngokubanzi nokuphatha izinkinga avela. Amakhono okuhlola amasu. Amakhono lwesifundo nokuhlola inqubomgomo. Amakhono okuphatha izimali kanye nokuphatha imikhuba/izinhlela. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha kahle. Izakhiwo zobuntu: Othisayo kumele abe nokuzethemba futhi azifake egameni, aqhamuke futhi adale, abeke phambili abathengi futhi aqikelele ngabathengi, afune izisombululo futhi akwazi ukusebenza emahlotsheni. Isifundo esifanele ngengabalisi le-NQF 7 kwiZenzululwazi Ngokomphakathi, Ukuphathwa, Izifundo Zokuthuthukisa noma eminye imikhakha ehlobene. Eminyakeni engu-8 okungenani yokuhlolwa komphakathi kahulumeni nokuphathwa okuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-5 okumele kusezingeni lomphathi ophakathi/omphezulu. Isifundo sokuthi umfundile ngemuva (NQF 8) kuthole isenzo esingaphezulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe. Amakhono / Izindlela: amakhono okuhlola, okuxhumana, okubhala umbiko kanye namakhono ekuphathwa iqembu nokuba ngumholi. Othanda kumele futhi abonise amakhono aphakeme ekuthuthukisweni, ekusetshenzisweni nasekubukeni izinqubomgomo nezenkalo; amakhono okuhlaziya, okuphatha imali, amakhono okuphatha izimali ne-HR nezobuchwepheshe, amakhono okuphatha izinhlela kanye nokuba nomphumela wokubekezela kubantu. Ulwazi oluhle lwezinhlelo ze-Microsoft Office luyadingeka. Izakhiwo zobuntu: lowo othathwe isikhundla kumele abe nokuzethemba futhi azifake egameni, aqhamuke futhi adale, abeke phambili abathengi futhi aqikelele ngabathengi, afune izisombululo futhi akwazi ukusebenza emahlotsheni anesikhathi, kanye nesikhathi sokugcina izimfihlo eziphezulu. Othanda kumele azibe nokuzethemba.
zu.duties: Umntu othathwe isikhundla uzobe nokubuka, uhlole, ahlolisise futhi aqondanise izinhlelo zesikhungo (Izinhlelo eZibalulekile, Izinhlelo Zomsebenzi Wonyaka, Izinhlelo Zokusebenza & Izinhlelo Zokusetshenziswa) nezinhlelo kahulumeni nezinhlelo zeminyango yezwe nezikhungo zomphakathi ze-Schedule 3A. Qinisekisa inqubo evumelekile yokubika ngokusebenza nsuku zonke kokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zeminyango yezwe nezikhungo zomphakathi ze-Schedule 3A. Kuthuthukise, qondanise futhi usize ekubukeni izinhlelo, amasu kanye nendlela ngokuqondiswa. ukuhlela izinhlelo zeminyango yezwe nezikhungo zomphakathi ze-Schedule 3A. Phatha, qondanise futhi usize ekubambisaneni nabanomthwalo wemisebenzi ekuhleleni izinhlelo zeswe kanye nokubika kweminyango yezwe nezikhungo zomphakathi ze-Schedule 3A. Ukuphatha ngobuchwepheshe nokuholwa ngokohlelo olunikeziwe kumisebenzi ebalulekile nemikhuba enikezwe i-Directorate nokusekela imisebenzi ehlukene emnyangweni. Umtu othathe isikhundla uzobe nokusekela ukuphuculwa kokulethwa kwezinsiza ngokuqapha phambili futhi anikeze isixazo ekwaziseni ngokuqapha okwenziwa abaphathi. Ukuhlela, Ukuhlola (Uhlelo Lonyaka). Ukuqapha Ukubuka & Ukwesekwa & Ukuphatha Ulwazi. Ukuxhumana kwezemuqQLa futhi kuzibophezele ekushintshweni. ukuqinisekisa & ukweseka ukuthuthukiswa. Ukuphatha izinsiza ze-Directorate.

xh.title: Oqhathambezulu Ophakamileyo: Uqwalaselo LweNkqubo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa oqhathambezulu ophakamileyo ePretoria ukuze aqophe kwaye alinganise iinkqubo zenkcubeko nezakhiwo zorhulumente, kubandevela ifanelekwana le-NQF 7 namava eminyaka engama-8 kuqwalaselo lwenkqubo.
xh.requirements: Ifanelekwana eliqhelekileyo le-NQF level 7 naliphothwe kulinye lwalemimiselo: Social Science / Economics Development Studies / Public Administration / Management. Iminyaka engama-8 yamava kwicala lokucwangcisa iindidi-migca / kukucwangcisa iinkqubo zenkcubeko kwicala lorhulumente / kukucwangcisa iziseko eziphatha kwicala lorhulumente / kukucwangcisa utshintsho-lwazi kwicala lorhulumente / kulandelelorho lwemiba yorhulumente apho iminyaka emi-5 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba eliphakathi/phezulu loku-lawula. Ifanelekwana le-NQF level 8, okanye ngaphezulu, luya kuba lusisongezo. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba egunyazisiweyo. Ukuqonda okulungileyo ngemiba zezopolitiko, zokucwangcisa zorhulumente nolawulo. Ukuqonda okulungileyo korhulumente kuwo onke amazantsi amathathu nabadibaniselo bazo bokwenza utshintsho. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo yorhulumente (kuquka namagqabantshintshi we-National Treasury), iinkqubo, iinkqubo zolawulo, iinkqubo zenkcubeko, neenkqubo. Ulwazi nge-National Development Plan (NDP) naye-Medium-Term Development Plan nendlela zokuzisebenzisa zazo. Amandla okwakha nokulawula iindlela ezisebenzayo zokusebenza namanye amasebe eziko lorhulumente nabadibaniselo bakhula-ntlonlo bakhuthaza izenzo ezihlangeneyo nezilungelelanisiweyo. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba rhoqo. Amandla & Amakhono: Amandla okulawula aquka ukulawula abantu nokuqinisekisa amandla abo, namava ekulawuleni iinqela ezinabaphathi abanobundlela obungenasiphithiphithi. Amandla okunika inkqubo yokuqonda iindlela ezifanelekileyo nokuqhathanisa. Amandlo/amava okuyila indalo eqhube phambili ulwazi lokusebenza ngonombolo ophezulu nophuhliso lwabasebenzi. Amandla okulawula iiprojekthi ezininzi ngesixa solusu. Amakhono amnandi oyonwabiso & oqhagamshelwano (awabhaliyo & athethwayo). Amakhono obunyulu bokuxoxisana nokulawula iingxabano aqhube phambili. Amandla aqhube phambili nezalathiso ezingahlaziywayo. Amandla ophando lokulawula iinkqubo nabanzi-mboyi. Amandla okulawula imali nemiso/inkqubo yeprojekthi. Amakhono amnandi okusebenza ngekhompyutha. Iimpawu zobuntu: Kufuneka okhululekile ekubeni nexesha elide lokuqonda izinto aze azichaze, aqueke iingcinga ezintsha nezodidiweyo, aqwalasele abakhWebzileyo, alungelelanise isisombulu, abe nakho ukusebenza ngemisebenzi egcwele umdla. Ifanelekwana eliqhelekileyo le-NQF Level 7 kwi-Social Sciences, Public Administration, Development Studies okwezinye iindawo ezingemva. Amava afanelekileyo okungenaphi under eminyaka engama-8 kwezoluntu imimiselo yorhulumente nokuqwalasela apho iminyaka emi-5 ibengowokulingana nolonke (okanye ngaphezulu) kukhulise indlela. Isiqendu esifanelekileyo sokuba negunya le-NQF Level 7 lizakuba luncedo. Ilayisenesi yokuhamba egunyazisiweyo. Izakhono / Iimfuno: izakhono zokucinga, zokuthetha, zokubhala iingxelo, zokuqulunqa amagqabantshintshi nokukhokela iinteam. Kufuneka abonise ukuqonda okukhulu ekubakho, ekuyileni nasekuboniseni imigaqo-nkqubo ethethwe ngokulandelelanisa, okukhulu, izalathiso ngezenzo nangamava okwenza imali. Imfihlo yoluntu: Kufuneka abe namandla, abe namandla aphuma kuye, aqueke iingcinga ezitsha, aqueke iminqweno yamakhaya, aqueke iindlela ezisisombulu kwaye akwazi ukusebenza ngexesha elinzima egcwele ukungabi nangxaki nokugcina iimfihlo ezininzi zentlalo yakhe.
xh.duties: Kulawulwe, kokwelula, kwayalwa kwaye kwenziwa isiko ulungelelwano lwezicwangciso (iStrategic Plans, iAnnual Performance Plans, i-Operational Plans & i-Implementation Plans) ngokwemigaqo-nkqubo kwaye abe ngowona mathanda amanye amanyathelo oqhagamshelwano amazwe iSizwe neSizwe neziqhankqela zendalo lwakhe Schedule 3A. Kuqinisekiswa ngokubeka yonke imijaho yokubhala iNgqungquthela egqithiswe ngenkqubo ngokwekhareli yokubhala iSizwe njengokuzaliseka kweSizwe ngokungezantsi kweSizwe kwamaza amathathu yaye abe ngowona maxwebhu iNgqo e-3A. Kuyilwa, kwayalwa kwaye kusikelwa phantsi iindidi-mgca yolungelelwano, iStrategic Plans neenkqubo kunokulinganisela: ulungelelwano lwesikhankqazo sesizwe ngeentshaba lamanyathelo oqhagamshelwano nezindlela ezikwi iSchedule 3A. Kwenziwa ulawulo, ukuyalwa nokukhokela abantu abamhlophe kumaziko ezizwe nakuzo iNkqubo nakuwo wonke amaziko ezibhalwe ku-3A ngokunyathelo lolungiselelo lwebhankithi phantsi kolawulo kolu setyenzo oluqhuba e-Sizwe kwaye uxhaswe imisebenzi ehambelanayo kwesebe. Umntu ophumeleleyo uzakuba nobulumko bokukhokela iinkqubo ngokusebenza kumgangatho wangaphambili wekuqwalasela iinkqubo, kwakunye nolwazi olukhulu ekusebenzeni kolawulo ngokwezonyaka weenkqubo ezisetyenziswa ngokuphindiweyo kubhaqabhakho neNkqubo eNcenyesiwe. Ukubeka, ukuqhathanisa (iNgqungquthela yonyaka). Ukulawula ukuqwalaselwa & UkuNxiba ulwazi. Ukuze kubhale iziphumo kunye nokuNxibelelana nokuguqula. isiqiniseko & Ukuyala ulungiselelo. Ukulawula amagcisa e-Sizwe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Management Accounting
jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 897 per annum (Level 09), plus benefits
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Management Accounting in the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation, Pretoria, requiring a finance qualification and five years' experience including BAS.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year tertiary qualification (NQF level 6) in finance related field with at least 5 years’ experience in finance environment of which 3 years should be at supervisory level. Must have working experience on the Basic Accounting System (BAS). An NQF level 7 in Finance related field and working experience on PERSAL will be an added advantage. Knowledge Competencies and skills: Must have good communication and presentation skills. Good analytical, problem solving and report writing skills. Must be a team player, flexible and reliable. Knowledge requirements: Good understanding of the PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Good knowledge of Modified Cash Standards and basic understanding of the SCM processes.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for providing financial planning and reporting for the department in accordance with the prescripts. This entails preparation of Annual Financial Statements (AFS) and Interim Financial Statements (IFS). Providing financial planning in accordance with the prescripts and Management of Expenditure. Provide BAS System Controller. Supervision of staff.
jobs.enquiries: Ms B Sebuyana Tel No: (012) 312 0462
jobs.applications: can also be emailed to Recruitment33@dpme.gov.za
jobs.notes: The relevant reference number must be quoted on all applications. The successful candidate will have to sign an annual performance agreement and will be required to undergo a security clearance. Applications must be submitted on a signed Z83 accompanied by a comprehensive CV only specifying all experience indicating the respective dates (MM/YY) as well as indicating three reference persons with the following information: name and contact number(s), email address and an indication of the capacity in which the reference is known to the candidate. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. Applicants will be required to meet vetting requirements as prescribed by Minimum Information Security Standards. The DPME is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s) Failure to submit the above information will result in the application not being considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Reference checks will be done during the selection process. Note that correspondence will only be conducted with the short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Shortlisted candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by DPME. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks will be conducted once they are short-listed and the appointment is also subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. For salary levels 11 to 15, the inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The DPME reserves the right to utilise practical exercises/tests for non-SMS positions during the recruitment process (candidates who are shortlisted will be informed accordingly) to determine the suitability of candidates for the post(s). The DPME also reserves the right to cancel the filling / not to fill a vacancy that was advertised during any stage of the recruitment process. Prior to appointment, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details      can   be     sourced        by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates are required to use the new Z83 (Application for employment) that is implemented with effect from 1 January 2021. A copy can be downloaded on the website of the Department of Public Service & Administration (DPSA) at www.dpsa.gov.za MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Umsekeli Womqondisi: Izibalo Eziphathwayo Zezimali
zu.summary: Umsekeli Womqondisi: Izibalo Eziphathwayo Zezimali kuMnyango Wokuhlela, Okuhlola Nokubuyekea, ePretoria, ofuna izifundo ezimalini nosizo lweminyaka emihlanu okuhlanganise iBAS.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esifanele samayunivesithi eminyaka eyi-3 (izinga le-NQF 6) enkundleni ehlobene nezimali nobungcweti obungenani iminyaka eyi-5 kwindawo yezimali okuhlanganiswe kuyo iminyaka eyi-3 ezingeni lokuqondisa. Kumele abe nokuhlolandlela kokusebenza kusistimu ye-Basic Accounting System (BAS). Izinga le-NQF 7 enkundleni ehlobene nezimali nokuhlolandlela kukusebenza kwiPERSAL kuzoba ngcoliselo. Ulwazi, amandla nokubekezela: Kumele abe namandla okuxoxa kahle nokwethula. Amandla okuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokubhala imibiko. Kumele abe ngumuntu osebenza kwindawo yeqembu, oguquguqukayo futhi othembekile. Izidingo zolwazi: Ukuqonda kahle iPFMA nezinqubo ze-Treasury. Ulwazi oluhle lwe-Modified Cash Standards nokuchazwa okuyisisekelo kwezinqubo ze-SCM.
zu.duties: Lowo setshenzwayo uzobe egatya ukunikeza ukuhlelwa kwesibikezelo sezimali nokubika umnyango ngokuhambisana nemigomo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukulungiswa kwezitatimende ezimali zeminyaka yonke (AFS) nezitatimende ezesikhashana (IFS). Ukunikeza ukuhlelwa kwesibikezelo sezimali ngokuhambisana nemigomo kanye Nokulawula Okushiswa. Ukunikeza ukulawula isistimu yeBAS. Ukuqondisa abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: i-Akhawuntingi yoLawulo
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: i-Akhawuntingi yoLawulo kwiSebe leZolucango, lokuQaphela nokuLinganisa, Pretoria, elifuna isigqibo sezimali nolwazi lweenyanga ezintlanu lokungenisa i-BAS.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo esifanelekileyo se-tertiary seminyaka emi-3 (inqanaba le-NQF 6) kwindawo ehambelana nezimali nolwazi olungangathanga ludlula iminyaka esi-5 kwindawo yezimali apho kwiminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokulawula. Kufuneka ube namava okusebenza kwi-Basic Accounting System (BAS). Inqanaba le-NQF 7 kwindawo ehambelana nezimali namava okusebenza kwi-PERSAL kuya kuba lusizo oluqhubekayo. Ulwazi lamakhono abanzi namakhono: Kufuneka ube namakhono mahle okunxibelelana nokubonisa. Amakhono mahle okuhlenga, okusombulula iingxaki nokubhala iingxelo. Kufuneka ube ngumntu osebenza ngokwq kim, oguquguqukayo othembekileyo. Iimfuno zolwazi: Ukuqonda okuhle nge-PFMA neMithetho yeTreasury. Ulwazi oluhle lwe-Modified Cash Standards nokuqonda okuyimvelaphi yeenkqubo ze-SCM.
xh.duties: Owayo kuyo le sithuba uya kuba nomxhanxa wokunikela ngolucango lwezimali nokubika ngezebe ngokomiselo oqokelelweyo. Oku kuquka ukuqulunqa iinkqubo zezezimali eziyiNgqonyela (i-AFS) nezezezimali eziyiNgqonyela ezixubeneyo (i-IFS). Ukunika ulucango lwezimali ngokomiselo oqokelelweyo noLawulo loTsalabo. Ukunika ulawulo lwe-BAS System Controller. Ukuqokelela iimbaleki.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Salaries, TAX and S&T
jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09), plus benefits 37% in lieu
jobs.summary: Assistant Director responsible for salaries, tax management, and S&T services within the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3 year tertiary qualification (NQF level 6) in Finance with a minimum of 5 years’ experience in Salaries and Tax environment of which 3- years should be at supervisory level. Should have extensive knowledge and experience of BAS, Tax and PERSAL and a high level of computer literacy. Competencies and skills: High level of management skills, planning, report writing skills, organisational skills, good interpersonal relations and Communication skills (written & verbal). Must have good understanding of PFMA, Treasury Regulations and other relevant legislation. Personal Attributes: Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality. Be able to work under constant pressure. Must be a team player, flexible and reliable.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for providing salaries, tax management and S&T services to the Department. This entails: Processing salary claims, payroll, Commissioner and Audit Committee payments. Conducting Tax reconciliations and submissions. Suspense accounts and reporting. Development of procedure manuals and review of policies. Supervision of staff.
jobs.enquiries: Ms B Sebuyana Tel No (012) 312-0462
jobs.applications: can also be emailed to Recruitment34@dpme.gov.za
jobs.notes: The relevant reference number must be quoted on all applications. The successful candidate will have to sign an annual performance agreement and will be required to undergo a security clearance. Applications must be submitted on a signed Z83 accompanied by a comprehensive CV only specifying all experience indicating the respective dates (MM/YY) as well as indicating three reference persons with the following information: name and contact number(s), email address and an indication of the capacity in which the reference is known to the candidate. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. Applicants will be required to meet vetting requirements as prescribed by Minimum Information Security Standards. The DPME is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s) Failure to submit the above information will result in the application not being considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Reference checks will be done during the selection process. Note that correspondence will only be conducted with the short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Shortlisted candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by DPME. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks will be conducted once they are short-listed and the appointment is also subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. For salary levels 11 to 15, the inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The DPME reserves the right to utilise practical exercises/tests for non-SMS positions during the recruitment process (candidates who are shortlisted will be informed accordingly) to determine the suitability of candidates for the post(s). The DPME also reserves the right to cancel the filling / not to fill a vacancy that was advertised during any stage of the recruitment process. Prior to appointment, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details      can   be     sourced        by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates are required to use the new Z83 (Application for employment) that is implemented with effect from 1 January 2021. A copy can be downloaded on the website of the Department of Public Service & Administration (DPSA) at www.dpsa.gov.za MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Salarisse, TAX en S&T
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur verantwoordelik vir salarisse, belastingbestuur en S&T-dienste binne die Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF level 6) in Finansies met 'n minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring in 'n salaris- en belastingomgewing waarvan 3 jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Moet oor uitgebreide kennis en ervaring van BAS, Tax en PERSAL beskik, asook 'n hoë vlak van rekenaarvaardigheid. Bevoegdhede en vaardighede: Hoë vlak van bestuursvaardighede, beplanning, verslagskryfvaardighede, organisatoriese vaardighede, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Moet 'n goeie begrip hê van PFMA, Treasury Regulations en ander tersaaklike wetgewing. Persoonlike eienskappe: Vermoë om 'n hoë vlak van vertroulikheid te handhaaf. Moet onder constante druk kan werk. Moet 'n spanspeler wees, buigsaam en betroubaar.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van salaris-, belastingbestuurs- en S&T-dienste aan die departement. Dit behels: Verwerking van salariseise, loonstaat, Kommissaris- en Ouditeerkomiteebetalings. Uitvoer van belastingherverwerkings en indienings. Hangende rekeninge en verslagdoening. Ontwikkeling van prosedurehandleidings en hersiening van beleide. Toesig oor personeel.

zu.title: Osizo Oqondiswa: Amaholo, I-TAX kanye ne-S&T
zu.summary: Osizo Oqondiswa onobunjiniyeli ngamaholo, ukuphathwa kwentela, kanye nesevisi ye-S&T ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole saminyaka yeshumi (NQF level 6) kwe-Finance ezibandakanya iminyaka engu-5 yokuhlangabezela kwinkundla yamaholo nentela, lapho konyakeni omu-3 kumele kube ngazinga lobuhloli. Kufanele ube nolwazi olunzulu kanye nokuhlangabezela kwe-BAS, i-Tax ne-PERSAL kanye nelinga eliphezulu lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono neziqu: Ikhono eliphezulu lokuphatha, ukweluleka, ukubhala umbiko, ikhono lokuhlela, ubuhlobo obuhle kanye nekhono lokuxhumana (okushiwayo nokukhulunwayo). Kumele uqonde kahle i-PFMA, imithetho ye-Treasury kanye nomthetho ohlobene nayo. Izici zobuntu: Ikhono lokugcina ukungatholakali okuphezulu. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi eqhubekayo. Kumele ube ngumdlali wesiqhaza, ukuguquguquka futhi uthembekile.
zu.duties: Umuntu oqokiweyo uzobe nesibopho sokunika umnyango amaholo, ukuphathwa kwentela, kanye nesevisi ye-S&T. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: Ukucubungula izikhalazo zamaholo, i-payroll, ukukhokha i-Commissioner ne-Audit Committee. Ukwenza ukubuyekeza kwentela kanye nokuhumusha. I-suspense accounts kanye nokubika. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemibhalo yokuqondisa kanye nokubuyekeza izinhlelo. Ukugada abasebenzi.

xh.title: Isikhulu esiNcedisayo: Imivuzo, iTAX neS&T
xh.summary: Isikhulu esiNcedisayo esibhekisele kumvuzo, ulawulo lwesixa senkcitho, neenkonzo zeS&T ngaphakathi kwiSebe loCwangciso,okuQwalasela nokuHlolwa ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo zemyakuzo yeminyaka emi-3 (inqanaba le-6 le-NQF) kwezeMali zinomgangatho weemvakalelo zeminyaka engama-5 kwishishini lweMivuzo nesiXa senkcitho, apho iminyaka engama-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokulawula. Kufuneka abe nolwazi olubanzi kunye namava kwi-BAS, isiXa senkcitho nePERSAL nakumgangatho ophezulu wolwazi lwekhompyutha. Iikhompetensi kunye namakhono: Umgangatho ophezulu wamakhono olawulo, ucwangciso, amakhono okubhala iiriphothi, amakhono azenziwe, ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu kunye namakhono eNtetho (ebhaliweyo nethethwayo). Kufuneka abe nguqondisiso oluhle kwi-PFMA, Iimigaqo zeTreasury namanye emagazini ahambelana nayo. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ulwazi lokugcina umxholo oqotho ngokupheleleyo. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo olusoloko lukhona. Kufuneka abe ngumdlali webhodi, aflexibhile athembekile.
xh.duties: Umama okhethiweyo uya kuba necwaka lokubonelela ngenkonzo yemivuzo, ulawulo lwesixa senkcitho neS&T kuSebe. Oku kuthetha ukuba: Ukucubungula iindlela zemivuzo, i-payroll, nentlawulo yeKomishoni yoMlawuli kunye neKomiti yoQwalaselo. Ukwenza uqwalaselo nokungenisa izixa zenkcitho. Ii-akhawunti ze-Suspense nokubika. Upelo lwesixhobo samacebo okwenza imisebenzi nokuqwalasela kwakhona iinkqubo. Ukuqondisa abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Institutional Assessments
jobs.department: Department of Public Service and Administration
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (an all-inclusive remuneration package). Annual progression up to a maximum salary of R1 098 195 per annum is possible , subjected to satisfactory performance. The all-inclusive remunerative package consists of basic salary (70% of the total remuneration package), the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion that may be structured according to personal needs within a framework.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Institutional Assessments at the Department of Public Service and Administration in Pretoria, responsible for developing policies and monitoring organisational functionality assessments.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate, a minimum qualification at NQF Level 7 in Operations Management / Management Services / Industrial and Organisational Psychology / Public Administration / Public Management as recognised by SAQA. 3 years’ experience in Assistant Director level/first-level management. 5 years’ experience in organisational development/monitoring and evaluation/strategic planning environments. Knowledge of government legislative frameworks. knowledge of public service legislative and policy frameworks (PSAs). knowledge of government programmes such as the National Development Plan, Outcome 12, and Key Strategic Priorities of Government; knowledge of public policy development processes; and knowledge of public policy analysis. Functional Skills: Written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and coordination, analytical skills, and programme and project management. Generic Skills: Problem-solving, decision-making, computer literacy, knowledge management, change management and interpersonal relations. Technical (Specialisation) Skills: Knowledge of the Public Service Act and Framework, Knowledge of Public Service Operations Management Framework, Basic research skills and basic monitoring and evaluation, including data analysis skills. Attributes: Problem- solving and innovation skills, planning and organising, teamwork, and working independently operations and analysis and improvement. Adapts and responds well to change. Manages pressure effectively and copes well with setbacks; ability to persuade, influence and lead; ability to maintain confidentiality; and ability to manage time and multiple target dates.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Institusionele Assessering
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Institusionele Assessering by die Department of Public Service and Administration in Pretoria, verantwoordelik vir die ontwikkeling van beleide en die monitering van organisatoriese funksionaliteitsassessering.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat, 'n minimum kwalifikasie op NQF Vlak 7 in Bedrywighedebestuur / Bestuursdienste / Bedryfs- en Organisatoriese Sielkunde / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur soos erken deur SAQA. 3 jaar se ervaring op Assistent-Direkteur-vlak/ eerste-vlak bestuur. 5 jaar se ervaring in organisatoriese ontwikkelings-/ moniterings- en evaluerings-/ strategiese beplanningsomgewings. Kennis van regeringswetgewende raamwerke. Kennis van openbare diens wetgewende en beleidsraamwerke (PSA's). Kennis van regeringsprogramme soos die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, Uitkoms 12, en Kern Strategiese Prioriteite van Regering; kennis van openbare beleidsontwikkelingsprosesse; en kennis van openbare beleidsontleding. Funksionele Vaardighede: Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie, belanghebbende bestuur en koördinasie, analitiese vaardighede, en program- en projekbestuur. Generiese Vaardighede: Probleemoplossing, besluitneming, rekenaargeletterdheid, kennisbestuur, veranderingbestuur en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Tegniese (Spesialisering) Vaardighede: Kennis van die Openbare Dienswet en Raamwerk, Kennis van Openbare Diens Bedrywighede bestuursraamwerk, Basiese navorsingsvaardighede en basiese monitering en evaluering, insluitend data-analise vaardighede. Attribute: Probleemoplossing en innovasievaardighede, beplanning en organisering, spanwerk, en onafhanklike werk bedrywighede en analise en verbetering. Pas aan en reageer goed op verandering. Hanteer druk doeltreffend en gaan goed om met terugslae; vermoë om te oortuig, te beïnvloed en te lei; vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf; en vermoë om tyd en veelvuldige teiken datums te bestuur.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en monitor die implementering van beleide en voorskrifte oor Organisatoriese Funksionaliteitsassesserings, verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan provinsiale en nasionale departemente oor die institusionalisering van die Direktief vir organisatoriese funksionaliteitsassessering, voer monitering en evaluering van nakoming en impakassessering oor die Direktief op OFA uit, en verskaf ondersteuning in alle Bedrywighede, Stelsels en Prosesse van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Onobhala: Ukulinganiswa Kwezikhungo
zu.summary: Onobhala: Ukulinganiswa Kwezikhungo eDepartment of Public Service and Administration ePretoria, onenxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubomgomo nasekuqaphelelweni kokulinganiswa kokusebenza kwezinhlangano.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatasa, noma ngabe yisiphi isabelo esingunqangoba wemfunda ezingeni le-NQF Level 7 kwi-Operations Management / Management Services / Industrial and Organisational Psychology / Public Administration / Public Management njengoba kuhlonzwe yi-SAQA. Uzoba neminyaka engu-3 yohlelo emazingeni e-Assistant Director/abaphathi bomlinganiso wokuqala. Uzoba neminyaka engu-5 yohlelo emibilini yesithuthukiso sezinhlangano/ukuqaphela nokuhlola/iplani ezinkundleni zamasu. Ukwazi izinhlelo zomthetho kahulumeni. Ukwazi izinhlelo zomthetho nezinqubomgomo zesevisi yomphakathi (PSAs). Ukwazi amaphrogramu kahulumeni njenge-National Development Plan, i-Outcome 12, kanye ne-Key Strategic Priorities of Government; ukwazi inqubo yothuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo zomphakathi; kanye nokuqonda ukuhlaziya izinqubomgomo zomphakathi. Amakhono Okusebenza: Ukuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nangokukhulunywa, ukuphathwa nokuhlelwa kwabahlobene, amakhono okuhlaziya, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Amakhono Ajwayelekile: Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukwazi ukusebenzela ikhompyutha, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuphathwa kokushintsha kanye nokuhlobana nabantu. Amakhono Okusebenza (Obuchwepheshe): Ukwazi umthetho kanye nesakhiwo se-Public Service Act, ukwazi isakhiwo sokuPhathwa kwe-Public Service Operations Management, amakhono obuncwadi besisekelo kanye nokuqaphela nokuhlola okuyisisekelo, okuhlanganisa namakhono okuhlaziya idatha. Iimpawu: Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokudala izinto ezintsha, ukuhlela nokuhlela, ukusebenza njengeqembu, kanye nokusebenza izenzakalo ezingezona ezigqamile zokusebenza nokuhlaziya ukuthuthukiswa. Uyajwayela futhi uphendula kahle ushintsho. Uphatha umfutho ngokuphumelelayo ajwayele kahle nezikhathi ezingezinhle; ikhono lokukholisa, ukuba negalelo kanye nokukhokha; ikhono lokugcina imfihlo; futhi ikhono lokuphatha isikhathi kanye nezinsuku zokuqedwa eziningi.
zu.duties: Thuthukisa futhi uqaphele ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo nemiyalo yokulinganiswa Kokusebenza Kwezinhlangano, nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe eminyangweni yezifundazwe nasenyangweni kazwelonke ngokumisa njengesiko ngokusemthethweni imiyalo yokulinganiswa kokusebenza kwezinhlangano, qaphela futhi uhlolo ukuvumelana nokulinganiswa komthelela kumyalo we-OFA futhi nikeza inkxaso kuyo yonke I-Operations, I-Systems kanye ne-Processes ze-Directorate.

xh.title: Owayo oNgcangcazelo: Ukuqinisekiswa kweZiko
xh.summary: Owayo oNgcangcazelo: Ukuqinisekiswa kweZiko kwi-Department of Public Service and Administration e-Pretoria, unoxanduva lokuphuhlisa imigaqo nokulawula ukulinganisela ukusebenza kweentlangano.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo, ifomali ephantsi kancinane kwi-NQF Level 7 kwi-Operations Management / Management Services / Industrial and Organisational Psychology / Public Administration / Public Management njengoko ivunywe yi-SAQA. Unyaka wama-3 wamava kwinqanaba lika-Assistant Director/abaphathi abangesiqaqambu. Unyaka wama-5 wamava kwindawo zophuhliso lwentlangano/ulawulo nokuqinisekisa/ucwangciso lwezicwangciso. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo karhulumente. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo kwinkonzo karhulumente namavaqabo (PSAs). Ulwazi ngeenkqabo karhulumente ezinjengesicwangciso seZizwe eziPhuhliswayo, i-Outcome 12, nokuqwalaselwa kwemigangatho ebalulekileyo karhulumente; ulwazi ngamavaqabo ephuhliso lwemigaqo yoluntu; kunye nolwazi ngokuhlola imigaqo yoluntu. Amandla oKusebenza: Unxibelelwano ngokubhalwa nangokuthethwa, ulawulo lokulawula abanomdla nokuqukanisa, amandla okuhlola, kunye nolawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Amandla aJikelele: Ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulawulo lolwazi, ulawulo lotshintsho kunye noonxibelelwano babantu. Amandla oBugcisa (okuQanjiweyo): Ulwazi ngoMthetho woBucala boLawulo kunye neNkqubo yomGaqo-nkqubo, Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yoLawulo lwaBasebenzi beSikhonzo soLawulo, Amandla abalulekileyo wophando kunye nolawulo lokulinganisela nokuqinisekisa oluquka amandla okwahlula-hlula iingcombolo. Iimpawu: Amandla okusombulula iingxaki nokudala izinto entsha, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela, ukusebenza njengesiqhathi, kunye nokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo izicelo kunye nokuqwalasela nokuphucula. Itshintshe kwaye iphendule kakuhle utshintsho. Ilawula umfutho ngempumelelo kwaye ihambelana kakuhle neenguqu ezibuhlungu; amandla okuthenga, ukuchaphazela kunye nokukhokela; amandla okugcina iimfihlo; kunye namandla okulawula ixesha namaphinda amaxesha okuvala.
xh.duties: Phuhlaza kwaye ulawule ukuqutywa kwemigaqo nemiyalelo yokulinganisela ukusebenza kweentlangano, nikezela inkxaso yobugcisa kumasebe abakwingingqi nakulawuzwe ngokulinganisela ukusebenza kweentlangano, yenza ulawulo lokulinganisela nokuqinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo nokulinganisela ukucinga ngomthetho wokulinganisela ukusebenza kweentlangano, kwaye unikezela inkxaso kuzo zonke iZicelo, iinkqubo, neenkqubo zeNtlangano.
