af.title: Onderdirekteur: IKR-bewind
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: IKR-bewind by die Department of Public Service and Administration in Pretoria, vereis 'n NQF Level 7 IKR-kwalifikasie en agt jaar se ondervinding.
af.requirements: A Senior Certificate, 'n minimum kwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 in Information Communication Technology (IKR) soos deur SAQA erken. Minimum 8 jaar se ondervinding in 'n IKR-omgewing. Kennis van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika en kennis van die regeringswetgewingsraamwerk. Kennis van openbare diens-wetgewende en beleidsraamwerke. Kennis van regeringsprogramme soos die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan. Kennis van die kern strategiese prioriteite van die regering. 'n Deeglike begrip van IKR-bestuur en bedrywighede en 'n begrip van die bewind van IKR. Begrip van besigheids- en IKR-aflyningbeplanning en die implementering daarvan. Begrip van Enterprise Architecture. Begrip van veranderingsbeheer en -bestuur en begrip van ontluikende tegnologieë. Analise, ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering en evaluering van IKR-beleide, norme, standaarde, kontroles, raamwerke en verwante middle en meganismes. Probleemoplossing en analise, beplanning en organisering, spanleierskap, finansiële bestuur, veranderingsbestuur, kommunikasie en koördinasie, belanghebbendebestuur en diensleweringsinnovasie. Werkkennis, aanvaarding van verantwoordelikheid, gehalte van werk, betroubaarheid, inisiatief, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, beplanning en uitvoering, fasilitering, etiese gedrag, aanpasbaarheid, buigsaamheid, vertroulikheid, aanbieding en verslagskrywing.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer voorskrifte oor IKR-bewind. Doen navorsing vir die ontwikkeling van IKR-voorskrifte. Verskaf implementeringsondersteuning aan departemente. Ontwerp oudite of assesserings van IKR-bewindstelsels wat binne departemente uitgevoer word. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en advies soos vereis. Verskaf kapasiteitsbou en/of lewer bydraes tot die ontwikkeling van kapasiteitsontwikkelingsprogramme deur die tersaaklike instellings. Monitor implementering en nakoming. Doen evaluering en impakstudies soos vereis. Verskaf ondersteuning in alle bedrywighede, stelsels en prosesse van die direktoraat. Stel inligting en advies op vir die MPSA, die Kabinet, die Parlement en ander interne en eksterne belanghebbendes.

zu.title: OwayenguMongameli we-ICT Governance
zu.summary: Isikhundla soba nguMongameli we-ICT eNtshonalanga KwaZulu-Natal eThekwini. Kudingeka abe nobuchwepheshe be-ICT ezifundweni ezinkulu. Kudingeka abe namava iminyaka eyishumi ekusebenzeni ngezinhlelo zokuxhumana nezokwazisa. Kubalulekile ukuba ayikho imfundo efanayo nokuthi ayikho imfundo efanayo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esiphakeme, iziqu ezibekiwe ezibonakala ngesibalo esingaphansi kwesikhombisa kwischema leNQF kwibanga lesi-7 kwe-ICT, njengoba kubonwa ngumphathi weziqu, i-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Kudingeka kube nokutholakala kweziqu ezisetshenziswa ngamagunya asanda kubakha. Kubalulekile ukuba ulwazi ngalelo bizo elithi 'umbuso wentengo yonke imali'. Lolu hlelo lunikeza isikhundla kubantu abaningi abafisa ukusebenzela imali. Akukho okunye okudingekayo.
zu.duties: Bumba futhi usebenzise imiyalo ebuzwa kubuMbusi be-ICT. Yenza ucwaningo ukuze kuthuthukiswe imiyalo ye-ICT. Nikeza ukusekelwa ekusebenziseni kumamanyango. Bhala izikhwama zokuqapha noma izikhwama zokuhlola izinhlelo zokuBusa i-ICT ezwenziwa ngaphakathi kwamanyango. Nikeza ukusekelwa ngobuchwepheshe nokuweluleka njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza ukwakhiwa kwamandla bese ubuye unikeze igalelo ekuthuthukisweni kwamaphrogremu okwakha amandla ezikhungeni ezihambisana nalokhu. Qapha ukusebenza nokuhambisana nemithetho. Yenza ukuhlola nokufunda ngemiphumela njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza ukusekelwa kuyo yonke imisebenzi, izinhlelo, kanye nendlela zokwenza zale ndaba. Bhala ulwazi nokuweluleka uma kukhulunywa ngeMPSA, iCabinet, iParliament kanye nabanye abathintekayo bangaphakathi nangaphandle.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ulawulo loBuchule boLwazi (ICT Governance)
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli: Ulawulo loBuchule boLwazi kwisebe leZabantu zikaRhulumente noMphathiswa kwindawo yokuhlala yasePretoria, kufuneka nesiqinisekiso seNQF Level 7 sokuchwetheza ulwazi lokunxibelelwana (ICT) kunye neminyaka eyisibhozo yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samatatu esiphezulu, isiqinisekiso esincinci singanga NQF Level 7 kwiNgcaca yolwazi lokunxibelelwana (ICT) njengokuqatshelwa yiSAQA. Amanqanaba angaphantsi kweminyaka eyisibhozo yamava kwindawo yolwazi lokunxibelelwana (ICT). Ulwazi ngomgaqo-siseko woRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika nolwazi ngenkqubo yomthetho karhulumente. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zomthetho nemigaqo yinkonzo zikarhulumente. Ulwazi lweenkqubo karhulumente ezinjengoNdulo lokuphuhliswa kweSizwe. Ulwazi ngamaphambili abalulekileyo oloyiso karhulumente. Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo ngolawulo bolwazi lokunxibelelwana (ICT) nokuqonda ngolawulo lwe-ICT. Ukuqonda ukumiselwa kolwazi lokunxibelelwana (ICT) nexesha lokuyisebenzisa. Ukuqonda iNqanaba leYakho. Ukuqonda ulawulo lokutshintsha olulawulwayo nokuqonda iindlela ezintsha zobuchule. Ukuhlalutya, ukuphuhlisa, ukuyisebenzisa nokuqonda ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zolwazi lokunxibelelwana (ICT), iindlela ezichaziweyo, iziganeko, iindlela ezilawulwayo, iinkqubo zolawulo iindlela ezahlukeneyo nezicwangciso. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukucwangcisa nokuqwalasela, ukulawula iqela, ulawulo lweemali, ulawulo lokuza kutshintsha, unxibelelwano nokuqwalasela, ulawulo babathinti nokuphucula iindlela zokuhamba kwenkonzo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi, ukwamkela urhulumente, umgangatho womsebenzi, ukuzinika isiqinisekiso, ukuzimisela, ukuqonda ubuhlobo, ukucwangcisa nokuyisebenzisa, ukwazisa, ukuziphatha ngokwezibhalo, ukuzigqatsa, ukuguquguquka, ukuzigcina, ukubonisa noku bhala iiripothi.
xh.duties: Ukuphuhlisa nokuyisebenzisa iziqendu ngeelawulo zeBuchule boLwazi (ICT Governance). Ukwenza uphando ngokuphuhliswa kweziqu zolwazi lokunxibelelwana (ICT). Ukubonelela ngenkxaso yomsebenzi kumasebe. Uku bhala ukuhlolwa okanye iintseleko zolawulo lolwazi lokunxibelelwana ezweni. Ukubonelela ngenkxaso yobuchule nengcedi njengoko kufuneka. Ukubonelela ngokwakha amandla okwenza okanye ukwenza isiqendu sokuphuhliswa kweenkqubo zokwakha amandla ziindlanga. Ukujonga ukuyiswa kwenkqubo nokulawuleka. Ukuhlalutya ukusebenza nokuqonda iziphumo njengoko kufuneka. Ukubonelela ngenkxazo kuzo zonke iinkqubo, iindlela nezicwangciso kule ndlu. Uku bhala intsingisano nengcedi kwiMPSA, iKhabhinethi, iPalamente nabalawuli bangaphakathi nangaphandle.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Administrative Officer (MR-6)
jobs.department: Department of Public Service and Administration
jobs.salary_text: R610 434 – R1 442 451 per annum, (Salary will be in accordance with OSD determination).
jobs.summary: Provide professional legal support, draft public administration legislation, and advise the Department and Ministry on legislative processes.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF Level 7 in law, a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) or a Bachelor of Procurationis (B Proc) as recognised by SAQA, at least 8 years’ of appropriate post-qualification legal experience. Good knowledge of the South African legal system and a good understanding of legislative processes. Ability to draft legislation, conduct legal research, and work independently. Good interpersonal, problem-solving, and dispute resolution skills. Computer Literacy. Sound knowledge of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, Public Service Act, Public Administration Management Act, and Public Finance Management Act is required. Good communication and writing skills, willingness to travel is essential. Knowledge of public service legislative and policy frameworks.
jobs.duties: To provide professional legal support and advice to the Department and Ministry. Drafting and scrutiny of public administration legislation. Provide guidance to the Department of Public Service and Administration in respect of legislative processes and participate in policy processes requiring reflection or entrenchment in legislation. Draft bills where drafting capacity does not exist elsewhere in the DPSA. Provide written or oral legal opinions on legislative matters pertaining to existing public administration related to legislative. Comment on draft legislation relating to the public administration. Provide oversight in respect of technical quality, adherence to best practice, and consistency with the constitution and other primary legislation of the DPSA. Review legislation administered by the Minister for the Public Service and Administration. Supervise and support the Legal Administration officer.
jobs.enquiries: Adv. Mmasetshaba Matlou Tel No: (012) 336 1638
jobs.applications: E-mail your application to Advert152026@dpsa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must quote the relevant reference number and consist of: A fully completed and signed NEW Z83 form which can be downloaded at https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/.’’From 1 January 2021 should an application be received using the incorrect application for employment (Z83), it will not be considered”, a recent comprehensive CV; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated); Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed curriculum vitae (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents, all non- SA citizens must attach a copy of proof of permanent residence in South Africa on or before the day of the interviews). Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks on criminal records, citizenship verification, financial records, qualification verification and applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Senior Regsadministratiewe Beampte (MR-6)
af.summary: Verskaf professionele regssteun, stel openbare administrasie-wetgewing op, en gee advies aan die Department en Ministerie oor wetgewende prosesse.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 in die regte, 'n Bachelor of Laws (LLB) of 'n Bachelor of Procurationis (B Proc) soos deur SAQA erken, ten minste 8 jaar se toepaslike postkwalifikasieregsonderwinding. Goeie kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse regstelsel en 'n goeie begrip van wetgewende prosesse. Vermoë om wetgewing op te stel, regsnavering te doen en onafhanklik te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike, probleemoplossende en geskilbeslegtingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Deeglike kennis van die Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, Public Service Act, Public Administration Management Act en Public Finance Management Act word vereis. Goeie kommunikasie- en skryfvaardighede; bereidwilligheid om te reis is noodsaaklik. Kennis van openbare diens-wetgewende en beleidsraamwerke.
af.duties: Om professionele regssteun en advies aan die Department en Ministerie te verskaf. Opstel en ondersoek van openbare administrasie-wetgewing. Verskaf leiding aan die Department of Public Service and Administration ten opsigte van wetgewende prosesse en neem deel aan beleidsprosesse wat oorweging of vaslegging in wetgewing vereis. Stel wetsontwerpe op waar opstelkapasiteit nie elders in die DPSA bestaan nie. Verskaf skriftelike of mondelinge regsmenings oor wetgewende aangeleenthede rakende bestaande openbare administrasie wat verband hou met wetgewing. Lewer kommentaar op konsepwetgewing rakende die openbare administrasie. Verskaf toezig ten opsigte van tegniese gehalte, nakoming van beste praktyke, en ooreenstemming met die grondwet en ander primêre wetgewing van die DPSA. Hersien wetgewing wat deur die Minister for the Public Service and Administration geadministreer word. Hertoets en ondersteun die Regsadministrasiebeampte.

zu.title: Ongceliwe Oluphakeme Wezomthetho Wokuphatha (MR-6)
zu.summary: Nika inkuseleko yomthetho yobungcweti, bhala umthetho wokuphatha kwabeziguqulele kubantu, futhi welule iMnyango neNgqungquthi mayelana nezinqubo zomthetho.
zu.requirements: Isthelo sokufunda esincanyelwe kusika ezingan lokuqonda 7 kumthetho, iBachelor of Laws (LLB) noma iBachelor of Procurationis (B Proc) njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA, okungenani eminyakeni engu-8 yokuhlukelela ngokusemthethweni ngemva kokuthola isithelo sokufunda. Ulwazi oluhle lwesimiso somthetho saseNingizimu Afrika kanye nozwelo oluhle lwezinqubo zomthetho. Ikono lokubhala umthetho, ukwenza ucwaningo lomthetho, nokusebenza zendela yakho. Amakhono ahle okuxhumanisa kwezabantu, ukusombulula izinkinga, nezokuxazulula iziphikiswano. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ngokwekhompyutha. Kuyadingeka ukuba ube nolwazi oluhle lweSikhatulo sokwakha iRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, iPromotion of Access to Information Act, iPromotion of Administrative Justice Act, iPublic Service Act, iPublic Administration Management Act, kanye nePublic Finance Management Act. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana nokubhala, ukuzithandela ukuzula kubaluleke kakhulu. Ulwazi lwezimiso zomthetho kanye nezinhlelo zohlelo ebe zisebenza emnyangweni wabasebenzi.
zu.duties: Ukubanika inkuseleko yomthetho yobungcweti kanye neluleko kwiMnyango naseNqunquthini. Ukubhala nokuhlolisiswa komthetho wokuphatha kubasebenzi bazwe. Ukubanika inkondzo eMnyangweni Wezaphakathi Zolwazi Nokuphatha kolawu lwabantu mayelana nezinqubo zomthetho nokubamba iqhaza kuzinqubo zohlelo ezidinga ukucabangisiswa noma ukuqiniswa emthethweni. Ukuhola amabhoso lapho ikono lokubhala lingekho khona kwezinye izindawo eDPSA. Ukubanika imibono yomthetho ebalayo noma evezwa ngomlomo mayelana nezindaba zomthetho ezibhekele kulawulo lwabantu abadlanga oluhlotshaniswa nomthetho. Ukuphawula ngomthetho osebhukwini mayelana nolawulo lwabantu. Ukuhlola nokugadwa kokuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, ukuhlonipha iziqu ezinhle, kanye nokuqondana kakhululana ngesimiso esisodwa nelinye kanye nomthetho omkhulu weDPSA. Ukubuyekeza umthetho ohlolwa yiNgqikazi noma iNgqongqothi mayelana namaphoyisa aphathwa esimeni sakwaZwe. Ukuba umholi osekela inkinobho eNtengo womthetho.

xh.title: Isikhulu Esiphakamileyo SoloMiso wezomthetho (MR-6)
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yomthetho yobuchwepheshe, qamba umthetho wolonulo lwikomikhulu, kwaye uncede ngeenkomphi kwiiNkqubo zomthetho zeSebe kunye neYunivesithi yeMpumaKoloni.
xh.requirements: Isigqeba esingaphantsi kwesiya kwiNqanaba le-7 kumthetho, iBachelori yoMthetho (LLB) okanye iBachelori yeProcurationis (B Proc) njengoko kugunyaziswa yi-SAQA, ubuncinane i-8 iminyaka yamava omthetho afanelekileyo emva kokuqokelelwa isigqeba. Ulwazi olululu lenkqubo yomthetho yaseMzantsi Afrika nokuqonda okululu kweenkqubo zomthetho. Ukuqamba umthetho, ukwenza uphando lomthetho, nokuzebenzela ngokuzimela. Amakhono amabalise aphilayo, okusombulula iingxaki, nokuqonda isisombululo sezixabaniso. Ukuzazi ukusebenzela ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olunzulu lweMithetho-siseko yoRiphabhlikhi yaseMzantsi Afrika, uMthetho woPhuculo lokuFikelela kuLwazi, uMthetho woPhuculo lwaBala-baLungileyo kuBambe lwaBantu, uMthetho weSebe loWiso-mthetho, uMthetho woLawulo lwakwaZimbini, noMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaLuntu yaye ulufunekayo. Amakhono amabalise okuthetha nokuwra, kwaye kukho kuyo nayiphi na imini yomgibelo.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkxaso yomthetho yobuchwepheshe kunye nenkumbuzo iSebe kunye neYunivesithi yeMpumaKoloni. Ukuqamba nokuphepha umthetho wolonulo lwikomikhulu. Ukunika inkqikelelo iSebe loWiso-mthetho kunye nokuLawula kubalulekileyo kwinkqubo zomthetho nathabatha inxaxheba kweenkqubo zamacebo ezifuna ukucatshulwa okanye ukuzinzisa kumthetho. Qamba amagazethi apho amandla okuqamba engabikho kwenye indawo kwiDPSA. Ukunika izalathiso zobuchwepheshe ezibhaliweyo okanye ezithethwayo ezimalunga nomthetho ohamba phambili kubalulekileyo ekubeni ngokusemthethweni.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Records Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Service and Administration
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09). Annual progression up to a maximum salary of R573 897 is possible, subject to satisfactory performance.
jobs.summary: An Assistant Director: Records Management position is available in Pretoria, involving the development and implementation of records management policies and procedures.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate, a minimum qualification at NQF Level 6 in Records Management / Information Management / Science / Knowledge Management / Public Management / Public Administration as recognised by SAQA. Minimum 2 years’ supervisory experience. A minimum of 3 years’ experience in a records management environment. Knowledge Section 13(5) of the National Archives and Records Service Act, 1996, as amended; Personal Information Protection Act (POPIA); Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS); proficiency in Electronic Records Management Systems (ERMS); knowledge of environmental practices; and knowledge of relevant statutory and regulatory frameworks governing records management. Attributes: professionalism, flexibility, resourcefulness, ability to work under stressful situations and pressure, trustworthiness, hard work, ability to work independently, teamwork and self-motivation. Generic skills: interpersonal skills, patience, problem- solving skills, analytical skills, administrative skills, organisational skills, meticulousness, planning and time management, influencing, managing performance, managing people, accuracy and attention to details, capability of prioritising, ability to maintain the integrity of information and computer literacy. Management Skills: Management skills, communication skills, decision-making skills, leadership skills, change management, project management, people management, policy analysis and development. Technical skills: Record management principles, contract management and a driver's licence.
jobs.duties: Develop, review, implement and monitor Records Management policies, guidelines and procedure manuals. Conduct research/benchmark on records management procedure manual, policies, and guidelines. Conduct awareness on approved records management policies and filing system. Provide reproduction, administer and safeguard documents. Supervise the rendering of Messenger services and Mailroom services. Monitor service level agreements of contracts. Compile quarterly contracts performance management report. Provide records classification, indexing services, records keeping systems and disposal programme. Maintain the approved filling system and records storage systems. Ensuring that all electronic records are managed according to the requirements of the National Archives and good governance. Provide support in all the Operational, Systems and Processes of the Directorate. Address all audit findings by the approved due dates.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Rekordbestuur
af.summary: 'n Assistentdirekteur: Rekordbestuur-pos is beskikbaar in Pretoria, wat die ontwikkeling en implementering van rekordbestuursbeleid en prosedures behels.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat, 'n minimum kwalifikasie op NQF Level 6 in Rekordbestuur / Inligtingbestuur / Wetenskap / Kennisbestuur / Openbare Bestuur / Openbare Administrasie soos erken deur SAQA. Minimum 2 jaar se toesigervaring. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n rekordbestuursomgewing. Kennis van Section 13(5) van die National Archives and Records Service Act, 1996, soos gewysig; Personal Information Protection Act (POPIA); Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS); vaardigheid in Electronic Records Management Systems (ERMS); kennis van omgewingspraktyke; en kennis van relevante statutêre en regulasieraamwerke wat rekordbestuur regeer. Attribute: professionalisme, buigsaamheid, vindingrykheid, vermoë om onder stresvolle situasies en druk te werk, betroubaarheid, harde werk, vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, spanwerk en selfmotivering. Generiese vaardighede: interpersoonlike vaardighede, geduld, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, administratiewe vaardighede, organisatoriese vaardighede, deeglikheid, beplanning en tydbestuur, beïnvloeding, prestasiebestuur, mensebestuur, akkuraatheid en aandag aan besonderhede, vermoë om prioriteite te stel, vermoë om die integriteit van inligting te handhaaf en rekenaarvaardigheid. Bestuursvaardighede: Bestuursvaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede, besluitnemingsvaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede, veranderingsbestuur, projekbestuur, mensebestuur, beleidsanalise en -ontwikkeling. Tegniese vaardighede: Rekordbestuursbeginsels, kontrakbestuur en 'n bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, hersien, implementeer en monitor Rekordbestuur-beleide, riglyne en prosedurehandleidings. Doen navorsing/benchmarking oor rekordbestuur-prosedurehandleiding, beleide en riglyne. Skep bewustheid rakende goedgekeurde rekordbestuur-beleide en liasseringstelsel. Verskaf reproduksie, administreer en beveilig dokumente. Hou toesig oor die lewer van boodskapperdienste en poskantdienste. Monitor diensvlakooreenkomste van kontrakte. Stel kwartaallikse kontrakprestasiebestuursverslag op. Verskaf rekordklassifikasie, indekseringsdienste, rekordbewaerstelsels en beskikingsprogramme. Onderhou die goedgekeurde liasseringstelsel en rekordbergingsstelsels. Verseker dat alle elektroniese rekorde bestuur word volgens die vereistes van die Nasionale Argief en goeie bestuur. Verskaf ondersteuning in al die Operasionele, Stelsel- en Prosesaspekte van die Direktoraat. Adresser alle ouditbevindings teen die goedgekeurde sperdatums.

zu.title: Ongezwayo: Abaqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kwezinkomba
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaOngezwayo: Abaqondisi: Ukuphathwa kwezinkomba sitholakala ePretoria, sihilela ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo nemicimile yokuphathwa kwezinkomba.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Samatungulu, ngesikhundla sokugcina kufanele wadinga noma iyiphi idiploma ezingeni elisha. Kubafundi abafuna imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezinkomba, kuyadingeka kutholakale noma iyiphi idiploma eNQF Level 6 ekuphathweni kwezinkomba / ekuphathweni kolwazi / ezezibalo / ekuphathweni kolwazi ngokwemvelo / ekuphathweni komphakathi / ekuphathweni kocingo. Lolu hlobo lwediploma kufanele ludunyiswe nguSAQA. Kubafundi abadinga imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezinkomba, kuyadingeka bakhombise ukuthi banamava amabili ekwenza iNQF Level 6. Kubafundi abadinga ukuba ngamabhodi abaphathi, kuyadingeka bafunde izidingo ezihlukene.
zu.duties: Hlolisisa izinqubomgomo, izeluleko kanye nezincwadi ezibeka izinqubo zokuphathwa kwezinkomba, ukuze uzibe ukuthi ziyasebenza yini na. Zama ukuthola izinto ezintsha ngokwenza ucwaningo mayelana nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezinkomba. Yenza imiphakathi yezinto ezintsha ngokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo ezinhle zokuphathwa kwezinkomba. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaphoyisa ezinkomba abhalwe ngendlela efanelekile. Zama ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo ezinhle mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinkomba ezibhangezwe umnyango.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Ukulawula iSazizi
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedisi wenkulumbuso ekulawuleni izazizi sifumaneka ePretoria, siquka uphuhliso nokuqhayisisa iinkqubo zemigaqo yoncedo kunye neendlela zokulawula izazizi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethwe samabanga aphakamileyo, isigqibo esincinci kwinqanaba le-NQF Level 6 ekulawuleni izazizi / ekulawulweni kolwazi / eZenzululwazini / ekulawulweni kolwazi oluchanekileyo / ekulawulweni kaWonke-wonke / ekulawulweni lokuphathwa kweentlangano karhulumende njengakuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Amava amabini angenazantsi okuba ngumlawuli. Amava amathathu angenazantsi kwendawo yokulawula izazizi. Ulwazi malunga Candu 13(5) lomthetho weNational Archives and Records Service Act, 1996, njengoko ulungisiwe; umthetho wePersonal Information Protection Act (POPIA); i Minimum Information Security Standards (MISS); ukuziphatha kwezobuchwepheshe kwiinkqubo zokulawula izazizi ngekhompyutha (ERMS); ulwazi ngamalungele obuhlengwa; nolwazi ngeenkqubo zemithetho nolawulo oluhambelana nokulawula izazizi. Iimpawu: ubungcali, ukuguquguquka, ukukwazi ukuzoba izibonelelo, ikhamelo lokusebenza phantsi kweemeko ezinxulumene nengxaki nengcinezelo, ukwethenjwa, ukusebenza nzima, ikhamelo lokusebenza kodwa, ukusebenza ngokubutho nokuziqhayisa. Amandla angabazali: amandla okusebenza nabantu, ukuzinikela, amandla okusombulula iingxaki, amandla oyanzulwazi, amandla okulawula izicwangciso, amandla ezenza ubume obuhle, ukucokiseka, ukucwangcisa nokulawula ixesha, ukunika isithuthi, ukulawula ukusebenza, ukulawula abantu, ukumiselwa nolondolozo lweminutswana, amandla okulinganisa okuphambili, ikhamelo lokugcina uchunge oluchanekileyo lolwazi nolwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Amandla okulawula: amandla okulawula, amandla okuthetha, amandla okwenza izigqibo, amandla okukhokela, ukulawula utshintsho, ukulawula iiprojekthi, ukulawula abantu, uhlalutyo nokuphuhliswa kwemigaqo. Amandla ezenz Luzulu: iinkqubo zokulawula izazizi, ukulawula iinkontrakhthi nelayisensi yokushayela.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa, phinda uqhayise, qhayisa uze ulawule imigaqo yokulawula izazizi, iinkqubo zokuthathwa kwemigaqo kunye nezikhokelo. Yenza ucando lwamathuba okulinganisa iinkqubo zokulawula izazizi, iinkqubo zokuthathwa kwemigaqo, kunye neenkqubo zokwamkela imigaqo. Yaza malunga nokwamkelwa kwemigaqo yokulawula izazizi yamkelekileyo nendlula yokubeka iifayile. Zisa inkonzo yokuphindaphinda nokuze ulawule ugcino lwamaxwebhu. Lawula ukuhlinzwa ngabathunywa beb xa kunokubakho iinkonzo nendlula yeposi. Lawula iinkonzo zelayisensi ngeenkontrakhthi. Hlaziya iveza ngenyanga yexesha yoxela ngokusebenza ngokulawulwa kweenkontrakhthi. Zisa inkonzo yokuhluza izazizi, ukumisela iinkonzo, iinkqubo zokugcina izazizi noxolelo lokwenza iinkonzo. Gcina indlu yokubeka iifayile yamkelekileyo nendlula yokugcina iinkqubo zesazizi. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke izazizi zamakhalikhwekha zilawulwa ngokuthobela imfuno yenkulumbuso ye-National Archives engazima. Zisa inkxaso kuzo zonke iinkqubo, iindlela, iinkqubo noseto. Phatha zonke iinkcukacha ngokulandwa kwesikripthi kuqatshelwe amaxesha alungelelanen.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Public Administration Ethics, Integrity
jobs.department: Department of Public Service and Administration
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09). Annual progression up to a maximum salary of R573 897 per annum is possible, subject to satisfactory performance.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director supporting ethics and integrity management prescripts development within the Department of Public Service and Administration in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF Level 6 in Public Administration / Public Management / Law / LLB as recognised by SAQA and Ethics Officer Certification. A minimum of 5 years’ experience in the field of ethics management / monitoring / compliance environments. Government legislative framework, public service legislative and policy framework, government programs such as the National Development Plan, and key strategic priorities of government. Attributes: honesty, ethics, sensitivity, professionalism, reliability, loyalty, confidentiality, and diligence. Open to new ideas, innovative, able to make sound judgements based on legal grounding and able to communicate advice with authority. Ability to communicate effectively on highly sensitive issues with employees and managers at all levels, with particular emphasis on developing trust and demonstrating fairness. Interpersonal relations skills, team player Generic skills: Client orientation and customer focus, problem-solving, decision-making, written and verbal communication and information management, interpersonal facilitation, negotiation, presentation, report writing, computer literacy (at least Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel), and project management. Technical skills: data analytics, organisational skills, policy analysis and development, and research skills.
jobs.duties: Support the development of ethics, integrity & conduct management prescripts. Conduct research to support the drafting of Public Administration Ethics, Integrity & Conduct Management prescripts (policies, norms and standards, directives, circulars, frameworks, and guidelines). Draft of Public Administration Ethics, Integrity & Conduct Management prescripts (policies, norms and standards, directives, circulars, frameworks, and guidelines). Conduct pilots as part of the development of the prescripts, if required. Submit/communicate approved prescripts to departments for implementation. Provide implementation support to the departments. Requests for approval of requests and responses to inquiries are processed to the relevant approval authority within the unit and DPSA. Provide technical support and advise as required. Provide capacity building and make/contribute to the development of capacity development programs by the relevant institutions. Design advocacy programs to promote ethics in public administration. Monitor compliance with ethics, integrity & conduct management prescripts. Draft and maintain systems (e.g., collection and analysis of data) to monitor compliance. Assist in conducting evaluation and impact studies by implementing the approved instrument. Provide support in all the operations, systems, and processes of the directorate. Support systems for the effective and efficient functioning of the Directorate. Complete and submit inputs in the directorate budget by the stipulated due dates. Contribute to the effective and efficient management of the budget. Make inputs to audit findings by the approved due dates.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Openbare Administrasie Etiek, Integriteit
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur wat die ontwikkeling van voorskifte vir die bestuur van etiek en integriteit binne die Department of Public Service and Administration in Pretoria ondersteun.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum kwalifikasie op NQF Level 6 in Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur / Regte / LLB soos deur SAQA erken, en Sertifikasie as Etiekbeampte. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring in die veld van etiekbestuur / monitering / nakomingsomgewings. Regeringswetgewende raamwerk, openbare diens wetgewende en beleidsraamwerk, regeringsprogramme soos die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, en sleutel strategiese prioriteite van die regering._Attributes: eerlikheid, etiek, sensitiwiteit, profesionaliteit, betroubaarheid, lojaliteit, vertroulikheid en ywer. Ontvanklik vir nuwe idees, innoverend, in staat om goeie oordeel op grond van regsgrondslag te lewer en in staat om advies met gesag te kommunikeer. Vermoë om doeltreffend oor hoogs sensitiewe kwessies met werknemers en bestuurders op alle vlakke te kommunikeer, met spesifieke klem op die opbou van vertroue en die toon van billikheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede, spanspeler Generiese vaardighede: Kliëntgerigtheid en klike-fokus, probleemoplossing, besluitneming, skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie en inligtingsbestuur, interpersoonlike fasilitering, onderhandeling, aanbieding, verslagskrywing, rekenaarvaardigheid (ten minste Microsoft Word, PowerPoint en Excel), en projekbestuur. Tegniese vaardighede: data-analise, organisatoriese vaardighede, beleidsanalise en -ontwikkeling, en navorsingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Ondersteun die ontwikkeling van voorskifte vir die bestuur van etiek, integriteit en gedrag. Doen navorsing om die opstel van voorskifte vir die bestuur van openbare administrasie etiek, integriteit en gedrag (beleide, norme en standaarde, direktiewe, sirkulieres, raamwerke en riglyne) te ondersteun. Opstel van voorskifte vir die bestuur van openbare administrasie etiek, integriteit en gedrag (beleide, norme en standaarde, direktiewe, sirkulieres, raamwerke en riglyne). Voer loodsprojekte uit as deel van die ontwikkeling van die voorskifte, indien vereis. Dien goedkeurde voorskifte by departemente vir implementering in / kommunikeer dit na departemente vir implementering. Verskaf implementeringsondersteuning aan die departemente. Versoeke om goedkeuring van versoeke en reaksies op navrae word verwerk na die tersaaklike goedkeuringsgesag binne die eenheid en DPSA. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning en advies soos vereis. Verskaf kapasiteitsopbou en dra by tot die ontwikkeling van kapasiteitsontwikkelingsprogramme deur die tersaaklike instellings. Ontwerp voorligtingsprogramme om etiek in openbare administrasie te bevorder. Monitor nakoming van voorskifte vir die bestuur van etiek, integriteit en gedrag. Stel stelsels op en onderhou dit (bv. versameling en ontleding van data) om nakoming te monitor. Bystand verleen met die uitvoer van evaluasie- en impakstudies deur die goedgekeurde instrument te implementeer. Verskaf ondersteuning in al die bedrywighede, stelsels en prosesse van die direktoraat. Ondersteun stelsels vir die effektiewe en doeltreffende funksionering van die Direktoraat. Voltooi en dien insette vir die direktoraat se begroting teen die voorgeskrewe sperdatums in. Dra by tot die effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van die begroting. Lewer insette tot ouditbevindings teen die goedgekeurde sperdatums.

zu.title: Onozindi Osizo: Izokuhloniphekileko Nobuzothando Komphathi Woluleko
zu.summary: Onozindi Osizo osekela ukuthuthukiswa kwemithetho yokuphatha izokuhloniphekileko nobuzothando ngaphakathi koMnyango Wesebenzi Kazwelonke Nokuphatha ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesibalo seNQF Level 6 kuzeinthulo Yoluleko Kazwolonke / Ukuphatha Kwoluleko Kazwolonke / Umthetho / LLB njengokuqashelwa yiSAQA kanye Nesitifikathi SoMphathi Wezokuhloniphekileko. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yohlu lolunzulu ekuphathweni kwezokuhloniphekileko / ukubheka / ukuziphendulela kwemibandela. Uhlaka lomthetho kahulumeni, uhlaka lomthetho nemigomo yesebenzi kazwelonke, izinhlelo kahulumeni ezifana neNational Development Plan, kanye nezindlululo eziyisidingo sokuhleleka kahulumeni. Izici: ukuqiniseka, izokuhloniphekileko, ukuzwa izinkinga zabanye, ukuzithiba ngobungcweti, ukuthembeka, ukuzinikela, ukugcina imfihlo, kanye nokwenza umsebenzi ngokuzifaka inzima. Ukwamukela imibono entsha, ukuba nomqondo omutsha, ukwenza izinqumo ezihle ngesisekelo somthetho, kanye nokukwazi ukuchaza izeluleko ngenkokhobeli. Ikhono lokuchaza ngokusebenzayo ngemicimbi ehlobene kakhulu nemfihlo nabasebenzi nabaphathi ezingeni ngalinye, ngokugqamisa ukwakha ithemba kanye nokubonisa ubulungiswa. Ikhono lokuxhumana nabantu, ukusebenza ngokuqoqa. Izikhondo ezivamile: Ukuqondiswa kubathengi nokugxila kubakhokhelwa, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukubhala nokukhuluma ukuze kuqedulule ulwazi nokuphathwa kolwazi, ukulawula ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu, ukuxoxisana, ukuhola, ukubhala umbiko, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (okungenani iMicrosoft Word, PowerPoint kanye neExcel), nokuphatha izinhlelo. Izikhondo zobungcweti: ukuhlaziya idatha, ukuhleleka kwentokozo, ukuhlaziya kanye nokuthuthukisa imigomo, kanye nezikhondo zocwaningo.
zu.duties: Sekela ukuthuthukiswa kwemithetho yokuphatha izokuhloniphekileko, ubuzothando nomuzwa. Yenza ucwaningo ukuze usekele ukubhalwa kwemithetho yokuphatha Izokuhloniphekileko, Ubuzothando kanye Nomuzwa Woluleko Kazwelonke (imigomo, izilinganiso, imiyalo, izaziso, izakhiwo, kanye neziqondiso). Bhala imithetho yokuphatha Izokuhloniphekileko, Ubuzothando kanye Nomuzwa Woluleko Kazwelonke (imigomo, izilinganiso, imiyalo, izaziso, izakhiwo, kanye neziqondiso). Yenza ukuhlolwa kokuzama njengengxenye yalokho ukuthuthukiswa kwemithetho, uma kudingeka. Thumela/chaza imithetho evunyiwe kumimnyango ukuze isetshenziswe. Nikeza inkxaso yokuqashele kumimnyango. Izicelo zokuqinisekiswa kwezicelo kanye nempendulo emibuzweni zibhalwa esikhundleni esifanele sokuqinisekisa ngaphakathi kwesebe naseDPSA. Nikeza inkxaso yobungcweti kanye nencekelo uma kudingwa. Nikeza inkxaso yokwakha amandla kanye nokwenza/ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo zokwakha amandla ezikhungweni ezifanele. Hlela izinhlelo zokusasaza ulwazi ukuze kusasaze izokuhloniphekileko kululeko kazwelonke. Bheka ukuziphendulela kwemigomo yokuphatha izokuhloniphekileko, ubuzothando nomuzwa. Bhala kanye nogcine izindlela ezisesichengeni nengqondo (isb, ukuqoqa ukuhlaziya idatha) ukuze uqaphele ukuziphendulela. Siza ekuhlolweni kanye nophenyo lwemiphumela ngokusebenzisa isixhobo esivunyiwe. Nikeza inkxaso kuzo zonke izinto ezenziwayo, izindlela, kanye nenqubo yoluleko. Sekela izindlela zokusebenza kahle futhi ngempumelelo koluleko. Qedela futhi uthumela izinkomba esebhelini mali yohlelo ngosuku obekiwe. Faka isandla ekuphathweni okusebenzayo futhi okuhle kakhulu kweshebhuli mali. Yizinkonzo ezibhalwayo kumiphumela yokuhlola ngosuku obekiwe.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Izobunyulu kwiZokulawula iRhulumente, Ukuzinikela
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso onceda ekwenzeni izalathiso ezithintela ubuqhophololo nokuzinikela ngaphakathi kwisebe leZonzululwazi noLawulo koRhulumente ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezincinci ezikwiNQF Level 6 kwiZokulawula iRhulumente / uLawulo lweRhulumente / iZomthetho / i-LLB njengoko evunywa yi-SAQA nesiQinisekiso sikaMphathiswa weZobuqhophololo. Amava amncinci eminyaka eli-5 kwikhondo lolawulo lobuqhophololo / ukuqapha / ukwamkelwa kweenkqubo zokuziphatha. Ulwazi lomthetho karhulumente, inkqubo yomthetho nangomgama wesebe lolawulo lwez Rhulumente, iinkqubo zikarhulumente ezinjengoQelele ngokuLula nokuQumba isiQongo, nemiqondiso ephambili yokulawula kurhulumente. Iimpawu: inyaniso, izobuqhophololo, ukuzipatha kahle ngokuzimisela, ukuthembeka, ukuzinikela, ukugcina iimfihlo, nokuqwalasela konke okwenziwayo. Ukuvulekile kwiingcinga ezintsha, ukuba nobuchule obutsha, ukwazi ukwenza izigqibo ezinzima ngesiseko somthetho nokwazi ukubikelela ngelizwi elinamandla. Ikhono lokunceda ngokuchanekileyo kumaphupha amnandi kakhulu kubasebenzi nabalawuli kuzo zonke iinqanaba, ngokuzimisela ekwakheni ithembá nokubonisa ukulunga. Ikhono lokuhlobana nabantu, ukubamba iqhaza kw iqela Ikhono eliqhelekileyo: Ukwakheka koluntu kumthengi nokuqwalasela iimfuno zomthengi, ukuzalisa iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo, ukubhala nokuvelisa ulwazi, ukubhekana nabantu, ukubalandela, ukunikezela ngezinto, ukubhala iingxelo, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (okungenani iMicrosoft Word, iPowerPoint ne-Excel), noLawulo lweProje. Ikhono lobufundi: ukuhlalutya iidata, ulwazi lokuhamba kwishishini, ukuhlalutya nokwenza umgama, nolwazi lokuphanda.
xh.duties: Uncedo ekwenzeni izalathiso ezithintela ubuqhophololo, ukuzinikela nokuziphatha. Ukwenza uphando ukuze kuqedwe izalathiso ezithintela izobuqhophololo, ukuzinikela nokuziphatha kolawulo lweRhulumente (iingcamango, imilinganiselo nemiqathango, izalathiso, izaziso, iinkqubo, neendlela ezilawulayo). Ukubhala izalathiso ezithintela izobuqhophololo, ukuzinikela nokuziphatha kolawulo lweRhulumente (iingcamango, imilinganiselo nemiqathango, izalathiso, izaziso, iinkqubo, neendlela ezilawulayo). Ukwenza izicwangciso zemveliso ekuqalisweni kwezalathiso, ukuba kuyimfuneko. Ukuhambisa/kuqulunqwe izalathiso ezamkelwe kumasebe ukuze zisetyenziswe. Ukunika inkxaso ekuqhubeni amasebe. Iimfuno zokuqinisekisa iimfuno nemiimpendulo kwimibuzo zicutshungulwa kumagunya okuqinisekisa afanelekileyo ngaphakathi kweyuniti naseDPSA. Ukunika inkxaso yobufundi nokubikelela njengoko kufuneka. Ukunika inkxaso ekwakheni amandla nokwenza/ukubambelela ekwakheni iinkqubo zokuphucula amandla eendawo ezifanelekileyo. Ukuyila iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ukuthethwa kwezobuqhophololo kulawulo lweRhulumente. Ukuqapha ukwamkelwa kwezalathiso ezithintela izobuqhophololo, ukuzinikela nokuziphatha. Ukubhala nokuqhuba iinkqubo (umz., ukuqokelela nokuhlalutya idatha) ukuze kuqatshwe ukwamkelwa. Uncedo ekwenzeni uqeqesho nophando ngokuqhuba isixhobo esamkelwe. Ukunika inkxaso kuzo zonke iinkqubo, iinkqubo, nenkqubo yolawulo. Inkxaso kweendlela ezisebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo kwilowulo. Ukugqiba nokuhambisa izimvo kwisigqibo sewolo ngosuku olumisiweyo. Ukubambelela ekulawuleni ngenkqubo ekhanya ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukwenza izimvo ngokusetyenziswa iziphumo njengosuku olumisiweyo.

Kennis van die Government Employees Housing Scheme en sy produktoebied, kennis van openbare diensadministrasie, kennis van die Batho Pele-beginsel, kennis van Diensvoorwaardes, kennis van die Public Service Act en kennis van Public Service Regulations. Generiese vaardighede: Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, fasiliteringsvaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, rekenaarvaardighede, kliëntgerigtheid, konflikbestuur, interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, probleemoplossing, en oplossingsgerig en innoverend. Attribute: Goeie telefoonetiket, vindingryk, veerkragtig en buigsaam, professioneel, selfversekerd, passievol en 'n spanwerker. Tegniese vaardighede: Klantsorg- en bemarkingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf kapasiteitsbou en ondersteuning aan regeringsdepartemente en werknemers rakende GEHS-dienste en -produkte. Reageer op kliëntnavrae, klagtes en geskille oor GEHS-produkte en -dienste. Verskaf leiding en bystand aan regeringsdepartemente en werknemers om navrae, klagtes en geskille rakende huisvestingstoelaag-voordele te besleg. Help regeringswerknemers met die proses om by die GEHS in te skryf. Hanteer inkomende oproepe en e-posse van regeringswerknemers en verwys tersaaklike navrae na die toepaslike amptenare. zu.title: Inkulu Yekhaya Labasebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokusekela i-Government Employees Housing Scheme esigabeni 06 e-Pretoria, siphendula imibuzo futhi sinike amaphili abomnyango.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esiphezulu, ngaphezu kwalokho kudingeka ubuderebe obungaphansi kwesigaba 4 ekusekeleni abakhulumyi / ekudayisweni / ekuxhumeni / ekuphathweni kwabasebenzi njengoba kuqashelwa ngu-SAQA. Kubalulekile ukwazi i-Government Employees Housing Scheme nezinhlobo zemikhiqizo yayo, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuphathwa kohlangothi lomphakathi, ukwazi isimiso se-Batho Pele, ukwazi izimo zokusebenza, ukwazi umthetho wasezikhungweni zomphakathi kanye nokwazi imitheshwana yamaphoyisa omphakathi. Amakhono awo wonke: amakhono okubhaliweyo nokuKHULUMA, amakhono okuhola ingqungquthela, amakhono okwakhiwa isibonelo, amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuhlela imiklamo, amakhono ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha, ukukhathalela amakhasimende, ukuphatha ukungabonani, amakhono okuzwana nabantu, amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuqondiswa ezixazululweni futhi nokubumba izinto ezintsha. Izinto ezingaguquguquki: Ukukhuluma kahle ngomakhalekhukhwini, ukuba nobuchule bokusebenza, ukuqina ukuzinza, ukuguquguquka, ukuba ngumuntu ochotshozwayo, ukuzethemba, ukuba nomoya onzima nokuba yingxenye yeqembu. Amakhono abuchwepheshe: amakhono ekusekeleni abakhasimende kanye noku dayiswa.
zu.duties: Nika amaphili kanye nokuXhasa amaphoyisa ohlangothini lomphakathi kubasebenzi mayelana namaphili namaphrodyusa e-GEHS. Phendula imibuzo yamakhasimende, izikhalazo kanye nezingxabano mayelana namaphrodyusa namaphili e-GEHS. Nikeza inkombandlela nolwesizo emaphoyisa ohlangothini lomphakathi kubasebenzi ukuxazulula imibuzo, izikhalazo nezingxabano ezihlotshaniswa nezinzuzo zensiza yokuhlala. Siza abasebenzi bomphakathi inqubo yokubhalisa e-GEHS. Xazulula izingcingo ezifakwayo namaimilli ezivela kubasebenzi bomphakathi futhi uthumela imibuzo ehlobene kubasebenzi abahlobene. Nikeza amaphili emaphoyisa ohlangothini lomphakathi ngokusebenzisa izifundo ezifundisa i-GEHS kanye namaphili okungenwa endaweni yakithi. Lungiselela amaphojekthi izifundo e-GEHS kanye namaphili okungenwa endaweni yakithi. Nikeza ulwesiko ekwakhiweni kokuqinisekisa i-GEHS kanye namaphilana oku dayiswa futhi uvuselele iwebhusayithi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi woBomi beNkcIAR
xh.summary: Isithuba sokusingathwa kwabathengi somsebenzi wokubakho kwabasebenzi karhulumente ngomvuzo wamazwe aseburhulumentene kwindawo yokudibanisa ulwazi ngabathengi kunye nokuPhathwa kwabaThengi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu, nengeno mfuno ezingeni le-NQF Level 4 kwindawo yokuPhathwa kwabaThengi /okuYila izimemarkethe /kuVakalayo ulwazi /kuLawulwa uBuntu /kuLawulwa iziCwangciso zokuSebenza njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Ukuqonda i-Government Employees Housing Scheme nangokubakho kolwazi ngayo nangokubakho kolwazi kwinkqubo karhulumente yaseburhulumenteni, ukuqonda iimvisiswano zikaBatho Pele, ukuqonda iimfuno zoBomi beNkonzo karhulumente, kunye noBomi beNkonzo karhulumente, ukuqonda iNkqubo yezaBantu kunye noLawulo lweNkqubo yezaBalu karhulumente. Iimfuno: Ikhono lokubhala nokuthetha, ukukwazi ukuzisa abantu kwisikhundla esithile, ukukwazi ukubonisa, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela imisebenzi, ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, ukujongana nabathengi, ukulawula iingxabano, ukuphathwa kobudlelwane nakunye neenkxaso eziyimfuno kubantu abafundayo.
xh.duties: Nika izikhokelo kwaye uxhase amasebe karhulumente nabasebenzi ngemisebenzi nephakamiso le-GEHS. Phendula kwimibuzo, iingxaki kunye neentabiselo zabathengi malunga nephakamiso nemisebenzi ye-GEHS. Nikela ngenkqubo yemisebenzi kubasebenzi karhulumente nasebesikweni kwindlela yokuqeshwa kwi-GEHS. Nika inkxaso malunga nemitaro yamasebe karhulumente ngamasebe karhulumente kwindawo ekhoyo yokuqhuba i-GEHS. Xhobisa abantu abanezifundo nabasebenzi karhulumente, abaye banikwe isikhundla sokuba bangabasebenzi karhulumente. Funda kwaye ubeke iya kwindlela ekhoyo kunye nendlela ekhoyo kubasebenzi karhulumente. Vula iziko ekhoyo kumasebe karhulumente kwindlela ekhoyo kunye nokulungelelanisa amaqela e-GEHS kubasebenzi karhulumente. Xhobisa umsebenzi wokulungelelanisa iinkxaso kwindlela yokubakho kobuchwepheshe ekhoyo kwaye usasaze ulwazi olumandla ngelungelo lokubakho kobuchwepheshe ekhoyo.

zu.summary: Nika inkxaso yalawo msebenzi ejwayelekile kokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo, uphathwe yinkomisho, ukuqoshwa kwemininingwane, imibuzo evamile, kanye nokuphathwa kwenani lezinsiza Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isitifikeda Samatasa noma iziqu ezingaphansi kwe-NQF Level 4 njengoba sivunyelwe yi-SAQA. Akukho mkhuleko wangaphambili odingekayo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomclerki, izindlela kanye nokuqoqa nokubamba izibalo, ulwazi neqondo ngohlaka lolawulo oluholwa umnyango wezabhiliki kanye nolwazi lwezinqubo zokusebenza ngokusebenzisa imizi yesebenza. Amandla ajwayelekile: Amandla ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, ukuguquguquka nokubamba iqembu. Amandla obuchwepheshe (ezikhalazo): Ukwelula uhlelo nenhlelo, ulimi kanye nokuqonda okuhle kokukhuluma nokubhala. Izinto ezingaphandle: Ukuhlaziya, ukuthatha isinyathelo, ukuvuleka futhi kucace.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yalawo msebenzi yomclerki. Qopha, hlela, gcina, bamba futhi ulande inkomisho nemininingwane. Phatha imibuzo evamile, thayipha izincwadi, futhi uhlele amaminisi nezinye izincwadi ze-Directorate. Nikeza isikhungo senani lezinsiza. Inkxaso yomclerki kuleyo ngxenye. Buyekeza futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lezimpahla zaleyo ngxenye. Lawula izitoki zezinto zehhovisi. Gcina irekhodi lezikhathi zokuhamba zaleyo ngxenye. Nikeza inkxaso yomclerki yolawulo babantu kuleyo ngxenye futhi nikeze inkxaso yolawulo bezimali kuleyo ngxenye.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu okanye isidanga esingaphantsi kwe-NQF Level 4 njengoko samkelwe yi-SAQA. Akukho mfundo yangaphambili idingekayo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yee-khalaba, iinkqubo kwaye nako ukubamba nokuthatha iibhetshana, Ulwazi nakuqonda kwesiseko sezomthetho esilawula inkonzo kaRhulumente nolwazi lweenkqubo zokusebenza ngokomthetho wesikhululo somsebenzi. Amakhono ajikelezayo: Amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuhlobana nabantu, Ukuguquguquka noBumbano. Amakhono obuchwepheshe (obuchaza): Ukuqamba nokuhlela, ulwimi nolwimi oluhle lokunxibelelwana ngomlomo nolubhaliweyo. Iimpawu: Ukuhlalutya, Ukuzimisela, Ukwamkeleka nokubonakala.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo eziphakamileyo zoluncedo lweekhalaba. Qamba, hlela, gcina, batya iingxelo kwaye uhlaze iimemo nedayitha. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo, thayipha iileta, kwaye ulungelelanise amaminithi nantoni na enye i-memo yoMmandla. Bonezela izinto zokusetyenziswa ekubeni kwenzeke inkqubo. Iinkonzo zoluncedo lweekhalaba ngaphakathi kwecandelo. Hlaziya kwaye ugcine irejista yeempahla zecandelo. Lawula izinto zophahla zofiso. Gcina irejista yokuhamba kwabasebenzi yecandelo. Nikezela ngoluncedo lweekhalaba lolawulo lwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwecandelo kwaye unikeze ngoluncedo lolawulo lwezemali ngaphakathi kwecandelo.

jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R610 434 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package)
jobs.summary: Senior legal administration officer needed to manage legal advisory, litigation and contract vetting services for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of four-year degree (LLB) with at least 8 years appropriate post- qualification legal experience or 8 years’ experience as an in-house legal advisor or legal/contract administrator, Willingness to travel on an ad hoc basis and adapt to a work schedule in accordance with professional requirements, A valid driver’s licence. Admission as attorney or Advocate of the high court and supervisory/management experience will be an added advantage. Knowledge: Specialized knowledge of law of contracts, general administration of contracts and litigation within an organizational context, Legal research and professional legal assistance, In-depth knowledge of the Framework for Supply Chain Management [Regulations in terms of the Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (Act No. 1 of 1999) (PFMA)], Code of Conduct for Supply Chain Management Practitioners, the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, the Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, 2000 (Act No. 5 of 2000), the State Information Technology Agency Act, 1998 (Act No. 88 of 1998), the Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No. 103 of 1994), Public Service Regulations and other relevant legislation. Management of the legal advisory services on the drafting, vetting and amendment of contracts. Oversee the exploration of efficiency measures introduced. Provide general legal opinions to line function. Liaise with the office of the state attorney and consult, provide instructions, facilitate the compilation of documents in litigation cases. Consult with line function and take instructions. Management of litigation and debt files. Attend to PAIA and PAJA requests from line function.

af.title: Senior Regsadministratiewe Beampte: Regs- en Kontrakte
af.summary: Senior regsadministratiewe beampte benodig om regsadvies-, litigasie- en kontrakontloteerdienste vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n vierjaar graad (LLB) met ten minste 8 jaar toepaslike post-kwalifikasie regservaring of 8 jaar ervaring as 'n interne regsadviseur of regs-/kontrakadministrateur. Bereidwilligheid om op 'n ad hoc-basis te reis en aan te pas by 'n werkskedule ooreenkomstig professionele vereistes. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Toelating as prokureur of Advokaat van die hooggeregshof en toesigtige/ bestuurservaring sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis: Gespesialiseerde kennis van kontraktereg, algemene administrasie van kontrakte en litigasie binne 'n organisatoriese konteks. Regsnavorsing en professionele regshulp. Diepgaande kennis van die Raamwerk vir Voorsieningskettingbestuur [Regulasies ingevolge die Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (Act No. 1 of 1999) (PFMA)], Gedragskode vir Voorsieningskettingbestuurpraktisyns, die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, die Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, 2000 (Act No. 5 of 2000), die State Information Technology Agency Act, 1998 (Act No. 88 of 1998), die Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No. 103 of 1994), Public Service Regulations en ander tersaaklike wetgewing. Vaardighede: Deeglike en bewese regskonsep-, kommunikasie- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Klank analitiese en probleemidentifiserings- en oplossingsvaardighede. Taalvaardigheid. Handhawing van vertroulikheid van inligting. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Verhoudingsbestuur. Besluitnemingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike en diplomasie. Motiverings-, onderhandelings-, bemiddelings- en arbitrasievaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur van die voorsiening van algemene regsadviesondersteuningsdienste aan die departement en die Ministerie. Bestuur van alle litigieuse sake vir en teen die Departement en die Ministerie. Bestuur van die regsadviesdienste rakende die opstel, ontloteer en wysiging van kontrakte. Toesig hou oor die ondersoek van ingevoerde doeltreffendheidsmaatreëls. Verskaf algemene regsmenings aan lynfunksie. Skakel met die kantoor van die staatsprokureur en raadpleeg, verskaf instruksies, fasiliteer die samestelling van dokumente in litigasiesake. Raadpleeg met lynfunksie en neem instruksies. Bestuur van litigasie- en skuldlêers. Bearbei PAIA- en PAJA-versoeke van lynfunksie.

zu.requirements: Iziqu ezincane zezingu eminye emine (LLB) okungenani ngeminyaka engu-8 yohlakaniphi olufanele lomthetho emva kokuthola iziqu noma iminyaka engu-8 yamava njengomeluleki wangaphakathi nomthetho noma umlawuli wezinkontileka, Ukuzithoba ukuhamba ngesikhathi esithile futhi uvumeleke ohlelweni lwemisebenzi ngokwesidingo somsebenzi, Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olukhethekile lomthetho wezinkontileka, ukuphatwa jikelele kwezinkontileka kanye nezinkantolo ngaphakathi kohlaka lwenhlangano, Ukuqoqa ulwazi lomthetho kanye nokusiza ngomthetho ngobuchwepheshe, Ulwazi olujulile lohlaka lokuphatha uchungechunge lwezinsiza [Imithetho ngokwesiga somthetho wePetro yezimali zikahulumeni, 1999 (Isiga No. 1 of 1999) (PFMA)], Ikhowudi Yokuziphatha Yabaphathi Bochungechunge lwezinsiza, i-PFMA, Imithetho yeNdalispani, umthethowoJwazi wePholisi YokuThengwa Ngethemba, 2000 (Isiga No. 5 of 2000), umthetho weNhhela yeZobuchwepheshe Bolwazi Buhulumeni, 1998 (Isiga No. 88 of 1998), umthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi, 1994 (Isiga No. 103 of 1994), Imithetho Yesevisi Yomphakathi namanye omthetho ohlobene nalo. zu.duties: Ukuphatwa kokunikezwa kwezinsiza zokwesekwa ngomthetho jikelele kumnyango naseKhabhinethi. Ukuphatwa kwayo yonke imicimbi yezinkantolo yesandla nasengqondweni yawo umnyango naseKhabhinethi. Ukuphatwa kwezinsiza zokweluleka ngomthetho ekubhalweni, ekuhloleni nasekulungisweni izinkontileka. Ukuqapha ukuhlola izinyathelo zokusebenza kalula ezethulwe. Ukunikeza izincomo zomthetho jikelele kumsebenzi osemgwaqweni. Ukuxhumana nenhhela yengweli yesifundazwe kanye nokubuzisisa, ukunikeza imiyalo, ukwenza kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kwamadokhumente emacala ezenkantolo. Ukubuzisisa nomsebenzi osemgwaqweni bese uthatha imiyalo. Ukiphatwa kwamafayela ezenkantolo namasikweletu. Ukunakela izicelo ze-PAIA ne-PAJA ezivela kumsebenzi osemgwaqweni.

xh.title: Umlawuli Ophakamileyo Wolawulo Lomthetho: Umthetho namaqela ezivumelwano
xh.summary: Kufuneki ngumlawuli omkhulu wolawulo lomthetho ukuze alawule iinkonzo zoluleko lomthetho, imigwevo nokuqinisekiswa kweqela lezivumelwano kwiSebe lezeMisebenzi zaLuntu nezeNdalo yoluntu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi konyaka omine (i-LLB) kunye neminye engu-8 yamava wobugcisa emthethweni emfanelekileyo emva kokufumana isidanga okanye iminye engu-8 yamava njengomceli-mthetho wangaphakathi okanye umlawuli womthetho/maqela ezivumelwano; Ukulungele ukuhamba ngesithuba esingaqhagamshelwanga nokuzonikezela kwihamba nomhla lomsebenzi ngokweemfuno zobugcisa; Ilayisensi yokuqubula esemthethweni. Ukubhaliswa njengommeli okanye ukuba ngumongoqi weNkundla ePhezulu kunye namava okulawula kuya kuba lusizo olungenankqubo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluchanekileyo ngomthetho wamaqela ezivumelwano, ulawulo lweqela lezivumelwano jikelele kwakunye nemigwevo ngaphakathi kwendlela yokusebenza olwaziyo nangokoqhayo, Iphononongo lomthetho noncedo lomthetho olungcwathi, Ulwazi oluqulunqwe ngokwesiqu elinobulumko ngokuQulunqwa kweNdlela yoLawulo lweNkqubo yoNgeniso lweziMfuno [Izichibiyelo ngokweMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu, 1999 (uMthetho uNombolo 1 ka-1999) (i-PFMA)], Ikhodi yokuziphatha kubaLawuli beNkqubo yoNgeniso lweziMfuno, i-PFMA, Izichibiyelo ze-Nazyme, uMthetho weNkqubo yoThengo olukhethwayo, 2000 (uMthetho uNombolo 5 ka-2000), uMthetho weSebe leTekhnoloji yoLwazi loLuntu, 1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 88 ka-1998), uMthetho woNkonzo yoLuntu, 1994 (uMthetho uNombolo 103 ka-1994), Isonxibelelwano soNkonzo woLuntu nakwelinye igazethi echazwe ngokwemigaqo. Amakhono: Ukubhala imibhalo yomthetho ngokucoca kwaye iqinisekisiwe, amakhono othathunywa nokubonisa, Ukuhlola ngokucoca kunye nokuchonga iingxaki nokusombulula, Ukuguquguquka kolwimi, Ukuqhuba iimfihlo zelwazi, Ukubanzi kwelungiselelo lekhompyutha, Ulawulo lohlobo lwabantu, Amakhono okuthatha izigqibo, Ulwimo lokuzithoba nokuzipatha kahle, Amanqanqgaba okukhuthaza, Ukuququzelela, Ukubuyisana nomanyano lokuphawula nokusombulula iingxabano.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zoluncedo lomthetho jikelele kwisebe nekuMnye wezeNkonzo. Ukulawula yonke imicimbi yemigwevo ngesandla sewisebe nakwiMnye wezeNkonzo. Ukulawula iinkonzo zoncedo lomthetho ekubhalweni, ukuhlola nokulungisa amaqela ezivumelwano. Ukuphatha ngokucoca indlela yokuphonononga izithambo zokusebenza ezintsha kwaye zifake isandla. Ukunika izimvo zomthetho jikelele kumsebenzi wolawulo. Ukunxibelelana ne-ofisi yommeli karhulumente, kuze kubekho ingxoxo, kunikezelwe imiyalelo, kwaye kwenziwe kwangcono ukuqokelelwa kwamaphepha kumanqanqgaba emigwevo. Ukuxoxa nomsebenzi wolawulo kwakunye nokuthabatha imiyalelo. Ukulawula amafayile emigwevo nemali. Ukuphendula izicelo ze-PAIA ne-PAJA ezivela kumsebenzi wolawulo.

af.title: Administrasiebeampte: Benutting en Kontrak
af.summary: Administreer staatseiendombennutting, kontrakbestuur en kliëntkommunikasie by die Nelspruit Streekskantoor van die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Real Estate Management / Property Law / Law Degree of verwante kwalifikasie. Toepaslike relevante jare se ervaring in die veld. 'n Bestuurderslisensie. Hlela futhi wabelane ngezinkomba zomsebenzi ohambisana nezivumelwano. Qedela izinkomfa zokusungula imithetho yokuqasha uhlele noma yiziphi izinhlamvu ezidingekayo zokuxazulula izingxabano.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Planning and Reporting
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Planning and Reporting at National Treasury in Pretoria, responsible for strategic and annual performance plans, offering R487197 per annum.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6) or Bachelor’s Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Public Administration or Business Administration or Public Management or Business Management or related qualification. A minimum of 3 years’ experience in strategic monitoring and planning businesses in alignment with operation requirements. Knowledge and experience of the consolidation of Departmental Performance and Strategic Plans. Knowledge and experience of the Governments Policy Framework. Knowledge of strategic management and policy analysis. Ability to evaluate and analyse information for policy development and application of policies.
jobs.duties: Departmental Strategic and Annual Performance Plans: Assist with the development, implementation and maintenance of the Departmental Annual Performance Plan and divisional operational plans. Assist with analysing and assessing strategic and annual performance plans for the correct alignment thereof. Assist in the development and implementation of performance indicators and measurements for the Department. Assist in the compilation of a comprehensive feedback report outlining discrepancies that must be addressed and integrated in future Strategic and Annual Performance Plans. Planning and Reporting: Provide inputs to systems and tools for the utilisation in the planning and reporting of the Department’s performance and operations management framework. Assist with planning and evaluation of the reporting framework and reports on the Department’s performance in compliance with the relevant regulatory requirements. Assist with coordinating the Departmental planning and reporting mechanism for strategic and operational programmes. Assist with monitoring progress against strategic and annual performance plans of business units and performance assessment action plans. Policy Development, Research and Benchmarking: Obtain inputs in the development and implementation of best practices planning, monitoring and reporting systems and mechanisms. Obtain inputs in the development, implementation and review of a governance framework for quality assurance, oversight and performance standards. Assist with monitoring the implementation of performance guidelines and frameworks and advice stakeholders accordingly. Assist with coordinating the implementation of annual outcomes and impact reporting. Stakeholder Engagement: Engage internal and external stakeholders on the implementation plans pertaining to planning, monitor evaluation and reporting. Engage with stakeholders in the coordination and progress of the implementation of developmental and process enhancements. Engage with strategic partners in the support of implementation processes pertaining to monitoring, evaluation and reporting outcomes. Contribute to the governance of the Departmental Strategic, Annual Performance and Operational Plans, for a streamlined process.

Bied bystand by die ontleding en assessering van strategiese en jaarlikse prestasieplanne vir die korrekte belyning daarvan. Bied bystand by die samestelling van 'n omvattende terugvoerrapport wat afwykings uiteensit wat aangespreek en in toekomstige Strategiese en Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne geïntegreer moet word. zu.title: Assistant Director: Planning and Reporting

zu.requirements: Kudingeka ibe khona i-Grade 12 kanye nesitifiketi se-National Diploma (esilingana ne-NQF level 6) noma i-Bachelor's Degree (esilingana ne-NQF level 7) ku-Public Administration noma i-Business Administration noma i-Public Management noma i-Business Management noma iziqu ezihambisano. Kubalulekile ukuba ube nomzamo ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-3 ekubukeni nasekucubunguleni izindaba eziyisiqu kwamabhizinisi ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokusebenza. Ukwazi futhi ube namava ngokuhlanganisa imisebenzi komnyango kanye nezinhlelo zezindaba eziyisiqu. Ukwazi futhi ube namava ngesikhungo senqubomgomo kahulumeni. Ukuba ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezindaba eziyisiqu kanye nokuqonda inqubomgomo. Ukuba nokuthi ukwazi ukuhlola futhi uhlaziye ulwazi ngezenjalo zokubumba inqubomgomo kanye nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo.
zu.duties: Izinhlelo zokuqasha zezindaba eziyisiqu kanye nezinkathi zomsebenzi wesikhathi esiyisikhathi eside: Siza ekubumbeni, ekusetshenziseni nasekugcineni iNdlela Yokusebenza Yomnyango Yomsebenzi Wonyaka kanye nezindlela zokusebenza zamabhizinisi. Siza ekuhlaziyeni nasekuhloleni izinhlelo zezindaba eziyisiqu kanye nezomsebenzi wesikhathi esiyisikhathi eside ukuze zihambelane kahle. Siza ekubumbeni nasekusetshenziseni izinkomba zomsebenzi kanye nezindlela zokulinganisa umsebenzi komnyango. Siza ekubhalweni kombiko ophathe kakhulu ogqamisa iziphene okumele zilungiswe futhi zibekwe kuzo izinhlelo zezindaba eziyisiqu kanye nezomsebenzi wesikhathi esiyisikhathi eside ezizayo. Ukucubungula kumbiko: Nikeza iminikelo kuzinhlelo nezinsiza ezozosetshenziswa ekucubunguleni nasekubikeni ngemisebenzi komnyango kanye nesikhungo sokuphatha izindlela zokusebenza. Siza ekucubunguleni nasekuhloleni isikhungo sokubika kanye namabiko ngemisebenzi komnyango ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezihambisanayo zomthetho. Siza ekuhlanganiseni indlela yokucubungula nokubika komnyango ngezinhlelo eziyisiqu kanye nezokusebenza. Siza ekuqaphehleni intuthuko ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zezindaba eziyisiqu kanye nezomsebenzi wesikhathi esiyisikhathi eside zamabhizinisi kanye nezinhlelo zokuqonda umsebenzi. Ukubumba iNqubomgomo, Ukuhlola kanye nokulinganisa: Thola iminikelo ekubumbeni nasekusetshenziseni izinhlelo ezingcono zokucubungula, ukuqapha nokubika. Thola iminikelo ekubumbeni, ekusetshenziseni kanye nokuqamba kabusha isikhungo sobuso ngemigomo yokuqinisekisa izinga, ukuqapha kanye namazinga omsebenzi. Siza ekuqapheleni ukusetshenziswa kwezinkomba zemisebenzi kanye nezikhungo futhi umemezele iziphande ngokuhambiselana nalokho. Siza ekuhlanganiseni ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokubika ngemiphumela yonyaka kanye nomthelela. Ukuhlangana nabantu abathintekayo: Hlangana nabantu abathintekayo bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibhekene nokucubungula, ukuqapha ukuhlola nokubika. Hlangana nabantu abathintekayo ekuhlanganiseni nasekuqhubeni phambili ukusebenza kwezinto ezintsha kanye nokuqushumbisa izinqubo. Hlangana nabalingani abayisiqu ekwesekeni izinqubo zokusebenza eziphathelene ukuqapha, ukuhlola nokubika imiphumela. Nikeza iminikelo ebusweni bezinhlelo zezindaba eziyisiqu zomnyango, ezomsebenzi wesikhathi esiyisikhathi eside nezokusebenza, ukuze kubekho inqubo elula.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNgqungquthela: Iplani nokuxela ngayo
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNgqungquthela: Iplani nokuxela ngayo kwi-National Treasury ePretoria, nogqoqo lwendlulelo lokuyilwa kweekhaphukhobho zolwaziso, inikela ngo R487197 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka kubekho isiqinisekiso se-Graji yi-12 kunye ne-Diploma yaseZiko (elingu NQF level 6) okanye i-Bachelor's Degree (elingu NQF level 7) kwi-Public Administration okanye i-Business Administration okanye i-Public Management okanye i-Business Management okanye isiqinisekiso esinxulumene noko. Kufuneka kubekho isipho sobugcisa kwiminyaka engu 3 ngaphezulu kokumonitha iindlela ezicwangqisiweyo kwaye uplane amashishini ngokuhambelana neemfuno zokuqhuba imisebenzi. Ulwazi nokuphila kwinkqubo yokudibanisa iinkqubo zoMvuzo woMsebenzi kwiNqanaba lomNyango kunye neSayikhede Ezi cwangciswa ngokuhambelana nemigqaliselo yaWonke wonke neNqanaba loMsebenzi. Ulwazi lobugcisa ekwahlulweni kobumfama weenkqubo ezicwangcisiweyo. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwezicwangciso ezibalulekileyo nantluko yolwazi kumagqabantshi. Ulwazi lokulinganisa nokupapasha inkcazelo ngokunjalo nayimfuneko yokuzisebenzisa.
xh.duties: Icwangciso lugqoqo lwabanye abantu kwiSazizo esinye ngasiphi na: Nceda ekuyilwa, ekusebenziseni nasekugcineni inkqubo yokwenza iNqanaba loMsebenzi kwiNyango ngokweminyaka yayo yonke. Yiba ngumncedi ekupapasheni nokulinganiseni iindlela ezicwangcisiweyo zoMvuzo ngokweminyaka yonke ukuze zihambelane ngokuchanekileyo. Nceda ekuqumbeni ukusebenza kwemigqaliselo yokulinganisa umvuzo kwiNqanaba loNyango. Nceda ekubhalweni kwegxelo elingathe ithi lomthunzi woolwazi oluthe laba ngxaki ezimele zisuswe kwaye zifakwe kwiSayikhede yeNqanaba Yomsebenzi kwaye uluntu lulube ngaphandle. Iplani nokuXela: Nikela ngolwazi kwiinkqubo neesixhobo zokusetyenziswa ekuqwalaseleni nokuxelelweni ukusetyenziswa kweNyango nokuphatha iinkqubo. Nceda nakuqwalasela imiba yokubhalwa kwemiqulu nokuqwalasela imiba yokusebenza kwiNyango ngokulawuleka nokuvelana nezigqibo. Nceda ekumisweni weNyango ngokomgangatho woluntu olungachasanga komthetho ngokwemfuneko yokusombulula iingxaki. Nceda ekujikelweni iNqanaba loNyango kwiinkqubo neenkcukacha ezifuna ukusombululwa ngokuhambelana nomthetho oloko wawujongile nayena wena ungumntu othatha isigqibo. Nceda ekumisweni wolawulo lweNyango njengoko kuboniswe kumagqabiso awo nokumiswa kwakhe imiba yomsebenzi. Nceda ekujongeni imeko yokuba lisemqoka kwaye lahluliwe kwelinye. Inkqubo yoBomi, Upapasho lweNgcuceko noBom: Nceda ekubeni nzima kwiNqanaba loNyango njengoko kungekhona olu lwazi oluvela ngexesha elifanelekileyo lokuqinisekisa umba wokusinika isapho. Nceda ekuqwalaselweni nokubonelelwa ngeenkcukacha ezifana nokuqwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwekhalendi yazo nezinye iimfuno ezibalulwa kuyo. Nceda ekubonweni amanyathelo abonelela ngomngeni ongqongqo kwiinkqubo zokuphatha okanye ekusebenziseni iinkqubo ngokusuka kulo. Uncedo ekuphatheni amagqabantshi: Thetha nabasebenzi abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngolu lumko nokumisweni kwe-plani ezifana noqwalaselo nokuxela ngemiba. Thetha nabasebenzi abangaphakathi nangaphandle ekumisweni kwamathuba okuphucula amanqanaba okuphumeza iinkqubo ezintsha. Thetha namaqembu abakho isaziso ekuxhaseni iinkqubo ezifuna ukuqwalaselwa, uqwalaselo nokubonisana nemiba engumrhwebi. Yiba ngumntu onceda ekulawulweni nasekuphathweni amacebo esiNqanaba loNyango ngokuhambelana nemithetho yeNkqubo yeSizwe nakuzo zonke iinkqubo zakhe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Sanitation
jobs.summary: Assistant Director in the Department of Water and Sanitation based in Mmabatho, responsible for developing sanitation policies, strategies and monitoring programmes.
jobs.requirements: A relevant NQF level 6 qualification in Environmental Health/ Community Development Studies. Three (3) years’ experience in sanitation environment. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s licence. Knowledge of Public Service Act. Knowledge of sanitation policies and strategies. Problem solving and analysis. Excellent communication skills both (verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct. Computer literacy. Good interpersonal skills.

Assist in the planning, implementation and monitoring of sanitation programmes, projects and regulatory framework / prescripts. Participate in the assessment of Water and Sanitation Development Plans (WSDPs). Investigate sanitation complaints and attend to Ministerial referrals. Participate in advocacy programmes for sanitation. Staff supervision.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Sanitasie
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur in die Department of Water and Sanitation, gevestig in Mmabatho, verantwoordelik vir die ontwikkeling van sanitasiebeleide, -strategieë en moniteringsprogramme.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante NQF level 6-kwalifikasie in Omgewingsgesondheid/Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstudies. Drie (3) jaar se ervaring in 'n sanitasie-omgewing. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurslisensie. Kennis van die Public Service Act. Kennis van sanitasiebeleide en -strategieë. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondelings en skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede.

Bystand verleen aan die beplanning, implementering en monitering van sanitasieprogramme, projekte en regulatoriese raamwerk/voorskryfte. Personeeltoesig.

zu.title: Onozinti Abasizi: Ukuhlanzwa
zu.summary: Onozinti Abasizi ku-Department of Water and Sanitation ababeka ikakhulukazi e-Mmabatho, benomsebenzi wokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zokuhlanzwa, izindlela kanye nezinhlelo zokulandelela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezihambisanayo ze-NQF level 6 kwi-Environmental Health/ Community Development Studies. Three (3) years’ experience in sanitation environment. Ukubuyisa izinhlobo zokushayela okusebenzayo futhi esingekapheli. Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Act. Ulwazi lwezinqubomgomo nezindlela zokuhlanzwa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Amakhono okuxhumana aphezulu (okukhulunywayo nokuqoshiwe). Ukubekezelela nendlela yokuziphatha ngokuzethembeka. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu.
zu.duties: Siza ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubomgomo nezindlela ezibhekwe ezinhlelweni zokuhlanzwa. Siza ekubekweni kwesu, ekuqalweni kanye nokulandeleleni izinhlelo zokuhlanzwa, amaphrojekthi kanye nesesekela somthetho / iziyalezo. Thatha inhlomulo ekuhloleni ama-Plan wokuThuthukiswa koManzi nokuHlanzwa (WSDPs). Phenya izikhalazo ngokuhlanzwa uphendule izinto ezithunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe. Thatha inhlomulo ezinhlelweni zokukhuthaza ukuba khona kwemisebenzi yokuhlanzwa. Ukulawula abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umphathi Oncedisa: Ulondolozo lweNdalo
xh.summary: Umphathi Oncedisa kwiSebe lezeManzi nokuLondolozwa kweNdalo ohleli eMmabatho, unomsebenzi wokuphepha iindlela zokulondolozwa kwendalo, iindlela nezinkqubo zokuqwalasela.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo seNQF level 6 kwiZempo loNyango lweNdalo/ uPhuhliso looLuntu. Iimfuno zamashumi amathathu (3) eminyaka yamava kwindawo yokulondolozwa kwendalo. Ukutyhila ilayisensi yokuqhuba eseyiqinisiweyo engagqithanga. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woBukhulu baseNarha. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokulondolozwa kwendalo nezakuqwalasela. Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuqwalasela. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelana ngamandla (elentlou nangeloxwelo). Ixabiso nokuziphatha ngokobulelwane. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iikhono ezinhle zokunxibelelana nabantu.
xh.duties: Nceda kuphuhliso lweendlela nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zokulondolozwa kwendalo. Nceda kwicandelo lokucinga, nokuphumeza nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zokulondolozwa kwendalo, amaprojekthi nendlela yokulawula / izalathiso. Thatha inxaxheba kwiqwalaselo lwezecu zeManzi nokuLondolozwa kweNdalo (WSDPs). Phanda iingxaki ezimalunga nokulondolozwa kwendalo uzinakele iinkqubo ezifakwa nguNgqongqoshe. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokukhuthaza ukulondolozwa kwendalo. Uqophelelo lwabasebenzi.
