af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Rekordbestuur
af.summary: Oorsee die implementering van rekordbestuursbeleid en register-nakominginspeksies by die Department of Water and Sanitation se Pretoria-hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Rekordbestuur/ Inligtingbestuur/ Inligtingwetenskap/ Kennisbestuur op NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie. Vyf (5) jaar se funksionele ervaring in Argief- en Rekordbestuur of Inligtingsdienste/bestuur op toesighoudende vlak. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering, Nasionale Argiefregulasies en die National Archive and Records Services Act of South Africa (NARSASA). Kennis van analitiese prosedures. Begrip van regeringswetgewing. Kennis van finansiële bestuur en die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Kennis van tegnieke en prosedures vir die beplanning en uitvoering van bedrywighede. Kennis van program- en rekordbestuurstelsels. Probleemoplossing en analise. Verhoudings-, mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die implementering van rekordbestuursbeleide en -prosedures. Monitor en evalueer rekordbestuurspraktyke vir nakoming. Fasiliteer nakominginspeksies van registries. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou die departementale lêerstelsel. Administreer en onderhou die lêerplan. Ondersteun alle satellietkantore oor Rekordbestuursaangeleenthede. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne en finansiële hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umncedisi weQhosa: Ukuphathwa kwezinqubo
zu.summary: Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwamasu okuphathwa kwezinqubo kanye nezemvume yokuthobela umthetho kumabhalo e-Department of Water and Sanitation Pretoria Head Office.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe kwiRecords Management/ Information Management/ Information Science/ Knowledge Management ezingeni le-NQF level 6. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yokusebenza kwi-Archive and Records Management noma i-Information Services/Management ezingeni lokuba ngumlawuli. Ulwazi lokuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwamasu, i-National Archives Regulations kanye ne-National Archive and Records Services Act of South Africa (NARSASA). Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokuqonda incazelo. Ukuqonda izigaba ezithathwa hurumeni kahulumeni. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezimali kanye ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi lwezindlela nezenqobo zokuqamba nokwenza imisebenzi. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zokulawula amaphrogramu namaphayili. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda incazelo. Ukuphathwa kobudlelwano,abantu nokuahlukana. Ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuqonda imisebenzi yomthengi. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle kakuhle (adlula emlonyeni nakuqoshiwe). Ukuza kubophezeleka nokuziphatha ngokwesimiso.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuthi kusetshenziswe izinqobo ezilawula ukulawulwa kwezinqobo. Qapha futhi uhlole izindlela zokulawulwa kwezinqubo ukuze zihambisane nomthetho. Yenza ukuthi kuhlolelwe ukuzithobela kwemithetho kumabhalo. Thuthukisa, sethenze futhi ulondoloze uhlelo lokuqukethwe kwemibhalo yomnyango. Lawula futhi ulondoloze uhlelo lokuqamba amaphayiphu. Sekela wonke amahhovisi kwezindaba zokuphathwa kwezinqobo. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zabantu nezimali.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: uLawulo lweZixhobo zeNkcukacha
xh.summary: Qhoboshela ukusebenza kolawulo lwemigaqo yokulawula izixhobo zenkcukacha nokuphononongwa kokuzithoba kolawulo lwezareji kwisebe lezeManzi nokuCogula kwiNtloko ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sikaZwelonke kokuLawula iZixhobo zeNkcukacha/ ukuLawula ulwazi/ iNzululwazi loLwazi/ ukuLawula ulwazi kwinqanaba lesi-6 leNQF. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava angaphiliko kwindawo yokuGcina iin kcukacha nokuLawula iziXhobo zeNkcukacha okanye iInkonzo zoLwazi/okuLawula kwinqanaba lokuhlola. Ulwazi ngophuhliso nokusebenza kolawulo lwemigaqo, iMigaqo yokuGcina iinNkcukacha yeZwelonke neMigaqo yokuLawula iziXhobo zeNkcukacha yoLwazi lwaseMzantsi Afrika (NARSASA). Ulwazi lweendlela zohlolo-lwazi. Ukuqonda okuqulunqwe ngurhulumente. Ulwazi lolawulo lweemali neMigaqo yoLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA). Ulwazi lweendlela namakhaladi eplani nokuzebenza kweendlela zokusebenza. Ulwazi lolawulo lweenkqubo namashishini okulawula izixhobo zenkcukacha. Ukuzisombulula iingxaki nokuqhathanisa. UkuLawula ubudlelwane, abantu nobuninzi. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nogqwalaselo komthengi. Amakhono amamIncoko (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ixabiso nokuziphatha ngokuyinyaniso.
xh.duties: Yenza kube lula ukusebenza kolawulo lwemigaqo namakhaladi yokulawula izixhobo zenkcukacha. Qhoboshela ukuzithoba kolawulo lwemigaqo yokulawula izixhobo zenkcukacha. Yenza kube lulu ukuphonononga ukuzithoba kwezareji. Phuhlisa, yenza isebenze zigqibe ulondolozo lolawulo lwezareji loMmandla kwakusebe loLuntu. Lawula ulondolozo lweplani yamafayile. Xhasa yonke iiofisi ezingamahlwela kumaphondo ezeNdabam zelawulo lweziXhobo zeNkcukacha. UkuLawula amabhafu abantu namaxhobo eemali.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Clerk Supervisor
jobs.summary: Supervise supply chain operations including procurement planning, demand management and supplier shortlisting for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Gqeberha.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate or equivalent. Three (3) to (5) five years’ relevant in Supply Chain Management experience required. Basic knowledge of supply chain duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collate administrative statistics. Knowledge and understanding of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework (PPPFA) and all applicable SCM guidelines, policies, practices, and procedures. Knowledge of financial operating systems (SAP, CSD etc). Knowledge and insight of Human Resources prescripts. Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environments. Knowledge and understanding of the framework governing the Public Service. Interpersonal relations. Good Communication skills both (verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct. Framework for managing performance information. Knowledge of implementing policies of PMDS. Problem solving and Analysis. People and Diversity Management. Client Orientation, Communication, Accountability and Ethical Conduct.
jobs.duties: Coordinate, review, research, analyses and plan the procurement needs of the Cluster. Coordinate, review, collect information and implement the demand management plan for the Cluster. Receive requests for goods and services from end user and verify for compliance. Shortlist suitable suppliers from Central Supplier Database. Invite and receive quotations from suppliers. Ensure compliance with SCM policies, processes, and procedures. Render demand and acquisition clerical support. Provide secretariat functions to bid committee Check purchase requisitions and purchase order for correctness, completeness and sign the requisition and order documents. Approve purchase requisitions and purchase orders on SAP system. Create contracts and ensure contract performance is adhered to. Administer, maintain, and update contract register to ensure transparency and record keeping. Implement controls to ensure that purchase orders are placed for items on approved contracts and non-contract requisitions. Update and ensure the maintenance of vendors on system. Render logistical support service: Receive and verify goods delivered from suppliers prior to performing goods receipts (Goods Receipt Voucher) on SAP system and maintain goods receipts register. Issue goods to the end-users (direct and stock purchase) Identify redundant and obsolete stock. Control stock levels and conduct stock taking. Assess SCM audit and compliance readiness. Supervise human resources/staff. Render asset management clerical support: Process payments on SAP. Provide training to the internal clients regarding updates on SCM processes and procedures. Attend to SCM related enquiries.

af.title: Voorsieningsketting Klerk toesighouer
af.summary: Hou toesig oor voorsieningskettingbedrywighede, insluitend inkoopbeplanning, vraagbestuur en verskaffer kortlyssing vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Gqeberha.
af.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate or equivalent. Three (3) to (5) five years' relevant in Supply Chain Management experience required. Basiese kennis van voorsieningskettingpligte, -praktyke as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collate administrative statistics. Kennis en begrip van Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework (PPPFA) en alle toepaslike SCM-riglyne, -beleide, -praktyke en -prosedures. Kennis van finansiële bedryfstelsels (SAP, CSD ens.). Kennis en insig van Human Resources-voorskrifte. Kennis van werksprosedures binne die werksomgewings. Kennis en begrip van die raamwerk wat die Public Service regeer. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goed kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Kennis van die implementering van PMDS-beleide. Probleemoplossing en analise. Mens- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie, kommunikasie, verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Koördineer, hersien, ondersoek, analiseer en beplan die inkoopbehoeftes van die Cluster. Koördineer, hersien, versamel inligting en implementeer die vraagbestuursplan vir die Cluster. Ontvang versoeke vir goedere en dienste van die eindgebruiker en verifieer vir nakoming. Kortlys geskikte verskaffers uit die Central Supplier Database. Nooi en ontvang kwotasies van verskaffers. Verseker nakoming van SCM-beleide, -prosesse en -prosedures. Verskaf vraag- en verkrygingsklerklike ondersteuning. Verskaf sekretariaatsfunksies aan die bie-komitee. Kontroleer inkoopversoeke en inkoopordervir korrektheid, volledigheid en teken die versoek- en orderdokumente. Keur inkoopversoeke en inkoopbestellings op die SAP-stelsel goed. Skep kontrakte en verseker dat kontrakprestasie nagekom word. Administreer, onderhou en werk die kontrakregister by om deursigtigheid en rekordhouding te verseker. Implementeer kontroles om te verseker dat inkoopbestellings geplaas word vir items op goedgekeurde kontrakte en nie-kontrakversoeke. Werk verskaffers op die stelsel by en verseker die onderhoud daarvan. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuningsdiens: Ontvang en verifieer goedere wat deur verskaffers afgelewer is voordat goedereontvangste (Goods Receipt Voucher) op die SAP-stelsel uitgevoer word en onderhou die goedereontvangsregister. Reik goedere uit aan die eindgebruikers (direk en voorraadaankoop). Identifiseer oortollige en verouderde voorraad. Beheer voorraadvlakke en voer voorraadtelling uit. Assesseer SCM-oudit en nakomingsgereedheid. Hou toesig oor menslike hulpbronne/personeel. Verskaf batesbestuursklerklike ondersteuning: Verwerk betalings op SAP. Verskaf opleiding aan die interne kliënte met betrekking tot opdaterings van SCM-prosesse en -prosedures. Hanteer SCM-verwante navrae.

zu.title: Umphathi Womshini We-Supply Chain
zu.summary: Qondisa imisebenzi ye-supply chain okuhlanganisa ukuhlela ukuthenga, ukuphathwa kwesidingo kanye nokukhetha abahlinzeki abafanele ku-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Gqeberha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma esifanayo. Kudingeka ubambebe iminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kuyisihlanu (5) ubudala wemisebenzi ehambisana ne-Supply Chain Management. Ukwazi okuyisisekelo ngemisebenzi ye-supply chain, izindlela zokwenza kanye nobuchule bokufaka idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zezokuphathwa. Ukwazi nokugonda i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Treasury Regulations, i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework (PPPFA) kanye nayo yonke imininingwane ye-SCM, izinqubomgomo, izindlela zokwenza, kanye nemithethonqubo. Ukwazi ngezistimu ezisebenza ngemali (SAP, CSD etc). Ukwazi nokuqonda imithethonqubo ye-Human Resources. Ukwazi ngezinqubo zokusebenza ngokwesimo sendawo yokusebenza. Ukwazi nokugonda uhlelo olawula i-Public Service. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle (abukhulumayo nombhalo). Ukubekezela kanye nokuziphatha ngokwesibonelo. Uhlelo lokuphatha ulwazi ngemiphumela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa izinqubomgomo ze-PMDS. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokubuhlukahluka. Ukugxila kaklayenti, Ukuxhumana, Ukubekezela nokuziphatha ngokwesibonelo.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa, buyekeza, ucwaninge, hlaziye futhi uhlele izidingo zokuthenga ze-Cluster. Hlanganisa, buyekeza, qoqa ulwazi futhi usebenzise uhlelo lokuphathwa kwesidingo le-Cluster. Yamukela izicelo zezimpahla nezinsiza abasebenzisi ezibhalile, uqiniseke ukuthi zihambisana nemithetho. Khetha abahlinzeki abafanele kwi-Central Supplier Database. Memela futhi wamukele izikhwephethi kubahlinzeki. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nenqubomgomo yama-SCM, izinqubo, kanye nemithethonqubo. Nikeza ukwesekwa kwezibhalo ezithintela ukuthenga kanye nesidingo. Nikeza imisebenzi yamabhibhodi eqoqweni likabhasha. Hlola ukufaneleka nokuphela kwezicelo zokuthenga kanye nomyalezo wokuthenga, bese usayina amadokhumenti wesicelo nomyalezo. Vumela izicelo zokuthenga kanye nemiyalezo yokuthenga kwisistimu ye-SAP. Dala izinkontilaka futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhlonishwa ukusebenza kwenkontilaka. Phatha, gcina, futhi buyekeza irejista yezinkontilaka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobeka kanye nokugcina amarekhodi. Sebenzisa izilawuli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiyalezo yokuthenga ibekelwe izinto ezikwizinkontilaka ezivunyiwe kanye nezicelo ezingezona zenkontilaka. Buyekeza futhi uqinisekise ukugcinwa kwabahlinzeki kwisistimu. Nikeza inkonzo yesekelo lezokuhambisa: Yamukela futhi uqinisekise izimpahla ezithunyelwe abahlinzeki ngaphambi kokwenza ukwamukela izimpahla (Goods Receipt Voucher) kwisistimu ye-SAP futhi ugcine irejista yokwamukela izimpahla. Yabelana ngezimpahla kubasebenzisi bokugcina (okuthengwa ngqo nokuqoqwa). Hlukanisa impahla engasetshenziswa kanye naleyo edlule ithunjwe. Lawula amazinga empahla futhi wenze ukubala kwempahla. Hlola ukulungele ukuhlolwa kanye nokuhambisana kwe-SCM. Qondise abantu/imisebenzi yabantu. Nikeza ukwesekwa kwezokuphathwa kwezimpahla: Lungisa izinkokhelo kwi-SAP. Nikeza uqeqesho kubaklayenti banganaphakathi mayelana nobuyekezo kwezinqubo kanye nemithethonqubo ye-SCM. Ziphendule imibuzo ehambisana ne-SCM.

xh.title: Supply Chain Clerk Supervisor
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi ye-supply chain kuquka ucwangciso lokuthenga, ukulawula imfuno nokukhetha ababoneleli kwi-Department of Water and Sanitation eGqeberha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Senior/Grade 12 okanye esilinganayoyo. Iimfuno zolwazi lokuqeqeshwa kweminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kwishlanu (5) kwimisebenzi ye-Supply Chain Management. Isiququmbi selwazi ngemisebenzi ye-supply chain, iinkqubo nakanjani namandla okungena idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwaye uqokelele izibalo zolawulo. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), iTreasury Regulations, i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework (PPPFA) nazo zonke iinkqubo ze-SCM, iinkqubo, iinkqubo nezithethe ezifanelekileyo. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokusebenza kwemali (SAP, CSD etc). Ulwazi nokuqonda izalathiso ze-Human Resources. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokusebenza ngokwemida yemisebenzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda isakhiwo esilawula i-Public Service. Izimalamano nabantu. Amakhono obuqu wokunxibelelwana (ethethwayo nolotshiweyo). Ixabiso nokuziphatha ngokwesistu. Isakhiwo sokulawula ulwazi ngemveliso. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iinkqubo ze-PMDS. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela. Ulawulo lwabantu nolwahluko. i-Client Orientation, Communication, Accountability and Ethical Conduct.
xh.duties: lungelanisa, phinda uhlole, uphonononge, uhlalutye ucwangcise iimfuno zokuthengwa kwempahla ze-Cluster. Lungelanisa, phinda uhlole, qokelele ulwazi uze usebenzise icebo lokulawula imfuno ye-Cluster. Yamkela iicelo zempahla nezinkonzo ezivela kumsebenzisi wokugqibela uze uqinisekise ukuzinikela kumthetho. Khetha ababoneleli abafanelekileyo kwi-Central Supplier Database. Menga uze uyamkele iintengiso ezivela kubaboneleli. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela kumthetho kwiinkqubo, iinkqubo nezithethe ze-SCM. Yiba noluxhaso kwimisebenzi yofako lweemfuno nokufunyanwa kweepropathi. Yiba nemisebenzi yobunyulu kumkomfa wotender. Hlola ukuchanekana nokuzaliseka kweepropathi zokuthenga kwaye usayine amaxwebhu epropathi yokuthenga noda yokuthenga. Vuma iipropathi zokuthenga neoda zokuthenga kwinkqubo ye-SAP. Dala iinkontilaka uze uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa kwento ekwayenzelwe kuyo inkontilaka. Lawula, gcina uze uhlaziye irejista yeekontilaka ukuze uqinisekise ukucaca nokugcina iirekhodi. Sebenzisa izilawulo ukuze uqinisekise ukuba iioda zokuthenga zibekelwe izinto ezikwinkontilaka evunyiweyo nakuqinisekiso okungaluthengwa. Hlaziya uze uqinisekise ukugcinwa kobaboneleli kwinkqubo. Yiba noluxhaso lwezinkonzo zokuhamba kwempahla: Yamkela uze uqinisekise impahla ethunyelwe ngababoneleli phambi kokwenza okufunyanwe kwempahla (Goods Receipt Voucher) kwinkqubo ye-SAP uze ugcine irejista yoko kufunyanwe kwempahla. Yiphe impahla abasebenzisi bokugqibela (okuthengwayo ngqo nokuqokelelwe) Chonga impahla engasafunekiyo negadileyo. Lawula amanqanaba empahla uze wenze ukubala impahla. Hlola ukulungelelana kwe-SCM nokuvavanyo kokuzinikela kumthetho. Lawula abantu/abasebenzi. Yiba noluxhaso kwimisebenzi yokulawula ithafa: Qhubeza iintlawulo kwinkqubo ye-SAP. Yinkqubo yokuqeqesha abathengi bangaphakathi ngenkcazelo yohlaziyo kwiinkqubo nezithethe ze-SCM. Phendula imibuzo ehlobene ne-SCM.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Clerk Supervisor
jobs.summary: Supervise staff and oversee procurement, asset management and SCM compliance for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Bellville.
jobs.requirements: A Senior / Grade 12 certificate or equivalent. Three (3) to (5) five years’ experience in Supply Chain Management is required. Basic knowledge of supply chain duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collate administrative statistics. Knowledge and insight of Human Resources prescripts. Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environments. Knowledge of financial operating systems (SAP, CSD etc). Knowledge and understanding of the framework governing the Public Service. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility and teamwork. Basic knowledge of Problem solving and analysis. People and diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Good Communication skills both (verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Supervise human resource/staff. Render asset management clerical support: Administer the procurement of goods and services. Ensure compliance with SCM policies, processes, and procedures. Provide training to the internal clients regarding updates on SCM processes and procedures. Attend to SCM related enquiries. Render demand and acquisition clerical support: Check purchase requisitions and orders for correctness, completeness and sign the requisition and order documents. Release purchase requisitions and orders on SAP system. Administer, maintain, and update contract register to ensure transparency and record keeping. Compile audit reports. Implement controls to ensure that purchase orders are placed for items on approved contracts and non-contract requisitions. Render logistical support service: Receive and verify goods delivered from suppliers prior to performing goods receipts (Goods Receipt Voucher) on SAP system and maintain goods receipts register. Issue goods to the end-users (direct and stock purchase) Identify redundant and obsolete stock. Control stock levels and conduct stock taking. Assess SCM audit and compliance readiness. Process payments on SAP.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezinkundla Zokulethwa Kwezimpahla
zu.summary: Qapha abasebenzi futhi ulawule ukuthenga izimpahla, ukuphathwa kwefa nalokho kuhambisana nemithetho ye-SCM kumnyango we-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Bellville.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Senior / Grade 12 noma esingulinganiselayo. Kudingeka ubhekisele kokuthathu (3) kuya kokuhlanu (5) iminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza ekuphathweni kwenkundla zokulethwa kwezimpahla. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemisebenzi yenkundla zokulethwa kwezimpahla, izinqubo kanye namandla okufaka idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Ulwazi nokuqonda imithetho ehlonga izinsiza zomuntu. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokusebenza mayelana nendawo zokusebenza. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zokusebenza kwezimali (SAP, CSD njll). Ulwaziokuqonda umbhede ophatha Imphakathi Ohlombe. Ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ukuguquguquka nokusebenza njengeqembu. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lokuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuhlukahluka kwebantu. Ukugxila kumthengi nokunaka iklayenti. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle womabili (okukhulunywayo nokubhaliwayo). Ukubekezelelwana nokuziphatha ngokuzotha.
zu.duties: Qapha izinsiza zabantu/abasebenzi. Nikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa kwefa: Phatha ukuthengiswa kwezimpahla nezinsiza. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nenqubomgomo ye-SCM, izinqubo, nezindlela. Nikeza uqeqesho kubaklayenti baphakathi mayelana nezibuyekezo kuzinqubo nezindlela ze-SCM. Phendula imibuzo ehlobene ne-SCM. Nikeza inkxaso yokufuna nokuthenga: Hlola izicelo zokuthenga nemiyalelo yokuthenga ngokulunga, ngokuphelele bese usayina amadokhumenti wesicelo nomyalelo wokuthenga. Khulula izicelo zokuthenga namayalelo okuthenga kwisistimu ye-SAP. Phatha, gcina, futhi ubuyekeze irejista yamakhontrakti ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukucaca nokugcina izinkomba. Hlanganisa imibiko yokuhlola. Setsha izilawuli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amayalelo okuthenga abekelwa izinto ezikumakhontrakti avunyiwe nesicelo esingekho kukhontrakti. Nikeza inkxaso yezokusweleka: Yamukela futhi uqinisekise izimpahla ezilethwe ngabanikezeli ngaphambi kokwenza ukwamukelwa kwempahla (Goods Receipt Voucher) kwisistimu ye-SAP futhi ugcine irejista yokwamukelwa kwempahla. Khuphula izimpahla kubasebenzisi bomphumela (okudlulela kokuthenga ngokuqondile nasesitokeni). Bona izitoku ezingasetshenziswa naleso esidala. Lawula izinga lesitoku futhi wenze ukubalwa kwesitoku. Hlola ukulungele ukuhlolwa nokuhambisana kwe-SCM. Cedula imikhawulo yezimali kwi-SAP.

xh.title: Umphathi Wegosa Le-Nkokelo Zoluhlinzo
xh.summary: Qondisa abasebenzi kwaye ulawule ukuthengwa kwezinto, ulawulo lwempahla kunye nokuzithobela kwe-SCM kwi-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Bellville.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Senior / Grade 12 okanye esilinganayo. Kufuneka kube kukho amava eminyaka mithathu (3) ukuya kwemihlanu (5) ekulawulweni kwe-Supply Chain Management. Ulwazi olusesixhoseni ngemisebenzi ye-supply chain, iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi nakho nako ukwaziswa ukungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokudibanisa izibalo zolawulo. Ulwazi nakuqonda i-prescripts ze-Human Resources. Ulwazi lweendlela zokusebenza ngokomgangatho wemimandla yokusebenza. Ulwazi lweendlela zokuqhuba ezimalini (SAP, CSD njl). Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho olawula i-Public Service. Izikhulmanthathano ezikhulumisanayo. Ukuguquguquka nokusebenza njengesiqanga. Ulwazi olusesixhoseni lokuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlola. Ulawulo lwabantu nolwahlukano. Ukwazinikela kumthengi nagqinisekiso lomthengi. Amakhono amabalisele eb nalento ethethwayo. Ixabiso nendlela yokuziphatha ngokumoral.
xh.duties: Qondisa abantu abasebenzayo/abasebenzi. Nikela inkxaso yegosa kulawulo lwempahla: Lawula ukuthengwa kwezimpahla kwaye unikezelo ngeempezeko. Qinisekisa ukuzithobela kwezinqumogcolo, iinkqubo, nendlela ze-SCM. Nikeza uqeqesho kumthengi bangaphakathi malunga nokuhlaziya iinkqubo nendlela ze-SCM. Phendula imibuzo ngokuphathelene ne-SCM. Nikela inkxaso yegosa kufuno nokuqokelela: Linganisa izicelo zokuqokelela izimpahla negunya ukuqinisekisa ukulungileyo, ukuzalisekileyo uphinde usayine izicelo zemifuziselo nemifuziselo yegunya. Khupha izicelo zokuqokelela izimpahla nemifuziselo yoluhlinzo kwinkqubo ye-SAP. Lawula, ulondoloze, uphinde uhlaziye ukubhaliswa kwekontrakti ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukucaca ukugcina iirekhodi. Hlola iimpha ezibali eziphela kunye nokulungiswa ukuze kubekho olunye uqeqesho kwindlela yokulungelelanisa izicelo eziya kwindlela ze-SCM. Qhobosha ulawulo ngesixa sabo bonke abathengi bemali. Lawula inkqubo yokuhambisa iimpahla: Yamkela uphumeleliswe ngemveliso eziye zafika kubanikezeli ngaphambi kokuqalisa ukwenza ukwamkelwa kwemveliso kwindlela ye-SAP kwaphaya ukugcina iirekhodi zamkelo lemveliso. Yabelia iimpahla kubasebenzisi bangapha godu (ngqo nendlela yokuthenga eziguqukayo) Phawula ukusilela nokungalawuleki kwendlela ebusuku. Lawula iimali ezigqiniweyo zenkomba kwixesha elifutshane. Linganisa izigqibo solawulo lwe-SCM malunga nokulungelelana nendlela ekuxukwene ngayo. jobs.title: Administration Clerk Supervisor
jobs.summary: Supervise and provide clerical support services including records management, filing, data capture and supply chain administration for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Uitkeer.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate or equivalent. Three (3) to (5) five years’ relevant experience. Knowledge of clerical functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collate administrative statistics. Knowledge and insight of Human Resources prescripts. Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environments. Knowledge of financial operating systems (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, etc). Knowledge and understanding of the framework governing the Public Service. Interpersonal relations, flexibility and teamwork. Basic knowledge of problem solving and analysis. People and diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Good communication skills both (verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Supervise and render general clerical support services e.g. Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data. Handle routine enquiries. Keep and maintain the filing system. Type basic letters and/or other correspondence when required. Supervise and provide supply chain clerical support services e.g. Laise with internal and external stakeholders in relation to procurement of goods and services. Stock control of office stationery. Keep and maintain the asset register. Arrange travelling and accommodation. Supervise and provide personnel administration clerical support e.g. Keep and maintain the attendance register, personnel records and leave register. Supervise and provide financial administration support e.g. Capture and update expenditure. Check correctness of subsistence and travel claims and submit to manager for approval. Handle telephone accounts and petty cash. Supervise human resources / staff. Allocate and ensure quality of work. Personnel development. Assess staff performance. Apply discipline.

af.title: Administrasieklerk toesighouer
af.summary: Verskaf toesig en klerklike ondersteuningsdienste, insluitend rekordbestuur, lêerwerk, datainvorderings en voorsieningskettingadministrasie vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Uitkeer.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. Drie (3) tot (5) vyf jaar se relevante ervaring. Kennis van klerklike funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data in te vorder, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en administratiewe statistiek saam te stel. Kennis en insig van Menslike Hulpbrondokumente. Kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewings. Kennis van finansiële bedryfstelsels (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, ens). Kennis en begrip van die raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Tussenmenslike verhoudings, buigsaamheid en spanwerk. Basiese kennis van probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en klienfokus. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Toesig hou en algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste lewer bv. Korrespondensie en data opneem, organiseer, stoor, invorder en terugkry. Roetine-navrae hanteer. Die lêerstelsel hou en in stand hou. Basiese briewe en/of ander korrespondensie tik wanneer vereis. Toesig hou en voorsieningsketting-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste verskaf bv. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Die bate-register hou en in stand hou. Reis en akkommodasie reël. Toesig hou en personeelsadministrasie-klerklike ondersteuning verskaf bv. Die bywoningsregister, personeelsrekords en verlofregister hou en in stand hou. Toesig hou en finansiële administrasie-ondersteuning verskaf bv. Uitgawes invorder en opdateer. Korrektheid van verblyf- en reisgoedkeurings nagaan en aan bestuurder vir goedkeuring voorlê. Telefoonrekeninge en klein kontant hanteer. Toesig hou oor menslike hulpbronne / personeel. Werk toeken en kwaliteit daarvan verseker. Personeelsonwikkeling. Personeelprestasie assesseer. Dissipline toepas.

zu.title: Umphathi Womlawuli Wezokuphathwa
zu.summary: Qondisa futhi unikeze izinsiza zokwesekwa kwezokubhalisa kuhlanganise nokuphatwa kwemibhalo, ukuhlela amafayela, ukuthwebula idatha kanye nokuphatwa kwenxhunyanano yokulethwa kwempahla ye-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Uitkeer.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma esilinganayo. Unyaka abathathu (3) kuyakuwa (5) ohambweni oluhlobene. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezokubhalisa, izendlela zokwenza kanye nenhlonipho yokuthwebula idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuqoqa izibalo zokuphatwa. Ulwazi nokuqonda izimiso zemithetho ye-Human Resources. Ulwazi ngokuhamba kokuqashwa emiholweni yemisebenzi. Ulwazi mayelana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezimalini (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, etc). Ulwazi nokuqonda ohlakeni lolawula I-Public Service. Izidingo zobuhlobo nabantu, ukuguquguquka kanye nokusebenza ndawonye. Ulwazi oluwulwangu lokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda. Ukuphatha abantu nokubekezelelana. Ukugxila kukhasimende nokuqwalasela isikhathi sabathengi. Amakhono okuthumela imiyalezo kahle kokubili (okwenkomishi nokuqoshiwe). Ukubekezela kanye nokuziphatha ngokuzotha.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi unikeze izinsiza ezijwayelekile zokwesekwa kwezokubhalisa njengoku: Bhala, hlela, gcine, thwebula futhi ubuyisele imibhalo kanye nedatha. Khuma imibuzo ejwayelekile. Gcina futhi ulondoloze inqubo yokuqhweba amafayela. Thayipha izinhlamvu ezimfushane kanye/noma omunye umbhalo uma kudingeka. Qondisa futhi unikeze izinsiza zezokubhalisa ezinkundleni yokulethwa kwempahla njengoku: Xhumana nabahlangenwayo baphakathi nangaphandle mayelana nokuthenga impahla nezinsiza. Lawula isitokhwe samakheli ohhovisi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista yempahla. Hlela ukuhamba nokuhlala. Qondisa futhi unikeze izinsiza zezokubhalisa ekuqashweni kwabasebenzi njengoku: Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista yokuhamba kwabasebenzi, imibhalo yabasebenzi kanye nerejista yokwelunga. Qondisa futhi unikeze izinsiza zokuphatwa kwezimali njengoku: Thwebula futhi ubuyekeze izindleko. Hlola ukulunga kwamafomu e-subsistence and travel claims uwahambise kumphathi ukuba awamukele. Khuma amakhonti efoni kanye nemali yokuphila. Qondisa i-human resources / abasebenzi. Hlukanisa futhi uqiniseke ukuthi umsebenzi usuliqondo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Linganisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Faka isiyahlulela.

xh.title: Umlawuli wosoba lolawulo
xh.summary: Zoba ngakho eze kwaye uze unike iinkonzo zoluncedo kwizithuba, kuquka ukugcina iinkqubo zamafayile, ukulawula iinkqubo ezichanekileyo, ukungena kwamava emisebenzi kunye nolawulo loku Lungelelwaniso kwezinto ezithengiswa kwisebe le Department of Water and Sanitation e Uitkeer.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSikhundla samabanga aphakamileyo/ samabanga ali-12 okanye esilinganayo. Iimbonelelo ezichanekileyo zeminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kwenye (5) iminyaka. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi wobhala, iindlela zokwenza izinto kunye namandla okubhala ulwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokugcina iindaba zoluncedo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iimiyalelo yeZabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngendlela eziselwe nzimiso zokusebenza kwindawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lweenkqubo ezisebenzisa imali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, njl). Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo ezilawula ezikarhulumente. Ukuba nolwelo nzulu kuluntu, ukuguquguquka nokusebenza njengesiqhagma. Ulwazi olusisiseko nge-problem solving nokwahlulwahlula. Ukulawula abantu nabahlukileyo. Ukuzinikela nakulandela iimfuno zabaxhasi. Amandla okunxibelelana (nokuthetha nokubhala). Ukuba nenkathalo nokuziphatha ngokweenkqubo.
xh.duties: Zoba ngokusebenzisa iinkonzo zoluncedo kwindawo yokubhaliweyo, njengokubhala, ukulungiselela, ukugcina, ukufaka nakugcina ulwazi. Songa imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Gcina ulungelelwaniso lwamafayile. Bhala iileta ezisisiseko okanye ezinye iindaba xa kufuneka. Zoba ngokusebenzisa iinkonzo zoluncedo kwintengiso njengokuba nentsebenziswano nabantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuthengwa kwezinto nokwenziwa kwezinto. Lawula izinto zomsebenzi ezisetyenziswa. Gcina ukuLungelelwaniso kwempahla. Lungiselela ukuhamba nakulala. Zoba ngokusebenzisa iinkonzo zoluncedo kwabasebenzi njengokugcina, nokulawula ukubhaliswa kwabasebenzi, izikhulumi kunye nokuLungelelwaniso lokushiywa komsebenzi. Zoba ngokusebenzisa iinkonzo zoluncedo kwimali njengokubhala, nokuhlaziya iimali ezithengisiweyo. Pheqa ukuba zichanekile na iimali ezikhutshwayo n ezokuHamba, uze uzinike kulawuli ukuba azamkele. Lawula i-akhawunti ze-telefón kunye nemali encinci. Lawula abasebenzi. Wabelane imisebenzi uze uqinisekise ukuba yenzelwe kakuhle. Ukusasazwa kwamandla abasebenzi. Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Sebenzisa isohlwayo.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Clerk Production
jobs.summary: The Department of Water and Sanitation seeks a supply chain clerk to coordinate demand plans, conduct sourcing and manage inventory at its Bellville office.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate or equivalent qualification. Basic knowledge of supply chain duties, practices as well as ability to capture data, operate computer and collect statistics. Basic knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environments. Flexibility and teamwork. Basic knowledge of problem solving and Analysis. People and diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Good Communication skills both (verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Coordination of demand plans. Ensure that all procurement is in line with demand plans. Perform quarterly reviews to ensure procurement purchases are in line with demand. Conduct sourcing of quotations. Conduct inventory checks, administer goods receipts and goods issue. Ensure that all procurement is in line with prescribed legislation and regulations. Assist with procurement of price quotations, tenders, evaluation and adjudication. Effective management of controls and registers. Capturing of requisitions, orders, goods receipting and payments. Manage filing of Supply Chain Management documentation. Maintain registers for orders, payments and requisitions. Handle queries from suppliers and capture new suppliers onto the database. Maintain and administer stores. Recording, faxing, copying and filing of documentation. Render asset management clerical support. Render demand and acquisition clerical support. Render logistical support services. Assist with the compilation and maintenance of records according to Supply Chain Management (SCM) prescripts, e.g. procurement batches, goods received, asset verification, stocktaking and bar – cording of assets, courier services etc. Compile and maintain records e.g. asset records/database. Check and issue furniture, equipment and accessories to components and individuals. Identify redundant, non-serviceable and obsolete equipment for disposal. Verify asset register. Request and receive quotations. Place orders. Issue and receive bid documents. Provide secretariat or logistical support during the bid consideration and contracts conclusion processes. Compile draft documents as required. Receive requests for goods and services from end users. Place orders for goods and services. Receive and verify goods from suppliers. Capture goods and services receipt vouchers. Issue goods to end users. Process payments on SAP.

af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk Produksie
af.summary: Die Department of Water and Sanitation soek 'n voorsieningskettingklerk om vraagplanne te koördineer, bronverkryging te doen en voorraad by sy Bellville-kantoor te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Grade 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Basiese kennis van voorsieningskettingpligte, -praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bediene en statistiek te versamel. Basiese kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werkomgewings. Buigsaamheid en spanwerk. Basiese kennis van probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntgerigtheid en klasteufokus. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondelings en skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Koördinering van vraagplanne. Verseker dat alle verkryging in ooreenstemming met vraagplanne is. Voer kwartaallikse hersienings uit om te verseker dat verkrygingsaankope in ooreenstemming met die vraag is. Doen bronverkryging van kwotasies. Doen voorraadkontroles, administreer goedontvangste en goedafgifte. Verseker dat alle verkryging in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe wetgewing en regulasies is. Bystand met verkryging van pryskwotasies, tenders, evaluering en adjudikering. Effektiewe bestuur van kontroles en registers. Vastlegging van versoeke, bestellings, goedontvangste en betalings. Bestuur lêerwerk van Supply Chain Management-dokumentasie. Onderhou registers vir bestellings, betalings en versoeke. Hanteer navrae van verskaffers en lê nuwe verskaffers op die databasis vas. Onderhou en administreer winkels. Opteken, faks, kopieer en lê dokumentasie weg. Lewer batesbestuursklerklike bystand. Lewer vraag- en verkrygingsklerklike bystand. Lewer logistieke bystandsdienste. Bystand met die opstel en instandhouding van rekords volgens Supply Chain Management (SCM)-voorskrifte, bv. verkrygingslots, ontvangste goedere, batesverifikasie, voorraadopname en strepieskodering van bates, afleweringsdienste ens. Stel rekords op en onderhou dit bv. batesrekords/databasis. Kontroleer en reik meubels, toerusting en bybehore aan komponente en individue uit. Identifiseer oortollige, onbruikbare en verouderde toerusting vir beskikking. Verifieer batesregister. Versoek en ontvang kwotasies. Plaas bestellings. Reik en ontvang bieddokumente uit. Verskaf sekretariaats- of logistieke bystand tydens die bodoorwegings- en kontrakafsluitingsprosesse. Stel konsepdokumente op soos vereis. Ontvang versoeke vir goedere en dienste van eindgebruikers. Plaas bestellings vir goedere en dienste. Ontvang en verifieer goedere van verskaffers. Lê goedere- en diensteontvangsbons vas. Reik goedere aan eindgebruikers uit. Verwerk betalings op SAP.

zu.title: Umhloli Wezinsiza Zokuhlinzeka Nokulethwa Kwezimpahla Kwezinkalo
zu.summary: I-Department of Water and Sanitation ifuna umhloli wezinsiza zokuhlinzeka nokulethwa kwezimpahla ongaxhumana namaphulani ezidingo, enze ukutholwa kwemithombo yokuletha kanye nokuphathwa kwemitapo yezimpahla esikhungweni sayo eBellville.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Senior/Grade 12 noma iziqu ezalinganayo. Ukwazi okuyisisekelo ngemisebenzi yezinsiza zokuhlinzeka nokulethwa kwezimpahla, izindlela zokwenza kanye namandla okungena idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibalo. Ukwazi okuyisisekelo ngemigomo yomsebenzi maqondana nendawo yokusebenza. Ukuguquguquka nokusebenza ndawonye. Ukwazi okuyisisekelo ngokusombulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokohlukahluka kwezinhlanga. Ukuqondiswa ngomthengi nogqoza komthengi. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle womlomo nombhalo. Ukwazwa nokuziphatha ngokwesimilo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa amaphulani ezidingo. Qinisekisa ukuthi konke ukuthengwa kwempahla kuhambisana namaphulani ezidingo. Yenza ukubuyekezwa kwamakota ukugqinisekisa ukuthi okuthengiwe kuhambisana nezidingo. Yenza ukutholwa kwemithombo yamaxaxa. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwemitapo yezimpahla, uphathwe ukwamukelwa nokukhishwa kwezimpahla. Qinisekisa ukuthi konke ukuthengwa kwempahla kuhambisana nomthetho nokumiswa kwemithetho ebalulekile. Siza ekuthengeni amaxaxa, izitendeni, ukuhlola nokwehlulelwa. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kokulawula nokubhaliswa. Ukungena kokuadingekayo, izioda, ukwamukelwa kwezimpahla nokuNikela. Phatha ukugcina kwemibhalo ye-Supply Chain Management. Gcina ukubhaliswa kwezioda, izinkokhelo nezinto eziyisiyalo. Phathela imibuzo emvela kubanikazi bempahla faka abanikazi abasha kusizi data. Gcina kuphathwe izitolo. Ukurekhoda, ukufaksa, ukukhophya nokugcina imibhalo. Nikeza usizo lokuqukethwe ekuphathweni kwempahla. Nikeza usizo lokuqukethwe ezidingweni nasekutholeni impahla. Nikeza usizo lokuletha izinto. Siza ekwakheni nasekugcineni imibhalo ngokusho kwezimiso ze-Supply Chain Management (SCM), isb. ukuthengwa ngamaqoqo, ukwamukelwa kwezimpahla, ukuqinisekiswa kwempahla, ukuqhotsa izinto nokwebha kwezimpahla, izinsiza zokuthumela ngenwebhu njll. Hlela futhi ugcine imibhalo isb. imibhalo/izizi data yempahla. Hlola futhi ukhulule izinto zobhalwe, amadivayisi nezokuhlobiswa kumagatsha nabantu. Bonisa izinto ezingasetshenziswa, ezingasebenzi namadivayisi aseduze nasesikhathini ukuze zikhishwe. Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa kwempahla. Cela futhi wamukele amaxaxa. Beka izioda. Khulule futhi wamukele imibhalo yezitende. Nikeza usizo lwezinsiza zikasobala noma lokuletha ngesikhathi kucatshangelwa izitende futhi kuqedwe imigoqo. Hlela imibhalo eyidrafu njengoba kudingeka. Yamukele izicelo zezimpahla nezinsiza ezivela kubasebenzisi. Beka izioda ngezimpahla nezinsiza. Yamukela futhi uqinisekise izimpahla ezivela kubanikazi. Faka amavawusha okwamukelwa kwezimpahla nezinsiza. Khulula izimpahla kubasebenzisi. Libaza izinkokhelo kwi-SAP.

xh.title: Iclerko yokuLawula iQela leMnini-simas ekwenziweni
xh.summary: Isebe lezeManzi nokuTsala kuFunza lifuna igosa leqela lomnini-simas ukuba lingqwengqwele iicwangciso zefuno, lenze ukuqokelela kwamaxabiso liphathe uluhlu lwempahla kwindlu yalo esase Bellville.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSikhundi / seGredi 12 okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo. Isazima esisekelo seemisebenzi yokuLawula Iqela leMnini-simas, iindlela zokwenza, kunye namandla okubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kunye nokuqokelela izibalo. Isazima esisekelo seendlela zokusebenza ngokwemizekelo yemisebenzi. Ukuguqu-guquka nokusebenza njengesiqhenga. Isazima esisekelo sexa ngokubaluleka kwengxaki nokuqonda ngokummi. Ulawulo labantu nolwahlulohlulo. Imbonakalo yabathengi kulwa baxhasi. Amandla okunxibelelana okukhulu (kokuthetha nokubhala). Ukuziphendulela nokuziphatha ngendlela ethile.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa iicwangciso zefuno. Qinisekisa ukuba konke ukuthengwa kuhambelana neecwangciso zefuno.enza iingqibo zenyanga ezintathu ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukuthengwa kuhambelana nefuno.enza ukulinganisela kwamaxabiso.enza iindwendwe zoluhlu lwempahla, ulawule ukufumana kwempahla nokuphumiswa kwempahla. Qinisekisa ukuba konke ukuthengwa kuhambelana nemithetho ecwangqisiweyo nemimiselo. Nceda ukuthengwa kwamaxabiso, amaxabiso okuletywa, ulungelelwaniso nokunqunyuliswa. Ulawulo olusebenzayo lwesixhobo somlawulo nokubhalisa. Ukubhalisa iicelo, iodolo, ukufumanisa impahla nokuhlawula. Lawula ukugcina iifayile zoxwebhu lokuLawula Kweqela leMnini-simas. Gcina ukubhalisa kwee-odolo, iintlawulo neecele. Phatha imibuzo evela kubanikazi bempahla ubale abanikazi abasha kwidatabase. Gcina ulawule iindawo zokugcina impahla. Ukubhalisa, ukuthumela ngefax, ukukopa nokugcina iifayile zoxwebhu. Yinkqubo yokwenza inkqubo yokulawula impahla. Yinkqubo yokwenza inkqubo yefuno nokuqokelela. Yinkqubo yokwenza iinkonzo zokulawula. Nceda nokuqokelela nokugcina iirekhodi ngokwezikhokelo zeNkonzo yeLawulo leQela leMnini-simas (SCM), umzekelo amaqela okuthengwa, impahla efunyenweyo, ukuqinisekiswa kwempahla, ukuqhutywa kwesitokhwe kunye nokubhaliswa kweekhodi zempahla, iinkonzo zokuthumela impahla, njl. Qokelela ulugcina iirekhodi, umzekelo iirekhodi/idatabase yempahla. Khangela uphume iyanitsho, izixhobo nezinto ezongezelelweyo kumacandelo nabantu. Chonga izixhobo ezingasafunekiyo, ezingasebenziyo namadala azange athengiswe. Qinisekisa irekhodi yempahla. Cela ufumane amaxabiso. Faka iiodolo. Phume uze ufumane amaxwebhu okuletywa. Yiba nomsekisi okanye inkxaso yamava ngesikhathi kunqunyulwa amaxabiso kuphelwe iinkontraki. Qamba iixwebhu ezisemva kwesiqu njengoko kufuneka. Yamkela iicelo zemihla yonke ngezenzo evela kubasebenzisi bokusuku. Faka iiodolo zemihla yonke ngezenzo. Yamkela uqinisekise impahla evela kubanikazi. Bala iinkqubo zemihla yonke ngezenzo. Phuma impahla kubasebenzisi. Qhuba iintlawulo kwi-SAP.

jobs.title: Maintenance Vehicle Operator
jobs.summary: Operate and maintain specialised heavy plant and vehicles, conducting daily roadworthy inspections and ensuring timeous servicing at the Breede/Gouritz office in Worcester.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 4. The disclosure of a valid Code EC /EC1 (or equivalent) unexpired driver’s license with valid PDP. Certified competency /operating certificate or relevant heavy plant/ machinery. At least five (5) years’ experience in driving heavy motor vehicles and operating heavy equipment. Traffic and road safety regulations. Mechanical knowledge of heavy vehicles and machinery. Occupational Health Safety (OHS). Basic knowledge of departmental transport policies and procedures. Basic record keeping and reporting procedures. Good Communication skills both (verbal and written). Attention to details and alertness. Problem solving in operational environments. Ability to work under pressure and in adverse weather/site conditions. Integrity and discretion.
jobs.duties: Responsible for conducting quality assurance of driver/operator systems. Operate specialized plant/ equipment. Implement best practice of driver/operator systems. Responsible for daily roadworthy inspections. Responsible for ensuring that vehicles are serviced on time. Analyze logistics operations. Transportation of work teams and materials/ equipment. Collection of goods at suppliers and department stores. Maintenance of registering department and pickups. Function in accordance with applicable legislative requirements. Detect and repair minor mechanical problems on the vehicles/ equipment and take steps to have it repaired. Report major defects for repairs. Routine maintenance of equipment. Conduct routine inspection of visible defects around the exterior of the equipment and vehicles. Attend to special requests. Recording of daily trips, fuel and fluids levels and logbooks for both vehicles and equipment. Periodic checks on vehicles maintenance standards. Ensure that the place is clean, where equipment is kept avoiding fire hazards. Adherence to Safety and procedures: ensure the safekeeping of equipment and vehicles. Assist with maintenance work at gauging stations. Assist with refurbishment and construction work at gauging stations. Assist civil teams with civil maintenance and construction work of Government Water schemes infrastructure. Use of handheld tools and power tools during construction work.

af.title: Onderhoudsvoertuigoperateur
af.summary: Bedryf en onderhou spesialisde swaar masjinerie en voertuie, voer daaglikse padwaardigheidsinspeksies uit en verseis tydige onderhoud by die Breede/Gouritz-kantoor in Worcester.
af.requirements: 'n NQF level 4. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige Code EC/EC1 (of gelykwaardige) onverstreke bestuurderslisensie met 'n geldige PDP. Gesertifiseerde bevoegdheids-/bedryfsertifikaat of relevante swaar masjinerie. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die bestuur van swaar motorvoertuie en die bedryf van swaar toerusting. Verkeer- en padveiligheidsregulasies. Meganiese kennis van swaar voertuie en masjinerie. Occupational Health Safety (OHS). Basiese kennis van departementele vervoerbeleid en prosedures. Basiese rekordhouding en verslagdoeningsprosedures. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik). Aandag aan besonderhede en waaksaamheid. Probleemoplossing in operasionele omgewings. Vermoë om onder druk en in ongunstige weers-/terreintoestande te werk. Integriteit en diskresie.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die uitvoer van gehalteversekering van bestuurder/operateurstelsels. Bedryf gespesialiseerde masjinerie/toerusting. Implementering van beste praktyke van bestuurder/operateurstelsels. Verantwoordelik vir daaglikse padwaardigheidsinspeksies. Verantwoordelik om te verseker dat voertuie betyds diens ontvang. Analiseer logistieke bedrywighede. Vervoer van werkspanne en materiaal/toerusting. Insameling van goedere by verskaffers en departementwinkels. Onderhoud van registrasie van departement en aflewerings. Funksioneer in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewende vereistes. Opmerk en herstel klein meganiese probleme aan die voertuie/toerusting en neem stappe om dit te laat herstel. Rapporteer groot gebreke vir herstelwerk. Roetineonderhoud van toerusting. Voer roetine-inspeksie uit vir sigbare gebreke rondom die buitekant van die toerusting en voertuie. aandag aan spesiale versoeke. Registrering van daaglikse ritte, brandstof-en vloeistofvlakke en logboeke vir beide voertuie en toerusting. Periodeke ondersoeke op voertuie se onderhoudstandaarde. Verseker dat die plek skoon is waar toerusting gehou word om brandgevaar te vermy. Nakoming van veiligheids- en prosedures: verseker die veilige bewaring van toerusting en voertuie. Bystand met onderhoudswerk by peilstasies. Bystand met opknapping en konstruksiewerk by peilstasies. Bystand aan siviele spanne met siviele onderhoud en konstruksiewerk van Staatswaterskema-infrastruktuur. Gebruik van handgereedskap en kraggereedskap tydens konstruksiewerk.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wesithuthi Sokugcina
zu.summary: Okusebenza kanye nokugcina izitsha eziyisikhwama ezinzima namathrekhi ezithize, ukwenza ukubuyekezwa okuphephile komgwaqo nsuku zonke futhi kuqinisekiswe ukukhonza ngasikhathi sioffice yakwa-Breede/Gouritz eWorcester.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 4. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokushayela ekhona engeke iphelelwe isikhathi ye-Code EC/EC1 (noma efanayo) ene-PDP esebenzayo. Isitifikedi sokukhono/isitifiketi sokusebenza noma isisetshenzwa esinzima esihambisanayo. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yohlu lwemisebenzi ekushayeni izithuthi ezinzima zomoto futhi ekusebenziseni izisetshenzwa ezinzima. Imithethonqubo yokuphepha kumagumbi nakuwo wonke umgwaqo. Ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe emithethanweni namathrekhi namasetshenzwa. I-Occupational Health Safety (OHS). Ulwazi olusaningi lwemithethonqubo yezithuthi komnyango nendlela yokwenza izinto. Izindlela ezisaningi zokugcina amarekhodi nokubika. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (aphuma emlonyeni nakubhalwe). Ukuqaphela izinkomba nokuba nozwelo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ezindaweni zokusebenza. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokucindezela futhi emiminisizweni engemihle yezulu noma esikhwameni. Ukuqotho nokuzigaba.
zu.duties: Ubhekele ukwenza ukulolonga khona uhlelo olusebenzayo lomshayeli/umsebenzisi. Ukuqasha izitsha/izisetshenzwa ezithize. Ukufaka endleleni okuhle kakhulu kohlelo lomshayeli/umsebenzisi. Ubhekele ukubuyekezwa okuphephile komgwaqo nsuku zonke. Ubhekele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izithuthi zikhonza ngasikhathi. Ukwenza isilinganiso kwimisebenzi yokuqhathanisa izinto. Ukuthuthatha amaqembu okusebenza namaphakethe /amathrekhi. Ukuthola amafutha kubanikezi bempahla nakuqhagamishelo lwemphahla lakomnyango. Ukwenza okuhlobene nokubhalisa komnyango futhi nasekuhlaleni izithuthi. Ukusebenza ngendlela ekuhambisana nezidingo ezithile zemithetho. Ukuqapha nokulungisa izinkinga ezincane zezobuchwepheshe ezithuthini/izisetshenzwa bese uthatha izinyathelo zokuthi zilungiswe. Ukubika izikweletelo ezinkulu ezidinga ukulungiswa. Ukugcinwa kokujwayelekile kwesisetshenzwa. Ukuqapha ngokujwayelekile ukubona izikweletelo ezingaphandle kwezisetshenzwa nezithuthi. Ukuphendula izicelo ezithize. Ukubhalwa kwamagama ohambahambayo nsuku zonke, amazinga amafutha kanye namabhukwemu atholakala ezithuthini nasezisethenzini. Ukubuyekezwa okuphephile ngokujwayelekile emazingeni okugcina izithuthi. Ukugcina izindawo zokugcina zicoce kuye nasezibambele ukuthi kusindwe izinsimbi ezingaba yingozi emlilweni. Ukulandela imithethonqubo yokuphepha: ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa okuphephile kwamathrekhi namasetshenzwa. Ukusiza emsebenzini wokugcina emayini eGauging stations. Ukusiza emsebenzini wokubuyisela okusha nasezimeni zokwakha emayini eGauging stations. Ukusiza amaqembu abasebenza imisebenzi emphakathi futhi ukwakhe emaphoyintini okuqasha eGovernment Water schemes. Ukusebenzisa amathuluzi okubamba ngesandla namathuluzi anamandla kwakha kwezempahla.

xh.summary: Ukwenza kwaye ulungiselele izityalo ezithile ezinkunzi nezithuthi, ukuqhubelela phambili iinkonzo zakuqinisekisa ukulungele ukuhamba kwendlela nsuku zonke, kuqinisekise ukuba nenkozo yesixhobo ixesha elichanekileyo kwiofisi yase Breede/Gouritz e Worcester.
xh.requirements: NQF level 4. Inikezelo lwelayisense yokushaya ithanga ekusebenzayo ethi Code EC/EC1 (okanye efanayo) engaphelelwa lixesha elinamapaspoti avunyiweyo (PDP). Isatifikethi sokuzipatha / isatifikethi sokusebenza okanye impahla/matshini ezisindayo ezifanelekileyo. Ubuncinane ihlathi (5) leminyaka yamava ekushayeni izithuthi ezisindayo kwaye esebenzisa impahla ezisindayo. Imigaqo yokhuseleko yethrafikhi nendlela. Ulwazi lomatshini malunga nezithuthi nempahla ezisindayo. Isebe loKhuseleko lweMisebenzi (OHS). Ulwazi olusisiseko lwemigaqo-siseko yothutho lwesebe neenqubo. Iinkqubo ezisisiseko zokugcina irekhodi nokubika. Amandla okuthetha nabantu ngokubhaliswa nangokuthethwa. Ukunakela iinkcukacha nokuba buhlwenguzela. Ukusombulula iingxaki kwindawo yokusebenza. Amandla okusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo nakuloo maxa angathandwayo /iimeko zendawo. Ukuzithoba nokugcina imfihlo.
xh.duties: Ubekiwe ekwenzeni isiqiniseko sokulunga kweenqubo zomqhubi/umsebenzisi. Ukusebenzisa izixhobo ezithile/impahla. Ukusebenzisa iindlela ezilonelayo kweenqubo zomqhubi/umsebenzisi. Ubekiwe ekwenzeni iinkonzo zokuqinisekisa ukulungele umgama wendlela nsuku zonke. Ubekiwe kuqinisekiso ukuba izithuthi zihluzwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukuphonononga imisebenzi yokuhamba. Ukuthutha iinqwele zomsebenzi nezinto/impahla. Ukuqokelela izinto kubaphengi nakuivenkilekuni zesebe. Ukugcina irekhodi lokubhalisa kwisebe nasekuthathweni kwezinto. Ukusebenza ngokwemigaqo-siseko efunekayo. Ukuqapha kulungiswe iingxaki ezincinci zomatshini kwiisithuthi/impahla kwaye athathwe iinyathelo zokuzilungisa. Ukubika iziphene ezinkulu ezifuna ukulungiswa. Ukulungiswa okwamaxesha onke kweempahla. Ukuqhelisa ukuqapha iziphene eziphaphathileyo ejikeleze ngaphandle kweempahla nasezithuthini. Ukuphendla iimfuno ezithile. Ukugcina irekhodi lezithuthi zemihla ngemihla, amafutha kunye namazinga oketshezi nakumanqaku okuhamba kwezithuthi naye impahla. Ukuhlola amaxesha onke amanqanaba okugcina izithuthi. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba indawo ihlanjiweyo apho kugcinwa khona impahla, kuvalwe amaxhoba omlilo. Ukuzinikela kwiinkqubo zoKhuseleko: ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa okukhuselekileyo kweempahla nezithuthi. Ukuncedisa nomsebenzi wokulungiswa kwiisikhululo zokuqikelela. Ukuncedisa nomsebenzi wokulungiswa nokwakha kwiisikhululo zokuqikelela. Ukuncedisa amaqela abasebenzi bezolwandle kunye nomsebenzi wokulungiswa nokwakha kolwandle kwezakhiwo zelwabiwo lwamanzi looRhulumente. Ukusebenzisa izixhobo zesandla namandla ngelixa kukho umsebenzi wokwakha.

Five (5) years of experience at a Senior Managerial level (within financial management) Pre Entry SMS or Nyukela Certificate is compulsory and will be required prior appointment. Oversee budget preparation process and budget monitoring for the department. Oversee the final draft budget preparation process and provide support to internal stakeholders’ prior submission. Manage compilation and implementation of monthly forecasts. Oversee compilation and timely submission of monthly, quarterly and annual financial performance reports and provide recommendations and advice programmes to address significant variances. Ensure financial statements are submitted timeously in accordance with applicable standards and legislative requirements. Oversee provisioning Financial Accounting and Administration Services: Ensure development, monitoring and implementation of financial administration and accounting policies, systems and processes. Ensure the management of salary payments and rebates. Ensure the management of expenditure and general payments services. Oversee expenditure control systems to prevent over/under- expenditure and unauthorized, irregular, fruitless and wasteful expenditure (UIFW). Ensure provision of asset liability and debt management services. Oversee development, implementation, and monitoring of revenue management frameworks, systems, and processes to ensure effective billing, collection, and accounting of revenue generated by the department. Ensure management and provisioning of bookkeeping and financial accounting services. Oversee the provisioning of supply chain and asset management services: Oversee the development and monitoring on the implementation of supply chain management internal policies, systems and processes. Ensure the management of demand management services. Manage the provision of asset management services. Manage rendering services to and advise internal units with regards to demand and acquisition of services and goods. Ensure sound provisioning of supply and logistics management services. Ensure sound management and provisioning of procurement performance and compliance monitoring services. Ensure management of assets and fleet management services. Ensure accuracy, completeness and validity of financial reporting on departmental assets and accurate departmental asset register. Ensure the provision of internal control and compliance management services: Manage coordination on the implementation of audit recommendations. Oversee management of Fraud and loss in the department. Oversee management of Fraud Prevention. Ensure implementation of governance framework across the department. Ensure compliance monitoring in relation to policies, processes and procedures. Ensure implementation of corrective measures and preventative controls in respect of all financial risk and audit findings as per reports of the Auditor General and Internal Audit Unit. Ensure monitoring of operations on accounting systems, controls and procedures to ensure the integrity of financial information. Promote good corporate governance. Employee Performance: implementation and monitoring of the policy focused priorities as pronounced in the Departmental Policy Speech, Promote intergovernmental relations, integrated governance and sound stakeholder relationship, Management of Provincial transversal programs, Facilitation of minimum information security standards (MISS) and overall accountability of the Department. Key Government Focus Arears: Develop and implement an effective and efficient supply chain management system, Support international and regional integration programmes and commitments, Promote diversity and Transformation management Priorities, Promoted integrated Governance. Auditor General: Focus on the measurement of the extent of the departmental financial and legislative compliance, Ensure no material findings on non-compliance with legislation, Ensure financial statement is free from material misstatements. Organizational Performance: Ensure the development, implementation and review of the Departmental Strategic Imperatives, Focus on assessing the organizational performance based on the predetermined targets in the Annual Performance Plan, Ensure the audited Annual Report (AR) will be used to establish the extent in which the objective in the APP has been achieved.

Resultate / Kwaliteitsbestuur, Besluitneming, Kennisbestuur, Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare diens regeer, Begrip en toepassing van die volgende voorskrifte: Public Finance Management Act, DORA, Tesourie-regulasies, Tesourie/Praktyknotas, Tesourie- & DPSA-omsendbriewe, Algemene Rekeningkundige Beginsels (GRAP), SCM-riglyne en -raamwerke, Begrip van Finansiële Bestuur se beste praktyke, Finansiële Bestuurstelsels (PERSAL, BAS & LOGIS). Begrotingsamestelling en -beheer, finansiële verslagdoening en oudit-koördinasie, risikobestuur en interne beheer, infrastruktuurbefondsingsraamwerke en finansiële modellering, regeringsprogramme, inligtingsbestuur, burgerlike fokus en reaksievermoë, ontwikkeling van ander, toegepaste tegnologie-grondbeginsels, toegepaste strategiese denke, mensebestuur, netwerking en die bou van bande, diversiteitsbestuur, verslagskrywing, rekenaargeletterdheid, onderhandeling, kommunikasie en inligtingsbestuur, aanbieding, analities, begroting en finansiële bestuur, projek/bestuur, strategiese bestuur, motiverings-, konflikhantering / probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Oorsien die bestuur en voorsiening van bestuursrekeningkundige dienste: Verseker toepaslike bestuur, beplanning en samestelling van die MTEF-begroting en aanpassingsramings vir die departement. Oorsien die begrotingsvoorbereidingsproses en begrotingsmonitering vir die departement. Oorsien die finale konsep-begrotingsvoorbereidingsproses en verskaf ondersteuning aan interne belanghebbendes voor indiening. Bestuur die samestelling en implementering van maandelikse vooruitskattings. Oursien samestelling en tydige indiening van maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse finansiële prestasieverslae en verskaf aanbevelings en adviesprogramme om beduidende afwykings aan te spreek. Verseker dat finansiële state betyds ingedien word in ooreenstemming met toepaslike standaarde en wetgewende vereistes. Oorsien die voorsiening van Finansiële Rekeningkunde en Administratiewe Dienste: Verseker die ontwikkeling, monitering en implementering van finansiële administratiewe en rekeningkundige beleide, stelsels en prosesse. Verseker die bestuur van salarisbetalings en terugbetalings. Verseker die bestuur van besteding en algemene betaaldienste. Oorsien bestedingsbeheerstelsels om oor-/onderbesteding en ongemagtigde, onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en vermorsende besteding (UIFW) te voorkom. Verseker die voorsiening van bateskuld- en skuldbestuursdienste. Oorsien die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van inkomste-bestuursraamwerke, stelsels en prosesse om doeltreffende fakturering, invordering en rekeningkunde van inkomste wat deur die departement gegenereer word, te verseker. Verseker die bestuur en voorsiening van boekhoud- en finansiële rekeningkundige dienste. Oorsien die voorsiening van voorsieningsketting- en batesbestuursdienste: Oorsien die ontwikkeling en monitering van die implementering van interne beleide, stelsels en prosesse vir voorsieningskettingbestuur. Verseker die bestuur van vraagbestuursdienste. Bestuur die voorsiening van batesbestuursdienste. Bestuur die lewer van dienste aan en adviseer interne eenhede met betrekking tot die vraag en verkryging van dienste en goedere. Verseke goeie voorsiening van voorraad- en logistieke bestuursdienste. Verseker goeie bestuur en voorsiening van inkoopprestasie- en nakomingsmoniteringsdienste. Verseker die bestuur van bates- en vlootbestuursdienste. Verseker akkuraatheid, volledigheid en geldigheid van finansiële verslagdoening oor departementele bates en 'n akkurate departementele batesregister. Verseker die voorsiening van interne beheer- en nakomingsbestuursdienste: Bestuur die koördinasie van die implementering van ouditaanbevelings. Oorsien die bestuur van Bedrog en verlies in die departement. Oorsien die bestuur van Bedrogvoorkoming. Verseker die implementering van 'n bestuursraamwerk oor die hele departement. Verseker nakomingsmonitering met betrekking tot beleide, prosesse en prosedures. Verseker die implementering van korrigerende maatreëls en preventiewe beheer ten opsigte van alle finansiële risiko's en ouditbevindings volgens verslae van die Auditor General en die Interne Oudit-eenheid. Verseker die monitering van bedrywighede op rekeningkundige stelsels, beheer en prosedures om die integriteit van finansiële inligting te verseker. Bevorder goeie korporatiewe bestuur. Werknemerprestasie: implementering en monitering van die beleidsgefokte prioriteite soos uitgespreek in die Departementele Beleidstoekspraak, Bevorder interregeringsverhoudinge, geïntegreerde bestuur en goeie belanghebbende verhoudings, Bestuur van provinsiale transversale programme, Fasilitering van minimum inligtingsekuriteitsstandaarde (MISS) en algehele verantwoordelikheid van die departement. Kern Regeringsfokusareas: Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n doeltreffende en doeltroude voorsieningskettingbestuurstelsel, Ondersteun internasionale en streeksintegrasieprogramme en -verpligtinge, Bevorder diversiteit en Transformasie-bestuursprioriteite, Bevorder geïntegreerde bestuur. Auditor General: Fokus op die meting van die mate van departementele finansiële en wetgewende nakoming, Verseker geen wesenlike bevindings oor nie-nakoming van wetgewing nie, Verseker dat die finansiële staat vry is van wesenlike misstellings. Organisatoriese Prestasie: Verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering en hersiening van die Departementele Strategiese Imperatiewe, Fokus op die assessering van die organisatoriese prestasie gebaseer op die voorafbepaalde teikens in die Annual Performance Plan, Verseker dat die geouditeerde Annual Report (AR) gebruik sal word om die mate waarin die doelwit in die APP bereik is, vas te stel.

zu.title: Umphathi Oholiwe: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali
zu.summary: Umphathi Oholiwe Wokuphathwa Kwezimali eBisho, oqapha ukuphathwa kokuqoshwa kwezimali, ukuhlanganiswa kwebhajethi ye-MTEF nokulalelwa kwebhajethi kwi Department of Public Works & Infrastructure.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate yezwe, I-Bachelor's Degree kwi-B.Com, Ukuphathwa Kokuqoshwa Kwezimali, Ukuphathwa Kwezimali (I-NQF L7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA, ukuthweswa iziqu ngemuva kokuqedwa kweziqu ezezimali nokwenza izinkomba kuzoba yithuba elingeziwe. Amnyaka amahlanu (5) wokuqashwa ezingeni lomphathi ophakeme (ngaphakathi kokuphathwa kwezimali). Isitifiketi se-Pre Entry SMS noma se-Nyukela sididayo futhi sizodingeka ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ulayisense otholile wokushayela. Ulwazi Namakhono: Umthetho nemithetho ehlobene nale ndaba. Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango ezihlobene nale ndaba. Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi. Umthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi. Ukuphathwa Kwezinga Lemiphumela/Khwalithi, Ukwenza Izinqumo, Ukuphathwa Kolwazi, Ulwazi nokuqonda umsakazo womthetho ohola isevisi yomphakathi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imithetho elandelayo: Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, i-DORA, imithetho ye-Treasury, ama-Treasury/Practice Notes, ama-Treasury & DPSA Circulars, Izimiso Ezijwayelekile Zokuqoshwa Kwezimali (GRAP), Izinkomba Namaphu Wokuqasha Izimpahla (SCM), ukuqonda amasu ahamba phambili okuphathwa kwezimali, Amasistimu Okuphathwa Kwezimali (PERSAL, BAS & LOGIS). Ukuhlanganiswa nokulawula ibhajethi, ukubika ngemali kanye nokuhlanganisa isibuyekezo, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nezilawulo zangaphakathi, amaphu wokuxhaswa kwezinsimbi kanye nokuqashwa kwemali, amaphukahle ahulumeni, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukunaka futhi uphendule izakhamuzi, ukuthuthukisa abanye, izisekelo zobuchwepheshe, ukucabanga ngokusobala mayelana nenhinhlabo, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuxhumanisa nokuakha ubuhlobo, ukuphathwa kobunye, ukubhala imibiko, ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ukuxoxisana, ukuxhumana nokuphathwa kolwazi, ukubukhonisa, ukuhlaziya, ibhajethi nokuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa/ukuhlela amaphrojekthi, ukuphathwa ngokusobala, ukukhuthaza, ukuxazulula izingxubevange/izinkinga.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuphathwa nokunikezwa kwezinkomba zokuqoshwa kwezimali: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukuhlela nokuhlanganiswa kwebhajethi ye-MTEF kanye nokulinganiswa okushintshiwe kwezimali eziyisilinganiso zomnyango. Qapha inqubo yokulungiselela ibhajethi nokulalelwa kwebhajethi komnyango. Qapha inqubo yokulungiselela isibuyekezo esigcinwe ngokuphelele bese unika inkxaso abaphathi baphakathi ngaphambi kokuhumusha. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa nokusetshenziswa kokuqagela kwanyanga zonke. Qapha ukuhlanganiswa nokuhumushwa ngokuvimba imibiko yemveliso yezimali yanyanga zonke, yenyanga yamathathu kanye neminyaka yonke, bese unikeza izincomo nenkezo mayelana nezinhlelo zokuqeda ukwehluka okubalulekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi izitatimende zezimali zihumushwa ngokuvimba ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso ezifanele nezidingo zomthetho. Qapha ukunikezwa kwezinkomba zokuqoshwa kwezimali Nesevisi Yokuphathwa: Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukulalelwa kanye nokusebenziswa kwezinqubomgomo, amasistimu kanye nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezimali nokuqoshwa kwezimali. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinkokhelo zamaholo namasontiphu. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimali ezikhokhiwe nezinkokhelo ezijwayelekile. Qaphela amasistimu wokulawula izimali ezikhokhiwe ukuze kuvindele ukukhokhelwa kwezimali ngaphezulu/ngaphansi kanye nezimali ezingavunyelwe, ezingajwayelekile, ezingatholakali kanye nezimali ezingela nsipho (UIFW). Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinkomba zokuphathwa kwemitshwana nemikhonto yenzani. Qapha ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, nokulalelwa kwamaphu wokuphathwa lemali engenayo, amasistimu, kanye nezinqabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imali ekhokhiwa iqoqwa futhi iqoshwe ngokuphumelelayo umnyango. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa nokunikezwa kwezinkomba zobuchwepheshe bezezimali. Qapha ukunikezwa kwezinkomba zokuqashwa kwempahla namasistimu wokuphathwa: Qapha ukuthuthukiswa nokulalelwa kusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo zangaphakathi zokuqashwa kwempahla, amasistimu kanye nezinqubo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinkomba zokuqashwa kwempahla ecelayo. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinkomba zokuphathwa kwempahla. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinkomba kanye nenkxaso kumayunithi angaphakathi mayelana nezinkinga zokuqashwa nokuthola izimpahla. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa okuhle kwezinkomba wokuphathwa kwezimpahla. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle nokunikezwa kwezinkomba zokulalela kwezinkokhelo ngokuvumelana nezinqubo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwempahla nezinkomba zokuqashwa kwezimoto. Qinisekisa ukunemba, ukugcwaliswa nokusebenza kobuni imibiko yezimali ngempahla yomnyango, namagama empahla esikhundla. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinkomba zokulawula zangaphakathi nokulalela ukuvumelana nezinqubomgomo: Phatha ukuhlelwa kokusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezingezinhle. Qapha ukuphathwa kwamaphiliso nezimpahla zomnyango. Qapha ukuphathwa kokuvindezelwa kwamaphiliso. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwesakhiwo sokuhola kulo lonke umnyango. Qinisekisa ukulalela ukuvumelana kwezinqubomgomo, izinqobo nezinqubo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinyathelo zokulungisa izinto kanye nokulawula ukuvimbela kumazinga wonke ezingcuphe ezingezimali nemibhoko yamaphiliso njengoba kubhaliwe emibikweni yoMphathi Jikelele kanye neYunithi Yokuqapha Yangaphakathi. Qinisekisa ukulalelwa kwezinto ezisenziwa kumasistimu obuchwepheshe bezezimali, izilawulo nezinqabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubunemba bolwazi lwemali. Khuthaza ukuphathwa okuhle kwezinhlangano. Ukusebenza Kwabasebenzi: ukusetshenziswa nokulalelwa kwezidingo ezibalulekile eziqondiswe kwezinqubomgomo njengoba kuchazwe Inkulumo Yezinqubomgomo Yomnyango, ukuthuthukisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwahulumene, ukuphathwa okuhlanganisiwe kanye nobuhlobo obuhle nabaphathi, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zohulumbe zesifundazwe, ukwenza kusebenze izindinganiso zokuvikeleka kolwazi (MISS) kanye nekhono eliphelele lomnyango. Izindawo Eziphathi Isikhathi Kahulumeni: Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise isistimu esebenzayo yokuphathwa kokuqashwa kwempahla, xhasa izinhlelo zobudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe naso sonke isifunda kanye nemithefulo, khuthaza ukubanzi kanye nokuphathwa kokuguqula kwezidingo, khuthaza ukuphathwa okuhlangene. UMphathi Jikelele: Gxila ekulinganiseni izinga elibekiwe lokuvumelana komnyango nemithetho ezezimali, qinisekisa ukuthi abukho mbiko obubalulekile ngenxa yokungalaleli umthetho, qinisekisa ukuthi izitatimende zezimali azinawo ukuphikisana okubalulekile. Ukusebenza Kwezinhlangano: Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa nokubuyekeza izigaba eziyisibusiso Zomnyango, gxila ekuqoqeni imikhiqizo yomnyango ngokwezinhloso ezibekiwe eNdkhleni Yomnyaka Yokusebenza, qinisekisa ukuthi iSibuyekezo Somnyaka (AR) esihlolwe kuzosetshenziselwa ukubeka izinga lokuthi izinhloso e-APP zifezwe njengani.

jobs.title: Director: Property Management
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Lead provincial expense lease portfolio and property management strategy for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Bisho.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, B Degree/B SC in Property Studies/Real Estate (NQF level 7 as recognized by SAQA) with 5-years of experience at Middle/ Senior Managerial level. Pre-entry certificate for the Senior Management Service (Nyukela) is compulsory and will be required prior appointment. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge and Skills: In-depth knowledge and understanding of legislative framework that governs the Public Service, In-depth knowledge and understanding of National and Provincial Property legislation, Regulations and Policies. Understanding of public sector governance framework, compliance and accountability mechanisms, In-depth knowledge, understanding and application of GIAMA. Expertise in lease management, state land administration, property valuations and asset optimisation strategies. In-depth knowledge of and understanding of Public Finance Management Act. Applicable legislation and Prescripts. Government Programmes. Information Management. Citizen Focus and Responsiveness. Develop Others. Applied Technology Basics. People Management. Applied Strategic Thinking. Networking and Building Bonds. Diversity Management. Report Writing. Communication and Information Management. Negotiations. Analytica. Strategic Management. Budget and Information Management. Motivational. Conflict Resolution / Problem Solving. Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership. Communication. Client orientation and Customer Focus. People Management and Empowerment. Problem Analysis and Solving. Financial Management. Programme and Project Management. Results/ Quality Management. Decision Making. Knowledge Management. Change Management.
jobs.duties: Ensure Sound Management of Expense Lease. Provide strategic leadership and oversight for the provincial expense lease portfolio to ensure alignment with departmental accommodation strategies and infrastructure plans. Oversee implementation of Immovable Asset Management Policy related to leasing and ensuring compliance with legislative and governance frameworks. Direct strategic accommodation planning based on User and Custodian Asset Management Plans to optimised leasing decisions. Oversee provincial leasing procurement planning to ensure cost effectiveness, compliance, and responsiveness to client departmental needs. Manage high-level stakeholder relations between landlords, client departments, and government stakeholders to ensure service delivery and value optimisation. Ensure Sound Management of Income Lease. Provide strategic leadership in managing the provincial income lease portfolio to maximise revenue generation and asset utilisation. Oversee development and maintenance of the Provincial Income Lease Register to ensure accuracy, compliance, and strategic decision making. Drive strategies for commercialisation and optimal utlilisation of state land and buildings. Provide strategic oversight and support to regional offices to ensure consistent revenue lease management practices. Strengthen stakeholder partnerships with private sector and public institutions to enhance revenue opportunities. Ensure Proper Management of Property Holdings. Provide strategic oversight on management of provincial property holdings to ensure optimal utilization, compliance and asset value preservation. Oversee lease contract governance to ensure compliance, validity, and risk mitigation across the property portfolio. Direct strategic land administration initiatives, including land audits, utilisation assessments, and long-term planning. Facilitate high- level stakeholder engagement with public and private sector entities regarding property matters. Oversee research, reporting, and information management systems to support evidence-based property management decisions. Ensure Effective Management of Municipal Services, Property Rates and Taxes. Provide strategic oversight on the management of municipal services rates, and taxes to ensure compliance with financial and legislative prescripts. Oversee validation and payment processes for municipal accounts to ensure financial accuracy and accountability. Ensure effective management of debtors and creditors relating to municipal services, including risk mitigation and financial reporting. Engage strategically with municipalities to resolve service delivery and billing challenges affecting state properties. Manage Allocated resources services. Manage the allocated resources.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. T. Matiso at 066 489 / S. Zazini Tel No: (040) 602 4236 / Mr L Maliti at 066 489 6117 e-recruitment Technical Enquiries: e-recruitment-bhisho@ecdpw.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted as follows: via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e- Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: e-recruitment- bhisho@ecdpw.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00-16:30 Mon- Thursday and 08:00-16:00 on Friday). Hand-delivered/ E-Mailed/ Faxed/ Posted applications will not be accepted.
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to Coloured male with disability. Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful.
