af.summary: Bied provinsiale huurportefeulje vir uitgawes en eiendombestuurstrategie vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Bisho.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat, B-graad/B SC in Property Studies/Real Estate (NQF level 7 soos erken deur SAQA) met 5-years ervaring op Middle/Senior bestuursvlak. Toegangsertifikaat vir die Senior Management Service (Nyukela) is verpligtend en sal voor aanstelling vereis word. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer; Diepgaande kennis en begrip van Nasionale en Provinsiale eiendomswetgewing, Regulasies en Beleide. Begrip van openbare sektor se bestuursraamwerk, nakomings- en verantwoordingsmeganismes; Diepgaande kennis, begrip en toepassing van GIAMA. Kundigheid in huurbestuur, staatslandadministrasie, eiendomswaarderings en batesoptimeringstrategieë. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die Public Finance Management Act. Toepaslike wetgewing en Voorskrifte. Regeringsprogramme. Inligtingbestuur. Burgerlike fokus en reaksie. Ontwikkel ander. Toegepaste tegnologie-basics. Mensebestuur. Toegepaste strategiese denke. Netwerking en die bou van bande. Diversiteitsbestuur. Verslagskrywing. Kommunikasie en inligtingbestuur. Onderhandelings. Analities. Strategiese bestuur. Begroting en inligtingbestuur. Motiverend. Konflikoplossing / Probleemoplossing. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Kommunikasie. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Probleemanalyse en -oplossing. Finansiële bestuur. Program- en projekbestuur. Resultate/kwaliteitsbestuur. Besluitneming. Kennisbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur.
af.duties: Verseker deeglike bestuur van uitgawehuur. Verskaf strategiese leierskap en toesig oor die provinsiale huurportefeulje vir uitgawes om belyning met departementele akkommodasie-strategieë en infrastruktuurplanne te verseker. Hou toesig oor die implementering van die Immovable Asset Management Policy met betrekking tot verhuring en verseker nakoming van wetgewende en bestuursraamwerke. Rig strategiese akkommodasie-beplanning op grond van User en Custodian Asset Management Plans vir geoptimaliseerde huurbesluite. Hou toesig oor provinsiale huurverkrygingsbeplanning om koste-effektiwiteit, nakoming en reaksie op kliëntdepartementele behoeftes te verseker. Bestuur hoëvlak-belanghebbenderelaties tussen verhuurders, kliëntdepartemente en regeringsbelanghebbendes om dienslewering en waarde-optimering te verseker. Verseker deeglike bestuur van inkomste-huur. Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die bestuur van die provinsiale inkomste-huurportefeulje om inkomstegegenereering en batesbenutting te maksimeer. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van die Provincial Income Lease Register om akkuraatheid, nakoming en strategiese besluitneming te verseker. Dryf strategieë vir kommersialisering en optimale benutting van staatsland en geboue. Verskaf strategiese toesig en ondersteuning aan streekskantore om konsekwente inkomste-hurbestuurpraktyke te verseker. Versterk belanghebbendevennootskappe met die private sektor en openbare instellings om inkomstegeleenthede te verbeter. Verseker behoorlike bestuur van eiendomsbelang. Verskaf strategiese toesig oor die bestuur van provinsiale eiendomsbelang om optimale benutting, nakoming en behoud van batewaarde te verseker. Hou toesig oor huurkontrakbestuur om nakoming, geldigheid en risikobeperking oor die eiendomsportefeulje te verseker. Rig strategiese landadministrasie-inisiatiewe, insluitend landoudits, benutting-assesserings en langtermynbeplanning. Fasiliteer hoëvlak-belanghebbende-betrokkenheid met openbare en private sektor-entiteite rakende eiendomsake. Hou toesig oor navorsing, verslagdoening en inligtingbestuurstelsels om bewysgebaseerde eiendombestuurbesluite te ondersteun. Verseker effektiewe bestuur van munisipale dienste, eiendomsbelasting en belasting. Verskaf strategiese toesig oor die bestuur van munisipale dienste, tariewe en belasting om nakoming van finansiële en wetgewende voorskrifte te verseker. Hou toesig oor validasie en betalingsprosesse vir munisipale rekenings om finansiële akkuraatheid en verantwoordelikheid te verseker. Verseker effektiewe bestuur van debiteure en krediteure met betrekking tot munisipale dienste, insluitend risikobeperking en finansiële verslagdoening. Skakel strategies met munisipaliteite om dienslewering en faktureeringsuitdagings wat staats eiendomme raak, op te los. Bestuur toegekende hulpbronne en dienste. Bestuur die toegekende hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kwakho Izimpahla
zu.summary: Hola iqembu lokushajwa kwezinto eziqashwayo esifundazweni nendlela yokuphathwa kwakho izimpahla kuMnyango Wezomphakathi Nokwakhiwa Kwezindawo eBisho.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme Kuzwelonke, I-Degree ye-B/ I-B SC Kwezifundo Zokuphathwa Kwakho Izimpahla/ Izindlu Eziqashwayo (I-NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA) ngeminyaka yokuqasha eyi-5 kulelinga lokubusa Elingaphakathi/ Eliphakeme. Isitifiketi sokungena ngaphambilini sezikhundla Ezingamabanga Aphakeme (I-Nyukela) iyindlela ephothule kanti izodingeka ngaphambi kokwethweswa kulesikhundla. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi olujulile nekuqonda uhlelo lomthetho olubusa Inkonzo Yomphakathi. Ulwazi olujulile nekuqonda Umthetho Wezimpahla Kazwelonke NaseSifundazweni, Izimiso Namapholisi. Ukuqonda uhlelo lolawulo lwesikhungo somphakathi, ukuvikelwa kwemithetho nemisiza yokubhekeka. Ulwazi olujulile, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa i-GIAMA. Amakhono ekuqashweni kwezinto, ukuphathwa kolimi lwesizwe, ukuhlola inani lezimpahla, nezindlela zokwenza izimpahla zisebenze ngendlela efanele kakhulu. Ulwazi olujulile nokuqonda umthetho ophathelene nokuphathwa kwemali Yomphakathi. Umthetho osetshenziswa nemyalo. Izinhlelo Zikahulumeni. Ukuphathwa Kolwazi. Ukugxila Kusizakathi Nokusabelo. Ukuthuthukisa Abanye. Izisekelo Zobuchwepheshe Obusetshenzisiwe. Ukuphathwa Kwabantu. Ukucabanga Ngendlela Ebuqamise. Ukuxhumaniswa Nokwakha Izibopho. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlobonhlobo Zabantu. Ukubika. Ukuxhumana Nokuphathwa Kolwazi. Izinkulumo Ezigqanyisiwe. Ukucubungula. Ukuphathwa Ngesu. Ibhajethi Nokuphathwa Kolwazi. Ukukhuthaza. Ukuxazulula Izinkinga. Amakhono: Ikhono Ebuqamise Nokubusa. Ukuxhumana. Ukuqondiswa Kwabathengi Nokuqonda Iminikelo. Ukuphathwa Kwabantu Nokuzelelisa. Ukuhlaziwa Kwemiba Nokuzezelwa. Ukuphathwa Kwemali. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Namaphrojekthi. Ukuphathwa Kwemiphumela/ Ikhwalithi. Ukwenza Izinqumo. Ukuphathwa Kolwazi. Ukuphathwa Koshintsho.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa Ukuphathwa Kwezinto Eziqashwayo Ezibiza Kakhulu. Nikeza isibonakaliso esibuzayo negadi ekubeni kokubuka kwebhange elibiza kakhulu lesifundazwe nokuqinisekisa ukumisana nezindlela zesikhungo sokuhlaliswa kwezinhlobo futhi kuhlelwe izinto ezakhiwayo. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kuhlelo lokuphathwa kwempahla engahambi ngeya ekubeni kokushaja izinto kanti futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka emthethweni nakuhambo lolawulo. Hola ukuhlela kwezikhundla okubuzayo ngokususela Kuhlelo Lokuqasha Izimpahla Lomsebenzisi Ngalowo Ozigcini kakhulu ukuze kube khona izinqumo ezishajayo ezisebenza kahle. Qapha ukuhlelwa kwesifundazwe kokuthenga ngeqembu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle ngemali, ukuvikelwa emthethweni, futhi kusabelo izidingo zamanye amanye amanye amadolobha. Phatha ubuhlobo obuphezulu obubalulekile phakathi kwezinkosi, amadolobha abathengi, nezitho zikahulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwezinsiza kanti futhi zisebenza kahle ngaphandle kokubamba iqhaza. Qinisekisa Ukuphathwa Kwezinto Eziqashwayo Ezenza Imali. Nikeza isibonakaliso esibuzayo ekuqashweni kwemali yebhange elenza imali lesifundazwe ukwandise ukukhiqizwa kwemali nokusetshenziswa kwempahla. Qapha ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwebhange elenza imali lesifundazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunemba, ukuvikelwa emthethweni, nokuqapha izinqumo ezibuzayo. Hola izindlela zokwenza izimpahla zisuswa ezweni zakho nemizi ukuze ithole imali ngokuphepha neziteshi zangasese. Nikeza isibonakaliso esibuzayo negadi kumakonti asesifundazweni ahlala nasendaweni eziyisifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhiqizwa ngokuqhubekayo kwemali yokushaja izinto. Qinisekisa ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani zamuntu siqu nezikhungo zomphakathi ukuze kwandise amathuba okwenza imali. Qinisekisa Ukuphathwa Kwezimpahla Kahle. Nikeza isibonakaliso esibuzayo ekuphathweni kwempahla lesifundazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele kakhulu, ukuvikelwa emthethweni nokugcina inani lempahla. Qapha ukuvikelelwa emthethweni kwesivumelwano sokushaja izinto ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa emthethweni, ukusemthethweni, nokunciphisa izinsongo ekuqashweni kwempahla ngokuphelele. Hola imizamo ebalulekile yokuphathwa komhlaba, okuhlanganisa nokuqasha umhlaba, ukuqeqesha abantu ukuthi basebenzise kahle umhlaba, futhi kuqashwe izinhlelo zesikhathi eside. Lungiselela ukubonisana ngosizo oluphezulu phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi nezinkampani zamuntu siqu ezithinta izimpahla. Qapha ukucwaningwa, ukubikwa, nezindlela zokuphathwa kolwazi ukuze kusekele izinqumo ezimi emthethweni ekuphathweni kwempahla. Qinisekisa Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza ZamaDolobha Amakhulu, Izilinganiso Kwezimpahla Nemali Yezinkokhelo. Nikeza isibonakaliso esibuzayo ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamadolobha amakhulu, izilinganiso kwezimpahla nemali yezinkokhelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa emthethweni ophathelene nemali futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa emthethweni. Qapha ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo ezisetshenziswa kwi-akhawunti zamadolobha amakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunemba kokubala kanye nokubhekeka. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okubalulekile kwabangwe nemali kanye nalabo abakwe imali kwezinsiza zikahulumeni, kuhlanganisa nokunciphisa izinsongo kanti futhi kubikwe ngeziyimali. Bonisane ngemigqa yesu ngemililo yezezindlu ebanzi ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga zokulethwa kwezinsiza futhi kuxazululwe izinkinga zokubala imali. Phatha Izinsiza Ezenzelwe. Phatha izinsiza ezinikelwe.

Provide executive oversight on feasibility and viability assessments to guide sustainable revenue-generating property development initiatives. Provide strategic leadership in the development of policies, guidelines, procedure manuals and processes that regulate property investment and development. Drive strategic approval process for all newly developed policies, guidelines, procedure manuals. Monitor the strategic impact and effectiveness of implemented policy frameworks on the overall performance, compliance and risk profile of the property portfolio. Ensure alignment of property investment policies with provincial socio-economic priorities and infrastructure strategies. Effective Management of Investment Planning Services. Evaluate and manage risks and returns of property developments initiatives. Provide advice on financing models, yield optimisation, and investment structuring for property development projects. Manage the Allocated Resources. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure timeous development of job descriptions and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all employees in the Unit. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets.

af.title: Direkteur: Eiendomsbelegging en -ontwikkeling
af.summary: Die Departement of Public Works & Infrastructure in Bisho soek 'n Direkteur van Eiendomsbelegging en -ontwikkeling om staatseiendomme te bestuur en strategiese beleggingsleiding te verskaf.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate, B-graad/B.Sc in Property Studies/Real Estate (NQF level 7 soos deur SAQA erken) met 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. 'n Voor-toelatingsertifikaat vir die Senior Management Service (Nyukela) is verpligtend en sal voor aanstelling vereis word. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van Nasionale en Provinciale Eiendomswetgewing, Regulasies en Beleide. Begrip van die openbare-sektor se bestuursraamwerk, nakomings- en verantwoordingsmeganismes. Diepgaande kennis, begrip en toepassing van GIAMA. Kennis van huurbeheer, staatslandadministrasie, eiendomswaarderings en bate-optimaliseringsstrategieë. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die Public Finance Management Act. Toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte. Regeringsprogramme. Inligtingsbestuur. Toepaslike Raadsregistrasie-wetgewing, prosedures en gedrag. Regeringsprogramme. Inligtingsbestuur. Burgerlike fokus en reaksievermoë. Ontwikkeling van ander. Toepaslike tegnologie-begbasiese beginsels. Mensebestuur. Toegepaste strategiese denke. Netwerk bou en verbindings vestig. Diversiteitsbestuur. Verslagdoening. Kommunikasie en inligtingsbestuur. Onderhandelings. Analitiese denke. Strategiese bestuur. Begrotings- en inligtingsbestuur. Motivering. Konflikoplossing/probleemoplossing. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Kommunikasie. Kliëntoriëntasie en klieëntfokus. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Probleemanalise en -oplossing. Finansiële bestuur. Program- en projekbestuur. Resultate/kwaliteitsbestuur. Besluitneming. Kennisbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur.
af.duties: Verseker doeltreffende bestuur en optimale benutting van staatseiendomme. Verskaf advies oor strategiese beleggingsbeslissings deur deskundige tegniese leiding te gee oor waarderingsmetodes, eiendomsnavorsing en markneigings om die portefeulje se langtermynwaarde te optimaliseer. Verskaf strategiese toesig oor portefeuljeprestasie deur prestasie-aanwysers en markinligting te interpreteer om beleidsrigting te gee en belyning met organisatoriese doelwitte te verseker. Lei omvattende eiendomsnavorsingsinisiatiewe om beleggingsgeleenthede te identifiseer, potensiële hefboomwerking te assesseer en langtermynbatebeplanning in te lig. Verskaf uitvoerende toesig oor haalbaarheids- en lewensvatbaarheidsassesserings om volhoubare inkomste-genererende eiendomsontwikkelingsinisiatiewe te lei. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van innoverende raamwerke om inkomste-generering oor die staatsportefeulje te verbeter. Lei hoëvlak-ekonomiese en fiskale navorsingsinisiatiewe om eiendomsverwante inkomstebronne te identifiseer en te prioritiseer deur gevorderde koste-batenabstraksie en scenario-beplanning te gebruik om strategiese beleggingsbeslissings oor die staatsportefeulje in te lig. Bestuur ontwikkeling en verseker implementering van meganismes om eiendomsontwikkelaars en beleggers aan te trek vir ekonomiese verbetering van die staatsportefeulje. Bestuur die facilitering en vestiging van strategiese vennootskappe met ontwikkelingsbemiddelaars om die transformasie van die eiendomssektor te ondersteun en geleenthede vir opkomende marktoetreders uit te brei. Hou toesig oor die bestuur en prestasie van langtermynverhuring en verseker die ontwikkeling van programme om volhoubaarheid en nakoming te verseker. Verseker deeglike bestuur en koördinasie van beleids- en riglynraamwerke vir doeltreffende implementering van die sub-program. Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die ontwikkeling van beleide, riglyne, prosedurehandleidings en prosesse wat eiendomsbelegging en -ontwikkeling reguleer. Druk strategiese goedkeuringsprosesse vir alle nuut ontwikkelde beleide, riglyne en prosedurehandleidings aan. Monitor die strategiese impak en doeltreffendheid van geïmplementeerde beleidsraamwerke op die algehele prestasie, nakoming en risikoprofiel van die eiendomsportefeulje. Verseker belyning van eiendomsbeleggingsbeleide met provinsiale sosio-ekonomiese prioriteite en infrastruktuurstrategieë. Doeltreffende bestuur van beleggingsbeplanningsdienste. Verskaf strategiese leiding oor die vrystelling en benutting van onroerende bates om ekonomiese en sosiale opbrengste te maksimeer. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van beleggingsbemarkingsstrategieë. Evalueer en bestuur risiko's en opbrengste van eiendomsontwikkelingsinisiatiewe. Verskaf advies oor finansieringsmodelle, opbrengsoptimalisering en beleggingsstruktuur vir eiendomsontwikkelingsprojekte. Bestuur die toegekende hulpbronne. Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span/afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van gehal/ hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer op met minimum leiding van die bestuurder. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling van posbeskrywings en implementering van Werksplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle werknemers in die Eenheid. Bestuur daaglikse werknemersprestasie en verseker tydige Prestasie-assesserings van alle ondergeskiktes. Verseker bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van bates.

xh.title: Director: Property Investment and Development
xh.summary: Kufunwa i-Director: Property Investment and Development ngurhulumente wesebe i-Department of Public Works & Infrastructure e-Bisho ukulawula izinto zomhlaba karhulumente nokunika isikhokelo sokuzimisela ukutyala imali.
xh.requirements: I-Matric, i-Degree ye-B / i-B SC kwizifundo zePropoti / iNkqubo yokuThengisa iPropoti (iNqanaba le-NQF 7 njengoko kubonakaliswa yi-SAQA) kunye neminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi / eliphezulu labaphathi. Isatifikethi sangaphambili seNkqubo yoLawulo lweZikhulu eziPhakamileyo (iNyukela) sinyanzelekile kwaye siya kufuneka phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ulwazi namekhono: Ulwazi olujulileyo nokuqonda kwangaphakathi kolwabiwo lomthetho olulawula iinkonzo ezisohlwini. Ulwazi olujulileyo nokuqonda kolwabiwo lomthetho wePropoti leSizwe naka-Province, iMigaqo yokuLawula kunye neenKqubo zokuLawula. Ukuqonda inkqubo yokuLawula koluntu olusebenziswa kwisebe, ukuhambelana nendlela ebalulekileyo yokuhamba nendlela yokuLawula. Ulwazi olujulileyo, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa i-GIAMA. Ulwazi olungenisa ithemba ekulawulweni kweziqinisekiso, ekuLawulweni komhlaba weSizwe, ekulinganisweni kobungakanani nobuhle bePropoti, kunye nemigaqo yokulungisa nokusebenzisa izinto ngokufanelekileyo. Ulwazi olujulileyo nokuqonda kumthetho weNkqubo yoLawulo lweMalini ekaRhulumente. Umthetho osebenzayo kwaye oluBekiweyo. Iinkqubo zoRhulumente. Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngomthetho weNkqubo yoBhaliso koBungcali, iinkqubo nokuziphatha. Iinkqubo zoRhulumente. Ulwazi olusebenzayo ngolwazi. Ukuqondisisa iimfuno zoluntu kunye nokuphendula kuzo. Ukuphuhlisa abanye. Iinkqubo eziyimfuno ekusebenzeni. Ukulawula abantu. Ukusebenzisa iNkqubo yokuqonda iMbali. Ukwakha ubuhlobo nokuQinisekisa ubudlelwane. Ukulawula iindidi ezahlukeneyo zabantu. Ukubhala iingxelo. Unxibelelwano nolawulo lolwazi. Iingxoxo. Ixabiso. I-Citiz. I-Citizen foc. Ukuqonda izinto. Ukulawula inani.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa uLawulo oluSebenzayo nokuSebenzisa ngokubakonakaliseyo izAhlulelo zeNtsimbi zeSIzwe. Nikela icebiso ngokuzimisela iingqwelisiso zotyalo-mali ngokunika isikhokelo esingcali kwiindlela zokulinganisa ixabiso, uphando lwempahla, nemiqathango yasemthethweni ukuze kusondezwe isixa esidlule kumvuzo wande. Nikela isikhokelo esiNgqwelisiso sokusebenza kolwabiwo lwempahla, kuqondwe ngokucacileyo iinkqubo zokulinganisa ukusebenza kunye nolwazi ngemigaqo yasemthethweni ukuze kwamkelwa iindlela ezichanekileyo kwaye kugcinwe kumgama ochanekileyo nemigiqo yentlangano. Khokela iinkqubo zophando olubanzi ukwaziswa amathuba okutyalo-mali, kuqondwe amandla okusebenza, kwaye kubekho oluvo olude olumalunga nolwabiwo lweempahla. Nikela isikhokelo esiphezulu kwimivuzo yokuqonda nokulinganisa ukuba imiselwe yamathuba okwanda kwimali ehlohlezayo ngokwasemthethweni kwinkqubo yophuhliso lwempahla. Qinisekisa uPhuhliso nokuSetyenziswa kweziLinganiso ezintsha ukuze kuNyuke ukuvela kwemali kwizoZinto eziSihlwele. Khokela iinkqubo zophando lwamaphulo nezeemali ezikumgangatho ophezulu ukubonisa amathuba okuzuza imali etsinwe kumthetho weempahla, kusetyenziswa iindlela ezithile zokuqikelela iindleko nenzuzo kunye neembonakaliso ezahlukeneyo ukunika isikhokelo kwiingqwelisiso zotyalo-mali kuyo yonke imali ehlohlezayo esisigxina. Lawula uphuhliso kwaye uqinisekise ukuzinza kweendlela ezintsha zokuzoba abaphuhlisi bempahla nabadibani namathuba emali ukuze konyuke amaphulo womgaqo weempahla. Lawula inkqubo yokubambisana noku misela ubudlelwane phakathi kwezinye iinkampani kunye nabo baxhasa uphuhliso ukuxhasa iinguquko kwingingqi yempahla noku ngenisa amathuba kwabantu abafuna ukungena kwimarike. Lilawule igunya lomthetho nesebe ngokubakonakaliseyo ekubeni kwenzeke imigiqo yokugcina amandla nokuze kuhambelane nemigaqo. Qinisekisa uLawulo oluLungileyo nokuHambelana koBumfihlo kunye neNkqubo yoKhokelo ukuze kuSebenze ngokuchanekileyo isiSebe. Nikela isikhokelo esiNgqwelisiso ekuphuhliseni imigaqo, iinkqubo zokuziphatha, iinkqubo zolawulo kunye neenkqubo ezilawula ukuzityala-mali noku phuhlisa impahla. Qhubele phambili inkqubo yesigqibo esiNgqwelisiso ekubeni zithathwe iigqibo kuzo zonke imigaqo, iinkqubo zokuziphatha, iinkqubo zolawulo ezintsha. Lilindele imiba ekubeni yintoni na kwaye iqinisekise ukuba imigaqo esetelwe iinkqubo iyasebenza nakanjani kubakonakaliseyo ngokubanzi, kuhambelane na yaye ingenisa bungakanani na ubungozi bubakho na kwisixa sempahla. Qinisekisa ukuba imigaqo yokuzityala-mali ihambelana namagunya emiba apho iphila kona i-province ngokwezimali nezentlalo nendlela ezakhiwa ngayo. Lawula iNkqubo yoLawulo oluSebenzayo lweeNdleko. Nikela isikhokelo esiNgqwelisiso ekukhupheni nasekusetyenzisweni kwempahla engabuyiselwayo ukuze konyuke imivuzo yamaphulo nentsalo. Lawula uphuhliso lweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezibamba inxaxheba ekuzameni ukuvelisa iindleko ezincinci. Hlola kwaye ulawule iingozi kunye naziphi na iindleko ezingaveliswa bubukho beempahla ezizakutyalelwa imali. Nikela icebiso ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqinisekisa imali ehlohlezayo, ukwandiswa kweemvuzo, noku miswa kweenkqubo zotyalo-mali kumaprojekthi zophuhliso Iwempahla. Lawula iNkqubo yemisebenzi eNikelwe kwoMele. Gcina iindleko ezikumgangatho ophezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela / isigaba sivelisa umsebenzi omhle ngokobungakanani / ubukhulu bako nangokwexesha elithile. Susa iingxaki ezibangelwa kukungabi namandla nokuzimisela ngokwemigaqo eluncedo kakhulu ekuyiweni koomphathi. Nikela iinkqubo zokuzimisela kubasebenzi ngokusekelwe kwimisebenzi yomntu ngamnye yamandla abo nika isikhokelo esifunekayo kwaye uxhase abasebenzi ngenkululeko yokufunda noku phuhlisa iinkwanano. Qinisekisa ukuba kubhaliwe iinkcazelo zomsebenzi ngexesha elichanekileyo kwaye kusetelwe iNkqubo yokuSebenza kunye neNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweNtsebenziswano (PDP's) kubo bonke abasebenzi kwiSebe. Lawula ngokwemigaqo yemisebenzi yabasebenzi yamihla le kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kubhaliwe iNkqubo yokuQonda ukusebenza ngexesha elichanekileyo bonke abantu abalawulwa nguwe. Lawula ukugcinwa, ukulungiswa nokugcina kakuhle iimpahla.

jobs.title: Director: Infrastructure Delivery for Health Facilities
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Direct the delivery of health facility infrastructure in Bisho, overseeing construction procurement strategy and programme management for the Eastern Cape Department of Public Works.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, B Degree (NQF level 7 as recognized by SAQA) in Civil Engineering/ Quantity Surveying/ Construction Management/ Architecture with 5-years of experience at Middle/ Senior Managerial level in Construction (Building structures). Pre-entry certificate for the Senior Management Service (Nyukela) is compulsory and will be required prior appointment. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge and Skills: In-depth knowledge and understanding of legislative framework that governs the Public Service, In-depth knowledge Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS). Understanding of Infrastructure Programme Management Plans (IPMP) and IPIPs. Knowledge of project lifecycle costing and asset management (planning, procurement implementation maintenance. Understanding of life-cycle costing and asset management principles. Knowledge and understanding Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA). Knowledge and understanding Infrastructure Development Act. Knowledge of National Building Regulations and standards. Knowledge of CIDB processes and tender systems. Citizen Focus and Responsiveness. Develop Others. Applied Technology Basics. People Management. Applied Strategic Thinking. Networking and Building Bonds. Diversity Management. Report Writing. Communication and Information Management. Negotiations. Analytica. Strategic Management. Budget and Information Management. Motivational. Conflict Resolution/ Problem Solving. Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership. Communication. Client orientation and Customer Focus. People Management and Empowerment. Problem Analysis and Solving. Financial Management. Programme and Project Management. Results/ Quality Management. Decision Making. Knowledge Management. Change Management.
jobs.duties: Lead and govern development of construction procurement strategy and Infrastructure Programme Management Plan (IPMP). Direct development and alignment of IPMP and procurement strategies with DoH priorities. Oversee integration of technical standards, lifecycle planning, and professional inputs. Drive innovation and sustainable infrastructure solutions. Ensure integration of infrastructure planning with budgeting and service delivery priorities. Advise executive management on infrastructure planning strategies. Lead Infrastructure Programme Implementation and Delivery Oversight. Ensure development and alignment of Infrastructure Programme Implementation Plans (IPIPs) with strategic and budget priorities for sign of by DoH. Direct and prepare the procurement plan. Direct development and governance of service delivery agreements. Oversee implementation of infrastructure programmes to ensure alignment with time, cost, and quality. Ensure alignment of IPIPs with budgets and cash flow projections. Oversee validation of infrastructure designs and ensure compliance with National and Municipal Regulations. Overseer Infrastructure Procurement and Contract Management. Ensure appointment of suitable professionals from DoH in collaboration with the Departmental Supply Chain Management Unit (SCM). Direct governance and compliance within SCM processes. Manage preparation of relevant procurement documentation throughout the different phases in the project management cycle. Ensure registration of projects on the CIDB i-tender system. Ensure appointments of competent service providers and contactors. Direct issuing of work and batch orders. Oversee Sector Performance and Infrastructure Programme Reporting. Provide strategic oversight of IPIPs and Project Execution Plans (PEPs) to ensure alignment with DoH Priorities and budgets. Ensure implementation of infrastructure programmes and contracts to ensure delivery within scope, time, cost, and quality standards. Direct management of contract performance, risks, and cost variations to ensure compliance and value for money. Lead programmes monitoring, evaluation, and reporting to inform decision-making and governance structures. Facilitate high-level stakeholder coordination with DoH and implementing agents to resolve challenges and improve delivery outcomes. Lead transition and integration of projects from alternative implementing agents to ensure continuity and accountability. Lead Programme Planning and Performance Planning Management Systems. Oversee budgeting and financial management to ensure efficient and aligned resource utilization. Drive the development and alignment of IPIPs with strategic and funding priorities. Oversee implementation and performance of infrastructure programmes against approved plans. Direct strategic performance reporting to support governance and decision-making. Oversee procurement planning to ensure alignment with delivery plans and compliance. Manage the Allocated Resources. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality /quantity and timeline. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure timeous development of job description and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all employees in the Directorate. Manage daily employees’ performance and ensure timely performance Assessment of all subordinates. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets.

View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercises and interviews. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behaviourally preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12/24 months. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme      Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. af.title: Direkteur: Infrastruktuuraflewering vir Gesondheidsfasiliteite
af.summary: Bestuur die aflewering van gesondheidsfasiliteitsinfrastruktuur in Bisho, met toesig oor die konstruksie-aankoopstrategie en programbestuur vir die Eastern Cape Department of Public Works.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat, B-graad (NQF-vlak 7 soos erken deur SAQA) in Siviele Ingenieurswese / Hoeveelheidsopname / Konstruksiebestuur / Argitektuur met 5 jaar ervaring op Middle / Senior Bestuursvlak in Konstruksie (Geboustrukture). Voor-toelatingsertifikaat vir die Senior Management Service (Nyukela) is verpligtend en sal voorafgaande aan aanstelling vereis word. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Diepgaande kennis van Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS). Begrip van Infrastructure Programme Management Plans (IPMP) en IPIPs. Kennis van projeklewensikluskostering en batesbestuur (beplanning, aankoop, implementering, onderhoud). Begrip van lewensikluskostering en batesbestuursbeginsels. Kennis en begrip van Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA). Kennis en begrip van Infrastructure Development Act. Kennis van Nasionale Bouregulasies en -standaarde. Kennis van CIDB-prosesse en tenderstelsels. Burgerlike Fokus en Reaksievermoë. Ontwikkeling van Ander. Toegepaste Tegnologie-basis. Mensebestuur. Toegepaste Strategiese Denke. Netwerk bou en bande vestig. Diversiteitsbestuur. Verslagskryf. Kommunikasie en Inligtingsbestuur. Onderhandelings. Analities. Strategiese Bestuur. Begroting en Inligtingsbestuur. Motiverend. Konflikoplossing / Probleemoplossing. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese Vermoë en Leierskap. Kommunikasie. Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus. Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging. Probleemanalise en -oplossing. Finansiële Bestuur. Program- en Projekbestuur. Resultate / Kwaliteitsbestuur. Besluitneming. Kennisbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur.
af.duties: Lei en beheer die ontwikkeling van die konstruksie-aankoopstrategie en die Infrastruktuurprogrambestuursplan (IPMP). Bestuur die ontwikkeling en belyning van die IPMP en aankoopstrategieë met DoH-prioriteite. Hou toesig oor die integrasie van tegniese standaarde, lewensiklusbeplanning en professionele insette. Bevordering van innovasie en volhoubare infrastruktuuroplossings. Verseker integrasie van infrastruktuurbeplanning met begroting en diensleweringprioriteite. Adviseer uitvoerende bestuur oor infrastruktuurbeplanningsstrategieë. Lei Infrastruktuurprogramimplementering en aflewerings toesig. Verseker ontwikkeling en belyning van Infrastruktuurprogramimplementeringsplanne (IPIPs) met strategiese en begrotingsprioriteite vir ondertekening deur DoH. Bestuur en berei die aankoopplan voor. Bestuur ontwikkeling en beheer van diensleweringsooreenkomste. Hou toesig oor implementering van infrastruktuurprogramme om belyning met tyd, koste en kwaliteit te verseker. Verseker belyning van IPIPs met begrotings en kontantvloei-projeksies. Hou toesig oor validering van infrastruktuurontwerpe en verseker nakoming van Nasionale en Munisipale Regulasies. Hou toesig oor Infrastruktuuraankope en Kontrakbestuur. Verseker aanstelling van geskikte professionele persone van DoH in samewerking met die Departementale Voorsieningskettingbestuureenheid (SCM). Bestuur beheer en nakoming binne SCM-prosesse. Bestuur voorbereiding van tersaaklike aankoopdokumentasie deur die verskillende fases in die projekbestuursiklus. Verseker registrasie van projekte op die CIDB i-tender-stelsel. Verseker aanstellings van bekwame diensverskaffers en kontrakteurs. Bestuur uitreiking van werk- en lotbestellings. Hou toesig oor Sektorprestasie en Infrastruktuurprogramverslagdoening. Verskaf strategiese toesig oor IPIPs en Projekuitvoeringsplanne (PEPs) om belyning met DoH-prioriteite en begrotings te verseker. Verseker implementering van infrastruktuurprogramme en kontrakte om aflewering binne omvang, tyd, koste en gehaltestandaarde te verseker. Bestuur bestuur van kontrakprestasie, risiko's en kostevariasies om nakoming en waarde vir geld te verseker. Lei programmonitoring, -evaluering en -verslagdoening om besluitvorming en bestuursstrukture te stuur. Fasiliteer hoëvlak-belanghebbende-koördinasie met DoH en implementeringsagente om uitdagings op te los en afleweringsuitkomste te verbeter. Lei oorgang en integrasie van projekte van alternatiewe implementeringsagente om kontinuïteit en verantwoordbaarheid te verseker. Lei Programbeplanning en Prestasiebeplanningsbestuurstelsels. Hou toesig oor begroting en finansiële bestuur om doeltreffende en belynde hulpbronnutiging te verseker. Bevorder die ontwikkeling en belyning van IPIPs met strategiese en befondsingsprioriteite. Hou toesig oor implementering en prestasie van infrastruktuurprogramme teen goedgekeurde planne. Bestuur strategiese prestasieverslagdoening om beheer en besluitvorming te ondersteun. Hou toesig oor aankoopbeplanning om belyning met afleweringsplanne en nakoming te verseker. Bestuur die toegewysde hulpbronne. Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span / afdeling uitstaande werk lewer in terme van gehalte / hoeveelheid en tydlyn. Los probleme van motivering en beheer op met minimale leiding van bestuurder. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling van posbeskrywing en implementering van Werkplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle werknemers in die Direktoraat. Bestuur daaglikse werknemersprestasie en verseker tydige Prestasie-evaluering van alle ondergeskiktes. Verseker bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van bates.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Ukulethwa Kwemiyalo Yezempilo Esikhungweni
zu.summary: Qondisa ukulethwa kwemiyalo yezempilo esikhungweni eBisho, ulawule isu lokuthenga izinto zokwakha nokuphathwa kuhlelo kwiminyango ye Eastern Cape Department of Public Works.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-B Degree (NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA) ku-Civil Engineering/ Quantity Surveying/ Construction Management/ Architecture okuphephile kunyaka-5 wemivumelo ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi noma ophakeme kokwakha (izakhiwo). Isitifikedi sokuqala ngaphambi kokungena kwi-Senior Management Service (Nyukela) siyadingeka futhi sizophathwa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ilayisensi yokushayela ehambisana nemithetho. Ulwazi Nezakhono: Ulwazi olujulile nokuqonda ohlelweni lomthetho oluphatha Isebe Lezempilo, Ulwazi olujulile ngohlelo lokuphathwa kokulethwa kwemiyalo (Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS)). Ukuqonda ama-Infrastructure Programme Management Plans (IPMP) nama-IPIP. Ulwazi ngokuqondisa ibanga lemali yohlelo lwezokwakha nokuphathwa kwezimpahla (ucwangciso, uthenga, ukusetshenziswa, ukugcinwa). Ukuqonda izinkomba zokuqondisa ibanga lemali nokuphathwa kwezimpahla. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA). Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Infrastructure Development Act. Ulwazi ngemithetho namazinga okwakha kazwelonke. Ulwazi ngokuqhubeka kwe-CIDB nezinhlelo zokuqashisa. Ukuqaswa kwezakhamuzi nokusebenza ngokubhekise kubantu. Ukuthuthukisa abanye. Izisekelo zobuchwepheshe ezisetshenziswa. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukucabanga ngokuqondisa okusetshenzisiwe. Ukwakha izinhloba nobuhlobo. Ukuphatha ukwehlukana. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuxhumana nokuphatha ulwazi. Izinkulumo ezinga zhunywe. Ukwenza isibalo. Ukuphatha ngokuqondisa. Ibhajidi nokuphatha ulwazi. Ukukhuthaza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Amandla Nokuhola: Ikakhulukazi ukuqondisa nokuhola. Ukuxhumana. Ukuqondisela iklayenti nokubhekise kubathengi. Ukuphatha nokukhulisa abantu. Ukuhlaziya izinkinga nezixazululo. Ukuphatha izimali. Ukuphatha amapulani nezinhlelo. Ukuphatha imiphumela nengakhileyo. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ulwazi lokuphatha. Ukuphatha izinguquko.
zu.duties: Qondisa nokulawula ukuthuthukiswa kwesu lokuthenga izinto zokwakha ne-Infrastructure Programme Management Plan (IPMP). Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuhambisana kwe-IPMP namasu okuthenga ahambisana nezinhloso ze-DoH. Lawula ukuhlanganiswa kwamazinga obuchwepheshe, ucwangciso lwebanga lemali, nezimpumelo eziphathwayo. Hola ihlinzeko nokuzikwa kwemiyalo esebenzayo. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kocwaningo lwemiyalo nokuqondiswa kwebhajidi nezinhloso zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Celisa abaphathi abaphezulu ngamasu ocwaningo lwemiyalo. Qondisa ukuphathwa nokulethwa kwe-Infrastructure Programme Implementation Plan. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuhambisana kwe-Infrastructure Programme Implementation Plans (IPIPs) nezinhloso zokuqondisa nebhajidi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngu-DoH. Qondisa futhi ulungise isu lokuthenga. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa nokulawulwa kwezivumelwano zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zemiyalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nesikhathi, izindleko, izinga. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwe-IPIPs nokuqondiswa kwezimali. Lawula ukuqinisekiswa kwemiklamo yemiyalo futhi wenze isiqiniseki sokuzinza nemithetho kazwelonke nasedolobheni. Lawula ukuthenga kwemiyalo nokuphathwa kwezinkontilaka. Qinisekisa ukuqashwa kwabakhiqizi abafanele abavela ku-DoH ngokubambisana ne-Departmental Supply Chain Management Unit (SCM). Qondisa ukulawulwa nokuhambisana nemithetho ngaphakathi kwezinqubo ze-SCM. Phatha ukulungiswa kolwazi lokuthenga emaphusheni ahlukene kuhlelo lokuphatha amapulani. Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa kwamapulani kumlekeleli we-CIDB i-tender. Qinisekisa ukuqashwa kwezinsizakalo ezikhuthelezi nabathwebuli. Qondisa ukukhishwa komyalo wokusebenza nemiyalo yokuhlela. Lawula ukusebenza komkhakha nokubika kohlelo lwemiyalo. Nikeza ukuqondisa ngokusobala kwe-IPIPs nama-Project Execution Plans (PEPs) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nezinhloso ze-DoH nokuqondiswa kwezimali. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zemiyalo nezinkontilaka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa ngaphakathi kobungako, isikhathi, izindleko, namazinga. Qondisa ukuphathwa kokusebenza kwezinkontilaka, izengozi, izinguquko zezindleko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nomthetho nokuqinisekisa ukutholwa kwentsengo yemali. Qondisa ukulalela, ukuhlola, nokubika amapulani ukwazi ukwenza izinqumo nokulawula izakhiwo. Khokhela ukuhlelwa kwabaheyi mgqangi ngamazinga aphezulu nabayenza abaqondisile ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthuthukisa imiphumela. Qondisa ukuguqulwa nokuhlanganiswa kwamapulani omlingiswa abaqondisile ukwazi ukusebenza ngokuqhubekayo nokuqashwa. Qondisa ukucwangciswa kwamapulani nokuphathwa kohlelo lokucwangcisa ukusebenza. Lawula ukubhalwa kwesibhalo nobunjiniyela ukunikeza imali ukuze kusetshenziswe ngokushesha nokuhambisana. Hola ukuthuthukiswa nokuhambisana kwe-IPIPs nezinhloso zokuqondisa nezimali. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zemiyalo ngokumelene namapulani abambe iqhaza. Qondisa ukubika ngokusobala ukuze kusekelwe ukulawulwa kwezinqumo. Lawula ukucwangciswa kokuthenga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana namapulani okulethwa namaphoyinti. Phatha izinsiza ezabeliwe. Gcina amazinga aphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu isikhwaphu nikhiqize umsebenzi ohle emazingeni ohle, ngobungako, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Xazula izinkinga zokuqonda nezilawuli ngosizo oluncane otholwa kumphathi. Nikeza abasebenzi ukusebenza ngokulingana nokuhlanzeka kwamandla abo bonke, nikeza usizo oludingekayo futhi uphefumulele abasebenzi ukuze bakhule baze bafunde. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa ngokushesha kolwazi ngemisebenzi nokusetshenziswa kwe-Work Plans nama-Personal Development Plans (PDP's) bonke abantu abakwikhaya. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi nsuku zonke ukuze kube nokuhlola ukusebenza ngokushesha kabo bonke abangaphansi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa, nokuphathwa kwempahla.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ukulethwa Kolwazi-lokuqamba kwezempilo eBisho
xh.summary: Qhube ukulethwa kolwazi-locwentyo lwezempilo eBisho, ulawule isu lokuthenga izakhiwo nolawulo lwenkqabo kwisebe Lemo lime laseMpuma Koloni.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethla sencwadi yamagama eziko efanelekileyo, inqanaba le B (NQF level 7 njengoko kusetyenziswa zi-SAQA) kwi-Civil Engineering/ Quantity Surveying/ Construction Management/ Architecture kunye neminyaka yamava emi-5 kwinqanaba lokuLawula/ lawula okuphakathi ekuKhenkethweni (izakhiwo zeempahla). Isatifikethla sokuNgena kwiNyukela kuSebenzo esiKoyo samaPhathi abaPhezulu siyakufuneka kwaye siza kufunwa phambi kokuMiswa emsebenzini. Ilayisensi yokushayela ngokusemthethweni. Ulwazi nethamsanqa: Ukuqonda ngobunzulu iNkqubo yayo yonke imithetho elawula inkqubo yaseBurhulumente, nakuqonda ngobunzulu inkqabo yoLawulo loKuNxibelelwano lweNkcubeko (I-Delivery Management System i-IDMS). Ukuqonda iiNkcukacha zoLawulo lweNkqubo yeMiba ekuQhubwa (IPMP) kunye ne-IPIP. Ulwazi ngexabiso lexesha elizalisekayo leprojekthe nolawulo lwempahla (ucwangciso, ukuthenga, ukuphumeza, ukulondolozo. Ukuqonda iindlela zokubala ixabiso lexesha elide kunye neemigaqo yolawulo lwempahla. Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho woLawulo lweMpahla kaRhulumente (I-GIAMA). Ulwazi nokuqonda uMthetho woPhuhliso lweNkcubeko. Ulwazi ngeemigaqo yezakhiwo yeSizwe nemiGaqo. Ulwazi ngemiba yama-CIDB iinkqubo zokuNikwa kwamasebe. Ukuqonda iSizwe kunye nokuphendula. Phucula abanye. I-Nucleus yokuSebenzisa iNkcukacha. UkuLawula abantu. UkuSebenzisa uQqhofo oluNobulumko. Ukuqhagamshelana nokwakha iintshta. uLawulo loTshintsho lobuhlobo. UkuBhala iNgxelo. uNxibelelwano nokuLawula iNkcukacha. iZigqibo. iNkqubo eNika amandla. UkuLawula iNgxangxgaixho yeMali. iNkqubo yeSizwe namaxabiso. Ukuphucula ukuTyhila. UkuTyhila uMyalezo. UkuTyhila inkqubo yokuLawula iNkcukacha.
xh.duties: Yiba ngumanyi kuphuhliso lweNkqubo yokuthenga izakhiwo neNkqubo yoLawulo loLwazi loQhubo (i-IPMP). Qhomba ukupfumba neenkqubo ze-IPMP kunye neNkqubo zokuthi nga zizathu ezikwazione eziphuma ku-DoH eziphambili. Lawula uluhlu lweenkcukacha zobauchwepheshe, ucwangciso ngxexesha elifanekisiweyo, nangokubonelela ngolwazi ngesandleni. Qhweba uTshintsho gotyando neQumbo lokuzisa izisombulu ezingatshitshiyo. Qinisekisa intetho elungele ukuba ulwe ngokocwangciso kukuzisa amaxabiso kunye nezinto eziphambili ezirekhodu ezikwithuba. Yongeza ngokulayeza abasebenzi abakwindidi eziphambili ngemiba ycwangciso ezikwithuba. Qhweba uMvuzo ophaya weNkqubo enkqubo naloLawulo loQhweba lokuSetyenziswa kweSizwe. Qinisekisa ukupfumba nokuqhwesa kwankqubo yeNkcukacha ezikwithuba ukuba zenzeke ngexesha, ngamaxabiso nengomganga. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kwaba-IPMP kumaxabiso kunye neeprojekthi ezikwithuba esekelwe kumaxabiso obomi bendalo. Lawula ukuvavanya inkqubo yokudityaniswa kwaba-sakhiwo neeNkcukacha ezikwithuba ngamagunya esiZwe nakwiMigqango kaMasipala. Yiba ngumeli wolawulo oluphambili weNkqubo yokuthengisa iinkqubo zeempahla nezakhiwo. Lawula inkqubo yokwenzwa komyalelo wokubonelela abo bangcwngcw ovela e-DoH ukwakha iNkcukacha ezintsha ngendlela yolawulo lokuQhuba iNkqubela (i-SCM) yesebe. Lawula uLawulo lokuSebenzisa kolawulo iNkqubo yokuThengisa. Qhuba ucwangciso lweekqubo nolwazi lwexabiso kwindlela elungele ukuLungelelanisa iimfuno ziinkonzo ezahlukenyo zicwangciso. Lawula nokuvelisa isicwangciso sokuthenga izakhiwo nokusebenzisa izibonelelo ezingamakhaya. Lawula inkqubo yokusebenzisa noLawulo olungele iNkqubo yokuSetyenziswa kweSizwe. Yiba ngumgqatswa weNdlela yokuza kwaba-Project Execution Plans (i-PEP) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulungelelaniswa nexabiso leproject. Lawula inkqubo yokuphumeza iinkqubo zokwakhiwa eziya kubakho kwixesha elilungele lanxa nengemva kwexesha elichanekileyo. Lawula amaxabiso ekhula ukuba akhokelela kubakho bemiGaqo nokuphendula kumaxabiso. Qinisekisa isicwangciso sokubakho nokuqinisekiswa kwemiGaqo kaRhulumente kwiiNkqubo zoQoqosho. Phezulu, lawula imisbenze ngokomthetho weNkqubo yokulungelelanisa kwaye ubuye ulawule iinkonzo nokuPhefumlelwa kwabemi.

jobs.title: Director: Provincial Infrastructure Coordinating
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Director of Provincial Infrastructure Coordinating in Bisho, requiring a relevant degree and five years of senior managerial experience, at salary level 13.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, B Degree (NQF level 7 as recognized by SAQA) in Developmental Studies / Public Management / Public Administration / Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Structural, Mechanical) / Quantity Surveying / Architecture / Urban and Regional Planning / Occupational Construction Health and Safety / Safety Management with 5-years of experience at Middle/ Senior Managerial level in Infrastructure environment. Pre-entry certificate for the Senior Management Service (Nyukela) is compulsory and will be required prior appointment. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge and Skills: In-depth knowledge and understanding of legislative framework that governs the Public Service, In-depth understanding of the South African infrastructure landscape, public sector governance, and the legislative framework governing infrastructure development. Sound understanding of South African Infrastructure Landscape, Public Sector Governance and Legislative Framework Governing. Sound understanding of South African Infrastructure Landscape, Public Sector Governance, and Legislative Framework Governing Infrastructure Development and Maintenance. Knowledge of project lifecycle costing and asset management (planning, procurement implementation maintenance. In-depth understanding of infrastructure planning frameworks, norms and standards as well as lifecycle costing. In-depth knowledge of provincial and national infrastructure planning, delivery, and maintenance frameworks. Strong understanding of government planning, procurement, financial management (PFMA, Treasury Regulations), and governance systems. Knowledge of Project and Programme Management methodologies, including risk management and monitoring and evaluation frameworks. Understanding of intergovernmental coordination, infrastructure policy, and strategic planning principles. Citizen Focus and Responsiveness. Develop Others. Applied Technology Basics. People Management. Applied Strategic Thinking. Networking and Building Bonds. Diversity Management. Report Writing. Communication and Information Management. Negotiations. Analytica. Strategic Management. Budget and Information Management. Motivational. Conflict Resolution/ Problem Solving. Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership. Communication. Client orientation and Customer Focus. People Management and Empowerment. Problem Analysis and Solving. Financial Management. Programme and Project Management. Results/ Quality Management. Decision Making. Knowledge Management. Change Management.
jobs.duties: Manage and Govern Provincial Infrastructure Coordination Frameworks. Direct the development and institutionalisation of provincial infrastructure governance frameworks, systems, and protocols. Advise PICC, EXCO, and governance structures on infrastructure coordination and governance improvements. Champion intergovernmental coordination to align infrastructure planning and delivery across sectors. Drive alignment of infrastructure programmes with provincial priorities and policy frameworks. Oversee continuous improvement of governance frameworks to enhance accountability and performance. Direct Provision of Strategic Secretariat and Advisory Services to PICC. Lead provision of strategic secretariate services to Provincial governance structures. Ensure consolidation and strategic presentation of infrastructure reports in support of T-PICC and related governance structures, informing high-level decision-making. Advise governance structures on infrastructure performance, risks, and strategic priorities. Ensure effective functioning of governance forums through structured coordination and support. Facilitate informed decision-making through accurate, timely, and integrated reporting Lead Interventions in Resolving Infrastructure Delivery Bottlenecks and Drive Delivery of Provincial Strategics Projects (PSPS) and B5 Programmes. Direct identification and resolution of systemic infrastructure delivery bottlenecks. Oversee analysis of infrastructure performance trends and recommend strategic interventions. Advise on corrective and preventative measures to address delays and inefficiencies. Escalate high-impact risks and challenges to executive leadership for resolution. Champion collaborative platforms to strengthen coordination and accountability and shared responsibility among stakeholders. Oversee Infrastructure Documents Information and Knowledge Management Systems. Direct the development and management of infrastructure information and reporting systems. Ensure integrity, accuracy, and accessibility of infrastructure data to support decision-making. Champion knowledge management and digital transformation initiatives. Oversee production of strategic reports for executive and governance structures. Facilitate evidence-based planning and decision-making through integrated infrastructure information systems. Lead timeous development and submission of written reports to internal and external structures (EXMA / Top Management, EXCO resolutions, Working Groups, Cluster, Audit Committee, Risk and Ethics Management Committee, Portfolio Committees, Parliamentary Standing Committees, AGSA). Manage Allocated Resources. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure timeous development of job description and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all employees in the Directorate. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets. Ensure effective budget planning and financial management controls for the PICC Secretariat Directorate. Ensure implementation of localization of procurement for the PICC Secretariat Directorate. Manage risk and fraud prevention measures for the PICC Secretariat Directorate.

af.title: Direkteur: Provinsiale Infrastruktuurkoördinering
af.summary: Direkteur van Provinsiale Infrastruktuurkoördinering in Bisho, wat 'n tersaaklike graad en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring verg, op salarisvlak 13.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat, B-graad (NQF level 7 soos erken deur SAQA) in Ontwikkelingstudies / Openbare Bestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Ingenieurswese (Siviel, Elektries, Struktureel, Meganies) / Hoeveelheidsopmeting / Argitektuur / Stedelike en Streeksbeplanning / Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid in die Boubedryf / Veiligheidsbestuur met 5 jaar ervaring op Middle/Senior bestuursvlak in 'n infrastruktuur-omgewing. Voor-toetrede sertifikaat vir die Senior Management Service (Nyukela) is verpligtend en sal voor aanstelling vereis word. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer; Diepgaande begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse infrastruktuurlandskap, openbare sektor se bestuur, en die wetgewende raamwerk wat infrastruktuurontwikkeling regeer. Degelijke begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse infrastruktuurlandskap, openbare sektor se bestuur en wetgewende raamwerk wat regeer. Degelijke begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse infrastruktuurlandskap, openbare sektor se bestuur, en die wetgewende raamwerk wat infrastruktuurontwikkeling en instandhouding regeer. Kennis van projeklewensiklus-kosting en batebestuur (beplanning, verkryging, implementering en instandhouding). Diepgaande begrip van infrastruktuurbeplanningsraamwerke, norme en standaarde sowel as lewensiklus-kosting. Diepgaande kennis van provinsiale en nasionale infrastruktuurbeplanning, aflewerings- en instandhoudingsraamwerke. Sterk begrip van regeringsbeplanning, verkryging, finansiële bestuur (PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies), en bestuurstelsels. Kennis van projek- en programbestuurmetodologieë, insluitend risikobestuur en monitering- en evalueringsraamwerke. Begrip van interregeringskoördinering, infrastruktuurbeleid, en strategiese beplanningsbeginsels. Burgervokus en Responsiwiteit. Ontwikkeling van Ander. Toegepaste Tegnologie-basics. Mensebestuur. Toegepaste Strategiese Denke. Netwerking en die Bou van Bande. Diversiteitsbestuur. Verslagskrywing. Kommunikasie en Inligtingsbestuur. Onderhandelinge. Analities. Strategiese Bestuur. Begrotings- en Inligtingsbestuur. Motiverend. Konflikoplossing/Probleemoplossing. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese Vermoë en Leierskap. Kommunikasie. Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus. Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging. Probleemanalise en -oplossing. Finansiële Bestuur. Program- en Projekbestuur. Resultate/Kwaliteitsbestuur. Besluitneming. Kennisbestuur. Veranderingsbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en regeer Provinsiale Infrastruktuurkoördineringsraamwerke. Rig die ontwikkeling en institusionalisering van provinsiale infrastruktuurbestuursraamwerke, stelsels en protokolle. Adviseer PICC, EXCO en bestuursstrukture oor infrastruktuurkoördinering en bestuursverbeterings. Beywer vir interregeringskoördinering om infrastruktuurbeplanning en aflewering oor sektore te belyn. Dryf die belyning van infrastruktuurprogramme met provinsiale prioriteite en beleidsraamwerke. Hou toesig op deurlopende verbetering van bestuursraamwerke om verantwoordelikheid en prestasie te verbeter. Rig die verskaffing van strategiese sekretariaats- en adviesdienste aan PICC. Lei die verskaffing van strategiese sekretariaatsdienste aan provinsiale bestuursstrukture. Verseker konsolidasie en strategiese voorlegging van infrastruktuurverslae ter ondersteuning van T-PICC en verwante bestuursstrukture, wat hoëvlakbesluitneming inlig. Adviseer bestuursstrukture oor infrastruktuurprestasie, risiko's en strategiese prioriteite. Verseker effektiewe funksionering van bestuursforums deur gestruktureerde koördinering en ondersteuning. Fasiliteer ingeligte besluitneming deur akkurate, tydige en geïntegreerde verslagdoening. Lei ingrypings om infrastruktuurafleweringsbottelnekke op te los en dryf aflewering van Provinsiale Strategiese Projekte (PSPS) en B5-programme. Rig die identifisering en oplossing van stelselmatige infrastruktuurafleweringsbottelnekke. Hou toesig oor die ontleding van infrastruktuurprestasieneigings en beveel strategiese ingrypings aan. Adviseer oor korrektiewe en voorkomende maatreëls om vertragings en ondoeltreffendhede aan te spreek. Eskaleer hoë-impak risiko's en uitdagings na uitvoerende leierskap vir oplossing. Beywer vir samewerkingsplatforms om koördinering, verantwoordelikheid en gedeelde verantwoordelikheid onder belanghebbendes te versterk. Hou toesig oor infrastruktuurdokumente, inligting- en kennishbestuurstelsels. Rig die ontwikkeling en bestuur van infrastruktuurinligting- en verslagdoeningstelsels. Verseker die integriteit, akkuraatheid en toeganklikheid van infrastruktuurdata om besluitneming te ondersteun. Beywer vir kennishbestuur- en digitale transformasie-inisiatiewe. Hou toesig oor die vervaardiging van strategiese verslae vir uitvoerende en bestuursstrukture. Fasiliteer op bewyse gebaseerde beplanning en besluitneming deur geïntegreerde infrastruktuurinligtingstelsels. Lei tydige ontwikkeling en indiening van skriftelike verslae aan interne en eksterne strukture (EXMA/Topbestuur, EXCO-resolusies, Werkgroepe, Cluster, Ouditkomitee, Risiko- en Etiekbestuurskomitee, Portefeuljekomitees, Parlementêre Staande Komitees, AGSA). Bestuur toegekende hulpbronne. Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span/afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van kwaliteit/hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer op met minimum leiding van die bestuurder. Delegeer funksies aan personeel gebaseer op individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling van posbeskrywing en implementering van Werkplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle werknemers in die Direktoraat. Bestuur daaglikse werknemerprestasie en verseker tydige Prestasie-assessering van alle ondergeskiktes. Verseker bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van bates. Verseker effektiewe begrotingsbeplanning en finansiële bestuurskontroles vir die PICC-sekretariaatsdirektoraat. Verseker implementering van lokalisering van verkryging vir die PICC-sekretariaatsdirektoraat. Bestuur risiko- en bedrogvoorkomingsmaatreëls vir die PICC-sekretariaatsdirektoraat.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Provincial Infrastructure Coordinating
zu.summary: Umqondisi we-Provincial Infrastructure Coordinating e-Bisho, ofuna idigri ehambisana nemikhawulo kanye neminyaka emihlanu yokuba ngumholi ophakeme noma ongowesibili, ohlinzeka ngeholo elinganiselwe kwizinga 13.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-B Degree (NQF level 7 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Developmental Studies / Public Management / Public Administration / Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Structural, Mechanical) / Quantity Surveying / Architecture / Urban and Regional Planning / Occupational Construction Health and Safety / Safety Management emva kokuqashwa kweminyaka eyi-5 ezingeni lapho kuba khona i-Middle/ Senior Managerial level kwisakhiwo sangaphakathi. I-Pre-entry certificate ye-Senior Management Service (Nyukela) iyadingeka futhi iyodingeka ngaphambi kokwamukelwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe. Ulwazi kanye namakhono: Ulwazi olunjulu kanye neqiniso ngemashekethi okulawula okuphatha Isevisi Yomphakathi, ulwazi olunjulu ngendlela yesakhiwo sangaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, ukuphathwa kolwazi olungaba yisipho, namashekethi abalawula ukuthuthukiswa kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi. Ukuqonda ngokusobala kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, Isevisi Yomphakathi, kanye namashekethi abalawula ukuthuthukiswa kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi. Ukuqonda ngokusobala kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, Isevisi Yomphakathi, kanye namashekethi abalawula ukuthuthukiswa nokugcina isakhiwo sangaphakathi. Ulwazi ngokubala imali eqhamuka kumphathi wamaphrojekthi kanye nokuphathwa kwamaphoyinti abalulekile (ukuqavile, ukuthenga, ukusebenza, ukulungisa). Ukuqonda ngokusobala kwamashekethi okuqavile isakhiwo sangaphakathi, amanani namaphoyinti abalulekile kanye nokuqavela imali. Ulwazi olunjulu ngokuqavile nokuletha isakhiwo sangaphakathi esifundazweni nakulelo wesizwe, ukulethwa, namashekethi okulungisa. Ukuqonda ngokusobala kokuhlela kohulumeni, ukuthenga, ukuphathwa kwemali (PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations), kanye namasistimu okulawula. Ulwazi ngemiyalo yokulawula umphathi wamaphrojekthi kanye namaphrojekthi, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwengozi kanye namashekethi okuqapha nokuhlola. Ukuqonda ukubambisana phakathi kohulumene, amapholisi wesakhiwo sangaphakathi, kanye nezinhloso zokuqavile. Ukugxila kubantu bakhona kanye nokuqonda ukuthi badinga ini. Ukuthuthukisa abanye. Ukusebenzisa izisekelo zetheknoloji. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuqonda okubalulekile. Ukuxhumanisa nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ukuphatha ukwehlukana kwabantu. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuxhumana kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi. Izigigaba zokuqhuba imihlangano. I-Analytica. Ukuphatha okubalulekile. I-Budget and Information Management. Ukukhuthaza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga / ukuxazulula izinkinga. Iziqu: Ikhono elibalulekile lokulawula kanye nokuba ngumholi. Ukuxhumana. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuqapha umthengi. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokubakhuthaza. Ukuhlaziya izinkinga nokuzixazulula. Ukuphathwa kwemali. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. I-Results / Quality Management. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuphatha inguquko.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi lawule amashekethi ehlelo lokuhlanganiswa kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi esifundazweni. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusebenza kamashekethi abalawulayo bokuhlanganiswa kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi esifundazweni, amasistimu, kanye namaphrotokholi. Luleta i-PICC, i-EXCO, nezakhiwo ezibalawulayo ngokuhleliswa kolwazi kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi nangaphezulu kokulawula. Yiba ngumsizi ohamba phambili ekuhlelisweni kolwazi phakathi kohulumeni ukuze kuqondaniswe ukuhlelelwa nokulethwa kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi kuzo zonke izingxenye. Qedela ukuqondanisa amaphrojekthi wesakhiwo sangaphakathi nokuqavile izinhloso zesifundazwe kanye namashekethi amapholisi. Qaphelela ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo kwamashekethi abalawulayo ukuze kube khona ukubhekana nobunzima nentengo. Qondisa ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo eziyimfihlo ezibalulekile kanye nokweluleka i-PICC. Hola ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo eziyimfihlo ezibalulekile ezakhiweni ezingaba yizokulawula esifundazweni. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa nokwethulwa ngokulinganisela kwemibiko yesakhiwo sangaphakathi ukweseka i-T-PICC nezinye izakhiwo ezingaba yizokulawula, ngalokho kuqondwe izinqumo eziphakeme. Luleta izakhiwo ezingaba yizokulawula ngemvelo yesakhiwo sangaphakathi, izingozi, nezinto eziqavile eziphakeme. Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwamaselicunga okulawula ngokuhleliswa okwenziwe ngendlela eqondile nangesikhathi. Yenza izinqumo ezinolwazi ngokubika ngokunembile, ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi ngokuhlanganiswayo Hola ukungenelela ekuxazululeni izinselele zokulethwa kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi futhi Qedela ukulethwa kwamaphrojekthi abalulekile esifundazwe (PSPS) namaphrojekthi abalulekile. Qondisa ukubona nokuxazulula izinselele zokulethwa kwesakhiwo sangaphakathi ezitholakala ngamaphoyinti abalulekile. Qaphelela ukuhlaziya imvelo yesakhiwo sangaphakathi futhi umceleze izindlela eziphakeme zokungenelela. Luleta ngamanyathelo okulungisa nokuvinjelwa ukubhekana nobudezulu nengasebenzi kahle. Khuphula izingozi ezinamandlaakhulu nezinkinga ezibangelwa ukuphela kwesikhathi nabasebenzi abaphezulu ukuba bazixazulule. Yiba ngumsizi ohamba phambili kwamapulatifomu okusebenza ndawonye ukuze kuqiniswe ukuhleliswa kobunzima, ukubhekana nobunzima, kanye nobuningo obuhlanganyeni kwabahlanganyeli. Qaphelela amadokhumenti wesakhiwo sangaphakathi, Ulwazi, kanye namasistimu okuphathwa kolwazi. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwamasistimu wolwazi ngokusakhiwo sangaphakathi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lusesihlahleni. Yiba ngumsizi ohamba phambili ekuphathweni kolwazi kanye nakulwazi lwesikhathi sethu njengamanje. Qaphelela ukukhiqizwa kwemibiko ebalulekile yezakhiwo ezingaba yizokulawula futhi zibe yiziphathimandla. Yenza ukucatshangelwa okusebenzise ulwazi nokuqonda ukwenza izinqumo ngokuhlanganiswa kwamasistimu wolwazi ngokusakhiwo sangaphakathi. Hola ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlinzeka ngemibiko ebhalwayo ngesikhathi esifanele kwaba ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezakhiwo (i-EXMA / Top Management, izinqumo ze-EXCO, Amagembu Asebenzayo, I-Cluster, I-Audit Committee, I-Risk and Ethics Management Committee, I-Portfolio Committees, I-Parliamentary Standing Committees, i-AGSA). Phatha amaphoyinti abalulekile okugcina amaphoyinti abalulekile. Gcina izinga eliphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / isigaba sikhiqiza umsebenzi omuhle ngokobuningo / inani nangesikhathi. Xazulula izinkinga zokukhuthaza kanye nokuqondisa ngaphandle komsito omningi ovela kumphathi. Yabelana nomsebenzi nabasebenzi ngokususelwa kwingqikithi yomuntu ngamunyaye nika isikhathi esifanele sokuhlakanipha kanye nokusekela futhi unmike abasebenzi ithuba lokufunda nokuthuthuka. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa okuhambisana nesikhathi kwesinqumo somsebenzi nokusetshenziswa kwama-Work Plans nama-Personal Development Plans (PDP's) kubo bonke abasebenzi kwi-Directorate. Lawula imisebenzi yansuku zonke futhi uqinisekise ukulinganiswa kwemisebenzi yabo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa, kanye nokugqamisa amaphoyinti abalulekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi kubekho ukuhlela kweshedi yokugcinwa kwemali kanye nezilawuli zokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimali kwi-PICC Secretariat Directorate. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kokuqashwa kwemali kwi-PICC Secretariat Directorate. Lawula amaphoyinti abalulekile futhi uvimbele ukuphatha kabi imali.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Recruitment & Selection
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Recruitment and Selection at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Bisho, Eastern Cape, offering R932,292 per annum at Level 11.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, B Degree NQF Level 7 (as recognised by SAQA) in Human Resource Management/ Public Administration/ Industrial Psychology with three years’ relevant experience in Human Resource Management at an Assistant Director Level. A valid driver’s licence. Introduction to PERSAL Certificate is compulsory. Knowledge and Skills: In-depth knowledge and understanding of legislative framework that governs the Public Services. Knowledge, understanding and application of legislative framework policies and prescripts that govern the Recruitment and Selection process in the Public Service. In-depth knowledge and understanding of Human Resource Management prescripts and legislations. Knowledge of PERSAL System. Knowledge of Financial regulations and instructions and application of financial procedures. Applied strategic thinking. Research skills. Apply Technology. Budgeting and Financial Management. Communication and Information Management. Continuous Improvement. Citizen Focus and Responsiveness. Developing others. Diversity management Impact and Influence. Managing Interpersonal Conflict and Resolving Problems. Networking and building Bonds. Planning and organising. Problem solving and decision making. Project management. Team Leadership. Computer literate. Good communication skills (verbal and written). Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership. Communication. Client orientation and Customer Focus. People Management and Empowerment. Problem Analysis and Solving. Financial Management. Programme and Project Management. Results/ Quality Management. Decision Making. Knowledge Management. Change Management.
jobs.duties: Manage Implementation of Recruitment, Selection and Appointment Process. Develop and ensure implementation of Annual Recruitment Plan. Manage Implementation of Transfers, Translation and Secondments. Monitor and report on transfers of employees from other departments. Monitor and report on secondment of employees. Report on acting appointments of departmental employees. Management Development and Reviewal Recruitment Policies, Strategies & Procedures. Develop long-term strategies to address employee turnover. Present policy to stakeholders for input. Conduct awareness campaigns on developed and reviewed policy and strategies. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness and implementation of the retention strategies or techniques of the department. Manage Implementation of Pay Progression and Grade progression. Monitor Payments of Pay progression and Grade progression. Request HR status report. Managing area of responsibility. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team\section produces excellent work in terms of quality and timelines. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from managers. Delegate functions to staff, based on individual potential, provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Manage employee performance daily and ensure timely. Ensure development & implementation of work plans for all subordinates.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. T. Matiso at 066 489 6117Ms S. Zazini Tel No: (040) 602 4236 / Mr L Maliti at 066 489 6117 e-recruitment Technical Enquiries: e-recruitment-bhisho@ecdpw.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted as follows: via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e- Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: e-recruitment- bhisho@ecdpw.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00-16:30 Mon- Thursday and 08:00-16:00 on Friday). Hand-delivered/ E-Mailed/ Faxed/ Posted applications will not be accepted.
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to Coloured Female. Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercises and interviews. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behaviourally preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12/24 months. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme      Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews.
