af.title: Bouprojekbestuurder: Kapitale Werke
af.summary: Bestuur en koördineer kapitale werke-bouprojekte vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in die Eastern Cape.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat, Nasionale Hoër Diploma (NQF Level 6) in die Bou-omgewingsveld met 'n minimum van 4 jaar en 6 maande se gesertifiseerde ervaring/ B tech (NQF Level 7) in die Bou-omgewingsveld met 4 jaar se gesertifiseerde bestuurservaring/ Honneursgraad (NQF Level 8) in die Bou-omgewingsveld met 'n minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Verpligte registrasie by die SACPCMP as Professionele Bouprojekbestuurder. Kennis en vaardighede: Besluitneming. Spanleierskap, analitiese vaardighede, vindingrykheid, selfbestuur, finansiële bestuur, klinktfokus en reaksievermoë, kommunikasie, rekenaargeletterdheid, beplanning en organisering, konflikbestuur, probleemoplossing en ontleding, menslikehulpbronbestuur, veranderingsbestuur, innovasie. Bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuur, hoeveelheidsopmetingsbeginsels en -metodologieë, navorsing en ontwikkeling, rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings, kennis van regsvereistes, tegniese verslagskrywing, tegniese konsultasie, skep van 'n hoë-prestasiekultuur, professionele oordeel.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer alle aspekte van projekte (1) Lei die projekbeplanning. Implementering, monitering, verslagdoening en evaluering in ooreenstemming met projekbestuursmetodologie; (2) Skep en voer projekwerkplanne uit en hersien dit soos nodig om veranderende behoeftes en vereistes te akkommodeer; (3) Identifiseer benodigde hulpbronne en wys individuele verantwoordelikhede toe; (4) Bestuur die daaglikse operasionele aspekte van 'n projek se omvang en (5) Pas metodologie doeltreffend toe en handhaaf projekstandaarde om risiko op projekte te minimaliseer. Projekrekeningkunde en finansiële bestuur: (I) Rapporteer projekvordering aan die Hoof van Geboue- Kapitale Werke; en (2) Bestuur die projekbegroting en hulpbronne; Kantooradministrasie: (1 ) Verskaf insette aan ander professionele persone met tenderadministrasie; (2) Skakel en tree in interaksie met diensverskaffers, kliënte en bestuur; (3) Dra by tot aktiwiteite wat verband hou met die toegewysde menslike hulpbronne; (4) Onderhou die rekordbestuurstelsel en die argitektuurbiblioteek; en (5) Gebruik toegekende hulpbronne doeltreffend. Navorsing en ontwikkeling: (1) Hou tredy met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures; (2) navorsing/literatuur oor nuwe ontwikkelinge in projekbestuurstegnologieë; en (3) Skakel met tersaaklike liggame/raade oor projekbestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi Wephrojekthi Yokwakha: Umsebenzi Wemali Yamakhapithali
zu.summary: Phatha futhi uhlanganise amaphrojekthi okwakha omsebenzi wamali amakhapithali eMnyangweni WezokuSebenza Kahulumeni kanye Nezokwakha e-Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-National Higher Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwindiza Yendawo Eyakhiwe ngesilinganiso esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-4 nangaminyaka angu-6 yenkokhelo esemthethweni/ i-B tech (NQF Level 7) kwindiza Yendawo Eyakhiwe ngesiphiwo seminyaka engu-4 yokuhlola esemthethweni/ I-Honours Degree (NQF Level 8) kwindiza Yendawo Eyakhiwe ngesilinganiso esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-3. Ithikithi lokushayela elisebenzayo. Ukwethweswa ibhasokhi okuphothule kwi-SACPCMP njengomuntu osebenza ngobungcweti ekuphathweni kwephrojekthi yokwakha. Ulwazi nezikhono: Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuba ngumholi wqembu, izikhono zokuhlaziya, ukudala, ukuziphatha, ukuphatha imali, ukugxila kumthengi nokusabela, ukuxhumana, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, ukucubungula nokuhlela, ukuphatha izinkinga, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphatha abantu, ukuphatha ushintsho, ukuba yokudala amasu amasha. Amandla okwenza umsebenzi: Ukuphatha uhlelo kanye nensiza yomsebenzi, izimiso kanye nezindlela zokubala inani lolwazi, ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa, izinhlelo zokwakha ezisekelwe ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha, ulwazi ngokuziphendulela ngokomthetho, ukubhala umbiko obhekiswe kwimfundo eqondile, ukweluleka ngezobuchwepheshe, ukwakha isiko elenza umsebenzi ngendlela ephumelelayo, ukwahlulela ngobuchwepheshe.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlanganise zonke izici zephrojekthi (1) Qondisa ukuhlela kwephrojekthi. Ukusetshenziswa, ukulandelwa, ukubika kanye nokuhlola ngokuvumelana nendlela yokuphathwa kwephrojekthi; (2) Dala futhi usebenzise amaphulani okusebenza aphrojekthi futhi uguqule njengoba kufanele ukuze ahambelane nezidingo ezintsha nokushintshwayo; (3) Hlola imithombo edingekayo futhi unikeze izinkingonke umthwalo obhekene nawo; (4) Phatha izinto zansuku zonke eziphathelene nokusebenza kwephrojekthi begodu mhlawumbi (5) Sebenzisa ngokuphelele indlela yokwenza futhi ukhuthaze amazinga okuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi ukunciphisa ingozi yamaphrojekthi. Ukubala ibhajedi yamaphrojekthi kanye nokuphatha imali: (I) Bingela inqubo yephrojekthi kuHloiwozakwamaphrojekthi- Umsebenzi wezimali amakhapithali; futhi (2) Phatha ibhajedi nezinsiza zephrojekthi; Ukuphatha ihhovisi: (1) Nikeza izincomo kubanye ababungathi bekhono ngokuphatha uthando; (2) Thintana futhi uxhumane nezibonakaliso zokulethwa kwezidingo abathengi kanye nokuphatha; (3) Sebenzela kumisebenzi ebandakanya abantu ababelwe imithombo yamandla; (4) gcina ukuphathwa kwemibhalohle nobhalo nobhalo lobungcweti; ngaphezu kwalokho (5) sebenzisa imithombo ka-1988 esemthethweni nangekhono elihle. Ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa: (1) Ziba ngeznokutholwa ezintsha kanye nendlela ezintsha zokwenza; (2) ucwaningo/izincwadi ngokuthuthukiswa okusha ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo zokusebenza kwamaphrojekthi; ngaphezu kwalokho (3) Thintana nabaholi abahlobene /amabhodi ekuphathweni kwamaphrojekthi.

Ilayisenisi yokuqeshisa ethintekileko. Ukubhaliswa ngokuyimfuneko nge SACPCMP njengoMphathi weProjekthi yoKwakhiwa ogqithisweyo. Ulwazi ngezakhono: Ukuthatha iigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela, izakhono zohlalutyo, unxibelelwano, ukuziphatha, ulawulo lweemali, ugqozi kumthengi nempendulo, Unxibelelwano, Ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ucwangciso nolungiselelo, ulawulo lweengxaki, ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo, ulawulo labantu, ulawulo lotshintsho, innovesi. xh.duties: Phatha kwaye unqamise onke amaqondo eeprojekthi (1) Khokela ucwangciso lweprojekthi. Ukuqaliswa, ukulawula, ukubika nokuqwalasela ngokwandlela yokulawula iiprojekthi; (2) Yaza uze usebenze ngocwangciso lomsebenzi weprojekthi wenze utshintsho njengoko kufuneka ukusetyenziswa iimfuno neent的需要 ezitshintshileyo; (3) Chonga abantu abafunekayo kwaye wabelane ngemisebenzi ngamnye; (4) Phatha iinkalo zangemihla ngemihla zokusebenza kweprojekthi nolumgama kwaye (5) Sebenzisa ngenkqubo ngokuchanekileyo kwaye ulandele iinkqubo zeprojekthi ukunciphisa ingozi kwiiprojekthi. IiMali neProject nephathiweyo: (I) Xela inkqubela yeprojekthi kuSihlali wokuQhatha iiNtengiso zeNgcali ezisemzantsi-iCapitel; kwaye (2) Yenza ibhajethi neprojekthi; ulawulo lweofisi: (1 ) Nikezela iingcebiso kubaphi abangenela imisebenzi nolawulo lwe-bidders; (2) Unxibelelane kwaye uvakisane nenezo bezinkonzo, umthengi noyena ulawulo; (3) Ngenela kumsebenzi ochongiweyo kwimisebenzi engavela kwizihlabathi; (4) Sigcine inkqubo yoQhagamshelo lamagama eNgcwele yegumbi lokunconywa kwamasakhiwo; kwaye (5) Sisebenzisa abantu ababelwe imisebenzi ngokuchanekileyo. Uphando nentlarkahliziwa: (1) Sigcine ngokutsha kwiiNkqubo nendlela entsha; (2) Uphando okhankanyiweyo kolwazi iintshukumo ezintsha kwaye ngeenkqubo zolawulo lweenkqubo; kwaye (3) Unxibelelane nemiqulu ebalulekileyo/mikhulu malunga nophatho lweprojekthi.

xh.title: Isik-sokulinganisa izinto: Ukunikezela kolwakhiwo lwezemfundo
xh.summary: Isithuba somlinganisi wezinto eBisho esinika umvuzo we R791604 ngonyaka, sifuna isidanga esifanelekileyo, ukuqatshelwa kwi SACQSP namashumi amathathu eminyaka yamava emva kokufumana isidanga.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNqanaba EliPhezulu lesiKolo samabanga aPhakamileyo, iDegree yeBachelor (iNqanaba le-7 leNQF) nentlalontathu (3) yeminyaka yamava emva kokufumana isidanga njengomlinganisi wezinto iyafuneka. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukuqatshelwa ngokuyimfuneko kwi SACQSP njengoMlinganisi weZinto oyiNtonyi. Ulwazi nakhono: Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela, Umdali, Ukuzilawula, ukulawula imali, Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuphendula, amakhono othutho, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ulungiselelo nokuqamba, ukulawula iingxabano, Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela, Ukulawula abantu, Ukulawula utshintsho, ukuqamba okutsha. Iimfuno zobuchwephesha: Ukulawula iinkqubo namaphrojekthi, iindlela nemiYalelo yamaphrojekthi, Uphando nophuhliso, Izicelo zokwakhiwa ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ulwazi ngokuzithoba ngemigaqo yolawulo, ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwephesha, Ingxoxo yobuchwephesha, Ukwakha inkqubo yokusebenza ngamandla, Ukuzamela, Isigqibo sobuchwephesha.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokulinganisa izinto ezakhiwayo, iindawo okanye iziseko. Lungisanisa amaqela abo bongchi kwazo zonke iindawo ezimalunga nokulinganisa izinto. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba ngokwemigaqo yokulinganisa izinto. Nikela ngengcebiso yokulinganisa izinto nankxaso yobuchwephesha ekunikelweni amaxabiso. Qinisekisa ulawulo nolungiselelo lwebhajethi. Lawula izibonelelo, lungiselela uze uhlanganise izinto ezifakwayo ukuncedisa ukusetyenziswa kwezibonelelo. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba ngemigaqo nendlela zokuthengwa kwezinto ze SCM nabantu. Nikeza ingxelo mayela nentlawulo yokuvela kunye nesebe. Uphando nophuhliso. Uphuhliso oluzinzileyo lobuchwepheshe ngokwemigaqo yebhunga. Izifundo zophando/ulwazi mayela nokulinganisa izinto ukuphucula amakhono. Thetha nabalingane/bhunga abahlobene nezinto ezimalunga nokulinganisa izinto.

jobs.title: Town Planner: Immovable Asset Management
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Town planner needed in Aliwal North to manage immovable assets, facilitate land development projects, and ensure adherence to town planning legal requirements.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor Degree in Urban / Town and Regional Planning or relevant qualification with three (3) years’ post qualification professional experience required. Valid driver’s license. Compulsory Registration with SACPLAN. Knowledge and Skills: Decision making. Team leadership, Creativity, Self- management, financial management, Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication skills, Computer literacy, Delegation and development of others, Planning, organizing and execution, Ability to manage conflict, Problem solving and analysis, Insight, People management and Change management. Competencies: Project and Programme Management. T&R Principles and Methodologies. Research and Development. Computer-aided applications. T&R knowledge of legal compliance. Creating high performance culture. Technical consulting. Professional judgement.
jobs.duties: Ensure the application of Town and Regional Principles in land development. Facilitate and provide technical assistance to professional teams on all aspects regarding town and regional planning projects. Ensure adherence to legal requirements. Coordinate, evaluate and monitor the implementation of development in compliance with applicable legislation and town and regional planning standards and guidelines. Human Capital Development. Mentor, train and develop candidate town and regional planners. Supervise town and regional planning work processes. Office administration and Budget planning. Monitor and control budget. Report on delivery expenditure and service. Research and development. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on town and regional planning related matters. Research Literature studies on town and regional technology to improve expertise.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. M. Mavotsho at 083 753 9381/Mr. M. Tshwaku at 083 753 9381 e-recruitment Technical Enquiries: e-recruitment-bhisho@ecdpw.gov.za

af.title: Stadsbeplanner: Onroerende batebestuur
af.summary: Stadsbeplanner benodig in Aliwal North om onroerende bates te bestuur, grondontwikkelingsprojekte te fasiliteer en om aan stadsbeplanningsregvereistes te voldoen.
af.requirements: Bachelorsgraad in Stede-/Stads- en Streekbeplanning of 'n relevante kwalifikasie met drie (3) jaar se postkwalifikasie professionele ervaring word vereis. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Verpligte registrasie by SACPLAN. Kennis en vaardighede: Besluitneming. Spanleiding, kreatiwiteit, selfbestuur, finansiële bestuur, klintefokus en reaksievermoë, kommunikasievaardighede, rekenaarvaardigheid, afwenteling en ontwikkeling van ander, beplanning, organisering en uitvoering, vermoë om konflik te bestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, insig, mensebestuur en veranderingsbestuur. Bevoegdhede: Projek- en programbestuur. Stads- en streekbeplanningsbeginsels en -metodologieë. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde toepassings. Stads- en streekbeplanningskennis van regswerklikheid. Skep van hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Professionele oordeel.
af.duties: Verseker die toepassing van Stads- en Streekbeplanningsbeginsels in grondontwikkeling. Fasiliteer en verskaf tegniese bystand aan professionele spanne oor alle aspekte rakende stads- en streekbeplanningsprojekte. Verseker voldoening aan regvereistes. Koördineer, evalueer en monitor die implementering van ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en stads- en streekbeplanningsstandaarde en -riglyne. Menslike kapitaalontwikkeling. Mentor, trein en ontwikkel kandidaatstads- en streekbeplanners. Superviseer stads- en streekbeplanningswerkprosesse. Kantooradministrasie en begrotingsbeplanning. Monitor en beheer begroting. Rapporteer oor leweringsuitgawes en diens. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor stads- en streekbeplanningsverwante aangeleenthede. Doen literatuurstudies oor stads- en streekbeplanningstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter.

zu.title: Umqambi Wezindawo: Ukuphathwa Kwamafa Aze Afiwe
zu.summary: Kudingeka umqambi wezindawo eAliwal North ukuphatha amafa aze afiwe, ukweseka amaphrojekhi okuthuthukiswa kwomhlaba, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho zokuqamba izindawo.
zu.requirements: Kudingwa I-Degree ye-Bachelor kwi-Urban / Town and Regional Planning noma iziqu ezifanele okanye nokuthola ubunjiniyela obuncane eminyakeni eyithathu (3) ngemva kokuthola iziqu. I-License evumelekile yokushayela. Ukuhlangana okuphoqele ne-SACPLAN. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuba buhlobo bokuhuba iqembu, ukwakha, ukuziphatha, ukuphatha izimali, ukugxila kubathembeli nokuphendula, amakhono okuxhumana, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukunikeza amanye abantu iziqondiso nokubathuthukisa, ukuhlela, ukuhlela bese kwenziwa, ikhono lokuphatha inhlekelele, ukuxazulula izinkinga ukuze kuhlaziwe, ukuqonda, ukuphatha abantu kanye nokuphatha inguquko. Amakhono: Ukuphathwa kwe-Project kanye ne-Programme. Izimiso Nezendlela ze-T&R. Ukuhlola Nokuthuthukisa. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi lwe-T&R ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukwakha isiko lokusebenza kahle ngokwedlulele. Ukweluleka ngezobuchwepheshe. Isahlulelo sobunjiniyela.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezimiso ze-Town and Regional ekuthuthukisweni kwomhlaba. Weseka unikeze usizo lwezobuchwepheshe amaqembu obunjiniyela kuzo zonke izinto ezimala nama-projekhi okuqamba nokuhlela izindawo nesiswe. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho. Hlanganisa, hlolisisa ulawule ukusetshenziswa kokuthuthukiswa ngokuhambisana nomthetho osemthethweni nezindinganiso nezixwayo zokuqamba nokuhlela izindawo. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwemithamo Yabantu. Qondisa, qeqeshe futhi uthuthukise oqamba bakuqamba bahlela izindawo. Qapha izinqubo zokusebenza zokuqamba nokuhaeza izindawo. Ukuphathwa kwe-ofisi nokuhelela ibhajethi. Hlolisisa ulawule ibhajethi. Binga ngokuhlawulelwa nokuphathwa kwezinkonzo. Ukuhlola nokuthuthukiswa. Xhumana nezikhungo/nabahlanganyeli ngemicimbe ehlobene nokuqamba nokuhelela izindawo. Ukuhlola izifundo zolwazi ngezobuchwepheshe zokuqamba nezindawo ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe.

xh.title: Umcululi Wolawulo Lweedolophu: Ulawulo Lwezinto Ezingahambekiyo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umcululi welawulo lweedolophu e-Aliwal North ukulawula izinto ezingahambekiyo, ukwenza amaprojekthi okuphuhlisa umhlaba, nokuqinisekisa ukuthobela iimfuno zomthetho zolungiselelo lweedolophu.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ubenobudlelwane beDegree yesidanga sokuqala kwi-Urban / Town and Regional Planning okanye nelifikethwana elichanekileyo elineminyaka emithathu (3) yamava abuchwepheshe emva kokufumana ifikethwana. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. UkuRegisterwa ngokuyinyaniso ku-SACPLAN. Ulwazi nakhono: Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukuba ngumlawuli weqela, Umdla wokwenza izinto, Uzilawulo, ulawulo lwengxowa-mali, Ukugxila kubathengi nempendulo, Amakhono onxibelelwano, Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukunikela iindawo kwaye uphuhlise abanye, Ulungiselelo, ukuqamba kunye nokuphumeza, Ikhaladi lokulawula iingxabano, Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlola, Ukuqonda, Ukulawula abantu kunye nokulawula utshintsho. Ikhono: Ulawulo lweProjekthi kunye neNkqubo. Iziphembiso kunye neendlela ze-T&R. Uphononongo nophuhliso. Iindlela ezixhaswa yikhompyutha. Ulwazi lwe-T&R malunga nokuthobela umthetho. Ukuyila inkqubo yokwenza ngokusebenza kakuhle. Ingcebiso ngobuchwepheshe. Isigqibo sabuchwepheshe.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweZiphembiso zeZicelo zoBuhlaliswano kunye namaphondo eDolophu ekuphuhlisweni komhlaba. Yenze kwaye unikeze inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kwiqela labachwepheshe kuzo zonke iindaba ezimalunga neeprojekthi zolungiselelo lolawulo lweedolophu namaphondo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iimfuno zomthetho. Lungisa, hlola kwaye ulawule ukuphunyezwa kokuphuhliswa ngokuvumelana nomthetho osebenzayo neemigaqo yolungiselelo lolawulo lweedolophu namaphondo. Phuhliso lwamandla abantu. Zukhisa, qeqesha kwaye uphuhlise abaqeqeshi bolungiselelo lolawulo lweedolophu namaphondo. Lawula iinkqubo zomsebenzi wolungiselelo lolawulo lweedolophu namaphondo. Ulawulo lwe-ofisi kunye nolungiselelo lweNgxowa-mali. Qhathanisa kwaye ulawule ingxowa-mali. Xela ngokuchithwa koluletho kunye nenkonzo. Uphononongo nophuhliso. Thinta nabaholi nabagunyazisiwe ngeendaba ezimalunga nolungiselelo lolawulo lweedolophu namaphondo. Ziphonononge iifundo zolwazi ngezicelo zobuchwepheshe bolungiselelo lolawulo lweedolophu namaphondo ukuze kuphuculwe ubuchwepheshe.

jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Oversee lease management and coordinate facilities services across district offices in the Eastern Cape for the Department of Public Works & Infrastructure.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, National Diploma (NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA) in Facilities Management/ Property Management / Horticulture & Landscaping / Real Estate / Building / Construction Management with 3 years’ experience at supervisory level or SL7/8 in Facilities Management. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge and Skills: In-depth knowledge and understanding of legislative framework that governs Public Service. In-depth knowledge and understanding of GIAMA. Knowledge and understanding of PFMA. In-depth knowledge and understanding of Occupational Health and Safety Act and related buildings regulations. Knowledge and understanding of Facilities Management Policies, Procedures and Best Practices. Knowledge of Asset and Maintenance Management. Departmental service delivery principles. Departmental Strategic Planning. Departmental Annual Performance Plan. Policies and Procedures. Government Programmes. Provincial Growth and Development Plan for the Eastern Cape. Stakeholder and customer relationship management principles. Planning, coordination. Problem-solving and analytical ability. Facilities inspection and compliance monitoring. Report writing and data analysis. Stakeholder engagement and client relations. Communication. Client relationship management. Report writing and presentation. Computer literacy (MS Office, Facilities Management Systems). Project Coordination.
jobs.duties: Coordinate provision of cleaning services: Coordinate the provision of cleaning services across district facilities. Facilitate development of specifications and procurement processes for cleaning services. Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with service standards. Oversee contract administration, including verification of service delivery and certification of payments. Monitor cleanliness of government facilities to ensure adherence to departmental cleaning standards policies. Coordinate provision of gardening and beautification services: Coordinate provision of gardening and landscaping services for state facilities. Facilitate procurement and appointment of service providers in line with SCM processes. Monitor performance and quality of services delivered. Oversee contract implementation and compliance with environmental standards. Ensure alignment of services with departmental maintenance and beautification standards. Coordinate implementation of condition assessments: Coordinate implementation of condition assessments for state owned facilities. Analyse condition assessment reports to inform maintenance planning and prioritization. Facilitate development of maintenance plans and cost estimates based on condition assessment data. Provide reports to inform infrastructure and asset management decisions – making. Ensure proper recordkeeping of condition assessments and maintenance reports. Manage utilization inspection on state-owned buildings: Plan and conduct utilization inspections to assess use of allocated space. Monitor space utilisation and identify underutilized or non-compliant usage of facilities. Analyse inspection findings and compile reports to inform management decisions. Ensure compliance with GIAMA and space management standards. Monitor maintenance of utilisation and inspection records. Coordinate implementation of health and safety audits on state owned facilities: Coordinate implementation of occupational health and safety requirements across facilities. Monitor compliance with relevant OHS legislation and building regulations. Facilitate execution of health and safety inspections and audits. Analyse risks identified and recommended appropriate corrective interventions. Promote safe working environments in line with statutory and departmental requirements. Supervise the allocated resources: Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from Manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure timeously development of job description and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all employees in the sub- directorate. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Huurkontrakte
af.summary: Oorsien huurkontrakbestuur en koördineer fasiliteitsdienste oor distrikkantore in die Eastern Cape vir die Department of Public Works & Infrastructure.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate, Nasionale Diploma (NQF vlak 6 soos deur SAQA erken) in Fasiliteitsbestuur / Eiendomsbestuur / Tuinbou en Landskapargitektuur / Vastgoed / Boukunde / Konstruksiebestuur met 3 jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak of SL7/8 in Fasiliteitsbestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van GIAMA. Kennis en begrip van PFMA. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid en verwante gebouregulasies. Kennis en begrip van Fasiliteitsbestuurbeleid, -prosedures en -beste praktyke. Kennis van Bate- en Onderhoudsbestuur. Departementele diensleweringsbeginsels. Departementele strategiese beplanning. Departementele Jaarlikse Prestasieplan. Beleid en prosedures. Regeringsprogramme. Provinsiale Groei- en Ontwikkelingsplan vir die Eastern Cape. Belanghebbende- en kliëntverhoudingsbestuursbeginsels. Beplanning, koördinasie. Probleemoplossing en analitiese vermoë. Fasiliteitsinspeksie en nakomingsmonitering. Verslagskrywing en data-ontleding. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en kliëntverhoudinge. Kommunikasie. Kliëntverhoudingsbestuur. Verslagskrywing en aanbieding. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office, Fasiliteitsbestuurstelsels). Projekkoördinasie.
af.duties: Koördineer die verskaffing van skoonmaakdienste: Koördineer die verskaffing van skoonmaakdienste oor distrikfasiliteite. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van spesifikasies en prosesse vir die verkryging van skoonmaakdienste. Monitor kontrakteursprestasie en verseker nakoming van diensstandaarde. Oorsien kontrakadministrasie, insluitend verifikasie van dienslewering en sertifisering van betalings. Monitor netheid van regeringsfasiliteite om nakoming van departementele skoonmaakstandaardbeleid te verseker. Koördineer die verskaffing van tuinmaak- en verfraaiingsdienste: Koördineer die verskaffing van tuinmaak- en landskapdienste vir staatsfasiliteite. Fasiliteer verkryging en aanstelling van diensverskaffers in ooreenstemming met SCM-prosesse. Monitor prestasie en kwaliteit van gelewerde dienste. Oorsien kontrakimplementering en nakoming van omgewingsstandaarde. Verseker belyning van dienste met departementele onderhouds- en verfraaiingsstandaarde. Koördineer implementering van toestandsondersoeke: Koördineer implementering van toestandsondersoeke vir staatsbesitfasiliteite. Analiseer verslae van toestandsondersoeke om onderhoudsbeplanning en prioritisering in te lig. Fasiliteer ontwikkeling van onderhoudsplanne en koste-beramings gebaseer op toestandsondersoekdata. Verskaf verslae om infrastruktuur- en batebestuursbesluitneming in te lig. Verseker behoorlike rekordhouding van toestandsondersoeke en onderhoudsverslae. Bestuur benuttingsinspeksies op staatsbesitgeboue: Beplan en voer benuttingsinspeksies uit om gebruik van toegekende ruimte te beoordeel. Monitor ruimtebenutting en identifiseer onderbenutte of nie-nakomende gebruik van fasiliteite. Analiseer inspeksiebevindings en stel verslae op om bestuursbesluite in te lig. Verseker nakoming van GIAMA en ruimtebestuursstandaarde. Monitor onderhoud van benuttings- en inspeksierekords. Koördineer implementering van gesondheids- en veiligheidsoudits op staatsbesitfasiliteite: Koördineer implementering van vereistes vir beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid oor fasiliteite. Monitor nakoming van tersaaklike OHS-wetgewing en gebouregulasies. Fasiliteer uitvoering van gesondheids- en veiligheidsinspeksies en -oudits. Analiseer geïdentifiseerde risiko's en beveel toepaslike korrektiewe ingryping aan. Beveilig veilige werksomgewings in ooreenstemming met statutêre en departementele vereistes. Superviseer toegekende hulpbronne: Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span / afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van gehalte / kwantiteit en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer op met minimale leiding van die Bestuurder. Delegeer funksies aan personeel gebaseer op individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling van posbeskrywing en implementering van Werksplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle werknemers in die subdirektoraat. Bestuur daaglikse werknemersprestasie en verseker tydige Prestasie-assesserings van alle ondergeskiktes. Verseker bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van bates

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqhawe: Izikwemukelo
zu.summary: Qaphatha ukuphathwa kwezikwemukelo futhi uhlanganise imisebenzi yezikhungo kuzofisi zesifunda kwingingqi yakwa Eastern Cape umnyango we Department of Public Works & Infrastructure.
zu.requirements: I-Certificate yesiqu esimnyama sezwelonke, i-Diploma Yezwe (izinga 6 le-NQF njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA) ekuphathweni kwezikhungo / ekuphathweni kwempahla / ekuhlehleni nokuhlela indawo / kumakethe yasemuha / kwakhiwo / ekuphathweni kokwakha ibe nomuzwa wangeminyaka engu-3 ezingeni lokubeka abantu noma esigabeni se-SL7/8 ekuphathweni kwezikhungo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile nokubaqonda isimiso sezomthetho esibusula Inkonzo Kahulumeni. Ulwazi olujulile nokubaqonda i-GIAMA. Ulwazi nokubaqonda i-PFMA. Ulwazi olujulile nokubaqonda umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwenkonzo nomthetho ohlobene newakhiwo. Ulwazi nokubaqonda izinqubomgomo Zokuphathwa Kwezikhungo, Izinqubo Nezindlela Ezinhle. Ulwazi Lokuphathwa Kwempahla Nokugcinwa Kwakho. Imigidingo yaleyonke iminyango yokwethulwa kwenkonzo. Ukuhlela Isu Lenhlobo Yomnyango. Isu SokuQhuba Imisebenzi Ngonyaka Komnyango. Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo. Ohlelo Luhulumeni. Isu SokuKhula Nokuthuthuka Kwesifunda Sakwa Eastern Cape. Imigidingo yokuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zomphakathi nabakhulumisana kanye nabathengi. Ukuhlela, ukuhlanganisa. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuhlola izikhungo nokulawula ukuze kuhambisana nemigango. UkuBhala umbiko nokuHlaziya idatha. Ukuxhumana nabaphakathi nabathengi. Ukuxhumana. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zabathengi. UkuBhala umbiko nokuhlolwa kolwazi. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (I-MS Office, Amasistimu OkuPhathwa Kwezikhungo). UkuHlanganisa Amaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokucwaba: Hlanganisa ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokucwaba kuzo zonke izikhungo zesifunda. Siza ekuthuthukisweni kwemibhalo yeminyuzo nezinqubo zokuthenga izinkonzo zokucwaba. Qapha ukusebenza kwabathwesihlomulo ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemigango yenkonzo. Qapha ukuphathwa kwezinkwamuko, okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukunikezwa kwenkonzo kanye nesitifiketi sokukhokha. Qapha ukuhlanzwa kwezikhungo zahulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nezinqubomgomo zemigango yokucwaba yomnyango. Hlanganisa ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokulima izinkuni nokuhlobisa: Hlanganisa ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokulima nokuhlela indawo yezikhungo zezwe. Siza ekuthengeni nokumisweniabanikezeli benkonzo ngokushaywe isandla semiqondo ye-SCM. Qapha ukusebenza ikhono nemithombo yezinkonzo ezinikezwayo. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwenkqubo yezinkwamuko nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemigango yendalo. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwezinkonzo nemigango yokugcina nokuhlobisa yomnyango. Hlanganisa ukuphathwa kwesimo sezikhungo: Hlanganisa ukuphathwa kwesimo sezikhungo ezinkantolo zikahulumeni ezigcinwe ngawo uhlola isimo sezindawo ukwazisa ukuhlela ukugcina ukubaluleka kwazo. Siza ekuthuthukiseni izu lokugcina kanye nokulinganisa izindleko ngokususelwa emininingwaneni yesimo sokuhlola. Nikeza imibiko ukwazisa izinqumo zokuphathwa kwesisekelo kanye nemiphatho. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kohlule lwesimo sezikhungo kanye nemibiko yokugcina. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kwezikhungo ezakhiwe uhulumeni: Hlela futhi wenze ukubuyekeza ukusetshenziswa ukuhlola ukusetshenziswa kwesikhala esinikiwe. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwesikhala bese uthola ukusetshenziswa okungalungile noma okungalungi kwezikhungo. Hlaziya izimbola zokuqinisekisa bese uhlanganisa imibiko ukwazisa izinqumbo zomphathi. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana ne-GIAMA nemigango yokuqashwa kwesikhala. Qapha ukugcinwa kohlu lokubuyekeza nokusetshenziswa. Hlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kokuqinisekiswa kwezempilo kanye nokuphepha ezikhungweni zikahulumeni: Hlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezidingo zezempilo nokuphepha kuzo zonke izikhungo. Qapha ukuhambisana nomthetho ohlobene ne-OHS kanye nomthetho wakhiwo. Siza ekwenzeni ukuqinisekiswa kokuphepha kanye nokuhlolwa nokubuyekeza. Hlaziya izingozi ezitholakalayo futhi uncoma ukuxazulula okufanele. Khuthaza izindawo zokusebenza ezizibusayo ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho nomnyango. Lawula abasebenzi ababelwe: Gcina emazinga aphakeme nokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / isigaba sikhulela umbala omuhle ngenkani / ukuthi isimo kanye nokuthi senza ngokushesha. Xazulula izinkinga zenhlalo yokudlondlobala kanye nokulawula ngosizo oluncane ovela kumphathi. Nikeza abasebenzi umsebenzi ngokusekelwe ngokuphumelelayo kwabo, unikeze isiqondiso esidingekayo nesikhuthazo, unikeze futhi abasebenzi ithuba lokuzilolonga ukuze bathuthuke. Qinisekisa ngokushesha ukuthuthukiswa komyalelo wemisebenzi kanye nokuphathwa kohlelo lomsebenzi nokuThuthukiswa Kwesiqu (i-PDP) kubo bonke abasebenzi esimu-(subdirectorate). Lawula nsuku zonke ukusebenza kwabasebenzi futhi uqinisekise isikhathi sokubuyekeza ukusebenza kubo bonke abangaphansi kwakho. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa nokusethwa kwezimpahla

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Iziqeshi
xh.summary: Qwalasela ulawulo lweziqeshi kwakunye nokuqamba iinkonzo zokwakha endaweni yamagumbi ohlelo kumazantsi e-Eastern Cape esebe lezaMsebenzi Akuwo wonke & ezokuPhangisa.
xh.requirements: Isetifikethi seQonga leSizwe, iDiploma yaseNalweni (inqanaba le-6 le-NQF njengokuqatyiweyo yi-SAQA) kuLawulo lwezinto ezingundoqo / uLawulo lwezindlu ne propoti / uLimi kwendlalo nokuHlela iNdalo / iMveliso eYilelwe / uKwakha / uLawulo lokuKhakha olunesipho saminyaka i-3 kwinqanaba lokuqalisa okanye i-SL7/8 kuLawulo lwezinto ezingundoqo. ilayisenisi ekhethwayo yomqhubi. ulwazi namakhono: ukuqonda ngolwizi olujulileyo usethelekiso wolwangu olulawula inkonzo kaWonkewonke. ulwazi olunjulileyo nokuqonda nge-GIAMA. ulwazi nokuqonda nge-PFMA. ulwazi nokuqonda olunjulileyo ngoMthetho wokuKhuseleka nokuPhila komSebenzi namagunya ezakhiwo axhunye nawo. ulwazi nokuqonda ngeNkqubo zoLawulo lwezinto ezingundoqo, iinkqubo nezinto ezenziwa kakuhle. ulwazi ngoLawulo lweempahla nokuyigcina. iingcamango zokuHlinza inkonzo zesabe. iCebo leSakhiwo seSabe. iCandelo loMsebenzi lwamnyaka lakaWonkewonke leSabe. iinkqubo neenkqubo zokusebenza. iinkqubo zoHulumende. icebo loKhulo nokuPhuhlisa koPhondo lwe-Eastern Cape. iingcamango zoLawulo lwesimo lokusebenzisana nabanikeli besebenzi nabathengi. ukuCwangcisa, ukuQamba. isakhono sokuzalisa iingxaki nokuqonda ngokuhlalutywa. ukugcinwa kwezinto ezingundoqo nokuqwalasela ukuzaliseka. ukubhala iingxelo nokuhlalutya idatha. ukuthintana nabanikeli besebenzi nokuqhubana namathenga. ukuThetha. ulawulo lokusebenzisana namathenga. ukubhala iingxelo nokuvo ekhoyo. ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office, iinkqubo zoLawulo lwezinto ezingundoqo). ukuQamba amaphulo.
xh.duties: Qamba ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zokucoza: Qamba ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zokucoza kumazantsi amagumbi ezinto ezingundoqo. Yenza uphuhliso lwezinto ezichaziweyo neenkqubo zokuthenga iinkonzo zokucoza. Qwalasela ukusebenza komthengi ukuqinisekisa ukuzaliseka kwemigangatho yenkonzo. Qwalasela ulawulo lweqesho, kuquka ukuqinisekisa ukunikezwa kweenkonzo nokuqinisekisa imirhozo yokuhlawula. Qwalasela ukusula kwezakhiwo zohulumende kuqinisekisa ukuzinikela kweenkqubo zemigangatho yokucoza yesabe. Qamba ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zelimi ebalayo nokuhlobisa: Qamba ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zelimi nokuhlela indalo kumagumbi ohulumende. Yenza ukuthenga nokumisa abaniki besebenzi ngokweenkqubo ze-SCM. Qwalasela ukusebenza nomgangathoweenkonzo ezenzelweyo. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweqesho nokuzaliseka nemigangatho yendalo. Qinisekisa uqikelelo lweenkonzo nemigangatho yokulungisa nokuhlobisa yesabe. Qamba ukuphunywa kwezimo ezihlolwayo: Qamba ukuphunywa kwezimo ezihlolwayo kwizakhiwo ezikabuhulumende kwelakwe nayiphi na indawo. Hlalutya iingxelo zemo ezihlolwayo ukwazisa ukuCwangcisa uLungiso nokubeka izinto phambili. Yenza uphuhliso lweendawo ezilungiswayo kunye nezilinganiso zexabiso ngokusekwa kwedatha yemo ezihlolwayo. Nikeza iingxelo ezizisa izigqibo ezimayela noLawulo lwemitaro yokuphila nokwakhiwa – ukuza. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa koluhlu lwezimo ezihlolwayo nokuLungisa iingxelo. Lawula ukusetyenziswa koluhlu oluhlolwayo kwizakhiwo zikahulumende: Cwangcisa ukuze uhlole ukusetyenziswa ukuze uqwalasele ukusetyenziswa kwendawo enikiweyo. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwendawo uze uchukulule ukusetyenziswa okunganasiphelo okanye okungalunganga kwezinto ezingundoqo. Hlalutya iziphumo ezihlolwayo uze uhlanganise iingxelo ezizalisa izigqibo bolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela kwi-GIAMA kumigangatho yolawulo lwesithuba. Qwalasela ukulungisa iirekhodi zokusetyenziswa nezihlolwayo. Qamba ukuphunywa kwevidyanso yokuKhuseleka nokuPhila kwizakhiwo zikabuhulumende: Qamba ukuphunywa kwezidingo zokuKhuseleka nokuPhila abasebenzi kulo onke amagumbi. Qwalasela ukuzinikela ngomthetho olongeneyo we-OHS namagunya ezakhiwo. Sabela ekuphunyweni kokuhlolwa nokuphonononga kokuKhuseleka nokuPhila. Hlalutya iingozi ezichukululwayo uze uzeke izindululo ezilungileyo. Khuthaza izithuba zokusebenza ezikhuselekileyo ngokwemfuno yesab nakomthetho yesabe. Lawula abasebenzi ababelweyo: Gcina imigangatho ephezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela / icandelo lvela nomsebenzi omhle ngokwemigangatho / ngobungakanani naxesha. Nika isisombululo iingxaki zokukhuthaza nokulawula ngoncedo oluncinci oluvela kuManaja. Yabelana imisebenzi abasebenzini ngokusekwa kwesakhono sabo, nikeza ingcebiso nencedo elifunekayo uze unike abasebenzi ithuba lokuziqeqesha nokuphuhlisa. Qinisekisa ukuba kuphuhlise ngexesha elifanelekileyo inkcazelo yomsebenzi nokuphunywa kweeNkqubo zoMsebenzi neZicwangciso zoPhuhliso zeSiqu (i-PDP's) kubo bonke abasebenzi kwicandelo elingamelwa ngaphansi. Lawula umsebenzi wansuku yonke wabasebenzi ukuze uqinisekise ukuba kwenziwa ukuhlolwa kokusebenza ngexesha elifanelekileyo kubo bonke abangamelwa ngaphansi. Qinisekisa uLawulo, ukuLungisa nokugcinwa kweempahla

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Land and Property Development
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director overseeing land and property development, immovable asset registers and GIS mapping for the Department of Public Works in Mount Ayliff.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificates/ National Diploma (NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA) in Real Estate/Property Management/ Land Administration/ Town Planning with three years’ experience at supervisory level in Property Management. Valid driver’s licence. Knowledge and Skills: In-depth knowledge and understanding of legislative framework that governs the public service. Departmental service delivery principles. Knowledge of departmental policies and procedures. Knowledge and application of Property development principles. Knowledge of Land administration and vesting processes. Knowledge and application of GIAMA. Knowledge Deed Registries Act, Surveyor General’s office procedures. Knowledge of Deeds Office and Surveyor General procedures. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management Act and procedures. Knowledge of GIS and Land Information Systems. Planning and coordination. Property data analysis. Stakeholder engagement. Report writing. GIS and property systems literacy. Problem-solving.
jobs.duties: Coordinate development and maintenance of Immovable Asset Register. Coordinate process for collection, verification, and updating of immovable asset data. Facilitate GIS mapping and site verification and desktop research processes. Monitor accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the Immovable Asset Register. Facilitate provision of property information to stakeholders. Liaise with municipalities and relevant stakeholders to validate asset data. Coordinate Acquisition & Disposal of Immovable Assets Coordinate acquisition and disposal processes of immovable assets in line with legislation. Facilitate stakeholder engagement with municipalities, landowners, and relevant authorities. Oversee preparation and submission of acquisition and disposal applications. Monitor compliance with land claim verification and statutory requirements. Coordinate registration, transfer, and safekeeping of property documentation. Monitor updating of asset registers following acquisition or disposal processes. Coordinate implementation of vesting process. Coordinate identification of state properties requiring vesting. Facilitate preparation and submission of vesting applications. Coordinate presentation of vesting cases to relevant committees. Monitor recording of vested properties in relevant systems (LAW & Asset Register). Provide technical support on vesting processes. Coordinate land and audit projects. Coordinate planning and implementation of land audit projects. Provide technical oversight into audit methodologies and processes. Facilitate data collection, verification, and site inspection processes. Consolidate audit findings and ensure integration into asset management planning. Monitor progress and quality of audit outputs. Supervise the allocated resources: Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure timeously development of job description and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all employees in the sub-directorate. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates.

Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behaviourally preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Grond- en Eiendomsontwikkeling
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur wat toesig hou oor grond- en eiendomsontwikkeling, register van roerlose bates en GIS-kartering vir die Departement van Openbare Werke in Mount Ayliff.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Nasionale Diploma (NQF vlak 6 soos erken deur SAQA) in Onroerende Eiendom/Eiendomsbestuur/Grondadministrasie/Stadsbeplanning met drie jaar se ervaring op toesighoudende vlak in Eiendomsbestuur. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die staatsdiens regeer. Departementele diensleweringbeginsels. Kennis van departementele beleide en prosedures. Kennis en toepassing van eiendomsontwikkelingsbeginsels. Kennis van grondadministrasie en vestigingsprosesse. Kennis en toepassing van GIAMA. Kennis van Akteregisterwet, prosedures van die Kantoor van die Landmeter-generaal. Kennis van Aktekantoor- en Landmeter-generaal-prosedures. Kennis van die Supply Chain Management Act en prosedures. Kennis van GIS en Grondinligtingstelsels. Beplanning en koördinering. Eiendomsdata-analise. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Verslagdoening. Geletterdheid in GIS- en eiendomstelsels. Probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Koördineer ontwikkeling en instandhouding van die Register van Roerlose Bates. Koördineer proses vir die versameling, verifikasie en opdatering van roerlose bate-data. Fasiliteer GIS-kartering, terreinverifikasie en lessenaarnavorsingsprosesse. Monitor akkuraatheid, volledigheid en integriteit van die Register van Roerlose Bates. Fasiliteer verskaffing van eiendomsinligting aan belanghebbendes. Skakel met munisipaliteite en ter sake belanghebbendes om bate-data te bevestig. Koördineer Verkryging en Van Rooi van Roerlose Bates. Koördineer verkrygings- en van rooi-prosesse van roerlose bates in ooreenstemming met wetgewing. Fasiliteer belanghebbende-betrokkenheid met munisipaliteite, grondeienaars en ter sake owerhede. Hou toesig oor voorbereiding en indiening van verkrygings- en van rooi-aansoeke. Monitor voldoening met grondeisverifikasie en statutêre vereistes. Koördineer registrasie, oordrag en veilige bewaring van eiendomsdokumentasie. Monitor opdatering van bateregisters na verkrygings- of van rooi-prosesse. Koördineer implementering van vestigingsproses. Koördineer identifisering van staatseiendomme wat vestiging vereis. Fasiliteer voorbereiding en indiening van vestigingsaansoeke. Koördineer voorlegging van vestigingsake aan ter sake komitees. Monitor registrasie van gevestigde eiendomme in ter sake stelsels (LAW & Asset Register). Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning oor vestigingsprosesse. Koördineer grond- en ouditprojekte. Koördineer beplanning en implementering van grondouditprojekte. Verskaf tegniese toesig oor ouditmetodologieë en -prosesse. Fasiliteer data-versameling, -verifikasie en terreininspeksieprosesse. Konsolideer ouditbevindings en verseker integrasie in batebestuursbeplanning. Monitor vordering en gehalte van oudit-uitsette. Osesig hou oor toegewysde hulpbronne: Handhaaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span/afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van gehalte/hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Los probleme van motivering en beheer op met minimum leiding van die bestuurder. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling van werksbeskrywings en implementering van Werksplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle werknemers in die subdirektoraat. Bestuur daaglikse werknemerprestasie en verseker tydige Prestasie-assesserings van alle ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Umncintiswano Wezimo Eziphakeme: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwendawo Nendalo Yezindlu
zu.summary: Umkhulumi ohola ukuthuthukiswa kwendawo nendalo yezindlu, ukuqoshwa kwezimpahla ezingahambahambi kanye nokumaptha kwe-GIS kuMnyango Wezomsebenzi Womphakathi e-Mount Ayliff.
zu.requirements: Izitifikedi eziphakeme zesifunda/I-Diploma Yezwe (izinga le-NQF 6 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Estate Yezindlu/Imigomo Yendawo/ Ukuphathwa Kwendawo/ I-Town Planning enamava eminyaka emithathu ezingeni lokuqashisa kuphathwa kwendawo. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ulwazi Namasakhono: Ulwazi olujulile nokukuqonda umthethosisekelo ohola isevisi yomphakathi. Imigomo yokuhlinzwa ngekhulu le-Departmental. Ulwazi ngemigomo noma imiyalelo yesigaba esithi ukuthuthukiswa kwendawo. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwendawo namapurekhedi okubekela izimpahla iromodhi. Ulwazi nokusetshenziswa kwe-GIAMA. Ulwazi lwe-Deed Registries Act, izinqamulelo ze-Surveyor General's office. Ulwazi lwe-Deeds Office nezinqamulelo ze-Surveyor General. Ulwazi lwe-Supply Chain Management Act nasezinqamulelweni. Ulwazi lwe-GIS namasistimu e-Land Information Systems. Ukuhlela ukubambisana. Ukuhlaziya idatha yendawo. Ukuthintana nabanomzabalazo. Ukubhala imibiko. Ulwazi olubanzi lwe-GIS namasistimu ezindawo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Xhumanisa ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kolunye lwaziswa olungahambahambi. Xhumanisa inqamulelo yokuqoqa ukuqinisekisa futhi ubuyekeze idatha yezimpahla ezingahambahambi. Xhumanisa imisebenzi yokumaptha kwe-GIS ukuqinisekisa isiza nokwenza ucwaningo lwekhompyutha. Hlola ukuqondakala ukugqamisa ukuzinza kolunye lwaziswa olungahambahambi. Xhumanisa ukunikezwa kwendawo ngolwazi kubanomzabalazo. Thintana nabalawuli bomphakatha futhi kubanomzabalazo abahambisanayo ukuze uqinisekise idatha yezimpahla. Xhumanisa ukutholwa nokuhetha izimpahla ezingahambahambi Xhumanisa ukutholwa nokuhetha izimpahla ezingahambahambi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Xhumanisa ukuxhumana kubanomzabalazo ngabalawuli bomphakatha, abanomhlaba, namaphuzu ahambisanayo. Hola ukulungiswa nokuthunyelwa kwezinqubo zokuqasula nokuthengiswa. Xhumanisa ukuhambisana nomthetho kokuqinisekisa izifungo zendawo kanye nezidingo ezisemthethweni. Xhumanisa ukuqoshwa, ukudluliswa, nokugcinwa kokuqoshwa kwezimpahla. Hlola ukubuyekeza izibuko lezimpahla ngemva kokuqasula noma ukuhetha. Xhumanisa ukusebenzisa inqamulelo yokubekela izimpahla iromodhi. Xhumanisa ukubona izimpahla zikahulumeni ezidinga ukubekelwa iromodhi. Xhumanisa ukulungiswa nokuthunyelwa kwezinqubo zokuqasula iromodhi. Xhumanisa ukuhola izinkomba zokuqasula iromodhi kubaholi abahambisanayo. Hlola ukubhalwa kwendawo ekuthunyelwe iromodhi kwizinhlelo ezingezansi (LAW & Asset Register). Nikeza usizo olujulile ngeziphiwo zokuqasula iromodhi. Xhumanisa imiklamo yendlalo nokuhlolwa kweminyaka. Xhumanisa ukulungelelwa nokusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuqasula imiholo yezimpahla. Nikeza ukuhola ngokobuchwepheshe emakethweni nasemaqoqweni ohlelo. Xhumanisa ukuqoqwa kolwazi, ukuqinisekiswa, nokuqashwa kwesiza. Xhumanisa iziphumo zokuqasula ukuze zibekwe kunokuhlelelwa kokuphathwa kwezimpahla. Hlola inqubomgomo kanye nobuningi bokusebenza okuhle. Qaphela imithombo ekiwe ngokwezimali ekiwe: Gcina izinga eliphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu/isigaba siyakha ngokuphumelelayo ngokobuningi kanye ngesikhathi. Xazulula izinkinga zokuqasha nokulawula ngaphandle kokuholelwa ngaphezulu komphathi. Yabelana imisebenzi kubasebenzi ngokobuchwepheshe babo nikeza isiqondiso kanye nokuqashisa bakanikeza abasebenzi ithuba lokulolongwa nokuqashiswa. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa kwesikhathi sokusebenza okuhlobene nezidingo zomsebenzi nokusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza nokuphumelela ngokomuntu ngamunye (i-PDP's) kubasebenzi bonke baku-sub-directorate. Lawula ukubonakala kwabasebenzi nsuku zonke futhi uqinisekise ukubaluleka kokuhlolwa kokuphumelela ngasikhathi sobonke abaphansi.

xh.title: I-Assistant Director: Land and Property Development
xh.summary: I-Assistant Director elawula uphuhliso lomhlaba nempahla, iirejista zempahla ezingahanjiswa kunye nokumapisha kwe-GIS kwi-Department of Public Works e-Mount Ayliff.
xh.requirements: Izatifikethi ze-National Senior Certificates/ i-National Diploma (NQF level 6 njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Real Estate/Property Management/ Land Administration/ Town Planning kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava kwinqanaba lolawulo kwi-Property Management. I-Valid driver's licence. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi oluqinileyo nokuqonda kolawulo ngokomthetho olulawula inkonzo karhulumente. Iimvisiswano zolawulo lwenkonzo yesebe. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo nemiqathango yesebe. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa iimvisiswano zophuhliso lwendawo. Ulwazi ngolawulo lomhlaba neenkqubo zokubeka izinto ngokomthetho. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa i-GIAMA. Ulwazi nge-Deed Registries Act, iinkqubo zofiso lwe-Surveyor General. Ulwazi nge-Deeds Office neenkqubo zika-Surveyor General. Ulwazi nge-Supply Chain Management Act neenkqubo zayo. Ulwazi nge-GIS nge-Land Information Systems. Ukuqwalasela ukuqondanisa. Ukuhlola iinkcukacha zendawo. Ukuzibandakanya nabantu abahlukeneyo. Ukubhala iingxelo. Ulwazi lwe-GIS ngeenkqubo zendawo. Ukusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Qondanisa uphuhliso nolondolozo lwe-Immovable Asset Register. Qondanisa inkqubo yokuqokelela, ukuqinisekisa, nokuhlaziya iinkcukacha zempahla ezingahanjiswa. Yenza kube lula ukumapisha kwe-GIS nokunyanzezelwa kwindawo nweenkqubo zophando kwiidesktop. Lilise ukuchaneka, ukuzaliseka, nokuthembeka kwe-Immovable Asset Register. Yenza kube lulu kubonelelwa abantu abahlukeneyo ngeenkcukacha zendawo. Thathelana ngeenkcukacha kunye namaphondo nabantu abahlukeneyo abafanelekileyo ukuqinisekisa iinkcukacha zempahla. Qondanisa Ukufunyanwa kwaye Kusetyenziswe i-Acquisition & Disposal of Immovable Assets Qondanisa iinkqubo zokufumanisa nokususa izinto ezingahanjiswa ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Yenza kube lulu ukuthathelana nabahlobo namaphondo, abanini-mhlaba, namagunyaziso afanelekileyo. Qhathanisa ulungiselelo nokungenisa izicelo zokufumanisa nokususwa kwempahla. Lilise ukuzinikela ngokomthetho ekungeniseni iinkcukacha zesikolo kwaye uqinisekise izinto ezifunwa ngomthetho. Qondanisa ukubhalisa, ukudlulisa, nokugcina iinkcukacha zendawo. Lilise ukuhlaziya kweepathi ezibhalwe kubo impahla emva kokuba ifunyenwe okanye isusiwe. Qondanisa ukusebenza kwenkqubo yevesting. Qondanisa ukuchonga iindawo karhulumente ezifuna ivesting. Yenza kube lulu ulungiselelo nokungeniswa kwezicelo zevesting. Qondanisa ukubonisa iicala zevesting kwiikomiti ezifanelekileyo. Lilise ukubhalwa kweendawo ezinikezelwe kwiinkqubo ezifanelekileyo (LAW & Asset Register).ikaZiko loncedo lobuchwepheshe kwinkqubo yevesting. Qondanise iiprojekthi zokuhlola umhlaba. Qondanisa ukuqwalasela nokuphumeza iiprojekthi zokuhlola umhlaba. Zinze ukulawula ngobuchwepheshe iindlela nemiqathango yokuqwalasela. Yenza kube lulu ukuyohola iinkcukacha, ukuqinisekisa, nokuqwalasela iindawo. Dibanisa iziphumo zokuqwalasela uze uqinisekise ukuzidityanisa kwazo kuluhlu lokuqwalasela impahla. Lilisa inkqubo nangobuchwepheshe iziphumo zokuqwalasela. Lawula imithombo enikiweyo: Zigcine kuqondo eliphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela / candelo lvela umsebenzi ongummthetho ngokwakhe nangokwexabiso / ubungakanani kwaye ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Susa iingxaki zemifuno nokulawula ngenkxaso encinci evela kumlawuli. Yabelana ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi ngokwamandla abo athile ubonelele ngenkxaso efunekayo yaye unike abasebenzi ithuba elifanelekileyo lokuzilolonga nokuphucula ulwazi lwabo. Qinisekisa ukuba kuphuhliswa ngexesha elifanelekileyo iinkcazelo zomsebenzi nokuphunywa kweWork Plans kunye ne-Personal Development Plans (PDP's) yabo bonke abasebenzi kwesebe ngaphantsi kwalo. Lawula imisebenzi yabasebenzi yemihla ngemihla uze uqinisekise ukwenziwa kokuhlola ngokusembeni kwabo bonke abantu abangaphantsi kwakho.

af.title: Hoofambagsman: Graad a
af.summary: Bestuur tegniese dienste, lei veld- en werkswinkelspanne, en verseker gehaltversekering en veiligheidsnakoming vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Handelstoetssertifikaat binne die bou-omgewing met tien (10) jaar post-kwalifikasie-ervaring vereis as 'n Ambagsman/Ambagsman-voorman. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Algemene Kennis: Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act. Projekkoördinasie, Tegniese Ontwerp en Analise-kennis, Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Tegniese ontwerp en analise-kennis, tegniese verslagdoening, tegniese konsultasie, rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings, wettige nakoming, produksieproseskennis en -vaardighede, spanwerk, interpersoonlike vaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede. probleemoplossing en analise, besluitneming, Beplanning & Organisering, rekenaarvaardighede, bestuur, klantfokus en reaksievermoë.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste. Lei en begeleid die levering van tegniese dienste in die veld en werkswinkels. Fasiliteer en monitor die bevordering van veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulasiesvereistes. Verskaf gehaltversekeringsdienste in ooreenstemming met spesifikasies. Bestuur onderhoud van tegniese dienste. Bestuur die onderhoud van alle soorte tegniese toerusting en fasiliteite. Onderhou die tegniese infrastruktuur. Bestuur en monitor die uitvoering van daaglikse voorkomende en onderhoudswerk. Bestuur administratiewe en verwante funksies. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses. Stel verslae op en dien dit soos vereis in. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese operasionele plan. Bestuur die opdatering van die databasis. Bestuur menslike en fisiese hulpbronne. Afrig en mentoreer ondergeskiktes. Stel werksprofiele op. Ontwikkel werksplanne. Voer prestasie-evaluerings uit. Identifiseer opleidingsbehoeftes. Finansiële Bestuur. Beheer en monitor bestedingsneigings. Personeelbestuur. Onderhou en bevvaardig kundigheid.

zu.title: INkosi Yobuciko: Ibanga a
zu.summary: Phatha izinsizakalo ezobuchwepheshe, uhola amaqembu asemdedeni nasemsebenzini wokwenza izinto, futhi uqinisekise ukulawula ikhwalithi nokuhambisana nemithetho yokusicekela phansi kweMnyango WezemiBhalo Nokwakhiwa.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Esifanelekile Sovivinyo Lobuciko endaweni yokwakhiwa esinaminyaka eyishumi (10) yeminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza ngemuva kokuthola iziqu njengobuciko/Umphathi Wobuciko. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Olujwayelekile: Imithetho Yesevisi Yomphakathi, Umthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi. Ukuhlelana Kophrojekthi, Ulwazi Lokwakha Nokuhlaziya Kwobuchwepheshe, Ucwaningo Nokuthuthukisa. Ikhono Lezobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi lokwakha nokuhlaziya kwobuchwepheshe, ukubhala okubikezela ngobuchwepheshe, ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibusayo ezobuchwepheshe, ukuhambisana nomthetho, ulwazi nenkathi yezindlela zokukhiqiza, ukusebenza njengeqembu, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuxhumana. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuthatha izinqumo, ukuhlela Nokuhlela, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuphatha, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsizakalo ezobuchwepheshe. Hola futhi uhole ekunikezweni izinsizakalo ezobuchwepheshe emdedeni nakumisebenzi wokwenza izinto. Yenza futhi ulawule ukukhuthaza isicekela phansi ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezomthetho nangemithetho. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi ngokuhambisana nezinkomba. Phatha ukugcinwa kwezinsizakalo ezobuchwepheshe. Phatha ukukhonza konke uhlobo lwesikhungo nobuchwepheshe nezinsiza. Zigcine izinsiza ezobuchwepheshe. Phatha futhi ulawule ukwenza umsebenzi wokuvikelwa nokugcinwa nsuku zonke. Phatha imisebenzi yokuqasha nezinhlobonhlobo ezihlobene nayo. Nikeza umnikelo ohlelweni lokwenza isabelo. Qamba futhi uhlele imibiko njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise iminikelo ohlelweni lokusebenza kobuchwepheshe. Phatha ukuvuselela idethabhesi. Phatha izinsiza zabantu nezithako. Coche futhi ululele ababekize phansi. Qatha izinkomba zomsebenzi. Thuthukise amaphulani omsebenzi. Yenza ukubuyekeza ukusebenza. Hlaziya izidingo zokuqeqesha. Ukuphatha Izimali Lawula futhi ulawule izinto zokuchithwa kwemali. Ukuphatha Abantu. Gcina futhi uthuthukise ubuchwepheshe.

xh.title: Ntloko-ntu yomsebenzi wezandla: Garidi a
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zobugcisa, nqamla amaqela asemontwenzi nakwindlu yomsebenzi, kuqinisekiswe izinga lemigiqwa kunye nokuzithoba ngokomthetho wephepha lendalo ngokukaDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe esifanelekileyo seTrade Test kummandla we-built environment nemyaka elishumi (10) yamava emva kokufumana isikhosi njengomsebenzi wozandla/Okhundla wabasebenzi bezandla. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi olubanzi: Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act. Ulwazi lokuqamba amaphulo, ulwazi lobugcisa bokulinganisa nokuhlalutya, uphando nophuhliso. Amandla obugcisa: Ulwazi lobugcisa bokulinganisa nokuhlalutya, ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa, ingcebiso zobugcisa, izicelo zobugcisa eziphathwa ngokwegqitha-khompyutha, ukuzithoba ngokomthetho, ulwazi namakhono okwenza imveliso, ukusebenza njengesiqhobo, amakhono okuhlangana nabantu, amakhono okuthetha. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqhobo, ukwenza izigqibo, ukuqamba ngokwezicwangciso, ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha, ulawulo, ukujolisa kumthengi nokuphendula.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zobugcisa. Qamba ulwazi lwento eya kwenzeka nokuqhuba iinkonzo zobugcisa emontwenzi nakwezindlu zemisebenzi. Qinisekisa nolawula ukukhuthazwa kokhuseleko ngokwemigaqo yomthetho nengqikitho. Nikela ngeenkonzo zokuqinisekisa izinga lemigiqwa ngokwemiqathango. Lawula ukulondolozwa kweenkonzo zobugcisa. Lawula ukukhonza konke okwenziwa ngemikhobo nobugcisa nokwakha. Zihlazi iinkqubo zobugcisa. Lawula nolawula ukwenza umsebenzi wemini nemini yokulondolozwa. Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo nokuqhagamshelana kuyo. Nikela ngolwazi kuqhubeka-phela kokucwangcisa indlela yokuhlawulela. Lungelelanise uze unike iingxelo njengoko kuyimfuneko. Nikela uzihlanganise ulwazi oluqhagamshela kwicala lolwazi lwendlela yokusebenza. Lawula uhlaziyo lwegcine yonke iingxelo. Lawula iziseko zomntu nezomzimba. Fundisa nokuqamba abangaphansi. Lungelelanise iinkcazelo zemisebenzi. Yila amacebo omsebenzi. Yenza iingxelo zokuqwalasela imisebenzi. Chonga iimfuno zokuqeqesha. Lawulo lweemali Lawula ulawule ukutshaqiswa kwemali. Lawuloabantu. Hlala uzisebenzise ulwazi oluqhawulezayo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Facilities & Operations Management
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to manage facilities and operations including cleaning services, procurement, and contract oversight at the Aliwal North district office.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, National Diploma NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA in Facilities Management / Property Management/Horticulture & Landscaping / Real Estate / Building / Construction Management / Quantity Surveying with 3 years’ experience in supervisory level or SL7/8 in Facilities Management. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge and Skills: In-depth knowledge and understanding of legislative framework that governs Public Service. In-depth knowledge and understanding of GIAMA. Knowledge and understanding of PFMA. In-depth knowledge and understanding of Occupational Health and Safety Act and related buildings regulations. Knowledge and understanding of Facilities Management Policies, Procedures and Best Practices. Knowledge of Asset and Maintenance Management. Departmental service delivery principles. Departmental Strategic Planning. Departmental Annual Performance Plan. Policies and Procedures. Government Programmes. Provincial Growth and Development Plan for the Eastern Cape. Stakeholder and customer relationship management principles. Planning, coordination. Problem-solving and analytical ability. Facilities inspection and compliance monitoring. Report writing and data analysis. Stakeholder engagement and client relations. Communication. Client relationship management. Report writing and presentation. Computer literacy (MS Office, Facilities Management Systems). Project Coordination.
jobs.duties: Coordinate provision of cleaning services: Coordinate the provision of cleaning services across district facilities. Facilitate development of specifications and procurement processes for cleaning services. Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with service standards. Oversee contract administration, including verification of service delivery and certification of payments. Monitor cleanliness of government facilities to ensure adherence to departmental cleaning standards policies. Coordinate provision of gardening and beautification services: Coordinate provision of gardening and landscaping services for state facilities. Facilitate procurement and appointment of service providers in line with SCM processes. Monitor performance and quality of services delivered. Oversee contract implementation and compliance with environmental standards. Ensure alignment of services with departmental maintenance and beautification standards. Coordinate implementation of condition assessments: Coordinate implementation of condition assessments for state owned facilities. Analyse condition assessment reports to inform maintenance planning and prioritization. Facilitate development of maintenance plans and cost estimates based on condition assessment data. Provide reports to inform infrastructure and asset management decisions – making. Ensure proper recordkeeping of condition assessments and maintenance reports. Manage utilization inspection on state-owned buildings: Plan and conduct utilization inspections to assess use of allocated space. Monitor space utilisation and identify underutilized or non-compliant usage of facilities. Analyse inspection findings and compile reports to inform management decisions. Ensure compliance with GIAMA and space management standards. Monitor maintenance of utilisation and inspection records. Coordinate implementation of health and safety audits on state owned facilities: Coordinate implementation of occupational health and safety requirements across facilities. Monitor compliance with relevant OHS legislation and building regulations. Facilitate execution of health and safety inspections and audits. Analyse risks identified and recommended appropriate corrective interventions. Promote safe working environments in line with statutory and departmental requirements. Supervise the allocated resources: Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from Manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure timeously development of job description and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all employees in the sub- directorate. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets.
jobs.enquiries: contact Mr. M. Mavotsho at 083 753 9381/Mr. M. Tshwaku at 083 753 9381 e-recruitment Technical Enquiries: e-recruitment-bhisho@ecdpw.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted as follows: via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e- Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: e-recruitment- bhisho@ecdpw.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00-16:30 Mon- Thursday and 08:00-16:00 on Friday). Hand-delivered/ E-Mailed/ Faxed/ Posted applications will not be accepted.
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to Youth, African Males. Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercises and interviews. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behaviourally preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12/24 months. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme      Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews.
