xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate yaseNzulwini, i-Diploma yaseNzulwini (iNqanaba le-NQF 6 njengoko kuqatshiwe yi-SAQA) kwi-Nkqubo yeLawulo leNkqubo yeziQhago/iNkqubo yoLawulo lwaZizwe/iNkqubo yoLawulo lwezomRholo/i-Logistics/uBalo noluLawulo lweZemali ngeminyaka yamava 1-2. iLayisensi yokuQhuba esemthethweni. ulwazi neNthetho: iMiyalelo nemiLambo yeTreasury yaseNzulwini, iMiyalelo nemiLambo yeTreasury yoMmandala, oLawulo lwe-SCM, iMigaqo nemiLambo, uMthetho waBantu baSebenzayo, iMigaqo yaBantu baSebenzayo ka-2016, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (i-PFMA), uMthetho nemiLambo eSebenzayo, i-CIBD, i-BBBEE, i-PPPFA, iMigaqo nemiLambo yoLawulo abaBantu, ukuBala iNgxelo, ulwazi lweKhompyutha, ukuNxibelelana, uLawulo lweNkcazelo, iPresentation, uHlohloliziyo, uLawulo lweMali neZemali, iNkxaso, uSombululo weengozi/ uSombululo lweengxaki, i-KPA'S Zenzelela iinkonzo zolawulo lwemfuno: Qinisekisa ukuchaneka nokuzaliseka kwamaxwebhu awalathiweyo, khetha abanikezeli bemisebenzi kwi-CSD (umda ngaphantsi kwe-R30 000), Qinisekisa izicazaziso.
xh.duties: Hlanganisa Amaxwebhu eNtengiso; Hlola ukuHambelana namaxwebhu alathiweyo uze unikeze inani le-SCMU, Hlola amaxwebhu eNtengiso, Bekisa iinkxaso zeentengiso, zigcine irejista yentengiso uze uhlanganise iingxelo zenyanga ngeentengiso ezibekisiweyo, Zenzelela imisebenzi yekomakhulu, wamkele iicelo ezivela kwiinkqubo uze udadle iajenda, wazise amalungu ngokuhlangana kwekomiti yesicazaziso sentengiso, Hlola olunye ulungiso uze ubekise kumXholo ofaneleyo, Zisele iindibano zokuNika iNkcazelo apho kusemthethweni uze urekhode iMimuzuzu. Yenza imiSebenzi yoLawulo; Vula ifayile yalowo nalipho na iprojekti egunyaziweyo, zikope onke amaxwebhu ngokwale chkliste, Zirekhode uze zithunyelwe kwi-Acquisitions, Zirekhode iicelo; Qinisekisa amaxwebhu enxaxheba, zirekhode onke amacelo kwirejista eNGENAYO uze zithunyelwe kwi-Acquisitions.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Management Officer: Logistics Management
jobs.closing_date_text: 17 August 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Supply Chain Management Officer position in Bisho requiring a National Diploma in Supply Chain Management or related field with 1-2 years of experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, National Diploma (NQF Level 6 as recognised by SAQA) in Supply Chain Management/Public Management/Public Administration/Logistics/Cost and Management Accounting with 1-2 relevant experience. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge and Skills: PFMA, Treasury Regulations, National Treasury Regulations. Planning and Organising. Good interpersonal relation skills. Presentation skills. Computer Literacy. Problem Solving skills.
jobs.duties: Supervise and undertake logistical support services. Check, place and verify orders for goods. Receive and verify goods from suppliers. Capture and ensure that goods are captured in registers and database. Receive requests for goods from end users. Issue goods to end users. Check and maintain goods registers. Update and ensure the maintenance of the register of suppliers. Supervise human resources. Allocate and ensure quality of work. Personnel development. Assess staff performance. Apply discipline.
jobs.enquiries: Ms S. Zazini at 066 489 6117 / Mr L Maliti at 066 489 6117 e-recruitment Technical Enquiries: e-recruitment-bhisho@ecdpw.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted as follows: via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e- Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: e-recruitment- bhisho@ecdpw.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00-16:30 Mon- Thursday and 08:00-16:00 on Friday). Hand-delivered/ E-Mailed/ Faxed/ Posted applications will not be accepted.
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to Youth Coloured Male. Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercises and interviews. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behaviourally preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12/24 months. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme      Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Supply Chain Management Officer: Logistics Management
af.summary: Supply Chain Management Officer-pos in Bisho wat 'n National Diploma in Supply Chain Management of 'n verwante veld met 1-2 jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat, Nasionale Diploma (NQF Level 6 soos deur SAQA erken) in Supply Chain Management/Public Management/Public Administration/Logistics/Cost and Management Accounting met 1-2 relevante ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: PFMA, Treasury Regulations, National Treasury Regulations. Beplanning en organisering. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Voorleggingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Superviseer en onderneem logistieke ondersteuningsdienste. Kontroleer, plaas en verifieer bestellings vir goedere. Receive en verifieer goedere van verskaffers. Vang en verseker dat goedere in registers en databasis vasgelê word. Ontvang versoeke vir goedere van eindgebruikers. Reeik goedere aan eindgebruikers uit. Kontroleer en handhaaf goedere-registers. Werk die register van verskaffers by en verseker die instandhouding daarvan. Superviseer menslike hulpbronne. Allokeer en verseker gehalte van werk. Personeelontwikkeling. Evalueer werknemersprestasie. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.title: Mswana We-Supply Chain Management: Logistics Management
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumswana we-Supply Chain Management e-Bisho sidinga i-National Diploma kwi-Supply Chain Management noma kwelinye ibalazwe kanye namava eminyaka 1-2.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Sabazali Sabangeni kwesikhashana, i-National Diploma (NQF Level 6 njengoba kuhambisana ne-SAQA) kwi-Supply Chain Management/Public Management/Public Administration/Logistics/Cost and Management Accounting nokuba namava afanele unyaka 1-2. Ilayisensi yokushayela ethi yakho. Ulwazi namakhono: PFMA, Treasury Regulations, National Treasury Regulations. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Amakhono obudlelwano obuhle nomuntu. Amakhono okubonisa. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi ube ngumuntu ophethe nemisebenzi yenkonzo yokwesekela kwezokulethwa nokuhambisa impahla. Hlola, faka futhi qinisekise ama-oda empahla. Yamukela futhi qinisekisa impahla evela kubanikazi bemithelela. Faka futhi qinisekise ukuthi impahla ifakwe kumarejista nakwidatabheyisi. Yamukela izicelo zempahla ezivela kubasebenzisi bokugcina. Yabelana impahla kubasebenzisi bokugcina. Hlola futhi gcine amarejista empahla. Buyekeza futhi qinisekise ukulondolozwa kwerejista labanikazi bemithelela. Qapha abasebenzi.abelana futhi qinisekise ikhwalithi yomsebenzi. Intuthuko yabasebenzi. Hlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Faka isinyathelo sokulawula.

xh.title: Ofisi yoLawulo lwenkonzo yeNkcitho: uLawulo loQhagamshelo
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaOfisi woLawulo lwenkonzo yeNkcitho eBisho esifuna iNdiploma yeSizwe kwiLawulo lwenkonzo yeNkcitho okanye indawo ehambelana nayo enamava emyineminyaka 1-2.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sePhakathi sesiZwe, iNdiploma yeSizwe (Inqanaba le-6 leNQF njengokuvunywa yi-SAQA) kwiLawulo lwenkonzo yeNkcitho/uLawulo lweNtlu/uLawulo lweNkululeko lweNtlu/amaQhagamshelo/uQibo nokuLawula kubalo ngemava elifanelekileyo emyineminyaka 1-2. ilayisenisi yomqhubi egqityiweyo. ulwazi namakhono: i-PFMA, iNgcinga zeQhagamshelo, iNgcinga zeQhagamshelo zeQhagamshelo leSizwe. uQqamba nokuCwangcisa. amakhono amabalwane obudlelwaneabantu. amakhono okubonisa. ulwazi lweKhompyutha. amakhono oLususo lwezinkinga.
xh.duties: uLawula uze wenze iinkonzo zoxhaso loqhagamshelo. uPhonononga, ubeka uze uqinisekise iiodolo zemveliso. uThatha uze uqinisekise imveliso kubaniki. uFaka uze uqinisekise ukuba imveliso ifakwe kwiirejista nasekugcineni iingcombolo. uThatha izicelo zemveliso kubasebenzisi abaphelayo. uNika abasebenzisi abaphelayo imveliso. uPhonononga uze ulondoloze iirejista zemveliso. uQinisekisa uze ulondoloze ukuzinza kwarejista yabaniki bemveliso. uLawula abantu. uMisa uze uqinisekise umgangatho womsebenzi. uPhuhliso babantu. uQwalasela inkqubo yabasebenzi. uFaka inyameko.

jobs.summary: Supply Chain Management Officer ensuring compliance with SCM legislation and evaluating bid processes at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Bisho.

Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, 5 of 2000. Performance management principles. Stakeholder and customer relationship management principles. Planning and organizing. Creative thinking. Self-management. Problem analysis.

Assist in evaluating bid processes to ensure adherence to prescripts. Attend to tender briefings and give guidance. Receive complaints on terms of reference and acknowledge thereof. Conduct SCM risk management and advice on internal controls. Assist in evaluating the capabilities of service providers. Assist to Investigate the legitimacy of service providers. Responsible for loss control on fixed assets and consumable stores. Register all cases of lost assets and consumables Assist to investigate the circumstances thereof. Make follow up on criminal procedures where required. Supervise the allocated resources. Maintain high standards by ensuring that the team / section produces excellent work in terms of quality / quantity and timeliness. Resolve problems of motivation and control with minimum guidance from manager. Delegate functions to staff based on individual potential provide the necessary guidance and support and afford staff adequate training and development opportunities. Ensure timeously development of job description and implementation of Work Plans and Personal Development Plans (PDP’s) for all employees in the Sub-directorate. Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates. Ensure management, maintenance and safekeeping of assets.

af.title: Supply Chain Management Officer: Risk and SCM
af.summary: Supply Chain Management-offisier wat nakoming van SCM-wetgewing verseker en bieprosesse by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Bisho evalueer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat / Nasionale Diploma) NQF level 6 soos erken deur SAQA) in Supply Chain Management / Public Management / Public Administration / Logistics / Cost and Management Accounting / Internal Auditing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Tesourieregulasies. PFMA. Nakomingsbeleide en prosedures. SCM-beleide. Public Service Act, 1994. Public Service Regulations 2001. Public Finance Management Act, 1999. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, 5 of 2000. Prestasiebestuursbeginsels. Belanghebbende- en kliënteverhoudingsbestuursbeginsels. Beplanning en organisering. Kreatiewe denke. Selfbestuur. Probleemanalise.
af.duties: Voer nakoming van supply chain management-wetgewing uit. Kontroleer of die termyne van verwysing in ooreenstemming met regulerende beleidsvoorskrifte is. Bystand verleen by die evaluering van bieprosesse om nakoming van voorskrifte te verseker. Biedingsvoorligtings bywoon en leiding gee. Klagtes oor termyne van verwysing ontvang en daarvan kennis neem. SCM-risikobestuur uitvoer en advies oor interne beheer gee. Bystand verleen by die evaluering van die vermoëns van diensverskaffers. Bystand verleen om die legitimeit van diensverskaffers te ondersoek. Verantwoordelik vir verliesbeheer oor vaste bates en verbruikbare voorrade. Register alle gevalle van verlore bates en verbruiksgoedere Bystand verleen om die omstandighede daarvan te ondersoek. Opvolg doen op strafregtelike prosedures waar nodig. Die toegekende hulpbronne bestuur. Hoë standaarde handhaaf deur te verseker dat die span / afdeling uitstekende werk lewer in terme van gehalte / hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Probleme met motivering en beheer oplos met minimum leiding van die bestuurder. Funksies aan persone delegueer op grond van individuele potensiaal die nodige leiding en ondersteuning bied en persone voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede bied. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling van posbeskrywing en implementering van Werksplanne en Persoonlike Ontwikkelingsplanne (PDP's) vir alle werknemers in die Subdirektoraat. Daaglikse werknemersprestasie bestuur en verseker tydige Prestasie-evaluerings van alle ondergeskiktes. Verseker bestuur, instandhouding en veilige bewaring van bates.

zu.title: Inkosikazi/Inkosana Yokuphathwa Kwezinsiza: Ubungozi kanye Nesikhungo Sokuphathwa Kwezinsiza
zu.summary: Inkosikazi/Inkosana Yokuphathwa Kwezinsiza eqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho wokuphathwa kwezinsiza futhi ihlola izinqubo zokuqashwa emnyangweni we Public Works and Infrastructure eBisho.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatjhedi aphakeme kazwelonke/ izidiploma kazwelonke) izinga le-NQF 6 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA) ekuphathweni kwezinsiza / ekuphathweni kwabezantu / ebufundazweni bomphakathi / ezezimali zokuhamba / ekubaleni izindleko kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali / ekuhlolweni kwangaphakathi. Isicard sokushayela esevumelekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Izilawuli ze Treasury. PFMA. Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zokuqinisekisa. Izinqubomgomo ze-SCM. Umthetho Womsebenzi Womphakathi, 1994. Izilawuli Zomsebenzi Womphakathi 2001. Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1999. Umthetho Wokuhlolwa Kokuthenga Ngokuthandwa, 5 ka-2000. Izimiso zokuphathwa kokusebenza. Izimiso zokuphathwa kwezimalo zabathintekayo nakhabhasi. Ukucubungula futhi kuqhatshwe. Ukucabanga ngokubumbana. Ukuziphatha. Ukuhlaziya izinkinga.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho wokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Hlola ukuthi amagama okuhlolwa ahambisana yini nezinqubo ezilawulayo. Siza ekuhlokeni izinqubo zokuqashwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zihambisana nezinqubo ezilawulayo. Hlanganyela kumafomu okuhlolwa okuthengwayo futhi unikeze isiqondiso. Thola izikhalazo ngamagama okuhlolwa futhi uzazi. Yenza ukuphathwa kobungozi kwe-SCM futhi unikeze izeluleko ngokulawula ngaphakathi. Siza ekuhlokeni amandla abanikezi zinsiza. Siza ukuphenya ukuthi abanikezi zinsiza basebenza ngokusesibonakalweni. Bheka ukulawula ukulahlekelwa kwempahla ecelelekile nezinto ezisetshenziswa. Bhalisa konke okulahlekelwe impahla nezinto ezisetshenziswa Siza ukuphenya izimo ezibalulekile. Landela izinqubo zezecaleni lapho kudingeka khona. Lawula izinsiza ezinikiwe. Gcina amazinga aphakeme ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / isigaba sikhiqiza umsebenzi ohle kakhulu ngokwesimilo / ngobuningi nangesikhathi. Xazulula izinkinga zomoya kanye nolawulo ngosizo oluncane otholwa kumphathi. Nika abasebenzi imisebenzi ngokusekelwe amandla womuntu ngamunye nikeza isiqondiso nesisekelo esidingekayo futhi unikeze abasebenzi ithuba lokulolongwa futhi bathuthuke. Qinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa isikhathi esifanele ukucubungula incazelo yomsebenzi futhi kusetshenziswe amaphulani okusebenza namaphulani Luntu EPhila Aphendukayo (PDPs) kubo bonke abasebenzi kuhlelo olungaphansi. Lawula imisebenzi yansuku zonke futhi qinisekisa ukuthlola ukusebenza ngokushesha kwabo bonke abangenhla kuye. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukugcinwa kanye nokuvikelwa kwempahla.

xh.title: Ofisa woLawulo lweNkqubo yoQoqosho: Igozi nakuLawulo kwe-SCM
xh.summary: Ofisa woLawulo lweQoqosho loQoqo oqinisekisa ukuhambelana nomthetho we-SCM nokuvavanya iinkqubo zokuqashwa kwisebe leDPWandI eBisho.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSihloko seNazionale / Isidanga seNazionale) inqanaba 6 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA) kuLawulo loQoqosho loQoqo / uLawulo lwaRuzivo / uLawulo lwezeNkonzo / i-Logistics / uBalo nokuLawula / ukuVavanywa ngaphakathi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Iimigaqo yeTreasury. PFMA. Iinkqubo zokuhambelana & iinkqubo. Iinkqubo ze-SCM. uMthetho weNkonzo kaZwelonke, 1994. Iimigaqo yeNkonzo kaZwolonke 2001. uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali kaZwelonke, 1999. uMthetho weNkqubo yokuThenga ngokuthandwa, 5 ka 2000. Iingcamango zolawulo lwenkqubo. Iingcamango zolawulo lobudlelwane nabathintekayo nakwixesha elithile. uCingo nokuhlela. Ukucinga ngendlela entsha. uLawulo lwakho. Uhlalutyo lweengxaki.

Dala ukuhambelana kweenqobo ezisemthethweni ezilawula ulawulo lwesikwitshi esixhomekeke kwinani. Qinisekisa ukuba iitem zomsebenzi zihambelana neengqondo ezilawulayo zemigaqo. af.title: Werkinspekteur: Meganies
af.summary: Meganiese werkinspekteur benodig in Queenstown om inspeksies en onderhoud op projekterrene uit te voer en sodoende nakoming van regulasies en gehaltebeheerstandaarde te verseker.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate, Nasionale Diploma NQF vlak 6 in Meganiese Ingenieurswese (T/N/S Strome) OF N3 en geslaag vir handelstoets Meganies binne die geboude omgewing), OF Registrasie as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus (Meganies). 1-2 jaar se relevante ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en Vaardighede: Gebouregulasies, Gehaltebeheer van alle gebouwerk, Bestuur van mense. Risiko. Verandering en bevordering van spanwerk. OHS-wet. Goeie mondelinge, skriftelike en kommunikasievaardighede. Konflikbestuursvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kliëntoriëntasie en klintefokusvaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Selfbestuur.
af.duties: Voer inspeksies of onderhoud uit aan werk wat op projekterrene onderneem word om te verseker dat dit gedoen word in ooreenstemming met alle relevante regulasies en wetgewing en dat behoorlike gehaltebeheer gehandhaaf word. Stel 'n skatting op van herstelwerk en koste vir klein nuwe werk en onderhoudswerk wat onderneem moet word. Handhaaf 'n elektroniese rekordsisteem vir werk wat gedoen word en werk wat afgehandel is. Ontwikkel vorderingsverslae oor uitstaande en afgehandelde werk. Adviseer en lei kontrakteurs met betrekking tot nakoming van wetgewing en prosedures. Inspekteer werkdukumente deur kontrakteurs om te bepaal of dit in ooreenstemming is met alle relevante voorgeskrewe standaarde. Stel op en prosesseer variasiebestellings en versoeke om sperdatums te verleng. Stel betalingsdokumente op. Verseker effektiewe kontrakadministrasie. Tydige ontwikkeling van verslae oor probleme wat uit projekte voortspruit. Versamel en dien inligting in ingevolge die uitgebreide openbare werke-program (EPW). Ontwikkel en interpreteer planne en sketse. Stel kwotasiedokumente op en stel spesifikasies, hoeveelheedlyste en bieddokumente saam. Neem deel aan die adjudikasieproses en verskaf aanbevelings vir kwotasies. Skakel met relevante belanghebbendes met betrekking tot tegniese aspekte.

Kwakhiwe imibiko yokuqhubela phambili ngomsebenzi ongaziqediwe nowoqedwayo. Kunikelwe izeluleki futhi kuholwe abathwesimikhiqizo mayelana nokuziphatha ngokomthetho nokuqhutshwa. Kuhlolwe imibiko yomsebenzi ngabathwesimikhiqizo ukuze kutholakale ukuthi iyahambisana yini nawo wonke amazinga abekiwe. Kubhalwe futhi kucutshungulwe amasonto okuhlukana nezicelo sokwelisa isikhathi samasongo okuvala. Kubhalwe imibiko yezimali. Kuba londolozwa ukulawula inkontileka ngendlela ephumelelayo. Kubhalwe ngokushesha imibiko ngezinkinga eziphuma kwamaphrojekthi. Kuqoqiwe futhi kunikelwe ulwazi ngokomthetho ohlelweni olwandisiwe lomsebenzi kazwelonke (EPW). Kuthuthukiswe futhi kuchazwe amaphulani nezithombe. Kubhalwe imibiko yezilinganisela futhi kuhlanganiswa izici, amabhili amabala kanye nemibiko yokubiza. Kuthathwe inxaxheba enqubweni yokuqamba futhi kunikelwe iziphakamiso mayelana nezilinganisela. Kuxhunyane abahlanganyeli abahlobene ngemithetho inzulwamu.

xh.title: Umhloli weMisebenzi: yezoNcedo lwezoBuchwepheshe
xh.summary: Kufuneka kuye igcisa lokuQwalasela uMsebenzi wezoBuchwepheshe kwiZiko leNtlaza iKamva lokuQwalasela ukuba kwenze iindwendwe nolungiselelo lwendawo zeprojekthi, kuqinisekiswe ukuvunywa komthetho nemigangatho yolawulo lokhwalithi.
xh.requirements: Iseele yeSikolo samabanga aphakamileyo seSizwe, iDiploma yaseNingizimu kwelaseNtshona yeNqanaba le-6 (T/N/S Streams) kwizifundo zediploma zeNgingi nakwingingi yolwazi ngesiZulu, okanye ibhalwe njengonobuchwepheshe boBaphandi beMisebenzi yediploma noma i-3 kwaye kudlulwe uvavayo lwebhasi yaseRiphabhlikhini. 1-2 iminyaka yamava ahambelana nayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi noko kukwaziyo: Urhulumente weFakalthi wezoBuchwepheshe beMfundo ePhakamileyo nakumava abonelelwe ngawo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi nobuchule: Iimigaqo yoMthetho weZakhiwo, Ulawulo lokuQinisekisa ukuba sekusingathweni kwakho konke ukwakhiwa, uLawulo lweBantu. Ingxaki. Uguqulo lokukhuthaza ukusebenza njengesiqhema. UMthetho we-OHS. Amakhono amabalisa ekuBhalweni nakuThethathethwano. Amakhono oluLawulo lweNxaxheba. Ulwazi olusezibenzi ngezikrwele. Ukuba nombono ogqithiswe kumthengi nakuqwalasela iindidi ngokobuchwepheshe beziqu eziliNani elifingqiphwa. Amakhono okuBhala iingxelo. ULawulo lokuZilawula.
xh.duties: Qwalasela okanye lungisa umsebenzi oqhubekayo kulawulo lwendawo zokwenza iinkqubo zokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba uyenzwa ngokumgama woMthetho nokuqwalaselwa kwemigaqo yekhomishini yexesha elithile, ikwalinganiswe ngokwemilinganiselo efanelekileyo kumsebenzi okhoyo nayokulungelelwa. Hlaziya izithuba zokuqinisekisa ukuba ingcali iyazisebenzisa ngokupela nokuqinisekiswa komthetho nokulunga kwayo. Yenza ibali elithile lokulungisa nokulinganisa ukusetyenziswa kweziphakamiso ezilinganayo zemisebenzi entsha nentsha yokulungelelwa. Gcina inkqubo yokugcina iirekhodi ezibalulekileyo ngokutsha kwendawo apho kubhalwa khona nalapho kugqitywa khona umsebenzi. Yenza iingxelo ezithile ngokuhamba kwexesha malunga neemfuno ezikwisikhundla sokugqitywa komsebenzi.nika izalathiso nolwazi kubakhiwo beenkqubo nangeendlela ezimanyaniswe kwiSaziso seKhomishani yokuQwalasela imigaqo yolawulo. Qwalasela amaxwebhu abakhi beznkqubo zokusebenza ngokulinganisela ukubonisa ukuba ziyathobeka na kumgama wemigaqo equkethwe ngumthetho. Hlaziya nokusingatha iinkqubo zokuguqula nokucela ukwandiswa kwexesha elibe lelokwazi ukugqitywa komsebenzi. Hlaziya iingxelo ezithile malunga neengxaki ezibangelwa zinkqubo zokusebenza. Lungelelanisa nokuba negalelo ngokubonelela ngolwazi ngokwemigaqo yeNkqubo yoLawulo lweNdalo namaphulo eNkqubo eZizwe. Hlaziya nokuguqula iinkqubo zokusebenza nezalathiso nokuQwalasela amagama eempawu eNkqubo. Yenza iingxelo nokuQwalasela iimfuno nokuqwalasela uluhlu lweMali yokuQwalasela iimpawu zamaphulo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yokuLawula iinkqubo zemisebenzi nokuQwalasela ukuyicima ngokutsha ukusebenza. Xhumanisa nendalo ekhoyo ngokusebenzisa izalathiso ezinokugqitha ukuba ngumvuzo wolwazi lweNkqubo yokuba ngokwemigaqo yekhomishani eyahlukeneyo.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Wokudonga: Izinga A: Ukugcina Izinto Zisebenza
zu.summary: UMnyango Wezomsebenzi Osezweni NezemInfrastruckha ufuna abonjiniyela abakhuniwegqoki abanemvume yokuqasha izikhundla zokulondoloza kumaziko amathathu e-Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Esifanele Sokuvivinya Umsebenzi (Carpentry). Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ulwazi Olubanzi: Izinqubomgomo Zomsebenzi Ohulumeni, Umthetho Womsebenzi Ohulumeni. Ulwazi Lokuqhathaniswa Kwephrojekthi, Ukuklama Okusebuhleni Nokuhlaziya, Ukucwaninga nentuthuko. Amakhono Obuchwepheshe: Ulwazi lokuklama okusebuhleni nokuqondisisa, ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe, ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zekhompyutha eziseduzwe nobuchwepheshe, ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ulwazi namakhono ohlelo lokukhiqiza, ukusebenza njengohlelo, amakhono okuzwana nabantu, amakhono okuxoxa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqondisisa, ukwenza izinqumo, ukwelula nokuhlela, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuphatha, ukugxila kumthengi nesibonakaliso sokuphendula.
zu.duties: Ukuklama: Khiqiza amadizayini ngokwezidingo zamakhasimende futhi ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamakhono okukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza: Khiqiza izinto ngezinto zokwakha ngedivayisi ngokwesici somsebenzi nasemizinganweni eseqashelwayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kokulingana kwezinto ezenziwe. Ukugcina izinto zisebenza: Hlola idivayisi kanye/noma izinto zokusebenzela ukuthola kuyiphi inkinga yobuchwepheshe. Lunga idivayisi nezinto zokusebenzela ngokwemithetho. Hlola ukulungiswa kwedivayisi noma izinto zokusebenzela ngokwezidingo. Qinisekiswa ukulingana kwezinto ezigcinwe ezisebenzayo futhi ezilungile. Azenze imisebenzi yohlelo neminye engeminye: Buyekeza ukubhaliswa kwemikhuba egciniwe futhi elungisiwe. Qamba futhi uhumbe imibhalonike. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lomsebenzi. Nikeza imibono ohlelweni lokusebenza. Qapha futhi uholele abasebenzi. Gcina ulwazi olukhulu: intuthuko eqhubekayo yomuntu ngamunye ukugcina amakhono amasha nobuchwepheshe.

xh.title: Umenzi wemisebenzi yezandla eWotshela amaza: Inqanaba A: Ukulungisa
xh.summary: Isebe leZoMisebenzi kaWonke nokuZinza lidinga abenzi bemisebenzi yezandla abagqithisweyo kwicandelo lewotshela amaza kumagumbi akulungisa kumathathu amagumbi e-Eastern Cape.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esiFanelekileyo sokuVavanya uBugcisa (ukwotshela amaza). Ilayisenisi yokuQhuba eSebenzayo. ulwazi oluJikelele: IimGaqo-Nkqubo zoLuntu, uMthetho woLuntu. uQhagamshelwano loPhando, uLwazi nokuNtsalwa kweNkqubo, uphando nokuPhuhliswa. Ikhono leBuchule: ulwazi lokuNtsalwa kweNkqubo nokuHlalutya, ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa, ingxelo yobugcisa, izicelo zobugcisa ezixhaswa ngemithombo yamakhompyutha, ulwazi ngokuzithobe kumthetho, ulwazi namakhono epinkqubo yokwenza, ukusebenza njengesigqiki, amakhono obudlelwane bomntu nomntu, amakhono othetha-nxaxheba. ukusombulula iingxaki nokuHlalutya, ukuThatha iziQqibo, ukuCwangcisa nokuHlela, amakhono eKhompyutha, ukuLawula, ugqalelo kumthengi nokuPhendula.
xh.duties: UkuNtsalwa: ukuNtsalwa kweenkqubo ngokwezicelo zomthengi nakumida obubekwe kukwazi kokwenziwa. ukuKhiqiza: ukuKhiqiza izinto ngezinto zokwakha nemixhobo ngokwesicelo somsebenzi nangokwezinga elaziwayo. uQinisekiso lolwabiwo lwezinto ezenziweyo. ukulungisa: ukuHlola imixhobo nani mizekelo/iindawo ukuba kukho iziphene zobugcisa. ukuLungisa imixhobo nani ndawo ngokwezinga. ukuVavanya imixhobo elungisiweyo nani ndawo ngokwesicelo. uQinisekiso lolwabiwo lwezinto ezenziweyo eZikhonzileyo nokuLungisiweyo. ukuPhehlezelela imisebenzi enxulumene nokuSebenza: ukuBuyekeza irekhodi yeziphene ezilungisiweyo nokugcinwe. ukuQamba nokuThumela iingxelo. ukuGcina nokuLungisa irekhodi yomsebenzi. ukuNika isalathiso kwiinkqubo zoMsebenzi. ukuLawula nokuKokela abasebenzi. ukuGcina ulwazi obuchule: ukuPhuhliswa ngokukhulileyo komntu ngamnye ukugcina inqanaba namatechnoloji namashishini amatsha.

zu.summary: I-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ifuna abantu bemisebenzi yezandla ekwakheni amabhuloki ezikhundleni zokugcinwa kwezinto kwizindlu zokulondoloza izinto e-Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele sokuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe (Ukwakha amabhuloki). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi olubanzi: Izimiso zabenkomakhulu, umthetho wabenkomakhulu. Ulwazi lokuhlanganisa amaphrojekthi, ukwakheka kwemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya, ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izindlela zokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi lokwakheka kwemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya, ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe, ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisekelwe kwikhompyutha, ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ulwazi kanye namakhono emikhiqizo, ukusebenza njengesiqembu, amakhano abantu, amakhono okuxhumana. ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukuthatha izinqumo, ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela, amakhono ekompyutha, ukuphatha, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula.
zu.duties: Ukwakha: Khiqiza izinhlobo zokwakha ngokwezidingo zomthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza: Khiqiza izinto ngesinto kanye nempahla ngokwezidingo zomsebenzi nangokwezindinganiso ezaziwayo. Qinisekisa izinga lemikhiqizo ekhiqiziwe. Ukugcinwa kwezinto: Hlola impahla kanye/noma izimpahla ngaphakathi kwamaphutha obuchwepheshe. Lungisa impahla nezimpahla ngokwezindinganiso. Hlola impahla elungisiwe kanye/noma izimpahla ngokwezidingo. Qinisekisa izinga lempahla ekhonziwe kanye naleyo egciniwe. Yenza imisebenzi yobusuku kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene: Buyeza irekhodi leziphutha ezigciniwe kanye nezelungisiwe. Hlanganisa futhi unikeze imibiko. Gcina futhi ugcine irekhodi lomsebenzi. Nikeza okufakwe kuhlelo lokusebenza. Qaphisa futhi ube umuntu onikeza isikhuthazo abasebenzi. Gcina amakhono: ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo komuntu ngamunye ukuze aqhubeke nokushaya izindlela ezintsha nobuchwepheshe kanye nezinqubo.

xh.title: Ubugcisa bokwakha ngetitshu: Inqanaba le-E Grade Esiqulathweni sokulungisa
xh.summary: Isebe leZaba zikawonke wakunye nokuQuquzelela lifuna abagcisa bokwakha ngetitshu kwizithuba zokulungisa izikhuselo i-Eastern Cape.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sokuVavanya uBugcisa (Ukwakha ngetitshu). Ilayisensi yokuqeshisa efanelekileyo. ulwazi olubanzi: iMithethonqamlomoya yaseNkonweni kaWonke-wonke, uMthetho waseNkonweni kaWonke-wonke. uLungelelwaniso lweProjekthi, uKwaziswa nokuDwelisa inqaku lwezemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe, uPando kunye nokuPhuhlisa. Iimfuno zobuchwepheshe: ulwazi lokwazisa nokuDwelisa inqaku lwezemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe, ukuBhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe, ukuCelisa ngemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe, izicelo zobuchwephesha ezisebenziswa khompyutha, ulwazi nokuThobela imithetho, ulwazi namakhono obunyuko-bakho bonke wemveliso. Umsebenzi ngabanywe, ukusebenzisana, nethamsanqa qha, izikhalazo ezahlukeneyo, iindlela zokuqondisa, izindlu zeenkqubo, ukuphatha iNgqungqutha, ukulungiselela nokuhlela, izakhono zekhompyutha, ulawulo, unxibelelwano nabo bafuyiweyo nabathunyiwe, nokuziphendulela.
xh.duties: Ukwakha inkqubo ekuxubeni: ukulungiselela iinkqubo ngakumbi ngokweemfuno zoluntu olungeniswa. Iinkqubo: Ukulunga iindikimba ngokwemfuno yokusebenza nangokomthetho oqulathiweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko kwindikimba. Ukulungisa nokulondoloza ezinye iindawo zokusebenza ezahlukeneyo kwangaphakathi nokulungisa ezinye izicwangciso. Ulwazi lwezobugcisa: Ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo ezizele zonke iinkalo kakhulu ukuqokelelwa okusemthethweni njengoko kubekiweyo.

af.summary: Die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure soek 'n Handelaar Skilder (Graad A Onderhoud) by Libode Depot om ontwerpe te vervaardig, toerusting te onderhou en gehalteversekering te verseker.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Handelstoetssertifikaat (skilderwerk) met geldige bestuurderslisensie. Algemene kennis: Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act. Projekoördinasie, Tegniese ontwerp en analise-kennis, navorsing en ontwikkeling. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Tegniese ontwerp en analise-kennis, tegniese verslagskrywing, tegniese konsultasie, rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings, kennis van regsnavolging, produksieproseskennis en -vaardighede, spanwerk, interpersoonlike vaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede. probleemoplossing en analise, besluitneming, Beplanning en Organisering, rekenaarvaardighede, bestuur, klienfokus en reaksievermoë.
af.duties: Ontwerp: Vervaardig ontwerpe volgens klienspesifikasies en binne die perke van produksievermoë. Produksie: Vervaardig voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspecificasie en erkende standaarde. Gehalteversekering van vervaardigde voorwerpe. Onderhoud: Inspekteer toerusting en/of fasiliteite vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteite volgens standaarde. Toets herstelde toerusting en/of fasiliteite teen spesifikasie. Gehalteversekerde diens en onderhoude toerusting. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit: Werk register van onderhoude en herstelde foute by. Stel verslae op en dien dit in. zu.title: Isikhundla sokubhala: Ukugcinwa Kwemisebenzi Yesibilianga A
zu.summary: Umnyango we Public Works and Infrastructure ufuna Isikhundla sokugqoka imisebenzi (Ukugcinwa Kwemisebenzi Yesibilianga A) e Libode Depot ukukhiqiza izinkonzo, ukugcina izinto ezisetshenziswayo futhi kuqinisekiswe ukukhiqizwa okuhle.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Esifanele Se Trade Test (painting) nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Olujwayelekile: Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act. Ulwazi Lokucofa Umsebenzi, Ulwazi Lokubuka Izinto Ezingochwepheshe Nakokuhlaziya, Ukucwaninga Nokukuthuthukisa. Isikhundla Esibuso: Ulwazi lokubuka izinto ezingochwepheshe nokuhlaziya, ukubhala amarekhodi ngobuchwepheshe, ukweluleka ngokubuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zokusiza ezingochwepheshe ngokusetyenziswa kwelungiselelo lekhompyutha, ulwazi ngemithetho yesikhashana, ulwazi namakhono emikhiqizo yokwenza izinto, ukusebenza njengosuku, amakhono okubonisana nabantu, amakhono okuthuthukisana. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda izinto, ukuthatha izinqumo, Ukuhlela Nohlelo, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukulawula, ukunaka futhi uphendule okufunwa ngumthengi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela: Kukhiqize izinhlelo ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwesigaba sokukhiqiza okungenzeka. Ukukhiqiza: Kukhiqize izinto ngemishini nangezinsimbi ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi nezindinganiso eziqashelwayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwemithamba yokukhiqizwa. Ukugcinya: Kuhlole izinsimbi nezinsiza ukuze kubonakale izinkinga ezibangelwa ubuchwepheshe. Kulungiswe izinsimbi nezinsiza ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso. Kuhlolelwe izinsimbi ezilungiswe futhi nangezinsiza uma zihambisana nezidingo. Kukhiqizwe isevisi eqinisekisiwe kanye nezinsimbi ezigciniwe. Kwenze imisebenzi ebalulekile emayelana neminye imisebenzi ebalulekile: Kuhlaziye irhekhodi lezinkinga ezigciniwe futhi ezilungisiwe. Kuhlele futhi kuhambise amabhulogi. Kugcine futhi kugcine irhekhodi yomsebenzi. Kunikeze okufakwe ocwaningweni lwezinhlelo zokusebenza. Kuqaphele futhi kuqeqeshe abantu. Kugcine ulwazi: ukuqeqeshwa ngokuphelelayo komuntu ngamunye ukuze kugcinene nobunye bezinsizakalo ezintsha futhi izindlela.

xh.title: UMgcini wePeyinti: Inqanaba A Lokulungisa
xh.summary: Isebe lezoMisebenzi zoLuntu nezeZakhiwo lifuna uMgcini wezinto (uPeyinti weNqanaba A Lokulungisa) eLibode Depot ukuyila amayilo, ukulondoloza ulwande kwaye uqinisekise umgangatho.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekilesi soVavanyo lobuNgcali (upeyinti) nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. ULwazi jikelele: IIMgaqo-Nkqubo zoNkonzo kaRhulumente, uMthetho woNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi lokuLungelelanisa iiprojekthi, ukuYila ngobuChwepheshe nokuHlalutya, uPhando nokuPhucula. Amandla obuChwepheshe: ulwazi lokuYila ngobuChwepheshe nokuHlalutya, ukuBhala iingxelo zobuChwepheshe, ukuCecezelwa ngobuChwepheshe, izicelo zobuChwepheshe eziqhotyoshelwa khompyutha, ulwazi ngokuZinza komthetho, ulwazi namakhono oMgangatho wokukhiqiza, ukusebenza njengesebe, amakhono abantu phakathi kwabo, amakhono eNkulumo. ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuHlalutya, ukuThatha iziGqibo, uCwangcisa & ukuLungelelanisa, amakhono eKhompyutha, uLawulo, ukuzinikela kumthengi nokuPhendula.
xh.duties: Uyilo: Yenza amayilo ngokwezicelo ziklayenti ngaphakathi kwemida yamandla okukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza: Khiqiza izinto ngezinto zokwakha nolwande ngokomgangatho womsebenzi namagqabantshintshi amaziwayo. Qinisekisa umgangatho wezinto ezenziwe. Ukulungiswa: Hlola ulwande okanye iziseko ukuze ubone iimpazamo zobuchwepheshe. Lungisa ulwande neziseko ngokwamagqabantshintshi. Vavanya ulwande olungiweyo okanye iziseko ngokuchasene nesicelo. Iinkonzo ezinomgangatho oqinisiweyo nolwande olulungiweyo. Yenza imisebenzi yophando nezinxulumene nayo: Hlaziya irejista yemiphumo egcinwe nokulungisiweyo. Qamba uze ugcwalise iingxelo. Gcina uze ulondoloze irekhodi lomsebenzi. Nikezela ngeengcombolo kwiplani zokusebenza. Lawula uze ulungelelanise abasebenzi. Bolisa ulwazi: ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo kobuntu ukuze ughube nobuchwepheshe obutsha nemigaqo.

zu.summary: Umsebenzi Wobuchwepheshe Wamagesi ogcina imishini nezikhungo ezindaweni eziningi zamadepo e Eastern Cape ku Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Esifanele Sokuhlola Umsebenzi (kagesi) sinelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi Olubanzi: Imithetho Yomsebenzi Womphakathi, Umthetho Womsebenzi Womphakathi. Ulwazi Lokuquumba Imisebenzi, Ukuklama Nokuqonda Okusemthethweni, Ucwaningo Nentuthuko. Iziqu Zobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe bokuklama nokuqonda, ukubhala imibiko yezobuchwepheshe, ukweluleka ngezobuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zezobuchwepheshe ezingathonywa khona, ukuziphendukela emthethweni, ulwazi namakhono okukhiqiza, ukusebenza ndawonye, amakhono okuxhumana. ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqonda, ukuthatha izinqumo, Ukucubungula nokuhlela, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuphatha, ukugxila kulimi futhi uphendule kumthengi.
zu.duties: Ukuklama: Khiqiza amakhlama ngokwezidingo zklayenti futhi ngaphakathi kwezikhawu zokhiye ukukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza: Khiqiza izinto ngezinto zokwakhiwa nempahla ngokwezidingo zomsebenzi nangokwesilinganiso esamukelekile. Ukuqinisekiswa kwemithetho yezinto ezikhiqiziwe. Ukulungisa: Hlola impahla kanye noma izinto zokusiza ukuthole iziphazamiso. Hlola impahla kanye nemisebenzi engavuthwa kahle. Ukulungiswa kwempahla futhi kwezimpilo ezingezinhle zokusebenza komphakathi kanye nezinto ezingavuthwanga. Ukuhlola impahla ekhonjiwe kanye noma izinto ezingasizeki kahle ngokwezidingo. Ukuphatha kwezimali, isigaba sohwebo nokwelulekwa kwabanye abantu kanye nokugcina imali kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwempahla. Ukwenza imisebenzi yobulungiswa nokulawula: Ukuthuthukisa isibuyekezo sezinkinga ezilungisiwe kanye nezinto ezibekiwe ehlezi. Qamba futhi unike imibiko. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lomsebenzi. Nikela ngolwazi ezindleleni zokusebenza. Qaphisise futhi ululele abasebenzi. Gcina ulwazi: ukuthuthukiswa komuntu ngamunye okuqhubekayo ukuze ugqame ngamateknoloji namasu amatsha.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wamaGesi obugcisa: uGcino lweNqanaba a
xh.summary: Umsebenzi wobugcisa wamagesi ukugcina izixhobo kunye neziseko ekuqhubeni iindawo ezininzi e Eastern Cape kuSebe loMsebenzi kaRhulumente noLwakhiwo lwezoLimo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sovavanyo lolwazi (lwamandla kagesi) kunye nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. ulwazi Olubanzi: Imigaqo yoNkonzo kaRhulumente, uMthetho woNkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi loPhuhliso loMsebenzi, uYilo nobuNzulu bolwazi, uPhando nokuPhuculwa koolwazi. Amandla obuGcisa: uYilo nobuNzulu bolwazi, ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa, ingcebiso zobugcisa, izicelo zobugcisa ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuthobela umthetho, ulwazi namandla kwindlela yokwenza iinkqubo, ukusebenza njengesiqhema, amandla okusebenzisana nabantu, amandla okunxibelelana. ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhlola, ukwenza izigqibo, uCocwo noLungelelwaniso, amandla ekompyutha, ulawulo, ukujongana nabanxibelelanayo kunye nokusabela.
xh.duties: Uyilo: Yakha izinto ezilungelelaniswa nesicelo seklayenti kwaye ngaphakathi kwemigangatho yamandla okwenza iinkqubo. Ukwenza iinkqubo: Yenza izinto ngezinto ezisetyenziswayo nangaphezulu kwemisebenzi ngokwemigaqo yolusebenzi kunye nemigangatho ekelwe ngayo. Uqinisekiso lwegangatho kwezinto ezenziweyo. Ukugcina: Hlola izixhobo kunye/okanye iindawo zolwakhiwo ukujonga iimpazamo zobuchwepheshe. Lungisa izixhobo kunye nendawo zolwakhiwo ngokwemigangatho efunekayo. Vavanya izixhobo ezilungiweyo kunye/okanye iindawo zolwakhiwo ngokomgangatho ofunekayo. Iinkonzo ezikumgangatho olungileyo nezixhobo ezigciniweyo. Yenza imisebenzi yophando kwaye ibe nomsebenzi ongumphathe-phathe: Hlaziya irekhodi lempazamo ezilungiweyo kwaye zigciniwe. Qamba iingxelo kwaye uzithumele. Gcina kwaye uhlaziye irekhodi yolusebenzi. Nikela nengcamango kwemiqathango yokusebenza. Lawula kwaye ululele abasebenzi. Gcina amandla obuchwepheshe: kuphuhliso oluqhubelekayo komntu ngamnye ukuze aqhubeke ngeendaba zezona nzucbo zutsha kunye neendlela zokwenza izinto.

af.title: Ambagsman Lugversorging: Graad A: Onderhoud
af.summary: 'n Lugversorgingsambagsman word by die Mthatha Depot benodig vir die onderhoud, ontwerp en kwaliteitsversekering van toerusting.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Handelsloopbaantoetssertifikaat (lugversorging). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Algemene kennis: Openbare Diensregulasies, Openbare Dienswet. Projekkoördinasie, tegniese ontwerp en ontledingskennis, navorsing en ontwikkeling. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Tegniese ontwerp en ontledingskennis, tegniese verslagskrywing, tegniese konsultasie, rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings, regsnavolging, produksieproseskennis en -vaardighede, spanwerk, interpersoonlike vaardighede, Kommunikasievaardighede. probleemoplossing en ontleding, besluitneming, beplanning en organiseringsvaardighede, rekenaarvaardighede, bestuur, kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë.
af.duties: Ontwerp: Vervaardig ontwerpe volgens kliëntspesifikasies en binne die perke van produksievermoë. Produksie: Vervaardig voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspesifikasie en erkende standaarde. Kwaliteitsversekering van vervaardigde voorwerpe. Onderhoud: Inspekteer toerusting en/of fasiliteite vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteite volgens standaarde. Toets herstelde toerusting en/of fasiliteite teen spesifikasie. Kwaliteitversekerde diens en onderhoudde toerusting. Verrig administratiewe en verwante funksies: Werk die register van onderhoude en herstelde foute by. Stel verslae op en dien dit in. Hou werksrekords aan en onderhou dit. Verskaf insette tot bedryfsplanne. Hou toesig oor personeel en mentorn hulle. Onderhou kundigheid: deurlopende individuele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures.

zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu obalulekile wokuqhuba isikhathi esiphezulu eMthatha Depot ukugcinwa, ukwakheka kanye nokutholakala kwekhwalithi yemishini.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esifanele seTrade Test (Air conditioning). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi olubanzi: Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act. Ukulungiselela kuphrojekthi, ukwakheka kobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqonda ukuhlaziya, ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko. Iziqu zobuchwepheshe: ukwakheka kobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqonda ukuhlaziya, ukubhala umbiko wobuchwepheshe, ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zokusebenza zesidlange ezibuswa yikhompyutha, ukuhambisana nomthetho, ulwazi kanye namakhono inqubo yokukhiqiza, ukusebenza njengesiqu, amakhono abantu bokuzwana, amakhono okuxhumana. ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukulungelela nokuhlela, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuphatha, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula.
zu.duties: Ukwakheka: Kukhiqize ukwakheka ngokwezidingo zakhamengi futhi ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yamandla okukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza: Kukhiqize izinto ngezinto zokwakha kanye nemishini ngokohlelo lwemisebenzi kanye namazinga avunyiwe. Ikhwalithi etholakala ezintweni ezikhiqiziwe. Ukugcinwa: Hlola imishini futhi noma izakhiwo ukutholwa kwezimpazamo zobuchwepheshe. Lungisa imishini nezakhiwo ngokwamazinga avunyiwe. Hlola imishini efakshiwe kanye nezakhiwo ngokwezidingo. Isevisi enekhwalithi etholakala kanye nemishini egciniwe.enza imisebenzi yophalathe namanye eminye: Buyela emuva kubhalo lwezimpazamo ezigciniwe nezilungisiwe. Lungeza futhi uhluze umbiko. Ligcine futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lemsebenzi. Nikeza ngesingenzo ohlelweni lokusebenza. Qaphise futhi uhole abasebenzi. Londoloza ubuchwepheshe: intuthuko yomuntu ngamunye ephethe ukugcina isikhathi nezindlela ezintsha zokusebenza.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wezandla ozenza umoya oqhotyoshelwayo: Inqanaba A: Ukugcina
xh.summary: Kufuneka umsebenzi wezandla ozenza umoya oqhotyoshelwayo kwi-Depot yaseMthatha ukugcina, ukuyila nokuthembisa ngangokwemigaqo isixhobo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esifanelekileso sovavayo lwebhaja (Ukuqhotyoshela umoya). Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. ulwazi jikelele: Iimigaqo yoLwazi lwaZwelonke, uMthetho woLwazi lwaZwelonke. uQhagamshelo lweProjekthi, uKwazi ukuYila nokuChaza ngokobuchwepheshe, uPhando nentl Developed. izipho zobugcisa bokuchwepheshe: ukwazi ukuyila nokuchaza ngokobuchwepheshe, ukubhalwa kweenxibe zokubhala ngokobuchwepheshe, ingcebiso ngokobuchwepheshe, iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezancediswa ngobuchwepheshe, ukuthobela umthetho, ulwazi namakhono enkqubo yokwenziwa, ukusebenza njengesiqhanga, amakhono okuhlobana nabantu, amakhono okunxibelelana. ukusombulula iingxaki nokuzezisiso, ukwenza izigqibo, ukuCwangcisa & ukuQamba, amakhono ekhompyutha, ulawulo, ukugxila kumthengi nokuPhendula.
xh.duties: uYilo: Yakha amayilo ngokwezicwangciso zomthengi nangaphakathi kwemida yenkqubo yokwenza. ukuYila: Yakha izinto ngezixhobo nangemixholo ngokwezicwangciso zomsebenzi nangokweemigaqo eziyaziwayo. Ukuthembisa ngangokwemigaqo izinto ezenziweyo. ukuGcina: kuphande isixhobo kwaye noma iziseko zeempawu zokubakho kweempazamo ngokobuchwepheshe. Lokusa isixhobo neziseko ngokwemigaqo. Vavanya ukulunga isixhobo kwaye noma iziseko ngokwezicwangciso. Iinkonzo ezithembiswe ngangokwemigaqo nangaphezulu kwaye isixhobo esigcinweyo. Yenza imisebenzi yoluluvo kwaye nayo enxulumene nayo: Hlaziya irejista yemipazamo egciniweyo nalungisiweyo. Qamba kwaye ungenise iinxibe. Gcina kwaye ugcine irekhodi yomsebenzi. Nikeza ingcombolo kwiinkqubo zokuqhuba phambili. Lawula kwaye ulungelelanise abasebenzi. Gcina ulwazi olunjalo: ukuphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo ngamntu wonke ukuze wagcinhambe nobuchwephesha obutsha neenkqubo.

Ukugcina: Hlola impahla kanye/noma izikhungla ukuthi zithole iziphazamisi zobuchwepheshe. Lungisa impahla nezikhungla ngokwezinga eliqashiwe. Hlola impahla esetshenzisiwe kanye/noma izikhungla ngokwezidingo. Isevisi eqinisekisiwe ikhwalithi kanye nempahla egcinwe. Yenza imisebenzi yabalawuli kanye nemisebenzi ehlobene nayo: Buyekeza irekhodi leziphazamisi ezigciniwe nezilungisiwe. Qamba futhi uthumele imibiko. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lomsebenzi. Nikeza iminikelo emigqugquphelweni yokusebenza. Qapha futhi uholele abasebenzi. Lugcine ulwazi oluhlukile: ukuthuthuka okuqhutshwa ngamunye ukuze kugcinwe nokuthi kulandelwe izobuchwepheshe ezintsha kanye nezinqubo.

Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercises and interviews. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behaviourally preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12/24 months. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme      Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Distrikskoördinering: EPWP
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk wat kantoorondersteuning en sekretariaatsbywerking vir EPWP-distrikskoördinering in Mount Ayliff bied, wat 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat en rekenaarvaardigheid vereis.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat. Geen ondervinding vereis nie. Kennis: Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet (PFMA); Voorskrifte; DORA, PEP's, Openbare Diensregulasies, BBBEE-wet, EPWP-beleid. EPWP-fase 3-riglyne Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan. Ministeriële Bepaling. Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, Wet No.108 van 1996.Beroepsgezondheids- en Veiligheidswet. Rekenaarvaardigheidsvaardighede. Diagnostiese vaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Beleidsontwikkelingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Kantoorondersteuning-Reël plek vir vergaderings en besprekings. Behandel inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Skryf van notule. Skakel met Openbare liggame aangaande algemene administratief-verwante aangeleenthede. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die sekretariaat vir die funksionele stuurkomitees in ooreenstemming met EPWP-norme en -standaarde. Fasiliteer die data vaslegging van DPW&I en Openbare Liggame in die EPWPRS -Skakel en raak betrokke by Munisipaliteite en Openbare Liggame binne die O.R Tambo-streek. Verifieer inligting vir akkuraatheid, nakoming en volledigheid. Voer die invulsisteem vir die eenheid uit. Voer maandelikse monitering uit van vaslegde inligting teenoor inligting in die stelsel. Implementering van Prestasie-inligting-Voer werfverifikasieloggings uit om nakoming met EPWP-riglyne en vaslegde inligting in die EPWP RS na te gaan. Versameling van Aanwesigheids- en Betalingsregisterkopieë, Dienskontrakte van Deelnemers. Voer lêerverifikasieloggings van DPWI-projekte uit. Kontroleer nakoming van inligting en skep 'n nakomingsjabloon vir elke projek. Skep individuele lêers vir elke EPWP-projek. Verkrygingsdiens aan EPWP-direktoraat- Fasiliteer die verskuiwing van fondse en moniteer Begroting om onder- en oorbesteding te voorkom. Uitvoering van 'n verkrygingstelsel vir akkommodasie, plekke, skryfbehoeftes, brandstof eise en ander goedere en dienste vir die program. Beheer van die verkrygingsproses om te verseker dat alle dokumentasie en handtekeninge korrek is. Beheer en verseker dat Ontvaste Uitgawes op datum gehou word.

zu.title: Ikhomishana Ebusweni Elamukelekayo: Ukulinganisela Kwendawo: EPWP
zu.summary: Ikhomishana Ebusweni Elamukelekayo elinikeza isekelo ehhovisi kanye nensekelo esibungweni sokuhlelelwa kwe-EPWP kusikhungo sase-Mount Ayliff, esidinga Isitifiketi Esiphakeme Sabazali kanye nolwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Sabazali seSikolo Samabanga Aphakeme. Akukho mkhawulo weminyaka yokulingiselela. Ulwazi: I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA); Imiyalo; i-DORA, ama-PEP, Imithetho Yomzimaba Kazwelonke, i-BBBEE Act, Inqubo ye-EPWP. Imihlahlandlela yesigaba se-3 se-EPWP National Development Plan. Isinqumo Sengqungquthle. Umthethosisekelo weRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho uNo.108 ka-1996.Umethetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Komsebenzi. Izindlela zokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ikhono lokuhlola izinkinga. Ikhono lokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa imigomo.
zu.duties: Isekelo Ehhovisi-Hlela izindawo zokuhlangana kanye nezibukelo. Phendla incwadi engenayo naphumayo. Ukubhala amaminithi. Xhumana nomzimaba kazwelonke ngamaphuzu ahlobene nokuphatheka kwezokongqonga. Nikeza isekelo esibungweni sakomiti ebuzayo ngokuvumelana nemigomo namazinga e-EPWP. Qondisa ukungenisa idatha ye-DPW&I kanye Nomzimaba Kazwelonke ku-EPWPRS-Xhumana futhi uxhumane neziNdawo kanye Nomzimaba Kazwelonke endaweni yakwa-O.R Tambo. Qinisekisa ulwazi ngokuchaneka, ukuvumelana, nokugcwaliseka. Phetha uhlelo lokugcwalisa amafayela aliwo msebenzi. Yenza ulwazi lwanyanga zonke lokuqapha idatha engenisiwe uma iqathaniswa nelwazi esihlelweni. Ukusebenzisa Ulwazi Ngemisebenzi-Yenza ukuvakashela izinda ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana nemigomo ye-EPWP nolwazi olungenisiwe ku-EPWP RS. Ukuqoqa amakhophi Ezibukelo ezinganisiwe kanye namarejista ekhokhayo, Amakhasimomsebenzi Wabathathi nxaxheba. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwamafayela amaphrojekthi e-DPWI. Hlola ukuvumelana kolwazi futhi udale ithemplethi yokuvumelana yamaphrojekthi wonke. Dala amafayela ngayinye yaphi iphrojekthi ye-EPWP. Isekelo EsokuThenga Kuqondisi be-EPWP- Qondisa ukudluliswa kwemali kanye nokuphatha ibhajethi ukugwema ukungasebenzisi ngokweqile noma ukweqa imali. Ukuphethwa kohlelo lokuthenga ngokwamasiza, izindawo, izinto zokubhala, izimangalo zamafutha, kanye nezinye izinto kanye nezinsiza zohlelo. Lawula inqubo yokuthenga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibhalo kanye nezinkimbobhalo ziyiyo. Lawula futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ukuchithwa kwemali kugcinwa kuseduze nesikhathi.

xh.title: Iclerki yolawulo: Ilungiselelwe leZithethe: EPWP
xh.summary: Iclerki yolawulo ehlinzeka ngenkxaso leofisi kwaye inceda ngeenkxaso zesikithi kumanyano lwesithili se-EPWP eMount Ayliff, ifuna isatifikethi seZiko leSizwe nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seZiko leSizwe. Akukho mqobo funwa. Ulwazi: UMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA); Imiyalelo; DORA, PEPs, Iimithetho yoKwesebenza kuRhulumente, uMthetho ka- BBBEE, iNkqubo ye-EPWP. Iinkqubo zohlobo loku-3 le-EPWP iNkqubo yoPhuhliso leSizwe. Isigqibo seNgangam. uMthethosiseko weRiphablikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho u-No.108 ka-1996. uMthetho woKhuseleko loNyango. Iakhadi zokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okuchonga iingxaki. Amandla okuhlaziya. Amandla oxazula iingxaki. Amandla okuphuhliswa kweenkqubo.
xh.duties: Inkxaso yeOfisi-Hlela indawo yemiqungumbetho, nokuqamba iindawo. Jongana nokubhalisa okungena nokuphuma. Ukuqwalanisa amanqaku. Xhumana nobukhosi ngemiba yentlawulo- yamandla obutyungethelayo. Hlinzeka ngenkxaso kwisikithi sabo bagqiba kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ngokwemigaqo namazinga e-EPWP. Yenza ukuqamba i-data ka- DPW&I nabakwiBala laze kwi- EPWPRS - Xhumana uzame kuMasipala nemiBala yoluntu ngaphakathi kwi- O.R Tambo Region. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka, ukuvunywa, nokuzaliseka kolwazi. Phumeza inkqubo yokugcina ulwazi yeqembu. Yenza ukuyilo nyanga zonke kolwazi oluqambiwe elithe lwahlathwa ngokwelu lwazi olusesixubeneni. Ukuphumeza iNkqubo yoLwazi loMsebenzi- Yenza iindwendwe eziguquguqukayo ukuzama ukuhlela kwemigaqo ye-EPWP nolwazi oluqambiwe kwi- EPWPRS. af.title: Rekenaarklerk: Rekonsiliasie
af.summary: Instapvlak-rekenaarklerk in Mthatha wat registerdienste, posverwerking en kliëntnavrae hanteer; vereis Graad 12 sonder vooraf ervaring.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Geen ervaring vereis. Kennis & Vaardighede: National Archives-gids en Record Service, Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Batho Pele-beginsels. Departementbeleid beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Public Finance Management Act. Wetlike vereiste: COIDA. Public Service Act. PFMA en National Treasury Regulations. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations. Vaardighede: Verbale en geskrewe kommunikasie. Interpersoonlike verhouding probleemoplossing. Organisasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf registertoonbankdienste: Bedien kliënte. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae ontvang. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgelewerde pos / lêers. Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie: Ontvang alle pos. Sorteer, registreer en stuur pos uit. Versprei kenniggewings oor registuraangeleenthede. Lewer effektiewe indiening- en rekordbestuursdienste: Oopmaak en sluit van lêers volgens rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Indiening / berging, nasporing (elektronies/ handmatig) en terugwinning van dokumente en lêers. Voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Bedryf kantoorMasjiene in verband met die registurfunksie: Oop en hou franking machine register aan. Frank pos, rekordgeld en werk register daagliks by. Onderneem steekproefkontroles op pos om te verseker dat geen private pos ingesluit is nie. Sluit pos in pos sak vir boodskappers om by die Post Office af te lewer. Oop en hou remittance register aan. Rekord alle waardevolle artikels soos voorgeskryf in die remittance register. Hand af en teken remittances oor aan finansies. Stuur verkeerde remittances terug na sender via geregistreerde pos en rekord verwysingsnommer in register. Hou daaglikse rekord van aantal gefrankeerde briewe. Verwerk dokumente vir argivering en / of vernietiging: Elektroniese skandering lêers. Sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel lys op van alle dokumente om gearchiveer te word en dien by die toesighouer in. Hou rekords vir gearchiveerde dokumente.

zu.title: Ilekela lezezimali: Ukubuyiselanisa
zu.summary: Ilekela lezezimali elinganqwa e-Mthatha elibhekene nezinkonzo zeregistry, ukucubungula iposi nokuphendula imibuzo yamakhasimende; lifuna i-Grade 12 ngaphandle kokho kokutholakala ngaphambilini.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Akukho mkhondo odingekayo. Ulwazi & Amakhono: Isiqondiso se-National Archives kanye ne-Record Service, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Inqubomgomo yomnyango yezempilo nokuphepha kumsebenzi. I-Public Finance Management Act. Isidingo somthetho: I-COIDA. I-Public Service Act. I-PFMA kanye nezilawuli ze-National Treasury. I-Public Service Act. Izilawuli ze-Public Service. Amakhono: Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe. Ukuxhumana kwabantu kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuhlela.
zu.duties: Nikela izinkonzo zeregistry: Phathela abakhasimende. Phatha imibuzo yocingo neminye engenayo. Yamukela ubhalise iposi / amafayela ahanjiswe ngesandhla. Phatha ukunyakathisana kwemibhalo engenayo naphumayo: Yamukela yonke iposi. Hlela, bhalela futhi thuma iposi. Sabelana izaziso ngemikhakha yeregistry. Nikela izinkonzo zokugcina kanye nokuqashelwa kwegama: Ukuvula kanyeokuvala amafayela ngokwesimiso sokuhlukanisa amarekhodi. Ukugcina / ukusiza, ukulandela (ngekhompyutha/ngesandhla) nokuthola amadokhumenti namafayela. Gcwalisa amakhadi wonke amafayela. Sebenzisa imishini yehhovisi ehlobene nomsebenzi weregistry: Vula futhi gcine irekhodi yemishini yokufaka uphawu lweposi. Faka uphawu lweposi, bhala imali futhi buyekeza irekhodi nsuku zonke. Yenza ukuhlolwa okungalindelwe kweposi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ayikho iposi yangasese ebandakanyiwe. Khiyiza iposi esikhwameni seposi abathunywa bayoyethuna ePost Office. Vula futhi gcine irekhodi yokuthumela imali. Bhala yonke izinto ezinokwenza njengoba kushiwo kurekhodi yokuthumela imali. Ytha uhlethe usayine imali ezothunyelwa kwezimali. Thumela emuva imali ethunyelwe kabi kumthumeli ngeposi ebhalisiwe ubhale inombolo yokubhalisa kurekhodi. Gcina irekhodi lansuku zonke lenombolo yamagazethi afakiwe uphawu. Hlela amadokhumenti wokuyogcina noma okulahliwa: Skena amafayela ngekhompyutha. Hlela futhi boza amafayela okuyogcinwa okuthunyelwe. Hlela uhlu lwawo wonke amadokhumenti okuyogcinwa uwenze kumlawuli. Gcina amarekhodi wamadokhumenti agciniwe.

Zenza iinkonzo zokuqwalasela iifayile eziphumelelayo: Ukuvula nokuvala iifayile ngokwinkqubo yokwahlula irekhodi. Ukuqwalasela / ukugcina, ukukhangelo (ngqo ngesandla) nokukhupha amaxwebhu nangeefayile. Qedela amakhadi e-index kuwo onke amafayile. Sebenzisa iimishini zofiso ngokwabantlu kwindima yeregistry: Vula ulugcine ulwazi lwemashini maling. Qinise inkosi, bhala imali uze uhlaziye ulwazi lwemashini maling yonke imihla. Yenza ukuhlola inkosi ukuze qiniseke ukuba akukho inkosi yangasese ifakwe kuyo. Tshixa inkosi kwi-postbag umthunywa aze ayithumele ePost Office. Vula ulugcine ulwazi lweremittance. Bhala zonke izinto ezixabisekileyo njengoko kumiselwe kulwazi lweremittance. Zenzela ngentsandla uze utyikitye iiremittances kumntu wezimali. Thumela iiremittances ezichukumnisiwe emva kumthumeli ngeinkosi ebhaliweyo uze ubhale inamba yesalathiso ulwazini. Gcina ulwazi yonke imihla lwenani le letters ezinqwambisiweyo. Yenza amaxwebhu okwenza i-archiving nokutshatyalalisa: Ukuskana iifayile ngqo. Hlela upake iifayile iarchive nakusasazo. Yaza uludwe lwawo onke amaxwebhu okwenza i-archive uze uwazise kumlawuli. Gcina ulwazi ngamaxwebhu a-archived.

zu.title: Umlobi Wezobulungiswa: Ukulandelela noku-Hlola: EPWP
zu.summary: Umlobi wezobulungiswa osekela ukulandelela nokuhlola i-EPWP e-Aliwal North, ofuna National Senior Certificate ongadingi mcwayo wangaphambili.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate noma NQF Level 4. Akukho mcwayo odingekayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) DORA, PEPs, Public Service Regulations, BBBEE Act, EPWP Policy. Ukuxhumana nabalingani; Ukuphathwa kwezimali, Ukusebenzisa amapholisi. Ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukusebenzisa inqubo, ukuphathwa kwamakhasimende nokuqinisekwa ikhwalithi, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ikhono elihle lokubusa nokuqonda, ukuzibusa, amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono ekhompyutha, amakhono okucubungula nokuhlela, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi, amakhono okuxoxisana nokubhukuda.

Lungisela ifayela lephrojekthi ukuze libe negqozi. Qaphela inani lembiko yokuqeda ifayela nyanga zonke. Lungisela imibiko yemihlangano yesekithi nesifunda. Qaphela izinqumo zesekithi nesifunda. af.title: Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Veiligheidsbeampte word in Queenstown gesoek om toegangsbeheerfunksies uit te voer; vereis Grade C PSIRA-registrasie en 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat. Basiese veiligheidsbeampte-kursus. Grade C-registrasie by PSIRA. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die toegangsbeheerprosedure Kennis van beheermaatreëls en beweging van toerusting en voorrade Skryf sekuriteitsprosedures voor, bv. MIS, NISA, Wet op die Beskerming van Inligting, Noodprosedures. Kommunikasievaardighede, lees en skryf.
af.duties: Voer toegangsbeheerfunksies uit Bepaal afsprake of dienste wat besoekers benodig Kontak die betrokke werknemer om afspraak te bevestig of verwys besoeker na die tersaaklike diensleweringspunt Voltooi of verseker dat die toelatingsbeheerregister voltooi is Reik toelatingsbeheerdokumente/kaarte uit soos vereis Begelei besoekers na tersaaklike werknemers/plekke waar nodig Sluit en ontsluit ingange Verseker dat ongemagtigde persone en gevaarlike voorwerpe nie die gebou/perseel betree nie Volg op voorvalle Undertsele gebou/perseelpatrollies Identifiseer en kontroleer of deure gesluit of ontsluit is soos vereis Kontroleer waterlekkasies en dat krane toe is Identifiseer en kontroleer brandgevare, blootgestelde elektriese kontakte en ander brandgevare Kontroleer ligte, skakel aan en af soos vereis Kontroleer verdagte voorwerpe en pakkies en rapporteer dit Pas noodprosedures toe Verseker veilige bewaring van toerusting, dokumente en voorrade van die Departement Voltooi registers om die beweging van toerusting, voorrade en dokumente te beheer Bevestig dat geen toerusting, voorrade of bates van die departement die gebou/perseel ongemagtig verlaat nie Inspekteer voertuie wat die perseel betree en verlaat Versamel inligting en rapporteer oor vermiste en gesteelde toerusting en voorrade Hanteer dokumente by toegangspunte volgens klassifikasie en die voorskrif.

zu.title: I-ofisa Lokuvikela
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-ofisa lokuvikela e Queenstown ukwenzia imisebenzi yokulawula ukungena; kudingeka ukubhaliswa kweGrade C PSIRA nesatifikedi seeNdebe zeSenior.
zu.requirements: Isatifikedi seeNdebe zeSenior. Ikosi eliyisisekelo le-ofisa lokuvikela. Ukubhaliswa kweGrade C ne-PSIRA. Akukho olunye uhlezi oludingekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngendlela yokulawula ukungena Ulwazi ngendlela yokulawula nokuqhathaniswa okush intuthuko yamathuluzi nezimpahla. Indlela ekubeketshelwe yokuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka njengeMIS, NISA, umthetho weProtection of Information, namaphoyisa aphephile. Ulwazi lokukhuluma nolokufunda nokubhala.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula ukungena. Qinisekisa ukuthi ngabe yiziphi izinsiza abathomyi bezidinga. Thintana nomsebenzi okuthile ukuthi aqinisekise isikhathi sokubetha noma uxhume umthwambe kwindawo ethile yokulethwa kwensiza. Qedela noma qinisekisa ukuthi isikhwama sokulawula ukungena sigcwele. Nikela amathikithi/amakhadi okungena njengoko kudingwa. Hambisa abathomyi kubasebenzi abathintayo/ kulezo zindawo. Vala kavule amasango. Qinisekisa ukuthi abantu abangenemvume kanye nezinto eziyingozi zingangeni esakhiweni/ endaweni. Landelela izinto ezenzekile. Zenza isibheke sabantu esakhiweni/ endaweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasango avuliwe noma ayalaliwe njengako. Hlola ukuthi kunezikebhezi bese vala amakhaphukhaphu. Qinisekisa futhi uhlole izingozi zomlilo kanye nezinye izidingo ezikuleso simo. Hlola ukukhanya, uvule uvale njengako. Hlola izinto ezishushu namaphakethe bese usibika. Sebenzisa izinkambiso zezimo eziphuthumayo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwamathuluzi, amadokhumenti nezimpahla zikaManyango. Qedela isikhwama ukuze ulawule ukunyakaza kwamathuluzi, izimpahla namadokhumenti. Qinisekisa ukuthi akukho mathuluzi, izimpahla nezimpahla zikaManyango eziphuma esakhiweni/ endaweni zingangenamvume. Hlola izithuthi ezifika nezihamba endaweni. Qoqa ulwazi bese usibika ngamathuluzi nezimpahla ezilahlekile noma eziyize. Phatha amadokhumenti endaweni yokungena ngokwezinga kanye nesimiso.

Collect, sort, and distribute mail and documents from the various institutional components. Collect and deliver documentation and related items in the department or other departments. Prepare packages/parcels for dispatch by the courier or postal service. Copy, shredding and binding of documents. Perform or assist with any other duties assigned within the registry.

af.title: Bode
af.summary: Die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure soek 'n bode in Queenstown om pos en dokumente in te samel, te sorteer en te besorg, met ABET Level 4 en basiese kommunikasievaardighede as vereistes.
af.requirements: ABET Level 4 of NQF Level 1. Geen ervaring nodig nie. Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van algemene werk en skoonmaakdienste. Kommunikasievaardighede. Moet kan lees en skryf.
af.duties: Lewer effektiewe bodedienste. Versamel en besorg pos na/van die Postkantoor en ander pos/kuurierdienste. Versamel, sorteer en versprei pos en dokumente van die verskeie instellingskomponente. Versamel en besorg dokumentasie en verwante items in die departement of ander departemente. Hou register van dokumentasie wat ontvang en besorg is. Versprei interne, departementele en nasionale sirkulieres. Verseker dat waar van toepassing, 'n ontvangserkening vir pakkies, pos, korrespondensie en sirkulieres wat besorg is, geteken word. Berei pakkies/posstukke voor vir versending deur die koerier- of posdiens. Fotostaat, vernietiging en inbind van dokumente. Voer uit of help met enige ander pligte wat binne die registratuur toegeken word.

zu.title: Umthumeli mpumela
zu.summary: I-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ifuna umthumeli mpumela e-Queenstown ukuqoqa, hlela futhi athule imephu namadokhumenti, idinga ABET Level 4 nalamakhono okuxoxa abantu.
zu.requirements: ABET Level 4 noma NQF Level 1. Akukho njongo yomlando oyidingayo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi jikelele nesevisi yokuhlanzwa. Amakhono okuxoxa. Ukuba nokwazi ukufunda nokubhala.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi ethile yomthumeli mpumela. Qoqa futhi ufake uphawu lweposi evela/kuya e-Post Office nasezinye izinkonzo zokuposa/zezikweli. Qoqa, hlela, futhi wabelane ngemephu namadokhumenti avela kumangotho ahlukeni ezikweni. Qoqa futhi uwakhiwe amadokhumenti nezinye izinto ezihlobene nazo kumnyango noma kwezinye iminyango. Gcina irekhodi lwamadokhumenti atholiwe nawethunyelwe. Yaba phakathi imiyalezo yomnyango, kanye neyezwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi lapho kufanelekile, kunikwa isibonakaliso sokwamukela okushiwo ngokuphawula amaphakethe, imephu, imibhalo, kanye nemiyalezo ethunyelwe. Lungisa amaphakethe/izinto zokuthumela ngesevisi yesikweli noma yeposi. Kopisha, sula futhi ubophe amadokhumenti. Wenze noma usize kunoma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi enikezwe kule ndawo yokugcina amarekhodi.

xh.title: Umthunywa
xh.summary: Isebe leZoMisebenzi Zolawulo nokuQulunqwa lifuna umthunywa eQhukeni ukuba aze axele, alungele abathunywa kwaye aze athwalele imile nemiqathango, kufuneka ABET Level 4 nendlela esisiseko yokunxibelelana.
xh.requirements: ABET Level 4 okanye NQF Level 1. Akukho mfundo yomsebenzi efunekayo. ulwazi nemiqobo: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ejikeleze nesevisi yokucocwa. Amandla okunxibelelana. Makakwazi ukufunda nokubhala.
xh.duties: Nika ngobuchule iinkonzo zomthunywa. Qokelela kwaye uthwalele imile kuye/Buye kwiPost Office nasezinye iinkonzo zokuposa/abathunywa. Qokelela, ulungelelanise, kwaye usasaze imile nemibhalo ezahlukahlukeneyo eziqukiweyo kumagatya amaninzi ecalo kobukhosi lo Mzantsi Afrika. Qokelela kwaye uthwalele imibhalo nezinto ezinxulumene nayo kule sebe okanye kwezinye iisebe. Gcina irekhoda yemibhalo efunyanwe kwaye ithunyelwe. Sasaza amakhaphukhaphu angaphakathi, amasebe, nawe sizwe. Qinisekisa ukuba apho kusebenzisekayo, kusayinwa isiqinisekiso sokwamkela kwiiqhina, imile, iindaba ezithunyelwayo, namakhaphukhaphu athunyelwayo. Lungiselela iipakethe/iiqhina ukuba zithunyelwe ngumthunywa okanye inkonzo yeposa. Kopisha, uqhamle, kwaye ubophe imibhalo. Zenze okanye uncede naluphi na olunye umsebenzi onikiweyo ngaphakathi kwegumbi legcina amaphepha.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Cultural Affairs
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 – R1 858 821 per annum (Level 14). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Chief Director needed at the Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce to manage arts, culture and heritage services at senior management level.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus an NQF level 7 qualification as recognized by SAQA in Cultural Studies / Arts Management / Public Administration / Public Management/ Management/ Library and Information Science/Archives & Records Management/ Heritage & Museum studies/ Cultural Heritage Management/ History/ Fine Arts/ Performing Arts. 5 years minimum experience at senior managerial level. A successfully completed SMS pre-entry programme Nyukela Certificate is required before appointment. Extensive experience in a relevant managerial field. Experience in developing strategic and business plans. Experience in government financial management. Extensive knowledge and experience in Government policies and procedures. Excellent communication and analytical skills. Extensive knowledge of Arts and Culture, Libraries and Archives, Museums and Heritage as well as Language Services are essential. Knowledge of and experience in sector needs and business. Extensive knowledge in government prescripts, policies and procedures. Willingness to work extra hours. Computer literacy with an emphasis on Excel and PowerPoint. An independent worker, meeting timeframes. Monitoring and managing compliance of the District with the Statutory Bodies. Must be in possession of a valid code 08 driving licence. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Knowledge & Skills: Sound understanding of basic accounting principles (GRAP and Modified Cash Basis) and proven ability to apply them. Knowledge of budget process, BAS, PERSAL and LOGIS∙ Have the ability to perform independently and under pressure. Good written and verbal communication skills. Computer literacy in MS Word, Excel and Outlook, knowledge of Legislation, Regulations, Policies, Instructions, Practices, Public Finance Management Act, Notes of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and National Treasury Regulations. SMS pre-entry certificate (completed) is one of the minimum requirements for SMS positions as indicated under paragraph 10.3 of the DPSA Directives as an online course on www.thensg.gov.za. Excellent facilitation, research, negotiation, presentation, project management, strategic planning and motivations skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure provision of arts and culture services. Create and monitor environment for development of performing arts. Create and monitor environment for development of visual arts and crafts. Manage promotion and preservation of culture and moral regeneration. Control and manage the function of art centres, campsites and funding thereof. Ensure provision of museums and heritage services. Manages the revitalization and development of museum services. Monitor and coordinate the usage of heritage facilities. Manage and coordinate the utilization of heritage institutions. Ensure provision of libraries and information services. Monitor the delivery of efficient library and information services. Oversee library awareness programs for development of community libraries. Facilitate and manage the resource provision to the Municipality libraries. Monitor the provision of archives and repository management services. Facilitate and monitor the implementation of the budget of the library infrastructure programs. Ensure provision of language development and literature services. Facilitate and monitor provision of language development and literature services in the province. Oversee provision of translation and interpretation services. Manage and coordinate promotion of language development and preservation. Manage and coordinate the development and preservation of indigenous language. Promote Good Corporative Governance. Employee Performance: Implementation and monitoring of the policy focused priorities as pronounced in the Departmental Policy Speech. Promote Intergovernmental Relations, Integrated Governance and Sound Stakeholder Relationships. Facilitation of minimum information security standards (MISS and overall accountability of the Department. Key Government Focus Areas: Develop and implement an effective and efficient supply chain management system. Support International and Regional Integration Programmes and Commitments. Promote Diversity and Transformation Management Priorities. Promote Integrated Governance. Auditor General; Focus on the measurement of the extent of the departmental financial and legislative compliance. Ensure no material findings on non-compliance with legislation. Ensure financial statement is free from material misstatements. Organisational Performance: Ensure development, implementation and review of Departmental Strategic Imperatives. Focus on assessing the organisational performance based on the predetermined targets in the Annual Performance Plan (APP). Ensure the audited Annual Report will be used to establish the extent in which the objectives in the APP has been achieved. Ensure management and monitoring of programme risk register.
