SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercises and interviews. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behaviourally preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12/24 months. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Kulturele Sake
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur benodig by die Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce om kuns-, kultuur- en erfenisdienste op seniorbestuursvlak te bestuur.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken in Cultural Studies / Arts Management / Public Administration / Public Management / Management / Library and Information Science / Archives & Records Management / Heritage & Museum studies / Cultural Heritage Management / History / Fine Arts / Performing Arts. 5 jaar minimum ervaring op seniorbestuursvlak. 'n Suksesvol voltooide SMS voor-toelatingsprogram Nyukela-sertifikaat word voor aanstelling vereis. Uitgebreide ervaring in 'n relevante bestuursveld. Ervaring in die ontwikkeling van strategiese en besigheidsplanne. Ervaring in staatsfinansiële bestuur. Uitgebreide kennis en ervaring in regeringsbeleid en prosedures. Uitstekende kommunikasie- en analitiese vaardighede. Uitgebreide kennis van Arts and Culture, Libraries and Archives, Museums and Heritage asook Language Services is noodsaaklik. Kennis van en ervaring in sektorbehoeftes en besigheid. Uitgebreide kennis van regeringsvoorskrywings, beleid en prosedures. Bereidwilligheid om ekstra ure te werk. Rekenaarvaardigheid met die klem op Excel en PowerPoint. 'n Onafhanklike werker wat tydraamsters nakom. Monitering en bestuur van die distrik se voldoening aan die statutere liggame. Moet in besit wees van 'n geldige kode 08-bestuurslisensie. Alle kortlys-kandidate vir SMS-poste sal aan 'n tegniese oefening en onderhoud onderwerp word. Na die tegniese oefening en onderhoud sal 'n maksimum van drie (3) SMS-kandidate psigometriese assesserings ondergaan om kognitiewe vermoëns, gedragsvoorkeure, emosionele intelligensie en integriteit te assesseer. Kennis & Vaardighede: Deeglike begrip van basiese rekeningkundige beginsels (GRAP en Modified Cash Basis) en bewese vermoë om dit toe te pas. Kennis van begrotingsproses, BAS, PERSAL en LOGIS∙ Het die vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Word, Excel en Outlook, kennis van Wetgewing, Regulasies, Beleid, Instruksies, Praktyke, Public Finance Management Act, Notes of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en National Treasury Regulations. SMS voor-toelatingsertifikaat (voltooi) is een van die minimum vereistes vir SMS-posisies soos aangedui onder paragraaf 10.3 van die DPSA Direktiewe as 'n aanlyn kursus op www.thensg.gov.za. Uitstekende fasilitering-, navorsing-, onderhandelings-, aanbiedings-, projekbestuurs-, strategiese beplanning- en motiveringsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker voorsiening van kuns- en kultuurdienste. Skep en monitor omgewing vir ontwikkeling van uitvoerende kunste. Skep en monitor omgewing vir ontwikkeling van visuele kunste en vakke. Bestuur bevordering en bewaring van kultuur en morele regenerasie. Beheer en bestuur die funksie van kunssentra, kampterreine en die befondsing daarvan. Verseker voorsiening van museum- en erfenisdienste. Bestuur die revitalisering en ontwikkeling van museumdienste. Monitor en koördineer die gebruik van erfenisfasiliteite. Bestuur en koördineer die benutting van erfenisinstellings. Verseker voorsiening van biblioteek- en inligtingsdienste. Monitor die lewer van doeltreffende biblioteek- en inligtingsdienste. Hou toesig oor biblioteekbewustheidsprogramme vir die ontwikkeling van gemeenskapsbiblioteke. Fasiliteer en bestuur die verskaffing van hulpbronne aan die Munisipale biblioteke. Monitor die voorsiening van argief- en bewaarplekbestuursdienste. Fasiliteer en monitor die implementering van die begroting van die biblioteekinfrastruktuurprogramme. Verseker voorsiening van taalontwikkeling en literatuurdienste. Fasiliteer en monitor voorsiening van taalontwikkeling en literatuurdienste in die provinsie. Hou toesig oor voorsiening van vertaal- en tolkdienste. Bestuur en koördineer bevordering van taalontwikkeling en bewaring. Bestuur en koördineer die ontwikkeling en bewaring van inheemse tale. Bevorder Goeie Korporatiewe Goewerneerbaarheid. Werknemersprestasie: Implementering en monitering van die beleidgefokusde prioriteite soos uitgespreek in die Departementele Beleidstoespreek. Bevorder Tussenregeringsverhoudinge, Geïntegreerde Goewerneerbaarheid en Gesonde Belanghebbende Verhoudinge. Fasilitering van minimum inligtingsekuriteitsstandaarde (MISS) en algehele aanspreeklikheid van die Departement. Hoof Regeringsfokusareas: Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n doeltreffende en doeltredende toevoerkettingbestuurstelsel. Ondersteun Internasionale en Regionale Integreringsprogramme en Verbintenis. Bevorder Diversiteit en Transformasie Bestuursprioriteite. Bevorder Geïntegreerde Goewerneerbaarheid. Auditor General; Fokus op die meting van die mate van departementele finansiële en wetgewende voldoening. Verseker geen wesenlike bevindinge oor nie-nakoming van wetgewing. Verseker finansiële staat is vry van wesenlike wanvoorstellings. Organisatoriese Prestasie: Verseker ontwikkeling, implementering en hersiening van Departementele Strategiese Imperatiewe. Fokus op die assessering van die organisatoriese prestasie gebaseer op die voorafbepaalde teikens in die Annual Performance Plan (APP). Verseker dat die oudit Jaarverslag gebruik sal word om die mate te bepaal waarin die doelwitte in die APP bereik is. Verseker bestuur en monitering van programrisikoregister.

zu.title: I-Chief Director: I-Cultural Affairs
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Chief Director e-Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture eQonce ukuphatha amasevisi obuciko, inhlalo nomphakathi kanye nelifa esigabeni sophatho.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Senior Certificate kazwelonke kanye nethi qualification yesigaba se-NQF level 7 njengoba kunjengiswa i-SAQA kwezifundo zamasiko / ukuphathwa kobuciko / ukuphathwa kahulumeni / ukuphathwa kahulumeni / ukuphathwa / i-Library kanye nolwazi lwezissenschaft / ukuphathwa kweziqu nokugcina amaphuzo / izifundo zomlando namamnyuziyamu / ukuphathwa kwelifa lenhlalo nomphakathi / umlando / iFine Arts / iPerforming Arts. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yamava esigabeni sophatho. Kudingeka ithi Nyukela Certificate yesikhathi sangaphambi kokuqala i-SMS ihambiswe ngaphambi kokuqashwa. Amabe amaningi ngenqubo yolawulo enkundleni ehambisanayo. Amabe ekuthuthukiseni inhlelo yezinjongo neyebhizinisi. Amabe ekuphathweni kwezimali kahulumeni. Ulwazi olude kakhulu kanye namaba emigomo noma inqubo kahulumeni. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nokuhlaziya inqubo. Ulwazi olude kakhulu ngobuciko ngenhlalo nomphakathi, i-Library, Archives, iMuseum kanye nelifa kanye namasevisi olimi kuyadingeka. Ulwazi kanye namaba kwezidingo zenqubo kanye nebhizinisi. Ulwazi olude kakhulu ngezinhlelo kahulumeni, imigomo kanye nenqubo. ukuzithoba ukusebenza amahora amaningi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ngokugcizelela i-Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint. Ukusebenza eyedwa, ukuhlangabezana nensimi. Ukulawula kanye nokuphatha ukuhambisana kwesiFunda ngezikhungo ezibekwe umthetho. Kudingeka abe nelayisense yokushayela i-code 08. Bonke abantu ababekwe ohlwini i-SMS bazohlangabezana nesenzo senzima kanti bazohlangana namava. Emva kwesenzo senzima, abantu abasha abangu-(3) i-SMS bazohlaziywa ukubona ukuthi bakhona kangakanani ngokomqondo, izinketho zenqubo, inhlakanipho yezimo, nokuba nokholo. Ulwazi kanye namakhono: ukuqonda kahle izimiso zokubala ezisisekelo (i-GRAP kanye nokuthi Kusukela kumva) kanye namandla okugcina ukwaziswa kwenqubo. Ukubona kakhulu ukubonwa, isimo sokubonakaliswa kolimi, imigomo, kanye netimu yegama. Ulwazi ngepayipi yebhajethi, i-BAS, i-PERSAL kanye ne-LOGIS. Ukwazi ukusebenza eyedwa nangaphansi kwezinkinga. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokukhuluma. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ku-MS Word, i-Excel kanye ne-Outlook, ulwazi lwezilawuli, izincazelo, imigomo, izinkomba, izindlela, umthetho wezimali kahulumeni, izinkomba zomthetho wezimali kahulumeni kanye ne National Treasury Regulations. I-SMS pre-entry certificate (completed) iyisidingo esingaphansi kokuqashwa kwisevisi yezikhundla se-SMS njengoba kunjengiswa kumagama angu-10.3 we Directive ka-DPSA njengesifundo esiku-inthanethi ku www.thensg.gov.za. Amakhono amahle okuquumba, ukucwaninga, ukuxoxisana, ukubonisa, ukuphatha iphrojekthi, ukuhlela izinjongo nokwenza izinkuthazo.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi yobuciko nenhlalo nomphakathi. Dala futhi ulawule imvelo yokuthuthukiswa kobuciko bokwenza. Dala futhi ulawule imvelo yokuthuthukiswa kobuciko obubonwayo nokucula. Lawula futhi uphathe ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwenhlalo nomphakathi kanye nokuvuselelwa kobulungiswa. Lawula futhi uphathe imisebenzi yezikhungo zobuciko, izindawo zokuhlola kanye nokuqashwa kwazo. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi yamamnyuziyamu kanye nokugcinwa kwelifa. Phatha ukuvuselelwa nokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi yamamnyuziyamu. Qaphela futhi uhlanganise ukusetshenziswa kwezinto zokugcina umlando. Lawula futhi uhlanganise ukusetshenziswa kwezikhungo zokugcina umlando. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi yolayibrari kanye nemininingwane. Qaphela ukulethwa kwemisebenzi esebenzayo yolayibrari kanye nemininingwane. Qapha izinhlelo zokwazisa ngolayibrari ukuthuthukiswa kwezolayibrari zomphakathi. Wenze futhi ulawule ukunikezwa kwezinsiza kuzolayibrari zamasipala. Qaphela ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwe-archives kanye nezindawo zokugcina. Wenze futhi uqaphele ukuphathwa kwebhajethi yezinhlelo zokwakha izolayibrari. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kokuthuthukiswa kolimi kanye nemisebenzi yolwazi. Wenze futhi uqaphele ukunikezwa kokuthuthukiswa kolimi nemisebenzi yolwazi esifundazweni. Qapha ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi yokuhumusha nokutolika. Lawula futhi uhlanganise ukukhuthazwa kokuthuthukiswa kolimi nokugcinwa kwakho. Lawula futhi uhlanganise ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kolimi lwasekhaya. Khuthaza i-Corporate Governance elungile. Ukusebenza kwabasebenzi: Ukuphatha nokuphatha izinhloso ezigxile kwenqubomgomo njengoba kunjengiswa eKhalimoni Lenqubomgomo Yomnyango. Khuthaza Izinhlobonhlobo Zahulumeni, Intengiselano Yahulumeni Kuyo Yonke Indlela Nokuba Nobudlelwano Obuhle Nabo Bonke Abathintekayo. Ukwenza izidingo zokuphatha ulwazi oluyisisekelo (MISS kanye nenamba yomnyango yonke indawo. Izindawo Eziyisihloko Ezigxile Kuzo Uhulumeni: Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise isimiso sokuphatha isikhwama esisebenzayo nangempumelelo. Sekela Izinhlelo Nokuzibophezela Kwezifundo Zamazwe Omhlaba Nakwesifundazweni. Khuthaza Izinhlobonhlobo Nobuholi Bezinguquko. Khuthaza Intengiselano Yahulumeni Kuyo Yonke Indlela. Umhloli Jikelele; Gxila ekulinganiseni izinga lokuhambisana kwezimali nomthetho komnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi akukho mibiko enzima ngezenzo ezingahambisana nomthetho. Qinisekisa ukuthi izitatimende zezimali azikho namaphutha amakhulu. Ukusebenza Kwezinhlelo: Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokubuka kabusha kwezinhloso eziyisinqamuli Zomnyango. Gxila ekuhloleni ukusebenza kwezinhlelo ngokususelwa okuhloswe kakhulu eNhlelweni Yomsebenzi Wonyaka (APP). xh.title: Um lawuli Omkhulu: Iindaba Zamasiko
xh.summary: Kufunekiwo uM lawuli Omkhulu kwi Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture eQonce ukulawula iinkonzo zobugcisa, amasiko nengqungquthela kwinqanaba lelona linqanaba liphezulu lokulawula.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate enye ne-NQF level 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA kwi-Cultural Studies / Arts Management / Public Administration / Public Management/ Management/ Library and Information Science/Archives & Records Management/ Heritage & Museum studies/ Cultural Heritage Management/ History/ Fine Arts/ Performing Arts. Iminyaka elingu-5 ubuncinane yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lokulawula. Kufuneka kugqitywe ngempumelelo inkqubo ye-SMS pre-entry programme Nyukela Certificate phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Amabanin amaninzi kwindalo ebalulekileyo yokulawula. Amava ekwakheni iinkqubomphambili zoshishino neeshedi zoshishino. Amava ekulawulweni kwezemali kurhulumente. Ulwazi namava amaninzi kumagazini urhulumente nemigaqo. Amava amakhulu ekunxibelelaneni nokuhlalutywa. Kubalulekile ukuba nalwazi oluninzi nge-Arts and Culture, Libraries and Archives, Museums and Heritage naku-Language Services. Ulwazi namava kwiimfuno zecandelo noshishino. Ulwazi oluninzi kumagazini urhulumente, iinkqubomphambilo nemigaqo. Qwalasela lokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngakumbi kwi-Excel ne-PowerPoint. Umsebenzi ozenzelayo, ahlangabezanenexesha eliquluniweyo. Ukulawula nokuphatha ukwaneliseka kwe-District ngebhunga ezibekiweyo. Kufuneka abe nelayisenisi yokushayela i-code 08 esebenzayo. Onke amagosa abekwe kuluhlu olufutshane kumagazana e-SMS aya kujongwa ngenkqubo yobugcisa bengcali negumbi lembuzo. Emva kwenkqubo yobugcisa bengcali negumbi lembuzo, amagosa amabini abeke kakhulu kuthathu (3) ama-SMS aya kuphuhliswa i-psychometric assessments ukulinganisa iinkanishi zengqondo, izinto azithandayo ngokuziphatha, ubuhlakani bokuziphatha kwakunye nokuqina. Ulwazi & Amakhono: Ukuqonda ngokubanzi kwemigaqo esisiseko yemali (GRAP and Modified Cash Basis) nendlela eqinisekisiweyo yokuyisebenzisa. Ulwazi ngendlela yokwenza ibhajeti, BAS, PERSAL ne-LOGIS∙ Ukuba nemigaqo yokwenza umsebenzi yenze nangaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono mahle okubhala nokuqhuba unxibelelwano. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa i-MS Word, Excel ne-Outlook kwikhompyutha, ulwazi lwe-Legislation, Regulations, Policies, Instructions, Practices, Public Finance Management Act, Notes of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) ne-National Treasury Regulations. Isatifikethi se-SMS pre-entry (esiqedyiweyo) ngelinye lamafunelo amancinci kumagazana e-SMS njengoko kubonisiwe kumazantsi omazwi angu-10.3 abhengezwa yi-DPSA njengenkqubo kwi-www.thensg.gov.za. Amakhono amakhulu ekukhuthaza, kuphande, malungiswano, okubonakalisa, ekulawuleniprojekthi, ekuqwenisa iinkqubomphambilo nokuqinisekisa.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngeenkonzo zobugcisa namasiko. Yaza ulawule imo yokuphuhliswa kwezobugcisa bokwenziwa. Yaza ulawule imo yokuphuhliswa kwezobugcisa ebonakalayo neemfihlo zobugcisa. Inkqubo yamagosa: Ukusebenzisa nokulawula iinkqubomphambilo eziqwalaselwa ngumthetho njengoko kuchaziwe kulumko yesebe. Khuthaza iin relationship zaphakathi karhulumente, Integrated Governance ne-Sound Stakeholder Relationships. Ukwenza i-minimum information security standards (MISS) nokuşikwa isexebe ngenkathazo yesebe. Iindawo ezibalulekileyo eziqwalaselwa kurhulumente: Phuhlisa usebenzise inkqubo elungileyo nesebenzayo yokulawula i-Supply Chain Management. Xhasa iinkqubo zokuhlanganiswa ngamazwe nasekuhlaleni kwaye ugcine izimviso. Khuthaza ukuba banjiwe nokuqhutywa ngaphambili kokuyilwa. Khuthaza Integrated Governance. Auditor General; Qwalasele ukulinganisa ukungathathi hlakulo ngemigaqo yemali nayo kwesebe. Qinisekisa akukho zifundo ezibalulekileyo ngokungalwanga ngomthetho. Qinisekisa isitatimende semali size linganaso nakutheniyo esingeyi kwangoko. Inkqubo yoShishino: Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenzisa nokuphinda ubuke i-Departmental Strategic Imperatives. Qwalasele ukuhlalwa kwento inkqubo yoshishino esekwe kumgca oqinisekisiweyo kwi-Annual Performance Plan (APP). Qinisekisa ukuba i-Annual Report elingiweyo isetyenziselwa ukumisela ukuba zide zifikelela phi iinjongo kwi-APP. Qinisekisa ukulawula nokuqwalasela i-programme risk register.

jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture

jobs.summary: The Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture seeks a Deputy Director for Corporate Services in the Amathole District, Eastern Cape, to manage financial administration and compliance.

A minimum of three (3) years’ experience at an assistant director level. In-depth knowledge and understanding of corporate services management in public service. Service delivery innovation skills. Problem-solving and analysis skills. People management and empowerment skills. Client orientation and customer focus. Communication skills. Honesty and integrity. Networking and presentation skills. Computer skills. Excellent, in- depth knowledge of and insight into all applicable policy frameworks governing the public sector. A valid driving licence.

jobs.title: Scientist Production: Palaeontology
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R761 157 – R816 852 per annum, an all-inclusive remuneration, (OSD)
jobs.summary: Scientist Production in Palaeontology at Albany Museum in Makhanda, requiring a master's degree and SACNASP registration to curate fossil collections and conduct palaeontological research.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a master’s degree in Paleontology / Geology / Geo Science/Zoology, specializing in Eastern Cape Palaeoscience. Compulsory registration with SACNASP as a professional Natural Scientist. A minimum of three (3) years relevant experience in a museum natural science environment. Knowledge of curating paleontology collections, research, fieldwork, fossil preparation and publication of scientific papers. Ability to recognise diagnostic characteristics on which classification systems are based. Computer knowledge, laboratory protocol, word computer packages, paleontology, and financial management. Program and project management. Communication skills, Report writing skills, People management skills, Customer or client orientated approach. Knowledge of public service regulations, legislations/ policies/ prescripts and procedures. Knowledge of Eastern Cape Museum Act. National Heritage Act, Operational standards for natural science museum, South African National Standards for Museums. A valid driving licence.
jobs.duties: Identify, name and classify fossil species based on morphology, and evolutionary relationships. Conduct field surveys and excavations, perform laboratory analysis (fossil preparation and microscopic analysis), curate paleontology collections, and publish research to support knowledge generation and understanding of changing ecosystems through time, and heritage management. Develop and implement methodologies, policies, systems and procedures. Identify and consolidate needs for methodologies, policies, systems and procedures. Identify gaps and develop appropriate interventions. Monitor and evaluate program performance. Perform scientific functions that require interpretation in the absence of an established framework. Provide scientific support and advice. Develop working relations with client base. Create public awareness of the science system. Provide scientific data, information and advice as requested. Review scientific publications. To perform scientific analysis and regulatory functions. Conduct analysis of scientific data. Gather and interpret data, evaluate results and disseminate information, through both scientific publications and public outreach initiatives. Apply appropriate scientific models to generate information and knowledge. Formulate proposals and compile reports. Develop and customize models and techniques. Conduct research and development. Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies, procedures and knowledge. Conduct basic and applied research. Research/literature studies to improve expertise. Publicly present research findings. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on science-related matters. Manage human capital development. Mentor, train and develop candidate scientists and others to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound scientific principles and code of practice. Supervise scientific work processes. Manage performance and development.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie: Paleontologie
af.summary: Wetenskaplike Produksie in Paleontologie by Albany Museum in Makhanda, wat 'n meestersgraad en SACNASP-registrasie vereis om fossielversamelings te kurateer en paleontologiese navorsing te doen.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus 'n meestersgraad in Paleontology / Geology / Geo Science/Zoology, met spesialisering in Eastern Cape Palaeoscience. Verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as 'n professionele Natural Scientist. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n museum natuurowetenskaplike omgewing. Kennis van die kurateer van paleontologie-versamelings, navorsing, veldwerk, fossielvoorbereiding en publikasie van wetenskaplike artikels. Vermoë om diagnostiese eienskappe te herken waarop klassifikasiestelsels gebaseer is. Rekenaarkennis, laboratoriumprotokol, woordrekenaarpakkette, paleontologie, en finansiële bestuur. Program- en projeksbestuur. Kommunikasievaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, mensebestuursvaardighede, kliëntgerigte benadering. Kennis van openbare diensregulasies, wetgewing/beleide/voorskrifte en prosedures. Kennis van Eastern Cape Museum Act. National Heritage Act, operasionele standaarde vir natuurowetenskaplike museum, South African National Standards for Museums. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Identifiseer, benoem en klassifiseer fossielsoorte op grond van morfologie en evolusionêre verwantskappe. Undertoe veldopnames en opgrawings, voer laboratoriumontledings uit (fossielvoorbereiding en mikroskopiese ontleeding), kurateer paleontologie-versamelings, en publiseer navorsing om kennisgenerering en begrip van veranderende ekosisteme oor tyd, en erfenisbestuur te ondersteun. Ontwikkel en implementeer metodologieë, beleide, stelsels en prosedures. Identifiseer en konsolideer behoeftes vir metodologieë, beleide, stelsels en prosedures. Identifiseer leemtes en ontwikkel toepaslike ingryping. Monitor en evalueer programprestasie. Voer wetenskaplike funksies uit wat interpretasie vereis in die afwesigheid van 'n gevestige raamwerk. Verskaf wetenskaplike ondersteuning en advies. Bou werksverhoudinge met kliëntbasis op. Skep publieke bewustheid van die wetenskapstelsel. Verskaf wetenskaplike data, inligting en advies soos versoek. Hersien wetenskaplike publikasies. Voer wetenskaplike ontleding en regulerende funksies uit. Voer ontleding van wetenskaplike data uit. Versamel en interpreteer data, evalueer resultate en versprei inligting, beide deur wetenskaplike publikasies en openbare werksaamhede. Pas toepaslike wetenskaplike modelle toe om inligting en kennis te genereer. Formuleer voorstelle en stel verslae op. Ontwikkel en pas modelle en tegnieke aan. Voer navorsing en ontwikkeling uit. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë, prosedures en kennis. Voer basiese en toegepaste navorsing uit. Navorsings/literatuurstudies om kundigheid te verbeter. Dra navorsingsbevindings in die openbaar voor. Skakel met relevante liggame/raade oor wetenskapverwante aangeleenthede. Bestuur menslike kapitaalontwikkeling. Mentor, leer en ontwikkel kandidaatwetenskaplikes en ander om oordrag van vaardighede/kennis en nakoming van deeglike wetenskaplike beginsels en gedragskode te bevorder. Hou toesig oor wetenskaplike werksprosesse. Bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling.

zu.summary: Isayensi Yokukhiqiza kuPalaeontology eAlbany Museum eMakhanda, idinga idigri yob master kanye nokubhaliswa kuSACNASP ukuze kugcinwe iqoqo lamafosha futhi kwenziwe ucwaningo lwe-palaeontological.

Ulwazi lokulondolozwa kweqoqo le-paleontology, ucwaningo, umsebenzi wensimu, ulungiselelo lwamafosha kanye noshicilelo lwamaphepha esayensi. Ikhono lokubona izici eziyisibonakaliso ezisekelwe kuzinhlelo zokuhlukanisa. Ulwazi lwekhomphyutha, imithetho yelabhorethri, amaphakheji wekhomphyuthawegama, i-paleontology, kanye nezokuphathwa kwezimali. Uphathwa lwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okuphatha abantu, indlela yokuqondiswa kumthengi noma iklayenti. National Heritage Act, izinga lokusebenza kwemnyuziyamu yesayensi yendalo, South African National Standards for Museums. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.

jobs.title: Chief Language Practitioner
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 – R713 535 per annum (Level 10), an all-inclusive remuneration
jobs.summary: Chief Language Practitioner at the Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, responsible for language policy development and multilingualism promotion.
jobs.requirements: A National Senior Certificate plus a National Diploma NQF Level 6 / Preferably bachelor’s degree NQF Level 7 as recognized by SAQA in Linguistic, Socio / Applied -linguistic, Language Planning, Translation and Interpreting Studies, Language Practice / Terminology & Lexicography / Journalism / Communications / Editing or Publishing studies (Languages and Literature services) plus a minimum of three (3) years relevant work experience at a supervisory level (SL 7 / 8) in the field of Languages and Literature development, translating documents from English to isiXhosa. Experience in procurement of goods and services will be an added advantage. A valid driving licence.
jobs.duties: Assist in developing language legislation and policy. Formulate language legislation and policy. Facilitate implementation of language policy. Promote the principle of multilingualism in the province. Facilitate establishment of language units in government departments. Coordinate strategic engagements with the Eastern Cape Language Forum. Facilitate translation and interpreting services. Coordinate development of term lists in all official languages of the province. Conduct research on all difficult terms/words on the term list. Terminology development services. Develop terms in conjunction with language role players. Research on difficult terms. Facilitate authentication/verification of difficult terms. Facilitate approval of terms of difficult nature by national term bank. Development of isiXhosa/Sesotho orthography. Provide administrative support for the component. Facilitate the development of Literature. Coordinate engagements with Literature bodies in the province. Facilitate Literature Development programs. Coordinate both literature and language projects. Assist in the development of strategic, operational and procurement, business and projection plans. Manage financial resources. Manage human resources. Compile monthly and quarterly reports. Allocation of resources for staff. Manage EPMDS and provide staff development training needs.

Kulungelelanise ukuqanjwa kooluhlu lwamagama ngeyonke iilimi ezisemthethweni zephondo. Kuphenye ngawo onke amagama/amagama anzima kuluhlu lwamagama. Iinkonzo zophuhliso lwamagama. Kwenze amagama kunye nabakhusela izinto ngezilimi. Uphando ngamagama anzima. Kukhokise ukuqinisekiswa/ukuqinisekiswa kwamagama anzima. Kukhokise ukuvunywa kwamagama abuzekayo yibhangi yamagama yasekuhlaleni. Uphuhliso lolwimo lwesiXhosa/Sesotho. Kuboneze inkxaso yolawulo leqela. Kukhokise uphuhliso lwezibhalo. Kulungelelanise oonxibelelwano namabhunga ezibhalo kwiphondo. Kukhokise iinkqubo zophuhliso lwezibhalo. Kulungelelanise iiprojekthi zezibhalo nolwimi. Kuncede ekuphuhliseni iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo, ezingomsebenzi wemini nEmini kunye nokuzelelwa kwezinto, zoshishino nokubonisa iinkqubo. Lawula izixhobo zemali. Lawula izixhobo zabantu. Hlanganisela iingxelo zenyanga nethatu-nyanga. Ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi kubasebenzi. Lawula i-EPMDS kwaye nikeze iimfuno zokuqeqesha abasebenzi abafuna ukuphucula izakhono.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: School Sport
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 – R713 535 per annum (Level 10), an all-inclusive remuneration
jobs.summary: Co-ordinate school sport programmes and district championships, manage partnerships, and support schools participating in leagues and festivals.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a three-year Degree/Diploma (NQF level 6) as recognised by SAQA in Sport Management / Sport Administration / Human Movement studies / Recreation Leisure studies / Sport coaching and Human sciences / Sport and Exercise science / Sport and Exercise technology coupled with three (3) years’ relevant experience in Sport and Recreation environment at Senior/officer level or SL 7/8 in the field of Sport and Recreation. Good communication and organising skills. Ability to work under pressure. Basic computer skills. Basic knowledge of Financial Administration. Report writing skills, Presentation skills will be an added advantage. Knowledge of relevant prescripts. A valid driving license is required. Competencies: Project Management will be an added advantage. Knowledge and understanding of the Conditional Grant Framework. Knowledge of relevant pre-scripts acts and regulations that govern sport and recreation. Understanding of policies and regulations that govern school sport Provincially and Nationally. Knowledge of wide range of work processes and procedures such as events management, government procurement, monitoring and evaluation. Good decision-making, analytical and negotiation skills. Financial management, strategic and operational, planning and organizing, people management, problem-solving and conflict management skills. Good report writing skills. Computer literacy (Excel and PowerPoint) and good interpersonal relations. Should be able to work independently and under pressure. Computer Literacy. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Co-ordinate the Implementation of School Sport Programmes and District Seasonal School Sport Championships (NSSC). Implement strategic partnership programmes with School Sport Sector. Facilitate the support towards schools participating in leagues, festivals and provision of equipment and attire. Facilitate the establishment of fully fledged school sport structures and the support towards school sport structures. Develop a database of schools in the within zonal and circuits educational areas. Conduct regular meetings with Department of Education to plan, implement and monitor school sport programmes. Formulate key and strategic partnerships with local stakeholders and NPO’s/NGO’s towards the support of school sport programmes. In conjunction with the DoE and School Sport Structures facilitate the submission of training delegates towards education and training courses in the Province. Provide monthly, quarterly, semester and annual performance and expenditure reports on the school sport. Facilitate the annual registration of schools in the school sport programme. Facilitate Stakeholder engagement sessions with the school sport sector to plan for the development of the annual operation plan. Co-ordinate the provision of non-financial support to be provided to schools and school sport structures. Manage the School Sport budget and the procurement of goods and services as per the annual operational plan and conditional grant requirements. Submit all conditional grant reporting requirements as per the conditional grant framework and department reporting requirements. Develop an annual school sport plan in conjunction with all school sport stakeholders. Monitor and evaluate implementation of school sport programmes.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Skoolsport
af.summary: Koördineer skoolsportprogramme en distrikkampioenskappe, bestee vennootskappe en ondersteun skole wat aan ligas en feeste deelneem.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n driejaar Graad/Diploma (NQF vlak 6) soos erken deur SAQA in Sportbestuur / Sportadministrasie / Menslike Bewegingstudies / Ontspanning en Vryetydstudies / Sportafrigting en Menslike Wetenskappe / Sport- en Oefenwetenskap / Sport- en Oefentegnologie gepaard met drie (3) jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n Sport- en Ontspanningsomgewing op Senior/offisiersvlak of SL 7/8 in die veld van Sport en Ontspanning. Goeie kommunikasie- en organisasievaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Basiese rekenaarvaardighede. Basiese kennis van Finansiële Administrasie. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede; aanbiedingsvaardighede sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van relevante voorskrifte. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis. Bevoegdhede: Projektebestuur sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis en begrip van die Voorwaardelike Toelaeraamwerk. Kennis van relevante voorafgeskrewe wette en regulasies wat sport en ontspanning regeer. Begrip van beleide en regulasies wat skoolsport provinsiaal en nasionaal regeer. Kennis van 'n wye reeks werkprosesse en prosedures soos gebeurtenisbestuur, staatsinkoop, monitering en evaluering. Goeie besluitnemings-, analitiese en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Finansiële bestuur, strategiese en operasionele, beplanning en organisering, mensebestuur, probleemoplossing en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Goeie verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Excel en PowerPoint) en goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Moet in staat wees om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Koördineer die implementering van skoolsportprogramme en distrik se seisoenale skoolsportkampioenskappe (NSSC). Implementeer strategiese vennootskapprogramme met die skoolsportsektor. Fasiliteer die ondersteuning van skole wat aan ligas en feeste deelneem en die verskaffing van toerusting en kleding. Fasiliteer die vestiging van ten volle ontwikkelde skoolsportstrukture en die ondersteuning van skoolsportstrukture. Ontwikkel 'n databasis van skole binne sonale en sirkel-opvoedkundige gebiede. Hou gereelde vergaderings met die Departement van Onderwys om skoolsportprogramme te beplan, te implementeer en te monitor. Formuleer sleutel- en strategiese vennootskappe met plaaslike belanghebbendes en NPO's/NGO's ter ondersteuning van skoolsportprogramme. In samewerking met die DoE en skoolsportstrukture, fasiliteer die voorlegging van afgevaardigdes vir opleiding en opleidingskursusse in die Provinsie. Verskaf maandelikse, kwartaallikse, semester- en jaarlikse prestasie- en bestuursverslae oor die skoolsport. Fasiliteer die jaarlikse registrasie van skole in die skoolsportprogram. Fasiliteer belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsessies met die skoolsportsektor om te beplan vir die ontwikkeling van die jaarlikse bedryfsplan. Koördineer die verskaffing van nie-finansiële ondersteuning wat aan skole en skoolsportstrukture verskaf sal word. Bestuur die skoolsportbegroting en die inkoop van goedere en dienste ooreenkomstig die jaarlikse bedryfsplan en voorwaardelike toelaervereistes. Dien alle voorwaardelike toelaerapporteringsvereistes in ooreenkomstig die voorwaardelike toelaeraamwerk en departementele rapporteringsvereistes. Ontwikkel 'n jaarlikse skoolsportplan in samewerking met alle skoolsportbelanghebbendes. Monitor en evalueer die implementering van skoolsportprogramme.

zu.title: Umcelimngeni Othuthukisiwe: Ezemidlalo Ezikoleni
zu.summary: Qondanisa imiklamo yezemidlalo ezikoleni nemincintiswano yemiphakatsi, phatha ubudlelwano, futhi usekele izikole ezithatha iqhaza kumacashem nemikhosi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Samatikulu eSikoleni okanye i-Degree/Diploma yeminyaka eyisithupha (NQF level 6) evunyiwe yi-SAQA kwi-Sport Management / Sport Administration / Human Movement studies / Recreation Leisure studies / Sport coaching and Human sciences / Sport and Exercise science / Sport and Exercise technology kahambisana neminyaka eyisithupha (3) yohlelo oluhambisana kumkhakha wezemidlalo nokuzilibalisa ezingeni le-Senior/officer noma i-SL 7/8 ekuhalweni kwezemidlalo nokuzilibalisa. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nokuhlela. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi. Amakhono obumfihvo bokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ulwazi olusisekelo lokuqasha Izimali. amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okethula ozobe ngconcosa. ulwazi ngemithetho ephathelene. Idrayiva lesitshali kutholakala ukuthi iyadingeka. Amakhono: i-Project Management izobe ngconcosa. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Conditional Grant Framework. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemithethoisimo elawula izemidlalo nokuzilibalisa. Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo nemithethoisimo elawula izemidlalo ezikoleni ezifundazweni nasezweni lonke. Ulwazi ngenqubo eziningi zokusebenza njengokuqashwa kwezehlakalo, ukuthenga kukahulumeni, nokuhlola amaphutha. Amakhono okwenza izinqumo, ukuhlaziya kanye nokuxoxisana ngokuhle amakhono. Imfihlo yezimali, ukuhlela ngokohlelo kanye nokuqhutshelwa, ukuphatha abantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuphatha izinkinga. Amakhono okubhala imibiko kahle. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Excel ne-PowerPoint) nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza yedwa futhi ngaphansi kwezingcindezi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Idrayiva lesitshali.
zu.duties: Qondanisa ukuphumeleliswa kwezinhlelo zezemidlalo ezikoleni kanye nemincintiswano yesikhathi sezemidlalo ezikoleni emiphakathini (NSSC). Phumeza izinhlelo zohlelo zezemidlalo ezikoleni. Qondisa usizo kwezikole ezithatha iqhaza kumacashem, imikhosi kanye nezenzo nemfushini. Qondisa ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zezemidlalo ezikoleni kanye nokwesekwa kwazo. Yakha isibalomfundo sezikole ezindaweni zemifelandawonke zokufunda. Butha izinkomfa ezivamile ne-Department of Education ukuhlela, ukuphumeza futhi uhlole imiklamo yezemidlalo ezikoleni. Bumba ubuhlobo obubalulekile nabahlinzeki bendawo kanye nama-NPO/NGO ukusekela imiklamo yezemidlalo ezikoleni. Ekubambisweni ne-DoE ne-School Sport Structures qondisa ukuthunyelwa kwezithunywa ekusebenzeni nasekuletheni izifundo esifundazweni. Hlinzeka ngemibiko yentengo nemibalo yethanga, nyanga, isikhathi esiyisigamu kanye nenyanga zonke ngemidlalo ezikoleni. Qondisa ukubhalisa kwamashune njalo ngonyaka kumkhalo wamashune ezemidlalo. Qondisa izinkomfa nabahlinzeki ngomkhakha wamashune ezemidlalo ukuze kuhlelwe ukuthuthukiswa kweplani yokusebenza kanonyaka. Qondanisa ukutholakala koshizo olungemali olunikelwa ezikoleni nasezinhlelweni zemidlalo. Phatha izimali ze-School Sport kanye nokuthenga impahla kanye nezinkonzo njengoba kuhlelwe unyaka wonke kanye nezidingo eziyisihloko esikhokhelwayo. Thumela zonke izidingo zemibiko yesibonezelo esikhokhelwayo njengoba kusho isihlelo sesibonezelo kanye nezidingo zemibiko. Yakha iplani yamashune ezemidlalo unyaka wonke ekubambisweni nabahlinzeki. Hlola futhi uhlole ukuphumelelwa kwemiklamo yemidlalo yasezikoleni.

xh.title: Umsekeli woMlawuli: Imidlalo yeziKolo
xh.summary: Qhoboshela iinkqubo zemidlalo zezikolo nabadlali bezithili, lawula ubudlelwane, kwaye ncedise izikolo ezithatha inxaxheba kumanyano nemimandla.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate nexesha lemfundo leminyaka emithathu yeDegree/Diploma (NQF level 6) evunyiwe yi-SAQA kwiSport Management / Sport Administration / Human Movement studies / Recreation Leisure studies / Sport coaching and Human sciences / Sport and Exercise science / Sport and Exercise technology kunye neminyaka emithathu (3) yamava afanelekileyo kwendawo yeSport and Recreation kwinqanaba laseSenior/officer okanye SL 7/8 kwinkalo yeSport and Recreation. Amaxesha alungileyo okuxoxa nokuqamba. Ikhalithi yokusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelo. Isiphumezi-msebenzi esisekelweni sekhompyutha. Ulwazi olusekelwayo lweFinancial Administration. Amakhono ebhaliwe, amakhono okubonisa abayakuba luncedo. Ulwazi ngebhalo ephathwayo. Ifayidini yolawulo lokushayela iyafuneka. Iikhompetensi: Ulawulo loMsebenzi luyakuba luncedo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwiConditional Grant Framework. Ulwazi ngeebhalo, iimithetho nemigangatho ephathwayo elawula imidlalo nentsho. Ukuqonda kweenkqubo kunye nezigwegwenda ezilawula imidlalo yezikolo ePhondo naseLwizwe. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yemisebenzi eyahlukeneyo nolandelwaniso olunjengolawulo lwemigramatshi, olu khawulezwayo lolawulo, nokuqonda nokuqonda umsebenzi. Amakhono amabalulekekileyo wokwenzisa izigqibo, ukuhlaziya noxholelwaniso. Ulawulo lweemali, elokuqamba elokusetyenziswa, ukulungiselela nokuqamba, ulawulo lwabantu, iisimo ezinzima, namakhono olawulo loxhantamsho. Amakhono amabalulekileyo ukubhala. Ulwazi lokusetyenziswa iikhompyutha (Excel kunye nePowerPoint) nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza ngokwakhe nangaphantsi kwexinzelelo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Qhoboshela ukuSetyenziswa kweenkqubo zeMidlalo zeziKolo kunye neDistrict Seasonal School Sport Championships (NSSC). Zisebenzise iinkqubo ze Strategic partnership kunye noManyano loMsebenzi wamakhaya. Qhoboshela inkxaso ebanjwe kumaziko aphakathi kwamanyano nemimandla eqhuba ukunika ixesha abadlali kunye namakhaya ashukumisayo. Qhoboshela ukwakhiwa kweziko lemidlalo yezikolo ngokupheleleyo kunye nenkxaso ekusekelweni kumaziko. Panga uhlu lwezinyanya kwiiNgcango ezikwiiNhlangano zemfundo yezikolo kwiiNgcango ezikwiiNhlangano zemfundo yezikolo. Yiba nabaqhubi bamagosa abangapheli xesha noma iyiphi na indawo yoluntu ukusula iiNdlela zokuSebenzisa iNkqubo yeMidlalo yoLuntu. Panga iimanyano ebalulekileyo neziguqukileyo ngohlobo lwentshukela, izibonelelo, uluntu, imveliso, neenkxaso zemisebenzi yokulungelelana nokuvuleleka koluntu. Hlanganisa iMfundo yokulawula nokubonelela ngemfundo ekwindalo eqhuba imfundo esemthethweni yoluntu kumaziko apho umthetho wokuqinisekisa uluntu owuthunyelwa uluntu. Thumela imali yokuqedela imisebenzi yokuSebenza eyisigidi, ngokutsha kwexesha nangokweminyaka yonke imali echithwe nokuchazwa ngokubanzi ngelinye ilizwe. Qhoboshela ukubhaliswa kwamabomvu kwishumi eminyaka yonke imidlalo yamaphondo. Qhoboshela iNkqubo yokuSetyenziswa koluntu kulo lonke uluntu lokulungiselela imisebenzi yamaphondo. Qhoboshela ukubonelela ngeenkxaso zokwakh' ezizezekhaya nasekusebenzeni kwezinyanya zeMfundo yoluntu ebalulekileyo. Lawula imali yokwakha iinkqubo nokubonelelwa kwemveliso nakumakhaya eSizwe njengoko kuchazwe kwinkqubo yoluntu nasekusebenzeni koluntu. Thumela zonke iinkcukacha zokuSetyenziswa koluntu ekusebenzeni ngokutsha kwexesha nakwindalo ekulungelelana nemigangatho yoluntu nemithetho yokuSebenza yoluntu. Panga inkqubo yeminyaka yonke yokwakha iinkqubo zeMfundo nemisebenzi yamaphondo. Lawula nokuhlaziya inkqubo yokuSetyenziswa iMfundo yoluntu.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Risk & Intergrity Management
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 897 per annum (Level 09), an all-inclusive remuneration
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role in Risk and Integrity Management at the Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture, requiring a diploma and three years' supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus National Diploma (NQF level 6) as recognised by SAQA) in Risk Management or Internal Auditing or Accounting with at least 3 years’ experience at supervisory level or (SL 7/8) in the field of Ethics Management or Anti-Corruption Field. Certification as Ethics Officer will be an added advantage. Project Management and Supervisory Experience. Job related Knowledge of Public Service Regulations and Legislation as well as Integrity Management Framework. Conceptual and Analytical thinking and Problem-solving ability. Good Report Writing skills. Communication skills (written and verbal skills), Staff and Interpersonal Relations. Creative Presentation skills. Interpretation of Policy. Planning and organizing skills. Research capability and Investigation Methodology Skills. Understanding of investigation techniques, tools, and processes. Honesty and Integrity. Time management Skills. Ability to work under pressure. Work independently with minimal supervision for extended periods. Computer literacy in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Willing to travel extensively. A valid driver’s license is a requirement. No criminal record or pending cases.
jobs.duties: Assist in Development and Management of Ethics Management Strategy, Policies and Programmes in the Department. Co-ordinate and assist in the development of departmental ethics and fraud risk registers. Provide continuous support to staff within the Risk Management unit to prevent ethics, fraud and corruption-related risks. Manage and ensure that reported cases of conflict of interest and remunerative work performed without permission are investigated. Assist in Administration and co-ordination of financial declarations by departmental officials. Co-ordinate the implementation of Ethics and Fraud Management strategy. Initiate the development of Ethics and Fraud Implementation Plans. Monitor, evaluate and report on remunerative work performed outside the Public Service. Monitor and report on the ethics performance of the organisation. Monitor and report on integrity systems and processes within the department. Manage and monitor compliance to ethics and fraud policies. Conduct Lifestyle Reviews and/or Lifestyle Audits and draft reports for review by the deputy director. Provide technical support to the departmental Ethics and Fraud Champions. Co-ordinate the sitting of Risk/Fraud/Ethics forum meetings. Liaise with stakeholders. Conduct ethics and fraud/anti-corruption awareness campaigns within the department.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Risiko- en Integriteitsbestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur-pos in Risiko- en Integriteitsbestuur by die Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture, waarvoor 'n diploma en drie jaar se toesigervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6) soos erken deur SAQA) in Risikobestuur of Interne Oudit of Rekenkunde met ten minste 3 jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak of (SL 7/8) in die veld van Etiese Bestuur of Antikorrupsie-veld. Sertifisering as Etiekbeampte sal 'n voordeel wees. Projekbestuur en Toesigervaring. Werksverwante kennis van Publieke Diens-regulasies en -wetgewing asook die Integriteitsbestuursraamwerk. Konseptuele en analitiese denke en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Goeie verslagskryfvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelike en mondelinge vaardighede), personeel- en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Kreatiewe voorleggingsvaardighede. Beleidsinterpretasie. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Navorsingsvermoë en ondersoekmetodologie-vaardighede. Begrip van ondersoektegnieke, -nutsprogramme en -prosesse. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Tydbestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Onafhanklik werk met minimale toesig vir lang periodes. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint. Bereid om uitgebreid te reis. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie is 'n vereiste. Geen strafregtelike vonnis of hangende sake.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die Etiese Bestuur-strategie, beleide en programme in die Departement. Koördineer en staan by met die ontwikkeling van departementele etiek- en bedrog risikoregistries. Verskaf deurlopende ondersteuning aan personeel binne die Risikobestuur-eenheid om etiese, bedrog- en korrupsie-verwante risiko's te voorkom. Bestuur en verseker dat aangemelde gevalle van belangenbotsing en vergoedende werk sonder toestemming ondersoek word. Bystand verleen met die administrasie en koördinasie van finansiële verklarings deur departementele amptenare. Koördineer die implementering van die Etiek- en Bedrogbestuur-strategie. Inisieer die ontwikkeling van Etiek- en Bedrog-implementeringsplanne. Monitor, evalueer en rapporteer oor vergoedende werk buite die Publieke Diens verrig. Monitor en rapporteer oor die etiese prestasie van die organisasie. Monitor en rapporteer oor integriteitstelsels en -prosesse binne die departement. Bestuur en monitor nakoming van etiek- en bedrogbeleide. Voer leefstylherwinning en/of leefstyloudits uit en stel verslae op vir hersiening deur die adjunkdirekteur. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan die departementele Etiek- en Bedrogkampioene. Koördineer die sitting van Risiko-/Bedrog-/Etiek-forumvergaderings. Skakel met belanghebbendes. Voer etiek- en bedrog-/antikorrupsie-bewustheidsveldtogte binne die departement uit.

zu.title: Osiza-Abaqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kwezingozi Nokuziphatha
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguOsiza-Abaqondisi ekuphathweni kwezingozi nokuziphatha e-Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture, sidinga idiploma namava eminyaka emithathu yokuba ngumphathi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Senkokhelo Yesikole Samabanga Aphakeme kunye neDiploma Yezwe (NQF level 6) eqashelwe yi-SAQA) ekuphathweni kwezingozi noma ekuhlolweni kwangaphakathi noma ekuhlokweni kwemali ezama ongakenyanga angu-3 abaphephile emzingweni wokuba ngumphathi noma (SL 7/8) ekhethini Lokuphathwa Kwezokuziphatha noma ekhethini Lokulwa Nokokhuza. Ukuba nesitifiketi sokuba nguMphathi Wezokuziphatha kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukuqondisa amaphrojekthi namava okuba ngumphathi. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi lwezimiso zomphakathi kanye nomthetho kanye Nohlelo Lokuphathwa Kokuziphatha. Ukucabanga ngokuhlakanipha nangokuhlaziya kanye nethuba lokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okubhala imibiko ngendlela elungile. Amakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunywa), ubudlelwano bobantu kanye nokuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okubukeza ngobusiko obuchothayo. Ukuhumusha izinqumo. Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela. Ikono lokucinga ngesikhathi nendlela yokuphenya. Ukuqonda izindlela zokuphenya, amathuluzi, kanye nenqubo. Ukuqinisile nokuba neciniso. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxabo. Ukusebenza eyedwa ngaphandle kokuphathwa okuncane isikhathi eside. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint. Ukuqina ukuhamba kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba evumelekile iyisidingo. Kungabi nerekhodi lokwephula umthetho noma icala elingake laphathwa.
zu.duties: Siza ekuthuthukisweni nakuphathweni kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kokuziphatha, izinqumo, kanye nezinhlelo kuloMnyango. Hlanganisa futhi usize ekuthuthukiseni amarekhodi wezokuziphatha nomthelela wengozi zomnyango. Nikeza inkxaso eqhubekayo kubasebenzi besekelini sokuphathwa kwezingozi ukuthintela ingozi ezingokuziphatha, ukukhwabanisa kanye nobukhohlwa. Phatha futhi qinisekisa ukuthi icala elicikwayo lempixano yenzinkalo kanye nomsebenzi ozenzayo onemvume utholakale, liphathywa. Siza ekuphathweni nasekuhlanganisweni kwezitatimende zezimali ezwenziwa abasebenzi bomnyango. Hlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokuphathwa kokuziphatha nangozi. Qala ukuthuthukisa amaphulani okuphatha kokuziphatha nangozi. Qaphula, hlaziya futhi ube imibiko ngomsebenzi ohweba ngaphandle kweSebe likahulumeni woomphakathi. Qaphula futhi ube imibiko ngemvelaphi yezokuziphatha kwezinhlangano. Qaphula futhi ube imibiko ngamasistimu nokuziphatha kanye nenqubo kuloMnyango. Phatha futhi qaphula ukuthobela izinqumo zokuziphatha nangozi. Yenza izibuyekezo zendlela yokuphila futhi ulungise imibiko ukuze ihlolwe nguSekela Mqondisi. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kubasiza bokuziphatha nangozi bomnyango. Hlanganisa ukuba kwezinkumpanyana zokuhlangana kweBhodi yeNgozi/Ukungaziphathi/Kwezokuziphatha. Xhumana nalabo abahlobene nomsebenzi. Yiza imikhankaso yokwazisa ngokuziphatha nangozi/ukulwa nobukhohlwa kuloMnyango.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNqanaba: UqondoIso & Ulawulo loQiniseko
xh.summary: Isikhundla sikaMncedisi weNqanaba kwiQondoIso noLawulo loQiniseko kwiSebe lezemoMzimba, iNdimi, iZobucala nengcolo kwiphondo le-Eastern Cape, sifuna idiploma neminyaka emithathu yamava okuba ngumlawuli.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate kunye ne-National Diploma (inqanaba le-NQF 6) eqatshiwe yi-SAQA) kuLawulo loQondoIso okanye ukuQwalasela ngaphakathi okanye ukuBala iimali enorkele elinye kwawo, ngonani elingangenantsunda leminyaka emi-3 yamava kwinqanaba lokulawula okanye (SL 7/8) kummandla woLawulo lweZoBulehlaza okanye ummandla woKulwa nokukruquka. Ukuba nguMlawuli weZoBulehlaza ngokuqatshiwe kuya kuba ludedyo. ULawulo lamaPilo nokuba namava njengomlawuli. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi ngeSystemiso zoLuntu nabaKawulo-kawulo nemigca yomthetho nakwesiKokelo soLawulo loQiniseko. Ukucinga ngokweqondo nokuhlola nokusombulula iingxaki. Amandla okubhala iingxelo ezilunge. Amandla okuthetha nokubhala, noManyano no-Bulumko nabantu. Amandla okubumba iingcombolo ezinovuyo. Ukuqonda iNgqungquthela-mthetho. Amandla okucwangcisa nokuhlela. Amandla okuziphanda nendlela yokuphonononga. Ukuqonda iindlela, izixhobo, namanyathelo okuphonononga. Uyanyaniseka yaye ugqamisa isithunzi. Amandla okulawula isixa. Amandla okusebenza phantsi kwengcindezi. Amandla okusebenza yedwa ngaphandle kolawulo oluncinci ixesha elide. Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha ngokulinganayo kwi-MS Word, Excel, kunye ne-PowerPoint. Ukuqinisekela ukuhamba ubusuku bonke. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni ngumfuno. Akukho n克兰cimal yentjwebhiso okanye icala elindele.
xh.duties: Kuncede ekuyilweni nakulawulweni kweNkululeko-migca yokuLawula iziBulehlaza, iNgqungquthela-mthetho namanyathelo naseSebeni. Ukuqamba ngenkqubo-yokusebenza yokuphuhliswa kwezibuko zesebe ezimala nokusolwa ngemali-kamva nokungalunga njenge-corruption ekusebenzisa ulwazi ngobundlobongela kwi-ofisi. Bancedise ekulawulweni kwe-imini-yonke iindlela ezikwisiphakadi ngokukhusela iingxaki ezibangwa zisoBulehlaza, imali-yokwenza, nokungalunga njengama-corruption ekusebenzisweni kwentsebenziso yoluntu ekubeni nakho imveliso ehamba ethunononononon ngaphakathi, kwaye bakhusele abasebenziyo. Yonke iingxelo ezindululwa ngokuchasene nokungalungelani nokusetyenziswa kwamalizo njengokungalunga njengokungalunga ngokomthetho ziza kuba kwiNkcitha kwiNkcitha kwiKhomishini yokubala into yokungalunga ngokuthi zingene nakulandulo yoluntu, iNkcitha kwiNkcitha.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Strategic Planning
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 897 per annum (Level 09), an all-inclusive remuneration
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Strategic Planning at the Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, coordinating strategic and operational planning processes.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 6) in Public Administration, Public Management / Business Management / Strategic Management / Management Sciences / Business Administration / Development studies/ Policy & Development Management / Monitoring & Evaluation / Project Management / Organizational Development/ Economics / Management Sciences / Governance / Development planning / Operations management / Social Sciences. Minimum of three (3) years’ experience at supervisory level 7/8 in strategic management/planning. Knowledge of Public Service Act, (Batho Pele Principles), PFMA, and Framework and Guideline for Departmental Strategic Plans and Annual Performance Plans. Application of planning methodology. Basic project management. Strategic formulation and implementation. Public sector governance framework. Communication (verbal and written). Problem solving and analysis. Planning and organising. Knowledge management. Diversity management. Budgeting and financial management. Basic research skills. Willingness to drive long Hours. Computer literacy. Thorough Knowledge of Microsoft Office. Incumbent must have worked in strategic planning or monitoring and evaluation. Competencies: Development and operational effectiveness, good people skill & teamwork, results orientated, self-starter, presentation and communication skills. A valid driving license is required.
jobs.duties: Coordinate operational and strategic planning processes. Facilitate the development, review, and alignment of strategic and operational plans in line with organisational objectives, policies, and legislative requirements. Facilitate planning sessions and provide guidance to business units on strategic planning processes, frameworks, and methodologies. Support the development of performance plans, implementation plans, and related planning documentation. Monitor progress against approved plans and identify risks, challenges, and opportunities for improvement. Compile strategic planning reports, dashboards, and briefing documents for management consideration. Ensure effective coordination between strategic priorities, operational activities, and resource allocation. Facilitate the identification of service delivery challenges and support the development of improvement plans and interventions. Facilitate stakeholder engagement to ensure service delivery initiatives are responsive to organisational and stakeholder needs. Support the implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of service delivery improvement initiatives. Analyse performance information and provide recommendations to enhance efficiency, effectiveness and quality of service delivery. Track implementation progress and prepare reports on improvement initiatives, outcomes, and areas requiring intervention. Promote continuous improvement practices across the organisation. Coordinate and support the implementation of priority programmes /projects. Facilitate the planning, implementation, and monitoring of priority programmes and strategic projects. Provide project coordination support, including tracking milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies. Facilitate collaboration among internal and external stakeholders involved in priority initiatives. Monitor project performance against approved objectives, timelines, and outcomes. Prepare progress reports, presentations, and updates for management and relevant governance structures. Support the resolution of implementation challenges to ensure successful delivery of strategic priorities. Management of administration support. Give input in the development of policies and operational plans. Compile and submit monthly and quarterly reports. Determine and verify the authenticity of the evidence provided. Attend and respond to audit matters. Supervise human resources. Maintain staff discipline.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Strategiese Beplanning
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Strategiese Beplanning by die Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, wat strategiese en operasionele beplanningsprosesse koördineer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 6) in Openbare Administrasie, Openbare Bestuur / Besigheidsbestuur / Strategiese Bestuur / Bestuurswetenskappe / Besigheidsadministrasie / Ontwikkelingstudies / Beleid- en Ontwikkelingsbestuur / Monitering en Evaluering / Projekbestuur / Organisasie-ontwikkeling / Ekonomie / Bestuurswetenskappe / Regering / Ontwikkelingsbeplanning / Operasionele bestuur / Sosiale Wetenskappe. Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring op toesighoudende vlak 7/8 in strategiese bestuur/beplanning. Kennis van Public Service Act, (Batho Pele-beginsels), PFMA, en Raamwerk en Riglyn vir Departementele Strategiese Planne en Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne. Toepassing van beplanningsmetodologie. Basiese projekbestuur. Strategiese formulering en implementering. Openbare-sektor-regeringsraamwerk. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Probleemoplossing en analise. Beplanning en organisering. Kennisbestuur. Diversiteitsbestuur. Begroting en finansiële bestuur. Basiese navorsingsvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om lang ure te bestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Deeglike kennis van Microsoft Office. Ampshouer moet in strategiese beplanning of monitering en evaluering gewerk het. Bevoegdhede: Ontwikkeling en operasionele doeltreffendheid, goeie mensevaardighede en spanwerk, resultaatgerig, selfaanvaller, voorlegging en kommunikasievaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Koördineer operasionele en strategiese beplanningsprosesse. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling, hersiening en belyning van strategiese en operasionele planne in ooreenstemming met organisatoriese doelwitte, beleide en wetgewende vereistes. Fasiliteer beplanningssessies en verskaf leiding aan besigheidseenhede oor strategiese beplanningsprosesse, raamwerke en metodologieë. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling van prestasieplanne, implementeringsplanne en verwante beplanningsdokumentasie. Monitor vordering teenoor goedgekeurde planne en identifiseer risiko's, uitdagings en geleenthede vir verbetering. Stel strategiese beplanningsverslae, dashborde en briewingsdokumente vir bestuursoorweging op. Verseker effektiewe koördinasie tussen strategiese prioriteite, operasionele aktiwiteite en hulpbrontoewysing. Fasiliteer die identifisering van dienslewering-uitdagings en ondersteun die ontwikkeling van verbeteringsplanne en ingrypings. Fasiliteer belanghebbende-betrokkenheid om te verseker dat dienslewering-inisiatiewe reageer op organisatoriese en belanghebbende behoeftes. Ondersteun die implementering, monitering en evaluering van dienslewering-verbeteringsinisiatiewe. Analiseer prestasie-inligting en verskaf aanbevelings om doeltreffendheid, effektiwiteit en kwaliteit van dienslewering te verbeter. Monitor implementeringsvordering en berei verslae voor oor verbeteringsinisiatiewe, uitkomste en areas wat ingryping vereis. Bevorder deurlopende verbeteringspraktyke regoor die organisasie. Koördineer en ondersteun die implementering van prioriteitsprogramme/projekte. Fasiliteer die beplanning, implementering en monitering van prioriteitsprogramme en strategiese projekte. Verskaf projekkoördinasie-ondersteuning, insluitend die monitering van mylpale, lewerbare produkte, risiko's en afhanklikhede. Fasiliteer samewerking tussen interne en eksterne belanghebbendes betrokke by prioriteitsinisiatiewe. Monitor projekprestasie teenoor goedgekeurde doelwitte, tydlyne en uitkomste. Berei vorderingverslae, voorleggings en opdaterings vir bestuur en relevante bestuursstrukture voor. Ondersteun die oplossing van implementeringsuitdagings om suksesvolle levering van strategiese prioriteite te verseker. Bestuur van administratiewe ondersteuning. Lewer insette in die ontwikkeling van beleide en operasionele planne. Stel maandelikse en kwartaalverslae op en dien dit in. Bepaal en verifieer die egtheid van die verskafde bewyse. Woon ouditsake by en reageer daarop. Onderhou menslike hulpbronne. Handhaaf personeelsdissipline.

zu.title: Umsekeli Wohlelo: Ukuhlela Okuyisikhuthazi
zu.summary: Umsekeli Wohlelo Wokuqamba Amasu osikhundleni se Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture e Qonce, ohlela kabusha izinqubo zokuqamba amasu nokuhlela okusebenzayo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Samatiketi ePhezulu ngaphezu kwemfundo ephansi (NQF level 6) kwi-Public Administration, Public Management / Business Management / Strategic Management / Management Sciences / Business Administration / Development studies/ Policy & Development Management / Monitoring & Evaluation / Project Management / Organizational Development/ Economics / Management Sciences / Governance / Development planning / Operations management / Social Sciences. Okuncane iminyaka emithathu (3) yohlelo njengesiboneli izinga 7/8 ekupheni amasu/ukuqamba. Ulwazi ngomthetho weSebenzi Kahulumeni, (Imigomo kaBatho Pele), i-PFMA, kanye Nesakhiwo Nesiqondiso Sokuhlela Amasu Omnyango Namapulani Emyalezo Wonyaka. Ukusetshenziswa kwendlela yokuqamba. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo ngokuyisisekelo. Ukuqamba nokusebenzisa amasu. Isakhiwo sokubuswa komphakathi. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nokubhaliwe). Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zabantu. Ukwenza kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali. Amakhono ocwaningo okuyisisekelo. Ukuzethemba ekushayeni ithemu isikhathi eside. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ulwazi olujulile lwe Microsoft Office. Umuntu owayesele uhlezi ohlela amasu noma ohlola bese eveza. Amakhono: Ukuthuthukiswa nokusebenza kahle, amakhono abantu kahle kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu, ukugxila emiphumeleni, ukuziqalisela, amakhono okwethula kanye nokuxhumana. Kudingeka iphasikhidi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Hlela izinqubo zokusebenza kanye nokuhlela amasu. Yisa isikhuthazi ekuthuthukisweni, ekuhlolweni, kanye nokuhambisana kohlelo oluyisikhuthazi nolusebenzayo ngokulandelana kwemigomo yenhlangano, izinqubo, nezidingo zomthetho. Yisa isikhuthazi kumasessini wokuqamba bese unikeza isiqondiso emayunithi wezoshintsho ngezinqubo zokuqamba amasu, izakhiwo, nezindlela. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa kwamapulani okusebenza, amapulani okuphumeza, namadokhumenti ohlelo ahlobene. Hlola inqubo ngokwamapulani avunyiwe bese ukhomba izingozi, izinselele, namathuba okuthuthukisa. Hlela imibiko yokuqamba amasu, amabhodo okubuka, namadokhumenti okwazisa ukuze kuphathwe ngokomphathi. Qinisekisa ukuhlangana okusebenza kahle phakathi kokuqamba okuyisikhuthazi, izenzo ezisebenzayo, nokwabiwa kwemithombo. Yisa isikhuthazi ekuhlotsheni izinselele zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo bese usekela ukuthuthukiswa kwamapulani okuthuthukisa kanye nokungenelela. Yisa isikhuthazi ekuxhumaneni nabanomzondo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zivakalelwa izidingo zenhlangano kanye nabonomzondo. Sekela ukuphumeza, ukuhlola, bese ukwazisa izinhlela zokuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Hlaza ulwazi ngemiphumela bese unikeza iziphakamiso ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza kahle, ukusebenza ngempumelelo, kanye nengcono yokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Landa inqondo yokuqamba bese ulungiselela imibiko ngokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlela, imiphumela, kanye nezindawo ezidinga ukungenelela. Khuthaza izinqubo zokuthuthukisa njalo enhlanganweni. Hlela bese usekela ukuphumezwa kwezinhlela eziyisikhuthazi /amaphrojekthi. Yisa isikhuthazi ekuqambeni, ekuphumezeni, nasekuhloleni izinhlela eziyisikhuthazi namaphrojekthi ayisikhuthazi. Nikeza inkxaso yokuhlela amaphrojekthi, okuhlanganisa ukulanda izigidingo, okuhlolwayo, izingozi, kanye nezinto ezingezange zamenywa. Yisa isikhuthazi ekuhlanganiseni abanomzondo bangaphakathi nabangaphandle ababandakanyekayo kwezinye izinhlela eziyisikhuthazi. Hlola ukusebenza kwephrojekthi ngokwemigomo evunyiwe, izinkathi, namaphethini. Lungiselela imibiko yokuqamba, ukwethula, kanye nezibuyekezo ngokomphakathi ngesakhiwo esihlobene sokubusa. Sekela ukuxazulula izinselele zokuqamba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa ngempumelelo kwezinto eziyisikhuthazi. Ukuphathwa kwenkxaso yentlonvo. Nikeza iziphakamiso ekuthuthukisweni kwemigomo namapulani okusebenza. Hlela bese uthumela imibiko yenyanga nezinyanga ezintathu. Qinisekisa futhi uqinisekise ukuzinise kobufakazi obunikezwayo. Yibukhule futhi uphendle izindaba zokuhlola. Qapha abantu abasebenzayo. Gcina isithunzi sabasebenzi.

xh.duties: Qhoboshela iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo kwaye uzamile ukuqhuba imisebenzi ehamba ngokulawulo. Yenza okunokusonyeza kwakho ukuba ngumqeqeshi oncomekayo kubasebenzi, uncedise abantu abangangeniswa kumsebenzi nangaphezulu.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 897 per annum (Level 09), an all-inclusive remuneration
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management position in Makhanda with the Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture, requiring HR management qualifications and three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 6) as recognized by SAQA in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management /Public Administration / Public Management / Business Management / Industrial Psychology. Minimum of three (3) year’s functional experience on Senior Personnel Practitioner Level (7/8) in Human Resource Management. Extensive knowledge of PERSAL, ISISELE & Pension Case Management systems. Human Resource Management Methodology, Principles and Strategies. COIDA, DPSA Directives, Customer Service principles (Batho Pele Principles). Budgeting and Financial Management , Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic Condition of Employment Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury regulations, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Minimum information security standard (MISS), Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Skills: Coaching and Mentoring, Conflict Management, Critical and Innovative Thinking, Inspire Commitment, People Management, Performance and oversight, Performance/ Project Management, Quality Assurance, Risk Management. Ability to work under pressure and independently. A valid driving license is required.
jobs.duties: Facilitate and monitor Human Resource Management and Personnel Conduct: attend and hold Human Resource meetings. Coordinate HR Reports. Coordinate recruitment, selection and appointment process. Develop and implement recruitment and selection plans in line with approved workforce plans. Champion the advertising, screening, shortlisting, interviewing, and appointment of employees. Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, policies, and recruitment procedures. Provide support to the selection committees during recruitment and selection processes and technical support on recruitment matters. Monitor vacancy rates and recruitment turnaround times. Prepare recruitment reports and maintain accurate recruitment records. Promote employment equity and transformation objectives during recruitment processes. Administer conditions of service. Manage the implementation and administration of employee conditions of service. Understanding of GEPF and Pension Case Management system. Ensure accurate administration of appointments, transfers, promotions, terminations, leave and leave gratuity management, overtime, housing allowance, long-service recognition, and other employee benefits. Provide guidance on human resource policies and applicable legislation. Monitor compliance with service conditions and resolve employee enquiries. Ensure accurate personnel records and HR information management. Liaise with payroll and other stakeholders to resolve personnel administration matters. Coordinate performance management and development services. Provide guidance and training to managers and employees on performance management processes. Monitor compliance with performance planning, reviews, assessments, and development plans. Identify training and development needs based on performance outcomes. Ensure proper record keeping and reporting on performance management activities. Facilitate and monitor Human Resource Development and EPMDS. Monitor the development of Workplace Skills Plan. Monitor development of performance contracts. Conduct quarterly reviews and Validation of Reviews and Assessment. Coordinate the administration of PMDS, Monitor and facilitate Training & Capacitation of employees. Coordinate labour relations services, Facilitate the implementation of labour relations policies and procedures. Give advice to management on labour legislation and collective agreements. Execute disciplinary, grievance and incapacity processes. Promote sound employer-employee relations and conflict resolution. Monitor implementation of labour relations decisions and maintain records. Coordinate wellness programmes services. Plan and implement employee health and wellness programmes (EHWP). Develop and implement wellness initiatives addressing physical, emotional, financial, and psychosocial wellbeing. Organise awareness campaigns on health, wellness, and work-life balance. Facilitate counselling referrals and employee support services. Monitor employee participation and evaluate programme effectiveness. Promote a healthy, safe, and productive work environment. Management of all administration processes. Give input in the development of policies and operational plans. Compile and submit monthly and quarterly reports. Develop and interpret reporting templates. Determine and verify the authenticity of the evidence provided. Attend and respond to audit matters. Supervise human resources. Maintain staff discipline.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur pos in Makhanda by die Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture, wat menslike hulpbronbestuurkwalifikasies en drie jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 6) soos erken deur SAQA in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Personeelbestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur / Besigheidsbestuur / Bedryfsielkunde. Minimum van drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op Senior Personnel Practitioner Level (7/8) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Uitgebreide kennis van PERSAL, ISISELE & Pension Case Management stelsels. Menslike Hulpbronbestuur metodologie, beginsels en strategieë. COIDA, DPSA Directives, Customer Service beginsels (Batho Pele Principles). Begroting en Finansiële Bestuur, Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic Condition of Employment Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury regulasies, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Minimum information security standard (MISS), Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Vaardighede: Afrigting en mentorskap, konflikbestuur, kritiese en innoverende denke, verbintenis inspireer, mensebestuur, prestasie en toesig, prestasie/projekbestuur, gehalteversekering, risikobestuur. Vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Fasiliteer en monitor Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en Personelegedrag: woon menslike hulpbronvergaderings by en hou dit. Koördineer HR-verslae. Koördineer werwing-, seleksie- en aanstellingsproses. Ontwikkel en implementeer werwings- en seleksieplanne in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde arbeidskragplanne. Bestuur die advertering, sif, kortlys, onderhoude en aanstelling van werknemers. Verseker nakoming van tersaaklike wetgewing, beleide en werwingsprosedures. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die seleksiekomitees tydens werwings- en seleksieprosesse en tegniese ondersteuning oor werwingsake. Monitor vakaturesyfers en werwingsomkeertye. Berei werwingsverslae voor en hou akkurate werwingsrekords aan. Bevorder indiensneemsgelykheid en transformasiedoelwitte tydens werwingsprosesse. Administreer diensvoorwaardes. Bestuur die implementering en administrasie van werknemers se diensvoorwaardes. Begrip van GEPF en Pension Case Management stelsel. Verseker akkurate administrasie van aanstellings, oorplasings, bevorderings, beëindigings, verlof en verlofgratiebestuur, oortyd behuisingstoelaag, erkenning vir langdiens, en ander werknemervoordiele. Verskaf leiding oor menslike hulpbronbeleide en toepaslike wetgewing. Monitor nakoming van diensvoorwaardes en los werknemersnavrae op. Verseker akkurate personeelrekords en HR-inligtingbestuur. Skakel met salaradministrasie en ander belanghebbendes om personeeladministrasie-aangeleenthede op te los. Koördineer prestasiebestuur en ontwikkelingsdienste. Verskaf leiding en opleiding aan bestuurders en werknemers oor prestasiebestuurprosesse. Monitor nakoming van prestasiebeplanning, hersienings, assesserings en ontwikkelingsplanne. Identifiseer opleidings- en ontwikkelingsbehoeftes gebaseer op prestasie-uitkomste. Verseker behoorlike rekordhouding en verslagdoening oor prestasiebestuuraktiwiteite. Fasiliteer en monitor Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling en EPMDS. Monitor die ontwikkeling van Workplace Skills Plan. Monitor ontwikkeling van prestasiekontrakte. Voer kwartaallikse hersienings en validering van hersienings en assessering uit. Koördineer die administrasie van PMDS, monitor en fasiliteer opleiding en kapasitasiesbou van werknemers. Koördineer arbeidsverhoudingsdienste, fasiliteer die implementering van arbeidsverhoudingsbeleide en -prosedures. Verskaf advies aan bestuur oor arbeidswetgewing en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Voer dissiplinêre, klagte en onbevoegdheidsprosesse uit. Bevorder gesonde werknemer-werkgewer verhoudings en konflikoplossing. Monitor implementering van arbeidsverhoudingsbesluite en hou rekords aan. Koördineer welstandsprogramdienste. Beplan en implementeer werknemergesondheids- en welstandsprogramme (EHWP). Ontwikkel en implementeer welstandsinitiatiewe wat fisieke, emosionele, finansiële en psigososiale welsyn aanspreek. Reël bewustheidsveldtogte oor gesondheid, welstand en werk-lewe balans. Fasiliteer beradingsverwysings en werknemersondersteuningsdienste. Monitor werknemerdeelname en evalueer programdoeltreffendheid. Bevorder 'n gesonde, veilige en produktiewe werksomgewing. Bestuur van alle administratiewe prosesse. Verskaf insette in die ontwikkeling van beleide en operasionele planne. Stel maandelikse en kwartaalverslae op en dien dit in. Ontwikkel en interpreteer verslagsjablone. Bepaal en verifieer die egtheid van die verskafde bewyse. Woon ouditaangeleenthede by en reageer daarop. Spendeer toesig aan menslike hulpbronne. Handhaaf personeeldissipline.
