zu.requirements: Ithiphu Lesikhathi Esiphezulu SaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nokuqashwa kwabafundi abangenayo (NQF level 6) njengoba kubalulekile yi-SAQA kwi-Human Resource Management / Personnel Management /Public Administration / Public Management / Business Management / Industrial Psychology. Ubude besikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) emsebenzini ophilayo kwi-Senior Personnel Practitioner Level (7/8) kwi-Human Resource Management. Ulwazi olwandisiwe mayelana namasistimu e-PERSAL, ISISELE & Pension Case Management. Indlela yokwenza izinto, imigomo nemikhakha kwi-Human Resource Management. COIDA, DPSA Directives, imigomo yensebenzo yamakhasimende (Batho Pele Principles). Ukuhlela ukulingana kwezimali nokulawula imali, Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic Condition of Employment Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury regulations, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Minimum information security standard (MISS), Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Amandla: Ukulungisa futhi uhole abanye, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukucabanga okujulile nokubuza imibuzo, ukukhuthaza ukuzibophezela, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukulawula ukwenza kuhambisane nemigomo, ukulawula amaphuzu/Project Management, ukuqinisekisa izinga, ukulawula ingozi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxanduva nokuzenzela. Idrayiva lesiteshe sokushayela elivunyiwe liyadingeka.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi ulawule Izabalulo zabasebenzi nokuziphatha kwabasebenzi: banda ubude bendawo yokusebenza futhi ugcine ukubhaliswa kwemibhalo yokubika. Qondisa inqubo yokubumba abasebenzi, ukukhetha nokuqasha. Lumba futhi usebenzise izinkomba zokubumba nokukhetha ngokuhambisana nezinkomba ezamukelekwe zamandla abasebenzi. Qondisa ukushaywa kwemikhiqizo, ukuhlola, ukukhetha, kubuze imibuzo, nokuqasha abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho, nemithetho yokusebenza, kanye nezindlela zokuqasha abasebenzi. Nikela ngokwesekela okushibhile emakomidi okukhetha futhi weseke ngokwamakhono ezindabeni zokuqasha abasebenzi. Hlola izinga lokuba khona kwamathuba okusebenza nesikhathi okuthathwa ukugcwalisa isikhundla. Lungiselela imibiko yokuqasha futhi ulondoloze imibiko equkethe ulwazi olunembile. Phakamisa izinga lokulingana emsebenzini futhi uthuthukise izinhloso zokugcina ulwazi. Phatha imithetho yokusebenza kulezi zikhathi. Lawula ukuqashwa nokusetshenziswa kwemithetho yokuqasha abasebenzi emahhovisi. Qondisa amakhono okubika kwabasebenzi. Qondisa futhi ulawule ukuthuthwa kwabasebenzi kanye nokulondolozwa kwemibhalo yabasebenzi. Lawula isikhathi sokubika, amanye amaphuzu, futhi ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi koxanduva. Isitifiketi sezimoto esisebenzayo sidingekile.

xh.title: Umncedi weNqanaba eliphezulu: uLawulo lweZisebenzi
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedi weNqanaba eliphezulu kulo lawulo lweZisebenzi eMakhanda naseBeni lezemidlalo, iondlovo, ubugcisa nendalo,elifuna izifundo zolawulo lwezisebenzi kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava.
xh.requirements: I-Certificate yamabanga aphakamileyo yaseMzantsi Afrika ngenye nangaphezulu idhraghi yabafundi (NQF level 6) evunyiwe yi-SAQA kwilawulo lweZisebenzi / uLawulo lweNqwili / uLawulo lukaRhulumente / uLawulo lweShishini / iSayikholoji yamashishini. Okungwnamba iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava oqeqesho kwinqanaba loGunya oluphezulu lweNqwili (7/8) kuLawulo lweZisebenzi. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga nePERSAL, ISISELE & iinkqubo zoLawulo lweeMava zemihla. Indlela, iimigaqo kunye namacebo oLawulo lweZisebenzi. I-COIDA, iimiyalelo ze-DPSA, iimigaqo yokuPhathwa kwaSixhosa (iimigaqo zeBatho Pele). Ulawulo lweNxowanyo nokuLawulwa kweMali, uMthetho weNxowa-mali, uMthetho weMilinganiselo yokuSebenza esiYilwayo, uMthetho weMigaqo esisiseko yokuSebenza, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA), iimgqathiso zeQaphela-iMali yoMbuso, uMthetho wokuKhuthaza uFikelelo kwiiNkcukacha, uMthetho wobulungisa kolawulo (PAJA), izinga eliphantsi lokhuseleko lweenkcukacha (MISS), uMthetho woKhuselo lweeNkcukacha zobuNhlobo bomntu (POPIA) Amapiko: uQeqesho nokuKhusela, uLawulo lweNxaxheba, uKuxabisa okuBalulekileyo nokuCinga okutsha, uKhuza iThemba, uLawulo labaBantu, uMiso nokuqaphela, uLawulo loMiso / lamaPhojekithi, uQinisekiso loYilo, uLawulo lweengozi. Ukuba namandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo nangokuzimeleyo. Kufuneka kubekho ilayisensi yokushayela.
xh.duties: Qhubeza uLawulo lweZisebenzi uze ulawule ukuziphatha kweNqwili: zama ubambe iindibano zoLawulo lweZisebenzi. Linganisela iidatha ezimalunga neZisebenzi. Qhubeza inkqubo yokubumba, ukukhetha nokuqesha abantu. Yila uze usebenzise iicandelo zokubumba nokukhetha ngokwamacebo amvuliyo omanyano lwabasebenzi. Phatha ukuthumela kwabarhambo, ukuhluzwa, ukubekwa kuludwe, iindibano nokuba kwangoku sabo basebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela kumagqathiso, iingcapondo nendlela yokubumba. Nikela inkxaso kwiikomiti ekukhethweni nasekuqeshweni kwaye unike inkxaso yobugcisa kumangombe aqhubela phambili. Qaphela izigaba zokuzibumba kunye nexesha elitshatayo lokubumba. Lungelelanisa iidatha ezimalunga nokwenza iirekhidi ezichanekileyo. Khuthaza ukulingana kokubumba nemiqonda yentlupheko ngelixa kukho inkqubo yokubumba. Phatha iimeko zokuba ngumsebenzi. Lawula ukusebenziswa nokuphathwa kweemeko zokuba ngumsebenzi. Ukuba nokuqonda ngeGEPF nendlela yokulawula iinkqubo zemihla. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okuchanekileyo kokubumba, ukudluliswa kolunye icandelo, ukunyuswa esikhundleni, ukuphuma kwabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kweekhefu nakumvuzo weekhefu, ukugqitha kwexesha lokusebenza, izibonelelo zezindlu, ukuvunywa koluhlu ngenkonzo ende, nezinye izibonelelo zabasebenzi. Nikela isikhokelo malunga neengcapondo zezisebenzi nalamagqathiso afanelekileyo. Qaphela ukuzithobela kweemeko zenkonzo uze ulawule iimbuzo ngabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba koko kugqityiweyo ngabasebenzi kulungile kunye noLawulo lweNkcukacha ezisebenzayo. Thintana nalowo uphathwa ngekhadi lemihla nabanye abantu kuLawulo lweento ezimalunga nabasebenzi. Qhubeza imisebenzi yokulawula nokuqhutywa phambili. Unike isikhokelo uqeqeshe abalawuli kunye nabasebenzi malunga neenkqubo zokuyila nokulawula. Qaphela ukuzithobela kwakho uqwalaselo lomsebenzi, izicelo zolwazi uqeqesho nokuyila amacebo. Phawula iimfuno zeqeqesho nokuqhutywa phambili ngokwemigaqo yokugqiba umsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa kakuhle ngenkcazelo yemisebenzi yokuqhubela phambili. Qhubeza uze ulawule uLawulo lweZisebenzi nakwaziswa nokuQhutywa kwabantu kwiinkqubo ze-EPMDS. Qaphela iCandelo lokuyila iGcuva leKhoyo Lasekhaya. Qaphela iCandelo lenkonzo yokuyila. Yenza iindibano ezihlulwe zibe zithathu kwaye uzamkele iCandelo leSicelo sokulwa nokugqibela. Linganisela inkqubo yokuLawula inkonzo yokuyila nokulawula inkonzo yokuqeqeshwa nokuqhutyiswa phambili kwabasebenzi. Qhubeza iinkonzo ezimalunga nobudlelwane bomsebenzi, khuthaza ukuSetyenziswa kweengcapondo zolawulo lomsebenzi. Nikela uluvo kuGunya ngamagqathiso obudlelwane bomsebenzi nangezivumelwano. Zenza izicelo zokuziphatha okungalunganga, iingxaki nokuqhubela phambili. Khuthaza ubudlelwane obulunge phakathi kwegosa nalo msebenzi nokusombulula iingxabano. Qaphela ukusetenziswa kwezigqibo zobudlelwane bomsebenzi uze ulunde iirekhidi. Qhubeza iinkonzo zeinkqubo ezichumisa iimpilo. Cwangcisa uze usebenzise iinkqubo zeinkqubo ezichumisa iimpilo zabasebenzi (EHWP). Yila uze usebenzise iinkqubo ezichumisa iimpilo ezibhekisa kumpilo, iingcamango, iimali, nangase mazantsi othando. Hlela iikhaphukhaphu zokuqaphela ngempilo, iimpilo, nobuncwatywa bokulinganisa ukusebenza. Qhubeza iingcebiso ezingathunyelwa ngenkonzo yokuNceda. Qaphela ukuzibandakanya kwabasebenzi uze uhlole ukusebenza kwenkqubo. Khuthaza iindawo ezichanekileyo ezilungele impilo nakhuselekileyo ezinomsebenzi oqhubela phambili. Lawula zonke iinkqubo zolawulo lwenkonzo. Zinike uluvo kwiyila lweengcapondo namacebo okusebenza. Lungelelanisa uze uxhase iidatha zenyanga zonke kunye nezethoba kwigumbi. Lungelelanisa iindlela ezaziswa ngexesha lokuLinganisa imisebenzi esemthethweni. Misela uqinisekise ukuba kukho izibizo ezichanekileyo ezinikelwe. Zama uze uphendule iingxaki ezimalunga nokuhlolwa. Lawula abasebenzi basekhaya. Qedela ukuxhathwa ngokuchanekileyo kwemigaqo yabasebenzi.

A minimum of three (3) years’ experience at supervisory level SL 7/8. In-depth knowledge and understanding of corporate services management in public service. Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership skills. Programme and project management skills. Financial management skills. Change management skills. Knowledge management skills. Service delivery innovation skills. Problem-solving and analysis skills. People management and empowerment skills. Client orientation and customer focus. Communication skills. Honesty and integrity. Networking and presentation skills. Computer skills. Excellent, in-depth knowledge of and insight into all applicable policy frameworks governing the public sector. A valid driving licence. A valid driving license is required.

Facilitate the implementation of ARP through recruitment and selection and process. Coordinate the process of conditions of service. Monitor records management system. Facilitate human resource development and training. Render integrated performance management development system. Coordinate integrated employee wellness services. Monitor attendance register and leave records. Maintain staff discipline. Provide financial management services. Give input in the development of procurement plans. Monitor budget expenditure. Monitor and ensure payment of suppliers. Monitor banking and revenue services. Provide supply chain management services. Render demand and acquisition management services. Facilitate logistics and asset disposal management services. Monitor facilities management services. Monitor supply chain compliance. Provide maintenance of museum buildings and grounds. Ensure maintenance of museum buildings. Ensure maintenance of museum grounds. Ensure general cleaning services of museum. Provide secretariat services to the museum board. Compile and manage board files. Compile board documents in preparation for meetings. Prepare invitations for board meetings. Provide secretariat services and minute taking in meetings. Create and update pending items to board members. Compile and submit quarterly reports on board matters. Liaise with museum subscribers, donors and supporters. Provide administration support. Attend and respond to audit matters. Supervise financial and human resources. Manage allocation of staff resources. Compile and submit monthly and quarterly reports. Supervise PMDS and staff development training needs. Supervise attendance register and leave records. Supervise mentoring and coaching of experiential learners and interns. Maintain staff discipline.

af.title: Assistenterdirekteur: Korporatiewe Dienste
af.summary: Assistenterdirekteur: Korporatiewe Dienste by die Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, Eastern Cape, wat menslike hulpbronadministrasie en rekordbestuur op vlak 09 oorsien.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF vlak 6) soos deur SAQA erken in Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur / Bestuur / Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Verskaffingskettingbestuur / Finansiële Bestuur. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak SL 7/8. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van korporatiewe dienste-bestuur in die openbare diens. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede. Program- en projekbestuursvaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Veranderingsbestuursvaardighede. Kennisbestuursvaardighede. Diensleweringinnovatie-vaardighede. Probleemoplossing en analise-vaardighede. Mensebestuurs- en bemagtigingsvaardighede. Kliëntoriëntasie en klante fokus. Kommunikasievaardighede. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Netwerk- en voorleggingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. Uitstekende, diepgaande kennis van en insig in alle toepaslike beleidsraamwerke wat die openbare sektor regeer. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Verskaf menslike hulpbronadministrasiedienste. Lewer insette vir die jaarlikse werwingsplan oor museum poste. Fasiliteer die implementering van ARP deur werwing en seleksie en proses. Koördineer die proses van diensvoorwaardes. Monitor rekordbestuurstelsel. Fasiliteer menslike hulpbronontwikkeling en opleiding. Lewer geïntegreerde prestasiebestuurstelsel. Koördineer geïntegreerde werknemerwelsynsdienste. Monitor bywoningsregister en verlofrekords. Handhaaf werknemersdissipline. Verskaf finansiële bestuursdienste. Lewer insette by die ontwikkeling van voorsieningsplanne. Monitor begrotingsbesteding. Monitor en verseker betaling aan verskaffers. Monitor bank- en inkomstedienste. Verskaf verskaffingskettingbestuursdienste. Lewer vraag- en verkrygingsbestuursdienste. Fasiliteer logistiek- en bate-uitfaseringsbestuursdienste. Monitor fasiliteitsbestuursdienste. Monitor verskaffingsketting-nakoming. Verskaf onderhoud van museumgeboue en gronde. Verseker onderhoud van museumgeboue. Verseker onderhoud van museumgronde. Verseker algemene skoonmaakdienste van museum. Verskaf sekretariatsdienste aan die museumraad. Stel raaddleêrs op en bestuur dit. Stel raaddokumente op ter voorbereiding van vergaderings. Berei uitnodigings vir raadsvergaderings voor. Verskaf sekretariatsdienste en notule neem in vergaderings. Skep en werk hangende items vir raadslede by. Stel kwartaalverslae oor raadsaangeleenthede op en dien dit in. Skakel met museumintekenare, skenkers en ondersteuners. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning. Woon auditaangeleenthede by en reageer daarop. Supersiede finansiële en menslike hulpbronne. Bestuur toewysing van personeelhulpbronne. Stel maandelikse en kwartaalverslae op en dien dit in. Supersiede PMDS en personeelontwikkeling-opleidingbehoeftes. Supersiede bywoningsregister en verlofrekords. Supersiede mentorskap en afrigting van ervaringsleerders en internskappe. Handhaaf werknemersdissipline.

zu.title: Onozintaba: I-Corporate Services
zu.summary: Onozintaba: I-Corporate Services e-Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture e-Qonce, Eastern Cape, ephatha ulawulo lwemithombo yabantu nolawulu lwamarekhodi kwelisa 09.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-National Senior Certificate kahle neshadi le-Bachelor's elifanele (NQF Level 6) njengoba kubonwa u-SAQA ku-Public Administration / Public Management/ Management/ Human Resource Management, Supply Chain Management/ Financial Management. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuhlola ezingeni lokulawula SL 7/8. Ukuqonda okujulile kolwazi ngolawulo lwezinkonzo zabantu emsebenzini kahulumeni. Amandla: Amandla okubumba uhlelo nobuholo. Amandla olawula amapulani namaphulo. Amandla olawulu wezimali. Amandla olawula inguquko. Amandla olawulu ulwazi. Amandla okwakha izindlela ezintsha zokulethwa kwezinkonzo. Amandla okuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Amandla olawula abantu nokubakhulisa. Ukubhekisela kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Amandla okuthetha. Ukwethembeka nokubaqeda. Amandla okuxhumana nokubonisa. Amandla ekhompyutha. Ulwazi oluhle, olujulile futhi oluqondile kuyo yonke imigqa yemithetho elawula indawo kahulumeni. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo kudingidwa.
zu.duties: Nika izinkonzo zolawulo lwemithombo yabantu. Faka izimvo ohlelweni lonyaka lwesikhathi sokubumba abasebenzi kumaphosithi emnyuziyamu. Qedela ukuphatha i-ARP ngokubumba abasebenzi nokukhetha nendlela. Hlela inqubo yezimo zomsebenzi. Qapha isistimu yolawulu lwamarekhodi. Qedela ukuthuthukiswa kwemithombo yabantu nokolotshi. Nikeza isistimu ehlanganisiwe yokuthuthukiswa kolawulu kokusebenza kahle. Hlela izinkonzo eziyisisekelo zokuphiliswa komsebenzi wabasebenzi. Qapha irekhodi lokubikhona namarekhodi okukhetwa. Gcina isithibekelo sabasebenzi. Nikeza izinkonzo zolawulu wezimali. Nikeza izimvo ekuthuthukiseni amapulani okuthenga. Qapha ukuchithwa kwebhajethi. Qapha futhi uqiniseke ukukhokhwa kwezinkampani ezibonelelayo. Qapha izinkonzo zebhange nemali engenayo. Nikeza izinkonzo zolawulo lwesonto xeshe. Nikeza izinkonzo zolawulu lokufuna nokuthola. Qedela izinkonzo zolawulu lwezimpahla nokulahla impahla. Qapha izinkonzo zolawulu lwezakhiwo. Qapha ukuzigxila kolawulu lwesonto xeshe. Nikeza ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo nemithi yemnyuziyamu. Qapha ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo yemnyuziyamu. Qapha ukugcinwa kwemithi yemnyuziyamu. Qapha izinkonzo zokucwasha okujwayelekile kwemnyuziyamu. Nikeza izinkonzo zebhodi lemnyuziyamu. Hlanganisa futhi ulawule amafayela ebhodi. Hlanganisa amadokhumenti ebhodi ukuze alungele imihlangano. Lungiselela imemo yemihlangano yebhodi. Nikeza izinkonzo zebhodi futhi ubhale iminithi emihlanganweni. Yakha futhi ubuyekeze izinto ezingakalungiswa kubaluleki bebhodi. Hlanganisa futhi ufake imibiko yenyanga ngamunye nenyanga ezimbili ezimalungisweni ebhodi. Xhumana nalabo abhalise kumnyuziyamu, labo abanikelayo nabasekelayo. Nikeza usizo lolawulo. xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Iinkonzo zoBuntu
xh.summary: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Iinkonzo zoBuntu kwiSebe leMidlalo, iNkonzo yokuZonwabisa, uBuchule namasiko eQonce, eMpuma Koloni, uphelo lulawulo lolwabiwo lwemisebenzi yoluntu kunye nokulawulwa kweefayile kwiNqanaba 09.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi samabanga aphezulu sezwe plus idigri yeBachelor efanelekileyo (iNqanaba 6 leNQF) njengokuqatshiweyo yiSAQA kuLawulo lukaRhulumente / uLawulo lukaRhulumente/ uLawulo/ uLawulo lweMisebenzi yabaBantu, uLawulo lweShishini leNkokhelo/ uLawulo lweMali. Amava amabaluleke ngaphezulu eminyaka emithathu (3) kwinqanaba labaphathi SL 7/8. Ulwazi oluthe nkqo kwaye kuqondwe kakuhle ngolawulo lweekonzo zobuntu kumanyano kazwelonke. Iindlela zokuziphatha: Amandla obuchule bokuhlela kunye namakhono abakhoki. Amakhono obulawulo beenkqubo namaphulo. Amakhono obulawulo bemali. Amakhono obutshintsho bolawulo. Amakhono obulawulo bolwazi. Amakhono obuchule bokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Amakhono obulawulo babantu noku banikela amandla. Umonakaliso kumaxhoba kunye nokuqwalasela abathengi. Amakhono othetha. Inyaniso nokuzithembisa. Amakhono obudlelwano nokubonisa. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ulwazi oluhlaza, oluthe nkqo noluqondayo kakuhle lonke olulawulo lolwaba-mthetho olusebenza kumacandelo kazwelonke. Ilayiseni yokuqeshela auto esemthethweni. Kufuneka ilayiseni yokuqeshela auto esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Kubanikeze iinkonzo zolawulo lweMisebenzi yabaBantu. Zithumela iingcali ngeNdlela yokuqesha ngokweminyaka kwiindawo zobuzwe nemicimbi yamajeze. Yenza kubekho lisebenziso kwe-ARP ngokwandisa ucingo kwaye uthathe iindlela ezingangqamana. Lawula inqanaba lemimiselo yeenkonzo. Qwalasela indlela yolawulo lweefayile ezikuyo. Yenza kube lula intshukubo yokuziphilisa kubantu neyokuqeqesha. Banikela inkqubo enyukene yePMS (Performance Management and Development System) nokuQaliswa kwayo. Lawula iinkonzo ezinyukene zenkcubeko yokwaneliseka kwabasebenzi. Qwalasela undiso wokubakho kunye namarekhodi obhedesho. Singatha isithinti somanyano lwabantu. Banikela iinkonzo zokulawula ukusetyenziswa kweMali. Nika ingxelo kwindlela esemthethweni yokukhethwa. Qwalasela ukuchithwa kwesabelo. Qwalasela kwaye uqinisekise ukwahlulelwa kweemvuzo. Qwalasela iinkonzo zeMali kunye nokuPela. Banikela iinkonzo zokulawula kwinkqabo yokusetyenziswa. Zibonelela ngokufuna nokuba nesabelo kwezintlu. Yenza kube lula kwiinkonzo zobuLawulo beLogistics kunye neefayile ezingasebenziyo. Qwalasela iinkonzo zobuLawulo bomjongo. Qwalasela iindlela ezikulawulo lokuKhetha kwenkonzo. Songa iinkonzo zobuLawulo ezingowakho kunye namajelo. Yenza isithembiso ngokusingathwa kweendonga zomjongo kunye nokuba ngcono. Qwalasela isimo sokubakho kwamashishini eMuseum. Qwalasela ukuba ngcono kokubakho komjongo. Qwalasela ukuba ngcono kwezinto ezingamanzi. Qwalasela amacebo okucoca ngokubanzi. Banikela iinkonzo kwiBhunga lomuzi weendawo zobuzwe. Lungelelanisa amaphepha eBhunga kwaye awaqwalasele. Lungelelanisa amaxwebhu eBhunga ngolungelelwano lomzila weeNkomfa. Lungiselela iimemozo kumzila weNkomfa. Banikela iinkonzo kwaye uthathe imizuzu kwiNkomfa. Dala kwaye ulungiselele iindlela ongazenzelayo kubaluleki. Khokela ngokulungiselelwa kwamaxwebhu kunye nokubiza abakwaBhunga. Yibanise nabathengisi bamajelo,abanikeli, kunye nabaxhasi. Banikela inkxaso yokuLawula. Thinta kwaye uphendule kumaphupha oMnyama weendaba. Lawula imali kunye namandla oBantu. Lawula ukwabiwa kwamandla oBantu. Khokela ngokulungiselelwa kwamaxwebhu ngamnye kunye namaxesha nganeno. Lawula iPMDS kunye neemfuno zokuqeqeshwa koluntu. Lawula undiso wokubakho kunye namarekhodi obhedesho. Lawula ukukhuthaza nokuqeqeshwa koluntu ukuba kuzinike iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Yenza isithinti somanyano lwabantu.

af.title: Bibliotekaris
af.summary: Bibliotekarispos in Gqeberha waarvoor 'n diploma of graad in Biblioteek- en Inligtingwetenskap met 1 tot 2 jaar se ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus 'n National Diploma of B.Bibl. Degree/ B Tech (NQF Level 6) in Library and Information Science / Studies of Bachelor of Information Sciences met ten minste 1 tot 2 jaar se werkservaring in die biblioteek- en inligtingsdiensveld. Kennis van openbare diens-wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte. Basiese kennis van biblioteek- en inligtingwetenskaplike prosedures en prosesse. Goeie rekenaar-, organiserings-, kommunikasie- en verslagskryfvaardighede, uitstekende menslike en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Deeglike kennis van belanghebbendes. Kennis van ten minste vier Eastern Cape amptelike tale sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Voer bewustheidsveldtogte, leesprogramme en bevordering van biblioteekgebruik tot alle gemeenskappe uit. Doen voorraadbeheer van alle biblioteekmateriaal. Bestuur, ontvang en vereffen biblioteekmateriaal van die distrikkantoor. Sorge vir gebruikersbehoeftes. Stel maandelikse gebruikerstatistieke en verslae op. Neem deel aan die opstel van die besigheidsplan. Bestuur biblioteekbates en -hulpbronne. Implementeer jaarlikse terugvordering van geld. Stig en handhaaf biblioteekstrukture. Bestuur mini-lib-dienste. Hou toesig oor personeel.

zu.title: Umtapo wezincwadi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somtapo wezincwadi eGqeberha esifuna idiploma noma idigri kuLibrary and Information Science oneminyaka engu-1 kuya kweyi-2 yeminyaka yemfundo.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate kanye ne-National Diploma noma i-B.Bibl. Degree/ B Tech (NQF Level 6) kuLibrary and Information Science / Studies noma i-Bachelor of Information Sciences nobuncwethe bomsebenzi ongaphansi konyaka oyu-1 kuya kowe-2 enkundleni ye-Library and Information Service. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo, namagunya omenzi wonke. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nezinqubo namasu etapolini nezincwadi zobulwazi nolwazi. Amakhono amahle ekhompuyutha, ekuhleleni, ekuxhumaneni, nasekubhaleni imibiko, ubudlelwano obuhle bomuntu nobuwomuntu. Ulwazi olusagxekile mayelana nabalingani. Ukuqonda okungenani izilimi ezine ezisemthethweni sikaEastern Cape kuzoba yinzuzo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Qamba amathambo okwazisa, izinhlelo zokufunda kanye nokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwetapolo kuyo yonke imiphakathi. Yenza okulawulwayo kwesitokwe samathambo onke etapolweni. Phatha, wamukele futhi uhambisanise amathambo etapolo avela kohhotela laseningizimu. Phendla izidingo zabasebenzisi. Qamba izibalo zeminye yonke inyanga nemibiko yabasebenzisi. Thatha inxaxheba ekubhalweni kohlelo lokusebenza. Phatha amafaphu nezinsiza etapolweni. Yenza ukubuyiswa kwemali ngonyaka wonke. Sula futhi ugcine izakhiwo etapolweni. Phatha isevisi ye-mini-lib. Qaphisa abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umthunywa wolwimi
xh.summary: Isithuba somthunywa wolwimi eGqeberha esifuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwiNzululwazi ngeNdalo yolwazi nolwazi kunye namashumi amabho eminyaka yamava okusebenza eyi-1 ukuya kweyi-2.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi SeNqanaba EliPhakamileyo saseMzantsi Afrika kanye neDiploma YaseMzantsi Afrika okanye Isidanga se-B.Bibl./ B Tech (NQF Level 6) kwiNzululwazi ngeNdalo yolwazi nolwazi / Izifundo okanye iNzululwazi yolwazi nolwazi ngeBachelor of Information Sciences nalungenelo lonyaka wamava okusebenza ongaphantsi kwamashumi amabho eminyaka eyi-1 ukuya kweyi-2 kwindalo yesebe lolwazi nolwazi. Ulwazi ngomthetho weNkonzo zikaZwelonke, iinkqubo zamagazethi, namagazetho wolawulo. Ulwazi olusesantlwengweni lweNqanaba leNzululwazi nolwazi ngeendlela ezilandwayo kwaye nenkqubo yokuqhuba imisebenzi yolwazi nolwazi. Amabino alungileyo ekhompyutha, ekwakheni, ekuthetheni, nasekubhalweni ivezo ezibalulekileyo, nobudlelwane beluqhelano nabo bonke abantu. Ulwazi olusesantlwengweni lolwazi ngabathathi-nxaxheba. Ukuqonda ngeelwimi ezisemthethweni ezili-4 zeMpuma Kapa kuya kuba ngowongezo olublethelayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Qhuba amaqela okunyusa ulwazi, iinkqubo zokufunda nokukhuthaza isixhobo somthunywa wolwazi kwilali zonke. Qhuba ulawulo lwegcina lezixhobo zonke zomthunywa wolwazi. Lawula, wamkele kanje nokuqwalasela izixhobo zomthunywa wolwazi eziphuma kwiofisi yesithili. Phendula iimfuno zomsebenzisi. Qekelela ivezo ngenyanga ngokwakha izibalo zabasebenzisi namaxesha. Thatha inxaxheba ekubhalweni kohlelo lokusebenza. Lawula izixhobo neendalo ezikumthunywa wolwazi. Zisa inkqubo yonyaka wokulungisa imali. Misela kanje nokugcina iinkqubo zomthunywa wolwazi. Lawula iinkonzo ze-mini-lib. Lawula abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Sport Promotion Officer: School Sport
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07), an all-inclusive remuneration
jobs.summary: Coordinate school sport structures and clubs across the Amathole District, supporting local federations and recreation initiatives.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a three-year Degree/Diploma (NQF level 6) as recognised by SAQA in Sport Management / Sport Administration / Human Movement studies / Recreation Leisure studies / Sport coaching and Human sciences / Sport and Exercise science / Sport and Exercise technology coupled with 1 to 2 years’ relevant experience in Sport and Recreation environment. Competencies: Good communication and organising skills. Knowledge of relevant pre-scripts in sport and recreation. Ability to work under pressure. Knowledge and understanding of the departmental policies and procedures. Coaching and mentoring skills. Project and event management skills. Basic computer skills. Basic knowledge of Financial Administration. Report writing skills, Presentation skills will be an added advantage. Knowledge of relevant prescripts. Exposure in several codes or federations. A valid driving license is required.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the establishment and provide support to sport and recreation structures in schools, wards and local areas, in conjunction with relevant stakeholders. Establish and maintain sport and recreation structures and clubs in schools, wards and local areas. Provide support services to federations, clubs and school sport structures. Provide support to provincial sport academy and satellites. Implement programmes to increase and improve relations between sport and recreation stakeholders. Establish good governance structures of sport and recreation as dictated by relevant legislation. Facilitate sustainable capacity development programmes in sport within schools, wards, local areas and districts. Facilitate capacity-building programmes. Create an enabling environment for talent identification. Administer coach education in terms of different sporting codes. Monitor and evaluate progress of education and training activities. Promote sports and skills management. Implement sport and recreation programmes in the schools, wards, local areas for the development of sport and recreation. Perform events management / coordination activities. Liaise with hubs, sport federations, sport councils and academy to increase the number of participants in sports and recreation activities. Implement programmes to increase and improve relations between sports and recreation stakeholders. Plan, develop and implement school and community sports, school and community mass participation and high- performance programmes. Formulate and administer league-related sports programmes. Promote health and fitness in communities. Provide an oversight role in the implementation of sports academy and recreation council programmes. Encourage all levels of communities to participate in different codes of sport and recreation activities. Coordinate flagship programmes through sport and recreation activities. Monitor and evaluate compliance with sport and recreation transformational policies. Monitor the implementation of all transformation policies and programmes. Promote gender mainstream in sport and recreation. Promote integrated programmes of all sector departments and relevant stakeholders. Promote awareness and participation to all ages, gender and capability categories. Provide administrative functions in relation to programmes that are implemented. Collect, analyze, compile and update data in all sport and recreational activities. Provide administrative and technical support with regard to sports and recreation facilities and infrastructure. Administer the system for storage, maintenance issue and return of sport and physical recreation equipment. Examine, compile and monitor transfer payments of funded projects.

af.title: Sportbevorderingsbeampte: Skoolsport
af.summary: Koördineer skoolsportstrukture en -klubs regoor die Amathole Distrik en ondersteun plaaslike federasies en ontspanningsinisiatiewe.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n driejaargraad/-diploma (NQF vlak 6) soos deur SAQA erken in Sportbestuur / Sportadministrasie / Menslikebewegingstudies / Ontspanning-en-vryetydstudies / Sportafrigting en menswetenskappe / Sport-en-oefenwetenskap / Sport-en-oefentegnologie tesame met 1 tot 2 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n sport- en ontspanningsomgewing. Bevoegdhede: Goeie kommunikasie- en organisasievaardighede. Kennis van tersaaklike voorskrifte in sport en ontspanning. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Kennis en begrip van departementele beleide en prosedures. Afrigtings- en mentorskapsvaardighede. Projek- en bestuursvaardighede vir geleenthede. Basiese rekenaarvaardighede. Basiese kennis van finansiële administrasie. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van tersaaklike voorskrifte. Blootstelling aan verskeie kodes of federasies. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Koördineer die totstandbrenging en verskaf ondersteuning aan sport- en ontspanningsstrukture in skole, wyke en plaaslike areas, in samewerking met tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Vestig en onderhou sport- en ontspanningsstrukture en -klubs in skole, wyke en plaaslike areas. Verskaf ondersteuningsdienste aan federasies, klubs en skoolsportstrukture. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die provinsiale sportakademie en satelliete. Implementeer programme om betrekkinge tussen sport- en ontspanningsbelanghebbendes te vermeerder en te verbeter. Vestig goeie bestuursstrukture vir sport en ontspanning soos bepaal deur tersaaklike wetgewing. Fasiliteer volhoubare kapasiteitsontwikkelingsprogramme in sport binne skole, wyke, plaaslike areas en distrikte. Fasiliteer kapasiteitsbouprogramme. Skep 'n bemagtigende omgewing vir talentidentifikasie. Administreer afrigteropleiding ten opsigte van verskillende sportkodes. Monitor en evalueer vordering van opvoedings- en opleidingsaktiwiteite. Bevorder sport- en vaardigheidsbestuur. Implementeer sport- en ontspanningsprogramme in skole, wyke en plaaslike areas vir die ontwikkeling van sport en ontspanning. Voer geleentheidsbestuur- / koördinasie-aktiwiteite uit. Skakel met sentrums, sportfederasies, sportrade en die akademie om die aantal deelnemers aan sport- en ontspanningsaktiwiteite te vermeerder. Implementeer programme om betrekkinge tussen sport- en ontspanningsbelanghebbendes te vermeerder en te verbeter. Beplan, ontwikkel en implementeer skool- en gemeenskapsport-, skool- en gemeenskapsmassadeelname- en hoëprestasieprogramme. Formuleer en administreer liga-verwante sportprogramme. Bevorder gesondheid en fiksheid in gemeenskappe. Verskaf 'n toesigrol by die implementering van sportakademie- en ontspanningsraadprogramme. Moedig alle vlakke van gemeenskappe aan om aan verskillende kodes van sport- en ontspanningsaktiwiteite deel te neem. Koördineer vlagskipprogramme deur sport- en ontspanningsaktiwiteite. Monitor en evalueer nakoming van sport- en ontspanningstransformasiebeleide. Monitor die implementering van alle transformasiebeleide en -programme. Bevorder geslagsmainstreaming in sport en ontspanning. Bevorder geïntegreerde programme van alle sektordepartemente en tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Bevorder bewustheid en deelname aan alle ouderdom-, geslags- en vermoënskategorieë. Verskaf administratiewe funksies met betrekking tot programme wat geïmplementeer word. Versamel, ontleed, stel op en dateer data in alle sport- en ontspanningsaktiwiteite op. Verskaf administratiewe en tegniese ondersteuning ten opsigte van sport- en ontspanningsfasiliteite en -infrastruktuur. Administreer die stelsel vir berging, instandhouding, uitreiking en terugbesorging van sport- en fisiese ontspanningsuitrusting. Ondersoek, stel op en monitor oorplasingsbetalings van befondsde projekte.

zu.title: Inkantsha Yokuqhuba Izemidlalo: Imidlalo Yezikole
zu.summary: Hlela futhi ulawule izakhiwo nemikhiqizo yezemidlalo ezikoleni kulo lonke i-Amathole District, usekela izinhlangano zezemidlalo zasendaweni kanye nezinhlela zokuzilibazisa.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate kazwelonke kanye ne-Degree/Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (NQF level 6) evunyiwe yi-SAQA kwi-Sport Management / Sport Administration / Human Movement studies / Recreation Leisure studies / Sport coaching and Human sciences / Sport and Exercise science / Sport and Exercise technology okuhambisana neminyaka engu-1 kuya kweyi-2 yohlelo oluhambisana nendawo yezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Ikhono: Amakhono okuxhumana nokuhlela ahle kahle. Ulwazi lwezimiso ezibalulekile ezemidlalweni nasekuzilibaziseni. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinyalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango. Amakhono okuqeqesha nokuhlakanipha abanye. Amakhono okuphatha izinhlela nezinkundla. Amakhono wesikhashana ohle kahle ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olwenzelayo mayelana ne-Financial Administration. Amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okubamba izinkulumo kuzongeza inzuzo. Ulwazi lwezimiso ezibalulekile. Isipiliwo esimikhubekayo emikhubeni noma izinhlangano eziningi. Iseluleko sokushayela esivumelekile sitholakala.
zu.duties: Hlela ukusungula futhi unikeze inkxaso ezakhiwini zezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa ezikoleni, emawardeni nasendaweni zasendaweni, ngokubambisana neziphathimandla ezibalulekile. Sungula futhi ulondoloze izakhiwo nemikhiqizo yezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa ezikoleni, emawardeni nasendaweni zasendaweni. Nikeza amasiza ezinhlanganweni, emikhiqizweni nakuzakhiwo zezemidlalo zezikole. Nikeza inkxaso kwikhonomo lezemidlalo lasifundazwe nasemikhakheni ehambisana nalo. Phatha izinhlela ukwandisa futhi ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwane phakathi kweziphathimandla zezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Sungula izakhiwo zolawulo oluhle zezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa njengoba kushiwo umthetho ohambisana nalokhu. Qondisa izinhlela zokuqinisa amandla ezinzile ezemidlalo ezikoleni, emawardeni, kwindawo zasendaweni nasemakhaya. Qondisa izinhlela zokwakhiwa kwamandla. Dala indawo ekhululekile yokuhlakanipha amathalenta. Lawula imfundo yabalushi ngokwemikhuba yezemidlalo ehlukene. Qaphela futhi uhlole inqubo yemfundo nokuqeqeshwa. Khuthaza izemidlalo nokuphathwa kwamakhono. Phatha izinhlela zezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa ezikoleni, emawardeni nasendaweni zasendaweni ngenhloso yokuqinisa izemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Zenza izinkundla zokuphatha / ukuhlela. Xhumana namaphoyinti, izinhlangano zezemidlalo, amakhonsi ezemidlalo nasekhounamu ukwanda inani labathathi nxaxheba ezinkundleni zezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Phatha izinhlela ukwandisa futhi ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweziphathimandla zezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Cwebezela,UTHUTHUKISE futhi uphathe izemidlalo zezikole nomphakathi, ukuthatha inxaxheba kabanzi ezikoleni nalomphakathi kanye nezinhlela eziphakeme. Hlela futhi ulawule izinhlela zezemidlalo ezihlotshaniswa namaligi. Khuthaza impilo yomzimba nokulungele kobuhle emphakathini. Dlala indima yokuhlola ekuqhubeni izinhlela zesikhungo semidlalo kanye namakhonsi okuzilibazisa. Khuthaza izinga lonke umphakathi ukuba athathe inxaxheba emikhubeni ehlukene yezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Hlela izinhlela eziyinhloko ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Qaphela futhi uhlolo ukuzivumelanisa nezinqubomgomo zokushintsha izemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Qaphela ukuqhubwa kwezinqubomgomo nezinhlela zokushintsha zonke. Khuthaza ukuqeqeshwa ngokobulili ezemidlalweni nasekuzilibaziseni. Khuthaza izinhlela ezintathiswe kahle zamaphikia onke eminyangeni kanye neziphathimandla ezibalulekile. Khuthaza ukuqonda nokuqasha inxaxheba nakuzo zonke izinga lobudala, ubulili namakhono. Nikeza imisebenzi yokuqeqesha ehlobene nezinhlela ezisetshenziswayo. Qoqa, hlaziya, qondisa futhi ususe amaphutha kwiminingwane kuzo zinkundla zezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Nikeza inkxaso ekulawuleni nasebuchwephesheni ngezikhungo zezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Lawula isistimu yokulondoloza, ukulungiswa nokubuyiswa kwemishini yezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa komzimba. Hlola, qondisa futhi ulawule izinkokhelo ezibuyiselwa kumaphrojekthi axhaswa imali.

xh.title: Ofisa Wokukhuthaza Imidlalo: Imidlalo Yabafundi
xh.summary: Lungiselela iinkqubo zemidlalo yabafundi namaqela kulo lonke elase Amathole District, ngenkxaso kumaziko amakhulu emisintu kumaphandle nasekuqhubeni iinkqubo zokuzonwabisa.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seQela leSizwe samabanga aphakamileyo kunye neNgqakaqo/Ncedolwazi lokwazisa iminyaka emithathu (inqanaba le-6 le-NQF) njengoko ivunyiwe yi-SAQA kwiLawulo Lemidlalo / Ulawulo Lwemidlalo / Iifundo ZokuShukuma Komzimba Womntu / Iifundo Zokuzonwabisa / Ukuqeqeswa Kwemidlalo Kunye Nezopolongo / ISayensi Yemidlalo Kunye Nokuqhuba / Inzululwazi Yemidlalo Kunye Nokuqhuba, ekwanense nolwazi olunxulumeneyo lonyaka oyi-1 ukuya kowi-2 kwimeko yemidlalo nokuzonwabisa. Iimpawu zokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi: Amakhono amabalawulo lithetha kakuhle aphakamileyo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo ekhoyo ngemidlalo nakuzonwabisa. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo namacebo asebe. Amakhono okuqeqesha nokukhokela. Amakhono olawulo lweenkqubo nemiganu. Amakhono aphakamileyo ekhompyutha. Ulwazi olusisiseko luluwo Lolawulo lweMali. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo, amakhono okubonisa aya kuba ngenxa engongameleyo. Ulwazi ngeziqulatho ezifaneleyo. Inkanuko nakumakhowudi ahlukeneyo okanye amaziko amakhulu. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evunyiwe iyafuneka.
xh.duties: Lungiselela ukusekwa kunye nokunikela inkxaso kwiinkqubo zemidlalo kunye nokuzonwabisa kumaziko emfundo, kwiiwadi nakumaphandle, ngokubambisana nabathathi nxaxheba abahambelanayo. Seka kwaye ugcine iinkqubo zemidlalo kunye nokuzonwabisa nakumaziko emfundo, kwiiwadi nakumaphandle. Nikela iinkonzo zenkxaso kumaziko amakhulu emisintu, nakumaqela kunye neenkcukacha zemidlalo yabafundi. Nikela inkxaso kumaziko amakhulu emfundo yemidlalo nasezikhulwini. Zisa kubakho iinkqubo eziza wandisa kunye nokuphucisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwabathathi nxaxheba bemidlalo kunye nokuzonwabisa. Seka iinkqubo zorhulumente olulungileyo zemidlalo nokuzonwabisa njengoko kuchazwa ngumthetho ochanekileyo. Khokelela iinkqubo ezizinzeleyo zophuhliso lwamandla kwimidlalo ngaphakathi kwamaziko emfundo, kwiiwadi, kumaphandle nakumaphondo. Khokelela iinkqubo zokwakha amandla. Dala indawo ethintelelayo yokubonwa iintalent. Lawula imfundo yabalungi ngokwamakhowudi amahlukeneyo emidlalo. Lilise ukuze uphephe kunye nokuhlola inkqubo yemfundo nolungelelwaniso lweenkonzo. Khuthaza imidlalo kunye nokulawula amakhono. Zisa kubakho iinkqubo zemidlalo nokuzonwabisa kwimizi yemfundo, kwiiwadi, nakumaphandle ukuze kuphuhlise imidlalo nokuzonwabisa. Zenza imisebenzi yolawulo / ulungelelwaniso lwemiganu. Thatha ingxoxo namaphandle, namaziko amakhulu emisintu, namabhunga emidlalo nasezikhulwini ukuze kwande inani labathathi nxaxheba kumsebenzi wemidlalo nokuzonwabisa. Zisa kubakho iinkqubo eziza wandisa kunye nokuphucisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwabathathi nxaxheba bemidlalo nokuzonwabisa. Cwangcisa, phuhlisa kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zemidlalo yemfundo nentsapho, inkqubo yobuthathaka ngokubanzi kwemfundo nentsapho, neenkqubo zokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu. Lungelelanisa ulawulo lwemidlalo ehambelana no_manyano. Khuthaza impilo yomzimba kunye nokulungelelana kwemizimba kumaphakathi. Nikela indima yokujonga ekusebenzeni kweenkqubo zomzila wemidlalo kunye neebhunga zokuzonwabisa. Khuthaza onke amanqanaba emphakathi ukuba bathathe nxaxheba kumakhowudi ahlukeneyo emidlalo nemisebenzi yokuzonwabisa. Lungiselela iinkqubo eziphambili ngokusebenza kumsebenzi wemidlalo nokuzonwabisa. Lilise ukuze uphephe kunye nokuhlola ukuzinikela kwiinkqubo ezitshintshayo zemidlalo kunye nokuzonwabisa. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweenkqubo zonke ezingundoqo zoluguqulo. Khuthaza ukubakho kobulungisa bobulili kwimidlalo nakuzonwabisa. Khuthaza iinkqubo ezidityanisiweyo zayo yonke iindawo zamasebe kunye nabathathi nxaxheba abahambelanayo. Khuthaza ukuqonda ngakumbi ukubakho nxaxheba kubo bonke ubudala, ngobulili nangamandla. Nikela imisebenzi yolawulu ngenxaxheba yeenkqubo ezisetenziswayo. Qokelela, hlaziya, hlanganisa kwaye uhlaziye iingcombolo kuyo yonke imisebenzi yemidlalo nokuzonwabisa. Nikela inkxaso yolawulo nenzululwazi ngenxaxheba yeempahla kunye nezakhiwo zemidlalo nokuzonwabisa. Lawula inkqubo yokugcina, yokulungisa iingxaki nokubuyisela iimpahla zemidlalo ezilungelelwanisiweyo ezilungele ukuzonwabisa. Qwalasela, hlanganisa kwaye ulilise ukubonelelwa ngeemali kwiiprojekthi ezingaxhasiwayo.

jobs.title: Sport Promotion Officer: Recreation Development
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07), an all-inclusive remuneration
jobs.summary: Promote healthy lifestyle programmes and coordinate support for community-based sport and recreation forums in the OR Tambo District.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a three-year Degree/Diploma (NQF level 6) as recognised by SAQA in Sport Management / Sport Administration / Human Movement studies / Recreation Leisure studies / Sport coaching and Human sciences / Sport and Exercise science / Sport and Exercise technology coupled with 1 to 2 years’ relevant experience in Sport and Recreation environment. Competencies: Good communication and organising skills. Knowledge of relevant pre-scripts in sport and recreation. Ability to work under pressure. Knowledge and understanding of the departmental policies and procedures. Coaching and mentoring skills. Project and event management skills. Basic computer skills. Basic knowledge of Financial Administration. Report writing skills, Presentation skills will be an added advantage. Knowledge of relevant prescripts. Exposure in several codes or federations. A valid driving license is required.
jobs.duties: Promote and implement healthy lifestyle programmes in communities and wards to increase participation in sport and recreation. Coordinate non- financial and financial support towards community-based sport and recreation forums. Assist in the implementation of interventions to increase the number of participants from specific target groups in sport and recreation activities. Establish local community sport and recreation structures in wards and hubs. Facilitate the provision of equipment and attire resources to Hubs and communities. Conduct coaching clinics and workshops for sport and recreation participants and structures. Promote and Implement Indigenous Games programmes in wards and capacitate stakeholders on the technical guidelines. Collect and consolidate all related data and submission of weekly and monthly reports. Facilitate skills development initiatives in communities and recreational structures. Implement all recreational programmes as per the annual operational plan. Perform events management/coordination activities in recreational programmes and activities. Liaise with Hubs, NPO’s, NGOs and sister departments to increase the number of participants in sports and recreation activities. Plan, develop and implement community sports, and community mass participation programme. Conduct monthly meetings with community sport and recreation forums, federations, clubs and schools. Coordinate campaigns with relevant stakeholders and government departments. Promote integrated programmes of all sector departments and relevant stakeholders. Promote awareness and participation to all ages, gender and capability categories. Provide administrative functions in relation to programmes that are implemented. Collect, analyze, compile and update data in recreational activities

Bevoegdhede: Goed kommunikasie- en organiseervaardighede. Kennis van relevante voorafskrifte in sport en ontspanning. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Kennis en begrip van die departementele beleide en prosedures. Afrigting en begeleiding vaardighede. Projek- en bestuursvaardighede vir geleenthede. Basiese rekenaarvaardighede. Basiese kennis van Finansiële Administrasie. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Voorleggingsvaardighede sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van relevante voorafskrifte. Blootstelling aan verskeie kodes of federasies. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Bevorder en implementeer gesonde leefstylprogramme in gemeenskappe en wyke om deelname aan sport en ontspanning te verhoog. Koördineer nie-finansiële en finansiële ondersteuning vir gemeenskapsgebaseerde sport- en ontspanningsforums. Bystaan met die implementering van ingrypings om die aantal deelnemers uit spesifieke teikengroepe in sport- en ontspanningsaktiwiteite te verhoog. Stig plaaslike gemeenskapsport- en ontspanningsstrukture in wyke en sentrums. Fasiliteer die voorsiening van toerusting en kledinghulpbronne aan sentrums en gemeenskappe. Hou afrigtingsklinieke en werkswinkels vir sport- en ontspanningsdeelnemers en -strukture. Bevorder en implementeer inheemse speletjiesprogramme in wyke en bevoeg belanghebbendes oor die tegniese riglyne. Versamel en konsolideer alle verwante data en indiening van weeklikse en maandelikse verslae. Fasiliteer vaardigheidsontwikkelingsinisiatiewe in gemeenskappe en ontspanningsstrukture. Implementeer alle ontspanningsprogramme volgens die jaarlikse operasionele plan. Voer geleentheidsbestuurs/koördinasie-aktiwiteite uit in ontspanningsprogramme en -aktiwiteite. Skakel met sentrums, NPO's, NGO's en susterdepartemente om die aantal deelnemers aan sport- en ontspanningsaktiwiteite te verhoog. Beplan, ontwikkel en implementeer gemeenskapsport, en gemeenskapsmassadeelname-programme. Hou maandelikse vergaderings met gemeenskapsport- en ontspanningsforums, federasies, klubs en skole. Koördineer veldtogte met relevante belanghebbendes en regeringsdepartemente. Bevorder geïntegreerde programme van alle sektordepartemente en relevante belanghebbendes. Bevorder bewustheid en deelname aan alle ouderdoms-, geslags- en vermoë-kategorieë. Verskaf administratiewe funksies met betrekking tot programme wat geïmplementeer word. Versamel, analiseer, stel op en dateer data in ontspanningsaktiwiteite op

zu.title: Inkantshu Yokukhuthaza Ezemidlalo: Ukuthuthukisa Imidlalo Yokuzilibazisa
zu.summary: Khuthaza izinhlelo zokuphila okunempilo uhlele inkusezela kumabhulumuwe ezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa abatholakala emphakathini esifundeni sika OR Tambo.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate yezwe kanye ne-Degree/Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (NQF level 6) evunyiwe ngu-SAQA kokuqashwa kwezemidlalo / ukuqashwa kwabaholi bezemidlalo / izifundo zokunyakaza komzimba / izifundo zokuzilibazisa nokuphumula / ukuqeqesha ezemidlalo kanye nezenzululwazi zabantu / isayensi yezemidlalo nokuzivocavoca / ubuchwepheshe bezemidlalo nokuzivocavoca kanye neminyaka engu-1 kuya kweyi-2 yokuqashwa okuhambisana nemvelo yezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Amakhono: Amakhono ohlelo nokuxhumana. ulwazi lwemibhalo ehlobene nezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi koxanduva. Ulwazi nokugonda izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango. Amakhono okuqeqesha nokuhlakanipha. Amakhono okuphatha imikhiqizo nezinketho. Amakhono obuchwepheshe besikhashana. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokuqashwa kwezimali. Amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okwethula kuzongeza inani. Ulwazi lwemibhalo ehlobene nalokho. Isipiliyoni emikhakheni eminingana noma kubhungu. Kudingeka ibhayisikili evunyiweyo.
zu.duties: Khuthaza futhi usebenzise izinhlela zokuphila okunempilo emiphakathini naseziwardini ukuze kwandise inani labantu abathatha inxaxheba ezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Hlela inkusezela ezingezona zezimali kanye neyamaFinance kumabhulumuwe ezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa abakwamphakathi. Siza ekusebenziseni izindlela ezolandisa inani labathatha inxaxheba ababekwe njengengqikithi ezimweni zemidlalo nokuzilibazisa. Misela izakhiwo zendawo yamphakathi zemidlalo nokuzilibazisa emawardini nasemajalidini. Qedela ukunikezwa kwesicongo nezimpahla kumajalidi nasezimiphakathini. Qeqesha abathatha inxaxheba kwezemidlalo nokuzilibazisa futhi ubambe iworkshop. Khuthaza futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zezinhlelo zemidlalo yesintu emawardini, uqeqeshe izakhamuzi ngemithetho yokuphatha. Qoqa uhlanganise yonke imininingwane ehlobene nokuthumela imibiko yokumasonto nanyanga yenyanga. Khuthaza izindlela zokuthuthukisa amakhono emiphakathini nakwezinhlelo zokuzilibazisa. Sebenzisa yonke imikhakha yokuzilibazisa ngendlela efanayo kwesikhathi esihlelelwe minyaka yonke. Yenza izinketho zokuhlela / ukuhlanganisa ezinkethweni zokuzilibazisa. Xhumana namajalidi, ama-NPO, ama-NGO neminyango yabafowethu ukwandisa inani labantu abathatha inxaxheba ezemidlalo nakwezokuzilibazisa. Caba, bese uhlela futhi usebenzisa imidlalo yamphakathi, kanye nenani elikhulu labantu abathatha inxaxheba emphakathini. Yenza imihlangano yenyanga yonke nababhulumuwe bemidlalo nokuzilibazisa bomphakathi, nababambisene nalabo, namaklabhu nasemzikweni. Hlanganisa izikhalazo nabahlanganyeli kanye namanyango ohulumeni. Khuthaza izinhlelo ezintsha zamanyango onke kanye nalabo abahlanganyele kuyo. Khuthaza ukwaziswa kanye ngenxaxheba kubantu bonke bangakanani, nanjani. Nikela ngemisebenzi ehlobene nezinhlela ezisebenziswayo. Qoqa, hlaziya, qamba futhi ubuyekeze imininingwane ezimweni zokuzilibazisa

xh.title: Mphathi Wekhuthazo Lemidlalo: Intshukumo Ngenkqubela Phambili Yomthombo Wothando
xh.summary: Khuthaza iinkqubela ezintsha ngokusingathwa komzimba okunempilo zize zilungelelanise inkxaso kumagatya amabala aphakathi kwintsapho emidlalweni nasekulungiselelweni kwexesha lokuzonwabisa kummandla ka OR Tambo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu sesiKolo kwaye sibe nidigri okanye idiploma yeminyaka emithathu (inqanaba le-NQF 6) njengoko evunyiwe yiSAQA kwindawo yoLawulo Lomdlalo / uLawulo Lomdlalo / Izifundo ezingqamisana nomzimba / Izifundo zokuzonwabisa nasekuphumlweni / uQeqesho komdlalo nenzululwazi yabantu / uBuchule bomdlalo namanyathelo okuzilolonga / Itekinoloji yomdlalo namanyathelo okuzilolonga kopela nolwazi olunamava eminye ukuya k Kwiminyaka emibini engochwepheshe ekusingathweni kwemidlalo nasekulungiselelweni kokuzonwabisa. Iikhompetensi: Amandla okuthetha nokuhamba-hamba okulungileyo nokuphatha izinto. Inolwazi ngesiqendu esibalulekileyo kwimidlalo nasekulungiselelweni kokuzonwabisa. Amandla okusebenza ngocango. Ulwazi nokuqonda iindlela ezahlukeneyo nemigaqo yesebe. Amandla oqeqesha nokulunga abanye. Amandla okuphatha iiprojekthi nemicimbi. Amandla abalulekileyo ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olusisiseko lolawulo lwezimali. Amandla okubhala iiripoti, amandla okubonisa i prezanteyishin aya kuba lusizo olungezelelweyo. Inolwazi ngeziganeko ezibalulekileyo. Uphila oluqenelekileyo kumagazini ahlukeneyo okanye kumaziko alawulayo. Ifayekhi yokuqhuba echanekileyo iyafuneka.
xh.duties: Khuthaza uze usebenzise iinkqubela ezintsha ngokusingathwa komzimba okunempilo kwilokishi nakumawadi ukuze wandise inani labantu abathatha inxaxheba kwimidlalo nasekulungiselelweni kokuzonwabisa. Langelelanisa inkxaso engengoimali nesezimali kwigumba lemidlalo nasekulungiselelweni kokuzonwabisa kumphakathi. Nceda ekusebenziseni iindlela ezintsha ukuze wandise inani labantu abathatha inxaxheba kwimidlalo nasekulungiselelweni kokuzonwabisa kwelinye iqela labantu. Misela iindidi zolawulo lwemidlalo nokuzonwabisa kumphakathi kumawade kwaye nakuwo onke amaziko olawula imisebenzi yomphakathi. Yenza iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokunika izixhobo nokubeka iimpahla kubakho nasekuphatheni izixhobo kumphakathi. Qeqesha abathatha inxaxheba kwimidalo nokuzonwabisa kwaye wenze iindidi ezahlukeneyo zemisebenzi egudlula kubathathi nxaxheba kolawulo. Khuthaza uze usebenzise iinkqubela zomdlalo wendalo kwilokishi uze waze wanceda abantu abangenisa isixhobo ekusebenziseni iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezimiselwe ngurhulumente. Qokelela uze udibanise onke amagama ahambelanayo nale mimiselo yenze iirekhodi ezahlukeneyo zangaphakathi nasaphandle kwentsuku ezisixhenxe kunye neznyanga zonke. Sakulula amandla abantu ekubeni baziakonze imisebenzi kwaye nasekulungiselelweni kokuzonwabisa kwentsapho. Sebenzisa zonke iinkqubela ezahlukeneyo ngokwemigaqo yenyanga ekusebenzeni okujoliswe kuyo. Zenza umsebenzi wokulawula okanye ukulungelelanisa imicimbi ekusebenzeni kwentsaphu nakumaxwebhu ayo. Thetha nabakho, NPO, NGOs namageba ahlukeneyo ka rhulumente ukwanda inani labantu abathabatha inxaxheba kumaxwebhu ahambelanayo nobucwepheshe. Cwangcisa, uze wakhe uze usebenzise imidlalo yomphakathi, n inkqubela yokubakho kwelinye iqela abathabatha inxaxheba ngokubanzi kumphakathi. Yenza iindibano ezahlukeneyo zenyanga zonke ngemidlalo nokuzonwabisa kwingqungamvana yomphakathi, kwamanye amacandelo, kwabanye abantu basezikolweni. Langelelanisa iinkqubela kwaye uthethe nabantu abahambisanayo nesebe lokuhamba kwahlule. Khuthaza inkqubela ezimanyene zonke amasebe nendlela ezahlukeneyo ezimisela ngokomthetho abanye abantu abahambisanayo nabo. Khuthaza ulwazi olutsha nakwinkinga ezahlukeneyo ukhule wonke umntu ngokwakhe ubomi bakhe bangakanani, kwabesini nakumizamo yekati elahlekileyo. Nikezela ngendlela yolawulo ehambisanayo nendlela yokusebenzisa ezi nkqubela. Qokelela, hlola, dibanisa uze uvuse iziga kubakho abangenisa isixhobo esahlukeneyo.

jobs.summary: Accounting clerk sought for the East London Museum in Ku-Gompo City to verify and capture salary transactions on PERSAL, requiring an NQF level 6 finance or accounting qualification.

An NQF level 6 qualification in the Financial Management/Accounting/Financial accounting/ Bookkeeping/ Finance/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Public Finance/ Business Admin with Accounting (Finance subject/ B.com/ Accounting science/ Public Management with accounting/ Finance subject. No work experience, however, exposure in the environment will be an advantage. Knowledge of basic financial operating systems (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, etc). Job related skills: Planning and organisational. Computer literacy. Communication (verbal and written). Basic numeracy. Recall and Reverse official’s salaries where applicable. Capture change of official’s banking details. Capturing of fuel reimbursement claims for official’s salaries where applicable. Ensure record keeping and filing of salary related documents.

af.title: Rekeningklerk (PRODUKSIE)
af.summary: Rekeningklerk gesoek vir die East London Museum in Ku-Gompo City om salaris-transaksies op PERSAL te verifieer en in te voer, waarvoor 'n NQF level 6 finansies- of rekeningkundige kwalifikasie vereis word.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat. 'n NQF level 6 kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur/Rekeningkunde/Finansiële rekeningkunde/Boekhouding/Finansies/Koste- en Bestuursrekeningkunde/Openbare Finansies/Besigheidsadministrasie met Rekeningkunde (Finansies vak/B.com/Rekeningkundige wetenskap/Openbare Bestuur met rekeningkunde/Finansies vak. Geen werkervaring nie, maar blootstelling aan die omgewing sal 'n voordeel wees. Werkverwante kennis: Basiese kennis van finansiële funksies en praktyke, asook die vermoë om data in te voer, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële statistiek bymekaar te maak. Basiese kennis en insig van die Openbare Diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en Tesourie-regulasies (Public Finance Management Act, Division of Revenue Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Financial Manual). Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, ens.). Werkverwante vaardighede: Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Basiese syferkundigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Verifieer en voer alle salarisiertransaksies op die PERSAL-stelsel in. Ontvang en verifieer die volledigheid en korrektheid van alle vereiste dokumente van die HR-departement en ander belanghebbendes. Berei voor en voer verlofgratifikasies op PERSAL in. Dien dokumente by interne beheer in vir nakomingskontrole. Berei BAS-betalings en joernale voor. Roep amptenare se salarisse terug en keer dit om, waar van toepassing. Voer veranderings in amptenare se bankbesonderhede in. Voer brandstofvergoedings eise vir amptenare se salarisse in, waar van toepassing. Verseker rekordhouding en lêer van salaris-verwante dokumente.

zu.title: Accounting Clerk (PRODUCTION)
zu.summary: Kumnyango we-East London Museum eKu-Gompo City kufunwa isikhundla somuntu oza kubhalisa izimali ezihlobene nokuqinisekiswa nokubhaliswa kwentela kuhlelo lokubhaliswa kwe-PERSAL, kanti lo msebenzi ufuna isiqu esingumkhakazi wezezimali noma i-NQF level 6 ezezimali.
zu.requirements:
National Senior Certificate. NQF level 6 qualification in Financial Management/Accounting/Financial accounting/ Bookkeeping/ Finance/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Public Finance/ Business Admin with Accounting (Finance subject/ B.com/ Accounting science/ Public Management with accounting/ Finance subject. Akekho obungenayo umuntu oseqinisweni ngokutholakala kwesikhathi eside esiyifunayo, nokho-ke, ukuba nobe yisiphi isipiliyoni esimweni sokusebenza kuleliya khuqo lomuntu kuzobe kungumthombo ovelele wokuthola iziqu.
Ukwazi okuhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nemisebenzi yezezimali, izinqubo kanye nakhono lokungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlela izibalo ezimalini. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo nokuqonda kwemithetho yezimali yesebe likahulumeni kanye nemithetho yezezimali yeTreasury Regulations (Public Finance Management Act, Division of Revenue Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Financial Manual).
Ukwazi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezisebenza ngemali eziyisisekelo (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, etc). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukulungiselela nokuqasha. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Ukubala okuyisisekelo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izoba yinuzuzu.
zu.duties:
Qinisekisa futhi ubambe zonke izinhlelo zentela eziye zenzeka ohlelweni lokubhaliswa lwemali etholwayo kuhlelo i-PERSAL system. Zithole futhi uqinisekise ukugqamuka ngokugcwalileyo nokulunga kwezinto ezidingekileyo emininzi eziye zabhaliswa ohlelweni i-HR department nakwezinye izindawo ezingenele kulemikhakha yokubhaliswa kwemali etholwayo.
Lungiselela futhi ubambele izimali ezibekelwe ukukhishwa kwezinto kagesi ezigcinwa kuhlelo i-PERSAL. Thumela izinto kwindawo yokulawula ngaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziyahambisana nemithetho.
Lungiselela nokuKhokhiwa kuhlelo i-BAS payments kanye nezinto ezibhalisiweyo ezisetshenziswayo. Khumbuza futhi ubuyisela emuva izimali zabasebenzi uma kudingeka. Shenise izinguquko ezizenziwe kuzo zonke izinkambu zokubhaliswa kwemali ezisetshenziswayo.
Bhala izimali ezibekelwe ukukhokhiwa kwezimali ezitholwayo zabasebenzi uma kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwezulu nokubhaliswa kwezinto eziye zenzeka ohlelweni lokubhaliswa kwemali etholwayo.

xh.title: Umphathi wezimali (PRODUCTION)
xh.summary: Kufuneki incwadana ezingoweemali kwisiko le-East London Museum e-Ku-Gompo City ukunika isiqinisekiso nokubhala iintengiselwano zomvuzo kwi-PERSAL, kufuneka ifikelele kwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 kwimfundo yezimali okanye isikhosi sezimali.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samatanga sawo onke amazwe. Ifikhalifhayeshini yangengxwangxa ye-NQF level 6 kwi-Financial Management/Accounting/Financial accounting/ Bookkeeping/ Finance/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Public Finance/ Business Admin with Accounting (Finance subject/ B.com/ Accounting science/ Public Management with accounting/ Finance subject. Akukho nqamlezo yokusebenza, nangona kunjalo, ukuba nakho isipili sesimo kulindeleke ukuba kuya kubakho nzuzo. af.title: Receptionist
af.summary: Verskaf ontvangs- en sekretariële ondersteuning by Bayworld Museum in Gqeberha, deur oproepe, besoekers en kantooradministrasie te hanteer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat. 'n NQF level 6-kwalifikasie in Office Admin/ Business Admin/ Secretarial Studies in Management Assistant / Public Administration / Tourism management sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Geen werkervaring word vereis nie, blootstelling aan diens in die Public Service-kantoor met relevante ervaring sal egter 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis: Uitstekende taalvaardighede en die vermoë om goed te kommunikeer met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde. Goeie telefoonetiket. Rekenaarvaardigheid en die vermoë om met alle Microsoft-toepassings en verwante stelsels te werk. Degelike organisatoriese vaardighede. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Uitstekende skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Goeie versorging en aanbieding. Bly op hoogte van voorskrifte/beleide en prosedures wat op haar/sy werkterrein van toepassing is. Bly op hoogte van die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van toepassing is.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële ondersteuningsdiens aan die kantoor: Ontvang, filter en stuur inkomende oproepe na die regte persoon deur terwyl akkurate boodskappe geneem word. Verwelkom besoekers, bepaal hul behoeftes en verwys hulle na die gepaste personeellede. Tik dokumente vir die personeel binne die kantoor. Bedryf kantoortoerusting soos faksmasjiene en fotostaatmasjiene. Bystand verleen met vriende van die Museum-intekeninge en groepbesprekings. Verskaf 'n klerklike ondersteuningsdiens aan die kantoor: Skakel met reisagentskappe om reisreëlings te tref vir die personeel van die kantoor. Regering reëel vergaderings en gebeurtenisse vir die kantoor. Prosesseer die reis- en bestaans aansprake van die personeel van die kantoor. Stel roetine-korrespondensie en verslae op. Behartig die verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, vermaak, ens.

zu.title: Umamukeli wezithombe
zu.summary: Nika inkonzo yokwamukela kanye nosekela lwezobungqangi e Bayworld Museum e Gqeberha, uphatha amakholi, abavakashi kanye nolawulo lwehhovisi.
zu.requirements: I-Certificate yesiNganga saseNgilandi. I-Certificate yesiNganga saseNgilandi noma i-diploma kuma-office administration noma i-secretarial studies izoba yindlela enhle. Akenankinga yeminye yemisebenzi, kodwa ukuba nolwazi oluthile kwezomphakathi noma emkhakheni ohlobene nalesi sikhundla kuzoba yindlela enhle. Ulwazi: Ukuthoba ukukhuluma kahle nezilimi ezahlukene kakhulu nabantu abahlukene kakhulu. Ulwazi lolwazi kwezokusebenza ngezinto ezincane. Isibonelo ukuba nokukhuluma okuhle kancane nabantu abakhuluma kakhulu. Ulwazi lolwazi kwezokusebenza ngezinto ezincane nokusebenza kahle nabantu abahlukene. Ukuba nokukhuluma kahle nabanikazi bawo wonke umuntu. Ulwazi lolwazi kwezomsebenzi. Ulwazi lolwazi ezinhle. Ulwazi lolwazi ekubhaleni. Ulwazi lolwazi kwezomthetho. Ulwazi lolwazi kwezokusebenza kahle nabantu. Ulwazi lolwazi kwezinto ezincane ezifana namakhompyutha, imitshini yokubhala nokubhalwa kwakho okuhle. Ulwazi lolwazi ekubhaleni. Ulwazi lolwazi ekubhaleni izinto ezincane.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yokusekela ngokobungqangi ehhovisini: Thola, hlola bese udlulisela amakholi asezingeni elinganayo komunye umuntu othize ngenkathi ubhala imiyalezo eqondile. Hlola ukuba ngabakho abavakashi, kubalulekile ukuba bacinge ngezidingo. Bhala imibhalo yezinto abayicelayo ukuze bakwazi ukuyenza. Sebenzisa imitshini yehhovisi efana namafaxi kanye nemifanekisto. Sebenza nabahambi bezwi nabantu abavakashela iminyuziyamu bese uhlela imibhalo. Thatha imibhalo yehhovisini bese uyibhalisa emakhompyutheni. Sebenzisa imibhalo yehhovisini. Bhala imibhalo yabahambi bezindawo ehlukene. Hlela imihlangano yehhovisini. Thola imibhalo yomkhakha ohlukile njengamadwala amabili.

xh.title: Umamkeli wezithandathu
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yomsebenzi wokumkela abantu neliso lezicwangciso eBayworld Museum eGqeberha, kuphathe iinkcukacha zocingo, iindwendwe nolawulo leofisi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNazwisi lweSekondari. Akukho nqamlezoyilo idunyiswa, nangona kunjalo, amava okusebenza kwisebe lolawulo kwabeenekonzo ezimalunga nomyalezo wamkelwa njengesixa esongezelelweyo. Ulwazi: Ikhono elihle lokuqhatha nendlela yokuchazana ngokuhamba-hamba nabantu abakumazinga ahlukeneyo nendawo ebevela kuzo. Indlela elungileyo yokuthetha ngocingo. Ikhono elihle lokubhala nokuchazana nabanye. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobubebe nangokugcina imfihlo. Ukuzicotha ngokwemvelo nokubonakala ngokuhambelana nesikhundla. Ukuhlala utyhila ngemigaqo/iingqinisiso nemigaqo-nkqubo esebenza kummandla wakhe womsebenzi. Ukuhlala utywilile ngeenkqubo nendlela ezisebenza ngayo ofisi yakhe.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolisekela leofisi kule ofisi: Amkela, hlola uze udlulise iinkcukacha zocingo ezifike kumntu ochanekileyo ngelixa ubhala ngokuchanekileyo imiyalezo. Wamkele iindwendwe, gqiba ukuba zifuna ntoni uzize uqondise kwabasebenzi abafanelekileyo. Thayipha amaxwebhu abasebenzi bale ofisi. Sebenzisa izixhobo zofisi njengamatshini wefeksi nakwezokutsala amakhophi. Nceda ngabahlobo beMuseum Subscriptions nezoMdlalo wamaQela. Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yohlelo ofisini: Thethathelana neziko lezohambo ukwenza izicwangciso zohambo abasebenzi bale ofisi. Cwangcisa iindibano neziganeko zale ofisi. Cwangcisa iingxowa zokuhamba nokuzihlengela ezimalunga nabasebenzi bale ofisi. Bhala iinkcukacha eziqhelekileyo ngokomqobo wexesha neengxelo. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezingowonaqhayiya njengesixhobo sokubhala, iziselo njl.nj.

Uitstekende skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Goeie versorging en voorkoms. Op hoogte bly van voorskrifte/beleide en prosedures wat van toepassing is op haar/sy werksterrein. Op hoogte bly van die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van toepassing is.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële ondersteuningsdiens aan die kantoor: Ontvang, sift en stuur inkomende oproepe aan die regte persoon deur terwyl akkurate boodskappe geneem word. Verwelkom besoekers, bepaal hul behoeftes en lei hulle na die gepaste personeellede. Koördineer afsprake met die Appointments Secretary. Tik dokumente vir die personeel binne die kantoor. Bedryf kantoortoerusting soos faksmasjiene en fotokopieerders. Verskaf 'n klerklike ondersteuningsdiens aan die kantoor: Skakel met reisagentskappe om reisreëlings vir die personeel van die kantoor te tref. Reël vergaderings en geleenthede vir die kantoor. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers en organiseer vermaak. Verwerk die reis- en bestaanstoelaes van die personeel van die kantoor. Opstel van roetine-korrespondensie en verslae. Hanteer koeriersdienste en telefoonrekeninge. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos stasieer, vermaak ens.

zu.title: Umamukeli Wezivakashi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umamukeli wezivakashi e-EL Museum e-East London ukunika inkonzo yobhasha, ukuphatha amakholi nezivakashi, kanye nohlelo lokuhlangana. Kudingeka isitifiketi samatikithi aphansi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Esiphakeme Sezwe. Isifundo esinganqangi esingaba yinzuzo ukuba nesiqu se-NQF level 6 kokuqashwa kohlelo / Ukuphathwa Kwezohwebo / Izifundo Zokuba Ngumobili Wezinsiza Eziphathwa Ngabaphathi / Ukuphathwa Kwabezulumayo. Alikho ithuba elidingekile lokusebenza, kodwa-ke, ukuba nobuchule kulokhu kusebenza kuyoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi: Amandla amakhulu olimi kanye nesikhathi sokuxoxa kahle nabantu abavela ezinkathini ezahlukene kwaye bavela kwezinye izinkalo. Isobho evundlile yocingo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha kanye nesikhathi sokusebenza ngazo zonke izinhlelo ze-Microsoft Applications kanye nezinhlelo ezihlotshanisiwe. Amandla amakhulu ohlelo. Izinga eliphezulu sokuthembeka. Amandla amakhulu okubhala. Isikhathi sokuziphatha ngobungcweti kwaye ungakhulumi ngakho konke. Ukugqoka okuhle kwaye ubonakale kahle. Gcina ulwazi lwakho lusanda mayelana nemithetho/izinqumo kanye nezindlela ezisebenza kwindawo yakho yokusebenza. Gcina ulwazi lwakhe olusanda ngendlela nezinqumo ezisebenza esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yokwesekela ngokwasekhaya ohlinzeka ngayo kulesikhundla. Sizwa, hlunga futhi udlulise amakholi asezingeni eliphezulu komunye umuntu ofanele ngenkathi uthatha imiyalezo eqondile. Bambele abavakashi, qonda izidingo zabo bese ubaholela kubasebenzi abafanele. Hlela ithuba lokuhlangana noMbhali Wezinhlelo Zokuhlangana. Bhala amadokhumenti abasebenzi bakulesikhundla. Phatha izinsiza zokusebenza efana namashini efeksi kanye nezidluli. Inkonzo yokwesekela ngokwemibhalohlela ikwindawo yokusebenza. Hlanganyele nezinhlelo zokuhamba ukuze uhlele ukuhamba kwabasebenzi bakulesikhundla. Hlela izinkumbulo kanye nezinkomba zomnyango. Qaphela izikhungo ezifanele zokuhlangana, mema abadlali ababalulekile bese uhlela ukudla. Thola izimali ezibekiwe zokuhamba nokuphila kwabasebenzi bakulesikhundla. Bala imibhalo eqondile nokuqhuba imibiko. Phatha izinkonzo zamaphakethe namakhawundi efoni. Phatha uthengo lwezinto ezivamile njengamapheni, ukudla okuphathwa esikhunjini, nokunye.

xh.title: Umamkeli wabafikelwayo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umamkeli wabafikelwayo kwi-EL Museum e-East London ukunika inkxaso yobhala-phandle, ukulawula iingxoxo nomnxeba nabafikelwayo, nokuqhubeza namaqumbe. Kufuneka kubekho i-National Senior Certificate.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate. I-NQF level 6 kwizifundo ze-Office Admin/ Business Admin/ Secretarial Studies in Management Assistant / Public Administration/ iya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Akukho mdla wamava womsebenzi ofunekayo, nangona kunjalo, ukuba kulwazi kule ndawo kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi: Amandla amathambo ngolwimi nokuwukwazi ukuchazela kakuhle nabantu abakumazantsi ahlukeneyo nasekwimvelaphi ehlukileyo. Indlela elungileyo yokuthetha kumnxeba. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuwukwazi ukusebenza nazo zonke i-Microsoft Applications nendlela ezidityaniswayo nazo. Amandla amathambo kulungelelaniso lwezinto. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Amandla amathambo ekubhaleni unxibelelwano. Ukwazi ukuziphatha ngokuqonda nangokuzigqiba. Ukuzigqoka nokuvela kakuhle. Ukuhlala ulwazi ngemigaqo/iindlebe nemigaqo yomsebenzi ephathekayo kwindawo yakhe/yezakhe zemisebenzi. Ukuhlala ulwazi ngenkqubo nendlela ezisebenzwayo kwindawo yakhe/yezakhe zemisebenzi.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkxaso yobhala-phandle kule ndawo: Ukufumana, ukuhlola nokuqhushumba iingxoxo ezizayo kumntu ochanekileyo ukuze athathe imiyalezo ecacileyo. Ukwamkela abafikelwayo, ukumisela iimfuno zabo nokubakhokelela kubasebenzi abafaneleyo. Ukuqhubeza namaqumbe nomamkeli wamaqumbe. Ukuthayipha amaxwebhu abasebenzi kule ndawo. Ukusebenzisa izixhobo zendawo njengemachini yefeksi nakwindlu yokutsala iikopi. Ukunika inkxaso yekleriki kule ndawo: Unxibelelwano nee-agenzi zokuhamba ukwenza ulungelelwaniso lokuhamba abasebenzi bale ndawo. Ukulungela iindibano neziganeko zale ndawo. Ukumisela iindawo zedibano, ukumema abathathi nxaxheba, nokulungela iziselo. Ukusebenza izimangalo zokuhamba nokuhlala abasebenzi bale ndawo. Ukubhala iindaba zemihla nemizekelo neengxelo. Ukusebenza iinkonzo zokuthunyelwa kweekhorya ne-akhawunti zemnxeba. Ukusebenza ukufumana izinto ezingagqibekanga njengamaxwebhu okubhala, iziselo njl.njl.

jobs.title: General Assistant: Logistics Services
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R144 024 – R169 656 per annum (Level 02), an all-inclusive remuneration
jobs.summary: General Assistant needed for logistics services in the Eastern Cape to receive, check and store goods, requiring ABET Level 4 and a valid driving licence.
jobs.requirements: Abet Level 4 or grade 10. National Senior Certificate will be an added advantage. No experience required. Exposure to the environment will be an added advantage. Prepared to work after hours. Knowledge: Basic knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Interpersonal relations and communication skills. A valid driving license.
jobs.duties: Facilitate receipt of goods and services. Receive, check and record the goods and invoices received from suppliers. Reconcile goods received with requisition forms. Endorse with signature on receipt of goods. Record goods received. Keep goods in a correct and safe place. Facilitate storage, issuing and distributing stores item/inventory. Enter goods in a correct bin allocation. Update bin cards and item records. Liaise with the end user for collection of goods received. Issue and facilitate signing of goods receipt voucher by the end user. Facilitate capturing and submission of payment voucher documents. Compare and check invoice against the order and the goods received. Check validity of the invoice (stamp, signature and banking details). Receive and capture submission on the system. Record outgoing submission. Forward the submission to payments. Conduct and control stocktaking.
