af.title: Algemene Assistent: Logistiekdienste
af.summary: Algemene Assistent nodig vir logistiekdienste in die Eastern Cape om goedere te ontvang, te kontroleer en te stoor; vereis ABET Level 4 en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.requirements: ABET Level 4 of grade 10. National Senior Certificate sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Geen ervaring vereis. Blootstelling aan die omgewing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bereid om buite kantoorure te werk. Kennis: Basiese kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Tussenmenslike verhoudings en kommunikasievaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Fasiliteer ontvangs van goedere en dienste. Ontvang, kontroleer en registreer die goedere en fakture wat van verskaffers ontvang is. Versoen goedere ontvang met bestelvorms. Onderteken by ontvangs van goedere. Registreer goedere ontvang. Hou goedere op 'n korrekte en veilige plek. Fasiliteer stoor, uitreiking en verspreiding van voorraadartikels/voorraad. Voer goedere in 'n korrekte bentoewysing in. Werk binkaarte en artikelrekords bygewerk. Skakel met die eindgebruiker vir die afhaal van goedere ontvang. Reik uit en fasiliteer ondertekening van goedereontvangstalloon deur die eindgebruiker. Fasiliteer vaslegging en indiening van betaaltalloon-dokumente. Vergelyk en kontroleer faktuur teen die bestelling en die goedere ontvang. Kontroleer geldigheid van die faktuur (stempel, handtekening en bankbesonderhede). Ontvang en voer indiening op die stelsel in. Registreer uitgaande indiening. Stuur die indiening aan betalings. Voer en beheer voorraadopname uit.

zu.title: Umsizi Jikelele: Izinkonzo Zokuhamba nokuhamba
zu.summary: Umsizi jikelele odingekayo ezinkonzeni zokuhamba nokuhamba e Eastern Cape ukuthola, ukuhlola futhi agcize izimpahla, kudingeka abe ne-ABET Level 4 nefayela lokushayela elikhonayo.
zu.requirements: Abet Level 4 noma ibanga le-10. I-National Senior Certificate izoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Akukho kuphephile okudingekile. Ukuba nesipilinge kulesi simo kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ukubekezela ekusebenzeni ngemva kwamahora. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemisimo yokusebenza ngokohlelo lwesimo sokusebenza. Ubudlelwano nabantu nobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Ifayela lokushayela elikhonayo.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukwamukelwa kwezimpahla nezinkonzo. Thola, hlola futhi uthayiphe izimpahla namanotshe awutholile kubanikezeli. Hlanganisa izimpahla ezitholiwe ngefomu lesicelo. Saya usiginesha lapho kwamukelwa izimpahla. Thayipha izimpahla ezitholiwe. Gcina izimpahla endaweni efanele nephathike kakhulu. Qondisa ukugcinwa, ukunikwa nokusatshazelwa kwezinto zesitolo. Phefumulela izimpahla kwindawo efanayo. Buse izinkathi zokuqhuba futhi uvuse ifomu lezimpahla. Xhumana nomsebenzisi wokugcina ngezimpahla azitholile. Nikeza futhi qondisa ukusayinwa kwesitifikedi sezimpahla ngumsebenzisi wokugcina. Qondisa ukubhalwa nokungeniswa kwemibhalo yesitifikedi sekhishi. Qhathanisa futhi uhlole inotshe nomyalo nezimpahla ezitholiwe. Hlola ukusemthethweni kwanotshe (isitembu, isiginesho nemininingwane yebhange). Thola futhi ubhale ingeniselo kusistimu. Bhala ukungenisa okuphuma. Thumela ukungenisa kwemali. Yenza ulawulo lokuqhuba izimpahla.

xh.title: I-General Assistant: Iinkonzo ze-Logistics
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-General Assistant ye-logistics services kwi-Eastern Cape ukwamkela, ukuhlola nokugcina izinto, kudingeka i-ABET Level 4 kunye nelayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.requirements: Abet Level 4 okanye grade 10. National Senior Certificate iya kuba ngomonde. Akukho mfundo yolwazi edingekayo. Ukuvakashela kwendalo iya kuba ngumonde. Ulungele ukusebenza emva kweyure yolwazi. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olusisiqulatho semigaqo yomsebenzi malunga nendalo yokusebenza. Unxibelelwano koluntu kunye namakhono othetho. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Qhubeza ukwamkelwa kwezinto nezinkonzo. Yamkela, hlola urekhode izinto kunye nee-invois ezifunyanwe kubaphathi. Qamatha izinto ezamkeliweyo nefomu ezicelo. Tyeleza ngesigunyaziso xa kwamkelwa izinto. Rekhoda izinto ezamkeliweyo. Gcina izinto kwindawo echanekileyo ekhuselekileyo. Qhubeza ukugcina, ukunikela nokusasaza izinto ezigcinwayo/izinto ezikhoyo. Faka izinto kwibin allocation echanekileyo. Hlaziya amakhadi e-bin kunye nerekhodi yezinto. Thathelana nabasebenzisi ekugqibeleni malunga nokuthathwa kwezinto ezamkeliweyo. Nikela qhubeze ukusayina kwesatifiketi sokwamkela izinto somsebenzisi wokugqibela. Qhubeza ukufaka nokungenisa amaxwebhu evawucha yokuhlawula. Thelekisa uhlola invois ngokuchasene nodelo kunye nezinto ezamkeliweyo. Hlola ukusebenza kwe-invois (istampu, isigunyaziso kunye nethalbek yemali). Yamkela ufake ungenise isibhalo kwinkqubo. Rekhoda ungeniso oluphumayo. Thumela ungeniso kwiipayimenti. Qhubeza ulawule ukubala kwesitokhwe.

jobs.title: Intern: Human Resource Development
jobs.summary: The Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture seeks an intern to administer workplace skills, bursary and internship programmes at its Head Office in Qonce for 24 months.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 with a three-year degree/National Diploma (NQF 6) as recognised by SAQA in Training and Development/ Management of Training/ HRM with Training as a Major subject. Be a South African citizen. Must have no criminal record. Applicants must be unemployed and never participated in an internship programme previously.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement the Workplace Skills Program (WSP). Administer bursary programs for all bursary awards. Administer the Graduate Internship, TVET and Work Integrated programmes. Maintenance of the database for all HRD programmes. Perform administrative duties such as preparing for Induction of graduates and learners, writing of appointment and exit letters for external funded students. Monitor Internship reports and attendance registers. Provide assistance in coordinating Compulsory Induction (CIP), Departmental induction, and maintaining of inducted officials and Departmental orientation. Organise Youth Developmental Programme meeting and taking of minutes.
jobs.enquiries: can be directed to Ms. Z. Mhloma / Ms. R. Swartbooi Tel No: (043) 492 1338 / 043 492 0949 For e-Recruitment Technical Enquiries email to: erecruitment@ecsrac.gov.za
jobs.notes: The Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts & Culture is offering an internship programme. The programme will be for a non-renewable period of 24 months. Unemployed Graduates are invited to apply and be in possession of the National Diploma / Degree as indicated in the requirements below. Applicants who previously underwent or are currently on an internship programme will not be considered. The objective of the Internship program within the public service, is to address the problem of youth unemployment, especially tertiary (university and Technikon) graduates by providing them with work experience opportunities in the public service. As per the Directive issued by DPSA on the employment of persons to developmental programmes in the public service: Internship, Learnership, Apprenticeship, Graduate recruitment schemes and related programmes, this Internship programme is specifically aimed at the following: Interns need to be graduates and unemployed. Interns need to be within their specific demographic area. The internship should not exceed a period of 24 months, meaning candidates cannot enter into an internship program more than once. During the tenure of the contract, the youth will receive continuous learning and development interventions to improve their skills through on-the-job training initiatives for optimal performance and to equip them for future employment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Intern: Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling
af.summary: Die Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture soek 'n intern om werkplekvaardigheids-, beurs- en internskapprogramme by sy Hoofkantoor in Qonce vir 24 maande te administreer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Matriek Sertifikaat/Graad 12 met 'n driejarige graad/Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) soos deur SAQA erken in Opleiding en Ontwikkeling/Bestuur van Opleiding/ HRM met Opleiding as 'n hoofvak. Wees 'n Suid-Afrikaanse burger. Moet geen strafrekord hê nie. Aansoekers moet werkloos wees en voorheen nooit aan 'n internskapprogramme deelgeneem het nie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer die Workplace Skills Program (WSP). Administreer beursprogramme vir alle beursbekendigings. Administreer die Graduate Internship-, TVET- en Work Integrated-programme. Onderhoud van die databasis vir alle HRD-programme. Verrig administratiewe pligte soos die voorbereiding vir indoksing van afgestudeerdes en leerders, asook die skryf van aanstellings- en uitgangsbriewe vir ekstern gefinansierde studente. Monitor Internship-verslae en bywoningsregisters. Verskaf bystand by die koördinering van Compulsory Induction (CIP), departementele indoksing, asook die onderhoud van geïndokste amptenare en departementele oriëntering. Reël Youth Developmental Programme-vergaderings en die neem van notules.

zu.title: Umfolophi: Isiqondiswa Sokuqeqesha Abantu Abasebenzayo
zu.summary: i-Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture ifuna umfolophi ozoqeqesha ukulawula amaholoho abasebenzi, izibonelo zokufunda nezinhlelo zokufunda esikhundleni sobumfihlo ku-Head Office e-Qonce izinyanga ezingama-24.
zu.requirements: UFunde ibanga le-12 nge-degree yeminyaka eyithathu/National Diploma (NQF 6) evunyiwe yi-SAQA kwe-Training and Development/ Management of Training/ HRM, ithi Training ibe ngosubject osemqoka. Ube ngumZulu ongumbuso waseNingizimu Afrika.ungatholakali esikhwameni sezephula umthetho. Abafaki izicelo kufanele bengasebenzile futhi bangazange bathathe inxaxhebe kunhlangano yokuqeqeshwa esikhundleni sobumfihlo ngaphambilini.
zu.duties: Yakha futhi usebenzise i-Workplace Skills Program (WSP). Lawula izinhlelo zezibonelo zakho konke okunikezwa ngomsiza. Lawula i-Graduate Internship, TVET nezinhlelo ze-Work Integrated Integrated. Gcina idatabase yonke imihlenhlo ye-HRD. Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula efana nokulungiselela ukungena kolusebenzako kwabaphothule nabaqeqeshi, ukubhala ohlamvu lokuqashwa nokuphuma abafundi abaxhasiwe bangaphandle. Qapha izibali zenhlangano yokufunda nokuthi bakhona njani. Siza ekuhlanganiseni ukungena okuphoqiwe emsebenzini (CIP), ukungalolonga kwabasebenzi bomnyango, nokugcina uluhlu lwabasebenzi abangene emsebenzini. Hlela indodana yenhloso yokuthuthukisa abantu abasafufusa ubudala kwaye uze uthathe imizuzu nemibuzo yakho.

jobs.title: Intern: Strategic Planning
jobs.summary: Internship in strategic planning at the Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, requiring a diploma or degree in public management or related fields.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 with a three-year National Diploma or bachelor’s degree (NQF Level 6/7) recognised by SAQA in: Policy Development/ Public Management/ Public Administration/ Strategic Management and Planning/ Social Science/ Business Management. Be a South African citizen. Must have no criminal record. Applicants must be unemployed and never participated in an internship programme previously.
jobs.duties: Assist in organisation of Strategic Planning and Strategic Review Sessions of the Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture (DSRAC) in order to develop the statutory planning documents of the department. Collect and compile inputs from the managers and unit manager for the development and production of various statutory documents to submit to the Provincial and National Treasury, National Department of Sport, Arts and Culture and Provincial Legislature. Assist with the collection and consolidation of planning inputs from all programmes within the department. Facilitate the distribution of the Strategic Planning Cycle Framework to all programme managers at all Districts and Head Office. Assist all managers in the directorate in the execution of their duties related to strategic planning. Organise sessions with internal and external stakeholders to communicate the approved Strategic and Annual Performance Plan for their knowledge and information. Assist with logistics related to travel and accommodation for strategic management staff. Take minutes and compile reports for strategic management sessions. Undertake any other duties related to strategic management as delegated by managers.
jobs.enquiries: can be directed to Ms. Z. Mhloma / Ms. R. Swartbooi Tel No: (043) 492 1338 / 043 492 0949 For e-Recruitment Technical Enquiries email to: erecruitment@ecsrac.gov.za
jobs.notes: The Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts & Culture is offering an internship programme. The programme will be for a non-renewable period of 24 months. Unemployed Graduates are invited to apply and be in possession of the National Diploma / Degree as indicated in the requirements below. Applicants who previously underwent or are currently on an internship programme will not be considered. The objective of the Internship program within the public service, is to address the problem of youth unemployment, especially tertiary (university and Technikon) graduates by providing them with work experience opportunities in the public service. As per the Directive issued by DPSA on the employment of persons to developmental programmes in the public service: Internship, Learnership, Apprenticeship, Graduate recruitment schemes and related programmes, this Internship programme is specifically aimed at the following: Interns need to be graduates and unemployed. Interns need to be within their specific demographic area. The internship should not exceed a period of 24 months, meaning candidates cannot enter into an internship program more than once. During the tenure of the contract, the youth will receive continuous learning and development interventions to improve their skills through on-the-job training initiatives for optimal performance and to equip them for future employment. af.title: Intern: Strategiese Beplanning
af.summary: Internskapsprogram in strategiese beplanning by die Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, waarvoor 'n diploma of graad in openbare bestuur of verwante velde vereis word.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 met 'n driejaar-National Diploma of bachelorsgraad (NQF Level 6/7) wat deur SAQA erken word in: Policy Development/ Public Management/ Public Administration/ Strategic Management and Planning/ Social Science/ Business Management. Wees 'n Suid-Afrikaanse burger. Moet geen strafblad hê nie. Aansoekers moet werkloos wees en mag nog nie voorheen aan 'n internskapsprogram deelgeneem het nie.
af.duties: Help met die organisering van Strategiese Beplanning- en Strategiese Hersieningsessies van die Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture (DSRAC) ten einde die statutêre beplanningsdokumente van die departement te ontwikkel. Versamel en stel insette van die bestuurders en eenheidbestuurder saam vir die ontwikkeling en produksie van verskeie statutêre dokumente om by die Provinciale en Nasionale Tesourie, National Department of Sport, Arts and Culture en Provinciale Wetgewer in te dien. Help met die versameling en konsolidasie van beplanningsinsette vanuit alle programme binne die departement. Fasiliteer die verspreiding van die Strategiese Beplanningsiklusraamwerk aan alle programbestuurders by alle Distrikte en Hoofkantoor. Help alle bestuurders in die direktoraat met die uitvoering van hul pligte verbonde aan strategiese beplanning. Reël sessies met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes om die goedgekeurde Strategiese en Jaarlikse Prestasieplan vir hul kennis en inligting te kommunikeer. Help met logistiek rakende reis en akkommodasie vir strategiese bestuurspersoneel. Neem notule en stel verslae vir strategiese bestuursessies op. Onderneem enige ander pligte verbonde aan strategiese bestuur soos deur bestuurders gedelegeer.

zu.title: Umphathi wesikhathi esibekiwe: Ukuhlela Kabuso Kwebhizinisi
zu.summary: I-athishiphu ekuhleni kobuchwepheshe kumnyango wezemidlalo, umzobo, ezemfuyo kanye nenhla emaQonce, ifuna idiploma noma ibanga leziqu eziphakathi kobuphathi bomphakathi noma emikhakheni ehlobene noku.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikithi ePjekondari/isitifiketi seMatikhi/ibanga lesi-12 nge-diploma yezwe eminyaka emithathu noma ibanga lesi-7 lesiqu (NQF Level 6/7) esamukelwe yi-SAQA kwil: Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo / Ukuphathwa Komphakathi / Ukuphathwa kukaMphakathi nokuHlela Kabuso kwebhizinisi / Ezenhlalakahle naseBhizinisini Nokuphathwa. Kumele ube ngumakadebonke waseNingizimu Afrika. Kumele uhmamathe alandelwe ngalutholakalwa oyiphutha lomthetho. Abafaki bahlale bangasebenzi futhi abaze babengeyilungu elithathwayo emehlathini ekuhleleni isikhathi esibekiwe.
zu.duties: Siza ekuhleleni iNgqungquthela YokuHlela iNqubo yeMisebenzi kanye noBuhlakani beMisebenzi ohlelweni lomnyango Wokuzijabulisa, Ukuzijabulisa, Ezemidlalo, ezokuHlela nasezokuMoya kanye nokuHlinzwa ngemikhiqizo emikhulu kahulumeni wasekhaya kakhulunywe. Qoqa futhi uhlele imininingwane evela kubaphathi kanye nomphathi webhulokhothi ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kukhiqizwe amaphepha abalulekile okuthunyelwa kwiliphalamende lesifundazwe kanye neLungu lePhalamende, uNyango weZeMzimba weHlabathi futhi aluholele ezweni, nabasebenzi beNdlu yesiFunda. Siza ukuqoqa futhi uhlanganise imininingwane yokuhlela kusuka kuyo yonke imikhakha ohlelweni lohulumeni. Hlinzeka ngohwebo lokuhlinzwa kwendlela yokuthumela imiyalo yokuHlela iNqubo yokuSebenza kubo bonke abaphathi bemitolayo kuyilabo bonke abasebenzi bakhomidi nahhovisi elikhulu. Siza bonke abaphathi ohlelweni ekuhambiseni imisebenzi yabo ehlobene nokuhlela nokuqukethwa. Hlela izingqungquthela nabashaywe bengaphakathi nangaphandle bakaHulumeni ukubakhombisa iNqubo eHlomula kanye noHlela lweminyaka yomsebenzi oHleliwe ukuze bakwazi futhi bahlakaniphiswe. Siza ngezidingo ezihlobene nokuhamba nokuhlala ezindlini zabantu abasiza abahamba bayo. Bhala imininingwane futhi uqoqe imibiko yemihlangano eHlobene noHlelo Iqinisiswe, iphinde ibhale imibhali eminingi eya tholakalaya kubaphathi bemitolayo ezinye izinkalo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wokuqeqeshwa: Ukuqweba iNdlela
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuziqhelanisa ekubaleni indlela kwiSebe lezemidlalo, ezenkxaso, nobugcisa nolwazilwini eQonce, sifuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwindlela yolawulo loluntu okanye kwimimandla engqamana nayo.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi ePhakamileyo yoMntu wonke/Isitifikathi seMatric/Isigaba se-12 kunye neDiploma yaseNzululwazi yamakhulu amathathu okanye isidanga sobugcisa (iNqanaba le-6/7 leNQF) esamkelwe yi-SAQA kwi: iNkqubo yoLawulo/ uLawulo loLuntu/ uLawulo lokuQweba kunye noQulunqo/ uQulunqo lweZenzo ezingoMntu wonke/ uLawulo lweShishini. Uba ngumzi ongumMzantsi Afrika. Makabengathanga naye enenye yecalengxaxhe. Abafaki zicelo makabengabasebenzi kwaye bangazange bathathe inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuqeqeshwa ngaphambili.
xh.duties: Nceda ekulungeniseni iSeshoni zoQulunqo oluQweba iNdlela nokuphonononga iNdlela kwiSebe lezemidlalo, ezenkxaso, nobugcisa nolwazilwini (DSRAC) ngenjongo yokwakha amaxwebhu oqulunqo esemthethweni esebe. Qokelela uze udibanise iziphakamiso ezingena kubalulekile nabaphathi bemimimangaphakathi ngenjongo yokuphuhlisa nokudalisa amaxwebhu ahlukahlukeneyo esemthethweni okuNikela kuBallo LwePhondo naseLwandle, eSebe leZemidlalo, iBugcisa nolwazilwini LwesiZwe nakuBandla loMthetho wePhondo. Nceda ngeqokelelo nangokudibanisa iziphakamiso zoqulunqo ezivela kuzo zizonke iinkqubo ngaphakathi kwisebe. Yenza izaphulo zokusasaza iSangqa soQulunqo oluQweba iNdlela kuwo onke abaphathi beenkqubo kuzo zonke iDistrakthi naseKomitini nguMlawuli eNtloko. Nceda onke abaphathi kwidirekethi ekusebenziseni kwemisebenzi yabo equleyo kuqulunqo oluqweba indlela. Lungiselela iiseshoni namaxhaxhe ezingaphakathi nangaphandle ukwazisa iNdlela eVunyiweyo neSicwangiso seNkonzo yeNyanga ngokwazi nokwazi. Nceda ngokusetyenziswa koluhlobo lokuhamsha nendlalo yokuhlala kubasebenzi bolawulo oluqweba indlela. Tsala amaminithi uze udibanise iingxelo ngeeseshoni zolawulo oluqweba indlela. Thatha nawo nanoyiphi na enye imisebenzi equleyo kulawulo oluqweba indlela njengoko kutyunjiswa ngabaphathi.

Ukuqoqa imibiko, ukubhaliswa kwamadlali ezikoleni, emahubeni nakumaklabhu abathatha inxaxheba kumicimbi yemidlalo. Ukwenza isilinganiso sezidingo nokubhala idatha. Ukusiza emthethweni wokuthenga.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethe seBanga leSizwe/Isatifikethe seMatrik/IBanga le-12 nceda ngedigri yeminyaka emithathu/NesiDiploma zeSizwe (NQF 6) ekuqatywe yi-SAQA kwizifundo zeentsapho zeentsomi / Ulawulo lwezibalo / Ulawulo lukaRhulumente / Ulawulo lukaRhulumente/ Ulawulo/ iNcedo nolwazi lweZibhalo/Ulawulo lweZibhalo nemiba kaHleze/ izifundo zoBugcisa beNtlanga & iziLwimi/ Ulawulo lweNtlalo yoBugcisa/ iMbali/ iZibalo eZilungileyo/ uBugcisa bokwenza/ izifundo zeentsapho zeentsomi ekhula elithile kwezi zilandelayo okanye kwezinye iindawo ezing ezinye iingoma, umDaniso & iNtsomi, iziBalo eziBonakalayo, iFilm. Yiba ngumZi weMizi weSewula Afrika. Makungabi nalupo na igunya lolwabiwo lwemigalelo kwizigwebo. Abafaki isicelo makube bengasebenzanga kwaye bangazange bashiyekule inkqubo yokubakho ngamagcisa abanike ngenxaxhe.
xh.duties: Nceda ekuyilweni amaxwebhu okuqonda. Ukuqamba iindibano nokuthabatha amaxwebhu okubhalwa kwindibano. Nceda ekuyilweni kumalinganiso nokuZalisekisa iNdlela yoKusebenza. Nceda kuQhatho lweMibhangqo eXhaswa ngemali yeZibalo nentsapho yenkcubeko. Yila uze uhlaziye isiseko seHlathi soBuki bendalo ngoBashwankathelo bamabalwa. Uqaphele uluqhathaniselwano ngokusebenza noBashwankathelo bamabalwa. Lungelela iingxelo zemibhangqo. Zalisekise imibhangqo yeZibalo & inTlanga. Lungelela iingxelo nyanga zonke nge candelo. Nceda ekuyalekeni iindibano. Zalisekise iinkqubo zokuphangela kolunye. Nceda nangokulunga okuthathwayo kwicandelo. Nikezela ngencedo ekuLungenisweni okuQhelekileyo.

jobs.title: Intern: Sport & Recreation
jobs.summary: A 24-month internship in sport and recreation administration based in Gqeberha, requiring a diploma or degree in sport management or human movement science.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 with a National Diploma / Degree, NQF Level 6 in Sport Management / Human Movement Science. Understanding of the National Sport and Recreation Plan will be added advantage. Must have an understanding of the Sport and Recreation environment/sector within Nelson Mandela Bay. Good presentation, verbal and writing skills. Willingness to work under pressure. Computer skills. Be a South African citizen. Must have no criminal record. Applicants must be unemployed and never participated in an internship programme previously.
jobs.duties: Assist Sport and Recreation sub sections in the administration and Implementation of programmes/events in the district. Collect data and compile stats on sport and recreation programmes/events in the district. Assist in the delivery of sport and recreation equipment/attire to beneficiaries. Compile Team List. Communicate with communities/clubs and schools on sport and recreation programme requirements and compliance. Assist in the co- ordination of community festivals/coaching clinics and special projects. Develop and compile database of sport and recreation information. Assist sub sections in the compilation of monthly reports and collection of portfolios of evidence. Social Cohesion and Development: using sport and recreation for youth development, crime prevention, health promotion, inclusion of people with disabilities. Assist in organising and coordination of Sport and recreation activities. Liaise between DSRAC and sport and recreation structure and DoE. Compile reports, register athletes in sport and recreation schools, hubs, and club participating in sport and recreation events. Compile needs analysis and capture data. Assist in the procurement process.
jobs.enquiries: can be directed to Ms. Z. Mhloma / Ms. R. Swartbooi Tel No: (043) 492 1338 / 043 492 0949 For e-Recruitment Technical Enquiries email to: erecruitment@ecsrac.gov.za
jobs.notes: The Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts & Culture is offering an internship programme. The programme will be for a non-renewable period of 24 months. Unemployed Graduates are invited to apply and be in possession of the National Diploma / Degree as indicated in the requirements below. Applicants who previously underwent or are currently on an internship programme will not be considered. The objective of the Internship program within the public service, is to address the problem of youth unemployment, especially tertiary (university and Technikon) graduates by providing them with work experience opportunities in the public service. As per the Directive issued by DPSA on the employment of persons to developmental programmes in the public service: Internship, Learnership, Apprenticeship, Graduate recruitment schemes and related programmes, this Internship programme is specifically aimed at the following: Interns need to be graduates and unemployed. Interns need to be within their specific demographic area. The internship should not exceed a period of 24 months, meaning candidates cannot enter into an internship program more than once. During the tenure of the contract, the youth will receive continuous learning and development interventions to improve their skills through on-the-job training initiatives for optimal performance and to equip them for future employment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Intern: Sport & Ontspanning
af.summary: 'n 24-maande internskap in sport- en ontspanningsadministrasie gebaseer in Gqeberha, wat 'n diploma of graad in sportbestuur of menslike bewegingskunde vereis.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Matrik Sertifikaat/Graad 12 met 'n Nasionale Diploma / Graad, NQF-vlak 6 in Sportbestuur / Menslike Bewegingskunde. Kennis van die Nasionale Sport- en Ontspanningsplan sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Moet 'n begrip hê van die Sport- en Ontspanningsomgewing/-sektor binne Nelson Mandela Bay. Goeie aanbiedings-, verbale en skryfvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om onder druk te werk. Rekenaarvaardighede. Wees 'n Suid-Afrikaanse burger. Moet geen strafblad hê. Aansoekers moet werkloos wees en voorheen nog nooit aan 'n internskapprogramme deelgeneem het nie.
af.duties: Ondersteun Sport- en Ontspanning subafdelings in die administrasie en implementering van programme/aktiwiteite in die distrik. Versamel data en stel statistieke op oor sport- en ontspanningsprogramme/aktiwiteite in die distrik. Ondersteun by die aflewering van sport- en ontspanningstoerusting/klere aan begunstigdes. Stel spanlyste op. Kommunikeer met gemeenskappe/klubs en skole oor sport- en ontspanningsprogramvereistes en nakoming. Ondersteun by die koördinering van gemeenskapsfeeste/afrigtingsklinieke en spesiale projekte. Ontwikkel en stel 'n databasis van sport- en ontspanningsinligting op. Ondersteun subafdelings by die opstel van maandelikse verslae en die versameling van portefeuljes van getuienis. Sosiale Samehorigheid en Ontwikkeling: gebruik van sport en ontspanning vir jeugontwikkeling, misdaadvoorkoming, gesundheidsbevordering en insluiting van persone met gestremdhede. Ondersteun by die reël en koördinering van Sport- en ontspanningsaktiwiteite. Skakel tussen DSRAC en sport- en ontspanningsstrukture en DoE. Stel verslae op, registreer atlete in sport- en ontspanningskole, sentrums en klubs wat aan sport- en ontspanningsaktiwiteite deelneem. Stel behoefteontledings op en voer data in. Ondersteun by die verkrygingsproses.

zu.title: Isivumelwano sokufunda ngaphansi: Sport & Recreation
zu.summary: Iminyaka yeminyaka emibili ekuqashweni ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sokusebenza ezindaweni ze-sport and recreation eGqeberha, idinga idiploma noma idigri ekuphathweni kwamasuntshu noma enzululwazi lokunyakaza komzimba.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 6 equ to National Diploma / Degree, NQF Level 6 in Sport Management / Human Movement Science. Ukuqonda i-National Sport and Recreation Plan kuyoba yinzuzo. Kumele abe noqonda ngemvelo/inqunqe ye-Sport and Recreation kuleyo Nelsom Mandela Bay. Amakhono amahle okwethula, okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkulu. Amakhono ekhomphyutha. Kumele ube ngumakadebonke waseNingizimu Afrika. Kumele kungabi namaphoyisa okungenwa esikhungweni. Abafake izicelo kumele bengasebenzi futhi bengakaze bakhomunyuke enkqazweni yabafundi abasebenza ngaphansi kwesivumelwano.
zu.duties: Siza izigaba ezincane ze-Sport and Recreation ekuqweni nokuphathweni kwezinhlelo/emicimbo esifundeni. Qoqa idatha uze uhlanganise izibalo mayelana nezinhlelo/emicimbo ze-sport and recreation esifundeni. Sisa ekuletheni izinto ezidingekayo/izingubo ze-sport and recreation kubenefishari. Hlanganisa uhlu lwethimba. Xhumana nomphakathi/amaclub nabezikole mayelana nezidingo zohlelo lwe-sport and recreation nokuze kuhambisane nemithetho. Sisa ekuhlelweni kanye nokuquumbiswa kwemikhosi yomphakathi/amasu okuqeqesha namaphrojekthi ajwayelekile. Bukuda futhi uhlanganise idathabhesi yenhlolakulo nge-sport and recreation. Sisa izigaba ezincane ekuhleni izikedingo zanyanga zonke kanye nokuqoqweni kwemibhalo yesiqiniseko. Ukuxhumana koluntu kanye Nentuthuko: ukusebenzisa i-sport and recreation ekuthuthukisweni abasha, ekuvikweni ubugebengu, ekukhuthazweni kwempilo yomphakathi, nasekubandakanyeni abantu abakhubazekile. Sisa ekulungeniseni nasekuquumbisweni kwezinhlobonhlobo ze-sport and recreation. Xhumana phakathi kuka-DSRAC kanye nezakhiwo ze-sport and recreation kanye no-DoE. Hlela izikedingo, bhalisa abadlali ezikoleni ze-sport and recreation, emahobhu, nasezamaclub ezihlanganyelayo emicimbweni ye-sport and recreation. Bukuda isilinganiso sezidingo bese ufaka idatha. Sisa enkqazweni yokuthenga izinto ezidingekayo.

xh.title: Umatsha: Ulwazi lwezemidlalo neNgcibelelo
xh.summary: Inkqubo yomsebenzi wonyaka wama-24 ekulawulweni kwemidlalo nengcibelelo eGqeberha, ifuna idiploma okanye iziqondo zamabakala kulo lonke ulawulo lwezemidlalo okanye isayensi yokuwohloka komzimba.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Seziko Seziko SazA Sokuqala / Isatifikethi somatikheti / Igleyidi ye-12 eneDiploma Yezwe / Izinga elibekiweyo, inqanaba le-NQF le-6 kulo Lawulo Lwemidlalo / Isayensi Yokuwohloka Komzimba. Iqonda le Nkqubo Yezemidlalo neNgcibelelo Yezwe iya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Kufuneka abe noluqonde lukamo lwendawo/lingingqi lezemidlalo nengcibelelo ngaphakathi kweNelson Mandela Bay. Izakhono ezilungileyo zokubonisa, kolunye nothetho nokubhala. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngaphezulu. Izakhono zekhompyutha. Mmama-antjingalwandle waseMzantsi Afrika. Kufuneka angabi namabhaki amabhoshwana. Abafake izicelo kufuneka bengenamsebenzi kwaye bangazange bathathe inxaxheba kwinkqubo yomsebenzi wonyaka ngaphambili.
xh.duties: Nceda iindawu ezincinci zolwazi lwezemidlalo nengcibelelo ekulawulweni nakuphocebweni kweenkqubo/iiganeko kwelali. Qokeleza idatha und uqulunqe iindlela ezingezizo zelwazi zemidlalo nengcibelelo/iiganeko kwelali. Nceda ekuphatheni izixhobo/izingubo zemidlalo nengcibelelo kubanyuzezeleko. Qulunqe uluhlu loQqeba. Thetha noluntu/amasiko ncese kwimfuneko zomthetho nengqwalasela yolwazi lwemidlalo nengcibelelo. Nceda kwityaliswa lamakhosi loluntu/amasiko ekolunye neenkqubo ezikhetekileyo. Phuhlisa uqulunqe ulwazi lwezemidlalo nengcibelelo. Nceda iindawo ezincinci ekuqulunqeni iingxelo zanyanga zohlelo nasekuqokelelweni kofakelo lobungqina. Ukunyaniseka koluntu noPhuhliso: ukusebenzisa izemidlalo nengcibelelo ekuphuhliseni abutsha, ekuthinteni kweakhalathi, ekugqamiseni impilo, ekuhlangenweni nabantu abakhubazekileyo. Nceda ekulungiseleleni nasekuhlanganiseni izemidlalo nengcibelelo. Thetha phakathi koDSRAC nobuliso bemidlalo nengcibelelo kwaye noDoE. Qulunqe iingxelo, bhalisa abatshaji kwimiddala yemidlalo nengcibelelo, kumathuba, nakumasiko athatha inxaxheba kwiiganeko zemidlalo nengcibelelo. Qulunqe uhlalutyo lwezidingo uze ufake idatha. Nceda inkqubo yokuzele.

af.title: Intern: Museums & Heritage
af.summary: 'n 24-maande internskap in museum- en erfenisbestuur, met bystand by erfenisbronprojekte, die bevordering van kulturele toerisme, en die aanbied van gebeure.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Matrieksertifikaat/Graad 12 met 'n Nasionale Diploma of Graad (NQF Level 06 soos erken deur SAQA) in Toerismebestuur/Geskiedenis/Sosiale Wetenskappe. af.duties: Bystand verleen met die implementering van projekte wat gemik is op die identifisering, bewaring en bestuur van erfenisbronne. Bystand verleen met die skep van gemeenskapsbewustheid en die ontwikkeling van strategieë om die beskerming en behoorlike bestuur van erfenisbronne te bevorder.

zu.title: I-Intern: Amamineuziyamu & Amasiko Okufanele Agcinwe
zu.summary: I-internship yezinyanga ezingama-24 ekuphathweni kweminyuziyamu namasiko okufanele agcinwe, ukusiza kumaphrojekthi wamasiko okufanele agcinwe, ukuthuthukisa ukuvakasha emasikweni, kanye nokubamba imikhosi.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 with a National Diploma or Degree (NQF Level 06 as recognized by SAQA) in Tourism Management/History/Social Science. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Computer Literacy. Be a South African citizen. Must have no criminal record. Applicants must be unemployed and never participated in an internship programme previously.
zu.duties: Siza ekusebenzeni kwezinhlelo ezijwayele ukutholwa, ukugcinwa kanye nokuphathwa kwamasiko okufanele agcinwe. Sisa ekusebenzeni kwezinhlelo ezijwayele ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokuvakasha emasikweni. Sisa ekubamheni kwabezwe imihlangano yezinsuku ezibalulekile zomphakathi nemikhosi yamasiko emqoka. Sisa ekubukeni izindawo nezinto ezibalulekile emasikweni nasemlandweni esifundazweni ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi zisaphila futhi ziyakhula kulezo zindawo. Ukuthola, ukuthuthukisa futhi ukugqugquzela ulwazi olungabonakali ngemisoco yamasiko kanye nolwazi lwendabuko. Abantu abavela emakhaya abahleli kahle nomphakathi kufanele bazame ukubakhuthaza ukuthi bakhulume ngemvelo leyo ekhonza isifundazwe sonke. Siza ekubukeni izinto ezibalulekile emlandweni nasemakhaya ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi kulezo zindawo ezisukela emakhaya kuye esibayeni, abantu abadala emakhaya, izikhulu zendabuko kanye nalabo abasondelene nabo emasikweni nakwizinkolo kulezo zindawo. Sisa ekubukeni izinto ezibalulekile emlandweni kanye nalokho okufundwayo ezingeni elinguSenior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 noma iziqu ze-NQF Level 06 ezivunyiwe yi-SAQA kumongo wezokuvakasha, kulelo zinga elithi Tourism Management/History/Social Science. Abantu abathanda ukuba yingxenye yalesi sikhundla kumele bakhulume kahle nathi, futhi bakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Abantu abafuna lesi sikhundla kumele babe ngabakwa-South African citizen abangabi namacala. Abantu abafuna lesi sikhundla kumele babe ngabangaqashwa ngabantu futhi bengaze baba yingxenye yalolu hlobo luhle olwazi ukuthi sikhona ngaphambilini.

xh.title: Umzobi: Iimvulandlela & Ifa leNkcubeko
xh.summary: Inkqubo yokungenwa emsebenzini yonyaka we-24 kwindawo yolawulo lweemvulandlela nefa lenkcubeko, ukuncedisa kwimiprojekthi zemithombo yelifa lenkcubeko, ukukhuthaza ithal yabakhenkethi yenkcubeko, nasekuqukeni iiganeko.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sokuQhelaniswa lesiXhosa esiqinisekisiweyo/iSatifikethi seMatric/IsiGredyeshi 12 ngeDiploma yesiLwazi okanye iNqanaba leQeqeshe (iNqanaba le-NQF Level 06 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA) kwiLawulo loThal wabakhenkethi/Imbali/Izazinzulu; Amapapashi amnandi weThuba labantu abanako ukuzwilana. Ukuqonda ngokusebenzisa iKhompyutha. Kufuneka ube ngumZindi waMazantsi Afrika. Akufuneki ube nognogelo lwenobangela kwindawo efunwa isatifikethi sokungashwankatheliswa. Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe ngabantu abangasebenzanga baze babebekungazange bathathe inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokungenwa emsebenzini yabalimi phambi koku.
xh.duties: Uncedo ekusebenzeni iinkqubo ngeendlela ezikwazi ukubonakalisa iindawo zelifa lenkcubeko, nokuzalathisa. Uncedo ekuphuhlisweni iinkqubo ezijonge ekukhuthazeni ithal yabakhenkethi ekunyuswa kwexesha elidlulayo. Uncedo ekuqukeni iintsuku zesizwe neegqitho ezibalulekileyo ezingabakho zidlule. Uncedo ekuqwalaselweni iindawo namagumbi abalulekileyo ehlotyeni nenkcubeko kummandla. Ukuzalathisa, ukuphucula nakukhuthaza iziko elingabonwa ngamehlo lolwazi olwaziwayo lwesiXhosa. Ukuqondisa inkqubo yokwomeleza ubudlelwane namadoda abalawula, izikhosi, namakhosi ezinkolo kwilixa ngokubandakanya abantu abathe xaxhi ekuwohlokeni. Ukunikela iinkqubo zolawulo ngokubanzi eflikisini kwindawo efunekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba iliza lisebenza ngokupheleleyo nelidlala indawo ephumelelayo kwindawo. Uncedo ekwazisweni kombandela nakuphuhliseni iindlela ezikwazi ukukhusela nokulawula ngokufanelekileyo iindawo zelifa lenkcubeko.

af.summary: Afgestudeerde internskap in behuisingsontwikkeling by die Department of Human Settlements in Bloemfontein, wat 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie in stedelike of streeksbeplanning vereis.

af.duties: Die volgende take sal uitgevoer word: die Kandidaat sal ondersteuning bied rakende die evaluering en monitering van navorsingsprojekte wat deur die Departement uitgevoer word; om die skryf van verslae te vergemaklik deur inligting uit verskeie databasisse te onttrek en te ontleed; om departementele werksessies by te woon om die goeie werking van die departement en sy programme te verseker; om verenigbaarheid met die jongste riglyne en regulasies wat deur die departement uitgevaardig is, te verseker; om die nodige korrespondensie te doen wat verband hou met die werksaamhede van die Program vir die Ontwikkeling van Menslike Nedersettings; om interne en eksterne organisatoriese aktiwiteite te vergemaklik; om administratiewe ondersteuning rakende die Volhoubare Menslike Nedersettings-ontwikkelingsprogram en verwante programme te verskaf; om departementele argiefpraktyke en protokolle na te kom; om gehalteversekering in te bou by die volledige implementering van die programme wat deur die werknemer uitgevoer word; om te verseker dat die jongste aanbiedingsgegewers en analitiese inligting wat deur die departement ontwikkel is, gebruik word in die uitoefening van die werknemer se pligte; om enige ander take te verrig soos deur die toesighouer van tyd tot tyd aangedui.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Macro-economic Analysis
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for macro-economic analysis at Provincial Treasury in Johannesburg, requiring an Honours degree in Economics or Finance plus three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Relevant tertiary qualification in Economics/Econometrics/ Finance at NQF level 8 e.g. Honours Degree. 3 years functional experience in Economics or Finance and/ or related fields. Knowledge and understanding of MFMA, Treasury regulations, accounting principles, and PFMA.
jobs.duties: To determine and evaluate economic parameters and socio- economic parameters and imperatives within the provincial and macro-economic context. Analyse key economic variables their interrelations and relevance for the budget. Perform periodic analysis, maintenance and update of provincial socio- economic indicators and conduct research which contributes to departmental publications. Support the Deputy Director by producing chapters in the research publications of the Macro-Economic Analysis unit. Perform econometric modelling for research and provide economic information to meet ad hoc requests. Support the Budget Management unit by researching and submitting contributions to the economic section of the Estimates of Provincial Receipts and Expenditure (EPRE). Perform econometric modelling for research, analysis and forecasting of trends to inform policy makers of the potential future impact of their decisions and the unfolding events in the economy. Remain abreast with all economic trends both locally and internationally so that the impact of these on the provincial economy can be anticipated.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Baleseng Sedibe – email: baleseng.sedibe@gauteng.gov.za

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Makro-ekonomiese Analise
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir makro-ekonomiese analise by Provinsiale Tesourie in Johannesburg, wat 'n Honneursgraad in Ekonomie of Finansies plus drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie in Ekonomie/Ekonometrie/Finansies op NQF-vlak 8 bv. Honneursgraad. 3 jaar funksionele ervaring in Ekonomie of Finansies en/of verwante velde. Kennis en begrip van MFMA, Tesourieregulasies, rekeningkundige beginsels en PFMA.
af.duties: Bepaal en evalueer ekonomiese parameters en sosio-ekonomiese parameters en imperatiewe binne die provinsiale en makro-ekonomiese konteks. Analiseer sleutel ekonomiese veranderlikes hul onderlinge verhoudings en relevansie vir die begroting. Voer periodieke analise, onderhoud en opdatering van provinsiale sosio-ekonomiese aanwysers uit en doen navorsing wat bydra tot departementele publikasies. Ondersteun die Adjunkdirekteur deur hoofstukke in die navorsingspublikasies van die Makro-Ekonomiese Analise-eenheid te produseer. Voer ekonometriese modellering vir navorsing uit en verskaf ekonomiese inligting om ad hoc-versoeke te beantwoord. Ondersteun die Begrotingsbestuur-eenheid deur navorsing te doen en bydraes tot die ekonomiese afdeling van die Skattings van Provinsiale Inkomste en Uitgawes (EPRE) in te dien. Voer ekonometriese modellering vir navorsing, analise en vooruitskatting van tendense uit om beleidmakers in te lig oor die potensiële toekomstige impak van hul besluite en die ontvouende gebeure in die ekonomie. Bly op hoogte van alle ekonomiese tendense beide plaaslik en internasion sodat die impak daarvan op die provinsiale ekonomie vooruit gesien kan word.

zu.title: Umsekeli Nomphathi: Ukuhlaziya amabanga amakhulu wezomnotho
zu.summary: Umsekeli Nomphathi wokuhlaziya amabanga amakhulu wezomnotho e Provincial Treasury e Johannesburg, ofuna iziqu ze-Honours kwezomnotho noma kwezemali kanye neminyaka emithathu yemvelaphi ehambisana nalokhu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziphathelene nezomnotho/iziNani/Ezemali ezingeni le-NQF level 8 njenge-Honours Degree. 3 iminyaka yemvelaphi yomsebenzi kwezomnotho noma izemali kanye/noma emikhakheni ehlobene nalokhu. Ukwazi futhi kuqonde i-MFMA, imithetho ye-Treasury, izimiso zokubala imali, kanye ne-PFMA.
zu.duties: Ukuquma futhi uhlolothe izinkomba zezomnotho kanye nezinkomba kanye nezidingo zenhlalo-omnotho ngaphakathi kwesigungu sombuso wesifundazwe kanye nesimo sezomnotho samabanga amakhulu. Hlaziya izinto eziyinhloko zezomnotho kanye nobudlelwano bazo kanye nokuqakatheka kwazo kumasabelomali. Yenza ukuhlaziya okuvundlile, ukugcinwa kanye nokubuyekezwa kwezinkomba zenhlalo-omnotho zesifundazwe futhi ube ucwaningo oluncedayo ekushicilelweni kweminyango. Sekela i-Deputy Director ngokubhala izingxenye ezishicilelwayo zocwaningo equkethe i-Macro-Economic Analysis unit. Yenza ukumodela nge-econometrics ngenhloso yocwaningo futhi nikeze ulwazi ngezomnotho ukuze kwaphulukelwe nezicelo ezingazange zibhekwe. Sekela i-Budget Management unit ngokucwaninga futhi ungenise izinto ezingene izingxenye zezomnotho ze-Estimates of Provincial Receipts and Expenditure (EPRE). Yenza ukumodela nge-econometrics ngenhloso yocwaningo, ukuhlaziya kanye nokubikezela phambili kwamaqondo ukuze uxwayise ababeni-mthetho ngesiphithiphithi esingaba khona ngokusasa kwezinqumo zabo nakwezehla-philayo kwezomnotho. Gcina ulwazi lwamanje ngeqhaza elikhulu nangamabanga amakhulu wezomnotho yomhlaba wonke ukuze kuthi isiphithiphithi salokhu kumnotho wesifundazwe kuba kuhlakaniphwe.

xh.title: Umncedisi weSikhululi: Uhlolojlobo lwezolimo-mthethwe-nkqubo ezinkqubweni ezikhulu zezoqoqosho
xh.summary: Umncedisi weSikhululi wokuhlolojlobo lwezolimo-mthethwe-nkqubo ezinkqubweni ezikhulu zezoqoqosho e Provincial Treasury e Johannesburg, ifuna izidanga zamabanga aphakamileyo kwi Economics okanye i Finance kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava ahambelana nalenxa.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo samabanga aphakamileyo kwi Economics/Econometrics/ Finance kwinqanaba le NQF level 8 umzekelo izidanga zamabanga aphakamileyo. I 3 years yamava omsebenzi kwi Economics okanye i Finance kwaye noma/o kwezinye iindawo ezinxulumene nayo. Ulwazi nakuqonda kuka MFMA, iimithetho ye Treasury, iingcali ezilawula iimali, nakwi PFMA.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba nokuhlola imilinganiselo yezoqoqosho nemiqathango nezinyanzelo zezenzululwazi-ntlalontle ngaphakathi kwezolimo-mthethwe-nkqubo ezinkqubweni nasenkqubweni ngenkqubo ezinkqubeni ezinkulu zezoqoqosho. Ukuhlola iiguqulo ezingundoqo zezoqoqosho kwaye zihlobene kwakunye nendima yawo kubujimo. Ukwenza uhlolojlobo nxesha-nxesha, ukugcina nokuhlaziya iinkomba zolimo-mthethwe-nkqubo ngenkqubela-phambili yezidolophu kwaye wenze uphando oluncedo kumaphepha-ndaba esebe. Ukuxhasa uSekela Mongameli ngokubhiyazela amanqaku kumaphepha-ndaba ophando kwindlu ehlolojwayo i Macro-Economic Analysis. Ukwenza ukulinganisa ngokwemithetho ye-mlinganiselo wezoqoqosho ngenjongo yophando kwaye unikeze ulwazi lwezoqoqosho ukwazisa iimfuno ezingazange zicetywe kwaye naziwe ngaphambili. Ukuxhasa le ndlu ephatha amaBajeti ngokwenza uphando kwaye uzinike izityalelo kunye nezinyikima ezikwindawo ye-Economics yamagama e Estimates of Provincial Receipts and Expenditure (EPRE). Ukwenza ukulinganisa ngokwemithetho yomlinganiselo wezoqoqosho ngenjengo yophando uhlolojlobo nokuqamba iindikimba zangomso ukuze abantu abakha iinkqubo-mthethwe-nkqubo bakwazi ukulindela iimpembelelo zexesha elizayo ezinokuthi zibakho ngenxa yezigqibo ezithathiweyo nemiqaqo evelayo kwizolimo-mthethwe-nkqubo. Ukuhlala ufunde nazi zonke iindikimba kwezolimo-mthethwe-nkqubo kule ndawo nakwelinye ilizwe jikelele ukuze iimpembelelo zazo kwizolimo-mthethwe-nkqubo yendawo zinokuthi ziboniswe kwaye zilungelwe ngaphambi kokuba zize.

Ukutholwa unyaka wez-3-5 kumsebenzi wokuphathwa kwenqwaba yezinsizakalo. Izakhiwo: Izaziso nezinkomba ze-National Treasury; Inqubo yokuzeza izinsizakalo, izimiso zomthetho wezinkontileka/ izinqubo; Izimiso zokulawula kwesevisi yomphakathi, ukuphathwa kwezimali; Ukuhlaziya nokwakhiwa kwezinqubo, ukuhumusha komthetho. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Bambisisezi nemibono ekufanele, ziqinise ukuqapha nokubhekana nezimali. Hlaziya izibika ze-UIF&W futhi uhlole ukubuyela kabili kwezengozi zokuhambisana nomthetho kwe-SCM. Zwana nabasimame ngendlela ekufanele yakho nokuthatha izinyathelo zokuhambisana nemithetho. Siza abasimame ekuxazululeni izinkinga zokubika kwe-SCM. Gcina izibika zokuhambisana nomthetho kanye namabhangi wamazwana ahamba kanjalo-ke ngenzuzo ezingaphezu kwesikhathi. Hlela izibika zenyanga ngenyanga ngekhota ngeminyaka yonke ngokuqinisekileko mayelana nezinsiza ezifanele. Siza abasimame ekugcineni izinqubo zokuphathwa kwemithetho ye-National Supply Chain Management (SCM) kanye nezinkomba ezifaneleko. Hlela izibika zokuqinisa izincomo ongazikhethula ezingathunyelwa kubaphathi ukuthi bazibuke. Bambisana no-Finance uthuthukiswe izindleko futhi zibuyekeze imibuzo ephendulwayo.

Qeqesha izakhamuzi ngendlela zokulungisa nokulandelwa imigaqo. Nceda izakhamuzi ngeengxaki zokubika i SCM. gcina iinkcukacha zangoku neenkqubo zokuthotyelwa imigaqo ze SCM. Qinisekisa ukuba iimpendulo zenziwa kwixa elibekwe ngokumiselwa. Qamba iinkcazelo nyanga nenyanga nethoba kwikota ngenkcazelo ye SCM. Nceda izakhamuzi ekubeni zikwazi ukuyilawula ngokufanelekileyo iinkqubo zokulawula iinkqubo ne nkqubo yolawulo. Lukatha amanqaku nemiqathango nayo yonke imihla nangaphezulu kuyo nayidibana nawo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: VIP and Pool
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed in Koedoespoort to administer VIP and pool vehicle bookings, chauffeur services and transport requests at salary level 9.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Degree/Diploma in Transportation Management / Fleet Management / Logistics / Finance / Business Administration. 3 – 5 years’ experience in fleet management and knowledge in office administration. Driving license as an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Administer requests from VIP and Pool clients: Manage the booking of chauffeur and VIP services. Verify the booking form signed by the delegated transport officer/manager/financial official as per the transport policy. Confirm the availability of the requested vehicle as per the request. Manage the client department to provide an authorised trip authorisation form (Z606) and driver’s license for the collection of vehicle/s. Monitor vehicles allocated to staff. Resolve all queries within acceptable time frame. Facilitate contract administration of short-term rentals: Manage all contracts as prescribed by entity. Approve contracts on Financial Information System. Verify that VIP section is completed on the application form and on the active contracts. Monitor records of daily contract activities. Send letters to clients whose contracts are about to expire and put them to the terms of the contract. Manage the cancellation of contract by the client. Manage the Fleet Management System for chauffeurs: Schedule drivers for chauffer services on Fleet Management System. Monitor and report the status of chauffeur bookings and vehicles allocated to officials. Compile Financial Information System reports and submit vehicle tracking reports timeously. Develop and facilitate the implementation of policies and procedures: Participate in the development, review and implementation of policies and standard operating procedures. Compliance with all relevant departmental legislation, policies and procedures. Improve accuracy in service delivery. Filling of VIP and POOL reports and approved contracts. Submit monthly and quarterly reports on agreed time frames. Supervise staff (Human/equipment/Assets): Keep proper filing for all records. Manage staff work attendance including leave. Manage performance of staff (Implement Performance Management Development System) Implement and manage Facilities processes, procedures and systems. Compile operational planning for the team. Facilitate staff development.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Precious Maimela Tel No: (011) 345 – 1538
jobs.applications: must be submitted online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za alternatively email to gFleeTRecruitment@gauteng.gov.za. For general enquiries please conduct Human Resources on 010 345 1538.
jobs.notes: It is our intention to promote representative (Race, Gender, and Disability) in the Public Service through the filling of this post. Applications must be submitted on form Z83(effective 01 January 2021), obtainable from any public service department or on internet at www.dpsa.gov.za /documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each application for employment form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialled by the applicant. Failure to fully complete, initial and sign this form may lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. A fully completed, initialled, and signed new form Z83 (Section A, B, C and D compulsory and (Section E, F and G ignore if CV attached) and a detailed CV is required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents not older than six months on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. NB: If you do not receive any response within 3 months, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. No faxed, post or hand delivered, and late applications will be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (positive Identity, qualification, fraud listing, employment reference, and criminal record verification as well as the required level of security clearance process). The logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. Department reserves the right not to make appointment to the advertised post.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: VIP en Swembad
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur benodig in Koedoespoort om VIP- en swembadvoertuigbesprekings, bestuurderdienste en vervoerversoeke te administreer op salaris vlak 9.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Graad/Diploma in Vervoerbestuur / Vlootbestuur / Logistiek / Finansies / Besigheidsadministrasie. 3 – 5 jaar se ervaring in vlootbestuur en kennis van kantooradministrasie. Bestuurderslisensie as 'n bykomende voordeel.
af.duties: Administreer versoeke van VIP- en Swembadkliente: Bestuur die bespreking van bestuurder- en VIP-dienste. Verifieer dat die besprekingsvorm deur die gedelegeerde vervoerbeampte/bestuurder/finansiële amptenaar onderteken is ooreenkomstig die vervoerbeleid. Bevestig die beskikbaarheid van die aangevraagde voertuig ooreenkomstig die versoek. Bestuur die klientdepartement om 'n gemagtigde reismagtigingsvorm (Z606) en bestuurderslisensie te verskaf vir die afhaal van voertuig/voertuie. Monitor voertuie aan personeel toegewys. Los alle navrae binne aanvaarbare tydsraamwerk op. Fasiliteer kontrakadministrasie van korttermynhuur: Bestuur alle kontrakte soos voorgeskryf deur entiteit. Keur kontrakte op Finansiële Inligtingstelsel goed. Verifieer dat die VIP-afdeling op die aansoekvorm en op die aktiewe kontrakte voltooi is. Monitor rekords van daaglikse kontrakaktiwiteite. Stuur briewe aan kliente wie se kontrakte op die punt staan om te verval en bring hulle onder die terme van die kontrak. Bestuur die kansellasie van kontrakte deur die klient. Bestuur die Vlootbestuurstelsel vir bestuurders: Skeduleer drywers vir bestuurderdienste op Vlootbestuurstelsel. Monitor en rapporteer die status van bestuurderbesprekings en voertuie aan beamptes toegewys. Stel Finansiële Inligtingstelselverslae op en dien voertuigopsporingsverslae betyds in. Ontwikkel en fasiliteer die implementering van beleide en prosedures: Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling, hersiening en implementering van beleide en standaardbedryfsprosedures. Voldoening aan alle relevante departementele wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Verbeter akkuraatheid in dienslewering. Invul van VIP- en Swembadverslae en goedgekeurde kontrakte. Dien maandelikse en kwartaalverslae ooreenkomstig ooreengekome tydsraamwerke in. Hou toesig oor personeel (Menslike/Toerusting/Bates): Hou behoorlike lêerwerk vir alle rekords. Bestuur personeel se werkbywoning insluitend verlof. Bestuur prestasie van personeel (Implementeer Prestasiebestuurstelsel). Implementeer en bestuur Fasiliteitsprosesse, -prosedures en -stelsels. Stel operasionele beplanning vir die span op. Fasiliteer personeelontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umncedi Weziqu: I-VIP Nephulo Lemoto
zu.summary: Kudingeka umncedi weziqu eKoedoespoort ukuphatha ukubhuka kwezimoto ze-VIP nepulo, izinsizakalo zabashayeli nezicelo zokuthutha ezingeni leholo 9.
zu.requirements: I-Degree/Diploma efanele kwabathuthi / ePhulweni Lemoto / e-Logistics / e-Finance / e-Business Administration. Umbhalo ohamba phambathi 3 – 5 weminyaka kobuhle bokulawula imoto nolwazi ekuphathweni kohhovisi. Ilayisensi yokushayela njengento ephulukisa.
zu.duties: Phatha izicelo ezivela kubahlanganyeli be-VIP naphulo: Lawula ukubhuka kwezinsizakalo zabashayeli neze-VIP. Qinisekisa ukuthi ifomu lokubhuka lisayinwe umphathi wezokuthutha onikwe amandla/abaphathi/umphathi wezimali ngokomthetho wezokuthutha. Qinisekisa ukuthitha kwemoto etholwayo ngokwesicelo. Lawula umnyango wubahlanganyeli ukunikeza ifomu lesigunyaziso sesihambo (Z606) nelelayisensi yokushayela yokuthola imoto/ezimoto. Qapha imoto ezinikwe abasebenzi. Soxazula yonke imibuzo esikhathini esamukelekile. Khokhela ukuphathwa kwezenkonzo zasesikhathini esifushane: Lawula wonke amakontrathi njengokuqokwe yisikhungo. Vumela amakontrathi kusistimu yolwazi lwezimali. Qinisekisa ukuthi isigaba se-VIP sigcwele kufomu lokufaka isicelo nakwamakontrathi asebenzayo. Qaphela amarekhodi wansuku zonke wemisebenzi yekontrathi. Thumela amagwembe kubahlanganyeli abakontrathi abazosabela ukubuyiselwa futhi ubafundise ngamagama akontrathi. Lawula ukukhanselwa kwakontrathi ngumhlanganyeli. Lawula isistimu yophulo lemoto yabashayeli: Hlela abashayeli bezinsizakalo zokushayela kusistimu yophulo lemoto. Qaphela futhi uchaze isimo sokubhuka kwabashayeli nezimoto ezinikwe abaphathi. Hlela imibiko yesistimu yolwazi lwezimali futhi uhambise imibiko yokuqopha imoto ngesikhathi esifanele. Thuthukisa futhi ukhokhele ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo nezinhlelo: Yiba ngomunye wabathuthukisa, ababuyekeza futhi abasetenzisa izinqubo nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Hambisana nawo wonke umthetho, izinqubo nezinhlelo zomnyango. Thuthukisa ukuqinisekiswa kokulethwa kwensizakalo. Gcwalisa imibiko ye-VIP nepulo nakwamakontrathi avunyiwe. Hambisa imibiko yenyanga nenyanga neyesikhathi esithathu ngesikhathi esivunyiwe. Qapha abasebenzi (abantu/impahla/izimpahla): Gcina ukuhloba okuhle kwayo yonke imirekhodi. Lawula ukubakhona emsebenzini kwabasebenzi kuhlanganise nelivu. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi (setenzisa isistimu yokuthuthukiswa yokuphathwa kokusebenza) Setenzise futhi uphathe inqubo, izinhlelo nezisistimu zezinsiza. Hlela ukucwangciswa kwezokusebenza iqembu. Khokhela ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: i-VIP neQela leZithuthi
xh.summary: Kufuneka ugqithiswe umncedisi wengqophi-mthetho eKoedoespoort ukulawula ukubhalisa kwezithuthi ze-VIP nezeqela, iinkonzo zokuqhuba abakhenkethi, nezicelo zothutho kwinqanaba lemvuzo le-9.
xh.requirements: Izeyirhi/Diploma efanelekileyo kwiLawulo loThutho / uLawulo loQela leZithuthi / i-Logistics / izeMali / uLawulo lweShishini. 3 – 5 unyaka bemfundo ngokulinganisela kwilawulo leqela lezithuthi nolwazi kulawulo le-ofisi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela njengento eyongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Lawula izicelo ezivela kumXhasi we-VIP neQela: Lawula ukubhalisa kweekonzo zokuqhuba abakhenkethi neze-VIP. Qinisekisa ifomu yokubhalisa esayinwe ngumlawuli wothutho obekelweyo/umphathi/igqeba lemali njengoko kumalathiselwa ngumgaqo wothutho. Qinisekisa ukubakho kwesithuthi esiceliweyo njengoko celwa. Lawula isebe lemxhasi ukunika ifomu yegunya lohambo elamkelekileyo (Z606) nelayisenisi yokushayela ukuyokuqokelela isithuthi/isithuthi. Hlola izithuthi ezinikelwe abasebenzi. Sululusa yonke imibuzo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esamkelekileyo. Qhubeka nolawulo lweqela leenkonzo zemithesho yokuhira ixesha elifutshane: Lawula yonke imithesho njengoko kuchazwa ngumbutho. Vuma imithesho kwinkqubo yeZemali. Qinisekisa ukuba isigaba se-VIP sigqityiwe kwifomu yesicelo nakwimithesho esebenzayo. Hlala ulandela iirekhodi zemisebenzi yemithesho yemihla ngemihla. Thumela iileta kubaxhasi benkqabo yabo ethi iphele kwaye ubafake kwemiqathango yemithesho. Lawula ukuhoxiswa kwemithesho ngumxhasi. Lawula inkqubo yoLawulo loQela leZithuthi kubaqhubi abakhenkethi: Lungiselela abaqhubi bekonzo yokukhenketha inkqubo yoLawulo loQela leZithuthi. Hlala ujonga ukuze waxece ixabiso lokubhalisa kubaqhubi abakhenkethi nezithuthi ezinikelwe abasebenzi. Hlanganisa iirekhodo zeNkqubo yeZemali uze udlulise iirekhodo zokulandela izithuthi ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Phezulu nokwenza kusebenza iinkqubo nemigaqo: Thatha inxaxheba kwakhiwo, ukuphonononga nokwenza kusebenza iinkqabo nemigaqo yokusebenza esemgangathweni. Khothelelana kunye namagazethi womthetho, iinkqabo nemigaqo yesebe. Phezulu ukuchaneka ekunikeleni ngenkonzo. Gqiba iirekhodo ze-VIP nezeQela kwakunye nemithesho evunyiweyo. Dlulisa iingxelo zenyanga nentsalu kwiixesha ezivunyiweyo. Lawula abasebenzi (Abantu/izixhobo/iSixhobo): Phatha ukugcinwa kweenkqabcadi ngokuchanekileyo. Lawula ukubakho kwabasebenzi emsebenzini kubandakanya inkqubo yamalungelo. Lawula inkqabo yabasebenzi (Yenza kusebenze inkqabo yoLawulo lwaBasebenzi). Yenza kusebenze ulawulo lweenkqubo, iinkqubo neenjongo zeZiseko. Hlanganisa ulungiselelo lomsebenzi lokuqhuba iqela. Phatha phambili ukuzinza kwabasebenzi.

af.title: Regsondersteuningsbeampte (MR5): Regsadvies
af.summary: Regsondersteuningsbeampte wat regsadvies lewer, die departement in verrigtinge verteenwoordig en PAIA-, PAJA- en POPIA-nakoming by die Johannesburg-hoofkantoor verseker.

Voer 'n data-inventaris uit om te bepaal watter persoonlike inligting verwerk word, waar dit gestoor word en met wie dit gedeel word. zu.title: IOfisa Yokuphathwa Kwezomthetho (MR5): Imibono Yomthetho
zu.summary: IOfisa Yokuphathwa Kwezomthetho esinika imibono yomthetho, esimela umnyango ezinkundleni, futhi esiqinisekisa ukuzithobela kwe-PAIA, PAJA ne-POPIA eOfisini Elikhulu elise-Johannesburg.

Yenza isibalokhulu sedatha ukuze kutholwe ukuthi yiphi imininingwane yomuntu siqu eqashwa, igcinwa kuphi, kanti yabelwa nobani. Zifeze izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zokuvikela idatha, okuhlanganisa isaziso esiphelele sobumfihlo, ohlelo lokugcina idatha kanye ngezinqubo zokubhujisa ngokuphephile. Zive esinkantolo, hole ubufakazi bese ukhetha izinkulumo-mpikiswano zomthetho. Qamba futhi unikeze izinkulumo-mpikiswano zomthetho ezethembisayo ejaji noma emajistratsheni. nikeza usizo/imibono yomthetho kumnyango cwaninge ukusetshenziswa kwezimiso zomthetho kumibono yomthetho cula imibuzo okumele iphendulwe kumibono yomthetho, funde futhi ucaphune izimoto ezihlobene nezindaba ezithinta imibono yomthetho, phendula ezindabeni zemibono yomthetho ezivela ngesikhathi kwabezimiso zomphakathi nasenkundleni yePhalamende, xoxa nabanjiniyeni abahambisana nomsebenzi Nikeza usizo ngokusomba ukuze kugwenywe izindleko zomthetho ezingadingekile. Cwaninge ngogaxa olusha ngezigaba zomthetho.

xh.title: I-Ofisa yoLawulo loMthetho (MR5): IMbonakaliso yoMthetho
xh.summary: I-Ofisa yoLawulo loMthetho enika iimbonakaliso zomthetho, imela isebe kwiinkqubo, kwaye iqinisekisa ukuthobela i-PAIA, i-PAJA ne-POPIA kwiJohannesburg Head Office.
xh.duties: Nikeza imeko yomthetho egqwesileyo kwisebe, Bhala iimbonakaliso zomthetho zesebe, Mela isebe kwicala leentsapho zemithetho, Nikeza inkxaso yomthetho jikelele nokuthobela i-PAIA, i-PAJA ne-POPIA. Yenza uluhlu lwedata ukuze uqonde ukuba yiphi iinkcukacha zobuqu ezisetyenziswayo, ziyaphi ezigcinwa, kwaye zabelwa nabani. Zisebenzisa iinkqubo nemigaqo yokhuselo lwedata, kuquka isaziso esibanzi sobumfihlo, iinkqubo zokugcina idatha, kunye nenkqubo yokutshatyalaliswa okukhuselekileyo. Bonakala enkundleni, yenza ishishini njengenxeba lakhona kunye nokubonelela nemiyo yomthetho. Qamba unikeze imiyo yomthetho ethembisayo kumantyi okanye kumantyi wesigqeba. Nikela ngengcebiso/umbono womthetho kwiSebe phanda ukusebenziseka kwemiqathango yomthetho kuMbono womthetho yenza imibuzo ekufuneka iphendulwe kwiimbonakaliso zomthetho, funda uze ucaphule ecaleni ngemiba enxulumene neembonakaliso zomthetho, phendula kumiba emayela nombono womthetho owavela ngelixa lokuva koluntu kunye neenkqubo zepalamente, welulelana nomsebenzi onxulumeneyo ngokusesikweni Cebisa ngentsebenziswano ukuze kugqitywe isigqibo ukuze kugqithiswe iindleko zomthetho ezingafunekiyo. Phanda ngenkululeko yamva nje kumashishino omthetho.

zu.title: Chief Director: Human Resource Management and

jobs.title: Director: Human Resource Administration
jobs.department: Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive remuneration package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services)
jobs.summary: Director of Human Resource Administration at the Department of Cooperative Governance in Pietermaritzburg, requiring a bachelor's degree and five years of managerial HR experience.
jobs.requirements: The ideal candidate must be in possession of a Bachelors Degree/ NQF Level 7 qualification in Human Resource Management field as recognised by SAQA coupled with at least 5 years middle/senior managerial experience in a Human Resource environment, as well as an SMS Pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) as offered by the National School of Government (NSG) (Certificate submitted prior to appointment) and a valid Drivers licence. Essential Knowledge, Skills And Competencies Required: The successful candidate must have:- Sound knowledge of the RSA Constitution; Public Service Act; Public Service Regulations; Public Finance Management Act; Labour Relations Act; Employee Performance and Management System; Basic Conditions of Employment Act; Project Management Principles; Millennium development goals; Youth development policy; National and Provincial practice notes; Supply Chain management practices and procedures; Promotion of Access to Information Act; Service Delivery frameworks; Promotion of Administration Justice Act; Skills Development Act; Human Resource Development strategy of South Africa; National Skills Development Strategy; National Development Plan; Provincial Growth and Development Plan; Treasury Regulations; KZN Citizens Charter; Occupational Health and Safety Act; Intergovernmental matters; Ministerial Handbook; Protocol manual of South Africa; Promotion of Equality and Prevention of Unfair Discrimination Act and any other relevant Act/Legislative mandates; language skills; listening skills; presentation skills; analytical thinking; interpersonal relations; strategic planning skills; organisational skills; research skills; analytical skills; leadership skills; financial Management skills; time Management skills; report writing skills; problem solving skills; conflict management skills; change management skills; self discipline and able to work under pressure with minimum supervision; project management skills; people management skills; relationship management; decision making; facilitation skills; risk management skills; strategic direction; Good communication skills (verbal & written) with staff and management, other departments and private sector organisations, educational institutions, and good computer literacy in MS Office.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be required to manage an efficient Human Resource Administration services within the department with the following responsibilities: Manage and ensure the provision of recruitment, selection and other life cycle event of employees; Manage the conditions of services and remuneration matters of employees; Manage the human resource management information systems; Develop policies, procedures and strategies aimed at improving service delivery within the municipal administration environment and Manage the resources of the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Dlamini Tel No: (033) 260 8058
jobs.applications: To be posted to: The Chief Director, Human Resource Management & Development, Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Private Bag X9078, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Hand Delivered To: The Chief Registry Clerk, 2nd Floor, South Tower, Natalia, 330 Langalibalele Street, Pietermaritzburg. Applications received after this date will not be accepted. Applicants can also submit their Z83 and CV via e-Recruitment System on www.eservices.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms E Perumal
jobs.notes: To Applicants: Applications must be submitted on the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) available from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV. The Department discourages applications sent by registered mail and will not be held responsible for applications sent via registered mail which are not collected from the post office. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application reaches the Department timeously. Failure to comply with any instruction will disqualify applicants. Applicants can also submit their Z83 and CV via e- Recruitment System on www.eservices.gov.za.Appointment is subject to a positive outcome on the following checks (Security Clearance, Citizenship, qualification verification, criminal records, credit records and previous employment). Faxed or late applications will not be accepted. Should applicants not receive any response from the Department within three months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to empowering people with a disability. OTHER POSTS
