zu.requirements: Umphilisi ofanele kumele abe nesiquephuma se-Degree / NQF Level 7 se Bachelor's Degree / NQF Level 7 ukuphatwa kwamasipala / ukuphatwa kabantu / uhulumeni basezingeni lethu / / ukuqashwa kwezihwebi njengoba kunikwa isibephu yi-SAQA, kanye namava anjalo amalinganisela eminyaka emihlanu (5) ekuphateni abalawuli abaphakathi / abaphezulu emikhakheni yeminyango, njengenye nesitifikedi sokungena kwi-SMS (Nyukela) njengoba kunikezwa yi - National School of Government (NSG) (Isitifikedi kunikezwa phambi kokumiswa) kanye ne drivers licence (code 8). Uluhlwempolilelo, namakhono abalulekile okusebenza asabekwayo: Umphilisi ophumeleleyo kumele anamakhono:- Ulwazi olwengeziyo ngomgaqo-siseko wase-RSA; Umthetho wokuLawula Izinkalo ezahlukeneyo ezikumgaqo-siseko wase-2006 we Local Authorities; Umthetho wesikhashana ka-1974; umthetho wesikhashana ka-2006; umthetho wolawulo kolunye ulwazi lwesikhathi; izimiso zomsebenzi kabantu poholwa ngomthetho; umthetho wokwamkela izinduna zomthetho; umthetho wokulawula iinkundla zentengiso; umthetho wokulawula iinkundla zomthetho wolawulo lwezonyango; iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zelungiselelo lolawulo; ulwazi ngemithetho yesikhathi; ukulawula imigqaqo yomthetho; iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zokwamkelwa kolunye ulwazi lwesikhathi; iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ze-municipal acts; ukwaziswa kwesikhathi; izindlu zokuzimisela; amandla okulawula iinkundla; ulwazi olujulile ngokwamkela kolunye ulwazi lolawulo lwezonyango; ulwazi lwemithetho yezomthetho yomasipala; ulwazi olujulile ngamathubana okusebenza komthetho wokulawula kolunye ulwazi lwemithetho yamasiko; ukwazi ukwenza izimiso zomthetho; ukuphatha amathuba okusebenza; iinkondlo zokusebenzela ezisemthethweni nakwamanye amaqumundu athile amathuba okusebenza kumnyango wezamaphakathi; iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza kolunye ulwazi; amandla okwenza izigqibo ezinhle; amandla okuqonda; ukusebenza ngokobuchwepheshe; nokulawula izinkalo ezahlukeneyo; nokwaziswa kwezimali, ukusebenzela ngokwerhashe, iinkomolo, iziqu zokubonakalisa kumabonakude, izinkondlo, ukulawula kolunye ulwazi lwesikhathi, ukuzimisela, amandla okulawula, ukwazi ukulawula iinkondlo, iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zelungiselelo lolawulo lwezonyango, iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zomthetho wokuqondisa kwabasebenzi, amandla okulawula, amandla okwakha amathuba, iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ngokwakha amathuba, ukulawula izindlu, ukulawula iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zokuzimisela, ukusebenzela kolunye ulwazi, iinkondlo, iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zomthetho, izinkalo ezahlukeneyo zolwazi lomthetho wokulawula.
zu.duties: Umphilisi ophumeleleyo kumele axhome enye yezinsizakalo ezingeyomthetho nokulawula izinsizakalo ezijulile kwezokuphatha kwezonyango, nokugcina izindlu ezihlala zinempumelelo kuzo zonke izinkondlo komasipala, ngokwaleyo ndlela azime ngayo izindlu ekulawuleni izinto ezibalulekile ezweni ngaphandle kwengxenye yezomthetho.

xh.title: UmLawuli: Ukulawula KoMasipala
xh.summary: UmLawuli Wokulawula KoMasipala ophethe iinkonzo zenkampani neendaba ezisemthethweni zolawulo kuzo onke amaMasipala eKwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umgcini abe neDegree yeBachelors / NQF Level 7 kwizifundo ezinjengoKulawula KoMasipala / Ukulawula Kwentlalo / URhululelo Wasedolophini / Ukulawula Koshishino njengokuvunywe yi-SAQA, akhokelelwe nokuba nabaphela iminyaka engu-5 yamava abuphathi aphakathi / aphezulu kwimeko yokulawula koMasipala, kananjalo nesatifikhephe yokungena ngaphambili ye-SMS (Nyukela) enikezelwa yi-National School of Government (NSG) (isatifikhehte sifakelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni) nelayisensi esemthethweni yokushayela (code 8). Iimfuno eziyimfuneko, amakhono nemisebenzi efuneka: Kufuneka ophumeleyo abe nayo:- Ulwazi olugqithisileyo ngoMgaqo-siseko weRSA; Umthetho wezohlelo lukaMasipala; Umthetho wase-KZN wokuBaziswa nokuTshisa izidumbu, ka-2006; UMthetho wamaGunya eDolophini, ka-1974; UMthetho wokuGcina izilwanyana e-KZN, ka-2006; Umthetho weRhululelo yaseKwindla; Izicwangciso zabasebenzi beRhululelo yaseKwindla; Umthetho WabezeNkonzo zeRhululel; Irecalu zeNkonzo zeRhululelo; Umthetho woLawulo lweMali lweRhululelo; Umthetho weMibuso yeMisebenzi; Inkqubo yokulawula nokuqonda ngemigaqo yemisebenzi; Umthetho woLawulo lweMali lukaMasipala; Imigaqo yokulawula iiprojekthi; IziNhloso zentukuthelwano yawo onke amawaka; Iimpembelelo zenkqubo yentlalo yakwakhulu amawaka onke ekwakha ilali; Icwangciso lweNkonzo eZikummandla wakowonke nawo onke amawaka; Iindlela zokuqhuba izinto ngokubonelela; Iindlela neenkqubo ezikwinkqubo yokuHlinzekwa ziMbuyekezo nokwenza iinkonzo; Umthetho wokuQashela ekwaziseni ngokufikelela ulwazi; amakhono olimi; amakhono okulalela; amakhono okubonisa; ukucinga ngokwahlulelana; iintlanganiso zabantu; amakhono okucwangcisa ngokusoloko uqamba; amakhono abakowonke; amakhono okuphonononga; ukucinga ngokwahlulelana; amakhono okuba ngumlawuli; amakhono okulawula imali; amakhono okulawula isithuba; amakhono okubhala iingxelo; amakhono okusombulula iingxaki; amakhono okulawula ukungavani; amakhono okulawula uku-tshintsha, amakhono okulawula iiprojekthi; amakhono okulawula abantu; ukulawula iintlanga-ntlanganiso; ukwenza isigqibo; Amakhono amaninzi okuthetha nokubhala (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo) namaMasipala, abasebenzi besebe kwi-SALGA, namakhono amaninzi okusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office.
xh.duties: Umgcini ophumeleyo uya kufuneka abe ngumlawuli woxhaso nokuqikelelo kweenkonzo zenkampani nendaba ezisemthethweni zolawulo ngaphakathi kwamaMasipala ngokwemithetho nemicile yomthetho akaMasipala, azakuba nemisebenzi elandelayo: Ulawula uxhaso nokuqikelelo kweenkxaso zokulawula abantu kwabaphathi abaphezulu kumaMasipala kummandla onke; Ulawula uxhaso, ukuqikelelo nokuhloola uqikelelo lokuqamba usapho lwekhaya lukaMasipala; ulawula neendaba zolawulo ezisemthethweni zoMasipala; Ulawula uxhaso nokuqikelelo kwe-ICT kumaMasipala kummandla onke; Yakha iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokusebenza neenqobo ezijoliswe ekuphuculeni ukunikezwa kweenkonzo ngaphakathi kwimeko yokulawula koMasipala nokulawula izibonelelo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Credit Management
jobs.department: Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs
jobs.summary: Manage creditor management services including invoice processing, supplier payments within 30 days, financial reconciliations and unit resources for the Department of Cooperative Governance in KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: The ideal candidate must be in possession of a Bachelors Degree/ NQF Level 7 qualification in Financial Management as recognised by SAQA coupled with 3 years supervisory experience in a financial management environment and a valid Drivers Licence. Essential Knowledge, Skills And Competencies Required: The successful candidate must have: Sound knowledge of procurement and payments systems, policies and procedures; Sound knowledge of PFMA and Treasury Regulations, SCM and other prescripts; Function knowledge of BAS; Knowledge of Public Service Act and Regulations; Labour Relations Act; Good planning, decision making and problem solving skills; Ability to develop the unit into a team; Numeracy skills; Report writing; Financial Management; Good communication skills (verbal & written) with colleagues, management, Treasury and suppliers; Good computer literacy in MS Office (Ms Word and Ms Excel); must be prepared to drive official vehicles.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be required to manage creditor management services with the following responsibilities: Manage the receiving and recording of valid invoices; Manage the payment of suppliers within 30 days; Manage financial reconciliations and reporting; Manage resources of the unit.
jobs.enquiries: Ms S Chetty Tel No: (033) 260 8118
jobs.applications: To be posted to: The Chief Director, Human Resource Management & Development, Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Private Bag X9078, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or Hand Delivered To: The Chief Registry Clerk, 2nd Floor, South Tower, Natalia, 330 Langalibalele Street, Pietermaritzburg. Applications received after this date will not be accepted. Applicants can also submit their Z83 and CV via e-Recruitment System on www.eservices.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms E Perumal
jobs.notes: To Applicants: Applications must be submitted on the new Application for Employment Form (Z83) available from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV. The Department discourages applications sent by registered mail and will not be held responsible for applications sent via registered mail which are not collected from the post office. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application reaches the Department timeously. Failure to comply with any instruction will disqualify applicants. Applicants can also submit their Z83 and CV via e- Recruitment System on www.eservices.gov.za.Appointment is subject to a positive outcome on the following checks (Security Clearance, Citizenship, qualification verification, criminal records, credit records and previous employment). Faxed or late applications will not be accepted. Should applicants not receive any response from the Department within three months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to empowering people with a disability. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Kredietbestuur
af.summary: Bestuur skuldeiserbestuursdienste, insluitend faktuurverwerking, verskafferbetalings binne 30 dae, finansiële reconciliës en eenheidshulpbronne vir die Department of Cooperative Governance in KwaZulu-Natal.
af.requirements: Die ideale kandidaat moet in besit wees van 'n Bachelors Degree/ NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur soos erken deur SAQA tesame met 3 jaar toesigervaring in 'n finansiële bestuuromgewing en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. Essensiële kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet oor die volgende beskik: Deeglike kennis van verkrygings- en betalingstelsels, beleide en prosedures; Deeglike kennis van PFMA en Tesourieregulasies, SCM en ander voorskrifte; Funksionele kennis van BAS; Kennis van Public Service Act en Regulasies; Labour Relations Act; Goeie beplannings-, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Vermoë om die eenheid tot 'n span te ontwikkel; Syfervaardighede; Verslagskrywing; Finansiële Bestuur; Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik) met kollegas, bestuur, Tesourie en verskaffers; Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office (Ms Word en Ms Excel); moet bereid wees om amptelike voertuie te bestuur.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om skuldeiserbestuursdienste te bestuur met die volgende verantwoordelikhede: Bestuur die ontvangs en opname van geldige fakture; Bestuur die betaling van verskaffers binne 30 dae; Bestuur finansiële reconciliës en verslagdoening; Bestuur die hulpbronne van die eenheid.

zu.title: Umncedi Ohlelayo: Ukulawula Izezimali
zu.summary: Phatha izinsizakusebenzi zokulawula abanikaziwezimali okuhlanganisa ukucutshungula izinkampani, ukuhlawula abahlinzeki ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30, ukuqondanisa izimali kanye nemithombo yenqaba ye-Department of Cooperative Governance in KwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: I think candidate ngaphandle kwemvume kuphela kwesiqu somuntu onguthisha ohlezi ohambweni lwamanje lwe-SAQA nendlela yokusebenza ethize ekuphathweni kwezimali, kanye namakhono aphansi kakhulu ekubeni nesiqu somuntu ohlezi ohambweni olushukumisayo, kanti futhi nendlela yokwenza izinto ngokuphumelelayo. Imfundo ebalulekile, amakhono namekhono ayingxenye yalezi zinto: Umuntu ophumelelayo kufanele abe noku: Ukwazi okuhle mayelana namasistimu wokuthenga nokukhokha, izinqubomgomo neziya; Ukwazi okuhle mayelana ne-PFMA nemithetho yeTreasury, i-SCM kanye namanye amagugu; Ulwazi lokusebenza kwe-BAS; Ulwazi ngomthetho wePublic Service kanye nemithetho; Umthetho wezidingo zomsebenzi; Amakhono ohlelo lokucabanga, ukuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga; Ikhono lokuthuthukisa inqaba ibe yiqembu; Amakhono okubala; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuphathwa kwezimali; Amakhono okuxhumana ahle (agqamayo & abhaliwe) nabasebenzi nomphathi, iTreasury kanye nabahlinzeki; Amakhono amahle ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha ku-MS Office (Ms Word kanye ne-Ms Excel); kufanele abe ulungele ukushayela izimoto zasemthethweni.
zu.duties: Umphumeleli ophumelelayo uzodingwa ukuba aphathe izinsizakusebenzi zokulawula abanikaziwezimali ngezinselelo ezilandelayo: Ukuphatha ukwamukela nokurekhoda izinkampani eziyiqiniso; Ukuphatha ukuhlawula abahlinzeki ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30; Ukuphatha ukuqondanisa kwezimali nokubika; Ukuphatha amas endeavor wonhloko.

xh.title: Umphathi wongenelelo: Ulawulo Lwetyala
xh.summary: Ukulawula iinkonzo zolawulo lwabatyaliweyo kuquka ukuqhuba iinvoisi, ukuhlawula ababoneleli ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezingama-30, ukulinganiswa kwezemali namathuba eqoqo leSebe loLawulo Ngokusebenzisana eKwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: UmSea kufuneka abe nesiQinisekiso seDegree yeBachelor/ NQF Level 7 kwiLawulo LweMali njengoko kuthathwa ngu-SAQA kunye neminyaka yam-3 yamava okuba ngumphathi kwimeko yelawulo lemali kunye neDriver's License esebenzayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono Namabalo Abalulekile Afunekayo: Umphumelelo kufuneka abe: Nolwazi olululo ngeendlela zokuthenga nokuqhutywa kweentlawulo, iinkqubo namacebiso; Nolwazi olululo nge-PFMA kunye neeTreasury Regulations, SCM nezinye izalathiso; Ulwazi lokusebenza nge-BAS; Ulwazi nge-Public Service Act neeRegulations; I-Labour Relations Act; Amakhono obuciko bokulungiselela, okuthatha iigqibo nokuzalisa iingxaki; Ikhono lokuphucula iqoqo libe licandelo; Amakhono okubala; Ukubhala iingxelo; Ulawulo LweMali; Amakhono obuqhawumbile obuthetha (ngomlomo nobubhalwe) nabasebenzi nabo, abaphathi, iTreasury kunye nababoneleli; Ulwazi olululu lokusebenza ngemithi ye-MS Office (Ms Word neMs Excel); kufuneka afune ukuqhuba izithuthi ezisemthethweni.
xh.duties: Umphumelelouya kufuneka alawule iinkonzo zolawulo lwabatyaliweyo ezinemisebenzi elicandelo leminikelo: Ukulawula ukufumana nokubhala iinvoisi ezisebenzayo; Ukulawula ukuhlawula ababoneleli ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezingama-30; Ukulawula ukulinganiswa kwezemali nokubika; Ukulawula amathuba eqoqo.

jobs.summary: Coordinate fire safety initiatives by monitoring and supporting municipalities with fire and rescue service plans, legislative frameworks and strategies.
jobs.requirements: The ideal candidate must be in possession of an appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) in Fire Technology as recognised by SAQA coupled with 2 years experience in Fire and Rescue services and a valid C1 Drivers Licence. jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be required to support municipalities and stakeholders with fire and rescue services with the following responsibilities: Monitor, evaluate and provide support with the development and implementation of plans, legislative frameworks and strategies for fire and rescue services within the Province; Implement and support municipalities with fire safety and services capacity building programmes; Support with establishment and maintenance of IGR structures in fire and rescue services; Support municipalities with coordination of response capabilities; Provide technical support for compliance with National and Provincial imperatives.

af.title: Brandveiligheidskoördineerder
af.summary: Koördineer brandseekheidsinisiatiewe deur munisipaliteite te monitor en te ondersteun met brand- en reddingsdiensplanne, wetgewende raamwerke en strategieë.
af.requirements: Die ideale kandidaat moet oor 'n toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Brandtegnologie soos deur SAQA erken beskik, tesame met 2 jaar ervaring in brand- en reddingsdienste en 'n geldige C1-bestuurslisensie. Essensiële Kennis, Vaardighede En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet oor die volgende beskik: Deeglike kennis van die Disaster Management Act; Fire Brigade Act; Kennis van brand- en reddingsdiensprosedures; Public Service Act; Munisipale regulasies en beleide; Vermoë om beleide te ontleed en te interpreter; Notule neem en verslagdoeningsvaardighede; Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede, kantoorbestuur en dokumentopsporing; Kapasiteitsbou; Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik) met munisipaliteite, Tradisionele Instellings, die Publiek, privaatsektorpersoneel en bestuur; Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office (Ms Word, Ms Excel en PowerPoint).
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om munisipaliteite en belanghebbendes te ondersteun met brand- en reddingsdienste met die volgende verantwoordelikhede: Monitor, evalueer en bied ondersteuning met die ontwikkeling en implementering van planne, wetgewende raamwerke en strategieë vir brand- en reddingsdienste binne die Provinsie; Implementeer en ondersteun munisipaliteite met kapasiteitsbouprogramme vir brandseekheid en -dienste; Ondersteun met die totstandbrenging en instandhouding van IGR-strukture in brand- en reddingsdienste; Ondersteun munisipaliteite met die koördinering van reaksievermoëns; Bied tegniese ondersteuning vir nakoming van Nasionale en Provinsiale vereistes.

zu.title: Nhlanganisi Wokuphepha Kwezimlilo
zu.summary: Nhlanganisa izinhloso zokuphepha kwezimlilo ngokuqapha nokusekela ngamasipala ngezinhlelo zezinsiza zezimlilo nokuPinkula, izakhiwo zomthetho kanye nezindlela.
zu.requirements: Izakhamuzi ezifanele kumele zibe ne-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanele kwi-Fire Technology njengoba kuhlonzwe yi-SAQA ehambisana neminyaka engu-2 yohlu oluqhashiwe kwezinsiza zezimlilo nokuPinkula kanye ne-C1 Drivers Licence esebenzayo. Ulwazi Olubalulekile, Amaskills Namakhono Adingekayo: Izakhamuzi eziphumelelayo kumele zibe: Ulwazi oluhle ngomthetho we-Disaster Management; Umthetho we-Fire Brigade; Ulwazi ngenqubo yezinsiza ze-Fire and Rescue Services; Umthetho wePublic Service Act; Izimiso nezinqubo zomasipala; Ikhono lokuhlaziya nokuhumusha izinqubo; Ikhono lokubhala amaminithi namarephothi; Amaskills amahle wobuhlakani bokuhlela, abalulekile bisebenze emsakazweni we-MS Office (Ms Word, Ms Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint).
zu.duties: Izakhamuzi eziphumelelayo zobe zidingeka ukusekela ngamasipala nakubantu abanezinhlobonhlobo ngemisebenzi yezimlilo nezinsiza zokubuyisa ezinezibopho ezilandelayo: Qapha, hlaziya futhi unikeze inkuthazo ekwakhiweni nakusetshenzisweni kwezinhlelo, izakhiwo zomthetho kanye nezindlela zezinsiza zezimlilo nokubuyisa ngaphakathi kwe-Province; Setha futhi usekele ngamasipala ngemisebenzi yokwakha amandla okuphepha kwezimlilo nezinsiza; Sekela ekusekeleni kwakho nokugcinweni kwezakhiwo ze-IGR kuzinsiza zezimlilo nokuPinkula; Sekela ngamasipala ekuqashelweni kwendlela yokuphendula; Nikeza inkuthazo yobuchwepheshe ukuze kuhambisane nemithetho ebalulekile yezwe nakwi-Provincial.

xh.title: Ququumbela loMobo weNgingo yakuLoywa ngumLilo

zu.requirements: Umuntu ofanele kumele abe nesifundo se-Grade 10 kahle nokuqashelwa kweminyaka engu-7 – 12 yokuqhashelwa okuhlobene nesivume sokushayela esikhokile se-code 8. Ulwazi olubalulekile, amakhono nokuzikhethela okudingekayo: Umuntu oqashiwe kumele abe nalokhu: Ulwazi ngemiyalo yokuqhuba imoto, isb. imiyalo yokuthola izimvume zokuhamba, ukugcwalisa incwadi yokuhamba yemoto, ukuthola okudingekayo (isb. uphethiloli) nokuthola izinsiza eziyisisekelo (isb. ukulungisa inyangu elingcolile), Ulwazi ngemiyalo yokusebenzisa kahle imoto, isb. kanjani nangani iphuzu iphutha imoto ingenziwa, yini okudingekayo ekugcinweni kwesithuthi, Ulwazi ngemiyalo yokuthola ukuthi imoto igcinwa ilungile, Ulwazi ngemiyalo yokwenza imisebenzi yethumela izixwayi kanye nenkxaso evela kwohhofisi njengenkxaso yomhlinzeki wenhhovu wokugcina amafayela kanye nokwenza amakhophi; amakhono amahle okuxhumana; amakhono amahle okuxhumana (abakhulunyayo kanye nobhalwayo).
zu.duties: Umuntu oqashiwe uzodingeka anikeze imisebenzi yokushayela nokuthumela izixwayi ngemithwalo engukeywayo: Ukushayela izimoto ezincane nezaphakathi; Ukunika inkxaso yokuthumela izixwayi ehhofisini elihlobene; Ukugcwalisa yonke imibhalo edingekayo neyemiyalo kanye namabhuku okuhamba ngokuhlobene nesithuthi kanye nezimpahla ezibambe; Ukwenza ukugcinwa ngemiyalo esithuthini esinikiwe.

xh.title: Umshayeli/ithumela
xh.summary: Kunika iinkonzo zokushayela nokuthumela izixhobo kwiSebe leCooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs eDurban, kufuneka kubekho isifundo seGrade 10 nelayisensi yokushayela ye-code 8 esemthethweni.
xh.requirements: Umzobi oqeqeshiweyo kufuneka abe nesidanga se-Grade 10 kunye noqeqesho olufanelekileyo lweenyanga ezingama-7 – 12 nelayisensi yokushayela ye-code 8 esemthethweni. Ulwazi, Amafutha Namakhono Abalulekileyo Afunekayo: Umzobi opumelelayo kufuneka anele: Ulwazi lweendlela zokuqhuba imoto, umzekelo iinkqubo zokufumana iinkqubo zemithetho yohambo, kugqitywe iibhuku zemoto, ukufumana izinto ezisetyenziswayo (umzekelo i-petrol) nokufumana iinkonzo eziyisisiseko (umzekelo ulungiso lenyathi), Ulwazi lweemithetho ekuyimfuneko yokusebenzisa imoto ngendlela elungileyo, umzekelo indlela nangenijongo yantoni na imoto ingasetyenziswa, yintoni na imfuneko yokugcina imoto, Ulwazi lweendlelaokuqinisekisa ukuba imoto igcinwa ngokuchanekileyo, Ulwazi lweendlela zokwenza imisebenzi yokuthumela izixhobo nokusekela iofisi ngokwesiko njengemisebenzi yeregistry nokwenza iiphotocopy, amakhono amabalantlabahlobo; amakhono oluntu (okuthetha nokubhala).
xh.duties: Umzobi opumelelayo uya kufuneka anike imisebenzi yokushayela nokuthumela izixhobo nemiyelelo ebalulekileyo elandelayo: Kushayela iimoto ezikhoyo nakwezamazinga amancinci namaphakathi; Ukunika inkonzo yokusekela ngokuthumela izixhobo kule ofisi ethinteleweyo; Kuqitywe yonke irekhodi neebhuku zemoto ezifunekayo ezibhalwe ngokomthetho mayela nemoto nokuhamba kwempahla, Ukwenza ulondolozo lwemoto enikiweyo rhoqo.

jobs.title: Deputy Direct HRM: Monitoring & Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (an all-inclusive MMS package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director HRM for Monitoring and Evaluation at Ugu Health District Office, responsible for integrated HR planning and performance monitoring across district institutions.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate,3 year Bachelor Degree / National Diploma in HR Management Human Sciences / Public Management or Administration, A minimum of 3 years’ Managerial Experience in Human Resource Management, PERSAL certificate, Computer literacy: MS Office Software Applications, Valid code EB driver’s license (code 8); Project management and strategic planning, An understanding of the “push” factors affecting human resource supply and demand within the health sector, Ability to prioritize issues and other work- related matters so as to comply with time frames, Broad knowledge of HR practices and disciplines, Excellent management, facilitation, communication and interpretation skills, Expert knowledge legislative and policy framework informing the area of operation, Ability to capture and communicate the essence of recommendation in a concise and clear corporate language, Ability to prioritize issues and after work related matters in order to comply with tight deadlines, A clear understanding of challenges facing the Public Sector.
jobs.duties: Ensure and facilitate the consolidation of an integrated HR Plan for the District and monitor and evaluate the performance of Institutions to accomplish the identified human resource management indicators, provide early warning and develop innovative solutions to overcome identified problem areas; Oversee and manage processes for the alignment of organizational and post establishment structures within the District in line with emerging service delivery demands as well as the imperatives set by the Annual Performance Plan of the District, the Service Transformation Plan of the Department, budget allocations as well as standards and workload statistics; Oversee the effective implementation of Human Resources management policy imperatives in Institutions and ensure consistency in the application thereof; Ensure a well- coordinated and integrated approach to develop sound labour relations and within the District promote staff wellbeing, safety, employee performance management and develop system (EPMDS); Manage the utilization of resources allocated to the section inclusive of the development of staff; Provide District HR compliance and support services.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs N. Govender Tel No: (039) 682 4715
jobs.applications: Application to be forward to: The District Director, Ugu Health District Office, Private Bag X735, Port Shepstone, 4240. Applications can also be e-mailed to: UGU.HRIntern@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : The Human Resource Manager
jobs.notes: Detailed application for employment (Z83) and Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies must not be submitted when applying for employment (Only short listed candidates will be requested to submit proof). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur MRM: Monitering en Evaluering
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur Menslike Hulpbronbestuur vir Monitering en Evaluering by Ugu Gesondheidsdistrikkantoor, verantwoordelik vir geïntegreerde MH-beplanning en prestasiemonitering oor distriksinstellings.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat, 3 jaar Baccalaureusgraad / Nasionale Diploma in MH-bestuur Menslike Wetenskappe / Openbare Bestuur of Administrasie, 'n Minimum van 3 jaar bestuurservaring in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, PERSAL-sertifikaat, Rekenaarvaardigheid: MS Office-sagtewaretoepassings, Geldige kode EB-bestuurderslisensie (kode 8); Projekbestuur en strategiese beplanning, 'n Begrip van die "druk"-faktore wat menslike hulpbron-aanbod en -vraag binne die gesondheidssektor beïnvloed, Vermoë om kwessies en ander werkverwante sake te prioriteer om tydraamsters na te kom, Breë kennis van MH-praktyke en -dissiplines, Uitstekende bestuurs-, fasiliterings-, kommunikasie- en interpretasievaardighede, Kundige kennis van die wetgewende en beleidsraamwerk wat die operasionele gebied rig, Vermoë om die wese van aanbevelings vas te lê en in bondige en duidelike korporatiewe taal te kommunikeer, Vermoë om kwessies en werkverwante sake te prioriteer om styf sluitingsdatums na te kom, 'n Duidelike begrip van die uitdagings wat die Openbare Sektor in die gesig staar.
af.duties: Verseker en fasiliteer die konsolidering van 'n geïntegreerde MH-plan vir die Distrik en monitor en evalueer die prestasie van Instellings om die geïdentifiseerde menslike hulpbronbestuursaanwysers te bereik, verskaf vroegtydige waarskuwing en ontwikkel innoverende oplossings om geïdentifiseerde probleemareas te oorkom; Oorsien en bestuur prosesse vir die belyning van organisatoriese en posvestigingsstrukture binne die Distrik in ooreenstemming met ontluikende diensleweringsbehoeftes asook die imperatiewe wat deur die Jaarlikse Prestasieplan van die Distrik, die Dienstransformasieplan van die Departement, begrotingstoekenning asook standaarde en werkladingstatistieke gestel word; Oorsien die effektiewe implementering van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur se beleidsimperatiewe in Instellings en verseker konsekwentheid in die toepassing daarvan; Verseker 'n goed gekoördineerde en geïntegreerde benadering om gesonde arbeidsverhoudinge te ontwikkel en binne die Distrik werknemerswelsyn, veiligheid, werknemerprestasiebestuur en -ontwikkelingstelsel (EPMDS) te bevorder; Bestuur die benutting van hulpbronne aan die afdeling toegewys, insluitend die ontwikkeling van personeel; Verskaf Distrik-MH-nakoming en -ondersteuningsdienste.

zu.title: Obamba-Sebe Wezabasebenzi: Ukuqapha Nokuhlola
zu.summary: Obamba-Sebe Wezabasebenzi ekuqapheni nokuholeni ehhovisi le-Ugu Health District, onesibopho sokuhlela izinkambiso zokuqashwa kwabasebenzi kanye nokuqapha ukusebenza ezikhungweni zesifunda ngokuhlanganisiwe.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate, IDiploma yeminyaka eyi-3 ye-Bachelor / i-National Diploma kwezabasebenzi / ezabaluli / ukuphathwa komphakathi noma ibhalansi; Okungenani ungamava eminyaka engu-3 ekuphatheni abantu basebenzini, Isitifikedi se-PERSAL, Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha: Izinhlelo ze-MS Office; Ikhodi EB yelayisense ebhalwe ngokusemthethweni (ikhodi 8); Ukuphathwa amaphrojekthi kanye nokuhlela ngokusobala, ukuqonda okubangela inkinga yokwaneliswa nokudingwa kwabasebenzi emkhakheni wezempi lo, ikhono lokubeka izinto ezibalulekile kanye nezinye izindaba zomsebenzi ukuze kuhambisane nesikhathi, ulwazi olubanzi ngezinkambiso nezinhlela zezabasebenzi, amakhono aphambili okuphatha, okuqondisa, okuxhumana nokuhlaziya, ulwazi olujulile ngemithetho kanye nezinhlelo eziholela endaweni yokusebenza, ikhono lokubumba nokwedlulisa incazelo yesincomo ngolimi olucacile nangomumo ofanele, ikhono lokubeka izinto ezibalulekile kanye nezinye izindaba zomsebenzi ukuze kuhambisane namadethayim alukhuni, ukuqonda ngokucacileyo izinselele ezibhekene nomphakathi kahulumeni.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa futhi ubeke isikhathi sokuhlanganisa i-HR Plan yesifunda ngokuhlanganisiwe, bese uqapha ukuholisisa ukusebenza kwezikhungo ukufeza izinkomba zezabasebenzi ezitholakalayo, nikeza isexwayiso sokuqala futhi uthuthukise izisombululo ezingokwesiko ngenhloso yokunqoba izindawo ezinobunzima obutholakele; Qapha bese uphatha izinkambiso zokuqondanisa izakhiwo zenhlangano namasakhiwo Izikhundla ngaphakathi kwesifunda ngokuhambisana nezidingo eziphetha ngokuletha inkonzo kanye nezinhloso ezibekwe i-Annual Performance Plan yesifunda, i-Service Transformation Plan yomnyango, imitholo yebhajidi kanye nezindinganiso izibalo zomsebenzi; Qapha ukuphumelela ukusetshenziswa kwezinhloso zomthetho wezabasebenzi ezikhungweni bese uqinisekisa ukuhambisana ekusetshenzisweni kwazo; Qinisekisa indlela ehlelekile futhi ehlanganisiwe yokuthuthukisa ubuhlobo obuhle bomsebenzi futhi ngaphakathi kwesifunda khuthaza inhlalakahle yabasebenzi, ukuphepha, ukuphathwa kokusebenza kwabasebenzi kanye nokuqalisa izinhlelo (EPMDS); Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ezenzelwe isigaba kuhlanganise nokuqeqesha abasebenzi; Nikeza inkonzo yokuhambisana nokuweseka kwezabasebenzi esifundeni.

xh.title: Isekela-Mongameli we-HRM: Ulondolozo & Inzululwazi
xh.summary: Isekela-Mongameli we-HRM woLondolozo nenzululwazi kwiNkundla yoMthetho we-Ugu Health District Office, onoxanduva lokucwangcisa ngokudibeneyo kwe-HR nokuqwalasela ukusebenza kwindalo yamasebe kwiiNkundla zangaphakathi.
xh.requirements: Senior Certificate,3 year Bachelor Degree / National Diploma in HR Management Human Sciences / Public Management or Administration, Okungezelelwe kuka-3 eminyakeni yamava abalawuli kuLawulo lweBantu, Isatifikethi se-PERSAL, Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha: Izicelo ze-MS Office Software Applications, Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba ye-code EB esebenzayo (code 8); ulawulo lweenkqubo nezicwangciso ezingundoqo, Ukuqonda iimeko ezibangela ukubonelela nokuFunyanwa koludwe lwabantu kw candz lempilo, Amandla okubeka phambili izinto ezibalulekileyo neminye imisebenzi ehlobene nomsebenzi ukuze uhambelane nexesha elinikiweyo, Ulwazi olubanzi lwezenzo neendlela ze-HR, Amandla aphezulu okulawula, okwenza kubekho lungelelwaniso, okuthetha nokutolika, Ulwazi olunamandla ngokomthetho nangolwakhiwo lwengqungquthela eqondisa indawo yokusebenza, Amandla okubamba nokudlulisa iinjongo zemimiselo ngolwimi lucacileyo nalulula lwevenkile, Amandla okubeka phambili izinto neminye imisebenzi ehlobene nomsebenzi ukuze uhambelane nexesha elifutshane elinikiweyo, Ukuqonda ngokucacileyo iingcinezelo ezibhekise kwiNgxoxo yoWiso-mthetho.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa futhi wenze kube lula ukudityaniswa kweNkqubo ye-HR eyodwa yeNkundla kwaye ulawule ukuze uqwalasele ukusebenza kweziNkundla ukufezwa kwezinto eziphawulwayo ezibalulekileyo kulawulo lweBantu, nike isilumkiso ngaphambi koxahtsholo kwaye udalangondlela ezitsha zoku-zeza kwendawana ekudityaniswe kuzo iingxaki; Qaphela kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuqwalasela ulwakhiwo lweNkundla ngokwamagunya oLwakhiwo lweNkundla ngokwamagunya abekwe kwi-Nkqubo yoMsebenzi woNyaka, iNkqubo yoTshintsho lweSebe, imigeqa yemali enikiweyo, neemilinganiselo nemigangatho yomthwalo wemisebenzi; Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kweekhetho ezibalulekileyo ngokomthetho kulawulo lweBantu kwiNkundla kwaye uqinisekise ukuzinza ekubeni zisetyenziswa ngendlela efanayo; Qinisekisa indlela ehleliweyo futhi edibeneyo yokugqiba ukusebenza ngokomthetho wezabasebenzi kwaye kwiNkundla ukhuthaze impilo yabasebenzi, ikhuseleko, iqwalaselo ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi kunye nokuvela kolwazi ngokwe-Nkqubo yoQwalaselo lokuQhuba iMisebenzi yabaSebenzi (EPMDS); Lawula ukusetyenziswa kolwazi olunikezwe inkqubo ehlanganisela nokugqiba ulwazi lwabasebenzi; Nike ngokusetyenziswa okuhle ngokomthetho iinkonzo zokuxhasa i-HR zeNkundla.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 OR Grade 2
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum Other Benefits: 13th cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Home owner’s allowance (employee must meet prescribed Requirements) and 12% Rural Allowance
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 or 2 sought at Othobothini Community Health Centre in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science.
jobs.requirements: Senior certificate/STD 10/Grade 12. Basic R425 qualification (diploma/degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse and Midwife.1 year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Assessment, Diagnosis, Treatment and Care accredited with SANC. Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 2 A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing.10 years of experience of the experience referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining a 1–year Post Basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Assessment, Diagnosis, Treatment and Care accredited with SANC. Knowledge, Skills, Training, and Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care and procedures. Knowledge of SANC Rules and Regulations and other relevant Legal framework. Knowledge of Quality Assurance Programmes, Batho-Pele principles and Patient Rights charter, human resource management and basic financial management skills. Leadership, supervisory and report writing skills. Good communication, counselling, interpersonal relations, conflict management, decision making and problem-solving skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure the efficient and effective control of surgical sundries, pharmaceuticals, equipment and miscellaneous stores. Promote preventive and promote health for clients in the facility. Maintain accurate and complete patients’s records according to legal requirements. Assist in compiling and updating of procedural guidelines. Identify problems and areas of improvement and communicate with the Operational Manager. Deal with grievances and labour relations issues in terms of laid down procedures/policies. Provide direct and indirect supervision of junior staff and give guidance for quality patient care. Implement infection control standards and practices to improve quality health care. Initiate treatment and ensure evaluation of patients’s clinical conditions. Participate in health promotion activities in the clinic and in community. Assess in-service training needs, plan and implement training. Participate in data management processes. Participate in the attainment of National Core Standards, realisation of ideal clinic (ICRM), PSI and Surveys on PEC and waiting time.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. S.R Dlamini Tel No: (035) 572 9002
jobs.applications: to be hand deliver to Othobothini CHC HR Department next to Msiyane High School, Jozini, 3969. Or email to Sabelo.Mchunu@kznhealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the Application for Employment Form (Z83), which is obtainable at any Government Department or from website- www.kzhealth.gov.za Applicants are not required to submit Copies of educational qualifications and Professional registration certificates such documents will be requested only from shortlisted candidates. People with disabilities should feel free to apply. Reference numbers must be indicated on the space provided. Please note that appointment will be subject to positive outcome obtained from NIA on the following checks: security clearance, credit record, qualifications, citizenship, and previous experience verification. Should you not hear from us three months after the closing date, please accept that your application was not successful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 1 OF Graad 2
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 1 of 2 gesoek by Othobothini Community Health Centre in KwaZulu-Natal, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap vereis.
af.requirements: Senior certificate/STD 10/Grade 12. Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (diploma/graad in verpleegkunde of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige en Vrouwerektoors toelaat.1 jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap, Assessering, Diagnose, Behandeling en Sorg wat by SANC geakkrediteer is. Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 1 'n Minimum van 4 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 2 'n Minimum van 14 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde.10 jaar van die ervaring waarna hierbo verwys word, moet gepaste/erkenbare ervaring wees na die verkryging van 'n 1-jaar Post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap, Assessering, Diagnose, Behandeling en Sorg wat by SANC geakkrediteer is. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorg en prosedures. Kennis van SANC-reëls en -regulasies en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerk. Kennis van Kwaliteitsversekeringsprogramme, Batho-Pele-beginsels en die Handves vir Pasienteregte, menslikehulpbronbestuur en basiese finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Leierskap, toesighoudende en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie, berading, interpersoonlike verhoudings, konflikbestuur, besluitneming en probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker die doeltreffende en effektiewe beheer van chirurgiese verbruiksgoedere, farmaseutiese middels, toerusting en diverse voorrade. Bevorder preventiewe gesondheidsorg en gesondheidsbevordering vir kliënte by die fasiliteit. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasienterekords volgens regskundige vereistes. Bystaan met die opstel en opdatering van prosedurale riglyne. Identifiseer probleme en areas vir verbetering en kommunikeer met die Operasionele Bestuurder. Hanteer griewe en arbeidsverhoudingskwessies ooreenkomstig vasgestelde prosedures/beleide. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor junior personeel en gee leiding vir gehalte pasientesorg. Implementeer infeksiebeheerstandaarde en -praktyke om gehalte gesondheidsorg te verbeter. Inisieer behandeling en verseker evaluering van pasiente se kliniese toestande. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevorderingsaktiwiteite in die kliniek en in die gemeenskap. Assesseer in-diens opleidingsbehoeftes, beplan en implementeer opleiding. Neem deel aan dataverwerkingsprosesse. Neem deel aan die bereiking van Nasionale Kernstandaarde, verwesenliking van ideale kliniek (ICRM), PSI en opnames oor PEC en wagtyd.

zu.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 noma Grade 2
zu.summary: Kudingwa udokotela ohlengikazi ohlola iziguli osemzigqweni 1 noma 2 e-Othobothini Community Health Centre e-KwaZulu-Natal, ofuna ukubhalisa ku-SANC afunde isifundo esingaphezu kwesisekelo kwezolimo ezenzululwazi zokuhlengikazi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu/STD 10/Grade 12. Isifundo esiyisisekelo se-R425 (idiploma/idegri kubuhlengikazi noma isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengosiHlengikazi osebenzayo kanye nokuNhua. Unyaka oyu-1 wemfundo engaphezu kwesisekelo kwezolimo ezenzululwazi zesiNgangingqangi, ukuhlolwa, ukuxilongo, ukwelapha kanye nokuNakwa ukugunyazwe yi-SANC. Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 Ubude besikhathi osingathi iminyaka engu-4 kokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele/okubonakalayo kubuhlengikazi emva kokuBhalisa njengoHlengikazi osebenzayo ku-SANC ekuHlelweni okujwayelekile. Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 2 Ubude besikhathi osingathi iminyaka engu-14 kokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele/okubonakalayo kubuhlengikazi emva kokuBhalisa njengoHlengikazi osebenzayo ku-SANC ekuHlelweni okujwayelekile. Kumele iminyaka engu-10 kokuhlangenwe nakho okushiwo ngenhla kube kokufanele/okubonakalayo emva kokuthola isifundo sonyaka o-1 esingaphezu kwesisekelo kwezolimo ezenzululwazi zesiNgangingqangi, ukuhlolwa, ukuxilongo, ukwelapha nokuNakwa kuqinisekiswe yi-SANC. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye namakhono adingekayo: Ulwazi ngokunakekelwa kwezokunyanga nendlela zokwenza. Ulwazi ngemiCaciso nemiThetho ye-SANC kanye nezinye izakhiwo ezingokomthetho ezihlobene. Ulwazi ngeziHlelo zokuQinisekisa izinga, izimiso zeBatho-Pele nesibambela samalungelo abagula, ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye namakhono ayoqobo okuphatha imali. Amakhono okuhola, okulawula nokubhala imibiko. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, ukweluleka, izinhlangano zomuntu siqu, ukuphatha izingxabano, ukuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuqonda inkinga.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukulawula okusebenzayo nokuqonde phambili kwemitshizo yokuhlinzwa,amakhemikhali okwelapha,amagogogela nezinye izinto ezigcinwayo. Khuthaza ukuvikela nokukhuthaza impilo yabakhiqizi esikhungweni. Gcina irekhodi eliqondile neliphelele labagula ngokusho kwemithetho edingekayo. Siza ekwakheni nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi ziyaphila. Hlola izinkinga nendawo ezingathuthukiswa bese uxhumana nomenzele Ohlezi. Phatha izikhulumi kanye nezindaba zomsebenzi ngokusho kwemithetho/amasu abekiwe. Nikeza ukulawula okuqondile nokuqondile kwabasebenzi abancane futhi unikeze imiyalo yokunakekelwa kwemfundo ephezulu yomuntu ofundayo. Phekela izinyathelo nendlela zokuqothula ukutheleleka ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yezokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Qala ukwelapha bese uqinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwezimo zomuntu ofundayo. Ngenza kumisebenzi yokukhuthaza impilo eqoqweni nasemmongweni. Hlola izidingo zokuqeqeshwa kumsebenzi, uhlele futhi usebenzise ukuqeqeshwa. Ngenza kumasekhethi okuphatha idatha. Ngenza ekufezeni Izindingo eziyisisekelo ezingowezwe, ukufeza isibhedlela esihle (ICRM), i-PSI kanye Nocwaningo nge-PEC nesikhathi sokulinda.

xh.title: Umongikazi weKhlinikhi woMgangatho weQela 1 okanye weQela 2
xh.summary: Kufunwa umongikazi wekhlinikhi womgangatho weqela 1 okanye 2 kwiZiko loLunjizo lweMpilo loPhakathi eKwaZulu-Natal, kufuneka abhaliswe kwiSANC abe nengqekembe yesikhundi ngasemva kwesiseko kwiZesuluntu esiNzulu seSayensi yokugonya.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphakamileyo/STD 10/Grade 12. Ingqekembe yesisiseko seR425 (idiploma/inqanaba lokugqiba kwizifundo zokugonya okanye nangqekembe ezingathathwa njengento efanayo evumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi oPhatha nbobona ongumongikazi wokuvelisa. Unyaka woku-1 ngasemva kwesiseko singqekembe kwiSayensi yokugonya iKhlinikhi, ukuNika isahlulelo, ukuBeka iSaziso sokugula, ukuPhatha nokunakekela evunyiweyo yiSANC. Umongikazi weKhlinikhi woMgangatho weQela 1 Okungenani eminyaka emi-4 yamava afanelekileyo/okuqatshelwa kwindima yokugonya emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oPhatha nbobona kwiSANC ekuGonyeni iNtloko. Umongikazi weKhlinikhi woMgangatho weQela 2 Okungenani eminyaka eyi-14 yamava afanelekileyo/okuqatshelwa kwindima yokugonya emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oPhatha nbobona kwiSANC ekuGonyeni iNtloko. Eminyaka eyi-10 yamava kwawo amava akuchazwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/okuqatshelwa emva kokufumana ingqekembe yenyanga eyi-1 ngasemva kwesiseko kwiSayensi yokugonya iKhlinikhi, ukuNika isahlulelo, ukuBeka iSaziso sokugula, ukuPhatha nokunakekela evunyiweyo yiSANC. ulwazi, amakhono, uQeqesho, namandla aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngokunakekela nokugonya kunye neendlela zokusetyenziswa. Ulwazi ngeeMigaqo kunye neMiGaqo yeSANC nangaphezu kolunye ulwandiso lweMthetho oluhambelanayo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zoQinisekiso lweMgangatho woMsebenzi, imigaqo yeBatho-Pele nelayisensi yamaLungelo oMdlwayo, ulawulo lwabantu besiza ukuqhuba imisebenzi yomzimba kwakunye namakhono obugcisa bokulawula iimali. Amakhono obhalo-mbhalo, okulawula nokuqamba iinguqulelo zobuqhawe. Amakhono alungileyo othetha nothintathu nabantu, uxolelo, izihlobo phakathi kwabantu, ulawulo lweengxaki, ukwenza izigqibo kwakunye nokuzisa izisombululo kwiingxaki.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokusebenziseka nangokuchanekileyo izinto zokulungelelwa izilonda, izitya-mithi, iimpahla zokusebenza nengcino ehlukene. Phakamisa nokuKhuthaza iNtla ezikhuselo kunye nokukhuthaza umzimba woluntu kwizigulana ezikwisikhululo. Gcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo nezize ngokupheleleyo zesigulana ngokwemfuneko yomthetho. Siza ekuyilweni nangokuhlaziya iindlela zokwenza imisebenzi. Bathathe iingxaki kwaye ubone iindawo ezingapucululwa aze axele kwiMphathi yeNkonzo. Phatha iingxaki zamalungu oqeqesho kunye nezinto ezithintela uluntu ngokwemigaqo/iinkqubo ezelwe iso. Nikeza ulawulo oluqhubekayo nolungaqhubekanga kwabasebenzi abasezantsi ubeke umkhosi wokuqhuba ngokuchanekileyo ukunakekela izigulana. Sebenzisa imilinganiselo nendlela yokulingana nokuqhubela phambili isigulana ukulawula iingxaki ezibangelwa zizifo. Latha isigulana ngoMngeni wokugula ubephila ngokunakekela kwaye uqhube unyamezele isimo sezempilo somguli. Nceda ekubakho kolwazi mayelana nokunakekela indalo yakho nasekuqhuba imisebenzi kwindawo esijayisa uluntu ehlala kuyo naphakathi koMzimba woluntu. Qinisekisa imfuneko yokuba ngumntu oHlala eKliniki aze alungiselele iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokunakekela imisebenzi yaseKhaya noNcedo lokukhulisa izingcinga olunzima loNyuso nokunakekelwa koluntu. Hlanganyela ekusebenziseni iindlela ezifuna ipakati nokuhamba kweluntu kwindlu yamagosa alawula uluntu nokuba ngamnye lowo uyaqinisekisa igunya elinye lokuLawula iinkalo ekuqhubela iMizamo yabaMama nabantwana baseNtshona Koloni yeSizwe kunye nokuSebenzisa iNkqubo yokuSetyenziswa kwezaMava abantu abaziNtsundu kunye neSazi ngokulindela koluntu. Hlanganyela ekusebenziseni imilinganiselo eqikelela iNkqubo ekuqhubela imizamo yeKhosi ebusuku nomhla wesine weMizi nakuluntu kuwo onke amaphondo eSazisi ukuba ancede ekwenzeni iinkqubo ezikwindlu ekuyilwa kuyo ngokuhamba koluntu nokunakekela iSazizi ngokuya ngokusetyenziselwa oluLuhlu lwexesha elihamba ekuqhubela uluntu nokulawulwa koluntu.

jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Specialty position at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration and relevant nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. A relevant one (01) year Post Basic qualification in Operating Theatre Nursing Science. Registration certificate with South African Nursing Council (SANC). Current SANC receipt (2026). To nurse a paediatric ventilated/high care patient in ICU within directorate. Maintain Professional growth/ethical standard and self-development. Assist in reduction of complaints within the directorate. Previous experience in the following disciplines would be advantageous: - General surgery. Laparoscopic surgery Orthopaedic surgery, Recovery Room, CSSD, Obstetrics & Gynea.

Provision of quality services through setting of standards, policies and procedures. Participate in the implementation of National Priorities clinical guidelines, protocols. Maintain accurate and complete patient records according to legal requirements. Exercise control over discipline, grievance and labour relations issues. Promote good working relationships amongst staff and patients. Assist in supervision and development of all nursing staff. Reduction of maternal and child mortality and morbidity rate. Ensure effective participation in all hospital programs e.g. IPC, Quality Assurance, etc. Provide a Safe, therapeutic and hygienic environment for patients, visitors and staff.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit-pos by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat SANC-registrasie en relevante verpleegkundige ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 (veertien) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging waarvan ten minste 10 (tien) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesialiteit moet wees na verkryging van die 1 (een) jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in relevante spesialiteit. Minimum Vereistes: Senior Sertifikaat of ekwivalent. Graad/Diploma in Algemene verpleging of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Relevante een (01) jaar Post-Basiese kwalifikasie in Operasieteater Verpleegkunde. Registrasiesertifikaat by die South African Nursing Council (SANC). Huidige SANC-kwitansie (2026). 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatutes, en ander relevante regsraamwerk. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede- mondelings en skriftelik. Koördinasie- en skakelvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede en kritiese denkvaardighede. Vermoë om binne die multidissiplinêre span te werk. Om 'n gepassiveerde hoësorg-pasiënt in ICU binne direktoraat te verpleeg. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaard en selfontwikkeling. Bystaan in vermindering van klagtes binne die direktoraat. Vorige ervaring in die volgende dissiplines sal voordelig wees: - Algemene chirurgie. Laparoskopiese chirurgie, Ortopediese chirurgie, Herstelkamer, CSSD, Verloskunde & Gynea.
af.duties: Effektiewe bestuur van pasiënte, toon begaan oor pasiënte, bevorder en beyder. Behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en gewilligheid om aan pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtings te voldoen. Voorsiening van gehaltedienste deur die vasstelling van standaarde, beleide en prosedures. Neem deel aan die implementering van Nasionale Prioriteite kliniese riglyne, protokolle. Handhaaf akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords volgens regsvereistes. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, griewe en arbeidsverhoudingskwessies. Bevorder goeie werksverhoudinge onder personeel en pasiënte. Bystaan in toesig en ontwikkeling van alle verpleegkundige personeel. Vermindering van moeder- en kindersterfte en morbiditeitskoers. Verseker effektiewe deelname in alle hospitaalprogramme bv. IPC, Kwaliteitsversekering, ens. Verskaf 'n veilige, terapeutiese en higiëniese omgewing vir pasiënte, besoekers en personeel.

zu.title: IsiQhwaga seNesi Esinamakhono
zu.summary: Isikhundla seSiQhwaga seNesi Esinamakhono eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC kanye nohluvo oluhambisano lokunakekelwa.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yohluvo oluhambisana/oluhlolwayo kuleso suku emva kokubhalisa njengesiQhwaga seNesi kwi-SANC ekuNakekelweni Okujwayelekile. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-14 (eyishuminane) yohluvo oluhambisana/oluhlolwayo kuNokunakekelwa emva kokubhalisa njengesiQhwaga seNesi kwi-SANC ekuNakekelweni Okujwayelekile okukhona okungenani iminyaka engu-10 (ishumi) kumele kube uhluvo oluhambisana/oluhlolwayo esigabeni ngemva kokuthola isidingo seminyaka eyi-1 (eyodwa) yasesikhundleni sobuchwepheshe esigabeni esihambisanayo. Izidingo Esiyingxenye: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme noma esilinganayo. I-Degree/Diploma ekuNakekelweni Okujwayelekile noma isidingo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengesiQhwaga seNesi. Isidingo esihambisanayo seminyaka eyi-1 (eyodwa) yasesikhundleni sobuchwepheshe eNyunyani yeNesi yesiQhwaga seThiyetha. Isitifiketi sokubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC). Isipeshadi samanje se-SANC (2026). Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yohluvo oluhambisana/oluhlolwayo emva kokubhalisa njengesiQhwaga seNesi kwi-SANC ekuNakekelweni Okujwayelekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa kanye Nokuqinisekiswa Okudingekayo: Ulwazi ngamasu nangendlela yokunakekelwa kwesifo, izixhumaniswa zamasesi, kanye nezinye izisekelo ezihambisanana nomthetho. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle- okukhulunywayo nokubhalwayo. Amakhono okuhlanganisa kanye noxhumano. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokucabanga ngokujulile. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kweqembu elinabantu abaningi abanamakhono ahlukene. Ukunakekela isiguli sengane esiphefumula ngesitshixo/abaguli abaphezulu bokuqashwa e-ICU ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Ukugcina ukukhula kwesiQhwaga/izinga lezimilo kanye nentuthuko yakho. Ukusiza ekunciphiseni izikhalazo ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Ohluvo lwangaphambilini kulezi zikhombandlela zingaba nomthelela omuhle: - Ukugcina okujwayelekile. Ukugcina ngendlela yokuhlonga, Ukuganya amathambo, Igumbi Lokuphola, i-CSSD, Ukubeletha neGynecology.
zu.duties: Imisebenzi ehle yabalingiswa, ukubonisa ukukhathaleka ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza nokumela kubaguli. Ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okuhle kuhlanganise ukwazile nokuthanda ukuphendula izidingo, izifiso kanye nezethemba zabaguli. Inikezwa kwezinsiza zohlelo ngokusungula izinga, izinqubomgomo kanye namasu. Ukubambe iqhaza ekusetshenzisweni kwemiyalo yezohluvo lwezempilo eziyisiqalo zamaphuzu abaluleke kakhulu, namaphrotokholi. Ukugcina amarekhodi abaguli aqinisekisiwe afakiwe ngokugcwele ngokwesidingo somthetho. Ukusebenzisa amandla okulawula isiyalo, izikhalazo nezindaba zomsebenzi. Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi kanye nabaguli. Ukusiza ekulawuleni nasekuthuthukisweni bonke abasebenzi bezokunakekelwa. Ukunciphisa izinga lokufa kanye nokugula kwabesifazane nabantwana. Ukuqinisekisa ukubambe iqhaza ngempumelelo kuzo zonke izinhlelo zesibhedlela njenge-IPC, ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, njll. Ukunikeza isimo esivikelayo, esiphilisa kanye nesisuthu kubaguli, abavakashi kanye nabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umongikazi weqhinga lokunyanga
xh.summary: Isithuba somongikazi weqhinga lokunyanga esibhedlele i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC namava afanelekileyo ekunyanga.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: iyangantoni eli ningcedo/elimvelayo ekunyangen emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi ochube phambili kwi-SANC ekunyanyeni ngokubanzi. Inqanaba 2: iminyaka eli 14 (elishumi nane) ubuncinane yamava ancédile/abonakalwe ekunyanyeni emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi ochube phambili kwi-SANC ekunyanyeni ngokubanzi, apho iminyaka eli 10 (lishumi) kufuneka ibe yamava ancédile/abonakalayo kweqhinga emva kokufumana isidanga seminyaka elisi-1 (nye) ngemva kwe-base ekwiphiko elifanelekileyo kweqhinga. Iimfuno zokungangeli: Isatifikethi sokuTsibela inqanaba okulingana naso. Isidanga/iploma ekunyanyeni ngokubanzi okulingana nesidanga esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ochube phambili. Isidanga seminyaka eli-1 (01) ngemva kwe-base kwiqhinga lokunyanga kwindlu yokuhlinzwa. Isatifikethi sokubhalisa kunye neSouth African Nursing Council (SANC). Isiphi sendalo se-SANC (2026). Ubuncinane beminyaka eli 4 yamava ancédile/abonakalayo emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi ochube phambili kwi-SANC ekunyanyeni ngokubanzi. Ulwazi, Amandla, uqeqesho namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo nemigaqo yokunyanga, izigaba ezithatha ngokunyanya, nakwisiseko sezomthetho. Amandla amaninzi okunceda-ke, ekuthetheni nasokubhaleni. Amandla okulungelelanisa nokudibana. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki namandla okucinga ngokujonga. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba elinezinto ezininzi. Ukunyanga isiguli se-paediatric esifumana i-ventilation/esikumngeni ophezulu kwi-ICU ngaphakathi kolawulo. Ukugcina ukukhula komntu oqeqeshiwe / ngokumyinge wemigaqo-yokuziphatha nokuziphuhlisa. Ukunceda ukunciphisa iingxaki ngaphakathi kweso lawulo. Amava amabini kweli candelo alandelayo aya kuba luncedo: - Ukuhlinza ngokubanzi. Ukuhlinza ngendlela ye-laparoscopic, ukuhlinza ngemithambo-ligunya, Igumbi lokubuyisela umntu esimeni somzimba, i-CSSD, i-Obstetrics & Gynea.
xh.duties: Ukulawula abasiguli ngokusebenzayo, ukubonisa inkathalo ngabasiguli, ukukhuthaza nokuchasa. Unyango oluchanekileyo nenkathalo ehlanganisa ukuqonda nokulungele ukuphendula iimfuno, iimfuno nethemba labasiguli. Ukunikezela iinkonzo zomgangatho ophezulu ngokuseta imilinganiselo, iinkqubo kunye neenkqubo zokwenza. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba ekusebenziseni imigaqo ekuyiyo yesizwe namagunya okunyanga, iinkqubo. Ukugcina amarekhodi achanekileyo apheleleyo abasiguli ngokulandela iimfuno zomthetho. Ukuzinza ngaphezulu kolawulo ekulinganiseleni, iingxaki kwezomanyano nezempilo. Ukukhuthaza ulwalamano oluhle olusebenzayo phakathi kwabasebenzi nabasiguli. Ukunceda ekulawuleni nokuphuhlisa bonke abasebenzi abangongiki. Ukunciphisa izinga lokufa komama nomntwana. Ukululise ukuthabatha inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo kulo onke amanqanaba e-prog e-sibhedlele.
