The appointment is subject to a positive outcome obtained from NIA to the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous employment experience verifications and verification from the company Intellectual Property (CIPC). The Department reserves the right not to fill the post (s). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige gesoek vir die spesialiteiteenheid by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital om gehalte-verpleegsorg te verskaf en personeel te superviseer.
af.requirements: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 (veertien) jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde, waarvan ten minste 10 (tien) jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in die spesialiteit moet wees. Minimum Vereistes: Senior Certificate of gelykwaardig. Graad/Diploma in Algemene verpleegkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Terugwonende een (01) jaar Post Basic kwalifikasie in Nefrologie Verpleegkunde Wetenskap. Registrasiesertifikaat by die South African Nursing Council (SANC). Huidige SANC-kwitansie (2026). 'n Minimum van 4 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatute, en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerk. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede-verbaal en skriftelik. Koördinasie- en skakelingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede en kritiese denkvaardighede. Vermoë om binne die multidissiplinêre span te werk.
af.duties: Bystand met die beplanning/organisering en monitering van doelstellings van die gespesialiseerde eenheid. Verskaf 'n terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënte en die publiek. Verskaf omvattende, gehalte-verpleegsorg. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor alle verpleegpersoneel/huishoudelike personeel en gee hulle leiding en verseker kontinuïteit van pasiëntesorg op alle vlakke. Toon doeltreffende kommunikasie met pasiënte, families, die multidissiplinêre span en ander departemente binne die hospitaal. Bystand met toekenning/veranderingslys, dag- en nagdiensroosters en insetsels vir verlof. Bystand met rekordhouding en verskaf statistiese inligting oor opleiding en personeel. Om bystand te verleen met EPMDS-evaluering van personeel en EAP te implementeer. Bystand met oriëntasie, induksie en monitering van alle verpleegpersoneel. Om pasiëntverwante data te voltooi en aan navorsing deel te neem. Bevorder gehalte gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg soos bepaal deur die omvang van praktyk en standaarde vasgestel deur die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Om bystand te verleen met tydelike pligte van die toesighouer en optree as junior skifteleier op beide dag- en nagshift. Om deel te neem aan algehele gespesialiseerde eenheidsfunksies, d.w.s. spanbou. Doeltreffende en doeltreffende bestuur van alle hulpbronne. Werk onder direkte toesig van die Critical Care Operational Manager. Om intermittente hemodialise vir akute en chroniese pasiënte binne die fasiliteit uit te voer. Om alle nierdienste binne die fasiliteit te koördineer. Om pasiënte op CRRT te koppel en te monitor. Om doeltreffend met die multidissiplinêre span te werk. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaard en selfontwikkeling. Bystand met vermindering van klagtes binne die direktoraat.

zu.title: Professional Nurse Specialty
zu.summary: Kudingwa umongikazi wezokwelapha othwebule ukuya kwesikhungo samakhono i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwamakhono abangcweti futhi aqonde abasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Okuncane iminyaka engu-4 yokuhlangabezana nayo/okubonakalayo ekuqashweni nasesikhundleni somsebenzi wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa njengongcweti wezokwelapha ku-SANC kwisifundo se-General Nursing. Izinga 2: Okuncane iminyaka engu-14 (fourteen) yokuhlangabezana nayo/okubonakalayo ekuqashweni nasesikhundleni somsebenzi wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa njengongcweti wezokwelapha ku-SANC kwisifundo se-General Nursing, lapho okungenani iminyaka engu-10 (ten) kumele kube ukuhlangabezana/okubonakalayo ekuqashweni kwaleso sikhundla. Izidingo Okuncane: Senior Certificate noma okulinganayo. Degree/Diploma ku-General nursing noma izifundo ezifanayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengongcweti wezokwelapha. Isifundo esihambisanayo samunyaka owodwa (01) se-Post Basic kwi-Nephrology Nursing Science. Isitifiketi sobhaliso ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC). Isipeshadi samanje se-SANC (2026). Okuncane iminyaka engu-4 yokuhlangabezana nayo/okubonakalayo emva kokubhalisa njengongcweti wezokwelapha ku-SANC kwisifundo se-General Nursing. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa noKuhlakanipha Okudingekayo: Ulwazi lwenqubo nezinhlela zokwelapha, izinqubo zomthetho, namanye okuhlobene nazo. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle-akuye nakubhaliwe. Amakhono okuququzelela nokuxhumana. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono okucabanga ngokujulile. Isikhono sokusebenza ngaphakathi kweqembu elisebenza ngendlela yamakhono amaningi.
zu.duties: Msiza ekubekweni ihlelo/ukuhlelweni nasekuqondweni izinhloso yeqoqo elikhethiwe. Nikeza isimo esithuthukisayo emphakathini wabasebenzi, abagulayo kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuphelele nokunobungcweti kwezokwelapha. Nikeza okuhlakaniphile okuphelele nakwezinye izindlela ekubhekeleni bonke abasebenzi bezokwelapha/abasebenzi bohlolojikelele futhi ubanikeze isiqondiso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa kwesiguli ngamazinga onke. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nesiguli, mindo, iqembu elisebenza ngendlela yamakhono amaningi kanye namanye amaminyango ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela. Siza ekwabelweni/ushintshweni kohlu, kwamashifu emini nasebusuku, kanye neminikelo yamalungu. Siza ekugcineni amarekhodi futhi uhlinze ngolwazi ngezibalo ngokuqeqeshwa kanye nezisebenzi. Ukusiza ekuhloleni abasebenzi nge-EPMDS futhi usebenzise i-EAP. Siza ekujwayelweni, ekungeniseni nasekuqondweni bonke abasebenzi bezokwelapha. Ukuqedela imininingwane ehlobene nesiguli futhi ubambe iqhaza ocwaningweni. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa okunobungcweti kwezokwelapha njengokuqondiswa isibalo sokusebenza kanye namazinga abekwe uhlelo oluhambisanayo. Ukusiza ngezinkinga zokusiza zomphathi futhi ube ngumholi weshifu osemncane womhlaba nosuku. Ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yonke yeqoqo elikhethiwe, okungukuthi ukwakha iqembu. Uphathe ngokusebenzayo nangokuphumelelayo wonke amasu. Sebenza ngaphansi kokuqondiswa okuphelele komphathi we-Critical Care Operational Manager. Ukwenza i-intermittent haemodialysis kumagula ajulile nangesikhathi eside ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Ukuhlanganisa zonke izinsizamoya zobungani empilweni ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Ukuhlanganisa inani labantu abayisihlanu futhi ulawule ukuphila kwabo ngokuphelele. Ukuhlanganyela ngokuphumelelayo neqembu elisebenza ngendlela yamakhono amaningi. Gcina ukukhula komsebenzi/izinga lokuziphatha ngokuzethemba ekuzidumiseni. Siza ekwehliseni izikhalazo ngaphakathi kwesikhungo.

xh.title: Umongikazi weZiseko ngomKhakha
xh.summary: Kufuneki kubekho umongikazi ochwepheshe wesebe ngobuchwepheshe kwiDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital ukuze anikeze ukhatho olungangomkhakha lwakhe lokusingatha iintsapho nokuqondisa abasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane kule minyaka engama-4 yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo kwingcali yokunyanga emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi weZiseko nge-SANC ekunyangekeni iNgokubanzi. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane kule minyaka elingama-14 (ishumi elinesine) yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo ekunyangekeni emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi weZiseko nge-SANC ekunyangekeni iNgokubanzi, apho ubuncinane iminyaka elingu-10 (lishumi) kumele kube ngamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo kweso siwelwe. Iimfuno eZiseko: Isatifikethi Senqanaba lesiXeko okanye into elingana nayo. i-Degree/i-Diploma ekunyangekeni ngokubanzi okuba nelifa elilingana nalo elivumela ukubhalisa nge-SANC njengoMongikazi weZiseko. Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sonyaka omnye (01) se-Post Basic kwenzululwazi yokunyanga iNephrology. Isatifikethi sobhaliso ngeSouth African Nursing Council (SANC). Isipedi sesiNgangamaxesha se-SANC (2026). Ubuncinane kule minyaka engama-4 yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi weZiseko nge-SANC ekunyangekeni iNgokubanzi IZaziso, amakhono, uqeqesho kunye noLwazi olufunekayo: Ulwazi ngemiqatho kunye nemithetho yokunyanga, izikwelo zokunyanga, nolunye ulwembu olusemthethweni oluhambelana nendawo. Amanono amaninzi athetha nokuwela-thetha ndawonye namabali ecandelo, oluqinileyo nesilulumagama apho baxutywa ngawo ii-Nilotic group kunye nezinye iilwimi zase-Afrika ezithethwa ngasemzini kwamagatya, ezisezandleni zokwenza izixhobo eziphathekayo nezigcina kwindlu imithi yokubakho imigqa ingangativi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphakathi kothotho lweengcali ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Uncede ekubekeni/uqoqi nakulwathweni lwemigqangqelo yeseko ngobuchwepheshe. Unike indawo ekubakho iintsapho, iindwendwe, iingcali, izisebenzi, iindwendwe zomzi, abantu abakwindlu, uluntu. Unikezele ngokubanzi ukhatho olupheleleyo ngokwemigaqo yolwazi lwakhe. Nikezela ngokulawula nokuqonda okuqinileyo ukuba abantu abayiyo iindwendwe kumva kwaloo ndalo bakhuliswa xa kubakhona isihlanji, iingcali zokukhulisa uluntu, ezidibana nomntu ngamnye xa kukho iinkqubo ezikunika isalathiso nakuzo zonke iindwendwe ezingadanga ngokubanzi. Unike isalathiso esilula kwizinto ezinokwenzeka kwasekhaya, iingcali ezikwaziyo ukusuka emzini ukuyisebenzela, nakuqonda kakuhle nokuvela kwemizekelo yakhe ekwindlu ngasekhaya ekuthathwa ngoko zangele iintsapho. Yonke imisebenzi yokwenza isakhiwo esingathathi nkqubo, izisebenzi ezikwindlu zakhe nakuvela kwiindwendwe ngakunye nokulinganisa iindwendwe ezikwazi ukuqonda ekubeni ziseko ngokubanzi. Uncede ekubekeni nasekulawuleni izinto ezinokubakho yindima, iindwendwe ngokunxulumana ne-Professional ngokubanzi nabantu abasuka kwindlu bahlala ekhaya. Unceda ngokubakho ngumanyano, ovela kumyalezo othunyelwa abantu abangekho ekhaya neNkqubo yokuqinisekisa ukuba zizonke iindwendwe ezindala ngokubanzi zikwindlu ngakunye nokuhlala kwazo ngokubanzi.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse (SPECIALTY) Grade 1/2
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 530 – R752 913 per annum plus 13th Cheque, Home Owners Allowance Employee must meet prescribed requirements), Medical aid (Optional)
jobs.summary: Provide specialist midwifery and neonatal nursing care at Queen Nandi Regional Hospital in Empangeni, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic advanced midwifery qualification.
jobs.requirements: Matric/Grade 12 Certificate. Degree / Diploma qualification that allows registration to General Nursing & Midwifery plus a relevant post basic qualification (Diploma in Advanced Midwifery & Neonatal Nursing Science). Registration certificate with South African Nursing Council (SANC). Current SANC receipt (2026). Experience required: Grade 1 is a minimum of 4 years’ experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse. Grade 2 is a minimum of 14 years’ experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing at least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the 1 year post basic qualification in the relevant specialty. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Required: Knowledge of South African Nursing Act (Act 33 of 2005) and SANC regulation. Knowledge of Public Service Acts, regulations and policies. National Health Act. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal frameworks. Knowledge of Maternity care guidelines (latest South African guidelines). Knowledge of guidelines for saving mothers and saving babies. Knowledge of essential steps in managing obstetric emergencies (ESMOE). Knowledge of essential care of the new-born (ECN). Knowledge of basic Ante Natal Care (BANC Plus) and MBFHI. Management of obstetric emergencies (PPH, eclampsia, shoulder dystocia, cord prolapse etc). Maternal and Perinatal death surveillance and response. Knowledge of Ideal hospital framework, quality assurance and clinical governance. Leadership and supervision, good communication, verbal, written, leadership, interpersonal, problem solving, conflict management and decision-making skills. Health information systems and recordkeeping, data analysis and use of health indicators. Knowledge and experience in implementation of Batho Pele Principles and Patient’s Rights Charter, Code of Conduct. Team building and diversity Management skills.
jobs.duties: Provide comprehensive specialist midwifery care to antenatal, intrapartum, postnatal, and neonatal patients according to national and provincial guidelines. Provision of quality services through setting standards, policies and procedures. Reduction of maternal and child mortality and morbidity rate. Initiate and lead all obstetric programs i.e. PPP, PMTCT, CARMA MBFHI, ESMOE, etc. Manage obstetric and neonatal emergencies, initiating appropriate treatment and timely referral where necessary. Implement maternal and perinatal quality improvement programmes, including maternal death reviews, perinatal mortality meetings, and clinical audits. Participate in the implementation of National Priorities clinical guidelines, protocols. Supervise, mentor, and support nursing staff, student nurses, and community service nurses in the maternity unit. Exercise control over discipline, grievance and labour relations issues. Assist in development of all nursing staff. Ensure infection prevention and control (IPC) measures and maintain patient safety standards. Maintain accurate patient records, statistics, and reports in accordance with Department of Health policies. Promote maternal, new-born, and family health education, including breastfeeding support and family planning. Provide a Safe, therapeutic and hygienic environment for patients, visitors and staff. Ensure availability and proper management of medicines, equipment, and supplies within the maternity unit. Participate in continuous professional development (CPD), research, and implementation of evidence- based practice. Comply with legal, ethical, and professional standards, including the Nursing Act, National Health Act, Batho Pele Principles, Patients' Rights Charter, and other relevant policies.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs J Marais Tel No: (035) 907 7005
jobs.applications: All applications must be forwarded to: Human Resources Offices at Queen Nandi Regional Hospital Private Bag X20005, Empangeni, 3880. Physical Address: 21 Union Street, Empangeni, 3880. Email: queennandihospital.hrjobapplication@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Deputy Director Human Resources Mr. SM Ndabandaba Tel No: (035) 907
jobs.notes: Applicants are requested to apply with a new Z83 Application Form obtainable at any Government Department or the website www.kznhealth.gov.za (effective from 01.01.2021). The Z83 form must be completed in full and page 2 duly signed. Clear indication of the post and reference number that is being applied for must be indicated on Z83. Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Information such as Educational qualifications, date(s) of registration with council, relevant work experience and periods in service should be clearly indicated on the CV. Applicants are not required to submit Copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Such documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. General information: Short- listed candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determine by the KZN Department of Health. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). People with disabilities should feel free to apply. Males are encouraged to apply for this post. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must consider their applications unsuccessful. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have a foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All employees in the Public Service that are presently on the same salary level but on a notch/package above of the advertised post are free to apply. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be assessed. Due severe budgetary constraints that the hospital is currently facing, candidates are respectfully advised that the following cost-cutting measures will apply: Subsistence & Travelling (S&T) allowance claims will not be processed. Resettlement and or relocation claims will not be paid. The Hospital has a limited accommodation; therefore, incumbents appointed for the post should arrange their own private accommodation prior the assumption of duty NB: Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of work experience endorsed and stamped by the employer/s and/or certified copies of qualifications and registration certificates (where applicable) prior to the date of the interview.

af.title: Professional Nurse (SPECIALTY) Graad 1/2
af.summary: Verskaf spesialist-vroedvroue- en neonatale verpleegsorg by Queen Nandi Regional Hospital in Empangeni, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n post-basiese gevorderde vroedvroue-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Senior sertifikaat/St. 12-sertifikaat. Graad / Diploma-kwalifikasie wat registrasie by General Nursing & Midwifery toelaat plus 'n tersaaklike post basiese kwalifikasie (Diploma in Advanced Midwifery & Neonatal Nursing Science). Registrasiesertifikaat by South African Nursing Council (SANC). Huidige SANC-kwitansie (2026). Ervaring vereis: Vlak 1 is 'n minimum van 4 jaar se ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professional Nurse. Vlak 2 is 'n minimum van 14 jaar se ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professional Nurse met SANC in General Nursing waarvan ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit moet wees na verkryging van die 1 jaar post basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van die South African Nursing Act (Act 33 of 2005) en SANC-regulasies. Kennis van Public Service Acts, regulasies en beleide. National Health Act. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander tersaaklike regskwadrante. Kennis van kraamsorg-riglyne (jongste South African riglyne). Kennis van riglyne vir die redding van moeders en babas. Kennis van noodsaaklike stappe in die bestuur van verloskundige noodgevalle (ESMOE). Kennis van noodsaaklike sorg van die pasgeborene (ECN). Kennis van basiese Ante Natal Care (BANC Plus) en MBFHI. Bestuur van verloskundige noodgevalle (PPH, eklampsie, skouerdistosie, koordprolaps, ens.). Moeder- en perinatale sterfte-bewaking en -reaksie. Kennis van Ideal hospital-raamwerk, gehaltesekerheid en kliniese bestuur. Leierskap en toesig, goeie kommunikasie, mondeling, skriftelik, leierskap, interpersoonlik, probleemoplossing, konflikbestuur en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Gesondheidsinligtingstelsels en rekordhouding, data-analise en gebruik van gesondheidsaanduiders. Kennis en ervaring in die implementering van Batho Pele Principles en Patient's Rights Charter, Code of Conduct. Spanbou- en diversiteitsbestuurvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf omvattende spesialist-vroedvrouesorg aan prenatale, intrapartum, postnatale en neonatale pasiënte volgens nasionale en provinsiale riglyne. Verskaffing van gehalte dienste deur die instelling van standaarde, beleide en prosedures. Vermindering van moeder- en kindersterftes en morbiditeitsyfers. Inisiëer en lei alle verloskundige programme, d.w.s. PPP, PMTCT, CARMA MBFHI, ESMOE, ens. Bestuur verloskundige en neonatale noodgevalle, inisiëer toepaslike behandeling en tydige verwysing waar nodig. Implementeer moeder- en perinatale gehalteverbeteringsprogramme, insluitend hersiening van moedersterftes, perinatale sterftesvergaderings en kliniese oudite. Neem deel aan die implementering van nasionale prioriteite kliniese riglyne en protokolle. Superwiseer, mentor en ondersteun verpleegpersoneel, studenteverpleegkundiges en gemeenskapsdiensverpleegkundiges in die verloskunde-eenheid. Oefen beheer uit oor disspline, griewe en arbeidsverhoudingskwessies. Bystand in die ontwikkeling van alle verpleegpersoneel. Verseker infeksievoorkoming en -beheer (IPC) maatreëls en handhaaf pasiëntveiligheidsstandaarde. Onderhou akkurate pasiëntrekords, statistieke en verslae in ooreenstemming met die Department of Health se beleide. Bevorder maater-, pasgebore- en gesinsgesondheidsopvoeding, insluitend borsvoedingsondersteuning en gesinsbeplanning. Verskaf 'n veilige, terapeutiese en higiëniese omgewing vir pasiënte, besoekers en personeel. Verseker beskikbaarheid en behoorlike bestuur van medisyne, toerusting en voorrade binne die verloskunde-eenheid. Neem deel aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling (CPD), navorsing en implementering van getuienisgebaseerde praktyk. Voldoen aan wettige, etiese en professionele standaarde, insluitend die Nursing Act, National Health Act, Batho Pele Principles, Patients' Rights Charter en ander relevante beleide.

zu.title: I-Nurse ejwayelekile (SPECIALTY) I-Grade 1/2
zu.summary: Nikela ngokunakekelwa okukhethekile kwezokubeletha nezesimo sezokunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa eNodi Yezempilo Yendawo yakwaNandi eNkandla, idinga ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuthuthukisiwe okuyisisekelo kwezokubeletha kabanzi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikilikho e-Grade 12. I-degree noma i-diploma ezivumela ukubhaliswa njengonobhala wezokwelapha kanye nobuhlakani bokubeletha kanye nokuqeqeshwa okufanelekile okwaziswa ngemva kokuthola idiploma. Isitifiketi sobuhlakani esibhaliswa e-South African Nursing Council (SANC). Isiphathi sakamuva se-SANC (2026). Isipiliyoni esidingekayo: I-Grade 1 idinga ubuncane beminyaka emi-4 yokusebenza njengesibhedlela sezingane ngemva kokubhaliswa njengonobhala wezokwelapha. I-Grade 2 idinga ubuncane beminyaka eyi-14 yokusebenza njengesibhedlela sezingane ngemva kokubhaliswa njengonobhala wezokwelapha nge-SANC kubuhlakani bokubeletha okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube isipiliyoni esifanele kuleyo nhlangano ngayinye ngemva kokuthola isiphathi sokusebenza kwakhona kwamakhulu eminyaka. Ulwazi, amakhono nezidingo ezidingekayo: Ulwazi ngomthetho wezamabomu e-Afrika Kuzulu-ningizimu (Act 33 of 2005) kanye nokuqashwa kwe-South African Nursing Council. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesikhungo sikaZwelonke. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zokunakekelwa nokwelashwa kwezimpilo zomphakathi, imithetho yezamabamu kanye nezinye izinkomba ezingokomthetho. Ulwazi lwezinkomba zokunakekelwa kwabesifazane ezikhulumwa ngomthetho wezwe. Ulwazi ngezigaba ezithile ezidinga ulwazi ngendlela ezisindisa abesifazane nabantwana. Ulwazi ngezigaba eziyisisekelo ezingokunakekelwa kwabesifazane (BANC Plus) kanye ne-MBFHI. Ulwazi ngezimo eziphuthumayo ezingokwelashwa kwabesifazane. Ulwazi olubalulekile lokunakekelwa kwezinsiza zokubeletha kanye nokunakekelwa kwamaphoyisa. Ulwazi lokusiza ekunakekeni abesifazane nabantwana. Ulwazi lokulawula izimo eziphuthumayo ezithinta ukubeletha. Amakhono obuholi futhi abhekise kalula, okubalulekile ukuthi aphathwe ngokusebenzisa izinkomba ezihlukene. Ulwazi lokulawula nokugcina izinkomba.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokunakekelwa okukhethekile kwezokuqeqesha abeluleki kubafundi abakhulelwe, ngesikhathi sokubeletha, emva kokubeletha, kanye nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ngokuya emihlahlandlela yezwe nesifundazwe. Ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi emihle kokuqikelela kabanzi emiqondweni yokumisa amasu. Ukwehlisa izinga lokufa kokubeletha kwezibelethi nakubantwana. Qala futhi uhole wonke amaphrogramu obugcisa wokubeletha njengakwalawo abayise ngezigaba ezahlukene. Phatha izimo eziphuthumayo zokubeletha kanye nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa, uqale unyakaze ekwelaphweni okufanele futhi uthumele abaguli kwezinye izikhungo ngesikhathi esifanele uma kunesidingo. Setha amaphrojekhi okuthuthukisa izinga eliphezulu lezokubeletha kanye nezokusinda kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa, okuhlanganisa ukubuka kabusha izifo zokufa kwezibelethi, izinkomfa ezithintisa ukusinda kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa, kanye nokuhlola izinto ezenziwe ezingcali zempilo. Thatha inhlangothi ekusepheni izinkomba zenani elihle lokwelapha ezindleleni ezihlelwe ngaphezulu ngokubaluleka kwesifundazwe, kwezombusazwe nakwezinye izinhlangano ezifana neziphathimandla. Qaphisisa, nikeza ulwazi futhi useke abasebenzi bezokunakekelwa kwabafundisisa bezokwelapha abahlala emphakathini ohlinzweni nabesifazane ababelethisayo. Lawula ngokuphelele izindaba zokuhlakanipha, izinkinga, kanye nezomsebenzi kubantu. Siza ekuthuthukiseni bonke abasebenzi bezokunakekelwa. Qinisekisa izinto ezivimba ukuthelelelana nokulawula ukwanda kwawo kanye nokugcina amazinga okuphepha komuntu ofuna ukwelashwa. Gcina irekhodi eliqinisekiswa nobunyene bobungcweti bamaphupha nokunakekelwa kwengculaza nokwelapha ngomshweshelo. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa okuphelele kwabesifazane, abantwana, imfundo yempilo yomndeni okuhlanganisa ukusiza ukukhulisa ingane ngobisi kanye nokuqunjelwa kwamasiko okuhlelwe kahle. Nikela ngokuhlinzeka okuphephile okwelapha futhi kungenwa kunoma ibuphi ubungozi kubantu abanye abafuna ukwelashwa, abantu abavakashayo, kubasebenzi. Hlola ukuthuthukiswa kolwazi lokusebenza kahle ngokulandelana kwezinkomba ekusebenzeni ngokusesigabeni esithile. Hlanganyela ekubhaliseni izinhlelo ezifana nezigaba ezithile kwabasebenzi abaningi abanamakhono ukuthi bakwazi ukuphathwa ngokuphelele kokulimala nokunakekelwa, ucwaningo kanye nokusetshenziswa kolwazi olusha ekusebenzeni ngesisekelo salo. Landela ngemithetho yezomthetho ezifana nomthetho wezamabomu e-Afrika Kuzulu-ningizimu, isibopho sezomthetho sakho konke okushiwo ocwaningweni olubhalwe ngezansi.

xh.title: Nongendi oPhathe kakhulu (ISIGABA) Grede 1/2
xh.summary: Nika unakekelo olusesigabaneni kukaNongendi wokuzala kwabazali nasekwabanini abasandula ukuzalwa eQueen Nandi Regional Hospital e-Empangeni, kufuneka ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC unobe nesidanga sokugqibela kwiNgodzi yolwazi lokuzala kwabazali oluphambili.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric/Grede 12. Isidanga / Isidanga sokugqibela esivumela ukubhaliswa kuQeqesho lweNgodzi nokuNongenda kunye nendlela ekufuneka ithathwe iNgodzi yeBhedi elandela isidanga (Isidanga kuQeqesho oluphambili lokuNongenda & cEzekiso lweNyanga entsha). Isatifikethi sokubhalisa ngoMongameli wokuNongenda woMzantsi Afrika (SANC). Isipho sokuqala sama-2026 kwi-SANC esisezantsi. Iimfuno zolwaphulo-mthetho: I-Grede 1 ngumlinganisela osezantsi kwiminyaka emi-4 yamava aNongendi emva kokubhaliswa njengoNongendi oPhathe kakhulu. I-Grede 2 ngumlinganiselo osezantsi kweminyaka engama-14 yamava eNongendeni emva kokubhaliswa njengoNongendi oPhathe kakhulu nge-SANC eNongendeni jikelele ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 kwelo xesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka ibe yamava afanelekileyo/okubonakalayo kwesi sigaba ngemva kokuthatha unyaka omnye weNgodzi yokugqibela kwesi sigaba. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi ngoMthetho wokuNongenda woMzantsi Afrika (UMthetho 33 ka-2005) kunye noLawulo lwe-SANC. Ulwazi ngeMithetho yeNkonzo kaWonke-wonke, imigaqo nakwiinkqubo. UMthetho wezeMpilo loMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuNongenda nendlela ezilandelwa ngayo, imithetho yeNongendi nolunye ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngomthetho. Ulwazi ngeenkqubomgaba zokunakekelwa kwabazali (imigaqo yakutshanje yoMzantsi Afrika). Ulwazi ngeenkqubomgaba zokusindwa kwabazali nakwabanini abasandula ukuzalwa. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo eziyimfuneko ekulawuleni iimeko eziphuthumayo zokuzala (ESMOE). Ulwazi ngeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo zokunakekela umntwana osandula ukuzalwa (ECN). Ulwazi ngoQeqesho lwangaphambi kokuzalwa (BANC Plus) nange-MBFHI. Ulawulo lweemeko eziphuthumayo ezibhekene nokuzala (PPH, i-eclampsia, i-shoulder dystocia, i-cord prolapse, njl). Ulwazi lwezibalo kumazali nakwabanini abasandula ukuzalwa. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yePython.
xh.duties: Nika ukunakekelwa okupheleleyo nokusesigabaneni kukaNongendi kwabaguleli abasemvakweni wokuqala, abasemvakweni wokuzala, emva kokuzala, nasekwabanini abasandula ukuzalwa ngokwemigaqo yaseburhulaphuleni nakwisixeko. Unikezelo lweenkonzo zomgangatho ophezulu ngokumisela amanqanaba, iinkqubomgama kunye neendlela ezilandelwayo. Ukunciphisa izinga lokufa nokugula kwabazali nasekwabanini. Qala uze ulawule zonke iinkqubo zokuqala kwabazali njenge-PPP, PMTCT, CARMA MBFHI, ESMOE, njl. Lawula iimeko eziphuthumayo zokuzala kwabazali nakwabanini abasandula ukuzalwa, uqale unyango olufanelekileyo uze uthumele kwabanye ngexesha elifanelekileyo apho kufuneka khona. Zisebenzise iinkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho kumazali nakwabanini abasandula ukuzalwa, kuquka nokuphonononga ukufa kwabazali, iintlanganiso zokufa kwabanini abasandula ukuzalwa, kunye nokujongwa nzulu kweenkonzo zempilo. Thatha inxaxheba ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zombuzo wamazwe ngamazwe zemigaqo yamangqamuzana yeenkonzo zempilo. Tyhalela, kube ngumzekelo, unike ncedo abasebenzi bokuhlola, abafundi bakwaNongendi, kunye nabaNongendi besebenzo loluntu kwicandelo labazali. Lawula isithintelo, iingxaki kunye neendaba ezimalunga nomsebenzi. Nceda ekuphuculweni kwabasebenzi bonke bakwaNongendi. Qinisekisa amanyathelo okuthintela ukutwalwa kweentyetyebo (IPC) ugcine amanqanaba okhuseleko lomguli. Gcina amarekhodi omguli akwayinyanisekile, izibalo, neengxelo ngokuvumelana neenkqubomgama zeSebe lezeEmpilo. Khuthaza imfundo ngeempilo zamazali, abanini abasandula ukuzalwa, nentsapho, kuquka ukuxhasa ukunyathelisa kunye noqeqesho lwezocalulo. Nikela indawo ekhuselekileyo, eyonyangayo, ehlanzweyo kwabaguleli, ababhekiyo, nasebasebenzini. Qinisekisa ukufumaneka kolawulo oluchanekileyo lwamayeza, izixhobo, nezinto ezifunekayo kwicandelo labazali. Thatha inxaxheba ekuphuculeni ngokusondeleyo ubuchule obungowomsebenzi (CPD), kuphononongo, nasekusebenziseni amasu asekelwe kwizinto eziziqhayiso. Landela amanqanaba okusesikweni, obugqila, nobomprofethuni, kuquka uMthetho wokuNongenda, uMthetho wezeMpilo loMzantsi Afrika, iMigaqo yeBatho Pele, ilungelo loMguli, nanye iinkqubomgama ezimalunga neso.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse General Stream
jobs.centre: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.city: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (General Stream) position at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, open across three experience grades.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: No experience required. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Minimum Requirements: Degree/Diploma qualification that allows registration to General Nursing & Midwifery. Plus, a relevant post basic qualification in Operating Theatre nursing. Registration certificate with South African Nursing Council (SANC) Current SANC receipt (2026). 4 years’ experience in General Nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse. Successful candidate will have to spend minimum of one year in service. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Knowledge of Public Service Acts, regulations and policies. Knowledge of SANC rules and regulations. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal frameworks. Good communication, verbal, written, leadership, interpersonal, problem solving, conflict management and decision making skills. Knowledge and experience in implementation of Batho Pele Principles and Patient’s Rights Charter, Code of Conduct. Team building and diversity Management skills. Previous experience in the following disciplines would be advantageous: - General surgery. Laparoscopic surgery Orthopaedic surgery, Recovery Room, CSSD, Obstetric & Gynae.
jobs.duties: Effective management of patients, display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating. Proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient’s needs, requirements and expectations. Provision of quality services through setting of standards, policies and procedures. Participate in the implementation of National Priorities clinical guidelines, protocols. Maintain accurate and complete patient records according to legal requirements. Exercise control over discipline, grievance and labour relations issues. Promote good working relationships amongst staff and patients. Assist in supervision and development of all nursing staff. Reduction of maternal and child mortality and morbidity rate. Ensure effective participation in all hospital programs e.g. IPC, Quality Assurance, etc. Provide a Safe, therapeutic and hygienic environment for patients, visitors and staff.
jobs.enquiries: Ms SC Nduli: Nursing Manager – Dr PKISMH Tel No: (031) 530 1565
jobs.applications: To be hand delivered to 310 Bhejane Street (Hospital Gate Number 2) Kwamashu or Emailed To: pixley.recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za or Couriered To: 310 Bhejane Street (Hospital Gate Number 2) Kwamashu FOR ATTENTION : Deputy Director: HRM
jobs.notes: The following documents must be submitted, Application for employment form (Z83), which is obtainable at any Government Department or form website- www.kznhealth.gov.za. Originally signed Z83 must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of current/previous work experience endorsed and stamped by Human Resource Department & other required documents. Applications must be submitted on or before the closing date. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83 e.g. DPKISMH 14/2023. NB: Failure to comply with the above instruction will disqualify applicants. Please note that due to the number of applications anticipated, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to short listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within two months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The appointment is subject to a positive outcome obtained from NIA to the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous employment experience verifications and verification from the company Intellectual Property (CIPC). The Department reserves the right not to fill the post (s). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Algemene Stroom
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Algemene Stroom) pos by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, oop oor drie ervaringstegnieke.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Geen ervaring vereis nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Minimum Vereistes: Graad/Diploma-kwalifikasie wat registrasie tot Algemene Verpleging en Vrouensiekte en Verloskunde toelaat. Plus 'n toepaslike post basiese kwalifikasie in Operasiesaalverpleging. Registrasiesertifikaat met die South African Nursing Council (SANC). Huidige SANC-kwitansie (2026). 4 jaar se ervaring in Algemene Verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal 'n minimum van een jaar in diens moet deurbring. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van Openbare Diens Wette, regulasies en beleide. Kennis van SANC-reëls en regulasies. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegwette en ander toepaslike regsraamwerke. Goeie kommunikasie, mondelingse, skriftelike, leierskap, interpersoonlike, probleemoplossing, konflikbestuur en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Kennis en ervaring in die implementering van Batho Pele-beginsels en die Handves vir Pasiente se Regte, Gedragskode. Spanbou en diversiteitsbestuurvaardighede. Vorige ervaring in die volgende dissiplines sal voordelig wees: - Algemene chirurgie. Laparoskopiese chirurgie Ortopediese chirurgie, Herstelkamer, CSSD, Verloskunde en Vrouensiekte.
af.duties: Effektiewe bestuur van pasiente, toon sorg vir pasiente, bevordering en voorstaan. Behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiente se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te reageer. Lewering van gehalte dienste deur die instelling van standaarde, beleide en prosedures. Neem deel aan die implementering van Nasionale Prioriteite kliniese riglyne, protokolle. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasientrekords volgens wetlike vereistes. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, griewe en arbeidsverhoudingsake. Bevorder goeie werkverhoudinge tussen personeel en pasiente. Bystaan met toesig en ontwikkeling van alle verpleegpersoneel. Vermindering van moeder- en kindersterfte- en siektesyfer. Verse doeltreffende deelname aan alle hospitaalprogramme bv. IPC, Gehalteversekering, ens. Verskaf 'n veilige, terapeutiese en higiëniese omgewing vir pasiente, besoekers en personeel.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ohlobile Ohloleni Olujwayelekile
zu.summary: Isikhundla somhlengikazi ohlobile (ohloleni olujwayelekile) esibhedlela i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, sivulekile kumazinga amathathu okuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Akukho okuhlangenwe nakho okudingekayo. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 kokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele/okubonakalayo ekunakekelweni kwabagule emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ohlobile ne-SANC ekunakekelweni kwesijwayelekile. Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka engama-20 kokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele/okubonakalayo ekunakekelweni emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ohlobile ne-SANC ekunakekelweni kwesijwayelekile. Izidingo ezingangeni ndawo: I-Degree/Diploma evumela ukubhalisa ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile kanye nokubelethisi. Futhi, izifundo ezifanele zangemva kwesisekelo ekunakekelweni kwendlu yokuhlinzwa. Isitifiketi sobhaliso ne-South African Nursing Council (SANC). Isibambo se-SANC samanje (2026). Emva kweminyaka eyi-4 yokuhlangenwe nakho ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ohlobile. Umphumelelesi uzodinga ukusebenza okungenani unyaka owodwa enkonzweni. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho nethonyeliwa: Ukwazi umthetho wesevisi yomphakathi, izimiso kanye nemigomo. Ukwazi imithetho nezimiso ye-SANC. Ukwazi inqubo nezinyathelo zokunakekela, umthetho wokunakekela kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisana nalokho. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle, abhalayo, okukhuluma, obukhosi, obantu abaningi, okuxazulula izinkinga, okuphatha izingxabano kanye nokuthatha izinqumo. Ulwazi nokuhlangenwe nakho ekuphothweni kwezenkambiso ze-Batho Pele kanye ne-Patient's Rights Charter, i-Code of Conduct. Amakhono okwakha iqembu nokuphatha ukwenzekalisana. Kokuhlangenwe nakho kwangaphambili kule minyakazo edlulile kungaba ngcono: - Ukuhlinzwa okujwayelekile. Ukuhlinzwa ngendlela ye-Laparoscopic, ukuhlinzwa kwezitho ezithwalwayo, igumbi lokuphiliswa, i-CSSD, i-Obstetric & Gynae.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha abagule ngempumelelo, ukubonisa ukukhathazeka ngabagule, ukukhuthaza nokumela. Ukunakekelwa nokwelashwa okuhle okuhlanganisa ukuqonda nokuzithobela ekuphenduleni izidingo, izidingo kanye nezinhlayiya zabagule. Ukunikwa kwezinsiza zezinhlelo ngokuhlela amazinga, imigomo kanye nezinyathelo. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuphothweni kwezinqubomgomo zezinto ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa eziklinikhini, namaphrothokholi. Ukugcina ukubhalwa kwemibhalo yomuntu oyedwa yomgula okunembile kanye nokuqeda ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomthetho. Ukulawula isiyaluzi, izikhalazo kanye nezinkinga zobudlelwano bemisebenzi. Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza phakathi kwabasebenzi kanye nabagule. Ukusiza ekulawuleni nasekuthuthukisweni bonke abasebenzi bokuqeqesha. Ukunciphisa izinga lokufa komama kanye nezingane. Qinisekisa ukuthatha inxaxheba ngempumelelo kuzo zonke izinhlelo zesibhedlela njenge-IPC, i-Quality Assurance, njll. Nikeza isimo esiphephile, esiphilisa futhi esihlanzekile sabagule, abavakashi kanye nabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umongikazi ochweba Ojikeleze
xh.summary: Isithuba somongikazi (ojikeleze) eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sivulekile kuzo zonke iinqanaba ezithathu zeminyaka yamava.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mva luyfunekayo. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinci beminyaka engama-10 yamava afanelekileyo/avekwayo ekunyangeni emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi ochweba ku-SANC ekunyangeni ngokujikeleze. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinci beminyaka engama-20 yamava afanelekileyo/avekwayo ekunyangeni emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi ochweba ku-SANC ekunyangeni ngokujikeleze. Iimfuno ezingapheliyo: Isidanga/Isatifikethi esivumela ukubhaliswa ekunyangeni ngokujikeleze neNokuzalwa. Kananjalo, isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sasesebe sokusebenza ngemva kwesidanga kwisebe lokuba yimongikazi egumbi lokusebenla. Isatifikethi sobhaliso neSouth African Nursing Council (SANC). Isiphiwo samanje se-SANC (2026). Ubuncinci neminyaka emi-4 yamava ekunyangeni ngokujikeleze emva kobhaliso njengomongikazi ochweba. Umntu okhethiweyo kuya kufuneka achithe ubuncinci unyaka omnye kwinkonzo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nokuManyana okuyiMfuno: Ulwazi ngomthetho wesebe loLuntu, iimigaqo nengqiqo. Ulwazi ngokuwohloka kweendaba ze-SANC. Ulwazi ngeenqobo zokusuka, iindlela ezisetyenziswa ngoko, ngoko nalawunye ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngomthetho. Amakhona obuzwayo, elutyiwayo, okubhalwayo, okulawulayo, okuhambelana nabantu, okusombulula iingxaki, okulawula ingxabano nokwenza izigqibo. Ulwazi namava ekuphumezeni iMigaqo ye-Batho Pele ne-Magna yolungelo lwesigul, nakuwo onke amanye amathjuba. Ulwazi ngokusekela abantu kwiiNkqubo zokuSebenzela iNtsebenzo yoLuntu. Ubomi ngokwawo nolonwabo lokuzonwabisa kubantu abasetyenziniweyo: - Iyonke iNkqubo yoKusombulula iNgxaki. Iyonke iNkqubo yoKusebenzela iNgxaki eMatyhaleni bomzimba, iNkqubo yoKusebenzela iNgxaki ngeMithambo-lunga neNkqubo yokwamkela iNgxaki.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha abagula kakuhle, ukubonisa inkathalo ngeziguli, ukukhuthaza nokubakholela. Unyango oluchanekileyo nenkathalo okubandakanya ukuqonda nokuzimisela ukuphendula iimfuno zesiguli, iimfuno nethemba. Unikezelo lweenkonzo ezilungileyo ngokumisa iindlela, iinkqubo neenkqubo. Ukuzibandakanya ekusebenziseni iindlela ezibekwe ziNkqubo zoLuntu nemiqathango. Ukugcina iiNcwadi zeNcwadi ezichanekileyo nanezigqibo ngokomthetho. Ukulawula inkqubo yokuziphatha okanye ukungalungelelani nemiba yabasebenzi ngokomthetho. Ukukhuthaza ulwalamano oluhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaguli. Ukunceda ekulawuleni nasekuphuhliseni bonke abasebenzi beNkqubo yoKusika isiGul. Ukunciphisa igazi lesiguli nomtw. Ukukhokeza inKqubo yokusika ngokuchanekileyo yonke imisebenzi yeNkqubo yeNkhosi njengoko kubekwe nguRhulumende. Ukuqhuba imisebenzi emibi eqondene nokwakha uluntu olukhuselekileyo nolusingathwa kakuhle ngokomthetho kwabasebenzi, iindwendwe nabaguli.

jobs.title: Artisan Production Grade A, B (CARPENTER)

jobs.summary: The Department of Health seeks an artisan carpenter at Queen Nandi Regional Hospital to carry out maintenance, repairs, and installation of carpentry works and related fixtures.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10. Appropriate Trade Test Certificate in Carpentry in terms of section 13(2) (h) of the Manpower Act of 1981 as amended. Artisan Grade A: At least 0-2 years’ appropriate experience in an area after obtaining the relevant trade certificate. Artisan Grade B: At least 14 years’ appropriate / recognisable experience in an area after obtaining the relevant trade certificate. Valid driver’s license. Knowledge, Skills And Competencies Required: Sound knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993. Good communication skills, Interpersonal skills and negotiation and planning. Technical report writing, practical skills and experience of the trade. Good knowledge of hospital plant and machinery, equipment, air conditioning, as well as gas application and gas equipment. Good knowledge of legal compliance. Creativity and analytical thinking, problem solving and decision-making skills. Ability to work in a team, be customer focused and responsiveness. Computer Literacy: MS Office Software Package and presentation skills.
jobs.duties: Carry out maintenance, repairs, installation, and replacement of carpentry and joinery works throughout the hospital and associated facilities. Repair, manufacture, and install doors, door frames, windows, cupboards, cabinets, counters, shelves, partitions, ceilings, roofing timber, and other wooden structures. Install and maintain hospital furniture, fittings, fixtures, and specialised timber components in wards, theatres, clinics, offices, and accommodation. Repair and replace locks, hinges, door closers, handles, and other ironmongery associated with carpentry works. Inspect buildings and hospital infrastructure to identify defects and carry out preventative and corrective maintenance. Read and interpret drawings, sketches, specifications, and work instructions to execute carpentry projects. Operate, maintain, and ensure the safe use of carpentry hand tools, power tools, machinery, and workshop equipment. Manufacture timber items according to required specifications and quality standards. Ensure compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, infection prevention and control measures, and Departmental policies while performing maintenance activities. Respond promptly to emergency maintenance requests to ensure continuity of healthcare services. Inspect completed work to ensure compliance with quality standards and building regulations. Maintain accurate job cards, maintenance records, material usage records, and daily work reports. Assist in preparing material estimates, specifications, quotations, and procurement requirements for carpentry projects. Monitor and control the use of materials, tools, and equipment, ensuring accountability and minimising wastage. Participate in planned preventative maintenance programs and infrastructure improvement projects. Supervise and provide guidance to Artisan Assistants, Tradesmen Aids, interns, and learners where applicable. Work collaboratively with other maintenance disciplines, including Electrical, Plumbing, Mechanical, Painting, and Civil teams. Ensure good housekeeping in the carpentry workshop and maintain tools and equipment in a safe and serviceable condition. Participate in after-hours standby duties and emergency call-outs when required. Perform routine inspections of hospital infrastructure to identify potential safety hazards and maintenance requirements. Ensure compliance with the National Building Regulations and relevant South African National Standards (SANS). Assist with disaster recovery and emergency repairs during adverse weather events or infrastructure failures. Promote efficient utilisation of resources and implement cost-saving measures in maintenance operations. Mentor apprentices and contribute to skills development within the Maintenance Department. Maintain effective communication with users, supervisors, and contractors regarding maintenance activities. Perform any other maintenance-related duties as delegated by the Maintenance Supervisor, Foreman, or Chief Artisan.
jobs.enquiries: Mr ME Mhlongo Tel No: (035) 907 7006

Physical Address: 21 Union Street, Empangeni, 3880. Email: queennandihospital.hrjobapplication@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Deputy Director Human Resources Mr. SM Ndabandaba Tel No: (035) 907
jobs.notes: Applicants are requested to apply with a new Z83 Application Form obtainable at any Government Department or the website www.kznhealth.gov.za (effective from 01.01.2021). The Z83 form must be completed in full and page 2 duly signed. Clear indication of the post and reference number that is being applied for must be indicated on Z83. Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Information such as Educational qualifications, date(s) of registration with council, relevant work experience and periods in service should be clearly indicated on the CV. Applicants are not required to submit Copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Such documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. General information: Short- listed candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determine by the KZN Department of Health. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). People with disabilities should feel free to apply. Males are encouraged to apply for this post. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must consider their applications unsuccessful. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have a foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All employees in the Public Service that are presently on the same salary level but on a notch/package above of the advertised post are free to apply. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be assessed. Due severe budgetary constraints that the hospital is currently facing, candidates are respectfully advised that the following cost-cutting measures will apply: Subsistence & Travelling (S&T) allowance claims will not be processed. Resettlement and or relocation claims will not be paid. The Hospital has a limited accommodation; therefore, incumbents appointed for the post should arrange their own private accommodation prior the assumption of duty NB: Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of work experience endorsed and stamped by the employer/s and/or certified copies of qualifications and registration certificates (where applicable) prior to the date of the interview.

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A, B (TIMMERMAN)
af.summary: Die Departement van Gesondheid soek 'n ambagsman-timmerman by Queen Nandi Regional Hospital om instandhouding, herstelwerk en installasie van timmerwerk en verwante toebehore uit te voer.
af.requirements: Graad 10. Toepaslike Handelsertifikaat in Timmerwerk volgens artikel 13(2) (h) van die Mannekragwet van 1981 soos gewysig. Ambagsman Graad A: Ten minste 0-2 jaar se toepaslike ervaring in 'n area na verkryging van die relevante handelsertifikaat. Ambagsman Graad B: Ten minste 14 jaar se toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in 'n area na verkryging van die relevante handelsertifikaat. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Deeglike kennis van die Ockupasionele Gesondheid en Veiligheidswet 85 van 1993. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, interpersoonlike vaardighede en onderhandeling en beplanning. Tegniese verslagskrywing, praktiese vaardighede en ervaring van die handel. Goeie kennis van hospitaalaanleg en masjinerie, toerusting, lugversorging, asook gastoepassing en gastoerusting. Goeie kennis van wettige nakoming. Kreatiwiteit en analitiese denke, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk, klantgefokus wees en reaksievermoë. Rekenaargeletterdheid: MS Office-sagtewarepakket en aanbiedingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer instandhouding, herstelwerk, installasie en vervanging van timmer- en skrynwerk deur die hele hospitaal en verwante fasiliteite. Herstel, vervaardig en installeer deure, deurrame, vensters, kaste, kabinette, toonbanke, rakke, skeidingsmure, plafonne, daktonnels en ander houtstrukture. Installeer en onderhou hospitaalmeubels, passings, toebehore en gespesialiseerde houtkomponente in saale, teaters, klinieke, kantore en akkommodasie. Herstel en vervang slotte, skarniere, deursluitters, handvatsels en ander ysterware wat met timmerwerk gepaard gaan. Inspekteer geboue en hospitaalinfrastruktuur om gebreke te identifiseer en voorkomende en korrektiewe instandhouding uit te voer. Lees en interpreteer tekeninge, sketse, spesifikasies en werkinstruksies om timmerprojekte uit te voer. Bedryf, onderhou en verseker die veilige gebruik van timmerhandgereedskap, kraggereedskap, masjinerie en werkswinkeltuig. Vervaardig houtitems volgens vereiste spesifikasies en gehaltstandaarde. Verseker nakoming van die Ockupasionele Gesondheid en Veiligheidswet, infeksievoorkoming en -beheermaatreëls en departementele beleide terwur instandhoudingsaktiwiteite uitgevoer word. Reageer vinnig op noodinstandhoudingsversoeke om kontinuiteit van gesondheidsorgdienste te verseker. Inspekteer voltooide werk om nakoming van gehaltstandaarde en bouregulasies te verseker. Onderhou akkurate werkkaarte, instandhoudingsrekords, materiaalgebruikrekords en daaglikse werksverslae. Bied bystand by die voorbereiding van materiaalskattings, spesifikasies, kwotasies en verkrygingsvereistes vir timmerprojekte. Monitor en beheer die gebruik van materiaal, gereedskap en toerusting, en verseker verantwoordelikheid en minimalisering van vermorsing. Neem deel aan beplande voorkomende instandhoudingsprogramme en infrastruktuurverbeteringsprojekte. Superviseer en verskaf leiding aan Ambagsman-assistente, Handelsmanne-helpers, internes en leerders waar van toepassing. Werk saam met ander instandhoudingsdissiplines, insluitend Elektriese, Loodgieter, Meganiese, Verf en Siviele spanne. Verseker goeie huishouding in die timmerwerkswinkel en onderhou gereedskap en toerusting in 'n veilige en diensbare toestand. Neem deel naure buite-ure standby-pligte en noodoproep wanneer vereis. Voer roetine-inspeksies van hospitaalinfrastruktuur uit om potensiële veiligheidsgevare en instandhoudingsvereistes te identifiseer. Verseker nakoming van die Nasionale Bouregulasies en relevante Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Standaarde (SANS). Bied bystand by rampsherstel en noodherstelwerk tydens ongunstige weergebeurtenisse of infrastruktuurfalings. Bevorder doeltreffende benutting van hulpbronne en implementeer kostebesparingsmaatreëls in instandhoudingsbedrywighede. Leer vakleerlinge aan en dra by tot vaardigheidsontwikkeling binne die Instandhoudingsdepartement. Onderhou effektiewe kommunikasie met gebruikers, toesighouers en kontrakteurs rakende instandhoudingsaktiwiteite. Voer enige ander instandhoudingverwante pligte uit soos gedelegeer deur die Instandhoudingtoesighouer, Voorman of Hoofambagsman.

zu.title: Izenzo zokwenza: Ukukhiqiza izinga A, B (UMCATHI)
zu.summary: Umnyango Wezempiro Usebenza afune umcathi kwa-Queen Nandi Regional Hospital ukwenza ukugcinwa, ukulungiswa, kanye nokufakwa kwemisebenzi yokucatha kanye nezinto ezihlobene nayo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 10. Isitifiketi esifanele sokuhlolwa kwabacathi ngokusho kwesigaba 13(2) (h) soMthetho WezaBantu wango-1981 njengoba ushintshisiwe. Izenzo zokwenza izinga A: Okungenani unyaka 0-2 weminyaka yohluvo olufanele endaweni emuva kokuthola isitifiketi esihlobene nobucathi. Izenzo zokwenza izinga B: Okungenani unyaka 14 weminyaka yohluvo olufanele / olubonakalayo endaweni emuva kokuthola isitifiketi esihlobene nobucathi. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ethembekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono Nokubekezela Kudingekile: Ulwazi olujulile ngoMthetho Wezokuphepha Nokugcinwa Kwemisebenzi 85 ka-1993. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle, amakhono obuntu nokuxhumana nomunye umuntu kanye nokuqamba izindlela zokwenza into kanye nokuhlela. Ukuibhala ngokobuchwepheshe, amakhono asebenzayo kanye nohluvo lobucathi. Ulwazi oluhle ngesitshalo sezibhedlela nemishini yaso, izinto zokusebenza, umoya opholile kanye nokusetshenziswa kwegesi kanye nemishini yagesi. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubumba izinto nokucabanga ngezinto ezingahlukaniswe, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono okuthatha izinqumo. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokusabela. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha: I-MS Office Software Package namakhono okubonisa.
zu.duties: Yenza ukugcinwa, ukulungiswa, ukufakwa, kanye nokushintshwa kwemisebenzi yokucatha nokuhlanganisa izinto esibhedlela sonke kanye nezinye izindawo ezihlobene. Lungisa, yakha, futhi ufake amasu, amafremu omumo, amawindi, amakhabethe, amakhaphethe, oshebhi, izingqimaba, amaphuzu okuhlukanisa, amaphuzu okuhlukanisa, izingceba, okubhukwe okungenamakhanda, faka eminye imisakazo yemitshini yokuqinisa ukhuni. Faka kanye nokugcina amafunita ezesibhedlela, izinto zokuhlobisa, izinto ezingaguquki, futhi izingxenye ezikhethekile zemitshini yokuqinisa ukhuni amawadi, izinkundla, amakliniki, ohhovisi, futhi endaweni yokuhlala. Lungisa futhi ushintshe isibhamugi, amaphakethe okuvala amasu, izinto zokuvala, izibambo, futhi ezinye izinkuni ezihlobene nomsebenzi wokucatha. Hlola izakhiwo kanye nesisindo esibhedlela ukuze uthole izinto ezingalungile futhi wenze ukugcinwa okuvimbela nokulungisa. Funda futhi uhume izithombe ezingaqondakali kalula, izithombe ezingezona ezomumo, izinkomba, kanye nemiyalo yomsebenzi ukuze uphoqe izinhloso zokucatha. Sebenzisa, gcina, futhi qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuphephile kwezandla zokucatha, amathuluzi amandla, imishini, kanye nezinto zokusebenza endaweni yokusebenza. Yakha izinto zemitshini yokuqinisa ukhuni ngokwezinkomba eziyimfuneko kanye namazinga okunambitheka. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana noMthetho Wezokuphepha Nokugcinwa Kwemisebenzi, izinyathelo zokuvimbela ukutheleleka nokulawula, kanye nemigomo YeMnyango ngenkathi kwenziwa imisebenzi yokugcina. Sabela ngokushesha kuswelo ukugcinwa okubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphela kwezinsiza zezempilo. Hlola umsebenzi oqedile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhambisana namazinga okunambitheka kanye nemithetho yokwakha. Gcina amakhadi ohlelo olunembile, izinkomba zogcino, izinkomba zokusetshenziswa kwempahla, kanye nembiko yomsebenzi wansuku zonke. Siza ekulungiseni izilinganiselo zempahla, izinkomba, imibiko yentengo, kanye nezidingo zokuqasha izinto ezidingekayo emisebenzini yokucatha. Qapha futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwempahla, amathuluzi, kanye nezinto zokusebenza, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kunobuhlakani nokunciphisa ukupalalisa. Ngenela izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukugcinwa okucwangciswe kanye nemiklamo yokuthuthukiswa kwesisindo. Hola futhi nikeza isiqondiso kwAbasizi Bezinto Zokwenza, Abasizi Bobucathi, abafundi abasebenza ngaphandle kwemali yokwengamela, kanye nabafunda lapho kufanele khona. Sebenza ndawonye namanye amaqembu okugcina, okuhlanganisa AmaKhandlela, Iplambingi, Isimo Sezimoto, Ukudweba, Kanye namaQembu Ezenzakalo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwendawo yokusebenza emphucula ukucatha kwaye zigcine amathuluzi nezinto zokusebenza isimo esiphephile nesisebenzayo. Ngenela imisebenzi yokulinda ngemva kwamasikhathi kanye nezinsiza zokubiza eziphuthumayo lapho kudingeka khona. Yenza ukuphenya okujwayelekile kwesisindo sezesibhedlela ukuze kutholwe izingozi ezingase zibe khona kanye nezidingo zokugcina. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana noMthetho Wazwe Wezokwakha Kanye Nezindinganiso Zazwelonke ZaseNingizimu Afrika (SANS) Eziyimpumelelo. Siza nokuBuyisela Kwezinsiza Ezingajwayelekile kanye nokulungiswa okubalulekile ngesikhathi sezimo ezingabambeki zemvilophi noma ukuphela kosisindo. Khuthaza ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwemithombo futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokonga izindleko ekugcineni imisebenzi. Hola abafundi futhi aze nesandla ekuthuthukisweni amakhono ngaphakathi koMnyango Wokugcina. Gcina ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabasebenzisi, abahloli, kanye nabaqashi bezinkontileka ngemisebenzi yokugcina. Yenza noma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi odinga ukugcinwa njengoba kumiwe ngumqashi Wokugcina, Uphayona Womsebenzi, noma Uyihlo Womsebenzi.

xh.title: Umdlali wezandla ngokupheleleyo, ube namanani (UKWAKHIWA)
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMPilo lifuna umsebenzi wokwenza izandla ekuQhelekileyo kwisibhedlele iQhelekileyo iNandi ukuze aze akwazi ukulungisa, ukulungisa, nokuqwalasela iindawo ezahlukeneyo.
xh.requirements: Masiwele iya kwelakwa isahluko 13(2) (h) soMthetho woBomi bokwenzela iimisebenzi ka-1981. Ukuze umsebenzi uphele: 0-2 ukuba ufumene isatifikethi. Ubudala: 14 kwakhona ukuba ufumene isatifikethi. Isatifikethi sokusebenzela iimoto. Ulwazi ngomthetho weMisebenzi nokhuseleko kwiNtlangano ka-1993. Isakhono sokuxoxa, nokuba nobudlelwane, nokuzimisela, nokuyila. Isakhono sokubhala iingxelo ezifanelekileyo zolwazi loluhlelo. Ulwazi olubanzi lwesibhedlele ngezixhobo, amandla ombane, iyonke imizekelo yokusebenza. Ulwazi loluntu nokulawula. Ukuba nomdla, ukuba nexesha lokucinga, isakhono sokuzama ukwenza izinto, kunye nokuba nesakhono esisesikweni. Isakhono esisesikweni sokuqonda iingxaki zolwazi. Isakhono sokuqonda iinkqubo zamakhompyutha.
xh.duties: Zenza ulungiso, ukulungiswa, ukufakelwa, nokuwtshintshwa kwezinto ezidityaniswe kunye nolwezandla ezikwisibhedlele nakwezonyango. Lungisa, yenza, ufake iingcango, amakhaka acetyiweyo, iifestile, amakhabethe, iikhabhathi, iikhowunthari, izihlalo, iindonga ezingenamaxango, amapham, iindonga ezidityaniswe kunye nolunye uhlobo lwezinto. Faka ulungise izikhundla, izixhobo ezifakelwayo kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo njengamazaqendu, amajogra, amaphondo, iofisi, nendawo yokuhlala. Lungisa ufake iziqhwaga, amahinge, izivalo zangcango, izandla, nezinye izixhobo ezidityaniswe kwishishini. Pheqa izakhiwo nakunye nezindawo zokusebenzela ukuba uzibone ukuba zithini, ulungelelani ukuba kungabi nazifo. Funda ukuqonda iimpawu, iintlunga, iinkcazelo, nezinye iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi. Sebenzisa, ulungise, ugcine ukusebenza kolwakhiwo, amandla okushukuma, izixhobo zokwenza iindawo, nakwakhona nezinye iindlela. Sebenzisa ulwakhiwo ngokweemfuno nangokomgangatho. Qinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iindlela ezifaneleyo ngokwesikhundla sesiXhosa, iinkqubo zokuthintela iindwangu, kunye neemigaqo yesiXhosa ekwenzeni umsebenzi. Phendula ngokukhawuleza kumagoso okulungisa ukuze kuqhubeke ukusebenza kwesibhedlele. Pheqa umsebenzi oqediweyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba udibana nemigaqo. Gcina ulwazi olunyani malunga nomsebenzi ongakawenzwa, nangezinto ezisetyenziswayo, nangemisebenzi yonke emihla. Nceda kwakulungiselelo lwezinto ezizakusebenziswa, iinkcazelo, iindlela zokuthenga, nakunye nolunye ulwazi. Qwalasela ulawulo lwezinto, izixhobo, kunye nolawulo lokuba kungabi nazifo. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokulungisa izinto kwinkqubo ethile. Lawula inceba kunye nabancedisi bezandla, kwakunye nabafundi apho kufuneka khona. Sebenzisana nabanye abasebenzi kumagosa ahlukeneyo njengamandla ombane, amanzi, iimoto, ipeyinti, nakwishishini lakho. Qinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iindlela ezifaneleyo kwishishini lakho. Yiba yinkxaso kubafundi kwakunye nabancedisi. Gcina ukwazisana nabasebenzisi, oogqirha, kwakunye nazo zonke iindaba. Yenza nawuphi na umsebenzi ongafunekiyo njengoko ukhankanyiwe ngumlawuli wezandla.

jobs.title: Director: Provincial Infrastructure Management
jobs.summary: Director role coordinating KZN provincial infrastructure planning, capital expenditure estimates and programme monitoring within the Provincial Treasury.

Training in Cost benefit analysis model building. Professional Registration with relevant Built Environment council. 5 years middle or senior managerial experience in a relevant infrastructure environment. SMS Pre-entry Certificate prior to appointment. A valid driver’ s licence and people living with disabilities who are without valid drives licenses will be assisted by the department to meet work related travel obligations. Skills, Knowledge And Competencies: Extensive working knowledge of applicable national and provincial polices and legislation is required Advanced Project Management. Contract Management. Financial Management. Personnel Management. Administrative Procedures. Public Finance Management Act (PFM). Municipal Finance Management (MFMA). Division of Revenue Act (DoRA). Preferential Procurement Policy Framework (PPPFA). Framework for Infrastructure Delivery and Procurement Management (FIDPM). Broad Bases Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE). Construction Industry Development Broad Act (CIDB). Treasury Regulation. Provincial Growth and Development Strategy (PGDS). Provincial Spatial and Economic Development (PSEDS). Provincial Procurement Act and regulations. Public Finance Management Act – Best Practice National Treasury Guideline documents. South African Fiscal and monetary policy. Provision policy priorities Budget formulation. Code of conduct. Legislation applicable to allocated department. Political and socio-economic environment Labour Relations Act. Employment Equity Act. Organising. Planning. Facilitation and presentation. Problem solving. Research. Analytical Diplomacy. Computer literacy. Time management Conflict management Decision making. Inter-personal relation. Verbal and written communication. Financial management. Human resource management. Project planning and management. Policy Analysis and development. Strategic Management.
jobs.duties: Co-ordinate and manage the Provincial Infrastructure portfolio Planning. Compile the Estimates of Capital Expenditure. Monitor, Evaluate and Report on provincial Infrastructure programmes. Support to the internal and external stakeholders. Manage the implementation of polices. Manage Resources of the Directorate.

Candidates will be subjected to security screening and a technical assessment. Under no circumstances will be faxed, emailed and late applications be accepted. af.title: Direkteur: Provinsiale Infrastruktuurbestuur
af.summary: Direkteursrol wat KZN provinsiale infrastruktuurbeplanning, ramings van kapitaalbesteding en programmonitoring binne die Provinsiale Tesourie koördineer.
af.requirements: 'n 3 jaar NQF Vlak 7 kwalifikasie in Argitektuur, Stads- en Streekbeplanning, Hoeveelheidopmeting, Siviele Ingenieurswese en Projektbestuur in die bou-omgewing. zu.duties: Hlanganisa bese uphatha iProvincial Infrastructure portfolio Planning. Hlanganisa i-Estimates of Capital Expenditure. xh.title: Umongameli: Ulawulo LwemiNzuzo esiPhakam-yiSizwe
xh.summary: Indima yoMongameli yokulungisa ulwalo-mbe lwemNzuzo esiPhakam-yiSizwe eKZN, uqikelelo lokuchithwa kwemali yotyalo-mali nokugcina iliso kwenkqubo ngaphakathi kweNdlu yoMnotho esiPhakam-yiSizwe.
xh.requirements: Isigqizo seNQF Level 7 kwiminyaka engu-3 kwiZakhiwo, uLwalo-mbe loMbindi nakuwoWonke-wonke, ukuLinganisa kwemiSebenzi yokuAkha, uNjineli wesiCivile noLawulo lweNkqubo kwindalo ezakhiweyo. Uqeqesho kwimodeli yokwenza uLungaziso lokutya kobomi ngenzuzo. Ubulungiswa obuNgemvethi kunye neNgcwadi eMalunga nokuZinikela nokuAkhiwa endalo. Iminyaka engu-5 yamava okuba nguMphathi oPhezulu okanye oPhakathi kwindalo eNgezizo ezahlukeneyo zemNzuzo. Isatifikethi se-SMS Pre-entry ngaphambi kokwenzelwa isikhundla. Ilayisenisi yokuQhuba egqithisiweyo labantu abaphila ngokhubazeko abangenayo iYisenisi yokuQhuba ngokusemthethweni baya kuncedwa nguiSebe ukuba bagqibezele izithintelo zokuHamba ngenxa yomSebenzi. Amakhono, uLwazi naMaphakathi: Kufuneka kubekho ulwazi oluLuzeleyo ngemigaqo nakumthetho welizwe nesePhakam-yiSizwe. uLawulo lweNkqubo oluPhezulu. uLawulo lweKontrak. uLawulo lweMali. uLawulo lweZabantu. iNkqubo zoLawulo. uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhuqo (PFM). uLawulo lweMali yoRhuqo kumaKhumpha (MFMA). uMthetho woWabo lweMali (DoRA). uMthetho weNkqubo yoNgcwadi loThengiso (PPPFA). iNkqubo yokunikela iNzuzo noLawulo loThengiso (FIDPM). uLawulo luBanzi lweQoqa lamandla oQoqosho eMnyama (BBBEE). uMthetho woPhuhliso lweMvelaphi yoQoqosho (CIDB). iMigaqo yeNdlu yoMnotho. uMmotho woPhuhliso noPhakam-yiSizwe (PGDS). uPhuhliso lweSithuba nokuQoqosha esiPhakam-yiSizwe (PSEDS). uMthetho woThengiso esiPhakam-yiSizwe nemiQathango. uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhuqo – iNkqubo eLungileyo eSekwe kwiNdlu yoMnotho yoLawulo lweNyanga. iNkqubo yeMali eNexesho kwi-Afrika yaseMzantsi. iNkqubo eBekwa phambili yokunikela iNkqubo. uLungaziso loLawulo loQoqosho. iNkqubo yoQqho. uMthetho oSebenzayo kuiSebe eNikiweyo. imeko yeSazopolitiko nakuQoqosho. uMthetho weQela labasebenzi. uMthetho woBulingiswa kokuQeshwa. ukuQumba. ukuCocwa. ukuNika iNkuthazo nokubumba. ukuSombulula iNgxaki. uphando. ukuQonda izinto ngesiZwe. ukuQwashisa ngeKhompyutha. uLawulo loQondo. uLawulo lokuGqabha. ukuThabatha isiQibo. uQhagamshelwano loQobo. ukuThetha nokubhala. uLawulo lweMali. uLawulo lweMisebenzi yabantu. uLungaziso lokuQamba nokulawula iNkqubo. uCocwo nokuPhuhliso lweNkqubo. uLawulo lokuQamba iNdlela.
xh.duties: Ukulungisa nokulawula uQhagamshelo oluNtsundu lwemNzuzo esiPhakam-yiSizwe. Ukuqamba uQikelelo lokuchithwa kwemali yokwenza iNkqubo. ukuQwalasela, ukuLinganisa nokuba ngexesha ngemNzuzo esiPhakam-yiSizwe iNkqubo. uNcedo kubaphathi abeNgaphakathi nabeNgaphandle. uLawulo lokuThatha inkonzo yemigaqo. uLawulo lweMisebenzi yoMongameli.

jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.summary: Lead and manage the delivery of clinical and administrative services at KwaMhlanga Hospital in Mpumalanga as Chief Executive Officer.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) in a Health related field as recognized by SAQA. Registration with relevant Professional Council (2026) plus a Degree / Diploma in Health Management. Five (5) years’ experience in health management service environment. Valid driver’s licence. Knowledge of relevant legislation such as National Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PMFA), Public Service Act and related regulations and policies. Core Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership programme and project management, financial management, change management, people management and empowerment. Progress Competencies: Service delivery innovation, knowledge management, problem solving and analysis, communication, client orientation and customer focus.
jobs.duties: To plan, direct co-ordinate and manage the efficient and effective delivery of health / medical and administrative support services at the hospital within the prevailing legal and statutory framework through working with the key executive management team at the hospital, to represent the hospital authoritatively at provincial and public forums, to provide strategic leadership to improve operational efficiency within the health establishment to improve health outcomes. Strategic Planning: Prepare a strategic plan for the hospital to ensure that it is in line with the 10-point plan, national, provincial, regional and district plans. Financial Management: Maximize revenue through collection of all income due to the hospital, ensure that adequate policies, systems and procedure are in place to enable prudent management of financial resources, planning of financial resource mobilization, monitoring and evaluation and asset and risk management. Facility Management: Ensure business support and systems to promote optimal management of the institution as well as optimal service delivery, ensure that systems and procedures are in place to ensure planning and timeous maintenance of facilities and equipment. Human Resource Management: Develop, implement and maintain human resource management policies and guidelines, systems and procedures that will ensure effective and efficient utilisation of human resources, promote a safe and healthy working environment through compliance with relevant legislation including occupation health and safety committees. Ensure continuous development and training of personnel and implement monitoring and evaluation of performance. Procurement and Management of Equipment and Supplies: Implement procurement and provisioning system that is fair, transparent, competitive and cost effective in terms of provincial delegated authority and in line with the PFMA, ensure that goods are and services are procured in a cost effective timely manner. Clinical and Corporate Governance: Oversee clinical governance to ensure high standards of patient care establish community networks and report to the Hospital Board. Responsible for corporate governance inclusive of infrastructure planning and maintenance as well as occupational health and safety, manage the institution’s risk to ensure optimal achievement of health outcomes, development and training of personnel and implement monitoring and evaluation of performance. Procurement and Management of Equipment and Supplies Implement a procurement and provisioning system that is fair, transparent, competitive and cost effective in terms of provincial delegated authority in line with PFMA, and Supply Chain Management prescripts; Ensure that goods and services are procured in a cost effective and timely manner; Ensure sound contract management for all contracted services.
