zu.title: Umqondisi Omkhulu Womphakathi
zu.summary: Hola bese uphatha ukulethwa kwemisebenzi yezokwelapha nololawulo e-KwaMhlanga Hospital e-Mpumalanga njengoSihlalo Womphakathi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zezinga elingaphansi kweziqu ze-university (NQF Level 7) enkundeni ehlobene nezempilo njengoba kunconywa yi-SAQA. Ukuqashwa kuKhanselana Yezomsebenzi ehlobene (2026) kanye ne-Degree / Diploma enkundeni yokuphathwa kwezempilo. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yokuhlukelela enkundeni yomphakathi wokuphathwa kwezempilo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi ngomthetho ofanele njengoMthetho Wezempilo Womphakathi, uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali Yomphakathi (PMFA), uMthetho Womphakathi Wezinsiza kanye nemithetho nezinqumela ezihlobene. Amandla Okuyisisekelo: Isikhathi sobuholi kanye nokuqondisa nokuqashwa, nokuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa koshintsho, nokuphathwa kwabantu nokuqinisekisa amandla. Amandla Okuthola Isikhathi Esisha: Ukuletha izinto ezintsha ngokuhlinza, ulwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlola, ukuxoxa, ukubuka izidingo zalabo osebenza nabo nokunaka izidingo zabakhiqizi futhi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela, ukubaqondisa, ukuhlanganisa futhi kuphathe ukulethwa okusebenzayo nokuqondile kwemisebenzi yezempilo / yezokwelapha kanye nosekelo ololawulo esibhedlela ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sezomthetho esikhona ngokusebenza ndawonye nenqola yabantu abaphathi ababalulekile esibhedlela, ukumela isibhedlela ngokugcwele emikhakheni yesifundazwe kanye nabezomphakathi, ukunikeza ubuholi bokuhlela ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle kwemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sezempilo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimpumputheko zezempilo. Ukuhlela Okuhlelekile: Lungiselela icebo elihlelekile lesibhedlela ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi lihambisana nokuhlela kwamaphuzu ayi-10, amaphulu wezwe, wesifundazwe, wesifunda nakomasipala. Ukugcina Imali: Khulisa inkomithi ngokuqoqa wonke umholo ofanele isibhedlela, qinisekisa ukuthi kunemithetho yomsebenzi, izinhlelo kanye nendlela yokwenza ezanele ukwenza kube lula ukuphathwa okuhlakaniphile kwemithombo yemali, ukuhlela ukutholakala kwemithombo yemali, ukubuka nokuhlola kanye nokuphathwa kwemitshinalo kanye nokulawula ingozi. Ukuphathwa Kwesikhungo: Qinisekisa ukusekelwa kwezomabhizinisi kanye nezinhlelo ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa okufanele kwesikhungo kanye nokulethwa okufanele kwemisebenzi, qinisekisa ukuthi kunamaphulani nezindlela zokwenza ukuze kuqiniseke ukuhlela kanye nolondolozo lwesikhathi esifanele kwemisebenzi kanye nemishini. Ukuphathwa Kwabasebenzi: Bumba, faka esikhathini futhi ulondoloze imithetho yokuphathwa kwabasebenzi kanye nezimiso, izinhlelo kanye nezindlela zokwenza ezizoqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nokuqondile kwabasebenzi, khuthaza indawo yokusebenza ephephile enempilo ngokuhambisana nomthetho ofanele ohlanganisa amakomidi ezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo kanye nokwesekwa ngemfundiso yabasebenzi bese kufakwa ukubuka nokuhlola ukwenza umsebenzi. Ukuthenga Nokuphathwa Kwemishini Kwezinsiza: Faka ohlelweni ukuthenga kanye nokuhlinzwa ngemiyalo okulungiwe, lula ukubonwa, lwa khwise futhi luncane izinketho ngokusho kwesigaba sokwesekwa esifundazweni futhi huhambisana ne-PFMA, qinisekisa ukuthi impahla nezinsiza zithengwa ngendlela ebiza kancane ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuhlonza kanye Nokolawula Izindaba Zomphakathi Nabamninimai: Buka ukubusa kwezempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa kwesiguli, sake izinkundla zomphakathi bese ukubika kwi-Hospital Board. Uxanduva lokubusa kwesikhungo okuhlanganisa ukuhlela nolondolozo lwezinto ezenziwayo kanye nokuphepha kwabasebenzi, phatha ingozi yesikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufeza okufanele kwempumputheko yezempilo, ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokwesekwa ngemfundiso yabasebenzi bese kufakwa ukubuka nokuhlola ukwenza umsebenzi. Ukuthenga Nokuphathwa Kwemishini Kwezinsiza: Faka isimiso sokuthenga nokuhlinza esimnyama, esibonakalayo, esikhuphukelwayo futhi esibiza kancane ngokusho kwesigaba sokwesekwa esifundazweni esihambisana ne-PFMA, nezimiso zoMgwago wokuqashwa kwezinsiza; Qinisekisa ukuthi impahla nezinsiza zithengwa ngendlela ebiza kancane nangaleso sikhathi esifanele; Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwamakontrakti okuhle kwezinsiza zazo zonke izinsiza eziqashiwe.

xh.title: Umphathi Omkhulu
xh.summary: Yiba nokulawula nokuphatha ukunikela kweenkonzo eziphathwayo nezolawulo esibhedlele iKwaMhlanga Hospital eMpumalanga njengoko nguMphathi Omkhulu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwesidanga (NQF Level 7) kwicala lezempilo njengokuqatshiwe yiSAQA. Ubindo kuluntu kwiKhomishane Yabaphathi Abanemvume (2026) kwaye nesiNgqinqwa / iDiploma ekulawulweni kwezempilo. Iminyaka elishanu (5) yamava kokusingqongileni kwesebe lokulawula izempilo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohambelanayo ofana noMthetho wezeMpilo kaZwelonke, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PMFA), uMthetho woBuntu kaRhulumente namagqabantshu amanqaniselwayo neemboniso ahambelanayo. Amandla aphakathi: Amakhono abalulekileyo aphakathi kolawulo njengenkululeko yokusebenza ngokwezicitya, ulawulo lweenkqubo, ulawulo lemali, ulawulo lentshuko, ulawulo labantu nokuVusa amandla. Amandla aphuhlisayo: Ukulungelelanisa ukuXhumi kwkonzo eziyimfihlo nentsusa yokwazi, ukulawula ulwazi, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuHlalutya, unxibelelwano, ukuQwalasela umthengi nokuNxiba ingqalelo kumthengi.
xh.duties: UkuCwangcisa, ukubaPhatha kunye nokulawula ngokulinganiselanayo ukunikela okusebenzayo nokuSebenza kakuhle kwezempilo / zokugonya ngenkxaso yezolawulo kwiinkonzo esibhedlele ngaphakathi kolwakhiwo lolawulo ngokomthetho nangokwesibhengezo ngokusebenzana nethimba eliyinkosi ekulawulweni esibhedlele, ukumela isibhedlele ngokugqibeleleyo kwindalo zommandla nakwezoluntu, ukubonelela ngolawulo olunesakhono sokuphucula ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo ngaphakathi kweNdawo yezoMpilo ukuphucula iziphumo zezempilo. jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 sought for Barberton Hospital in Mpumalanga, requiring an MBChB degree and HPCSA registration to manage patient care across shifts.
jobs.requirements: MBChB degree (qualification) that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Current registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (2026) (Independent Practice). NB: The appointed Medical Officer must be able to work shifts. A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Grade 1: No experience required after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Minimum of 1-year relevant experience after registration with a recognised Foreign Health Professions and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice) for foreign qualified employees. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competences Required: Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Sound clinical knowledge, competency and skills in general clinical domains. The ability to work under supervision as an efficient team member. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal, and supervisory skills. Ability to manage patients independently, diligently, responsibility and engage when necessary. Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programmes and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach, guide and junior staff within the department. Behavioural Attributes: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationship.
jobs.duties: To execute duties and functions with proficiency, to support the aims and objectives of the Institution that consistent with standards of patient care. Accept responsibility for the management of patients admitted in a level 2/3 package of service facility. Assist in the preparation and implementation of guidelines and protocols. Participate in academic and training programmes. Assist with clinical audits actively participate in continuous professional development. Provide support to hospital management towards an efficient standard of patient care and services is maintained.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Emmanuel Makokoropo Tel No: (013) 766 3384 / Ms. Gugu Nkosi Tel No: (013) 766 3103 / Ms. Nomsa Maphanga Tel No: (013) 766 3207 / Ms. Sebenzile Mthisi Tel No: (013) 766 3339 and IT related queries: Help desk Tel No: (013) 766 3018.
jobs.applications: Departmental Online Application System: www.mpuhealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: N.B. Applicants are advised to apply as early as possible to avoid disappointments. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. In order to alleviate administration burden on HR Sections as well as considering the cost for applicants, Departments are encouraged to request certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview following communication from the relevant HR section of the Department. All posts health/engineering posts that are advertised within the Department professional registration will be required from various statutory council for shortlisted candidates. A complete set of application documents should be submitted separately for every post that you wish to apply for. Please ensure that you clearly state the full post description and the relevant Post Reference Number on your application. No fax applications will be considered. Applicants must ensure that they fully complete and sign form Z 83, even if they are attaching a CV. Incomplete and/or unsigned applications will not be considered. If you are currently in service, please indicate your PERSAL number at the top of form Z83. Due to ongoing internal processes, the Department reserves the right to withdraw any post at any time. The Department reserves the right to verify the qualifications of every recommended candidate prior to the issuing of an offer of appointment. All short listed candidates will be subject to a vetting process prior to appointment. If no response is received from Mpumalanga Department of Health within 90 days after the closing date of the advertisement, applicants must assume that their application was not successful. Please quote the Correct references when applying and where possible the station / centre where the post is. www.mpuhealth.gov.za Only Online Applications will be accepted. NB: Candidates who are not contacted within 90 days after the closing date must consider their applications as having been unsuccessful. Please Note The Department reserves the right to amend / review / withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (People with disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the following posts advertised on the Public Service Vacancy Circular 25 dated 17 July 2026, the posts of Professional Nurse Grade 1 (PN-A2): With Midwifery (Amajuba Memorial Hospital, Gert Sibande District) with Ref No: MPDoH/July/26/1080 and Senior Administrative Officer: Salary Administration (Matikwana Hospital, Ehlanzeni District) with Ref No: MPDoH/July/26/1062 with the closing date of 23 June 2026, the posts have been withdrawn. af.title: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1 gesoek vir Barberton Hospitaal in Mpumalanga, wat 'n MBChB-graad en HPCSA-registrasie vereis om pasiëntsorg oor skofte te bestuur.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad (kwalifikasie) wat registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Huidige registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn (2026) (Onafhanklike Praktyk). NB: Die aangestelde Mediese Beampte moet in staat wees om skofte te werk. 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Diensregulasies en beleide. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Vlak 1: Geen ervaring vereis na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Minimum van 1 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie met 'n erkende Buitelandse Gesondheidsberoepe en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk) vir buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis, bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onder toesig as 'n doeltreffende spanlid te werk. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, interpersoonlike en toesighoudende vaardighede. Vermoë om pasiënte onafhanklik, ywerig en verantwoordelik te bestuur en in te skakel wanneer nodig. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleide, -wetgewing, -programme en -prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te begelei. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Om pligte en funksies met vaardigheid uit te voer, om die doelwitte en oogmerke van die Instelling te ondersteun wat in ooreenstemming is met standaarde van pasiëntsorg. Verantwoordelikheid aanvaar vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3 dienspakketfasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen met die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning aan hospitaalbestuur bied om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en -dienste gehandhaaf word.

zu.title: Onogqaji Bezokwelapha Isibalo 1
zu.summary: Kufunwa Onogqaji Bezokwelapha Isibalo 1 esibhedlela i-Barberton Hospital eMpumalanga, kudingeka iziqu ze-MBChB nokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ukuphatha ukunakekelwa kwabagula phansi kwamashifithi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-MBChB (isiqui) ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqaji wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje kwi-HPCSA njengogqaji wezokwelapha (2026) (Ukwenza ngazibuse). QAPHELA: Onogqaji bezokwelapha abakhethiwe kumele bakwazi ukusebenza amashifithi. I-permit yokuqashwa evumelekile kuzodingeka kubantu abangaboNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle ngenzondo yokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kolunye uhlobo lokwazi kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu kanye nalolunye uhlobo lokwazi kwinkalo ngayoye yokwelapha. Ulwazi ngemithetho namapholisi wamanche wezempilo nabeMphakathi. Amakhono okuhola iseluleko, ukuthatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwelapha nokuphatha ngokwelapha. Isibalo 1: Akukho lolunye uhlobo lokwazi oludingwa ngemva kokuqhathaniswa nobuhle nobuncane bokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqaji wezokwelapha (Ukwenza ngazibuse). Uhlobo lokwazi oluncane oludingekayo emva kokuqhathaniswa nobuhle nobuncane bokubhaliswa kwelinye izwe elisebenza ngamakhono ezempilo e-HPCSA njengogqaji wezokwelapha (Ukwenza ngazibuse). Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa nokuqonda okudingekayo: Ulwazi oluhle ngenzondo yokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kolunye uhlobo lokwazi kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu kanye nalolunye uhlobo lokwazi kwinkalo ngayoye yokwelapha. Ulwazi oluhle ngokwelapha, ukuqonda nakhono kwawo wonke amanani ezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokuhola njengilungu elisebenza kahle leqembu. Amakhono ahle okukhuluma, okuhola, okuxhumana nokubuka abanye. Ikhono lokuphatha abagula ngazibuse, ngokuzifunda, ngobanjele nokuqaphela lapho kudingeka khona. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezempilo, izinhlelo nobaluleko ekhona manje ngaphakathi kwale nkalo. Ikhono lokufundisa,okuqondisa abasebenzi abancane ngaphakathi komnyango. Izici zenkondlo: Ukubekezela ukucindezeleka, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqembu, ukuzethemba kanye nokuqonda ukwakha kanye nokuqinisekisa ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngokusebenza kahle, ukusekela amagugu nemigomo yesikhungo ehambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kwabagula. Ukuthathwa kobujamelelokuphatha abagula abangenwe eziteshini ezingeni 2/3 sephakheji yesevisi. Ukusiza ekulungiseni nokuqalisweni imigomumtheleko. Ukuthathwa inkalo ekwelapheni izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa. Ukusiza ngokuhlola izinto ezingekho emthethweni, ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni ngokwemisebenzi ngokuzenzakalela. Ukunika inkombo ebusweni benhlanganisela yokuphatha ibhangelela iholo elincane lomsebenzi wokunakekelwa nokwelatshwa kwabagula.

xh.title: Isebe Lolungelo Lwezokwelapha Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Kufuneka kujulwe isebe Lolungelo Lwezokwelapha Inqanaba 1 kwiBarberton Hospital eMpumalanga, lifuna iziqu ze-MBChB nokuqwalaselwa kwi-HPCSA ukulawula ukunakekelwa kwabaguli kuwo onke amashiphthi.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ze-MBChB (isifikelelo) ezivumela ukuqwalaselwa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Dokhota Wezokwelapha. Ukuqwalaselwa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA njenge-Dokhota Wezokwelapha (2026) (Ukuqhubela phambili Ngokuzimele). QAPHela: Isebe Lolungelo Lwezokwelapha eliqokiweyo kufuneka likwazi ukusebenza ngamashiphthi. Ipermithi yomsebenzi esebenzayo iya kufuneka kubangabasebenzisi abangeyo kuMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngokuziphatha kwamalungiselelo ezokwelapha. Ukulawulwa ngamasebe amaninzi nokusebenza njengeqela kunye namava kwizifundo ezihambelana nezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemithetho yezempilo kwaye nesebe lokuQondiswe kuLuntu yangoku. Amandlaokuqonda ngokuqhubana nabaguli, ukuthatha imbali, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwezokwelapha nokulawula ngokwezokwelapha. Inqanaba 1: Akukho mva alunyanziiswe emva kokuqwalaselwa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Dokhota Wezokwelapha (Ukuqhubela phambili Ngokuzimele). Umba weminyaka el-1 yamava ahambelana nayo emva kokuqwalaselwa kwi-Foreign Health Professions ekuqatyiweyo nokuba ngaphakathi kwaye i-HPCSA njenge-Dokhota Wezokwelapha (Ukuqhubela phambili Ngokuzimele) kubasebenzi abangaphandle abaqokelelweyo. Ulwazi, Amandlaokuqonda, uQeqesho namAba afunekayo: Ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngokuziphatha kwamalungiselelo ezokwelapha. Ukulawulwa ngamasebe amaninzi nokusebenza njengeqela kunye namava kwizifundo ezihambelana nezokwelapha. Ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngokwezokwelapha, ukuziphatha namandla kummandla wokwelapha ngokubanzi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo njengelungu elisebenzayo leqela. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelana, ukuba ngumqathi, eliphakathi kwabantu, nokuqapha. Ikhono lokulawula abaguli ngokuzimela, ngokuzinikezela, ngobunini bentlonitlwano. Ulwazi ngemigaqo, imithetho, iinkqubo neenjongo ezimalunga namandla wokwelapha. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukukhokela abasebenzi abasebugxotsheni kwisebe. Iimpawu ezingokuziphatha: Ukumelana nendyikitya, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela, ukuzethemba nokwakha uludwe lokwakha nokugcina ubuhlobo obuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze kuphunywe umsebenzi nemisebenzi ngekhono, ukuze ixhasa iinjongo nemiQongo yeNhlanganisela ehambelana nemilinganiselo yokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Ukubamanyisela ngxaki yolawulo abaguli bafakwe kwisiseko selevel 2/3 seenkcubeko. Ukuncedisa ulungiselelo nokusetyenziswa kolwazi kunye nemigaqo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kweenkqubo zesizinda noQeqesho. Ukuncedisa kwiqondo eliphathwayo ngokwezempilo ngokubandakanya ekuphuhliseni oluhamba phambili. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele ukuya kwizinga elisebenzayo lokunakekelwa kwabaguli nesebe.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Begroting en Besteding
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur by Witbank Hospital wat begrotingsprosesse, finansiële beplanning, bestedingsmonitering en begrotingslyning met strategiese planne bestuur.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 plus Diploma / Graad (NQF Level 6/7) in Finansies / Finansiële Bestuur / Bestuursrekenkunde soos deur SAQA erken. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ondervinding in Finansiële Bestuur op toesig / bestuursvlak (Level 7/8). Bevoegdheid in MS Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint en MS Project. Generiese Bevoegdhede: Beplanning en organisering. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Koördinering. Projeksbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Spanleierskap. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus. Diversiteitsbestuur. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Uitgebreide kennis van Finansiële Bestuur en Munisipale Inkomstebestuur. Omvattende kennis van die Division of Revenue Act (DoRA), die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Beleidsontwikkeling. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Om begrotingsprosesse te bestuur en te fasiliteer. Fasiliteer en bestuur finansiële beplanning en begrotingsprosesse. Stel begrotingsyfers op. Lyn begrotings met strategiese en jaarlikse prestasieplanne in. Verskaf advies oor begrotingsverwante aangeleenthede. Monitor bestedings teen die toegekende begroting. Versoei begrotings-/bestedingsinvoer vir kwartaalse foutiewe toewysings en magtig joernaalinskrywings. Monitor besteding teen die toegekende begroting (program / sub-program). zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samatinhla / IGrade 12 kahle kanye nediploma / idigri (I-NQF Level 6/7) kwezezimali / ekuhutzeni kwezezimali / kubuhle bokubala izimali njengoba kusobala ku-SAQA. Kalingene ubuncwane beminyaka eyishumi (10) yohlelo (kwi-Senior Management Service) ekusebenzeni ngezinsizakusebenza ze-ICT Level 14. Ubuchwepheshe ekubukeni izinkomba ze-ICT ezinqamulelayo zokuphathwa kwenhlangano yokuzivikela / yezokuphepha kanye nokulawula ukuqaliswa kohlelo lwezinsizakusebenza ze-ICT; kule ndima, ukuhlakanipha okungenhlawula ezindaweni ezitholakala khona; kule ndima kulindeleke ukuba nobuchwepheshe ekwenzeni isilinganiso esihlangene; kule ndima kulindeleke ukuba nobuchwepheshe ekuthathweni kwezinqumo; ukuhlakanipha ekubukeni izinkomba; amaqhaza e-ICT ebuswa ngumnyango wezululwazi netheknoloji; ukuhlela amaphrojekthi; ukulawula amaphrojekthi kanye namandla okuqonda ibhunga, abasebenzi, izihambi nabathengi ekusebenzeni nge-ICT; ekubukeni amandla okwakha okuhlukile kokuxhumana nokubhalwa kwemibhalu; ekuphathweni kwezimali; kule ndima, kulindeleke ukuba namandla okuholela, aqonde kangcono ibhunga, abasebenzi, izihambi kanye nabathengi, amakhono okuxhumana okuhlukahlukene; amandla okusebenza ngokubambisana namanye amaphoyisa namanye amaningana; ukutadisha ngemisebenzi eya ocansini. Isitifikedi esivunyiwe sokuqhuba.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela ukuqashwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezingena ngemvume. Ukwenza futhi kuphathwe ukuhlelwa kwezimali nezinhlelo zokugcina izimali kanye namaphulo. Ukwenza isilinganiso sokugcina imali. Ukuqondanisa amaphulo nezinhlelo zokusebenza ekugcineni konyaka. Ukunika izeluleko ngemibuzo ehlobene nezimali. Ukulawula ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwesabelo esinikiwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali ikhona ngaphambi kokuba kutholwe izimpahla kanye nezinsizakusebenza. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izabelo ezifanele ze-SCOA zisetshenziswa okubhalwe ekukhokhelweni. Ukuhlola imibhalo yokulawula yenyanga ngenyanga. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibhalu edluliwe ihambisana nezindinganiso zokuhlolwa. Ukubala izidingo zezimali zokusebenza zezifunda ngaphakathi kokuchithwa kwemali empeleni. Ukulinganisa izabelo zokugcina ezingangeni emaphusheni e-BAS. Ukucela ukungeniswa kwezimali ezichithiwe kwizabelo ezingalungile ezibikwa njalo ngenkathi ukuze zigunyazwe izinkomba zokubhala. Ukulawula ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwesabelo esinikiwe (umhlabahle / umhlabahle ongaphansi kwawo). Ukubhala imibiko yemali echithiwe (ezabelo ezingangenwa izinkondolo nezinganisayo). Ukuhlanganisa izinsizakusebenza eziphendula imibuzo yokuhlolwa ngaphakathi nakunaphandle kanye nokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwezindululo zokuhlolwa. Ukuxesha abaphathi besibhedlela mayelana nokuchithwa kwemali ngaphezulu nakungaphezulu. Ukulawula izinto ezenza ukuthi imali ichitheke kakhulu. Ukuqedela imibiko eqinisekisiwe futhi ebukeka ngokokuhle ngamapheshezi ohlelo olunqunyiwe.

xh.title: UMcedisi woMlawuli: iBheyaji nokuChithwa kweMali
xh.summary: Umncedisi woMlawuli eWitbank Hospital elawula iinkqubo zesicwangiso sebheyaji, ukuhlelwa kweemali, ukulandelela ukuchithwa kwemali nokulungeyanisa ibheyaji neezicwangiso ezibalulekileyo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo / Grade 12 kwaye kwelitshumi elinamfundo iDiploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) kwezamali / ekuLawulweni kweeMali / ekuBhleni kweeMali njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane iiminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kokulawula iimali kwelinye inqanaba lokulawula / lokulawula (Level 7/8). Ukuba lilung kwimenyu ye-MS Excel, i-MS Word, PowerPoint kunye ne-MS Project. Ikhompetensi eJikelele: Ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuze isigqibo. Ukuhlanganisa. Ukulawula amaprojekhthi. Ukulawula abantu nokuqhutywa kwamandla. Ukulawula iqela. Ukwakha ingqondo kwiklayenti nokuqwalasela ukwaneliseka kwiklayenti. Ukulawula ihlonipho lweentsapho. Unxibelelwano (ngolwimi lomlomo nangolubhaliweyo). Ikhompetensi eButhekayo: Ulwazi olubanzi ekuLawulweni kweeMali nasekuLawulweni kweVuzo yamaMasipala. Ulwazi olubanzi kwaye, kwiMthetho woWoLulo-mali (DoRA), uMthetho woKulawula kweeMali zorHulumente (PFMA) nakuPhuhliso weMigaqo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuququzelela iinkqubo zesicwangiso sebheyaji. Ukuququzelela nokulawula ukuhlelwa kweemali nokwenziwa kwezicwangiso zebheyaji. Ukulungiselela uqikelelo lwebheyaji. Ukulungezanisa iibheyaji ngeezicwangiso eziyiyoghuta zorhulumente kunye nezicwangiso zonyaka wemfanelo. Ukunika izindululo ngeendaba ezinxulumene nebheyaji. Ukulandelela ukuchithwa kwemali nxamkele ibheyaji elabelwe. Ukuqinisekisa ukubakho kwemali ngaphambi kokuba kuthengwe izinto neenkonzo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa izabelo ezichanekileyo ze-SCOA kwipakethe yokuhlawulela. Ukuhlola iingxelo zolawulo lwebali zenyanga. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iinxatshana ezazicwatyisiweyo zihambelana nemigangatho yokujonga. Ukubala iimfuno zebheyaji yemisebenzi yemihla ngemihla kumaphondo ngokwakelo lokuchithwa kwemali okwenyani. Ukulinganisa isabelo sokugqibela sebheyaji kwi-BAS. Ukucela isigqibo sebheyaji okanye inkcazelo yochitho-mali kwimizi yokubuyisela kwikhota elingachanekanga kunye nokugunyazisa izibhalo-eziguqukayo. Ukulandelela ukuchithwa kwemali nxamkele ibheyaji elabelwe (inkqubo okanye iinkqubo ezincinci). Ukulungiselela iingxelo zokuchithwa kwemali (amaholo abelwe ngokulingana kunye namaholo anemiqathango). Ukuququzelela amathambo kumbuzo wokujonga wangaphakathi nangaphandle kwaye ulandelele ukusetyenziswa kweendululo zokujonga. Uku lumkisa iNkulumbuso leSibhedlele ngeendlela zokuchitha kakhulu okanye kancinci imali. Ukulandelela izinto eziphatha ukubiza kakhulu. Ukugqiba iingxelo ezichanekileyo nangokuzenzileyo ezihlaziyiweyo njengoko kuchazwe kwiziqwenga zexesha.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Budget & Expenditure
jobs.summary: Manage and facilitate budgeting processes, financial planning and expenditure monitoring at Matikwana Hospital in the Mpumalanga Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus six (6) years relevant experience in Finance / Salary Administration or Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Finance / Public Administration / Public Management as recognised by SAQA plus three (3) years relevant experience in Human Resource Management / Salary Administration. At least three (3) years’ experience in the post of Chief Administration Clerk / Administrative Officer (Level 7). Knowledge of PERSAL System with courses will be an added advantage. Knowledge and understanding of the PFMA and Treasury Regulations; knowledge and understanding of the Basic Accounting System (BAS); good communication (verbal and written) skills; computer literacy; problem-solving skills; planning and organizing skills; analytical skills; liaison skills; client orientation skills; financial management skills; presentation skills; customer care skills. Ability to work in a team and independently. Assertiveness; and self-starter. Ability to work under pressure and good computer literacy skills (MS Excel and MS Word). Valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: To manage and facilitate budgeting processes. Facilitate and manage financial planning and budgeting processes. Compile budget estimates. Align budgets with strategic and annual performance plans. Provide advice on budget-related matters. Monitor expenditure against allocated budget. Confirm availability of funds before goods and services are procured. Ensure correct SCOA allocations are used on payment packs. Checking monthly document control reports. Ensure all processed documents are audit compliant. Costing operational budget requirements needs of Districts within actual expenditure trend. Balancing of final budget allocation on BAS. Request budget / expenditure input to quarterly erroneous allocations and authorize journal entries. Monitor expenditure against allocated budget (programme / sub- programme). Compile expenditure (equitable and conditional grants) reports. Coordinate resources to internal and external audit queries and monitor the implementation of audit recommendations. Alert the Hospital Management to over and under expenditure trends. Monitoring of key cost drivers. Complete accurate and updated report as per prescribed time frames. Supervise and control the work of sub-ordinate in the expenditure management unit. Authorize payments on Bas and Logis system. Understanding of all aspects of supply chain processes. Ensuring compliance with departmental and treasury regulations. Establish and enforce internal control measures. Manage all open orders report (Accruals) and reconciliation of accounts. Deal with Human resources matters such as leave and perform development system of quarterly evaluation reports. Attend and respond to audit queries.

af.title: Senior Staatsrekenmeester: Begroting en Besteding
af.summary: Bestuur en fasiliteer begrotingsprosesse, finansiële beplanning en bestedingsmonitering by Matikwana Hospital in die Department of Health: Mpumalanga.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 plus ses (6) jaar se relevante ervaring in Finansies / Salarisadministrasie of Diploma / Graad (NQF-vlak 6/7) in Finansies / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur soos erken deur SAQA plus drie (3) jaar se relevante ervaring in Menslikehulpbronbestuur / Salarisadministrasie. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring in die pos van Hoofadministratiewe Klerk / Administratiewe Beampte (Vlak 7). Kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel met kursusse sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en begrip van die PFMA en Tesourieregulasies; kennis en begrip van die Basiese Rekeningkundige Stelsel (BAS); goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik) vaardighede; rekenaargeletterdheid; probleemoplossingsvaardighede; beplannings- en organisasievaardighede; analitiese vaardighede; skakelvaardighede; kliëntgerigtheidsvaardighede; finansiële bestuursvaardighede; aanbiedingsvaardighede; kliëntsorgvaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Beslistheid; en selfstandig. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en goeie rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede (MS Excel en MS Word). Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Om begrotingsprosesse te bestuur en te fasiliteer. Fasiliteer en bestuur finansiële beplanning en begrotingsprosesse. Stel begrotingskattings op. Lijn begrotings met strategiese en jaarlikse prestasieplanne in. Verskaf advies oor begrotingsverwante aangeleenthede. Monitor bestedings teen die toegewysde begroting. Bevestig die beskikbaarheid van fondse voordat goedere en dienste verkry word. Verseker dat die korrekte SCOA-toewysings op betalingspakkette gebruik word. Kontroleer maandelikse dokumentbeheerverslae. Verseker dat alle verwerkte dokumente oudit-konform is. Bepaal die koste van operasionele begrotingsvereistes en behoeftes van Distrikte binne die werkelike bestedingsneiging. Balansering van die finale begrotingstoewysing op BAS. Versoeke begroting-/bestedingsinvoer vir kwartaallikse foutiewe toewysings en magtig joernaalinskrywings. Monitor bestedings teen die toegewysde begroting (program / sub-program). Stel bestedingsverslae (billike en voorwaardelike toelaes) op. Koördineer hulpbronne vir interne en eksterne ouditvrae en monitor die implementering van ouditaanbevelings. Stel die Hospitaalbestuur in kennis van oor- en onderbestedingsneigings. Monitering van sleutelkostaandrywers. Voltooi akkurate en opgedateerde verslae binne die voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke. Outeur en beheer die werk van ondergeskiktes in die bestedingsbestuurseenheid. Magtig betalings op die BAS- en Logis-stelsel. Begrip van alle aspekte van voorsieningskettingprosesse. Verseker nakoming van departementele en tesourieregulasies. Stel en handhaaf interne beheermaatreëls. Bestuur alle verslae oor oop bestellings (toekomsbetalings) en die rekonsiliasie van rekenings. Hanteer menslikehulpbronbelange soos verlof en voer die ontwikkelingstelsel van kwartaallikse evaluasieverslae uit. Woon ouditvrae by en reageer daarop.

Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA kanye Nemithetho yeSikhwameni; ulwazi nokuqonda iSistimu Esiyisisekelo Yokubala Imali (BAS); amakhono okuxhumana ohlakaniphile (okukhulunywayo nokubhaliwe); ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; amakhono okuhlela futhi uhle imisebenzi; amakhono okuhlaziya; amakhono okuxhumana nabantu; amakhono okubuka izidingo zikhasimende; amakhono okuphatha izimali; amakhono okubhukuda; amakhono enakekelwa yikhasimende. Ikhono ukusebenza eqenjini nangabanye. Ukuqina; futhi ngumuntu oqala yedwa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxabo kanye namakhono ohlelo lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Excel kanye ne-MS Word). Ilayisensi yokushayela.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha futhi ukuqondisa inqubo yokwenza ngemali. Ukuqondisa futhi kuphathe ukuhleleka kwezimali nokuqondisa inqubo yokubeka izimali ezidingekayo. Ukuqoqa izilinganiselo zokubeka izimali. Ukuqondanisa amabhajethi namapulani okwenza ngemfumo nonyaka. Ukunika izeluleko ezimalini ezihlobene nokubeka izimali. Ukugcina amehlo kwezimali ezichithiwa uma ziqhathaniswa nemali ebekelwe umsebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali ikhona ngaphambi kokuthenga impahla nezinsizakalo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kusetshenziswa izabelo ezifanele ze-SCOA eziguqulweni zokukhokha. Ukuhlola imibiko yokuqinisekisa ukulawula kwamadokhonda njalo ngenyanga. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibhalu egqitshiwe ihambisana nemigomo yokuhlola. Ukulinganisa izindleko zezimali ezidingekayo ukusebenza kwawo masifunda ngokuvumelana nendlela okuchithwa ngayo imali. Ukulinganisa ngokwanele ukwabiwa kwemali eqedile kwi-BAS. Ukucela inani lokuqasha nemali echithiwe kumasonto amane ezabelweni eziyiphusa futhi uvume ukungena kwezinhlelo. Ukugcina amehlo kwezimali ezichithiwe uma ziqhathaniswa nemali ebekelwe umsebenzi (uhlelo / uhlelo oluncane). Ukuqoqa imibiko yemali echithiwe (amaholo alinganayo nemikhiqizo ekhethekile). Ukuhlanganisa izinsiza ezibuuzo zokuqoqa izibekelo zabantu ngaphakathi naphandle futhi ugcine ukusethenziswa kwamaphuzu okuhlola. Ukwesaba abaphathi wesibhedlela mayelana nokuchitheka kwezimali ngokweqisa nangokungaliseki. Ukugcina amehlo ezinto ezibiza kakhulu. Ukuqedela imibiko eqinisekisiwe futhi esanda kulungiswa ngokusethenzwa kwesikhathi. Ukuqondisa futhi ulawule umsebenzi abangaphansi kwakho enkabeni yokulawula ukuchitheka kwemali. Ukuvumela ukukhokhelwa kwi-BAS nankompyutha ye-Logis. Ukuqonda zonke izinkomba zokuqondisa inqubo yokulethwa kwempahla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemigomo yesiKhwameni neManyuvesi. Ukumisa futhi ukuphoqa izindlela zokulawula ezisebenzayo. Ukuphatha imibiko yazo zonke izifundo ezingavuliwe (Ama-Accruals) nokuqondanisa izimali. Ukubhekana nemibuzo yabantu njengokuphumula nokwenza inqubo yokuqoqa imibiko yokuqinisekisa isikhathi njalo kumasonto amane. Ukuhamba futhi uphendule izibuzo zokuqoqa izibekelo zabantu.

Ukugqamisa ukulandelwa kwezinqumo zokuphatha izimali ezingenayo. Ukusekela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga lolwazi.

Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amabala amaninzi angalawulo athembekileyo ekuboniswaneni nabantu nasekuvezweni okubhalwayo nokuThethwayo. Amapleya obomi kunye nezakhono ezibalulekileyo ekulawuleni abantu. Ukwazi ukusebenza lodwa ngokwakho kwaye usebenze ngexesha elifingqwayo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba eyanzeleyo iba lusongo olungongezelelwayo.
xh.duties: Ikwazi ukubhalisa kulawulo lwemali engenayo kwi-hospitals e-Ehlanzeni District. Ukwenza igqibe ngokuchanekileyo ukubhalisa koluntu kumaziko e-Ehlanzeni District. Ukuncedisa ekulawuleni imali ezingenileyo nokulandelela. Ukuqwalasela ukuthobela iindidi-mithetho ngokulawula imali engenayo. Ukuxhasa uLwazi oluqhutywa ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.

af.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 met vroedvroukunde word by hospitale in Mpumalanga se Gert Sibande en Ehlanzeni-distrikte benodig, met SANC-registrasie en Grade 12 as vereistes.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus Basiskwalifikasie geakkrediteer met die South African Nursing Council (SANC) (d.w.s. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die SANC as Professional Nurse (2026) toelaat. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede.

Neem deel aan die implementering van die Nasionale Kerntandarde en Ideal Hospital Realisation Framework. Toon doeltreffende kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om gehalte-verpleegsorg te verseker. Werk doeltreffend, saamwerkend en vriendelik met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdiensverskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevordering en voorstanding van behoorlike behandeling en sorg, insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te reageer (Batho-Pele). Bestuur doeltreffend die hulpbronne wat aan u eenheid toegewys is.

zu.summary: Kudingeka usesiwezempihlengulo Ezingeni 1 obuthwelelabantu ezibhedlela eMapumalanga kuzigodi ze-Gert Sibande ne-Ehlanzeni, kudingeka ibhalise ku-SANC kanye ne-Grade 12.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 kanye nesiqu esisisolo esifakwe i-South African Nursing Council (SANC) (okungukuthi iDiploma / i-Degree ekuQeqeshweni Lokuzelele) noma isiqu esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengosesiwezempihlengulo (2026). Ukukwazi ukusebenza ozibuse kanye nokubeka phambili umsebenzi. Ikhono lokubusa kanye namakhono ahleRelationship komunye umuntu, ukuxazulula izinkinga namakhono okuthatha izinqumo.
zu.duties: Yenza ukusebenza kwezempilo ngokuvumelana nomkhakha wokusebenza kanye namazinga okuhlengula njengoba kuncike isikhungo sezempilo. Khuthaza izinga lokuhlenga njengokuqondiswa umkhakha wokusebenza ochwepheshe kanye namazinga. Thatha inhlalo yokusetshenziswa kwe-National Core Standards kanye ne-Ideal Hospital Realisation Framework. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabagulayo, abaphathi kanye nabanye ochwepheshe, okubandakanya ukubhala imibiko lapho kudingeka khona. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elinoziga ezahlukene ukuze kuqiniseke izinga lokuhlenga. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokubambisana ngokuhwebisana kahle nabantu abahlukene ngengqondo, ngamasiko, ngobuhlanga nangokholo. Ukukwazi ukuhlela futhi uhlele umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabasebenzi abasiza ukuze kuqiniseke ukuhlengula okufanele. Khombisa ukukhathalela ngabagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokweseka ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele okubandakanya ukwaziswa kanye nokuzithoba ekuPhenduleni izidingo, izidingo kanye nezinhlangothi zabagulayo (Batho-Pele). Phatha ngokusebenzayo izinsiza ezabelwe kwilabhho yakho.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo / iSivi 12 kanye nesimangalo esisekweyo ngeBhunga lesiZulu seNdluvo yoQhwagela lwezwe laseMzantsi Afrika (i-SANC) (oko kukuthi iDiploma / iNqanga ekuQhwageleni jikelele) okanye isimangalo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalwa kwi-SANC njengoQhwagela oneMvuzo (2026). Ulwazi lokuSebenza nokuzimela nokubeka izinto ngokubaluleka kwazo. Ubunkokeli nakhono oluhle lokuhlangenwe nako nabantu, ukuxazula iingxaki nakhono lokwenza izigqibo.
xh.duties: Yenza uqeqesho lweNdluvo yoQhwagela ngokuvumelana nommandla wokuSebenza namazinga okuQhwagela njengokoquliswa sisiphithiphithi sempilo. Khuthaza umgangatho wonxibelelwano lweNdluvo njengokulawulwa ngummandla wokuSebenza oqingqiweyo namazinga. Thatha inxaxheba ekusebenziseni iZizo eZiNgunzi zeLizwe neSakhulo soQeqesho lweBhedlele eQinisekileyo. Bonisa ngenkathazo yokuxhumana neGazi, nabaphathi nakwezinye iinqhwagela, kuquka nokubhala iingxelo xa kuyimfuneko. Sebenza njengesinye iqela elisebenza ngeendlela ezininzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe umgangatho weNdluvo yoQhwagela. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokuthomalalisa ngokwamkelekileyo nabantu abahlukene ngobuchule, inkcubeko, uhlanga okanye inkolo. Akwazi ukuCela nokuhlela umsebenzi wakhe nowabantu abancedisyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunyamezela okulungileyo kweNdluvo. Bonisa inkathazo kwiGazi, ukukhuthaza nokuvakalisa unyamezelo olulungileyo nokukhathaleka kuquka nokuqonda nesifiso sokuPhendula kwiimfuno zamaGazi, iimfuno nemithelela (iBatho- Pele). Lawula ngokusebenzayo izibonelelo ezabeliwe kwicandelo lakho.

jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualifications that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Officer (2026). A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Knowledge, skills, Training and Competences required. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Sound clinical knowledge. Competency and skills in general clinical domains. The ability to work independently and under pressure and beyond normal working hours and work with diverse team. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal, and engage when necessary. Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programs and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach and guide junior staff within the department. Behavioural Attributes: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationship.

Participate in academic and training programs. Assist with clinical audits actively participate in continuous professional development. Provide support to hospital management towards an efficient standard of patient care and services maintained. Comply with the performance Management and Development System (conducting quarterly reviews and final assessment).

af.title: Sessie Mediese Beampte Graad 1
af.summary: Sessie Mediese Beampte Graad 1 gesoek by Bernice Samuel Hospital in Mpumalanga om pasiënte te bestuur en institutionele gesondheidsorgdoelwitte te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasies wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Medical Officer (2026) moontlik maak. 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Health and Public Service regulasies en beleide. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Vereiste kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis. Bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk en buite normale werksure en saam met 'n diverse span te werk. Goeie kommunikasie, leierskap, interpersoonlike vaardighede, en om in te skakel wanneer nodig. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleide, wetgewing, programme en prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te lei. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings op te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Om pligte en funksies met bekwaamheid uit te voer, om die doelwitte en oogmerke van die instelling te ondersteun wat ooreenstem met standaarde van pasiëntsorg. Verantwoordelikheid aanvaar vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3 dienspakket fasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen by die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning bied aan hospitaalbestuur sodat 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en dienste gehandhaaf word. Voldoen aan die Performance Management and Development System (die uitvoer van kwartaallikse hersienings en finale assessering).

zu.title: Inkantolo Yezokwelapha Yesikhathi Esithile Ezingeni 1
zu.summary: Kufunwa Inkantolo Yezokwelapha Yesikhathi Esithile Ezingeni 1 eBernice Samuel Hospital eMpumalanga ukuphatha iziguli nokusekela izinjongo zezempilo zesikhungo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengenkantolo Yezokwelapha (2026). Kuzodingeka i-permit yomsebenzi ehamba nobulungu kubantu abangengabakwaSouth Africa. Ukuqonda okuhle ngokuziphatha kwemithetho yezokwelapha. Ukuphatha ngokwezinhlanga eziningi nokusebenza njengomphakatsi kanye namava endaweni yezokwelapha ehambisana nalokho. Ulwazi lwemithetho nezinhlelo zamasonto wesikhathi samanje zezempilo nokwasemphakathini. Amakhono ohlelweni lokweluleka, ukuthatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwezokwelapha nokuphatha ngokwezokwelapha. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa namiqondo edingekayo. Ukuqonda okuhle ngokuziphatha kwemithetho yezokwelapha. Ukuphatha ngokwezinhlanga eziningi nokusebenza njengomphakatsi kanye namava endaweni yezokwelapha ehambisana nalokho. Ulwazi oluhle ngokwezokwelapha. Ikhono namakhano kwizindawo ezijwayelekile zezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nangaphansi kwezingcindezi nangaphandle kwezikhathi ezijwayelekile zokusebenza nokusebenza nomphakatsi ohlukahlukene. Inking enhle yokuxhumana, ukuba ngumholi, nokuxhumana nabantu, nokuzibandakanya lapho kudingeka khona. Ulwazi lwemithetho, izinhlelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqasha zezempilo zasemhlabeni jini. Ikhono lokufundisa nokuhola abasebenzi abancane kulelo mnyango. Iziphimsiso Eziziphathaneni: Ukubekezela ekusebenzeni ngaphakathi komphakatsi, ukuzethemba nakhono lokwakha nokuqinisa ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuqhuba imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngekhono, ukusekela izinjongo nezinhloso zesikhungo eziyahambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kweziguli. Ukumamatheka ukuphathwa kweziguli ezifakiwe esikhungweni sephakeji lelevel 2/3 yesevisi. Ukusiza ekulungiseleleni nokuphothulwa imihlahlandlela namaphrothokholo. Ukubamba iqhaza kuhlelo lokufunda nokuqeqesha. Ukusiza ezivivinyweni zezokwelapha nokubamba iqhaza kumapulashe ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubelekayo. Ukunika inkxaso ekuphathweni kwevesihele ukufeza amazinga aphelele okunakekelwa kweziguli nokugcina izinsiza ezisebenza kahle. Ukuhambisana nokuqashwa kwehlelokusebenza lapho okuthuthukiswa ikhokho elihlobene nekhalenda lezikhathi ezintathu kanye nokuqeqeshwa.

xh.summary: Kufunwa iSikhululi sokusebenza somGcini wezoNyango inqanaba 1 eBernice Samuel Hospital eMpumalanga ukulawula abaguli noku nxamela iinjongo ezempilo zolawulo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoMgcini wezoNyango (2026). Amapondo ngokubakho ngokwemibuzo yonyango, ukuthathwa komlando, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwezempilo nokulawula izigulo ngokwezempilo. Ulwazi, amapondo, uQeqesho namakhono afunekayo. Ulwazi olululo ngokuziphatha kwempilo. Ulawulo lweqela elinamasebe ahanahanisileyo nokusebenza ngeqela namava kwelo candelo lezonyango ezithile. Ulwazi olululo ngempilo. Ulwazi namakhono kumagunya amaninzi ezempilo. Ikhono lokusebenza yedwa naphantsi kwengcinezelo nangaphezulu kweeyure ezizelekileyo zokusebenza nokusebenza ngeqela elahlukahlukene. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelwana, ukuba ngumlawuli, unxibelelwano namakhono okusebenza nabantu, nokuqabisa xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngemigaqo, izinto ezilawulayo, iinkqubo nangokusenziwa kwaye kugqalwe kwindawo ethile. Ikhono lokufundisa nokukhokela abasebenzi abangakwaziyo kwesebe. Iimpawu ezithintela ukuziphatha: Ukumelana nengcinezelo, ukusebenza kwinqanaba eliselu, ithemba ngokwakho nakhono lokwakha nokugcina unxibelelwano oluhle.

Ukuphendula ngokulawula abaguli abangeniswe esixhobo selevel 2/3 seenkonzo ezithile. Ukuncedisa ekulungelelweni nokuphumeza imigaqo nemila yonke. Ukubandakanyeka kwiinkqubo ezimalunga nokufundiswa. Ukuncedisa ekuhloleni izigulo ngokuchanekileyo. Ukubandakanyeka ekuphuculeni ulwazi ngokuchanekileyo ngokwemiba yamanye amathombo. Ukunikela inkxaso kulawulo lesikhululu ngokuchana kwemigaqo yonke ephucula iinkonzo zabaguli. Ukulandela imigaqo yokuLawula iNkonzo nokuphucula (ukwenza ukuphonononga kwemihla ngemihla).

Amakhono amabalwe nabathethwayo okuxhumana. Ukuba nobugcisa ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha, ukuba nakho ukusebenza kwezi nkqubo zisoftwareilandelayo, i-Microsoft Office ne-Power Point. zu.title: Isibhali kwiDirektha: Biodiversity Management
zu.summary: Nika inkxaso eyisibhali kanye nokwamukela abafakisi kwiDirektha yeBiodiversity Management eKimberley, okuhlanganisa ukuphatwa kwedayari, ukuhlola amakholi kanye nokuqondanisa imibhalohlelo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu ngaphandle kwalolu okungenani eminyakeni emi-2 yohluva lokusebenza njengesibhali; Ulwazi ngemikhakha kanye nokuqhubeka okusetshenziswa ekuphatweni kwehhovisi; kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ms Word, power point, excel, Ms Outlook kanye nokusebenzisa i-intanethi), Amandla okuxhumana (angamlomo nangabhalwayo) kanye namandla okuxhumana kahle nabantu abangezinkango ezahlukene futhi bavela kumakhaya ahlukene; Amandla okusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ukuphatwa kwendawo yehhovisi jikelele, imibhalohlelo kanye nokuphatwa kwamafayela. Kulungele ngesinye isikhathi ukusebenza ngemva kwamahola lapho kudingeka khona. Amandla okuhlela/ukubeka eduze imisebenzi futhi uphathe isikhathi ngempumelelo. Ulwazi ngezenkambiso kanye neziqondiso zomnyango. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izokuba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yokwesekela eyisibhali/kwamukela abafakisi kumenzeji ophakeme; Amukela futhi uhlola amakholi efoni amenzeji ophakeme; Phatha idayari yomenzeji ophakeme futhi ubekel eduze izinhlelomiszo uma kunesidingo; Hlela, hlela kahle, hilonganisa futhi uphathe ukugeleza kwemibhalohlelo ehhovisi lomenzeji ophakeme; Yenza umsebenzi wokuthayipha ongathamandla; Sebenzisa futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zehhovisi, njengomshini we-fax kanye nesikopizi sezikopiso zisezimeni egudileyo yomsebenzi; Qinisekisa ukuthi abavakashi bamukelwa ngendlela eyakhisa isithombe sobungcweti behhovisi. Nikeza inkxaso yokuhlela logistik kunuzakalo kumenzeji ophakeme noma kwelunga (ukuhamba, ukwendlala kanye nokucubungula izifundo); Hlela izinkomfa, amawokishophu kanye nemicimbo yomenzeji ophakeme nanabasebenzi abanye egumbini, tshola izindawo, mema abalingisi, hlela ukuphuzwayo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imibhalohlelo edingekayo itholakala; Lungiselela izinhlelo zomhlangano futhi ubhale amaminethi ezinkomfa zemenzeji negumbi; Bhala amagama, amamemorandamu futhi uhlele imibiko. Yenza ukufaka kwemibhalohlelo; Phatha izinkomfa zokuqhashiya; Qoqa futhi/uqonde ulwazi lomenzeji ophakeme, njengoba kudingeka, hlola izinhlelo zomhlangano nemibhalohlelo yomhlangano ukuze tshole imibhalohlelo edingekayo okufanele itholakale kumenzeji ngesikhathi somhlangano. Hlala unolwazi olusha mayelana nemiyalo/ izinkambiso futhi izinqubo ezifanele kwizwe lakhe/ umsebenzi wakhe ukuze qinisekise inkxaso esebenzayo nesezifundweni kumenzeji.

xh.title: Indlu yenkundla kuMlawuli: Ulawulo lweZinzo
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yenkundla nokuamkela izigqibo kuMlawuli weZinzo eKimberley, kuquka ulawulo lwesikhawula, ukuhlola amafowuni nokuqhotyoshwa kwamaxwebhu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior nesiphiwo seminyaka engama-2 yamava wokusebenza njengesekela-maphathiswa; Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela zokwenza izinto ezisebenziswa kulawulo lendlu; kufuneka ube nolwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (Ms Word, power point, excel, Ms Outlook nokuza kwi-intanethi), Amandla okunxibelela (okuthethwayo nokubhalwayo) nokuqonda ukunxibelela kakuhle nabantu abakwizigaba ezahlukeneyo kwaye bebavela kummandla ongamnye; Amandla okusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo. Ulawulo olubanzi lwendlu, ulawulo lwamaxwebhu namafayile. Isazelo sokusebenza nangemini xa kufuneka nangomso. Amandla okuhlelwaokuqamba izinto nokuqamba kakhulu izabelo ezibalulekileyo nokulawula isikhathi kakuhle. Ulwazi ngamagunyaziso nendlela zokwenza izinto zesebe. Ilayisensi yokushayela ephilayo iya kuba yinzuzo enkulu.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yenkundla/ yokwamkela abantu kwinjiniela; Thatha uze uhlolle amafowuni efon entlanganisweni kwinjiniela; Lawula isikhawula senjiniela uze uqambe izigqibo ezibalulekileyo xa kuyimfuneko; Cwangcisa, hlela, qhotyoshela ulawulo lokuhamka kwamaxwebhu ofisini yenjiniela; Yenza umsebenzi obanzi wokuthayipha; Sebenzisa uze uqiniseke ukuba izixhobo zofisi, umzekelo imishini yefaks nesikopisi sisebenza kakuhle; Qinisekisa ukuba abantu bafunyanwa ngendlela ephakamisisa umfanekiso ochumileyo weOfisi. Nika inkxabo yezinto ezahlukeneyo kwinjiniela nakunye nalawo makaphathiswe kuwo (ukuhamba, indlu yokukhula nokugqibela iimfuno zentlawulo-yamava); Hlela iindibano, iindaba ezisemthethweni nemicimbi kwinjiniela nakwezinye iindwendwe kwiSebe, phawula iindawo, mema abathathi-nxaxheba, hlela ukutywa kwesixa ukuze uqiniseke ukuba onke amaxwebhu abalulekileyo afumaneka; Lungiselela izihloko ezizakulandelwa kwimibiko yendibano yomphathi weSebe nemiqulu yolawulo; Bhala iileta, ooncedo wezincwadana aze uqulunqe iingxelo. Yenza ifayile yamaxwebhu; Lawula izitatu ze Ndlela yokuvakalelwa; Qokelela okunye Ulawulo iNgcombolo xa ifuneka kwinjiniela, hlohloza izihloko yemibiko yendibano aze uchaze inxaxheba kumaxwebhu abalulekileyo afanele ukuba abe nakufumaneka kumphathi ngelixa lendibano. Zama ukuhlala ulwazi ngemithetho/ amagunyaziso nendlela ezisebenza kummandla wakhe womsebenzi kuze kuqiniseke inkxaso eyiyo nesebenzayo kumphathi.

xh.title: Ungenyisi kuLawuli: uLawulo nokuPhinyisa
xh.summary: Nika inkonzo yongenyisi noshishino lokwamkela abantu kuLawuli woLawulo nokuPhinyisa ukuze abe nokwenziwa kweenxwelo eKimberley, ukulawula iinxwelo, oonxibelelwano kwidayari noku kulawulwa kweenxwelo zofisini.
xh.requirements: Ukwazi iinkqubo nenkqubo ezisetyenziswa kulo lawulo lofisini; kufuneka akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ms Word, power point, excel, Ms Outlook nokusetyenziswa kwe-intanethi), Amandla okunxibelelana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe) noku koko ukuba nakho ukunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu abakumazinga ahlukeneyo bavela kumvelaphi ehlukileyo; Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngowoxolo. Ulawulo jikelele lofisini, ulawulo lweenxwelo namafayile. Ukulungele ngamanye amaxesha ukusebenza emva kweyure xa kufuneka. Ukuba nakho ukuqamba/ukubeka phambili imisebenzi aze alophule ngokuchanekileyo ixesha. Ukwazi iingcamango namagqabantshi esebe. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile iya kuba yongezo.

Amakhono okuhlela/ ukubeka izidingo phambili kanye nokuphatha isikhathi ngempumelelo. Ulwazi ngamapholisi kanye nendlela kanye nenqubo yomnyango. Isitifiketi sokushayela esimtshaliweyo sizoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Nika insiza yobunogwaja / obomamukeli kwaMphathi Ophakeme; Amukela futhi uhlolojwe amakholi efoni eza kuMphathi Ophakeme; Phatha ikhalenda kaMphathi Ophakeme futhi ubambe iqhaza kuma-aphoyintimenti uma kunesidingo; Hlela, hlela kahle, hlanganisa futhi uphathe ukuphela kwemibhalo enkundleni kaMphathi Ophakeme; Yenza umsebenzi wokuthayipha ongumzinga ophezulu; Sebenzisa futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zohlelo lwezendlu, njengomshini we-fax kanye nomshini wokushaja uxhunyiwe begodu usebenza kahle; Qinisekisa ukuthi abavakashi bamukeleka ngendlela ekhulisa isithombe sesikhundla esihle. Nikeza insiza yezokuhamba kuMphathi Ophakeme noma kwesigaba (ukuhamba, ukwendlala kanye nokugaywa kwama-claims); Hlela izingqungquthela, amawokishophu kanye nemicimbo kaMphathi Ophakeme nakubanye abasebenzi basesigabeni, tshola izindawo, mema abadlali ababalulekile, hlela ukudla futhi uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imibalo ebalulekile itholakala; Lungiselela izinhloso zangingqungquthela futhi ubhale amaminithi ayingqungquthela kaMphathi nakwesigaba; Bhala amagama, amamemorandamu futhi uhlanganise imibiko. Yenza ukuhlelwa kwemibhalo; Phatha izinkomba zezinkuleko; Qoqa futhi/ noma uhlanganise ulwazi kuMphathi Ophakeme, njengoba kudingekile, funda izinhloso zangingqungquthela nemibalo yayo ukuze tshole imibalo ebalulekile edinga ukutholakala kuMphathi ngenkathi yengqungquthela. xh.title: Unobumba kuM lawuli: PaPaalo ya Twe-lo ya Tikologo
xh.summary: Fana ka tshegetso ya mosebetsi wa boseketeri le wa ho amogela baeti ho Molaodi wa Taolo ya Boleng ba Tikologo Kimberley, ho laola dipontsho, ditelefono, le ditokumente.
xh.requirements: Setifikeiti sa Higher Grade le phahamisetsa pakeng tsa 2 ya boiphihlelo ya ho sebetsa e le mosebetsi wa boseketeri; Tsebo ya ditsela tse sebetswang taolong ya kantoro; o tlame ho ba le tsebo ya ho sebelisa khomphuta (Ms Word, power point, excel, Ms Outlook le ho sebelisa intashenete), thari ya ho bua le ho ngola (ya molomo le ya ho ngola) le matla a ho buisana le batho ba maemong a fapaneng le ba tswang mafelong a fapaneng; Matla a ho sebetsa nako ya kgateleho. Taolo ya kakaretso ya kantoro, taolo ya ditokumente le faele. Tswello-pele ya ho sebetsa nako e fetileng ka nako e itseng ha ho hlokahala. Matla a ho hlopha/hlatholla mesebetsi le ho laola nako ka tsela e atlehileng. Tsebo ya maano le ditsela tsa seabe. Leshense ya ho qetisa e tla ba molemo.
xh.duties: Fa tshegetso ya mosebetsi wa boseketeri/ho amogela baeti ho Molaodi; Amogele le ho hlahloba ditelefono bakeng sa Molaodi; Laola letlakala la letsatsi la Molaodi le ho hlatholla dipontsho ha ho hlokahala; Raela, hlopha, hokanya le ho laola phallo ya ditokumente ofising ya Molaodi; Phetha mesebetsi ya ho thaepa ya maemo a hodimo; Sebelisa le ho netefatsa hore thekiso ya kantoro, mw. fax le sehatisi di sebetsa ka ho le ho lokile; Netefatsa hore baeti ba amogelwa ka tsela e phahamisang setshoantsho se phethahetseng sa Ofisi. Fana ka tshegetso ya ho hlopha bakeng sa Molaodi le/kapa yunita (leeto, borokolong le tshwara ya dikgetse); Raela dikopano, diworkshop le ditiragalo bakeng sa Molaodi le basebetsi ba bang Yuniting, hlatholla mafelo, mema batho ba nang le karolo, hlopha dintho tsa ho ntha le ho netefatsa hore ditokumente tsohle tse bohlokwa di fumaneha; Lokisa mananeo a kopano le ho ngola metsotso ya dikopano ya molaodi le Yunita; Ngola mangolo, memorandamm le ho hlophisa ditshwa. Etsa faele ya ditokumente; Laola di rejistara tsa boikgetlo; Htara le/kapa hokanya tshedimoso bakeng sa Molaodi, ha ho hlokahala, hlahloba mananeo a kopano le ditokumente tsa kopano ho hlatholla ditokumente tse bohlokwa tse tlame ho fumaneha ho molaodi bakeng sa kopano. Phele o ntse o tseba ka ga ditsela tsa mosebetsi/maano le ditsela tse sebetsang setjhabeng sa hae/e wa hae ho netefatsa tshegetso e atlehileng le e sebetsang ho molaodi.

zu.title: Unobhala weSikhulumi: Ukusekela Abakhiqizi Bezolimo
zu.summary: Nika inkxaso yokuba ngunobhala nomsizi wokwamukela abantu komphathi wesikhulu ophethwe kwisoqhqwoghwa sikaZulu eNyakatho Kapa kwisebe lezululimo. Kubalulekile ukuba unemfundo yesidanga seSenior Certificate kwaye unamava eminyaka emibini kule ndlela.
zu.requirements: Isatifikedi seSenior Certificate esinamava okungenwa ibango elinganiselwe kwiminyaka engu-2 ngokuba ngunobhala; Ulwazi lwemigaqo nemigangatho yokusingathwa kofisi; kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (iMs Word, i-Power Point, i-Excel, iMs Outlook nokusetyenziswa kwe-intanethi); ukuzoba ulwimi lomzimba nokuloba; nako ukuchazana kakuhle nabantu abavela kumgangatho ohlukeneyo nase kubveli ezahlukeneyo; ukuba nakho ukwenza umsebenzi ngesixhobo sokulingana. Ulawulo olubanzi lwenkonzo yofisi, ukulawula amaxwebhu namafayili. Ukuzimisela ngamaxesha ukusebenza ngaphandle kweyure ezinqamlezileyo xa kufunwa. ukuba nakho ukumisela/ukubeka phambili umsebenzi, nokulawula ngokuchanekileyo ixesha. Ulwazi lweengqinisekiso nemigaqo yomnyango. Ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni kuya kuba luncedo.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yokuba ngunobhala nomsizi wamkela isithuba ngokusabela kwisikhulumi esiphakathi; yamkela ukuze uhlole amacingo oMphathi weSikhulumi ngentsomi; ulawule i-Agenda yomPhathi oPhakamileyo, aze abeka phambili izigqibo xa kunesidingo; cwangcisa, lungisa, bambisela, ulawule ukugqitha kolwazi olukhulu kwindawo yokusebenzela komPhathi; wenze umsebenzi wokuthayipha obalulekileyo; uqalise kuqinisekise ukuba izixhobo zikamabhasi ngokomzekelo i-fax kunye nokukhanya izikrwele zikamasebe nangokuqhuba kakuhle; qinisekisa ukuba abantu abavela batyatywa kalumnzayo ukuzoba isimo sobunzima seHhovisi. Nikela inkonzo ngokusabela kumPhathi oPhakamileyo naxa kunesitshixo (ngokuhamba, indlu yokuhla kunye notshintsho lwezimali); cwangcisa iindaba, amanqanqamuzi, namatshukudi omPhathi wesikhokelo wamanye amalungu oMgangatho, uqonde izinto, mema abanxaxheba, hlela okokuzityela, uqinisekise ukuba zonke iintlobo ezibalulekileyo zeenkca zikho; zibe neNkqubo zeentlanganiso gqiba iNqanaba kuBhedeshwa woSuku okugqibele leNhlangano ngobuNganga; hlenga iindlela ezenzwa ngayo iinzwi, iMemo ngokubhalayo ze zikho iziko exesha. Nghenisa iNngada ngomzila okwangamva osuka kulawulo oluvela kuwo yonke imiYilo yoxhumana ukuze abe yinto Ndayigci eDangatya ngobukum baliwo inzala ngoluvo lokulungelelanisa iNkonzo ukuze isebenze ngamandla kusetyenziswa ngendlela yokuQinisekisa amaNqanaba wolawulo ngaloo ndlela kuBhedashwa. Khotha izinhlaka ezinkulu Abasebenzi abangakumbi basebenza ngokusemthethweni abalawulwa njengesihloko seSigaba esingamaNqanaba aNikiwe imiYilo ngokusemthethweni.

xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yenkonzo yenkosikazi nokwamkela abantu kuMphathi oyigqatswa; Yamkele uhlolisise iinxoxo ezibhalwe ngentlungu zelefowuni ezibhalwe ngentlungu zelefowuni ezibhalwe ngentlungu zelefowuni kuMphathi oyigqatswa; Lawule idayari kaMphathi oyigqatswa ubize izicelo xa kubalulekile; Cwangcisa, qamba, qhoboshela nilawule iinkqubo zamaxwebhu eofisini kaMphathi oyigqatswa; Zenze imisebenzi ebhalwayo ephakamileyo; Sebenzise qinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zofisini, umzekelo ifax machine nephotocopier zisebenza kakuhle; Qinisekisa ukuba ababekelayo bamkelwe ngendlela ekhuthaza isimilo sobungcali eofisini. Nikezela ngenkxaso yezixhobo kuMphathi oyigqatswa nakulo nayiphi na ingxenye (isahluko, indlu yokuhlala nokubala izikwele); Cwangcisa iindibano, iinkqubo zokuzilolonga neziganeko zoMphathi oyigqatswa nangabanye basebenzi baseQkontswini, gqiba izindawo, mema abadlali beentsengo, qamba iziselo qinisekise ukuba yonke imibhalo ebalulekileyokho; Lungelelanisa iinkqubo zokubhala ubhale okubhaliweyo nengxoxo yomphathi neseQkontswini; Bhala iileta, iimemo uze uhluze iingxelo. Yenza izicelo zamaxwebhu; Lawule amagama okubaleka koMphathi oyigqatswa, njengoko kufuneka, lungelelanisa izinkqubo nemibhalo yeendibano ukuzichaza imibhalo ebalulekileyo ekufuneka ifumanekise komphathi oyigqatswa kwindibano. Phelelwa ngolwazi ngemithetho echaza imigaqo nenkqubo ezichaza kummandla wakhe wemisebenzi ukuqinisekisa inkxako emzuzweni nangokusebenzisekela komphathi.

jobs.title: Secretary to Director: Veterinary Services
jobs.department: Department Agriculture, Environmental Affairs, Rural Development and Land Reform
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and receptionist support to the Director of Veterinary Services in Kimberley, including diary management and document coordination.

General office administration, document and file management. Willingness to occasionally work after hours when required. Ability to organize/prioritize tasks and effectively manage time. Knowledge of departmental policies and procedures. A Valid Driver’s license will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Render a secretarial/ receptionist support service to the Senior Manager; Receive and screen telephone calls for the Senior Manager; Manage the diary of the Senior Manager and prioritize appointments if necessary; Plan, organize, co-ordinate and manage documentation flow in the office of the Senior Manager; Perform advanced typing work; Operate and ensure that office equipment, e.g. fax machine and photocopier are in a good working order; Ensure that guests are received in such a way as to enhance the professional image of the Office. Provide logistical support to the Senior Manager and/ or the component (travel, accommodation and processing of claims); Arrange meetings, workshops and events for the Senior Manager and other staff in the Unit, identify venues, invite role players, organize refreshments and ensure that all relevant documentation is available; Prepare agendas and record minutes of meetings of the manager and the Unit; Draft letters, memorandums and compile reports. Do filing of documents; Administer leave registers; Collect and/or co-ordinate information for the Senior Manager, as required, peruse agendas and meeting documents to identify relevant documentation that need to be available to the manager for the meeting. Remain up to date with regard to the applicable prescripts/ policies and procedures applicable to his/ her work terrain to ensure efficient and effective support to the manager.

af.title: Sekretaresse vir Direkteur: Veeartsenykundige Dienste
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en ontvangsteun aan die Direkteur van Veeartsenykundige Dienste in Kimberley, insluitend dagboekbestuur en dokumentkoördinasie.

zu.title: Unobhala we-Director: Veterinary Services
zu.summary: Nika inkxaso yobusebhalaralarhi kanye nokwamukela abantu kwi-Director ye-Veterinary Services e-Kimberley, okuhlanganisa nokulawula idayari nokuqondanisa amadokhumenti.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate enokuhlolwa okungenani eminyakaengu-2 ukusebenza njengonobhala; Ulwazi mayelana nezinqubo nemithetho esetshenziswa ekulawulweni kohlelo; kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ms Word, power point, excel, Ms Outlook kanye nokusebenzisa i-intanethi), Amakhono okuxoxa (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe) kanye n ikhono lokuxoxa kahle nabantu abakulezinga elahlukene futhi bevela kwezinye izindawo; Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinezulu. Ukulawula kohlelo lwehhovisi ngokujwayelekile, ukuqondanisa amadokhumenti kanye nokulawula amafayela. Ukuqonda ukusebenza nge-esikhathi esingemva kweyora noma sikhatsi lesiye sicedzile uma kudingekile. Ikhono lokuhlela/ukubeka phambili imisebenzi kanye nokulawula isikhathi ngokuphumelelayo. Ulwazi mayelana nemithetho kanye nezinqubo zomnyango. Ukugcina i-Driver's license evumelekile kuzoba yindlela enenye yokuzuzisa.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yokusebenza njengoba ngumamukeli wehhovisi kumqashi; Yamukela futhi uhlole izingcingo zobumnini bamakhono; Lawula idayari nokulawula uhlelo ngaphansi kwesimo; Hlela, lungisa, qondanisa n lawula ukudluliswa kwamadokhumenti kumqashi; Yenza umsebenzi wokuthayipha ongcono khulu; Sebenzisa futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zokusebenza zihlezi ziyasebenza; Qinisekisa ukuthi abavakashi bamukeleka ngendlela okwakha isithombe ngalokho kungokozele kumkhakha wehhovisi. Yenza inkxaso yohlelo komunye umuntu (vasha, bhalise emakhaya, kanye nokulungiselela ukuphathwa kwezimali); Lungiselela ukusebenza, izindaba zomthetho, okuthunyelwe kubantu bomkhakha bengeni emhlathini, imvula, izinhlaka, uhlelo lokuthumela imali. Kufanele ukuthi wenze i-subroutine yokusetshenziswa kwamafayela, abeke imvula yezinkomba, aze ahle amafayela aseviki. Hlela imvula, izingxabano nezincwadi ze-memorandam, afake imibhalo. Qondanisa imisebenzi yohlelo lwakho nhlobo, ize uhlele amafayela; Zama ukuthi wenze imisebenzi yokuxhumana nabantu ngokuzimeleyo ngokusebenzisa inethiwekhi. Yenze imvula yamalungiselelo kubantu abangaphandle; Hlela izinkomba ezisuke kubantu abalulekile ngemvula, kuleyo ngalendlela aze uhlele izinkomba zamalungiselelo esikhundleni sakho esivela kummandla ngalolunye ukuze kwakheke amalungiselelo aqondene nendlela yakho. Hlelela imvula ehamba phambili enye isiqalo esihle, i-committee, nalawulo olulawulwa enye isikhathi; Hlela imvula nemisebenzi yokwamukela imithombo yezimali egunyaziwe; Lokha nini uma imisebenzi idlulisekela emoyeni, kumele uhlele imisebenzi kuleso sikhathi esilawulwa emkhakheni wakho ngemvula yesikhathi. Yenza imvula ngokuhlolwa kwaleso sikhathi esiku-valiwe, akufanele uthole imvula engazange imenyulwe ngaloluhlelo; Hlinzekela imvula yohlelo lwendlela, kanye namagama abhalwe ezindlwana ngenzuzo. Wazi okumayelana nemithetho ebulawa kummandla wakhe, awukhulumi ngalelo zinga, uyisebenzise ngenhloso yokwakha imisebenzi egunyazwe ngumthetho, kuleso sikhundla kumele wenze izinto ezifanele ukuba uvume imisebenzi yakho.

xh.title: Ummeli we-Director: Veterinary Services
xh.summary: Nika inkonzo yoxhaso lommemeli wabafundi kunye noxhaso lomamkeli kwi-Director: Veterinary Services eKimberley, kuquka ukulawula idayari kunye noqoqosho lwamaxwebhu.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate enayo ubuncinane iiminyaka eli-2 yamava yokusebenza njengommeli; Ulwazi ngenkqubo nendlela eziriswa kumphathi weofisi; kufuneka azi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Ms Word, power point, excel, Ms Outlook nokusetyenziswa kwenethiwekhi), Amandla okunxibelelwana (ngolwedidi nolubhaliweyo) nendlela yokunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu abakumazinga ahlukeneyo kwaye abavela kumvelaphi ehlukileyo; Amandla okusebenza ngocinezelo. UkuLawula okuJikelele koFisi, uphatho lwamaxwebhu noshicilelo. Ilungelelaniso lokusebenza ngesithuba emva kweyureyure xa kufuneka. Amandla okuqamba/ukubeka kuqaga imisebenzi kwaye uphathe ixesha ngendlela echanekileyo. Ulwazi lweenkqubo kunye neenkqubo zesebe. I-Driver's license esebenzayo iya kuba ngowona msebenzi uphawulwayo.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yoxhaso lommeli/omamkeli abafundi eMphathini oPhezulu; Amkele uhlu kwaye uhlole iingxoxo zefowuni zeMphathi oPhezulu; Phatha idayari yeMphathi oPhezulu kwaye uqokele iingqungquthela xa kuyimfuneko; Cwangcisa, lungisa, co-ordinate kwaye uphathe ukujikeleza kwamaxwebhu eofisini leMphathi oPhezulu; Zenze umsebenzi otyikityo oluphakamileyo; Sebenzise kwaye uqiniseke ukuba izixhobo zofisi, umzekelo ifeksi negalelo-mifanekiso zisebenza kakuhle; Qiniseka ukuba abakhwezeli bamkelwe ngendlela ephakamisisa umbono ochumileyo woFisi. Nikezisa ngexhaso loguquko-mthunywa kuMphathi oPhezulu nakunye/nakwicala (kuhamba-hamba, indawo yokuhlala kunye nokucubungula iindleko); Lungiselela iindibano, iindawo zokusebenza nemicimbo yoMphathi oPhezulu nakwabanye basebenzi baseBhungeni, phawula iindawo zedibano, mema abadlali begatya, lungiselela ukutya okubuyiselayo kwaye uqiniseke ukuba yonke imixholo efunekayo iyafumaneka; Lungiselela iajenda kwaye uqophe imizuzu yeedibano yomphathi neseBhungeni; Bhala iileta, iimemorandam kwaye uhlanganise iingxelo. Yenza ukuGcinwa kwamaxwebhu; Phatha iirejista zokushiya; Qokelela kwaye/uco-ordinate ulwazi kuMphathi oPhezulu, njengoko kufuneka, funda iiajenda namaxwebhu edibano ukuze uchaze imixholo efunekayo ekufuneka ibe khona kumphathi wedibano. Hlala uyazihlaziyla ngemigaqo/ iinkqubo nezithetho ezisebenza kwicala lakhe/ lomsebenzi wakhe ukuze kuqinisekiswe uxhaso olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo kumphathi.

af.requirements: 'n Graad 10-sertifikaat; met 'n kode 10-bestuurslisensie. Kandidaat moet fisies geskik wees en in staat wees om in uiterste werkstoestande te werk (hitte, koue, in die veld met beperkte of geen kommunikasie); moet goed in 'n span kan funksioneer en opdragte kan uitvoer.
af.duties: Verrig fisiese instandhouding van paaie, heinings, staproetes en reservaatvoertuie; Verrig fisiese instandhouding van Goegap Nature Reserve se gebou-infrastruktuur en besoekergeriewe; Verrig fisiese roetine-instandhouding aan Goegap Nature Reserve se operasionele toerusting en reservaatvoertuie; Verskaf fisiese bystand in die bestuur van die ekologie van die Goegap Nature Reserve; verrig alle administratiewe en verwante funksies.

zu.title: Umncedisi Jikelele
zu.summary: Kudingeka umncedisi jikelele e-Goegap Nature Reserve e-Northern Cape ukugcina izindlela, izibhobo, izindlela zoku-hamba, izakhiwo nezithuthi, kudingeka ibe ne-Grade 10 nesicelo sokushayela se-code 10.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 10; nesicelo sokushayela se-code 10. Umethuli kumele abe nomzimba ophilile futhi akwazi ukusebenza emigqeni yomsebenzi enzima (ushwalale, isikhova, enkundleni ngenhlobonhlobo encane noma ingenayo); kumele akwazi ukusebenza kahle eqenjini futhi alandel imiyalo.
zu.duties: Yenza ukugcinwa komzimba kwezindlela, izibhobo, izindlela zoku-hamba ngezithuthi zasendaweni; Yenza ukugcinwa komzimba kwezakhiwo kanye nezindawo zabakhamosi ze-Goegap Nature Reserve; Yenza ukugcinwa komzimba njalo ezisetshenzisweni zokusebenza kanye nezithuthi zasendaweni ze-Goegap Nature Reserve; Nikeza uncedo lomzimba ekuphathweni kwe-ecology ye-Goegap Nature Reserve; yenza yonke imisebenzi yophalalo neminye imisebenzi ehlobene nayo.

xh.title: Umncedi Jikelele
xh.summary: Kufuneka umncedi jikelele kwi-Goegap Nature Reserve e-Northern Cape ukugcina iindlela, iindlela zokwenzela, iindlela zohambo, izakhiwo neimoto, kwaye kufuneka abe ne-Grade 10 nelayisensi yokushayela ye-code 10.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 10; nelayisensi yokushayela ye-code 10. Umangqeshwa kufuneka abe nomzimba ofitile kwaye akwazi ukusebenza kwiimeko zokusebenza ezibuhlungu (ubushushu, qabaneo, kwinkundla ngenye inkqubo yothintathuxwano enguziro okanye ingekho); kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza kakuhle eqabini nakwaye akwazi ukuphumeza imiyalelo.
xh.duties: Yenza ulondolozo olusebenzayo lwezindlela, iindonga, iindlela zohambo nezimoto zesigcini; Yenza ulondolozo olusebenzayo loyilo-mhlaba lwezakhiwo neziseko zivakashi kwi-Goegap Nature Reserve; Yenza ulondolazo olusebenzayo ngokuqhubekayo kumsebenzi wokusebenza wesixhobo nokuthengisa kwi-Goegap Nature Reserve; Yenza uncedo olusebenzayo ekulawulweni kokusingqongileyo kwi-Goegap Nature Reserve; yenza yonke imisebenzi yabhalisiweyo namanye ahambelana nayo.

af.title: Hekwag
af.summary: 'n Hekwag word by Rolfontein Nature Reserve in die Northern Cape benodig om besoekers te ontvang, inkomste te hanteer en inligting oor die reservaat te verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 10-sertifikaat met 'n bewese ervaring in toerisme en/of sekuriteitsbestuur. 'n Geldige Code E-bestuurderslisensie. Die ampsdraer moet gewillig wees om 'n hersiene skedule te werk.
af.duties: Die kandidaat sal 'n ondersteunende rol tot die bestuur van die reservaat vervul deur: Ontvang en skakel met besoekers aan by die Rolfontein Nature Reserve; Verskaf openbare skakeling en gee inligting oor die reservaat; Ontvang en hanteer van inkomste by Rolfontein Nature Reserve; Insameling en beheer van inkomste by die ingangshek; Onderhou van Rolfontein Nature Reserve se gebou-infrastruktuur; Verskaf hulp aan die Rolfontein Nature Reserve se instandhoudingspan met die instandhouding van paaie, staproetes en reservaatstrukture; Verskaf handearbeid, instandhouding van reservaat-infrastruktuur; Verskaf hulp met rehabilitasie- en landskapsprogramme; Verrig alle administratiewe en verwante funksies; Woon vergaderings by; Woon opleidingskursusse by; Hou op hoogte van algemene arbeidsverwante kwessies; Voltooi en onderhou toeriste-inligtingsprofiele en relevante verslae.

zu.title: Umlobi wesango
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlobi wesango e-Rolfontein Nature Reserve e-Northern Cape ukwamukela amabhasi, ukuphatha imali engenayo, futhi ukunikeza ulwazi mayelana namasimu.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-grade 10 esinolwazi olubonakalayo oluthile kwezokuvakasha kanye/noma ukuphathwa kwezokuvikela. Ilayisensi yokushayela ekhona ebhalwe nge-Code E. Umuntu othathayo kumele azizwe ejabulile ukusebenza kohlelo olusha isihele.
zu.duties: Umuntu othathayo uzothatha izikhundla zokweseka iziphathi zemfuyo ngokuthi: Anukele futhi axhumane namabhasi ase-Rolfontein Nature Reserve; Axhume nomphakathi futhi athwale ulwazi ngemfuyo; Amukele futhi aphathe imali engenayo e-Rolfontein Nature Reserve; Aqoqe futhi alawule imali engenayo esangeni sokungena; Agcine izakhiwo zomgwaqo e-Rolfontein Nature Reserve; Asize iqembu eliphatha e-Rolfontein Nature Reserve ekugcineni kwezindlela, izindlela ezihamba ngawo nezinyawo kanye namagumbi; Anikeze ukusebenza ngezandla, ukugcina izakhiwo zemfuyo; Asize ngezinhlaka ezihlinzeka ngokulungiswa nokwakhiwa; Enze wonke umsebenzi wokubhalisa nokuhlobene nawo; Ahhabe izihlanga; Ahhabe izifundo zokuqeqeshwa; Azibe usekhona ngemibuzo ehlobene nomsebenzi; Abhale futhi agcine izinkomba zobulumnandi namakhasi ahlobene nawo.

xh.title: Umlosi weSangqa
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umlosi weSangqa kwiRolfontein Nature Reserve eNorthern Cape ukwamkela iindwendwe, ukuphatha imali engenayo, nokunika inkcazelo ngabaphethe.
xh.requirements: Isatifikeda samabakala 10 esenza ubungqina ngamava obungqina kwishishini lokhenketho kwaye okanye ulawulo lokhuseleko. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba ekhethwayo yeCode E. Umntu ofakelweyo kufuneka akhuseleke xa esebula kwijadule emlungiselelweyo.
xh.duties: Umphulothe wakunika inkxaso kurhologelo oluyinkosi kwisifundo ngokwale ndlela: Wamkela ukuhlangana neendwendwe ezikwindawo yokhenketho kwakubude bezilwanyana eRolfontein Nature Reserve; Wabonelela ngokuhlanganisa nomphakathi udlule ulwazi mayela nasesimeni; Wamkele aphathe imali engenayo eRolfontein Nature Reserve; Waqokelele ulawule imali engenayo kumnyango wokungena; Wagcine izakhiwo zolwakhiwo lweRolfontein Nature Reserve; Wanika inkxaso iqela elilawulayo lokulondoloza eRolfontein Nature Reserve ekulondolozweni kweendela, iindlela zokuhamula ukuhamba ngesinyi nolwakhiwo lwengingqi; Wabaniselelisa ngabasebenzi baseveni, ukulondoloza ulwakhiwo nendalo engingqi yengingqi; Wanika inkxaso nemigaqo yokubuyisa uluhlu nemigangatho yokwenza umthi opheleleyo; Wenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo nezinxulumene nayo; Wathatha inxaxheba kwindibano; Wathatha iindlela zokuqeqesha; Wagcina ukuya phambili nezithuba ngokubalulekileyo ngokuhamba kwexesha ekuhambeni komsebenzi wokuqhwesheya; Wapheda wagcina iinkcukacha ngolwazi lwamaphakathi nemiqulu ebakhuluwayo nobulumko

af.title: Algemene Assistent: Korporatiewe Dienste
af.summary: 'n Algemene assistent word benodig in Kimberley om skoonmaak, werfonderhoud, tuinwerk en basiese kantoorondersteuningtake vir korporatiewe dienste te verrig.
af.requirements: Graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie; Vorige ervaring in 'n soortgelyke rol sal 'n voordeel wees; Goeie fisieke gesondheid en vermoë om handmatige take te verrig; Basiese begrip van kantoorprosedures; Vermoë om instruksies te volg en selfstandig te werk; Goeie kommunikasie en spanwerkvaardighede.

zu.title: Usizi Olujwayelekile: Izinkonzo Zezinkampani
