jobs.title: Chief Director Districts and Institutional Support
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund, a medical fund, and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules.
jobs.summary: Chief Director for Districts and Institutional Support at the Department of Social Development in Mahikeng, offering R1,554,696 per annum at SMS Level 14.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. Bachelor’s Degree (NQF Level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Management / Public Administration / Social Science / Public Management/Project Management. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at a senior managerial level or equivalent to SMS level from other sectors. A valid driver’s license. Nyukela certificate is required for all SMS positions before appointment (Certificate for entry into the senior management service from the National School of Government). Knowledge: Service delivery innovation, Problem Solving and Analysis. Client Orientation and Customer Focus, Communication, Strategic Capacity and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management, Change Management, Programme and Project Management. In-depth knowledge and understanding of corporate services management in public service. PFMA. Public Service Act and Regulations, Policy Formulation, Project Management, Labour Relations Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership skills. Programme and project management skills. Strong financial management skills, change management, problem-solving and conflict management skills. People management and empowerment skills. Client orientation, customer focus and communication skills. Honesty and integrity, knowledge management, networking, presentation skills and computer skills. Excellent in-depth knowledge and insight into all applicable policy frameworks governing the public sector and the social development environment.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and management to the following programmes: District Coordination (district offices, service points, sub-offices) Institution Management (institutions and facilities). Manage and facilitate the implementation of Corporate Services. Manage and facilitate the implementation of Finance Administration and Management. Manage and facilitate the implementation of Social Welfare Services. Manage and facilitate the implementation of Specialist Social Services. Manage and facilitate the implementation of Development and Research. Liaise and account to Government oversight structures. Liaise with key departmental partners. Develop and maintain social contact with the service beneficiaries of the Department. Establish and maintain good intergovernmental relations.
jobs.enquiries: Ms MP Mhlongo- Kgaboesele Tel No: (018) 388 2043/1668
jobs.applications: E-Mail: SDRecruitmentPO@nwpg.gov.za

af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak of gelykstaande aan SMS-vlak vanuit ander sektore. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. af.title: Dienspuntbestuurder
af.summary: Bestuur dienspunte wat maatskaplikewerk- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsprogramme aan kwesbare groepe in die Noordwes-provinsie lewer.
af.requirements: A Graad 12-sertifikaat. Baccalaureusgraad in Maatskaplike Werk / Honneursgraad / Nagraadse Diploma (NQF 7/8) Sosiale Wetenskappe / Publieke Administrasie / Publieke Bestuur kwalifikasies soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 – 10 jaar relevante ervaring waarvan 3 op Juniorbestuursvlak moet wees. Registrasie by die SACCP-raad sal as 'n voordeel beskou word. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf Maatskaplike Werk en Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdienste binne die Dienspunte deur die bevordering van maatskaplike verandering, probleemoplossing in menslike verhoudinge en deur die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van tersaaklike programme in samewerking met belanghebbendes. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en beplanning van programme en ingryping om maatskaplikewerk- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdienste te lewer deur die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe benutting van finansiële hulpbronne. Beplan en verseker dat maatskaplikewerk- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing, situasie-ontleding en profilerings onderneem word om ingrypings in die gedefinieerde areas te bepaal. Verseker beheer oor die gehalte van die werk wat gelewer word. Monitor en evalueer dienste en beheer die gehalte van die werk wat deur alle personeel by die dienspunt gelewer word. Bestuur die verskaffing van korporatiewe en finansiële bestuursdienste in die dienspunt se strategiese plan, jaarlikse prestasieplan, operasionele plan en diensleweringsverbeteringsplan binne die staatsdiensraamwerk. Verseker prestasiebestuur, mense- bemagtiging en hulpbronbestuur. Verseker effektiewe bestuur van belanghebbende verhoudinge in vennootskap en samewerking met ander departemente & nie-regeringsinstellings.

zu.title: Umphathi Wesikhungo Sezinsiza
zu.summary: Phatha izikhungo sezinsiza ezinikeza izinhlelo zokusebenza komphakathi nentuthuko yomphakathi kumaqembu abuthathaka e-North West Province.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-Bachelor's degree Social Work / Honours Degree/Post Grad Diploma (NQF 7/8) Social Sciences/ Public Administration / Public Management qualifications njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Ubude obungeqile 5 – 10 iminyaka yohlelo oluhambisana lapho kuleminyaka engu-3 kumele kube ngemoMphathi oBancane. Ukuqokwa kwi-SACCP council kuzothathwa njengenzuzo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza Zokusebenza Komphakathi Nentuthuko Yomphakathi ngaphakathi Kwezikhungo Sezinsiza ngokukhuthaza inguquko yomphakathi, ukuxazulula izinkinga ezihlobene nezinhlonzi zomuntu kanye nokunakekela, ukusekela, ukuvikela nentuthuko yabantu ababuthathaka, amaqembu, izindlu kanye namaphakathi ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezihambisana ngokubambisana nabashwarenkeli. Yenza ube nomthelela entuthukweni nokuhlelwa kwezinhlelo nezinyathelo zokunikeza insiza yokusebenza komphakathi nentuthuko yomphakathi ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zezimali ngendlela esebenzayo, eshoga imali futhi ehamba kahle. Hlela uqiniseke ukuthi ucwaningo lokusebenza komphakathi nentuthuko yomphakathi, uhlolojwolezi zimo kanye nokuqamba izinhlaka kwenziwa ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo kumakhono achaziwe. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwegqondo lemisebenzi ethunyelwe. Qapha futhi uhlolisise izinsiza futhi ulawule igqondo lemisebenzi ethunyelwe bonke abasebenzi esikhungweni sezinsiza. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuphathwa kwenkampani nezimali ohlelweni lwamasu esikhungo sezinsiza, ohlelweni lokusebenza ngonyaka, ohlelweni lokuqhuba kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukisa ukunikezwa kwezinsiza ngaphakathi kohlelo lwesevisi yomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kokusebenza, ukunikeza amandla abantu kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwamagunya amahle nabashwarenkeli ngokubambisana nokusebenza ndawonye namanye eminyango & izikhungo ezingezona zahulumeni.

xh.title: UmLawuli weNdawo yeNkonzo
xh.summary: Lawula iindawo zenkonzo ezibonelela ngeenkqubo zobucala baseLuntu nokuPhuhlisa komphakathi kumacandelo asengozini eNorth West Province.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethda seGredi 12. IBachelor's degree Social Work / Honours Degree/Post Grad Diploma (NQF 7/8) Social Sciences/ Public Administration / Public Management qualifications njengoko kuqatshelwa yiSAQA. Okungenani 5 – 10 iminyaka yamava ezifaneleyo apho kufuneka ithathe iminyaka engama-3 kwiNqanaba leBala leCandelo eliPhakamileyo. UkuBhaliswa kwikhandili leSACCP kuya kongezwa njengentsusa. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekileyo.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zoBucala baseLuntu nokuPhuhlisa iKomkhulu kwiNdawo zoKwenza iinkonzo ngokukhuthaza utshintsho lwentlalo, ukusombulula iingxaki kumanxulumoabantu nakunokukhathaleka, ukuxhasa, ukukhuselwa nokuPhuhlisa abantu abasengozini, amaqela, usapho nakumaphakathi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifaneleyo ngokubambisana nabashareholders. Qhubele phambili uPhuhliso necwangciso lweenkqubo nokungenelela ukuze kubekho iinkonzo zobucala baseLuntu nokuPhuhlisa komphakathi ngokusetyenziswa okusebenzayo, okuchitha kancinane nokuQinisekileyo kwemithombo yemali. Cwangcisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kuqutywa uphononongo ngobucala baseLuntu nokuPhuhlisa komphakathi, uhlalutyo lwezimo negrafu yemimiselo ukuze kugqitywe ukungenelela kumaphakathi achaziweyo. Qinisekisa ulawulo lomgangatho womsebenzi onikiweyo. Qwalasela ukhathazo nokuQinisekisa ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi nokulawula umgangatho womsebenzi onikiweyo bonke abasebenzi kwindawo yenkonzo. Lawula ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo zolawulo lweikorporat nolawulo lwezimali kwicwangciso elinguwo wendlalo lendawo yenkonzo, icwangciso lokusebenza kwangonyaka, icwangciso lokuQhutywa kwemisebenzi nokuPhuculwa kwenkonzo ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sabasebenzi bakaRhuwa. Qinisekisa ukuLawulwa kokusebenza, ukunikwa amandla abantu nokuLawulwa kwemithobo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okusebenzayo kweNxulumano nabashareholders ngokubambisana nabeSebe ezinye neendawo ezingengovyo kaRhulumente.

af.summary: Maatskaplikewerkbestuurder Graad 1 word benodig by die Dr Ruth Segomotsi Mompati Distriskantoor om maatskaplike werkdiens en programme te bestuur en te fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Grade 12. Bachelor's Degree in Social Work (NQF Level 7). 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se erkende ervaring as Maatskaplike Werker. Registrasie by die SACSSP-raad. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördineringsvaardighede. Skakelvaardighede. Netwerk bou. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Leierskapvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Diplomatie. Veranderings- en kennisbestuur. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Mensebestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisering. Tydbestuur. Spanspeler. Strategiese beplanning. Beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling.
af.duties: Verseker dat Maatskaplike Werkdiens gelewer word deur die bevordering van maatskaplike verandering, probleemoplossing in menslike verhoudings en bemagtiging van mense om welsyn te verbeter. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en beplanning van programme en intervensies om Maatskaplike Werkdienste te lewer deur die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe gebruik van hulpbronne. Bestuur Maatskaplike Werkeenheid om te verseker dat doeltreffende en effektiewe maatskaplike werkdiens gelewer word deur benutting van hulpbronne (menslik, finansieel en toerusting) ooreenkomstig tersaaklike riglyne en wetgewing. Verskaf geïntegreerde maatskaplike werkdienste binne die gedefinieerde areas rakende sorg, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare groepe in vennootskap en samewerking met tersaaklike belanghebbendes Health, Correctional Services, South African Police Services en ander departemente. Evalueer en monitor nakoming van beleide, en dwarslonende maatskaplike werkdiensnorme en -standaarde, South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) en ander tersaaklike wetgewende beleide en prosedures. Hou tredy met nuwe ontwikkelings in die Maatskaplike Werk- en Bestuursvelde en deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling deur intersektore samewerking en belanghebbendebestuur en verseker dat die departement bydra tot geïntegreerde dienslewering. zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wabezomphakathi Ungqa 1
zu.summary: Ifuna ophethe umsebenzi wabezomphakathi ongqa 1 esikhungweni iDr Ruth Segomotsi Mompati District Office ukuze aphathe futhi aqhube umsebenzi wabezomphakathi nezinhlelo.
zu.requirements: Ithuluzi lesi 12. I-degree yeziqu kumsebenzi wabezomphakathi (NQF Level 7). Umcilio ofingqiwe kweminyaka engu-10 wokuhluhleka okubonakalayo kumsebenzi wabezomphakathi. Ukuqashwa nesaba leSACSSP. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyelwe. Ikhono: Ikhono lokuxhumana kahle. Ikhono lokubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokulingisa. Ikhono lohlonza. Ikhono lokuxhumana. Ukuxhuma. Ikhono lokuxhumana nabantu. Ikhono lokubusa. Ikhono lokuhlaziya. Ubudlelwano bobomdabu. Ukuphathwa kokushintsha nolwazi. Ikhono lokucubungula nokuqamba. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukucubungula nokuqamba. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi. Umdlali wesixuku. Ukucubungula ngokuhlosiwe. Ukuhlaziya nentuthuko yemigomo.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthi Isevisi Yomsebenzi Wabezomphakathi inikezwa ngokuthuthukisa Utshintsho Lwabezomphakathi, ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibudaladeni babantu kanye nokubusiseza abantu ukuze kube khona impilo enhle. Siza ekuthuthukisweni nasekucubungulweni kwezinhlelo nomsebenzi wokungenelela ukuze kunikezwe Isevisi Yomsebenzi Wabezomphakathi ngokusebenzisa ngokusebenza kahle, ngokugcina imali nangokusebenza kahle izinsiza. Phatha iyunithi Yomsebenzi Wabezomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsebenzi wabezomphakathi usebenza kahle futhi unikezwa ngokusebenzisa izinsiza (abantu, imali nezisetshenziswa) ngokuhambisana nemiyalo nokuqashwa komthetho ohambisana naleso. Nikeza umsebenzi wabezomphakathi ohlanganisiwe endaweni echaziwe mayelana nokunakekelwa, ukuvikelwa nentuthuko yamagumbi abalulekile ngokubambisana nabahlotshaniswa abahlobene Izezempilo, Isevisi Zolungisiso, Isevisi Zokupholisa ZaseNingizimu Afrika kanye namanye eminyango. Hlola futhi Qapha ukuthobela emigomweni, kanye nemigomo namazinga ohlelo lwemisebenzi wabezomphakathi ongaphandle kwezindikimba, Nesaba LaseNingizimu Afrika leZikhungo Zemisebenzi Yezinsizakalo Zabezomphakathi (SACSSP) kanye namanye amagumbi omthetho kanye nemigomo kanye namagumbu. Gcina ukuya emva kokutholakala okusha emkhakheni Womsebenzi Wabezomphakathi kanye noMphathi bese kuqhutshwa ukuthuthukiswa kobuhlule obuhlobene ngokubambisana phakathi kwemikhakha kanye nokuphathwa kwabahlotshaniswa futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umnyango ungenele ekunikweni izinsizakalo ezihlanganisiwe. zu.title: Deputy Director: Administration Support and Coordination
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaDeputy Director esikhungweni se-Provincial Office eMahikeng esiphatha imisebenzi yokuphathwa kanye nokuqukathanisa kwofelwa lenduna ephethe.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-Diploma (NQFL 6) noma i-Bachelor's Degree / i-Advanced Diploma (NQF L 7) njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA kwi-Public Administration / Public Management. 3 – 5 iminyaka yeminyuzulu yokuhlangabezana nayo, okuyiminyaka emi-3 kufanele ibe kuleveli ka-Assistant Director. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile. Ukuba nokuhlangabezana nokwenza inkonzo esimeni sofelwa lenduna ephethe kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukuthusa: Ulwazi: Ulwazi olubanzi kanye nokuqonda izindawo ezisebenza kazo eziswe ngunduna ephethe. Ukuthusa okubonakalayo ekuphathweni. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwezinqubo zezombusazwe kanye nezinkundla zokuxoxa eNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi lokuqondisa Izinqubo Zomnyango Wezempesheni. Iziqu: Ukubhala ngekhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Iziqu zokuhlaziya, Iziqu ezinhle zokuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuqashwa), Iziqu zokuqonda abanye, Iziqu zokuveza, Iziqu zokubhala imibiko, Iziqu zokuqondana nokuqeda izinkinga. Iziqu ezinhle zocwaningo nokuhlela. Isikhathi sokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ulwazi: Ukuphatha, Intuthuko yalethwa yinkonzo, Ukuxazulula nokuhlaziya izinkinga. Ukuqondiswa kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi, Ukuxhumana, Isikhathi neziqu eziyisiqu sokuhamba phambili, Ukuphatha abantu nokubakhulisa, Ukuphatha izimali, Ukuphatha inguquko, Ukuphatha amaphulo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi olujulile nokuqonda ukuphatha amasevisi ebhalansi kubonakala ngomsebenzi wezempesheni.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yokuphathwa kanye nokuqukathanisa ngaphakathi kwofelwa lenduna ephethe. Bumba, faka ezweni futhi zigcine izimiso, izinkomishi kanye namadatabheyisi ukuze kulawulwe futhi kuphathwe ukugeleza kwamafayela eya kwezinye izindawo, eza kwezinye izindawo futhi ehamba ngaphakathi kwofelwa lenduna ephethe. Qukathanisa ukuthenga kanye nokugcinwa kwemishini futhi uphathe iholo kwofelwa lenduna ephethe. Phatha irejista kwofelwa lenduna ephethe. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafayela aqokunqunywa ngokuvumelana nemiyalo ye-MIS futhi aphathwe ngokuvumelana nendlela aqokunqunyiwe ngayo. Xhumana nabaphathi abaphezulu ezikhungweni ezisezansi kwendlu yenduna ephethe. Qukathanisa imisebenzi yofelwa lenduna ephethe. Nikeza inkonzo yokusiza ibhodi yezigunyazwe kunduna ephethe.

xh.title: iSekela-Ngqonyela: Inkxaso ye-Administration noQwalaselo
xh.summary: Inkumbulo yesekela-ngqonyela kwiOfisi yephondo eMahikeng ephatha imisebenzi yenkxaso ye-administration noqwalaselo kwi-ofisi yegunya eliphezulu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe seGrade 12. I-Diploma (NQFL 6) okanye i-Bachelor's Degree / i-Advanced Diploma (NQF L 7) eqatshiwe yi-SAQA kwi-Public Administration / Public Management. 3 – 5 iminyaka yamava eqinisekisiweyo kwindawo, apho kuyo iminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibengowqanaba lomncedi weNgqonyela. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Amandla wokuba namava ekunikweni inkonzo kwindawo ye-Ofisi yegunya eliphezulu kuya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Ikhompethensi: Ulwazi: Ulwazi olubanzi nokuqonda iindawo zokusebenza ezikhuhlelwe yiplam yegunya eliphezulu. Ikhompethensi yolawulu eqinisekisiweyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza kwamanyathelo amapolitiki neyepalamente eMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi lokuLawulwa kweenkonzo zaBantu. Amakhono: Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint), ukuxazulula iingxaki, amakhono oqwalaselo, amakhono olunxibelelwano oluhle (olubhaliwayo noluthethwayo), Amakhono oNxibelelwano namabakho, amakhonookuBhentetha, amakhonookuBhala iingxelo, amakhono oQwalaselo lwengxaki. Amakhono alula wokuququzelela nokuhlela. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi: uLawulo, intshukumbiso yokuNika inkonzo, ukuxazulula iingxaki noQwalaselo. uQwalaselo lweKlayenti nogqalelo lokuSebenzela, uNxibelelwano, iNqanaba eliQingqiweyo noBuntu, uLawulo lwabantu, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo lweNkqubo neeProjekthi. Ulwazi olujulile noqwalaselo lolawulo lweenkonzo zenkampani kwiinkonzo zabantu.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha imisebenzi ye-administration noqwalaselo ngaphakathi kwi-ofisi yegunya eliphezulu. Ukuqamba, ukuqalisa nokugcina iinkqubo, izitili kunye namabhanki-datha ukuze kuqatywe kusolulwe ukusuka, ukuza nakwingaphakathi kwiofisi yegunya eliphezulu. Ukuqwalasela ukuthengwa nokugcinwa kwemixhobo nokulawula ibhajeti kwi-ofisi yegunya eliphezulu. Ukulawula irejistri yofisi yegunya eliphezulu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu ahlelwa ngokwemiqathango ye-MIS kwaye ahathwa ngokuhlelwa kwawo. Ukunxibelelana nabaqathi abaphezulu kwiindawo ezikhuyela kuyo iplam yegunya eliphezulu. Ukuqwalasela imisebenzi ye-ofisi yegunya eliphezulu. Ukunikela inkonzo yenkxaso khansele yegunya eliphezulu kwigunya eliphezulu.

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Gemeenskapsontwikkeling Graad 1
af.summary: Koördineer en implementeer geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsprogramme by Moretele en Maquassi Hills dienspunte in die North West Province.
af.requirements: ‘n Bachelorsgraad in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling/ Ontwikkelingsstudies of Sosiale Wetenskappe. ‘n Minimum van 8 jaar erkende ondervinding in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling na verkryging van die vereiste kwalifikasie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. ‘n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels. Begrip van gemeenskapsdinamika. Netwerkwerking en die vestiging van vennootskappe. Begrip van gemeenskapsontwikkelingsprogramme. Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing. Begrip van gemeenskapsontwikkelingswetgewing. Beplanning en organisering; Netwerkvaardighede; Kommunikasie (skriftelik en verbaal); Projektbestuur; Spanleierskap. Mensbestuur. Konflikbestuur. Projektbestuur. Finansiële Bestuur. Trediend bly met nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelingsvelde om dienslewering te verbeter. Kennis van beleide en wetgewende mandate rakende Gemeenskapsontwikkeling.
af.duties: Koördineer die identifisering, fasilitering en implementering van geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsintervensies/ programme in samewerking met ander tersaaklike belanghebbendes deur doeltreffende en ekonomiese benutting van hulpbronne. Doen navorsing oor gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk. Interpreteer, implementeer en gee leiding oor beleide, wetgewing verwant aan gemeenskapsontwikkeling. Bestuur betrekkinge met alle tersaaklike rolspelers, intern en extern. Monitering en evaluering van programme. Bestuur hulpbronne (menslik, finansiël, bates). Verseker die verskaffing van sterk vennootskapmobiliseringstelsels.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlanganyele Ekokuthuthukisweni Komphakathi Isigaba 1
zu.summary: Ukuhlanganisa nokuphetha imiklamo yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ohlangene kumaphoyinti okulekelela e-Moretele nase-Maquassi Hills esifundazweni i-North West Province.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree kokuthuthukiswa komphakathi/ izifundo zokuthuthukiswa noma i-Social Science. Ukwazi okungenani iminyaka eyi-8 yokuhlolwa kokusebenza kokuthuthukiswa komphakathi emva kokuthola izifundo ezidingekayo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Izikompethensi: Ulwazi ngokuziphatha kwabantu namasistimu omphakathi. Ukuqonda ukuphila komphakathi. Ukuxhumana nokwakhiwa kwezinhlangano. Ukuqonda imiklamo yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ucwaningo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuqonda umthetho mayelana nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuhlela nokuhlela kabusha; Amakhono okuxhumana; Unxibelelwano (olubhaliwe nolwenziwayo); Ukuphatha imiklamo; Ukubusa iqembu. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphatha izingxabano. Ukuphatha imiklamo. Ukuphatha izimali. Ukuhlala wedelela ngokuthuthukiswa okusha emkhakheni wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukuze kuphuculwe ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Ulwazi ngemikhuba nemithesho yomthetho ehlobene nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa ukuqashwa, ukukhuthaza, nokuphetha izinhlanga/zinhlela zokuthuthukiswa okuhlangene ngokubambisana namanye abahluleki abahlobene ngokusebenzisa okusebenzayo nangokwezimali izinsiza. Ukwenza ucwaningo oluhlobene nomsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuhumusha, ukuphetha futhi unikeze imiyalezongo emiklabeni nasemithethweni ehlobene nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuphatha izindaba nabadlali bonke abahlobene, bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuqapha nokuhlola imiklamo. Ukuphatha izinsiza (abantu, izimali, izimpahla). Ukuqinisekisa ukulethwa kamasistimu okuzwakalayo wokuxhumanisa izinhlangano.

xh.title: Umphathi ongeneleyo eNtshukumbuzo yoluntu inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Qambisa ndawonye kwaye ufakele phakathi iinkqubo zentshukumbuzo yoluntu ezahluweneyo kumajelo inkonzo ze Moretele naka Maquassi Hills e North West Province.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelor ku Community Development/ Developmental Studies okanye eSocial Science. A minimum of 8 years recognisable experience in Community Development after obtaining the required qualification. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenesi yokushayela evakalayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokuziphatha kwabantu ngeendlela zentlalo. Ukuqonda ukusebenza koluntu. Ukudibanisa amajelo nokuqamba ubudlelwane. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zoshukubo lwentlalo. Uphononongo lwe Community Development. Ukuqonda umthetho osemthethweni we community development. Ukuceba nokuqamba; Ikhono lokudibanisa amajelo; Unxibelelwano (elubhalwe phantsi nokuvela ngomlomo); Ukulawula iiprojekhthi; Ukukhokelela iqela. Ukulawula abantu. Ukulawula ingxabano. Ukulawula iiprojekhthi. Ukulawula iimali. Ukugcina isikhokelo nakuqhubeka ngezinto ezintsha kummandla we community development ukuphucula ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo. Ulwazi ngabomgca nengunyuleyo ngomthetho mayela noshukubo lwentlalo.
xh.duties: Qambisa ukuqaphela, ukulawula, nokuqhuba phakathi indlela zokuphucula ezahluweneyo / iinkqubo ngokudibana namanye amajelo abalulekileyo ngokusetyenziswa okusebenzayo noko kungakhathaliyo kwamathuba. Yenza uphononongo ngokusuka kulawulo osekwe kuluntu. Tolika, fakele phakathi, kwaye nikeza isikhokelo ngabomgca nomthetho osemthethweni ongqonganweni noshukubo lwentlalo. Lawula ubudlelwane bonke namajelo abalulekileyo abangenaphandle nangaphakathi. Ukulandela nokuqwalasela iinkqubo. Lawula amathuba (abantu, iimali, izinto ezikwolawulo). Qinisekisa ukunikwa nokuqhutywa kwamacebo okubaka ngokwamanyano ekutywineni intshukumbo.

'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in General Nursing. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksetiek.

Personeelaangeleenthede insluitend toesig en Prestasiebestuur, Finansies en Verkryging, asook die implementering van beleide, voorskrifte en protokolle rakende die genoemde aspekte. zu.title: Umphathi Wokusebenza Wezokwelapha Uhlulekile (UKUKELEKA OKUJWAYELEKILE)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wokusebenza wezokwelapha e-Sonop Old Age Home e-North West, esifuna uMhlengikazi Ochwepheshe oneminyaka engu-7 yohlaka nesiqinisekiso sokushayela esikhona.
zu.requirements: Izifundo eziyisisekelo (okungukuthi iDiploma/iDegree ekukelekeni). Ukuqashwa kwi-SANC njengoMhlengikazi Ochwepheshe. Umdlalo ophephile ungakaphephuli eminyakeni engu-7 edlule, noma ubuphephile kodwa angazange abe ngumphathi wesikhathi eside kakhulu. Isiqinisekiso sokushayela esikhona. Ikhono lokubhala imibiko, ukuhlela nokuhlela, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi, ukuxhumana okuhle nobudlelwano abantu, ukwazi ukusebenza kakhompyutha, ukusebenza njengelanga nokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Izimiso zokusebenza.
zu.duties: Phatha, lawula futhi ube ngumuntu ofana nemikhakha yezempilo, ukusekela, ukuvikeleka, ukucocwa, ukulawulwa kokutheleleka kanye nosebenzi lomhlaba. Izindaba zabasebenzi okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezisebenzi nokuphathwa Kokusebenza Kahle, Izimali nokuthenga, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo, imiyalo nemithetho ehlobene nemikhakha ekhushiwe. Hlela ukulekelela ukunika inkonzo yezempilo ebanzi ngokwesikhathi esifishane/esiphakathi/eside. Nikeza inkonzo yezokwelapha futhi uhlele inkonzo enentengo elinganisela nsuku zonke. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayatholakala ekulelweni ngokweZinhlelo Zabo Zokuzithuthukisa futhi Zokusebenza Kahle. Hlanganyela ekuthathweni kwesiqulumo emphakathini. Qoqa futhi qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwezibalo ezifaneni ngesikhathi futhi unikeze ukwesekwa okuhle okuphathwa ngokusondezelwa kini ofakela emsebenzini.

xh.title: Umphathi weSebe lokuQhatha ekusebenzeni (ikuQhatha iJikelele)
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi weSebe lokuQhatha ekusebenzeni eSonop Old Age Home eNorth West, sifuna uQhatha oGqithiswayo oneminyaka eli-7 yamava ngokusebenza akanelayisensi yokushayela evakalayo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo eziyimfuneko (oko kukuthi iDiploma/iDegree ekuqhatheni). Ukuqatshelwa neSANC njengoQhatha oGqithiswayo. Akufuneka abe namlaphi athi ngqo eli-7 amava afanelekileyo/avakalayo ekuqhatheni emva kokuqatshelwa neSANC njengoQhatha oGqithiswayo kukuQhatha iJikelele. Ilayisensi yokushayela evakalayo. Iimfuno zokusebenza: ukubhala iingxelo, amakhono ekuceba lula nokuhlela, ulawulo lwexesha, unxibelelwano olulungileyo namakhono okuhamba nabantu, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukusebenza njengqela nokusebenzisana. Iingcali zomsebenzi.
xh.duties: Lawula, lilise nokuziphatha kumacala onke ezeempilo, inkxaso, ukhuseleko, ukucoza, ulawulo lwentsifo nokunye konke ekuhambeni kwamasebe. Izindaba zabasebenzi kuquka ukulawula nokuLawulwa koMsebenzi, iimali nokuThenga, njengoko nokuSebenzisa iinkqubo, iimigaqo namacebiso malunga namacala abe ethuliweyo. Lawula ukuqeqesha ukwenza isebe lezeMpilo ngokubanzi ngokwesexeshana elifutshane/elingaphakathi/elide. Zenza iinkonzo ezeMpilo uze uhlele inkonzo engurable yemali yonke imihla. Qinisekisa ukuba onke abasebenzi bagqithela kuvimba wokuQeqeshwa ngokweCandelo loNyuso lomSebenzi kaqeqesha ngamnye. Thatha inxaxheba kuluntu. Qokelela uze uqinisekise ukugeniswa kwezibalo ezichanekileyo ngexesha elifanelekileyo uze unike inkxaso ezoqoqosho ezelolo kuMphathi weSiseko.

Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions as maatskaplike werker en bewys van betaling van jaarlikse fooie vir die huidige siklus. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike ervaring in maatskaplike werk na registrasie as maatskaplike werker by die SACSSP. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Om te verseker dat 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens ten opsigte van die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van die tersaaklike programme gelewer word. jobs.title: Assistant Director Internal Control and Compliance
jobs.summary: Oversee internal audit plans and compliance controls at the Department of Social Development's North West Provincial Office in Mahikeng.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12. National Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree (NQF 6/7) in Commence (Major with Auditing and Accounting) / Internal Auditing. Three 3-5 years’ relevant experience, of which 3 years must be at supervisory level. Valid driver’ licence. Knowledge: Knowledge of Risk Management, Internal Control strategies /frameworks/ policies. Knowledge of the SCM Framework and Financial systems. Knowledge and understanding of PFMA, PPPFA, Treasury Regulations, Modified Cash Standard (MCS) & Accounting Manual for Departments (AMD), Auditing and Financial reporting. Skills: Numerical skills, Problem solving skills, Planning and organising skills, Communication (verbal and written) skills, Computer literacy. Interpersonal Attributes: Ability to work in a team, Ability to work under pressure and to cope with a high workload.
jobs.duties: Supervise and participate in the development of strategic internal audit plans. Coordinate and maintain the efficient and effective controls and achieving the objectives of the department. Engage in continuous professional development activities relevant as required or prescribed by new developments in the internal audit environment. Attend to all audit queries in respect of the Financial Statements. Ensure that there is proper audit trail and working papers (Audit file) in respect of the Financial Statements. Assist in providing financial inputs into the Annual Report. Management of irregular, fruitless and wasteful expenditure. Conduct monitoring and capacity building on NPO funded projects Identify any discrepancies on the general ledger reconciliations and propose corrective actions. Manage staff and resources.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur Interne Kontrole en Nakoming
af.summary: Hou toesig oor interne ouditplanne en nakomingskontroles by die Department of Social Development se North West Provincial Office in Mahikeng.
af.requirements: Graad 12. Nasionale Diploma / Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 6/7) in Handel (Hoofvak met Ouditing en Rekeningkunde) / Interne Ouditing. Drie 3-5 jaar se relevante ervaring, waarvan 3 jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Kennis van Risikobestuur, Interne Kontrole-strategieë / raamwerke / beleide. Kennis van die SCM-raamwerk en Finansiële stelsels. Kennis en begrip van PFMA, PPPFA, Tesouriereëlings, Modified Cash Standard (MCS) & Accounting Manual for Departments (AMD), Ouditing en Finansiële verslagdoening. Vaardighede: Numeriese vaardighede, Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik) vaardighede, Rekenaarvaardigheid. Interpersoonlike eienskappe: Vermoë om in 'n span te werk, Vermoë om onder druk te werk en 'n hoë werklading te hanteer.
af.duties: Bestuur en neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van strategiese interne ouditplanne. Koördineer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kontroles en bereik die doelwitte van die departement. Neem deel aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite wat relevant is soos vereis of voorgeskryf deur nuwe ontwikkelinge in die interne ouditomgewing. Hanteer alle ouditnavrae ten opsigte van die Finansiële State. Verseker dat daar behoorlike ouditspoor en werkdokumente (Ouditlêer) ten opsigte van die Finansiële State is. Bied bystand deur finansiële insette in die Jaarverslag te verskaf. Bestuur van onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en vermorsende uitgawes. Voer monitering en kapasiteitsbou uit op NPO-gefondeerde projekte. Identifiseer enige afwykings op die algemene grootboekafstemming en stel korrektiewe maatreëls voor. Bestuur personeel en hulpbronne.

zu.title: Onozindlela Abasiza uKulawula Ngaphakathi nokuhambisana
zu.summary: Qapha izinhlelo zokuqapha ngaphakathi kanye nezilawuli zokuhambisana ehhovisi leNyundwe laseNyakatho Ntshonalanga le-Department of Social Development e-Mahikeng.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatimu e-Kilasi 12. Ikhambi leSizwe / I-degree ye-Bachelor (NQF 6/7) ku-Commence (Major with Auditing and Accounting) / Internal Auditing. Minyaka emithathu 3-5 yokuhlanganyela, lapho kunyaka abayi-3 kufanele kube kuleveli yokubuka. Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi lokuLawula ingozi, izindlela zokuLawula ngaphakathi /izinhlelo/ izinqubomgomo. Ulwazi ngesakhiwo se-SCM nezinhlelo zezezimali. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA, i-PPPFA, imithetho ye-Treasury, i-Modified Cash Standard (MCS) & i-Accounting Manual for Departments (AMD), ukuqapha kanye nokubika ngezezimali. Amakhono: Amakhono ezibalo, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlele, amakhono okuxoxa (ngomlomo nangokubhala), ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izakhiwo zobuntu: Ikono lokusebenza eqenjini, ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxalabo bese uzibekela ukubekezelela umthwalo omkhulu wemisebenzi.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo ezibalulekile zokuqapha ngaphakathi. Hlanganise futhi ulondoloze izilawuli ezisebenzayo futhi ezinhle kanye nokufeza izinhloso zomnyango. Thyitheka emsebenzini waqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwemithamo yobungcweti ohlobene njengoba kudingeka noma njengoba kumisiwe izinto ezintsha ezenzeka emkhakheni wokuqapha ngaphakathi. Phendula yonke imibuzo yokuqapha ngokuhlobene nezinkomba Zezimali. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona umkhondo wokuqapha ofanele namaphepha okusebenza (Ifayela lokulinganisa) ngokuhlobene nezinkomba Zezimali. Siza ekunikeni iminikelo yezimali Kumbiko Wonyaka. Uphatho kwento yokuchithwa okungalawuleki, okungenampumelelo nendlela yokuphunga imali. Yenza ukulandelela nokwakha amandla emiklomini eminikelwe imali ye-NPO. Hlonza noma yikuphi okungahambisani kumabhalance ejenerali bese uphakamisa izinyathelo zokulungisa. Phatha abasebenzi nezinsiza.

xh.title: Umphathi ongenelelo oNcedo kuLawulo langaphakathi nokuThobela imigaqo
xh.summary: Qonda iplani yokuhlolwa ngaphakathi namalawulo okuthobela imigaqo kwiNkundla yePhondo leNyakam eNdiwo yePhondo elithi North West eMahikeng kwisebe leZenzo loPhuhliso lwezeNtlalanthu.
xh.requirements: Igreyidi 12. I Diploma yesiZwe / I Degree yeBachelor (NQF 6/7) kwi Commerce (Eyesemfundo enkulu nge Auditing ne Accounting) / i Internal Auditing. Iimfuno zokuba namava afanelekileyo kwiminyaka engu-3 ukuya kwengu-5, apho iminyaka engu-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba labagcini bahloli. Ilayisenesi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngeLawulo loMngeni, iindlela zokuLawula ngaphakathi / iimigaqo / iimgaqo-mthetho. Ulwazi ngeMigaqo ye-SCM namasistim ezeMali. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA, i-PPPFA, iMigaqo yeTreasury, i-Modified Cash Standard (MCS) & iNqaku lezeMali kumasebe (AMD), iAuditing nokuxela ngemali. Ikhono: Ikhono lokubala, Ikhono lokuxazula iingxaki, Ikhono lokuceba nokuhlela, Ikhono lokuthetha nokuzaLibhala, Ilwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iimpawu zoBubeke bomntu bomntu: Ukukwazi ukusebenza eqileni, Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngxama nokunyamezela umsebenzi omninzi.
xh.duties: Qapha kwaye uthabaxande ekwakheni iiplani ezingundoqo zokuhlolwa kwangaphakathi. Lungiselela kwaye ugcine amalawulo asebenzayo nasebenza kakuhle ekufikelelweni kwemigwahlana yesebe. Thabatha inxaxheba kuqeqesho lwebungcali obuzinzileyo njengoko kufuneka okanye njengokuqatshulwa ziimvelo ezintsha ekuyholenweni kwangaphakathi. Joyina yonke imibuzo yokuhlolwa malunga neNkcazelo yezeMali. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho isikhokelo soqondo sokuhlolwa namaphepha okusebenza (Ifayile yokuHlolwa) malunga neNkcazelo yezeMali. Nceda ekunikeni iziqalelelo zezeMali kwesibingo seNyanga. Ulawulo lokuchithwa kwerhafu engalungeleyo nengenamsoco. Yenza ulwikeleko lokhuseleko lwamakhulu apho kukho iintengiso ezikhawulezayo nazo zonke. Zenza uqhathaniso olungalunganga nendlela ekubhalwa ngayo iincwadi ze-SCM kwizinto ezikhawulezayo ezingenwa izihlakaniphi ezazimbindi ngokubaluleka ekhoyo nezinye na kwiinkcukacha. Lunyuse isiphithiphithi ekujoliswe kuso ngokutsha kolwimi olufaneleyo lweNPO ekwabelwa amakhuli ayo namakhosi abancedisa bethu ngaphakathi kwexesha elifanelekileyo. Zama ukusetyenziswa kolwazi olubonakalayo nolubhaliweyo oluphumela kwakhona kwimiba yezoBomi bendalo ngokukhawuleza okukhawulezileyo ngokubanzi ngokwemibandela ekuhluziweyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Epmds
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for EPMDS at the North West Provincial Office, requiring a diploma or degree in HR Management with supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12. National Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree (NQF 6/7) in Human Resource Management / Human Resource Management and Industrial Psychology. A minimum of 3-5 years’ experience in human resource management, of which 3 years must be at supervisory level. A valid driver’s license. Computer literacy, presentation skills, planning and organising, and communication skills. Sound and in-depth knowledge of relevant prescripts as well as understanding of legislative framework governing the public service e.g. PFMA, Public Service Act and Regulations, and Labour Relations Act etc. Be able to interpret Policies, Knowledge of PERSAL system. Competencies: an understanding of administrative polices, including the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and PSA, Credible knowledge of Human Resource Practices and Administration, Human Resource Capacity building and Utilisation, Human Resource Planning, Employee Health and Wellness, as well as People Management and Labour Relations, Programme and Project management skills. Operational planning capabilities, facilitation, communication and leadership skills. Empowerment skills, service delivery improvement skills and report writing skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure implementation of Human Resource Management directives, policies, strategies, and plans. Coordinate implementation of employee Performance Management Development System, Training and Development. Facilitate submission of Performance Agreements, Work Plans, Mid-Year, Final Assessment and Probation. Monitor compliance of EPMDS, Support and advice training unit. Manage the of PMDS Policy. Supervise Staff.
jobs.enquiries: Ms P Mathe Tel No: (018) 388 5684
jobs.applications: E-mail: SDRecruitmentPO@nwpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae via e- mail or hand delivery. On the subject line of your e-mail, indicate the correct name of the post and the reference number include the department, also use the correct e-mail. All attachments for online submission must include the Z83 form and updated Curriculum Vitae only be in PDF Format, also as one document. Failure to do so, your application will be disqualified. NB: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service (SMS Pre Entry Certificate) is required prior to finalisation of an appointment into any SMS post. For      more      details     on     the     pre-entry    course     visit: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training -course/sms-pre-entry programme. Note: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. NB: All shortlisted candidates including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir EPMDS by die North West Provincial Office, wat 'n diploma of graad in HR-bestuur met toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12. Nasionale Diploma of Bachelors-graad (NQF 6/7) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en Bedryfsielkunde. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se ervaring in menslike hulpbronbestuur, waarvan 3 jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaargeletterdheid, aanbiedingsvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, en kommunikasievaardighede. Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van relevante voorskrifte asook begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare diens regeer, bv. PFMA, Public Service Act en Regulasies, en Labour Relations Act ens. Beleid kan interpreteer, kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel. Bevoegdhede: 'n begrip van administratiewe beleide, insluitend die PFMA, Treasury Regulations en PSA, Geloofwaardige kennis van Menslike Hulpbronpraktyke en Administrasie, Menslike Hulpbron-kapasiteitsbou en Benutting, Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning, Werknemer Gesondheid en Welstand, asook Mensebestuur en Arbeidsverhoudinge, Program- en Projekbestuursvaardighede. Operasionele beplanningsvermoëns, fasilitering, kommunikasie en leierskapsvaardighede. Bemagtigingsvaardighede, diensleweringverbeteringsvaardighede en verslagskryfvaardighede.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Information Management
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Information Management at a North West district office, overseeing data analysis, performance monitoring and reporting for the Department of Social Development.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Inligtingbestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Inligtingbestuur by 'n Noord-Wes distrikkantoor, wat data-analise, prestasiemonitoring en verslagdoening vir die Department of Social Development oorsien.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma / B.Tech / Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 6/7) in Inligtingbestuur / Inligtingwetenskap / Inligtingstegnologie met 'n statiese agtergrond. Kennis van en ervaring in die gebruik van statistiese sagtewarepakkette. Ten minste 3 - 5 jaar ervaring in 'n inligtingbestuursomgewing, waarvan 3 jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Bevoegdhede: Uitgebreide kennis van tersaaklike Openbare Diensbeleide en -wetgewing. Verslagskryf- en voorleggingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Excel, PowerPoint). Goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardigheds. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Die vermoë om onder druk te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer die distrik se Inligtingbestuurs Operasionele Plan. Monitor en evalueer distriksprestasie-inligting teen vasgestelde teikens. Vang data en inligting vanaf dienspunte en programme vas, ontleed en stel dit saam. Stel distrik kwartaal- en jaarverslae op. Koördineer en fasiliteer opleiding rakende inligtingbestuur. Bied ondersteuning aan die dienspunt- en instansiedatavasvangers. Voer kwartaallikse gehalte data-oudits in die openbare dienspunt uit. Verseker die glinsterende implementering van die Social Development Information Management System en NISIS, asook die Performance Information Management System. Bestuur die inligtingbestuurbegroting, asook menslike en ander hulpbronne.

zu.title: Onozane Oqondiswa: Ukulawula Ulwazi
zu.summary: Onozane weNkundla Yenkolo Yokusiza eNtshonalanga Kapa, oqapha ukutholwa kohlangothi, ukuhlola ukusebenza kanye nokubhala imibiko yeNkundla Yokusiza.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samazwe ngamazwe / i-B.Tech / iziqu ze-Bachelor's (NQF 6/7) eZulazulweni kolwazi / Esayensi Yolwazi / Iteknoloji yolwazi ngemuva kokuba nokuhlakanipha ngemibalo. Ukwazi nokuba namava ekusetshenzisweni kwamaphakheji wesoftware yezibalo. Okungenani uneminyaka engu-3 - 5 imva ekuqhubeni i-enyuzamondo yamaphakheji wesoftware. Amakhono: ulwazi olubanzi ngezinqumo zomphakathi kanye nemitapo yezincwadi eqondene nomsebenzi womphakathi. Amakhono okubhala imibiko kanye nokwenza izethulo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (i-Excel, i-PowerPoint). Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuthutha imiyalezo. Ukuzithoba ekungeneni izinsuku. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela.
zu.duties: Butha futhi ulondoloze iNdlela Yokusebenza Yokulawula Ulwazi yesifunda. Qaphisisa futhi uhlole ulwazi mayelana nenani lemisebenzi yesifunda ngokusha amaphuzu abekiwe. Qoqa, hlaziya futhi uhlanganise idatha nolwazi ezikhungweni zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo nakuhlehlweni. Khiqiza imibiko yenyanga yamakhasimende kanye neminyuzwe yesifunda. Hleze futhi unciphise ukuqeqeshwa okuhlobene nokulawula ulwazi. Nikeza usizo labo aboqoqa idatha ezikhungweni zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo nasezikhungweni. Yenza ukuhlola kwamakota kwekhwalithi yedatha esikhungweni sokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuyaqhubeka ngokululeleka ukusetshenziswa kwesistimu yokulawula ulwazi yaseNyanyweni lomphakathi kanye ne-NISIS, kanye nesistimu yokuphatha ulwazi lwemitapo yezincwadi. Lawula izimali zokulawula ulwazi, kanye nabantu nolunye uhlangothi lwemithombo.

xh.title: Umncedi weKhophu: Ulawulo lweNkcukacha
xh.summary: Umncedi weKhophu woLawulo lweNkcukacha kwiofisi yommandla eNorth West, elawula uhlalutyo lwedata, ulawulo lwenkqubo yokusebenza neemvumbozo zesebe loPhuhliso loLuntu.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma / i-B.Tech / i-Bachelor's degree (NQF 6/7) koLawulo lweNkcukacha / iNzululwazi yeNkcukacha / iNkundlwanolwazi ngeembathi zezibalo. Ulwazi lwe- Software packages nolwazi lokuthotho kwenzekiswa iinkqubo ze-software packages. Isipho sobungcali sithathwa kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo.  Iimfuno: Isiqondo esingangezantsi sokulawula idata nokwenza izigqibo ezikumgangatho ophezulu. Isiqondo sendlela zokusebenzisa iinkqubo zekhompyutha kwaye ukwazi ukuhlalutya idata ngokusemthethweni nangokusesikweni. Isiphithiphithi sokumela abantu kunye nokubakhokhela. Ukuchaneka kwesimo sangaphakathi nesimo sangaphandle kwakho. Isakhono sokubeka iingcinga zobomi ezandleni kwaye uzibuse ngendlela yakho yokuziphatha. Isidima sokubala iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuphuhamba isixokelelwano senkqubo yeNkcukacha. Isidima sokubala iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokulawula inkqubo yeNkcukacha.
xh.duties: Yakha uze usebenzise iNkqubo yoSebenzo yoLawulo lweNkcukacha yommandla. Lilinde uze ulinganise iNkcukacha yemisebenzi yommandla ngokumelana neenjongo ezibekiweyo. Thumba, hlalutya uze uhlanganise idata neenkcukacha ezivela kwiindawo zokuqokelela iinkcukacha kunye neenkqubo. Yenza iimvumbozo zexesha loNyaka zommandla kunye nezoNyaka zonke. Hlela uze ukhokelele isikolo esimalunga nolawulo lwenkcukacha. Zisa inkxaso kwindawo zokuqokelela iinkcukacha kunye nabantu abathumba idata kwishishini. Yenza ukuhlola ngokusesikweni ugqithiso lwedata kwisikhathi sonyaka kwinkonzo yangasese. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yoLawulo lweNkcukacha loPhuhliso loLuntu kunye ne-NISIS, kunye neNkqubo yoLawulo lweNkcukacha yoMsebenzi isebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Lawula ingqalaseli yomvuzo wolawulo lwenkcukacha, njengoko kukhona abantu nentsingiselo yentsingiselo.

Ukuzinikela kubantu, ukugxila kumthengi kwaye uthande ukuchuma kobulumko; ukubonakala, ukulunga, ulwazi lokubuka izinto. ukulawula ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukudlala ngobuchule, amandla okuqonda izinto ezintsha kwaye uzibandakanye nabanye.

Ukwenza izinkulumo-mhlangano ezingxoxweni mayelana nokuhlola imisebenzi ezingxoxweni, incazelo yomsebenzi, izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza. Ulwazi olubanzi nolufileyo lokuxoxa iinkqubo nezicwangciso ezilawula le ndawoikorhu, ukuxazula iingxabano, amakhono okudala, amakhono okuxoxa ngokuzimisela, ukusebenza njengesiqhaga.
xh.duties: Yenza inkqubo yoQwalaselo lweMisebenzi uze umbonise eNkundleni yeQinisekiso loMgangatho kwiQwalaselo lweMisebenzi naseBhungini loLawulo lwemigaqo. Yenza inkonzo nokuPhuhlisa iinkcazelo zeMisebenzi uze uqinisekise ukuzinikwa kolawulo. Thatha inxaxheba uze ucedise ekubakheni iSakhiwo seMimiselo. Ceda ekubakheni iNkqubo eZiqhwayiniyo zoKusebenza. zu.title: Isikhundla somphathi omkhulu wezokuphathwa: Izimo zokusebenza
zu.summary: Umphathi omkhulu wezokuphathwa uphatha izinqubomgomo ezimala nezimo zokusebenza, ukushiya kubesebenza kanye nezinzuzo zokusebenza eNdiweni leSifundazwe saKwaNyakatho Ntshonalanga.
zu.requirements: Ikhredi 12. Ikhithiqui noma Iziqephu (NQF 6/7) ekuPhathweni Kwebalo Labantu / ezenzululwazi zengqondo yezimboni / ekuPhathweni Kwezomphakathi. Isiphephelo seminyaka engu-2 kuya koku-3 kulowo mhlela, lapho unyaka oyedwa kumele abe ngengaphansi kokugada. Isiphephelo nesigqi sengaphakathi kwesistimu yePERSAL. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukwazi: Ukugada, intuthuko yokuhanjiswa kwezinsiza, ukuxazulula nobuhlakahlwembu izinkinga. PERSAL, ukuqondiswa kumthengi nokuqwalasela umthengi, ukuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokunikeza amandla, ukuphathwa kwinguqulo, ukuphathwa kohlangothi namaprojekthi. Ukuqondwa kokuphathwa kwezinkonzo zamabhangqa, Imigombelo kaBatho Pele. Amakhono: Amakhono okuphatha amahle namaprojekthi, ukuphathwa kwinguqulo, ukuxazulula izinkinga namakhono okulawula izinkinga. Amakhono okwethula, amakhono okuphatha abantu nokunikeza amandla. Ukuqondiswa kumthengi, ukuqwalasela umthengi namakhono okuxhumana. Ukuqina nokuba nokwesaba ukuqamba, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuxhumana, amakhono okwethula namakhono ekhompyutha. Ulwazi olujulile nokuqonda zonke izinhlobonhlobo zezinqubomgomo ezilawula indikimba yomphakathi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okudala, amakhono okuxoxisana, ukusebenza njengeqembu.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okunempilo kwezinqubomgomo namazwana okwenza ngendlela ahlobene nezimo zokusebenza nezinzuzo zokusebenza. Nikeza inkxaso ezimweni zokusebenza futhi ungapla isikolela ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nezinto ezintsha ngokuphathelene nezinzuzo zokusebenza nezinqubomgomo. Phatha ukushiya endaweni yokusebenza nokuphela kwezinkonzo. Uphathwa kwezindlela zokukhokha isikhathi esingenwe ngaphezulu kwezinsiza. Qinisekisa ukuhamba kweqiniso kusistimu yokuphatha izinhloli (PERSAL) kuphathwe kwiPILIR. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okunempilo kwe-COIDA. Lawula futhi uqinisekise ukukhokhelwa kwesikhathi samahhovisi nezinzuzo zokusebenza kubasebenzi abafanelwe. Uphathwa lwe-Pension Administration ukukhokhwa kwezimali nezindlela zokukhokha isikhathi esingenwe ngaphezulu kwezinsiza. Gaga izinkalo zabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi oPhakamileyo weNkululeko: iimeko zoKwenzakala koMsebenzi
xh.summary: Umsebenzisi oPhakamileyo weNkululeko ophatha iindlela zokusebenza ngezenzo zenkonzo ezimalunga neemeko zoKwenzakala koMsebenzi, iindlela zokusingatha iinkhuleko ngeemeko zoKwenzakala koMsebenzi ngezenzo zenkonzo eziphakamileyo kwiiNkonzo zaKwaZulu-Natal eNyakatho.
xh.requirements: Iza leminyaka eli-12. I Diploma okanye i Degree (NQF 6/7) kwiQhinga lokuLawula abasebenzi nokuqonda ngokwengqondo / ezoBuchwepheshe bokuZiva iingcali / uLawulo oluNtloko. Isiphaladhised pele esingamathakumba angu-2-3 kwiinkalo ngokugqithiswano apho kuthi phakathi koxaka umnyaka oya kubakho ngokulawula. Isiphaladhised pele ngolwazi oluthe chatha mayela nendlu yokuphatha iinkonzo ezikwakhona kwiPERSAL. Ilaysensi yokushweshwela kwaye idityaniswe nayo nayoyiyo olusebenzisekayo kwizinto ezinjengokulawula. Ulwazi: Ukulawula, iNkonzo ezokuqaliswa ngenxaxhe, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuHlola. I PERSAL, ukujolisa kumthengi nokuQwalasela iimfuno zakho, ukuThetha, ukuLawula abantu nokuBa namandla, ukuTshintsha indlela, ukuLawula iinkqubo nokuLawula amaphondo. Ukuqonda ukulawula iinkonzo ezikumgangatho kwinkonzo yaseburhulumenthe, iMigaqo yeBatho Pele. Iindlela ezikwisakhono: Izakhono zokulawula iinkqubo nokuqhuba amaphondo, ukutshintsha indlela, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuYila iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokusombulula iingxaki. Isakhono sokuZenela abantu, isakhono sokulawula abantu nokuBa namandla. Ukujolisa kumthengi, ukugqithela kwimfuno yamathenga nokuThetha. Ukuzithembisa ngokwenene, ukuLawula ulwazi, ukuXhumana, ukubonakalisa izakhono nokuSebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi oluthe chatha olubanzi nokuQonda iindlela zonke zokuQaliswa kwemigaqo ephatha kalawe iluntu mayela nobulungisa bemigaqo elawula uluntu, ukusombulula iingxabano, izakhono zokudala, isakhono sokucinga ngokubanzi, ukusebenza ngokutsha.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukusebenza kweemigaqo nezincwadada zeendlela ezahlukeneyo ngezenzo ezimalunga neimeko zoKwenzakala koMsebenzi nokuQwalasela iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezibonelela ngemisebenzi ekumgangatho oPhezulu wakwaNyakatho njengoko kubhaliwe kumagatya eNyakatho eNtshona weNtshona Koloni yaKwaZulu-Natal. Nikela ngencwadada ethi yakho ibe yindlela yokusebenza ngeemeko zoKwenzakala koMsebenzi ekunokuba yindawo ethile yokuba nikwe ngolwazi oluqulunqwe njengalomhla wamva nje ngezenzo zenkonzo ezahlukeneyo ngeemeko ezahlukeneyo nazo zonke iinkalo ezibalulekileyo. Lawula iinkhuleko zamava nakuRhoxiswa kokukwaziswa kwemisebenzi. UkuLawula ukusebenza ngokugqitha umda kaqha nokuBekwa ngakumbi ekubekeni umzisa. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kolwazi kwinkqubo yolwazi (PERSAL). UkuLawula i PILIR. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kweMigaqo ye COIDA. Lawula nokuqinisekisa ukuba kube kukhixelwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo kwemivuzo yamathanda neemeko ezahlukeneyo ezipha abasebenzi abafanelekileyo isixa esithile. UkuLawula iNkokelo, umvuzo nokuBekwa njengesixa esithile. Lawula imisebenzi yalabo ababelwe ngakunye.

af.title: Senior Provisioning Admin Officer: Logistics
af.summary: Senior Provisioning Admin Officer gesoek by die North West Provincial Office om aankooporders te magtig, verslae op te stel en toesig oor personeel te hou.
af.requirements: Graad 12. Diploma of Graad (NQF 6/7) in Logistic Management / Financial Management / Supply Chain Management. 'n Minimum van 2-3 jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld waarvan 1 jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Toesighoudend, diensleweringsinnovasie, probleemoplossing en analise, kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus, kommunikasie, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, veranderingbestuur, program- en projeksbestuur. zu.title: Senior Provisioning Admin Officer: I-Logistics
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Senior Provisioning Admin Officer e-North West Provincial Office ukugunyaza ama-oda okuthenga, ukuqamba imibiko nokuqapha abasebenzi.

Okungenani unyaka we-2-3 wemfundo yokuqasha enkundleni ehambisanayo lapho kulelo nyaka elilodwa kumele kube ngqondondlela. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Izifundo: Amandla okuphatha amaphrojekhi, ukulawula izinguquko, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqondanisa izinkimbinkimbi zabantu. Amandla okubonakalisa, ukuphatha abantu nokuqinisa abantu. Ulwazi olunzulu nokuqonda konke umthetho ohambisana nokuphathwa kwezinkonzo zikahulumeni, ukuxazulula izingxabano, amandla okudala, amandla okuxoxisana, ukusebenza njengomuntu wesiqhingi.

xh.summary: Kufuneka abe ngUmsebenzi Ophakamileyo Wolawulo Wokubonelela kwiNorth West Provincial Office ukugunyazisa iiodolo zokuThenga, ukuqokelela iingxelo nakuphathwa abasebenzi.

af.title: Hoofwerke-inspekteur: Infrastruktuur
af.summary: Inspekteer infrastruktuurprojekte en onderhoudswerk by die North West Provincial Office, wat 'n diploma in die geboude omgewing en twee tot drie jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. 'n Diploma / Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 6/7) soos deur SAQA erken in enige van die volgende geboude-omgewingsdissiplines (Argitektuur, Hoeveelheidsopmeting, Siviele / Strukturele Ingenieurswese of Elektriese / Meganiese Ingenieurswese). 2 – 3 jaar relevante ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Toesighoudend, dienslewering-innovasie, probleemoplossing en analise. Kliëntoriëntasie en klieënfokus, kommunikasie, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, veranderingbestuur, program- en projekbestuur. Rekordbestuur, kennis en begrip van korporatiewe dienste-bestuur in die openbare diens, Batho Pele-beginsels. Bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuursvaardighede, veranderingbestuur, probleemoplossings- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Voorleggingsvaardigheid, mensebestuurs- en bemagtigingsvaardighede. Kliëntoriëntasie, klieënfokus en kommunikasievaardighede. Eerlikheid en integriteit, kennistekuurstuur, netwerking, voorleggingsvaardighede en rekenaarvaardighede. Uitstekende diepgaande kennis en insig in alle toepaslike beleidsraamwerke wat die openbare sektor regeer, konflikoplossing, kreatiewe vaardighede, onderhandelingsvaardigheid, spanwerk.
af.duties: Identifiseer behoeftes en vereistes van nuwe werk en herstelwerk deur ondersoek van klagtes van kliënte en nuwe dienste. Lewer 'n inspeksiediens van werk gedoen aan nuwe projekte (sowel onderhouds- as kapitaalprojekte) en bestaande strukture. Stel relevante projekdokumentasie vir nuwe en bestaande strukture op. Bestuur die aktiwiteite van kontrakteurs op projekterreine. Versamel en dien inligting in in terme van die uitgebreide openbare werke-program, die Framework for Infrastructure Delivery and Procurement Management (FIDPM). Bestuur die departementele gehuurde kantoorakkommodasie-portefeulje en verseker dat gehuurde geboue aan OHS voldoen deur moniteringstelsels wat met verhuurders ooreengekom is. Hou toesig oor die prestasie en gedrag van ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Chief Works Inspector: Infrastructure
zu.summary: Hlola amaphulo e-infrastructure kanye nomsebenzi wokulungisa eNorth West Provincial Office, okudinga i-diploma kummandla wokwakha kanye neminyaka emibili kuya kwezintathu yohlolojwabe.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-Diploma / Bachelor's Degree (NQF 6/7) esemthethweni ngokwe-SAQA kunoma yisiphi isifundo esilandelayo semvelo yakhiwe (Architecture, Quantity Surveying, Civil / Structural Engineering noma Electrical / Mechanical Engineering). 2 – 3 iminyaka yohlolojwabe oluhambisana naleso sikundla. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Oluphathwa ngomphathi, bungozi ekuletheni izinsiza, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukugxila kumthengi nokuqaphela ikhasimende, Unxibelelwano, Ukuphatha abantu nokuklusula, Ukuphatha izinguquko, Ukuphatha amaphulo kanye namaphulo. Ukuphathwa kwemibhalo, ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo zocorpo kumnyango womphakathi, Izimiso zeBatho Pele. Amakhono: Amakhono okuphatha amaphulo kanye namaphulo, ukuphatha izinguquko, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono okuphatha inhlanganisela. Amakhono okwethula, amakhono okuphatha abantu nokuklusula. Ukugxila kumthengi, ukugxila ikhasimende kanye namakhono okuxhumana. Ukwethembeka kanye nokuba straight, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukuxhumanisa, amakhono okwethula kanye namakhono ekhompyutha. Ulwazi olujulile kakhulu kanye nokuqonda konke okuwumthetho wehlayo elawula umnyango womphakathi, ukuxazulula inhlanganisela, amakhono obuciko, amakhono okuxoxisana, ukusebenza njengeqembu.
zu.duties: Hlola izidingo nezimfuneko zomsebenzi omusha nokulungiswa ngokuphenya izikhalazo zabathengi kanye nosebenzi olusha. Nikeza insiza yokuhlolwa komsebenzi ozenziwe emapulo amasha (kokubili ukulungiswa kanye namaphulo ohmumo) kanye nezakhiwo ezikhona. Hlela imibhalo ehambisan nephulo yezakhiwo ezisha nakwezikhona. Phatha imisebenzi yabakhi-msebenzi emabhulokweni amaphulo. Qoqa futhi uhlele ulwazi ngokohlelo olwandisiwe lomsebenzi womphakathi, i-Framework for Infrastructure Delivery and Procurement Management (FIDPM). Phatha izikhungo zomnyango eziqashiwe zokusingathwa kwezohlwayo futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo eziqashiwe zihambisana ne-OHS ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokuqapha ezivunyelwe nabanini nezakhiwo. Qapha ukusebenza nokuziphatha kwabaphansi.

xh.title: Mohloli oyintloko woMsebenzi: iZakhiwo esingaPhakathi
xh.summary: Qwalasela amaprojekthi esakhiwo esingaphakathi kunye nomsebenzi wokugcina e-North West Provincial Office, kufuneka idiploma yendalo e Yakhiweyo kunye neminyaka emibanda kuthotho yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGarde 12. I-Diploma / Isidanga se-Bachelor (NQF 6/7) esamkelwa yi-SAQA kulo naliphi na kwezi ndlela zesakhiwo esingaphakathi (i-Architecture, i-Quantity Surveying, uCivo / i-Structural Engineering okanye i-Electrical / i-Mechanical Engineering). 2 – 3 iminyaka yamava ahambelanayo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. ULwazi: oLawulo, ukuPhefumlelwa kwiNkonzo eNikwayo, ukuSombulula iNgingxaki noQwalaselo. uQwalaselo kwiKlayenti nokuQwalasela uMthengi, ukuThetha-thetha, uLawulo abaBantu noMandiso, uLawulo loTshintsho, uLawulo loQhagamishelo namaProjekthi. uLawulo lweerekhodi, ulwazi nokuqonda uLawulo lweenkonzo zeshishini kinkonzo kaRhulumente, iimPelo ze-Batho Pele. Ikhono: Iakhono eNikwa ziQhagamishelo namaProjekthi, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, iakhono zoSombululo lweengxaki noLawulo loMngeni wokulwa. IKhono loKubonisa, iakhono zoLawulo abaBantu noMandiso wabo. uQwalaselo kwiKlayenti, uQalekiso koMthengi nakhono zokuThetha-thetha. uQinisekiso nokuZinika, ulwazi ngokuLawula, ukwenza ulungelelwano, iakhono zokuBonisa kunye nakhono zekhompyutha. ULwazi olubanzi olunzulu nokuQonda iinKqubo zonke zeenGingqi ezeLuncedo ngokuLawulwa kwesektorhutashi, ukulungiswa kwemiba, iakhono zokuDala, iakhono zokuRhoxisa isivumelwano, ukusebenza ngokweliQela.
xh.duties: Chonga iimfuno neemfuno zemisebenzi emitsha nokuqwalasela ngokuphenya iingxaki zabathengi kunye neenkonzo ezintsha. Yenza inkonzo yokuqwalasela komsebenzi ozenziweyo kumaprojekthi amasha (koko kukunonophela imisebenzi egcina kunye namaprojekthi eengeniso) nakwezakhiwo ezikhoyo. Qamba ixatyiweyo yeprojekthi efanelekileyo yezakhiwo ezintsha nakwezikhoyo. Lawula imisebenzi yabaqeshi kumawebhu amaprojekthi. Qokelela uthume ulwazi ngokwesixeko senkqubo yentlalo yokusebenza ekwandisiweyo, iSakhiwo sokuNika iNkonzo yeZeMiziNelwa kunye noLawulo (FIDPM). Lawula iziko lomsebenzi wesebe lezindlu ezinqqiweyo zofiso, uze uqiniseke ukuba izakhiwo ezinqqiweyo zihambelana ne-OHS ngokweenkqubo zokuqaphela ezivunyelwe nabanini izakhiwo. Qapha ukusebenza nendlela abasebenza abanzekileyo.

af.title: Senior Admin Offisier: Vervoer
af.summary: Bestuur die regeringsvloot by die North West Provincial Office, met toezig oor voertuigverslae, bate-nakoming en roetine-inspeksies.
af.requirements: Driejarige graad of Nasionale Diploma in Vervoerekonomie, Logistieke Bestuur of Openbare Administrasie. 3 – 5 jaar se relevante ervaring in Regeringsvlootbestuur binne die Openbare Diens waarvan 1 jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie kennis van Vervoerwetgewing, Beleid en prosedures. Rekenaargeletterdheid. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Gevorderde bestuursvaardighede sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis: Toesig, diensleweringinnoviasie, probleemoplossing en analise. Kliëntoriëntasie en klantefokus, kommunikasie, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, veranderingbestuur, program- en projekbestuur. Rekordbestuur, kennis en begrip van korporatiewe dienstebestuur in die openbare diens, Batho Pele-beginsels. Bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuursvaardighede, veranderingbestuur, probleemoplossing- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardigheid, mensebestuurs- en bemagtigingsvaardighede. Kliëntoriëntasie, klantefokus en kommunikasievaardighede. Eerlikheid en integriteit, kennisbestuur, netwerk, aanbiedingsvaardighede en rekenaarvaardighede. Uitstekende diepgaande kennis en insig in alle toepaslike beleidsraamwerke wat die openbare sektor beheer, konflikoplossing, kreatiewe vaardighede, onderhandelingsvaardigheid, spanwerk.
af.duties: Bestuur van die regeringsvloot in ooreenstemming met beleidsbepalings. Analiseer en verseker tydige indiening van maandelikse VMS-verslae. Verskaffing van verslae (ongelukke, hernuwing van skywe, verliese, diens). Implementering van batebestuursprosedures en verseker nakoming. Voer roetine-inspeksies uit om nakoming te verseker. Verseker nakoming van vervoerbeleid, prosedures, voorskrifte en toepaslike wetgewing. Implementeer beheermaatreëls om onreëlmatige, nuttelose en vermorsende uitgawes te identifiseer en te voorkom. Bestuur van personeel.

zu.title: Officer Abaphezulu: Transport
zu.summary: UkuLawula ihhwayi likahulumeni e-North West Provincial Office, ngokuBuka izibalo zezimoto, ukulandelwa kwezinkomba, nokuHlola njalo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zezinga leminyaka emithathu noma i-Diploma Yezwe kwezEzomnotho zokuThutha, ukuLawulwa kwezinto noma ukuLawulwa kwezomphakathi. Iminyaka engu-3 – 5 yohlaka lwemisebenzi ehlobene ekuLawulweni kwehhwayi likahulumeni ngaphakathi koMphakathi lapho unyaka owodwa kufanele abe kwinga lokubhekisisa. Ukuxhumana kahle kanye nokuhlobana nabantu. Ukuqonda okuhle kwezinqumomthetho zokuThutha, izinqubo, kanye namasiko. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela elifanele. I-Advanced driving izoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi: Ukubhekisisa, intuthuko yaletho yesevisi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuHlaziya. Ukujwayela iklayenti nokuQwalasela iklayenti, ukuxhumana, ukuLawula abantu noMvuselelo, ukuLawulwa koshintsho, ukuLawulwa kohlaka nohlaka lwamaphrojekthi. UkuLawulwa kwezinkomba, ulwazi nokuqonda ukuLawulwa kwezinkonzo ekuMnyangeni koMphakathi, izimiso zeBatho Pele. Ikhono: Ikhono lekuLawulwa kohlaka nohlaka lwamaphrojekthi, ukuLawulwa koshintsho, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuLawulwa kwezinxaxheki. Ikhono lokuYethula, ukuLawula abantu nomvuselelo. Ukujwayela iklayenti, ukuqwalasela iklayenti kanye nekhono lokuxhumana. Ukwethembeka nokuqotho, ukuLawulwa kolwazi, ukuxhumanisa, ikhono lokuYethula kanye nekhono lekhompuyutha. Ukuqonda okujulile kakhulu nokuBona ngaphakathi kuzo zonke izakhiwo zohlelo lomthetho ezibuso isebe likahulumene, ukuxazulula izinxaxheki, amakhono okudala, ikhono lokucinga, ukusebenza njengeqembu.
zu.duties: Ukulawula ihhwayi likahulumeni ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso zwenza umthetho. Ukuhlaziya futhi uqinisekise ukuthunyelwa ngesikhathi kwezibalo ze-VMS zanyanga zonke. Ukunikeza izibalo (ezemishenguza, ukubuyiselwa kwamadijayiski, izintela, izonke). Ukuphatha izindlela zokuqinisekiswa kwempahla bese kuqinisekiswa ukulandelwa kwazo. Ukwenza okuhlwayo njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandelwa kwemithetho. Ukuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezinqumomthetho zokuThutha, izinqubo, imilayo kanye nomthetho ophathekayo. Ukufaka izindlela zokuLawula ukuze kutholwe bese kuvinjelwa ukuchithwa okungalungile, okungalubali, noma ukuchithwa okuyize. Ukulawula abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Chief Network Controller

af.title: Hoofnetwerkbeheerder
af.summary: Hoofnetwerkbeheerder benodig by die North West Provincial Office vir die bestuur van IK-netwerke, wolkinfrastruktuur en gebruikerondersteuning, met 'n salaris van R413,001 per jaar.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Nasionale diploma/bachelorsgraad (NQF 6/7) in Inligtingstegnologie/Inligtingstegnologie-bestuur/Rekenaaringenieurswese/Rekenaarwetenskap soos deur SAQA erken, met 2-3 jaar se ervaring in die veld. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Kennis van regeringsbeleid en voorskrifte, openbare diens se regulatoriese raamwerk. Kennis van IT-diensbestuur (ITSM) en prestasiemonitoringnutsmiddels. Kennis van Microsoft Azure-wolkdienste, netwerkwerking en sekuriteit. Bediener- en netwerkadministrasie (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP). (Bevoegdhede) Diensleweringsinnovasie. Probleemoplossing en analise. Kliëntoriëntasie en klijëntfokus, kommunikasievaardighede, spanwerk. Kennis en begrip van korporatiewe diensbestuur in die openbare diens, Batho Pele-beginsels. Eerlikheid en integriteit, kennishantering, rekenaarnetwerke en netwerkinfrastruktuurondersteuning. Prosedures en prosesse vir rekenaaropstelling, konfigurasies en opgradering. Hardeware- en sagteware-randtoerusting.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die installasie en onderhoud van alle IK-kommunikasiestelsels, netwerke en wolkinfrastruktuur. Konfigureer netwerktoestelle. LAN- en WAN-ondersteuning. Monitor die werkskermondersteuning en opleidings. Monitor netwerkprestasie. (Installeer en toets Microsoft-pakkette). (Voer gebruikeradministrasie in departementele stelsels uit). Onderhou bedryfstyd van LAN- en WAN-skakels. Fasiliteer en onderhou IK-infrastruktuur, implementeer IK-sekuriteitsbeleid en IK-kontinuïteitsplanne. Stoor en rugsteun alle departementele data. Onderhou die beskikbaarheid van gebruikerdata. Konfigureer IK volgens standaarde. (Onderhou IK-diens- en bateregister). (Onderhou IT-sekuriteit en kuberveiligheidsinfrastruktuur. Implementeer IT-sekuriteitsbeleid rakende die veilige bewaring en berging van data). (Voer IT-sekuriteits hersienings en IT-risikobevalings uit). (Fasiliteer en onderhou IK-dienste en IK-bates) Onderhou IK-dienshandves. Onderhou gebruikergettoegte en gebruikergettoegte-hersienings. Bestuur die toegekende hulpbronne van die subdirektoraat. Fasiliteer afrigting, mentorskap, opleiding en ontwikkeling van werknemers.

zu.title: UMlawuli Omkhulu Wenethiwekhi
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMlawuli Omkhulu Wenethiwekhi eNorth West Provincial Office ukuphatha amanethiwekhi e-ICT, insimbi yefu kanye nokusekelwa komsebenzisi, ngeholo le-R413,001 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-National Diploma/ibhalori (NQF 6/7) ku-Information Technology/Information Technology Management/Computer Engineering/Computer Science njengoba kunconywa i-SAQA neminyaka yama-2-3 yokuhlolwa kule minyaka. Ilayisensi yokuqamba ehambi nayo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye nokuhlelelwa kahulumeni, uhlelo lwemithetho yasezikhungweni zikahulumene. Ulwazi ngokuqashwa kwemisebenzi ye-IT (ITSM) namathuluzi okuhlola ukusebenza. Ulwazi ngamasevisi e-Microsoft Azure efu, amanethiwekhi, kanye nokuvikelwa. Ukuphatha isikhulu kanye nenethiwekhi (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP). (Izindingo) ukuthuthukiswa kwezinto ezintsha zokuletha inkonzo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlola. Ukubhekisela kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi, amakhono okuxoxa, Ukusebenza njengomndeni. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo zenhlangano kubahulumene baqomile, Imigomo ye-Batho Pele. Ukwethembeka nokubaqotho, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukusekela insimbi yenethiwekhi yekhompyutha. Izinqubo zokuhlela amakhompyutha, ukuhlela futhi wenze ngcono. Iphiphali yehadiwe kanye nesoftware.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukufakwa nokugcinwa kwakho konke ukuxhumana kwamasistimu e-ICT, amanethiwekhi nensimbi yefu. Hlela amadivayisi wenethiwekhi. Ukusekela i-LAN ne-WAN. Qapha ukusekelwa kwezinqamuleli zedeskithophu kanye nokolunye. Qapha ukusebenza kwenethiwekhi. (Faka futhi uhlôle amaphakheji e-Microsoft). (Yenza imini ngemini abasebenzisi kumasistimu omnyango). Gcina isikhathi sokusebenza kesixhumanisi se-LAN ne-WAN. Qondisa futhi ugcine insimbi yefu ye-ICT, phakamisa izinqubomgomo zokuvikela i-ICT kanye namaphulani okuqhubeka i-ICT. Gcina futhi thwebula zonke idatha lomnyango. Gcina ukutholakala kwedatha yomsebenzisi. Hlela i-ICT ngokwezindinganiso. (Gcina isikhundla senkonzo nezarejista wezimpahla ze-ICT). (Gcina ukuvikelwa kwe-IT nensimbi yefu yokuvikela i-cybersecurity. Phakamisa izinqubomgomo zokuvikelwa kwe-IT ekugodweni nokugcineni idatha). (Yenza izibuko zokuvikela i-IT kanye nokuhlola ingozi ye-IT). (Qondisa futhi ugcise izinkonzo ze-ICT kanye nezimpahla ze-ICT) Gcina ishoda senkonzo ye-ICT. Gcina amalungelo okufinyelela komsebenzisi kanye nokubuka kwabasebenzisi. Phatha izinsiza ezabelwe phansi kwesikhundla. Qondisa ukwengamelela, ukwelulekwa, ukuqeqesha nokuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: UmLawuli Oyintloko weNethiwekhi
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMlawuli Oyintloko weNethiwekhi kwiNorth West Provincial Office ukuze aphathe iinethiwekhi ze-ICT, isakheko seklawu nenkxaso yabasebenzisi, anemvuzo we R413,001 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12. I-National Diploma/izidanga zobugcisa (NQF 6/7) kwi-Information Technology/Information Technology Management/Computer Engineering/Computer Science njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA enomava peminyaka ye-2-3 kule ndawo. Ilayisenesi yokuqeshisa eyasebenzayo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngeengqiqo zorhulumente nemigaqo, yophuhliso lolawulo lwesebe loluntu. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweenkonzo ze-IT (ITSM) nezixhobo zokuqwalasela inkqubo. Ulwazi ngeenkonzo ze-Microsoft Azure cloud, iinethiwekhi, nokhuseleko. Ukuqeshisa kwenethiwekhi neseva (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP). (Iakhompetensi) Intsingiselo yokudala iindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ukuxazula iingxaki noqwalaselo. Ukumisela kumxhasi nogqaliselo kumthengi, amakhono onxibelelwano, Umsebenzi wochwepheshe. Ulwazi kuqondeko yolawulo lweenkonzo zabakhozi kundlu zorhulumente, iimpawu zeBatho Pele. Inyaniso nentlalontle, ulawulo lolwazi, inkxaso yesakheko yekhompyutha yeenethiwekhi. Iinkqubo neenjongo zokuqwalasela ukwakhiwa, uqwalaselo nokuqhakamshwa kweekhompyutha. Izixhobo zekhompyutha nesoftware.
xh.duties: Qhuba ukuhoywa nokugcinwa kweenkqubo zolonxibelelwano lwe-ICT, iinethiwekhi nethowuzi yezixhobo zeklawu. Misela inkqubo yamacebo ethu yeenethiwekhi. Inkxazo ye-LAN ne-WAN. Qwalasela inkxaso desktop nokuqeqeshwa. Qwalasela inkqubo yeenethiwekhi. (Seka uze uvavanye iinkqubo zeMicrosoft). (Yenza ulawulo lo msebenzisi kwizixhobo zesebe). Gcina uxolo/ukuphila kolwathi lwe-LAN nothe LUthe LUthe luqhawule. Zama ugcine izixhobo zeklawa ye-ICT, njengokumisela iingqiqo zokhuseleko lwe-ICT nezicwangciso zokuqhubekayo ze-ICT. Gcina konke okubhalwe kwaye ulondoloze i-data yonke yeSapho. Yenza olwandisiweyo ukubakho kolwazi-mvuzo wabasebenzisi. Misela inkqubo ye-ICT ngokwemigangatho. (Phatha ulondolizo lwexabiso leenkxaso nempahla ye-ICT). (Yenza ulondolizo lokhuseleko lwe-ICT kwiindawo ezikhuselayo. Misela inkqubo yokuziphendula kubukhosi be-ICT). (Yenza isicwangciso sokhuseleko lwe-IT). (Qhuba ulondolizo lweenkxazo ze-ICT nempahla ye-ICT) Gcina isatifikethi semfanelo ye-ICT. Londa ukungenela kolwazi-mvuzo kubasebenzi.
