af.title: Maatskaplike Werker Graad 1
af.summary: Maatskaplike Werker Graad 1-posisies by verskeie North West-sentra wat maatskaplike werksdienste aan kwesbare en riskante individue bied, waarvoor 'n Maatskaplike Werk-graad en SACSSP-registrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12. 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Maatskaplike Werk wat professionele registrasie by die South African Council for Social Services Profession (SACSSP) as 'n Maatskaplike Werker moontlik maak. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Die volgende kennis en vaardighede word vir aanstelling vereis: Begrip van maatskaplike dinamika, menslike gedrag en maatskaplike stelsels. Maatskaplike ingryping en bemagtiging. Maatskaplike ondersteuning. Beskerming van kwesbare individue. Begrip van Maatskaplike Werk-wetgewing. Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings). Spanwerk en samewerking. Beplanning en organisering. Diversiteitsbestuur. Begrip van maatskaplike werkwaardes en -beginsels. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van menslike gedrag en maatskaplike stelsels. Begrip van gemeenskapsdinamika. Netwerkbou en die vestiging van vennootskappe. Begrip van gemeenskapsontwikkelingsprogramme. Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing. Begrip van gemeenskapsontwikkelingswetgewing. Beplanning en organisering; Netwerkvaardighede; Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings); Projektbestuur; Spanleierskap. Mensebestuur. Konflikbestuur. Projektbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Tred hou met nuwe ontwikkelinge in die veld van gemeenskapsontwikkeling om dienslewering te verbeter. Kennis van beleide en wetgewende mandate wat verband hou met Gemeenskapsontwikkeling.
af.duties: Lewer maatskaplike werksdienste deur die bevordering van maatskaplike verandering, probleemoplossing in menslike verhoudings en die bemagtiging en bevryding van mense om maatskaplike welsyn te verbeter. Om maatskaplike werksdienste te lewer ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, blootgestel aan risiko is en nie in staat is om hulself te beskerm nie. Voer assesserings uit om toestande in individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe te identifiseer wat relevante ingrypings regverdig. Identifiseer en doen aanbevelings oor die toepaslike ingrypings wat vereis word om die geïdentifiseerde toestande aan te spreek. Implementeer die aanbevole ingrypings deur deurlopende ondersteuning, berading, leiding en advies aan die geaffekteerde individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe te bied. Monitor en evalueer die doeltreffendheid van die aanbevole ingrypings, doen verslag oor vordering en identifiseer verdere gewysigde ingrypings om die geïdentifiseerde toestande aan te spreek.

zu.title: Social Worker Grade 1
zu.summary: Izikhundla ze-Social Worker Grade 1 kumakhaya amaningi eNorth West anikeza amasevisi omsebenzi wokuqasha kubantu abasengozini futhi abadinga usizo, edinga i-degree ye-Social Work kanye nokubhalisa ku-SACSSP.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. I-Bachelor of Social Work evumela ukubhalisa njengomsebenzisi wezomphakathi ku-South African Council for Social Services Profession (SACSSP). Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Kudingeka ubekho nolwazi namakhono alandelayo ukuze uthole le sikhundla: Ukuqonda ukuphila komphakathi, indlela abantu abaphila ngayo kanye namasistimu omphakathi. Ukungenelela kwemisebenzi yomphakathi kanye nokuqinisekisa amandla abantu. Ukusiza ngomphakathi. Ukuvikela abantu abasengozini. Ukuqonda umthetho mayelana nomsebenzi wokuqasha. Ukuthintana ngolimi (olubhalwe nolukhulunywayo). Ukusebenza njengeqembu kanye nokubambisana. Ukubeka uhlelo bese uhlela. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zabantu. Ukuqonda amagugu nezimiso zomsebenzi wokuqasha. Amakhono: Ulwazi ngendlela abantu abaphila ngayo kanye namasistimu omphakathi. Ukuqonda ukuphila komphakathi. Ukuxhumana nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ukuqonda amaphrogremu okuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ucwaningo lokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukuqonda umthetho mayelana nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukubeka uhlelo bese uhlela; Amakhono okuxhumana; Ukuthintana (okubhalwe noku khulunywa); Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Ukuba ngumholi wethimba. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuhlala uninikeza ngolwazi olusha mayelana nemikhakha yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ukuze kube khona ukulekelela okusebenzayo. Ulwazi ngemigomo nemithetho ehambisana nokuthuthukisa umphakathi.
zu.duties: Nikeza amasevisi omsebenzi wokuqasha ngokuthuthukisa inguquko yomphakathi, ukuxazulula izinkinga ebudlelweni babantu kanye nokuquinisisa noku khulula abantu ukuze kube khona impilo enhle yomphakathi. Ukunikeza amasevisi omsebenzi wokuqasha ohlose ukuvikela abantu abasengozini, abangenakho ukuze baziqede bese bengenakho ukuvikela. Qamba ukulinganisa okuhlose ukubona izimo ezibantu, amaqembu, imindeni nasezinhlanganweni zomphakathi ezingenza ukuthi kufanele kube khona ukungenelela okuhambisana naleso simo. Bona bese uncoma ukuthi ukungenelela okufanele ukwenziwe ukuxazulula izimo eziye kubonakala. Phefumulela okushiwo ukungenelela ngokunikeza ukwesekwa okuqhubekayo, incomo kanye neseluleko kulabo abathintekayo, amaqembu, imindeni kanye nomphakathi. Bheka bese ukhulelula ukusebenza koluhlho lokungenelela okushiwo, yenza umbiko ngokuqhubeka kwezinto bese ubona enye indlela engase yenziwe ukuxazulula izimo eziye kubonakala.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokhathalelo Lwentlalo Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Izithuba zomsebenzi wokhathalelo lwentlalo inqanaba 1 kumasebe amaninzi e North West ebonelela ngeenkonzo zokhathalelo lwentlalo kumntu othintelweyo nabanengozi, kufuneka idanga ekhathalelo lwentlalo nokubhaliswa kwi SACSSP.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12. IBachelor of Social Work evumela ukubhalisa ngokobuchwepheshe kwi South African Council for Social Services Profession (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi wokhathalelo lwentlalo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayiseni yomqhubi ethile. Kufuneka kube khona ulwazi neakhono ezilandelayo ukwenzela ukumiswa: Ukuqonda iintsingiselo zentlalo, indlela abantu abaphila ngayo neenkqubo zentlalo. Ukungenelela kwezobunntu nokwakhisa amandla. Inkxaso yentlalo. Ukukhusela abantu abathintelweyo. Ukuqonda umthetho wokhathalelo lwentlalo. Unxibelelwano (elubhalwe nangomlomo). Ukusebenza njengesiqhanga nokusebenzisana. Ukuceba nokuhlela. Ulawulo lweenkulungwane ezahlukeneyo. Ukuqonda amaxabiso nemiğelela yokhathalelo lwentlalo. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi ngendlela abantu abaphila ngayo neenkqubo zentlalo. Ukuqonda iintsingiselo zomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa kweenethiwekhi nokuseka ubudlelwane. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zophuhliso lomphakathi. Uphando ngophuhliso lomphakathi. Ukuqonda umthetho ngophuhliso lomphakathi. Ukuceba nokuhlela; Ikhono lokwakha iinyethiwekhi; Unxibelelwano (elubhalwe nangomlomo); Ulawulo lomsebenzi; Ukukhokela iqela. Ulawulo labantu. Ulawulo loqhushumbishumbo. Ulawulo lomsebenzi. Ulawulo lweemali. Ukuhlala usemandleni ngophuhliso olutsha kwindawo zophuhliso lomphakathi ukuze kulungiseke ukubonelelwa ngenkonzo. Ulwazi lweenqgela zomthetho namagunya afanekiselwa kophuhliso lomphakathi.
xh.duties: Bonelela ngeenkonzo zokhathalelo lwentlalo ngokukhuthaza inguquko yentlalo, ukusombulula iingxaki kwintlobo-mntu nokwakhisa amandla nokukhulula abantu ukuze kuphuculwe impilo yentlalo. Ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zokhathalelo lwentlalo ngokukhusela abantu abathintelweyo, abanengozi abangekho nakuzikhusela. Qamba isiqendu esijoliswe ekuchazeni iimeko kumntu, maqela, usapho nakumaphakathi eziza nokubonelela ngezinye iindlela ezifanelekileyo. Qamba kwaye uze unike iimpegiso ngeendlela ezifanelekileyo ezifunekayo zokungenelela ekusombululeni iimeko ezifunyanisiweyo. Zalisa iindlela ezithiweyo ngokubonelela ngenkxaso ephila, inceba lweenkxaso yolwazi kunye nengcebiso kubantu abachaphazelekayo, maqela, usapho nakumaphakathi. Qwalasela kwaye ulinganise ukusebenza kwale ndlela ethiweyo, wenze ingxelo ngophuhliso kwaye uchaze ezinye iindlela ezilungisiweyo zokungenelela ekusombululeni iimeko ezifunyanisiweyo.

Ukuguquguquka nokuthembeka. Ukuphatha impikiswano.

Ukuguquguquka nokuthembeka. Ukuqwalasela iingxabano.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zolawulo olubanzi. Yonakele iinkonzo zokuNxibelelana nokuNika iinxaxheba kwindlu yamajelo.

Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree (NQF 6/7) in Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Financial Management. 2 – 3 years relevant experience, of which 1 year must be at supervisory level. Knowledge: Client Orientation Customer Focus, Communication, Planning, Organising Competencies: Honesty and integrity, flexibility, computer skills. Good verbal and written communication skills, teamwork.

Request and receive quotations. Capture specification on the electronic purchasing system. Place orders. Issue and receive bid documents. Provide secretariat or logistical support during the bid consideration and contracts conclusion process. Compile draft documents as required.

af.title: Toesighoudende Klerk vir Voorsieningskettingbestuur
af.summary: Ouloer toe sig hou oor klerklike funksies vir voorsieningskettingbestuur, insluitend vraag, verkryging, onderhoud van die verskafferdatabasis en kwotasieverwerking by die Dr Kenneth Kaunda District Office.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Diploma / Baccalaureusgraad (NQF 6/7) in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Logistieke Bestuur / Finansiële Bestuur. 2 – 3 jaar relevante ervaring, waarvan 1 jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Kennis: Kliëntgerigtheid en kliestefokus, Kommunikasie, Beplanning, Organisering. Bevoegdhede: Eerlikheid en integriteit, buigsaamheid, rekenaarvaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, spanwerk.
af.duties: Lever klerklike ondersteuning vir vraag en verkryging. Werk die verskaffer- (insluitend kontrakteurs) databasis op en onderhou dit. Registreer verskaffers op Logis of 'n soortgelyke stelsel. Vra kwotasies aan en ontvang dit. Vang spesifikasies op die elektroniese aankoopstelsel. Plaas bestellings. Uitreik en ontvang bieddokumente. Verskaf sekretariële of logistieke ondersteuning gedurende die biedoerwagtings- en kontraksluitingsproses. Stel konsepdokumente soos vereis op.

zu.title: Umphathi Wabasebenzi Bokuqashwa Kwezinsiza Zokuhlinzeka
zu.summary: Qapha imisebenzi yokulelela kokuqashwa kwezinsiza zokuhlinzeka okuhlanganisa isidingo, ukuthola izinsiza, ukugcina isisekelo sedatha yabahlinzeki kanye nokucubungula izinketho eNkundleni YoMbuso Yase Dr Kenneth Kaunda District.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Se-Grade 12. Diploma / I-Degree Yezinhlelo ezingaba ngu-NQF 6/7 kokuqashwa kwezinsiza zokuhlinzeka / Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza / Ukuphathwa Kwezimali. Uhambo olungu-2 – 3 lweminyaka yokuqonda kule ndawo, lapho kuyadingeka khona ukuthi unyaka owodwa ube ngaphansi kokulinganiswa ngesikhathi sokuphatha. Ulwazi: Ukuqondisisa nomnxhinnyo wabathengi, Ukuxhumana, Ukweluleka, Ukuhlela. Izindawo: Ukuqinisekisa kanye nokuthembeka, ukuguquguquka, amakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono ahle ahambisana olimini nolubhalwayo okuxhumana ngawo, ukusebenza njengaqembu.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngenkazo yomsebenzi ophathelene nesidingo kanye nokuthola izinsiza. Bukanisa uphinde ulondoloze isisekelo sedatha yabahlinzeki. Bhalisa abahlinzeki ku-Logis noma ezinye izinhlela ezingafaniyo. Cela uphinde wamukele izinketho. Faka izinkomba ezinhleleni zokuthenga ngekhompyutha. Faka izinketho futhi ulandele imiyalo. Khishela futhi wamukele amadokhenda wemibhudo. Hlinzeka ngenkazimulo noma uphathwa kwezinsiza ngesikhathi sokucubungula imibhudo futhi uqedele amasivini. Hlola imibhalo yesando njengoba kuyidingeka.

xh.title: Omlindi Wabasebenzi Bolawulo Loqoqosho Lwemisebenzi
xh.summary: Qondisa imisebenzi yolawulo loqoqosho lwemisebenzi ehlanganisela isicelo, ukufumana, ukugcina ulwazi lwabathengisi nokusebenza iivoti kwiOfisi yoMmandla ka Dr Kenneth Kaunda.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethe seGrade 12. I-Diploma / I-Bachelor's Degree (NQF 6/7) kwisiCandu soLawulo loQoqosho lwemiSebenzi / uLawulo lweLogistics / uLawulo lweMali. 2 – 3 iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo, apho unyaka woku-1 kufuneka ube kwinqanaba lokulawula. ulwazi: uQonde kumNxhashi, ukuzinikela kumNxhashi, iNtetho, uCwangciso, uLungelelwaniso namakhono: uQinisekilelo nokuzithembisa, ukuguquguquka, amakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono amabalwe athetha nokuwabhala, ukusebenza njengohlobo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kumacandu isicelo nokufumana. Buyeza ugqibe ulwazi abathengisi (kuquka abenzi kontraki). Bhalisa abathengisi kuLogis okanye inkqobo efanayo. Celá wamkele iivoti. Faka iinkcazelo kwinkqobo yokuThenga ngekhompyutha. Beka iiodá. Khupha wamkele amaxwebhu okubaza. Nika inkxaso yasekretariya okanye yelogistics ngexesha lenkqubo yokucinga ngokubaza negqiba kontraki. Uxela amaxwebhu okudweba njengoko kufuneka.

jobs.centre: Sonop Old Age Home (Bojanala) (X2 Posts) JB Marks Treatment Centre (DR Kenneth Kaunda) (X3 Posts)

Knowledge and understanding of public service regulatory frameworks. A valid driver’s licence and computer literacy.

Ensure the implementation of, and adherence to Patients’ Rights Charter and Batho Pele principles. Manage and administer medication. Coordinate admissions and discharge planning. Ensure proper record-keeping. Ensure quality services delivery. Work effectively, cooperatively and amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious groups.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 – Graad 3
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundiges word by twee North West ouetehuise en behandelingsentrums benodig om omvattende kliniese verpleegsorg en opvoeding binne 'n multidissiplinêre span te bied.
af.requirements: Basiese kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma of Graad in Verpleging) of herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Aansoeker moet by die South Africa Nursing Council geregistreer wees. Wees in staat om begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wetlike en etiese verpleegpraktyk te toon. In staat wees om elementêre funksies volgens die omvang van praktyk te implementeer. Wees in staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Kennis en begrip van openbare diens regulerende raamwerke. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie en rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaffing van holistiese/omvattende gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg. Bestuur die doeltreffende benutting van hulpbronne. Verskaffing van opvoedkundige dienste. Verskaffing van doeltreffende ondersteuning aan verpleging. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om gehalte verpleegsorg te verseker. Voer kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die relevante gesondheidsfasiliteit. Verskaf nood sorg en tree as skiftleier in die eenheid op en wees beskikbaar om oortyd te werk en bystand te staan. Verseker die implementering van en nakoming aan die Handves vir Pasiente se Regte en Batho Pele-beginsels. Bestuur en administreer medikasie. Koördineer toelatings en ontslagbeplanning. Verseker behoorlike rekordhouding. Verseker gehalte dienslewering. Werk doeltreffend, saamwerkend en vreedsaam met persone van diverse intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige groepe.

zu.title: Unesi Ohleziwe Ngesikhathi Esikhethekile Isigaba 1 – Isigaba 3
zu.summary: Kudingeka osonesi abahleziwe ngesikhathi esikhethekile emazweni amabili e-North West okhunjakhunja namasikhungo okwelashwa ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okuphelele kanye nemfundo ngaphakathi kwenhlanganishe yemisebenzi ehlukene.
zu.requirements: Ithembu elisisekelo (okungukuthi iDiploma noma i-Degree eZokunesi) noma ulwazi oluhlolwayo ezokunesi emva kokubhalisa kunhlangano ye-SANC njengoNesi Ohleziwe Ngesikhathi Esikhethekile. Isiceli kufanele sibhaliswe kuSouth Africa Nursing Council. Kufanele akwazi ukukhombisa ukuqonda ngemithetho yesiNesi kanye nokusebenza okusemthethweni nangokuziphathisa komgaqo-siseko ezokunesi. Akwazi ukusebenzisa imisebenzi ebalulekile ngokwesigaba sokusebenza. Akwazi ukuhlela futhi ahambe kahle nomsebenzi wakhe nalowo wabasebenzi abasiza ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa kwabanesi okuhle. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ngemiqathango yokulawula komphakathi wonke izikhulu. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo kanye nokuqonda ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa ngokunesi okukhethekile okuphelele. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo emishise ngempumelelo. Ukunikeza izinkonzo zemfundo. Ukunikeza ukusekela okusebenzayo ezokunesi. Ukusebenza njengenhlanganishe yemisebenzi ehlukene ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa ngokunesi okuyisikhathi esihle. Ukwenza ukusebenza ngokunesi ngokwesigaba sokusebenza nangokwezinga lokunesi njengakuqunywe isikhungo sezempilo esihlobene. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuphuthumayo futhi ube ngumholi wesikhathi esigabeni futhi utholakale ukusebenza isikhathi esidlule lokusebenza kanye nokulindele. Qinisekisa ukuSetshenziswa nokuba namazwi omuhla kuNqango lazo Amalungelo Wegula kanye nemiqathango yaseBatho Pele. Phatha futhi unikeze imithi yokwelapha. Hlela ukungenisa kanye nokuqamba ukuphuma. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kohlaka oluhle kwezibhalo. Qinisekisa ukulethwa kwezinkonzo ezinga elihle. Sebenza ngempumelelo, ngokubambisene futhi ngomoya omuhle nabantu abahlukene ngokwezinga lokuqonda, inkolo, isibalo noma amasiko.

xh.title: Umhlengikazi oPhakamileyo inqanaba 1 – inqanaba 3
xh.summary: Kufunekwa abahlengikazi abaphakamileyo kwiikhondo ezimbini ezikwiziko lokhululo nyothingo eNorth West ukunika ukhathalo lokhululo olupheleleyo nemfundo ngaphakathi kwethumba elinabasebenzi behlelo elahlukahlukenyo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisiseko (oko kukuthi iDiploma okanye iDegree eNursing) okanye amava aqatshelwayo ekhululweni emva kokuqatshelwa kwiSANC njengoMhlengikazi oPhakamileyo. Kufuneka umfakisicelo abeqatshelwe kwiSouth Africa Nursing Council. Makakwazi ukubonisa ukuqonda ngemithetho ekhululweni namanye amathetho ahambelana nomsebenzi wokhululo ongemthetho ongagqamiseyo. Makakwazi ukusebenzisa imisebenzi yezisiseko ngokommandla womsebenzi. Makakwazi ukucwangcisa kulungiselele umsebenzi wakhe nawabasebenzi abaxhasiyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalo lokhululo olufanelekileyo. Ulwazi noqonda ngohlobo lolawulo lwesebe likawonke-wonke. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo nobuchwephesha bekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Unikezelo lokhathalo lokhululo olupheleleyo/olubanzi oluchanekileyo. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kwemithombo ngokusebenzayo. Unikezelo leenkonzo zemfundo. Unikezelo loxhaso olusebenzayo ekhululweni. Sebenza njengesigxina sethumba elinabasebenzi behlelo elahlukahlukenyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalo lokhululo olungomgangatho ophezulu. Yenza umsebenzi wokhululo ngokommandla womsebenzi namazinga okhululo njengoko qhotswe besisindalo sesikhululo esphantsi kwesiko lezo.nika ukhathalo lokhululo oluphuthumphuthu ube ngumkhokheli weshifthi kwilungu ube khona ukusebenza ihours ezongezelelweyo ube kwindlela yokumila. Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa nokujikwa koMthetho weMelidzo wamaRighti abaguli namagqabantshi eBatho Pele. Lawula unikeze imithi. Linganisela ukungeniswa kwabaguli noqwalaselo lwamalungelo okushiya isibhedlele. Qinisekisa ukugcina iirekhodi ngokufanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kweenkonzo zomgangatho ophezulu. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokubambisana ngokuhle nabantu bahlukeneyo ngengqondo, ngenkcubeko, ngerhesi okangeenkolo.

jobs.summary: Community Development Practitioner Grade 1 positions across multiple North West centres, requiring a relevant qualification in Community Development or Social Science.

Competencies: Knowledge of human behaviour and social systems. Understanding community dynamics. Networking and establishing partnerships. Understanding community development programmes. Community Development research. Understanding community development legislation. Planning and organising; Networking skills; Communication (written and verbal); Project Management; Team leadership. People management. Conflict management. Project management. Financial Management. Keeping abreast with new developments in the community development fields to enhance service delivery. Keep up to date with new developments in the Community Development field to enhance service delivery.

af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyn Graad 1
af.summary: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyn Graad 1-posisies oor verskeie North West-sentrums, wat 'n relevante kwalifikasie in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling of Sosiale Wetenskappe vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12. 'n 3-jarige relevante kwalifikasie in Gemeenskapsontwikkeling / Ontwikkelingsstudies of Sosiale Wetenskappe. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels. Begrip van gemeenskapsdinamika. Netwerking en die vestiging van vennootskappe. Begrip van gemeenskapsontwikkelingsprogramme. Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing. Begrip van gemeenskapsontwikkelingswetgewing. Beplanning en organisering; Netwerkvaardighede; Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings); Projektebestuur; Spanleierskap. Mensebestuur. Konflikbestuur. Projektebestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Tentyd bly met nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelingsvelde om dienslewering te verbeter. Kennis van beleide en wetgewende mandate wat verband hou met Gemeenskapsontwikkeling.
af.duties: Implementering van wetgewing en beleide om te help met ingrypings in wyke waar mense met omgewings interakteer om selfbemagtiging te bevorder. Skakel en interakteer met verskeie gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstrukture om samewerking te fasiliteer en vennootskappe te vestig om volhoubaarheid van ontwikkelingsaksies binne die gemeenskap te verseker. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsveld om dienslewering te verbeter.

zu.title: Umpraktikala Wezokusungula Komphakathi izinga 1
zu.summary: Izikhundla zompraktikala wezokusungula komphakathi izinga 1 kumakhela amaningi eNorth West, ecinga isidingo sokuba nemfundo efanele kwezokusungula komphakathi noma Izayensi Zezenhlalo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. Ifunda iminyaka emi-3 elidingekayo ezokusungula komphakathi / Izifundo Zokuthuthukisa noma Izayensi Zezenhlalo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokuziphatha komuntu kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ukuqonda ukwakheka komphakathi. Ukuxhumana nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ukuqonda izinhlelo zokusungula komphakathi._ucwaningo lwezokusungula komphakathi. Ukuqonda umthetho wezokusungula komphakathi. Ukubeka uhlelo nokuhlela; Amakhono okuxhumana; Ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunwayo); Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Ukuba nobuholi beqembu. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphatha izingxabano. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuhlala unolwazi olusha ezinkambeni zokusungula komphakathi ukuze kululiswe ukulethwa kwezinsizakulo. Ulwazi ngemigomo nemiyalelo yomthetho ehlobene nezokusungula komphakathi.
zu.duties: Ukuqaliswa komthetho nemigomo ukuze kusize nokuqhathaniswa emawadeni lapho abantu behlangana namaphemvelo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuziqhakambisa. Ukuhlanganyelela nokuxhumana nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokusungula komphakathi ukuze kululiswe ukusebenzelana nokwakha ubudlelwano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugcinwa kwezenzo zokuthuthukisa emphakathini. Ukuhlala unolwazi olusha enkambeni yezokusungula komphakathi ukuze kululiswe ukulethwa kwezinsizakulo.

xh.title: UmPhathi Wenkqubo Yophuhliso Lombono Grade 1
xh.summary: Izithuba zomPhathi Wenkqubo Yophuhliso Lombono Grade 1 kumaziko amaninzi eNorth West, ezifuna isifundo esifanelekileyo kunkqubo Yophuhliso Yoluntu okanye kwezenzululwazi Zentlalo.
xh.requirements: Grade 12. Isifundo seminyaka eli-3 esifanelekileyo kunkqubo Yophuhliso Yoluntu / Izipho zophuhliso okanye Izenzululwazi Zentlalo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushumba esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokuziphatha kwabantu nezakhiwo zentlalo. Ukuqonda ukujikeleza koluntu. Ukuzalanisa nokwakhiwa kogqu PHANTSE. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zophuhliso zoluntu. Uphononongo lophuhliso koluntu. Ukuqonda umthetho oqhlekileyo lophuhliso koluntu. Ukuceba nokuhlela; Ikhono lokuzalanisa; Ikhono lokunxiba (elibhalwe noku thethwa); Uphuhliso Lweenkqubo; Inkululeko yeqela. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ulawulo lwengxumbo. Ulawulo lweenkqubo. Ulawulo lweemali. Ukugcina isiko nophuhliso olutsha kumahlulo lophuhliso olubunjwa koluntu. Ulwazi lweenkqazo nemithelelo yomthetho ophatha ukwakhiwa koluntu.
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela umthetho neenkqazo ukuncedisa ekungeniseni izigalo kwiiwadi apho abantu bahlangana khona nezinto zendalo ukuze bancede ukuziziphilisa. Ukunxibelelana nokubambisana nabantu bakwinkqubo zophuhliso zoluntu ukuze kwakhiwe ingqungumbala nokwakhiwa kogqu PHANTSE ukuze kugqitywe ukusuka kwinqqamano lokubakho koluntu. Ukulandela iindlela entsha kuphuhliso lwesizwe ukuze kuqhutywe ngoncedo lweenkqubo.

jobs.title: Communications Officer
jobs.summary: Communications Officer at the North West Provincial Office responsible for internal communications, circulars and notice boards, requiring a diploma and 1 to 2 years of public service experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12. Diploma (NQF 6) in Communication / Marketing / Journalism /Public Relations / Media Studies. At least 1 – 2 years’ experience in a corporate communication environment in the public service. Computer literacy, Photographic skills. A valid driver’s license. Competencies: Honesty and integrity, flexibility, computer skills. Good verbal and written communication skills, teamwork.
jobs.duties: Responsible for development of internal releases to update staff about internal developments i.e. news, transformation issues, conditions of service matters, etc. Distribution of internal circulars and memos through electronic and print channels. Regularly updating of notice boards and monitoring proper placement of notices. Develop creative communication initiatives to the interest all stakeholders including staff members on departmental matters. Assist with the production of internal departmental publications (e.g., newsletters, calendars, diaries, programmes, posters, print advertisement, etc). Responsible for internal corporate identity brand campaign and awareness. Monitor and report adherence to the department’s corporate identity manual. Assist with branding and exhibitions. Coordinate and take part in all internal and external events. Update the website on a regular basis.

af.title: Kommunikasiebeampte
af.summary: Kommunikasiebeampte by die North West Provinsiale Kantoor verantwoordelik vir interne kommunikasie, sirkulieres en kennissborde, wat 'n diploma en 1 tot 2 jaar se openbare diens ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 12. Diploma (NQF 6) in Communication / Marketing / Journalism / Public Relations / Media Studies. Ten minste 1 – 2 jaar se ervaring in 'n korporatiewe kommunikasie-omgewing in die openbare diens. Rekenaarvaardigheid, fotografiese vaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Eerlikheid en integriteit, buigsaamheid, rekenaarvaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, spanwerk.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die ontwikkeling van interne vrystellings om personeel in te lig oor interne ontwikkelings d.w.s. nuus, transformasiekwessies, diensvoorwaardesake, ens. Verspreiding van interne sirkulieres en memorandums deur middel van elektroniese en drukkanale. Gereelde opdatering van kennissborde en monitering van die behoorlike plasing van kennissgewings. Ontwikkel kreatiewe kommunikasie-inisiatiewe om alle belanghebbendes insluitend personeellede te interesseer in departementale aangeleenthede. Bied hulp met die produksie van interne departementale publikasies (bv. nuusbriewe, kalenders, dagboeke, programme, posters, drukadvertensies, ens). Verantwoordelik vir interne korporatiewe identiteitshandelsmerk-veldtog en bewustheid. Monitor en rapporteer nakoming van die departement se korporatiewe identiteitshandleiding. Bied hulp met handelsmerke en tentoonstellings. Koördineer en neem deel aan alle interne en externe geleenthede. Dateer die webwerf op 'n gereelde basis op.

zu.title: Inkulu Yezokuxhumana
zu.summary: Inkulu Yezokuxhumana eNorth West Provincial Office enobuhlakani bokuxhumana ngaphakathi, izincwadi ezisabhokhile namabhodi ezaziso, edinga idiploma namafamu angu-1 kuya ku-2 ubudala beminyaka yohlelololuholo
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. Idiploma (NQF 6) kwi-Communication / Marketing / Journalism /Public Relations / Media Studies. Okungenani 1 – 2 iminyaka yokuhlola emhlabeni wezokuxhumana webhizinisi ohlelweni loluholo. Ukubazi kwamakhompyutha, izikhathi zokuthwebula izithombe. Ilayisense elivumelekile lokushayela. Ikhono: Ukwethembeka nokuba yinkunzi, ukuzinza, izikhathi zekhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala, ukusebenza njengobaqhubi.
zu.duties: Ubhekene nokusungulwa kwemilolongane yangaphakathi ukuze ubuqashe izisebenzi ngokuthuthuka kwangaphakathi okuyinto ezihlanganisa izindaba, izindlela zokushintsha, izindaba zezenzo zenkonzo, njll. Ukusatshalaliswa kwezincwadi ezisabhokhile nememorandamu ngaphandle ngemikhondo yamakhompyutha nesibhali esiphrintiwe. Ukuphinda ubuqashe amabhodi ezaziso ukuze uhlole ukubekwa okuhle kwamazaziso. Ukuhlela imilolongane yokuxhumana ebumbayo ehlokwa yibo bonke abahlabangazi okuhlanganisa izisebenzi ngendaba zomnyango. Ukusiza ekukhiqizweni koshicilelo bangaphakathi beminyango (isb, izindatshana, amakhalenda, amabhuku ezinsuku, izinhlelo, amaphositha, izikhumuzo ephrintiwe, njll). Ubhekene nenhlelo yophawu lokuzihlonza ngaphakathi lwebhizinisi kanye nokuqwashisa. Ukuhlola kwaye ubika ngokuzinza kwehhovisi elibhalwe ngophawu lobunikazi beminyango. Ukusiza ekuphawuleni nakumabonwe njengobungcweti. Ukuhlela bese ubambe iqhaza kuwo wonke amaculo angaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukubuqasha i-website ngasikhathi sinye.

xh.title: Isikhokeli seNxibelelwano
xh.summary: Isithuba sikasebenzi weNxibelelwano kwi North West Provincial Office esinexanduva lonxibelelwano olungaphakathi, iindatshana zamajelo azimeleyo namabhoodi ezaziso, kwaye sifuna i diploma kunye neminyaka engama 1 ukuya kweyi-2 yamava kumsebenzi kawo wonke-wonke.
xh.requirements: Ireyidi 12. I Diploma (NQF 6) kwi Communication / Marketing / Journalism /Public Relations / Media Studies. Ubuncinane 1 – 2 iminyaka yamava kwimeko yonxibelelwano lwenkampani kumsebenzi kawo wonke-wonke. Ukuba lilwazi ngekhompyutha, amakhono okuthatha iifoto. Ilayisenesi yokuqeshisa ngokusemthethweni. Iikhompetensi: Uxinzelelo nengqondo elungileyo, ukuguquguquka, amakhondo ekhompyutheni. Amakhondo amaninzi aneloyo onxibelelwano lweenkulumbuso nolobhalwayo, ukusebenza njengelinye iqela.
xh.duties: Uxanduva lokuphuhlisa izaziso ezangaphakathi ukuze abasebenzi babenolwazi ngenkqubela yangaphakathi njengamafa, iindaba zenguquko, iindaba zemigaqo yesebenza, njl njl. Ukusasaza iindatshana zamajelo azimeleyo nezaziso ezangaphakathi ngeendlela zeelektroniki nzezipapashwe. Ukuhlaziya njalo amabhoodi ezaziso nokugcina iliso ukubekwa okuchanekileyo kwezaziso. Ukuphuhlisa iinjongo ezitsha zokunxibelelwana ezenza ukuba bonke abathathi-nxaxheba kuquka abasebenzi banomdla kwiindaba zesebe. Uncedisa ekwenziweni kweepapasho zangaphakathi zesebe (umzekelo, iindaba zemigca, amakhalenda, iidayari, iinkqubo, iiposta, iinkxaso ezipapashwayo, njl). Uxanduva lweqela lesimo sabakhamizi-inkampani langaphakathi nokwazisa ngalo. Ukugcina iliso nokubika ngokuzinikela kwemigaqo yesimo sabakhamizi-inkampani yesebe. Uncedisa ngesimo sabakhamizi-inkampani nemiboniso. Ukuhlanganisa kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kuyo yonke iminyhadala yangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuhlaziya iwebhusayithi ngamaxesha angamiselwanga.

jobs.title: Child and Youth Care Supervisor Grade 1
jobs.centre: JB Marks Treatment Center (X1 Post) Reamogetswe Child And Youth Care Center (X3 Posts) Khuseleka One Stop Center (X1 Post) Taung Old Age Home (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: R265 755 per annum, (OSD package), (an all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Child and Youth Care Supervisor Grade 1 positions across four North West social service centres, requiring Grade 12, a Child and Youth Care certificate, and SACSSP registration.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 and certificate in Child and Youth Care. Current proof of registration with South African Council for Social Services Professionals (SACSSP) (proof of registration submitted when shortlisted) Experience in CYCC will be added advantage. Current registration with the SACSSP council as Child and Youth Care worker. Competencies: Ability to maintain confidentiality. Good communication skills. Good time keeping. Ability to work as a team. Problem solving skills. Planning and organising skills. Knowledge of relevant legislations, policies and procedures in Child and youth Care. Interpersonal and Leadership skills. Able to do shift work.
jobs.duties: (JB Marks Treatment Centre service users, Reamogetswe: children, Khuseleka: survivors/victims Taung Old Age Home: Older Persons). Supervision of Care and Development: Ensures that children and youth in care facilities receive appropriate developmental, therapeutic, and life-space interventions to enhance their well-being and growth. Including monitoring of daily routines, developmental programs, and therapeutic activities. Ensure adequate supervision. Work within a multidisciplinary team to ensure the formulation and implementation of individual developmental plans Life-Space Supervision: Guide CYC workers, providing immediate feedback and support in real-time situations. Assess CYC workers performance, intervene when necessary, and model effective interactions with children and youth. Staff Mentoring and Coaching: Mentoring and coaching CYC workers, transmitting knowledge, skills, and professional attitudes. Provide guidance on handling complex situations, encourage reflective practice, and support professional development through performance appraisals and continuing professional development. Program Implementation and Administration: Oversee the planning and execution of programs tailored to the developmental needs of children and youth. Manage administrative tasks such as shift registers, incident reports, logbooks, and compliance with policies and procedures. Coordinate escorts and liaise with the Multidisciplinary Team. Ensuring Compliance and Advocacy: Ensure adherence to legislative and policy frameworks governing child and youth care centres. Promote children’s rights, maintain quality control of services, and advocate for the needs of children and youth.

af.title: Kinder- en Jeugsorgtoesiender Graad 1
af.summary: Kinder- en Jeugsorgtoesiender Graad 1-posisies oor vier Noord-Wes maatskaplike dienssentrums, wat Graad 12, 'n Kinder- en Jeugsorg-sertifikaat en SACSSP-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 en sertifikaat in Kinder- en Jeugsorg. Huidige bewys van registrasie by South African Council for Social Services Professionals (SACSSP) (bewys van registrasie voorgelê wanneer voorkeur gegee word). Ervaring in CYCC sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Huidige registrasie by die SACSSP-raad as Kinder- en Jeugsorgwerker. Bevoegdhede: Vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie tydsbestuur. Vermoë om as 'n span te werk. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Beplannings- en organiseervaardighede. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing, beleide en prosedures in Kinder- en Jeugsorg. Interpersoonlike en leierskapsvaardighede. In staat om skofwerk te doen.
af.duties: (JB Marks-behandelingsentrum diensgebruikers, Reamogetswe: kinders, Khuseleka: oorlewendes/slagoffers Taung Old Age Home: bejaardes). Toesig oor Sorg en Ontwikkeling: Verseker dat kinders en jeugdiges in sorgfasiliteite toepaslike ontwikkelings-, terapeutiese en leefruimte-intervensies ontvang om hul welwees en groei te bevorder. Insluit die monitering van daaglikse roetines, ontwikkelingsprogramme en terapeutiese aktiwiteite. Verseker voldoende toesig. Werk binne 'n multidissiplinêre span om die formulering en implementering van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne te verseker. Leefruimte-toesig: Begelei CYC-werkers en verskaf onmiddellike terugvoer en ondersteuning in intydse situasies. Evalueer CYC-werkers se prestasie, tree in wanneer nodig, en modelleer effektiewe interaksies met kinders en jeugdiges. Personeelmentorskap en -afrigting: Mentor en afrig CYC-werkers deur kennis, vaardighede en professionele houdings oor te dra. Verskaf leiding oor die hantering van komplekse situasies, moedig reflektiewe praktyk aan, en ondersteun professionele ontwikkeling deur prestasie-evaluerings en voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling. Programimplementering en administrasie: Oorsien die beplanning en uitvoering van programme wat op die ontwikkelingsbehoeftes van kinders en jeugdiges afgestem is. Bestuur administratiewe take soos skofregister, voorvalverslae, logboeke en nakoming van beleide en prosedures. Koördineer escorte en skakel met die Multidissiplinêre Span. Verseker nakoming en voorligting: Verseker voldoening aan wetgewende en beleidraamwerke wat kinders- en jeugsorgsentra regeer. Bevord kindersregte, handhaaf gehaltebeheer van dienste, en pleit vir die behoeftes van kinders en jeugdiges.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokunakekelwa Kwabantwana Nezesilangwana Isigaba 1
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomphathi wokunakekelwa kwabantwana nezesilangwana isigaba 1 kuzona zonke izikhungo ezine zezinsiza zomphakathi e-North West, ezidinga isigaba se-12, isitifikedi sokunakekelwa kwabantwana nezesilangwana, nokubhalise kwi-SACSSP.
zu.requirements: Isigaba se-12 nesisitifikedi sokunakekelwa kwabantwana nezesilangwana. Ubufakazi bokuthi ubhalise njalo nge-South African Council for Social Services Professionals (SACSSP) (ubufakazi bokubhalisa bunikezwa lapho kukhethwa abangaphakathi) Phezu kwalokho, olunye uhlakulo kule minyaka yesi-CYCC kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ukubhalisa njalo kubandla le-SACSSP njengomsebenzi wokunakekelwa kwabantwana nezesilangwana. Amakhono: Ikhono lokulondoloza imfihlo. Amakhono ahle wokuxhumana. Ukuphatheka kahle kwesikhathi. Ikhono lokusebenza njengeqembu. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlanganisa. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubo namaphulasi abalulekile ekukeni kwabantwana nezesilangwana. Amakhono ohlanganisiwe kanye noqeqesho ngokubhalisa. Ukuthi ukwazi ukusebenza ngesikhathi esikleliswe.
zu.duties: (Abasebenzisi bezinsiza e-JB Marks Treatment Centre, Reamogetswe: abantwana, Khuseleka: abasindile/abahlushwa Taung Old Age Home: Izintandisi). Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza nokuthuthukiswa: Kutholakala isiqiniseko sokuthi abantwana nezesilangwana ezindaweni zokunakekelwa bethola ukuthinta okufanele ukuthuthukisa nokwelapha, ukuthuthukisa impilo yakho nokututhuka. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukulonda imisindo yansuku zonke, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa, kanye nemikhakha yokwelapha. Kutholakala isiqiniseko sokulonda okusemthethweni. Ukusebenza phakathi kweqembu elihlangene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukumiswa nokusetshenziswa kwephulani ngaymunye yokuthuthukisa Ukulonda ngaphezulu: Kuboniswa abasebenzi be-CYC, ukunikeza iphethini ngokushesha kanye nosekelo ezimeni ngesikhathi sangempela. Kubalwa ukusebenza kolimi be-CYC, okuphendulwa kuso lapho kudingeka, nokubonisa ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo nabezilangwana. Ukuqeqesha nokululela abasebenzi: Ukuqeqesha nokululela abasebenzi be-CYC, ukudlulisela ulwazi, amakhono, kanye nezinkulumo zobungcali. ukunikeza isiqondiso kubangani bezindlela ezibucayi, ukukhuthaza izindlela eziyisibonelo, kanye no ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa ngokusebenza ngokusatshaliswa ukusebenza ngokuhlangenwe nakho kanye nokuthuthukiswa ngokulandelana. Ukuqinisekiswa kophulani nokuphatha: Ukuqinisekisa ukuhlelwa nokusetshenziswa kwephulani ngokuthuthukiswa kwabantwana nezesilangwana. Ukuphatha imisebenzi yophatha efana nokubhalisa ngesikhathi esikleliswe, izindaba zezigameko, ukubhalisa okuyisibuko nokuzinhlanganisa ngemithetho nezinqubo. Ukubambisana nabahambi bokuqedela kuhlanganiswa namasilingane phakathi kweqembu lendawo yonke. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza nokuxhaswa: Ukuqinisekisa ulandelo lomthetho namaphulasi okuphatha amabhawuka abantwana kanye nabesilangwana ukunakekelwa. ukukhuthaza amalungelo abantwana, ukugcina isimo esiphezulu sokuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa, kanye nokuxhasa imithetho yabantwana nezesilangwana.

xh.title: Ulawulo lokuNakekela uMntwana noMntu oshaBini, iGraji 1
xh.summary: Izithuba zeChild and Youth Care Supervisor Grade 1 kumaziko amane ezeemisebenzi yezentlalo eNorth West, ezifuna iGraji 12, isatifikedi seChild and Youth Care, nokubhalisa kwiSACSSP.
xh.requirements: Urhwetyana lweGraji 12 nesatifikedi kwiChild and Youth Care. Isibonakaliso sangoku sokubhalisa kwiSouth African Council for Social Services Professionals (SACSSP) (isibonakaliso sokubhalisa sithunyelwa xa umntu eqwalaselwe). Amava kwiCYCCuya kuba luncedo. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwibhunga leSACSSP njengonakekeli weChild and Youth Care. Ikhono: Ikhono lokugcina iimfihlo. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelana. Ukugcina ixesha elihle. Ikhono lokusebenza njengelinye iqela. Ikhono lokuxazulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokuqamba nokulungiselela. Ulwazi ngemithetho, iinkqubo, neendlela ezimalunga neChild and Youth Care. Ikhono lokunxibelelana nabantu nolokuba ngumkhokeli. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa kwabasebenzi.
xh.duties: (Abasebenzisi besebenziso kwiJB Marks Treatment Centre, iReamogetswe: abantwana, iKhuseleka: iindlebe ngokuhlukunyezwa/banethemba iTaung Old Age Home: Abantu abadala). Ulawulo loNakekelo noPhuhliso: Qinisekisa ukuba abantwana nabantu abasha bakwiziko lokunakekelwa bafumana unakekelo olufaneleyo lophuhliso, lokwelapha, nolwendawo yokuphila ukuze kube kukhuseleko nentlaliswano yabo. Kuquka nokugqithisa ulwandulo kwimithambo yemihla ngemihla, iinkqubo zophuhliso, nemisebenzi yokwelapha. Qinisekisa ulawulo olwaneleyo. Sebenza kwithimba elinabasebenzi bakumazwe ngamazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwenziwa nokusebenza kweenkqubo zobomi bethungo. ULawulo lweNdawo ekuPhila kuyo: Khokelela oonakekeli beCYC, ubanike ingxelo ekhawulezayo nenkxaso kwiimeko ezihlaziywayo. Hlola ukusebenza koonakekeli beCYC, ungene phakathi xa kusenyanzelekile, uze ubonise indlela engcono yokusebenzisana nabantwana nabantu abasha. UkuKhokela noQeqesho kwaBasebenzi: Ukuqeqesha nokukhokela oonakekeli beCYC, ukudlulisela ulwazi, amakhono, nokuziphatha ngobungcali. Bonelela ngokukhokela ukujongana neimeko ezinzima, khuthaza ukuzilolonga, uze unike inkxaso ekuphuhliseni ubungcali ngokuhlola ukusebenza nokuphuhlisa ubuchule obutsha. UKwenza kweenkqubo noLawulo: Qhubele phambili uqwalaselo nokwenziwa kweenkqubo ezizimiweyo kwiimfuno zophuhliso zabantwana nabantu abasha. Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo njengamagama abhalwayo, iingxelo zezehlo, iibhuku ezibhalwa kuzo, nokuhambelana neenkqubo nezinqamla. Lawula abalondele kwaye udibanise nethimba elinabasebenzi bakumazwe ngamazwe. UKuqinisekisa ukuHambelana noLutsholingo: Qinisekisa ukuhambelana nemiGalelo yomThetho nolwezeNqubomgomo elawula iinkqubo zokunakekela abantwana nabantu abasha. Khuthaza amalungelo abantwana, gcina umgangatho wonakekelo, uze ube ngumthethonjiniyela wemfuno zabantwana nabantu abasha.

jobs.title: HCM Production Clerk: Appointments
jobs.summary: Production clerk responsible for capturing appointments, transfers and terminations on the PERSAL system at the North West Provincial Office.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate 0–1-year relevant experience. Practical PERSAL experience will serve as an advantage. Computer Literacy. A Valid driver’s license. Competencies: Honesty and integrity, flexibility, computer skills. Good verbal and written communication skills, teamwork.
jobs.duties: Ensuring correct implementation and capturing of appointments, promotions, translations, secondments, and transfers on the PERSAL System. Assist in the administration of service termination timeously on PERSAL. Attending Human Resource related enquiries. Provide Human Resource technical support during shortlisting’s and interviews.
jobs.enquiries: Ms MJ Molamu Tel No: (018) 3881552/2416
jobs.applications: E-mail: SDRecruitmentPO@nwpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae via e- mail or hand delivery. On the subject line of your e-mail, indicate the correct name of the post and the reference number include the department, also use the correct e-mail. All attachments for online submission must include the Z83 form and updated Curriculum Vitae only be in PDF Format, also as one document. Failure to do so, your application will be disqualified. Compliance: It is compulsory to fill all fields on the New Amended Z83 Form (81/971431) as prescribed with effect 01 January 2021, part of declaration must be signed, dated and initialed only on the first page. The Form is obtainable at any Public Service Departments and DPSA Website, www.dpsa.gov.za. Part A the applicant(s) must indicate the correct advertised Post name and Centre, Reference number. The Z83 Form must be accompanied by a recently updated Curriculum Vitae with full personal details, qualifications current and previous experience must be listed in date’s order, with relevant requirements of the post including three (3) names of contactable referees. Part B, C and D applicant must provide sufficient information relevant to the post applying for. Parts B, C and E fields for date of birth, work permit, business interest and preferred language, current study can be left blank, mark them as not relevant, and uses dashes or N/A if they don’t apply to you. Part E, F and G may not be fill if your CV already has the updated information. Applicant can skip experience section, but Part F is compulsory to be completed if you are seeking re- employment into the Public Service. Please note: It is a responsibility of a Person in possession of a foreign qualification to furnish the Department with an evaluation certificate from South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) only when shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidate(s) for post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview. NB: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service (SMS Pre Entry Certificate) is required prior to finalisation of an appointment into any SMS post. For      more      details     on     the     pre-entry    course     visit: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training -course/sms-pre-entry programme. Note: All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: All shortlisted candidates including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applications received after the closing date will, as a rule will not be accepted. It will be expected of candidates to be available for interview process on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Applicant(s) previous background/reference checks will be verified through contactable referees. Shortlisted candidate(s) will be required to undergo personnel suitability checks, which include criminal records, citizenship, financial credits, asset records, qualifications verification and vetting. The successful candidate will enter into an annual performance agreement. The candidate annually will be requested to disclose his/her financial interest. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment. Applicant requiring additional information regarding advertised post must direct their enquiries to the relevant person indicated. NB: Communication and Correspondence will be limited to short listed candidates only. If you have not heard from us within six (3) months after the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours. NB: Regrettably due to excessive budget cuts, the department is not in a position to mee any travel and subsistence costs relating to the recruitment process for the shortlisted candidates. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: HCM-Produksieklerk: Aanstellings
af.summary: Produksieklerk verantwoordelik vir die vaslegging van aanstellings, oorplasing van een werknemer na 'n ander posisie en diensbeëindigings op die PERSAL-stelsel by die North West Provincial Office.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat 0–1 jaar se relevante ervaring. Praktiese PERSAL-ervaring sal 'n voordeel wees. Rekenaargeletterdheid. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Eerlikheid en integriteit, buigsaamheid, rekenaarvaardighede. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, spanwerk.
af.duties: Verseker korrekte implementering en vaslegging van aanstellings, bevorderings, oorplasing van een pos na 'n ander, ontheffings en oorplasing van een werknemer na 'n ander posisie op die PERSAL-stelsel. Bystand verleen met die tydige administrasie van diensbeëindiging op PERSAL. Hanteer navrae rakende Menslike Hulpbronne. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning vir Menslike Hulpbronne tydens voorkeurkeur en onderhoude.

zu.title: Iseluleki Sokukhiqiza se-HCM: Izabelo
zu.summary: Iseluleki sokukhiqiza esibhekele ukufaka izabelo, ukudluliselwa kwezikhundla kanye nokuphela kwemisebenzi kulesistimu ye-PERSAL e-North West Provincial Office.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi sesigaba sesi-12 0–1 unyaka wokuhluleka okuhambisana nalesikhundla. Ukusebenza ngokuphathelele ku-PERSAL kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukubhaliswa ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ukuzithoba nentliziyo ethe straight ukuba nokuzethemba, ukuguquguquka, amakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa ngomlomo nokuwabhala, ukusebenza njengohlelo.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele nokufakwa kwezabelo, ukukhushulelwa, ukuhumusha, ukwesabelwa, kanye nokudluliselwa kwezikhundla kulesistimu ye-PERSAL. Usiza ekuphathweni kokuphela kwesevisi ngesikhathi esifanele ku-PERSAL. Ukuhlanganyela kumibuzo ehlobene nabasebenzi. Ukunika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ehlobene nabasebenzi ngesikhathi sokuhlonganisa abantu abafanelekile nokuxoxisana nabathunyiwe.

xh.title: HCM Unobhala Wokukhiqiza: Izithuba
xh.summary: Unobhala wokukhiqiza ocelelwe ukubhalwa kwezithuba, ukudluliselwa kwabasebenzi nokupheliswa kwesikhonzo sabasebenzi kwinkqubo yePERSAL kwindawo yesebe leNorth West Provincial.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 0–1-year relevant experience. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iPERSAL luya kuba lusisigqithiso. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela eseleyo. Iakhono: Inyaniso nokuzithoba, ukuguquguquka, iakhono zekhompyutha. Aakhono amabaloi ebali ethethwayo n ebali ebhaliweyo, ukusebenza njengodidi.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziwa ngokuchanekileyo nokubhalwa kwezithuba, ukuphakamiswa, ukuhunjiswa, ukuthunyelwa ngesikhashana, kunye nokudluliselwa kwabasebenzi kwinkqubo yePERSAL. Ukuncedisa ekulawulweni kwesikhondo esilandelayo sokupheliswa kwesikhonzo sabasebenzi ngexesha elifanelekileyo kwiPERSAL. Ukuphendula imibuzo enxulumene nabasebenzi. Ukunika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekubalweni ngamagama amafutshane nakwiintervyu.

jobs.title: SCM Clerk Production Acqusition Management

af.title: SCM Klerk Produkasie Verkrygingsbestuur
af.summary: SCM-klerk wat vraag- en verkrygingsondersteuning by die North West Provincial Office bied, met 'n vereiste van Graad 12 en tot een jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. 0–1-jaar relevante ervaring. Kennis: Kliëntgerigtheid, Kommunikasie, Beplanning, Organisering. Bevoegdhede: Eerlikheid en integriteit, buigsaamheid, rekenaarvaardighede. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, spanwerk.
af.duties: Lewer vraag- en verkrygingsklerklike ondersteuning. Werk die verskaffer (insluitend kontrakteurs) databasis by en onderhou dit. Registreer verskaffers op Logis of 'n soortgelyke stelsel. Vra aan en ontvang kwotasies. Vaslegging van spesifikasies op die elektroniese aankoopstelsel. Plaas bestellings. Uitreik en ontvang boddokumente. Verskaf sekretariaat- of logistieke ondersteuning tydens die bodoorwegings- en kontraksluitingsproses. Stel konsepdokumente op soos vereis.

zu.title: Umlobi we-SCM Wokuqashwa Kokukhiqizwa
zu.summary: Umlobi we-SCM ohlinzeka ngokusekela isidingo nokuqashwa e-North West Provincial Office, ofuna iGrade 12 kanye nokuhamba phambili kwamanye unyaka wokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. 0–1 unyaka wokuhlola okuhlobene. Ulwazi: Ukujhepha abathathi zinkonzo Ugqolo Kukhasimende, Ukuxhumana, Ukuhlela, Ukuhlelwa Kokuhlonza ikhono: Ukuqinisela nokuzithiba, ukuguquguquka, izisekelo zekhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala, ukusebenza njengeqembu.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokusekela okuyimisebenzi yomlobi mayelana nesidingo nokuqashwa. Bulunga bese ulondoloza isisekelo sedatha yabahlinzeki (abaphakhe nabahlinzeki bamakhontrathi). Bhalisa abahlinzeki ku-Logis noma ohlelweni olufanayo. Cela bese uthola izikaleshini. Tsala izinkomba zohlelo lokuthenga ngoku-elekthronikhi. Beka amakhakhelo akhiqize bese wamukela amaxeshana okubhadala. Nikela ngokusekela kobunikazi noma ngokuhamba kwemikhakha ngesikhathi kucatshangelwa amaxeshana futhi kuqedwa ngokumiswa kwezinkambiso zamakhontrathi.

xh.title: Iklerk ye-SCM yolawulo lokufumana izinto zoqobo
xh.summary: Iklerk ye-SCM enika inkxaso yemfuno nokufumana izinto kwiNorth West Provincial Office, ifuna iGrade 12 nangaphezulu konyaka omnye wamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12. 0–1-year amava ahambelana nomsebenzi. Ulwazi: Ukuqhelanisela nabaxhasi ukugxila kubathengi, Unxibelelwano, Uplani, Ulungelelwaniso Amakhono: Inyaniseko nokuzinza, ukuguquguquka, amakhono ekhompyutha. af.title: Sekretaris
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die direkteur by die North West Provincial Office, en bestaan korrespondensie, vergaderings en dagboekskedulering.
af.requirements: Graad 12. 'n Kwalifikasie in Sekretariële / Bestuursassistent / Kantoorbestuur of administrasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Word, Excel en PowerPoint). 0 – 1 jaar se relevante ervaring in kantooradministrasie. Bevoegdhede: Organisering, tydbestuur, kommunikasie en verslagskryfvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf sekretariële / ontvangsondersteuningsdienste aan die direkteur. Neem en bestuur korrespondensie op. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Neem inkomende en uitgaande dokumente en korrespondensie op. Skeduleer vergaderings en bestuur die direkteur se dagboek. Verskaf logistiese reëlings vir vergaderings en werkswinkels. Ondersoek voorleggings en verslae om te verseker dat dit aan basiese standaarde voldoen. Bestuur kliënte se navrae/klagtes. Bestuur inkomende en uitgaande telefoonoproepe.

zu.title: Umbhalikhasi
zu.summary: Nikela ngesekelo lokubhaliswa kolwazi kanye nokuphathwa kwezobhalo kumqondisi e-North West Provincial Office, ngokuphatha imibhalo, izingqungquthela kanye nokuhlela isikhathi.
zu.requirements: Ibanga le-12. Isiqu sokuba ngumabhalikhasi / msizi wabaphathi / abaphathi bebhalo noma ukuphatha kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft word, Excel, kanye ne-PowerPoint). 0 – 1 unyaka wemfundo ehambisanayo ekuphatheni kwebhalo lasehhovisi. Ikhono: Ukuhlela izinto, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuqamba imibiko. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsiza zokwesekela ezinhlelwini zomabhalo / zokwamukela abanye kumqondisi. Ukuqopha futhi kulawulwe imibhalo exhunyiwe. Ukubumba izinsiza zesekela lolu hlelo. Ukuqopha amadokhumenti nezincwadi ezigingqiwe naseziphumayo. Ukulungiselela izingqungqutha futhi kulawulwe isikhathi somqondisi. Ukunikeza izinhlelo zokuhlela izinto zokusebenza kwezinkqungquthela, izinhlangano. Ukuphenya izincomo nemibiko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihambisana nemigomo yesisekelo. Ukulawula imibuzo / izikhalazo zabathengi. Ukulawula amakholi efoni engenayo naphumayo.

xh.title: Inkosikazi/Usilihwe
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yabasebenzi be-ofisi kunye nolawulo kumlawuli kwiNorth West Provincial Office, ulawule imibhalo, iintlanganiso, kwaye ulungiselele ishedyule yemisebenzi.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12. Isifundo kwiSecretarial / Management Assistant / Office Management okanye kulawulo siya kuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemikhonzo (Microsoft word, Excel, nepowerPoint). 0 – 1 unyaka wamava ahambelanayo kulawulo lofisi. Iakhomazi: Iakhomazi: Ukulungiselela, ulawulo lwexesha, unxibelelwano, kunye namakhono okubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkxaso yabasebenzi be-ofisi / abamke abantu kumlawuli. Ukubhala kunye nolawulo lwemibhalo. Ukubonelela ngenkxaso yolawulo. Ukubhala amaxwebhu kunye nemibhalo ezingelayo naphumayo. Ukulungiselela iintlanganiso nolawulo lweshedyule yomlawuli. Ukubonelela ngezicwangciso zokuhamba zeentlanganiso, iinkqubo zokufundisa. Ukuhlola izicelo kunye neengxelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iimigangatho esisiseko. Ulawulo lwemibuzo / iingxelo zabathengi. Ulawulo lwamagama ethunjini ezingelayo naphumayo.

jobs.title: Child and Youth Care Team Leader Grade 1
jobs.salary_text: R211 899 per annum, (salary will be in accordance with OSD determination)
jobs.summary: Lead and supervise child and youth care workers at JB Marks Treatment Centre in North West, overseeing admissions and developmental activities for children and youth.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12. Certificate/ Diploma (NQF level 4 /5/6). FET (a degree in Child and Youth Care would be an added advantage). A minimum of 7 years’ experience in Child and Youth Care work after obtaining the required qualification. Current proof of registration with South African Council for Social Services Professionals (SACSSP) (proof of registration submitted when shortlisted). A valid driver’s license. Experience in Secure Care will be added advantage. Competencies: Ability to maintain confidentiality. Good communication skills. Good time keeping. Ability to work as a team. Problem solving skills. Planning and organizing skills. Knowledge of relevant legislations, policies and procedures in Child and youth Care. Interpersonal and Leadership skills. Able to do shift work.
jobs.duties: Supervise Child & Youth Care Workers. Manage work performance of supervisee. Oversee the admission and related activities of children and youth to the facility. Oversee the access of children/ youth to medical services. Oversee the implementation of planned activities, residential developmental and therapeutic programmes. Oversee basic life space work. Undertake inspections during a shift and report on incidents and challenges identified. Perform administrative work relevant to the job. Oversee the completion of daily registers, e.g., logbooks, incident reports, etc. Ensure the attendance registers are signed and kept up to date. Perform all the administration functions required by the job. Accompany, assist and escort service users within healthcare facilities when necessary.

af.title: Kinder- en Jeugsorgspanleier Graad 1
af.summary: Lei en hou toesig oor kinder- en jeugsorgwerkers by JB Marks Treatment Centre in North West, en hou toesig oor toelatings en ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite vir kinders en jeug.
af.requirements: Graad 12. Sertifikaat/ Diploma (NQF-vlak 4 /5/6). FET ('n graad in Kinder- en Jeugsorg sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees). 'n Minimum van 7 jaar se ervaring in Kinder- en Jeugsorgwerk nadat die vereiste kwalifikasie verwerf is. Huidige bewys van registrasie by die South African Council for Social Services Professionals (SACSSP) (bewys van registrasie word ingedien wanneer daar op 'n kortlys geplaas word). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Ervaring in Sekuriteitsorg sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bevoegdhede: Vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie tydhou. Vermoë om as 'n span te werk. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Beplannings- en organiseervaardighede. Kennis van relevante wetgewing, beleide en prosedures in Kinder- en Jeugsorg. Interpersoonlike en leierskapsvaardighede. In staat om skofwerk te doen.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor Kinder- en Jeugsorgwerkers. Bestuur werkprestasie van toesighouers. Hou toesig oor die toelating en verwante aktiwiteite van kinders en jeug tot die fasiliteit. Hou toesig oor die toegang van kinders/ jeug tot mediese dienste. Hou toesig oor die implementering van beplande aktiwiteite, residensiële ontwikkelings- en terapeutiese programme. Hou toesig oor basiese leefruimtewerk. Onderneem inspeksies gedurende 'n skof en rapporteer oor voorvalle en uitdagings wat geïdentifiseer is. Voer administratiewe werk uit wat relevant is tot die werk. Hou toesig oor die voltooiing van daaglikse registers, bv. logboeke, voorvalverslae, ens. Verseker dat bywoningsregisters geteken en op datum gehou word. Voer al die administrasiefunksies uit wat deur die werk vereis word. Vergesel, help en begelei diensgebruikers binne gesondheidsorgfasiliteite wanneer nodig.

zu.title: Uholi Wothimba Lokunakekelwa Kwengane Nezinsizwa Izinga 1
zu.summary: Hola futhi uqaphele abasebenzi bonakekelwa bengane nezinsizwa e-JB Marks Treatment Centre e-North West, ubheke ukungena kanye nemisebenzi yentuthuko yezingane nezinsizwa.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12. Isitifikedi/ i-Diploma (NQF level 4 /5/6). I-FET (iziqu kuzokunakekelwa kwezinsizwa nezingane kuzoba yinto engeza inani). Okungenani unamava eminyaka engu-7 ekunakekelweni kwezinsizwa nezingane emva kokuthola izidingo ezidingekayo. Bufakazi bokubhalisa namuhla ku-South African Council for Social Services Professionals (SACSSP) (bufakazi bokubhalisa bonelelwa uma kusukwa ohlwini). Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehambile. Ulwazi ekunakekelweni okuvikelekile kuzoba yinto engeza inani. Amakhono: Ikhono lokugcina imfihlo. Amakhono anhle okuxhumana. Ukugcina isikhathi kahle. Ikhono lokusebenza njengobaqhashi. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono ohlelo lokulungiselela. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo ezihambisana nokunakekelwa kwezinsizwa nezingane. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu nokuhola. Ukuthi ukwazi ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha amashifu.
zu.duties: Qapha abasebenzi boKunakekelwa kwezinsizwa nezingane. Phatha ukusebenza kahle kwabaphathiweyo. Bheka ukungena kanye nemisebenzi ehambisana nayo yezingane nezinsizwa esikhungweni. Bheka ukufinyelela kwezingane/ izinsizwa kulezo zinkonzo zezokwelapha. Bheka ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi ezicwelisiwe, zokuthuthukiswa kwendawo yokuhlola kanye nezokwelapha. Bheka umsebenzi wansuku zonke wendlalo yokuphila. Yenza ukuhlola ngesikhathi sokusebenza ubike ngezehlakalo kanye nenkinga ezitholiwe. Yenza imisebenzi yokubhalisa ehambisana nomsebenzi. Bheka ukuqedwa kwezincwadi zansuku zonke, njengezincwadi zokungena, izikhalazo ezibhalwe phansi ngomthelela kwezehlakalo, njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi izincwadi zokubhalisa ziyashaywa usuku bese zigcinwa zibuyekeziwe. Yenza yonke imisebenzi yobhalisa edingwa umsebenzi. Qhuba, siza futhi uphathe abasebenzisi benkonzo ezikhungweni zezokwelapha lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: Umlawuli Weqela Lenkathalo Yabantwana Nakwishumi Eliphela Kwakhona Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Qonda uxanduva ulawule abasebenzi benkathalo yabantwana nakwishumu eliphela kwakhona e-JB Marks Treatment Centre e-North West, lilawule ukwamkelwa nemisebenzi yentluko yabantwana neentshaba.
xh.requirements: Grade 12. Isatifiketi/ Diploma (NQF level 4 /5/6). FET (idigri kwiNkathalo Yabantwana Nakwishumu Eliphela Kwakhona inguzibo engezweyo). Amava abyiminyaka engu-7 ubuncinane kwinkalo yokusebenza inkathalo yabantwana nakwishumu eliphela kwakhona emva kokufumana isigqibo esifunekayo. Ibizo langoku lokubhalisa kwi-South African Council for Social Services Professionals (SACSSP) (ibizo lokubhalisa lizonikezwa xa kubakho uluhlu lwabaphumeleleyo). Ilayisenisi yokushuka esebenzayo. Amava kwinkathalo ekhuselekileyo baya kuba luncedo engezweyo. Iakhono zokwenza: Amandla okugcina imfihlo. Aakhoni ezilowo zokunxibelelana. Ukugcina ixesha elilungileyo. Amandla okusebenza njengeqela. Aakhoni zokusombulula iingxaki. Aakhoni zokucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ulwazi ngemithethonkulu, iinkqubela namacebo afanelekileyo kwinkathalo yabantwana nakwishumu eliphela kwakhona. Aakhoni zokunxibelelana nabantu nolawulo. Amandla okwenza umsebenzi weeshifti.
xh.duties: Lawula abasebenzi beNkathalo Yabantwana Nakwishumu Eliphela Kwakhona. Lawula inkalo yomsebenzi walowo uxanduvayo. Lilawule ukwamkelwa nemisebenzi ehambelana nayo yabantwana neentshaba kwisikhululo. Lilawule ukufikelela kwabantwana/ iintshaba kwiinkonzo zonyango. Lilawule ukusebenza kwezinto ezicwangcisiweyo, iinkqubo zentluko zokuhlala nezenkathalo. Lilululele umsebenzi osisiseko wolawulo kwisithuba sabantu. Zenze ukutlolwa ngelixa leshifti uzive ngenxeba ngemiba nongcinga efunyenweyo. Zenze umsebenzi wolawulo ohambelana nomsebenzi. Lilawule igqibo kwiirejista zemihla ngemihla, umz., iilogbhukhi, iingxelo zemiba, njl. Qinisekisa ukuba iirejista zokuza zisayiniwe zigcinwe zintsha njalo. Zenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo efunekayo ngumsebenzi. Lulambe, ncedise uqonde abasebenzisi bezenkonzo kwiikhlinikh zonyango xa kuyimfuneko.

jobs.title: Nursing Assistant Grade 1 – Grade 3
jobs.centre: Sonop Old Age Home (Bojanala District) (X3 Posts) JB Marks Treatment Centre (Dr Kenneth Kaunda District) (X2 Posts)
jobs.salary_text: R181 230 per annum, (salary will be in accordance with OSD determination)
jobs.summary: Nursing Assistant positions at Sonop Old Age Home and JB Marks Treatment Centre in North West, requiring SANC registration as a Nursing Assistant with a Grade 12 certificate.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate, qualification that allows registration with South Africa Nursing Council (SANC) as Nursing Assistant. Applicant must be registered with SANC. Be able to demonstrate elementary understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practice. Able to implement elementary functions according to the scope of practice.
jobs.duties: Perform elementary clinical nursing practice in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards, as determined by the relevant health facility. Promote quality of elementary nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards, as determined by the relevant health facility. Conduct communication with patients and supervisors effectively. Work as part of multidisciplinary team to ensure quality nursing care. Work effectively, cooperatively and amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious groups. Passion to work with elderly persons and people with disability.
jobs.enquiries: Ms AB Nhlapo at 066 072 6993 Enquiries: Ms DC Monyemore Tel No: (018) 294 5134
jobs.applications: E-mail: SDRecruitmentBOJ@nwpg.gov.za E-mail: SDRecruitmentKK@nwpg.gov.za

af.title: Verpleegassistensie Graad 1 – Graad 3
af.summary: Verpleegassistensposise by Sonop Old Age Home en JB Marks Treatment Centre in North West, vereis SANC-registrasie as 'n Verpleegassistent met 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat, kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC) as Verpleegassistent moontlik maak. Aansoeker moet by SANC geregistreer wees. Wees in staat om 'n elementêre begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyk te toon. In staat wees om elementêre funksies ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk te implementeer.
af.duties: Voer elementêre kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde, soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder gehalte van elementêre verpleegsorg soos aangewys deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde, soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Voer doeltreffend kommunikasie met pasiënte en toesighouers. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om gehalteverpleegsorg te verseker. Werk doeltreffend, saamwerkend en vriendelik met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige groepe. Passie om met bejaarde persone en persone met 'n gestremdheid te werk.

zu.title: Onesezela Wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo Izinga 1 – Izinga 3
zu.summary: Izikhundla zoonesezela e-Sonop Old Age Home nase-JB Marks Treatment Centre e-North West, ezidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengonesezela onemfundo yesikhashana yesigaba sesi-12.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12, isiqu esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-South Africa Nursing Council (SANC) njengonesezela. Kumele afake isicelo abhaliswe e-SANC. Akwazi ukubonisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngomthetho wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi yokunakekelwa ngokomthetho nangokuziphatha kwemithethonqondo. Akwazi ukusebenzisa imisebenzi yoyisisekelo ngokwesibalo sokusebenza.
zu.duties: Yenza umsebenzi oyisisekelo wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokwesibalo sokusebenza nemigomo yokunakekelwa, njengokuqunjiswa isikhungo sezempilo esihlobene. Khuthaza izinga lomsebenzi oyisisekelo wokunakekelwa njengokuqondiswa isibalo sokusebenza semisebenzi nemigomo, njengokuqunjiswa isikhungo sezempilo esihlobene. Yenza ukuxhumana nabagulayo nabaphathi ngempumelelo. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elinochotho abaningi ukuze kuqiniseke izinga elihle lokunakekelwa. Sebenza ngempumelelo, ngokubambisana nangokuzwana nabantu abahlukene ngezingqondo, ngezamasiko, ngezinhlanga noma nangezinkolo. Unomdlandla wokusebenza nabantu abadala kanye nabantu abakhubazekile.

xh.title: Umncedi Wezesa Ukunyanga Inqanaba 1 – Inqanaba 3
xh.summary: Izithuba zomncedi wezesa ukunyanga kwiSonop Old Age Home naseJB Marks Treatment Centre eNorth West, zifuna ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomncedi wezesa ukunyanga kunye nesatifikethi seGrade 12.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12, ngesidanga esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth Africa Nursing Council (SANC) njengomncedi wezesa ukunyanga. Kufuneka umfaki isicelo abhaliswe kwiSANC. Makakwazi ukubonisa ukuqonda okusesikweni ngomthetho wokunyanga nemisebenzi eyimithetho nengokuziphatha ehambelana nokunyanga. Makakwazi ukusebenzisa imisebenzi esesisiseko ngokommandla wokwenza umsebenzi.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokuqonda eziphofoyo yokunyanga ngokommandla wokwenza umsebenzi namazinga okunyanga, njengoko kumiswe yifasilithi yezempilo echwayo. Khuthaza ubungakanani bolunulo olusesikweni lokunyanga njengoko kukhokelelwa ngummandla wokwenza umsebenzi och profeshaal kwaye njengoko kumiswe yifasilithi yezempilo echwayo. Yenza unxibelelwano nabagulayo nabanikeli bolawulo ngokusebenzayo. Sebenza njengenxalenye yeqela elihlangahlangalayo kumimandla emininzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubungakanani bolunulo lokunyanga. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokuhambisana nokuzonwabisa nabantu abavela kumacandla amahlukeneyo engqondo, basetyhini, bee-hlathi okanye eenkolo zezonqulo. Yiba nolwandle lokusebenza nabantu abadala nabanokuphila ukungabikhona kobomi.

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.summary: Cleaner needed at Sonop Old Age Home in North West to provide cleaning services including sweeping, emptying dustbins and maintaining stock levels.
jobs.requirements: Minimum Grade 10 or adult education and training (NQF Level 2). Knowledge of cleaning materials and equipment. Ability to operate cleaning equipment as well as cleaning methods and procedures. Good organising and interpersonal relationships. Basic literacy (ability to read and write) and basic numeracy (ability to count). Ability to work as part of the team. Ability to work around elderly people and have physical strength.
jobs.duties: Cleaning Services: Sweeping floor, emptying dustbins, cleaning offices and workshops (where applicable). Monitor cleaning material and report stock levels. Utilise cleaning equipment and ensure their safeguarding. Comply to Occupational Health and Safety requirements.
