af.title: Skoonmaker
af.summary: Skoonmaker benodig by Sonop Old Age Home in North West om skoonmaakdienste te lewer, insluitend vee, stofblikke leegmaak en die handhawing van voorraadvlakke.
af.requirements: Minimum Graad 10 of volwasse opvoeding en opleiding (NQF Level 2). Kennis van skoonmaakmateriaal en -toerusting. Vermoë om skoonmaaktoerusting te bedien asook skoonmaakmetodes en prosedures. Goeie organisasie- en interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Basiese geletterdheid (vermoë om te lees en te skryf) en basiese syferkennis (vermoë om te tel). Vermoë om as deel van die span te werk. Vermoë om rondom bejaarde mense te werk en fisiese krag te hê.
af.duties: Skoonmaakdienste: Vloere vee, stofblikke leegmaak, kantore en werkswinkels skoonmaak (waar van toepassing). Moniteer skoonmaakmateriaal en rapporteer voorraadvlakke. Gebruik skoonmaaktoerusting en verseker die veiligstelling daarvan. Voldoen aan Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-vereistes.

zu.title: Umhluzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhluzi e-Sonop Old Age Home e-North West ukunika amasevisi okuhlanzwa ahlanganisa ukushova, ukushosaliza izibodo nokugcina amazinga estoku.
zu.requirements: I-NQF Level 2 (esikhundleni se-Grade 10) noma mfundaze wabantu abadala. Ulwazi ngematriyali namathuluzi okuhlanza. Isikhashana sokusebenzisa amathuluzi okuhlanza kanye nezindlela nezinqubo zokuhlanza. Ukusebenzela kahle nokuba nobudlelwano abantu. Ukufunda nokubhala (isikhashana sokufunda nokubhala) kanye nokubala (isikhashana sokubala). Isikhashana sokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu. Isikhashana sokusebenza eduze kwabantu abadala futhi ube namandla omzimba.
zu.duties: Imisebenzi Yokuhlanzwa: Ukushova phansi, ukushosaliza izibodo, ukuhlanza ama-ofisi kanye namawokshopo (lapho kufanele khona). Qaphatha izinto zokuhlanza ubike amazinga estoku. Sebenzisa amathuluzi okuhlanza uqiniseke ukuphephiswa kwawo. Landela izidingo ze-Occupational Health and Safety.

xh.title: Umcindi
xh.summary: Kufuneka umcindi eSonop Old Age Home eNorth West ukunika iinkonzo zokucinda kubandakanya ukusula, ukuzalisa izikibo kwaye ugcine amanqanaba estoku.
xh.requirements: Ubuncinci ibanga lesi-10 okanye imfundo yabadala nolungelelwaniso (NQF Level 2). Ulwazi ngeziqhelwa zokucinda nempahla yokucinda. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa impahla yokucinda nakwintonjongo nezicwangciso zokucinda. Ukulungelelanisa kakuhle naye wena nabantu. Isiphatho esisisiseko (ukuqonda nokubhala) nesibalo esisisiseko (ukubala). Ukuba nakho ukusebenza njengengxenye yeqela. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kumandla abadala abadala kwaye ube namandla omzimba.
xh.duties: Iinkonzo zokucinda: Ukusula phantsi, ukuchitha izikibo, ukucinda ofisi namawindi (apho kufanelekileyo). Ukuphendula ngeziqhelwa zokucinda ukuxela amanqanaba estoku. Ukusebenzisa impahla yokucinda kuqinisekiswe ukhuseleko lwayo. Ukuzithobela iimfuno ze-Occupational Health and Safety.

jobs.title: Senior Registrar (MEDICAL) (CARDIOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: R1 395 528 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.) (It will be expected of the successful candidate to participate in a system of remunerated commuted overtime).
jobs.summary: Senior Registrar in Cardiology at Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Specialist with compulsory commuted overtime.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice) in Medicine. Inherent requirements of the job: Commuted overtime is compulsory. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge appropriate for approach to investigations of common cardiovascular disorders. Facilitation of management system. Effective and efficient administration. Communication including report generation, letter writing, consultation. Clinical Skills required of a Medical Specialist Physician (e.g. Assessment, diagnosis and treatment in inpatient, outpatient, and emergency contexts).
jobs.duties: Clinical Governance and Administration. Clinical Service Provision. Research for fulfilment of the MPhil Degree. Teaching and Training/Supervision of Junior Staff.
jobs.enquiries: Prof M Ntsekhe Tel No: (021) 404-6085 or email: mpiko.ntsekhe@uct.ac.za
jobs.applications: Applicants apply online: www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”)
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Please ensure that you attach an updated CV. Groote Schuur Hospital has adopted the department’s ecosystem framing of its training platform. Accordingly, all registrar appointments may be called upon to work across this platform and may include rotations at Metro West and Rural East hospitals. This includes Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, New Somerset Hospital, Mitchells Plein District Hospital, Victoria Hospital and George Provincial Hospital. Appointment as Senior Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 3 years. Senior Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Appointment as Senior Registrar will be on contract. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Senior Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrarship should they not be successful for advertised Medical Sub-Specialist positions. The Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated. Specific Senior Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Senior Registrars will be required to register as post-graduates with Stellenbosch University/ University of Cape Town according to the yearbook and guidelines. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status) It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Registrateur (MEDIES) (KARDIOLOGIE)
af.summary: Senior Registrateur in Kardiologie by Groote Schuur Hospitaal, Observatory, vereis HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Spesialis met verpligte pendel-oortyd.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesulis toelaat. Registrasie met 'n professionele raad: Registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis (Onafhanklike Praktyk) in Medisyne. Inherent requirements of the job: Pendel-oortyd is verpligtend. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toepaslike kennis vir benadering tot ondersoeke van algemene kardiovaskulêre afwykings. Fasilitering van bestuurstelsel. Effektiewe en doeltreffende administrasie. Kommunikasie insluitend verslaggenerering, briefskryfwerk, konsultasie. Kliniese vaardighede wat van 'n Mediese Spesialis Geneesheer vereis word (bv. Assessering, diagnose en behandeling in pasiënt-, buitepasiënt- en noodkontekste).
af.duties: Kliniese Bestuur en Administrasie. Kliniese Dienslewering. Navorsing ter vervulling van die MPhil-graad. Onderrig en Opleiding/Toesig oor Junior Personeel.

zu.title: Senior Registrar (MEDICAL) (CARDIOLOGY)
zu.summary: Umphathi we-Medical Specialist we-Cardiology e-Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhungo esiqeqeshiwe kwezokwelapha nokusebenza ihora elingeziwe okuyisidingo esibekiwe.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingavamile: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomunye wezikhungo eziqeqeshiwe. Ukubhaliswa eqhikwini lemithethe: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomunye wezikhungo eziqeqeshiwe (Umsebenzi ozenzelayo) kwezokwelapha. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo komsebenzi: Ukusebenza ihora elengeziwe kuyisidingo esibekiwe. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi olufanele mayelana nendlela yokuqondisa iziphico eziyisijwayeziwe. Ukukhuthaza uhlelo lokuphathwa kohlelo. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokuqondile. Ukuxhumana okuhlanganisa ukwenza imibiko, ukubhala izinhlamvu, kanye nokuqondisa. Amaxhono obudokotela wezokwelapha abhekiswa njengesidingo somunye wezikhungo eziqeqeshiwe (isb. Ukulinganisa, ukwahlulela kanye nokwelapha kubaguli ababheda phakathi, kubaguli abaphuma esibhedlela, nasemizamweni yesimo esiphuthumayo).

Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka engama-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengeGcina lezonyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye ibhunga langaphandle eliziswe ngokwemithetho laboGqirha bezeMisebensi yeZempilo malunga nomsebenzisi ozigqithisilele kwilizangaphandle) njengeGcina lezonyango kwi-Anaesthesiology. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka ali-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengeGcina lezonyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye ibhunga langaphandle eliziswe ngokwemithetho laboGqirha bezeMisebenzi yeZempilo malunga nomsebenzisi ozigqithisilele kwilizangaphandle) njengeGcina lezonyango kwi-Anaesthesiology. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: I-overtime ekhutshelwe iyamandla. Amandla (ulwazi/amazimiso): Esi sithuba singanika ithuba lokuzilolonga kwi-fellowship eqwesweyo ekulawulweni kwe-Anaesthesia yabantwana. Isipho sokuphanda. Ukuqonda ukuzithandela kukwenza iivavanyo ze-CMSA. I-MMed kwi-Anaesthesia. Isipho esomeleleyo semfundo okanye ukufundisa kummandla wabafundi abangagqithanga nabo bagqithileyo. Irekhodi enobulumko nangokuzithembisa enkqubweni yama-anesthetic. Ukuqonda iingcinga ezinzima kwiZempilo eMzantsi Afrika nase-Afrika, naku kobuninobulalu, utshintsho nolungelo. Amandla okusebenza kakuhle kwimeko yeqela nokuba ngumdlali weqela, enobuchule obuhle bokuthetha nabantu. Ukuzazi ikhompyutha, ukunxiba kaluhle, ulwazi lokuhlalutya nokuqonda indlela yokusombulula iingxaki. Amandla angenasiphithiphithi namava ekuqaphelelweni, kolawulo nolawulo oluxhwe kwi-anesthesia nasezorhwebo i-medicine. Irekhodi ebonakalisiweyo yonononelo yon lawulo nokuqamba iindlela enkqubweni yama-clinical nase-Anaesthesiology i-Perioperative Medicine.
xh.duties: Ukulawula abaguli abanenkathalo yespecialist yama-anesthetic ngaphakathi kwiSebe nakwizibhedlele ezinxulumene ne-Groote Schuur, iRed Cross War Memorial Children's, i-New Somerset ne-Mowbray Maternity Hospitals. Nikela iinkonzo ezikupela kwelona ngingqi. Nikela inkokeli yemfundo kwimimandla yokufundisa, uqeqesho nokuphanda abafundi abangagqithanga nabo bagqithileyo. Lungelelanise nikela ngokwakho kwiikhosi zokuqeqesha amaNJ ay ama-anesthetic. Lawula uze unikele inkokeli kuBaphathi uze nikele kakhulu kumsebenzi wolawulo wesebe esidityanisiweyo kuquka, iiarhente nokulawula ukusebenza. Nikele kulawulo nokulawula kwesebe uze unikele inkxaso ekuhambeni nasekuxhaseni iirhafu zemizi. Akha zigcine umoya wesebe wokuqina kunye nophuhliso.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokudokotela izinga 1 kuye ku-3 (OBSTETRICS)
zu.summary: Isikhundla Sokudokotela kwi-Obstetrics eMowbray Maternity Hospital, ukunikeza izokolulelela kwezokwelapha okubonakalayo kwezimo ze-O&G, ukulawula abafundi, kanye nokuphatha izindaba zokulawula.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi komthetho: Ithuluzi elifanele elicashunwe ukubvumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengodokotela. Ukubhalisa okhu kubungazi bendawo bokusetshenziswa: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emuva kokubhalisa njengodokotela ku-HPCSA kubhalwe izisebenzi ezifundele eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni seminyaka eyi-1 esifanele emva kokubhalisa njengodokotela ogunyaziweyo e-North Council Health Professional Council kubhalwe izisebenzi ezifundele kwezinye izwe, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi komthetho weminyaka eyi-5 njengodokotela emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela kubhalwe izisebenzi ezifundele eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esingaphansi komthetho weminyaka eyi-6 emva kokubhalisa njengodokotela ogunyaziweyo e-North Council Health Professional Council kubhalwe izisebenzi ezifundele kwezinye izwe, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoku kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi komthetho weminyaka eyi-10 njengodokotela emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela kubhalwe izisebenzi ezifundele eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esingaphansi komthetho weminyaka eyi-11 emva kokubhalisa njengodokotela ogunyaziweyo e-North Council Health Professional Council kubhalwe izisebenzi ezifundele kwezinye izwe, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esibhalwe kulesi sikhundla: Ilayisensi yokuqasha eyi-South African (Code B/EB) esevela. Ukuzithoba ukuthatha inhlengiyelo emsebenzini wamasikhathi angemva kwamahora – okuhlanganisa amasonto nangosuku lokuqashwa komphakathi. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Isipiliyoni samanje esihambisana namakhono ohlelo lokubeletha. Ukukwazi ukusebenza eqenjini nakubo bonke abasebenzi bamazinga ahlukene. Ukukwazi ukwenza isigaxa se-Caesarean section ngokuphepha nangaphandle kolawulo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ku-MS Office kuyadingeka. Isipiliyoni samanje esihambisana nokwenza isigaxa se-caesarean section ngokuphepha nangaphandle kolawulo; nobufakazi bokwenziwa kwezigaxa ezingaphansi kuka-50 ngokuzimele. Isipiliyoni samanje esihambisana nokulawula izindlela eziphuthuma zokwelapha izifo zabesifazane.
zu.duties: (Ukuhlatha kokwelapha nokulawula yonke imibonakalo ye-O&G ezingabi yisiphithiphithi neyesiphithiphithi eya kwi-Labour Suite eMowbray Maternity Hospital. Ukulawula abaguli abakude kakhulu bahlanganisa nokuvusa kabusha. Ukulawula nokufundisa abafundi, abaqashi kanye nababelethisi. Ukunikeza inkonzo yokuphatha okusebenzayo ngokuphathelele wonke amaphuzu okwelapha nangokungangewo kokwelapha nomsebenzi wezomthetho wezokwelapha. Ukunikeza isiqondiso nobuholo ukuze kufinyelelwe emigqeni nasezinhloso zomnyango. Kuqinisekise inkonzo ehlenga ngokwezimali emazingeni okwelapha ngokuphathelele izinkonzo zethi labhu, igazi, imithi, okusetshenziswa nezinsiza.

Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Amava akhoyo afanelekileyo namakhono ekunakekelwa kwezokuvelisa. Amandla okusebenza eqeleni lenqanaba elinye nelawula onke amaqela abasebenzi. Ukunikela inkonzo yolawulo olusebenzayo malunga nonke imicimbi yekliniki nengeyonto yekliniki nomsebenzi wezomthetho nezempilo. Ukunikela inkqubo nobukhosi malunga nokuphumeza iinjongo neenjongo ezikumgangatho wolawulo wesebe. Kuqinisekisa inkonzo entengo-luncedo kulawulo lwesibhedlele ngeemfuno ezihlobene neenkonzo zethanga, igazi, amayeza, izinto ezisetyenziswa izinto ezifunekayo kwaye kwaye nempahla.

zu.summary: Kuyadingeka abadokotela bezokwelapha eStikland Hospital ukuthi banikeze ukunakekelwa kwezengqondo kanye nezokwelapha jikelele, namaholo ake kulinganiswe ngokweminyaka yomsebenzi kanti futhi kuyadingeka ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: Iminikelo yemfundo edingekayo: Iminikelo efanele evumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomuntu osebenzayo. Ukubhalisa komkhandlu wezempilo: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela osebenzayo. Isipiliyoni: Isibanga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqinisekiswa njengodokotela osebenzayo kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo e-South Africa. Unyaka owodwa (1) wokuhlomula kwesipiliyoni emva kokuqinisekiswa njengodokotela osebenzayo komkhandlu wezempilo welinye ilizwe oqashiswayo, kubalule abasebenzi abathole izifudo kwamanye amazwe, abangeke badingwe ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Isibanga 2: Okungenani isipiliyoni esihlanu (5) esifanele sokuqinisekiswa njengodokotela osebenzayo emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela osebenzayo mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo e-South Africa. Isibhakhalo esingenaphansi kwekhulu lesipiliyoni (6) esifanele emva kokuqinisekiswa njengodokotela osebenzayo komkhandlu wezempilo welinye ilizwe oqashiswayo, mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwamanye amazwe, okudinga ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi okudingeka e-South Africa. Isibanga 3: Okungeni iminyaka yeshumi (10) yesipiliyoni esifanele njengodokotela osebenzayo emva kokuqinisekiswa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela osebenzayo mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo e-South Africa. Isibhakhalo esingenaphansi kweshumi elilodwa (11) leminyaka yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqinisekiswa njengodokotela osebenzayo komkhandlu wezempilo welinye ilizwe oqashiswayo, mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifudo kwamanye amazwe, abangeke badingwe ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izidingo eziyisiseko zendlela yokusebenza: Ukuzikhethela nokwazi ukusebenza ngokushintshana. Ukuzikhethela ukusebenza nabantu abanagculisi. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esikhundla sokuqala kwaye ufuna nokwazi ukuhamba; ukuvakatshelwa kwangemuva. Umdlandla emsebenzini wesikhathi esingemuva kwamasonto. (Ukwaziswa/Amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele kwezomqondo. (Ulwazi/Amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele kwezokwelapha. Isipiliyono esifanele esikweni lokusebenza ngokuhambisana nemithetho yesibhedlela. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekwelapheni. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekubhaleni izinhlangothi. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuhlehleni. (Ukwaziswa/Amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele mayelana nokunakekelwa komphakathi. (Ukwaziswa/Amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele ekudalweni. (Ukwaziswa/Amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele ekudaluleni izibalo ezidingekayo. (Ulwazi/Amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuhlaziyeni. (Ulwazi/Amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele ekusebenzeni. (Ulwazi/Amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele ekubukeni. (Ulwazi/Amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele ekunakekelweni kwengqondo. Ulwazi oluphelele / amakhono: Amakhono amahle okusebenza kanye nezempilo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokwelashwa ngokugcwele kokunakekelwa kwezomzimba kanye nengqondo kubaphila ngokuqaphela kanye nokwelapha izifo, izilime, nezinye izimo zempilo. Hlela uphathe izinhlela zokwelapha, okuhlanganisa nemithi kanye nendlela zokwelapha. Gcina amafayela asemthethweni futhi athwebule amaphoyisa nakho kokubili kokudala nasekubhaleni ngokwebhange kanye namaphoyisa. Kukhombise kubantu abanesipiliyoni noma abanye abanakekeli kubasebenzi balemikhuleko lapho kudingeka khona. Qedela imisebenzi ephathelene nokuqinisekiswa kwemfundo ye-HPCSA ukuze ugcine ukubhalisa. Qedela futhi unikeze imibiko yezokwelapha edingekayo namadokhumenti ezinto ezimalunga ngezomthetho nokulawula imikhuleko ukuba ihloniphe ngokusebenza. Qedela futhi unikeze imibiko yedokotela nezinye izinhlobo zemibiko ezingadingwa. Qedela imisebenzi ye-CPD edingekayo ukuze igcine isibhali kwi-HPCSA. Qedela futhi unikeze imibiko yezokwelapha edingekayo namadokhumenti ezinto ezimalunga ngezomthetho nezokuphathwa komsebenzi. Qedela futhi unikeze imibiko yezokwelapha edingekayo namadokhumenti ezinto ezimalunga ngezomthetho nezokuphathwa. Qhubeka ukhonza igazi elihlukanisiwe nasemkhakheni wezokwelapha njengoba kudingwa.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (MEDICAL Outpatients and Child
jobs.centre: Red Cross War Memorial Children’s Hospital, Rondebosch
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs).
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 needed at Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital to provide ambulatory, emergency and paediatric clinical services including teaching and training.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as a Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as a Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, who are not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years relevant experience after registration as a Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration as a Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Applicants must have a valid APLS/ PALS certificate. Willingness to travel within the District and Metro Region. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to comprehensively manage all paediatric cases including child protection cases and management of tertiary level patients. Proven leadership abilities. Experience in supervision of staff and students. Experience and effective management of allocated resources. Proven experience in teamwork. Proven knowledge/skills and experience in principles of service planning, organising, implementation, monitoring and evaluation. Proven ability to adhere to all departmental requirements and protocols. Proven knowledge of public health and public health policies, guidelines and related prescript to manage resources effectively. Computer literacy (Microsoft Office). Experience in general paediatrics post community service, including acute and chronic care. Willingness to develop protocols, attend meetings and prepare reports for child abuse and child protection. Willingness to work with the trauma unit, acute care and OPD on child abuse issues. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and maintain a high standard of professionalism. Ability and willingness to teach and supervise undergraduate and postgraduate students. Knowledge of protocols for common acute and long-term health conditions. Valid Advanced Paediatric Life Support course.
jobs.duties: Provide comprehensive, high-quality ambulatory, emergency, child protection and general paediatrics clinical services, with an emphasis on child protection and long-term health conditions. Teaching (formal and informal) and training in General Paediatrics (undergraduate, postgraduate, nursing, and allied health). Create a learning environment for students and junior colleagues. Do appropriate clinical audits and research within the department to stay abreast of clinical developments. Participation in existing research projects within the department and stay abreast of clinical developments. Alignment with clinical & corporate governance principles of General Paediatrics. Administration of HECTIS patient management system and other WCG health applications.
jobs.enquiries: Dr R Dunkley Tel No: (021) 658-5111 or email: rowan.dunkley@uct.ac.za / Dr R Johaar Tel No: (021) 658-5111 or email: Rizqah.Johaar@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applicants apply online: www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”)
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview.” This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 tot 3 (MEDIESE Buitepasiënte en Kind
af.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 tot 3 benodig by Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital om ambulatoriese, nood- en pediatriese kliniese dienste te verskaf, insluitend onderrig en opleiding.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Practicus moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Practicus. Ervaring: Grade 1: Geen na registrasie as 'n Mediese Practicus by die HPCSA met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n Mediese Practicus by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Practicus na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practicus met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n Mediese Practicus by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Council met betrekking tot buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Practicus na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practicus met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n Mediese Practicus by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Aansoekers moet 'n geldige APLS-/PALS-sertifikaat hê. Bereidwilligheid om binne die Distrik en Metro-streek te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om alle pediatriese gevalle, insluitend kinderbeskermingsgevalle en bestuur van tersiêre vlak pasiënte, omvattend te bestuur. Bewese leierskapsvermoëns. Ervaring in die toezig van personeel en studente. Ervaring en effektiewe bestuur van toegewysde hulpbronne. Bewese ervaring in spanwerk. Bewese kennis/vaardighede en ervaring in beginsels van diensbeplanning, organisering, implementering, monitering en evaluering. Bewese vermoë om aan alle departementele vereistes en protokolle te voldoen. Bewese kennis van openbare gesondheid en openbare gesondheidsbeleide, riglyne en verwante voorskrifte om hulpbronne doeltreffend te bestuur. Rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Office). Ervaring in algemene pedatrie na gemeenskapsdiens, insluitend akute en chroniese sorg. Bereidwilligheid om protokolle te ontwikkel, vergaderings by te woon en verslae vir kinderbedrog en kinderbeskerming voor te berei. Bereidwilligheid om met die traumaeenheid, akute sorg en OPD oor kinderbedrogkwessies saam te werk. Uitstekende interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en 'n hoë standaard van professionaliteit te handhaaf. Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om voorgraadse en nagraadse studente te onderrig en toe te sien. Kennis van protokolle vir algemene akute en langtermyn-gesondheidstoestande. Geldige Advanced Paediatric Life Support-kursus.
af.duties: Verskaf omvattende, hoëgehalte-ambulatoriese, nood-, kinderbeskermings- en algemene pediatriese kliniese dienste, met die klem op kinderbeskerming en langtermyngesondheidstoestande. Onderrig (formeel en informeel) en opleiding in Algemene Pedatrie (voorgraads, nagraads, verpleegkunde en verwante gesondheidsdienste). Skep 'n leeromgewing vir studente en junior kollegas. Doen toepaslike kliniese oudits en navorsing binne die departement om tred te hou met kliniese ontwikkelinge. Deelname aan bestaande navorsingsprojekte binne die departement en hou tred met kliniese ontwikkelinge. Belyning met kliniese en korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels van Algemene Pedatrie. Administrasie van die HECTIS-pasiëntbestuurstelsel en ander WCG-gesondheidstoepassings.

zu.title: i-Officer Yezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 (IZOKWELAPHA Ababuyiselwayo kanye Nengane
zu.summary: Kudingeka iDokotela Wezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 esibhedlela i-Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital ukunikeza izinkonzo ezingokwelapha ezingenangomoya, eziphuthumayo kanye nezabantwana okufaka phakathi ukufundisa nokwesigqila.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwazo: Ithuluzi elifanele lokufunda elivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kubungekho bokungenelela obusemthethweni: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokuqashwa njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha e-HPCSA kubasebenzi abaqeqeshwe eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esifanele seminyaka eyi-1 emva kokuqashwa njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha kubungekho bokungenelela bokwezokwelapha basemaphandleni obuseduze nabalawuli ababuyekeziwe, kubasebenzi abaqeqeshwe phesheya, abadingeki ukuthi benze Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kwesikhathi esingamakhulu amashumi amahlanu eminyaka njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha emva kokuqashwa e-HPCSA njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha kubasebenzi abaqeqeshwe eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esingaphansi kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka eyisithupha emva kokuqashwa njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha emaphandleni kubungekho bokwezempilo abaseduze nalawulo lwesipiliyoni esimfundo, kubasebenzi abangadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Isipiliyoni esiyikhulu kwamashumi amahlanu eminyaka njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha emva kokuqashwa e-HPCSA njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha kubasebenzi abaqeqeshwe eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyoni esiyiminyaka eyishumi nanye emva kokuqashwa njengeDokotela Wezokwelapha emaphandleni kubungekho bokungenelela bokwezokwelapha abaseduze nalawulo lwesipiliyoni esimfundo, kubasebenzi abangadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzo Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezingokwaleli thuluzi: Abafake izibhaso kufanele babe nesatifikedi esivumelekile se-APLS/PALS. Kulungele ukuhamba endaweni yesifunda nendawo yedolobhakazi. Ikhono (ulwazi/ithuluzi): Ikhono lokuphatha ngokugcwele zonke izimo zezongakazi kufaka phakathi izimo zokuvikela izingane kanye nokuphathwa kwabaguli besigaba sesithathu. Ikhono eliveziwe lokuhola. Isipiliyoni ekuqaphelweni abasebenzi nabafundi. Isipiliyoni kanye nokuphathwa okusebenzayo kwemithombo eknikiwe. Isipiliyoni esiveziwe ekubambeni iqhaza eqenjini. Ulwazi/ithuluzi nesipiliyoni ezimisweni zokuqashwa izinkonzo, ukuhlela, ukuqashwa, ukulawula kanye nokuhlola. Ikhono eliveziwe lokuhambisana nazo zonke izidingo nemigomo yomnyango. Ulwazi oluveziwe lwezempilo yomphakathi kanye nemigqabo yezempilo yomphakathi, imiqulu exhunyiweyo kanye nemiyalo ekhubazayo ukuphatha imithombo ngokusebenzayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Isipiliyoni kwezokwelapha ezijwayelekile zezongakazi emva konkonzo yomphakathi, kufaka phakathi ukunakekelwa okusheshayo nokuhlala isikhathi eside. Kulungele ukuthuthukisa imigomo, ukuhlangana emihlanganweni kanye nokulungisa imibiko yezohlukaniswa kwezingane kanye nokuvikelwa kwezingane. Kulungele ukusebenza neyuniti yezimali, ukunakekelwa okusheshayo kanye ne-OPD kwezindaba zokuhlukaniswa kwezingane. Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuthuthukisa ulwazi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokucindezelekile futhi zigcine emzingweni ophezulu wokungenelela okungokomthetho. Ikhono kanye nokulungele ukufundisa kanye nokuqapha abafundi abaphakathi nasesiphesheli. Ulwazi lwegunya elijwayelekile lokuhlolwa kanye nezimo zezempilo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Isatifikedi sokulawula ukuphila kwezongakazi esivumelekile.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi yezokwelapha ebumbeneyo, emzingweni ophezulu yokunakekelwa kwabangenayo ngokushesha, yokuvikela izingane, kanye nezokwelapha ezijwayelekile zezingane, nogqozi ekuvikeleni izingane kanye nezimo zezempilo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Ukufundisa (okusesimisweni nangokungasesimisweni) nokwesigqila kwezokwelapha kwezongakazi (abafundi abaphakathi, abaphesheya, abahlengikazi, kanye nezempilo ezihlotshanisiwe). Dala imvelakude yokufunda kubafundi nabangane abancane ngesikhundla. Yenza okufanelekile ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha kanye nokuqashelwa emnyangweni ukuze uhlale useqandabeni ngentuthuko yezokwelapha. Ukubamba iqhaza kumaphrojekthi okuqashelwa okukhona emnyangweni ukuze uhlale useqandabeni ngentuthuko yezokwelapha. Ukuhambisana nemigomo yobulungiswa obusemthethweni nobukhulu bambuso bezokwelapha kwezongakazi. Ukuphathwa kwe-HECTIS patient management system kanye nezinye izinhlelo zezempilo ze-WCG.

xh.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 ukuya ku-3 (MEDICAL Outpatients kunye ne-Child
xh.summary: Kufuneka kuba ngu-Medical Officer Grade 1 ukuya ku-3 kwi-Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital ukuze kube khona ukunika iinkonzo ezingamaxhosa okuhamba, ezipela nasezobugcisa bokwelapha abantwana ngokubandakanya ukufundisa nokuzimela.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsili: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo. Ukubhalisa kwi-bhungo lobugcisa: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo. Isipili sphelo: Grade 1: Akukho nto kwindalo yokubhalisa njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo kwi-HPCSA malunga namaphakathi asebenzela i-SA. 1 unyaka wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo kwi-Health Professional Council yamanye amazanga evunyiweyo malunga namaphakathi asebenzela amanye amazanga, abangafunekiyo ukwenza i-Community Service njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Grade 2: Ukungenwa kokungenwa phantsi kwamava afanelekileyo kakhulu kwiminyaka elingu-5 njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo malunga namaphakathi asebenzela i-SA. Ukungenwa phantsi kwamava afanelekileyo kwiminyaka elingu-6 emva kokubhalisa njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo kwi-Health Council yamanye amazanga evunyiweyo malunga namaphakathi asebenzela amanye amazanga, abangafunekiyo ukwenza i-Community Service njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Grade 3: Ukungenwa phantsi kwamava afanelekileyo kakhulu kwiminyaka elingu-10 njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo malunga namaphakathi asebenzela i-SA. Ukungenwa phantsi kwamava afanelekileyo kwiminyaka elingu-11 emva kokubhalisa njengo-Practitioner Wezempilo kwi-Health Professions Council yamanye amazanga evunyiweyo malunga namaphakathi asebenzela amanye amazanga, abangafunekiyo ukwenza i-Community Service njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Iimfuno ezifunekayo zomsebenzi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikhethe ye-APLS/ PALS esebenzayo. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba ngaphakathi kwe-District nase-Metro Region. Ukwaziswa nokugcina ulwazi (amava): Ukuba namandla okuphatha ngokupheleleyo yonke imibandela yabantwana ngokubandakanya imibandela yokhuselwa komntwana nokuphathwa kwamaphakathi abantu abanobunganga besiganga sesithathu. Ukuba namava obuqu obukhulu ngokukhokela. Isipili sphelo ekulawulweni basebenzi nabafundi. Isipili sphelo nokulawula ngokusebenza iindlela ezabelwe ngazo. Isipili sphelo ekuwiseni isicima kolwazi kwibhunga namava obuqu ekusebenzeni nomnye. Ulwazi/amava nokugcina ulwazi obuqu ekuqwalaselweni nokuqwalasela iinkonzo, ekulungenweni, ekuhombeni, ekujolisweni nasekuhlalutyeni ngokubanzi. Isakhono esibonakalayo sokuzinza kuyo yonke iimfuno zoluntu namacebiso awo. Ulwazi obuqu ngezempilo zoluntu namacebo azo, iindlela nezaziso nasekuqwalaselweni ukulawula amacebo ngokusebenza. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Isipili sphelo kugqira wezingane jikelele emva kwe-Community Service, ngokubandakanya ukhathalelo olukhawulezayo nolude. Ukuzimisela ukwenza amacebiso, ukuza kwindibano nokulungisa iingxelo ngokuphathwa nokhuselwa kwezingane. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ne-trauma unit, ukhathalelo olukhawulezayo ne-OPD kumcimbi wokuphathwa kwezingane. Isakhono esihle sokusebenzisana nabantu nokunxibelelana. Isakhono sokuvela ngaphantsi kwegcangca lokugxinwa kukusebenza nokugcina umgangatho ophezulu wobugcisa. Isakhono nokuzimisela ukufundisa nokulawula abafundi abangenayo nabanegquma lokugqitha. Ulwazi ngamacebiso abantu beempilo eziqhelekileyo nezinde zexesha elide. Isikhundi esisebenzayo se-Advanced Paediatric Life Support.
xh.duties: Kunika iinkonzo ezingamaxhosa, ezipela ngokwakha ngokuphezulu, zokukhuselwa kwabantwana nobugcisa bezingane, njengoko kunokugqaliswa kwindalo nokhuselwa kwabantwana. Ukufundisa (ngendlela esuka kanye ngaphandle kolwazi) nokulungisa iindlela ngokubanzi kwezingane (abafundi abangenayo, abanegquma, abalogazi, nezempilo ezidityaniswe ndlela). Ukuyila inkundla yokufunda kubafundi nakumaxhulu obugcisa obukhawulezayo. Ukwenza ukuphengwa ngokobugcisa nokuphanda kwisiseko sezempilo ukugcina ulwazi ngokutsha kwezobugcisa. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumaphulo okuphanda okhoyo kwisiseko kwaye uhlale ulandele iziphumo zezobugcisa. Ukumiswa kwendlal yoluntu nokuqwalaselwa kwamacebo ezingulwazi ngokusetyenziswa ngamaphakathi e-Paediatrics. Ukulawula i-HECTIS patient management system nezinye i-WCG health applications.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL: Internal Medicine) (X2
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs). (It will be expected of the successful candidate to participate in a system of remunerated commuted overtime)
jobs.summary: Two medical officers in internal medicine sought for Groote Schuur Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration, with salaries ranging from R1,041,402 to R1,375,245 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with the Professional Council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA-qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as a Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign-qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA- qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign-qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA-qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign-qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform community service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Commuted overtime is compulsory. Emergency and after hour call cover. Valid ACLS Certificate. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and clinical skills required of a Medical Officer (e.g. Assessment, diagnosis and treatment in inpatient, outpatient, and acute medical/emergency contexts). Practical clinical skills appropriate for diagnostic investigations and those required for resuscitation and stabilisation of acutely unwell patients according to ACLS principles. Effective and efficient administration. Effective leadership & interpersonal skills. Communication including clinical summary/report generation, consultation as well as patient counselling. Completion of FCP Part 1.
jobs.duties: Provision of safe medical care to patients in the Acute Medical Admissions and Short Stay Ward, High Care Unit, Inpatient medical wards and Medical Outpatients department at Groote Schuur Hospital and satellite hospitals. Perform onsite after-hours duties as per call roster. Supervise and support medical students, interns and community service medical officers providing medical care. Involvement in research/audits relating to Internal Medicine.
jobs.enquiries: Dr D Maughan Tel No: (021) 406-6422 or email: deborah.maughan@uct.ac.za
jobs.applications: Applicants apply online: www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”)
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a practical test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). Please ensure that you attached an updated CV. Groote Schuur Hospital has adopted the department’s ecosystem framing of its training platform. Accordingly, all Medical Officer appointments may be called upon to work across this platform and may include rotations at Metro West and Rural East hospitals. This includes Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, New Somerset Hospital, Mitchells Plein District Hospital, Victoria Hospital and George Provincial Hospital. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Mediese Beampte Graad 1 tot 3 (ALGEMEEN: Interne Geneeskunde) (X2
af.summary: Twee mediese beamptes in interne geneeskunde gesoek vir Groote Schuur Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie vereis, met salarisse wat wissel van R1,041,402 tot R1,375,245 per annum.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by die Professionele Raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Pendel-oortyd is verpligtend. Nood- en buite-kantoorure oproepdekking. Geldige ACLS-sertifikaat. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en kliniese vaardighede wat van 'n Mediese Beampte vereis word (bv. Assessering, diagnose en behandeling in pasiënt-, buitepasiënt- en akute mediese/noodkontekste). Praktiese kliniese vaardighede wat toepaslik is vir diagnostiese ondersoeke en dié wat vir resussitasie en stabilisering van akutelik siek pasiënte volgens ACLS-beginsels vereis word. Doeltreffende en effektiewe administrasie. Effektiewe leierskap en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Kommunikasie insluitend kliniese opsomming/verslagopstelling, konsultasie asook pasiëntberading. Voltooiing van FCP Deel 1.
af.duties: Verskaffing van veilige mediese sorg aan pasiënte in die Acute Medical Admissions en Short Stay Ward, High Care Unit, Inpatient medical wards en Medical Outpatients departement by Groote Schuur Hospital en satelliet hospitale. Verrig ter plaatse buite-ure pligte volgens oproeprooster. Outeur en ondersteun mediese studente, interne en gemeenskapsdiens mediese beamptes wat mediese sorg verskaf. Betrokkenheid by navorsing/oudite met betrekking tot Interne Geneeskunde.

zu.summary: Kufunwa abagciwesibeleshe baye ukwelashwa kwangaphakathi (medical officers) e-Groote Schuur Hospital, kudingeka ukubhalise ku-HPCSA, njalo ngamahlathi kaholo anesikhathi esi-1,041,402 kuye ku-1,375,245 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izindingo ezincane zemfundo: Isiqinisekho esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomqashi wezempilo. Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomqashi wezempilo. Isipiliyoni esihambisanayo seminyaka engu-6 ngemva kokubhalisa njengomqashi wezempilo kwi-HPCSA yamanye amazwe, kubasebenzi abafunde emazwe aphandle labo abadingeki ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlola, ukwahlula isifo ukubhekisisa ukwelashwa kwesiguli esibekiwe, esingangenanga esibhedlela, esibhalisiwe kanye nesikhashana). Amakhono okusebenza kahle ukwelashwa kwesifo nokuhlola isifo kanye nalawo adingekayo ukubuyisa isiguli esikhathini esibuhlungu ngokuhamba ngezimiso ze-ACLS. Ukuphatha okusebenzayo nokuhamba kahle. Amakhono okuhola okusebenzayo nokuxhumana nabantu. Ukuxhumana okubandakanya ukudala umbhalo/umbiko wesifo, ukweluleka kanye nokweseka isiguli. Ukuqedwa kwe-FCP part 1.

Ukwenza imisebenzi engemva kweyure njengohlu lokusetshenziswa. Ukulawula kwesikhashana nokweseka abafundi besayensi yokwelashwa, abafundi-gciwane kanye nabagciwesibeleshe bemisebenzi yomphakathi abanikele ngokwelashwa. jobs.title: Pharmacy Supervisor
jobs.salary_text: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs).
jobs.summary: Supervise pharmacy services and drug supply management at Swartland Hospital in the Western Cape, requiring SAPC registration and at least 3 years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic qualification accredited with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) that allows registration with SAPC as a Pharmacist. Registration with a professional council: Registration as a Pharmacist with the South African Pharmacy Council. Experience: A minimum of 3 years appropriate experience after registration as a Pharmacist with the South African Pharmacy Council. Ability to cope with pressure and maintain a high standard of professionalism. Good verbal, as well as written communication skills. Sound Management, communication and conflict handling skills. Computer skills (MS Office, Word, Excel and PowerPoint).
jobs.duties: Management of Drug Supply and Prescribing habits in the hospital and sub- district. Manage, assess and monitor compliance wrt Good Pharmacy Practice, Ideal Clinic and National Core Standards. Take leadership in the hospital and sub-district to establish a value driven pharmacy service and implement policies and guidelines in keeping with the Batho Pele, SAPC, National Drug policy, National and Provincial standard treatment guidelines. Human Resource Management for all Pharmacy staff in hospital and support within the sub-district. Management of Finance and Supply Chain. Participate in continuous quality improvement initiatives and support to Clinical Manager.

Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie as 'n Apteker by die South African Pharmacy Council. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as 'n Apteker by die South African Pharmacy Council. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om as 'n Verantwoordelike Apteker te registreer. Bereidwilligheid om studente en personeel te bestuur, onderrig en op te lei. Degelige bestuurs-, kommunikasie- en konflikhanteringsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede (MS Office, Word, Excel en PowerPoint).
af.duties: Bestuur van medikasievoorsiening en voorskrywingsgewoontes in die hospitaal en subdistrik. Bestuur, beoordeel en monitor nakoming t.o.v. Good Pharmacy Practice, Ideal Clinic en National Core Standards. Ukubhaliswa eqhubelokugqamisa: Ukubhaliswa njengesilwelaphi kwi-South African Pharmacy Council. Okuhlangenwe nakho: Ukuhlangenwe nakho okuncane kweminyaka engu-3 emumva kokubhaliswa njengesilwelaphi kwi-South African Pharmacy Council. Ulwazi oluzwakalayo ngempilo yomphakathe kanye nezinqubomgomo, iziqondiso nezinyathelo ezihlobene nokuphatha imithombo ngokusebenzayo. Ubuholi bokwelapha kanye nokuhlola okuhambisana nemisebenzi yansuku zonke yezokwelapha kwiqembu elihlukene komshini we-paediatric allergology kanye neqembu le-paediatric ejwayelekile esimeni samabanga aphakeme. Nikeza usizo lokweseka kanye nokuxhasa abathumelayo nabezikhungo abathumela abaguli, njengoba kudingeka. Yenza ukuhamba ebhedlela/izinkomana zokwelapha kubasebenzi abahlukene. Phatha futhi usebenzise ngokusebenzayo nangokuphumelela imithombo enikiwe. Ukuphatha izinkonzo zezokwelapha ngokusebenzayo nangokuphumelela. Zinza kuzilingo zonke izindaba zokuqasha abantu. Yakha imibuluko yokuqondisa abafundi kanye nabahlobo abasa ngaphantsi kokuba ngabafundi nangemva kokuba ngabafundi, njengoba kudingeka. Yenza ukuhlola izinkonzo zezokwelapha kanye nokuphanda ngaphakathi komnyango ukuze ugcine ukwazi ngokuthuthuka kwezokwelapha.

jobs.title: Scientist Production Grade a (FORENSIC Toxicology) (X3
jobs.centre: Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, Observatory Forensic Pathology Institute
jobs.summary: Three forensic toxicology production scientists are sought to perform scientific analysis, method development and medico-legal services at the Observatory Forensic Pathology Institute.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Science Degree (Bsc) (Hon) or relevant qualification that allows registration as a Professional Natural Scientist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SACNASP as a Professional Natural Scientist. Experience: 3 years post qualification natural scientific experience. Inherent requirement of the job: Ability to operate specialised analytical instrumentation and perform laboratory-based analytical work. Ability to maintain a high level of accuracy, confidentiality and attention to detail under operational pressures and deadlines. Willingness to participate in after-hours or court-related duties where required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Forensic Toxicology principles and medico-legal death investigation processes. Analytical chemistry and toxicological analysis techniques, including chromatography and mass spectrometry. Operation and troubleshooting of analytical instrumentation (e.g. LC-MS/MS) and laboratory equipment. Biological specimen handlings, chain-of custody and laboratory safety procedures. Quality Management Systems and ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation requirements. Quality management and quality control principles, including the interpretation and monitoring of internal quality control data, statistical quality assurance tools and Levy-Jennings charts. Applicable legislation, ethical principles and regulatory requirements relevant to forensic science and medico-legal investigations. Research methodology, scientific writing and data analysis principles. Microsoft Office, Laboratory Information Systems, computer-based scientific applications and statistical programs, (e.g. SPSS, R). Programme and project management, staff development and operational laboratory processes. -Work with medico-legal and potentially hazardous biological specimens within a forensic environment. Analytical and problem-solving skills. -Scientific and technical preparation skills. Scientific method development, validation an data interpretation principles. Data analysis and interpretation. Technical report writing and scientific communication. Planning, organisational, and time management. Interpersonal, teamwork and communication. Training, mentoring and supervision. Attention to detail and record-keeping. Ability to work independently and under pressure within a medico-legal environment. Ability to communicate clearly and discreetly in person and in writing. Appropriate experience working in an analytical or forensic toxicology environment. Appropriate experience working within and ISO/IEC 17025 Environment. Appropriate experience operation LC-MS/MS instrumentation.
jobs.duties: Effective and efficient scientific analysis and Medico-legal service delivery. Efficient method development, validation and laboratory improvement. Effective and efficient research, innovation and knowledge generation. Effective Human Capital development and Scientific leadership. Effective Quality Management System (QMA), Compliance and Operational support.

Toepaslike ervaring om binne 'n ISO/IEC 17025 Omgewing te werk. Toepaslike ervaring in die bedrywing van LC-MS/MS-instrumentasie.

Doeltreffende Kwaliteitsbestuurstelsel (QMA), Nakoming en Operasionele steun.

jobs.title: Lecturer Grade 1 to 2 Post Graduate Diploma Nursing
jobs.centre: Western Cape College of Nursing (based at: Metro Campus)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Lecturer position in nursing education at the Western Cape College of Nursing, Metro Campus, responsible for training and assessing student nurses.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R880 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification (R212) with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Nursing Education. A post-basic nursing qualification (R212) with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in one of the following fields: Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: Trauma and Emergency. Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing (Adult), Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Orthopaedic Nursing, A relevant master’s degree (NQF L9). Or A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Nursing Education. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in one of the following fields: Emergency Nursing, Orthopaedic Nursing, Critical Care Nursing (Adult), A relevant master’s degree (NQF L9). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/ recognisable nursing experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in Nursing Education or the relevant specialty. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Possess knowledge of relevant Legislation, Acts, Prescripts and Policy frameworks informing the area of operation. Knowledge of nursing education programmes and curriculum. Proficiency in teaching and assessment in Nursing Education including evaluation approaches. Possess good communication (written & verbal) and presentation skills. Knowledge of policy development, interpretation, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation. Sound conflict management and decision making / problem solving skills. Willingness to travel. Good research and analytical skills. Good managerial and interpersonal skills. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide education and training to student nurses. Coordinate clinical learning exposure to students between college and clinical areas. Conduct clinical accompaniment of students. Coordinate the teaching and learning and assessment of R635 programmes. Develop and ensure implementation of quality assurance programmes. Collaborate with other internal and external stakeholders and build a sound relationship within the Department. Supervision of students. Participate in the development and review of nursing curricula for Post Graduate Diploma Programmes. Implements the new nursing programmes in line with SANC and CHE regulations. Participate in the provisioning of Continuous Professional Development (CPD) activities at the Campus. Participate in all governance structures of the College. Support the mission and promote the image of the college.
jobs.enquiries: Dr Magerman Tel No: (021) 684-1225
jobs.applications: Applicants apply online: www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”)
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a competency test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post- basic qualification or post-graduate qualification in the relevant specialty. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Lektor Graad 1 tot 2 Nagraadse Diploma Verpleegkunde
af.summary: Lektorposisie in verpleegkunde-onderrig by die Western Cape College of Nursing, Metro Campus, verantwoordelik vir die opleiding en assessering van studenteverpleegkundiges.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R880 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nà-basiese verpleegkunde-kwalifikasie (R212) met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar geakkrediteer by die SANC in Verpleegkunde-onderrig. 'n Nà-basiese verpleegkunde-kwalifikasie (R212) met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar geakkrediteer by die SANC in een van die volgende velde: Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: Trauma and Emergency. Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing (Adult), Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Orthopaedic Nursing, 'n Relevante meestergraad (NQF L9). Of 'n 4 jaar Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Verpleegkunde-onderrig. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in een van die volgende velde: Emergency Nursing, Orthopaedic Nursing, Critical Care Nursing (Adult), 'n Relevante meestergraad (NQF L9). Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare verpleegkundige ervaring ná registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare verpleegkundige ervaring ná registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring wees ná verkryging van die 1-jaar nà-basiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in Verpleegkunde-onderrig of die relevante spesialiteit. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Beskik oor kennis van relevante wetgewing, wette, voorskrifte en beleidsraamwerke wat die werksarea oriënteer. Kennis van verpleegkunde-onderrigprogramme en kurrikulum. Bedrewe in onderrig en assessering in Verpleegkunde-onderrig, insluitend evalueringsbenaderings. Beskik oor goeie kommunikasie (geskrewe en mondelingse) en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling, -interpretasie, -implementering, -monitering en -evaluering. Soliede konflikbestuur en besluitnemings-/probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Goeie navorsings- en analitiese vaardighede. Goeie bestuurlike en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Verskaf onderwys en opleiding aan studenteverpleegkundiges. Koördineer kliniese leerblootstelling vir studente tussen die kollege en kliniese areas. Voer kliniese begeleiding van studente uit. Koördineer die onderrig en leer en assessering van R635-programme. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van gehalteversekeringsprogramme. Werk saam met ander interne en eksterne belanghebbendes en bou 'n stewige verhouding binne die departement. Toesig oor studente. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling en hersiening van verpleegkundige kurrikula vir Nagraadse Diploma-programme. Implementeer die nuwe verpleegkunde-programme in ooreenstemming met SANC- en CHE-regulasies. Neem deel aan die verskaffing van Continuous Professional Development (CPD)-aktiwiteite by die sentrum. Neem deel aan alle bestuursstrukture van die kollege. Ondersteun die missie en bevorder die beeld van die kollege.

zu.title: Isikhundla soku-1 kuya koku-2 sokufundisa se-Post Graduate Diploma Nursing
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokufundisa kwezifundo zokwelapha e-Western Cape College of Nursing, Metro Campus, esibhekene nokuqeqesha futhikuqapha abafundi bezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokufunda esingaphansi: Isidingo se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri kwezokwelapha) noma isidingo esilinganayo (R683 ehlanganise i-R880 nehlanganise i-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesibhedlela seProfessional Nurse. Isidingo se-post-basic nursing (R212) esithatha okungenani unyaka odidiwe kwi-SANC kwe-Nursing Education. Isidingo se-post-basic nursing (R212) esithatha okungenani unyaka odidiwe kwi-SANC kwenye yalezi zinkalo: Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: Trauma and Emergency. Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing (Adult), Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Orthopaedic Nursing, Idigri ephathelene ye-master's (NQF L9). Noma Idigri ye-Bachelor yeminyaka engu-4 kwe-Nursing (R174) noma isidingo esilinganayo (R683 ehlanganise i-R1497 noma i-R171 ehlanganise i-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesibhedlela seProfessional Nurse. I-post graduate diploma (R635) edidiwe kwi-SANC kwe-Nursing Education. I-post graduate diploma (R635) edidiwe kwi-SANC kwenye yalezi zinkalo: Emergency Nursing, Orthopaedic Nursing, Critical Care Nursing (Adult), Idigri ephathelene ye-master's (NQF L9). Ukubhalisa kwikhomishana ephathele: Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njenge-Professional Nurse. Isipiliyoni: Izinga loku-1: Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yesipiliyoni esifanele/sesaziwayo sezokwelapha emva kokuvela njenge-Professional Nurse kwi-SANC kwe-General Nursing. Izinga loku-2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-14 yesipiliyoni esifanele/sesaziwayo sezokwelapha emva kokuvela njenge-Professional Nurse kwi-SANC kwe-General Nursing. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 kuleso sikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kufanele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/sesaziwayo emva kokuthola isidingo se-post-basic unyaka we-1 noma i-post-graduate diploma kwe-Nursing Education noma isikhokelo esihlobene. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Amandla (ulwazi/amasu): Ukuba nolwazi lomthetho ophathelene, ama-Acts, ama-Prescripts nama-Policy frameworks aqinisekisa indawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zezifundo zezokwelapha kanye nocingo. Ukuba lula ekufundiseni nokuholweni kwe-Nursing Education okuhlanganisa nezindlela zokuqinisekisa. Ukuba nezisu zokuxhumana (ezibhalwe nezomlomo) nezokwethula. Ulwazi ngokuqamba izinkambiso, ukuhunyusha, ukusetshenziswa, ukuqapha, nokuqinisekisa. Amandla okulawula ingxabano nokwenza izinqumo / ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuzithoba ukuzula. Amandla amahle okuphenya nokuqoqa ulwazi. Amandla amahle okuphatha nokuxhumana nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nika izifundo nokuqeqesha abafundi bezokwelapha. Linganisela ukwaziswa kokufunda kwezokwelapha kubafandi phakathi kwekolishi kanye nezindawo zezokwelapha. Qedela ukuhlala nabafandi ngesikhathi kwezokwelapha. Linganisela ukufundisa, ukufunda nokuhlola izinhlelo ze-R635. Yakha futhi uqiniseke ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izinga elihle. Sebenzisana nabanye abaphathi bangoaphakathi nangaphandle futhi yakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kukaMnyango. Qapha abafundi. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakheni futhi uhlole izifundo zobuchwepheshe zokwelapha kwezinhlelo ze-Post Graduate Diploma. Setsha izinhlelo ezisha zezokwelapha ngokuvumelana nemithetho ye-SANC ne-CHE. Thatha inxaxheye ekubeni ngezinkqubo zokuqeqesha okuqhubelekayo (CPD) eSikhungweni. Thatha inxaxhebo kuzo zonke izakhiwo ezibusayo zeKolishi. Sekela umgomo futhi ukhuthaze isithombe sekolishi.

xh.title: Umfundisi Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 iDiploma ePhakamileyo yesiqu Yokhathalelo lwabagulayo
xh.summary: Isithuba somfundisi kwimfundo yokhathalelo lwabagulayo kwiWestern Cape College of Nursing, Metro Campus, enemviswano yokuqeqesha nokuqwalasela abafundi bokhathalelo lwabagulayo.

Isiqu sokhathalelo lwabagulayo esingaphaya kweziseko (R212) esithatha ubuncinane unyaka wesi-1 ogunyiwe yi-SANC kuMfundo Yokhathalelo lwabagulayo. Isiqu sokhathalelo lwabagulayo esingaphaya kweziseko (R212) esithatha ubuncinane unyaka wesi-1 ogunyiwe yi-SANC kwenye yezi ndawo zilandelayo: Isayensi Yokhathalelo lwabagulayo lwaBantu abaGulayo aPhakathi nokuQhunyiswa: Ukukhathalela iingozi nokuGqithisa eBungeni. Isayensi Yokhathalelo lwabagulayo lwaBantu abaGulayo aPhakathi nokuQhunyiswa (abadala), Isayensi Yokhathalelo lwabagulayo lwaBantu abaGulayo beNtshiyo, Idigri yamasters ehambelana nayo (NQF L9). Okt Idigri yeBachelors yeminyaka eyi-4 ekhathalelo lwabagulayo (R174) okanye isiqu esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengonganga ogunjiniwe. Idiploma ephakamileyo yesiqu (R635) egunyiwe yi-SANC kuMfundo Yokhathalelo lwabagulayo. Idiploma ephakamileyo yesiqu (R635) egunyiwe yi-SANC kwenye yezi ndawo zilandelayo: Ukukhathalela iingozi eBungeni, Ukukhathalela iintshiyo, Ukukhathalela abagulayo aPhakathi nokuQhunyiswa (abadala), Idigri yamasters ehambelana nayo (NQF L9). Ukbhaliso kolawulo lwabogunjini: Ukbhaliso kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengonganga ogunjiniwe. Amapupu: Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane iminyaka eyi-4 yamava ohambelana naye/okubonakalayo kokhathalelo lwabagulayo emva kokubhalisa njengonganga ogunjiniwe kwi-SANC kuKhathalelo lwabagulayo jikelele. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane iminyaka eyi-14 yamava ohambelana naye/okubonakalayo kokhathalelo lwabagulayo emva kokubhalisa njengonganga ogunjiniwe kwi-SANC kuKhathalelo lwabagulayo jikelele. Ubuncinane iminyaka eyi-10 yexesha elithethwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava ahambelana naye/okubonakalayo emva kokufumana isiqu sonyaka wesi-1 esingaphaya kweziseko okanye idiploma ephakamileyo yesiqu kuMfundo Yokhathalelo lwabagulayo okanye inkalo echaphazelekayo. Iimfuno ezibakhuselo lomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yomqhubi (Code B/EB) eseleyo. Amandla (ulwazi/amasizi): Ukuba nolwazi lweMigaqo yaseMthethweni, eeMithetho, iMigaqo yeZiko neMigaqo yokuLawula ekhokela indawo entshutsho. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zemfundo zokhathalelo lwabagulayo nezikimu zemfundo. Ukuba nobugcisa ekufundiseni nokuqwalasela eMfundweni Yokhathalelo lwabagulayo kuquka iindlela zokuqwalasela. Ukuba namandla anomdla wokuthetha (kubhalwe nangomlomo) nokuvezwa kwemizekeliso. Ulwazi ngokupepha, ukuceketisa, ukuzisa kwinkqubo, ukuqwalasela, nokuqwalasela imigaqo. Amandla okulawula iingxabano nokwenza izigqibo / ukusombulula iingxaki. Ukulungele ukuhamba. Amandla amabali wokhathalelo abo abantu nokuhlola. Amandla okulawula abantu nokuba nobudlelwane. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika imfundo nokuqeqeswa kwabafundi bokhathalelo lwabagulayo. Lungelelanisa ukunyatheliswa kwemfundo yamava okusesidlangalweni kubafundi phakathi kwesikolo nendawo yamava okusesidlangalweni. Qeqesha abafundi ngokuqhubekayo kwizikimu zabo ezisesidlangalweni. Lungelelanisa ukufundisa nokufunda nokulinganisa kwezinkqubo ze-R635. Phepha ukuqinisekiswa kokusebenza kweenkqubo zokuqinisekisa umgangatho. Sebenzisana nabanye babathunywa bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze usake amaqhina amandla ngaphakathi kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwabafundi. Thatha inxaxheba ekuphepheni nokuqwalaselweni kwezikimu zokhathalelo lwabagulayo kweziNqanaba zeDiploma ePhakamileyo. Zisa kwinkqubo iinkqubo ezintsha zokhathalelo lwabagulayo ngokwemigaqo ye-SANC ne-CHE. Thatha inxaxheba ekunikeni iinkqubo zophuhliso lwamava okuqhubekayo (CPD) eKhubini. Thatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke iinkqubo zolawulo zeSikolo. Nxiba isiphithiphathi kwaye wandise isithobe sesikolo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Operating
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Operating Theatre) at Paarl Hospital providing specialised clinical nursing care and supervising staff in the theatre unit.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre. A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Peri-operative Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. At least 10 years referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the 1 year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work shifts, night duty, overtime, public holidays and weekends to meet the operational requirements. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of relevant legislation and policies of the Department of Health Western Cape. Ability to function independently, as well as in a multi-disciplinary team to ensure good patient care. Ability to communicate effectively (both written and verbal). Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Leadership towards the realisation of strategic goals and objectives of Operating Theatre Unit. Skills to plan organise and the service by analysing problem, problem solving and decision making.
jobs.duties: Render and supervise specialized clinical nursing care and support clinical staff with procedures within the specific clinical specialty unit. Utilise human, material and physical resources and development of self and others. Display core values of the Department of Health and Wellness (WCG)on the execution of duties, while practicing within the legislation, regulations and protocols applicable to the public service. Ensure quality patient care regarding the identification of nursing care needs, the planning and implementation of nursing care plans and the education of nursing personnel as a Professional Nurse in the specific specialty clinical area.
jobs.enquiries: Ms LI Cupido, email, Le-Anchen.Cupido@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applicants apply online: www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”)
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the required qualification will be appointed into the general stream, and they will be required to obtain the necessary qualification within a predetermined period of time. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post basic qualification or a post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.
