af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Operating
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Operasiesaal) by Paarl Hospital wat gespesialiseerde kliniese verpleegsorg verskaf en personeel in die teatereenheid toesig hou.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.i. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre. 'n 4 jaar Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Peri-operative Nursing. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ten minste 10 jaar waarna hierbo verwys word, moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring na verkryging van die 1 jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit wees. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte, nagdiens, oortyd, openbare vakansiedae en naweke te werk om aan die operasionele vereistes te voldoen. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleide van die Department of Health Western Cape. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer, asook in 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie pasiëntesorg te verseker. Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (sowel skriftelik as mondelings). Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook). Leierskap tot die verwesenliking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke van die Operating Theatre-eenheid. Vaardighede om die diens te beplan en te organiseer deur probleemanalise, probleemoplossing en besluitneming.
af.duties: Lewen en hou toesig oor gespesialiseerde kliniese verpleegsorg en ondersteun kliniese personeel met prosedures binne die spesifieke kliniese spesialiteitseenheid. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne en die ontwikkeling van self en andere. Toon kernwaardes van die Department of Health and Wellness (WCG) by die uitvoering van pligte, terwyl daar binne die wetgewing, regulasies en protokolle wat op die openbare diens van toepassing is, gepraktyk word. Verseker gehalte pasiëntesorg met betrekking tot die identifisering van verpleegsorgbehoeftes, die beplanning en implementering van verpleegsorgplanne en die opleiding van verpleegpersoneel as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in die spesifieke spesialiteit kliniese area.

zu.title: Uguleqeqethe ohloniphekile Izinga 1 kuya ku-2 (OKUKHETHEKILE: Operating
zu.summary: Uguleqeqethe ohloniphekile (I-Theatre Theatre) ePaarl Hospital okunika ukunakekelwa kwabaguli okukhethekile kwezokwelapha futhi uphatha abasebenzi endaweni ye-theatre.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Isidingo se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu e-zokunakekela abaguli) noma isidingo esilinganayo (R683) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguleqeqethe ohloniphekile. Isidingo sokunakekela abaguli semva kweziqu, esithatha isikhathi esingathathi kalula unyaka, esagunyaziwe yi-SANC kwi-Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre. Iziqu zobungci bosuka emnyakeni we-4 e-Nursing (R174) noma isidingo esilinganayo (R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoguleqeqethe ohloniphekile. Idiploma yokuhlela okuphezulu (R635) esagunyaziwe yi-SANC kwi-Peri-operative Nursing. Ukubhalisa kwi-south african nursing council: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoguleqeqethe ohloniphekile. Okuhlolwayo: Izinga 1: Okuncane okuncane iminyaka eyi-4 yokuhlolwa okuhambisana/nokwaziwayo ezokunakekela abaguli ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoguleqeqethe ohloniphekile. Izinga 2: Okuncane okuncane iminyaka eyi-14 yokuhlolwa okuhambisana/nokwaziwayo ezokunakekela abaguli ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoguleqeqethe ohloniphekile. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 okushiwo ngentla kumele ibe yihlolwa okuhambisana/nokwaziwayo ngemva kokuthola isidingo semva kweziqu semnyaka owodwa noma idiploma yokuhlela okuphezulu ekhaleni lokuhlela. Izidingo ezimqoka zomsebenzi: Ukuthanda ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha, isibopho ebusuku, ukusebenza ngaphezu kwebanga, namaholide abantu kanye namasonto phakathi namasonto ukwenzela ukwaneliseza izidingo zokusebenza. Izindidi (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye namapulani eDepartment of Health Western Cape. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele, kanye nokuqoqa abantu abahlukene ukwenzela ukwaneliseza ukunakekelwa kwabaguli. Ikhono lokuxhumana ngokusebenza (kokubili okulotshiwe nokukhulunywa). Ukwazi kwezakhwama ngabakheni (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook). Ukukhonza kuleminsetjentfwe yesikhombisana semigomo nemigomo yase-Theatre Theatre Unit. Ulwazi lokuhlela ukuphumelelisa ulwazi Ikhono lokuhlela ukulungisa ukulawula isevisi ngokuhlaziya inkinga, ukuxazulula inkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo.
zu.duties: Nika futhi uphathe ukunakekelwa kwabaguli okukhethekile kwezokwelapha, futhi useke abasebenzi bezokwelapha ngezinhlolelo ngaphakathi kwesikhungla esikhethekile sezokwelapha. Sebenzisa abantu, izinsiza kanye nemithombo yezemidlalo nokuthuthukisa kwakho nokwabanye. Khombisa amagugu ayisisekelo eDepartment of Health and Wellness (WCG) ekwenzeni imisebenzi, ngenkathi usebenza ngaphakathi kwemithetho, imithetholawula kanye namaphrotokoholi asebenza kumnyango kazezimali. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwabaguli okukanani mayelana nokubona izidingo zokunakekelwa kwabaguli, ukuhlela nokuphatha amapulani okunakekelwa kwabaguli kanye nokuqeqesha abasebenzi bezokunakekela abaguli njengoguleqeqethe ohloniphekile endaweni ekhethekile yokunakekelwa kwabaguli.

xh.title: Umongikazi ongcali weDegree 1 ukuya kwiDegree 2 (ISIKOLO: Operating
xh.summary: Umongikazi ongcali (Operating Theatre) e Paarl Hospital ebonelela ngekhatho lempliliso elingcali elizele lwempilo kwaye ulawule abasebenzi kwicala lokuhlinza.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingowona sasekolishi: Isidanga se-Basic R425 (okt ithuba/degree kwindawo yokuhlinzwa) okanye isidanga esilinganayo (R683) esikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwi South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ongcali. Isidanga sokupheliswa kwezemfundo ezingowonaCALI, esithatha unyaka omnye ubukhulu, kwi-SANC kwizifundo zokuhlinzwa ezikwisibhedlele: Indawo yokuhlinza. Isidanga se-4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) okanye esilinganayo (R171 plus R1497) esikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwi South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ongcali. Isidanga se-post-graduate (R635) esibhalisiwe kwi-SANC kwizifundo ze-Peri-operative Nursing. Ukuhlaliswa koluntu: Ubhaliso kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ongcali. Isipilingo: Isidanga 1: Okanye iminyaka eli-4 engowona mlambo oqondwayo wemfundo ngena kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ongcali. Isidanga 2: Okanye iminyaka eli-14 engowona mlambo oqondwayo wemfundo ngena kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ongcali. Okanye iminyaka eli-10 edwelwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngowona mlambo oqondwayo emva kokuqesha isidanga so-1 year post-basic okanye i-post-graduate diploma kwicala elithandathu. Iimfuno eziyimfuneko yomsebenzi: Ukuza kulindele ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa kweeshift, ebusuku, ngaphezu kwexesha, ngeentsuku zohloliseko nangamaviki ukuze uhambelane neemfuno zokusebenza. Iimpawu zokusebenza (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngemithetho nemigaqo ye Department of Health Western Cape. Ukuzinikela ukusebenza kodwa, nakuluhlu lweqela elinamagunya amaninzi ukuvumela ukuba igazi lithathele ikhatho elilungileyo. Ukuzinikela ukuzithetha ngokusebenziselelwano (ngokubhaliweyo nangokuthethwayo). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Ubuqu ekufikeleleni iinjongo ezibalulekileyo neziqu zenkqubo ye Operating Theatre Unit. Amakhono okuqamba, ukulawula inkonzo ngokuhlalutya iingxaki, ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo.
xh.duties: Nika inkathazo eluhlaza kwimeko yezempilo eyingcali kwaye ulawule abasebenzi basekliniki kunye nendlela yokwenza izinto kwicandelo elithile lezempilo eyingcali. Sebenzisa izixhobo zendalo, izinto ezibonakalayo kwaye uphucule wena nabo bonke abantu. Bonisa iimvakalelo eziyimfuneko ze Department of Health and Wellness (WCG) ngelixa usenza imisebenzi yakho, ukuze uhambelane nemigaqo, iimithetho nemigaqo yesebenza yorhulumente. Qinisekisa ukhatho olulungileyo lwegazi malunga nokuqonda iimfuno zokhatho lwesiguli, ukuqamba nokuphumeza iplani yokukhathiswa kwesiguli kunye nokuqeqesha abasebenzi basemplilweni njengomongikazi ongcali kwicala elithile lezempilo ezingcali.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Information Management (SYSTEM
jobs.summary: Manage clinical systems and electronic health records across Western Cape hospitals and clinics, overseeing maintenance, access control, and user support.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate 3-year National Diploma or Degree. Experience: Appropriate experience in health facility administrative and clinical processes. Appropriate experience in primary health care facility systems. Appropriate experience in training and supporting system users on clinical applications. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s license. Willingness to travel to WCDHW health institutions. Willingness to work overtime. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Extensive knowledge and experience in clinical health systems. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to work in a team environment. Ability to provide user training and support. Accurate data capturing skills. Computer literacy, including MS Office and MS Project. Knowledge of all health information systems and modules within the Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness. Understanding of business process re-engineering. Understanding of system maintenance and enhancement process flows. Understanding and development of quality control processes.
jobs.duties: Manage and control the clinical systems and modules across all hospitals and clinics in the Western Cape. Oversee the maintenance of systems, documentation, access control, and print management. Maintenance and Support of the Electronic Health Record. Manage and ensure updates for annual or ad hoc regulatory changes. Liaise with HIS management, hospital management, IT and other stakeholders on clinical system matters. Provide end-user support and resolve system problems for clinical systems. Update and maintain user manuals and clinical system procedures. Oversee system changes and manage test processes with formal outcome reporting. Develop system release notices for system changes and ensure user awareness. Oversee training needs and training for users and core trainers. -Assist with data quality assurance. Manage compliance with system release logs and exception reports. Drive business process re-engineering in clinical system- related areas across hospitals. Support development and administration of new clinical system modules. Manage System Controllers. Collaborate with the Finance and clinical documentation teams to ensure compliance of clinical systems with hospital fees and patient administration policies and manage new enhancement requests through to deployment where accepted. Provide ad hoc support to the Deputy Director: eHealth Systems.
jobs.enquiries: Mr J Maharaj Tel No: (021) 938-6513

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Inligtingbestuur (STELSEL)
af.summary: Bestuur kliniese stelsels en elektroniese gesondheidsrekords in hospitale en klinieke in die Western Cape, hou toesig oor instandhouding, toegangsbeheer en gebruikerondersteuning.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike 3-jarige Nasionale Diploma of Graad. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in administratiewe en kliniese prosesse van 'n gesondheidsfasiliteit. Toepaslike ervaring in stelsels van primêre gesondheidsorgfasiliteite. Toepaslike ervaring in die opleiding en ondersteuning van stelselgebruikers vir kliniese toepassings. Inherent vereiste van die pos: Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om na WCDHW-gesondheidsinstellings te reis. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitgebreide kennis en ervaring in kliniese gesondheidsstelsels. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Bewese vermoë om in 'n spanomgewing te werk. Vermoë om gebruikeropleiding en ondersteuning te bied. Akkurate datavasleggingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend MS Office en MS Project. Kennis van alle gesondheidsinligtingstelsels en modules binne die Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness. Begrip van besigheidsprosesherontwerp. Begrip van stelselinstandhouding en verbeteringsprosesvloeie. Begrip en ontwikkeling van gehaltebeheerprosesse.
af.duties: Bestuur en beheer die kliniese stelsels en modules oor alle hospitale en klinieke in die Western Cape. Hou toesig oor die instandhouding van stelsels, dokumentasie, toegangsbeheer en drukbestuur. Instandhouding en ondersteuning van die elektroniese gesondheidsrekord. Bestuur en verseker bywerkings vir jaarlikse of ad hoc regulasiewysigings. Skakel met HIS-bestuur, hospitaalbestuur, IT en ander belanghebbendes oor kliniese stelselaangeleenthede. Bied eindgebruikerondersteuning en los stelselprobleme vir kliniese stelsels op. Werk gebruikershandleidings en kliniese stelselprosedures by en hou dit in stand. Hou toesig oor stelselwysigings en bestuur toetsprosesse met formele uitslaatverslagdoening. Ontwikkel stelselvrystellingskennisgewings vir stelselwysigings en verseker gebruikersbewustheid. Hou toesig oor opleidingsbehoeftes en opleiding vir gebruikers en kernopvoeders. -Assisteer met datagehaltewaarborg. Bestuur nakoming van stelselvrystellingslogs en uitsonderingsverslae. Dryf besigheidsprosesherontwerp in kliniese stelselverwante areas oor hospitale aan. Ondersteun ontwikkeling en administrasie van nuwe kliniese stelselmodules. Bestuur stelselbeheerders. Werk saam met die Finance en kliniese dokumentasiespanne om nakoming van kliniese stelsels met hospitaalgelde en pasiëntadministrasiebeleid te verseker en bestuur nuwe verbeteringsversoeke deur tot ontplooiing waar aanvaar. Verskaf ad hoc ondersteuning aan die Adjunkdirekteur: eHealth-stelsels.

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqonga: Ukuphathwa Kolwazi (SYSTEM
zu.summary: Phatha amasistimu okwelapha kanye namarekhodi ezempilo abhalwe ngokubhalisiwe emahospitela nakemitholanga eWestern Cape, ubukele ukugcinwa, ukulawula ukufinyelela, kanye nokwesekwa abasebenzisi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingesona ngaphansi kokuze: I-National Diploma noma i-Degree ezifanelekile yeminyaka engu-3. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanelekile kumagatsha okuphatha kwezempilo kanye namaphrosesi okwelapha. Isipiliyoni esifanelekile kumasistimu wesikhungo senkathi yokuqala yokwelapha. Isipiliyoni esifanelekile ekulolongeni nasekusekelweni abasebenzisi besistimu kumapulogwamu okwelapha. Isidingo esibelekelayo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuza ngokuthanda ukuhamba ezindaweni zezempilo ze-WCDHW. Ukuza ngokuthanda ukusebenza ngemva kwesikhathi. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhono): Ulwazi olubanzi kanye nesipiliyoni kumasistimu ezempilo okwelapha. Izikhono ezinhle zokuxhumana nabantu. Ikhono elibonakaliswe lokusebenza emaphanini. Ikhono lokunika ulolongo lwabasebenzisi kanye nokusekelwa. Izikhono zokungena kwemininingwane ngokunembile. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, okuhlanganisa i-MS Office kanye ne-MS Project. Ulwazi ngawo wonke amasistimu kanye namamojula wolwazi ngezempilo ngaphakathi kwaWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness. Ukuqonda kokuphakanyiswa kabusha kwamaphrosesi ebhizinisi. Ukuqonda ukugcinwa kwesistimu kanye namaphulosi okuthuthukisa ukugeleza. Ukuqonda nokuthuthukisa amaphulosi okulawula izinga.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ulawule amasistimu kanye namamojula okwelapha kuwo wonke amahospitela nakemitholanga eWestern Cape. Buka phezulu ukugcinwa kwamasistimu, ukubhalisiwe, ukulawula ukufinyelela, kanye nokuphathwa kokuphrinta. Ukugcinwa kanye nokusekelwa kwerekhodi ezempilo abhalisiwe ngokubhalisiwe. Phatha futhi uqinisekise izibuyekezo zezinguquko zemithesho yonyaka noma ezenzelwe isikhashana. Xhumana nokuphathwa kwe-HIS, ukuphathwa kwehospitela, i-IT kanye nabanye abantu abahlobene nemisebenzi yamasistimu okwelapha. Nikeza ukwesekwa kwabasebenzisi bokuqeda futhi uxazulule izinkinga zamasistimu wokwelapha. Buyekeza futhi ugcinde imanuwali yabasebenzisi kanye namaphulosi okwelapha amasistimu. Buka phezulu izinguquko zesistimu futhi uphathe amaphulosi ahlolwe ngebika lemiphumela esemthethweni. Thuthukisa izaziso zokukhishwa kwesistimu ngezinguquko zesistimu futhi uqinisekise ukwaziswa kwabasebenzisi. Buka phezulu izidingo zokololho kanye nokuqeqesha abasebenzisi nabalolongi ababalulekile. -Siza ekubukeni izinga ledatha ngokunembile. Phatha ukuziphatha ngokulandela amalogu okukhishwa kwesistimu kanye namarekhodi ekuhlotsheni. Qhushumba iinguqu zenkqubo ulawule iinkqubo zovavanyo ngengxelo echanekileyo yesiphumo. Qhuthumba iindaba zokuveza inkqubo ngenxa yenguqu ulawule ugqo lomngxeki. Nceda ekuphuhlisweni nolawulo lweemodyulu ezintsha zenkqubo zoqoqosho. Lawula abalawuli beenkqubo. jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver’s license (Code B/EB). Must be willing to assist at other facilities within the Substructure. Willingness to work shifts, night shift and overtime when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of Nursing Care processes and procedures Nursing Act. Problem-solving and decision-making. Report writing skills. Health promotion and team building. Good communication and interpersonal skills.
jobs.duties: Provide direction and supervision for the implementation of quality comprehensive nursing care within the Primary Health Care context. Maintain ethical practices within legal and regulatory frameworks. Maintain a constructive working relationship will all relevant stakeholders of the Primary Health Care team. Utilize human, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Participate in training programmes and research activities. Maintain workplace disciplinary of sub-ordinates.

zu.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL Nursing) (VARIOUS
zu.summary: Izikhundla ze-Professional Nurse kumanyuvesi amaningi e-Western Cape e-Primary Health Care, edinga idiploma noma idigri yokunursing ene-SANC registration, neholo elinganiselwe ku-R337359 kuya ku-R495423 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi kwemfundo: Basic R425 qualification (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ezokwelapha) noma isidingo esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoba uNesi ogunyaziwe. Noma 4-year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) noma isidingo esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoba uNesi ogunyaziwe. Ukubhaliswa kwikhalenda labangunyazi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengeProfessional Nurse. Isipiliyoni: Grade 1: Akukho. Grade 2: Ucingo lweminyaka engu-10 lokubeka okuhle/okuhlonishwa ekwelapheni ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengeProfessional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 3: Ucingo lweminyaka engu-20 lokubeka okuhle/okuhlonishwa ekwelapheni ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengeProfessional Nurse in General Nursing. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo (Code B/EB). Kufanele ukuba uvume ukusiza emanyuvesini aphakathi kwe-Substructure. Ukuvuma ukusebenza ngokushintshana, ukusebenza ebusuku nangaphezulu kwesikhathi uma kudingeka. Izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/izindlela): Ulwazi lwezindlela nokuhlelwa kweNursing Care Nursing Act. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Izindlela zokubhala imibiko. Ukukhuthaza impilo yabantu nokwakha amaqembu. Ukuxhumana kahle nolwazi lobuntu obuhle.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso nobuququli ekusebenzeni kwanobungcweti ekunakekelweni okuphelele kwesiguli ngaphakathi kwezimo ze-Primary Health Care. Gcina izindlela ezifanele zokuziphatha ngaphakathi kwemiThetho nemihlobo yayo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabo bonke abahlanganyeli abahlobene neqembu le-Primary Health Care. Sebenzisa izinsizakusebenza zomuntu, izinto kanye nezinto ezingokwemvelo ngendlela esebenzayo neyanele. Hlanganyela kumuhle wokuqeqesha imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi yocwaningo. Gcina isithunywa sokuziphatha kwindawo yokusebenza kwabangaphansi kwakho.

xh.title: Umhlengi ochungechphi weNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (UNqeqwesifo jikelele lweBheshte) (EZAHLUKENEYO
xh.summary: Izithuba zabahlengi ochungechphi kumaziko amaninzi ezoempilo eentsapho eWestern Cape, efuna idiploma okanye isidanga sokuhlenga kunye nogunyaziso lweSANC, lomvuzo uphehlelelwa ukusuka ku-R337359 ukuya ku-R495423 ngonyaka.

OKU Isidanga seBachelor seminyaka emi-4 eHlengeni (R174) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 okanye R171 plus R1497) esivumela ogunyaziso kunye neSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengi ochungechphi. Ugqanyiso kwibhunga lochungechphi: Ugqanyiso kwiSANC njengomhlengi ochungechphi. Imvelaphi: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-10 yemvelaphi evunywe ngokuhlenga emva kogunyaziso kwiSANC njengomhlengi ochungechphi kuNqeqwesifo jikelele. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-20 yemvelaphi evunywe ngokuhlenga emva kogunyaziso kwiSANC njengomhlengi ochungechphi kuNqeqwesifo jikelele. Iimfuno ezibangelwa msebenzi: Ilayisenisi yomqhubi esemthethweni (iCode B/EB). Kufuneka ube ngumntu olungele ukuncedela kwezinye iziko ngaphakathi kweSubstructure. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ithuba, ngobusuku nakumaxesha ongaphezulu kwemithetho xa kufuneka. Amappondo (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngeenkqubo namacebo onke lweNurses Act. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo. Unyuso lwempilo nokwakha iqela. Unxibelelwano oluhle namakhono onxibelelwano nosapho.
xh.duties: Nika isalathiso nolawulo lolwazi olubanzi lwezoxhitsho zemilinganisyo elungileyo ehle kwindalo yePrimary Health Care. Rhoqo zilandela umthetho oluqondayo uluntu nakwiinkqubo ezithethwe ngumthetho ezinye. Rhokotha ubudlelwane obuzemowokho boyakiya bonke abo bafakiweyo eqelini lePrimary Health Care. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto nezinto ezingomzimba ngokusebenza kakuhle kwaye ngamandla. Ngenela kumacandwo okuziilisa noshishino lobugcisa obutsha. Rhwememelela umthetho wezendawo ngokulawula abo bungaphantsi.

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R334 227 per annum Grade 2: R413 199 per annum Grade 3: R506 496 per annum Grade 4: R593 079 per annum
jobs.summary: Paramedic Grade 1 to 4 position within Western Cape Emergency Medical Services focused on continuous quality improvement and clinical governance in emergency care delivery.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Grade 1: Successful completion of the Critical Care Assistant (CCA) programmes that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Paramedic. -Grade 2: Successful completion of the Critical Care Assistant programme or a Recognized National Diploma that allows registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic. Grade 3: Successful completion of the Critical Care Assistant (CCA) programme or a Recognized National Diploma that allows registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic or B Tech Degree that allows registration with the HPCSA as Emergency Care Practitioner. Grade 4: Successful completion of the Critical Care Assistant (CCA) programme or a Recognized National Diploma that allows registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic or B Tech Degree that allows registration with the HPCSA as Emergency Care Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Grade 1: Registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic (CCA). Grade 2: Registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic with CCA or National Diploma. Grade 3: Registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic with CCA or National Diploma or ECP. Grade 4: Registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic with CCA or National Diploma or ECP. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic (CCA). Grade 2: 7 years after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic (CCA). None after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic with National Diploma. Grade 3: Registered Paramedic (CCA) - 14 years after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic. Registered Paramedic (NDip) - 7 years after registration with the HPCSA as a Paramedic. Registered ECP– None. Grade 4: Registered Paramedic (CCA) - 24 years after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic. Registered Paramedic (NDip) - 17 years after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic. Registered ECPs-10 years after registration with the HPCSA as an ECP. Inherent requirement of the job: Physical and mental fitness. Valid code C1 driver’s license. Valid professional driver’s permit (PrDP). Competencies (knowledge/skills): Excellent knowledge of all levels of emergency care protocols within the scope of registration category. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Computer literacy and skills.
jobs.duties: Clinical Quality Assurance & Patient Safety: Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive quality improvement frameworks to ensure consistent, high-standard emergency care delivery from roadside to bedside Establish and maintain robust clinical governance structures, including incident reporting systems, adverse event management, and patient safety protocols. Monitor and evaluate clinical performance against established emergency response timeframes and quality benchmarks across all service platforms. Coordinate systematic collection and analysis of patient feedback, complaints, compliments, and clinical outcomes to drive service improvements. Clinical Leadership & Professional Development: Provide strategic clinical leadership and mentorship to prehospital emergency care providers across all levels of service delivery. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop evidence- based clinical protocols, care pathways, and operational guidelines Design and facilitate continuous professional development programs, including clinical coaching, skills enhancement, and competency assessments Establish clinical oversight mechanisms to support real-time decision-making and maintain clinical excellence standards. Quality Improvement Program Management: Design, implement, and evaluate targeted quality improvement initiatives based on current evidence, best practices, and local contextual needs. Coordinate cross-functional quality improvement projects involving clinical, operational, and administrative stakeholders. Establish data-driven performance monitoring systems to track clinical outcomes, response times, and service effectiveness. Lead root cause analysis processes for clinical incidents and develop corrective action plans to prevent recurrence. Strategic Clinical Governance: Uphold and promote patient-centred care principles throughout all emergency medical service operations. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, professional standards, and organisational policies across geographic and clinical service platforms. Develop and maintain clinical standards, protocols, and quality metrics that align with national emergency medical service guidelines. Provide clinical expertise and leadership input for strategic planning and service development initiatives. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between clinical teams, management, and external healthcare partners. Represent the organisation in clinical governance forums, quality improvement networks, and professional development initiatives. Maintain relationships with regulatory bodies, healthcare institutions, and community stakeholders to support integrated emergency care delivery. Prepare and present clinical performance reports, quality improvement outcomes, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

af.title: Paramedic Graad 1 tot 4 (EMS deurlopende kwaliteit
af.summary: Paramedic Graad 1 tot 4 pos binne Western Cape Emergency Medical Services wat fokus op deurlopende kwaliteitsverbetering en kliniese bestuur in die lewerering van noodsgese hulp.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Graad 1: Geslaagde voltooiing van die Critical Care Assistant (CCA) programme wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Paramedic toelaat. -Graad 2: Geslaagde voltooiing van die Critical Care Assistant programme of 'n Erkende Nasionale Diploma wat registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic toelaat. Graad 3: Geslaagde voltooiing van die Critical Care Assistant (CCA) programme of 'n Erkende Nasionale Diploma wat registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic toelaat of B Tech Degree wat registrasie met die HPCSA as Emergency Care Practitioner toelaat. Graad 4: Geslaagde voltooiing van die Critical Care Assistant (CCA) programme of 'n Erkende Nasionale Diploma wat registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic toelaat of B Tech Degree wat registrasie met die HPCSA as Emergency Care Practitioner toelaat. Registrasie met 'n professionele raad: Graad 1: Registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic (CCA). Graad 2: Registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic met CCA of National Diploma. Graad 3: Registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic met CCA of National Diploma of ECP. Graad 4: Registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic met CCA of National Diploma of ECP. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic (CCA). Graad 2: 7 jaar na registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic (CCA). Geen na registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic met National Diploma. Graad 3: Geregistreerde Paramedic (CCA) - 14 jaar na registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic. Geregistreerde Paramedic (NDip) - 7 jaar na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Paramedic. Geregistreerde ECP – Geen. Graad 4: Geregistreerde Paramedic (CCA) - 24 jaar na registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic. Geregistreerde Paramedic (NDip) - 17 jaar na registrasie met die HPCSA as Paramedic. Geregistreerde ECPs - 10 jaar na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n ECP. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Fisieke en geestelike geskiktheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie kode C1. Geldige professionele bestuurderspermit (PrDP). Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende kennis van alle vlakke van noodsaaklike sorg protokolle binne die omvang van die registrasiekategorie. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid en vaardighede.
af.duties: Kliniese gehalteversekering en pasiëntveiligheid: Lei die ontwikkeling en implementering van omvattende gehalteverbeteringsraamwerke om konsekwente, hoëstandaard noodsaaklike sorg lewering van padkant tot bedkant te verseker. Vestig en handhaaf robuuste kliniese bestuursstrukture, insluitend voorvalverslagstawelsels, bestuur van nadelige gebeurtenisse, en pasiëntveiligheidsprotokolle. Monitor en evalueer kliniese prestasie teenoor vasgestelde noodreaksie-tydraamwerke en gehaltemylpale oor alle diensplatforms. Koördineer stelselmatige insameling en analise van pasiëntterugvoer, klagtes, komplimente, en kliniese uitkomste om diensverbetering te dryf. Kliniese leierskap en professionele ontwikkeling: Verskaf strategiese kliniese leierskap en mentorskap aan prehospitale noodsaaklike sorgverskaffers oor alle vlakke van dienslewering. Werk saam met multidissiplinêre spanne om bewysgebaseerde kliniese protokolle, sorgroetes, en operasionele riglyne te ontwikkel. Ontwerp en fasiliteer deurlopende professionele ontwikkelingsprogramme, insluitend kliniese afrigting, vaardigheidsverbetering, en bevoegdheidsassessering. Vestig kliniese toesigmeganismes om realtydbesluitneming te ondersteun en kliniese uitnemendheidsstandaarde te handhaaf. Bestuur van gehalteverbeteringsprogramme: Ontwerp, implementeer, en evalueer gerigte gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe gebaseer op huidige bewyse, beste praktyke, en plaaslike kontekstuele behoeftes. Koördineer kruisfunksionele gehalteverbeteringsprojekte wat kliniese, operasionele, en administratiewe belanghebbendes behels. Vestig datagedrewe prestasiemonitoringstelsels om kliniese uitkomste, reaksietye, en diensdoeltreffendheid op te spoor. Lei oorsaakanalise-prosesse vir kliniese voorvalle en ontwikkel korrektiewe aksieplanne om herhaling te voorkom. Strategiese kliniese bestuur: Handhaaf en bevorder pasiëntgesentreerde sorgbeginsels deur alle noodmediese diensoperasies. Verseker nakoming van regulerende vereistes, professionele standaarde, en organisatoriese beleide oor geografiese en kliniese diensplatforms. Ontwikkel en handhaaf kliniese standaarde, protokolle, en gehaltemetrieke wat met nasionale noodmediese diensriglyne ooreenstem. Verskaf kliniese kundigheid en leierskapinvoer vir strategiese beplanning en diensontwikkelingsinisiatiewe. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en kommunikasie: Fasiliteer effektiewe kommunikasie en samewerking tussen kliniese spanne, bestuur, en eksterne gesondheidsorgvennote. Verteenwoordig die organisasie in kliniese bestuursforums, gehalteverbeteringsnetwerke, en professionele ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe. Handhaaf verhoudings met regulerende liggame, gesondheidsorginstellings, en gemeenskapsbelanghebbendes om geïntegreerde noodsaaklike sorglewering te ondersteun. Berei voor en bied kliniese prestasieverslae, gehalteverbeteringsuitkomste, en strategiese aanbevelings aan senior bestuur voor.

zu.title: Umparamediki izinga 1 kuye ku-4 (I-EMS Continuous Quality
zu.summary: Isikhundla somparamediki izinga 1 kuye ku-4 ngaphakathi kwe-Western Cape Emergency Medical Services esigxile ekuthuthukisweni okuphuthumayo kokulingana nokuqondiswa kwezokwelapha ekunikezweni kwesibopho sezomoya ezimpilweni eziphuthumayo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezinguqculunqondo ezidingekayo: Grade 1: Ukuqedela ngempumelelo izinhlelo ze-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomparamediki. -Grade 2: Ukuqedela ngempumelelo ihlelo le-Critical Care Assistant noma i-Recognized National Diploma evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki. Grade 3: Ukuqedela ngempumelelo ihlelo le-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) noma i-Recognized National Diploma evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki noma i-B Tech Degree evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoba ngu-Emergency Care Practitioner. Grade 4: Ukuqedela ngempumelelo ihlelo le-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) noma i-Recognized National Diploma evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki noma i-B Tech Degree evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoba ngu-Emergency Care Practitioner. Ukubhalisa kunomkhandlu ogwemile: Grade 1: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki (CCA). Grade 2: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki nge-CCA noma i-National Diploma. Grade 3: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki nge-CCA noma i-National Diploma noma i-ECP. Grade 4: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki nge-CCA noma i-National Diploma noma i-ECP. Isiphephelo: Grade 1: Akukho okunye emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki (CCA). Grade 2: 7 years emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki (CCA). Akukho okunye emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki nge-National Diploma. Grade 3: Umparamediki obhalisiwe (CCA) - 14 years emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki. Umparamediki obhalisiwe (NDip) - 7 years emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki. I-ECP ebhalisiwe– Akukho okunye. Grade 4: Umparamediki obhalisiwe (CCA) - 24 years emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki. Umparamediki obhalisiwe (NDip) - 17 years emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomparamediki. Ama-ECP abhalisiwe-10 years emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njenge-ECP. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ulaka komzimba nengqondo. Ilayisensi yabadayizi ekhona ye-code C1. Isivumelwano esikhulu sabadayizi (PrDP) esikhona. Ikhono (ulwazi/izindlela): Ulwazi oluhle kumazinga onke amaphrotokholi ezokwelapha eziphuthumayo ngaphakathi kwesigaba sokubhalisa. Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana nabantu. Ukufunda nokubhala ngokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha namakhono.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekiswa kwelizinga lokwelapha Nokuphepha Kwesiguli: Buka ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ezibambekayo zokuthuthukisa izinga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunikezwa okuhlakaniphile kwesibopho sezomoya eziphuthumayo kusuka emgwaqweni kuye esibhedlela. Misag futhi ulondoloze izakhiwo ezigqamile zokuqondiswa kwezokwelapha, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokubika izehlakalo, ukuphathwa kwezehlakalo ezingemthetho, namaphrotokholi okuphepha kwesiguli. Qaphathazisa futhi uhlolisise ukusebenza kolwelapha uma kuqhathaniswa nezikhathi zokuvingca eziyisimiso nezinga lokulinga ezinkundleni zonke zezenkonzo. Hlanganisa ukuqoqwa okuhlelekile nokuhlaziya impendulo yamagiguli, izikhalazo, izibusiso, nemiphumela yokwelapha ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinkonzo. Ubunkunzi Bokwelapha Nentuthuko Yobuciko: Nikeza ubunkunzi bokwelapha obususunduwayo nokuqondisa abanikezi bezosizo lokwelapha eziphuthumayo ngaphandle kwezibhedlela emazingeni onke okunikezwa kwenkonzo. Sebenzisana namathambo anemikhakha eminingi ukuthuthukisa amaphrotokholi abekePILE ezokuswelapha, izindlela zosizo, nezinqubo ezilawula imisebenzi. Hlela futhi uncike izinhlelo zentuthuko eqhubekayo yobuciko, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqesha ukwelapha, ukuphucula amakhono, kanye nokuhlola ukufaneleka. Misela izinhlela zokuqapha izobuciko ukuze kusekelwe izinqumo zesikhathi sangempela futhi kugcinwe izinga lenkonzo yezobuciko. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Izinga: Hlela, setha, futhi uhlole izinhlelo ezihlose ukuthuthukisa izinga ezijwayelekile ezisuselwa kulwazi lwangoku, izindlela ezinhle kakhulu, nezidingo zendawo. Hlanganisa amaphulo okuthuthukisa izinga ahlangene nemikhakha ezosetshenziswa kukho ukwelapha, imisebenzi, nabaphathi bokuphathwa kwenkonzo. Misela izinhlelo zokuqapha ukusebenza eziqondiswa yidata ukuze kubheke imiphumela yokwelapha, izikhathi zokuvingca, nempumelelo yenkonzo. Buka izinqubo zokuhlaziwa yisizinda sehlakalo sokwelapha futhi uthuthukise izinhlelo zokuqondisa ukwenza okulungile ukuze kuthintelwe ukuphindwa kukacho. Ukuqondiswa Kokuhlangenwe Nako Ngokwesuqili: Gcina futhi ukhuthaze izimiso zosizo lwegiguli ezigxile kuyo kuyo yonke imisebenzi yosizo lomoya ophuthumayo. Qinisekisa ukuziphendula kwezidingo zomthetho, izinga lobuciko, kanye nemigomomthetho yesiphakamiso kulo lonke izinkambu zamagumbi nezenkonzo ezokwelapha. Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze izinga lokwelapha, amaphrotokholi, nabalawuli bokulinga ohambisana naphothokholi nosizo lomoya wezwe. Nikeza ulwazi lolwazi nobunkunzi ekubekweni izinhlaka ukuze kwethuthukiswe izinhlelo zemizamo nemigomomthetho yenkonzo. Ukuhlangenwe Nako Nabathintekayo Nokuxhumana: Yenza ukuxhumana nokusebenzisana okuyisigqo phakathi kwamathambo osizo lokwelapha, abaphathi, kanye nabalingani bangaphandle bezosizo ezempilo. Mela inhlangano emabhungeni okuqondiswa izokwelapha, kumajalidi wokuthuthukisa izinga, nasemizamweni yentuthuko yobuciko. Gcina ubudlelwano namadilinge okulawula, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nabathintekayo bomphakathi ukuze kusekelwe ukunikezwa kohlakaniphile kwesibopho sezomoya eziphuthumayo. Lungiselela futhi pwesenta imibiko yosizo lokwelapha okusebenza kahle, imiphumela yokuthuthukiswa kwesigqoko, nezinqumo zokusikisa esuqili kubankunzi abaphezulu.

xh.title: IParamedhiq inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-4 (i-EMS Continuous Quality
xh.summary: Isithuba seParamedhiq inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-4 kwisebe leWestern Cape Emergency Medical Services eligxile ekuphuculeni ngokuqhubekayo ubunganga nobulungisa bezempilo ekunikezweni konyango lweziganga.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezifunekayo ezincinci: Grade 1: Ukuphumelela kwinqanaba le-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq. Grade 2: Ukuphumelela kwinqanaba le-Critical Care Assistant okanye iDiploma yesiZwe ekuqaphelweyo ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq. Grade 3: Ukuphumelela kwinqanaba le-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) okanye iDiploma yesiZwe ekuqaphelweyo ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq okanye iziqu zeB Tech ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoPraktishanis wezonyango lweziganga. Grade 4: Ukuphumelela kwinqanaba le-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) okanye iDiploma yesiZwe ekuqaphelweyo ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq okanye iziqu zeB Tech ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoPraktishanis wezonyango lweziganga. Ukubhalisa kwiNkundla yabaphathi bemizi: Grade 1: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq (CCA). Grade 2: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq ngeCCA okanye iDiploma yesiZwe. Grade 3: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq ngeCCA okanye iDiploma yesiZwe okanye i-ECP. Grade 4: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq ngeCCA okanye iDiploma yesiZwe okanye i-ECP. Imfundo ngokubakho: Grade 1: Akukho emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq (CCA). Grade 2: Iminyaka eyi-7 emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq (CCA). Akukho emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq ngeDiploma yesiZwe. Grade 3: IParamedhiq ebhalisiweyo (CCA) - iminyaka eyi-14 emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq. IParamedhiq ebhalisiweyo (i-NDip) - iminyaka eyi-7 emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq. I-ECP ebhalisiweyo - akukho. Grade 4: IParamedhiq ebhalisiweyo (CCA) - iminyaka eyi-24 emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq. IParamedhiq ebhalisiweyo (i-NDip) - iminyaka eyi-17 emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoParamedhiq. AbaBhalisiweyo be-ECP - iminyaka eyi-10 emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-ECP. Iimfuno zendalo zomsebenzi: Ukuqina ngokomzimba nengqondo. ilayisenisi yomqhubi ekhethwe ngokusemthethweni ye-code C1. Ipermiti yomqhubi osebenzayo ngokusemthethweni (i-PrDP). Ukuziphatha (ulwazi/amehlo): Ulwazi oluhle ngamacebo onyango lweziganga onke amanqanaba ngaphakathi kwesigaba sokubhalisa. Amaxabiso aphilayo nokuchaneka ekunxibelelaneni nabantu. Ukuzazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha namakhono.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekiswa komgangatho konyango lwezempilo Nokhuseleko lwegazi: Ukuba ngumphathi ekuphuhliseni nokuqwalaselwa kweekhankula zokuphucula ubunganga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunikwa konyango olunesiganga esiphakamileyo noluhamba phambili ukusuka ehlangothini lwendlela ukuya ecaleni kobhedu. Ukuqamba zigama ezomeleleyo zobulungisa bezonyango, kuquka iinkqubo zokubika ngamaxa, ulawulo lweziganeko ezingezanga lzinto ezilungileyo, namacebo okhuseleko lwesiguli. Ukuqaphela nokuhlolwa komsebenzi wezonyango ngokuchasene nexesha elibekiweyo lokusabela kweziganga namanqanaba obunganga kuwo onke amanqanaba einkonzo. Ukuhlanganisa ukuqokelelwa ngokubakho nokwahlulwahlulwa kokuxoxwa ngesiguli, iingxelo, iindumiso, nangemiphumo yonyango ukuze kuqhutywe ngokuphuculwa kweenkonzo. uQhankqalazo lwezonyango Nakho Phuhliso lomsebenzi: Ukwethula iqhankqalazo lezonyango nokuqeqesha ukulawula abaniki bonyango baphandle kwekwikhliniki kuwo onke amanqanaba okunika iinkonzo. Ukusebenzisana nabantu abanengqondo ezininii ekuphuhlisweni kwamacebo onyango abakekelwe lulwazi, iindlela zonkezo nothango lokusebenza. Ukulungisa nokuncedisa iinkqubo zophuhliso ngokubakho kakhulu ezidibeneyo, kuquka ukuqeqeshwa ekunyameni, ukuphucula amandla, nokuhlola ukuziphatha. Ukumisa iinkqubo zolawulo lonyango ukuze zenzeke izigqibo ezibonwayo ngesikhathi esifanelekileyo nokugcina amanqanaba obukhulu ekusebenzeni konyango. Ulawulo lweenkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho: Ukulungisa, ukuqwalasela, nokuqinisekisa ukuphuculwa kokubakho okubakhe ngokusekwe kulwazi lwangoku, amaphakamiso ahamba phambili, neemfuno ezizodwa. Ukusebenzisana kwaba bedibano kwezonyango nokoqobo abadibano nabo ekwenziweni iiprojekthi zokuphucula ubunganga. Ukumisa iinkqubo ezisekelwe kumanani okuhlola ukusebenza ngokubakho ukuze kulandelwe imiphumo yonyango, ixesha lokusabela, nangokusetyenziswa kwenkonzo. Ukwenza uhlalutyo ngemveliswano yamaphupu amaphupu axhamla konyango nokudala amacebo okwenza into echanekile ukuze kungenwe ngaphakathi.

jobs.title: EMS Lecturer (PARAMEDIC) Grade 1 to 4
jobs.centre: Western Cape Government, College of Emergency Care
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R334 227 per annum Grade 2: R413 199 per annum Grade 3: R506 496 per annum Grade 4: R593 079 per annum
jobs.summary: EMS Lecturer (Paramedic) position at the College of Emergency Care, teaching health sciences programmes across NQF level 5 and above with clinical training duties.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Grade 1: Successful completion of the Critical Care Assistant (CCA) qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Paramedic. Grade 2: Successful completion of the Critical Care Assistant (CCA) qualification or a recognised National Diploma that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Paramedic. Grade 3: Successful completion of the Critical Care Assistant (CCA) qualification or a recognised National Diploma that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Paramedic or B-Tech degree that allows registration with the HPCSA as an Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Grade 4: Successful completion of the Critical Care Assistant (CCA) qualification or a recognised National Diploma that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Paramedic or B-Tech degree that allows registration with the HPCSA as an Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Registration with a professional council: Grade 1: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Paramedic (CCA). Grade 2: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Paramedic with CCA or NDIP. Grade 3: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Paramedic (CCA or NDIP) or ECP. Grade 4: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Paramedic (CCA or NDIP) or ECP. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic (CCA). Grade 2: 7 Years after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic (CCA). None after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic with a National Diploma. Grade 3: Registered Paramedic (CCA) - 14 years after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic. Registered Paramedic (NDIP) - 7 years after registration with the HPCSA as a Paramedic. None after registration with the HPCSA as an ECP. Grade 4: Registered Paramedic (CCA) - 24 years after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic. Registered Paramedic (NDIP) - 17 years after registration with the HPCSA as Paramedic. Registered ECP’s -10 years after registration with the HPCSA as an ECP. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid code B driver’s license. Physical and mental fitness. Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Medical Care (BEMC) or BTech EMC. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint. Ability to work under pressure in a stressful environment. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to provide mentorship and coaching. Ability to work within a team in Higher Education Institution.
jobs.duties: Provide effective and efficient teaching on NQF 5 and above health sciences programmes. Ensure Adherence to institutional policies and procedures. Perform front-line shifts with students and other clinical duties. Teach across clinical training programmes where required.
jobs.enquiries: Dr R Cermak Tel No: (021) 938-4116
jobs.applications: Applicants apply online: www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”)
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Izinga 4: I-Paramedic ebhalisile (CCA) - iminyaka eyi-24 ngemva kokubhalisa e-HPCSA njengo-Paramedic. I-Paramedic ebhalisile (NDIP) - iminyaka eyi-17 ngemva kokubbalisa e-HPCSA njengo-Paramedic. Grade 3: Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kwesidanga se-Critical Care Assistant (CCA) okanye i-National Diploma evunyiweyo evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengama-Paramedic okanye idigri ye-B-Tech evumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengo-Emergency Care Practitioner (ECP). Grade 4: I-Paramedic ebhalisiweyo (CCA) - Iya24 years emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengama-Paramedic. I-Paramedic ebhalisiweyo (NDIP) - Iya17 years emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengama-Paramedic. Amandla okusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo kwindawo ethileyo enoxinzelelo. Amandla aphezulu okuthetha nokuwuchaza ngelivi okubhalwayo. Amandla okunikela ngoncedo lolumo kunye noqeqesho. zu.title: Pharmacist Assistant (POST-BASIC) Grade 1 to 3
zu.summary: Amaphuzu amabili e-Pharmacist Assistant (post-basic, amagreyidi 1 kuya ku-3) e-Lady Michaelis CDC e-Atlantis, Western Cape, adinga ukubhalisa ku-SAPC.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi: Ngokwendlela esifunwa isikhungo sokolotshi kanye neSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) kanye nesebe lemfundo le-Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SAPC njenge-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) noma i-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) Institutional. Ukubhalisa kwisebe lezomthetho: Ukubhalisa ku-SAPC njenge-Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic) (Institutional) noma i-Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic). Isipiliyoni: I-Grade 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqanjwa igama ku-SAPC njenge-Pharmacist's Assistant (Post-Basic). I-Grade 2: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 yokuzibandakanya okufanele njenge-Pharmacist Assistant emva kokuqanjwa igama njenge-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) ku-SAPC. I-Grade 3: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-13 yokuzibandakanya okufanele njenge-Pharmacist Assistant emva kokuqanjwa igama njenge-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) ku-SAPC. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehamba phambili (Code B/EB). Ukuzithoba ukwenza imisebenzi evamile yasemuva kwamahora. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba phakathi kwamafasiliti e-PHC kwi-SWSS. Izindlwana zokusebenza (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kahle (i-MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook), i-JAC, i-Medsas. Ukuba nokuhlakanipha okuhle emsunweni nabantu kanye namakhono okuxoxa. Ikono lokusebenza njengelungu lesiqhaza noma ngabanye. Ikono lokusebenza ngokunembile ngaphansi kwegcino nokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha. Ukuba nakho ukuzivumelanisa ukuze ugwame ngokusimama endaweni yokusebenza eguqukayo.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi elandelayo ngaphansi kokulawula kwangasese nokuphathwa kwaphakade komthi wamakhemikhali: Ukusiza ekufundeni nasekulungiseni iresthripshini, ekukhethweni, ekusebenzeni noma ekwenzeni imithi, ukubhalwa kwaleybula nokuhlinzwa ngemithi esikitshaneni esifanele ngemuva kokuhumusha nokuhlola iresthripshini ngumthi wamakhemikhali. Ukusiza ekunikezeni imiyalo mayelana nokusetshenziswa okulungile kwemithi ehanjiwe nokunikeza ulwede abantu ukuthuthukisa impilo. Ukusiza ekusatshalalisweni, ekulawuleni naseku-odeni imithi nezinto ezihlelelwe isikhathi. Ukusiza ekwenzeni noma ekukhiqizeni imithi engenasidoda noma enasidoda noma into ehelelelwe isikhathi ngokusho kumafomula namasu okusebenza avunyiwe. Ukusiza emsebenzini wansuku zonke wokugcina indawo ihlanzekile nasezintweni ezibhalwe ngekhompyutha. Ukweseka izikhungo ekuphatheni nasekhuliseni ukufinyelela emithini yezifo ezingapheli kuwo wonke amamodeli ahlukene okunakekelwa njengokulethwa kwemithi yezifo ezingapheli emakhaya.

xh.title: Umncedi we-Tishala zamachiza (POST-BASIC) Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Amasithuba amababi omncedi wamachiza (post-basic, amanqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3) e-Lady Michaelis CDC e-Atlantis, e-Western Cape, afuna ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC.
xh.requirements: Izati yolwazi elincinci njengoko kufuneka: Njengoko kufunwa sisebe sokuqeqesha kunye ne-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) kananjalo ifakselo ye-Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant evumela ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengengenye yomncedi wamachiza (Post-Basic) okanye umncedi wamachiza (Post-Basic) weziko. Ukubhalisa kwikomiti yabaphathi: Ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wamachiza (Post Basic) (Institutional) okanye umncedi wamachiza (Post Basic). Imfundo yemirhabho: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nanye emva kokubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomncedi wamachiza (Post-Basic). Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka engu-5 ubuncinane yemfuno efanelekileyo njengomncedi wamachiza emva kokubhalisa njengomncedi wamachiza (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka engu-13 ubuncinane yemfuno efanelekileyo njengomncedi wamachiza emva kokubhalisa njengomncedi wamachiza (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Imfuno eqhelekileyo yesimo: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukuzimisela ukwenza imisebenzi ngeyure ezize ngokutshaqelekayo. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba phakathi kweziko ze-PHC ezise-SWSS. Amakhono (ulwazi/amandla): Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook), i-JAC, i-Medsas. Amandla amahle okuziphatha okunxibelelanayo nakuthetha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza njengenxalenye yeqela okanye ngokwakho. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo kwaye ugcine iwonga eliphezulu lobungcali. Ukuba nakho ukuzinza ukuze uzivumele ungene ngokukhululekileyo kwindawo ezitshintshayo zomsebenzi.
xh.duties: Yenza iinkonzo okanye izenzo ezilandelayo ngaphantsi kolawulo oluthe ngqo lwethutyana lomqambi wamachiza: Nceda ngokufunda nokulungiselela iresepthe, ukhetho, ukusingatha okanye ukuqamba kolwazi lwamachiza, ukubhalisa nokunikezwa kolwazi lwamachiza esityeni esifanelekileyo emva kokuchazwa nokuhlolwa kwangaphambili koresepthe ngumqambi wamachiza. Nceda ngokunika izikhokelo malunga nokuqhuba ngokuchanekileyo ukusetyenziswa kolwazi lwamachiza olunikiweyo nolwazi kubantu ukukhuthaza impilo. Nceda ngorhwebo, ulawulo nokuodola kolwazi lwamachiza ngezinto ezijidiswayo. Nceda ngokuqamba okanye ukwenza amachiza angenasiphephelo okanye anesiphephelo okanye isinto ezijidiswayo ngokwefomula nemigaqo yokuqhuba eyamkelekileyo. Nceda ngesimo sekhaya esiqhelekileyo kunye nemisebenzi yengqalaselwa. Xhasa iindawo ngokulawula nokwandisa ufikelelo kolwazi lwamachiza ashubileyo ngayo yonke iindlela ezingungqiyo zamakhonza umzimba, umzekelo ukuhamba kuye kunye nolwazi lwamachiza ashubileyo.

jobs.title: Artisan Production Grade a to C (ELECTRICAL)
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R253 341 per annum Grade B: R297 249 per annum Grade C: R345 342 per annum
jobs.summary: Artisan Production electrician at Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office servicing, repairing and installing electrical systems including CCTV, access control and power supplies.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate Trade Test Certificate. Experience: Grade A: No experience required. Grade B: At least 18 years appropriate/recognisable experience in the area after obtaining the relevant Trade Test Certificate. Grade C: At least 34 years appropriate/recognisable experience in the area after obtaining the relevant Trade Test Certificate. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid driver’s licence (Code B/EB) (Manual). Willingness to travel to perform maintenance duties throughout the Western Cape. Physically fit to perform duties. Work overtime should the need arise, day or night and perform standby duties and attend to emergency breakdowns (including after-hour repairs). Competencies (knowledge/skills): The ability to communicate eloquently. Occupational health and safety act 1993 and its relevant regulations and SANS 10142-1. Ability to fault-find and repairs down to component level.
jobs.duties: Service, repair and fault finding of Electrical Fence, CCTV, Access control and Fire detection. Service, repair and fault finding of various alternative power supplies (Generators/UPS/Inverters). Service, repair, fault finding and installation of various motors/pumps and motor control circuits. Compile and submit inspection reports as required on all electrical equipment stipulate on the preventative maintenance plan of the workshop to comply with SANS regulations. Give in service training to Handyman, Tradesmen Aid and Interns. Assist with the executing of all electrical projects.
jobs.enquiries: Mr S Khohli Tel No: (021) 370-1119
jobs.applications: Applicants apply online: www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”)
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. This post will be filled to the requirements of the approved Metro East Hub stationed at Lentegeur Psychiatric Hospital. Short-listed candidates might be subjected to a practical test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A tot C (ELEKTRIES)
af.summary: Ambagsman Produksie elektrisiën by Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Hoofkantoor wat elektriese stelsels insluitend CCTV, toegangsbeheer en kragbronne onderhou, herstel en installeer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike Handelsertifikaat. Ervaring: Graad A: Geen ervaring vereis nie. Graad B: Ten minste 18 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die veld ná verkryging van die tersaaklike Handelsertifikaat. Graad C: Ten minste 34 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die veld ná verkryging van die tersaaklike Handelsertifikaat. Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie (Kode B/EB) (Handrat). Bereidwilligheid om te reis om onderhoudspligte dwarsdeur die Western Cape uit te voer. Fisiek geskik om pligte uit te voer. Werk oortyd indien die behoefte ontstaan, dag of nag, en verrig bystandspligte en woon noodherstelwerk bye (insluitend buite-ure herstelwerk). Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Die vermoë om welsprekend te kommunikeer. Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid 1993 en die tersaaklike regulasies daarvan en SANS 10142-1. Vermoë om foute op te spoor en herstelwerk tot op komponentvlak te doen.
af.duties: Onderhoud, herstel en foutopsporing van elektriese heinings, CCTV, toegangsbeheer en brandopsporing. Onderhoud, herstel en foutopsporing van verskeie alternatiewe kragbronne (Generators/UPS/Inverters). Onderhoud, herstel, foutopsporing en installasie van verskeie motors/pompe en motorbeheerkringe. Stel inspeksieverslae op en dien dit in soos vereis op alle elektriese toerusting uiteengesit in die voorkomende onderhoudsplan van die werkswinkel om aan SANS-regulasies te voldoen. Gee indiensopleiding aan Handwerke, Ambagsmanne-assistente en Interns. Bystand verleen met die uitvoering van alle elektriese projekte.

zu.title: Izenzeli zokukhiqiza isibili izinga A kuye ku-C (KAGESIBHEKELWANO)
zu.summary: Izenzeli kagesibhekelwano zokukhiqiza esikhundleni esibhala seWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office, esizokukhonza, kulungise futhi safake izinhlelo zagesi okuhlanganisa i-CCTV, ukulawula ukungena kanye nezindawo zamandla kagesi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphansi kokudingekayo: Isitifiketi esifanele sokuhlola ubugesi. Isipiliyoni: Izinga A: Akukho isipiliyoni esidingekayo. Izinga B: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-18 yisipiliyoni esifanele/esiqashelekayo kuleso sikhundla ngemva kokuthola isitifiketi esihlobene sokuhlola ubugesi. Izinga C: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-34 yisipiliyoni esifanele/esiqashelekayo kuleso sikhundla ngemva kokuthola isitifiketi esihlobene sokuhlola ubugesi. Isidingo esingokwakheka komsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqasha evumelekile (Ikhodi B/EB) (Igesi ngesandla). Ukuqina ukuthanda ukuhamba ukuze wenze imisebenzi yokugcinwa kwayo yonke i-Western Cape. Ukuba nefisiki elinempilo ukuze ukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi. Ukusebenza ngemahora engeziwe uma kunesidingo, emini noma ebusuku, kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yokulinda kanye nokuphendela ekuqhekezeni okuphuthumayo (okuhlanganisa ukulungisa ngemva kwamahora asebenzayo). Ukuzwana komsebenzi (ulwazi/izikhali): Ikono lokuxhumana kakhulu. Umthetho wezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi ka-1993 kanye nemithetho eqondene nawo kanye ne-SANS 10142-1. Ikono lokuthola ithuba lokuhlakula nokulungisa ize kwezinga lezinhlayiyana.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola ukusebenza kagesi, ukulungisa nokuthola ithuba lokuhlakula kwesibhengezi kagesi, i-CCTV, ukulawula ukungena nokubona umlilo. Ukukhonza, ukulungisa nokuthola ithuba lokuhlakula kwezinye izindawo zamandla kagesi ezahlukene (Ama-Generatori/I-UPS/Abaguquli bamandla kagesi). Ukuhlola ukusebenza kagesi, ukulungisa, ukuthola ithuba lokuhlakula nokufaka izimota epompo/izipompo ezingahlukene kanye nezindikamabhasikidi zokulawula imoto. Ukuqamba futhi unikele umbhalo wolwazi njengoba kudingeka zonke izinto zokusebenza kagesi ezikhombiswe esikwaziweni sokulondolozwa kwendawo yokusebenza ukuze kuhambisane nemithetho ye-SANS. Nikela ikhono lokusebenza ku-Handyman, Tradesmen Aid kanye nabafundi abangashadile (Interns). Siza ekwenzeni wonke umsebenzi wezindaba zobugesi.

xh.title: Umenzi wezinto wenqanaba A ukuya kuC (ELECTRICAL)
xh.summary: Umenzi wezinto wedolophu eNtliko yesebe leWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness esebenzisa nasekulisweni, ekulungeniseni nakufakeni iinkqubo zombane eziquka i-CCTV, ulawulo lokungena kunye nezixhobo zamandla.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingunaphakade esincinci: Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo seVavayo lweTrade. Isiphiro: Inqanaba A: Akukho siphiro sifunekayo. Inqanaba B: Ubuncinane iinyanga ezili-18 zesiphiro esifanelekileyo/esiqondakalalayo kwindawo emva kokufumana iSatifikethi ehlobene neVavayo lweTrade. Inqanaba C: Ubuncinane iinyanga ezili-34 zesiphiro esifanelekileyo/esiqondakalalayo kwindawo emva kokufumana iSatifikethi ehlobene neVavayo lweTrade. Imfuno egqithiselayo yomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yomqeshi esemthethweni (iKhowudi B/EB) (Manual). Ukuzimisela ukuhamba ukuze uzenze imisebenzi yokonza kwiphakathi jikelele le-Western Cape. Ukuba namandla emzimbeni ukuze uzenze imisebenzi. Ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha xa kudingeka, emini ebusuku nokuzenza imisebenzi yokulinda kwaye uphendule iingxaki ezixhakabhakayo ezize ngokungalindelekanga (kuquka nokulungisa ngaphandle kweyure zomsebenzi). Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ikhono lokuthetha kakuhle. Umthetho wezempilo nokhuseleko kwangomsebenzi ka-1993 nolawulo lwalo oluhlobene kunye ne-SANS 10142-1. Ikhono lokufumana isiphene nokulungisa ida ngayisayensi yamacandelo.
xh.duties: Ukukonza, ukulungisa nokufumana isiphene kwe-Electrical Fence, i-CCTV, ulawulo lokungena nokubona umlilo. Ukukonza, ukulungisa nokufumana isiphene kwezixhobo ezahlukeneyo zamandla okutshintsho (i-Generators/UPS/Inverters). Ukukonza, ukulungisa, ukufumana isiphene nokufaka iimota/izityobo ezahlukeneyo kunye namasuntswana olawulo lweyota. Ukuqamba nokunikeza iingxelo zovavanyo njengoko kuyimfuno kwazo zonke izixhobo zombane ezichaziwe kwicebo logcino lwangaphambili lwesixhobo sangaphakathi ukuze kuhambelane nemigaqo ye-SANS. Ukunika inkululeko yokuqeqesha aba-Handyman, aba-Tradesmen Aid kunye nabantu abangaphakathi ekhaya. Ukuncedisa ekuphumezeni zonke iiprojekthi zombane.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Finance/admin
jobs.summary: Finance administration clerk at Vredendal Hospital handling payments, petty cash, debt management and financial reporting.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with Mathematics and/or Accounting as a passed subject and/or Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with experience/competencies that focuses on the Key Performance Areas of the post. Experience: Appropriate experience in Financial Management. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid Driver’s Licence (Code B/EB). Willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and practical experience of the LOGIS System. Sound knowledge of the Basic Accounting System (BAS) and all applicable government legislation. Computer literacy (MS, Excel and Word). Sound knowledge of PFMA, National and Provincial Treasury Instructions. Good communication skills.
jobs.duties: Payments and Journal Processing (Bas and Logis). Petty Cash Management and Supplier/Creditor bank details registration. Bas debt management and asset & Liabilities account clearance and management. Batch control and financial reporting. Support to supervisor and component.
jobs.enquiries: Mr B Landile Tel No: (027) 213-2039

It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Administrasieklerk: Finansies/admin
af.summary: Finansiële administrasieklerk by Vredendal Hospital wat betalings, kleinkontant, skuldbestuur en finansiële verslagdoening behartig.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde en/of Rekenkunde as 'n geslaagde vak en/of Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat op die Sleutelprestasieareas van die pos fokus. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Finansiële Bestuur. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Kode B/EB). Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en praktiese ervaring van die LOGIS-stelsel. Deeglike kennis van die Basiese Rekenkundige Stelsel (BAS) en alle toepaslike regeringswetgewing. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS, Excel en Word). Deeglike kennis van PFMA, Nasionale en Provinciale Tesourie-instruksies. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Betalings en joernaalverwerking (BAS en Logis). Kleinkontantbestuur en registrasie van verskaffer/skuldiger se bankbesonderhede. BAS-skuldbestuur en skikking en bestuur van bates- en lasterekenings. Lotkontrole en finansiële verslagdoening. Ondersteuning aan toesighouer en komponent.

zu.title: Clerk okuqondiswa Kuqondiswa: Izimali/admin
zu.summary: Clerk wokuphathwa kwezimali e-Vredendal Hospital ophatha izinkokhelo, imali ethile, ukuphathwa kwezikweletu nokubika ngezimali.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zokufunda ezingaphansi kwayo: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) ne-Mathematics futhi/noma i-Accounting njengenani elidlulile nezinye izindinganiso ezibalulekile zokusebenza. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele ePhathweni kwe-Financial Management. Izidingo ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: I-Driver's Licence (Code B/EB) evumelekile. Ukuza nangcono ukulalela ngemoto yokuhamba. Izindlela zokusebenza (ulwazi/amakhono ulwazi): Ulwazi nezinkomba zokusetyenziswa kwe-LOGIS System. Ulwazi olunzima ngesiBAS kanye nemithetho kahulumeni ephilayo. Ulwazi ngesi-CALS, National and Provincial Treasury Instructions. Amakhono okusebenza kahle komuntu komuntu.
zu.duties: Izinkokhelo kanye nokuphathwa kwe-Journal (Bas and Logis). Ukuphathwa kwe-Petty Cash kanye nokubhaliswa kolwazi lwebhange le-Supplier/Creditor. Ukuphathwa kwe-BAS debt kanye nesikhwama se-asset & Liabilities ukuphathwa kwezinkwenkwezane. I-Batch control kanye nokubika ngezimali. Ukusekela umphathi kanye nomsebenzi we-component.

xh.title: Umlozi Wolawulo: Iimali/olawulo
xh.summary: Umlozi wolawulo lweemali eVredendal Hospital uphehlele ngokuphathwa kweentlawulo, imali encinci, ulawulo lwezikrwele nokuvelisa iinkcazelo zeemali.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona mgangatho ongaphantsi: Isatifikethi esiphezulu (okanye esilinganayo) ngeMathematics nakanye i-Accounting njengesifundo esiphunyelelwe kwaye/nakanye Isatifikethi esiphezulu (okanye esilinganayo) nolwazi/amandla agxile kwimimandla eyiyo yemisebenzi yesithuba. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kulo Lawulo lweemali. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwalo msebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushova esemthethweni (iCode B/EB). Isazelo sokuhamba. Amando (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi namava okusebenza ngeNkqubo ye-LOGIS. Ulwazi olululo lweNkqubo yeBasical Accounting (BAS) nayo yonke imithetho kahulumeni ekufunekayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS, i-Excel neWord). Ulwazi olululo lwe-PFMA, nemiyalelo yeNational and Provincial Treasury. Izakhono ezilulo zokunxibelelana.
xh.duties: Ukuqhubwa kweentlawulo neenkcitho zeendatshuli (BAS nakaLogis). Ukuqwalaselwa kwemali encinci negquba kwaye kubhalwe iinkcukacha zebhanki zabenzi/babolekwa. Ulawulo lwezikrwele ze-BAS nokucofa i-akhawunti zezipho ezithintela kwaye kulawulwe. Ulawulo lweqela kwaye kwenziwe iinkcazelo zeemali. Inkxaso kumlawuli nakwicebo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Human Resource Management
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed at Radie Kotze Hospital in Bergriver to handle personnel and salary administration duties including appointments, leave, pensions and payslips.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in Human Resources that include Salary Administration, Service Conditions, Personnel Management, Pension Administration, PERSAL or Related salary administration system and Recruitment and Selection. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to travel and work overtime when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good verbal and written communication skills. Sound Knowledge of HRM Policies and Practices, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Collective Agreements regarding personnel- and salary administration. Computer literate (i.e. MS office package, e-mail and internet). Ability to meet deadlines and to maintain confidentiality.
jobs.duties: Perform all administrative duties pertaining to the personnel administration and salary administration functions e.g. appointments, service terminations, transfers, pension, leave, housing, injury on duty, distribution of monthly payslips and debt management and verify documents. Responsible for capturing transactions related to service terminations on PERSAL and audit personnel and leave records. Maintenance of effective recordkeeping systems and assist with registers related to PILIR, ORW’s etc. Assist with recruitment and selection processes any other related support functions. Provide an effective support service to supervisor, component and management (i.e. relief duties and attending meetings).
jobs.enquiries: Mr JR Smit Tel No: (022) 913-1246

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig by Radie Kotze Hospital in Bergriver om personeel- en salarisadministrasiepligte te hanteer, insluitend aanstellings, verlof, pensioene en salarystrokies.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronne wat Salarisadministrasie, Diensvoorwaardes, Personeelbestuur, Pensioenadministrasie, PERSAL of verwante salarisadministrasiesisteem en Werwing en Seleksie insluit. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om te reis en oortyd te werk wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Deeglike kennis van HRM-beleide en -praktyke, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Kollektiewe Ooreenkomste rakende personeel- en salarisadministrasie. Rekenaarbeeld (d.w.s. MS office-pakket, e-pos en internet). Vermoë om sperdatums te haal en vertroulikheid te handhaaf.
af.duties: Voer alle administratiewe pligte uit wat betrekking het op die personeeladministrasie- en salarisadministrasiefunksies bv. aanstellings, diensbeëindigings, oorplasings, pensioen, verlof, behuising, besering op diens, verspreiding van maandelikse salarystrokies en skuldbestuur en verifieer dokumente. Verantwoordelik vir die vaslegging van transaksies wat verband hou met diensbeëindigings op PERSAL en die oudit van personeel- en verlofrekords. Onderhoud van doeltreffende rekordhoudingstelsels en hulp met registers wat verband hou met PILIR, ORW's ens. Bystand met werwing- en seleksieprosesse en enige ander verwante ondersteuningsfunksies. Verskaf 'n doeltreffende ondersteuningsdiens aan toesighouer, komponent en bestuur (d.w.s. verligtingspligte en bywoning van vergaderings).

zu.title: Ikliki Yokabaluleka: Ukuphathwa Kwabasebenzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka ikliki yokuphathwa kabaluleke eRadie Kotze Hospital eBergriver ukuphatha imisebenzi yabantu nenyuso yokuhola okuhlanganisa ukumiswa kwabantu, ukushiya umsebenzi, imipeshanti nezeshedi zokuqhathanisa inhlengeleko.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi semfundo: Isitifikedi samabanga aphezulu (okuphambene nalesi). Isipilingo: Isipilingo esifanele kokuqashwa kwabantu okuhlanganisa ukulawula iholo, izimo zokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukulawula imipeshanti, i-PERSAL noma inkambiso ehlobene nenyuso yokuhola kanye nokuqasha nokukhetha. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: ukuzithobela ukuhamba nokusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi uma kudingeka. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhoni amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ulwazi oluhle ngemigomo nokwenziwa kokuqashwa kwabantu, umthetho wokusebenza kahulumeni, izimiso zokusebenza kahulumeni, izivumelano ngokuvumelana ngokuphathwa kwabantu nokulawula iholo. Ukubhala ngokuseluleki kwangaphakathi (okungaba msakazo we-MS, i-imeyili noma izwi lakho elingakhulumi). Ukukwazi ukuphumelela izikhathi nokuphatha izinto ezimfihlo.
zu.duties: Yenza yonke imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwabantu nokulawula imisebenzi yokuhola. ngokwesibonelo ukumiswa kwabantu, ukuphela kwesevisi, ukudluliselwa, imipeshanti, ukushiya, ukusingathwa kwezindlu, ukulimala esikhathini somsebenzi, ukusatshalaliswa kwezeshedi zenyanga zokuqhathanisa inhlengeleko nokuphathwa kwezikweletu futhi uhlole amadokhumenti. Uxibhele ekufakweni kwemikhiqizo engokuphela kwesevisi ku-PERSAL futhi uhlole ukugcinwa kwemikhiqizo yabantu nokuqophelwa lwa hhayi kuphela. Ukulondolozwa kwezindlela zokuqophelwa imikhiqizo ezisebenzayo kanye nokusiza ekubhalweni kwemikhiqizo ephathelene ne-PILIR, ORW, njll. Siza ekwenzeni imikhiqize yokukhethwa nokukhethwa kanye nanoma yimiphi eminye imikhiqizo ephathelene nokuqashwa. Nikeza inkonzo esekela ephathelene nomphathi wesikhathi, ongumuntu oyedwa kanye nomphathi wokuphathwa (okungaba ukuqashwa noma ukubhalwa kwezinsizakusebenza ekubhalweni kwezindlu).

xh.title: Clerk yolawulo: Lawulo Lebantu abasebenzayo
xh.summary: Kufuneka kude kwenziwe i-clerk yolawulo eRadie Kotze Hospital eBergriver ukuphatha imisebenzi yabantu bonke abasebenzayo nolawulo lomvuzo kuquka nokubekwa kwabantu emisebenzini, iiveki zokuphumla, imiholo namapayslips.
xh.requirements: Isifikiso sofundo esingenayo: Isatifikate samabanga aphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo). Isazizo: Isazizo esifanelekileyo kwabasebenzi abalawula abantu esiquka ulawulo lomvuzo, iimeko zesebenza, ulawulo lwabantu, ulawulo lwehhoso, i-PERSAL okanye inkqubo efana nolawulo lomvuzo nokukhethwa kwabantu. Iimfuno zendalo yomsebenzi: Ukulungele ukuhamba nokusebenza ngaphezu kwesixa esijisiweyo xa kuyimfuneko. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono amabalubuhlethu okubalisa ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo. Ulwazi oluqinisekileyo ngezikqubo nezenzo ze-HRM, umthetho wesebenza koluntu, iimthetho zolawulo koluntu, iinkqubomphakamisana ezimalunga nolawulo lwabantu nolawulo lomvuzo. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngekhompyutha (okt. i-MS office package, i-e-mail nayanetha). Ukuba nakho ukuhlangabezana nemigaqo yesixa kwaye ugcine izinto ezimfihlakeleyo.
xh.duties: Yenza wonke umsebenzi wolawulo othelekene nolawulo lwabantu nolawulo lomvuzo umzekelo ukubeka abantu emisebenzini, ukupheliswa kwesebenza, ukudluliswa kwabasebenzi, ihholo, iiveki zokuphumla, izindlu, ukuzingelwa emsebenzini, ukusasaza amapayslips nyanga zonke nolawulo lamatyala kwaye uqinisekise amaxwebhu. Uxanduva lokungenisa izinto ezithintwa kukupheliswa kwesebenza kwi-PERSAL nokuhlolo abantu namarekhodi eveki zokuphumla. Ukugcina iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zokulondoloza amarekhodi kwaye uncede kuma-registers athinta i-PILIR, i-ORW’s njl. Uncede nemiqubo yokukhethwa kwabantu naso nasiphi na isixhobo esixhobo sokuncedisa. Lisebenza elisebenzayo lokuxhasa umphathi, ulwande nolawulo (okt. imisebenzi yokulinganisa kwaye ukhubele iintshaxo).

zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingavunyelwe ukuba zingaphansi kwalezi: Isifundo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomncedisi wezokunakekelwa kokhuhpe obhalisiwe. Ukujikeleza kumanyango amanye. Izindlela zokusebenza (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi ngokwenza imisebenzi yezokunakekelwa kokhuhpe. Ukuvikela ukutheleleka, ukulawula izinyathelo kanye nokwenza imisebenzi. Ikhono lokuhlola izimpawu eziyisisekelo zezokwelapha ezibonakalayo nezimo ezingaphakathi kwesiguli. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha eliyisisekelo. Ikhono lokuphakamisa futhi uphendule iziguli, ukuma isikhathi eside nokuphakamisa izinto ezisindayo.
zu.duties: Ukuncedisa iziguli nemicimbe yokuphila nsuku zonke (ukunakekelwa komzimba). Ukunikela ngezokunakekelwa kokhuhpe eziyisisekelo. Ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo kwemithombo yezemali nangokomzimba. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi, amazinga okuziphatha kanye nokuziphumelela.
