xh.duties: Kuncede abagulayo ngemicimbi yokuphila yemihla le ( ukunakekelwa komzimba). Ukunika inakekelo elula yendalo yokuhlaza. Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo imithombo yomzimba nezimali. Ukugcina ukukhula komsebenzi, izimo ezisezinhlelweni zokuziphatha nokuziphilisa.

jobs.title: Sterilisation Operator Production (CSSD and GAS)
jobs.summary: Sterilisation operator at Groote Schuur Hospital responsible for decontaminating, packing and sterilising instruments while adhering to infection control standards.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std 7). Experience: Appropriate CSSD experience. Inherent requirements of the job: Work shifts including weekends, public holidays and night duty. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written). Good interpersonal relations skills. Ability to work in a co- operative way within a team context and willingness to be rotated within the CPD department. Basic understanding of disinfection, decontamination and sterilisation.
jobs.duties: Effective application of sterilisation processes and techniques and promote/adhere to infection control as well as health and safety regulations. Decontaminate, pack and sterilise instruments linen and supplies. Assist with cleaning and testing of sterilisation equipment, washing machine and autoclaves, lift-up and pushing heavy equipment. Maintain equipment in an optimum working condition and utilisation of resources. Use autoclaves, washing machines and equipment/consumables in a cost-effective manner. Monitor, control and maintain adequate stock levels, report, and assist with investigation of lost instruments/equipment.

af.title: Sterilisasie-operateur Produksie (CSSD en GAS)
af.summary: Sterilisasie-operateur by Groote Schuur Hospital verantwoordelik vir die dekontaminasie, verpakking en sterilisasie van instrumente terwyl aan infeksiebeheerstandaarde voldoen word.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std 7). Ervaring: Toepaslike CSSD-ervaring. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Werk skofte insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae en nagdiens. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om saamwerkend binne 'n spankonteks te werk en bereidwilligheid om binne die CPD-departement geroteer te word. Basiese begrip van ontsmetting, dekontaminasie en sterilisasie.
af.duties: Doeltreffende toepassing van sterilisasieprosesse en -tegnieke en bevordering van/voldoening aan infeksiebeheer asook gesondheids- en veiligheidsregulasies. Dekontamineer, verpak en steriliseer instrumente linnengoed en voorrade. Bystand verleen met skoonmaak en toetsing van sterilisasie-toerusting, wasmasjiene en outoklave, optel en stoot van swaar toerusting. Onderhou toerusting in 'n optimale werkende toestand en benutting van hulpbronne. Gebruik outoklave, wasmasjiene en toerusting/verbruikbare items op 'n kostedoeltreffende wyse. Monitor, beheer en onderhou voldoende voorraadvlakke, rapporteer en help met ondersoek na verlore instrumente/toerusting.

zu.title: Umuntu ophethe ukulungisa izinsimbi (CSSD neGAS)
zu.summary: Umlungi wezinsimbi eGroote Schuur Hospital onenza ngokuhlanza, ukupakisha nokulungisa izinsimbi ngenkathi ehlonipha izindinganiso zokulawula ukutheleleka.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezuncane zemfundo: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std 7). Isiphotho: Isiphotho esifanele se-CSSD. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo komsebenzi: Ukusebenza ngokushintshanisa amashifu okuhlanganisa amasonto, amaholide omphakathi kanye nesibopho sobusuku. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikhono lokuxhumana ngokusebenzayo (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Amakhono ahle okuxhumana nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokubambisana ngaphakathi kwethimba kanye nokuzithoba ukushintshwa ngaphakathi kwe-CPD department. ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngokuhlanzwa, ukuhsha nokulungiswa kwezinsimbi.
zu.duties: Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo inqubo nokwezobuciko bokulungiswa kwezinsimbi kanye nokukhuthaza/ukuhlonipha ukulawula ukutheleleka kanye nemithetho yokhatho nephephile. Hlanza, pakisha futhi ulungise izinsimbi, izikhiye nokunye okuhambisana naleyo. Siza ukushintsha nokuhlolwa kwezinsimbi zokuhlanzwa, umshini wokugeza nama-autoclave, ukuphakamisa nokushova izinsimbi ezindisiwe. Gcina izinsimbi zisebenza kahle ngokugcwele futhi usebenzise izinsiza. Sebenzisa ama-autoclave, imishini yokuzeba kanye nezinsimbi/okusetshenziswa ngendlela engagcwalisi imali. Qaphela, lawula futhi ugcine izinga elifanele lezinto ezikhona, biba, futhi usize ekuphenyweni kwezinsimbi/ezinsimbi ezilahlekile.

xh.title: Umvelisi Wolawulo Lokutshafa (i-CSSD ne-GAS)
xh.summary: Umlawuli wokutshafa kwiGroote Schuur Hospital onoxanduva lokuyihlamba, lokuyipakisha nokuqinisekisa ukutshafa izixhobo ngelixa ehambelana nemigangatho yolawulo kutyalwe imicrobe.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingowo Bottom obalulekileyo: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/Grade 9 (Std 7). Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo kwi-CSSD. Iimfuno ezisesandleni somsebenzi: Ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ishifu kuqukiwe iwekend, iintsuku ziholide zikarhulumente nolwangobusuku. Ukuzenzela (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokuziphatha kakuhle ngokuthetha (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Amakhono amabalawuni obuntu bomntu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwabelana ngaphakathi kothimba nokuzimisela ukujikelezwa ngaphakathi kwisebe le-CPD. Ukuqonda okuyimisebenzi ngokudisa, ukuhlamba izinto nokutshafa izinto.
xh.duties: Ukusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo iinkqubo zokutshafa nezicelo ukuxhasa/kuhambelana nolawulo kutyalwe imicrobe nendlela ezilungelelenza impilo yakho nawe uphile, noxanduva lokhuseleko. Ukuhlamba, ukupakisha nokutshafa izixhobo, izinto zokuhlamba kunye nezinto ezidityaniswayo. Ukuncedisa ekweni uyicoce aze uvavabe izixhobo zokutshafa, imatshini zokuhlamba izixhobo kwaye nayi-autoclave, kwaye uze uphakamise uze usonde izixhobo ezindindileyo. Ukugcina izixhobo ngeyonke imisebenzi yokwenza kakuhle nokusetyenziswa kwemithombo. Ukusetyenziswa kwe-autoclave, imatshini zokuhlamba izinto nezixhobo izinto/izinto ezisetiweyo ngendlela exabisekileyo. Ukuphapha, ukulawula kwaye ugcine amanqanaba amanzi ayesandi ekuqatsheni izinto, uchaze, uze uncedise ekuphandeni izixhobo eziphuthunywe.

af.requirements: Minimum vereiste: Basiese syfer- en geletterdheidsvaardighede. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n hospitale Voedselbedieningseenheid. Inherent vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte, naweke en openbare vakansiedae te werk. Vermoë om in grootskaalse vrieskaste en koelkamers te werk. Fisies sterk om swaar voorwerpe op te tel en die hele dag op hul voete te wees. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om in 'n groep te funksioneer en onder druk te werk. Berei babamelksformules en buisvoeding in die melk-kombuis voor. Skoonmaak en sterilisering van voedbekers en utensiele in die melk-kombuis. Volg en handhaaf higiëne- en veiligheidsriglyne, insluitend die gebruik van apparaat en toerusting, die was van erdeware en kookgereedskap. Bied bystand met die informele in-diens opleiding van nuwe werknemers. Woongeskryfde opleidingskursusse bywoon.

Izidingo ezingokwemvelo somsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngokushintsha izikhathi, ngeziyalomgqibelo, namaholide aphamile. Ikono lokusebenza kumafriji amakhulu nakamagumbi abanda. Ukuba ngenani elome ukuphakamisa izinto ezinzima nokuqhubeka umile lonke usuku. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikono lokusebenza phakathi kweqembu nangaphansi kokucindezela. Ikono lokulungisa ukudla ngokwemithetho ebekiwe yokupheka. Ulwazi ngeziHlelo Zokweluleka Zezinkonzo Zokudla ZweNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi ngokuhlanza okuyisisekelo nokulondolozwa kwezinsiza. Ikono lokufunda, ukukhuluma nokubhala ngokungenisa izilimi ezibusemi zesiNingizimu Afrika ezintathu kanti okungenzima ulimi olungenwa kuncane ukuthi kube ngu-OBAHALI abasha eyodwa noma ezimbili ngasinye sazi ezimbili ongaziphethe kubekhulu eqenjini elithile elisetshenziswa ekwelulekeni ezifundweni.
zu.duties: Lungisa, kabusha futhi ukhonze ukudla kwamasiko ejwayelekile nawayekhethekile. Siza ekutholeni, ekugcinweni, nasekolawulweni kwesitoko sezinsiza zokudla. Lungisa ubisi lwezinsana & ukudla okuphathwa ngomsephe esikhundleni sobisi. Ukuhlanza nokubulala amagciwane kwezinkomishi zokudla nezinsiza esikhundleni sobisi. Landela futhi ulondoloze imiyalo yokuhlanza nokuphepha, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza namapuledi, ukugeza izitsha nezinsiza zokupheka. Siza ngokuhleleka kokuqeqesha abasebenzi abasha ngesikhathi sokusebenza. Hlala ekhatsheni ukuzifundisa ekwelulekeni ezinsizeni ezikhangwa abafundi esikhundleni esethulwa kalula bese uye nakwezinye izikole zokufunda bedlula iqembu kusesikhathini izinto ngangokufundisa ithimba kusetshenziswa ongakathathwa ababambe phezulu eduze.

xh.title: Usenzo lwesebe lokunika ukutya
xh.summary: Usenzo lokuncedisa kwisebe lokunika ukutya kwi- Wesfleur Hospital, ukulungisa nokukhupha ukutya, ukulawula izinto zokutya, nokugcina amanqanaba okcoceka kwikhitshi.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Amandla okubala nokufunda okusemgangathweni osisiseko. Isipiliwo: Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo kwisebe lokunika ukutya esibhedlele. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukulungelelana ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ishedyuli, ngeekweekend, nangemihla yeholide. Amandla okusebenza kumagumbi amakhulu efrizi nakwindawo ebandayo. Ukomelela ngokomzimba ukuphakamisa izinto ezinzima nokuqhwesha ixesha lonke yonke imihla. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kwelqela nangaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amandla okulungisa ukutya ngokweenkqubo ezilawulwayo zokulungisa. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yaseBurm ekunika ukutya. Ulwazi ngokucoca nokugcina ipelelayo ekuqhelekileyo zempahla. Amandla okufunda, okuthetha nokubhala nolwimi olungenaphantsi kwezintathu kwezimbini ezisemthethweni zesiNtshona Koloni.
xh.duties: Lungisa, yaza kwaye unike ukutya okukulawulo loqobo nol olutsha. Ncedisa kwesityu okufumana ipelelayo yokutya, ulondolazo nol lawulwe ukutya. Lungisa ukutya okutsha olwenze ngalo abantwana noku ngokubamba ubumba emiyezweni yamasi, emthini wamasi yokwenza ukutya. Ukuqgumsha nokucoca inkonzo yamasi, izitya noku setyenziswa emthini wamasi. Landela nolondoloze imiyalelo engcolileyo noku qinisekisa indalo, ngesetyenziswa sovimba wolwazi, nokucoca izitya zoku pheka ukutya. Nceda inkonzo ekuqeqeseni kalolu hlobo olungalunganga abasebenzi abatsha. Makha zi zifundo zeza sifundo eziyimfuneko.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R671 per hour Grade 2: R766 per hour Grade 3: R887 per hour
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology sought for George Regional Hospital, providing clinical ENT care including surgery and emergency management.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in Otorhinolaryngology. Inherent requirement of the job: It will be expected of the successful candidate to comply with the governance processes of the department of health. A valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license and a willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good work etiquette; excellent communication skills; conflict management; cost conscious care provision. Manage own theatre lists and provide clear guidance on outpatient bookings. Good technology and computer skills; problem-solving experience; leadership and mentoring experience. Performance of audits, research and publications. Experience in teaching, conducting and supervising research. Proven knowledge of public health policies, guidelines and related prescript to manage resources effectively.
jobs.duties: Provision of definitive clinical Otorhinolaryngology care within the scope of a regional hospital service, including assessment, management, elective surgery, ongoing care, emergency care, and appropriate referral of complex cases in accordance with established referral pathways to tertiary facilities. Delivery of high-quality, patient-centred Otorhinolaryngology services, ensuring efficient management of patient workload while maintaining clinical standards, patient safety, and service satisfaction. Support and supervision of junior medical staff in the assessment, diagnosis, and management of Otorhinolaryngology conditions, including bedside and procedural guidance within the clinical environment. Commitment to structured teaching and training of junior doctors, interns, and other healthcare professionals through informal bedside teaching, as well as formal academic activities such as lectures, tutorials, and case discussions. Render an efficient, cost-effective high quality clinical service to patients managed by the hospital and district as the Rural East Ecosystem, by balancing throughput with quality. Active participation in departmental training programmes, continuing medical education (CME) activities, workshops, and professional development forums relevant to Otorhinolaryngology and district/regional service delivery. Involvement in clinical audits, quality assurance processes, and service improvement initiatives to strengthen Otorhinolaryngology service delivery within the district and regional health system. Participation in data collection, clinical data management, and reporting of service statistics to support governance, monitoring, and planning of Otorhinolaryngology services. Support clinical governance and administrative functions within the Otorhinolaryngology service, including medico-legal documentation, reporting requirements, staff- related administration, and compliance with departmental policies and protocols. Active participation in the development and maintenance of clinical guidelines, protocols, and referral systems to ensure safe and effective Otorhinolaryngology service delivery within a regional hospital platform. Strong ethical standards and sound clinical judgement, with appropriate counselling skills for patients and families. Strong leadership, communication, interpersonal, teamwork, and organisational skills suitable for a multidisciplinary regional hospital environment.
jobs.enquiries: Prof L Jenkins Tel No: (083) 795-1065
jobs.applications: Applicants apply online: www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”)
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates are subjects to a practical test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Otorinolaringologie gesoek vir George Regional Hospital, wat kliniese ENT-sorg verskaf insluitend chirurgie en noodbestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Otorinolaringologie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Otorinolaringologie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Otorinolaringologie nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Otorinolaringologie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Otorinolaringologie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Dit sal van die suksesvolle kandidaat verwag word om aan die borgingsprosesse van die department of health te voldoen. 'n Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie en 'n bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie werketiket; uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede; konflikbestuur; kostebewuste sorgverskaffing. Bestuur eie teaterlyste en verskaf duidelike leiding ten opsigte van buitepasiëntbesprekings. Goeie tegnologie- en rekenaarvaardighede; probleemoplossingservaring; leierskap- en begeleidingservaring. Uitvoering van oudits, navorsing en publikasies. Ervaring in onderrig, uitvoering en toesig van navorsing. Bewese kennis van openbare gesondheidsbeleid, riglyne en verwante voorskrifte om hulpbronne doeltreffend te bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaffing van definitiewe kliniese Otorinolaringologie-sorg binne die bestek van 'n streekhospitaaldiens, insluitend assessering, bestuur, elektiewe chirurgie, deurlopende sorg, nood sorg, en toepaslike verwysing van komplekse gevalle in ooreenstemming met gevestigde verwysingsroetes na tersiêre fasiliteite. Lewering van hoë gehalte, pasiëntgesentrede Otorinolaringologie-dienste, wat doeltreffende bestuur van pasiëntwerklast verseker terwyl kliniese standaarde, pasiëntveiligheid en dienstetevredenheid gehandhaaf word. Ondersteuning en toesig van junior mediese personeel in die assessering, diagnose en bestuur van Otorinolaringologie-toestande, insluitend bedkant- en prosedurale leiding binne die kliniese omgewing. Toewyding aan gestruktureerde onderrig en opleiding van junior dokters, internes en ander gesondheidsorgprofessionele deur informele bedkantonderrig, sowel as formele akademiese aktiwiteite soos lesings, tutoriale en gevalbesprekings. Lewer 'n doeltreffende, koste-doeltreffende hoë gehalte kliniese diens aan pasiënte wat deur die hospitaal en distrik as die Rural East-ekosisteem bestuur word, deur deurset met gehalte te balanseer. Aktiewe deelname aan departementele opleidingsprogramme, voortgesette mediese opvoeding (CME)-aktiwiteite, werkswinkels en professionele ontwikkelingsforums wat relevant is tot Otorinolaringologie en distriks-/streeksdienslewering. Betrokkenheid by kliniese oudits, gehaltemborgingsprosesse en diensverbeteringsinisiatiewe om Otorinolaringologie-dienslewering binne die distriks- en streekgesondheidstelsel te versterk. Deelname aan data-insameling, kliniese databestuur en verslagdoening van diensstatistieke om borging, monitering en beplanning van Otorinolaringologie-dienste te ondersteun. Ondersteun kliniese borging en administratiewe funksies binne die Otorinolaringologie-diens, insluitend medies-regtelike dokumentasie, verslagdoeningsvereistes, personeelverwante administrasie en voldoening aan departementele beleide en protokolle. Aktiewe deelname aan die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van kliniese riglyne, protokolle en verwysingstelsels om veilige en doeltreffende Otorinolaringologie-dienslewering binne 'n streekhospitaalplatform te verseker. Sterk etiese standaarde en gesonde kliniese oordeel, met toepaslike beradingsvaardighede vir pasiënte en gesinne. Sterk leierskap, kommunikasie, interpersoonlike, spanwerk en organisatoriese vaardighede wat geskik is vir 'n multidissiplinêre streekhospitaalomgewing.

zu.title: Iziqu Zezokwelapha Ezinga 1 kuya ku-3 (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
zu.summary: Kufunwa Iziqu Zezokwelapha kwi-Otorhinolaryngology e-George Regional Hospital, ukunikeza ukwelashwa kwe-ENT kwezokwelapha okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa ngokusoka kanye nobuphathi bezimo ezibuthaka.
zu.requirements: Izindingo ezingaphansi zemfundo: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njeng Iziqu Zezokwelapha kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Ukubhalisa emkhakheni weziqu eyingcweti: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njeng Iziqu Zezokwelapha kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Isipiliyoni: Inqanaba 1: Akukho sipiliyoni emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njeng Iziqu Zezokwelapha kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Inqanaba 2: Okungenani unyaka oluthatha isipiliyoni esifanele njeng Iziqu Zezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma ku-foreign Health Professional Council evunyiwe mayelana neziguli ezikulelizwe) njeng Iziqu Zezokwelapha kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Inqanaba 3: Okungenani unyaka oluthatha isipiliyoni esifanele njeng Iziqu Zezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma ku-foreign Health Professional Council evunyiwe mayelana neziguli ezikulelizwe) njeng Iziqu Zezokwelapha kwi-Otorhinolaryngology. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Kulindeleke ukuthi ompumelelayo ahambisane namaprosesi okubusa e-umnyango wezempilo. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esemthethweni nokuthanda ukuhamba. Amandla (ulwazi/iziqu): Ukuziphatha kahle emsebenzini; amandla okuxhumana abalulekile; ukuphatha izinkinga; ukunikeza ukwelashwa ngokugqamisa izindleko. Ukuphatha ohlwelwakho lwezokusoka futhi unikeze imiyalelo ecacile ngokubhuka iziguli ezibuyayo. Amandla amahle kakhulu kwiteknoloji nakumakhompyutha; isipiliyoni sosuxazuzululi; isipiliyoni sokubusa nokukhulekela. Ukuqhuba okuhloliswayo, ucwaningo lokushicilela. Isipiliyoni ekufundiseni, ukuqamba futhi ulawule ucwaningo. Ulwazi olususelwayo kumapholisi ezenzulimo, imiqaphela futhi imithetho exhulumene nalawo ukuphatha izinsiza ngempumelelo.
zu.duties: Ukunikezwa kokwelashwa ngokusuka kwe-Otorhinolaryngology ngaphakathi kwebizo lesikhungo sesibhedlela seningizimu nakhuvala, okuhlanganisa ukuqashwa, ukubuqhulula, ukusokwa ngokuzikhethela, ukwelashwa okuqhubekayo, ukwelashwa kwezibhaxo, nokuhola kwangendlela ezifanele ezimo ezinzima ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokuhola ezibekiwe e-National Referral eze-Trizone. Ukunikela ngezinkonzo ze-Otorhinolaryngology ezingeni eliphezulu, ezibheke kweziguli, kuqinisekiswe ukulawula ngokugqamisa imali yomthwalo weziguli kuyilawudla izindingo ze klinika, indlu yokusebenza komuntu, nezinga lokwaneliseka kwesevisi. Ukusekela nokukhulekela abasebenzi bezokwelapha abasezinqabeni ekwaphumeni, ukwelashwa, nokuqashwa kwesimo se-Otorhinolaryngology, okuhlanganisa ukukhulekela ngomumatha kwemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwendawo yokusebenza yokwelashwa. Ukuzinika isandla ekufundiseni emagqabaneni nokuqeqesha okucashile abafundi beshashalazi, namanye ochwepheshe bezempilo ngokufundisa ngemibhede ngokungacashile, kanye namanqanabe abhala amakhosi okufundela njengeminikhonzo, iminyakazo yokufunda, nezinkulumo-mphendulano zezimo. Ukuhlinzwa kokubonakala ngezinkonzo ze-Otorhinolaryngology ebalulekile ngokugqamisa imali kweziguli ezilawulwa isibhedlela kanye nendawo njengendawo ezungezileyo iRural East Ecosystem, ngokulinganisa inqanabe nobungako. Ukuthathwa inqxaxhebi kumanqanabe wobulungu bokuqeqesha umnyango, imikhankaso yokuqeqeshwa ngokuqhubeka (CME), izikhungo zokushintsha izinkalo, nama-forum okuqeqeshwa ngokungqongqo ahlobene ne-Otorhinolaryngology kanye nokunikwa kwesevisi sendawo. Ukuqhathaniswa emazweni abalulekile abhangele imikhankaso yesevisi, imikhuba yokuzibophezela kwesimo, nemikhankaso yokuthuthukiswa ibhalwe ukuligqamisa inqanabe lokunikwa kwe-Otorhinolaryngology emaphandle. Ukubamba iqhaza ekulondolozweni idatha yokusuka kweklinika, ukulawulwa kwedatha yokwelashwa, nokubika izibalo zesevisi ukusekela ukubusa, ukulawula nokuhlela iinkonzo ze-Otorhinolaryngology. Ukusekela ukubusa ngokwelashwa kanye nemisebenzi yohlelo lukahulumdeba ngaphakathi kwesevisi ye-Otorhinolaryngology, okuhlanganisa imibhalo yezomthetho-mphathwa wesibhedlela, izidingo zokubika, ukulawulwa kuka mlundi bomsebenzi, nokuvumelana nemigibe namaphrotokholi omyango. Ukuthathwa inqxaxhebi kokuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwemigibe yokwelashwa, amaphrotokholi, nezindlela zokucazula ngokuhola ukuqinisekisa ukunikezwa kwe-Otorhinolaryngology ngokuphephile nangempumelelo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela saseningizimu. Amazinga amahle kakhulu wezimilo ngokomthetho nesipiliyoni esihle sokwelashwa, ngamandla okukhulumisana kahle neziguli nemindeni. Amandla amakhulu sokubusa, ukuxhumanisa, okomuntu ngamunye, ukusebenza ngamakhosana, futhi uhlelo lwemisebenzi luhle kakhulu esimweni sesibhedlela seningizimu esihlanganisa iziqu ezingaphandle.

xh.title: Isebe lezonyanga Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (OTORHINOLARYNGOLOGY)
xh.summary: Kufunwa iMedical Specialist kwiOtorhinolaryngology kwiGeorge Regional Hospital, ebonelela ngelongentlondo yamayeza e-ENT ekuqala kunye nokusingathwa kweenohamba ehlanganisela nokwenza inyanga kunye nolawulo lweenohamba eziphuthumayo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingangatshiswa: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukuqeshwa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesebe lezonyanga kwiOtorhinolaryngology. Ukuqeshwa kwikomiti yamabango: Ukuqeshwa kwiHPCSA njengesebe lezonyanga kwiOtorhinolaryngology. Uqeqesho: Grade 1: Akukho nto emva kokuqeshwa kwiHPCSA njengesebe lezonyanga kwiOtorhinolaryngology. Grade 2: Okungenani 5 years uqeqesho olufanelekileyo njengesebe lezonyanga emva kokuqeshwa kwiHPCSA (okanye iHealth Professional Council yamanye amazwe ekuqatshelwa ngenxa yabasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe) njengesebe lezonyanga kwiOtorhinolaryngology. Grade 3: Okungenani 10 years uqeqesho olufanelekileyo njengesebe lezonyanga emva kokuqeshwa kwiHPCSA (okanye iHealth Professional Council yamanye amazwe ekuqatshelwa ngenxa yabasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe) njengesebe lezonyanga kwiOtorhinolaryngology. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Kuya kulindeleka kumqeshiweyo ukuba ahambelane neenqubo zolawulo zesebe lezonyanga. Ilayisense yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo nolwelo lokuhamba. Amaphepha ezenzo (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuziphatha okuhle emsebenzini; amakhono olwaziso olugqilileyo; ulawulo lweengxabano; ukubonelela ngenkathalo ngeexabiso. Ukuze ulawule uluhlu lwakhe lwasebuhlwini aze anike izikhokelo ezicacileyo ngokuqeshwa kwabafundi abavela. Amakhono obuchwepheshe kunye namakhono ekhompyutha amahle; uqeqesho lokusombulula iingxaki; uqeqesho kukhokelo nakusetyenziswa kolwazi. Ukwenza ukuhlola, uphando nokushicilela. Uqeqesho ekufundiseni, ekwenzeni nakulawulweni uphando. Ulwazi oluchangiweyo ngeenkqubo zamaziko ezingatshayiyo, iinkqubo ezilawula, namagunya alawula oovimba abanako ukubakho, ukuze kuqatshelwe oovimba abangathembekanga.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngelongentlondo lokuhola oluqinisekileyo kwiOtorhinolaryngology ngaphakathi kwemida yesebe lezonyanga lendawo, ehlanganisela ukuyalelwa, ukusingathwa, inyanga ngamadanga amakhethwa kukho, ukunyanga ngokuqhubelekayo, ukunyanga ngeenguqulelo eziphuthumayo, nokuthumela abantu abagula baya kwezinye iindawo zokuqinisekiswa ukuhamba njengoko kumiselwe iindlela ezisisiseko zokubonelela ii-arhente zendlu. Ukubonelela ngenkonzo kaNdokthela ye-otorhinolaryngology ekhokela kalula, ebonelelwa ngendotho yemveliso kugula ixesha elide, igcwalise amagunya amaninzi yokubonelela ngexesha elifanelekileyo lokuqalisa ukulungelelanisa izigulo ezikwindalo ekukhethwa. Ukuxhasa nokubeka bucala abasebenzi abangenamava balo mmandla ekuqwalaselweni, ukuvakalelwa nokuthunyelwa kolwazi ekubeniwe ngokuthumela ngobulemva ngobukhosi bokwakhiwa kwindlu evunyelwe ukuphila kwelinye ilizwe elinye. Ngenjabulo ngokuzinikela nokusetyenziswa kolwazi lwezobugcisa ekudiniweni kweekholeji ngezikhundla ekubeniwe ngaphantsi kokumiselwa kolwazi lwazobugcisa nemisebenzi yeenkundla zokudidiyela ngeenkalo ezizezicwangciso ngokufundisa izifundo ezingangenwa nkqubo namagunya eendawo abonelelwa kumazinga ambalwa alawula eentshabeni.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (SESSIONAL) (UROLOGY) (2
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R671 per hour Grade 3: R766 per hour Grade 3: R887 per hour
jobs.summary: Sessional medical specialist in urology (Grade 1 to 3) at Groote Schuur Hospital providing operative and outpatient services across related Western Cape hospitals.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Specialist in Urology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Urology. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Urology. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Urology. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA (Or as recognised foreign Health Professional council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Urology. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Experience in Adult and Paediatric Urology, renal transplantation, laparoscopic surgery, trauma, endourological and oncological surgery. Ability to perform urologic surgery at a tertiary level. Research experience in Urology.
jobs.duties: To provide services (operative and OPD consulting) at Eerste River and Western Cape Rehabilitation Hospitals. The management of specialist urological patients within the Division of Urology and at related hospitals to Groote Schuur Hospital. Supervision and performance of major Urology surgery, Laparoscopic surgery, laparoscopic surgery, trauma, endourological and oncological surgery. Oversee day surgery, surgical clinics and surgical emergencies. Organise and contribute to the surgical skills training courses. Contribute to the under and post grad training and research agenda of the Division.
jobs.enquiries: Ms P George Tel No: (021) 404 6105 or email: paige.george@uct.ac.za
jobs.applications: Applicants apply online: www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”)
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). Please ensure that you attach an updated CV. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (SESSIONEEL) (UROLOGIE) (2
af.summary: Sessionele mediese spesialis in urologie (Graad 1 tot 3) by Groote Schuur Hospital wat operatiewe en buitepasientdienste oor verwante Western Cape hospitale lewer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Spesialis in Urologie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Urologie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Urologie nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA (of erkennde buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Urologie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA (of as erkennde buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Urologie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Ervaring in Volwasse en Pediatrise Urologie, nieroorplanting, laparoskopiese chirurgie, trauma, endourologiese en onkologiese chirurgie. Vermoë om urologiese chirurgie op 'n tersiêre vlak uit te voer. Navorsingservaring in Urologie.
af.duties: Om dienste (operatief en buitepasientkonsultasies) by Eerste River en Western Cape Rehabilitation Hospitals te lewer. Die bestuur van spesialis-urologiese pasiënte binne die Afdeling Urologie en by verwante hospitale tot Groote Schuur Hospital. Toesig oor en uitvoering van hoof-urologie-chirurgie, laparoskopiese chirurgie, laparoskopiese chirurgie, trauma, endourologiese en onkologiese chirurgie. Toesig hou oor dagchirurgie, chirurgieke klinieke en chirurgiese noodgevalle. Reël en bydra tot die chirurgiese vaardigheidsopleidingskursusse. Bydra tot die voor- en nagraadse opleiding en navorsingsagenda van die Afdeling.

zu.title: Isikhulumi Sezokwelapha Sezinga 1 kuye Ku-3 (SESSIONAL) (UROLOGY) (2
zu.summary: Isikhulumi sezokwelapha kwanguqu ekufutheni (Izinga 1 kuye ku-3) e-Groote Schuur Hospital esinika izinsizakalo zokuhlinzwa nangaphandle kwezibhedlela eziyizindawana e-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemininingwane yemfundo: Ithuluzi elifanele elifuna ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengewitnessi Wezokwelapha kwi-Urology. Ukubhaliswa kwesikhwameni: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengewitnessi Wezokwelapha kwi-Urology. Isipiliyoni: izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengewitnessi Wezokwelapha kwi-Urology. izinga 2: Okuncane iminyaka engu-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (noma kwesikhulu esihloniphekile sabaphathi bezokwelapha ngaphandle komhlaba maqondana nomsebenzi ongumakadebona obhaliswe ngaphandle) njengewitnessi Wezokwelapha kwi-Urology. izinga 3: Okuncane iminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (noma njengoba kuhlonishwa isikhulu sabaphathi bezokwelapha ngaphandle komhlaba maqondana nomakadebona obhaliswe ngaphandle) njengewitnessi Wezokwelapha kwi-Urology. Izakhono (ulwazi/amasu): Isipiliyoni kwi-Urology yabadala nabaningwana, ukufakelwa inso, ukuhlinzwa nge-laparoscopic, izilimali, ukuhlinzwa kwe-endourological nangomdlavuza. Ikono lokwenza ukuhlinzwa kwe-Urology kwazinga eliphezulu. Isipiliyoni sophando kwi-Urology.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsizakalo (okuhilela ukusebenza kanye nokubonisana namazinga aphansi) e-Eerste River nakwa-Western Cape Rehabilitation Hospitals. Ukuphathwa kwabaguli ababalulekile bokufutha ngaphakathi kwe-Division of Urology nakwizibhedlela ezihlobene ne-Groote Schuur Hospital. Ukulawula nokwenza imisebenzi emikhulu yokufutha, ukwelapha ngokuhlinzwa ngendlela ye-laparoscopic, ukuphathwa kwezilimali, kanye nokuhlinzwa kwe-endourological nangomdlavuza. Ukuqapha ukuhlinzwa kwosuku, amakliniki wokuhlinzwa kanye nezimo eziphuthumayo zokuhlinzwa. Ukuhlela futhi ungene ngomnikelo emiklweni yokololonga amakhono wokuhlinzwa. Ukwenelela emkakheni wokuqeqesha abafundi abangaphansi nangaphezulu kanye nophando lwe-Division.

xh.title: Isigwebo sezembali sokwelapha Isikhululo 1 ukuya kwi-3 (SESSIONAL) (UROLOGY) (2
xh.summary: Isigwebo sezembali sokwelapha kwisebe le-urology (Isikhululo 1 ukuya kwi-3) eGroote Schuur Hospital esinika iinkonzo zokusebenza nasezikhulweni zokhuseleko kumazwe apho kuthethwa ngawo eWestern Cape.
xh.requirements: Iminikelo yemfundo engaphantsi kweyure: Inqobo ekufuneka ivumele ukubhalisa kwiBhunga lezeMisebenzi zeMfundo eZempilo eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengesigwebo sezembali kwisebe le-urology. Ukubhalisa kwabasebenzi bembuliso: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesigwebo sezembali kwisebe le-urology. Iminikelo yemfundo engaphezulu kweyure: Isikhululo 1: Akukho nto kuyo nayiphi na emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesigwebo sezembali kwisebe le-urology. Isikhululo 2: Iminikelo yemfundo engaphezulu kweyure ye-5 yemisebenzi emfanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye iBhunga lezeMisebenzi zeMfundo eZempilo eliqondo elinguqulo kwabasebenzi abavela ngaphandle) njengesigwebo sezembali kwisebe le-urology. Isikhululo 3: Iminikelo yemfundo engaphezulu kweyure ye-10 yemisebenzi emfanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye njengesigwebo sezembali esiqondo ngokwesiBhunga sezeMisebenzi zeMfundo eZempilo elingamagwebo angaphandle) njengesigwebo sezembali kwisebe le-urology. Iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi kwisebe le-urology kubantu abadala nabanabantwana, ukutshintshwa kwezintso, ukwenziwa kwezilo ngeendlela ezahlukahlukeneyo, iindaba zokulimala, ukwenziwa kwezilo ngeendlela ezahlukahlukeneyo kwisebe le-urology naseziloni ezihamba ngesiphithiphithi. Ulwazi lokwenza izilo zokuhlinza kwisikhululo se-urology. Ulwazi lolwazi lokwenza izilo ngesiphithiphithi kwisebe le-urology.
xh.duties: Ukunikela ngemisebenzi yokuhlinza nokubonelela ngemisebenzi yabasemakhaya kumazwe amaninzi eWestern Cape Rehabilitation Hospitals. Ukulawula abasemakhaya abangenisa imisebenzi kwisebe le-urology nakumazwe amaninzi ahambelanayo eGroote Schuur Hospital. Ukulawula nokwenza imisebenzi yokuhlinza kwisebe le-urology, ukwenziwa kwezilo ngeendlela ezahlukahlukeneyo, ukwenziwa kwezilo ngeendlela ezahlukahlukeneyo, ukulimala kwezinto ezihamba, ukuhlinza ngeendlela ezahlukahlukeneyo kwisebe le-urology naseziloni ezihamba ngesiphithiphithi. Ukulawula imisebenzi yokuhlinza kwemihla yonke, iikhiliniki zokuhlinza nokuza kubakho isiphithiphithi sokuhlinza. Ukulungisa nokwenza imisebenzi yokuqeqesha abantu abakwaziyo ukwenza izilo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuqeqesha abafundi abangenayo nabanamaphakama kwaye nenkqubo yophando kwisebe le-urology.
